/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: If we don't capture this officer now, we may never find out what they know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 如果我们现在不抓住这名军官，我们可能永远无法获得他的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: There's the officer. Capture them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 发现敌方军官，抓住他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Officer captured. I will begin interrogation immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方军官已被抓获，做得好，我会立即开始审问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've reached the location. Clear out any nearby hostiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你已抵达目标位置。清除附近的敌军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They've overrun the area. I'm aborting this mission, escape while you still can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌军已经攻陷该区域。我正在终止任务。趁还能脱身，快撤吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: There are too many Grineer. They've retaken the location. This mission is over. Find safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼兵力过多，区域被他们重新夺回了。任务结束，尽快撤到安全地带。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The location is ours… Wait. Incoming assault. Don't let them retake this territory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我方已控制区域……等等。敌人在反攻，别让他们夺回这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've captured the location. Do not let them retake it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 区域已被我方控制。绝不能让敌军重新夺回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You're losing control. Keep the enemy away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们正在失去区域控制权。击退敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Enemy forces are reaching a critical mass. Don't let them retake this location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌军兵力已逼近临界规模。别让他们夺回这块区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, I'm warning you. If you abandon this location, this mission will be a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，我必须警告你。一旦放弃这片区域，任务就会以失败告终。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy has fortified their camp. We've lost this opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人加固了营地。我们错失了这次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: A strategic location has fallen into enemy control. It must be liberated. Converge on the waypoint to accept this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 一处战略要地已落入敌人的掌控。我们必须夺回那里。前往路标点接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer are holding a key piece of strategic territory. If you accept this mission, move to the waypoint and drive the Grineer away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼正占据着一块关键战略区域。你要想接受这项任务，就去路标点，将他们驱逐出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: More fighters inbound, this isn't over yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 更多敌军来袭，战斗还没有结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They're not giving up. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人还没放弃进攻。继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I still need you to capture that enemy camp, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，我还需要你去夺取那处敌军营地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's the last of them. This location is ours now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 最后一批敌人已被清除。这片区域现在归我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Targets spotted. Strike fast and take out as many as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 发现目标。迅速出击，尽可能多地消灭敌军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They keep growing stronger, you're not going to break them at this rate. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人正在不断壮大。照这样下去，你无法击溃他们。任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Keep going. They won't be able to sustain these casualties for much longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 继续攻击。他们承受不了这种伤亡，撑不了多久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy has moved out, we've missed our opportunity. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人已完成集结并开拔，我们错失了机会。暂且这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've detected troop buildup in the region. If you accept this mission move to the waypoint and disrupt the force before they can mobilize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我侦测到该区域的敌军正在集结。如果要接受任务，前往路标点，趁他们尚未展开行动将其打散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, Grineer soldiers are amassing nearby. If you choose to take this mission proceed to the waypoint and take out as many Grineer as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，克隆尼士兵正在附近集结。如果要接受任务，前往路标点，尽可能多地消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've located another mass of enemies. Take the fight to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我定位了另一批敌人。主动出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: More Grineer amassing nearby. Get over there and take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 附近还有更多克隆尼正在集结，去消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, I still need you to disrupt these troops. Get to the waypoint if you can help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，我仍需要你打散这些部队。要是能支援，就去路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That does it. You've broken them, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 成了。你已经击溃他们，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The drone is nearby, find it and hack it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 无人机就在附近，找到并侵入它的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They destroyed the drone. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 很不幸，敌军摧毁了无人机。任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's it, the drone is under our control now. Escort it to the extraction point before the enemy can destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 好了，无人机已由我们控制。护送它前往撤离点，别被敌人破坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We are too late. The enemy has recovered their drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 来不及了，无人机已经被敌方部队回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We don't have much time. An enemy drone has crashed in your area, I need you to escort it to safety. Proceed to the waypoint if you accept this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们时间有限。有一台敌方无人机坠毁在你附近，我需要你护送它前往安全地带。要接受任务，就前往路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer are searching for a highly-sensitive spy drone they have lost. I need you to find it first and bring it back for study. Make your way to the waypoint to accept this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼正在搜寻一台遗失的机密间谍无人机。我需要你抢先找到它，并把它安全带回来研究。前往路标点，接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They're sending another wave to take out the drone. Stay vigilant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 他们又派了一批士兵准备摧毁无人机，保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: More Grineer inbound. Don't let them harm the drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 更多克隆尼正在接近，保护好无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: If you don't take this mission, the enemy will certainly recover their drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你要是不接受这个任务，敌人肯定会把无人机回收掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer are about to recapture their drone. Are you going to let that happen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼马上就要找到无人机了，你要眼睁睁看着他们得手吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The drone is safe. I will begin decoding its systems immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 很好，无人机安全抵达，我会立即开始破解它的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: In the age after the fall of the Orokin the grand clade-families of the Ostrons were cast wide across the solar system, roaming and homeless in their great floating markets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 奥罗金陨落后的岁月里，奥斯特朗人的庞大枝族散落于太阳系各处，栖身于巨大的移动集市，四处游荡，无家可归。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: In this time two young people were in love: the woman Er-Phryah and the man Mer-Sah. Er-Phryah was from the yingbindunyai clade (meaning "great bond"): a very old and wealthy compact of bonded families.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 在这样的年代里，有两个年轻人相爱了：女的名叫埃尔-芙丽雅，男的名叫弥尔-撒。埃尔-芙丽雅来自英宾杜奈枝族（意为「伟大的羁绊」），那是一个由许多结盟家族缔结而成的联盟，古老而富有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Mer-Sah, however, had no clade: his family having been shattered by the Grineer many years before. He was cetus, meaning 'landless, cladeless^ a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.' Er-Phryah belonged to families within families. Mer-Sah was alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 然而，弥尔-撒却没有枝族，他的家族多年前便被克隆尼摧毁了。他是一个「希图斯」，意思是「没有土地，没有枝族；躯体化为尘土，又化作微尘，散入无情的风中」。埃尔-芙丽雅身处层层相属的家族之中，而弥尔-撒却孤身一人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: But, to Er-Phryah, Mer-Sah was a poet who had eyes to see the beauty of things and ears to hear the softly whispered language of the universe. 'I know a place,' he said. 'Where I may be homeless no more. I have heard a voice, and it leads me there. Come with me.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 不过，在埃尔-芙丽雅眼里，弥尔-撒是一位诗人，他的双眼能看见万物之美，他的双耳能听见宇宙那轻柔的低语。「我知道一个地方，」他说，「在那里，我将不再无家可归。我听见了一个声音，它指引我前往那里。随我来吧。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: But Er-Phryah's father was a man made foolish by his wealth, and vociferously disapproved of their love. Mer-Sah was cast adrift from the floating market that was home to his one true love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 可是，埃尔-芙丽雅的父亲却是个被财富冲昏头脑的人，他声色俱厉地反对这对年轻人相爱。弥尔-撒因此被逐出移动集市，被迫离开了他此生唯一的挚爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Er-Phryah and Mer-Sah ran away together, as lovers do, and were never heard from again. Rent by grief her family thought her dead. Her father passed away, clutching her cameo, at peace thinking he would see her soon in some moonlit afterlife.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 埃尔-芙丽雅和弥尔-撒像所有相爱的恋人那样，私奔远走，从此杳无音讯。家人悲痛欲绝，以为她已不在人世。她的父亲临终时，手中紧攥着那枚刻着她容貌的浮雕饰物，心怀安宁，深信不久后便能在月光下的来世与女儿重逢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Decades later, ships entering ancient Er's orbit were hailed from the planet's poisoned surface by an old woman's voice, gentle and knowing. Traders would call for her, greet her, offer the latest news on their families and lives - but never did they learn anything of this woman, save that she had a husband and they were, somehow, happy living on the toxic skin of that hostile world. The old woman would always - always - ask those travellers of news of the yingbindunyai clade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 几十年过去了。每当飞船驶入阋神星那远古的轨道，这颗星球被剧毒侵蚀的地表，总会传来一位老妇人的声音，温柔而通透，向旅人致意。商人们会主动呼唤她、问候她，向她说起家人与生活的种种近况。然而，他们始终无从得知这位妇人的来历，只知道她有一个丈夫，二人不知何故，竟能在这颗充满敌意的星球那剧毒的表层上幸福地生活着。而那位老妇人，每一次，无一例外，总会向过往的旅人打听英宾杜奈枝族的消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Yingbindunyai junkers came searching for a sign of their missing daughter. The frail voice of their long-lost child reached out to them, and there was much joy. You will find us, her message said, by the light of our love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 英宾杜奈枝族的人们驾着飞船，前来寻找失踪女儿的踪迹。那个失散多年的孩子，用微弱的声音向他们传来了讯息，一家人喜极而泣。她在讯息中说，循着我们爱的光芒，你们便能找到我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Er-Phryah bade them make their home around a magnificent Orokin ruin, promising them that it would be a source of prosperity for generations to come. The yngbindunyai arrived in their vast floating market. There, by a ragged coastline, winked a point of light. Follow the brightness of the love between Mer-Sah and I, said the message, and be safe from all harm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 埃尔-芙丽雅嘱咐族人们环绕一座宏伟的奥罗金遗迹安家，并许诺此地将为他们带来世代不绝的繁荣。英宾杜奈枝族乘着他们庞大的移动集市，抵达了这里。在那崎岖破碎的海岸旁，一点微光正闪烁着。讯息中说，循着我与弥尔-撒之间那爱的光芒，你们便可免受一切伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The wrathful Grineer took umbrage at this and sought to block their passage but, upon approaching that ancient Orokin tower, found their transmissions silenced, their engines turned cold, and their weapons reduced to lumps of dead iron.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 暴怒的克隆尼对此深感不满，企图阻断他们的去路。然而，他们的舰队一旦靠近那座古老的奥罗金塔，通讯便会陷入沉寂，引擎彻底熄火，武器也尽数化作一堆毫无生气的废铁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: She was a being of the day^ her husband, a spirit of the night. Er-Phryah was a woman of the land^ Mer-Sah a man of the sea. Mer-Sah understood the crushing weight of time in which Er existed. In return Er gifted pieces of its ancient self to Mer-Sah: old things shaped to near shapelessness by a thousand years beneath the waves. Mer-Sah was a man dedicated to finding the sacred in the forgotten, the neglected. And took wisdom from them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 她是属于白昼的生灵，她的丈夫则是黑夜的精魂。埃尔-芙丽雅属于大地，弥尔-撒属于海洋。弥尔-撒读懂了阋神星，读懂了这颗星球在亘古岁月中承受的千钧重压。作为回报，阋神星将自身远古的碎片赠予了他，那些古物沉于浪涛之下千年之久，早已被磨蚀得几近无形。弥尔-撒毕生都在被遗忘、被冷落的事物里追寻神圣，再从中汲取智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: After many decades Mer-Sah had a small collection of such gifts - such that they could be held in two cupped hands - but in them he understood the lifespan of a world. And so he had struck an accord with the creatures of the sea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 几十年过去，弥尔-撒只攒下了一小捧这样的馈赠。尽管仅凭双手便能捧起，他却在其中参透了一个世界的存亡兴衰。于是，他与海中生灵缔结了契约。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: For her part, in her times alone, Er-Phryah came to know the birds and animals of the Plains and likewise struck an accord with them. Even the tortured Eidolons, creatures of this world and the next, left them in peace and made the lands around the Tower safe for the Ostrons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 至于埃尔-芙丽雅，在独处的时光里，她熟识了平野上的飞禽走兽，并同样与它们结下了默契。就连那些徘徊于现世与彼岸、饱经折磨的夜灵，也未曾侵扰他们，让奥斯特朗人得以在高塔周围安居。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: At the center of this place was the Tower. And within the Tower was the Unum: the voice, the force, that had called Mer-Sah and Er-Phryah there so many years ago for this exact purpose. But the Unum is a being for another time, and another story.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这片土地的中心矗立着高塔，高塔之中便是乌努母神。多年前，正是那道声音，那股力量，将弥尔-撒与埃尔-芙丽雅召唤至此，只为达成这一使命。但乌努母神属于另一个时代，那是另一段故事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Ostrons named their village Karifamil - 'family and prosperity'. Er-Phyrah was overjoyed to see her clade again… but Mer-Sah would not enter Karifamil, for he had no family save Er-Phyrah. Er-Phryah was drawn to her clade, and Mer-Sah felt no resentment. She would one day return to them^ Mer-Sah had known it would be so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 奥斯特朗人将他们的村庄命名为卡里法米尔，意为「家族与繁荣」。埃尔-芙丽雅与枝族重逢，满心欢喜。弥尔-撒却不愿踏入卡里法米尔，因为除了埃尔-芙丽雅，他已别无亲眷。埃尔-芙丽雅心系枝族，弥尔-撒却毫无怨言，因为他早已知晓，她终有一天会回到族人身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Mer-Sah took the things the sea had gifted him over his long life, and took to his boat, and sailed out across his midnight ocean. He returned those gifts to the deep... and himself to them too. But this was no death into which Mer-Sah stepped, for a world is made of cycles upon cycles. Mer-Sah stepped into his midnight ocean, falling down into it. The deeper he sank, the larger he became. This is how the oceans of Er came to be the home of the thousand-year fish: legendary, vast, reclusive, the rare sight of which changes men. One of the great ancient spirits of Er.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 弥尔-撒带上海洋在漫长岁月中赐予他的馈赠，登上小船，驶向午夜的汪洋。他将这些馈赠还给深海，也将自己一并归还。但弥尔-撒步入的并非死亡，因为世界本就是无尽的循环。弥尔-撒步入午夜的汪洋，不断向深处坠落。他下沉得越深，身躯便越发庞大。阋神星的海洋由此成为了千年鱼的栖息地。这种生灵庞大神秘且充满传奇色彩，常人难得一见，得见者皆为之改变。它是阋神星伟大的远古生灵之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The spirits of the land felt Er-Phryah's sadness, mad with grief for the loss of their friend to the spirits of the sea. The accord broke down, the animals and Eidolons returning once more to wildness. And so the people of the clade yingbindunyai rebuilt the great Orokin wall that had, in centuries gone by, ringed their gleaming Tower... and never again ventured out at night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 大地的生灵也感受到了埃尔-芙丽雅的悲伤。它们痛失挚友，眼看着他被海洋的生灵带走，伤心得几近癫狂。于是，那份契约破裂了，飞禽走兽与夜灵重新变回了野性难驯的模样。万般无奈之下，英宾杜奈枝族的族人只得重新筑起那道宏伟的奥罗金高墙，数百年前，正是这道墙环绕着他们那座熠熠生辉的高塔。从此之后，他们再也不敢在夜里踏出墙外半步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The villagers decided as one that their home would no longer be known as Karifamil, 'family and prosperity'. From that day forward it would be known as Cetus: landless, of no one clade, home to any who are blown as dust on the wind. Er-Phyrah lived there the rest of her days, and for the remainder of her nights she held vigil atop the walls of Cetus, looking to the sea and, some say, occasionally catching sight of a great fish, like an island in a midnight ocean, looking back at her. With love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 村民们一致决定，他们的家园不再叫作卡里法米尔。从那日起，它将被称为希图斯。它没有领地，不属于任何枝族，是所有如风中尘埃般飘零之人的归宿。埃尔-芙丽雅在那里度过了余生。此后的每一个长夜，她都在希图斯的城墙上守望，凝视着大海。有人说，她偶尔会看到一条巨鱼，宛如午夜汪洋中的一座孤岛。它也在回望着她，满怀爱意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: It is said that Mer-Sah continued to watch over the deep, as he had always done, and Er-Phryah the land. Often she would stand by her husband-sea, speaking in a language only those bound at the soul can know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 据说，弥尔-撒一如既往地守望深海，而埃尔-芙丽雅则守望大地。她常常伫立在化作汪洋的丈夫身畔，用唯有灵魂相契者方能听懂的语言，与他低语倾诉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: When the day came and Er-Phryah passed from the world, her family buried her on the land. A great fish watched from the sea, and kept vigil over her, for ten days and nights. When it sank beneath the waves, it was never seen again. Some say Mer-Sah, the thousand-year fish, waits to this day for their story to be retold - relived - that he and Er-Phryah, his great love, may one day be reunited again. This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Tale of the Wife of the Earth and the Husband of the Sea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 当埃尔-芙丽雅离世那日，家人将她安葬于大地。一条巨鱼在海面上静静注视，为她守灵十天十夜。随后它沉入波涛，世上便再也无人见过它的踪影。有人说，化作千年鱼的弥尔-撒至今仍在等待，等待着他们的故事被再次传唱，被再次重演。期盼着有朝一日，他能与一生挚爱埃尔-芙丽雅再度重逢。我是希图斯典籍官昂克，以上便是我译述的《大地之妻与大海之夫的传说》。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: There's the captive. Take out the guards, but be warned, the prisoner has been strapped with a bomb collar. Detection will start the countdown to detonation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 俘虏就在那边。干掉守卫，但要当心，俘虏被戴上了炸弹项圈。一旦敌人发现你们，引爆器就会进入倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The guards are down. Defuse the collar now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 守卫解决了。立刻拆除项圈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The prisoner has died. We failed them. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 俘虏已死亡，我们没能救下目标。本次任务到此结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The prisoner is out of range. Let's hope we get another opportunity like this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 俘虏已超出营救范围。但愿今后还有营救的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our enemy is in the process of relocating an allied prisoner. Will you help me free this individual? If so, get to the waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人正在转移一名我方俘虏。你愿意帮忙解救这名孤立无援的俘虏吗？愿意的话，就去路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer have captured an ally, I need you to rescue them before any harm comes to them. Go to the waypoint to take on this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼抓到了一名友军，我需要你在其受到任何伤害之前将其救出。前往路标点并接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've been detected. Hurry up and free the prisoner before that collar explodes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你的行踪暴露了。抓紧时间，在项圈爆炸前解救俘虏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: More enemies inbound, do not let them harm our ally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 更多敌军正在逼近，别让他们伤害到我们的盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: More Grineer are converging on your location. Protect the ally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 更多克隆尼正在朝你逼近。保护好盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, the prisoner is almost out of range. If you don't take this mission now, they may be lost forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，俘虏快要超出营救范围了。如果你不立刻接受任务，他们可能就会永远消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You freed the prisoner. Now escort them to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你成功解救了俘虏。现在将其护送到安全区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thank you, Tenno, our ally is safe now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 感谢你，Tenno，我们的盟友现在安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Among these troops is a resupply beacon, find it and take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这支部队携带着一枚补给信标，找到它，夺过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: There's the supply beacon. Grab it so I can call in the drop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 找到补给信标了，快夺过来，我来呼叫空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Take that supply beacon, and I will call in the drop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 夺取补给信标，我来呼叫空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy is onto us. They've rerouted the supplies to a far off location. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌军已经察觉了我们的意图。他们将补给改投到了远处。本次任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy has completed their supply drop. We let this opportunity slip through our fingers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 情况不妙，敌人的补给投放已经完成了，我们错失了好机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I have just uncovered the location of an enemy resupply drop. Proceed there at once to accept this mission and disrupt the operation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我刚刚发现了敌人的补给投送点。立即前往目标区域，接受任务，破坏他们的行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's the last pod. Destroy the supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那是最后一座补给舱。马上摧毁补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, reminder, I still need you to disrupt this supply operation. Go to the waypoint to accept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，提醒一下，我仍需要你破坏敌人的补给行动。前往路标点，接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Supplies are dropping now, destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人的补给空投来了，摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Here comes the supply pod. Destroy the supplies before the enemy can get their hands on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 注意！补给舱来了，赶在敌人取得物资前，尽快摧毁掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Supplies incoming, make sure the Grineer never get their hands on them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 补给正在投放，绝不能落到克隆尼手中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy can't wage war without supplies and you just cut another line of support off. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 没有补给，敌人就无法继续作战。你又切断了他们的一条补给线，做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've weakened the local Grineer operation with this strike. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这次打击削弱了克隆尼在当地的行动能力。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You're nearing the armored vault. Take out the surrounding guards. One of them is carrying a datamass and we'll need that to get inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你正在接近装甲金库。解决附近的守卫。其中一人携带了开锁的数据块，有了它我们才能进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The vault's armor is too strong for your weapons to penetrate, I will hack it open, but first I need a datamass from the guards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 金库的装甲过于坚固，你的武器无法击穿。我可以入侵系统将它打开，但首先我需要守卫身上的数据块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: If they destroy the console we'll never get the vault open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 控制台一旦被毁，我们就无法开启金库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The console is taking heavy damage. It must remain operational.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 控制台正遭到严重损伤。必须保证它正常运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You need to protect the console. It's vital to this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 保护好控制台。它是完成任务的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They destroyed the console. I'll never be able to open the vault now. Abandon the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人摧毁了控制台，我现在无法打开金库了。放弃任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They dropped the datamass, grab it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 数据块掉落了，拿上它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The contents of that armored vault have been airlifted to another site. We've lost this opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 装甲金库中的物资已被空运至其他位置。我们错失了机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Good, now insert that datamass into the console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 很好，现在将数据块插入控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy has put heavy guard around one of their mobile armored vaults. We need to break in and take what's inside. Move to the waypoint to accept this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人在一座机动装甲金库周围布下了重兵。我们必须攻进去，夺取里面的物资。前往路标点接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We're in. Take the resources.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们进来了，取走资源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Hold tight and protect that console. More Grineer are coming your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 守住阵地，保护控制台。更多的克隆尼向你袭来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Still hacking. Brace yourself for more fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 还在入侵中。准备好迎击更多敌军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, you're running out of time to strike this armored vault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，留给你突袭装甲金库的时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Mission complete. These resources will be supremely useful to our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 任务完成，这批资源将对我们有莫大的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Captain Vor has lived under suspicion of possessing Orokin technology that grants him powerful abilities. We cannot allow this. Get to his location and eliminate him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 沃尔上尉似乎掌握了奥罗金科技，并借此获得了强大的力量。绝不能姑息此事。找到并消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: This ship is crawling with grunts. Getting to Vor will prove difficult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 飞船上士兵众多，接近沃尔绝非易事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Vor's reputation precedes him. Taking him down will be a favor to the entire system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 沃尔恶名远扬。除掉他，对整个星系都是一件好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Vor is feared across the system. Do not underestimate him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 沃尔让整个星系闻风丧胆。别轻敌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: We believe Vor has the ability to teleport. You will need to watch your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 我们得知沃尔具有瞬移的能力。留意身后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Vor has a tendency to play with his prey. Do not let yourself become distracted by this tactic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 沃尔喜欢戏耍他的猎物。别被他的伎俩扰乱判断。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Intel suggests Hek is planning to add to his list of departed adversaries, including several of our own. Take him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 情报显示，海克正计划再除掉几个对手，其中就包括我们的人。我们要先发制人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Security is getting heavier. Hek must be close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 安保越来越严密了。海克应该就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Killing Hek will bring much needed stability to this sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 除掉海克，这个星区才能恢复往日的稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Hek has made many enemies. Eliminating him could gain us favor with the council.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 海克四处树敌。除掉他，我们或许能赢得议会的支持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: You have Hek insight. Stay alert, and stay alive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 你发现海克了！保持警惕，活着回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Hek is notoriously unpredictable. Be prepared for anything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 海克向来反复无常。准备好应付一切突发状况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: If Hek is allowed to live there could be drastic repercussions for the entire system. Take him down. There is no other option.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 如果让海克活下去，整个星系都将后患无穷。除掉他，我们别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: General Sargas Ruk has become a problem for our artifact recovery efforts. Several of our dig sites in this sector have been attacked and annexed by Ruk and his fleet. Take Ruk out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 萨加斯·鲁克将军严重妨碍了我们的遗物回收行动。我们在该区域内目前的几个挖掘点，都遭到他舰队的袭击和吞并。我需要你除掉鲁克。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Ruk sees flesh as a flaw. As a result, he has built a profitable artifact smuggling outfit to finance his search for the best in Grineer body modifications and augmentations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 鲁克认为肉体太过脆弱。为获取克隆尼最先进的躯体改造和强化技术，他建立了利润丰厚的遗物走私网络，为自己筹措资金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Ruk is nearby. Be warned that he is a formidable adversary, with an almost inhuman hatred for all that is not Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 鲁克就在附近。小心，他是一个极其难缠的对手，对克隆尼之外的人都抱着近乎病态的敌意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Ruk is the Grineer's preeminent artifact hunter. Taking him out will cripple their artifact recovery efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 鲁克是克隆尼中首屈一指的遗物猎人。除掉他就能浇灭他们寻找遗物的气焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Ruk will be adorning only the most impressive in Grineer body modifications. You will need to stay one step ahead of him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 鲁克全身上下都装备着最先进的克隆尼改造部件。你必须抢先他一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Eliminating Ruk will allow us to regain control of this system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 解决掉鲁克，我们就能重新夺回星系的控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: It was difficult to locate the source vector of this sector's infestation but you are finally here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 我们付出了不小的代价，才找到这片星区的感染源头。你终于到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Deep within this millennia old Orokin-turned-Infested ship lurks a creature created to fight in the Old War. Make your way to its location and dispatch this monster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 这艘已有数千年历史、被感染的奥罗金飞船深处，潜伏着一头为了远古之战而造的怪物。前往它的藏匿处并消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Be wary. The creature has grown unfathomably strong through centuries of absorbing matter and self-replication.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 多加小心。几个世纪以来，这个怪物不断吸收物质、自我克隆，力量已增长到难以估量的地步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Recent innovations in Corpus robotics have lead to a surge in production. Their newest animal-like proxy is an unrelenting hunter. Codenamed "Hyena", this robot is designed to work in packs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 最近，科普斯的机器人技术取得了突破，产能大幅飙升。他们最新一代的仿生兽形武器，是毫不留情的猎手。该机体代号「鬣狗」，设计用于群体协同作战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Our operatives have identified at least four different variations of the Hyena model, each with a different specialization and arsenal of attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 我们的特工已确认，鬣狗机型至少有四种变体。每种都具备不同的特化形态和攻击手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Use caution, the Hyena pack will work together to try and take you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 谨慎行事，鬣狗群会协同作战，联手攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: In an attempt to exert power and authority, the Corpus recently introduced their most lethal security proxy yet. Determine its location aboard this vessel and destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 为彰显武力，科普斯近期部署了一款迄今为止最致命的防卫机器人。在飞船上找到并摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Nicknamed "The Jackal," this is the same deadly quad-robot which has become extremely problematic for our cells in the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 它的代号是「豺狼」，这款致命的四足机器人对我们的前线小队造成了极大的麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Do not dismiss the Jackal as just another Corpus proxy. This will be unlike any enemy you have faced yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 别把豺狼当做普通杂兵。它和你之前遇到的所有敌人都不一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Kril is a seasoned war hero with many battles under his belt. His victories are decided by his trusty hammer. One which he wields with brutal consequences.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 克里尔是一位久经沙场、功勋卓著的战争英雄。他的胜利全仰仗那把从不离手的战锤。锤到之处，非死即残。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Kril is highly unpredictable. We suspect he may have other tricks up his sleeve. To survive this battle, you must strike hard and fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 克里尔的行踪难以预测，而且他可能还留有后手。要活着赢下战斗，出击就必须快准狠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: You are nearing Kril's location. Proceed with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 你正接近克里尔的位置，小心前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Kril is aware of your presence. Strike first!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 克里尔发现你的踪迹了，先发制人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Eliminating Kril is the only chance for our exposed colony.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 只有除掉克里尔，才能拯救毫无防备的殖民地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: One of our spy cells has been lost investigating this abandoned Grineer asteroid base. We need you to locate and eliminate whatever is responsible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 有支间谍小队在侦查克隆尼小行星基地时失联了。找到罪魁祸首，消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: This place is crawling with Infested. Unfortunately, something far more ominous awaits. Make your way deeper into the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 这里遍布感染者。不幸的是，还有更可怕的东西等着你。继续深入基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Your target is an aberration of twisted flesh. Put the thing out of its misery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 你的目标是一头血肉扭曲的畸形怪物。让它解脱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Avoid the creature's spine-strike. These razor-sharp quills will rip your Warframe to shreds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 避开它的脊刺攻击。那些锋利如刃的尖刺能把你的战甲扎成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: The creature is incredibly agile for a deformed quadruped. Keep moving to avoid being crushed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 这只畸形的四足生物动作非常敏捷。保持移动，躲避攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Listen for its screams. This will mean you are getting close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 注意听咆哮声。这说明你离它很近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Elude its bone-chilling shrieks if you wish to stay alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 想活下去，就躲开它那令人毛骨悚然的尖啸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: If Nef Anyo's prototype survives our assault, he'll be able to draw in a mountain of new offerings. We must turn his scheme against him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 如果我们不摧毁奈富·安尤的原型机，他肯定会借此弄到堆积如山的进献。我们必须反制他的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: All previous strikes against the Razorback have failed, you need to find a way to punch through its shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 此前针对利刃豺狼的行动都以失败告终，你需要找出别的办法来突破它的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Stay alert. Scans show this facility is also home to upgraded Bursa bipeds. You may have to deal with both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 保持警惕。扫描显示，这座设施里还部署了强化版的双足金流恐鸟。你也许会腹背受敌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Grineer researcher Tyl Regor has made alarming strides in the field of gene repair. His work would not only reverse centuries of deterioration due to excessive cloning but also allow for stronger and deadlier genetic moulds. Eliminate Regor and put a stop to his work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 克隆尼研究员泰尔·雷工在基因修复领域取得了惊人突破。他的成果不仅能扭转几个世纪以来，克隆尼由于过度克隆而导致的退化，还能制造出更强大、更致命的基因模板。干掉雷工，给他的研究划上句号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Regor is aware of your presence. Bring him down quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 雷工已经发现你了。尽快解决他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Regor will fight to the death to see this project through. We cannot let that happen. Silence his work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 为了完成这项研究，雷工会战斗到底。我们绝不能让他得逞。让他的研究计划破产。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: The only thing standing between the Grineer and total power is their continuous state of genetic deterioration. It's one of the few natural balances in this conflict. Regor's work would destroy this balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 阻挡克隆尼统治星系的唯一障碍，就是他们不断退化的基因。这是这场冲突中为数不多的天然制衡。而雷工的研究将彻底打破这种平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Expect Regor to be armed with the best in Grineer weapons and defense capabilities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 要小心，雷工有克隆尼最顶尖的武器与防御系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Regor's grunts are in full force. He must be close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 雷工的部队正在大举集结。他一定就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.text: Unfortunately Regor's brilliance is overshadowed by his complete lack of ethics. His work is a threat to the entire system. He must be terminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Bos.zhText: 可惜，雷工虽然才华横溢，却毫无道德底线。他的研究对整个星系构成了威胁，所以必须除掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Cor.text: Corpus Walkers are heading to your location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Cor.zhText: 科普斯步行者正向你靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Cor.text: Heavy robotics signature detected. Lock and load.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Cor.zhText: 侦测到重型机器人活动信号，准备战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DAc.text: It's time to issue your challenge.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DAr.text: Tenno, show me you have mastered the Archwing, navigate this course before the timer expires.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DAr.zhText: Tenno，展示你的曲翼驾驭技巧，在倒计时结束前完成训练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DAr.text: Passing through each ring awards additional time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DAr.zhText: 每穿过一个圆环，都会获得额外时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Prioritize and eliminate. Throw these canisters at enemies to render them vulnerable. But hurry, Tenno, your time is limited and the canisters will expire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 锁定目标，逐个击破。把这些容器扔向敌人，就可以削弱他们的力量。但动作要快 Tenno，时间紧迫，这些容器很快就会失效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Our target is dying. Hurry, complete the capture before they expire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 目标生命垂危。赶快，在他断气前完成捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Our target has died. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 目标已死亡。这次的任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: You've found a target. Capture them quickly before they escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 你找到目标了，快把他抓起来，别让他逃掉。
发现目标，马上进行抓捕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: We have multiple targets of interest for this mission. Bring them all to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 本次我们收到的任务内容有多个目标，把他们全带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Target captured. On to the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 成功捕获目标，再接再厉。
目标已成功控制，继续搜索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: We lost that one. Do not let any more get away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 我们放跑了一个，别再让其他目标逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Target escaped. Do not let that happen again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 居然让他跑了，下不为例。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: These are high value targets, their capture is crucial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 这些敌方重要目标对我们来说至关重要，必须把他们抓回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.text: Be aware Tenno, these targets are a very high flight risk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCa.zhText: 注意，Tenno，这些目标极易逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCh.text: A challenger has entered the dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCh.zhText: 有位挑战者进入了道场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCh.text: Another Tenno seeks battle, are you ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCh.zhText: 另一位挑战者下了战帖，你接受吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCn.text: A challenger has left the dojo.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.text: You have chosen to support the Grineer in this fight. Eliminate all Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.zhText: 这场战斗中你选择支持克隆尼，消灭所有科普斯部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.text: You are fighting alongside the Grineer on this mission. Destroy all Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.zhText: 在这次任务中，你与克隆尼并肩作战，消灭所有科普斯部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.text: Make sure the Grineer win this battle, leave no Corpus functioning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DCo.zhText: 确保克隆尼赢得这场战斗，消灭所有科普斯部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDe.text: Tenno, you can protect yourself but can you protect others at the same time? Survive each wave while defending the objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDe.zhText: Tenno，你可以独善其身，但你能同时保护他人吗？抵御攻势，保护目标，战斗到底。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDe.text: This embryonic fluid injector has been recalibrated to wreak havoc on Tyl Regor's cloning operation. Defend the injector for as long possible to ensure maximum damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDe.zhText: 我已重新校准了这台胚胎液注射器，它足以重创泰尔·雷工的克隆计划。保护注射器，最大程度破坏他的克隆计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDj.text: Show me your versatility, Tenno. Use both Archwing and ground fighting to reach the kill count goal. Melee strike the orbs to add extra seconds to the timer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDj.zhText: Tenno，把你的作战本领全部亮出来吧。结合曲翼与地面战斗，达成指定击杀数。用近战攻击打破光球可以延长倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: This is your most dangerous assassination yet - Captain Vor has teamed up with Lech Kril to take you down. Let's show them your true Tenno power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 这是迄今为止最危险的追击任务。沃尔上尉和莱克·克里尔准备联手除掉你。让他们见识一下真正的 Tenno 之力吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: Vor and Kril are waiting for you. I recommend you focus your attacks on one target, if you split your attention you may fail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 你将同时面对沃尔和克里尔。建议你先集中力量消灭其中一个目标。若分心对付两个，你可能会失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: Vor's mobility could make him the larger threat. Observe their attack patterns and look for an opportunity to divide and conquer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 你很难攻击到行动敏捷的沃尔，他的威胁会更大。留心观察他们的攻击规律，然后寻找机会，逐个击破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: You have lost. Perhaps more training is in order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 你输了。或许你需要勤加训练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: You are in need of practice, Tenno.
You are a worthy fighter but you must always stay vigilant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 你是一位优秀的战士，但要时刻保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.text: Very good Tenno, you have defeated the challenger.
Excellent - you have defeated your challenger.
You are a strong fighter, our enemies have much to fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DDu.zhText: 你是个强大的战士，敌人被你吓破了胆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: Keep fighting. As long as the enemy is here, this tower is useless to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 继续战斗，只要敌人还在这里，这座塔对我们来说就毫无用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: The tower's Neural Sentry has turned these soldiers into mindless attack drones. You need to take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 这座塔的神经哨卫把这些士兵变成了毫无意识的杀戮机器，你必须干掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: The Grineer should have known better than to walk into an Orokin Tower unprepared. Let's clean up their mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 克隆尼本该知道，毫无准备就闯入奥罗金塔会有什么下场。我们来收拾他们的烂摊子吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: You aren't the first ones here. I'm detecting multiple enemy signatures and they're all under the control of the tower. Eliminate the threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 你不是第一个来到这里的人，我侦测到了多个敌方信号，他们全都被塔侵蚀，受其控制。消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: The tower's Neural Sentry is operational. I'm picking up multiple threats all under Orokin control. Wipe them all out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 奥罗金塔的神经哨卫仍在运作，我侦测到了多个受塔控制的敌人，把他们全部消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: You are not alone. This tower is full of lifeforms, all corrupted by the Neural Sentry. Clean them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 这里并非只有你一人。这座塔里到处都是生命体，他们全都被神经哨卫操控腐化了。铲除他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: The enemy is broken. Well done, now get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 敌人已被击溃。做得好，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.text: You have broken their ranks and they are on the run. Another successful mission. Find extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DEx.zhText: 你击溃了敌人的阵型，他们正在四处逃窜。任务成功，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGa.text: Tenno, demonstrate superior battlefield efficiency. Kill and scavenge for beacons, and then quickly deliver them to the drop-off to earn the points needed to complete this test.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGa.zhText: Tenno，展示一下你高超的战斗技巧吧。歼灭敌人，回收信标，然后将其迅速送到投放点，从而赚取完成测试所需的点数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGa.text: This will be your hardest test yet. Defeat all incoming enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGa.zhText: 这将是你迄今为止遇到最严酷的考验。消灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.text: Picking sides is never easy. You are doing what you feel is right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.zhText: 要选边站固然不容易。去做你认为正确的事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.text: Supporting the enemy feels wrong, but keeping the balance requires tough choices.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.zhText: 与敌人站在同一阵线肯定心里不舒服，但为了维持平衡，必须做出艰难的抉择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.text: This aggression has upset the balance of power. We must set things right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGe.zhText: 这种侵略行为打破了势力间的平衡。我们必须让一切重回正轨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.text: The situation forces you to help The Corpus in this mission. Kill all Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.zhText: 由于形势所迫，你要帮助科普斯，消灭所有克隆尼部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.text: Your sense of duty compels you to help The Corpus today. Destroy all Grineer forces to help maintain the balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.zhText: 今天，你的使命感驱使你去协助科普斯，消灭所有克隆尼部队来维持势力平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.text: You are fighting with The Corpus in this battle. No Grineer can be left alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DGr.zhText: 这次，你选择和科普斯合作，消灭所有克隆尼敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.text: Tenno? Can you hear me? You've been a naughty little betrayer, haven't you? Did you really think your support for the Grineer would go unnoticed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.zhText: Tenno，能听到我说话吗？你还真是个不听话的小叛徒呢！你真以为暗中帮助克隆尼的小动作没人会发现吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.text: That is just the sort of behavior I just can't let go uncorrected. Otherwise, you'll never learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.zhText: 我绝不容忍这种小动作，必须予以惩戒。否则，你永远也学不乖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.text: This is really for your own good, Tenno. Help me, help you... help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.zhText: 这是为你好，Tenno。帮我相当于帮你自己……所以乖乖就范吧，嘿嘿嘿

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.text: Good job Zanuka. This Tenno's bones will make you a fine sibling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.zhText: 干得好，扎努卡。我可以用 Tenno 的骨头给你培育个好搭档。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.text: Zanuka? No! What have you monsters done to my beautiful creature? I won't forget this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHa.zhText: 扎努卡？不！你们这群怪物，对我的宝贝做了什么？这笔账，我不会就这么算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: So far so good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 目前一切顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Keep going. That Rover's contents will be a huge boost to our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 继续前进。漫游车的货物可以大大提升我们的实力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: You have almost reached the extraction point. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 你马上就到撤离点了，加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The rover is active but... wait... the Corpus have remotely corrupted its power cell. Hold on, I will reconfigure the rover to draw power from your shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 漫游车已启动，但等等……科普斯远程破坏了它的能量电池。稍等，我会重新配置漫游车，让它从你的护盾获取能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Good work we now have control of the rover... hold on Tenno... things just got more complicated. The Corpus have corrupted the rover's power-cell. I can reconfigure it but its new source of power will be your Warframe's shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 干得好，我们已经控制了漫游车。等等，Tenno……事情变复杂了。科普斯破坏了漫游车的电池。我可以重新配置它，但它将从你的护盾中获取能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Corpus have regained control of the Rover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 科普斯夺回了漫游车的控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Corpus are pulling back the Rover, you need to stay close to maintain control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 科普斯正在把漫游车往回拉，你需要留在附近，重新夺回控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Rover is reversing, get back in range as soon as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 漫游车现在正在倒退，尽快回到有效范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Critical damage. The rover is almost gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 损坏严重。漫游车快撑不住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Situation critical. The Rover must not take any more hits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 情况紧急。漫游车无法再承受更多攻击了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The rover is taking damage. The Corpus would rather destroy it than let us escape with its cargo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 漫游车正遭受攻击。科普斯宁愿把它毁了，也不愿让我们把货带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Protect the rover, if it's destroyed this mission will be considered a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 保护漫游车，如果它被摧毁，这次任务就宣告失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The rover is taking heavy damage, you must protect it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 漫游车正遭受严重损坏，必须保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Do not let the Corpus destroy the Rover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 绝不能让科普斯摧毁漫游车。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The rover has been destroyed. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 漫游车已被摧毁。这次任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: They destroyed the rover. We're going home empty handed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 他们摧毁了漫游车。我们只能空手而归了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We are here to hijack a Corpus Rover loaded with valuable cargo and escort it to our extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 任务是劫持一台装满贵重物资的科普斯漫游车，并护送它前往我们的撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Your target today is a Corpus Rover. Take control and escort the rover to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 你今天的目标是一台科普斯漫游车。控制并护送它撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Corpus are trying to scavenge anything of value from these crashed ships. This Rover is carrying their most important finds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 科普斯正试图打捞这些坠毁的飞船，从而找回贵重的东西。这台漫游车里有他们最重要的发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We have to move quickly, once the Corpus realize what we are trying to do, they will use everything they can to stop us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 我们必须迅速行动，一旦科普斯察觉到我们的目的，他们会不择手段地阻拦我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We are making progress. Stay sharp, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 进展顺利，保持警惕，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: So far so good. Keep moving the tram toward extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 目前一切顺利，继续将轨道车护送到撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: You have reached the midpoint. Disposing of these cores will be a massive blow to Vay Hek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 你已经抵达中途点。销毁这些核心，可以给韦·海克好好上一课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: You are making solid progress. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 进展很顺利，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: You are nearing extraction. This is the final push.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 快要到撤离点了。最后一段路，再多坚持一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Extraction is close. Do not let up. The Grineer must not be allowed to recover this core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 撤离点就快到了，Tenno，不要松懈，绝不能让克隆尼夺回核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Good, the tram has been rerouted. It will now draw power from your shields in order to keep moving forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 很好，轨道车已改道。它现在会吸收你的护盾能量作为能源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Excellent. We now have control of the tram. Its drive systems have been overridden and it will now draw power from your shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 太好了，我们现在控制了轨道车。成功接管了它的驾驶系统，现在会抽取你的护盾能量当做能源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Grineer have regained control of the tram.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 克隆尼夺回了轨道车的控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Grineer have control and are pulling back the tram.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 克隆尼阵营控制住了轨道车，正把车往回拉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The tram is retreating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 轨道车正在倒退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The situation is desperate, if that core takes much more damage it could wipe out you and this entire outpost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 现在情况千钧一发，如果核心再受到更多破坏，你和整个前哨站都会夷为平地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The core has almost ruptured. The situation is critical!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心就快要破裂了，情况非常危急！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The core is highly volatile. It will rupture if it takes too much damage. Do not let this happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 现在核心极不稳定，如果遭到过多损坏就会破裂，绝不能让这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Protect the core. We will destroy it in space. The consequences of a rupture here are unthinkable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 保护好核心，我们会把它带到太空中销毁。如果它在这里破裂，后果不堪设想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: That core is taking heavy damage. If it ruptures, the ground you stand on will be uninhabitable for millennia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心遭到严重损坏，如果进一步破裂，你脚下的土地将在数千年内寸草不生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Protect the core from enemy fire. A rupture means certain death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 保护好核心，避免被敌人炮火击中。核心一旦破裂，你必死无疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The Grineer are transporting the core by cargo tram. Find the control console to reroute the tram.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 克隆尼正在用货运电车运送核心，找到电车控制台，改变电车的路线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Watch out for mines on the track. The enemy will use everything they can to stop us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 一定要小心轨道上的地雷，敌人为了阻止我们无所不用其极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Be careful, my scans show this track has been mined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 小心，扫描发现这条轨道上埋有地雷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The track has been mined, proceed with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 轨道上埋有地雷，务必小心前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The core is rupturing. I am sorry Tenno, there is nothing I can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心正在破裂，Tenno，抱歉，我已经无能为力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: A rupture is imminent. Tenno, you must prepare yourself for what comes next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心即将破裂，Tenno，为接下来的一切做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The core has reached extraction. This is a major setback for Project Tethra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心已经抵达撤离点，韦·海克将会受到重创。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We have the core. The Grineer will not be pleased with our victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 核心到手了，克隆尼肯定不会喜欢这个结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We are here to hijack the transport of a Fomorian Power core before it can be installed in the growing Fomorian fleet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 我们的任务是，在巨人战舰核心被安装到那支不断扩增的舰队之前，拦截并劫持它的运输飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: A Fomorian Core is being transported from the factory for installation. You are here to make sure that core never reaches a Fomorian class ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 一枚巨人战舰核心正从工厂运往安装地点。你要确保这颗核心永远无法送到巨人战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: We need to take these cores into deep space for destruction. A core rupture here would turn this outpost into an uninhabitable wasteland.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 我们必须将这些核心运往深空销毁。这种核心要是爆炸，会把这座前哨站炸成寸草不生的废土。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Left unchecked, Project Tethra will create hundreds of new Fomorian class ships. We plan to stop as many ships being built as possible by destroying their most critical components, the Fomorian Core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 如果放任不管的话，泰特拉计划会制造出数以百计的新型巨人战舰，我们打算摧毁他们最重要的部件——巨人战舰核心，来尽可能阻止他们制造飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: Get these doors open if you want to keep the core moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 打开这些门，否则核心无法继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: The tram is not going anywhere until you get these doors open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 这些门打不开，轨道车就无法继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.text: They are trying to lock you in. Get the bay doors open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DHi.zhText: 他们想把你锁在里面，快把隔离舱门打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.text: The Infested are releasing toxic spores into the area. The emergency life support I am delivering is your only chance for survival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.zhText: 感染者正朝该区域释放剧毒孢子，坚持住，我投放的紧急维生装置是你唯一的生路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.text: A steady stream of toxic spores is being released into the area. Hold on, emergency life support is inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.zhText: 剧毒孢子正持续涌入该区域。坚持住，紧急维生装置即将送达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.text: Show me you are capable of fighting on multiple fronts. Capture and hold more points than the enemy to succeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.zhText: 证明你拥有多线作战的能力。占领并守住更多目标点，压过敌人，就能取胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.text: Let's see how you work under pressure. Eliminate all enemies before the timer reaches zero. Melee strike the orbs to have extra seconds added to the clock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DIn.zhText: 看看你顶着压力能有怎样的表现。在时限内消灭所有敌人，用近战攻击打破光球可以延长剩余时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: Tenno. Tenno can you hear me? You've been captured by Alad V's harvester. This is your chance, escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: Tenno，Tenno，能听到我说话吗？听着，你被阿拉德 V 的收割者抓住了。趁现在，快逃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: Tenno. Ready yourself. You have been captured by the Corpus. It is time to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: Tenno，准备应战，你被科普斯俘虏了。趁现在，逃出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: Oh, Tenno. I understand you're nervous. But if you come back to us I can assure you^ you won't feel a thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 哦，Tenno。我知道你很紧张。但只要你肯回到我们这里，我保证……你绝对不会痛的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: Tenno, don't listen to that... that Lotus. She just wants to hold you back. Stay with me explore your...potential.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: Tenno，别听那个……那个莲的话。她只是想限制你前进。留在我身边，让我带你发掘自己的……潜能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: Tenno, Tenno! There's an entire Grineer battalion here to rescue you. Your friends must really appreciate your support. Wait, no. I'm mistaken. You're alone, with no weapons and no friends. Silly me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: Tenno，Tenno！有一整营的克隆尼士兵来救你了。你那些朋友肯定很感激你的帮助。等等，不好意思，我搞错了。你孤身一人，手无寸铁，哪来的朋友呢。瞧我这记性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: The Grineer are a threat to us all. You need to understand the error of you ways. Consider my efforts a favor... yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 克隆尼是我们共同的威胁。你必须认清自己究竟错在哪里。就当我是在努力帮你吧……就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: You found your primary weapon. Lock and load.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 你找到了主武器，填弹上膛，准备战斗。
找到副武器了，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: I have extraction ready but you have to find your weapons first. Can you handle that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 撤离点已准备就绪，不过你需要提前找回武器。能搞定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: You're not going to last long without your weapons, they are scattered around this facility. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 没有武器，你撑不了多久的。你的武器就散落在这座设施各处，把它们找出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: You found all your weapons. Get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 所有武器都找齐了，离开那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.text: You're done. Extraction is waiting. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DJa.zhText: 任务完成，撤离点在等你，走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLa.text: Your foes are not the only dangers you will face in the field. Avoid the lasers and defeat the enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLa.zhText: 在战场上，你要面对的危险不只有敌人。避开这些激光，同时解决掉所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: Alad V's newest prototype is a monstrosity forged from the bodies of our fallen Tenno, we cannot allow Zanuka to go into full production. Destroy Alad V and his horrid 'pet'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: 阿拉德 V 最新的原型机扎努卡很可怕，它是由牺牲的 Tenno 遗骸拼凑而成的畸形怪物。绝不能让它量产，除掉阿拉德 V 和他那只可怕的「宠物」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: Too many Tenno have perished to make Alad V's abomination. There will be no stopping the Corpus if Zanuka is mass produced. You are here to make sure that doesn't happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: 阿拉德 V 为了制造这个怪物，杀害了太多 Tenno。一旦扎努卡投入量产，科普斯将无人能挡，你必须阻止这一切发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: The Zanuka prototype has made Alad V a very dangerous man. If he is allowed to carry out his plans, no Tenno in this system will be safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: 有了扎努卡原型机，阿拉德 V 已成为头号危险人物。如果让他的计划得逞，整个星系内的 Tenno 将无一幸免。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: Be careful Tenno, Zanuka has all the power of a Warframe with a full complement of mods. It's as if you are fighting one of your own today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: Tenno，要小心。扎努卡拥有战甲的全部技能和完整的模组强化。对付它，就如同与自己交战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: Alad V sees the power of the Tenno and thinks he can take it for himself. That power is sacred, this blasphemy must end now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: 阿拉德 V 见识过 Tenno 的力量后，便想将其占为己有。Tenno 的力量神圣不可侵犯，必须立刻结束他的亵渎之举。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.text: If Alad V is victorious today he will dissect your Warframe and use the pieces to build more of his 'pets'. You must not let this happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DLo.zhText: 如果阿拉德 V 今天赢了，他就会肢解你的战甲，用拆下来的部件制造更多「宠物」。绝不能让这种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DMR.text: Tenno. This is your true master test. Your only objective: survival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DMR.zhText: Tenno。这就是你的至崇宗师试炼。你唯一的目标就是：活下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DMo.text: You're fast, Tenno, but are you nimble enough to capture each one of these mobile control points?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DMo.zhText: 你速度很快，Tenno，但你是否快到可以占领这些移动的控制点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOp.text: Your fragile Tenno body is one of the most powerful forces in the known Universe. Show me you know how to wield this force, destroy the target without being destroyed yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOp.zhText: Tenno，你的躯体看似脆弱，实则承载着宇宙中最强大的力量。向我证明你懂得如何驾驭这股力量。保护好自己，摧毁目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: You've opened an Orokin Vault. It appears unaffected by the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 你打开了一座奥罗金宝库，看起来这里没有受到感染者影响。
一座完好无损的奥罗金宝库……有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: You've unlocked an Orokin Vault. Its... clean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 你打开了一座奥罗金宝库，这里……很干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: You have the Vault artifact, let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 宝库遗物到手了，我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: You've got it. Something is different about this artifact...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 拿到了。但这件遗物似乎有些不同……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: Vault artifact acquired. You'll need to extract before we can verify its function.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 宝库遗物已到手。但是你必须撤出来，我们才能鉴定它的功能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: The artifact you are carrying appears to be affecting your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 你拿到的这件遗物似乎正在影响你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: Until we get you to extraction, that artifact will continue to affect your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 你需要尽快抵达撤离点，否则那件遗物会一直影响你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: Your Warframe is being impaired by the artifact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 你的战甲被遗物削弱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: It appears that you've triggered security. The Corrupted are here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 看来你触发了安全警报，堕落者要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: Looks like some Corrupted stayed behind to guard the artifact, it must be valuable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 看来有些堕落者被留在这里负责看守遗物，想必它肯定价值不菲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.text: The Corrupted will stop at nothing to prevent that artifact from escaping. This won't be easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DOr.zhText: 堕落者将会不择手段阻止你带走遗物，这一仗可不轻松。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPa.text: As our enemies grow stronger, so too must the Tenno evolve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPa.zhText: 我们的敌人越来越强大了，Tenno 也必须随之变强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPa.text: I will teach you a new art of movement and forever change how you traverse the field of battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPa.zhText: 我会传授你一套全新的移动身法，你穿越战场的方式将得到进化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPl.text: Careful Tenno, the ground beneath you is crumbling. Can you defeat these enemies before you have nowhere left to stand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPl.zhText: 注意脚下，Tenno。地面正在逐渐崩塌，你能够在无处落脚之前解决掉所有敌人吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPl.text: Your Warframe's movement abilities are key to this challenge. Defeat all the enemies before the ground completely falls away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPl.zhText: 在这场战斗中，发挥你战甲的移动能力是致胜关键。在地面完全崩塌之前，消灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: Prosecutor down. Stay alert, there could be more ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: 判官被击败了。保持警惕，前面可能还有更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: Good work. You have proven the Prosecutors are not invincible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: 干得好，你证明了判官也并非刀枪不入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: Prosecutor eliminated. Watch out for more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: 判官被消灭了，但还是要提高警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: I am detecting a Prosecutor. Get ready for a tough fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: 发现了一名判官，准备好迎接一场硬仗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: Tenno. Get ready. A Prosecutor is approaching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: Tenno，做好准备。有个判官过来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.text: Use caution. I am picking up traces of Prosecutor shield auras in your vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DPr.zhText: 小心行动，我在你附近发现了判官护盾光环的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: All the pipes have been destroyed, the enemy has prevented the reactor from destroying itself. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 所有管道都被摧毁了，敌人阻止了反应堆自毁。这次任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: The reactor is a complex system, start by removing the coolant cells
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 反应堆系统很复杂，先从移除冷却单元着手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: A security lockdown has stalled your progress. Clear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 安全锁定启动了。它会妨碍你的任务，解除它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Coolant cell destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 冷却单元已摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Coolant cell extracted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 冷却单元已移除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: A coolant cell has been extracted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 你成功移除了一个冷却单元。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: A coolant cell has been placed in the fuel port.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 冷却单元已插入燃料端口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Guard the console and prevent lockdowns while the fuel erodes the coolant system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 守住控制台，阻止它启动锁定程序，让燃料腐蚀冷却系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Defend the system until the coolant has flooded the fuel system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 保护系统，直到冷却剂填满燃料系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Security has locked down the coolant cells, we have no choice but to destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 安保系统已锁死了冷却单元，我们别无选择，只能摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Security measures have locked the coolant cells in place. Destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 冷却单元已被安保系统锁死。摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Destroy the fuel injectors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 破坏燃料注入器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Careful, fire is spreading rapidly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 小心，火势正在迅速蔓延。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Watch your step, Tenno. There are severe coolant leaks throughout the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 注意，Tenno，飞船里有大量冷却剂泄漏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Beware Tenno, the ship is experiencing reduced gravity and magnetic anomalies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 当心，Tenno，飞船目前处于低引力状态，并伴有磁场异常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: A fuel cell has been placed in the coolant system. Restarting the reactor will produce hazardous magnetic activity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 燃料电池已置入冷却系统。重启反应堆将触发剧烈的磁场波动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Fuel cell reinserted. When the reactor is restarted, this will trigger a meltdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 燃料电池已重新插入。一旦反应堆重启，就会引发核心熔毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Hack the console to restart the reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 破解控制台，重启反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: The reactor must be restarted to trigger your sabotage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 必须重新启动反应堆，才能完成破坏任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: The reactor is going into stasis. Now is your chance to complete this sabotage. Use whatever you can to make sure it never works again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 反应堆进入休眠状态，现在是破坏它的好机会。动用一切手段，确保它彻底报废。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: I need you to sabotage this ship's reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 你的任务是破坏这艘飞船的反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Your sabotage is complete. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 破坏任务已完成。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: A blast door has blocked your evacuation route, find a way to open it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 有一扇防爆门封死了你的撤退路线，想办法打开它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: The enemy has destroyed a reactor pipe. You must protect them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 敌人摧毁了一根反应堆管道。你必须保护好它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: Another pipe destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 又一根管道被破坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.text: The reactor has gone critical, get to extraction immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRS.zhText: 反应堆已达到临界点，立即撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRa.text: How well do you shoot under pressure? You must traverse this space before the timer runs out. Shooting the targets will buy you extra time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRa.zhText: 顶着压力，你还能保持枪法吗？必须在时限内冲出重围，击中目标可以争取额外的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRa.text: The Raptor is the most recent Corpus heavy weapon. You must destroy it before they can begin full scale production.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRa.zhText: 猛禽是科普斯最新研发的重型武器，你必须在它们开始全面量产之前将其摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRe.text: Stay undetected while you melee strike all the orbs to free the prisoner. Once free, escort them to the safe zone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRe.zhText: 保持隐蔽，用近战攻击打破所有光球来解救俘虏。一旦他重获自由，就护送他前往安全区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 他们逮到我了，Tenno 救命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: I thought I was going to die in there. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 我还以为自己死定了，多亏了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: Thank the stars. Not a minute too soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 谢天谢地。你来的可正是时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: I knew you would come, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 我就知道你会来的，谢谢你 。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: I am in your debt Tenno. Lets go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 我欠你一个人情，Tenno 战士。我们回去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: I will not forget this, Tenno.
I can fight too, if you give me a weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 给我一件武器，我也可以战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: Give me a weapon and I'll watch your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 给我一把武器，让我来支持你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: Got an extra weapon? They won't just let us walk out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 有多的武器吗？他们不会让我们轻松走出这里的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: I don't suppose you have an extra gun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 我想你大概没有多出来的枪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.text: Got a weapon for me? I've got some scores to settle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DRs.zhText: 能给我件武器吗？我要让他们血债血偿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSb.text: Target destroyed. Now eliminate all enemy personnel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSb.zhText: 目标已摧毁。现在消灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSb.text: The sabotage is complete. Now exterminate the enemy's forces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSb.zhText: 破坏任务已完成。现在消灭敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSt.text: A full frontal attack is not always the best option. Using your stealth abilities eliminate all enemies without being detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSt.zhText: 正面强攻有时并非最佳选择，利用你的潜行能力，悄无声息地消灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Life support activated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 已激活维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Life support has been replenished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 维生装置已补充。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Fallen enemies will drop crucial life support, be on the lookout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 击杀敌人后会掉落维生装置，留意收集。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Look for personal life support modules dropped by fallen enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 留意倒下敌人所掉落的维生模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Extraction is available, if you need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 撤离点开放了，必要时可以撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: When you are ready, go to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 准备好后，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: When you need it, extraction is ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 撤离点已就绪，随时可以撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Critical life support levels. Extraction is your best option.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 维生装置快撑不住了，现在撤离是最稳妥的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: You are running out of time. Consider extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 时间不多了，最好赶紧撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Tenno, extraction is ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: Tenno，现在可以撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: I've delivered a life support capsule to the area. Activating it will buy you more time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 我在你附近投放了维生装置。激活它，能为你争取更多时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: The raid is off to a successful start.
