/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 这次行动开局顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: The operative has just made their first discovery. Keep up the good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 特工已经有了第一项发现，再接再厉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Our operative is making progress. This will help our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 特工取得了巨大进展，这个消息真是振奋人心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: The spores have almost completely saturated the atmosphere. You need to get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 空气中的孢子浓度已接近饱和，你必须马上离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Spore saturation is nearing critical mass, after that point no amount of life support will save you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 孢子浓度已逼近临界值，请迅速撤离，否则再多维生装置也无力回天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: You must provide cover for a lone Tenno operative. Set off the alarms and keep these infested busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 你要为一名孤军深入的 Tenno 特工提供掩护。去触发警报，牵制住这些感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Distract the Infested while a lone Tenno operative hunts for supplies. Set off the alarms to start.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 一名独自行动的 Tenno 特工正在搜寻补给。你来协助牵制感染者。去触发警报，开始行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Additional life support has arrived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 新的维生装置已经抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Another life support capsule is now available.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 另一个维生装置也能用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: I've delivered another life support capsule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 我又投放了一个维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Look what our Tenno operative just found. They could not do this without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 看看这名特工找到了什么。这可有你一半功劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: We will all share in this bounty. Hold out as long as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 这些收获人人有份。尽可能多坚持一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: The longer you fight, the more successful we will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 你坚持得越久，我们的收获就越多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: A lone Tenno operative is raiding this ship for supplies, you are here to distract the enemy. Trigger the alarm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 一名 Tenno 特工正在这艘飞船上独自搜刮补给。你的任务是牵制敌人​​，去触发警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Your job is to distract the enemy while a fellow Tenno operative raids the ship for much needed supplies. Make your presence known.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 你的任务是转移敌人的注意力，掩护这名特工搜寻这艘飞船上的补给。让他们知道你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Keep the enemy busy while a fellow Tenno operative raids this ship for supplies. Ready? Trigger the alarms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 缠住敌人，好让 Tenno 特工搜刮飞船上的资源。准备好了吗？触发警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Life support has been cut off. They're trying to choke you out. Hold on, I'm sending auxiliary life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 维生装置被切断了，敌人打算让你窒息而死。撑住，我正在投放辅助维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: They have just shut down all systems. I'm sending life support capsules your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 他们关闭了所有维生装置，我这就把维生装置给你送过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Thirty seconds left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 还剩 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: You are running out of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 你快没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Thirty second warning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 30 秒倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Tenno, you've found a Bypass. Use it on a console to give our operative a boost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: Tenno，你找到了速通装置。将它接入控制台，加快特工的行动进度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: That's a bypass. It will suspend security measures for our operative and hasten their work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 是速通装置。它能暂时解除针对特工的安保措施，加快特工的行动进度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: A bypass! Use that at a console to help our operative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置！将它接入控制台，协助我方特工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: You found a Bypass. Put it in a console to briefly disable security protections.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 你找到了速通装置。将它接入控制台，暂时解除安保措施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Bypass activated. Our operative is working double time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已激活。我们的特工在快马加鞭地行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: A bypass has been utilized. The operative is moving faster already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已生效。特工的行动进度正在加快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: A bypass has lowered security barriers slowing our operative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已暂时解除拖慢特工行动的安保措施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Bypass utilized. That will speed things up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已启用。行动进度可以加快了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Security bypass activated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 安保速通装置已激活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Bypass online. Our lone Tenno operative is working faster than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已接入。独自行动的 Tenno 特工正以前所未有的速度推进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Bypass activated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 速通装置已激活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Security bypass initiated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 安保速通装置已启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.text: Our operative has just been aided by a security bypass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DSu.zhText: 安保速通装置已生效，特工的行动速率获得提升。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: The longer you hold out, the deeper I can search, but if you need to leave, extraction is ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 你坚持的时间越长，我可以搜寻得越深，但如果你需要离开，撤离点也已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: The Grineer and Corpus came here in search of treasure but only found oblivion. They are trespassers here. You are not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: Grineer 和 Corpus 来这寻找宝藏，却得到了被吞没的下场。对这里来说，他们是闯入者。而你不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text:
Tenno,

Lua has felt my touch as I have felt its in return. Rescuing Lua - and you - from the Void may be changing this place. The Void stirs and shakes Lua to its core... exposing ancient halls long since abandoned. 

Smelling possible treasure, the Grineer Worm Queen ordered her troops to descend upon these newly exposed halls. They were instantly Corrupted by its long dormant Orokin Neural Sentry. 

The secrets that lie buried here are yours, not theirs. 

Infiltrate the Yuvarium and Circulus, survive the Corrupted and we will reclaim those secrets together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText:
Tenno，

月球感受到了我的触摸，就像我也感受到了它的。从虚空中拯救月球……和你，可能会彻底改变这个地方。虚空搅乱了月球核心……那些早已废弃的古老大厅重见天日。

嗅到此地潜藏宝藏的 Grineer 蠕虫女王命令她的军队突袭这些重现的大厅，却被在此休眠已久的奥罗金神经哨卫堕化了。

埋藏在这里的秘密是属于你的，而不是他们的。

潜入 Yuvarium 和 Circulus ，躲过堕落者的杀戮，我们将一起夺回这些秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: We have only scratched the surface. This place holds many more secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 我们只是触及了冰山一角。这个地方隐藏着更多的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: It's as if The Void wants us to find this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 仿佛虚空希望我们发现这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: This is yours by right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 这是你应得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: As Lua kept you safe in the dark age that followed the fall, it kept this hidden for you to find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 如同月球在奥罗金帝国衰败之后的黑暗时期保护你一样，它把这个地方藏起来是为了让你去发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: The treasures of the Orokin. Put them to better use than they did, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 奥罗金的宝藏。Tenno，把它们用在不同于以往的正面用途上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Long ago, one of your kind put an end to that final, desperate Continuity Ceremony. Her essence may still be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 很久以前，你们中的一个人结束了最后一场令人绝望的延续仪式。而她，可能还在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Lua rumbles. The Void exposes old scars and revives forgotten secrets. Survive against the Corrupted onslaught. I will recover what I long believed lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 月球在轰鸣。虚空暴露了旧伤疤，唤醒了被遗忘的秘密。在堕落者的攻击中幸免于难。我会找回我原以为已经失去的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Lua stirs, and lost, ancient chambers emerge from her ruin. Advance into this blasphemous space so that I may unearth what was buried so long ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 月球在翻搅，古老的大厅从她的废墟中显现。进入这个亵渎神明的空间，以便我可以挖掘出埋藏已久的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Lua kept you safe after the fall... but she wasn't always kind to the Tenno. When the Void Conjunction reached its peak... terrible things happened. If you are willing, we can uncover what was lost to the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 月球曾在奥罗金帝国衰败之后保护了你……但她对 Tenno 战士不再友善。当虚空联结达到顶峰时……可怕的事情发生了。如果你愿意，我们可以一起揭开过往所失之物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: The Orokin Neural Sentry is attempting to purge you from this place. Stand by for Life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 奥罗金神经哨卫正试图将你从这个地方清除出去。等待生命补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Tenno, if you have a Necramech, this would be an excellent place to deploy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: Tenno 战士，如果你有殁世机甲，这里将是部署它的好地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: All manner of Orokin technology may work here due to the Circulus' proximity. If you have a Necramech, you may use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 由于靠近 Circulus，所有形式的奥罗金技术都能在这儿发挥作用。如果你有殁世机甲，你可以使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Tenno - the Void has summoned a new presence, and it craves our Life Support. Destroy these manifestations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: Tenno 战士——虚空召唤了一个新存在体，它急需我们的维生装置。摧毁这些显化者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Void signatures, but outside the Corrupted. They are draining your Life Support, and fast. Eliminate them quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 虚空的痕迹，是独立于堕落者之外的存在。它们正在耗尽你的维生装置，速度极快。快消除它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: These manifestations, they aren't from the Neural Sentry. Destroy them - they are drawing from your Life Support!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 这些显化者，不是出自神经哨卫的手笔。摧毁它们——它们正在汲取你的维生装置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: These 'manifestations' must not be allowed a foothold on Lua. Life Support is at risk - destroy them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 绝不能允许这些"显化者"在月球上立足。维生装置处于危险之中——快摧毁它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Void manifestations, drawn to this cursed place of stolen lives. They will drain your life support unless they are destroyed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 这些虚空显化者，被吸引到这个丧失生机的诅咒之地。除非被摧毁，否则它们会耗尽你的维生装置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Hiding Lua in the Void risked the unfathomable. I fear we are seeing the consequences of that risk now. Destroy these Void-stained enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 将月球隐藏在虚空中有着无法估量的风险。恐怕我们现在正在目睹这种风险的后果。消灭这些被虚空洗脑的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Not since the onset of that last Void Conjunction have Tenno walked these halls. We have unfinished business here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 自从最后一次虚空联结开始以来， Tenno 战士就没有走进过这些大厅。我们在这有未完成的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: The Circulus, a Yuvan theater reserved for the mighty Seven. This is where executor Tuvul initiated the last continuity ceremony. But that was ages ago. Why is the Void surging here now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: Circulus，一个为强大的七人众保留的青春厅堂。执行者涂沃曾在这个地方发起了最后一次延续仪式。已经过去很久了。为什么虚空现在涌动得如此厉害？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Tuvul washed his hands of the Zariman after the catastrophic jump. He wanted all trace of her destroyed, including the survivors. The Tenno. Had it not been for Margulis, he would have succeeded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 涂沃在那灾难性的跳跃之后就和扎里曼号划清界线了。他要摧毁所有的痕迹，包括幸存者。也就是 Tenno 战士。如果不是 Margulis 的话，想必他早就得逞了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Lua spent so many cycles hidden in the Void. It altered her. And a Conjunction now, after so long... I cannot tell what new monstrosities could be unleashed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 月球在虚空中隐藏了这么多周期。她早已被虚空改变。现在又是一个新的联结周期，过了这么久……我不知道会释放出什么样的新怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.text: Yuvan. Continuity. Of all the evil things the Orokin perpetrated... The Seven considered this place the perfect harmony of science and dominance, but it is nothing more than a crime scene.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/DVo.zhText: 青春之躯。延续仪式。在奥罗金所犯下的所有邪恶中……七人众认为这里是科学与统治完美结合的地方，但它不过是个犯罪现场罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: We've received a message that we are to eliminate a target at this location. Carry out the assassination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 我们收到了指令，要求消灭这里的一个目标。去执行刺杀行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: It seems we'll be here a little longer. Deposit a data unit into the location's mainframe
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 看来我们得在这多待上一会儿了，将数据模块放入该设施的主机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: Change of plans, ignore your original objective. Leave nothing alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 计划有变，放弃原先的任务。歼灭所有目标，不留活口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: It appears there's some valuable intel stored here. Gather the intel now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 这里似乎存有重要情报，快去收集。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: Our mission just got more complicated. There's a hostage here. Rescue them now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 任务情况有变，这里关押了一名人质，立刻去解救他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.text: It appears we now need to sabotage this location. Destroy the Reactor Core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Dua.zhText: 看来我们还需要破坏这座设施，摧毁反应堆核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.text: You're on the sensors now. You've been detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.zhText: 感应器检测到了你，行踪暴露了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.text: Keep moving. None of the scanners have detected you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.zhText: 继续前进，扫描器还没发现你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.text: You're still in the clear. No detection from enemy sensors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.zhText: 你还没暴露，敌方感应器没发现你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Ene.text: Keep going. Nobody knows you're here.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: You're almost at the target, keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 你很靠近目标了，继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: The capture target has vital information that we will need to extract, we need our subject brought back alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 目标掌握着我们必须获得的重要情报，务必将目标活着带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: We cannot let our target know we're here. Track them down quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 不能让目标人物察觉到我们的存在，赶快找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: Scans indicate our target is in the vicinity. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 扫描显示目标就在附近，快把他们找出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: I'm still detecting a lot of infestation activity, let's clean it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 我侦测到附近还有大量感染者，把它们清除干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: There must be an access terminal around here, keep searching, we need those data units.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 这附近一定有存取终端。继续搜索，我们需要那些数据模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: Its critical that we retrieve that intel. You need to find an access terminal first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 必须回收那份情报。先找到一台存取终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: We're running out of time, you need to find all the remaining access terminal and get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 时间不多了。找到剩下的存取终端，然后撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: Keep going, we need all of the data units before you can leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 继续前进，拿到全部的数据模块才能离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: The mainframe is around here somewhere. Keep searching for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 导航系统就在附近某个地方，继续搜索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: The reactor will have tight security. Watch out for enemy patrols.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 反应堆周围必定戒备森严，注意敌方巡逻队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: Find the captive as soon as you can, we don't have much time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 尽快找到俘虏。我们的时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: We can't leave without rescuing the prisoner, keep searching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 我们不能不管人质的死活就这么离开。接着找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.text: There's no telling what the captors are doing to our rescue target, you need to find the holding cell immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Goa.zhText: 谁也说不准敌人究竟会对我们要救的人质做些什么，你必须尽快找到关押人质的牢房。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.text: Heads up. A Grineer assault team is headed your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.zhText: 注意，一支克隆尼突击部队正向你逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.text: I'm detecting a large security force heading your way. It's the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.zhText: 注意，一支克隆尼突击部队正向你逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.text: Watch yourself, foot soldiers are on the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.zhText: 当心，敌方步兵正在逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.text: You are surrounded by Grineer Marines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Gri.zhText: 你被克隆尼陆战队包围了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Hea.text: Stay focused, there's a Heavy Unit approaching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Hea.zhText: 要小心，有重型作战部队接近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: We need to clean this vessel up, search for the source of the infestation and exterminate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 我们必须清理这片区域，找到感染源头并将其根除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: The area is crawling with infested. If its not a Tenno, eradicate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 这片区域到处都是感染者。只要不是 Tenno，格杀勿论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: Multiple bio-signatures detected, we've got Infested incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 侦测到多个生物信号，感染者正在逼近。
大量感染者来袭，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: Multiple targets ahead. Leave no one standing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 前方有多个目标，消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: I'm detecting infested bio signatures all over the place. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 我侦测到周围布满了感染者的生物信号。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: The infestation has corrupted all life here, let's clear it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 病毒感染了这里的所有生物，把它们全部清除掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.text: We have got an infestation. Extermination is the only option.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Inf.zhText: 这里爆发了感染危机。唯一的办法是彻底清除威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Kil.text: There is a large platoon of Grineer Marines stationed here. Leave no one standing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Kil.zhText: 这里驻扎着一支大型克隆尼陆战队。全数歼灭，不留活口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Kil.text: All targets down. Get to extraction.
All targets eliminated. Let's get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Kil.zhText: 目标已尽数歼灭，离开这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbA.text: Alarm succesfully hacked, the location is returning to normal security levels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbA.zhText: 警报已成功解除，该区域正恢复至常规警戒状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbC.text: I'm detecting a large security force heading your way... it's the Gri...no wait, it's the Corpus. Definitely the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbC.zhText: 我侦测到一支大型安保部队正朝你逼近，是克……不，等等，是科普斯。绝对是科普斯。
更多敌人往你那边去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbD.text: Wow, they are not happy about you being here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbD.zhText: 哇喔，看来他们不是很欢迎你啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbD.text: Looks like you're on the systems now. So watch out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbD.zhText: 看来你被安保系统盯上了。当心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbS.text: Did they lock you out? That's cute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbS.zhText: 他们把你关在外头了？有点意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbU.text: Keep going. Nobody knows you're on this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/LbU.zhText: 继续前进，没人知道你上了这艘船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Loc.text: Your target is this location's computer system. Find and access the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Loc.zhText: 你的目标是这座设施的计算机系统。找到并接入那些终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Loc.text: Breach complete. We're free to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Loc.zhText: 突破完成，可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: The destruction of the Ambulas biped prototype has halted Corpus production plans for this latest model. We hope it is the only of its kind out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 「智踱恐鸟」双足原型机的毁灭，暂时中止了科普斯对这款最新型号的量产计划。希望这是唯一的一台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: The death of revered War Hero, Lech Kril will undoubtedly send shockwaves throughout Grineer society. The silencing of his hammer will bring security to this system, but we have potentially created a martyr in Kril.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 备受崇敬的战争英雄莱克·克里尔的死，势必会震动整个克隆尼社会。他的战锤终于沉寂，为这片星系带来了短暂的安宁。但我们也很可能亲手造就了一名「烈士」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Reinforcements available, do you choose to leave now or continue fighting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 援军已抵达。你可以现在撤离，也可以继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Extraction is ready. Unless you can handle more of the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 撤离点已就绪，当然，你也可以继续留下来迎战更多敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Go now Tenno. You have done well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 走吧，Tenno，你做得很棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Reinforcements are inbound. Hold the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 我们的增援马上就到，守住防线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: We are readying reinforcements. Keep fighting, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 我们正在加紧调动援兵，继续战斗，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Our position has been compromised. Defend the cargo until reinforcements arrive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 我们的位置暴露了。保护好货物，坚持到援军抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: The enemy is at our doorstep. You must defend our equipment until reinforcements arrive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 敌人已经近在眼前。你必须保护好我们的设备，坚持到援军抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Continue to defend! You will be rewarded for your bravery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 继续防守！你的英勇会得到回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Keep fighting. Another opportunity to extract will appear soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 继续战斗，很快还会有下一次撤离机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Tenno, you are but one against the horde. Your survival depends on speed. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: Tenno，你要孤身面对潮水般的敌人，能否存活全凭你的速度，上吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: A Tenno must be a master of all their weapons. Prove yourself with your primary weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: Tenno 必须精通所有武器。使用主武器来证明你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: I believe you can handle more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 我相信你还能应付更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Excellent. Continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 很好，继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Prove your ability with a sidearm. Eliminate all targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 使用副武器来证明你的实力。消灭所有目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Show me that you know of the old ways. Eliminate all targets using your melee weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 你应该知道传统的作战方式吧。使用近战武器来消灭所有目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: You have proven your skills with weapons, Tenno, but what of your endurance? Can you survive this onslaught?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: Tenno，你已经证明了自己使用武器的技巧，但是耐力呢？你能从围攻中活下来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Tenno are more than just fighters. Prove your intellect by hacking these terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: Tenno 绝不仅仅是一介武夫。黑进这些终端，证明你的智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Time to test your marksmanship. Track and shoot all targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 是时候测试一下你的枪法了。追踪并射击所有目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Your Warframe is a weapon. Prove you have mastered its power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 你的战甲就是一件武器。证明你能灵活运用它的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Now we will test your agility. Shoot the targets to create your path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 我们来测试一下你的敏捷度。射击目标，开辟出前进的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Most disappointing. Only return when you are ready for this challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 令人失望，等你做好准备迎接挑战再过来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: It appears you need more practice, Tenno. This challenge awaits you when you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 看来你还需要更多的训练，Tenno。等你准备好了，随时欢迎你再来挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: A formidable performance. This test is now complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 表现非常出色，本次试炼已完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Ready yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: This is the Foundry. Here you will build powerful new items to expand your arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 这是铸造厂，你可以在这里制作强力的新装备，不断扩充自己的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: To build an item requires a blueprint and its components. While there are blueprints in the market, most are hidden throughout the system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 制作物品需要它对应的蓝图和材料。有些蓝图可以在商店里买到，不过大部分都散落在星系各处，等待你去寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Search ships and defeat enemies to obtain components. The components found are influenced by the region of space you are in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 搜寻飞船、消灭敌人，都能获得制造所需的各种材料。不同的星区产出的材料也各不相同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: The Foundry is key to owning the most powerful weapons and artifacts that exist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 要获得强力武器和遗物，铸造厂至关重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: All data units located. Let's get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 所有数据模块都找到了，现在离开这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: There is still more data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 寻找其他数据模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: Find all the data units on this outpost. Valuable intel lies within.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 找到前哨站里所有数据模块，里面有我们需要的重要情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: The power core has been destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 能源核心已被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.text: This generator core on this outpost must be destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Lot.zhText: 务必摧毁这座前哨站的能源核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: This is a sabotage mission. Reach engineering and destroy the reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 本次为破坏任务。前往工程部，摧毁反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Our target is the reactor. Breach engineering and destroy it. Be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 我们的目标是反应堆。攻入工程部，摧毁它。小心行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Mission complete. Excellent work, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 任务完成。做得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Great work. I am pleased with your performance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 干得好。我对你的表现非常满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Another job well executed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 你再次出色地完成了任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Mission failed. The target has escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 任务失败，目标逃走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: They've got away. We have failed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 居然让他跑了，我们失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: You failed Tenno, your captive has escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: Tenno，目标逃跑了，任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: The Assassination target is nearby. Seek and destroy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 刺杀目标就在附近。找到，然后消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: The VIP that we're hunting is here, find them and take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 需要捕获的重要目标就在这儿，找到并除掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Assassination contracts are not to be taken lightly. Eliminating this target will have a significant impact on enemy forces. Search the area, leave no survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 刺杀合约不容轻视，清除目标可对敌方造成重大打击。搜索该区域，不留活口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: We've contracted you with a mark. You are here to find your mark, and eliminate the assigned target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 我们替你确认好了目标，你来这是为了找出并消灭刺杀目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: You are here to find our target and bring them to the extraction point. Happy hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 你的任务是找到目标，然后带他们前往撤离点，祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: We received intel that somebody vital to enemy operations is here. Find them, and capture them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 情报显示，有敌方重要人物就在这里，找到目标，将其捕获并带去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: You are here on a Capture mission. You must find, capture and extract our target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 这是一项捕获任务，你需要找到目标人物，捕获他们，并把他们带去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: We need to take full control here. Get to the rally point and defend it from enemy attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 我们必须掌控全局。赶往集合点，抵御敌军进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: We can't afford to lose this location. We must reach the rally point and resist all opposing forces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 绝不能丢掉这个阵地。赶往集合点，击退所有敌军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: The artifact we need is nearby, but it can't be extracted by regular means. We need to take full command here and defend the location against all attackers until an extraction crew can arrive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 附近有我们所需的遗物，但无法通过常规方式获取。我们必须夺取并控制该区域，撤退小队抵达前，守住阵地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: The intelligence files we need are in the area. Find all four computer access terminals and recover the data units from each of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 这里有我们需要的情报档案。找到全部四台电脑存取终端，从终端机逐一复原数据模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Intelligence files are stored on four separate data units in the vicinity. We need all the units before we can begin decryption on the data. Get out there and find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 情报档案分别储存于区域内四个独立的数据模块中。必须集齐所有模块，才能开始解密。出发，把它们全部找出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: We need all of the data units being stored in the vicinity. Search the area, find the access terminals, and retrieve each device.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 我们需要找到存放在附近的所有数据模块。搜索该区域，找到所有存取终端，逐一取回模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: This is a rescue mission. We need to find and liberate the hostage before any harm comes to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 我们的任务是救出人质，必须赶在人质受到伤害之前，找到并解救他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: There is a prisoner here that is vital to our operations. Search for the holding location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 这里关押着一名对我们很重要的人质。搜索这里，找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.text: Our intel suggests that our person of interest is in the vicinity. Search for the hostage, and bring them home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mis.zhText: 情报指出，我们要找的人就在附近。搜寻人质并将其安全带回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: All data logs indicate that there is an Orokin Artifact somewhere here, get to it now, defend it, and then we can leave!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 所有数据记录显示，这附近藏有一件奥罗金遗物。马上赶过去并守住它，然后我们就可以撤了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: The odds were against us, Tenno - but we did it. Mission complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: Tenno，虽然形势不利，但我们做到了。任务完成。
此区域目标完成，继续前进！
成功入侵终端机，继续行动！
这里完事了，前往下个地点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: Location reached: Drop me in and defend our position!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 已抵达目的地。把我接入终端机，守住这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: Terminal Spotted: Upload me in and prepare to defend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 发现终端机。把我接进去，然后做好防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: Here is a terminal: Get me in, and get ready to defend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 这就是终端机了。把我连上去，做好防守准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: This will only get more difficult. Get to a terminal and prepare for enemy resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 局势只会变得愈发严峻。找一台终端机，准备好应付敌人的反扑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: We have got to find a terminal. Proceed and prepare!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 我们必须要找到一台终端机，马上去做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: I need access to a terminal, find one and patch me in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 我需要接入一台终端机，找到它并帮我连进去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: Still working on it, continue to defend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 还在进行破解，继续防御！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: I'm in, Tenno. This will take a moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 我入侵进去了，Tenno。还需要一点时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: Artifact found. Defend it until the Extraction Team arrives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 找到遗物了，在撤离小队抵达前守住它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.text: This is a mobile defense mission. You must deliver payloads and defend a number of locations while I break into the network. Be prepared for heavy resistance. I can't do this without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Mob.zhText: 这是机动防御任务。你需要护送数据块送达指定位置，并在我入侵网络期间守住传输设备。准备迎接激烈的抵抗吧。没有你，我无法完成这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Nav.text: Upload completed. Nice work. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Nav.zhText: 上传成功，做得好。前往撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: They won't be bothering us anymore, let's get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 他不会再碍事了，撤离吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Nice work taking down the VIP, now get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 成功击杀重要目标，做得好！现在前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Target down, assassination contract complete. Great work, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 目标已消灭，刺杀合约完成。干得太棒了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Success! The captive is safely in our hands. Congratulations, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 成功了，他逃不出我们的手心了，干得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Mission complete, the captive has been escorted to the extraction point. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 任务完成，已成功护送俘虏抵达撤离点，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Excellent work. We'll interrogate the captive back at base. Your part is done here, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 太棒了，我们回到基地后就开始审问俘虏，你的任务圆满完成，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: That's the last of them, objective is secure. Lets go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 最后一批敌人也干掉了，目标区域安全了。我们回去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Very impressive Tenno, you held them all back. Time to get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: Tenno，干得很出色。你击退了所有敌军。该撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: We're done here. The extraction team will take over from here, time to evacuate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 我们成功了。回收小队会接手后续工作，该撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Excellent work Tenno, we've got all the data units now. Time to head for the exits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: Tenno，做得好。我们已取得所有的数据模块，是时候撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: That was the last data unit we needed. Lets get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 你拿到了最后一个数据模块。我们撤吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: With all four data units collected we can now compile the intelligence files. We're done here, get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 四个数据模块已集齐，我们现在可以着手整合情报档案了。任务完成，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Target spotted. Stay sharp, this one is a handful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 发现目标。保持警觉，这家伙十分难缠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: There is the assassination target, you know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 刺杀目标在那里，你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: You've located the VIP, time to go to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 你找到重要目标了，可以动手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Target acquired, take them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 发现目标，消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: The assassination target is here. Wipe them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 刺杀目标就在这儿。消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Here is one of the access consoles, you need to activate it to recover the data unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 这里有座存取终端。启动它，取回数据模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: You found an access terminal, use it to release the data mass from its storage unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 你找到存取终端了。操作终端机，取出储存装置中的数据模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Activate the access terminal and it should release the data unit. Get the device, and get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 启动存取终端，它应该会弹出数据模块。拿上模块，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: You've located the hostage. Escort the prisoner to the extraction point and I'll take care of the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 找到人质了，护送他去撤离点，其他事情交给我处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Subject found. You need to bring the captive to safety. Protect them at all costs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 发现目标！你无论如何都要把人质护送到安全地带。不惜一切代价保护他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.text: Prisoner located. We need to get them back to command in one piece, find your way to the exits and don't leave the subject behind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Obj.zhText: 人质已找到，你必须把他安全地送回总部，想办法找到离开这里的出口，别把人质落下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.text: Here are the holding cells. Search each one for the hostage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.zhText: 这里就是牢房了，逐个搜查，找出人质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.text: The captive will be in one of these cells. Search them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.zhText: 俘虏就在其中一间牢房里。找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.text: We've reached the prison. Find our prisoner in one of these cells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.zhText: 我们抵达监狱了。找出俘虏，他被关在某间牢房内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.text: This is the jail. Our hostage is in one of these cells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Res.zhText: 这就是监牢。我们的人质就被关在其中一间牢房里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.text: The Grineer have been harvesting a nearby planetoid for weapons-grade material. Locate and destroy their mining equipment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.zhText: 克隆尼正在邻近的小行星上开采军火级原料。找到并摧毁他们的采矿机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.text: Excellent work. You have managed to thwart potentially dangerous discoveries from being fully realized… for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.zhText: 做得好。你成功阻止了潜在的威胁变为现实……至少暂时如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.text: The mining equipment is nearby. It must be destroyed to prevent the Grineer from developing energy weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.zhText: 采矿机就在这附近。必须摧毁它，从而防止克隆尼研发出能量武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.text: This research could have unimaginable repercussions. Be on your guard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.zhText: 放任他们研究可能会造成难以想象的后果，保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.text: Mission success hinges on the destruction of the mining equipment. Expect heavy resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sab.zhText: 任务能否成功，取决于能否摧毁采矿机。准备好迎接猛烈抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: The cryogenics core has malfunctioned. Expect colder-than-normal temperatures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 飞船的低温核心发生故障，舱内温度将远低于正常水平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: I've detected freezing temperatures. The ice in here will damage your shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 检测到极寒低温。冰霜会持续侵蚀并削弱你的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: I'm detecting ice... lots of it. Be cautious, your shields will take a hit from the cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 侦测到大范围结冰现象，小心行动，低温会削弱你的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: This area has taken some hits. Stay away from fire damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 这一片受损严重。远离火焰，避免受伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: Doors are locked. Time to break in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 舱门已锁死，只能强行突破了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.text: We've been locked out. Let's override the security.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Shi.zhText: 我们被锁在外面了，覆写安保系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sys.text: Protect the relay. Running system bypass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sys.zhText: 保护好继电器，正在绕过系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sys.text: Okay, I'm in. Hold this position while I bypass the system controls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Sys.zhText: 好，我接入了。守住这里，直到我成功入侵控制系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.text: Target destroyed, proceed to the extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.zhText: 成功摧毁目标，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.text: That's it, now get out of here.
That's the reactor, expose its core and destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.zhText: 这就是反应堆，弹出它的核心，将其摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.text: Your target is the system mainframe. Deliver the payload.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.zhText: 你的目标是系统主机，将酬载送至指定位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.text: Okay, you're looking for the mainframe. It's critical that you deliver the payload to that location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.zhText: 很好，你正在寻找主机。将酬载安全送达至指定位置，这十分重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tar.text: We need to destroy the reactor.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: I am the Lotus. I will guide you but we must hurry, Vor is coming for you. I see that the cryo-sleep has taken your memory. It does not matter. You are Tenno, I will prepare you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 我的名字叫莲。我会指引你，但我们必须赶快，沃尔正赶来抓你。你在休眠过程中失去了记忆。不过没关系，你是 Tenno，我是来帮你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: I see that the cryo-sleep has taken your memory. It does not matter. You are Tenno, I will prepare you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 你在休眠过程中失去了记忆。不过没关系，你是 Tenno，我是来帮你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: I will test you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 我要考验一下你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: A Warframe shows your vital statistics. This shows your health.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 战甲会显示出你的生命体征。这里是你的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: This may hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 这可能会有点痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Now, I have engaged your shields. Shields absorb damage before health is affected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 我帮你激活了护盾。护盾会在生命值受损前优先吸收伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Notice how the shields will recharge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 注意，护盾会自动恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: I will show you the Tenno fighting system. It has three forms. The first is your blade. A Tenno's melee weapon is always with them, always at the ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 我来教你 Tenno 的战斗方式。总共分为三种，第一种是用你的利刃。Tenno 的近战武器从不离身，时刻严阵以待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: This display shows the clip size and the total ammo you have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 这里会显示弹匣容量，以及你拥有的总弹药量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Find ammo on dead enemies and in the environment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 你可以从敌人尸体和周围环境中找到弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text:
Take the ammo and reload your weapon.
Press <RELOAD> to reload.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 拾取弹药，重新装填你的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Excellent, the second form is your primary weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 很好，第二种方式是用你的主武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text:
Destroy these targets.
Press <PRE_ATTACK> to shoot.
Hold <AIM_WEAPON> to aim.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 摧毁这些目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Well done. Do you see the indicator below your weapon and Warframe? This is affinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 干得好，看到武器和战甲下方的指示条了吗？那代表经验值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: You increase affinity during combat, and in missions to come. Increase your affinity to unlock the power of your arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 你可以在战斗和后续任务中获取经验值。提升经验值可以解锁军械库中的新装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text:
Your third and final form is your secondary weapon. Switch weapons now.
Use <NEXT_INV> to switch weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 第三种，也是最后一种，用你的副武器。现在切换武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text:
Destroy this target with your blade.
Hold <NEXT_INV> to draw or sheath your melee weapon. 
Tap <MELEE> when you blade is drawn to strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText:
用你的利刃消灭这个目标。
按住 <NEXT_INV> 拔出或收起近战武器。
武器在手时，轻按 <MELEE> 挥砍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: A Tenno must use these forms in combination to destroy their enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: Tenno 必须把这些战斗方式融会贯通，才能击败敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Attack these targets using blade and gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 使用利刃与枪械，攻击这些目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Excellent. As you level, you receive points to customize your weapons and unlock Warframe powers. I will unlock a power now to demonstrate its use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 很好。随着等级提升，你将获得点数来改装武器并解锁战甲技能。我现在会先解锁一项技能，向你展示它的用法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Power consumes energy. Absorb this energy sphere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 使用战甲技能会消耗能量，吸收这颗能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: We can't afford to waste anymore time. You must get to extraction before Vor finds you. Hurry, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 不能再耽搁了。必须赶在沃尔找到你之前抵达撤离点，快，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Prove you are worthy to join us. Destroy the targets before time runs out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 在限定时间内消灭所有目标，证明你有资格加入我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: Excellent, you have attained the rank of Initiate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 很好，你的段位已晋升至「启蒙者」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: You have failed my test. Return here tomorrow, if you wish to try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 你没有通过我的试炼。如果还想挑战的话，明天再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.text: I await your return when you have learned more. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusBarks/Tut.zhText: 等你有所长进，再回来吧。我会等你的，再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: The Daughter of Hunhow seems content to guide your missions from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: Hunhow 的女儿似乎乐于在这里指导你的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: Our "guest" is still with us. I would make her more comfortable if I had the slightest idea how.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 我们的"客人"还在这里。如果我有哪怕一点点的办法，肯定会让她感觉更舒适。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: She remains as she was, Tenno. Attentive. Watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 她还是那个她，Tenno。全神贯注。时刻警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: The Cavia are wary of our visitor. I have reassured them she is to be trusted. Not that they listen to anything I have to say, mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 科维兽对我们的客人颇为戒备，我已经向它们保证她是值得信赖的。不过它们似乎不怎么理会我说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: I cannot envision the burden she has taken upon herself… nor what it is costing her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 我无法想象她所承受的重担……以及她所付出的代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: Lotus. Margulis. Natah. We live... we rise... we endure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: Lotus。Margulis。Natah。我们活着……我们崛起……我们坚守。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: Within this shell, the three of us entwine. We forge a new strength.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 在这个躯壳里，我们三人紧紧相连，共同铸就新的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: I kept vigil while you slept through the dark centuries. I can do it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 在你沉睡的那些黑暗岁月里，我守候着。我还能再做一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: I will not let It devour one instant of my pain. Not even Ballas. Not even the Jade Light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 我不会让它蚕食我任何一瞬的痛苦。无论是 Ballas，还是翠玉之光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: Lua. The miracle. Do you understand what it cost?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 月球。这个奇迹。你了解这背后的代价吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: You know what It gave. But what did you promise it in return?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 你知道它给予了什么。但你又向它承诺了什么作为回报？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: I was the Daughter. I became the Mother. In time I shall be the Witch, blind once again, empty of all but wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 我曾是女儿。后来成为了母亲。时光流转，我将变为女巫，再次失明，除了智慧，一无所有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: The system is changing. We are changing. If I become something you do not recognize, do not mourn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 星系正在演变。我们同样在变。如果我变成了你不认识的样子，不要哀悼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: I will guide you, as I always have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 我会继续指引你，如同以往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.text: It is hungry, Tenno. And I... am a distraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DL.zhText: 它饥渴难耐，Tenno。而我……只是个干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Hm? Oh. It's you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 嗯？噢。是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: This isn't just a bad memory, is it? This is new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 这不只是一段糟糕的回忆，对吗？这是新发生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: This isn't just a bad memory, is it? This is new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 这不只是一段糟糕的回忆，对吗？这是新发生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: This isn't just a bad memory, is it? This is new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 这不只是一段糟糕的回忆，对吗？这是新发生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: This isn't just a bad memory, is it? This is new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 这不只是一段糟糕的回忆，对吗？这是新发生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: I've seen that device before. Some kind of... communicator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 我以前见过那个装置。是某种……通讯装置？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: I've seen that device before. Some kind of... communicator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 我以前见过那个装置。是某种……通讯装置？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: I've seen that device before. Some kind of... communicator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 我以前见过那个装置。是某种……通讯装置？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: I've seen that device before. Some kind of... communicator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 我以前见过那个装置。是某种……通讯装置？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: It's him. I knew he'd come after you next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 是他。我就知道他接下来会来找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: It's him. I knew he'd come after you next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 是他。我就知道他接下来会来找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: It's him. I knew he'd come after you next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 是他。我就知道他接下来会来找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: It's him. I knew he'd come after you next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 是他。我就知道他接下来会来找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Easy. You're scaring the kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 放轻松。你吓到孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Easy. You're scaring the kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 放轻松。你吓到孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 放轻松。你吓到孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Whatever this is, I'm not leaving you alone with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 无论这是什么，我都不会让你一个人面对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Whatever this is, I'm not leaving you alone with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 无论这是什么，我都不会让你一个人面对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Whatever this is, I'm not leaving you alone with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 无论这是什么，我都不会让你一个人面对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Whatever this is, I'm not leaving you alone with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 无论这是什么，我都不会让你一个人面对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: D'you mind explaining exactly what you mean by that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你介意解释一下你的意思是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: D'you mind explaining exactly what you mean by that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你介意解释一下你的意思是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: D'you mind explaining exactly what you mean by that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你介意解释一下你的意思是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: D'you mind explaining exactly what you mean by that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你介意解释一下你的意思是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: You, my child. The Great Indifference wants to take. I want to let it. I feel... only the call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你，我的孩子。强大的虚空无情之物想要夺取。我想放手。我感觉到的……只有呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: You, my champion. Please. Drown out that noise that beckons. If any other answers the call... no. It has to be you. Our paradox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你，我的勇士。请压下那呼唤的噪音。若其他人回应那呼唤……不。非你莫属。我们的悖论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Who's there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 谁在那里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Is someone hiding?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 有人躲起来了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Show yourself, bloody coward!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 出来吧，你这个该死的胆小鬼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Who's stealin' my things?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 谁偷了我的东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Eleanor? I swear on it. Stop making my head hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 埃莉诺？我发誓。别再让我头疼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: My head, ugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 我的头，呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text: Do you hear it? The calls of angels, devils, life itself? It's grown so loud. It tries to follow in his footsteps through time. You must find him first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText: 你听见了吗？是天使、魔鬼、还是生命本身的呼唤？声音愈发响亮。它正试图跟随他的脚步穿越时空。你必须先找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.text:
[1.2]
Tenno,
[8.6]
None of us could hear the Device that was calling from the abyss of history.
[16.5]
The Daughter of Hunhow heard it, and almost succumbed to its call.
[23.2]
She raised her voice in song to drown it out, and that we did hear.
[29.7]
I should have known she was waiting for you.
[40.0]
You answered a call and in a way, found an answer. For me.
[46.8]
The time is almost right to finish the Kalymos Sequence.
[51.5]
I will soon be able to send you to the city-state of Höllvania,
[56.0]
in the plague year of 1999 - a most perilous time.
[58.3]
Without your equipment, you would surely perish.
[67.2]
Luckily, the Vessels have a connection to Albrecht's "volunteers" that I believe I can exploit.
[71.5]
You will not arrive unarmed, nor unarmored.
[74.5]
We won't be late!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LotusEaters/DO.zhText:
[1.2]
Tenno，
[8.6]
我们无人能听见那来自历史深渊的装置的呼唤。
[16.5]
但 Hunhow 的女儿听到了，差点被其吸引。
[23.2]
她用歌声掩盖了呼唤，而我们听见了她的声音。
[29.7]
我早该知道她在等你。
[40.0]
你回应了那个呼唤，也以某种方式，为我，找到了答案。
[46.8]
完成卡利莫斯序列的时刻快要到了。
[51.5]
我很快就能把你送到霍瓦尼亚市了，
[56.0]
那是瘟疫肆虐的 1999 年，那是一个极其险恶的时代。
[58.3]
如果没有你的装备，你肯定会丧命。
[67.2]
幸运的是，承载者与阿尔布雷希特的"志愿者"有某种联系，我相信我可以利用这一点。
[71.5]
你到达时，你将不会手无寸铁，也不会身无铠甲。
[74.5]
我们不会晚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: That bypass will hasten recovery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 那个速通装置将加快恢复速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: A bypass? That will speed my work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 一个速通装置？它能加快我的工作进程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Use that bypass at a console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 在控制台上使用那个速通装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Thank you for the help, Tenno, you've cleared a path for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: Tenno，感谢你的帮助，你为我清除了障碍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: I see clearly now, Tenno. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: Tenno，我现在看得清楚了。继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Well done. Bypass used.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 干得漂亮。已使用速通装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Don't worry; I'll take very good care of Voruna. I have just the spot in the kennel for her!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 别担心；我会好好照顾 Voruna 的。我家狗窝里正好有她的位置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: The Queens have sought out Warframes before. Vor sought to present them with yours. We cannot let the Worm have Voruna.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 女皇们曾经寻觅过战甲。沃尔一度试图将你的战甲呈献给她们。我们不能让蠕虫获得 Voruna。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Look at that; more kibble for the Drahks! Save some for me, puppies! Ahhhooooo!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 看看那个；更多爪喀的口粮！小狗们，给我留点！啊啊哦哦哦！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Worm Queen. Even as the neural sentry corrupts her best troops, she continues to send more. What is she after?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 蠕虫女皇。即使神经哨卫堕化她最强的军队，她依旧派出更多。她想干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: There you are... I think it's time we put a collar on you... Phh... Wait. You'd probably like that, wouldn't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 你来了……我觉得是时候给你套个项圈了……噗……等等。你会喜欢的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Worm has no compassion for her troops. She orders more to this place even though the Neural Sentry will surely corrupt them, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 蠕虫对她的部队毫无同情心。她命令更多军队到这个地方，即使神经哨卫注定也会把他们堕化掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Pick a card, Dreamer! The 'asphyxiation of hearts'. Lucky draw!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 抽一张卡，梦回者！是"窒息之心"。手气真好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: We are being observed. The Worm Queen wishes to gloat. Her troops are no longer her own, but she cares little for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 我们正在被监视。蠕虫女皇想幸灾乐祸。她的军队不再属于她，而她却并不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Alright tube-mutts, let's give our little rabbit a wee head start... and then off we go, hounds! (Woof! woof!)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 好吧，试管笨蛋，咱们让小兔子先跑一下下……猎犬们，咱们跟着就出发！ （汪！汪！）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: The Worm Queen has no control over the Corrupted. It is enough for her that they are hostile to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 蠕虫女王虽然无法控制堕落者。但是，他们对我们有敌意对她来说就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Poor Tuvul. Lost respect of the pack, so they did what I'd do... nom nom nom nom!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 可怜的涂沃。失去了狼群对他的尊重，所以它们做了我也会做的事……咀嚼美味！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: If only my sister could have seen this mess. She might have listened to me! You're a nightmare for the world, aren't you, Dreamer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 要是我姐姐能看到这个烂摊子就好了。她早该听我的话了！梦回者，你是世界的噩梦，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: I tried to tell her. Dreamers are a bad, bad continuity... better for biscuits than skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 我试着告诉她。梦回者是一种很坏，很坏的延续……用来当饼干总比当皮囊好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Big mommy never told you about the Yuvans, did she? Mmm-hmmm. Dreamers lining up to be skin. Not my thing, though. Too much baggage, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 老妈子从来没跟你提过青春之躯的事吧？嗯嗯。梦回者排着队成为皮囊。不过我不感兴趣。情感包袱太重了，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Oh. Looks like musty ol' Drusus neglected to mention a few things about Void Conjunctions... safety not guaranteed. HAHA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 哦。看起来老东西德枢忘了说一些关于虚空联结的事情……那就是安全无法保障。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: If only my dear sister were here. It would have warmed her heart to consume a child in this sacred place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 要是我亲爱的姐姐在就好了。在这个神圣的地方吞噬一个孩子会温暖她的心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: A lovely little song... all for me! Did it drown out the desperate barking from the friends you left behind, Dreamer? Sit, Voruna, Sit! Hahaha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 一首可爱的小曲……都是为我而作！梦回者，它是否压过了被你抛弃的朋友们的绝望吠叫？坐下，Voruna，坐下！哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.text: Look who showed up to the Void Conjunction. Now you wanna be a skin donor? Too late, Yuvan. You're not wanted anymore. Because you're bitter. And jealous. And ugly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoid.zhText: 看看谁出现在虚空联结。现在你想成为皮囊的捐赠者？太迟了，青春之躯。再也没人需要你了。因为你怨毒、嫉妒、而且很丑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.text: No no. I insist, you first.
If you insist. How kind, how very kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.zhText: 如果你坚持的话。真是体贴，多么体贴啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.text: Kind? You must be thinking of my sister.
Where is the fair lady, then? Should we deal her in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.zhText: 那么，这位女士在哪里呢？我们要把她加进来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.text: Well... she sort of lost her head the last we played...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.zhText: 她哦……上次我们玩的时候她有点丢了脑子……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.text: My Queen! The... The Drahk g-grow restless! Where are we to hunt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LuasPrey/DVoru.zhText: 我的女皇！爪喀...... 爪喀们变得焦躁不安！我们要去哪里猎杀？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: More Resonators means a bigger pulse field means a bigger headache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 更多的共鸣者，意味着更强大的脉冲场，也意味着更大的麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Every Resonator pushes the pulse field out wider, and we do not want that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 每个共鸣者都会使脉冲场扩散到更远的范围，而这不是我们想要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: There were four of us. Barroc, Kailen, Mutaru and me, patching ruptures on a rust bucket of a Railjack off the Delta Proxima. I remember our first sight of a Sentient Murex… Eh, maybe some other time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 曾经我们四个人，巴罗克、凯伦、穆塔鲁，还有我，正在三角比邻星域为一艘锈迹斑驳的航道星舰修补破损。我记得我们第一次见到 Sentient 骨螺战舰是什么样……呃，也许下次再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: One day you're a Railjack gunner, riding high and proud. The next you're a broken man on a Xenorhast bier, telling war stories to Tenno who politely pretend to listen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 前一天，你还是一名骄傲且自豪的航道星舰炮手。第二天，你就成了异源石棺材上的一个破碎的人，向假装在认真倾听的礼貌 Tenno 讲述着战争故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Not sure how much longer I can keep the lid on the mech project. She's not said anything, but I'm pretty sure she suspects.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 不知道我还能在机甲项目上隐瞒多久。她什么都没说，但我很确信她对此怀疑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You tried the Bonewidow yet? One of the most fearsome tools I've ever constructed. Cold, cutting, ruthlessly efficient. Based her on my wife.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你试过骨骸寡妇吗？我建造过的最可怕的工具之一。冷酷、尖刻、无情高效。以我妻子为她的原型。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Ballas, huh? Who would have known. Who… would… have… known.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: Ballas，是吗？谁会知道。谁……会……知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: I think my wife's clinging on to the idea we'll all just jump into new bodies one day. Would be nice. She sure made a mess of mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 我想我妻子一直坚信，有一天我们会跳入到新的身体里。真那样那就好了。她的确已把我的身体弄得一团糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: All done. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 圆满完成。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: That wraps it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 就这样结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Good work back there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 刚刚做的真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix incoming. Every one gives them more control. Make them think twice, and don't be afraid to bail when you have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇来袭。每一艘都会带给它们更多控制力。让它们三思而后行，并且紧要关头不必担心撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Sentient control will increase with every Orphix. If it tops out, you get out. Until then, fill every golden moment with sweet slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: Sentient 控制力会随着每个奥影母艇的出现而增加。如果它达到顶点，你就得撤离。在此之前，充分利用每一秒来对敌人大杀特杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Gloves are off now, kids. Beat them back as best you can. If they get the upper hand, get the hell out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 孩子们，大战在即。尽你最大努力击退它们。如果他们占据了上风，那就赶紧撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: That mech's still functional! Hop on board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 那台机甲还能运作！登舰吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Reckon you could get that mech up and running again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 我想你可以让那台机甲重新运作起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: That mech may not be in prime condition but we do not have time to be fussy. Go ahead, use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 那台机甲可能不在最佳状态，但我们没有时间去挑三拣四。去吧，就用它了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Damn fine work. Clock off any time you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 工作完成地真不赖。你准备好后可以随时撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Well done. Head on through to extraction when you feel the need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 做得好。当你觉得需要时便前往撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You can come out now, if you've had enough fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 如果你玩够了，现在就可以撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You are cutting it too damn fine. Get to Extraction. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你把时间卡得可太紧了。前往撤离点。现在就去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: So help me I will come down there and drag you to Extraction myself. MOVE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 所以我向老天发誓，我会下到那里，并亲自把你带到撤离点。快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: What are you doing, admiring the drapes? Time to move! Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你在做什么，欣赏窗帘？时间到了！出发吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Message reached you, huh? Good. Listen, a Necramech is not bright. They're not like Sentients. They can't learn squat. Sentients adapt to their attacks pretty quick. But hose a Sentient down with that Tenno hoodoo beam of yours, and all that adaptive resistance just burns clean off. Might want to remember that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你收到消息了，对吧？很好。听着，殁世机甲并不聪明。他们不像 Sentient。他们什么都学不会。Sentient 很快就能适应他们的攻击。但如果通过你的 Tenno 禁术光束来冲洗一下 Sentient ，所有的适应抗性都会被清除，你最好记住这这点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Going up against Orphix, you'll likely come away with your little hands full of Phasic Cells. Now, I can use those - probably the only person in the System who can! - so we can trade. I've been keeping some special stuff in reserve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 在对抗奥影母艇时，你很可能会带着许多相位电池满载而归。现在，我可能是星系中唯一一个可以使用它们的人！所以我们可以进行交易。我一直保留着一些特殊物品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Got an Orphix! It will boost the pulse field with Resonators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 有一艘奥影母艇！它会通过共鸣者增强脉冲场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: There's our problem! An Orphix. Soon it'll spread the pulse field wider.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 我们的麻烦来了！一艘奥影母艇。很快它就会使脉冲场扩散得更远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Back in the Old War, Orphix Sentients would hit us with pulses. Shut down anything more sophisticated than a lump hammer. Well, the Orphix are back. Only this time, someone's taught them how to override your Warframes. If they spread to cover the whole System, you're all shiny hat stands. The Orokin claimed Necramechs weren't smart enough to face an enemy that could learn, and retired them early. But my boneheads shrug off Sentient pulses like the morning dew. So I reckon between your frames and my old dusted-off war rigs, we might just have a hope in hell. Come see me on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 在过去远古之战的时候，Sentient 奥影母艇会用脉冲对付我们。只要是比锤子更精密复杂的东西都失去作用。好吧，奥影母艇又回来了。只不过，这次有人教会了他们如何控制你的战甲。如果他们扩散到了整个星系，你们就会成为活靶子。奥罗金人声称殁世机甲不够聪明，不足以面对具备学习能力的敌人，并早早淘汰了它们。但我的傻子们却对 Sentient 脉冲没有丝毫反应。所以我想，凭借你的战甲和我的老式锐将，我们可能还有一丝胜算。到火卫二来见我一面吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: I speak for myself. No. I am the hollow vessel. The echo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 我说的是我自己。不。我是个躯壳。回声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Sentient as we, as they are not. Simple. It is not simple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 我们是 Sentient，他们不是。就那么简单。却不那么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: The steel vipers sleep now, I showed them how. I... had my reasons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 这些钢铁蝰蛇睡着了，是我教他们的。我……有我的理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: I sing. No. The wind sings my emptiness. I am the Queen of nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 唱歌。不。风唱出了我的空虚。我是虚无的女王。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Unraveled. The serpent coilings of their genes. The secret phrases of cell and cipher. I too am encoiled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 解开了。他们的基因链如蛇形般盘绕。细胞和密码的暗号。我也深陷其中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Who woke the Orphix? Who sang the steel lullaby to the viperous children? Who?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 是谁唤醒了奥影母艇？是谁给毒蛇的孩子吟唱了钢铁催眠曲？是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix launch reinforcement across all lanes. Delta sequence A-1.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇向所有航道增援。Delta 层序 A-1。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Deploying squadron I-0-5 to attack vectors. Do not let their Old War relics interfere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 部署 I-0-5 中队攻击航道。不要让他们远古之战的老古董造成干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: M-2 protocol in effect. We require sector control. Do not let them advance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: M-2 协议生效。我们要求控制整个区域。不要让他们取得进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: All systems showing D-3 degradation. Did not anticipate Necramechs, but we will adapt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 所有系统都出现了 D-3 降级。没有预见到殁世机甲，但我们将会适应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Adapt next series. Deploying from Y-4 quadrant. We cannot be stopped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 适应下一个系列。从 Y-4 区进行部署。我们不能被阻止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix N-6 series lost. Adjusting repeater deployment algorithm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇 N-6 系列丢失。调整中继器部署算法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Entrati interference must be cross-controlled. Segment G-7 restarting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 英择谛干扰必须被交叉控制。G-7 模块重新启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Let's get their attention. That terminal. Go access it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 让我们引起他们的注意。那个终端。去访问它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Send them a wake up call. Access that terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 给它们敲响警钟。使用那台终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: There's another Orphix. Every one tightens the Sentients' grip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 还有另一艘奥影母艇。每一艘都能使 Sentient 掌控变得更牢固。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Big nasty on the scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 监测到讨厌的大家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Big old Orphix ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 前方大型的奥影母艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: As Mother would say; Kindly address the Orphix situation, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 就像"母亲"会说的那样；Tenno，请妥善解决关于奥影母艇的问题？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Sentient pulser. Wipe him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: Sentient 脉冲源。把他清除掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix just hit. Updating your map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇刚刚出现了。正在更新地图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Good job! They felt that back in Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 干得好！那些在 Tau 星系的也感受到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Bought yourself some time! Nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你给自己争取到了一点时间！不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Orphix down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Huh, that should give us some breathing space.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 嗯，那应该能给我们一些喘息的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: It's down! Good work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 它倒下了！干得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Push 'em back, one Orphix at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 击退奥影母艇，一步一个脚印地来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Letting an Orphix grow stronger just so you could feel like a hero for taking it down would be a dangerous game, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 让一艘奥影母艇变得更强后再击败它，只是为了使你觉得自己是个英雄。孩子，这会是个危险的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: An Orphix is like any other kind of personal hygiene problem. It will get worse if you ignore it. As I have been repeatedly reminded...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 奥影母艇就像任何其他类型的个人卫生问题。如果你忽视它，它将变得更糟。正如我一再被提醒的那样……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Better take down the Orphix before they get too strong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 最好是在奥影母艇过于强大之前把它们击败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Hope you're happy with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 希望你对它满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Whatever you need to keep those mechs up and running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 无论如何都要确保这些机甲正常运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Hope it makes up for the trouble you took.
