/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 希望它能弥补你遇到的麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You won't even be able to scratch that Orphix while there's Resonators nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 当附近有共鸣者时，你将无法伤害奥影母艇分毫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Get to popping Resonators. Then you can tackle the big guy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 去解决共鸣者。然后你就可以对付那个大块头了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: That's the stuff! Now hit that Orphix hard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 就是这个玩意！现在给我狠狠攻击奥影母艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You got him vulnerable. Dish out some punishment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你让他的弱点暴露无遗。给他点颜色看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Oh, that's a keeper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 哦，这是个值得保留的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Looks like you found yourself a little added value there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 看起来你在那为你自己找到了一点附加价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Look who found a new shiny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你好像找到了个闪闪发亮的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: You're losing ground, kid. Think about getting out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 孩子，你在失去地面控制。考虑一下撤离吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Sentients are kinda getting the advantage down there. You still good?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: Sentient 在那里取得了优势。你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Sentient control is riding pret-ty high. You comfortable with that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: Sentient 控制力上升得很高。你对此感到满意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: I cannot be held responsible for what happens if you insist on taking your Warframe into a pulse field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 如果你一意孤行，非要把你的战甲带进脉冲场，出了问题我可不负责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: Did you somehow not see that coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 你是因为某种原因而没看到它过来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.text: One more time: mechs are Sentient pulse-shielded, Warframes aren't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MechEvent/DMec.zhText: 再说一次：机甲对 Sentient 脉冲屏蔽，战甲不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Orokin sequencing medium. Pricks used it to archive everything. Memories, evidence... Warframes. The Orokin can rot in their own filth, but those Prime 'frames? They deserve to live again... and Regal Aya can make that happen. With Regal Aya, this Foundry can reconstruct you a Prime Warframe yanked straight from my time. As real as my pretty face in front of yours. No guesswork.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 奥罗金测序介质。那些混蛋用它来对一切进行存档。记忆、证据……战甲。奥罗金人可以在他们自己的污秽中腐烂，但那些 Prime 战甲？他们应该再活一次……而御品阿耶精华可以使之成为现实。有了御品阿耶精华，这个铸造厂就可以为你重建一个直接取自我那个时代的 Prime 战甲。就像我这张漂亮的脸蛋在你面前一样真实。无需臆测。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Whippings. Massacres. Executions. All their favorite memories. That's what the Orokin used those pretty Ayatans for. Channeling Aya, the essence of memory. I just love watching Maroo melt them down. Erasing the Orokin, piece by piece. Some things deserve to be forgotten. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 鞭笞。屠杀。处决。全部是他们最喜欢的记忆。这就是那些漂亮的阿耶檀识宝物对奥罗金人的用途。引导阿耶精华，记忆的精华。我只是喜欢看着 Maroo 把它们融化。逐个剔除奥罗金印记。有些事情应该被遗忘。永远遗忘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: We're on the verge of war. Take your sweetness where you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 我们正处于战争的边缘。尽力享受你的甜蜜时光吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Ha, look at you, looking so fine. No wonder your uncle Teshin's proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 哈，看看你，看上去真不错。难怪你的 Teshin 大叔很自豪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Inventory, secrets and scars. No need to put them all on display.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 仓库、秘密和伤疤。无需将它们全部展示出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Aya, regular and Regal, bring it here. Ayatans to the sweet thing over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 阿耶精华，无论是普通的还是御品的，都把它带来。阿耶檀识宝物是给那边那位甜心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: The kicker isn't that you kids brought down an Empire. It's that half of you don't remember doing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 最令人惊讶的不是你们这些孩子推翻了一个帝国。而是你们中有一半人不记得自己做过这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Rumors were true. The vault of history is open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 谣言是真的。历史的宝库开启了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: After that Sentient scum nearly killed me I swore I'd never take anything for granted. Not a breath, not a wink... not a kiss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 在那个 Sentient 败类差点杀死我之后，我发誓我永远不会把任何事情视为理所当然。一次呼吸，一次眨眼，一个吻……都不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Tempting Old War treasures on display.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 诱人的远古之战珍品展示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Keep it moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 继续往前走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: It's fine if all you want is a training Warframe, instead of a Prime. We all start somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 如果你想要的只是一款训练用的战甲，而不是一款 Prime 战甲，那也没什么。我们都是从某处开始的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Whatever Tenno and Dax may have been to one another in the past, that's in the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 无论 Tenno 和禁卫在过去有什么纠葛，那都是过去的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Enjoy your future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 享受你的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Make me proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 让我感到骄傲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Don't let your uncle Teshin down, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 可别让你那个 Teshin 大叔失望啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Well... good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 好吧……祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Don't go leaving anything unsaid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 有话就说，说完再走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Ah, kid. I'd trade all this Prime gear for a few shards of seriglass, a hammer, and five minutes alone with whatever gilded bastard gave the Sentients the key to the Reservoir. Erra hurt me. But if you kids hadn't showed up, he'd have killed me... and in my book, that means I owe ya. So. Here I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 啊，孩子。我愿意用所有这些 Prime 装备来换取几块玻璃窗碎片、一把锤子，以及和那个把储梦池钥匙交给 Sentient 的镀金混蛋单独相处五分钟的机会。Erra 伤害了我。但如果你们这些孩子没有出现，他就会杀了我……并且在我看来，这意味着我对你们有所亏欠。这就是为什么我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Tenno. Remember me? We never got introduced. Name's Varzia. Former Dax. Was on ice 'til our mutual friend over there popped my pod. Wasn't too happy about waking up with all my friends dead... and a headache bigger than Hunhow's ass hahaha, but a looker as sweet as Maroo... yeah, can help you forget anything. Huh... You're not here for my life story. You're hunting antiquities, right? Primes. I can make that happen, if you bring me Aya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Tenno，还记得我吗？我还没做自我介绍呢。我叫瓦奇娅，以前是个禁卫。在我们共同的朋友将我从冷冻舱中拽出来之前，我一直处于冷冻状态。我很气愤，醒来时我所有的朋友都死了……而且头痛得就像是被 Hunhow 撕裂一样，哈哈。但有 Maroo 这么可爱的人陪伴我……嗯，可以帮我忘掉任何烦心事。啊哈……你可不是来听我那些悲情往事的。你在搜寻远古遗物，对吧？Prime 装备，只要你给我带来阿耶精华，我就能帮你搞到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Alrighty. Let's make some memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 好的。让我们来创造一些回忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Been behaving yourself?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你有一直乖乖守规矩吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: You have my attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你引起了我的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Let's see who we can dredge up from the dim, dark past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 让我们看看能从暗淡无光的过去中挖出谁来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Can't ever be sure what I'll trawl up. Seems to come in waves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 永远无法确定我将会钓起什么。它们似乎是一波接一波的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Now here's a Tenno who looks after their frames.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 哦，这才是个好好照管着战甲的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Stand up straight, now. Let me look at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 现在，立正站好。让我看看你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Always feels like meeting an old friend, regardless of who's wearing them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 不管是谁穿着它们，总感觉像是见到了老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Haha, seeing one of you wearing a Prime always takes me back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 哈哈，看到你们中的谁穿着 Prime 装备总是让我想到过去的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Don't sweat the Dax thing. My oaths died with the Golden Lords. Looking this good in uniform, ah is just a bonus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 不用在意我的禁卫身份。我的誓言早就和那些黄金之主一起灭亡了。穿上制服让我显得好看，那不过是它的附加值罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Teshin. I dunno if I wanna slam him against a wall or have him slam me against one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Teshin。真不知道是该让我把他抵在墙上，还是他把我抵在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Time was I'd have had a thief like Maroo up on multiple charges. Won't be slapping cuffs on her now. Unless she wants me to, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 如果是过去，我会指控一个像 Maroo 那样犯下很多事的窃贼。不过现在我并不准备把她铐起来。当然，除非她主动找上我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Teshin's chapter-and-verse, until he gets his weapon in his hand. I never got tired of watching that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Teshin 做事总是按部就班，直到他把武器握在手里。看到他这样我从来不会感到厌倦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: You could live a thousand years and never wake to a face like hers. I slept a thousand, and look what I got. What do you think? A career con like her and an old Dax like me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你可以活上一千年，并且永远不会醒来看到一张像她这样的脸。我睡了一千年，看看我得到了什么。你的看法是什么？一个像她这样的职业骗子和一个像我这样的老禁卫？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: 'S weird. I barely remember the faces of the Seven. But that black-sash Yaskutai who served our mess table? Ha, every little bead of her sweat stands out like a diamond in my mind...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 真奇怪。我几乎不记得七人众的脸了。但对于那个为我们餐桌服务的黑腰带管家？哈，她的每一滴汗珠都像钻石一样闪耀在我的脑海中……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Teshin's like his blade, if you ask me. Cold, hard, and in desperate need of a good grinding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 如果你问我的话，Teshin 就像他的刀刃一样。冰冷、坚硬，亟需好好"打磨"一番。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: We need to be ready for the Sentients this time. I already got out of one coffin. So no stinking machine is going to put me in another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 这次我们需要为应对 Sentient 做好准备。我已经死里逃生过一次了。所以我不会让自己再次陷入类似的险境中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: My time is past, but damn, I miss the heft of a weapon... the stench of superheated plasma. Uh, I'd be fighting alongside you if I didn't have this thieving little miscreant to watch over. You can bet on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 我的时代已经过去了，但该死的，我怀念武器的重量……超热等离子的臭味。呃，如果我不需要看守这个小贼，我会和你并肩作战。这点你无需置疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Not looking to settle any old scores with your kind, Tenno. Working with Aya... I saw the way your amps carved people I loved in two. Don't think I didn't. But... we're all different people now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Tenno，不是想和你的同类清算任何旧账。通过阿耶精华……我看到了你们的增幅器是如何把我所爱的人们一分为二的。别以为我不知道。但是……我们现在都改变了不少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: I wear the uniform because I believe in the principles we died for. But the day will come when I take it off and lay it to rest. Hahaha, and, if I'm too bloody-minded, hopefully some pretty thing is there to do it for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 我穿制服是因为我相信我们为之牺牲的原则。但总有一天，我会把它脱下来并把它束之高阁。哈哈哈，另外，如果我实在是放不下这些的话，希望某位帅哥美女可以助我一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: You know how it is to serve in silence. We SAW things. The Yuvan Theatre. The Naberus Revels. Not the kind of things you can... convey... to people who just weren't there. Am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你知道只干活不出声是怎么回事。我们看到了一些东西。青春厅堂。纳贝流士狂欢夜。不是那种你可以……传达……给不在现场的人的东西。我说的对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Not sure I should let you handle these goods with all that Orokin blood on your hands. Kidding! I'm glad they're dead and I hope it hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 我不确定我是否应该让你那沾满了奥罗金之血的双手摸到这些货物。我开玩笑的！我很高兴他们死了，并且我希望他们死得很痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: I see there's been a whole lot of... valiant attempts to make Frames up to the Prime standard since my time. Bless them. They did the best they could with what they had.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 从我所处的年代开始，我已经看到有许多……勇敢的尝试，以使战甲达到 Prime 的标准。我很同情他们。他们已经竭尽全力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: You're not going to settle for a rank-and-file Warframe, are ya? Not when you could have Vanguard class?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你不会满足于一件普通战甲，是吗？尤其是当你可以获得先锋级战甲的时候？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: The Orokin were inhumane scum. The absolute dregs. But sweet tender mercy, could they design. The Primes they created have never been matched.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 奥罗金人是惨无人道的人渣。绝对的渣滓。但他们的设计却又巧夺天工。他们所创造的 Prime 装备向来无可比拟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Primes were reserved for the Prime Vanguard. The best of the best, and the rest... are adequate, I guess. If you're satisfied with merely adequate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Prime 装备是预留给 Prime 先锋部队的。王牌中的王牌，而剩下的……我想是足够了。如果你仅仅满足于足够的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: When your life's on the line and you're staring down that raging Eidolon, nothing will keep you in one piece better than a Prime. If you value your shiny ass, bring me that Aya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 当你命悬一线，并且久久凝视着狂暴的夜灵时，没有什么能比 Prime 装备更能让你保持完整性。如果你惜命的话，就把那个阿耶精华带给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others earned it. Ballas never told the whole truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 有些战甲从一开始就是 Prime 级别的。其余的则是靠自身努力赢得的。Ballas 从未全盘说出过真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: I was looking for Old War Treasures when I dug Varzia's pod up. Guess I found one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 当我挖到瓦奇娅的冷冻舱时，我正在寻找远古之战的宝藏。我猜，这也算是找到宝了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: That's Varzia all right: Bouncer, trader and tourist attraction all in one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 这就是瓦奇娅：保镖、商人和观光景点集于一身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Feels a lot safer with Varzia around... but that Dax helmet of hers leaves me feeling like I'm about to get busted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 有瓦奇娅在身边感觉安全多了……但她戴的禁卫头盔让我觉得我快要被打坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Never thought I'd be the type to settle down. Maybe you just have to dig up the right person.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 从未想过我会是安定下来的那类人。或许你只需要找到对的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Sure, Varzia's pretty amazing. Why? Has she said something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 当然，瓦奇娅非常了不起。怎么了？她有说过什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Having trouble handling the irony that someone who was once so much about rules… could be about to have me break mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 讽刺的是，一个曾经如此热衷于规则的人……可能会让我打破规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: There's wrong, there's right, and then there's me and Varzia. Is wrong-right a thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 有错的，有对的，然后是我和瓦奇娅。错对是一回事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Good. Don't rush into things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 很好。不要急于求成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: The circling hawk may choose its prey at leisure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 盘旋的老鹰可以随意选取它的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: In your own time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 你慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Damn. Sure I can't tempt you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 啧。难道你对我推荐的货一点儿都不感兴趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Ah, no pressure, but this stuff might not be here next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 啊，没事的，不过这东西下次可能就不在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Save your shot until you're sure of your target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 确定目标后再开枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: You choose when you're good and ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 等你想清楚了再做决定吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Let's talk about the good stuff. For old time's sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 让我们来聊聊好东西吧。看在过去的份上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: The Prime Vanguard. The Pride of Empire. And the end of it. Hell of a thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Prime 先锋部队。帝国的骄傲。也是它的终结。他们可太厉害了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Primes. As bright as if they were forged yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: Prime 装备。如此明亮，像是昨天才被锻造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: No guarantees with Void Relics. Just like life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 虚空遗物谁都说不准。就像人生一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Nothing left to chance if you're bringing Regal Aya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 有了御品阿耶精华，一切都是定数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: If you're here for Relics, you might have to crack a few before you get what you're after.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 如果你到这里是为了遗物，你可能需要打开好些个才能获得你想要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Might want to refine any Relics you get. For luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 要是希望走运的话，你可能要精炼你得到的任意遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: The Orokin made you bleed for Primes. You've bled enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 奥罗金令你为 Prime 装备而流血。你已经流得够多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: By the glory and wisdom of the Seven, yada yada yada.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 以七人众的荣耀和智慧之名，等等，等等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: From memory to reality, quick as a bowshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 从记忆到现实，快如弓箭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Ah, glad to see it back in action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 啊，看到它能重回战场，让我很是欣慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: May the Void bring you what you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 愿虚空带来你所需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Memory's a tricksy thing, but I think you'll do fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 记忆会欺骗你，但我认为你不会有事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.text: Here. Fresh from the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MegaPrimeVault.zhText: 拿去吧。这是刚出土的古董。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There's the ship, close the distance and intercept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就是眼前这艘，拉近距离，实施拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found the ship, give chase!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 找到目标了，追上去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good work. The ship is disabled. Wait… they're attacking the courier ship to keep us from it. Keep it safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 干得好。飞船已瘫痪。等等……为了不让我们得手，他们打算摧毁信使飞船。保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You disabled the courier, but this isn't over yet. They're going try to destroy it to keep it out of our hands. Do not let them succeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你让信使飞船瘫痪了，但还没结束。他们正试图毁掉飞船，避免它落入我们手中。别让他们得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: My recovery team is enroute. The Grineer will destroy the ship before they let us take it. Defend the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们的回收小队正在赶来。克隆尼会在我们攻下这艘船之前摧毁它。守住这艘飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They destroyed the courier. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们击毁了信使飞船。任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Courier destroyed, there's nothing more for us here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 信使飞船已被击毁，我们什么东西都带不走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Keep defending! My recovery team is almost there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 继续防守！回收小队即将赶到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Just a little bit longer until recovery arrives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 再坚持一会儿，回收小队马上就到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Don't let them hit the courier!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 别让他们击中信使飞船！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Slow it down, concentrate fire on its engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 集火攻击引擎，让它减速。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Aim for the engines, don't let it get away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 瞄准引擎，别让它逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The engines^ take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是引擎，摧毁引擎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Blow open those shield generators and expose the ship's vital systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 炸掉飞船的护盾产生器，让舰体的核心系统暴露出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Target the shield generators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 瞄准护盾产生器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Take out its shields by destroying the generators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 摧毁它的护盾产生器，解除护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Drones! Take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是无人机！摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Watch out for drones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 小心无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The engines are down. It's a sitting duck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 引擎已瘫痪。它现在动弹不得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Engines down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 引擎瘫痪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You took out the engines, they're not going anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你摧毁了他们的引擎，他们已经无路可逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They've repaired their engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们修复了引擎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Engines are back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 引擎重新启动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Their engines are online again, they're moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 引擎再次启动，目标正在移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Courier escaped. I'm aborting the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 信使飞船逃脱了。任务终止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The ship outran you. There's nothing more we can do here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 飞船把你甩掉了。我们无能为力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You secured the blackbox. We're all done here. Head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你拿到了黑匣子。任务完成。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We're in pursuit of a courier-class ship that is transporting material vital to our cause. Do not let it escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们正在追击一艘信使级飞船，上面载有对我们相当重要的物资。绝不能让它逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hunt down and capture this courier-class ship. We need what's inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 追上并捕获这艘信使级飞船。我们需要它载的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Generators are down, now target ship systems!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 产生器已被摧毁，现在瞄准飞船系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shields down, systems exposed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 护盾已解除，系统暴露了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're losing them. If you let the Courier get any further away, you'll have no chance of catching up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你快跟丢了。信使飞船再拉开距离，就追不上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You need to get closer, the Courier is about to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 必须靠近目标，信使飞船马上要逃脱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: If that ship escapes, this mission will be a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一旦飞船逃脱，任务就会失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's one less turret.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 又少了一座炮台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You took out a turret.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你摧毁了一座炮台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Turrets destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 炮台已被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Turrets down, they can't return fire now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 炮台已报废，它们现在无法回击了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've almost reached the loading docks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 马上就到装卸区了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The loading docks are just ahead, get ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 装卸区近在咫尺，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Almost there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就在眼前了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've almost made it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就差一点了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They're too close. Forget everything but the high-credit product and go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们离得太近了。其他东西都不管了，带上值钱的货，赶紧走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Interceptors?! They're flying right past you. Why do they call you Interceptors if you don't intercept?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 拦截机呢？！人家都在你们眼皮子底下飞过去了，什么都拦不住，还叫什么拦截机？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Board isn't going to be happy about this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 董事会肯定会扒了我们的皮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A credit bonus for any transport crew who escapes the Tenno raiders. That, and the opportunity to keep living.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哪艘运输船能逃过 Tenno 的袭击，所有船员就能拿到奖金——外加继续活命的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: In the name of the Void, protect our product, save our profits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 以虚空之名，护我货物，保我利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Rendezvous with your landing craft for extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 前往登陆艇会合，准备撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Extraction is ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 撤离点已就绪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're done here. Meet up with your ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你的任务已完成，与你的飞船会合吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're halfway there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 任务完成过半了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is the halfway point. Keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 任务完成一半了，继续加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've hit the midpoint, don't stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 进度过半了，别停下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The last transport escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 最后一艘运输船逃脱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hah. The last transport just left. Those Tenno will have to try harder next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哈，最后一艘运输船也撤走了。Tenno 下次可得再加把劲啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The last transport is leaving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 最后一艘运输船即将逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Don't let that last transport escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 别让最后一艘运输船逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hurry, the last transport is powering its engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快点，最后一艘运输船正在发动引擎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Go, go, go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 走，走，快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Get out of here, move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快撤，动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: All the transports escaped, this mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有运输船均已逃脱，任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You let all the transports escape. Move faster next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你放跑了所有运输船，下次动作快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You failed to stop the transports. Mission over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你没能拦住那些运输船，任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The transports are all safe. The profits safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 运输船都安全了，利润也保住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Call the Board, let them know the Tenno have failed… again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 联络董事会，告诉他们，Tenno……又失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Praise the Void. The profits are safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 赞美虚空，利润保住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We don't have much time. Race to the loading docks and destroy enemy transports before they can escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 时间不多了，火速前往装卸区域，在敌方运输船逃离前截住它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy is trying to escape with supplies. Hurry to the loading dock and destroy their transports.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人正企图带着物资逃离。立即前往装卸区，摧毁他们的运输船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is a race against time. Reach the loading bay and destroy the transport ships before they can escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们必须争分夺秒。前往卸货区并在敌人脱逃之前摧毁运输船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shields down. Open fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 护盾解除，开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Orbirters destroyed, target the transport.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 无人机被摧毁了，攻击运输船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It's vulnerable. Finish it off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目标已失去防护，摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transport. You're vulnerable. Get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 运输船，你的护盾失效了。快撤走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've found a transport, destroy the Orbiters to make it vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 找到运输船了，摧毁护卫无人机，解除它的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There's a transport, take out its shields by destroying those Orbiters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 那就是运输船，摧毁护卫无人机，解除它的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You need to disable shields before you can attack the transport. Target the Orbiters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 必须先解除护盾，才能攻击运输船，瞄准护卫无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transports, all power to shield Orbiters. Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有运输船，把全部能源输送给护盾飞行器。立刻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transports, deploy shield Orbiters. Protect your cargo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有运输船，部署护盾飞行器。保护好货物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It's all over? Tell me at least one survived. Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 都结束了？至少能保住一艘吧。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Some profit is better than no profit… I suppose that's what I'll tell the Board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 赚一丁点也是赚……我也只能这么跟董事会交代了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Too late, a transport escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太迟了，运输船已逃离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You let a transport escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你放跑了一艘运输船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You need to move faster, their transports are escaping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 加快速度，他们的运输船快逃脱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Too slow, Tenno! My transports are getting away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太慢了，Tenno！我的运输船早就开走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transport escaped. I'm getting a bonus for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 运输船成功撤离，这笔奖金我拿定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A transport is powering its engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一艘运输船正在启动引擎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A transport is fully loaded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一艘运输船已完成装载。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Load complete? Okay, get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 装完了？好，赶紧离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transport, stop loading and power engines. They're close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 运输船，停止装载，立即启动引擎。他们快到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, hurry. The first transport is almost loaded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，快。第一艘运输船就快装好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're running out of time. The first transport is about to depart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快没时间了，第一艘运输船即将离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You have to move faster. A transport is almost ready to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 加快速度，有艘运输船马上就要逃脱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Transports, prepare for evacuation. The Tenno are here to steal our profits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有运输船，准备撤离。Tenno 来抢我们的利润了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno assailants approaching fast. We must protect the product. Transports, initiate emergency departure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 突击队正迅速逼近，必须保住货物。所有运输船，启动紧急撤离程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Move fast, Corpus, the Betrayers are coming. Ready the transports, we have orders from the top, protect that product.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 动作快点，科普斯，背叛者杀过来了。准备运输船，上头有令，死也要保住那批货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It's the Tenno! Launch all offensive units. This is not a drill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是 Tenno！出动所有攻击单位，这不是演习！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, do you read. Tenno come in. Tenno...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，听得到吗？Tenno，请回（话）。Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We now have the tools to take on Vay Hek and his Balor Fomorians. His arsenal is growing but so will ours. There are more Archwing designs and more weapons. Together we will take to the skies and confront this new threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 现在，我们有足以抗衡韦·海克议员和巴罗尔巨人战舰的装备了。他的军械库不断扩张，我们的也一样。借助不断更新的曲翼蓝图与武器，我们将一同飞向天际，消灭新威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, tensions between the Grineer and Corpus are boiling over. You're here to find out what the Corpus know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，克隆尼和科普斯之间的大战一触即发，你需要查清科普斯的底细。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: For too long the Corpus have extorted the Grineer. Frohd Bek, consider our contracts cancelled. This is a hostile takeover!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 科普斯商会欺压克隆尼太久了。弗罗德·贝克，我们的合同就此作废。现在我来教教你什么叫恶意收购！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Not wise, Councilor. I was hoping the Tenno had taught you a little humility when they destroyed your precious Fomorian fleet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这话可不明智啊，议员大人。我本以为 Tenno 摧毁你心爱的巨人战舰时，多少教会了你一点谦虚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Did you really believe the Tenno destroyed all my Fomorians?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你不会真以为，这帮 Tenno 有本事摧毁我所有的巨人战舰吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have a problem... there is.. something breaking from the Void!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 情况不妙，有什么东西……正从虚空冲出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Bek! Meet Balor. Your fate, my future!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 贝克！来见识一下巴罗尔！你的末日，就是我的未来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Impossible... All units, full alert, prepare for boarding...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这不可能。所有单位，最高警戒，准备迎击登舰部队……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text:
Friends, I've gone and done it again, this time, I've pissed-off the Grineer with another awesome deal. Why do they hate my deals so much? Is it because they were born in a tube? Probably. Might also be that they think I've stolen their stuff. 
That means I've got to get rid of everything, fast. Each day I'll have a new deal, and anything you don't buy, I'm burning to an unrecognizable crisp. It's a fire sale! 
Darvo's Fire Sale: Buy it, or I burn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText:
朋友们，又出岔子了。这次我的超值特惠惹毛了克隆尼。他们干嘛这么讨厌我搞促销？因为他们是试管里出生的吗？有可能。不过也可能是他们觉得我偷了他们的东西。
所以，我得赶紧把手头的货全处理掉。每天我都有一个新优惠，如果货没卖光，我就全都烧掉，烧成灰看他们认不认得出来。就叫火热促销好了！
达尔沃的火热促销：卖不掉就烧掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text:
Friends, smell that? That's the final shipment of unsold merchandise going up in flames. Let's see the Grineer try to pin this on me now. Maybe, if they spent more time securing their shipments and less time chasing legitimate merchants all around the system, they wouldn't have this problem.
Me, I think I might have inhaled one too many flaming Grakatas, so I'm going to go lie down for a bit. 
Pleasure doing business with you, Tenno. Nighty-night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText:
朋友们，闻到了吗？那是最后一批没卖掉的货被我烧掉啦。看这帮克隆尼还怎么找我的麻烦。要是他们能把满星系追查合法商人的劲头，多花点在保护自己的货物上，大概就不会惹出这么多事了。
至于我嘛，这阵子我吸了太多葛拉卡达烧焦的废气，已经想吐了，我打算歇一阵子。
和你做生意真的很愉快，Tenno。晚安啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text:
Friends, I've done it again, I've ticked off the entire Corpus board with my amazing deals. They're so upset they make up lies, like, "Darvo's merchandise is our merchandise!" 

To which I say, "You can't prove anything."

So, to ensure they can't prove anything, I'm having a liquidation sale. Everyday a new deal. It all has to go. Act quick because any stock that's left when the Corpus troops come knocking is getting dumped into space. Got it? Good.

Darvo's Totally Legit sale: You pick the best, I'm flushing the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText:
朋友们，我又惹上事了，我的劲爆特惠把整个科普斯董事会都惹毛了。他们气急败坏，甚至编造各种谎言抹黑我，说什么「达尔沃的货是从我们这偷的！」

对此我只有一句话的回应：「有本事拿证据出来」。

因此为了确保他们不会抓住我的把柄，我要搞一次清仓大甩卖。每天都会有新的折扣，而且必须统统卖完。动作快点，要不然等科普斯士兵敲开我的门时，剩下的货都会被扔进太空里了。懂我的意思了？很好。

达尔沃的「完全合法」特卖马上揭晓：好货你挑走，剩下冲马桶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Operator, you are leaving the battle if you continue any further I will be forced to extract you and this mission will be a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 指挥官，您正在远离战场。若您继续走远，我将被迫执行强制撤离，任务也会因此失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, are you abandoning this battle? Return to your objective or I will have Ordis extract you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，你要放弃这场战斗吗？专注任务，不然我会让奥迪斯将你强制撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Very well, initiating emergency extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 好吧，正在进行紧急撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Ordis, commence extraction. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 奥迪斯，执行撤离。本次任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Ahhh!!! Curse you Tenno. You got me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 呃啊啊啊！！！该死的 Tenno。你惹毛我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is too easy. Tell your Lotus to send more capable fighters next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太轻松了。告诉你的莲，下次派点更能打的过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are not ready for this fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你还不配跟我交手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno. What makes you think you are ready to fight Vay Hek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno。谁给你的胆子，觉得自己够格跟我韦·海克交手？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The first Grineer who brings me the head of a Tenno will be permitted to wear its skull as a helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 第一个把 Tenno 脑袋提来的克隆尼，可获准把那颗头骨当头盔戴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill the Tenno scum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 杀！杀！杀！杀光这些 Tenno 渣滓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Your Lotus is leading you to destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你的莲正把你引向毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You Tenno are such a waste of good violence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 用如此精良的武器，来对付你们 Tenno 简直是种浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The experiment is in ruins. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这次的实验彻底泡汤了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This will be a massive setback for the Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这是对女皇的一次重挫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Well done. There will be no Kuva for the Queens today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 做得很好。女皇今天休想拿到一滴赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: What's in this sludge and why do the Queens think they can make Kuva from it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这团污泥中到底有什么？为何女皇认为可以从中提炼赤毒？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Queens have been frantically trying to produce more Kuva. Anything we can do to thwart their efforts will help our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 女皇一直在生产更多赤毒，而一切能挫败她们努力的行动都会对我们的目标有所帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Queens are attempting to distil Kuva, and we can't take the chance that they might be successful. Release this poison into their operation and defend the apparatus for as long as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 女皇正试图提炼赤毒，我们绝不能让她们得逞。把这种毒药注入她们的作业系统，并尽可能久地保护这个装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Queens hope they can create Kuva by way of this alchemy. We can't let that happen. Introduce poison into the system and defend the injector while it destroys their experiment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 女皇想要通过这种炼金术来制造赤毒。我们绝不能让这种事发生。将毒药引入系统中，并在毒药破坏实验的过程中保护好注入装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Quickly, activate the poison drip apparatus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快，启动毒药滴注装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Activate that apparatus to start the poison drip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 启动装置，开始滴注毒药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The poison drip has started. Defend the apparatus while it works. The longer you hold out, the more complete the destruction of the Kuva will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 毒药滴注已经开始。装置运行期间保护好它。你坚持得越久，对赤毒的破坏就越彻底。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hold on tight. The Grineer are going to do everything in their power to destroy the apparatus and salvage the experiment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 坚持住！克隆尼会不惜一切代价摧毁装置，抢救他们的实验成果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Just so you know. I'm a bit new to this whole guide thing, so it's not going to be like the Lotus. Don't worry everything will be just fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 先给你透个底，当向导这事儿我也头一回，所以肯定没法像莲那么得心应手。不过别担心，一切都会顺利的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Well that didn't work out as planned. Looks like I'm gonna need to find some more Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 唉，看来计划泡汤了。看来得再多找几个 Tenno 帮忙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's not good for business. That's not good for anyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这对生意可没好处。这对谁都没好处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Here we go. Are you ready? I'm ready. Take that data mass and drop it into the system, I'll be able to hack into the ship remotely once you do. Should be easy, you'll find what I need in no time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 走吧，我准备好了，你准备好了吗？带着这个数据块，把它插进系统里，之后我就能远程黑进飞船了。应该挺简单的，你很快就能找到我需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Did you hear something strange? No, okay I'll keep going, nearly done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你有听到什么怪声吗？没有？好吧，我继续了，马上搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Just making a few more adjustments. Nothing strange going on down there? Just corpus defenses? Nothing...else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我再最后微调一下，那边没出什么怪事吧？只有科普斯防御部队？没……别的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There you are. Thought you could hunt me, well look who I brought. The Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你在这呢，你以为能杀得掉我吗？看看我带谁来了，是 Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's it. hmm... I didn't find what I needed. Go to the next terminal. It should be there. I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 搞定。嗯……我没找到需要的东西。去下一个终端机，东西应该就在那了，应该没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I'm really sorry about this Tenno but you need to go to the third terminal. I just can't seem find what I'm looking for here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我真的很抱歉，Tenno。不过你得去第三台终端机，在这儿好像没找到我要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I think you're near the terminal. Yes, yes you are. Drop me in and I'll get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你应该快接近终端机了。对，没错就是这。把我接进去，我要开工了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're close, drop me in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你很接近了，把我连进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Forget everything I said before. This is nothing you can't handle, right! Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 忘了我刚才说的话。这对你来说肯定是小菜一碟，对吧？我看好你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Thank you Tenno. It should be a long time before we hear Vay Hek's ugly voice again. Now get to extraction, you've earned it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 谢谢你，Tenno。接下来很长一段时间，我们都不用再听到韦·海克的破嗓门了。前往撤离点吧，你该好好休整一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grustrag Three have been eliminated. Impressive but Tenno, next time follow my orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 格斯特拉格三霸已被消灭，你的表现可圈可点。不过，Tenno，下一次要听从我的指令行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That was the last of the Grustrag Three, you took a risk but it paid off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 那是格斯特拉格三霸的最后一员。你冒了风险，但这次赌对了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grustrag Three have been eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 格斯特拉格三霸已被歼灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That was the last of the Grustrag Three.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 那就是格斯特拉格三霸的最后一员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: |PLAYER_NAME| is the scrawniest of them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 是他们之中最弱小的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Is |PLAYER_NAME| the best they have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 是他们中最牛的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shiny little pretty things you Tenno are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你们 Tenno 都是闪亮又可爱的小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Is one of them wearing a scarf?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们其中有人戴着披巾吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are beneath us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你臣服在我们脚下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Are we sure these are the targets? They seem so inconsequential.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们能确定他们就是目标吗？他们看起来是多么微不足道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Do not waste my time, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不要浪费我的时间，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Boring!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 无聊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: |PLAYER_NAME|, your |PLAYER_WARFRAME| looks so... slippery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME|，你的战甲|PLAYER_WARFRAME| 看起来还真……脆弱啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I want to play with these ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我想跟这些家伙好好玩玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, listen carefully you are being hunted by... Abort the mission... Get to extraction ...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，听仔细了。你正在被死亡小队追杀。终止任务……尽快前往撤离点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Do not try to stay and fight... They will kill you...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不要试图留下来战斗……你目前的装备还对付不了死亡小队。他们会杀了你，并夺走你的装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Get away now. You do not want...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 立即撤离。你绝对不想知道死亡小队会怎么处置你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The... has been designed.... fight and kill Tenno... Do not risk...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 死亡小队就是为了猎杀 Tenno 而打造的。不要冒险去和他们战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, stand... something is happening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，原地待命……有情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: These readings, this should not be possible. Tenno, my sensors are...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些读数，这怎么可能？Tenno，我的传感器正……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno captured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 已捕获 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Target retrieved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目标寻回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: An easy capture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一次简单的捕捉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Captured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 抓到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Time for the fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 该是来找点乐子的时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This one is all mine now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这个人现在全是我的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This one is mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这家伙是我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Starting capture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 开始捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Too easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太容易了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Pathetic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 可悲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Wait to you see what comes next...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我来看看你下一步要怎么走……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Did you know, this is my favourite part?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你知道，这是我最喜欢的部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Councilor Vay Hek rose to power by 'eliminating' his enemies on the Grineer council. He now has near complete control which makes him one of the most influential Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 韦·海克议员靠着「铲除」克隆尼议会中的政敌，成功掌握了权力。如今，他几乎完全控制了克隆尼议会，成为了克隆尼最有影响力的人物之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Vay Hek's plans for complete system domination make him too dangerous. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 韦·海克企图统治整个星系，威胁已经不容忽视。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Our operatives tell us Vay Hek has undergone an expensive regime of combat enhancement. Expect the worst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我方特工报告，韦·海克已经接受了一系列代价高昂的战斗强化改造。做好最坏的打算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I knew this day would come. I've prepared, changed myself. I've made sacrifices. Tenno, Are you ready for a sacrifice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就知道会有这一天，我早有准备，改造了自己，也为此付出了牺牲。Tenno，轮到你来当牺牲品了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: An artifact has been located. Proceed to the dig site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 遗物位置已确定，前往挖掘点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Scanner has picked up a target. Go to the dig site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 探测器已锁定目标位置。前往挖掘点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The excavator has been deployed. Strike down Power Carrier enemies, take their fuel cells and bring the cells to the excavator to keep it powered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机部署完成。击杀携带燃料电池的敌人，夺取他们的燃料电池并送到挖掘机旁，保障能源供应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavator is ready to go. Use fuel cells to keep it powered while protecting it from enemy fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机已准备就绪，利用燃料电池维持其运转，同时保护它不受敌人攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavator is ready to go. Keep it powered and protected from enemy fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机部署完成。维持供能并保护它免受敌人攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavator deployed. Protect the unit while it extracts the artifact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机已部署。守住它，确保遗物挖掘顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavator destroyed. That artifact is now lost to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机被摧毁了。我们彻底失去了遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Keep fighting and excavating. When you need it, extraction is ready for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 继续战斗，继续挖掘。需要时，随时都可以撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Extraction available. You may leave now, or continue excavating artifacts. The choice is yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 撤离点已开启。你可以现在离开，或继续挖掘遗物。选择权在你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This excavator is fully powered. Additional fuel cells will be used to restore its shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这台挖掘机电力充足。额外的燃料电池将用于恢复其护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Look what we just uncovered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 瞧瞧我们挖出了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Dig complete. Your hard work has just been rewarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘完成，你的努力得到了回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavation complete, look what we found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘完成，看看我们挖到了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We are here to excavate long buried artifacts crucial to our cause. Marking the first digsite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们来这里，是为了挖掘深埋地下、对我们至关重要的远古遗物。正在标记第一个挖掘地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This area is rich with subterranean artifacts. I will help you recover them. Proceed to the marked digsite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这片区域的地下埋藏着大量遗物。我会协助你找回它们。前往标记的挖掘点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Scanner has been deployed. Keep it powered while it finds potential dig sites.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 探测器已部署完成，确保设备在勘探地形时，持续为它供能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Scanner needs more power. Find a cell
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 探测器需要更多的能量，快去找能量电池。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That Scanner won't work without more power. Locate a cell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 没有能量，探测器就无法工作，去找电池来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Look for Power Carrier foes.  Strike them down and bring their cells back to the excavators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 找到携带能量电池的敌人。消灭他们并将电池带回挖掘机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Excavator has lost power. Find another cell and bring it to the unpowered Excavator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机电力耗尽。找到另一块电池并送至挖掘机处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excavator stalled. Find another fuel cell a take it to the Excavator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 挖掘机停止运转了。找一块燃料电池来给它供能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The outpost is clean, proceed to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 前哨站已清理干净，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I'm still picking up signs of the Infested. Keep hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我还接收到感染者的信号，继续执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Sensors show this Outpost is crawling with Infested. Exterminate the threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Sensors show this Outpost is crawling with Infested. Exterminate the threat.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A friendly colony has been under a long-distance artillery barrage for several days. I've traced the attack back to an experimental cannon on the Queen's Fortress. Break in and silence the gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一座友方殖民地已连续数日遭到远程火炮轰炸。我追踪到攻击来自女皇要塞上的一门实验性火炮。攻入要塞，让那门火炮彻底哑火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A distant colony has been under fire from the Queen's Fortress for days. Destroy the Queen's experimental Navar-Cannon and send the Grineer a message.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一座偏远殖民地已连续数日遭到女皇要塞的炮击。摧毁女皇的实验性武器纳瓦尔巨炮，给克隆尼点颜色看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Queen's Fortress is using a friendly colony near Jupiter as target practice for its new long distance artillery. Breach the fortress and destroy the Cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 女皇要塞正把木星附近的一座友方殖民地，当作新型远程火炮的试射靶。攻入要塞，摧毁那门火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Plant the Moltecoil on the doors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 将热熔炸弹安放在门上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Done. The Cannon's telemetry has been reconfigured. Return to the Cannon and pull the trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 完成。巨炮的遥测系统已重新配置。回到巨炮那里，开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: No. You let them get off a Tectonic shot. The colony now faces certain destruction. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不。你没能阻止他们发射地壳破坏弹。殖民地如今在劫难逃。这次任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're too late, the Navar-Cannon has fired a tectonic shot at the colony. This is the worst case scenario. Abort the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太迟了，纳瓦尔巨炮已向殖民地发射了地壳破坏弹。这下全完了，终止任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Cannon is priming for a tectonic shot. Hurry, disable the Cannon's systems before it fires.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 巨炮正在填装一枚地壳破坏弹。抓紧时间，在它发射之前让巨炮系统报废。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've reached the Cannon. Shut it down before it fires the tectonic shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你已抵达巨炮所在地。在地壳破坏弹发射前，让它瘫痪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The gates are down. Get to the Navar-Cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 大门已攻破。前往纳瓦尔巨炮所在地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Moltecoil worked. Find the Navar-Cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 热熔炸弹起作用了。找到纳瓦尔巨炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The command-center controls the Navar-Cannon's telemetry systems. Use it to take out that Galleon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 指挥中心掌控着纳瓦尔巨炮的遥测系统。使用它摧毁那艘帆船战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Navar-Cannon has a massive range, capable of hitting targets in far off sectors. Up until now they've been testing conventional ammunition but we know that they are about to switch to devastating tectonic munitions. You can't let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 纳瓦尔巨炮射程极远，足以命中遥远星区的目标。目前他们还在测试常规弹药，但我们得知，他们即将换装极具毁灭性的地壳破坏弹。绝不能让这种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Right now, the Navar-Cannon is just a menace, but once the Grineer switch to Tectonic munitions it will become capable of obliterating colonies in a single shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 眼下，纳瓦尔巨炮还只是个威胁。然而一旦克隆尼换装了地壳破坏弹，仅用一炮就能把整个殖民地夷为平地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grineer know we're here for the Cannon. They're priming one last shot with a Tectonic round that is capable of destroying the colony in one hit. Do not let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 克隆尼已经知道了我们是冲着巨炮来的。他们正打算装填最后一发地壳破坏弹做最后一搏，这一炮足以毁灭整座殖民地。绝不能让这种灾难发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You let them destroy the console. You're out of options, abort the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你让他们摧毁了控制台。我们无路可退了，终止任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found a key. Take it to the console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到了一把钥匙。把它带去控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Insert that telemetry-key into the console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 将遥测系统钥匙插入控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Direct hit. The Galleon has been obliterated. Now return to the telemetry-system and make sure the Cannon stays silent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 直接命中。帆船战舰被彻底摧毁。现在，返回遥测系统，确保这门巨炮彻底哑火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's it. The Grineer are no longer in control of their Cannon. Now it's time to turn their weapon back on them, head to the control-center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就是这样。克隆尼失去了巨炮的控制权。现在是时候以彼之道，还施彼身了，前往指挥中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You did it. The Navar-Cannon is out of operation but you're not done yet, find the command-center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你做到了。纳瓦尔巨炮已经停止运作，不过你的任务还没有结束。找到指挥中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's the first key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 第一把钥匙已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good, one more to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 很好，还剩一把。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's it. We have triangulation. Protect the console while I reprogram the Cannon's telemetry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就是这样。坐标已完成三角定位。保护控制台，我来重新编写巨炮的遥测程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The targeting mechanism is out of commision, the Cannon is useless now. The Grineer will think long and hard before trying to use this weapon again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 瞄准装置已经报废，现在这门巨炮彻底没用了。克隆尼要是再想用它，可就得三思了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Defend the Moltecoil while it melts the locking mechanism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 保护热熔炸弹，直到它融穿闭锁装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Moltecoil is super-heating the locking mechanism. Defend it from attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 热熔炸弹正在将闭锁装置加热至熔化。保护好它，别让敌人靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Pick up that Moltecoil. You'll use it to breach the gates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 捡起那个热熔炸弹。你需要用它炸开要塞大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The fortress entrance is heavily reinforced. You'll need that Moltecoil to destroy the gates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 要塞入口经过重重加固。你得用那个热熔炸弹来炸开大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is the command-center. You'll need to locate all three of the telemetry-keys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这就是指挥中心。你需要找出全部三把遥测系统钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Find and destroy all the shield generators on the ship's exterior.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 找出并摧毁舰体外部的所有护盾产生器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Fomorian will remain impenetrable until you destroy all of its shield generators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 在你摧毁所有护盾产生器前，这艘战舰无懈可击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Power field regeneration imminent. Get out of there. FAST.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 力场马上就要恢复。立刻离开，赶快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Power field down. The core is exposed. Open fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 能量力场关闭，核心暴露了。火力全开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shield Generator destroyed, take out the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 护盾产生器已摧毁，把剩下的也解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shield generator down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 护盾产生器停止运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good work, now take out the remaining generators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 干得好，现在去摧毁其余产生器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're out of critical range, Tenno. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 成功脱离危机，Tenno。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've done your part Tenno, now rendezvous with your landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，你的任务完成了。现在去与登陆艇会合吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is the threat, a Balor Fomorian. Your mission is to get inside the beast and inflict as much damage as possible. Get in range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 巴罗尔巨人战舰是个威胁。你的任务是进入这头野兽的体内，尽力造成破坏。出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This Balor is protected by a series of shield generators, destroy these first, then get inside and deploy the Fomorian Disruptor. Only then will the Fomorian's core become vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这艘巴罗尔巨人战舰受到多座护盾产生器保护。先摧毁它们，然后进入内部部署巨人战舰干扰器。只有这样，才能破坏巨人战舰的核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Shields down. Now get inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 护盾解除了，现在进入战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, one of you needs to employ the Power Disruptor from your inventory to disable the power field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，你必须从道具栏使用能量干扰器来关闭力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, the core is protected by a power field. Engage your Power Disruptors to shut down the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，核心受到能量力场保护。启动能量干扰器来关闭力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There's the core, deploy your Fomorian Disruptor to knock out the power field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 核心在那里，部署巨人战舰干扰器，瘫痪能量力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hurry, Tenno, that power field will regenerate soon, and you do not want to be in here when it does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快，Tenno，力场很快就会恢复。别等它重启时还被困在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Grineer Brothers. I've done my part, now clean up this mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 克隆尼弟兄们。我已经做了我该做的，现在把这个废物收拾掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I am too important for this nonsense. Finish them off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这种破事还不配浪费我的时间。解决他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Do not think we are done here, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 别以为这样就结束了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: These criminals think they are commiting a justice. Not in my court.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些罪犯居然觉得自己是在主持正义。在我这儿还轮不到你们指手画脚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Why are these fools still breathing my air? This is unacceptable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 为何那群蠢货还在污染我的空气？不可理喻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Must I do everything myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 难道每件事都要我亲自出马吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Now we finish this business. Once and for all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们来把这笔账一次算清！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Incoming fire from the Fomorian, find cover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 巨人战舰炮火来袭。寻找掩体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Stay out of the line of fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 避开敌人的炮火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Get to cover, the Fomorian's guns will obliterate you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快隐蔽，巨人战舰的火炮会让你瞬间蒸发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Find cover now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 迅速隐蔽，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Fomorian's weapons are designed to destroy capital ships. Don't let them hit your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 巨人战舰的火力足以摧毁主力战舰。小心，别让炮火击中你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Death, death, death. Death to the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 死！死！死！Tenno 给我通通去死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, defend the Grineer Defector until we can muster a proper extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，保护叛逃的克隆尼，直到我们安排好撤离方案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Something in the air is corroding your Warframe. Limit your exposure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 空气中的某些物质正在侵蚀你的战甲，尽量减少暴露时间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, it's Darvo Deal time, but you gotta keep this one between you and me.^ My competition would be upset if they knew I was selling this stock this cheap. Come to think of it, they'd be upset to know I'm selling this stock at all… they're probably still looking for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，达尔沃特惠时间到。但这次买卖只有你知我知。要是我的老同行知道我把这批货的价格搞得这么卷，肯定要找我麻烦。再者说来，他们要是知道这票货居然落到了我手里，肯定更会气得跳脚……他们估计还在满星系找呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hey Tenno, you're just in time for a very special moving day sale. That's right, I need move all these items off my ship before the next Grineer spot check. What do you say, can you help me out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 喂 Tenno，你来得正是时候，我正准备搞超值清仓大甩卖。没错，我得赶在克隆尼下一轮突击检查前，把飞船上的货全部处理掉。怎么样，能帮兄弟减轻点负担吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, it's your lucky day! I found this great merchandise after it fell off the back of a Corpus shuttle. Actually, to be more precise, the entire back of the shuttle fell off when it took a direct hit from a Fomorian. So… not such a lucky day for those guys, but good for you, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，今天你可走大运了！我弄到了一批货，是从科普斯穿梭机的后舱掉下来的。嗯……实际更准确来说，是穿梭机被巨人战舰开火击中后，整个后舱都掉下来了。所以……对这些家伙来讲可算不上走运，但你赚到了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hey Tenno you ready for today's steal… whoa, I mean deal. Today's deal. I really have no idea why I said that, my items are one hundred percent legit. ... I swear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 喂 Tenno，准备好迎接今天我偷……呃，我是说本日促销，超级优惠的特惠商品。我的货可是百分之百合法的……我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Today only, I'm holding a lost and found sale. A Grineer transport lost its cargo and you found a great deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 仅限今天，失物招领大甩卖咯。一艘克隆尼运输船搞丢了货，而你捡到了大便宜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Psst, Tenno. I'm going to tell you about today's Darvo Deal but you gotta keep it quiet. Word gets out that I'm offering deals this sweet and suddenly everybody is getting nosey in my business. I like my privacy, so if someone asks, just tell 'em The Perrin Sequence sold it to you. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 嘘，Tenno。我准备告诉你今天的达尔沃特惠内容，但你得保密。要是传出去我给的折扣这么大，又会有好多人跑来教我怎么做生意了。我喜欢留点隐私，要是有人问起，就跟他们说是佩兰数列集团卖给你的，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: So, I take an order from Steel Meridian. Problem is it takes a little longer than usual to, how should I put this, 'acquire the merchandise' and just when I finally get the goods together, those cheapskates cancel their order. Taking too long they said. Bah, well I guess you know what that means Tenno, it's Darvo Deal time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 事情是这样，我接到钢铁防线集团的订单。问题是，怎么说呢，「进货」比平时多花了点时间。就在我好不容易把货凑齐时，那帮吝啬鬼居然取消了订单，说什么等太久了。哼，你应该知道这代表了什么，Tenno，又到了达尔沃特惠时间啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hey Tenno. One of my customers suggested I'd get more sales if I made a catchy jingle to go with my deals, so, here goes nothing: Darvo, Darvo, Darvo Darvo, Darvo, Darvo. Buy one get one free-e Buy one get one free-e^ For a limited time- YEAH^ So??? What do you think… You don't like it do you? Well whatever... buy one get one free deal, on now. Take it or leave it, I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 喂，Tenno。有一位客户建议，要是能编段洗脑的顺口溜，生意肯定会更好，那我就豁出去了：达尔沃，达尔沃，达尔沃，达尔沃，达尔沃，达尔沃，达尔沃的好货顶呱呱。买一送一随便拿，买一送一带回家……家。如何？你觉得怎么样……你不喜欢，是吧？算啦，随便吧……从现在开始，买一送一。你爱买不买我都不管了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Friends, when I first started out in the 'unsecured goods' business, I even imagined owning my own store.^ But look at me now! No doubt, I owe it all to you. So I want to give back.^ For a limited time, I have enabled a booster for each and every one of you.^ Thank you, Tenno. Now if you'll excuse me I think I have something in my eye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 朋友们，刚开始做「无担保货物」生意时，我想都没想过能拥有自己的店面。但看看我现在的样子！不用说，全多亏你们。所以我想回馈大家。在限定时间内，我给你们各位都安排了一项加成福利。谢谢你，Tenno。失陪一下，我眼睛里好像进沙子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, you ever drink Ganymede Geyser Water? One of my suppliers brought a case to the store yesterday. ^"Have a sip," he says, "we'll look over my items," he says. ^ Next thing I remember, I wake up with a headache surrounded by crates and crates of something called the NYX NEMESIS SKIN? ^ Well, I hope this item is of interest to you Tenno, because I've bought a lot of it.^ You check the market for a Darvo Deal. I'm going back to bed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，你喝过木卫三的间歇泉水吗？昨天我的一位供货商带了一箱来我店里。「尝一口吧，」他说道，「咱们边喝边看货。」接下来我只记得自己头痛得醒了过来，然后旁边堆满了箱子，箱子上还写着什么 NYX 复仇女神外观？好吧，Tenno，我希望你对这玩意儿有兴趣。因为我就这么进了一大批。你去商店看看达尔沃特惠吧。我要回去接着睡了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You have taken my bait but you will not take my cores. Grineer ATTACK!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你拿走了我的诱饵，但是你休想带走我的核心。克隆尼进攻！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You have already shown me your hand. Now it is time to see what I have up my sleeve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你已经亮出了底牌。现在，该让你看看我的杀手锏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Try it Tenno. Just try and walk out of here with the core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 试试看，Tenno。有本事就带着核心活着走出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are running out of time. There will be nowhere to hide from my Fomorians. And when the last of you is gone I will personally throw your beloved Lotus INTO THE SUN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你没时间了。在我的巨人战舰面前，你无处可逃。等你们死光了，我会亲手把你深爱的莲扔到太阳去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: What is happening? Where? Where is the core?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 出什么事了？在哪儿？核心在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Something is wrong. Tenno?!? Stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不对劲。Tenno？！？阻止他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: What is happening to the Tram? Investigate. Investigate now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 电车出什么事了？给我查，立刻去查！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Come back with the core. Or don't come back at all!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 带着核心回来，否则就永远别回来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Be warned. Failure to stop the Tenno will result in your failure to continue breathing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 听好了，要是拦不住 Tenno，你们只有死路一条。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Stop them. Recover the cores.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 阻止他们，然后夺回核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, Tenno, Tenno are here. Stop them. Stop them at once!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，是 Tenno，有 Tenno 在这。阻止他，马上阻止他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno have the core. They are not permitted to have the core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 抢走了核心，绝不能让他带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Assassins, thieves, miscreants. Leave my cores alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 刺客、小偷、匪徒。离我的核心远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are only delaying the inevitable. My Fomorians will be built. My ships will rule the system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你只是在拖延死期。我的巨人战舰必将建成，我的舰队会称霸整个星系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We will build the cores faster than you can destroy them Tenno. Mark my words!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们建造核心的速度会比你摧毁的速度更快，Tenno。给我走着瞧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You can not stop progress. All will be Grineer dominion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你阻挡不了进步的浪潮。一切都将归于克隆尼的统治。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We are in total control. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们已掌控全局，继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have control of all four towers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们已全数控制住四座塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We are dominating, keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 局势由我方掌控，继续保持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy is dominating, you must capture a tower, and quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人占据了上风，你必须尽快占领一座塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy has all four towers. You must stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人占领了四座塔台。你必须立刻阻止他们。
