/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have deployed fierce reinforcements, are you willing to stay and decode more messages?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人部署了强力增援，你愿意留下来破译更多讯息吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Still more data is being broadcasted. Are you willing to risk going back into the field?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 还有更多数据正在传播，你愿意冒险返回战场吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Extraction is available but there are more messages to be decoded. Will you stay or go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 撤离点整备完毕，但是还有更多的讯息需要破译。你想留下还是撤离？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have successfully decoded the message. Clear the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们成功破译讯息。清理这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have the decoded the message. The remaining enemies must not report back to their command. Eliminate everyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们破译了讯息。绝不能让残余的敌人向敌方指挥部汇报。消灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Message decoded. Leave none alive. Clear out the remaining enemy forces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 讯息已破译。不留一个活口，肃清残余敌军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We cannot allow the enemy to learn of our espionage. Eliminate the remaining enemy personnel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 绝不能让敌军察觉到我们的间谍活动。歼灭剩余敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have captured the message. We have failed today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌方先一步截获信息。这次失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have decoded the message. You have failed in your mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人已经破译了讯息。你的任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have located the enemy's planetary communication towers. Capture the towers and remain in control long enough to decode incoming messages.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们已锁定了敌人的行星通信塔台。占领这些塔台，并保持控制，直到我们把截获的讯息全部破译。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: These radio towers carry top secret interplanetary communications. You are going to capture the towers and decode incoming messages.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些无线电塔台负责传输绝密的星际通信。占领它们，截获并破译收到的讯息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Nearby communications towers are broadcasting crucial enemy intelligence. Capture the towers and decode any incoming messages.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 附近的通讯塔正在传输敌方的关键情报。占领塔台，截获并破译所有收到的讯息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We need to find out where the Fomorian Power Cores are being produced, intercept Grineer messages so that we may determine the facility's location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们必须查清巨人战舰能量核心的生产位置。拦截克隆尼的通信，才能锁定设施的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are here to intercept critical information about the location of the Fomorian Power Cores.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你此行目标，是截获有关巨人战舰能量核心所在地的关键情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Try and capture another signal. Be careful though, the enemy has surely rallied stronger reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 再截获一段信号。但要小心，敌人肯定已经集结了更强的增援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I have detected another incoming message. Capture and decode the signal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我又检测到一条来讯。截获并破译加密信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They are broadcasting another message, make sure the enemy never receives it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们在发送另一条讯息，确保敌人无法接收到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy will stop to capture this intel before we do. We cannot let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人会不惜一切代价，抢在我们之前夺回情报。绝不能让他们得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The data you have collected here today will go a long way in supporting our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你今天收集的数据将对我们的行动大有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good work today. Not only have we decoded the enemy transmissions, we have also disrupted their communications.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你今天干得很好。我们不仅破译了敌人的讯息，还干扰了他们的通信网络。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tower online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 塔台已上线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tower captured, beginning stream decode now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 成功占领塔台，现在开始进行串流解码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You have captured a radio tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你占领了一座无线电塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This tower is ours now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这座塔台现在归我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tower lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 塔台失守了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have captured a tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人占领了一座塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have lost control of a tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一座塔台已失去控制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have taken a tower, you must recapture it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人占领了一座塔台，你必须把它夺回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That did it, here comes the Juggernaut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 成功了，巨兽要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Juggernaut, I think you made it angry. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是巨兽，看来你把它惹毛了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That was a Juggernaut. They're lured out by the death of infested. Lay-low and it should go away or amp up the fight to draw it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 那是巨兽。它们会被死去的感染者吸引。放缓行动，它就会走开；或者加大火力，把它引过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A Juggernaut nearby? It will only attack when it senses high concentrations of Infested blood. Slow the fight if you want it to go away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 附近有巨兽？只有感知到大量感染者的血液，它才会现身攻击。放慢战斗节奏，它就会走开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I am no longer detecting signs of a Juggernaut, move on, you are safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 已经检测不到巨兽的信号了，继续前进，你安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Juggernaut has moved on. It's safe to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 巨兽已经离开。可以放心前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: (Maniacal laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: (Maniacal laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: (Maniacal laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: (Maniacal laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Unacceptable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不能接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That one will be difficult to replace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这家伙是难以取代的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are going to suffer for that, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你将为此承受苦痛，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I must extract crucial surveillance data from nearby satellites. Protect them until I complete my task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我必须从附近的卫星中提取关键监控数据。在我提取完成前，保护好它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Satellites in the vicinity contain important surveillance data, defend them while I extract that data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 附近的卫星存有重要监控数据。我提取数据时保护好它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy would rather destroy this data than have it land in our hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人宁愿毁掉这些数据，也不愿让它们落入我们手中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The surveillance data is heavily encrypted, it will take time to extract.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些监测数据经过多重加密，提取需要一点时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: All satellites have been hacked. Move to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有卫星都已被入侵，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Mission accomplished, proceed to your landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 任务完成，前往登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Your armor is degrading. Put serum in that medstation to cleanse yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你的护甲正在劣化。将血清放入医疗站进行清洁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Filling that medstation with serum will halt your health and armor from degrading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 向医疗站补充血清可以阻止你的生命值和护甲降低。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Without help from the Vaporizers the Pox will continue to erode these consoles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 如果没有雾化器抑制，脓包会继续侵蚀这些控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I will not be able to access these systems if the consoles degrade much further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 要是控制台被进一步腐化，我们就无法接入系统了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I have the manifest. Wipe out the remaining Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 清单到手了，消灭残余的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I'm finished. You must clear the area of Infested before we can continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我这边结束了。在我们继续前进之前，你必须清理掉该区域的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: These consoles have been compromised by a fast growing Infested pox. Use the Vaporizers to kill the pox and I will access the consoles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些控制台已经被迅速增生的感染脓包侵蚀。使用雾化器清除这些脓包，我才能接入控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There's pox everywhere on these consoles and it's corrupted the manifests. Do you see any Vaporizer units near by? Use those to temporarily kill off the pox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些控制台上布满了脓包，货运清单也因此受损。附近有看到雾化器吗？用它们暂时清除这些脓包。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I've reconstructed half the manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我已经重建了一半的货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I have almost finished reconstructing the manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 货运清单就快重建完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Keep fighting. I'm still working on this manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 继续战斗，我仍在处理这份清单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Here we go again. Get those Vaporizers working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 再接再厉。让这些雾化器运作起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Let's reconstruct the next manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 准备重建下一张货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Get ready. We're going reconstruct another manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 做好准备，我们将重建下一张货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This desolate Corpus research vessel conceals a rich cache of supplies. To locate them, I will reconstruct the ship's corrupted shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这艘荒废的科普斯研究船上藏有丰厚的物资。我会重构飞船残破的货运清单，从而找到这些补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The crew of this ship fell victim to the very Infestation they were researching. We're here to recover their extensive supplies. Find the consoles that contain the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这艘船的船员成了他们自己研究的感染者的牺牲品。我们来回收他们留下的大量物资，找出存有货运清单的控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is what was in the manifest. There's more where that came from, do you want to keep fighting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这就是清单记录的物品了。这里还有很多，要继续战斗吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Success. Do you want to attempt to reconstruct another manifest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 成功了。你想尝试重建另一份货运清单吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, these Infested hold the serum we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，这些感染者身上有我们需要的血清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Infested, they're dropping the serum we need for the Vaporizers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 感染者掉落了雾化器所需的血清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Those Infested must have taken that serum from the researchers on this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些感染者肯定是把船上研究员的血清拿走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You picked up serum, now put it in a Vaporizer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你拿到血清了，现在将它注入雾化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Put that serum in a Vaporizer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 将血清放入雾化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I've detected three resource caches on this vessel but Void interference is masking their location. You must decide if finding these caches is worth the added risk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我探测到这艘船上有三个藏有稀有物资的箱子，但虚空干扰掩盖了它们的位置。你必须决定是否冒险去寻找这些箱子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: My intel suggests there are rich enemy supply caches in the area but I am unable to pinpoint their exact location. Search them out if you are willing to shoulder the added risk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 情报显示，这一带藏有物资丰富的补给箱，但我无法锁定具体位置。如果你愿意冒额外的风险，那就去把它们找出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I also need you to find all hidden caches in the vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你还需要找出附近所有隐藏的补给箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The torsion beam device is directly beyond that portal. You'll need to travel through it to destroy the device.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 曲光装置就在传送门的另一头，你需要穿过传送门去破坏它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Quick pick up the key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快拿上钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found the first resource cache. I'm detecting two more faint hints
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到了第一个储藏箱。我还探测到另外两个微弱信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found a second cache. My readings indicate one more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到了第二个储藏箱。读数显示还剩最后一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found all the caches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 所有储藏箱都找到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: All your objectives are complete. Proceed to extraction now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 已完成所有任务目标。现在前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: All caches discovered, time to shut down that portal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 储藏箱已全部找到，该去关闭传送门了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Extraction is available or you can continue to search this tower for resource caches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 可以前往撤离点了。你也可以继续在这座塔里搜寻储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You have to find all caches before you can extract.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 必须找齐所有储藏箱才能撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There's the Torsion Beam Device but they've taken the Void key. Find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 曲光装置就在那，但钥匙被他们带走了。找到钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You got the key, now get back to the portal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 钥匙到手了，现在返回传送门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy have breached the Void portal in this Orokin structure, you here to cut off their access and stop them from coming back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人已经突破虚空传送门，进入这座奥罗金建筑了。你要在这里切断他们的后路，让他们有去无回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Intruders are forcing open this location's Void portal. You are here to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 入侵者正在强行开启此处的虚空传送门。你的任务是阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy are using a Void key and a portable torsion beam device to force open the portal. Destroy the key and the device.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人正利用虚空钥匙与便携式曲光装置强行开启传送门。破坏钥匙与曲光装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The first generator is fully powered, now activate the other one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 第一台发生器已充能完成，现在去启动另一台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They're on to us. Protect the generator console until the process is complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人察觉到我们了。保护发生器控制台，直到程序运行完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The portal only allows travel in one direction, start up the portal generators to reverse the polarity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 传送门只允许单向通行，启动传送门发生器来反转传送方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good work, the polarity has been reversed. Now travel through the portal, it's your turn to go on the offensive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 做得好，传送方向反转完成。现在穿过传送门，轮你进攻了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Objective complete, the Void key and Torsion beam device are out of commission. The enemy will not be returning any time soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目标完成，虚空钥匙与曲光装置已彻底报废。短时间内敌人无法再返回这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The device is set on overdrive. Get through the portal before it melts down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 装置进入超载状态。在它熔毁之前快穿过传送门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Go through the portal now, it's about to collapse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 现在快穿过传送门，它快要崩坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, you do not want to be on this side of the portal when that key melts down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，钥匙就快要熔毁了。别被困在传送门这一侧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Brothers. Do not let The Tenno threaten our destiny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 兄弟们，绝不能让 Tenno 威胁我们的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, detecting Void energy accumulation inside your objective: Fissures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，检测到虚空能量聚集，就在你的目标——裂缝内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Be aware: This storm is tearing open Void Fissures at your destination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 请注意：这场风暴正在你的目的地撕开虚空裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Void Storms mean a high-probability of Void Fissures forming inside nearby vessels. Be on high alert.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 虚空风暴会大幅提高附近飞船内部形成虚空裂缝的概率。保持高度警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Corpus are using a Gravity Conveyor system to move product up to the surface. These will be heavily shielded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 科普斯正使用重力输送系统将货物运到地表。这些输送系统都有极强的护盾保护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You need to drop some kind of explosive charge down the Gravity Conveyor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你需要把爆炸物投入重力输送器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Can you scavenge something explosive from the battlefield? You need a powerful explosive to attack the facility below.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你能从战场上找到爆炸物吗？你需要威力强大的炸药来攻击地下设施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: If you can destroy a Raptor, you may be able to repurpose its reactor from the wreckage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 如果你能击毁一架猛禽，或许可以从残骸里拆出它的反应堆，改作爆破装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I thought we had seen the last of this dreaded Raptor project but now the Corpus have escalated their interest and investments. We need to shut them down for good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我还以为可怕的猛禽计划已经终结，但现在科普斯不仅重启了项目，还加大了投资。我们必须彻底阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The new Raptor production facility appears to be entirely underground. A crashed freighter on the surface has been masking its location. I fear they have developed even more deadly Raptor prototypes here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 全新的猛禽生产设施完全建在地下。地表的一艘坠毁货船一直掩盖着它的位置。恐怕他们已经在这里研发出了更致命的猛禽原型机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This may be difficult. The production facility is entirely automated. There is no way in without your Warframe being torn up in the assembly line. You'll have to figure out how to destroy it from the planet surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这任务恐怕很棘手。生产设施是全自动化的，如果你的战甲进入装配线，瞬间就会被撕碎。你恐怕得想办法从地表摧毁工厂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We cannot risk the Corpus developing more advanced Robotics. If the Corpus are building newer Raptors, it's imperative we destroy the prototypes and their means of production.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们绝不能任由科普斯继续研发更先进的机器人技术。如果他们正在制造新型猛禽，当务之急就是摧毁原型机及其生产设备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Well done, Tenno! But you have to completely cripple this facility to halt Raptor production. Keep at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 干得好，Tenno！但要彻底停止猛禽生产，就必须让整座设施瘫痪。再接再厉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We're almost done. Stay alive and finish the mission. Take out the rest of the Conveyors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 就快成功了。活下来，完成任务。摧毁剩下的输送器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I'm seeing massive internal damage to their facility. Keep it up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 侦测到设施内部已严重受损。坚持住！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A devastating hit! Now finish the job!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 致命一击！现在，彻底解决它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The entire factory has gone critical! Great work, Tenno. The Corpus financiers will regret their investments today. Now get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 整座工厂已进入临界状态！干得好，Tenno。科普斯的投资者今天一定会后悔这笔投资。立刻离开那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I'm picking up huge subterranean implosions below ground. Well done, Tenno. Exfiltrate immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 侦测到剧烈的地下内爆信号。干得好，Tenno。即刻撤出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The factory is in ruins. You've dealt a critical blow to the Corpus war-machine today. Your landing craft is in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 工厂变成了废墟。今天你对科普斯的战争机器造成了沉重的打击。登陆舰已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy is on high alert, the moment you enter the holding area they'll trigger the execution sequence, rescue the hostage before it finishes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人现在处于高度戒备状态。你一旦踏入关押区，他们就会立即执行处决。你要在事态不可挽回前，救出人质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Tenno are here. Execute the hostage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 来了。处决人质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno! Begin the execution sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是 Tenno！启动处决程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno operatives have entered the cell block. Initiate execution sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 特工闯入了牢房区。启动处决程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Tenno have breached the holding cell. Discard the hostages.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 侵入了关押牢房。处理人质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are approaching the holding area. Careful, if the wardens detect you they will surely initiate the execution sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 前方接近关押区域，一定要保持警惕。一旦被守卫发现，我们的人质就会立即被处死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Hurry up, you are running out of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 动作快点，快没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The hostage is almost out of time. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 人质快不行了，动作快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They killed the hostage. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 人质被他们处决了，任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You let the hostage die. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你没能保住人质，任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Beware, those lasers are linked to the poison tumor nodes growing on the air-locks. Contact with the lasers will put our operative in immediate peril..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 注意，那些激光与生长在密封舱上的肿瘤节点是连在一起的。一旦触碰到激光，我们的特工就会有生命危险……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The infestation has spread to this location faster than anyone predicted, everyone is gone, except our operative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 感染病毒蔓延到这里的速度超乎了所有人的预料。除了我们的特工外，没有发现幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It is almost as if the Infestation has deliberately captured our operative. This sort of behavior is highly unusual
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这些感染者似乎是有意抓捕我们的特工，其中一定隐藏着某些不可告人的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Our operative was able to survive by hiding in an air-lock. Unfortunately, they've now become trapped by the Infestation's growths.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们的特工躲在了密封舱内才逃过了一劫。不幸的是，他们被越来越多的感染者绊住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Our operative has succumbed to the gas toxin. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们的特工死于毒气，本次任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You set off a laser, the Infestation is responding by gassing our Operative. Get them out of there immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你触发了激光，感染者正向我们的特工释放毒气。抓紧时间把人救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're here to rescue an operative who has been trapped by the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你此行目的是为了解救被感染者困住的特工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: One of our operatives has been trapped by the infestation, you must rescue them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们的一名特工被感染者困住了，你一定要把他救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Infestation has trapped our operative in an emergency airlock. Find and free the captive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 感染者把我们的特工困在了一处应急密封舱内。找到并救出他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The operative is trapped in one of these air-locks. You must destroy the tumor nodes before you can rescue them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 特工被困在其中一处密封舱内。你必须先摧毁肿瘤节点，然后才能实施救援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Destroy the tumor nodes and open the air-locks. Our operative is in one of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 摧毁肿瘤节点并打开气压过渡舱。我们的特工就在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The operative is safe. Good work, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 特工安全了，干得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You freed the captive. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你解救了我们的特工，做得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found the Operative. Now bring them home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到了特工，现在带他回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You located the Operative. Make sure they get to extraction alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到特工了，一定要确保他安全撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It's our agent, make sure they get home safely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是我们的特工，必须确保他安全归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found our agent, escort them to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到特工了，护送他去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There is a vault portal nearby. If security detects you, it will start the process to shutdown the portal, severing any link with our agent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 附近有一个保管库传送门。如果你被安保系统发现，传送门就会关闭，而特工会永远被困在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Our scavenger has been snared by a long dormant Orokin security system. It's our duty to see that they make it home safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我方搜寻员被处于长期休眠状态的奥罗金安保系统困住了。我们的任务是确保他们平安回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Vault portals are a link between this place and secure vaults across the system. Orokin security has trapped our agent in one of those vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 保管库传送门连接着这里与星系各处的保管库。我们的特工被奥罗金安保系统困在了其中某个保管库里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The security system is waiting to release our agent to Orokin authorities, authorities who are long dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 安保系统正听候指令，准备把我方特工移交给奥罗金官员，可是那些人都不知道死了多久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: While searching vault portals for lost artifacts, a Tenno ally has been trapped by a long forgotten Orokin security mechanism, rescue this agent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一名 Tenno 盟友在追查遗物下落的时候，被古代奥罗金安保设施困住了。你的任务是救出这名特工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: One of our allies has been trapped by an ancient Orokin security system. Get them out alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们的一位盟友被古代奥罗金安保系统困住了。Tenno，把他活着带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Quick, use those consoles to change the destination of the vault portal, one of them has to lead to our agent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 快，用那些控制台修改保管库传送门的目的地，其中一个肯定能传到特工所在的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Execution sequence initiated. Get the hostage out of there before it's too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 处决程序启动了。趁现在还来得及，赶紧把人质救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The injector is now in an unstable overdrive. Keep the Grineer away while it melts down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 注射器进入了不稳定的过载状态。守在这里，直到它彻底熔毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We are going to destroy the injector by operating it a dangerously high velocity. Keep the Grineer at bay until it melts down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们会让注射器以高速超负荷运转，让它自毁。在它熔毁前，挡住克隆尼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Neutralizing the Grineer toxin is the only way to save these forests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 要拯救这片森林，唯一的方法就是中和克隆尼的毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Our attack would be even more effective if we could figure out a way to neutralize the Grineer toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 要是我们能找到中和克隆尼毒素的办法，这次行动将取得更大的成效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That anti-toxin you brought is going to put a serious dent in Grineer deforestation efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你带来的解毒剂，将重挫克隆尼破坏森林的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I have the data, move onto the next target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 数据到手了。前往下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I got what we need. Find the next satellite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我获取了所需的数据，寻找下一颗卫星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Defend this satellite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 守住这颗卫星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This is it, defend the satellite while I extract what we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们到了，我提取所需数据时，守住这颗卫星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Do not let the enemy destroy this satellite before I have what we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 在我拿到所需数据前，绝不能让敌人摧毁卫星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Alarms have been triggered, you need to retrieve that data before the data destruction is complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你触发了警报。数据即将被销毁，赶紧带回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Alarms! Data destruction is imminent. You need to hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 警报触发！数据即将被销毁。你要赶快了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The enemy has successfully destroyed all the data. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌方已彻底销毁所有数据，任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We allowed the enemy to destroy all their data. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人已将数据全数销毁。本次任务宣告失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You're nearing the console, trigger the alarms now and they will start destroying the data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你正在接近控制台，现在要是触发警报，他们就会开始销毁数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The target console is nearby. If you trigger the alarms now, the enemy will start destroying data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目标控制台就在附近，如果你现在触发警报，敌人就会立刻开始销毁数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This console has been severely damaged, you can't get anything out of it in this state.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 控制台已严重损毁，这种情况下，你无法提取到任何数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It's too late, we've lost this data. You will need to be more careful with the next vault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 太迟了，这份数据被销毁了。潜入下一个密库时，你必须加倍小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: They destroyed the data, this must not happen with the next vault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 他们销毁了数据，下个密库绝不能再重蹈覆辙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We cannot let enemy command know we were here. Eliminate everyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们绝不能让敌方指挥部发现我们的行踪，歼灭所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We've set off too many alarms. Eliminate all remaining enemies so that news of our infiltration does not reach high command.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们触发了太多警报，消灭所有剩余的敌人，绝不能让潜入的消息传到敌方高层。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: No further enemies detected. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 没探测到更多敌人，准备前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We have everything we came for. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目标已全部达成。即刻前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The data we retrieved will have to suffice. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 目前获取的数据足够了。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You've triggered the alarms, lose this data and the mission will be a complete failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你又触发了警报，要是失去这份数据，任务将彻底失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, you are here to infiltrate data vaults and retrieve highly sensitive enemy information.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，你的任务是潜入数据密库，并回收高度敏感的敌方情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Your mission is to break into enemy data vaults and steal any intelligence files you find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你的任务是潜入敌方的数据密库，并拿走你找到的所有情报档案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, I need you to get inside enemy data vaults and retrieve crucial intelligence data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，我需要你深入敌方数据密库，并取回关键的情报数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, be on the lookout for increased security measures, the enemy would rather destroy their data than let it get into our hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，警惕敌方升级的安保措施，敌人宁可销毁数据，也绝不愿意让我们得手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, be on the lookout for increased security measures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，小心敌方升级的安保措施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You got it. The data is still intact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 成功得手。数据完好无损。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Data integrity verified, retrieval was succesful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 数据完整性已通过验证，任务成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Data extracted. They won't even know it's gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 数据提取完成。他们甚至没有察觉到情报失窃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Excellent work, a clean extraction with no alarms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 非常好，提取得干净利落，没有触发任何警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Moon's sudden exit from the Void has had unforeseen consequences, be on the lookout for localized continuity disturbances. You may be able to turn these to your advantage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 月球突然脱离虚空引力，造成了难以预料的后果。留意局部的持续干扰，你或许能借此扭转局势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good, you brought an anti-toxin capable of neutralizing any poison already released into the environment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 很好，你携带的解毒剂能中和已排放至环境中的任何毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The antitoxin you have crafted is strong enough to reverse much of the damage caused by the Grineer poison.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你制造的解毒剂药效强劲，可以修复大部分克隆尼毒素所造成的损害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno, there are still undiscovered supply caches in the area. You may want to locate them before leaving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno，这片区域中还有些未被发现的补给箱。离开之前可以去找找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: An undiscovered supply cache remains. Do you want to find it or proceed to extraction?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 还有一个补给箱尚未找到。要继续搜寻，还是前往撤离点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Good work. Now get to the Injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 做得好，现在前往注入器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Head to the Poison Injector now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 现在前往毒素注入器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Take care when destroying the biocatalyst cartridge it is highly explosive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 摧毁生物催化剂盒时务必小心，它极易爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Set the Injector into overdrive to incinerate the toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 让注入器超载运行，从而焚毁其中的毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Start the Injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 启动注入器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Defend the injector until it has finished pumping the antitoxin into the soil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 守住注入器，直到它将解毒剂完全注入土壤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You just destroyed a massive batch of Grineer toxin. Good work, get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你刚刚摧毁了一大批克隆尼毒素，做得好，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Your anti-toxin has been delivered deep into the forest floor and is already undoing the damage done by the Grineer. Get to Extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 解毒剂已渗入森林土壤深处，正逐步修复克隆尼对森林造成的破坏。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That was a powerful anti-toxin. This forest will not only heal but will also be resistant to future Grineer attacks. Extraction is ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这确实是强效解毒剂。这片森林不仅会逐渐恢复，甚至能抵抗住克隆尼未来的破坏。撤离点已准备就绪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grineer destroyed the Injector and saved their toxin. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 克隆尼摧毁了注入器，保住了他们的毒素。任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grineer are attempting to clear this forest by poisoning the soil. You are here to sabotage their efforts. Start with the Toxin Mixer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 克隆尼企图通过毒化土壤清除这片森林。你来这里是为了破坏他们的行动，从毒素混合器开始着手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Grineer want to poison the mighty forests of Earth to make more room for themselves. You are here to stop them, find the Toxin Mixer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 克隆尼想要毒化地球壮阔的森林，为自己扩张领地。阻止他们，找出毒素混合器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The mixer activates the toxin by combining it with a biocatalyst. Remove the biocatalyst to render the toxin harmless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 混合器会加入生物催化剂，激发毒素。移除催化剂，就能让毒素失效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Remove the biocatalyst from the mixer to halt the Grineer poisons creation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 从混合器中取出生物催化剂，阻止克隆尼毒素的生成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Remove the biocatalyst cartridge and insert your antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 移除生物催化剂盒，然后装入你的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Insert the anti-toxin into the mixer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 将解毒剂插入混合器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A Tenno has fallen, revive them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一名 Tenno 倒下了，快前去救助他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A fallen Tenno needs your help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一名倒下的 Tenno 需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno down, help them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 有 Tenno 倒下，快去救援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A Tenno needs to be revived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一名 Tenno 需要救援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: No. No, you will not stop this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 不。不，你别想阻止这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: That's it! You opened the Relic. Finish your mission and we'll take a look inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 大功告成！你开启了遗物。完成你的任务后再来看看里面有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Relic has been cracked open; finish your mission to find out what's inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 遗物已被开启，完成你的任务后再来看看里面有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: There are Void Fissures in the area, use these to crack open a Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这片区域内出现数道虚空裂缝，利用它们开启遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Void Fissures! You need them to open a relic, but are you confident you can withstand their fury?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 虚空裂缝！你需要它来开启遗物，但你有信心抵御虚空的冲击吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Watch out, I'm detecting a Void Fissures nearby. Do you have a matching Relic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 小心，我检测到附近有虚空裂缝。你带了对应的遗物吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are near a Fissure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 一道裂缝就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You found a Fissure. Look out for reactant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 你找到了一道裂缝。留意反应物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: A Fissure! Defend yourself and use reactant to open Relics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 是裂缝！保护好自己，并利用反应物打开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Corrupted enemies are dropping Reactant. Collect it to open your Void Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人正在掉落反应物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Corrupted foes are dropping Reactant. Use it to crack open a Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 敌人正在掉落反应物。用它破开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Use that Reactant to open a Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 用反应物来打开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Reactant is working on your Relic. Find more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 反应物对遗物起效了，去多找一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: You are going to need more Reactant if you want to open that Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 想开启遗物还需要更多的反应物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Don't forget the Reactant, you need more to open that Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 别忘了反应物，你需要更多才能打开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Keep fighting, look for more Reactant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 继续战斗，并搜寻更多反应物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text:
Void Relics, what a baffling concept.

Ordis will try to understand Void Relics again:

They say the contents of a Relic are simultaneously this thing, or this thing, or this thing, but also that thing and certainly never just one thing. That is, until... until it's exposed to a Void Fissure? And at that point, all the possibilities collapse, each one falling away until the Relic cracks open and exposes one, singular thing. Then -against all tenets of logic- that thing, becomes the only thing the Relic ever contained.

Pfft... -WHAT A LOAD OF- Ordis prefers known quantities, thank-you-very-much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText:
虚空遗物，多么令人困惑的概念。

Ordis 会再次尝试理解虚空遗物：

据说，遗物的内容可以同时是这个，这个，或者这个，但也可以那个，总之从来不仅仅是一个东西。直到……直到暴露在虚空裂缝之下？在那一时刻，所有的可能性坍缩了，都消失了，直到遗物破开，显露出一个唯一的物品。于是从那个时刻开始，过去存在于遗物之中的一直就是那个东西了。

噗……一派胡——Ordis 更喜欢确定的数量，非——常——感——谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Behold, they cut me down but still, I speak. I am energy and I cannot be destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 瞧啊，他们击倒了我，而我依旧在发声。我是不灭的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: This death is temporary. My existence is forever. I cannot be destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 这次死亡不过是暂时的。我的存在即是永恒。我永生不灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Now, I will stop them. Now, I am changed. Reborn through the energy of this Janus Key. Forever bound to the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 现在，我将阻止他们。如今我已脱胎换骨，借由雅努斯之钥的能量重获新生，永世与虚空同在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: It is time. I will teach these trespassers the redemptive power of my Janus Key. They will learn its simple truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 时候到了。我会让这些入侵者见识见识雅努斯之钥的救赎之力。他们终将领悟纯粹的真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: We cannot blame these creatures, they are being led by a false prophet, an imposter who knows not the secrets of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我们不该责怪这些生灵，他们只是被伪先知所蛊惑，一个丝毫不了解虚空奥秘的冒牌货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Let it be known. If the Tenno want true salvation, they will lay down their arms and wait for the baptism of my Janus Key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 让世人知道。倘若 Tenno 想得到真正的救赎，他们就该放下武器，静候雅努斯之钥的洗礼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: I was cut in half. Destroyed. But through its Janus Key, the Void called to me. It brought me here and here I was reborn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 我被斩为两段，身毁形灭。但凭借雅努斯之钥，虚空向我发出了呼唤。将我引向此处，令我在此重获新生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: The Tenno are lost and they will resist but I, Vor, will cleanse this place of their impurity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 完全迷失了，他们肯定会负隅顽抗。但我，沃尔，将彻底洗净他们的污秽，净化这片圣土。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: My brothers, did I not tell of this day? Did I not prophesize this moment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 兄弟们，我难道没预言过会有这一天吗？难道没预言过这一刻吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Tenno use the keys, but they are mere trespassers. Only I, Vor know the true power of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: Tenno 虽然握着钥匙，但他们终究只是入侵者。只有我，沃尔，才知晓虚空的真正力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Look at them, they come to this place when they know they are not pure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 看看他们，明知自己污秽不堪，却还是闯入了这片圣地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.text: Behold the Tenno, come to scavenge and desecrate this sacred realm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MissionObjecti.zhText: 看看这些 Tenno，又来搜刮和亵渎这片神圣的领域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DConc.text:
Tenno, you have learned much in a short period, but your work has barely started.

I have word from Venus. The people of Fortuna suffer under a corrupt, despotic preacher named Nef Anyo. They require a champion capable of fighting Corpus. Use the Venus Junction to bypass faction blockades. 

When you get to Fortuna, find a gentleman who goes by the moniker, The Business. He is trustworthy.

Your Lotus has graciously offered me residence in the relay. Come see me, when you wish to learn more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DConc.zhText:
Tenno，你在短时间内学到了很多，但你的挑战才刚刚开始。

我收到金星传来的消息。福尔图娜的人民正遭受着一个名叫奈富·安尤的腐败独裁宣讲者的迫害。他们需要一位能够对抗科普斯的勇士。请使用金星接合点来绕过敌方派系的封锁。

当你到达福尔图娜时，找到一位绰号叫「操盘手」的绅士。他可以信赖。

你的莲慷慨地邀请我安顿在中继站。如果你想了解更多信息，随时来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Do you even remember the Old War?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 还记得远古之战吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Well, you wouldn't anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 反正你也不会记得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: She made sure all the Tenno forgot. A mercy I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 是她让 Tenno 忘记了一切。算是种仁慈吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Finally. You have rested too long. Get up. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 总算醒了。你已经休息得够久了。快起来，快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: I have disabled your Warframe's abilities. Orokin tricks won't help you now. Pick up that weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 我封住了你的战甲技能。奥罗金那一套现在帮不了你了。拿起那把武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Your life depends on you proving to me that you are a Tenno and not some imposter. Now, try and cut me down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 想活命，就向我证明你是真正的 Tenno，而不是什么冒牌货。现在，试试能不能把我打倒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Ten- where-.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: Tenno——你在哪——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: We are beyond her reach. You are alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 在这儿她鞭长莫及。你只能依靠你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: What are you? Another mimic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 你到底是什么？又一个拟态者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: What feeble game is the Lotus playing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 莲到底在耍什么幼稚的把戏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Promising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 有点潜质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: You do remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 果真还记得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Yes! A Tenno indeed. How long I have waited for this day.  Stand down. We have much to review, and little time to do so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 没错！的确是 Tenno。这一天我已等候多时。停手吧。我们有很多知识要回顾，但时间紧迫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Come with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 跟我来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Your weapons bear no mods. Your Orbiter - no Mod Segment. Can the Lotus not provide even the simplest- It matters not, I now have one in my Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 你的武器没有装备任何模组。你的飞船里也没有模组模块。怎么这么基本的东西莲都不给——没关系，我的军械库里正好有一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Your first lesson is simple. Destroy these targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 你的第一堂课很简单，摧毁这些目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Can you not see? They are outfitted with advanced shields, vulnerable only to Electric elemental attacks. Your body remembers the stances, but your mind has forgotten your studies. Use my Arsenal and upgrade your weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 你没看出来吗？他们配备了先进的护盾，容易受到电击元素的伤害。你的身体还记得那些架势，大脑却忘了过去学过的技艺。去我的军械库，好好强化你的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Now, try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 现在，再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: See? Mods were the hidden power behind the Orokin's military. Capable of turning simple weapons into implements of mass destruction. Fueled by the miracle of Endo, they can be endlessly rearranged and tailored to cut through the defenses of any foe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 看到了吗？模组是奥罗金军队背后的底牌。它能够将普通的武器变成大规模杀伤性武器。在内融核心的神奇力量驱动下，它们可以无限次重塑和调整，从而撕开所有敌人的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Next lesson, see how your weapon fares against these targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 下一课，看看你的武器面对这些目标表现如何。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: These shields are only weak to Magnetic elemental damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 只有磁力元素才能对这些护盾造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Remember your Alchemy. When Electricity combines with Cold you create a Magnetic field. Apply your mods accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 牢记教你的元素转换知识。当电击与冰冻元素结合时，你就能创造出磁场。根据这个特性来配置你的模组。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: See? So simple, even a child could do it. Now test your work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 看到了吗？如此简单，连小孩子都能做到。现在来检验一下你的学习成果吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Not bad. Next we will-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 还不错。接下来我们将——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Right on schedule. Show these Corpus all you have learned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 来得正好。让科普斯领教一下你新学的东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Didn't think I would find you? Ha, you underestimate my tenacity and desire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 以为我找不到你？哈，你也太小看我的毅力和渴望了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Hmm… Your Warframe is fragile. How has the Lotus allowed you to enter battle in this state?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 嗯……你的战甲很脆弱。莲怎会任由你以这种状态进行战斗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: More will come soon. Bolster your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 还有更多的敌人会来。去强化你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Let us try this again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 我们再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Much better. That was the scouts, but the cavalry gather. Collect your weapons and take whatever Mods you need. We have little time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 好多了。刚才只是侦察兵，但主力部队正在集结。收好你的武器，带上所有你需要的模组。我们时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: I will take care of these mercenaries. Take the Mod Segment. It is too valuable to fall into Corpus hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 我会处理这些雇佣兵。把模组模块拿去吧。它太珍贵了，不能落到科普斯手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Take the Segment and go. I am not done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 带着模块走吧。我这儿还没完事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: GO! NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: 走！快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.text: Tenno! Tenno? Get to extraction. Is that a Mod Segment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DMods.zhText: Tenno！Tenno？去撤离点。那是模组模块吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Teshin is deep within this ship. Cut through the Corpus and find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 泰辛就被关在这飞船的深处。杀穿科普斯，找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Sweet fortune. What are the odds? Another bird flies into my hands. Nef Anyo will pay dearly for the two of you. Corpus, take the Tenno. Dead or alive, it matters little.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 真走运。这运气简直了！又一只自投罗网的小鸟。奈富·安尤一定会为你俩出个好价钱。科普斯部队，拿下 Tenno，死活不论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: You found him. First, eliminate the Wardens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 你找到他了。但首先，要解决那些典狱长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Get Teshin out of that cell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 把泰辛从牢房里救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: She sent you to rescue me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 是她派你来救我的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Not quite, Teshin. The Tenno is on a capture mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 不全是，泰辛。Tenno 正在执行捕获任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Very well. If you think they are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 好吧，你要是觉得他准备好了就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: You have already learned mod fusion. Did you show them this, Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 你已经学会了模组融铸。莲，是你教他的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Yes. You are the Tenno I remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 没错，我印象中的 Tenno 就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Okay, Lotus. Let's talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 行了，莲，我们聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: One more order of business, Tenno. Scuttle this vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: Tenno，还有一件事，击沉这艘飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: The reactor is protected by two control systems, you need to breach both systems to expose the reactor core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 反应堆由两个控制系统保护，你需要攻破这两个系统才能让反应堆核心暴露出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: This is it. Take out the reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 就是现在。摧毁反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Corpus! Stop that Tenno!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 科普斯！快阻止那个 Tenno！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: It is done. Now find extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 大功告成。现在前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: No. My ship. By the Tenets, how is this possible???
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 不，我的飞船。我的天哪，这怎么可能？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Treasurer, may I make a suggestion? Put out a distress call. When you do, let them all know, the Tenno are back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 司库，给你提个建议吧？发个求救信号。顺便让所有人知道，Tenno 回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Lotus… What you had the Tenno do to the Orokin? It was necessary. I concede that now. Will you tell them the truth of the matter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 莲……你当年让 Tenno 对奥罗金做的事？确实是必要的，我现在承认这点。不过你会告诉他们事实真相吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: In time. There are difficult conversations ahead. They will need a mentor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 会的。他们要学会接受现实。而现在，他需要一位导师。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: You trust me to do this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 你信得过我当导师？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: If you trust me to be their Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 只要你也相信我是他的莲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: It is not my choice. It is theirs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 这是他们自己的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Oh my, Tenno. I've gone and captured your comrade. So… Let's make a deal. You bring me the Mod Segment. I release the Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 哎呀，Tenno。我已经逮到你的同伴了。所以……我们谈笔交易吧。你把模组模块交出来。我就放了禁卫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Teshin gave you that Mod Segment? Maybe he can be trusted. Install it at once. You will need maximum power for your next mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 泰辛把模组模块给你了？也许他值得信任。立即安装它。下一次任务，需要最极致的输出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Good. When you are ready, find Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 很好。准备好之后，去找泰辛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Tenno. With Vor gone, Corpus forces have begun to scavenge his camps. Intel suggests they have detected a signal emanating from some reactivated Orokin-era technology. Move in and find the source of that signal before they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: Tenno。沃尔一死，科普斯部队就开始洗劫他的营地。情报显示，他们探测到奥罗金时代科技的重启信号。请务必赶在他们之前找到信号源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Careful. There are Corpus heat signatures ahead. Move toward the source of the signal. I will try and patch you into their comms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 小心，前方探测到科普斯的热能信号。往信号源去。我会试着帮你接入他们的通讯频道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Vor's demise is our golden opportunity. Corpus! Bring me the Orokin Mod Segment that our dearest benefactor, Nef Anyo, so deeply desires. Now, enough of this idleness. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 沃尔的死正是我们的绝佳机会。科普斯！把我们最敬爱的金主，奈富·安尤梦寐以求的奥罗金模组模块给我带回来。好了，别杵在这。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: The technology is a Mod Segment? That must stay out of Corpus hands at all costs! Tenno, recover it immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 这项技术是模组模块？不惜一切代价，绝不能让它落入科普斯手中！Tenno，立即把模块夺回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Neither Grineer or Corpus have the authorization to activate an Orokin-era distress beacon. So who did? Be wary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 克隆尼和科普斯都无权激活奥罗金时代的求救信标。那到底是谁干的呢？务必当心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Hmmm... Am I to believe that you are the Tenno who cut down the mighty Vor? Even these covetous merchants avoided triggering the segment's anti-tampering routine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 嗯……干掉堂堂沃尔的就是你这个……Tenno？连那些贪得无厌的商人都知道要避开这个模块的防篡改程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: That voice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 那个声音！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: The Tenno I remember could find their enemy's weakness faster than the kubrodon finds a jugular. What happened to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 我印象中的 Tenno，找敌人弱点的速度比库狛顿咬断猎物脖子还快。你到底怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: What are you doing here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 你在这里做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: I need to see for myself. Have the Tenno risen or is this another Lotus trick?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 我倒要亲眼看看。Tenno 是真的复活了，还是莲耍的另一个把戏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Teshin Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 泰辛禁卫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: This Tenno is not your foe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 这位 Tenno 不是你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: We shall see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: 试过才知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.text: Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ModQuest/DStag.zhText: Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Acceltra: a rapid-fire micro-missile launcher. The smooth polycarbonate barrels still carry a vague stench of ozone. Some think Gauss was a blunt instrument, all speed, with as much versatility as a cannonball. But the Acceltra implies more. It implies surging in, inviting the enemy to consider the blade, then rebounding to let missiles answer their confusion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 迅发电浆炮，一把速射微型导弹发射器。它光滑的聚碳酸酯枪管上，至今仍隐隐散发着臭氧的气味。有些人以为 Gauss 只是一件粗钝的兵器，除了速度之外别无所长，功能也和炮弹差不了多少。但迅发电浆炮会用事实告诉你，它的实力远不止如此。Gauss 会先以狂潮之势突入敌阵，用刀刃迫使对手分散注意力。再骤然回身拉开距离，让接踵而至的导弹，打敌人一个措手不及。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Dual sidearms pulled from Altra's outer ring of blastcrete bunkers. Something crashed through those bunkers at great speed, the impact scattering stone, and flesh all the same. An unearthly kinetic shockwave. Those insurgents with the misfortune of surviving the initial blast must have seen the Akarius for themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这副双枪，是从阿尔特拉高塔外围的防爆混凝土掩体中找回来的。曾有什么东西以惊人的速度撞穿那些掩体。爆发的冲击力击碎了坚石，碾碎了血肉。那不是人能掀起的恐怖冲击波。至于那些不幸从第一轮冲撞中幸存下来的叛军……他们想必亲眼见识了阿利乌双枪的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[4.6]
Ash. Avatar of murder.
[12.5]
Patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination known as... The Scoria.
[20.0]
Each assassin bore a mark: a swirling, smoky-black jewel between their eyes.
[27.4]
"You are forever the Scoria. The Scoria is forever you".
[34.0]
No devotee knew of any life, any thought that was not Scoria Doctrine.
[41.3]
For every question, so the Orokin of the Scoria said, Ash was the answer.
[49.9]
Two notable students of the Scoria's anthracite halls were also two brothers: Dom and Pilio.
[54.6]
Dom was nimble, cunning, and a quick study with the blade.
[65.9]
His brother, Pilio, however, was not so gifted. While he idolized Ash, worshipped him, Pilio lacked Dom's grace and clarity.
[76.3]
And Ash's ruthlessness. However... it was Dom who had been captured by the very target he was tasked to kill.
[87.3]
A sin unforgivable to the Scoria. So it fell to Pilio - the lesser - to uphold the Scoria by taking Dom's life.
[95.5]
By this, the Seven would have assurance that Dom's flaw was not a... familial trait.
[106.0]
You see, as you might expect of an Orokin school of murder, the Scoria were ruthless when it came to… "academic excellence".
[117.6]
With Dom dead at Pilio's feet, two essential killings would have taken place: that of a failure, and that of any shred of pity within Pilio.
[120.1]
Ash would oversee Pilio's mission.
[126.9]
Pilio's soul was to die that day: as the life drained from his brother's eyes
[137.7]
or if he could not do so, beneath the blades of his lifelong idol: Ash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[4.6]
Ash，是杀戮的化身。
[12.5]
同时也是奥罗金政治刺杀派——斯科里亚所供奉的守护神。
[20.0]
每位刺客都有相同的印记：眉心之间，嵌有一颗烟黑色宝石，其中似有浓烟流转。
[27.4]
「你永远是斯科里亚。斯科里亚也永远是你。」
[34.0]
信徒们的所知所想和生活方式，都完全遵循斯科里亚的信条。
[41.3]
对于所有的问题，斯科里亚学派的奥罗金给出的答案只有一个，那就是 Ash。
[49.9]
在斯科里亚漆黑的殿堂中，有两位杰出的弟子，他们也是一对亲兄弟：多姆和皮里欧。
[54.6]
多姆身手敏捷，头脑灵活，学习剑术一点就通。
[65.9]
但他的兄弟皮里欧，却没有这般天赋。他把 Ash 视作偶像，甚至奉若神明，却没有多姆那份从容与清醒。
[76.3]
也不如 Ash 那般冷酷无情。然而……多姆却在一次任务中反而被刺杀目标擒获。
[87.3]
对斯科里亚来说，这是不可饶恕的罪过。于是，维护学派戒律的重任便落到了较为平庸的皮里欧身上。而他必须亲手处决多姆。
[95.5]
只有这样，七人众才会认定多姆的缺陷……并非遗传。
[106.0]
你瞧，正如你所料，作为奥罗金创立的刺杀学派，斯科里亚对于……「学业优异」这件事，自然不会心慈手软。
[117.6]
倘若多姆死于皮里欧之手，就是一石二鸟。一来处决了失败者，二来抹杀了皮里欧心中最后一丝怜悯。
[120.1]
Ash 将亲自监督皮里欧执行这项任务。
[126.9]
无论如何，皮里欧的灵魂都注定在那一天消逝。要么随兄弟眼中的生机一同消散。
[137.7]
要么，他下不了手，便将成为毕生偶像 Ash 刀下的亡魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[8.2]
A sliver of pale sun found them close to a stately tower in the dusty heart of Martialis metropolis.
[15.2]
Coils of red Martian dust trailed tongues from the dark metal of Ash's Edo epaulets.
[26.1]
The boy idolized the Warframe and was eager to prove himself - even as some part of him felt cold and afraid at what he must do.
[35.7]
"Doubt is betrayal," taught the Scoria. Pilio recited this, but could not quench the fear he felt.
[46.8]
Fear of what he must do... and fear of what his hero and idol would do to him should his faith fail. Ash gave the signal.
[55.6]
Pilio shot forward in a bold, unconventional Dying Vine pattern, readying the Scoria-favored Dust Fang technique.
[64.1]
The tower guards squinted into the amber light of the Martian sunrise as a flash-cloud of smoke flooded the lane before them.
[76.6]
Shaking sleep from their heads and still thinking of breakfast, the guards readied themselves. From the smoke flew stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[8.2]
一缕暗淡的阳光照见了他们。两人来到了军管区大都会尘沙弥漫的腹地，一座宏伟的高塔矗立眼前。
[15.2]
赤红的火星尘沙滚滚卷来，自 Ash 那暗色金属制成的「江户」肩甲间拖曳而过。
[26.1]
少年将眼前的战甲奉若神明，迫切地想要证明自己。可一想到必须对自己的兄弟动手，他心底还是不由泛起一丝凉意，恐惧不断蔓延。
[35.7]
「怀疑即是背叛」。这是斯科里亚的信条。皮里欧反复默诵这句话，却始终无法平息心中的恐惧。
[46.8]
他害怕自己要做的事……也害怕自己要是下不去手，心中崇拜的英雄将置他于死地。Ash 发出了信号，示意他动手。
[55.6]
皮里欧剑走偏锋，以一招「死亡藤蔓」箭步冲出，准备蓄势施展斯科里亚的独门绝技「灰烬獠牙」。
[64.1]
高塔守卫迎着火星晨曦琥珀色的微光眯起眼睛。而下一秒，他们面前的街道就被烟尘覆盖。
[76.6]
守卫们甩去睡意，虽然还没搞清楚状况，却也本能地摆开防御阵势。此时，烟幕之中，星镖骤出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[6.3]
Staring into the lifeless eyes of the guardsman at his feet, bile rose in Pilio's throat.
[10.7]
The boy berated himself this weakness, this disgust.
[17.7]
Touching the symbol of his order, the smoke-gem between his eyes, he muttered a prayer for strength.
[28.0]
Stepping over the carpet of bodies, Ash crept into the courtyard, knowing full well the fifty-strong house guard would show itself in force.
[35.9]
With a sudden clatter, reinforcements lined the courtyard walls, balconies... The Scoria had a saying:
[41.4]
"You are immortal. One mistake makes that otherwise".
[46.2]
Ash had never made a mistake. Here were fifty.
[57.0]
With one swift movement, the Warframe swatted the boy into cover, unslung his Causta bow, and sprang into a flawless grey chrysanthemum combat solution.
[70.4]
Shame reddened Pilio's face as the courtyard lit noon-bright with the glare of a half-hundred muzzle flashes, his blade dry in his hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[6.3]
守卫们全部倒在了皮里欧的脚下。看着他们失去生气的双眼，皮里欧感到一阵恶心。
[10.7]
皮里欧在心里痛斥了自己刚刚的恶心和软弱。
[17.7]
他抬手触摸学派的印记，那块嵌在眉心的烟黑宝石。他低声祷告，祈求着力量。
[28.0]
Ash 跨过遍地尸体，悄无声息地潜入庭院。他很清楚，那支由五十人组成的护卫队，随时可能会一拥而上。
[35.9]
随着锵的一声，前来增援的守卫迅速在院墙和露台列阵……斯科里亚有一句箴言：
[41.4]
「你本不朽。一着不慎，万劫不复。」
[46.2]
在此之前，Ash 从未失手。但那天，却失手了足足五十次。
[57.0]
电光火石之间，他一把将皮里欧推到了掩体后面。紧接着，他解下了「灼蚀」之弓，纵身施展出无懈可击的「烬菊」战式。
[70.4]
五十道枪口火焰同时炸响，霎时把庭院映得宛如白昼。皮里欧羞愧得满脸通红。他手握刀刃，却仍未沾上敌人的一滴鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[6.5]
Ash methodically met and disassembled each and every guard, mezzanine to mezzanine:
[15.8]
a masterclass in the correct choices of stance, kata, technique, and attitude. Bodies rained into the courtyard.
[24.6]
Wincing, the boy looked away. Within minutes fifty corpses lay at their feet.
[32.6]
When Pilio felt Ash's shadow fall across him, he forced himself to look, trembling.
[39.2]
Ash's inscrutable gaze pinned him. Chest tight, breath terrified, and quick,
[43.5]
Pilio forced himself to stand and face his assessor.
[50.2]
He could not look at the bodies. Truthfully, he expected to die where he stood.
[55.2]
If the Warframe approved or disapproved, he gave no sign.
[63.6]
Rather, Ash opened an arm, showing the way toward Pilio's final trial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[6.5]
Ash 有条不紊地迎上面前的每个守卫，突破了一层又一层的包围。
[15.8]
这位武道宗师完美诠释了何为正确的架式、武形、招式与心境。尸体如雨点般洒落在庭院中。
[24.6]
少年面露惧色，移开了视线。短短几分钟后，地上就多了五十具尸体。
[32.6]
皮里欧察觉到 Ash 的影子映在自己身上，他浑身颤栗，强迫自己抬头。
[39.2]
Ash 看向皮里欧的眼神复杂深邃，将他牢牢钉在原地。皮里欧也不禁胸口发紧，呼吸急促。
[43.5]
但他还是强撑着站起身来，面向正在审视自己的 Ash。
[50.2]
他无法直视那些尸体。说实话，他早已做好当场死在这里的准备。
[55.2]
是认可，还是否定？Ash 的脸上没有流露半分情绪。
[63.6]
相反，Ash 只是伸出一只手，指向了皮里欧最后的试炼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[8.6]
In the target's chambers sat a middle-aged man with long, handsome mustaches, his eyes sad and kind.
[16.8]
And with him? Dom: in civilian clothes… sharing a glass of aged claret.
[22.7]
Pain cracked through Pilio's brain, the smoke-gem between his eyes flashing hot!
[27.4]
Sudden images of sunlight. Vineyards. A woman's face.
[31.4]
The gem burned as it pushed these images away.
[42.0]
A young man with grand mustaches smiling and saying, "Of all the sons I could have had, I'm glad it was you two".
[49.5]
Pain! Dom leapt to his feet, urging his brother to hear what the target had to say,
[56.7]
but Pilio saw only the scabbed-over divot between Dom's eyes where a black jewel had once rested.
[64.8]
Dom had turned his back on their order. Why? Why had he done this?
[72.9]
The mustachioed man leapt to Dom's defense, snatching his sidearm from beneath his ironwood desk - a foolish mistake.
[80.9]
Ash split into impossible multiples. The man opened fire on the three, before being seized from behind by the fourth.
[89.9]
Ash's illusory clones vanished. The weapon clattered to the polished wooden floor, even as his feet left it, dangling three feet above,
[103.7]
helpless - those sad, kind eyes locked on Pilio's in a regretful farewell. "Ask the Warframe," Dom said, "He knows exactly why."
[117.4]
Fear filled Pilio's heart. Pilio turned to his idol, that saint of murder. The same question, but this time for Ash: why?
[125.6]
That moment of breathtaking impudence stretched for an eternity. Ash released his grip.
[139.2]
His prisoner flopped to the floor, gasping. With one great hand, Ash reached toward Pilio's face... and sank a vicious talon beneath that midnight jewel.
[144.6]
Pilio screamed. Blood flowed.
[154.6]
The gem flew free with a nauseating pop, cracking against the wall to die in a weak plume of rancid smoke.
[162.1]
Blinding white insight descended upon Pilio DeNas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[8.6]
目标所在的房间内，坐着一位中年男人。他留着修长迷人的胡须，眼神忧郁而温和。
[16.8]
而在他身边的，正是衣着朴素的多姆。他和那名男人对饮同一杯陈年红酒。
[22.7]
皮里欧突然头痛欲裂，眉心那枚烟黑宝石发出炽热的亮光！
[27.4]
刹那间，他的脑海里出现了阳光、葡萄园以及一位女人的面庞。
[31.4]
宝石变得滚烫，那些影像也随之消散。
[42.0]
一位留着大胡子的年轻男人笑着说道：「能有你们这两个儿子，真是我的福分。」
[49.5]
剧痛袭来！多姆猛然起身，劝说他的兄弟听完目标打算说的话。
[56.7]
但皮里欧只是死死盯着多姆的额头。他的眉心之间本该有枚黑色宝石，现在，却只有一道凹陷的疤痕。
[64.8]
多姆背叛了学派。为什么？他为什么要这么做？
[72.9]
那个大胡子的男人立马挺身想护住多姆，顺势从那张铁木书桌下抽出佩枪——这是个愚蠢的错误。
[80.9]
Ash 瞬间化为无数分身。那名男人朝三个分身开火，却被第四个分身从背后牢牢擒住。
[89.9]
Ash 的幻影分身随即消失。那把枪咣当一声掉在了光滑的木地板上，而男人则被高高举起，离地三尺，双脚无力地悬在半空。
[103.7]
绝望无助。那双忧郁温和的眼睛望着皮里欧，像是在做最后的告别。「问问 Ash，」多姆说，「他什么都知道。」
[117.4]
皮里欧心中充满了恐惧。他转头望向自己崇拜的偶像，那位杀戮之神。还是那个问题，但这一次他问的是 Ash：为什么？
[125.6]
皮里欧的质问，令人屏息。那一刻被拉得漫长，仿佛持续了永恒。终于，Ash 松开了手。
[139.2]
之前被高高举起的男人跌落在地，喘着粗气。Ash 将一只手伸向皮里欧的面庞……用锋利的爪尖抠向黑色宝石下方。
[144.6]
皮里欧嘶声惨叫。鲜血喷涌而出。
[154.6]
伴随着一声令人反胃的闷响，那颗宝石被硬生生剜了出来，撞碎在墙上，化作了一缕微弱而腐臭的烟雾。
[162.1]
一道炫目的白光当头照下，皮里欧·德纳斯终于明白了一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[9.0]
Pilio was Pilio DeNas. Everything the black gem had walled off within his mind was now laid bare.
[20.0]
The Scoria had stolen the sons of Lio DeNas. Lio DeNas - kind-eyed Lio DeNas - was stealing them back.
[32.3]
"Of all the sons I could have had, I'm glad it was you two." Father and son beheld each other truly for the first time in almost twenty years.
[39.9]
Pilio had long-aspired to wearing the Edo armor, the highest honor, to signify his faith,
[46.9]
but now he saw only the bare ribs of Ash's Cremata syandana, signifier of death,
[53.5]
and knew with certainty that was the sole credo of the faith he had followed.
[60.0]
Had. The boy, who until that moment had thought himself a lifelong killer,
[67.9]
was now torn between the nocturnal life he thought he knew and the sunlit life he had been stolen from.
[82.7]
Torn between Doctrine and family. And, blade in hand, torn between saving himself by killing his brother… or dying alongside him at the hand of his idol.
[92.1]
Ash waited, patient as the death he signified, in a room in a moment that felt suspended in eternity.
[102.4]
Waiting for Pilio's decision. The blade fell from Pilio's hand. Dom reached out and gently took that hand.
[105.8]
Ash did not move.
[122.6]
Lio DeNas swept his boys up and out of that room, and, as a family, they fled the Tower, the city, and Mars - forever. Ash did not move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[9.0]
皮里欧原来叫皮里欧·德纳斯。所有被黑色宝石封存的记忆，一下子涌入了他的脑海。
[20.0]
斯科里亚偷走了利奥·德纳斯的两个儿子。利奥·德纳斯，那个慈眉善目的男人，一直想把孩子夺回来。
[32.3]
「能有你们这两个儿子，真是我的福分。」历经了近二十年的磨难，父子终于团聚。
[39.9]
一直以来，皮里欧都向往着穿上「江户」肩甲，那是象征他信仰的最高荣誉。
[46.9]
可此刻，他眼中所见的，却只有 Ash 「焚烬」披饰背后裸露如肋骨的轮廓，那是死亡的象征。
[53.5]
他终于明白，自己一直追随的信仰，从头到尾只有一条教义：死亡。
[60.0]
到此为止了。在这之前，这个男孩认为自己注定要当一辈子的杀手。
[67.9]
而如今，他正在两种人生之间举棋不定：一种，是他自以为熟悉的黑暗人生；另一种，是被人偷走的灿烂人生。
[82.7]
他在教义和亲情之间左右为难。手中的剑，也不知该砍向何方。是杀死兄弟，保全自己……还是和兄弟一起，死在自己崇敬的偶像刀下。
[92.1]
Ash 静静等待着，如他所象征的死亡一样耐心。此时此地，时间似乎停止了流逝。
[102.4]
他等待着皮里欧做出选择。利刃从皮里欧手中滑落。多姆伸出手来，温柔地握住皮里欧刚刚拿剑的那只手。
[105.8]
Ash 纹丝未动。
[122.6]
利奥·德纳斯一把揽过两个儿子，冲出了房间。他们一家人逃出了那座高塔、那座城市、逃出了火星，一去不复返。Ash 依然一动不动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[3.6]
So. What are we to make of this?
[15.4]
Why did Ash - focal figure of the Scoria  - go against Doctrine and permit two boys who were both failures and traitors to fly free?
[23.7]
What was it this killer saw in two near-orphans that, shall we say, softened his heart?
[30.2]
We do not know. Neither did Pilio, whose memoirs bring us this story.
[47.9]
But. We do know this: in the final days of Orokin rule... as towers fell and death came for the white-and-gold gods…the Scoria were not spared.
[62.5]
No. Rather their senior ranks - the mentors and chief assassins - were exterminated to a figure in a pogrom of ruthless and breathtaking efficiency.
[74.3]
A near-total destruction led... in the main... by Ash. Curious, no?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[3.6]
那么，这个故事告诉了我们什么？
[15.4]
为什么身为斯科里亚核心人物的 Ash 会违背教义，放走那两个任务失败、背叛学派的少年？
[23.7]
这位顶级杀手，究竟从那两兄弟身上看到了什么，或者说，究竟是什么让他动了恻隐之心？
[30.2]
我们无从知晓。就连留下这段回忆录的皮里欧，也不知道答案。
[47.9]
不过，我们知道的是，在奥罗金统治的最后时日里，当高塔倾覆，死神终于找上了那些白金色的神明……斯科里亚也未能幸免。
[62.5]
是的。即便是学派中的高层——那些导师和高级刺客，也在一场无情而高效的大屠杀中几乎被屠戮殆尽。
[74.3]
那场近乎彻底的大清洗，其主导者……正是 Ash。耐人寻味，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This is Atlas. Hard as stone. Is it any surprise, that his story begins with an asteroid? Temple Telamon had cast a spell on the indentured masses with a song that heralded the coming of a great stone destroyer. A god who would shatter the world and lead them to a great rebirth. The Orokin mocked the cult's off-key singing, their spasmodic dancing, but the spell only grew stronger. Telamon broadcasts would oft-times wedge into controlled channels to spread their doomsday message. For the suffocated lower castes, the notion of something more powerful than their Orokin masters must have been intoxicating. A brutal Orokin crackdown seemed to be working… until… an asteroid was detected on a collision course with Earth. The Telamons celebrated it as prophecy writ true. Divine intervention. For the first time in living memory, the Orokin showed vulnerability. It did not matter that the destruction would be total. For the Temple, this was a sign of a new age.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这就是坚如磐石的 Atlas。要是他的故事始于一颗小行星，是不是也不足为奇了？特拉蒙神殿用一首歌蛊惑了受契约奴役的民众。歌中预言，一位伟大的巨石毁灭者即将降临。那是一尊能够击碎世界，并带领他们迎来新生的神明。奥罗金曾把这些人视为邪教徒，嘲笑他们跑调的歌声和丑陋的舞姿。但这首歌的影响力却不减反增。特拉蒙的广播时常在官方频道插播，传播他们的末日论。对于饱受压迫的底层人而言，一想到世上还有比奥罗金主子更强大的存在，便足以让他们心驰神往。奥罗金随即展开了残酷的镇压，并且看来颇有成效。直到……人们发现，一颗小行星正朝地球撞来。特拉蒙信众欢欣鼓舞，认定预言应验了，是神明出手了。有史以来，奥罗金第一次流露出脆弱的一面。这场灾难会不会毁灭一切，根本无关紧要。对于神殿来说，这标志着新时代的来临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Before you, a rare sight, two Rumblers, painstakingly recreated from fragments of the aforementioned Tableau. How these inert and rigid formations are compelled to life by Atlas defies reason. Yet, it is true. Consider the confusion of those Telamons as the very stone they worshiped came to life and set upon them. How could they retaliate against such a thing? Like sparring with a landslide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 在您面前的，是一场奇观。这两尊漫步石者，是用刚才提到的石化群像碎片作为依据，经过极其繁复的工序重新复原而成的。这些本该死寂僵硬的岩石，竟能被 Atlas 赋予生命，这完全有悖常理，但却是千真万确的事实。您可以想象，当那些被特拉蒙信徒顶礼膜拜的石头忽然活了过来，转身还向他们发起攻击，他们会有多么错愕。面对这些石头，他们又该如何还手？那无异于以卵击石。
