/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: A probe was sent to the asteroid, perhaps seeking proof of divine intervention. It found intervention, though it was anything but divine. The rock had been fitted with colossal steering thrusters and manning those thrusters, a bevy of well-armed Telamon. Having taken fate into their own hands, they set about a final convulsive dance aboard that rock. Battlecruisers, Orgon missiles, a gale-force of Dax… the Orokin could have resolved this in any number of ways. But their enemy was not the Telamons themselves. It was their ideas. Atlas, alone, was sent. As he crashed onto that rock, his Shikoro helm greeted the cultists. Note the angled ballistic plating and reinforced neck protection. He would soon need both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 或许是为了寻求「神降天灾」的证据，他们向这颗小行星发送了一枚探测器。探测器发现这并不是天灾，而是人祸。小行星上安装着巨大的转向推进器，而操控推进器的，则是一群全副武装的特拉蒙信徒。他们将命运掌握在自己手中，然后在那颗小行星上跳起最后一场诡异舞蹈。战巡舰，奥刚导弹，摧枯拉朽的禁卫部队……奥罗金有的是办法来解决这场危机。可他们真正的敌人，并不是特拉蒙信徒本身，而是他们的思想。于是，奥罗金只派出了 Atlas。当他轰然坠落到小行星上时，最先映入那些信徒眼帘的，是他的「兜围」头盔。请注意那倾斜的防弹板和加强过的颈部护甲。很快，它们都会派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: For years, historians felt this 'Tale of Telamon' quite improbable, an artifact of Orokin propaganda-myth. Then, on our system's outer edge, we found a debris field of small rocks and dust in a lazy elliptical orbit. Upon these rocks, we find the remains of peculiar stone statuary. The petrified figures, clearly Temple members, have been frozen into a tableau of struggle and death. Or was it, perhaps, a dance? This remarkable find forces us to rethink the entire tale as fact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 多年以来，历史学家们认为这个「特拉蒙传说」太过离奇，只不过是奥罗金编造出来标榜自己的故事。后来，人们在星系边缘发现了一片碎石与尘埃组成的碎石带，它们沿着椭圆轨道，静静飘行。碎石带上，我们找到残存的奇特石雕。那些被石化的人显然是神殿信徒，他们被永远定格在挣扎与死亡的瞬间……又或者是他们在舞蹈？栩栩如生。这一重大发现迫使我们重新审视整则传说。甚至不得不承认，那不是传说，而是史实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Earth swelled on the horizon, as the cult mocked Atlas with their chorus, "The stone shall shatter all!" Across the system, every Telamon echoed that final hymn. Children, as far as Neptune, turned their heads from greasy broth and gazed toward Earth. Would that careening stone change… everything? Atlas kneeled down, head and hands pressed to the ground in apparent defeat as the Telamon's hymn grew even louder. But Atlas was listening, feeling - the way the stone trembled to the hymn's pitch. The faults within the asteroid became vivid to him… and so a new song rose up. Rumblers. Erupting in a god-like rhythm, beating along the faults until Atlas, alone, struck the final, resonant chord. A tremor forked through the rock until… All at once, the great asteroid exploded, its dust falling as scintillating rain sparking across the atmosphere… and then gone… The Telemon's song fell silent and children, as far as Neptune, turned away and swirled their spoons in greasy broth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 随着小行星离地球越来越近，信徒们齐声歌唱，嘲笑着 Atlas，「行星将粉碎一切！」整个星系都回响着特拉蒙信众最后的赞歌。远在海王星的孩子们，都从油腻的肉汤前抬起头来，望向地球的方向。那块翻滚的小行星会改变……这一切吗？Atlas 跪倒在地，头和双手紧贴着小行星表面，显然，他的败局已定。特拉蒙信徒的歌声也愈发嘹亮，但他并未屈服。他在聆听，感受着这颗小行星如何随着赞歌的高音而震颤。在他眼里，小行星的断层轮廓变得清晰鲜明……新的歌声又响起了。漫步石者被召唤了出来。在神圣的节奏中钻入地层，沿着各个断层重重敲击，直到 Atlas，独自奏响最后一道引发共振的和弦。震颤如同迅速生长的藤蔓，在行星内部不断分叉、不断穿透，直到……刹那之间，巨大的小行星轰然爆裂。雨点般的碎石在大气层擦起万点火星，下起了一场闪耀的光雨，最终消失无踪……特拉蒙信众的歌声戛然而止。而那些远在海王星的孩子们，又转过头去，继续用汤勺搅动起油腻的肉汤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Stratum Syandana. Reserved and austere, until you turn it over and reveal the glowing hue of the amethyst crystal within. A breathtaking geode. Imagine its spiraling ribbons as Atlas tore toward the killer asteroid's thrusters. His plan must have been to reorient them and push the rock away from Earth. But, as the story goes, as he neared, the cultists detonated the thruster's footings and sent them careening into space. They were no longer needed, mass and inertia would carry the rock to its fate. Atlas was out of options, or so the Telamons thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 地层披饰。初看朴实无华，直到将其翻转过来，才能看见内部紫水晶散发出的耀眼光泽。简直是一块美得令人窒息的晶球。请想象一下，当 Atlas 冲向那颗灭世行星的推进器时，这件披饰上的螺旋飘带在他身后翻卷飞舞的景象。他原本肯定是想改变推进器的方向，将小行星推离地球。然而，事与愿违，他靠近时，信徒们引爆了推进器的底座，并将推进器送入了太空。他们用不上这些推进器了，因为质量和惯性会把这颗小行星带向它最后的归宿。Atlas 无计可施了，至少特拉蒙信徒是这么认为的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Tekko are, perhaps my favorite pieces in this gallery. Note the intricate, ornate moldings, the complex blades. Quite the contrast from Atlas' otherwise workmanlike appearance. The beauty and craftsmanship conceal the true purpose of the Tekko, as indentations found in cultist's skulls attest. I have to wonder what frenzied dance would have been interrupted - or - if the whiplash strikes and jabs of the Tekko might have blended into the crowd's fitful celebration?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这对「刺蛇」手甲，算是整座展馆里我最喜欢的藏品。请留意它精美绝伦的纹饰和层叠交错的刃部。与 Atlas 朴实无华的外表形成鲜明对比。在「刺蛇」巧夺天工的精美造型面前，人们往往忘记了它的真实用途，在信徒头骨上发现的凹痕已经说明了一切。我不禁怀疑，是那些信徒的舞蹈本身就那么疯狂，还是由于「刺蛇」的重击和穿刺，信徒们才做出了怪诞扭曲的动作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Are you… sure? My sincerest thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您……确定吗？请接受我最诚挚的谢意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This is too much… but I will accept it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这实在太多了……那就恭敬不如从命了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: A real patron of history! I am honored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您才真正为历史添砖加瓦！受您垂青是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: You must be insane! A pleasure to meet you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您太疯狂了！幸会，实在幸会！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: I… that is to say… I mean… you… really? Gosh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 我……也就是说……我是说……您……当真？噢，天哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Ahh... with that... I could buy my-- A lavish gift for the Leverian!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 有了这笔钱……我就能赎回我的——这是献给莱弗博物馆的一份厚礼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Oh? Humbled, truly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 哦？这可真让我受宠若惊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Very generous! Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您真慷慨！万分感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Unexpected… I'm speechless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 真没想到……我都不知道怎么感谢您了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 多谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: I will put it to good use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 我会妥善使用这笔捐赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Mmmm hmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Well… anything helps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 唔……多少都算心意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: That's fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 也好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Hello there. So, first time then? Drusus Leverian. Welcome to my humble cabinet of curiosities. Drop any donations in the little box. Now, the Leverian is a bit of a work in progress, but please do look around. I only ask you be gentle with the collection. The displays are quite valuable, quite rare, and some may still be… armed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您好，看着挺面生，你第一次来吗？我是德枢·莱弗。欢迎来到我这不起眼的奇珍陈列室。如有捐赠，请投入旁边的小箱子。莱弗博物馆目前还没有完全布置妥当，不过请尽管随便看看。我只求您对这些藏品温柔一些。展品不仅价值不菲，还极其罕见，而其中几件或许还……没有解除武装。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: A stripped-out Gauss Airfoil system. These fanciful contrivances contribute the Kubrodon's share of this Warframe's acceleration. Strength, mass, density - all held in a delicate balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这是一套从 Gauss 身上拆解下来的翼面系统。正是这些颇具巧思的装置，几乎包办了这具战甲的大半加速能力。强度、质量、密度——每一项都维持在精妙而脆弱的平衡之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Ahhh. Gauss. Where to begin, where to begin... Well, the Ceres excavation, of course. The site of the ancient tower of Altra. Blastcrete emplacements, air sentries… its fields saturated with tremor-mines. A great fortress for the great lords of Ceres... Until they were pitched from the roof, immortal bodies erupting on the dread mines below. An insurgency, from within. The Dax sent to reclaim Altra fared no better. Those that ran the gauntlet of bore-guns were soon cindered in the field beyond… That's when they called in our fleet-footed friend here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 啊——Gauss。该从哪儿说起……从哪儿说起呢……有了！当然得从谷神星的发掘现场说起。那里曾矗立着古老的阿尔特拉高塔。防爆混凝土工事、空中哨兵……周围的原野更埋满了震荡地雷。那曾是谷神星显贵们引以为傲的宏伟要塞……直到他们被人从塔顶扔了下去。那些号称不朽的身躯，引爆了深埋的地雷。那是一场内乱。随后，禁卫奉命夺回阿尔特拉高塔，可他们的下场也好不到哪里去。侥幸冲过枪林弹雨的禁卫，很快又在更远处的原野上被烧成灰烬……于是，他们请来了我们眼前这位号称「飞毛腿」的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Not the standard dress helm. This one has specialized control surfaces, angled plating. Supreme streamlining. It catches the light in a curious way, doesn't it? When it shines just so, I see myself atop Altra, a hostage perhaps, peering out across the desolate field… and then… I'd see it. A pale glint of light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这并不是制式礼装头盔。它配有专门设计的控制面、带斜角的镀层和完美的流线设计。它折射光线的方式很特别，不是吗？当光芒恰好这样从表面掠过，我仿佛看见自己正置身阿尔特拉塔顶。也许，我是一名被扣押的人质，正越过高墙，望向那片荒凉的原野……然后……我会看见它。远方一闪而过的苍白微光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Dax of the day had a saying: "That which cannot be hit cannot be killed". I can only imagine what they thought when they saw Gauss that day. A gleaming bullet, this Syandana pinned rigid like a flag in a maelstrom, streaking toward Altra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
当时的禁卫中流传着一句话：
「打不中的东西，就杀不死。」我只能想象，那一天，他们看见 Gauss 时，心里究竟作何感想。他如同一枚闪耀的子弹，直射阿尔特拉塔。这件披饰则在狂流中绷得笔直，仿佛一面迎着风暴飞扬的战旗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Gauss. Front edge: smooth heat-resistant composites. Trailing edges: streamlined, foiled, this particular one vaguely warped by extreme heat stress. The Saint of Altra. If the mind wanders, what do you see? I see a vivid Lord-like Festival, the tremor mines bursting in a blinding wave, rising toward Altra. And Gauss - a smear of light, just ahead of the thermal avalanche - fast as fire. No… faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Gauss。前缘：光滑的耐热复合材料。后缘：收束成流线翼面。其中这一片，已经在极端热应力下略微变形。阿尔特拉的守护神。任思绪驰骋时，您会看见什么？我看见一场盛大精彩的庆典。震荡地雷在刺目的光浪中接连炸响，释放的冲击波一路席卷，冲上阿尔特拉高塔。而 Gauss 化作一抹光的残影，始终抢在那场炽热冲击波之前。快如流火。不……比流火更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The voices of the dead ring out again thanks to your largesse, Tenno. Continued largesse, I hope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 得益于您的慷慨解囊，亡者之音才能再次响起。希望您能继续支持我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno! Of course! The Leverian always has time for our more generous patrons. Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno！莱弗博物馆的大门永远对慷慨大方的赞助人敞开。欢迎欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno! An honor, as always. We exist in part thanks to your generosity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno！一如既往的荣幸。您的慷慨让我们得以延续至今。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Most generous, Tenno. Welcome. Our donation box stands ready, as always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno，您太慷慨了。欢迎欢迎，我们的捐款箱就在那边，随时恭候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Most valued patron, friend to history, welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 最慷慨的赞助人、历史的挚友，欢迎光临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Ah, most valued patron. The donation box is there, as always. Ha ha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 啊，最慷慨的赞助人。捐款箱还在老地方，一如既往。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Money spent on education is never wasted. He said, gesturing toward the donation box.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 「花在教育上的钱，永远不会白费。」他指着捐款箱如是说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian's generous friend. Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 莱弗博物馆的慷慨贵客。欢迎您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome, friend. If you need anything just call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎光临，朋友。有任何需要，随时告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome, once again, to the Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎您再次光临莱弗博物馆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno! I trust you are well?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno！近来可好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Your kind donation has gone toward further exhibits. History thanks you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您的慷慨捐赠已用于筹备更多展品。我代表历史，感谢您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This is your history, Tenno. Your family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno，这是您的历史，也是所有 Tenno 的历史。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: History. It's like time travel… without the consequences.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 品味历史。就像穿越时空……只是不用承担任何后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno! I wasn't expecting your arrival. Please uh... make yourself at home, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno！我没想到您会大驾光临！请务必，呃……不要见外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Most generous patron! If it pleases you, may I elucidate as to this exhibit's storied history? It is quite riveting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 最慷慨的赞助人！可否允许我为您讲解一段这件展品背后的传奇？绝对精彩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Oh my. Tenno. You honor us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 天啊，Tenno。您的到来可真是蓬荜生辉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno. Your… your generosity has breathed new life into this humble museum. How may I serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno。您的……您的慷慨为这座小博物馆注入了新的活力。有什么能为您效劳吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno. Please. Allow me to escort you among the treasures your bountiful generosity has preserved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno。请容我带您在这历史海洋中徜徉，正是您的慷慨让展品得以保存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno, I've been considering one of those new Domestiks. Would you recommend such a purchase?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno，我最近考虑添置一台新款内务无人机。您觉得划算吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno. Welcome. Please. Enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno。欢迎光临，请慢慢欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome. Your more-than-generous contributions have aided the Leverian a great deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎。您的慷慨解囊，实在是帮了博物馆大忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian. The history you see here is, in part, preserved by your generosity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您在莱弗博物馆所目睹的历史，也有一部分因您的慷慨才得以留存至今。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: You are a friend, Tenno, and a champion of posterity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno，您是我们的朋友，也是历史传承的守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Ah yes. Quite a story to this one. Take a closer look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 没错。这件展品背后有段精彩的故事。走近些看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome. Now. Square your shoulders, for you are in the company of greatness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎。来，挺起胸膛。在博物馆里，您周围的展品无不彰显伟大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: History teaches us that we long for a better world, but hunger too quickly to do anything about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 历史告诉我们，人总向往更美好的世界，但又太快被欲望拖住脚步，无法真正行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Most honorable Tenno, most vaunted patron. The Leverian awaits your pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 最尊贵的 Tenno，最慷慨的赞助人。莱弗博物馆恭候您的光临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian welcomes her most valued patron.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 莱弗博物馆恭迎我们最尊贵的赞助人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The future thanks her guardian, the most generous Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 未来会向她的守护者——最慷慨的 Tenno 致谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno. I am forever your most humble servant. How may Drusus serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno。我永远是您最谦卑的仆人。今天能为您做些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Tenno. The Leverian, and all her treasures, are open to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Tenno，莱弗博物馆和其中所有的珍藏，随时向您开放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: We are forever in the company of those who have gone before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 肉体会消亡，但历史永远与我们同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Our sole allegiance is to Truth, Tenno. This place? Is testament to that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 我们只忠于真相，Tenno。这里的一切，便是证明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: I find simplicity to be the height of sophistication.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 在我看来，简洁往往是精致的极致。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Ah, lured back by the promise of knowledge?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 啊，您是被知识的魅力吸引回来的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian welcomes you once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 莱弗博物馆再次欢迎您的到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian is always open. Care to leave something to help keep the lights on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 莱弗博物馆随时欢迎您的光临。是否愿意留点心意，帮助我们维持博物馆运转呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: If you enjoy my displays, please, consider leaving a donation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 如果您喜欢这些展品，还请考虑慷慨解囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: You know, I never stopped loving the Grineer. Or started, to be honest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您知道，我从未停止过对克隆尼的爱。说实话，也从未有过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: History has taught me that people praise their ancestors because they never knew them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 历史告诉我，人们之所以歌颂祖先，多半是因为从未真正了解他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This place is sacred, Tenno. Tread lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这里是神圣之地，Tenno。还请小心些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Hello again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 又见面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Drusus Leverian. Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 我是德枢·莱弗。欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Any friend of history is a friend of the Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 凡是历史的朋友，就是莱弗的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Feel free to look around. All donations are appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 请随意参观。感谢您的捐赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome. Try not to touch anything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎光临，还请尽量别碰展品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Hello hello. Exhibition is that way, donation box just over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您好您好。参观展览请走那边，捐款箱就在旁边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Greetings. What piques your interest this fine day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 您好，今天是哪件藏品勾起了您的雅兴？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Leverian exists thanks largely to the donations of patrons such as yourself. Please, leave a little something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 莱弗博物馆能维持至今，多亏了像您这样的贵客慷慨解囊。还请多多支持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Enjoy and please: leave something in the little box over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 请慢慢欣赏，可以的话还请在那边的小箱子里留点心意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Welcome to the Leverian. We are, of course, always open. Donations appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 欢迎来到莱弗博物馆。我们当然随时欢迎您的光临。感谢您的捐赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Grendel: Primal. Insatiable. And, as this exhibit will demonstrate, a creature of surprising compassion. After the fall of the Orokin Empire a surviving Orokin Executor - a violet-scented brute named Karishh - lorded over Europa's frozen, famine-struck city of Riddha. Safe within his walled manse the moist and loathsome Karishh lived a lavish life while his frail citizens obeyed every edict in the hope of receiving his pre-masticated table scraps. As the city starved beneath him, Karishh commanded yet another feast for himself and his gluttonous sycophants… twelve courses for each of his twelve grafted digestive sacs… and one… one, uninvited guest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Grendel，代表原始、贪得无厌。而正如这件展品所展示的那样，他也有一副出人意料的慈悲心肠。奥罗金帝国覆灭后，一位浑身散发紫罗兰香气的幸存执行者占据了欧罗巴的瑞达城，彼时那里，正饱受严寒和饥荒的打击。他名叫卡里什，这个湿腻而令人作呕的恶棍，整天躲在高墙环绕的府邸中穷奢极欲，安然度日。城中骨瘦如柴的百姓却只能对他的每一道命令俯首听命，只盼能分到一口他吃剩的冷炙残羹。整座城市在他治下挨饿，卡里什却又一次下令举办盛宴，款待自己和那群贪食谄媚的走狗……他身上移植了十二个消化囊，每一个，都要配上十二道菜。而这场盛宴，还有一位……一位不请自来的客人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: It came as no surprise to me, to find this tiny fragment of Gauss just outside the city. Indeed, if one thing is for certain, wherever we find evidence of Grendel, we're sure to find some trace of Gauss as well. Did they breach the city as a pair? Or did Gauss hang back to intercept returning patrols, generously letting his friend Grendel eat his fill at the feast within?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 当我在城外发现这一小块属于 Gauss 的残片时，倒是一点也不意外。毕竟，有一件事几乎可以确定。哪里留下了 Grendel 的痕迹，附近往往也能找到 Gauss 的线索。他们当时是携手攻进城里的？还是 Gauss 负责断后，拦截回援的巡逻队，慷慨地把府邸里的盛宴都留给 Grendel 大快朵颐？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Note the open-face, almost maw-like design. A fitting visage for one of such singular, rapacious predilections. Grendel may hunger, yes, but not with the excesses of gluttony. Not when others are in need. Oral history tells of Grendel, newly-engorged from his repast, rolling through the miserable slums of Riddha, reinvigorating the sick and the lame, the hungry and the dying, with the power he had stolen - consumed - from their oppressors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 请留意这副开放式的面部设计，几乎就像一张大张的巨口。对于有着如此独特食欲的战甲而言，确实再合适不过。Grendel 的确会感到饥饿。但他的饥饿，并不是毫无节制的暴饮暴食。至少，当别人也在挨饿时，不是。口口相传的历史故事中，刚刚饱餐一顿的 Grendel 滚过瑞达城凄苦的贫民区，将自己从压迫者身上夺取——或者说，吞噬——而来的力量，分给了病弱者、残疾者、饥民与垂死之人。让那些人得以恢复生机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: There remains a shallow trench through the ruins. As if some colossal boulder had crashed from the manse and rolled down the hill… but what if it had rolled… up? Imagine if you will, Karishh's Dax on the day… peering out, dumbstruck by what they saw. They readied no blade, sounded no alarm as the expanding orb of gristle hurled toward them. And then, in a spasm of giblets, Grendel was before them. His 'cutlery' in hand... The Masseter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
废墟中至今还留着一道浅沟。看起来，就像有一块巨大的石球从府邸顺着山坡一路滚下……但倘若它滚动的方向……
是从下往上呢？想象一下，那天，卡里什麾下的禁卫探头望去，眼前的景象吓得他们目瞪口呆。一团不断膨胀的筋肉巨球正朝他们猛冲而来。他们甚至没来得及拔刀，也没来得及发出警报。下一刻，伴着一阵血肉翻涌，Grendel 已经站在他们面前。手中还握着他的「餐具」……「咀嚼金杖」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Here we have shattered fragments of the manse wall and the gate mangled by Grendel's Masseter blade. One can almost see, the city's masses, newly-rejuvenated by Grendel's healthful blessing, storming the manse. Shattered gates thrown wide, they take back what was theirs. Namely, control of their future. See here the scattering of genuine Orokin dinnerware. Worn with time, these must have been used for countless meals as the people of Riddha bravely weathered the dark times ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这里陈列的，是府邸墙壁的碎片，以及被 Grendel 用「咀嚼金杖」彻底绞毁的大门残骸。几乎不难想象当时的景象，瑞达城的民众在 Grendel 赐予的生命力下重新振作，随即一拥而上，冲进府邸。破碎的大门轰然洞开。他们夺回了本就属于自己的东西。换句话说，他们夺回了掌控自己未来的权力。再看看这些散落的奥罗金餐具。它们都是真品，表面都有被漫长岁月磨损的痕迹。在此后的黑暗年代里，瑞达城的人民想必曾无数次使用它们，共享一顿又一顿饭食，彼此扶持着活了下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Many Warframes have speed and litheness but power, momentum, impact… these require mass. And there… the creased mid-section - the seam. Does it split? Yawning open with a jagged, vacuous aperture to… to who knows? A certain Orokin may have found out. That night the people of Riddha ate their fill, feasting until the frozen mountains lit warmly with the dawn. It was toward those roseate peaks that the Executor had fled, pursued by Grendel. What his fate was I cannot say, but as the people feasted, so the story goes, they were suddenly struck silent by a strange, deep sound. A rumble carried from mountain to mountain: a Single. Satisfied. Belch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
许多战甲都兼具速度与轻盈的身手。可若要获得力量、气势与冲击力……那就需要足够的重量。再看这里……腹部褶皱之间的这道接缝。它会裂开吗？会不会张成一处布满锯齿、空无一物的大嘴，通往……通往谁也不知道的地方？某位奥罗金，或许亲自验证了答案。那天夜里，瑞达城的人民终于吃了顿饱饭。他们大快朵颐，直到晨光将冰封的群山染得温暖明亮。卡里什正是逃向了那些泛着玫瑰色的山峰。而 Grendel，紧追其后。
卡里什最后究竟遭遇了什么，我无法断言。不过传说称，就在人们继续饮宴时，一阵古怪而低沉的声音忽然传来，令所有人同时安静下来。那声轰鸣在群山之间久久回荡。那是一声……心满意足的……饱嗝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Scraps of cloth matching Grendel's unexpectedly elegant Syandana were retrieved from the site, hooked on the remnants of gilded gates, stained with evidence of his… degustation. Indeed, most of the Orokin hangers-on who attended the feast… became it. And Karishh himself fled shrieking into the hills of Riddha, as fast as his twelve exo-sac levitators would carry him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 人们在镀金大门的残骸上，找到了几片被勾住的布料。它们与 Grendel 那件惊艳典雅的披饰完全吻合，上面还沾满了他……品尝盛宴的痕迹。事实上，那些前来赴宴、攀附奥罗金的宾客，大多最后都成了宴席的菜肴。至于卡里什，则一路尖叫着逃进瑞达城外的群山。速度快到他的十二个体外消化囊都能带着他飘起来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Ivara ran at a wall, and up it. Hanging there, waiting, as the Myrmidon flipped into the room, blasting the spot where he had expected her to be.

Frustrated he again made that same elaborate gesture, trying his luck, and she saw it: that bracelet upon the wrist that glowed softly with the movement of that clutching gesture.

Ivara flipped from her perch, shouldering her exquisitely-crafted Rubico as she did so, and sighted the enemy. Through the Orokin-sculpted scope, hunter and huntress met eye-to-eye, each loosing a desperate blast: a bullet from Ivara, a killing light from the Myrmidon. The green light lashed, touching a shoulder plate of Ivara's Avia Armor, reducing it to dust. It saved her.

Huntress won out, her shot claiming the Myrmidon's device in a shower of sparks. But the Myrmidon's weapon remained lethal, and with it he lashed out at Ivara in an emerald fury.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Ivara 迎着墙壁冲去，蹬墙而上。她攀附在那，静候时机。不多时，密尔弥多涅冲进洞室，轰击了他以为 Ivara 躲藏的位置。看到那里空无一人，他略显失望。于是，他又摆出了那个手势，想再次碰碰运气。而 Ivara 看到了破绽：他做出抓握手势的时候，手腕上的一只手镯会泛起柔和的光芒。Ivara 从高处一跃而下，同时把制作精良的「绝路」狙击枪架在肩上，瞄准了敌人。透过奥罗金工艺雕琢的瞄准镜，两名猎手四目相接。双方同时发起殊死一击——Ivara 射出了一发子弹，而密尔弥多涅则放出了一道致命绿光。那绿光如鞭扫出，擦中了 Ivara 的「飞空」护甲的肩板，只见肩板瞬间化为尘埃。Ivara 逃过一劫。这次交手，是女猎手占了上风。她的子弹打中了密尔弥多涅的神秘装置，迸射出一片火花。但密尔弥多涅的武器并未失灵，他怒不可遏地再次向 Ivara 射出翠绿色的致命光束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
What is a bow without arrows? And these arrows? The Origin System has never seen their like, able to change their very nature at the whim of Ivara. Sleep, cloaking, rapid fire, they are the embodiment of her legendary versatility.

Ivara drew her bow again, this time for her fallen comrades. With inhuman speed shot after shot snapped and plucked each segment of carapace from the Myrmidon's lean frame. Straps severing, clips popping, he was undressed with swift efficiency by the preternatural accuracy of her aim and rapidity.

Even before her final arrow belted the visored helmet from his head, she had the killing shot nocked and ready. There he stood: the Myrmidon. Slayer of Warframes. Naked. Beauty, symmetry, even the capacity for language, sacrificed for… raw power. But his face… his face was a mockery of an Orokin face: those she was sworn to never kill. The smirk on his pallid, angular visage told her he knew it as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 弓若无箭，何以为弓？而这些箭，又为何物？整个始源星系，从未见过与之相似的武器。Ivara 只消心念一动，它们便能改变自身特性。沉眠、隐匿、速射，这些能力象征着她超群多样的技艺。Ivara 再次拉开了弓，这一次，是为了给阵亡的战友复仇。一发发箭矢以超越常理的速度飞向身形单薄的密尔弥多涅，将他身上的护甲一片片地击碎。束带断裂，卡扣崩飞。在 Ivara 神乎其技的准头和射速下，他很快被剥得一干二净。甚至，在她最后一箭将那个覆面头盔打飞之前，Ivara 的致命一箭已搭上弓弦，蓄势待发。密尔弥多涅就这样站在那里。战甲猎杀者。一丝不挂。他放弃了美感，匀称的体态，乃至语言能力，只为换取……最纯粹的力量。他的脸…… 徒有奥罗金的皮囊，却虚伪至极。Ivara 曾经立下誓言，绝不会杀奥罗金。对面那张惨白且棱角分明的脸上，浮现出得意的冷笑。一切都不言自明，他也知道这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Ivara hit the ground and sprang into a surrounding tunnel, the Myrmidon's shot lancing a gouge in the porous chamber wall. Ivara pressed her back to a shadowed outcrop at tunnel's end while the Myrmidon's weapon blazed and cut and chewed through her only cover.

As good a time as any to discuss the weapon before you: the Artemis Bow. The huntress' signature weapon and the tool with which she has wrought so much good. Said by some to be spirit-bonded to her, others say the product of forgotten Orokin technology.

What Porvis tells us next displays to good effect what warrior and weapon were capable of. Pinned behind eroding cover, seconds from death, Ivara summoned her Artemis Bow, and it came to her. She and weapon as one. Without rising she pulled back, aimed high - she and arrow as one - and loosed. Under Ivara's guidance the arrow turned its path and shot down the corridor, toward the Myrmidon, and lengthwise through his weapon. Around Ivara the walls flashed green for a micro-second, as the Myrmidon's weapon erupted, and then silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Ivara 落地后，立刻弹身冲进附近的隧道。密尔弥多涅射出的光束紧随而至，瞬间在那面斑驳的石壁上犁出一个大洞。Ivara 退至隧道尽头，后背紧贴着阴影中的一处突起，而密尔弥多涅的武器喷吐强光，正在一寸寸地啃噬着她仅有的掩体。说到这里，正好可以向您介绍一下面前这把「月神」狩弓。这是女猎手的标志性武器，帮助她战胜了无数敌人。有人说，这把武器和她心有灵犀。也有人说，它是早已失传的奥罗金科技产物。珀维斯记录的内容，充分展现了武器与战士之间所能达成的绝妙配合。就在掩体逐渐崩塌，死亡已然临近的关头，Ivara 召唤出了「月神」狩弓，弓也回应了她。她与这把武器合而为一。她并没有起身，只是拉开弓弦，朝高处瞄准。人箭合一后，她松开了弓弦。在 Ivara 的指引下，飞出的箭矢改变了轨迹，折返射入廊道，直奔密尔弥多涅而去，径直击穿了他的武器。密尔弥多涅的武器轰然爆炸，将 Ivara 四周的墙壁映得一片翠绿。随即，万籁俱寂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Ivara. The Huntress.

This tale comes to us from 'The Secret History of the Orokin Court', by the historian Porvis.

Have you perhaps heard tell of the Myrmidon? No matter. A preternatural beast-figure straight out of myth he was; one whose prey had no equal.

Warframes were what this villain hunted. It is said a number of 'frames had been erased from history by this monster, models who no longer exist on any record. Those who are not remembered.

It hardly seemed possible that a single person could stand against a Warframe, let alone destroy it. Let alone several. Perhaps Porvis enjoyed the telling a little too much or, perhaps, there is something to it.

Ivara encountered the Myrmidon quite early in her history.

Quite early indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这是女猎手 Ivara。这个故事来自历史学家珀维斯所著的《奥罗金宫廷秘史》。或许您曾听说过密尔弥多涅的故事？没有也无妨。他是一个传奇人物，拥有野兽的外形和超乎常理的力量。他盯上的猎物，自然是非同寻常。而他捕猎的对象，正是战甲。据说，在历史的长河中，这个怪物已经猎杀了不计其数的战甲。这些战甲再未留下任何记录，他们被历史彻底遗忘。仅凭一人之力能与战甲抗衡，似乎已是天方夜谭，更别说是摧毁了。至于摧毁数具战甲，就更无法想象了。可能是珀维斯夸大其词，也可能是确有其事。在 Ivara 的故事中，她很早就遭遇到了密尔弥多涅。早得出乎意料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Porvis tells us he compiled much of this tale from overheard exchanges between members of the Seven, and details that remained consistent in courtly whispers.

He tells us the second 'frame suffered the same fate as the first. Reacting, Ivara whirled and promptly vanished. But, one clutching gesture in her direction and Ivara's powers fled, her cloaking field nullified. Visible, vulnerable, she loosed a Dashwire arrow to a high alcove… but it never came. No escape. The Myrmidon was upon her.

The Huntress spun, opening fire with Aksomati pistols to send that devil scrambling for cover, arm thrown protectively across that twisted, armored head. That clutching gesture was the key. Ivara needed a plan, and she needed it fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 据珀维斯所述，这个故事的大部分内容都源于七人众之间的对话，是他无意间听到的。而其它细节则源于宫廷内相对可靠的流言。他告诉我们，第二具战甲遭遇了与第一具完全相同的命运。Ivara 立刻意识到危险，转身隐去了身形。可密尔弥多涅只朝她所在的方位做出了抓握的手势，Ivara 的力量便骤然失效，隐形力场也随之解除。身形暴露，防备尽失，她朝高处的壁龛射出了一发「悬丝」之箭试图脱身……但悬丝根本没有出现。她无路可逃。密尔弥多涅向她逼近。这位女猎手转身拔出了「轻灵月神」双枪，朝眼前的恶魔疯狂开火。纵使那个恶魔扭曲的头上包裹着护甲，也不得不抱头狼狈逃向掩体。那个抓握的手势就是破局的关键。Ivara 必须想出对策，而且要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
A Dax emergency call, so Porvis writes, led Ivara and two unknown Warframes to a convoluted cave system.

They found it littered with the bodies of murdered Dax and resplendent with bioluminescent fungi. I imagine the chitinous folds of her Salix Syandana would have made for excellent camouflage within that malevolent, supernal glow.

'The Secret History' tells us that the Myrmidon appeared boldly before the three, in a wide chamber connected by many tunnels. Clad in red-and-gold armor it gestured to the first Warframe with what Porvis describes as 'a strange clutching motion, as if seizing a falling apple.' But it was no greeting, as we shall see.

The powers of that first Warframe - the recipient of that gesture - promptly failed. The Myrmidon took advantage of the confusion to leap upon the hapless 'frame and press a palm to the warrior's head. In lurid detail Porvis describes a flash of the most scintillating emerald light and Ivara's battle sibling collapsed to hot dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 珀维斯写道，接到禁卫的紧急求助后，Ivara 和两位身份不明的战甲来到了一片错综复杂的岩洞。洞中遍布被杀害的禁卫尸体，发光的真菌把四周映照得诡异而绚丽。可以想象，在那凶邪莫测的幽光中，Ivara「柳叶」披饰上层叠如甲的褶片，一定会是绝佳的伪装。据《秘史》记载，在一座连接着多条隧道的洞室中，密尔弥多涅毫不遮掩地现身在了他们三具战甲面前。他身披红金相间的护甲，向第一位战甲做了个手势。珀维斯将其描述为「一个奇怪的抓握动作，仿佛要凌空抓住一颗下落的苹果。」但我们很快便会看到，那绝不是在打招呼。被这个手势指中的那具战甲，力量瞬间失效。密尔弥多涅趁对方惊愕之际，纵身扑上了那具无助的战甲，然后一掌按在他头上。珀维斯详细记录了这个可怕的瞬间：一道耀眼的翠绿色亮光闪过，Ivara 的战友瞬间崩解，化为一堆灼热的齑粉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
The grand doors of the Chamber of the Seven flew open.

Across that reverberating expanse of polished darkness strode Ivara, dragging her prize. Before the assembled Council she dropped him, and with it the Myrmidon's battered helmet. Here he would meet justice at the hands of his own people. Here her fallen friends would be avenged.

She beheld the Seven, awaiting their judgment. The Myrmidon got to his feet, cleaning dust from one shoulder with a contemptuous flick. One of the Seven leaned forward, removing a curious thing from their slender head - a lattice of delicate silver - placing it on the elevated, chest-high curve of obsidian that separated her from them. Instantly the Myrmidon collapsed, lifeless, to the floor.

Ivara did not understand. Why? Why? A stately voice intoned her name. There stood Executor Ballas. He told her: "You have been battle- and loyalty-tested. Your companions, they were found wanting. They failed to adapt. Failed to overcome. And so they are no more. But you, Ivara. You shall live. You shall be remembered." Her battle comrades, as we know, were not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 七人众议事厅的宏伟大门被猛然打开。Ivara 大步流星地穿过那片深邃幽暗的厅堂走了进来，手里拖着她的战俘。她把密尔弥多涅和他那顶破损的头盔一把甩到了议会众人面前。在这里，他将受到自己族人的审判。在这里，她终于能为她的战友报仇雪恨。她注视着七人众，等待着他们的裁决。密尔弥多涅却自行站起身来，轻蔑地弹去肩上的灰尘。七人众中的一位微微俯身，从自己修长的头上取下了一件奇怪的东西——一件精致的银晶格——并将其放到了 Ivara 和他们之间齐胸高的那块黑曜石弧台之上。顷刻之间，密尔弥多涅就失去了生机，跌倒在地。Ivara 无法理解眼前发生的一切。为什么？为什么会这样？此时，一个庄严的声音念出了她的名字。站在那里的是执行者拜勒斯。他对她说：「你已通过了战斗与忠诚的试炼。而你的同伴，他们还有所不足。他们不会随机应变，无法克服艰难险阻。因此，他们也就不复存在了。但是你，Ivara。你会活下去，你会永垂青史。」她的战友，正如我们所知，早已被遗忘了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Lavos. The transmuter. Called by some, anachronistically, the alchemist.

Transmutation, you say? A superstitious process from long ago, in which deranged old men heated stinking substances over fires of dung, thinking they could make gold?

No. To the Orokin, it was a darkly potent, forbidden science. They were not squeamish nor moral, so what profound taboos must this art have violated?

No transmuter was more dreaded than Javi. The Crawling Serpent. The Abhorred. The Filth-Speaker.

The Orokin feared him so greatly that they whispered he might, somehow, survive even the Jade Light, just as a severed snake was once believed to grow a new head. So instead he was imprisoned, that his evil might be contained, if not quenched.

His jailer was a brute of a Warframe named Lavos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Lavos 是炼金师。也有人沿用炼金术士这个古老的名字来称呼他。

您问，什么是炼金术？是远古时代那套迷信的把戏？一群走火入魔的老头，用燃烧的粪便熬煮臭气熏天的物质，妄想着能从中炼出黄金？

大错特错。对奥罗金而言，炼金术是一门黑暗而强大的禁忌科学。奥罗金向来肆意妄为、不讲道德，所以连他们都要严令禁止的技艺，究竟触犯了何等深重的禁忌？

所有炼金师中，最令人畏惧的莫过于哈维。人称伏蛇、众憎者、秽语者。

奥罗金对他深怀恐惧，甚至担心连翠玉之光都无法将他彻底抹杀。就像古人相信，断首之蛇还能长出一颗新头。因此，他们没有处决哈维，而是将他囚禁起来。他们心想既然无法彻底消除他的邪恶，至少还能将其困在牢笼之中。

负责看守他的狱卒，是一具粗蛮凶悍的战甲，名为 Lavos。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
They say that Lavos often takes counsel from his serpents. One is his brutal advisor, the other his wise teacher. Both have their wisdom, and Javi still whispers to his beloved student.

Much like the snake, Lavos is easy to misjudge. The serpents that poison can also cure. He may have been a monster in his previous life, but he was able to achieve something that eluded the most powerful of the Orokin. He changed.

Moreover, he changed himself. Javi may have helped and instructed, but the will to change must have begun with Lavos.

Perhaps we all have that golden gleam coiled within us somewhere, ready to slither forth from its old skin. We must only beware that we do not condemn as devilish that which we do not yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
据说，Lavos 时常向臂上的两条蛇讨教。一条会给他凶悍野蛮的建议，另一条会传授他智慧。两条蛇都有灵智，而时至今日哈维仍在向自己心爱的学生传授智慧。

和蛇一样，Lavos 也极易遭人误解。蛇毒可以致命，也可以入药疗伤。Lavos 从前可能确实是个怪物，但他做到连最强大的奥罗金都未能做到的事。他改变了。

更重要的是，他改变的是自己。哈维可能帮助过他、教导过他，可那份想要改变的意志，必定早已盘踞在 Lavos 心中。

也许在我们所有人体内，都蟠绕着一缕金色微光，只等着蜕皮苏醒，蜿蜒而出。我们只需警惕一件事：不要把尚未理解的事物，全都一棒子打成邪魔外道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
The wardens' records reveal an increasing unease with Javi's bizarre behavior.

Regardless of the potential risk, they determined that he should be executed - after a fashion. They would use cellular reversal. Javi would be reduced to a mere biological pulp with no more sentience than bread mold.

But the executioner? No jailer wanted to be the Pobber to bell that Kavat. So Lavos received this ceremonial helm, along with the power to reconfigure organic matter. He could be their instrument.

The walls, floor, and ceiling of the cell were, by now, overwritten with text. Lavos watched over Javi continually.

Bekran Zaft tells us that curiously, Lavos no longer beat the prisoners in the other cells. Even when the inmates shoved one of their hated fellows into his path, expecting a bloody beatdown, Lavos merely waited for him to get back to his feet before moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
看守人员留下的记录显示，他们对哈维怪异举止越发感到不安。

哪怕风险难以估量，他们最终还是决定以某种方式「处决」哈维。他们将使用细胞逆转技术，把他降解成一摊细胞组织，他所剩的知觉可能和面包上的霉菌不相上下。

可由谁来当这个刽子手？没有哪个狱卒愿意做那只给库娃挂铃铛的泡博。于是，这顶仪式头盔与重构有机物的力量一并交给了 Lavos。他将成为狱方手中的行刑工具。

此时，哈维牢房的墙壁、地板乃至天花板，都被写满了密密麻麻的文字。Lavos 则始终守在那里，寸步不离地注视着他。

贝克兰·扎夫特还提到一件怪事。从某一天起，Lavos 不再殴打其他牢房里的囚犯。
有时，犯人们会故意把某个讨人嫌的倒霉蛋推到他面前，等着欣赏一场头破血流的毒打。Lavos 却只是停下脚步，等那人自己重新站稳后，才继续向前走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Bekran Zaft says this of Execution Day.

The jailers gathered in the auditorium. With a slow funereal tread, Lavos escorted Javi to the execution dais. He gently raised a hood over Javi's head, cobra-like. He turned, then, to face the Orokin Warden, shotgun trembling in his mighty hands.

The silence, Zaft says, was absolute.

But then from beneath the hood came a whisper. Javi had some final words for his student.

The Orokin jailer shifted uncomfortably, looked to his functionaries. Would the execution even take place?

Lavos gave a stiff bow to Javi... and activated his power. 

Javi's skin peeled off in one grisly sloughing. He liquefied into a biological soup. 

A cheer went up from the assembled jailers.

Lavos gathered the remains of Javi tenderly in his hands. A soft glow emanated from them. As, in one horrible moment, Javi's Orokin oppressors realized what they beheld. And then: panic. Lavos was transmuting the remains.

A twining, living snake seethed up Lavos's left arm. Javi, transformed, and still - after a fashion - alive, just as they had feared. A second snake coiled around his right arm, this one sprouting from Lavos's own flesh.

Then Lavos leapt into the midst of the assembly, hurling vials left and right, bathing the hapless screaming jailers and functionaries - and their Warden - in icy vitriol. Not one survived - not for long, anyway.

And Bekran Zaft? Lavos bowed to her and moved on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
贝克兰·扎夫特是这么描述处刑那天的。

狱卒们齐聚大礼堂。Lavos 迈着缓慢而沉重的步伐，将哈维押上行刑台。他轻轻替哈维戴上兜帽，帽形的轮廓就像眼镜蛇撑开的脖颈。随后，他转过身，面对奥罗金典狱长。那把沉重的霰弹枪，竟在他强壮的双手中微微发颤。

扎夫特说，当时全场鸦雀无声。

紧接着，兜帽下传出一声低语。哈维还有几句遗言，要交代给自己的学生。

奥罗金典狱长不安地挪了挪身子，转头又望向身边的狱卒。这场行刑……究竟能否顺利执行？

Lavos 僵硬地朝哈维鞠了一躬……然后使用了能力。

哈维的皮肤在顷刻间整片剥落。紧接着，他的身体彻底溶为一摊血肉组织。

台下的狱卒顿时发出了一声欢呼。

Lavos 却俯下身，用双手轻轻捧起哈维的血肉，只见他掌中透出了柔和的光芒。就在那恐怖的一瞬间，囚禁哈维的奥罗金终于意识到眼前正在发生的事。然后，他们慌了。Lavos 正在转化哈维的遗骸。

一条鲜活的蛇翻腾而出，缠绕着爬上 Lavos 的左臂。
哈维完成了蜕变，并且以另一种生命形态存活了下来。正如奥罗金一度恐惧的那样。第二条蛇也盘上 Lavos 的右臂。这一条是从 Lavos 自己的血肉中长出来的。

下一刻，Lavos 纵身跃入人群。他向左右接连掷出药瓶，那些惊声惨叫的狱卒、官员，以及他们的典狱长，全都沐浴在冰冷的硫酸雨中，无一幸免。他们即便没有当场身亡，也没能活过多久。

至于贝克兰·扎夫特？Lavos 只是向她鞠了一躬，随后便径直离去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
The prison of Dabaoth-Kra no longer stands: both it and the slumped Venusian mountain peak upon which it stood were long ago obliterated. We have only records to tell us what went on there.

Javi was a scrawny, hairless man, scaly with skin disease. In reluctant recognition of his Archimedean status, he was permitted to wear the white robe - now a befouled, ragged garment. Two tattooed serpents crawled up each bony arm from elbow to wrist.

Lavos, we are told, was attentive to his prisoner. He administered the prescribed soup, water, and beatings with the same punctual fidelity.

These are recreations of Lavos's own snakes - no mere tattoos, but living bio-ferrous exoflesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
达巴奥斯-克拉监狱早已不复存在。监狱本身和金星上它所在的那座山峰早已荡然无存。那里曾经发生的一切，如今只剩档案可供追溯。

哈维是个骨瘦如柴的秃子，由于身患皮肤病，身上长满了鳞屑。碍于他哲士的头衔，狱方勉强准许他保留那袭白袍——尽管它早已污秽不堪、破烂褴褛。两条蛇形刺青分别盘踞在他嶙峋的前臂上，从手肘一路蜿蜒至手腕。

据记载，Lavos 对这名囚犯可谓「照料周到」。规定分量的汤食、饮用水，还有毒打，他都会一丝不苟地准时送上。

您眼前这些，是依据 Lavos 自身的蛇复原而成的。它们绝非普通刺青，而是活生生的「铁骨肉身」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
What actually was this forbidden practice of transmutation that terrified the Orokin so? At its pinnacle, it was nothing less than the purposeful elevation of consciousness.

To the Orokin, prisoners of their endless golden dream, the thought that a person could rise above their station was anathema. Transmutation could turn commoners into kings or riches into garbage. Worst of all, it could teach people not to be afraid.

I have seen a preserved image of Javi's cell. His scrawlings were not demonic sigils and barbarous texts but star charts. Evolutionary trees. Genome structures.

Javi was not defying Lavos with these cryptic daubings in his own blood. He was enlightening him. Not dark sorcery at all, but radiant science. And the snake? A symbol not of corruption but of healing.

Javi was a teacher. He might have taught millions. Now he had only one student.

But that student was attentive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
那么，这门令奥罗金闻风丧胆的禁忌炼金术，究竟是什么？它达到最高境界时，追求的正是有意识地升华心智。

奥罗金自囚于一场难以醒来的黄金美梦中。他们无法容忍有人竟能超越他们的存在与地位，这个念头本身就是大逆不道。炼金术可以把平民变成国王，也可以把万贯财富变为垃圾。更可怕的是，它能教会人们不再畏惧。

我曾看过一张保存下来的哈维牢房影像。他留在墙上的根本不是什么恶魔符号，也不是什么野蛮经文。而是星图、进化树、基因组结构。

哈维用自己的鲜血涂抹出这些晦涩的内容，并不是为了反抗 Lavos，而是在启迪他。那根本不是什么黑暗巫术，而是灿然生辉的科学。至于那条蛇？象征的也不是堕落，而是治愈。

哈维是一位导师。他原本或许能够教导数百万人，但他最后只有一个学生。

而那个学生，显然领悟了老师的教诲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Observers at the prison reported that Javi was frequently whispering to Lavos. There was some concern among the wardens, but they dismissed the whispers as mere posturing.

Javi's cell walls began to fill up with scrawlings, using blood and filth as ink. At first, these were simple symbols, but as time passed, they became more elaborate. It was as if the Archimedean was turning his cell into a demonic temple, baiting his captors. There was even an image of Lavos, resplendent in his Syandana of office - perhaps an attempt at a curse.

Lavos was ordered to beat him harder, and duly did so. With the blood on the wall, Javi drew a snake. An appeal, no doubt, to his depraved idol.

Floor-washer Bekran Zaft, the sole survivor of Dabaoth-Kra, would later tell of how Lavos would stride from cell to cell - weighty shotgun in hand - clubbing and beating as required. The nightmares still haunted her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
监狱有目击者指出，哈维经常对 Lavos 说悄悄话。看守人员起初颇为不安，最后却只把这些低语当成虚张声势，没有继续追究。

不久，哈维开始用鲜血和秽物在牢房的墙上写写画画。起初还只是些简单的符号，后来却日益复杂起来，仿佛这名哲士正把牢房改造成一座恶魔神殿，故意引诱看守者。墙上甚至画着 Lavos 的肖像，他身披象征职权的华丽披饰，威风凛凛。也许，那是一种诅咒。

狱方随即命令 Lavos 下手再重一些。他也一如既往，照令执行。哈维又用溅在墙上的鲜血勾勒出一条蛇。毫无疑问，至少当时的人认为，那是对他邪恶崇拜对象的祈求。

负责清洗地面的贝克兰·扎夫特是监狱唯一的幸存者。她后来回忆，Lavos 会手提沉重的霰弹枪，大步走过一间又一间牢房，按照命令挥枪痛殴囚犯。多年以后，那些景象依然是她挥之不去的梦魇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Nezha. The mercurial firemonger. The clarion of hope. However foul the decadent excesses of the Orokin Empire, the aftermath of its collapse was arguably worse. But, the darkest times often give rise to the brightest legends. We've seen that happen often, haven't we? Tales of a being called Nezha predate the Orokin Fall. They speak of a swift warrior who leaves trails of fire, summoning barbed spears from the very earth. But it is during a time of unsurpassed brutality, at a moment of wanton slaughter, that this most blazingly improbable of Warframes first proves to be more than a myth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: Nezha。机敏善变的驭火高手，代表着希望。无论奥罗金帝国的暴行有多么腐朽堕落、污秽不堪，它覆灭后的余波，恐怕有过之而无不及。然而，越是黑暗的时代，往往会孕育出最耀眼的传奇。我们对此已经屡见不鲜了，对吧？在奥罗金帝国覆灭之前，Nezha 的传说便早已流传。传说中，他是一位身手敏捷的战士，所到之处烈焰成径，更能从大地之中唤出荆棘长枪。但正是在那个生灵涂炭、残暴无度的时代，在一场肆意妄为的屠杀中，这位耀若朝阳、几乎不可能存在的战甲，才第一次向世人证明——他不只存在于神话之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This chakram was found in the ruins of the Reshantur temple along with fragments of stories, scrawled on slates in an immature hand, and oaths of dedication to a figure of legend. It seems the child-soldiers of Reshantur took courage from the tales of Nezha, adopting him as patron and protector. Their scratchings evince a firm belief that Nezha would bless them with victory should they fight without fear, and abandon them should they ever fear. So, they swore, they would defend the fields to the last drop of their blood. Clever manipulation. I wonder who put that idea into their heads. At any rate, they accepted it on faith. At least, until the Massacre of Reshantur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这件乾坤圈是在瑞圣途神庙的废墟中发现的。与它一同出土的，还有一块石板。上面刻着稚嫩的笔迹，记载了几个残缺的故事，以及向一位传说人物宣誓效忠的誓词。看来，瑞圣途的童子军从 Nezha 的传说中汲取了勇气，把他奉为了庇护者和守护神。他们刻下的文字流露出坚定的信念：只要英勇战斗，Nezha 就会保佑他们取得胜利。而一旦心生畏惧，Nezha 就会离他们而去。于是，哪怕流尽最后一滴血，也要捍卫自己的土地。好一套精巧的洗脑手段。我很好奇，究竟是谁给他们灌输的这种思想。无论如何，他们对此深信不疑。至少，在瑞圣途大屠杀之前，他们从未怀疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This blade! A tongue of exquisite flame in cold metal. It was unearthed by a poor farmer of Reshantur, as he followed his hulking plow-beasts across fields he would never own. Another might have bravely kept the dagger. But records suggest he handed it into his overseer on the spot, a half-cup of rice his princely reward. With no Dax to keep the peace, and no Parvos Granum to hold the Corpus Board together, bloody land grabs were routine.  The fertile fields of Reshantur changed hands many times. With each 'hostile takeover,' slain workers became 'fertilizer' for the next yield of crops - tended by the survivors - and so. It. Went. This created what you might call a staffing problem. If all the surviving adults are working the fields, then who is left to defend them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这把匕首！仿佛一缕炙热的火舌，凝结在冰冷的金属之中。它是瑞圣途的一名贫苦农夫从土里挖出来的。当时，他正赶着魁梧的耕牛、开垦着永远不属于他的田地。换作别人，可能会壮着胆子把匕首私藏下来。但根据记载，他当场就把它交给了监工。而他得到的「丰厚」赏赐，只有半碗大米。当时没有禁卫来维持秩序，也没有帕尔沃斯·格拉努维持科普斯董事会的秩序，血腥的土地掠夺早已成为家常便饭。瑞圣途的肥沃土地多次易主。每经历一次「恶意吞并」，遭到屠杀的工人便沦为下一季作物的「肥料」，再由幸存者们继续耕作。如此循环往复，便带来了人员配置上的问题。如果所有幸存的成年人都在田间劳作，那还剩谁来保护他们呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: The Corpus surveyor Jena Xasparin says she found a solitary child, wearing this helmet, in the midst of a charnel field of remains. But they were the remains of Corpus troops. Some dismembered, some impaled... all burned. Nezha did it, the boy said calmly. He flew down from the sky and tore the enemy asunder with wheels of flame. When a child fell, he would raise them up again. Nezha moved quick as a scimitar, and the earth burned where his feet touched. Now the others had gone with Nezha, part of his celestial army. The boy had stayed behind to tell the story. To Xasparin, the boy was merely traumatized, the massacre probably a mutiny within the Corpus ranks. But Reshantur has been excavated, and every single one of the thousands of blackened bones that were gene-tagged... had belonged to an adult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 科普斯调查员杰娜·哈斯帕林报告说，她在满地尸体的田野中央，发现了一个孤零零的孩子。孩子头上，正戴着这顶头盔。可现场全是科普斯士兵的尸体。有的被肢解，有的被刺穿……无一例外，都被烧焦了。「是 Nezha 做的。」男孩平静地说道。他从天而降，用风火轮将敌人撕成了碎片。每当有童子军倒下，Nezha 就会将他们救起。他的身手如飞刀般敏捷，他足尖所触之地，尽皆燃起烈焰。如今，其他孩子都变成了 Nezha 的天兵天将，和他一同离开了。只留下这个男孩，向世人讲述发生的一切。在哈斯帕林看来，这孩子不过是受了惊吓而神志不清，所谓的屠杀，多半只是科普斯内部发生的叛乱。然而瑞圣途的遗迹后来得到了全面发掘。对成千上万具焦骨都进行了基因检测……结果显示，每一块骸骨都来自成年人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: This spear, modeled on Nezha's own, was found buried in scorched soil. Note. The size. Records of the attack are nigh impossible to find. Not surprising. The massacre was almost certainly covered up to protect what the Corpus regarded as sensitive business practices. Imagine the children, Tenno, wearing their pathetic syandanas, bearing flimsy weapons, but with heads high - as warriors. Think of them rushing at their far superior foes, without fear... and imagine what those foes did. To this day, the fields of Reshantur cannot be plowed. The blades of plows are dented and destroyed by an earth that, still, remains thickly seeded with shot, and shells, and the cold brass teeth of war. But that is not why the event is called the massacre of Reshantur. The children charged. The Corpus took easy aim. Not one child's heart fluttered. And then? Flame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 这支以 Nezha 的圣火枪为原型的长枪，被发现时正深埋于焦土之中。请留意它的尺寸。有关那场袭击的记录几乎无处可寻。这也不奇怪，为了保护科普斯眼中所谓的「敏感商业手段」，那场屠杀几乎必然遭到掩盖。Tenno，想象一下那些孩子们，身披他们寒酸的披饰，手持不堪一击的武器，却像真正的战士一样昂首而立。想象他们毫无惧色地冲向远比自己强大的敌人……再想象一下，那些敌人会怎么对付他们。时至今日，瑞圣途的土地仍无法耕作。犁刃一入土，便会被撞出缺口，乃至彻底崩毁——因为那片土壤中，至今仍残存着弹丸、炮弹，以及战争留下的破铜烂铁。但这并不是这场惨剧被称为「瑞圣途大屠杀」的原因。童子军向前冲锋，成了科普斯的活靶子。没有一个孩子心生恐惧。然后呢？是熊熊火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: And at last, we meet Nezha face to face, in all his unquestionable reality. Did this Warframe model itself on the myths, to take on the mantle of a mythic hero? Or were the myths left in the Warframe's wake, a blazing trail to light the way? Ah. History will always be some manner of educated guesswork, and occasionally one of faith. Perhaps in some deeper stratum, we will find the lost children of Reshantur, sad little clusters of bones, not saved at all. But I have faith we will not. I leave you with this. Why do you suppose it was the child soldiers that Nezha chose to protect? Any war has its innocent casualties, but these seem to have called to him. What could a Warframe, a lethal specialist warrior, possibly have in common with a child? That riddle, I fear, must remain a riddle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 终于，我们和 Nezha 见面了，他的真实存在毋庸置疑。究竟是这具战甲以神话为蓝本，披上了神话英雄的衣钵？还是说，那些神话本就是他留下的余焰，化作照亮后人前进道路上的足迹？啊，所谓历史，终究少不了基于证据的推测。偶尔，也需要一点信念。或许有朝一日，我们能在地层深处找到那些失踪的瑞圣途童子军。他们可能早已化为了可怜的骸骨，从未得到过救赎。但我愿意相信，我们永远找不到。最后，我想留给您一个问题。您觉得为什么 Nezha 会选择保护那些娃娃兵？任何战争都会伤及无辜，但唯独这群孩子，似乎格外触动了他，感召着他。一具战甲，一个为了杀戮而生的战士，与孩子之间能有什么共通之处？这个谜团，恐怕没有人能够解开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text: Children. That's who. This dismal little relic was once part of a... of a 'Syandana', shall we say. Though not of Orokin make, clearly. No. Its young owner wove this from a fertilizer sack. There were many such capes found at the site. Enough for an army. Moas were expensive, you see. Children... they were cheap. And plentiful. It made good business sense to arm them. Not the very youngest, of course - just the near-adults. The still unbroken. Those who understood the stakes. The young defenders of Reshantur took their duty seriously. They formed into a little clan, trained every day in the ruins of an old temple, and even made themselves a uniform of sorts - part of which you see before you now. But this humble cape was modeled on something even older. The Syandana of Nezha himself -- displayed here -- before you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText: 答案是：孩子们。这件凄凉的遗物……曾是一件「披饰」，暂且这么说吧。这显然不是奥罗金的造物。它年幼的主人用肥料袋编织了它。现场发现了很多这样的斗篷，多得足以装备一支军队。您也知道，那时恐鸟造价不菲。孩子们嘛……便宜、数量还多。从生意上看，把他们武装起来相当划算。当然，年纪太小的孩子不行——只挑那些接近成年、尚未被现实压垮脊梁、明白生存代价的孩子。瑞圣途的少年卫士十分尽职尽责。他们组成了一个小型氏族，每天都在一座古老的神庙遗迹中训练，甚至还自制了一套勉强算作「制服」的装束。您眼前这块，便是其中一部分。但这个简陋披风仿照的，却是某件更古老的物件。Nezha 本尊的披饰，由莱弗博物馆珍藏，此刻就陈列在您面前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[7.9]
Nova. Mercurial, unpredictable and a miraculous example of harnessed antimatter.
[12.7]
It would be a bold fool indeed who tried to tame lightning.
[28.2]
One such individual was Holsom Yurr, a freelance problem-solver who commanded high fees for his low morals; a deficiency that netted him great success in endeavors where a conscience would have held others back.
[38.7]
He is the only figure known to have secured a back-channel charter permitting him to selectively raid certain rails, so long as Orokin ships were avoided.
[47.4]
The story of Nova and Yurr survives via the captain and security logs of the Orokin vessel Masker's Theodolite.
[53.2]
It survives because it was deemed to be... of historical importance.
[68.2]
Orokin investigators scrutinized every frame of security footage, each line of the captain's log, for assurance that the outcome of this encounter was indeed true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[7.9]
Nova。变幻莫测、难以捉摸，是完美驾驭反物质的奇迹典范。
[12.7]
胆敢去驯服闪电的人，一定是不知道天高地厚的蠢货。
[28.2]
霍索·尤尔便是这样一个人。他是自由接活的难题解决专家。他道德底线极低，收费却极其高昂。而正是少了良心上的负担，在那些旁人会知难而退的勾当中，他反而如鱼得水，大获成功。
[38.7]
据说，他是唯一一个获得特殊许可的人：只要不碰奥罗金的飞船，他可以有选择地打劫某些航道。
[47.4]
Nova 和尤尔的故事是通过奥罗金飞船「蒙面者的经纬仪号」上的舰长日志与安保记录保存下来的。
[53.2]
它能流传至今，是因为人们认为它……具有极高的历史价值。
[68.2]
奥罗金的调查人员仔细检查了安保录像的每一帧，细读了舰长日志的每一个字，只为确保这次交锋的结局真实无误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[8.5]
Unaware she was being led into a trap built just for her, I don't imagine Nova took any special precautions.
[12.4]
This Flux model helm, for example, was fairly standard.
[20.8]
The appealing venting displayed her antimatter nature; an announcement of power as much as an evocation of beauty.
[28.4]
Where were we? Ah yes. Nova and the rescued crew moved for the escape pods.
[37.4]
Once they were clear she would about-face and find some way to free the remaining ten-thousand-seven-hundred-and-ninety-two.
[46.1]
Alas, thuds and clangs resounded as every life pod ejected into space. Empty.
[51.9]
Yurr clarified, boomingly, that escape was not an option.
[58.2]
To punctuate this assertion bulkheads slammed down in every corridor shipwide.
[66.1]
The only path Yurr left open, worryingly, was the one that led directly to the Theodolite's antimatter reactor.
[74.9]
The very thing Nova had come to save. What was the old pirate playing at?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[8.5]
Nova 没有意识到，自己正被一步步引入专为她设下的陷阱。在我看来，她并没有采取任何特殊的防范措施。
[12.4]
比如说，这件当时她佩戴的「通量」头盔，只是件相当常规的装备。
[20.8]
那个醒目的排气装置彰显了她的反物质特性：既宣告了力量，也彰显出美感。
[28.4]
我们说到哪儿了？啊，对了。Nova 和获救的船员们向着逃生舱跑去。
[37.4]
只要先把这些人送走，她便会折返回去，想办法解救剩下的那一万零七百九十二个人。
[46.1]
可惜，沉闷的轰鸣与金属撞击声接连传来，所有逃生舱都被弹射进了太空。舱内空无一人。
[51.9]
与此同时，尤尔高声宣布，没人能从这里逃出去。
[58.2]
为了强调这一点，他还降下了船内所有走廊的隔舱门。
[66.1]
令人不安的是，尤尔留下的唯一通路，却偏偏指向了「经纬仪号」的反物质反应堆。
[74.9]
那正是 Nova 此行的救援目标。这个老东西究竟在打什么算盘？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[10.6]
Nova walked to her doom. As she entered the reactor's chamber Yurr smugly assured her she was doing the right thing.
[15.9]
Within the reactor's observation room the technicians nodded assent.
[23.2]
This was going to be close. From the bridge Yurr sealed the reactor chamber's blast doors.
[28.3]
Seconds later, on Nova's signal, the technicians overrode that command.
[34.7]
The doors shot upwards and Nova wormholed out of the chamber and back into the corridor.
[40.9]
Leaving that portal open she created another - straight up, into the vent system.
[49.3]
On the bridge Yurr had little time to react, but react he did: ordering all prisoners to be killed.
[58.3]
In that moment a portal flashed into existence - Nova launching herself amidst pirate captain and crew.
[62.0]
And showed them what she was made of.
[74.2]
In a blinding flash Yurr and every mercenary on that bridge was deeply infused with Nova's antimatter, starting a chain reaction within them.
[78.5]
Yurr realized what was happening, but too late.
[92.5]
With a few precise shots from her Syrah-customized sniper rifle Nova neutralized those mercenaries who were quicker off the mark before grabbing Yurr by his brightly irradiated hair.
[103.8]
Hurling him back through her network of wormholes, Nova sent Holsom Yurr pinging from portal to portal before tumbling out into the reactor chamber.
[108.9]
The wormholes collapsed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[10.6]
Nova 迈向了她的末日。她踏入反应堆室时，尤尔洋洋得意地告诉她，她做出了正确的选择。
[15.9]
反应堆观测室内，技术人员点头回应。
[23.2]
成败只在一线之间。尤尔从舰桥上封死了反应堆室的所有防爆门。
[28.3]
几秒钟后，Nova 打了个信号，示意技术人员覆写那条指令。
[34.7]
防爆门骤然升起，Nova 随即开启虫洞、逃出了反应堆室，回到了走廊。
[40.9]
在那道虫洞保持开启的同时，她又制造了另一个虫洞——向上直接连到通风系统。
[49.3]
舰桥上的尤尔几乎来不及做出反应，但他还是下令处决所有人质。
[58.3]
就在那一刻，一个虫洞骤然出现——Nova 把自己传送到了尤尔和他的手下之间。
[62.0]
也让他们亲眼见识了反物质的威力。
[74.2]
在一抹刺眼的强光中，Nova 给尤尔和那座舰桥上的每个佣兵的体内都注入了自己的反物质，并在他们体内引发了连锁反应。
[78.5]
尤尔终于意识到发生了什么。但为时已晚。
[92.5]
几名反应最快的佣兵刚要出手，Nova 便用那把「希拉」定制狙击步枪连开数枪，精准的子弹瞬间结束了佣兵的生命。然后她一把抓住了尤尔因为辐射而发亮的头发。
[103.8]
Nova 将霍索·尤尔猛地扔回到了虫洞网中，让他像皮球一样在数个虫洞之间来回弹跳，最终滚入反应堆室。
[108.9]
然后，虫洞随之闭合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[3.6]
Yurr answered Nova's unspoken question.
[6.6]
He had jettisoned the antimatter core.
[16.2]
Without that it was impossible for the reactor to function, and the Theodolite would smash into the planetoid in a matter of minutes.
[23.1]
Yurr had been paid, by persons unknown, to neutralize Nova completely.
[29.4]
Yurr, a man who prided himself upon an ignorance of the impossible, had agreed.
[37.2]
And devised this trap. Nova was a being created to contain and harness antimatter.
[41.3]
The antimatter drive no longer had a fuel core.
[53.6]
His proposition was simple: Nova would enter the reactor chamber, crack her own containment and kickstart a new reaction using her own body as fuel.
[60.9]
She could save 10,800 lives, but only at the cost of her own.
[72.2]
She had minutes to decide.  With a flick of her wrist Nova's Hikou throwing stars took out every camera in eyeshot, killing Yurr's surveillance of them.
[76.7]
This done, she turned to the technicians she had just saved.
[81.0]
She would need their help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[3.6]
尤尔解答了 Nova 心中的疑惑。
[6.6]
他已经丢弃了飞船的反物质核心。
[16.2]
没了核心，反应堆便无法运行，更无法提供动力。「经纬仪号」将在几分钟内迎面撞上小行星。
[23.1]
有人花钱雇佣尤尔，要求他彻底解决 Nova。
[29.4]
尤尔，一向自诩无所不能并以此为傲，自然接下了这桩生意。
[37.2]
他精心设计了这个圈套。Nova 本就是为了容纳并驾驭反物质而诞生的存在。
[41.3]
可如今，反物质引擎已经没有了燃料核心。
[53.6]
他的想法很简单：Nova 进入反应堆室，解除自身约束，然后以她自己的肉身为燃料，强行重启反应堆。
[60.9]
她可以挽救一万零八百条生命，但代价是必须牺牲自己的性命。
[72.2]
她只有几分钟时间来抉择。Nova 手腕轻轻一抖，掷出几枚「飞扬」星镖，破坏了视野范围内的所有摄像头，切断了尤尔对他们的监视。
[76.7]
在这之后，她看向那些刚才被她救下的技术人员。
[81.0]
她需要他们的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[5.5]
The passenger vessel Masker's Theodolite reported critical problems with her engines.
[16.8]
Nova, mistress of antimatter, was deployed to relight the Theodolite's antimatter reactor before the vessel was drawn into the gravity well of a nearby planetoid.
[20.4]
10,800 passengers were at risk.
[25.2]
Clipping this Syandana to herself she exited her lander.
[31.6]
The interior of the ship was deathly quiet, but then: chaos.
[37.6]
Behind her the section of the ship securing her lander was detonated and blown free.
[40.6]
Stranding her, for the time being.
[47.0]
From deeper inside the ship: cries for help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[5.5]
客运飞船「蒙面者的经纬仪号」发出紧急呼叫，飞船引擎发生严重故障。
[16.8]
反物质的主宰者 Nova 受命登船。她要赶在「经纬仪号」被拖入附近天体的重力井之前，重新点燃飞船的反物质反应堆。
[20.4]
船上的一万零八百名乘客，命悬一线。
[25.2]
披上这件披饰后，她离开了登陆艇。
[31.6]
飞船的内部一片死寂，但随之而来的却是一片混乱。
[37.6]
她身后，固定着她登陆艇的船舱区域轰然爆炸，这部分船体也因此坠入了太空。
[40.6]
眼下，她也被困在了这艘飞船上。
[47.0]
此时，飞船深处则传来了阵阵呼救声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[7.0]
Yurr struggled to his feet as every molecule in his body approached critical.
[16.4]
Behind the glass the technicians gave him a final, grim salute before slamming the blast door closed.
[22.9]
Holsom Yurr, pirate and legend, went nova.
[33.1]
The reactor caught the reaction. The technicians harnessed it, and the engines of the  Masker's Theodolite roared to life.
[39.5]
It was, indeed, the boldest of fools who attempted to leash lightning.
[46.8]
And so a notorious rogue, said to be unkillable, met his end in the attempt.
[52.2]
As the historical record now demonstrates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[7.0]
尤尔挣扎着站起身来，此时他身体里的每个分子都濒临崩溃。
[16.4]
隔着防爆玻璃，技术人员向他致以最后一次冷峻的敬礼，然后重重关上了防爆门。
[22.9]
霍索·尤尔，传奇海盗，瞬间化为了新星。
[33.1]
反应堆捕捉到了这股能量。技术人员趁此机会，让「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的引擎重新运作了起来。
[39.5]
胆敢去驯服闪电的人，果然是不知道天高地厚的蠢货。
[46.8]
就这样，一个号称拥有不死之身的臭名恶徒，就在这场狂妄的尝试中迎来了他的结局。
[52.2]
一如历史所记载的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
[4.0]
Nova sped toward the shouts of trapped crewmen.
[8.4]
Eight were locked in flow control behind a hardened glass wall.
[17.0]
Opening a wormhole between herself and them she phased the crewmen to safety as their compartment flooded with lethal gas.
[23.6]
Booming from speakers in every hallway, Holsom Yurr declared himself.
[29.8]
Holsom Yurr: the man who, at one time, had run the Pluto resistance.
[37.4]
Who spent 3 years terrorizing the rails between Jupiter and Venus just to prove that he could.
[55.3]
Who took that notoriety and translated it into a career: security, political assassination, courier runs, torture, graft, blackmail and, in one case so it was said, genocide.
[61.1]
There were graves already dug for him by the many who wanted him dead.
[75.6]
Word was Holsom already had a tomb prepared for himself on some distant moon, with a table piled high with riches and a chair just waiting for him to be sat in for eternity.
[82.1]
A man capable of anything; and a man who would rather die than lose.
[87.0]
A man easily recognized by the signature item before you.
[93.0]
It was, so they say, an item of great personal significance to the old rogue.
[101.1]
Why, and what history it shared with him, is a matter of some speculation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
[4.0]
Nova 循着呼喊声，向受困船员的方向奔去。
[8.4]
八名船员被锁在流量控制室里，隔着一面强化玻璃墙绝望挣扎。
[17.0]
致命气体正不断灌入舱室。Nova 在自己与船员之间开启虫洞，赶在毒气将他们吞没之前，将八人转移到了安全地带。
[23.6]
这时，所有走廊里的广播都响了起来，霍索·尤尔宣布了自己的身份。
[29.8]
霍索·尤尔曾经领导过冥王星上的抵抗运动。
[37.4]
三年间，他多次在木星与金星的航道上发动恐怖袭击。目的仅仅是为了证明自己的能耐。
[55.3]
他将这份恶名转化为了自己的事业：安保、政治刺杀、货物运输、酷刑拷问、贪污行贿、敲诈勒索。甚至据传言，他还参与过种族屠杀。
[61.1]
许多人都帮他挖好了坟墓，巴不得他早点死。
[75.6]
据说，霍索早就在某个遥远的卫星上为自己准备好了坟墓。里面有一张堆满财宝的桌子，以及一把椅子，静候他长眠于此。
[82.1]
这家伙无恶不作、宁死不屈。
[87.0]
您眼前的这件标志性物品，足以让任何人一眼认出他。
[93.0]
据说，这件东西对那个老恶棍有着非同寻常的意义。
[101.1]
至于个中缘由以及他和这件物品之间有什么故事，至今也没有确切的答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Styanax, the Hoplite. The spear-carrier. The shield-bearer. The hero.

We all know the story of Styanax and Leviathan. How wily Aria outwitted the cult leader they called the Philanthropist and called her Warframe ally down into the very heart of his monstrous laboratories.

And no wonder; because these events did not happen in some distant epoch, in the times of the Orokin Fall, the Great Unraveling, the Age of Despots, or the Smaragdine Concord.

They happened surprisingly recently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Styanax，是重装步兵、执矛者、持盾者，更是英雄。

Styanax 与利维坦的故事，想必大家都耳熟能详：足智多谋的阿莉亚如何智取人称「慈善家」的邪教首领，又如何将自己的战甲盟友召至那片骇人实验室的心脏地带。

这也难怪。毕竟，这一切并非发生在某个遥远纪元——既不是奥罗金覆灭之际，也不是「大崩解」、「暴君时代」或「翠绿协议」时期。

出人意料地，这些事是最近发生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Sketches of the Synmora Helmet were discovered among Aria's possessions, implying Styanax had a different earlier appearance.

Aria must therefore have been in contact with Styanax long before her Ascension Day, but how?

There is a story that crops were found flattened in those fertile fields, in the shape of a lotus flower.

Not easily visible from the ground but detectable by an automated satellite.

Styanax was there to defend Aria, and defend her he did.

Colossal fist met unyielding shield again and again; with agility and endurance, the Warframe outpaced his towering foe.

As the Warframe and the monstrosity did battle, Aria saw a familiar face among the multitude.

Her brother, Darro, his blank eyes showing no sign of recognition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
人们在阿莉亚的遗物中发现了步兵团头盔的草图。这说明，早期的 Styanax 或许曾有过另一副模样。

也就是说，早在「升天节」到来之前，阿莉亚便与 Styanax 有过联系。但她是如何做到的？

有一则传闻说，那片肥沃田野中的庄稼，曾被压倒成一朵莲花的形状。

站在地面上几乎看不出全貌，只有在自动卫星上才能辨认出来。

Styanax 是为保护阿莉亚而来，而他的确做到了。

巨大的拳头一次次砸在不屈的盾牌上。凭借敏捷与耐力，Styanax 始终快过那高耸的巨敌。

就在战甲与怪物激战之时，阿莉亚从怪物千百张面孔之中，看见了一张熟悉的脸。

是她的哥哥，达罗。然而，他空洞的双眼里，丝毫没有认出她的神色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
This was the fate of the Chosen.

To be merged together into a single monstrous mass.

Leviathan.

What possessed the Philanthropist to create such a... travesty... we can only speculate.

But we know that he had been studying the Infestation and that he believed Warframes to be weak and obsolete.

Perhaps he craved domination over others; perhaps he yearned to create new life. Life over which he alone... was god.

Regardless, he was too much of a coward to pilot the thing himself.

That was to be Aria's role.

But Aria called upon Styanax, who - if the ruins of the temple roof are any indication - made an explosive appearance.

Faced with the certainty of defeat, the Philanthropist clambered into Leviathan and took command of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
这，便是「受选者」的命运。

彼此血肉交融，化作一团庞大而畸形的怪物。

利维坦。

究竟是什么念头驱使「慈善家」创造出如此……扭曲人性的怪物……我们只能猜测。

但我们知道，他一直潜心研究感染者，而且认定战甲既孱弱，又落后。

也许他渴望支配他人，也许他一心想要创造新生命。一种只奉他一人为神的新生命。

无论如何，他终究懦弱得不敢亲自驾驭这头怪物。

原定的驾驭者，是阿莉亚。

可阿莉亚召来了 Styanax。从神殿屋顶留下的破洞来看，他显然是破顶而入——出场可谓相当轰动。

眼见败局已定，「慈善家」手脚并用地爬进利维坦，亲自控制了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
We have so many monsters. Every child in Orokin times heard legends of the bellygaunt, the slather, and the venomous thrax. Those were only stories, but one was real.

Its creator was dubbed 'the Philanthropist'. A Corpus renegade, he established a cult in a formerly desolate region, in a location which I have agreed to keep secret, to deter would-be looters and amateur archaeologists.

The site was never abandoned, you see, and one person's historical curiosity is another's beloved home.

With science, this 'Philanthropist' ensured ever-more bountiful harvests and secured himself both gratitude and worship. Legend says he would travel the System, seeking out... parentless children to... shelter... and... educate.

But this apparent charity concealed a darker purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
我们从来不缺怪物。奥罗金时代的每个孩子，都听过瘪腹怪、厚皮魔与毒凶魂的传说。那些都只是吓唬孩子的故事。可其中有一头，确实存在。

它的创造者，被人称作「慈善家」。他是科普斯的叛徒，他在一片曾经荒无人烟的地区建立了邪教组织。至于确切地点，我已经答应替当地人保密，免得引来盗掘者与业余考古爱好者。

要知道，那地方从未真正荒废。有人眼中的历史遗迹，或许正是另一些人珍爱的家园。

这位「慈善家」借助科学，让当地的收成一年比一年丰硕，也由此为自己赢得感激，乃至崇拜。传说，他还会穿梭星系，寻找那些……无父无母的孤儿，给予他们……庇护……和……教育。

可这副慈善面孔之下，藏着更加黑暗的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
The shield of Styanax, emblematic of his vow to protect those in danger.

Young Aria was certainly in danger, and well, she knew it. Along with her older brother Darro, she was one of the Philanthropist's Chosen.

When they came of age, they would be summoned for a ceremony called "Ascension Day," at which they would be taken to dwell with the Philanthropist in eternal paradise.

Certainly, none of those taken were ever seen again.

I do not know how Styanax became Aria's protector.

But I am certain Aria knew that when the Philanthropist came for her... her ally... would be waiting in the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Styanax 的盾牌，象征着他保护危难之人的誓言。
年轻的阿莉亚当时确实身处险境。她也心知肚明，自己和哥哥达罗一样，都是「慈善家」选中的「受选者」。

待他们成年，便会受召参加一场名为「升天节」的仪式。届时，他们将被带到永恒乐园，与「慈善家」同住。

当然，那些被带走的人，从此再也没有出现。

我不知道 Styanax 究竟是如何成为阿莉亚的守护者。

但我敢肯定，阿莉亚早已知道，当「慈善家」前来接走她时……她的盟友……会在暗影中蛰伏等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
As Styanax struck and struck again with the Afentis, making little headway against the relentless Leviathan, a final desperate scream from Aria achieved the impossible.

It awoke Darro.

From out of those thousands of fused bodies, a single mind was suddenly saying no.

Latching his remaining arm around his tormentor's throat with the very last of his life's strength, the doomed Darro distracted the Philanthropist long enough for Styanax to act.

One last act of love and protection. For his sister.

But the Warframe hesitated. It seems he understood the importance of Darro's rebellion.

If one mind could turn upon its master... why not all of them?

With but a gesture, he gave the captive minds their freedom.

Suddenly awakened and aware of their hellish plight, the damned townspeople tore at the Philanthropist's exposed face, the Leviathan's body coming apart as arms broke free from the mass, clawing for revenge.

Together they dragged the screaming Philanthropist down, rending and tearing.

In that moment, we can be assured the Philanthropist knew the depth of his failure.

His defeat.

Without worshippers, a god... is nothing.

And Styanax delivered the final, merciful stroke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Styanax 挥动圣英轮番发起了攻击，却始终无法撼动那头穷追猛打的利维坦。就在此时，阿莉亚发出了最后一声绝望的尖叫，打破了这一切。

尖叫唤醒了达罗。

在那成百上千具融合的躯体中，有一个意识忽然说出「不」。

达罗耗尽生命的最后一丝力量，用仅剩的胳膊死死锁住利维坦的喉咙，成功拖住了「慈善家」，为 Styanax 争取到了出手的机会。

那是他最后一次为了爱，为了守护，也为了他妹妹而战。

可 Styanax 没有立刻发动攻击。他似乎明白，达罗的反抗意味着什么。

若一道意识能够背叛自己的主人……其余的，为什么不能一起反抗呢？

Styanax 只做了一个手势，便将自由还给了那些被囚禁的意识。

意识们骤然苏醒，终于看清自己正身陷何等地狱。利维坦的身躯随之崩解，一条条胳膊从血肉中挣脱，疯狂撕扯「慈善家」暴露在外的脸，为自己复仇。

他们一拥而上，将尖叫的「慈善家」拖倒，抓挠、撕裂。

在那一刻，可想而知，「慈善家」才明白自己输得有多么彻底。

他一败涂地。

没有信徒，所谓的神……不过是一具空壳。

最后，Styanax 以仁慈的一击，为这一切画上句点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Imagine the horror the non-chosen felt in the aftermath.

Fear, uncertainty, and above all, unquestioned habit had allowed a monster to flourish.

Aria took over the cult and made it a community instead.

They still thrive to this day. Or so it is claimed. 

Styanax is the story's hero, but it was Aria's courage that summoned him.

All revolutions begin when one voice dares to say: "I will not". Somehow, across the dark reaches, Styanax saw that courage burning bright and swore... it would not stand alone.

I would visit Aria's temple myself, but I am indisposed at present... a... long-standing condition.

All donations are, of course, appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
想象一下，事后那些未受选者，心中该有何等恐惧。

恐惧，迷惘，尤其是那种从不质疑的习惯——正是这些，让一头怪物得以滋长壮大。

阿莉亚接管了教团，却把它变成了真正的共同体。

据说，那里直到今天依然兴盛。

Styanax 是故事中的英雄，但将他召来的，是阿莉亚的勇气。

所有革命，都始于一个声音敢于说：「我不愿意。」不知为何，隔着无尽黑暗的彼端，Styanax 看见了她熊熊燃烧的勇气。于是便立誓……绝不让这一腔孤勇熄灭。

我倒是很想亲自去参观阿莉亚的神殿，只可惜眼下行动不便……算是……老毛病了。

当然，我们感谢所有的捐赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Impressive, isn't she? The relentless hunting shadow of the night of Naga drums. The last thing many an Orokin lord ever saw. Voruna, She-Wolf Incarnadine. The Heart of the Pack. Hunter of god-prey.

We remember her as a primal horror. The pitiless devourer stalking burning cities of white-and-gold, slavering for god-flesh.

This was not always so! Once, Voruna was the obedient guardian of the Circulus, the holiest of Yuvan temples upon none other than veiled Lua. Like a loyal beast, Voruna would roam Lua with her four steel-maned wolves: the stealthy Dynar, the invigorating Raksh, the stalwart Lycath, and the fierce Ulfrun. But what they were sworn to guard was perverse, wrong. In a ceremony reeking of Kuva, the Orokin candidate would force their consciousness into the new chosen body - the Yuvan - consigning the mind of the hapless former owner to oblivion. They called this life-extending process... 'Continuity'.

Executor Tuvul was one of the ruling Seven and head of the Yuvan Clerisy: high-ranking officiators who enacted the hideous ritual. All of whom... were now all dead, torn apart, all save for Tuvul... now a man pursued. He abandons his family to that night of horrors, his friends to the flames, and whips his slaves to ferry his decrepit, dying body to… his personal ship. Destination? Void-locked Lua. Purpose? To initiate one final ceremony. To trade one last body - one last life - for his own. Before the Empire burned.

To slip the noose and escape the relentless hunting shadow that had, one-by-one, in just one night, found and eviscerated every last one of his Clerisy peers. The shadow that had once protected them.

I never liked Tuvul. What followed made me loathe him even more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
她太惊艳了，不是吗？长胴鼓响起的夜里，那道冷酷无情的狩猎暗影。许多奥罗金领主临死前最后看见的，正是她。赤影狼母 Voruna，是狼群之心，是弑「神」的猎手。

在后世的记忆中，她是原始的恐怖化身。城市在烈焰中燃起白金色的光，无情的吞噬者在光影中徘徊，为「神」之血肉而垂涎。

然而，以前并非如此！续生殿隐没于月球之上，它是所有青春神殿中最神圣的一座，Voruna 曾是圣殿的驯顺守卫。她如忠诚的猎兽般巡视月球，身边始终跟随着四头钢鬃狼伴：善于潜行的戴拿、赋予活力的亚克什、坚毅的莱卡斯，以及凶烈的乌尔佛伦。可她们誓要守护的，却是一桩邪恶而悖逆天理的仪式。在一场弥散赤毒腥气的典礼中，奥罗金受仪者会将自己的意识强行注入新选中的躯体——青春之躯。然后把肉身原主人的意识彻底抹去。他们把这套延寿之法称为……「延续仪式」。

执行者涂沃曾是统治帝国的七人众之一，同时也是青春仪使团之首。仪使团的成员都是主持这项骇人仪式的高阶主仪者。如今，那些人……全死了，个个被撕得粉碎，除了涂沃。而他，也成为了被追猎的人。在那个恐怖的夜晚里，他把亲人好友全都抛进火海，又挥鞭逼迫奴隶，将自己那具衰朽、濒死的躯体运上……他的私人飞船。目的地？是被虚空封锁的月球。目的？赶在帝国彻底焚尽之前，再举行最后一次仪式。拿最后一具肉身——最后一条性命——换他自己继续苟活。

他不仅要从死神手里逃脱，还要逃过那道穷追不舍的狩猎暗影。这道暗影在短短一晚上，便找到他仪使团里的每一名同僚，将他们开膛破肚。而她，曾经正是他们的守卫。

我从来就不喜欢涂沃。接下来发生的事，只会让我更加憎恶他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Here is Dynar, the shadowed. He gave Voruna the gift of stealth that she might only take by surprise - but never be taken.

 Hm. Let us speak of what made the Circulus special: the first Void Conjunction.

It came suddenly, steeping Lua in malevolent, lashing Void-stuff. Within the moon-plasm, thoughts took horrifying physical forms. Images dredged up from childhood nightmares, or adult neuroses were abruptly tangible and real. Madness overtook many.

It was to this place - the Circulus - that Tuvul fled through a Void tormented by an extremely unusual Conjunction. Thrashing eddies, violent currents, and the appearance of horrifying beasts never seen before or since. It was as if, some have noted, the fabric of the universe echoed the upheaval tearing apart the fabric of the Origin System. Coincidence? I have lived too long to believe so but can provide no explanation greater than that.

Hoping against hope that the Void would keep the shadow that stalked him from picking up his trail, Tuvul touched down upon the powdery skin of sacred Lua.

What Tuvul lacked in loyalty, he made up for with rat cunning. He should have known better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
这是潜影者戴拿。他赠予 Voruna 潜行的天赋，让她永远能出其不意地拿下猎物，却绝不会反被敌人打个措手不及。

嗯，接下来，我们来聊聊续生殿究竟有何特别之处——那里曾发生过第一次虚空联结。

虚空联结来得毫无征兆。充满攻击性的虚空物质如潮水般席卷月球，将整颗星球浸没其中。在被侵染的月球物质中，思想竟以骇人的形态实体化：从童年噩梦深处翻出的怪影，或是成年后深埋心底的恐惧，转眼便变得真实有形。许多人就此陷入疯狂。

涂沃逃往的地方，正是续生殿。为了抵达那里，他必须穿过一片被极不寻常的联结搅得天翻地覆的虚空。虚空漩涡疯狂搅动，暗流猛烈冲撞，更有种种前无古人后无来者的恐怖异兽从中涌现。有人认为，宇宙本身的经纬，仿佛也在回应那场撕裂始源星系的剧变。是巧合吗？我活得太久，早已不相信巧合。可除此之外，我也拿不出更合理的解释。

涂沃明知希望渺茫，却仍指望虚空能替他遮掩行踪，让那道猎影追不上他。于是他降落在神圣月球那片粉尘覆盖的表面上。

涂沃在忠诚上欠缺多少，就用鼠辈般的狡诈补回多少。可惜，他终究没有聪明到家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
The third of Voruna's wolves. Lycath, the stalwart brother, the provider, and soul of the pack.

We know that Voruna and her wolves had served rite after rite. She had watched the mists and savagely destroyed anything that menaced the ceremony, flanked by Lycath's fury.

The Yuvan Ceremony - 'Continuity' as they called it - was an obscenity. The Orokin elite, aged and foul, would slouch and leer as the 'Yuvan'- young men and women cultivated on red Mars and worlds beyond for this dire purpose - were paraded before them. They would make their choice, conduct the ritual, and then, well, that young life would be gone, and when those eyes opened once more, it would be their murderer looking out from behind them.

Is it any wonder Voruna, freed from the leash of loyalty, was so intent upon making a meal of the Yuvan Clerisy? I think not.

Let's get to dessert, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Voruna 的第三位狼伴——莱卡斯。如同一位坚毅的兄长，他是狼群的供养者，也是整个族群的灵魂。

我们知道，Voruna 与她的狼群曾为一场又一场仪式效命。她注视着虚空迷雾，任何胆敢威胁仪式的存在，都会遭到她凶猛的毁灭。而莱卡斯则怀着满腔怒火，始终守在她的侧翼。

青春仪式——也就是他们口中的「延续仪式」——本就是一种污秽的亵渎。那些衰老腐朽的奥罗金权贵，会瘫坐在那里，以贪婪而下流的目光，打量从他们面前依次经过的「青春之躯」。这些年轻男女是在赤红的火星，乃至更加遥远的星球上，专为这项恶行而豢养的。他们会像牲口一样被带到奥罗金权贵面前，任其挑选。他们选定肉身，举行仪式。然后，嗯，年轻的生命就此消逝。等那些眼睛再次睁开，那些目光背后隐藏的，正是杀死原肉身的凶手。

当 Voruna 终于挣脱忠诚的束缚，一心要拿青春仪使团大快朵颐，又有什么奇怪的呢？至少我毫不意外。

那么，移步最后的展品吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
It is unclear precisely why Lua is a site of very special Void Conjunctions, but enacting Continuity within the Circulus and Yuvarium thereupon guaranteed a safe and strong transition… so long as certain rituals were correctly observed.

A privilege reserved only for the Seven themselves.

Imagine the scene as the innocent Yuvan would have witnessed it. The vivid insanity of it all. The appointed Soprana bridging the gap between worlds with her song. The Orokin Executor shrilling the ritual words. The bone-white Void creeping in on all fronts. The Kuva steaming scarlet in its glass bowl. And the imposing wolf-giant, Voruna, pacing the perimeter, four loyal wolves at her side.

This wolf you see here is Raksh, the defender, Voruna's own loyal guardian, as she protected her Orokin overlord from whatever madnesses the Void Conjunction would bring.

Of which there were many. And on that night, Tuvul had no such guardian. Quite the opposite.

Now, Tuvul would need flesh into which he could pass, but the shipments of fresh young bodies from across the System were no more. Tuvul, we will see, had laid a dark contingency.

Rat cunning, as I said.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
月球为何会成为特殊虚空联结频发之地，至今仍是个谜。不过，只要在月球上的续生殿和延生殿举行「延续仪式」，意识便能安稳完整地转入新躯体……当然，前提是每一道仪轨都执行得分毫不差。

这份特权，只属于七人众。

想象一下这一幕，无辜的青春之躯亲眼目睹这一切。那生动得令人窒息的疯狂。受命的掌歌祭司用歌声架起两界之间的桥梁，奥罗金执行者尖声诵念仪辞，森白如骨的虚空从四面八方蔓延开来。玻璃碗中的赤毒蒸腾着猩红之气。仪式外围，威风凛凛的巨狼 Voruna 来回踱步，四头忠诚的狼伴紧随在侧。

您眼前这头狼，便是守护者亚克什。当 Voruna 保护自己的奥罗金主人，抵御虚空联结带来的疯狂时，亚克什便忠诚地守护着她。

而那疯狂，只多不少。可在那个夜晚，涂沃身边没有这样的守护者。恰恰相反——昔日的守护者，正在追杀他。

要完成「延续仪式」，涂沃必须找到一具能承载自己意识的肉身。然而，从星系各地运来的年轻躯体早已不复存在。不过，我们很快便会看到，涂沃早已留了一步阴暗的后手。

我说过——狡诈如鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
From Void signatures, evidence at the site, and what recording technology survived that once-in-a-lifetime Void Conjunction, I infer the following. Forgive an old man some dramatic license.

The Kuva was poured, the lamps were lit, and the ritual of Continuity began.

As Tuvul intoned the barbarous versicles of Continuity, a horde the breadth of which had never before been seen at such a ceremony massed in the gathering Void. Things with two heads or none, lopsided, broken-horned, perhaps drawing their being from Tuvul himself, as if expressions of his vice.
