At this moment, I believe Voruna and her pack attacked, hoping to end the ceremony before it began. No such luck. The circle site was later found to be treacherous with the remnants of slain abominations.

Voruna and her wolves tore into the manifestations, rending with axe and fang. While Tuvul droned on, panicked, the pack hacked and tore their way through the throng toward him.

Why was Tuvul not the first to fall? I cannot answer. Perhaps Albrecht's work had something to it. Or perhaps those beasts simply understood that this wretched old man was the only thing keeping the door open for them.

Tremors shook the surface of Lua, and a great cry rang out, like that of a mother crying for her children. Tuvul sweated. The Kuva trembled in its bowl.

Voruna was relentless, demons falling to blade and fang. But it was not enough. The hordes of the Void are without number, and this one? If Hell has a Hell, then those monsters knew it well.

Gentle-eyed Raksh was the first to fall to scything blades. They killed Lycath next, then Dynar, and Ulfrun last of all. Voruna had howled many times before, in hunger, in anger, and in triumph, but now for the first time, she howled in grief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
根据残留的虚空痕迹、现场证据，以及从那场千载难逢的虚空联结中幸存下来的记录资料，我推演出了以下情形。咳咳，原谅我这个老头子的一些戏剧性的改编。

赤毒被倾倒进玻璃碗，灯火依次点亮。「延续仪式」开始了。

当涂沃吟诵起那些「延续仪式」的粗鄙短祷时，逐渐汇聚的虚空中，也聚起了一支前所未有的怪物大军。这样的阵仗，从前从未在任何一次仪式中出现过。那些怪物有的长着两个头，有的根本没有头，有的身躯歪斜，断角残缺。它们或许正从涂沃身上汲取实体化的灵感，仿佛是他邪恶堕落的化身一般。

我相信，Voruna 与狼群正是在此时发起了攻击。她们想赶在仪式真正完成之前将其终结。可惜天不遂人愿。后来，勘察者在仪式现场发现了大量被斩杀的怪物残骸，散落得到处都是。

Voruna 与狼群猛扑进那些虚空造物之中，用战斧劈砍、用獠牙撕咬。涂沃惊恐万状，却仍拖着单调的腔调念个不停。狼群则一路劈砍、撕咬，硬生生撕出一条路，朝他逼近。

涂沃为什么没有第一个倒下？我无法回答。或许阿尔布雷希特的研究确实发挥了作用。又或许，那些虚空怪物本能地明白，只有眼前这个可悲的老头，才能替它们撑开大门。

月球表面地动山摇，一声巨大的哀号响彻四方，仿佛一位母亲正在呼唤她的孩子。涂沃汗流浃背，玻璃碗中的赤毒也在颤抖。

Voruna 一刻不曾停歇，怪物接连倒在她的利刃与獠牙之下。可那远远不够。虚空的怪物无穷无尽，至于眼前这一群呢？要是地狱之下还有地狱，那些怪物便是从那里爬出来的。

目光温柔的亚克什最先倒在死神的镰刀下。随后是莱卡斯，然后是戴拿，最后是乌尔佛伦。Voruna 此前曾无数次长嚎——为饥饿，为愤怒，也为胜利。但这一次，是她生平第一次为悲痛而哀嚎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Behold: Ulfrun the Fierce. The most formidable of Voruna's sept.

Executor Tuvul scrambled to set up the ritual room. This time the ceremony was different. Instead of a Soprana, there was a mere Mandachord playing automated notes. And instead of the prepared Yuvan, there was a most unusual cryopod - containing a young child, sleeping peacefully. The aforementioned contingency.

In Tuvul's hands, so it is said, were an artifact and a codex belonging to none other than Albrecht Entrati himself: Father of Void Travel and a man who had sacrificed his sanity to it.

Tuvul opened the book to pages strange and profane. We know this, having retrieved it from the site much later. It is my belief that Tuvul intended to protect himself from the horrors the Void would unleash, using what amounted to a madman's grimoire. A desperate act indeed.

I like to imagine that, as he parted his withered lips to begin the ceremony, to call down the Void... that was the moment he heard Ulfrun's ravening howl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
请看——凶烈者乌尔佛伦，他是 Voruna 狼群中最强悍的狼。

执行者涂沃手忙脚乱地布置好了仪式厅。但这一次，仪式与往常不同。没有掌歌祭司，只有一架曼达和弦琴，在机械地自动奏出音符。原本该安置青春之躯的位置，也没有早已备好的年轻躯体。而是放着一座不同寻常的冷冻舱，舱内是一名年幼的孩子，正安详地沉睡。
这，就是我先前提过的那步后手。

据说，涂沃手握有阿尔布雷希特·英择谛本人留下的一件遗物和一部法典。它们都属于那位虚空旅行之父，为探索虚空献出了自己的理智。

涂沃将法典翻到那些诡谲而充满亵渎之词的篇章。我们后来从遗址找回了它，所以这一点可以确定。依我看，涂沃是想借助这部与疯人魔典无异的著作，保护自己免受虚空即将释放的种种恐怖所害。他的确是走投无路了。

我总忍不住想象，就在他张开干瘪的嘴唇，准备开启仪式、召唤虚空降临时……
他听见了乌尔佛伦那饥狂的长嚎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.text:
Voruna trod and swung without relent toward the circle - carrying, by their silver scruffs, the severed heads of her fallen, beloved wolves. Severed from their dead bodies by her own hand.

With one last ululating cry, Tuvul's ritual reached its peak. Within the cryopod, the child's eyelids fluttered and Voruna… staggered. In what scratchy stills survived in Void-corrupted datamasses, what I saw between child and Warframe was... recognition.

Tuvul took some meager scrap of courage from this delay and reached for the bowl of Kuva, now boiling and steaming with weird energies.

Voruna struck him aside and seized the energized Kuva - not for herself, but for her wolves. Holding it high, she doused herself - and her slain packmates - with it.

Embraced by the seething crimson glow, connective tissue propagated. Sinew reached for bone, and within that marriage of occultism and science, she and her beloved wolves became one.

Her brethren lived again. In her. Voruna was now, and evermore, the heart of the pack.

Cheated of his continuity, Tuvul turned to flee. But his former warden was having none of it.

Those who came after found nothing but gnawed bones, some of them unusually long, twisted within shreds of white-gold raiments.

Good.

I did salvage one final image from those Void-corrupted datamasses, however. That of Voruna herself, striding back toward her craft, the child cradled in her arms.

Curious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/MuseumLeverian.zhText:
Voruna 一步未停，一斧未停，向仪式圆阵杀去。她还带着那些阵亡狼伴的头颅，手中紧紧攥住他们银鬃覆盖的后颈。那些头颅，正是她亲手从挚爱狼伴的遗体上砍下的。

随着最后一声尖厉的嚎叫，涂沃的仪式也来到关键时刻。冷冻舱内，孩子的眼睑微微颤动。Voruna……也随之踉跄了一步。在被虚空腐化的数据模块中，只留下了几张布满划痕的定格影像。而我在那个孩子与战甲之间看到的……是认出彼此的瞬间。

涂沃从这一刻的迟疑中，挤出了一丝勇气。他伸手抓向那钵正散发诡异能量、蒸腾出猩红雾气的赤毒。

Voruna 一击将他扫到一旁，夺过那钵满溢能量的赤毒。不是为了自己，而是为了她的狼群。她把钵高高举起，将赤毒浇在自己身上，也浇遍了那些死去的狼伴头上。

翻涌的猩红光芒将她们包围，结缔组织飞快再生，筋腱攀上骨头。在那场秘仪与科学的结合之中，Voruna 与她深爱的狼群融为一体。

她的手足再次活了过来，与她一体。从那一刻起，Voruna 永远都是狼群之心。

眼看自己的「延续仪式」彻底落空，涂沃转身便逃。可他昔日的守卫不肯放行。

后来赶到现场的人，只找到一堆被啃噬过的骨头。其中有些长得异乎寻常，与白金衣袍的碎片缠扭在一起。

很好。

不过，我的确从那些被虚空腐化的数据模块中，抢救出了最后一张影像。画面中的 Voruna 正大步走回自己的飞船，怀中抱着那个孩子。

耐人寻味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Hold up. Detecting glass resonance. It's close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 等等，检测到玻璃共鸣。很近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Eyes open. There's glass resonance in your neighborhood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 眼睛放亮点。玻璃共鸣就在你附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: We've got signals singin' the same song as our victim. Careful now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我们收到了信号，哼唱着和受害者一模一样的旋律。保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Cephalites! Time to smash some glass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 中枢人！该去砸烂这些玻璃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Where are they coming from? Void, who did this to them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们从哪儿来的？虚空啊，是谁把他们变成这样的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Whatever these Cephalites have become, there's no going back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 无论这些中枢人变成了什么，他们都已经回不去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: There's less than nothing left of who they once were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们昔日的自我，如今已荡然无存了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamer, there's gotta be a way to take these things down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者，一定有方法能摧毁这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: They're tough, but no glass is unbreakable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们很难对付，但世上没有砸不烂的玻璃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You gotta find out what's protecting them and then take your shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你得找出是什么在保护他们，然后再找准机会下手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamer! Picking up massive Weave resonance from the corpse. The Infestation can't take it… it's burning away. Look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者！从受害者遗体上接收到大量织网共鸣。感染者无法控制它……看，它正被慢慢烧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: The body… it's Orokin. Wait. Wait. Nooo... he wouldn't... would he?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 尸体……是奥罗金人。等等，等一下。不……他不会……不会吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Took you long enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你总算明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Justice never lived inside these walls, only oppression.  After all this time, from whatever hell he wound up in, the Glassmaker still wants to keep a heavy boot planted on every face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这些冰冷的高墙内从未有过正义，有的只是压迫。哪怕过了这么久，不管他是从什么境地爬了上来，玻璃匠依然妄想将他沉重的压迫之靴，狠狠踩在每个人的脸上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Oh please. The mob murdered the Empire. Since then, the Origin System has known nothing but conflict, chaos, and collapse. The human capacity for delusion truly is without limit. You ask why I exist? I give you this little mouthpiece for the collapse of civilization.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 哦，拜托，暴徒们灭亡了帝国，从那时起，始源星系就只剩下冲突、混乱，以及崩溃。人类的妄想真的是毫无止境。你问，我为什么存在？我让你瞧瞧，这个导致文明崩溃的传声筒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: These were all people once, Dreamer. Reduced to examples... to keep the rest in line. Just like Nihil is set on doing now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者，这些都曾是活生生的人。但却沦为了警示……好让剩下的人乖乖听话。就像无刹现在执意要做的一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Orokin laws. Legem. They had hundreds of these books. Easy to put a foot wrong when your masters change the rules as they please. Judging from their condition, I'd say when the Empire's end came, it was fast and violent. Someone saved these few - and they're all about glassing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 奥罗金的法律，律典。他们有成千上百本这样的书。如果你的主人随意改变规则，你就很容易犯错。从这些书的受损状况来看，我觉得当这个帝国走向终结时，过程必定极为迅猛且惨烈。有人抢救下了其中这几本——而且全都和玻璃化有关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: They were deranged children run amok. Centuries of progress - destroyed. But they never destroyed me. Never caught me. And our end only proved our correctness... that our laws had been just. Too late. But. It's never too late, is it, Nora?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们是疯狂且又肆意妄为的孩子。几个世纪的进程——被毁于一旦。但他们从未击垮我。从未抓到我。而我们的结局，只证明了我们的正确性……也就是说，我们的法律是公正的。太晚了。但是，这永远都不会太晚，是吧，诺拉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: This would be how Cutter got Nihil's attention. Woke him, maybe. Either way, he got a lot more than he bargained for when he connected to this abandoned part of the Weave. We all did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 就是这样，卡特引起了无刹的注意。也许是唤醒了他。不管怎样，当他接入这片废弃的织网时，他付出的代价远远超出了他的预期。我们所有人也都一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: So many souls were glassed here. These shackles... logged and numbered. This place is important to him. So important, I'm startin' to think he never left it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 许多灵魂在这里被玻璃化。这些镣铐……都带有记录和编号。这个地方对他来说很重要。重要到我甚至开始觉得，他从未离开过这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Butcher, barber, surgeon. These are issues of degree. Sometimes all that was needed was a little off the top... but it's the beheadings people remember. A society fails without both haircuts and hangings. Naughty Nora doesn't understand that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 屠夫、理发师、外科医生。不过是程度的问题罢了。有时候，需要做的只是修理头上的一点点……但人们只会记得斩首的事。当一个社会没有了形象和法度，它就会崩塌。"淘气"的诺拉不明白这点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Nihil's hit his endgame. Dozens are getting glassed now, systemwide, and he's just warming up. Easy to trace a signal that strong. This is where Nihil glassed thousands - maybe millions. Back in the day, this place would have been stacked with pretty glass bottles - Cephalon oubliettes. Tiny little hells, each built for one. He's hiding out. We gotta find out where - and fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 无刹亮出底牌了。现在，星系内的许多人都变成了玻璃，而他才刚刚热完身。那种强度的信号很容易被追踪到。这就是无刹当年玻璃化上千人——乃至上百万人的地方。以前，这里堆满了漂亮的玻璃瓶——也就是中枢密牢。为每个人量身定制的迷你地狱。他藏起来了。我们必须找到他藏在哪——越快越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: A little late for that. I'm everywhere now. Hello. Oh, she can't hear us. It's just you and me. For now. Once I filled this chamber with filled oubliettes. That anguished choir sang a song that healed my jaded old soul. That choir shall sing again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 有点迟了，现在的我无处不在。你好啊。哦，她听不到我们的对话。现在，只有你和我。我曾在这间屋子里布满了押有犯人的密牢。那感到极度痛苦的合唱团为我演奏着，歌声治愈了我疲惫衰老的灵魂。那合唱团会再次唱响的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Wait. Under that Infested mass… glass. Looks like we got a body after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 等等，那团感染组织底下……有玻璃。看来，我们终究还是发现了一具尸体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: The law is the heaviest of stones - a saving anchor for the righteous, a killing weight for the unjust. Prepare. For it now. Descends. Upon YOU.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 法律是众石之中最具分量的——是拯救正义之人的靠山，是压垮不义之人的重担。准备好。现在，它会、降临、在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Ssh. Ssh. There. Silence. I had the strength to turn my instrument of judgment upon myself, to escape hordes of ravenous, idiot little specks like you. I have more than enough strength to shut… you… up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 嘘，嘘，安静点。我有实力把我的审判工具对准我自己，来逃离诸多像你这样贪婪、白痴的小不点。我有足够的实力来让你……闭……嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamer!... He's… stealing me… from myself… but I'm not alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者！……他在……从我自己手中……夺走我……但我并非孤身一人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Naughty Nora with her little shoulder to the door, thinking to keep me out. Her defenses won't last long while you, on the other hand, have no defenses at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: "淘气"的诺拉用她弱小的肩膀顶着门，想把我拒之门外。她的抵抗不会持续太久，而你，却一点抵抗之力都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I am with Nora now, Tenno. She's afraid. But not for long. I shall remake her in an image more appropriate to her future function…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: Tenno，我现在和诺拉在一起。她很害怕，但这不会持续太久。我会重塑她的形象，以更符合她未来的职能……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Arc-screen is down. Feedback loops broken… Dreamer! He's here, he's right on top of me, coming through the --
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 弧形屏幕熄灭了。反馈回路已中断……梦回者！他在这儿，就在我上方，正在穿过——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: And to think you believed you were ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你还以为，自己已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Oop-sie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Hapless. Incompetence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 运气不佳。能力不足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Looks like Cutter was assigned homework. Looking into Parvos Granum. Something about 'old ways.' Did they know each other back in the day? Nihil seems to think he and Granum might be on the same page. An ally?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 看起来卡特分配到了任务：调查帕尔沃斯·格拉努。调查内容涉及「老规矩」。在此之前他们彼此认识吗？无刹似乎认为他和格拉努可能处于同一阵线。像是一位盟友？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Files on Shigg, Vondu and Gral - the other 3 victims. Cutter made a case for them being… used. Shigg was to invent some kind of device. Vondu built it. Gral… had the encrypted access so the device could broadcast wide. But broadcast what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 关于希格、方杜，以及格拉尔——也就是另外 3 名受害者的档案。卡特指出他们是被……利用了。希格负责发明某种装置。方杜把它造了出来。格拉尔……则握有加密访问权限，能让这个装置向全星系大范围广播。但广播的内容是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Looks like Cutter delivered the transmitter Shigg designed and Vondu built to… dammit. Somewhere. It's built to clone some kind of signal - holopresence maybe? - to multiple locations at once. Powerful, powerful signal. I do not like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 该死，看起来卡特把由希格设计、方杜制造的发射机运到了……某个地方。制造它的目的是为了复制某种信号，也许是全息投影？同时发送到多个地点。非常、非常强大的信号。这感觉可不妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dossiers on those Cutter suspected of being Solaris United, and closed dossiers on… the ones he confirmed. Some repoed, others used in Nef Anyo's Tribute experiments. Cutter wasn't SU - the opposite. He was being paid to identify and round up SU operatives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 那些是被卡特怀疑是索拉里斯联盟的人员名册，而这些封存档案……都是他确认过的。一些人被强行回收了部件，其他人则被用于奈富·安尤的贡品实验。卡特根本不是索联的，恰恰相反，他专门负责揪出并围捕索联特工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Grim. Looks like he had a moment with his killer, and he did not like it. The other victims were all taken fast, but Cutter had time to plead his case. What made him so different?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 太惨了。看起来他曾和杀手有过接触，并且他很不情愿。其他受害者都是在短时间内遇害，但卡特却有时间来为自己申辩。是什么让他如此与众不同？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamer, meet Cutter. This is the guy our Grineer victim was trying to contact. If Gral was part of a Solaris United whisper network then Cutter must have been his handler. So this was his bolthole. Look around, let's see what we can learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者，认识一下卡特。我们的克隆尼受害人曾试图与此人取得联系。如果格拉尔曾是索拉里斯联盟密语网络的一员，那么卡特肯定是他的上线。这就是他的藏身处。四处转转，看看有没有什么发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You want to know why I'm doing this. Your friend - Nora - wants to know. Naughty little Nora. Afraid I would find her all alone and put her in a bottle. Yes. Cutter and his friends have been quite helpful in opening my eyes and ears to the modern System.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你想知道我为什么要这样做。你的朋友 — 诺拉— 也想知道。"淘气"的小诺拉。怕我会发现她孤身一人并把她装进瓶子里。是的。在开阔我对现代世界的认知上，卡特和他的朋友帮助了我很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Why oppose me? We both prize Justice, defend it. What justice do you imagine enacting if I have to put you in a bottle?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 为什么反对我？我们俩都珍视正义，捍卫正义。如果我不得不把你装进瓶子里，那你又能做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Do you know mercy, Tenno? I almost spared Cutter. He was a traitor, but to betray one must belong. Cutter never did. He was a nation of one, and to that he was truly loyal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: Tenno，你懂得怜悯吗？我几乎就要放过卡特了。他是一个叛徒，但要背叛一个人，那就必须先从属于这个人。卡特从未这样做过。他从来都是一个人，并且只忠诚于他自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: But traitor he was and for all his proud words he begged at the end. And I… killed him, I suppose. Killed what he was. But you kill, too, constantly. Doesn't put you in much of a position to judge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 然而，他是一个叛徒，并且最后只能低三下四地求饶。然后，我想，我……杀死了他。杀死了过去的他。但是，你也一直在进行杀戮。因此，你没有资格来对我说三道四。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I have all that I need. Order will no longer be upheld one miscreant at a time. I am amplified. Soon I shall be everywhere and with it… order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我拥有我所需要的一切。再也不用通过一次次地消灭恶人来维持秩序。我变得更强大了。很快，我将无处不在，还有伴随着我的……秩序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: What a fine example each and every Tenno shall make, you killers of foes, friends and family. And naughty Nora. Her role won't change terribly much, but her agenda… very different. A voice of truth and order, sermonizing tirelessly, forever. Fully aware of what she has become. Goodbye, Tenno. Our next meeting will be our last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 每个 Tenno，所有 Tenno 都应被拿来以儆效尤，你们是杀害敌人、朋友，以及家人的凶手。还有"淘气"的诺拉。她的角色不会有太大变化，但她的日程……就完全不一样了。她的广播将发出真理与秩序的声音，永不停歇地进行灌输传播。而且她完全清楚自己会变成什么。再见了，Tenno。我们下次再见，那将是我们最后一次见面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Found someone, have you, Nora?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你找到了一个人，是吗，诺拉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Wait. Of all the prisoners to free, you chose the doll-hugging pacifist?! This is too much!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 等等。在所有的囚犯中，你竟然选择释放那个抱着娃娃的和平主义者？！这简直太过分了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Big words… from someone… who crapped his toga and hid in the weave… when the Tenno kicked in his door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 口气不小，说这话的人……当年 Tenno 踹开他的大门时……吓得长袍都尿湿了，躲进织网里瑟瑟发抖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: SHIGG!! You were scum when you were dragged to me… you were scum when you screamed, and you are scum now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 希格！！你被拖到我面前时，就是个人渣……哭喊尖叫的时候也是人渣，你现在还是人渣！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Shut up, man, we're busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 闭嘴，我们正忙着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: An old friend wants to say hi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 有位老朋友想打个招呼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Damn you! Oh, Bak Vondu. You shall sing for me again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 真是可恶！哦，巴克·方杜。你就应该再次为我而歌唱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Lot of info in here, Glassmaker. Legem 6-243. 'No capital sentence shall be passed without unanimous consent of the Seven, on pain of…' Oh, look at that. 'Forfeiture of all tools of office, banishment.' Huh. You're a criminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 玻璃匠，这里有不少条款啊。律典第 6 章第 243 条：「未经七人众一致同意，不得判处死刑，违者将……」噢，瞧瞧。「没收所有执法工具，予以流放。」哼，原来你当初是个罪犯啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: This won't be pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这样可不太妙呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You presumptuous tick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你就是个自以为是的蝼蚁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: How. Dare you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 什么？你竟敢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 休息！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Do you wish to make a final statement?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你希望去做最后的陈述吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Contemptible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 卑鄙小人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: On your knees!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 给我跪下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Disappointing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 真令人失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 注意言行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Bear up. It's nearly over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 忍忍吧。很快就结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: The Empire! Lives! Through me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这个帝国，因为我而存活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You. HURT. ME.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你。伤。害。了。我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You can't win. You can't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你赢不了的。你赢不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Aaaah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: We ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Waaaiiittt...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 等。一。等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Get him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 拿下他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: No! NOOOOOO...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 不要……不要啊……！啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Now sing, you bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 唱吧，混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: No! I will not fail again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 不！我不会再次失败的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: This is not the end, Betrayer! Our Golden Empire dies not here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这还远远没有结束，叛徒！我们黄金帝国绝不可能在这里覆灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: For you… for this… I shall create… such… hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 为了你……为了这个……我想创造一个……这样子的地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Pain! For you! Forever!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 痛苦！为你准备！永不结束！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Trapped, forever separated from his little fluffy friend. Pathetic. Leave him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 身陷绝境，可能永远也见不到他那毛毛绒绒的小朋友了。真是太可悲了。忘了他吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: The Orokin designed them to be perfect. This one's very existence spits in the face of perfection. And you would release him?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 奥罗金人把它们设计得非常完美。而这家伙的存在就是在完美的脸上啐了一口。而你还要放了他？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: A deviant who was an affront to generations of martial greatness deserves no better than an eternity in the prison to which I have consigned him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他离经叛道，侮辱了几代人的武术成就。他只配被我送进监狱里，永世不得自由！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Community. Raised him. Cared for him. And he turned his back on them! Let him suffer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 是社区抚养他长大。照顾了他。而他却背弃了他们！他必须因此受尽折磨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: He will never again see the plains from the height of his brothers' scaffolds. I have made sure of that. That is just.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他再也不能够站在他兄弟的绞首架上瞭望平原了。我非常确信这一点。那个就是正义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: This one will never again savor the taste of hot chimurr on a cold plains night. For his sins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这个人将永远也无法在平原上寒冷的夜晚里，品尝到一杯温暖的赤穆茶了。这都是因为他的罪行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: A lifetime of dogma and creed were not enough to prevent his… deviation… from the norms of his culture. His sentence is just.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 长久以来对教义和信条的耳濡目染都不足以防止他……偏离……他身处文化的规范。他的判决是公正合理的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Kindness. Charity. A violation of the social contract to which he was born. He deserves this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 善良。仁慈。他违反了与生俱来的社会契约。他罪有应得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Nevermore to extend a helping hand, this one. Leave him. He should wallow in that for eternity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他再也没有机会伸出援助之手了，忘了这个人吧。他应该永世沉沦于此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
[11.0]
When the barbarians are at the gate, the truly noble may choose to find an honorable way out; and so the crude and lawless find they have arrived too late.
[17.0]
And thus, the weave of history may disguise a cunning victory as a defeat.
[24.0]
I am Nihil. Glassmaker. Order. Shall be. Restored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
[11.0]
当野蛮人挡在门口时，真正高贵的人可能会选择寻找一条体面的出路；于是，粗鄙的不法之徒还是发现他们来得太迟了。
[17.0]
因此，历史的编织可能会把一场巧妙的胜利伪装成一场失败。
[24.0]
我是无刹。玻璃匠。秩序，将被，恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: We're all here… Gral, Bak Vondu, Shigg… every last glassed soul…. Find them, Dreamer… before we all join them...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我们都在这里，格拉尔、巴克·方杜、希格，每个被玻璃化封印的灵魂都在这儿……去找到他们吧，梦回者，在我们所有人彻底沦为玻璃之前……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Here he is. The Terror of the Orokin: bottled up like a rich lady's bathwater. Or two-credit hooch. Do what you want with him. Prop a door open, bury him twenty feet deep. Either way, he's yours. It's up to you to make sure he never gets loose again. Hell of a day, Dreamer. Hell of a day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他就在这儿。奥罗金的梦魇——像贵妇的洗澡水一样被装进瓶子里，又像两块钱的劣酒，随你怎么处置。拿他去顶门，或者把他埋到六米深的地底。不管怎样，都归你了。你要保证他再也逃不出来。今天真是要命啊，梦回者，真要命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You had to do it the hard way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你总是想要自讨苦吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Sentence... has been passed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 判决，已经传达下去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Guilty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 有罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: There is but one rule: the rule of the rod.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这只有一个原则：那就是严刑峻法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Persistent. Your kind always were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 固执己见。你们这种人向来如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You won't be getting any more help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你应该不会得到更多的帮助了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Glassing yourself let you escape once. Nowhere to run now. No clever way out. Time to live or die by those vaunted convictions. Glassmaker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 把自己变成玻璃让你逃过了一劫。现在无路可逃，无计可施了吧。是时候为你那些自吹自擂的信念付出生死代价了。玻璃匠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: So. Naughty Nora… fancies herself… a revolutionary AND a scholar. Well. I'm. The Big Dog. Here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 所以。淘气的诺拉……幻想她自己是……一名革命家和一名学者。不好意思，我才是这里真正的大人物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Irrelevant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 毫无关联。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Motion denied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 请求被驳回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Do you even know what you're looking for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你到底有没有搞清楚自己在寻找什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Haven't done your due diligence, have you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你还没有做尽职调查，对不对？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You made a mistake, placing me in here… whole and entire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你犯了个错误，把毫发无伤的我……关在这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Small minds die in cells. Great minds? Great minds do their finest work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 卑微的人会死在监狱里。伟大的人呢？伟大的人会实现他们最伟大的成就。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Look at you. Strutting. Righteous. We'll exchange places soon enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 看看你这副昂首阔步、正义凛然的样子。很快，我们的处境就会交换了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: HmmmmMmmmmm... Can I help you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 哼——嗯……有什么可以帮你的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I had generations to plan my return. Do you think - for one moment - that I had not allowed for this eventuality?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我用几代人的时间精心策划了我的归来。你该不会真的有一瞬间认为我从来没有考虑到这种可能性吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I glassed so many in my time. Surely you'd like to know where they are? Let me out. Let me out, and I'll show you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 想当年我把那么多人都变成了玻璃。你一定想知道他们在哪儿吧，对不对？放我出去。放我出去我就告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
Heard of those cubes? You know - 'Cephalons' right? Probably got one a bit-cracked, kissin' up to you all the time?

See, in the old days, crime and punishment was all in the hands of those Orokin judges, the Seven. Mercy was a quick flash of the Jade light… But - if they wanted to make an example, they'd suck up your soul and make you a prisoner of the glass, forever.

Seems like magic to us nowadays, but dreamers… someone's got it puzzled out again. Waves are buzzing, new glass is showing up. Souls getting snapped up and trapped up.

All we've got to go on is this crime-simula I pulled from the weave. No sign of our killer and not a soul to tell us where they went…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
听说过那些方块吗？你知道「中枢」吧？也许你就有一个，脑子有毛病，整天献殷勤？
过去，定罪与量刑全掌握在奥罗金法官——七人众手里。仁慈，不过是一闪而过的翠玉之光……他们想杀鸡儆猴，就会抽走你的灵魂，让你永远沦为玻璃中的囚徒。
如今看来，这就像魔法一样。但梦回者……有人又重拾了这项技术。电波嗡嗡作响，新的镜中牢不断涌现。灵魂被无情攫取，牢牢困入其中。
我们唯一的线索，就是我从织网里扒出来的这个犯罪模拟现场。凶手没留下任何痕迹，也没人知道他们去了哪…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Well, take a look around. See if you can suss out any clues about whoever this… 'Glassmaker' might be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 好吧，四下转转。看看你能不能找出线索，查出这个……「玻璃匠」究竟是谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
Used to be a middle-aged Ostron, but he's been… degraded. From the inside out. Glassed… but not all the way. You seeing that left hand? Burned.

Weirdest of the weird? What's left of him is… resonating. Like… singing some weird-assed song. Not diggin' this. Not. At. All.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
受害者是个中年奥斯特朗人，但他已被……分解了。从内到外，都变成了玻璃……但不是全身都如此。看见那只左手了吗？被烧焦了。

最诡异的是什么？他剩下的残躯正在……共鸣。就像在哼着某种诡异至极的歌。我不喜欢这种感觉。一点也不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Looking for custom tech, but it sounds like our guy didn't have the means.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 凶手正在找某种定制技术，但看来受害者并没有这个路子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Folklore has it these Ayatans used to hold memories. Nowadays, some Ostrons survive peddling Old War trinkets like this, harvested from the Tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 传说这些阿耶檀识是用来储存回忆的。如今，一些奥斯特朗人靠贩卖这些高塔上搜刮下来的远古之战玩意儿谋生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Community, sharing, it's ingrained in Ostron culture. Unusual that one would be looking to make a score of their own outside their commune markets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 互助共享的意识，深深根植于奥斯特朗文化中，很少有人会想在这公社市场之外自立门户。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Not the tools of someone who works the Tower scaffolds. Was he expecting trouble?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这不是高塔脚手架上干活的人该有的工具。他料到什么麻烦了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: That's it, I guess. Hmm. That energy resonance… You see it change?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我想就是这个了。嗯。那股能量共鸣……你看见它的变化了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Oh. I'm so glad you're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 噢。我很高兴你在这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Was old Shigg a mutual acquaintance? How well did you know him, really?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你也认识老希格？你对他有多了解，你是认真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Fine. You talk to daffy old Shigg. If you favor the opinions of the low. Of criminals. The depraved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 行吧。你就跟愚蠢的的老希格说吧。如果你倾向听取卑劣者的意见的话。他就是个罪犯。一个堕落的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Do you know what he did, old Shigg? Set out a selfish play against his clade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你知道他做了什么吗，那个老希格？他背叛了自己的族人且演了好一出自私自利的戏码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Willing and able to draw blood for it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 甚至不惜为此双手沾满鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: A foul necrocapitalist, a clear violator of the 401st and 623rd legem!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 一个毫不遵守规则的刽子手资本家，一个违反了律典第 401 和 623 条的违法者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: To your association I am now witness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我现在可是目睹了你们俩的来往了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamer! Where did you go? Did you get anything on the Glassmaker?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者！你刚才去哪儿了？找到什么关于玻璃匠的线索了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
'Legem'? That's an Orokin word, means law. Ain't nobody usin' that word these days. He sounds friendly enough, but listen to that anger. Anger like that only builds.

The soul he took held a clue. My gut says the only way you're trackin' the Glassmaker is from inside that maze. Bad news is the trail's gone cold. But the bad vibe snakin' up my spine says it won't be for long. Stay in touch, Dreamer. The Glassmaker's just gettin' started. I can feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
「律典」？那是个奥罗金词汇，意思是法律。这年头没人用这个词了。他言辞友善，但也能从话里听出愤怒。那种怒火只会越积越深。

他抽走的灵魂里藏着线索。直觉告诉我，想追踪玻璃匠，只有潜入那个迷宫深处。坏消息是，线索断了，但我有种不祥的预感，不久会有新线索。保持联络，梦回者，玻璃匠才刚开始行动，我能感觉得到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Our victim found a way to eavesdrop on encrypted channels. Hm. An agent for a Solaris United whisper network? Looks like he was giving colonies advance warning of Grineer attacks. Our boy wasn't a coward saving his own skin, he was risking his life out of a sense of morality. Obligation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我们的受害者找到了一种窃听加密频道的方法。嗯，是索拉里斯联盟密语网络的人？看起来他之前正在向殖民地发送克隆尼的袭击预警。这伙计可不是贪生怕死的胆小鬼，他是纯粹出于道德感和责任感，在拿自己的生命冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Standard issue for the Grineer… but hasn't been fired in a good long while. Chamber's clean, mag's empty. What kinda Grineer doesn't use their weapon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 克隆尼的标准制式武器……但是已经很久没有开过火了。枪膛很干净，弹匣是空的。什么样的克隆尼才不用他们的武器？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Kid's toy. That is messed up right there. Grineer take trophies, sure - weapons, tech, armor. But a scruffy little floof? If I didn't know better I'd say he felt something. Love? Guilt? Wouldn't have been tolerated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 小孩子的玩具。这真的不对劲。克隆尼的确会收集战利品——武器、技术、盔甲。但是一个破旧的毛绒玩具？如果不是亲眼所见，我甚至会说，他也许是真的有了感情。是爱？是内疚？无论是什么，对他们来说都是零容忍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: So, our boy was a reader. Somebody with questions. Not very Grineer. Goes against all their indoctrination. Like my Mama always said: nobody likes a thinker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 看来这家伙还喜欢读点书。一个充满好奇的人，很不像克隆尼的作风，完全违背了他们的思想灌输。就像我老妈总说：没人喜欢有头脑的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Abandoned Grineer watchpost. Not a lot of traffic these parts. He kept it up though, made it a home. Probably all he knew. Oddly peaceful. Like he was ready for it. Didn't put up a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 废弃的克隆尼哨所。虽然这里鲜有人迹，但他却把这儿收拾得很好，当成了自己的家。大概他只知道这个地方吧。出奇的安静，他像是早已准备好了，没有任何打斗的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Nihil. Worse than an executioner, worse even than an Excruciator. When my tired ol' grandma didn't have time for my nonsense, Nihil was the bogeyman she said was gonna come put naughty Nora in a bottle. But Nihil was real. He's still here, somehow, after all this time… and still passing judgment. We've got another victim, crystalized in exile. This one feels different. Can't put my finger on why. Get on up now. Determine his pattern. Gather the clues and get back into Nihil's Weave. We can't find him and there ain't no lockin' him back in whatever bottle he came from.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 无刹，比行刑者更残暴，比酷吏更没人性。小时候，每当我疲惫的老祖母没空搭理我胡闹时，就会拿无刹来吓唬我，说他会把淘气的诺拉装进玻璃瓶里。但无刹是真实存在的。不知为何，过了那么长时间，他依然还在这……并且仍在降下审判。又有一名受害者，在流放时被玻璃化。这个受害者似乎有些特殊，但我也说不上是因为什么。马上开始调查，摸清他的行事风格。收集线索，然后回到无刹的织网。我们得找到他，否则根本没法把他关回他爬出来的那个瓶子里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Rarely does one encounter a lamb so eager to know the mouth of the lion. But, since you're here…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 很少有人会遇到如此渴望了解虎口的小羊。但是，既然你在这里了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: There is order, and there is chaos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 有秩序，亦有混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I am order. He was chaos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我即是秩序。他曾是混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: His insubordination, thoughts… guilt… feelings… chaos to Grineer order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他的不服从，思考……负罪感……情感……对 Grineer 秩序来说是一场混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Your persistence is disruptive to my efforts to order. Therefore you are…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你的固执对我维持秩序的努力造成了干扰。那么，你是……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You are an infection. Chaos infects, as Gral was infected, and spreads. A lack of vigilance is the vector. Oh, we lose vigilance if not reminded. This Grineer? Now? Is an eternal reminder, has become an agent of order and so… is redeemed. You, yourself, are not beyond redemption.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你像瘟疫一样。混乱会传染，正如格拉尔被感染一样，并且混乱还会扩散蔓延。警觉性缺失就是病原携带者。噢，如果我们没有被敲响警钟，那么我们就会失去警觉性。这个 Grineer？现在？作为一个永恒的警钟，他已经变成了秩序的代言人，并且因此……得到救赎。你，你的本身，仍然可以获得救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
Glass is still turning up, Dreamer. But you already knew that, didn't you? Probably ran into a few 'Cephalites' yourself? Partial glass, like a Cephalon interrupted. Well, it seems they're on the move now, changing course. Why?

Here's the only lead we have. A new crime scene I managed to grab before the Taxmen moved in. Solo gig on a Corpus A-train.

You know what to do. Work the evidence. Piece it together. See how it connects. It's the only way back to that twisted weave. It's the only way to find out who's behind this and put a stop to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
玻璃化的人还在涌现，梦回者。你早知道了对吧？也许你遇到了一些「中枢人」？他们一部分是玻璃，像是受到干扰的中枢。看来他们正要往前走，改变路线。为什么？
这是仅有的线索。我抢在税务官介入前弄到的新犯罪现场。是一列科普斯 A 级列车上的单人秀。
你知道该怎么办。分析证据，拼起来，看看它们有何关联。这是重返那片扭曲织网的唯一方法。也是揪出幕后黑手，了结此事的唯一途径。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Every day they recite that Corpus dogma. The creed of righteous greed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们每天都背诵那套科普斯教条。写的全是打着正义旗号的贪婪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Bak Vondu - fiber jockey. If I know my Corpus script, this one had serious technical chops.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 巴克·方杜——线路高手。根据科普斯资料记载，这家伙的技术水平数一数二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: No accident their hoods look like this. Built-in voice modulator does the rest. Just another robot to the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 他们的外壳设计成这样绝非偶然。内置语音调制器会处理音色。不过是科普斯的另一台机器罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Oddly personal. What's this doing without a cipher?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 很奇怪。为什么这么私人的东西，怎么连加密都没有？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Expensive stuff. Did he see it for what it was? Corpus propaganda.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 贵重的物品。他有没有看透这玩意的本质？科普斯的宣传资料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text:
Been nagging at me. The word 'legem', that Orokin word for law. I put the feelers out. My network, Little Duck's, the Quills.

Dreamer, I think I know who the Glassmaker is... or... who he was...  Nihil. Every Ceph you ever met was once a person, before they met him. He made them all. For them. For the Orokin. As a punishment that would never end.

Now that Vondu's built him that broadcaster? He's lookin' to graduate from murder to mass murder. Nihil's gonna go wide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText:
我一直不安。「律典」是奥罗金的法律。为了查明真相，我放出了风声，动用了自己、小鸭子和夜羽的情报网。

梦回者，我猜到玻璃匠是谁了，或者说，他过去是谁……无刹。每个中枢曾都是活人，是他把他们变成那样，替奥罗金，作为永无止境的惩罚。

现在，方杜为他建好信号发射器，他的计划从谋杀，升级成大屠杀。无刹要大开杀戒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Oh dear. We meet again. I really am in the middle of something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 天啊。我们又见面了。我真的被卷入了什么大事里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: I find chaos… unsettling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 我注意到了混乱……令人不安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Corpus dogma demands self-interest. Their culture is ordered by it. Vondu here... was selfless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: Corpus 的教条追求个人利益。他们的文化与此一脉相承。万杜在这……显得很无私。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Look at the chaos that spewed from that. Broken laws, black marketeering, a broken-hearted mother and a collapsed family empire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 看看由此而产生的混乱。支离破碎的法律、黑市交易、一位心碎的母亲，以及一个家族帝国的瓦解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Everyone is guilty of the good they did not do - if one only looks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 如果只看表面，每个人都是有罪的，因为他们都有未行之善 。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: And I see everything. What to do. What to do...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 而我看到了一切。怎么办。该怎么办……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Ah ah ah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 啊 啊 啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: It's best you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你最好离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Friends! Only.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 无法访问。仅限朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You're not a real child... are you. Not really. None of you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你根本不是个真正的孩子……难不成你是吗。其实。你们没有一个人是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Time to go, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 该走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Braving the inside of another's mind. Takes a toll. Not for you, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 冒险闯入别人的心灵世界。就会带来痛苦和伤害。我想这里并不适合你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: No no no. I should think not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 不，不，不。我不该这么认为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Go now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: The last person to try that now lives behind another door. In another place. Far away. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 上一个尝试这么做的人，现在已经生活在另一扇门后面了。那里是一个非常遥远的地方。永远都回不来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: You got that right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 你说到点子上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: That's the pattern. Nihil's a judge, working to a long-dead playbook, without a shred of mercy. Almost like he's a precept, instead of a person. Every society has its misfits - you and me included - but a guilty Grineer with a moral compass? Next level. Some go their whole lives and never do nothin' like that. Respect. You're close. Each time Nihil glasses, he reveals. We just gotta get ahead of him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 这就是他的行事作风。无刹是个审判者，他还在奉行失传已久的律条，不带一丝怜悯。他几乎活成了一条准则，而不是一个人。每个社会都有不合群的人，你我也在其中，但如果说是个有良知、怀有负罪感的克隆尼呢？那会成为一段佳话。有些人终其一生，也做不出这种事，这样的人值得尊敬。你离无刹更近了。无刹每次进行玻璃化时，他都会显形。我们只需要比他快一步就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Dreamers, let's put these nightmares to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 梦回者，让我们终结这些噩梦吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Bedtime, baby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 该睡觉了，宝贝儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: From on high here's the lowdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 来自高处的内部消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Sweet dreams, suckers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 做个好梦吧，混蛋们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Lemme drop somethin' on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 给你放了点空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.text: Mic drop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NWGlassmaker/D.zhText: 完美收麦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: Working hard, are we? Trying to stop progress? Grineer progress? That's my progress. Might work with Vay Hek. Vay Hek might roll over but not Tyl. Not me. Not my Tubemen. We can't have that. No. Won't have that. Kill my tubemen. I make more. And more. And more. How many of you to kill? I count one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText:
你这么卖力？是想阻碍什么？挡住 Grineer 研究的脚步？那可是我迈出的脚步！你这样对付韦·海克可能有戏。或许能唬住他，但唬不住我泰尔。也唬不住我的克隆人。我们不会让这种情况发生。不。绝对不会。

杀了我的克隆人。我还能制造更多。一波一波。无穷无尽。而你们？我只要杀一个就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: What was that? I-wait. I am receiving a message from Earth. It seems they are reporting sightings of… strange drones. You must investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 刚才那是……我——等等。我收到了来自地球的消息。报告称有人发现了……奇怪的无人机。你必须去调查一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: You will need to gather scans of them to determine their origin and capabilities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 收集它们的扫描数据，我们需要确认它们的来源和能力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: You will need a scanner to gather more detailed data. I have added one to your inventory. Equip it to your gear wheel before heading to navigation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 你需要一台扫描器来获取更详细的数据。我已经把仪器放入了你的物品栏。去往导航台之前，先把它装备到携带装备轮盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: I've marked the signatures on your map. Something is jamming the visual feed. Gather scans but approach with caution, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 我已在地图上标记了这些信号。有什么东西正在干扰视觉画面。收集扫描数据，但接近时务必小心，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: It is… it is just Old War wreckage. Why would any drones suddenly be interested in it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 这是……只是远古之战留下的残骸。那些无人机为什么会突然对它感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: Tenno, another scannable signature just appeared near you. We may be able to determine what they are up to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: Tenno，你附近又出现了可扫描信号。也许我们能借此查明它们的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: This thing is not… If you can get another scan, I can determine its origin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 这个东西不……再扫描一次确认数据吧，我就能确定它的来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.text: Equip your scanner using your gear wheel, and aim your scanner at the object. Hold down the trigger until the scan is complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NatahRework/DS.zhText: 使用你的消耗品轮盘装备扫描仪，并将其对准目标。按住开火键，直到扫描完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Reformation is accelerating. Our Condrix are nearly ready. Our rebirth is at hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 改造的进展速度越来越快。谍影登陆舰就快要准备就绪了。我们的重生即将来临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: And the Golden Spear… How many battalions?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 还有黄金长矛军……还有多少个营队？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Still having lapses? Listen to me. That's the past. The Old War. Tell her, Maker!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 还是有问题？听我说。那都是过去的事了。远古之战。告诉她，创造者

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Yes! There is no Spear, Lo-- uh… Natah. Erra speaks--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 是的！并没有金之尖矛，莲（Lotus）——呃……Natah。Erra 说话了——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: -- Master Erra. He speaks true. My... The Orokin are gone. The 'bios' are divided. In-fighting over what remains. Only the Tenno--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: ——我是说主人 Erra。他道出了真谛。我的……奥罗金已不复存在了。"七人议会"也已四分五裂。还在为争夺剩下的东西打得不可开交。只剩 Tenno 战士——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: The Tenno. The Enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: Tenno 战士。敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Yes…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 是的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Made by you… to kill us…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 你创造了他……用来杀死我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: …Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: ……是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: But you have something our people have never had before, Natah. You're stained by their wickedness. Use it! Use their sin against them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 但你手上拥有我们的人民从来没有过的东西，娜塔。他们的罪恶玷污了你。利用这一点！用他们的罪恶，去对付他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: They're listening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 他们正在听……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Let them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 让他们听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: They know we are building.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 他们知道我们正在组建军队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: It won't matter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 没什么大不了的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: No. It won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 是的，没什么大不了的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: So what are you waiting for. Sing for us, sister. Call them home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 所以，您还在等什么？为我们唱歌吧，姐姐。叫他们回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: Let. Her. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 放。她。走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: If I had a heart, it would be broken. If my eyes could weep, I'd be blind. Look at what they've made of you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 如果我有一颗心，那它已经伤透了。如果我可以流泪，那我会痛哭到失明。看看他们都对你做了什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: You're a God. You're a Queen! But somehow the bees have you as a hostage. Do you even recognize me anymore?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 你是神明！你是女皇陛下！但不知为何，这些蜜蜂却把你当成了人质。你还能认得出我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: I recognize the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 我可以认得出敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: No… sister. It's me. Erra--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 不……姐姐。是我啊。Erra——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: The Makers caught you. Unravelled your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 创造者把你抓去。蛊惑了你的思想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: They're using you to kill us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 他们在利用你来杀害我们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: 'The Queen of the Aphids' with her Eye in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: "蚜虫女王"的眼里只剩下了虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: But I don't blame you. I blame... them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 但我并不怪你，姐姐，我只怪……他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: You believe these are your children… but I am the only family you've got left! So choose! Our family, our people… or these parasites. Choose, Natah! Choose!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 你认为这些东西是你的孩子……但我才是你唯一活着的家人！所以，做出选择吧！是选择我们的家族，我们的子民……还是这些寄生虫。Natah，选择吧！选择吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: I am not… 'Natah'...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 我，不是……"Natah"……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.text: I am… THE LOTUS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarPreview/.zhText: 我叫……我的名字叫莲（Lotus）。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: It only needs a voice, a spark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 只需一声呐喊，一点星星之火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text:
[3.0]
Mother's gone.
[6.0]
This is all that remains.
[10.0]
But you have her fire. And more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText:
[3.0]
母亲走了。
[6.0]
这就是剩下的一切了。
[10.0]
但你不仅拥有她的火焰。还有更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: You can finish what she started…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 你可以完成她未竟之事……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: On Lua. The Lotus… I… attacked you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 在月球上，莲（Lotus）呃…我曾 袭击了你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: Hmm... You don't remember everything, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 嗯……看来你什么都不记得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: Yes, your aphids wounded me. And our forces were depleting fast. I knew I had failed. Failed you, my sister. Failed our family. I had no choice but to retreat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 是的，那个时候你的蚜虫们打伤了我。我们的力量正在迅速枯竭。我知道我已经失败了。我知道我辜负了你，我的姐姐，辜负了我们的家族。但我别无选择，只能撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: …You were destroyed, the Tenno made sure of that--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: ……你被消灭了，Tenno 战士确保了这一点——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: --You're still recovering. With all that the Makers did to you, it will take time to heal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 你还未痊愈，创造者曾经对你造成了如此大的伤害，你需要时间来恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.text: He is one of them, isn't he? A Maker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NewWarStageTwo.zhText: 他就是其中一员，对吗？一个创造者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: Hey, Dreamers. We are up and ready to party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 喂，梦回者。我们准备好狂欢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: Well well well. Looks like some serious crud is going down out there. Here's to you, anonymous troublemaker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 哈哈哈，看来外头有人捅了大娄子。这杯敬你，不愿透露姓名的捣蛋鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: Any y'all see the feeds light up? It's goin' down, kids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 有人看到转播灯亮起了吗？好戏要开场了，各位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: Many things have been taken from us, it's true. But Fortune favors the bold… and there ain't none so bold as people with nothin' to lose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 诚然，我们被夺走了太多东西。但幸运会眷顾勇者……而在这个世界上，没有谁能比光脚的更无所畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: You're making waves, Dreamers. I can feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 你掀起了波澜，梦回者。我能感受到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.text: From little things big things grow, Dreamers. I believe in you all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DDay.zhText: 星星之火，可以燎原。梦回者，我完全相信你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DFir.text: Nora wants to reach out to all of you and say: welcome to the family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DFir.zhText: 诺拉想对你们所有人说：欢迎加入这个大家庭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DFir.text: Well well, looks like things are kickin' off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DFir.zhText: 哇哦，看来好戏要开场了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DGoo.text: It's time for Nora to say good night.
That's all we have time for.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.text: This is Nora Night, lettin' you know she's hangin' with you now that you're over the hump and on the home stretch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.zhText: 这里是诺拉·夜。注意啦，既然你熬过了最艰难的坎，踏上了归途的最后冲刺，诺拉会一直陪在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.text: Sometimes the end never seems further than when you're halfway there, but I'm here to tell you all that you got this thing beat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.zhText: 走到半路的时候，往往会觉得终点无比遥远。不过我来这儿，就是要告诉你们：你们一定能赢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.text: We got as many miles behind us as we do before us, but Dreamers, we got this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHaf.zhText: 尽管我们身后的路和我们前方的路一样漫长，但是，梦回者，这场胜利终将属于我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: Dreamers, I have for you a tale of triumph over adversity. Of one person actin' true to their truest self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 梦回者，我这里有个逆转困境的传奇故事。它讲述了人应该如何活出最真实的自我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: Ladies. And. Gentlemen. Listeners of all ages. I present to you. Walking amongst us. The once. And future. Bad. Ass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 女士们，先生们，所有频段的听众朋友们。向大家隆重介绍，一位来自我们之中，前无古人，后无来者的，狠，角，色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: Dreamers, Dreamers, Dreamers. There. Just. Is. No. Holding. You. All. Back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 梦回者，梦回者，梦回者。没有什么，能阻止你们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: Well, well, well, if y'all ain't my favorite brand of free-range lunatic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 哎，呀，呀，你们这群人，桀骜不驯，实在对我的胃口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: When the 'why' is plain as day the 'how' tends to get done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 当「为什么」已显而易见时，「怎么办」也自然迎刃而解了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: Thanking a killer is like petting a Kubrodon, is like petting a machine-gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 向杀手道谢，就像去爱抚一只库狛顿，或摸一挺机关枪一样危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.text: To quote another: 'Virtue, integrity, and courage are my priorities. I can be approached, but never pushed; befriended but never coerced; killed but never shamed.' Here's to you, Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHar.zhText: 借用前人的一句话：「吾以德行、气节与勇武为先。可近而不可迫，可亲而不可劫，可杀而不可辱。」敬你，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.text: Some are born to greatness. Some have greatness thrust upon them. The rest of us, we just have to work at it. You all know who you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.zhText: 有些人生来就很优秀。有些人总能交上好运。而其余的人，则只能努力奋斗。你们都知道自己属于哪一类人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.text: Never doubt yourselves, Dreamers. This System's up for grabs, and we are comin' for it with both hands, yes we are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.zhText: 永远别怀疑自己，梦回者。这个星系尚未尘埃落定，而我们会用双手把它夺过来。没错，我们势在必得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.text: Ain't no stoppin' someone who knows their worth. Nora's feelin' good about the state of things tonight, yes she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DHit.zhText: 谁也挡不住一个清楚自身价值的人。诺拉感觉今晚的势头很好，没错，她很有信心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.text: Now, just in case some of you ain't doin' all this outta the kindness of your hearts...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.zhText: 好吧，如果说你们之中有人来这里是为了追求回报……
诺拉很乐意提供物质奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.text: Nora's got the goods for one lucky Dreamer. Who's it gonna be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.zhText: 诺拉为一位幸运的梦回者准备了好货。幸运儿会是谁呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.text: Who have we got on the line? Oh yeah, I don't have a line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.zhText: 是哪位听众打进了热线？哦对了，我这压根没设热线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.text: Now, y'might be wonderin' if I'm holdin' back on y'all. Hmm, Dreamers…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DOpe.zhText: 现在，你可能会想我是不是对你们有所保留。唔，梦回者……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: A little bird tells me that nasty ol' Nef Anyo's got somethin' up his sleeve for the good people of Fortuna. But I have it on good authority help is on the way. Keep the faith, people. Sunshine is just around the corner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 有只小鸟告诉我，讨厌的奈富·安尤暗地里想对福尔图娜的勤劳民众下手。不过据可靠消息，有人已经决定出手相助。大家一定要坚定信念，曙光即将到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: On this cold and lonely eve spare a thought for tractor jockeys, rail agents and lone travelers making their way. Trying to bring a little joy to people's lives, one shipment at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 在这冰冷清孤的深夜，请想一想那些依然在太空忙碌的牵引机驾驶员、航道特工、独行旅人。他们还在一趟一趟地运送货物，尽己所能为人们带来快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Nora has it on good authority that rail pirates are hungry after a cold weekend, sweet thing. Check your mags and keep the gas tanks full.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 据可靠消息，在熬过了一个寒冷的周末后，航道海盗们已饥渴难耐。亲爱的，检查一下你的弹匣，把燃料箱装满吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Well, it's a lazy night between the stars for you and me, while out there the System is still on fire. Grineer on Corpus, Corpus on Infested - and in between the little people like you and me, well, we're just tryin' not to get stepped on. Here's to us, Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 嗯，对你我来说，今晚是个慵懒平淡的夜晚，但实际上星系内依然战火四起。克隆尼忙着对付科普斯，科普斯则忙着对付感染者。而夹在中间的，像你我这样的小人物，呵，我们只能尽量别被波及。干一杯吧，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: We're out of the night and into the dawn. Still hangin' on in a System on fire, thanks to the good work of people like the Tenno. That's a thank-you, from Nora to you. Wherever you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 夜幕退散，黎明将至。在这个战火纷飞的星系中，多亏了像 Tenno 那样肯出力的人，我们才得以苟延残喘。这是诺拉向你们致以的谢意，无论你身在何处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Ah, Nef Anyo ain't best pleased by the actions of some of our friends. Keep your heads down, Solaris United, and steer clear of Officer Friendly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 奈富·安尤似乎对我们某些朋友的举动有点不满。避一避风头吧，索拉里斯联盟，此外，记得离那位「友的长官」远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Dreamers, it's on these long and quiet nights I ask myself: How could I do more and do it better? And then something I read a long time ago whispers in my ear: "All human activities are equivalent and all are on principle doomed to failure. Thus it amounts to the same thing whether one gets drunk alone or is a leader of nations." And, Dreamers, I pour myself a drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 梦回者，在这种漫长寂静的夜里，我总扪心自问：我该如何才能做得更多更好？这时，我很久以前读过的一句话在我耳畔低语：「所有人类活动本质上都是等效的，其原则都是注定要失败的。因而，一个人独自买醉，还是当国家领袖，归根结底都是一回事。」梦回者啊，说到这里，我就得给自己倒上一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Do you feel the next world press close, on these late nights, Dreamers? Nora does. She feels the presence of those she lost, the great and the good. Gods and ghosts. We are watched - bet on it - by those who dwell in the direction we cannot point to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 在这深夜里，你是否感觉到彼岸的世界正在迫近，梦回者？诺拉感觉到了。我感受到了那些已逝之人的存在，那些伟大的、善良的灵魂，包括神明与幽灵。我敢打赌，我们正被注视着，被那些徘徊在不知名维度的存在注视着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Flattery flattery charges my battery. Some people ask where they can send me gifts. Some want to take me out to dinner. One lonesome ol' rail agent even asked Nora to marry him. Nora ain't the marryin' kind, but thank you. Was in love once. With a man. Face of an angel, morals of a chainsaw. We all have a type, don't we? Against which we must be forever on guard. But damn he looked good in a suit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 向我献殷勤，带来好心情。有人想知道怎样才能给我送礼物。有人想请我吃晚餐。还有一位单身的老航道特工甚至向诺拉求婚。谢谢你的好意，可惜诺拉不是那种成家过日子的类型。我以前坠入过爱河，爱上了一个男人。他有着天使般的面容，毫无底线的道德观。我们都有抵抗不了的理想型，不是吗？哪怕理智告诉我们要时刻提防。但他穿西装的样子实在是太他妈帅了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Grineer galleons kickin' up dust all the way from Venus to Pluto. Watch your backs, people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 从金星到冥王星，克隆尼的舰队在这一路上惹是生非。大家要注意身后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Nora has it on good authority that the enterprising Corpus are clearing ice out of newly-discovered tunnels. For what purpose she wonders?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 据可靠消息，那些野心勃勃的科普斯正忙着给新发现的隧道除冰。诺拉有些好奇，他们究竟有何目的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Well, it's early where Nora is and, as she wipes the sleep from her eyes, she wonders… does the Unum ever leave that Tower? Can she leave that Tower? Who is she? What is she? Someone in Cetus must have answers. Come on, sweet things. Give it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 嗯，诺拉这里的时间还很早。揉开朦胧的睡眼之后，我开始思考一些问题……乌努母神到底有没有离开过那座高塔？她能够离开那座塔吗？她究竟是谁？或者说她究竟是什么存在？希图斯里肯定有人知道答案。得了，亲爱的，赶紧爆点料吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Somethin's out there, Dreamers. Nora can feel it. Pullin' at her waters like the moon pulls the tides. Something big, an' somethin' old. It knows us. What will it say, I wonder, the day it steps up to our door and knocks?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 外面有某种东西，梦回者。诺拉能感觉得到。它就像月亮牵引着潮汐一样，牵扯着我的心绪。那是某种巨大且古老的东西。它知道我们的存在。等它哪天找上门来，敲响大门之时，它究竟会说些什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Now, I hear remarked that Nef's obelisk is lit up for another of the big man's showcases, parties, soirees, whatever. On the invite list is anybody who is anybody and nobody who is nobody. Even Nora Night didn't get an invite. Shame on you, Nef Anyo, for I am delightful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 最近，我听说奈富的天碑战舰灯火通明，那里似乎在为某个大人物举办展览、派对或是聚会什么的。受邀的全是些有头有脸的大人物，无名小卒显然连边都沾不上。就连诺拉·夜都没有收到请柬。这是你的损失，奈富·安尤，因为我可是活跃气氛的好手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: People ask me if it gets lonely out here. I say, lonely? Naw. I got all the company I need. I got you, sweet-things. Ain't nothin' for Nora in the real world, 'cept trouble. Trouble, and a few yahoos she could box for a century without a tea break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 有人问我待在这儿会不会觉得孤独。孤独？没那回事。我已经得到了我需要的所有陪伴。我有你们啊，亲爱的。现实世界里没有诺拉想要的东西，麻烦除外。有了麻烦，外加几个莽汉，就可以让诺拉把他们连续猛揍一个世纪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Nora tries, Dreamers. You know she does. But I swear, sometimes you be standin' there, soaked to the skin, and some idiot wants to talk about the weather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 诺拉尽力了，梦回者。你们都知道。只是有的时候，你站在外面，淋得像个落汤鸡，居然还有蠢货想跟你搭讪聊这鬼天气，这我实在忍不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.text: Well, bad news foodies: the Corpus are scrapping plans to bioengineer food from hazardous waste. Diners reported everything tasted like virmink... then exploded. Back to the lab, you crazy kids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRad.zhText: 唉，吃货们，有个坏消息：科普斯准备废除利用生物改造技术将危险废料转换为食物的计划。吃过的人都说味道很像是弗鸣克……然后他们都爆炸了。滚回实验室多研究研究吧，你们这些疯狂的毛头小子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.text: Does your backbrain feel that reptile tickle of reward? Do you see that bobbing light ahead, floating through the marsh of what is to come, promising you more and more and more? Do follow, Dreamers, into that sweet black tomorrow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.zhText: 你的脑海深处，是否感受到那股对奖励的原始渴望？你看到前方那盏在未来的沼泽地中隐现的明灯了吗？它正向你许诺着更多、无穷无尽的宝藏。跟着那道光吧，梦回者，迈进那甜美而漆黑的明日如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.text: Life is a cornucopia, friends. A movable feast. An act of guts and trust. Take it when and where you find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.zhText: 人生是一只丰裕之角，朋友们。是一场流动的飨宴，是一次胆量与信任的冒险。无论何时何地找到了它，请收入囊中吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.text: If there's one thing I've learned, Dreamers, it's this: just when you think you've had it all, seen it all, done it all… there's always more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.zhText: 如果说我学到了什么，梦回者，那就是：你以为自己拥有了一切，看透了一切，做完了一切时……精彩才刚刚开始。
幸运总是眷顾勇者，亲爱的。
干一行爱一行吧，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.text: You got that covered like the mornin' dew, sunshine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRan.zhText: 你这活儿干得滴水不漏啊，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 继续做真实的自己，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.text: Nora sleeps better knowin' her Dreamers are out there, workin' to lift us up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 得知梦回者在外为我们拼搏后，诺拉就能睡得更安稳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.text: I make exceptions for the exceptional.
With the impossible behind you, all that remains is what is necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 把「不可能」抛诸脑后，剩下的就是「势在必行」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.text: Lay 'em low and burn their shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 击垮它们，把影子也烧个干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.text: The steady blade in certain hands extracts a tithe of blood and pain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 好刀落在对的人手里，就会收取鲜血与痛苦作为代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.text: Flash and bite, the day is won not with a strike to the heart but a hundred cuts about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DRec.zhText: 刀光乍现，锋芒毕露。今天的胜利靠的不是一击穿心，而是千刀万刮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DUiI.text: Greed. Brutality. Oppression. True stories, all, and the System is full of them. Dreamers? You listening? The System needs you performing your good deeds for the day. Nora needs it. Needs you to act. To change things. Hear the news, Dreamers. Hear it, or be it. Your call. Because in Nora's System, no good act goes unrewarded. This is Nora Night. You're listening to Nightwave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DUiI.zhText: 贪婪、残暴、压迫，这些都是真实的故事，整个星系比比皆是。梦回者？你们在听吗？今天始源星系需要你们日行一善。诺拉需要你，需要你们去付诸行动，去扭转乾坤。听听真相吧，梦回者。做个旁听者，还是成为新闻的主角，全凭自己。因为在诺拉的星系法则里，任何善行都不会被辜负。这里是诺拉·夜。你正在收听的是午夜电波。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: Things seem tough, Nora knows, but believe: though it's going outta style there are people workin' to make this System a better place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 情况似乎有些棘手，诺拉明白这一点，不过请相信：虽然状况不乐观，但总有人在默默努力，只为让星系变得更美好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: Get comfy, Dreamers; one of our own believes they are the equal of our foe and, baby, they are actin' like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 放松点儿，梦回者。我们中有人相信自己与敌人不相上下，而且宝贝儿，他们已经在用行动证明了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: Word's comin' in of so many of you bein' your best selves. Nora is just beside herself with admiration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 从我收到的消息来看，你们很多人都发挥得相当出色。对此，诺拉简直对你们佩服得五体投地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: The path to greatness is walked one step at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 通往伟大之路，需要一步一个脚印地走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: Love folks who love what they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 就喜欢那些热爱自己事业的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: You wanna hit those high notes, you gotta mean it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 你想飙高音，就得拿出真本事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: You know what they say: the road to good intentions be paved with Hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 俗话说得好：通往地狱的道路，往往由善意铺就。
管用的话，就放手去做吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.text: Style, baby, it's all about knowin' who you are and not givin' a damn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWee.zhText: 所谓格调，宝贝儿，就是认清自己，然后不在乎别人怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Passing by that Mercury Junction… shimmering hot, tonight. Word on the grid is the devil's got his due… Should have known.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 正经过水星接合点，看来会是个闪耀炽热的夜晚。通讯网络中流传，那个恶魔终于遭了报应……算是意料之中吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: We saw the signs, didn't we? Sure. The Wolf got tough… tougher. But more than that, the Wolf got smart. Got a pack together. Worked the Corpus crypto. He's his own man now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 我们都看到了征兆，不是吗？恶狼变强了……前所未有地强。但更重要的是，恶狼变聪明了，他召集了狼群，还破解了科普斯的加密系统。他现在不再受人摆布了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Leavin' no more tracks. Is this the end? Dreamers, I hope so… but if I were you, I'd keep an ear out… 'cause one of these days you just might hear that howl come round your shoulder…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 他没再留下痕迹。这就结束了吗？梦回者，但愿如此，但我要是你的话，就会保持警觉……因为或许哪天，你会听到那狼嚎从你身后逼近……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: This is Nora Night, signing off. Stay deadly, Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 这里是诺拉·夜，即将下线。保持锋芒，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: The message read: GHARN IS YOURS. An anonymous gift. I know what this looks like. But the Wolf's too cold for revenge. The Grineer appoint Wardens for life. The Wolf had no choice but to shorten the term. Not payback, just 'never again.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 留言的内容是：加恩是你的了。一份匿名大礼。虽然这种发展很像是老套路。但是恶狼对复仇不感兴趣。克隆尼的典狱长职务是终身制的。恶狼能做的只有亲手缩短他的任期。这不是什么血债血偿，仅仅是「一劳永逸」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: But it was too easy. Days like these, an easy meal means you're taking someone's bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 但那样太容易了。这世道，天上掉下的馅饼只能是别人设下的圈套。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Alad V's. The devil in a Corpus cloak. Got the Wolf in an all-new prison, baby. Only this one's not made of bars, it's made of chemicals… hmmm… guess we all know someone like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 这正是阿拉德 V 设下的圈套。一个披着科普斯外衣的恶魔。他把恶狼关进了全新的牢笼，宝贝儿。只不过它不是由栅栏铸成的，而是由化学药剂……嗯……你懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: The whole lot has been transformed into these 'Amalgam Dogs'... his words. Hybridized, juiced on some Sentient strain. No nice way to put it, I think the pack is coming after you, Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 所有的囚犯都被改造成了「并合犬」……这是他的原话。那些怪物经由合成产生，注入了某种 Sentient 毒株。说句难听的，我觉得狼群正冲着你来了，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: It's a bad moon, Dreamers. Can you feel it? From my perch, at Nightwave I listen at the windows of the wealthy and well-to-do. Ever heard of Saturn Six? News to me too. Turns out the Grineer have a Max-Pen floating some six leagues deep in the gas. No one knew about it… 'cause no one ever busted out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 凶月当空，梦回者。你能感受到吗？我在午夜电波的高枝上，倾听着那些达官显贵窗边的风声。听说过土星六号吗？那对我来说也是新鲜事。原来克隆尼在气层数十公里深处，藏着一座最高戒备的漂浮监狱。无人知晓它的存在……因为从来没人能活着逃出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Until now, right? Some Grineer meathead they started calling 'The Wolf'. On account of him taking up howlin' at night. Decrypts say he was a model prisoner, doing the time. Fabbin' bombs with the rest of his con brothers. Apple of the Warden's eye even.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 之前都没听过，对吧？有个叫做「恶狼」的克隆尼傻瓜，据说他总是在夜里嚎叫，所以才有了这个绰号。破译的情报里还提到他是个模范囚犯，正在老老实实地服刑。和他的狱友弟兄们一起造炸弹，甚至还是典狱长眼前的红人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: But something cracked, and now he's out there on the loose… the so-called Wolf of Saturn Six.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 但他脑子里突然崩断了某根弦，现在他逃出生天了……他被称为「土星六号的恶狼」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: An ice-night in Neptune, Dreamers. Hold yours close and true, and hey… if you're between stops… Nora knows that mood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 海王星上冷若冰霜的夜，梦回者。牢牢抱紧你的梦，记住它。还有就是……你要是正漂泊在旅途中……诺拉完全明白那种心情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: But our Wolf… he's not alone tonight. Add this with me: The howler breaks out of Saturn Six. But get this… the howling doesn't stop… someone else takes to singing that cruel song. The Wolf knows why, and it called him back to the scene of the crime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 但我们的这头恶狼……他今晚不是孤身一人。想象一下：嚎叫者从土星六号成功越狱。不过，你要明白……狼嚎声并没有就此平息……有人会继续高唱那残酷的歌。恶狼知道这其中缘由，而那声音也会把他拉回到案发现场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Warden Gharn's little side business. Sellin' Grineer lemons for a Corpus squeeze. So freedom's got no hold on the Wolf, does it? No. It's the sisters and brothers from the joint that matter to him… The pack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 典狱长加恩有个小小的副业，把残次的克隆尼克隆体贩卖给科普斯获利。所以，自由根本拴不住这头狼，不是吗？拴不住。他在乎的，是牢房里的那些兄弟姐妹……他的狼群。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: We both know what happens next… when a Wolf finds its pack… they hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 我们都知道接下来会发生什么，一头恶狼找回了他的狼群后……它们就会开始狩猎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: It's late. You still with me, Dreamers? Soon we'll see the sun curve over the Venusian sky. A hot blue taste. What's keeping you up? For me, it's the gap-waves, all abuzz with the doings of a certain, big, bad, Wolf. Why didn't he run? Why didn't he hit that Solar Rail as far as it would take him?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 夜深了。你们还在听吗，梦回者？很快我们就能看到太阳勾勒出金星的天空了，那是一抹灼热的幽蓝。是什么让你夜不能寐？对我来说，是漂浮在星空中的电波，里面全都在议论某头凶神恶煞的大「恶狼」。他为什么不跑？为什么不直接搭上星际航道，逃得远远的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: Instead, he's stalking those soul-bare, money-huggers 'round Jupiter. My birds are sayin' the Corpus net got flipped. A system-wide message from the Wolf. DELIVER GHARN. Where'd a meathead learn a trick like that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 相反，他竟然潜伏在木星附近，盯着那群灵魂空虚的守财奴。我的线人告诉我，科普斯的通讯网已经被掀了个底朝天。恶狼向系统全域发出了广播：「交出加恩。」那个蠢货到底是从哪里学到了这种招数？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.text: And who's Gharn? Baby, you can guess… he's the Warden of Saturn Six! A big man, too well dressed for his station, too well fed for his rank. And he's in the solar wind too… think he knows how the Wolf came to howlin'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Nightwave/DWol.zhText: 那么这个加恩又是谁呢？宝贝儿，你肯定猜得到……他就是土星六号的典狱长！一个大人物，衣服穿得太华丽，完全不合他的职位；油水捞得太足，完全不配他的军衔。而且现在他行踪不明……你觉得他知道恶狼为何会对他嚎叫吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: Hey there, Dreamers. The Devil is home and the shades are up. That's right… it's just you and me, passin' each other slow and with a nod sayin' all that needs sayin'. I'm Nora Night, sayin'... you live with wolves you better act like one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 你好呀，梦回者。魔鬼回了家，窗帘也拉开了。没错……只有我们俩，缓缓擦肩，默契点头，一切尽在不言中。我是诺拉·夜，我想说……与狼为伍，那最好就亮出你的狼性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: Nora here. The Red King is at the dance. But listen… as you drift between the stars Nora wants you to know you ain't alone. Mm-mm. We're all of us a kinda family out here, ain't we? All of us. The multitudes. Driftin' and listenin'. But you need to remember: it never troubles the wolf how many the sheep may be. It never. Troubles. The Wolf.
