/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 我是诺拉。赤色之王已经登场。但是听好了……你在群星间漂流时，诺拉想让你知道你并不是孤身一人。嗯哼，我们在这儿都算是一家人，不是吗？宇宙中的所有人，浩瀚的芸芸众生。一边漂流，一边聆听。但是，有一点你一定要记住：狼从来不在乎羊有多少。狼，从不，在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: A voice in the night, a half-remembered dream, rising to the surface of your consciousness, from backbrain to forebrain, a sound to a vision, pullin' up and... knockity-knock. Hello, Dreamers. Let's get to know one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 黑夜中的一个声音，一场半梦半醒的幻境，就这么浮上你的意识水面，从后脑涌向前额，化声为影，不断上浮然后……咚咚，敲门啦。你好，梦回者。我们好好认识一下彼此吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: To all off you driftin' out there in the black, mark the frequency. The time has come to act together. To open our eyes and gaze with utmost clarity past the present and into a future we create. Shoulder-to-shoulder. Mark the frequency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 所有在黑暗中挣扎漂泊的灵魂，记住这个频率。睁开双眼，让目光清晰地穿透眼前的迷雾，望向那个由我们亲手开创的未来。肩并着肩，携手共进。锁定我的频道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: An echo. From long ago: 'For ten years I have been polishing this sword. Its frosty edge has never been put to the test. Now, I am holding it and showing it to you, sir: Is there anyone suffering from injustice?' Keep livin', Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 有一道来自遥远过去的回响：十年磨一剑，霜刃未曾试。今日把示君——谁有不平事？好好活下去，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: It can be tough as a kid. All sorts of people have it over you. People will kill you inside; kill you and forget your name. You grow up. They grow old. You remember. They don't. They just keep doing what they've always done. Only to someone else. Then, one day, they call you friend. And you wait. And you wait. You wait 'til they can't trust you any more than they do. And then you ask them if they enjoyed their dinner. And, looking into their panicked eyes as they gasp their last, you tell them your name. And you nod. "Yeah," your eyes say to theirs. "That was me." And then you leave. And the System is a better place. Be smart, Dreamers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 做个孩子可不容易，各种人都会骑在你头上。有些人会抹杀你的灵魂，然后抹杀你，抹去你的名字。接着你长大了，他们变老了。你仍记得往事，他们却忘了。他们只会换个目标，继续作恶。直到有一天，他们突然套近乎称你为朋友。而你接着等，等了又等，等到他们对你毫无防备。然后你走上前去，问他们这顿最后的晚餐可还合胃口。在他们咽下最后一口气、眼神惊恐散大时，你报上自己的名字。然后你点点头，用眼神告诉他们：「没错，就是我干的。」接着你转身离去。始源星系就此变得更加美好。放聪明点，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: In a world like this, it can be hard to have hope, when the man owns the system and the system serves to save the man, from us. But I'm here, Dreamers. To help you pierce that false fog. We'll chase it away with acts of beauty and, succeed or fail, face the foe eyes open. As someone once said: If nothing saves us from death, may love at least save us from life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 在这样的世界里，抱有希望确实很难。尤其是当权贵掌控着星系体制，而体制的存在只为帮权贵防范着我们。但有我在，梦回者。我会帮你们撕开那层虚伪的迷雾。我们会体体面面地让它消失。无论成败，我们都要睁大双眼直面宿敌。正如一句老话所说：如果没有什么能让我们免于死亡，至少爱可以让我们免于生活之苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.text: Acts of defiance, acts of generosity, acts of sacrifice... this is how we turn this system 'round. I'll take you there, Dreamers. I'll bring you back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveIsCom.zhText: 反抗之举，慷慨之行，还有牺牲之志……这正是我们扭转星系命运的力量。我会指引你们，梦回者。也会带你们平安归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: It's a bad cycle, Dreamers. Arlo's devoted had a party, and you're on cleanup detail. Derelicts are threatening every settlement from Mercury to Eris, and my sources say you're uniquely qualified to contain them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这是个恶性循环，梦回者。亚罗那些信徒留下的烂摊子要你来收拾。从水星到阋神星，遗迹飞船正威胁着每个定居点。我的线人说这事只有你能搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Meanwhile, I've been thinking. Not about Kenga, but about what he actually found down there. Arlo, whatever he was. Some kind of lure? An evolution to bait us in? Is there more to this Infestation than fangs and acid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 与此同时，我一直在想。想的不是肯加，而是他在那底下到底发现了什么。亚罗，他到底是什么。是某种诱饵？还是某种引我们过去的进化体？难道感染者身上，不只有獠牙和酸液这么简单？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: I know what my mother would say. The people saw what they wanted, heard what they hoped… and human nature did the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我知道，我的母亲会说：「人们只看自己想看的，只听自己想听的……而剩下的，人性自会补全。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Still. I'm hearing rumors. The mass on Eris is in turmoil and nobody, but nobody wants to check it out. It's seething. And if it's not thinking about this whole ordeal, baby, it's feeling it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 不过我还是听到了风声。阋神星上的那个异变体正在蠢蠢欲动，偏偏谁都不想去查明状况。它即将爆发，就算它现在还没脑子思考，宝贝儿，它也绝对感受得到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: This is Nora Night, saying for now… Dreamers… so long and hold on! And listen… Should you ever happen upon some vacant-eyed little kid someday… whatever you do, don't take 'em home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这里是诺拉·夜，今晚先说到这儿……梦回者……保重，坚持住！还有，如果有某天你遇到眼神空洞的小孩……无论如何，都别把他带回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Y'all did see this coming, right, Dreamers? Surely did… but not like this…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你们早就料到有这一天，对不对，梦回者？话虽如此，只是没料到会成这样……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: A grand gathering before the Emissary and his speaker. Standing room only. Bodies pressed to bodies, a great, overheated mass breathing as one. Waiting for their beloved healer-mute to speak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 密密麻麻的人群，聚集在使徒和他的发言人面前。座无虚席，只能站着。挤成人山人海，如同一团巨大而燥热的共生体。他们等待着那位万众敬仰却又无法说话的治疗者开口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Kenga hushed the crowd. He shed his mask and… there he was. Laughing at them. Sick as the day he was banished. More. His retribution was at hand, borne of a virus spreading further and faster than spore and space ever could have. Arlo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 肯加让喧闹的人群安静了下来。他摘下面具，然后……他就站在那里，对着所有人笑。他病得和当年被驱逐时一模一样，甚至更重。他的复仇已经近在眼前了。一种史无前例的、比孢子的传播性更强的病毒即将诞生。那就是，亚罗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: And in that stunned silence, Arlo himself made a sound! Not a word, but a stifled gag. A swollen choke, as he opened his mouth. And there it was. Pointed, black, a tongue… but not… snaking and bulging and splitting him apart…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 在那令人窒息的死寂中，亚罗本人发出了声音！并非话语，而是一阵压抑的干呕。他张开嘴时，喉咙肿了起来。随之出现的，是一条尖尖的，黑色的东西，一条舌头……又不像舌头……它不断扭动、膨胀，最终将他的身体撑开……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: I looked away then, I had to. But that sound stays with me. Not the sound of human terror, bad as it was, but what came after… The grinding wet, the rattling flutter… the congregation converted in the truest sense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 之后，我移开了目光，我别无选择。但那声音一直挥之不去。我说的不是人们的惊慌尖叫声，尽管那也够吓人的，而是那之后出现的……湿腻腻的摩擦声，嘎吱吱的颤动声。那群信徒们都迎来了真正意义上的「同化」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: I… Dreamers… you all got your work cut out for you. Though this 'movement' has lost its head, the body still lingers…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我……梦回者……接下来你们可有的忙了。虽然这场「运动」没了首脑，但躯体仍在苟延残喘……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Dreamers, you know 'bout the Infestation, right? Spreads like a month-old salad with genocidal intent. Swallows everything it touches… makin' monsters from meat or metal or both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 梦回者，知道感染者吧？蔓延起来像一份放了一个月的沙拉，怀着种族灭绝的意图，吞噬一切触及之物……把血肉、金属，或两者的结合体，变成怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Well, these days it's mostly contained. Spores as old as stone. Derelicts drifting in forgotten orbits…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 不过现在，基本控制住了。那些孢子已经变成了化石。而遗迹飞船在被遗忘的轨道上漫无目的地漂流……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: So it was with old Kenga. Somehow exposed and promptly cast out. Woke up on a blessed cage-drop down to Eris.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 那个老肯加也不例外。在被感染之后，他马上就遭到了放逐。他的牢笼最终被丢弃在了阋神星上，而他也在那儿醒了过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: But should some sad soul catch the grey-vein, well… every culture has its plague dogma.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 那些染上灰脉症的人都很可怜，唉……每个文明都需要面对瘟疫带来的难题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: But maybe there's something more to this 'Infestation'… something we all missed. Turns out... Kenga didn't find Void in that hell-nest, no. He found…  a survivor!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 不过，感觉这种「感染」有些不同寻常，我们好像错过了一些细节。结果……肯加没有在那个人间炼狱里魂归虚空，相反，他找到了……一位幸存者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Little boy. Arlo. Died three years ago, yet there he was. Lost his voice but gained his life… and somehow… saved old Kenga with the slightest. Touch. Of his slender hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这位名叫亚罗的小男孩，本该在三年前就已经死去，可如今却依然健在。尽管失去了自己的声音，但他却捡回了一条命……而且，不知怎的……他只是用纤弱的手触碰了一下，就治好了肯加。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Whether you're 'bad news first' or 'bad news last' tonight I got you covered cos bad news is all we got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 无论你习惯「先听坏消息」还是「后听坏消息」，我今晚都包你满意。因为我们这里只有坏消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: This Emissary's word is spreading fast. A hot fever. Some are going to extremes to prove their devotion. Trying the spores for themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这位使徒的布道传播得很快，并掀起了一场狂热。有些人想通过极端的方式来证明自己的虔诚。他们要亲身去试试那些孢子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: And they're finding it too. Some lunatic spikers jacked the Solar-Nav and flagged the Derelict zones for all to see. Old haulers and new hopefuls out there are proving just how smart most people aren't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 而且他们还真找着了。某些疯狂的激进黑客劫持了星系导航系统，并将那些遗迹飞船所在区域全盘标注了出来。外头那些老手和新秀，正用行动向我们证明，大多数人到底能有多蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Yet Kenga's ranks are growing. Arming themselves - for the safety and security of our Emissary. Setting the stage for a great assembly to come. Buzz is... buzz is... Arlo will break his silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 另一方面，肯加的追随者队伍仍在不断壮大。他们武装了起来——为了保障那位使徒的安全。同时也为即将到来的宏大集会搭建舞台。据说，据说……亚罗将打破自己的沉默。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: 'Til then, Dreamers, check under the bed. A fresh brood is sprouting up along the Rails. And it seems they have the scent of those blessed by the Emissary's touch…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 在那之前，梦回者，记得检查一下床底。一股新生势力已经开始在航道上发展壮大。而他们的身上，似乎携带着那位使徒的恩惠之触所留下的气息……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: My mother was a cynical woman. Smart as she was cruel. Nora, she said, no disease spreads faster or further than the ones in our head. She was talkin' about ideas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我的母亲是个愤世嫉俗的女人。她既聪明又冷酷。她曾对我说道，「诺拉，这世上传播性最强的疾病，其实来自于我们的大脑。」她指的，就是思想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Mine was that old Kenga and his wonder boy would've been splayed out in some bio-trader's lab by now. Or blood-studies for the Grineer Command. Dreamers, I was wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我曾以为，那个老肯加和他的奇迹男孩，肯定会沦为某个生化商人实验室的样本，或是被克隆尼指挥部拿去做血液研究。但是我错了，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Kenga's grey-vein was just the beginning. White lung, parasitic liver, clone rot… even bone spurs… Turns out this kid, Arlo, is a healer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 治好肯加的灰脉症不过是个开始。白肺，寄生肝，克隆组织溃烂……就连骨刺也都被治愈了。原来亚罗这个孩子，其实是个治疗者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: So many questions… an idea like that is like a flare dropped in vol-gas. Now the sick and curious are flocking the Rails to see this 'Emissary of Eris'. And who speaks for Arlo the mute? Why old Kenga, of course. No more the outcast, it is he who is spreading the word of Arlo's gift. Even you, Dreamers, may soon hear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 疑问层出不穷……传闻一出，如同丢入易爆气体中的照明弹。现在，病患和猎奇者都涌向航道，只为一睹「阋神星使徒」的真容。但谁能替哑巴亚罗说话呢？自然是老肯加了。自此，他不再是被放逐的弃子，而是宣扬亚罗神迹的传道士。就连你们这些梦回者，也会很快听到风声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: For all the universe's complexity, there is only one plot: Things Are Not What They Seem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 尽管整个宇宙错综复杂，但它总遵循着一个套路：表象不等于事实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Anyone else pickin' up weird signal-shapes floatin' in the clouds just off Gas City? Nora's keen to hear from any listeners with info.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 有人收到了散布在集气城市周围云层内的诡异信号吗？希望各位知情者能向诺拉提供相关线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Seems like every last Corpus who signed on to Alad V's project in the clouds have yet to be heard from. That's what I call a cast-iron non-disclosure agreement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 阿拉德 V 的计划就藏在那云雾之中，而所有参与的科普斯似乎都失去了音讯。这绝对算得上是铁打的保密协议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: The Emissary knows you... all... that you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 使徒知晓你……以及……你的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: You condemn our appetites... yet fail...  to retreat... from your own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你谴责我们的欲望……然而却无法……挣脱你自己的欲望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Primordial recollections… lifeforms chiropteran… annihilating darkness…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 原始的回忆……翼手目的生物……毁灭般的黑暗……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Bastions, be generous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 护卫们，请慷慨一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Nourish me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 给我滋养。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Bastions… give… to me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 护卫们……把它……给……我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: I… live… again...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我……又……活过来了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Come to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 到我这里来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: This... is but a breath... before... the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这……不过是呼吸……之前……下一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Protect Arlo's flame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 保护亚罗的火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Arlo's flame protects us… and us it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 亚罗的火焰保护我们……我们也保护它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: They must not steal our light...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 绝不会让他们偷走我们的光……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: You have not earned his gift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你还没获得他的恩赐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Imposter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 这个冒牌货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: His light is not for you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 他的光不是给你准备的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Darkness for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你只能得到黑暗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: What you stole… I retrieve…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我会取回你偷走的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: You... are beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你……非常美丽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Bastions! Protect... the congregation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 护卫们！快去保护教会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: We shall wash the self out of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我们将会抹除掉你自己的意识。呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: You think yourself... subtracting. You... are dividing. We... mul-tee-ply.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你以为自己……在不断减少。其实你……在不断分裂。我们……不断增加。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Paradise... comes for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 天堂为你而来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Your strength... valuable. Your... self. Worthless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 你的力量……很宝贵。但……你自己。毫无价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: We welcome... the myriad you shall become.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 在此恭迎……您将成为万象之躯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: A thousand hands wait... to embrace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 有一千只手在等待着拥抱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Welcome... You are welcome...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 欢迎……热烈欢迎……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: From Eris... we come...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 我们……来自阋神星……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.text: Arlo is with us... our touch... is his word...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NightwaveSeaso.zhText: 亚罗和我们一起……我们接触……是他的意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No one can truly control this complex blend of art and commerce.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有人能真正掌控艺术与商业的复杂融合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm givin' it my all, but if that ain't enough, I'll dig deeper and do even more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我正在全力以赴，但如果这还不够，我还会挖得更深，做得更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Motivation's a rollercoaster, dude. Always up and down. Can't depend on that if you wanna win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 兄弟，动力就像过山车一样，总是忽上忽下。如果你想赢，就不能依赖动力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I just wanna be seen as, like, professional, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我只是想让别人觉得我很专业，知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Not even screaming fans give me a rush anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 现在连尖叫的粉丝都不再让我兴奋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Numbers only get you so far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 光有数字是远远不够的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, it gets tough sometimes, but seein' the fans out there? That's what makes it all worth it, every single time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是的，有时会很辛苦，但看到外面的粉丝们？一切都是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Anyone in the biz who tells you they got nothing to prove is full of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这个行业里如果有人告诉你他们无需证明什么，那他一定是在说谎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: This is a decent hop-and-bop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这是一首不错的跳跳舞曲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Is this really who I wanna be? This? Is this all I've got?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这真的是我想要成为的自己吗？就这？这就是我所拥有的一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I probably need a break, but honestly? I don't want one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我可能需要休息一下，但说实话，我不想休息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Everyone leaves a piece of their soul in their work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 每个人都会在作品中留下一部分自己的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Me? Cry? Never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我？会哭？绝对不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My focus is seriously all over the place sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的注意力有时候真的很分散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All these fans, and I feel totally alone. The hell is wrong with me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这么多粉丝，我却感到孤独。我到底是怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nothing's ever disappointed me as much as celebrity culture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有什么能像名流文化这样让我如此失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I still believe we can do anything. Just gotta keep grindin', keep pushin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我依然相信我们无所不能。只要继续努力，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: When you take a loss, you shake it off, get back up, and come back stronger. Simple as that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当你面对损失时，你要摆脱它，重新站起来，变得更强大。就这么简单！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Spent my first paycheck on so much candy. Worth the stomachache!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我用第一份薪水买了好多糖果。肚子痛也值得！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I don't know, something is totally off… Think I just need to sleep. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我不知道，总感觉有些不对劲……我想我只是需要睡一觉。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If you're totally wiped out, it's cool to take a breather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你精疲力竭，那就休息一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Life's too short to trip on the small stuff, but man, it's hard not to sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 人生苦短，不能因小失大，但哥们，有时也很难做到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Aw babe, I hate seeing you like this. C'mon, can't we figure this out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 噢，宝贝，我讨厌看到你这样。拜托，我们不能解决这个问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Insert disc two.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 插入光盘 2。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, I'm so burnt out...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，我真的很累……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I like to think I've never made a bad song, but that's probably not true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我喜欢认为自己从未创作过一首糟糕的歌曲，但事实可能并非如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If I can inspire even one kid, then all this pain is worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果我能激励哪怕一个孩子，那么所有的痛苦都是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If there's something to gain, I'm gonna fight. And win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 只要有所得，我就会战斗，并且取得胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Change is kinda weird at first, but worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 改变一开始有点奇怪，但值得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All these back-to-back shows... I'm so tired I can barely see straight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这些连场演出……累得我几乎看不清东西了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Stadium vulnerable. Tool up. Crash the party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 体育馆易受攻击。装备武器。突袭派对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Systems recovering. Doors open. It is showtime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 系统正在恢复。门打开了。表演时间到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Crew. Their security is weakened. Bum-rush the show.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 舰员。他们的安保力量被削弱了。破坏演出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Offensive broadcast: incoming. This Railjack is compromised. Cannon offline. Take the towers down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 侦测到在途进攻。航道星舰已被攻入。火炮系统离线。摧毁感染囊巢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Crew. Unsolicited cacophony detected. Systems protesting. Put a boot through the speaker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 船员。检测到未经允许的杂音。系统抗议。摧毁那个扬声器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Systems function: suspended. Hold music: incoming. Crew. Shut it off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 系统功能：暂停。干扰噪音：来袭。船员，关掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If all your artists are giving you trouble, maybe the problem isn't with them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你旗下的所有艺人们给你添麻烦，也许问题并不在他们身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, Packet gets all of us feelin' protective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是啊，数据使者让我们所有人都有一种必须保护他的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What can I say? We missed you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我能说什么呢？我们想你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Harddrive punched a guy once for making fun of me. It was awesome! Wait, can I say that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 硬盘曾经因为一个家伙取笑我而揍了他一拳。太爽了！等等，我能这么说吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All right, who's ready for the next song?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 好吧，谁准备好唱下一首歌了吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I think solo artists get really lonely. Success can be isolating, but we've got each other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我认为独唱歌手会感到非常孤独。成功可能会让人感到孤独，但我们彼此拥有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You reflect the people you roll with, that's facts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 近朱者赤近墨者黑，这就是事实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The party has arrived!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 派对来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My dad always says it's good to be around people who push you to be better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我爸爸总是说，和那些激励你变得更好的人在一起是件好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Are you ready to party tonight?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你准备好参加今晚派对了吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's okay not to have some big dream as long as you're happy with where you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 只要你对自己的处境感到满意，没有什么伟大的梦想没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Bein' seen for who you are? You can't buy a feelin' better than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让人们看到真实的你自己？你花钱也买不到比这更好的感觉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Whoa, you throw a great party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哇，你办的派对太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: People believing in me... I mean, nothing feels better than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 人们相信我……我是说，没有什么比这感觉更好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm surrounded by these awesome guys who push me to be the best version of myself every day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我周围都是很棒的人，他们每天都激励着我成为最好的自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I always put the artists before the bottom line. That's why I've been successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我总是把艺术家的价值置于利润之上。这就是我成功的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ladies like a man who holds his own, sure, but they respect the one who knows when to walk away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当然，女士们喜欢有主见的男人，但她们也尊重知道何时该离开的男人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Feels good to be on the winning team!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 加入胜利队伍感觉真好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nice! Let's have a LAN party!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不错！我们开个局域网派对吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You know, famous people aren't really any different. We're all born special in our own way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你知道，明星其实并没有什么不同。我们每个人生来都是特别的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No matter what happens, I'm always grateful to the guys and our fans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 无论发生什么，我都很感激我们的队友和粉丝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I love people, man. I love makin' music that makes 'em happy. No shame in that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我爱大家，哥们。我喜欢创作能让他们开心的音乐。这并不丢人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're just not like the other girls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你和其他女孩不一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's not a normal life, but it's an awesome one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这不是正常的生活，但却是精彩的生活！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Thank you. I never wanna come off as pretentious. You know, If you're not genuine, everyone's gonna catch on eventually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 谢谢。我从来没想要表现得自命不凡。你知道，如果你不够真诚，最终大家都会发现的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I am sick of watching this industry punish talent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我厌恶这个行业惩罚人才的做法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No matter how rough it gets, it always gets better. Gotta hold onto that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 无论多么艰难，总会好起来的。一定要坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ya hate to see a good party shut down early.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 真不希望看到一个好的派对早早结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Honestly, I miss home more and more lately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 说实话，最近我越来越想家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: They're wrong, you know. There is such thing as bad press.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 他们错了，你知道的。确实有所谓的负面新闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fame only seems special until you understand it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当你理解了名气是什么，你会发现它不是什么特别的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No regrets, man. I stand by everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没什么可后悔的，哥们。我坚信我所做的一切都是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It was fun while it lasted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 玩的时候很尽兴就是了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I just really want people to like our songs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我只是真心希望人们喜欢我们的歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Just get this mic off of me already. I'm done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 快把麦克风从我身上拿开。我已经受够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'll always love music. Nothing can change that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我永远热爱音乐。这一点不会改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: At the end of the day, I know I gave it everything I got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 到了最后，我知道我全力以赴了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's not you, it's me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不是你的错，是我的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Don't you ever wish there was, like, a way to know for sure if you made the right choice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你有没有希望过，有一种方法可以绝对确认你做出的选择是否正确？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I guess this was all just too much for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我想这一切对我来说实在是太过分了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You own our contracts, not our souls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你们拥有的是我们的合同，而不是我们的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We're just tryna give our best, every time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们每次都尽力做到最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: That's a party foul, man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这可是犯规啊，老兄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I count on our fans. They're all we've got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我相信我们的粉丝。他们是我们的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Please, no more pizza. Just the thought makes me wanna hurl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 拜托，别再给我们披萨吃了。光是想想我就想吐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Just because someone appreciates music doesn't mean they can make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 有人欣赏音乐并不意味着他们就能创作音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I didn't handle fame right at first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我一开始并没有正确对待出名这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I see you're making some gains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我看你长了不少肌肉呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Wondering what people say about me, sometimes, I get these... I guess they're called panic attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我想知道别人是怎么说我的，有时候，我会……我猜这叫恐慌症发作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, to tell you the truth, I'm so damn tired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，讲真，我实在是太累了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've tried really hard not to let popularity influence me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我努力让自己不受名气的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You know you made it when strangers got a problem with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当陌生人对你指指点点时，你就知道自己火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Leaving so soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这么快就要走了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I don't get why people are so mean. Like, what's the point?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我不明白人们为什么这么刻薄。这有什么意义呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You can't do anything to hurt me that won't make a great headline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 任何你试图伤害我的事，都会成为新闻头条。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: These days, you're not a star until you're beyond global. Our reach has to be out of this world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如今，只有在全球范围内享有盛名，你才能称得上是明星。我们的影响力必须超越这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We're hittin' new spots, reachin' new fans. It's all about breakin' out the comfort zone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们要去新的地方，接触新的粉丝。这一切都是为了打破舒适区。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's not you, babe. I just don't have space for a relationship right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这不是你的问题，宝贝。我现在只是没有时间谈恋爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've got tons of floppy disks so I can keep all my computer stuff with me on tour!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我有数不清的软盘，这样我就可以在巡演时随身携带所有的电脑资料了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If I'm gonna lead the guys, I can't be getting all weighed down. No way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果我要带领大家，我就不能让自己负担太重。绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Dude, we're selling out overseas. The future's looking bright.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 伙计，我们的作品海外都售罄。前途一片光明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I love hittin' the road, wakin' up in a new city every day. That's the life, and I ain't givin' it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我喜欢在路上，每天都在新的城市醒来。这就是生活，我不会放弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Only thing better than a party is an after-party! Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 比派对更棒的事情就是派对后的派对！我们走吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I keep my gaming sharp on tour! Every country's got at least one awesome coin-op game.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我在巡演途中也保持着对游戏的敏锐嗅觉！每个国家都至少有一款超棒的投币游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The tabloids won't catch me losing my cool. Not happening!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 绝不能让八卦杂志看到我失去冷静的样子。绝不可能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I got good at business to protect myself and my friends who just want to make great art.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我精通商业，以保护自己和那些只想创作伟大艺术的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: New tour, new moves. We're always levelin' up, bringin' somethin' fresh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 新巡演，新舞步。我们一直在不断进步，带来新鲜事物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You wanna get outta here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你想离开这里吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I love getting new source codes from magazines and just messing around with them, making them do different stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我喜欢从杂志上获取新的源代码并摆弄它们，让它们做不同的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I will not let the fans down. Not a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我不会让粉丝们失望的。绝不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Space is silent again. As it should be. Let us go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 宇宙又恢复了寂静。一切本该如此。我们回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Slow clap. They are done. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 缓慢鼓掌。他们完了。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Their gig has bombed. Too bad. Time to leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 他们的演出失败了。可惜了。该撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Passion is what drives me. Not just some desire for success.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 激情是我前进的动力。而不仅仅是对成功的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What's a dot exey?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 什么是 exey 文件？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I worry about Zeke sometimes. Oh can I say that? I just... well, I care about all the guys, but it's a lot, a lot of pressure being a leader and stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我有时会担心兹克。哦，我可以这么说吗？我只是……好吧，我关心所有的人，但作为队长压力很大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, man, hurry up. I need to make a call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，哥们，快点。我要去打个电话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Between the five of us, we have so much range to play with. Harddrive's deep voice is a producer's dream. Seriously.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们五个人在一起可以创造出无限可能。硬盘低沉的嗓音是制作人的梦想。真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I just wanna do somethin' worth rememberin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我只是想青史留名而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yo, dude, why don't they just put the letters on this thing in, like, in A-B-C order? This makes no sense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哟，哥们，他们为什么不把这东西按照字母顺序 A-B-C 排列呢？这完全没道理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Drillbit reminds me to look out for myself. I think that's, like, important. Cause, you know, I always wanna make other people happy first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 钻头小子提醒我要照顾好自己。我认为这很重要。你懂的，我总想着怎么让别人开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Just going to stare at a screen all day, huh? You're as bad as Packet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 整天就只知道盯着屏幕，是吧？你和数据使者一样糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Look, in any creative industry, you're gonna have bigwigs who think their subjective taste defines what's good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 听着，在任何创意行业，都会有一些大人物自认为他们的主观品味决定了什么是好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Any exec who says we're like family is gettin' the side-eye from me. I mean, are we stackin' paper or we playin' house?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 任何说我们像家人一样的高管都会被我鄙视。我的意思是，我们是来赚钱的还是来玩过家家的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, can I get a spot from you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，我做组的时候你能帮我看着点吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: At the end of the day, I really think everyone's doing the best they can, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 总之，我认为每个人真的都尽力了，你明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I never wanna see cheese again. Seriously thinking I'll go vegan once this Big Bytes gig is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我再也不想看到芝士了。讲真，我在想等这次的超级比特营销结束，我就吃素去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Labels get comfy shortchanging artists, because artists rarely know the ins and outs of business, but I do, and I look out for my guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 唱片公司对欺骗艺人已经习以为常了，因为艺人很少了解生意的来龙去脉，但我知道，而且我会照顾好我的队友们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fine cars, fine food, and even finer women. Yeah, it's the good life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 香车、美酒和漂亮妞。没错，这就是美好生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Drives me nuts when tabloids pick on Packet, man. Just let him be young, you know? Have some fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 每次八卦杂志挑数据使者的毛病，我就烦死了。让他做会儿少年，懂吗？让他好好玩玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: How many boards does this game have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这个游戏到底有多少个面板？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Back in the day, I'd roll out in like my PJs. Now it's like, not a chance buddy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 以前，我还能穿着睡衣出门。现在好像，没这种机会了，伙计！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Drillbit says I think differently. Real focused. Yeah, I guess I can see that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 钻头小子说我的想法与众不同。真正的专注。是的，我想我看得出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You can't stop 'em from runnin' their mouths, but you can stop feedin' 'em reasons they should.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你无法阻止他们胡说八道，但你可以不给他们话柄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nothing like success to pump up the ego!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有什么比成功更能提升自我感觉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Dude, your pop culture references are, like, so old-school.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 老兄，你引用的流行文化的实在太老套了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You think you're all that? Yeah right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你以为你有多厉害吗？行吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fame is just a side effect of hard work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 名气只是努力付出的副作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You think you could do what I do, go ahead. Show me what you got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你觉得你能做我做的事，那就去吧。让我看看你的本事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What's the point in playing a game you always lose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 玩一场总是输的游戏有什么意思呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: When you're at the top, you gotta act like you're still at the bottom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当你在顶峰时，你必须表现得像你还在低谷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're being such a dweeb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你真是个呆子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm tired of execs who try to impress us by taking us to fancy restaurants and talking about themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我厌倦了那些高管们为了给我们留下深刻印象，带我们去高档餐厅，然后滔滔不绝地谈论自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh, so you punked a boy band? Yeah, that's real tough. Congratulations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，你把整个组合都给耍了？是啊，真不容易。恭喜啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Such a tease.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 真会捣蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I guess listening's pretty important. And knowing who to listen to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我想倾听是非常重要的。而且要知道听谁的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Laaaame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 真没意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Offensive music persists. Repel enthusiasts. Eliminate source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 攻击性音乐仍然存在。驱逐狂热者。消除源头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The party bus is coming. Eliminate the party bus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 派对巴士来了。消除派对巴士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Destroy second speaker tower. Eject the boarders. Kill the vibe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 摧毁第二个扬声器塔。驱逐入侵者。破坏氛围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, I don't respect anyone who underestimates their audience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是的，我从不尊重那些低估观众的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You don't get respect unless you earn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 尊重是要靠努力争取赢来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What's a pretty girl like you got to cry about?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 像你这么漂亮的女孩有什么好哭的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Game over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 游戏结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Pain. That's a beautiful thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 痛苦。是一件美丽的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sorry about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Gotta get those high - organs - in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 必须多吃点那些高——级器官——食物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oof, gotta tighten up the graphics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，得把图形做得更精致些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I love to see - you struggle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我喜欢看到你——挣扎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm getting a bit of latency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我这边有点延迟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I love the spotlight, man, I don't care who knows it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我喜欢聚光灯，哥们，我不在乎别人的看法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You call that a punch?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你管这叫拳击？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ooh, got any extra lives?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，还有另一条命吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: And they say don't meet your heroes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 人们都说不要去见你的偶像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You wanna run that back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你想再试一次吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Problem is, always somebody out there tryin' to knock you down, but you gotta stay up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 问题是，总有人想把你打倒，但你必须挺住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Mm that 'fit hugs your curves just right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嗯，那真是完美贴合你的曲线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: One day we'll laugh about this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 总有一天，我们会为此开怀大笑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: C'mon guys. Let's see those hands in the air!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 来吧大家。让我看看你们举起的双手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey man, if you want an interview, you should talk to our press team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，伙计，如果你想采访，你应该找我们的公关团队谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fame and secrets? Nah, they don't go together. Sooner or later, the tabloids catch up to all of us. It's a matter of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 名气和隐私？不，两者不可兼得。狗仔迟早会抓到我们所有人的把柄。只是时间问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm not gonna lie, seeing you with other dudes makes kinda me jealous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不瞒你说，看到你和其他男人在一起，我有点嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Only thing about this game is it's almost TOO good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这款游戏唯一的亮点就是它简直太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Get that camera out of his face!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 别把相机朝着他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nothing kills creativity faster than corporate overlords breathing down your neck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有什么比公司老板的严厉监视更能扼杀创造力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The image is one thing, but the real you? That's somethin' else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 人设是一回事，但真实的你呢？那就另当别论了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, this BLOWS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，这太糟糕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Good game, dude. Well played.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: GG，哥们。玩得真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You know, we wouldn't mind paparazzi so much if you used flattering lenses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你知道吗，要是他们用的是美颜镜头，我们就不会那么反感狗仔队了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, everyone wants a producer credit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 伙计，人人都希望能署名制片人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, I ain't no product. Don't box me in like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，我不是产品。别把我关在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You've gotta be KIDDING me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你肯定是在跟我开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Gotta admit your toon looks awesome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不得不承认，你的卡通头像看起来很棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's exhausting, this lack of privacy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有隐私真是太折磨人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm wary of people who value admiration above everything else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我警惕那些把赞美看得比什么都重要的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, way I see it, we're all sinners, so we're all in this together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 伙计，在我看来，我们都是罪人，所以我们要同舟共济。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: There ain't bad teams, just bad leaders, bro!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有糟糕的团队，只有糟糕的领导者，兄弟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I am who I am. It's not like I've tried to change that or anything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我就是我。我并没有试图改变过什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Tonight and forever, we are united by our hearts and our music. We'll never be alone. You will never be alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 从今晚直到永远，我们的心和音乐将永远连结在一起。我们永远不会孤单。你也永远不会孤单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Success is never something that happens overnight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 成功从来都不是一朝一夕的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: One dope thing is gettin' to inspire the people. I never take that for granted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 最棒的一件事就是振奋人心。我从不认为这是理所当然的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The party's just getting started!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 派对才刚刚开始呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh I try hard not to compare myself to others. Way too much pressure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，我尽力不把自己和别人比较。压力太大了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Come on, let's get you an autograph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 来吧，我来给你签个名。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You learn as you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 在实践中学习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We're straight up unstoppable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们简直势不可挡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Never look back! Keep going strong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 永不回头！继续变壮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm not the best dancer, like, naturally, but I put in the work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我不是最好的舞者，当然，但我付出了努力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Two weeks at number one! This is off the hook!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 连登两周榜首！这真是太不可思议了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My mind's always racing. All these ideas, not enough time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我总是思绪万千。这些想法太多，时间却不够用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Of course I wanna prove somethin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我当然想证明些什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yo, my bad about the mess in the hotel room. If it makes ya feel any better, we had an awesome time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哟，不好意思酒店房间太乱了。如果这能让你好受点，至少我们玩得很开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I wish I had Harddrive's confidence. Maybe someday!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 真希望我也能像硬盘一样自信。也许有一天吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Double-Platinum today baby. Multi-Platinum tomorrow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 今天是双白金了，宝贝。明天多白金！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I think we have another hit on our hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我想我们又有新作品问世了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, it's been a dope night for everyone!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是啊，今晚大家都很嗨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's get out there and show our fans how much we - destroy - them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我们走出去，向我们的粉丝们展示我们是怎么——摧毁——他们的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's arcade perfect, man!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 简直是完美的街机移植，伙计！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Moments like this make it all worthwhile!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这样的时刻让一切的付出都值得！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: And this is just the demo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这只是演示版本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Dream big. Then hustle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 梦想要远大。然后努力奋斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Gotta be ripped for the tour!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 为了这次巡演我一定要保持好身材！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Some days I wake up and have to pinch myself, like, is this real?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 有些时候，我一觉醒来就得掐自己一把，确认一下这一切是不是真的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You know I've been doing this for a while, and there's nothing like the roar of a stadium full of fans!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你知道我做这行已经很久了，没有什么比体育场里挤满粉丝的欢呼声更震撼人心的了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'll never retire. Take music out of my life and there's nothing left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我永远不会退休。如果生活中没有音乐，我将一无所有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Forget the bad press. We got fans showin' love worldwide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 忘掉负面新闻吧。全世界的粉丝都在应援我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You know what, buddy? Let's take this outside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你知道吗，伙计？我们到外面去说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Every day feels unreal, living the dream!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 梦想成真的生活，每天都感觉不真实！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We did it, guys! Multi-Platinum! Let's gooo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们做到了，哥们！多白金！走起！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm just happy to be the person I've become.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我很高兴自己能成为现在这个样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nah nah, I ain't no genius, but I pay attention. That'll take you far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不不，我不是天才，但我专心致志。那会让你走得更远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yo, I'm way too hammered to hit on you right now, but like, gimme your number. I'll hit on you later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哟，我现在太醉了，没法搭讪你，不过，把你的电话号码给我吧。我晚点再来搭讪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: First person I called after we won was my mom. She was so pumped!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们赢了之后，我打电话给的第一个人是我妈妈。她可激动了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Take that, tabloids! On-lyne forever!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 走着瞧，八卦杂志！线上时代万岁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The secret to selling out shows? Hard work. There's no short cut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 演出售罄的秘诀是什么？努力工作。没有捷径。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm all about perfectin' my craft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我只想让我的技艺更完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Feels even better than my first solo keg stand!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 感觉比我第一次单独做酒桶支架还要好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've played arcade games in, like, so many languages now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我现在已经玩过很多种语言的街机游戏了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: From the bottom of our hearts, we couldn't have done this without you - the fans!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 从心底里来说，如果没有你们——我们的粉丝们，我们不可能做到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Some people get famous, others actually earn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 有些人出名是靠运气，有些人则是靠实力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Respect's... Respect's all about who you are, and folks can spot a fake a mile away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 尊重……尊重的关键在于你是谁，人们隔着一里地就能看出谁在滥竽充数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Go on, guess how much I can bench.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 来吧，猜猜我能卧推多少重量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I totally clocked that game!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我完全掌握了那个游戏的诀窍！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Thank you and good night! We love you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 谢谢你，晚安！我们爱你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, no matter how talented you are, not everyone's gonna vibe with you. That's just how it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，不管你多么有才华，不是每个人都会和你合得来。这就是现实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'll always look out for my boys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我会始终守护我的兄弟们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: So, what do I get when I win?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 那么，我赢了之后会得到什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Honestly, deep down, I've always been kinda shy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 说实话，内心深处我一直有点害羞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Looks like a bad sprain. Think you can walk it off?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 看起来扭伤得挺严重的。你觉得你还能走走看吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My integrity is far more important than money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的诚信远比金钱重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No frontin', some people really earn that imposter syndrome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 说实话，有些人应该好好反省一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Being real, my first dance injury was bad too. Worse than my first sports injury.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 老实说，我第一次跳舞受的伤也很严重，比我第一次运动受的伤还要严重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Still gotta boot it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 还是要启动它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Need us to simplify the choreography for ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 需要我们给你简化下编舞吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We'd tell you, but we'd have to break our NDAs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们可以告诉你，但那样会违反我们的保密协议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: These days, I only hit up parties where they ain't lettin' cameras in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如今，我只参加禁止摄像机入场的派对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're cute when you're angry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你生气的时候很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You just blow on the cartridge. Probably some dust in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你只要吹一下游戏卡带就可以了。里面可能有些灰尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yikes. You wiggin' out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哎呀。你要抓狂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, we became a group because we have a love for music.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，我们之所以组成一个团体，是因为我们热爱音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Determination, man! That's what it takes to win, and we've got it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 决心，哥们！这就是取胜的必要条件，而我们有决心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh they're like my big brothers. Always looking out for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，他们就像我的大哥哥。总是照顾我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm not about to start a solo career. Well, not now anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我现在没有单飞的打算。至少现在还没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, we became a group because we - infect people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，我们之所以组成一个团体，是因为我们——感染人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I got faith in us, US - even if nobody else does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我对我们充满信心——即使其他人都不相信。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: But if you're into jocks, there's only one guy here that's your type - it's me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 但如果你喜欢运动员类型的，这里只有一个人是你的菜——那就是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: This industry can make people a little crazy. I'm lucky I've got my bros keeping me grounded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这个行业会让人变得有点疯狂。我很幸运，有我的兄弟们让我保持理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sorry, On-lyne's not looking for a sixth member.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 抱歉，线上时代不招纳第六名成员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Rotting tech - transcends borders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 腐烂的科技——超越国界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, success wouldn't mean much if I didn't have my people to share it with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，如果不能和我的亲朋好友分享成功，那成功对我就没有任何意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We all bring something to the group. I bring the muscle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们都为团队做出了贡献。我贡献的是肌肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Computers aren't really their thing, but they know the basics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 电脑他们虽然不太擅长，但是他们知道最基本的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Okay, which one of us is the best dancer? Be for real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 好吧，我们当中谁是舞担？说实话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Look, I know our music isn't for everyone, but we're proud of what we do. We bring people together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我知道我们的音乐并不适合所有人，但我们为自己所做的一切感到自豪。我们让人们团结在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My dude. We gotta have each other's backs. Nobody else will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的伙计。我们要互相扶持。别人是不会帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My bros always come first. We're a team, man!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的兄弟永远是排第一位的。我们是一个团队，兄弟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I really look up to all of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我真的很尊敬他们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Me? Aww, I'd be nothing without these guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我？噢，如果没有这些家伙，我什么也不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It was a - disappointing - performance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这是一次——令人失望的——表演。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Now I smile thinkin' of the folks who said I wouldn't make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 现在一想到那些说我不行的人我就会笑出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Time you hit the showers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 该去洗个澡了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Everyone's entitled to their own opinions... Even wrong ones!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 每个人都有权表达自己的观点……即使是错误的观点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It is true what they say! Art imitates life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 确实如他们所说！艺术源于生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fame you work for feels better than fame that's handed to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 自己努力争取的名声比别人送上门来的名望更令人心安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: How you take yourself seriously, actin' like that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你表现出那样怎么能把自己当回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Whatever, man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 随便吧，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Not everyone can sing or dance, and that's okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 并不是每个人都能歌善舞，没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, we're feeling the love tonight, are you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是的，今晚我们感受到了爱，你呢？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Anger and aggression are weak tools.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 愤怒和攻击是软弱的手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: There's too much I wanna get done, and no time to waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我想做的事太多了，没有时间可以浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The night's still young, boys!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 今晚才刚开始，男孩们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's have a good time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我们玩得开心吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: After another headline? Fine. Do your worst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 再来一个头条？好吧。尽管来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sadly, this'll be our last song tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 很遗憾，这是我们今晚最后一首歌了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Once you get a taste of - hearts - you're hooked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 一旦你尝到——心脏——的滋味，你就会上瘾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: One more lap! Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 再跑一圈！出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've been super into Beat-em-ups lately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我最近超级喜欢打打杀杀的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Do not be afraid to take risks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不要害怕去冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You've been the best audience!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你们是最棒的观众！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: They'll bleed you dry if you let 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你听之任之，他们就会榨干你的血汗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: God, I can barely control myself around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 天哪，在你身边我几乎无法控制自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Tough times are just part of the story, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 困难时期只是故事的一部分，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Man, I get it. It's hard not to compare yourself to like everybody else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，我懂。很难不拿自己和其他人做比较。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let your skills do the talking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 用实力说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let me hear you sing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我听到你的歌声！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hold my beer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 拿着我的啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We'll make you guys proud!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们会让你们骄傲的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: C'mon! Let me see you dance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 来吧！让我看看你们的舞姿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's turn up the volume!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我们调高音量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Fame? Man, fame just showed me how to party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 名气？哥们，名气让我知道了如何狂欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's get those muscles PUMPED.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我们把这些肌肉练大吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Time to debug.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 调试时间到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's make this the loudest crowd yet! Let's hear it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让这里成为最热闹的现场吧！让我们听听！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let me see you - suffer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我看看你——受苦的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I just wanna make people - hurt, man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哥们，我只想让人——受伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm gonna give you the night of your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我要让你度过一生中最美好的夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Wanna hit up an arcade or something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 要不要去街机厅什么的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh yeah, now this next one is for all the fans out there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 噢是的，接下来这首歌是献给所有粉丝的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Gotta be able to admit your mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 要敢于承认错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Who's been ridin' with us from day one? Yeah, let me hear ya!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 谁从第一天起就和我们在一起？来吧，让我听听！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey back off! What the hell is wrong with you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，退开！你到底怎么了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Our fans are the best!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们的粉丝是最棒的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey chill out! I'm on your side, remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，冷静点！我是站在你这边的，还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ah yes, fear of the blank page. Gotta overcome that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 啊，是的，害怕白纸。必须克服这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You ain't as tough as you act, better check yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你不像你表现得那么坚强，最好检查一下自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You've got this, bro! All you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 加油，兄弟！全靠你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, it's best not to keep all that anger inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是啊，最好不要把所有的愤怒都憋在心里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ok, ok. A message to our critics… Being nice is a choice, you know? Being a total prick is too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 好吧，好吧。这是给我们黑子的话……做个好人也是一种选择，你知道吗？做一个彻头彻尾的混蛋也是一种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Try again with a little more feeling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 再试一次，用心感受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I believe in - screaming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我相信——尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're so pretty when you smile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你笑起来真好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Gotta stay positive, no matter what!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 无论如何，都要保持乐观！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Nothing makes critics happy. That's why they're critics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 黑子永远不会感到满意。这就是他们成为黑子的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Mindset is everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 心态决定一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I know y'all know this one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我知道你们都知道这首！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh yeah! Paaartyyy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 噢耶！派——对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's dance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们跳舞吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've got one question for you: Are you having a good time?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我有个问题要问你们：你们玩得开心吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Music is truly a universal language.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 音乐确实是世界通用语言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ain't nothin' like hearin' the crowd sing your words back to you, you know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有什么比听到粉丝把你的歌词唱给你听更美妙的了，你明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Show me what you've got!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我看看你有什么本事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Don't need a manual for this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这个不需要说明书。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Let's make some noise! Yeah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 让我们制造些噪音！耶！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're hitting that note a bit sharp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你跑调了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Damn, you look - done for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 妈的，你看起来——完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh, you have a boyfriend? Where is he tonight?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，你有男朋友了？他今晚在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If you don't, like, talk things out, it can, really get to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你不把事情说清楚，它就会真的影响到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The audience's - blood and tears - make it all worthwhile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 观众的——血与泪——让这一切都值得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You can count on this coming up when we renegotiate my contract.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们重新协商我的合同时，你可以指望这一点被提及。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The fastest way to become what you hate is thinkin' you're above it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 变成自己最讨厌的样子，最快的方式是变得自以为是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Woo! Oh yeah, bro! My muscles are pumped!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哇哦！哦耶，兄弟！我的肌肉鼓鼓的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Whoa, and I thought I was the computer wiz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哇哦，我还以为自己是电脑天才呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's awesome. I seriously can't even remember the last time I felt this amazing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 太棒了。我真的不记得上次有这么棒的感觉是什么时候了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Just being real, if I had to choose between performing and producing, I'd choose producing. Every time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 实话实说，如果必须在表演和制作之间做出选择，我一定会选择制作。每次都是如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If you wanna wild out, that's on you. You won't catch me wreckin' a good thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你想狂野，那是你的事。我可不会破坏好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've got more to teach, if you're up for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你愿意的话，我还有很多东西可以教你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: DJ's always like, 'save your money,' but c'mon, I've got my whole life to do that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 打碟王总是说"省着点花"，但拜托，我有一辈子的时间去省钱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You guys are the best. Y'know I'm not the first to say that you can't have too many - rage - songs. That's still true. Always will be!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你们是最棒的。你们知道，我不是第一个说你们不能有太多——愤怒——歌曲的人。这话仍然是对的。永远都是！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The suits will try to convince you you're replaceable. You're not. They are. Realize that, and you can do business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 那些西装革履的人会试图让你相信，你只是可有可无的。但事实并非如此。他们才是。认清这一点，你就能做好生意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yo, mad respect for DJ. Zeke's got frontman energy, but the quiet ones run things behind the scenes. Always watchin', nothin' to prove.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哟，真的巨佩服打碟王。泽克主场气场强大，而安静的成员在幕后保驾护航。一直在观察，什么都不需要证明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Still haven't had my first - kill. Poor me, Poor me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 还没有过我的第一次——杀戮。我好可怜，我好可怜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: They get mad at me for hogging dial-up, 'cause their friends can't call, but all my friends are online, so kicking me off is unfair too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 他们因为我占用拨号网络而生气，因为他们不能和朋友打电话，但我所有的朋友都在网上，所以把我踢下线也不公平啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sleep? Yeah right. I told the suits we're exhausted. They just gave me dexies and a pat on the back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 睡觉？才不会呢。我告诉那些工作人员我们累坏了。他们只是给了我一些安眠药，然后拍了拍我的肩膀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It feels like our fans are right there with us, cruising down the information superhighway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 感觉我们的粉丝就在我们身边，与我们一起畅游信息高速公路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Every night, we're out here throwin' down, wearin' out our bodies. We ain't doin' it for nothin', y'know? It's gotta mean somethin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 每天晚上，我们都在这里卖力演出，耗尽体力。我们这样做不是无缘无故的，你知道吗？这一定有一些意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: How's it going, beautiful?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 最近怎么样了，美人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I want a pet so bad! I'd even settle for a fish, but Zeke says we're on the road too much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我太想要一只宠物了！我甚至想要一条鱼，但是兹克说我们在路上的时间太长了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ya know, tensions run high on the road sometimes, but at the end of the day, we have each other's backs. Right guys?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你知道，在路上有时候压力会很大，但最终我们都会互相支持。对吧，哥们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Only people who aren't achieving much get all starry-eyed over fame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 只有那些碌碌无为的人才会对名利充满幻想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: See, too many folks waste time tryin' to drag others down to their level. It's embarrassing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你看，太多人浪费时间试图把别人拉低到自己的水平。真是太丢脸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Even when life's getting us down, we can always come together and party!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 即使生活让我们失落，我们总是可以聚在一起开派对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Inspiration? I don't really know how to answer that, 'cause every moment's inspirational to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 灵感？我真的不知道该如何回答，因为每一刻都给我灵感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: My ideal girl? I just want someone who - dies - when she's with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的理想型女孩？我只想要一个和我在一起时会——死掉——的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sure, we read the web comments. The love, the hate, all of it. There's so much I wish we could tell you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 当然，我们会阅读网上的评论。爱与恨，一切尽收眼底。我有很多话想对你们说。
