/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: When we blew up, people who never even looked my way suddenly acted like we were tight. I dunno how to feel about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们出名后，那些从来没朝我这边看过一眼的人，突然都觉得我们很熟似的。我都不知道该有什么感想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Bro, you don't get better by staying in your comfort zone. Gotta push yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 兄弟，呆在舒适区不会让你变得更好。你必须推自己一把！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I was feeling kinda homesick, but Drillbit stayed up with me. It was really cool just having someone there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我之前有点想家，但钻头小子陪了我一整夜。有人陪着我真的很酷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Me? I'm majorly bored. We fly to all these different countries just to wait around in hotels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我？我太无聊了。我们飞到这么多不同的国家，却只是在酒店里等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: The web gives me hope that musicians can finally produce their work without selling their souls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 网络让我看到了希望，希望音乐家们最终能够创作出自己的作品，而无需出卖灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've seen way too many folks reach the top by takin' credit for somebody else's grind. It ain't right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我见过太多的人是靠摄取别人的功劳而登上巅峰的。这是不对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You're partying? Without me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你在开派对？竟然没叫我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I still get super nervous and excited when I meet celebs. I don't really feel like one myself just yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 见到名人时，我还是会超级紧张和兴奋。我现在还不觉得自己是名人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You think you're sick of Big Bytes Pizza? How do you think I feel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你以为就你吃腻了超级比特披萨吗？那你想想我会是什么感受？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Don't buy into what the suits say about caring for artists. They just want to see the numbers go up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不要相信那些西装革履的人所说的关心艺术家的话。他们只希望销量能上升。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: DJ? DJ listens, man. That's what makes him a real leader.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 碟王？碟王会倾听，哥们。这就是他能成为真正领导者的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Winners? They just decide to be winners, man, plain and simple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 赢家？他们只是决定要当赢家，就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh, I've got nothing but time to grow up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，我除了有时间长大什么都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All you paparazzi are just wannabe photographers turned stalkers. It's so wack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你们这些狗仔队不过是想当摄影师，结果变成了跟踪狂。真是太糟糕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Look, what do you want? An interview? I'll give you two minutes right now. Any questions you have that aren't about our personal lives, I'll answer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 听着，你想要什么？采访吗？我现在就给你两分钟。任何与我们的私生活无关的问题，我都会回答。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: One thing about pain, it's a real motivator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 关于疼痛，有一点很重要，它是一种真正的动力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What's your issue, dude? Take a pill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你有什么毛病，兄弟？吃点药吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh, you're a total button masher.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，你是那种只会乱按按键的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: For Sol's sake, don't take this out on me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 看在太阳神的份上，别把这气撒在我身上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I've learned to tell the difference between honest criticism and straight-up jealousy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我已经学会了区分真诚的批评和赤裸裸的嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Youth is cool, but wisdom? Wisdom is gold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 青春很酷，但智慧呢？智慧是金子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Bro, she cut her hair. Classic bad breakup response. I got this in the bag!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 兄弟，她剪头发了。典型的糟糕分手后反应。交给我没问题！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I know I get to do cool stuff, but there's a lot I miss out on that kids my age get to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我知道我在做很酷的事情，但我也错过了很多同龄孩子做的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: If management gives us one more passive aggressive smile, I'm gonna snap!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果公司高层再给我们一个假笑，我可要发飙了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Pop music's no place for elitist attitudes about art. That's what I love about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 流行音乐中容不下对艺术的精英主义态度。这就是我喜欢它的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Real talk? It ain't the money or the fame I'm after. It's the influence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 真心话？我追求的不是金钱或名气。而是影响力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I just wanna have fun, man. Is that so bad?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我只是想玩得开心，哥们。这有那么糟吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Most people totally change once they think they're a big star.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 大多数人一旦认为自己成为大明星，就会彻底改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Please keep showing us your support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 拜托了，请继续支持我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Anyone can critique a finished album, but few have the talent to create one from scratch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 任何人都可以评价一张完成的专辑，但很少有人拥有才华从头开始创作一张专辑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All that talk you hear about fame bein' like a cult? It ain't that far off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你听说过成名就像邪教吗？其实这还挺接近事实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Lonely? Never. Every city's got beautiful ladies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 寂寞？永远不会。每个城市都有美女！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: All my old friends from school are hitting me up for backstage passes now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我所有的老同学现在都向我要后台通行证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hey, nice to see you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 嘿，很高兴再次见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It doesn't matter how much you know about the process if you don't have what it takes to pull it off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 如果你不具备成功所需的条件，那么你了解多少流程都没有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I always had a loud voice, and I ain't ever been shy about usin' it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我的嗓门总是很大，而且我从不羞于展示它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I could bench press you, babe. Easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我可以卧推把你举起来，宝贝。小菜一碟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I used to stand in front of the mirror pretending I was performing for a huge crowd. Now it's real. It's just crazy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 以前，我总是站在镜子前，假装自己在为一大群人表演。现在这都是真的了。太疯狂了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: We have the best fans in the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们拥有世界上最棒的粉丝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Can't fix that in post.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 后期修复不了这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Everybody just cool off right? Relax!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 大家都冷静一下好吗？放轻松！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Touchdooown! Woo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 触地得分！哇哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ha, telefrag!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哈，瞬间移动偷袭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hands up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 举起手来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Too much gain on that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这太值得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh, wait, uh, come on now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 噢，等一下，嗯，嗨起来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Go long!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 传得远一点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Instagib!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 一击消灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Sing it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 唱吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Wanna back off the mic a bit?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 想稍微远离麦克风吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No breaks, keep it movin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不要休息，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Come on, you can do better than that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 加油，你可以做得更好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: What a newb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 菜鸟一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I can do this all night!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我可以整晚都这样做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You've gotta take better care of your voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你得好好保护嗓子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ain't nobody bulletproof.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 没有人是刀枪不入的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: It's bulking season!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 现在正是增肌的季节！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Get good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 多加练习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: OK guys, you know what time it is! Sing - for me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 好了，大家，你们知道现在是什么时候了！为我——歌唱吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm a singer, yeah. I'm also a professional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是的，我是一名歌手，也是专业人士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Whatever, man. They judge us no matter what.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 随便吧，哥们。不管怎样他们都会评判我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'll getcha back later, alright?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我待会儿再来找你，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Another award would be cool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 再拿一个奖就太酷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Our fans give us the most thoughtful gifts, like ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我们的粉丝送我们的礼物总是那么贴心，一直都是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Money runs the world. It's not right, but it's true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 金钱掌控世界。虽然不恰当，但却是事实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yeah, I mean, I've always had that drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 是的，我的意思是，我一直都有股动力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Dude, isn't it wild how the more cash you rake in, the more free stuff you get?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 兄弟，难道你不觉得疯狂吗，你赚的钱越多，得到的免费东西就越多？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: New high score!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 新高分！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You owe us big. We were just clueless when we signed those shady contracts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你欠我们太多了。我们在签那些有问题的合同时还一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You have to carve out your own path in this business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你必须在这行中走出自己的路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Oh yeah, I'm all about the designer threads.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哦，是的，我非常注重名牌衣服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Just keep your head in the game, man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 兄弟，你只要专注于游戏就行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I know a few cheat codes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我知道一些作弊码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Ambition, in itself, isn't a bad thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 野心本身并不是坏事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I ain't above temptation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 我可禁不住诱惑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Toss me a cold one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 给我来杯冰镇啤酒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Yo, this magazine's got a demo disc!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哟，这本杂志有张试听光碟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Aw man, getting this award? It's like, the best. We're beyond grateful!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 哇哦，拿到这个奖？这真是太棒了。我们感激不尽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: I'm really feeling this track.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 这首歌真对我胃口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: No, see, never let 'em catch you slippin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 不，听好了，千万别让他们抓住你的小辫子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: Hope you don't mind if I crash this party!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 希望你不介意我不请自来参加这场派对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: You gotta insert coin to continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 你必须投币才能继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.text: And the thing is we would've never have gotten this award without the support of you, our fans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineBoyB.zhText: 事实上，如果没有你们——我们的粉丝的支持，我们就不可能拿到这个奖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: What??? Oh man, thought for sure you'd be able to break into that cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 什么？？？哦天哪，我还以为你肯定能打开那个储藏箱呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Ahhh. The cache was destroyed. It's okay. We'll… make do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 啊啊。储藏箱被毁了。没事。我们……想办法凑合一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: To the victor, the spoils! Aaaand the extremely pissed-off bad guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 胜利者得战利品！当然，还有那些非常愤怒的坏蛋们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: YOU looted the CLUBhouse! Guess what. Their heaviest hitters are now on the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 你洗劫了俱乐部！猜猜怎么着。他们最厉害的打手现在正在路上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Just pinged one of Scaldra's secret stashes. Use Efervon Charges to melt the locks and get inside, but I got to tell you, they will not be happy about it if you do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 刚刚定位到了炽蛇军的一个秘密储藏点。得使用艾弗旺炸药把锁融掉才能进去，但我得告诉你，如果你这么做，他们肯定不会高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: This sector is home to a Scaldra high-security cache. Efervon Charges will get you inside, but you gotta be quick, they're rigged to self destruct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 这个区域存放着炽蛇军高安全级别的物资储备。艾弗旺炸药可以帮你进去，但你必须动作快，因为它们装有自毁装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You don't crack that cache soon, it's gonna deadlock permanently. Clock's ticking look for Efervon Charges!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 如果你不尽快破解这个储存箱，它将被永久锁定。时间紧迫，快找艾弗旺炸药！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Scaldra on high alert. Your window of opportunity to get into that cache is closing. Find Efervon Charges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 炽蛇军处于高度戒备状态。进入那个储藏点的机会窗口正在关闭。去找艾弗旺炸药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: That's the last of them. Time to come home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 处理完最后一个了。是时候回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: I'm calling it there. Your job is done. Head home before reinforcements show up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 就到此为止吧。你的任务完成了。在援兵到达之前赶快回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You're half way. More up ahead. And it looks like it's going to be the big guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 你已经完成了一半。前面还有更多。看起来接下来要面对重装部队了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Scaldra Command is gonna be pissed when they find out what happened to their purge squad. Keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 当炽蛇军指挥官发现他们的清洗部队发生了什么，他们一定会非常生气。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Their numbers are dwindling, we can't stop now. Any survivors will be transferred to a new squad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 他们的人数在减少，我们不能就此止步。所有幸存者都将被重新分配到新的小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: I got a message for Scaldra, Höllvania isn't your town and their purge squad is all dead! I mean, they will be when you're all done. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 我告诉炽蛇军：霍瓦尼亚不是你们的地盘，你们的清洗部队已经死绝了！我的意思是，等你们行动完毕就会这样。继续加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: There's barely any Techrot in the area. This is purely a civilian purge. Clearing out locals so that the Scaldra loyal can move in? Ugh, I hate Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 这个区域几乎没有科腐者。这完全是一次针对平民的清洗。清除当地人，以便炽蛇军的忠实拥护者可以搬进来？呃，我讨厌炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: How dare they blame us! We will not be their scapegoats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 他们怎敢归咎于我们！我们不会做他们的替罪羊的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Civvies ringing the alarm all over the KIM network: Scaldra's started a neighborhood purge and the locals got nowhere to run. What do you think? Time for a purge of our own?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 市民在即时通网络上到处发出警报：炽蛇军已经开始了社区大清洗，当地人无处可逃。你怎么看？我们是不是也该进行一次清洗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Scaldra purge-squad just moved into the area. They're putting down anything that moves, infested and civilians alike. How's about we return the favor? I'm talking total wipeout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 炽蛇军的清洗部队刚刚进入这个区域。他们正在消灭所有移动的目标，无论是被感染的人或正常人。我们是不是也该回敬一下？我说的是全部消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Scaldra's systematically pumping Efervon through this neighborhood. Not good for anything with a pulse, including civvies. Only way to stop them is to put them down first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 炽蛇军正逐步地向这个街区投放艾弗旺。这对所有生物体都是有害的，包括市民。阻止他们的唯一方法是先下手为强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Techrot's just the excuse. Scaldra is using these purges as cover to kill anyone who won't follow their orders. I say we send them a message and wipe out this entire purge squad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 科腐者只是个借口。炽蛇军利用这些清洗行动作为掩护，杀害任何不服从他们命令的人。我建议我们给他们一个教训，彻底消灭这个清洗部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Ugh... There's Efervon in the air. Sol-damned Scaldra knows civvies are trapped here and they're still starting a purge. We got to stop them... dead, every last one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 呃……空气中弥漫着艾弗旺。该死的炽蛇军知道平民被困在这里，他们还要发起清洗。我们必须阻止他们……一个不留地消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Read my mind, Aoi. Start marking targets, I'm going loud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 跟上我的思路，碧。开始标记目标，我要火力全开了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Aoi, I'm headed out. Need you on gridwatch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 碧，我要出门了。需要你指路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You got it. Oh and hey, I gave your Tommy a full tune-up. Go ahead and fire her up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 明白了。哦对了，我帮你把"原摩"整个调整了一遍。去吧，把她发动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 还不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You slugs still don't understand. This is a numbers game. Your blades will go dull before I run out of reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 你们这些鼻涕虫还是不明白。这是一场人数游戏。你们的刀会变钝，而我的援兵永远不缺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: And you wonder why you have a recruitment problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 而你却想知道为什么你招聘会遇到问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You puny slugs, so close to the ground you can't see the big picture. Chaos followed Doctor Entrati, but within chaos is opportunity. Opportunity I will seize, no matter how hard you squirm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 你们这些渺小的鼻涕虫，太过贴近地面而无法看到大局。混乱随着英择谛博士而来，但混乱中蕴藏着机会。我将抓住这个机会，不管你们怎么挣扎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Entrati is ours. We will find him. I promise you that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 英择谛是我们的。我们一定会找到他。我向你们保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Arthur? That is your name, is it not? Do you know what I do to slugs, Arthur? I grind them beneath my heel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 亚瑟？这是你的名字，对吧？你知道我是怎么对付鼻涕虫的吗，亚瑟？我会把它们踩在脚后跟下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Not really my idea of a good time, but to each their own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 这不是我心目中的好时光，但每个人都有自己的喜好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You should not, even for a second, think you have won something today. Scaldra is unending.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 哪怕只有一秒钟，也别认为你们今天赢了什么。炽蛇军是源源不断的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: Things look a bit different from my perspective. But what do I know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 从我的角度来看，事情似乎有所不同。但我又知道什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: You are nothing but a distraction. A plaything. When you grow lazy, and you will, I will find you. It will not be a pleasurable experience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 你只不过是个干扰，一个玩物。当你变得懒惰时，而且你肯定会的，我会找到你。那将不是什么愉快的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.text: I don't do lazy. And you need to start watching your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineDemo.zhText: 我不偷懒。而你最好开始小心你的背后了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineEcho.text: See you at the finish line!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Helminth is very good at Caliber Chicks, by the way. Suspiciously good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 顺便说一句，Helminth 很擅长玩《火力女兵》。玩的特别好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hope you don't mind - I rearranged some cables! Tidy space, tidy mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 希望你不介意——我重新整理了一下电线！看着干净，心情舒畅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You will tell me if the stubble gets too much, won't you? Don't want you to feel like a tramp's moved in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果胡茬太多了要提醒我，好吗？我可不想让你觉得家里来了个流浪汉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You have a very attractive heat signature. Did you know that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你的热成像非常迷人。你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Always a relief to see you back in one piece. Not sure I'll ever get comfortable worrying about someone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看到你完好无损地回来，我总是很欣慰。我不确定我是否能习惯总是为别人担心

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mhmmmmmm.
Heard ya coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 听到你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: There's SO much gold in here. Let's pretend we're royalty! Princess Aoi, your highness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这里有好多金子。就假装我们是皇室贵族吧！碧公主殿下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Look at you, prowling around your lair. Like you're protecting what's yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你看看你，在你的窝里走来走去。好像在保护你的东西一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I could have lots of little babies! They'd probably eat me, though. Nah, you wouldn't want to come home to that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我可以生很多小宝宝！不过他们可能会吃了我。算了，你不会想回到家就看到这个的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If I didn't have you talk to Sol knows where I'd be. Amir's a boy, Quincy's a thundercloud and Arthur swishes around like Alexander the Great. Rats are better conversation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果没有你听我说话，天知道我会变成什么样。阿米尔是个小孩，昆西是一朵雷云，亚瑟一副亚历山大大帝的架势。和小鼠聊天都比他们强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Chek. Chek. Boom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 检查，检查，砰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello Warframe with... benefits. Hehe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好，炮……甲，嘿嘿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Don't forget to safely turn off your computer before bed, Ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 睡前别忘了安全地关闭你的计算机，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You are giving me quite an appetite, looking like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你这副样子真让我胃口大开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Has Arthur been in here? There's little sword holes in the floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亚瑟来过这里吗？地板上有小剑孔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Have you seen Vaquero anywhere? That little bastard always gets into the weirdest of places in here…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你见到瓦奎罗了吗？那个小混蛋总能钻进这里最奇怪的地方……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! Lettie said I need more practice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! 莱蒂说我需要多练习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am a Warframe. Or is a Warframe me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我是战甲。或者说战甲是我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I tried on those Archwings of yours, ya know, they do grip tight in the hips. If you ever felt like... nevermind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我试过你的那些曲翼，你知道吗，它们在臀部那里还挺贴合的。要是你哪天想……算了，没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Should I get a little pinnie on and do some dusting? Would you like that? I could be persuaded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我是不是该戴个小围裙再去扫扫灰？你想看？我可以被说服的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm. You are giving me inappropriate thoughts. I can share them if you'd like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。你给了我不恰当的想法。如果你想知道，我可以和你分享。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All limbs intact? No extra holes? Good. Nobody gets to see you break a sweat except me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 四肢都还在吧？没多出什么洞？很好。除了我，没人能看到你流汗的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Every time one of 'em damn balloons pop pop pop in the mall, speeds up the heart. Gonna give me a heart attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 每次那些该死的气球在商场里啪啪啪地响，我就心跳加快。早晚会让我心脏病发作的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hmmm. Thinking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。正在想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Maybe I hid a crane somewhere? Maybe I didn't? Maybe I hid... two?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 也许我在某个地方藏了一只鹤？也许没有？也许我藏了……两只？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Helminth isn't watching, Kalymos isn't watching, even Eleanor isn't watching. And I am right here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Helminth 没在看，卡利莫斯也没在看，甚至连埃莉诺也没在看。而我就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am most exquisitely bored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我真是无聊透顶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What, were you expecting dinner? Fat chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么，你在等晚餐吗？不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Promise I won't leave no holes in the bricks here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我保证不会在这儿的砖上留下任何洞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fables & Frontiers but with guns. Oh, that could work. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 《寓言与边疆》，但可以用枪？哦，这主意不错啊，真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: More..coffee... Ah! You'll do too
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 更多的……咖啡……啊！你也有一样的效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sol's wounds, I am bushed. Maybe I should grab a shower. Join if you like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我的天啊，我累死了。也许我该去冲个澡。你要是想，就一起吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Living like this, do you ever feel like we're teetering on the edge of something, but never… quite… going over?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 像这样的生活，你有没有觉得我们在某个东西的边缘摇摇欲坠，但从来没有……完全……掉下去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Being bored is worse than overworked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 无聊比劳累过度更糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I see you, and I know you see me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我看到你了，我知道你也看到我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Roll for initiative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 掷骰子决定先攻吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wishing for anything? I could grant you something nice if you have just a few minutes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有什么愿望吗？如果你有时间的话，我可以帮你实现一些好东西噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I wonder how robust this furniture is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想知道这家具有多结实？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We are living in parenthesis. Swimming round and round like goldfish in a great big bubble of Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们活在条条框框里。就像金鱼在巨大的虚空泡泡里打转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: That mutant cat is staring at my little muffins again…if she makes one wrong move, I get a  new  leather coat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那只变异猫又在盯着我的小松饼看了……她要是敢动一下，我就换件新皮大衣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How's a man supposed to focus? With you giving me those looks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你用那种眼神看我，要我怎么集中注意力呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah! A ghost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊！有鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Don't laugh but this? I think this is the happiest I've ever been.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 别笑，但我想这是我有生以来最开心的时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Comms are on silent… Aoi's fielding ops… I am officially off duty. This is our time. Just you and me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 通信设备已调至静音……碧在外面指挥行动……我正式下班了。这是我们的时间。只有你和我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I didn't tidy up. Sorry. I have the housekeeping instincts of a feral cat. And a few others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我没有收拾干净。抱歉。我做家务的天分跟一只野猫差不多。可能还带点别的毛病。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's quiet here. I can at least hear myself think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这里很安静。至少我能听到自己的思考。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I got your 6.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我罩着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Vrooooooooooooooooom.
Sunscreen, please! There's no proof you're immune to sunburn, is there? Let's not find out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 涂防晒霜，拜托！没有证据表明你不会被晒伤，不是吗？我们还是不要知道的好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What we do… is up to us. I could cook us a meal. We could even get drunk! Sol. I've missed feeling safe enough to let my guard down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们做什么……都取决于我们自己。我可以给我们做顿饭。甚至可以喝得酩酊大醉！太阳神啊，我好很怀念那种安全到可以放松警惕的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you don't pay attention to me I'm going to go and snog the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你不理我，那我就和 Helminth 亲热去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So…  long day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 所以……很忙的一天？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Brave to walk right past me without a kiss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 敢从我身边走过，却不亲我一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello my Void kitten. Meow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我的虚空小猫咪，你好呀。喵~

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I hope it's not bothering you that I leave some lights on at night, it's - it's just a thing I've always done, and...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 希望晚上我开着一些灯不会打扰到你，这只是我一直以来的习惯，而且……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The only thing this place is missing is a nice big open fireplace. Oh, and a rug. Something furry, for wrestling on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这个地方就差一个漂亮的大壁炉了。哦，还有地毯。最好是毛茸茸的，可以在上面摔跤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gonna glaze over for a bit. Okay? Amir needs me in his head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我要放空一会儿，可以吗？阿米尔需要我在他脑海里帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ay, would it kill you to get a comfy place to sit in here, sunshine?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 诶，在这里弄个舒服的座位会死吗，小太阳？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You know I've a tattoo? Wonder if it survived the Entrati swap. You'll have to go looking around, for it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道我有个纹身吗？不知道在英择谛改造我之后还在不在。要不你帮我找找？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Jillian, Lillian, Amirian. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 吉利安、莉莉安，和阿米安。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We don't pay for internet right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们不用付网费对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Shame I'm not sleepy. It'd be lovely to wake up to your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 可惜我并不困。能醒来看到你的脸会是多么美好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We should check each other over for any new blemishes. Want me to do you first?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们应该检查一下彼此有没有新伤疤。要不要我先帮你看看？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Next time you're out, come back with some treats for Anita, she learned a new trick. It's the cutest thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 下次你出去的时候，给安妮塔带点小零食回来，她学会了一个新指令。超可爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: One of the stray kids out there told me they saw you practicing with my gear? Flattered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 外面有个流浪的孩子说，看到你在用我的装备练习？我挺受宠若惊的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Arthur this is Agent Lightning please send 10 Pizzas to the NEST. Lightning Out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亚瑟，这里是闪电特工，请给巢穴送 10 个披萨。通信完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I downloaded us a movie for later... you wanna chill?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我下载了一部电影……晚上放松一下如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: This tongue has a mind of its own. I'm struggling to keep it in check over here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这条舌头完全不听使唤。我在努力控制它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am so sore. And not the kind of pain I enjoy. Maybe you can fix that later?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我现在浑身酸痛。这种痛可不是我喜欢的那种。也许你晚点能帮我缓解下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So that Entrati then, he's just gone? Like gone gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么，那个英择谛就这么走了？是真的彻底消失了啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, sorry baby babe, just on a call. Yes so as I was saying I am the luckiest guy alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，对不起宝贝，刚接了个电话。是的，正如我所说，我是世界上最幸运的男人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know Amir could probably get a pizza here fastest, but watching Lettie try not to steal a bite on the way here would be much more fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道阿米尔可以以最快速度把披萨送过来，但看着莱蒂在路上努力不偷吃的样子更有趣！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We should climb up on the roof. Look at the stars together. Feed the pigeons. Sweep for snipers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们应该爬到屋顶上去。一起看星星。喂喂鸽子。检查一下有没有狙击手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I can close my eyes and feel this city breathing. All her roughest stones are stained with lives and stories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我闭上眼睛，就能感觉到这座城市在呼吸。她最粗糙的石头上都沾满了生命和故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey.  Tonight, when you're done… you and me. I have an itch to scratch, and I don't want you being nice about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿。今晚你忙完后……就我们两个。我有个地方很痒，希望下手不要那么温柔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm.  Want a taste?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。想尝尝吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Is there an evil Amir? Is it Rima? Amir backwards? I'll find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有一个邪恶的阿米尔吗？是尔米阿吗？阿米尔的倒写？我会找到他的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You can hear the Helminth too right? Not just me? Does it ever sleep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你也能听到 Helminth 的声音对吧？不只是我吧？它会睡觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm not saying it's on the cards, I'm not saying it's even going to happen, but: if Quincy gave me a tattoo, would you laugh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我不是说这是板上钉钉的事，我也不是说这一定会发生，但是，如果昆西给我纹身的话，你会笑我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: There's a whole world beyond Höllvania's walls. I'll show you around, if we ever get out of here. You can laugh at our primitive ways.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 在霍瓦尼亚的城墙之外，还有一个更广阔的世界。如果我们能出去的话，我带你四处转转。你可以笑话我们的原始生活方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You. Me. Tonight. You're late? I make you pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你。我。就今晚。敢迟到？我会让你付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Too many screens around here. These machines ever give you problems? It's on sight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这里的屏幕太多了。要是这些机器出幺蛾子？当场就处理掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Video games. Yeah. Fun to kill there, totally painful to kill the people out there not in the game that want to kill us. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 电子游戏。对。杀人游戏里很好玩，完全不像在外面杀那些想要杀我们的人那么痛苦。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I promise you'll never lose the remote, I can isolate it and just YOINK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我保证你永远不会找不到遥控器，我可以随时找到它，然后嗖的一下就拿到手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You know… Aoi always smiles when she sees me heading over here. Like she wants me to know it's all okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 知道吗……碧看到我往这里走的时候总会对我笑。她想让我知道一切都好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh Gods I just burped and tasted pigeon. How? That was MONTHS ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 天啊，我刚打了个嗝，有股鸽子味。怎么会这样？那都是几个月前的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Lua, save me, my feet hurt. Another long day. How're you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 月神，救救我吧，我的脚疼。又是漫长的一天。你怎么样?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey.  Let's relax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿。放松点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, naptime's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，午睡时间结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you think we should get everyone to pick some songs? I can burn a CD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得我们是不是应该让大家挑几首歌？我可以刻成 CD！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Little reminder. Your weapons need to be stripped down and cleaned regularly. Including me. Do we need to make this a disciplinary matter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 提醒一下。你的武器需要定期拆卸和清洁。包括我在内。需要我把这件事变成一个纪律问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I would like to have the kind of fun with you that nobody has even imagined before, except maybe a medieval peasant on a bad mushroom trip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我希望和你一起享受一种前所未有的乐趣，也许除了中世纪吃错蘑菇的农民之外没人能想到的那种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nice to get away from the crowds sometimes, no?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 偶尔远离人群感觉不错，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You feelin' fine?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: L is for the - you look at me - and then you keep looking at me - and oh no I should stop singing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: "L 是——你看我的方式"——然后你继续看着我——哦不，我应该停止唱歌了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's the Party of your life-time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这是你终身难忘的派对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I could still taste you on my lips this morning. Buggered up my concentration completely. You're a liability, you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今早我还能尝到你在我嘴唇上的味道。害得我完全没法专心。你简直就是个祸害，你就是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If it rains, I'm taking you up on the roof to dance in it. No arguments. Eleanor's rules.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果下雨了，我一定要带你上屋顶跳舞。不许拒绝。这是埃莉诺的规矩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sorry to be quiet today, corazón - the spiders are at it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 抱歉今天我比较安静，corazón——那些蜘蛛又回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need an umbrella today? Don't want you catching nothing out there. Nothing worse anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今天要不要带把伞？我可不想你在外面淋雨感冒、或生什么更严重的病。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Record-holder Amir Beckett stands undefeated, not a single high score higher than his at any video game in the mall-turned-HQ.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 纪录保持者阿米尔·贝克特仍然保持着不败战绩，在这个由商场改建的总部里的任何电子游戏中，没有一个比他更高的分数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I wish we could have more pets. More everything, really.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我真希望我们能有更多宠物。更多的一切，真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Have you been working out? Fancy a quick arm-wrestle? Any bruises, I'll tell Lettie I got them "in action."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你最近有锻炼吗？来场速战速决的扳手腕如何？如果我有淤青，我就告诉莱蒂，我是在"执行任务时"弄的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I want to paint on myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想在自己身上画画。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Rough day? Want me to kiss it better? Or make it hurt better?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 不顺的一天？要我亲一下让你好受点吗？还是让你更痛快一点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Since you're such a quick learner, I'm wondering if I can teach you a thing or two over here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 既然你学东西这么快，我在想能不能在这教你一两招。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Eleanorrrr. Ah! You can hear me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 埃莉诺。啊！你能听到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm, you smell nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯，你闻起来好香。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gods. I am such a lucky bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我的天，我真是个幸运的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh Gods. Sorry. The Techrot's trying to summon me again. Like an ex who just won't take the hint. I am taken. Move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦天。抱歉。科腐者又想召唤我了。就像个死缠烂打的前任一样。我已经名花有主了。死心吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The worst part about this shithole? Weak coffee. Pleegh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这破地方最糟糕的是什么？咖啡太淡了。呸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Steady days. Steady nights.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 平静的日子，安稳的夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I really hope Eleanor couldn't feel what we did last night in her mind. Yuck. Ah. Oh god.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我真的希望埃莉诺没能感觉到我们昨晚做的事情。真恶心。啊。天啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's not too bad, is it? Being here like this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 还不错吧？在这里待着？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Given the sort of stuff we've been getting up to, I think we can be pretty certain you're immune to the Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 考虑到我们一直在做的事情，我想我们可以相当确定你对科腐者免疫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you ever wonder how many laws we're breaking just by being together? Government laws, religious laws, laws of physics… I love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你有没有想过，我们在一起可能会打破多少规则？政府法律、宗教教规、物理定律……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: From here, I can't hear Amir's arcade games. Do those things only say the same four lines?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 从这里，我听不到阿米尔的街机游戏声。那些东西是不是只有四句台词？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm not mindin' the vibes here. Especially now that you're back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我挺喜欢这里的氛围的，尤其是你回来以后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Zap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's like every choice in my life led me to you. Thank you life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 就像我生命中的每一个选择都把我带到了你身边。感谢命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hold it. Quiet. Listen. All clear. Sorry, I'm twitchy. Old habits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 等等。安静。听。一切安全。抱歉，我有点紧张。老毛病了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We can go so deep in so many ways. All you have to do is tell me what you want.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们可以通过很多方式进行深入交流。你只需要告诉我你想要什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Man, you have so many fancy toys in here. And here I thought Quincy liked his guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 伙计，你这里的酷炫玩具真多。我还以为昆西是最喜欢枪的呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mind if I move some books in? A couple of favs would look good right there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 介意我搬些书过来吗？我最爱的几本书放在那里应该很不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'll never let a battery die in this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我不会让这个地方的任何一颗电池没电的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you can't hear a balloon pop from the mall, think of what they can't hear from us in here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你在商场都听不到气球爆炸的声音，想想他们在外面又能听到我们这里的什么声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You still got that old Kinepage? Might have to send you a text or two. Just so you know I'm thinking about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你还留着那台旧的即时通吗？可能会给你发一两条短信。就是想让你知道我在想你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you think Lotus will ever come here? Or would that be too weird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得 Lotus 会来这里吗？还是那样太奇怪了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Eleanor and I are talking now… like, really talking. Thanks to you, you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我和埃莉诺现在开始交流了……是真正的交流。这都多亏了你，你知道吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Don't mind me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 别在意我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So let's interface our peripherals later? If you know what I mean? I think I know what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么我们晚些时候再连接外围设备？你知道我的意思吗？我想我知道我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's soundproof in here, right? Oh I hope so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这里是隔音的吧？哦，我希望是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Just be glad I'm not taking you home to meet my parents. One warzone is enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你该庆幸我没带你回家见我父母。一个战场就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I remember when I first touched your mind with mine. The first thing I saw. A memory of the night sky… and all the stars were in the wrong places. That's how far apart in time we were when we were born.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我还记得我第一次用我的心灵接触你的心灵时。我看到的第一件事是一片夜空……但所有的星星都在错误的位置。这说明我们出生时相隔的时间有多久远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Today's a good day. Nobody's screaming. Nobody's bleeding. … Yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今天是个好日子。没人尖叫。没人流血。……暂时没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You can be quite the little songbird, can't you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你真是个小百灵鸟，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fables & Frontiers campaign idea: A very talented lightning caster gets seduced by a time traveling angel from the future. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 《寓言与边疆》剧本构思：一位非常有天赋的闪电施法者被一位来自未来的时间旅行天使所诱惑。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need any fixing up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要修理什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Kalymos? Hey, hey! Kalymos, c'mere. Come on, come to uncle Arthur. Come on, over here. Don't be scared, come on. Fine. Be like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 卡利莫斯？嘿，嘿！卡利莫斯，过来。来吧，到亚瑟叔叔这里来。来这里，来嘛。别害怕，过来。好吧，随你吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fair warning. If you do ever die, I'm coming after you. Sol help me, I will march into the Hooded Woman's judgment hall and make her give you back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 先提醒你。如果你真的死了，我一定会去找你。我向太阳神发誓，我一定会冲进那个戴帽子的女人的审判厅，让她把你还给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Arthur looks like he's finally getting some sleep at night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看起来亚瑟晚上终于能睡个好觉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Welcome home, babe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 欢迎回来，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: H - fancy O - L - L - V - A - N - I - A. Only one fancy O!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 霍、瓦、尼、亚。这里的霍比较特别哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I always wanted my own space to decorate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我一直想要一个自己可以装饰的空间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I can't believe you've got a frigging spaceship and you're slumming it, here, with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我真不敢相信你有一艘该死的太空飞船，还愿意在这里跟我混。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I used to love the old myths about mortals getting it on with Gods and monsters. Now I get to live out my very own. Oh, for a bard to write it all down for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我曾经特别喜欢那些凡人与神明、怪物相爱的古老神话。现在我终于能亲身体验一场属于自己的神话了。哦，要是有个吟游诗人能为我们写下这一切就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You think Aoi will finally take some time for herself, for a change?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得碧会不会终于给自己留点时间放松一下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mm mmm.  Don't mind the view.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯嗯。别介意我欣赏你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Knock knock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 咚咚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: That gold is real. I checked. Maybe I could, hm, make some handcuffs?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那些金子是真的，我检查过了。也许我可以，嗯，做些手铐？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Pick me up a black bow tie if you ever find one, okay? I'd look sharp in a black bow tie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 要是看到有黑色领结的话给我买一个，好吗？我戴黑领结会很帅的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm the biggest monster you ever took down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我是你征服过的最强大的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I think the two little boys are finally playing nice together. Good, because they were driving me up the walls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想这两个小伙子终于能好好相处了。太好了，因为他们之前简直快把我逼疯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Run along, if I catch you, hm, well let's say you won't get much done today will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 快走，如果我抓到你，嗯，那么你今天可能什么也做不成了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I like it right here, and over there, and there and even up there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我喜欢在这里，那里，还有那边，甚至在那上面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I wonder if Eleanor and Lettie would be up for a movie night. A chick flick would be so fun. Amir can come too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 不知道埃莉诺和莱蒂今晚想不想一起看电影。适合女生的电影一定很有趣。阿米尔也可以来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hand on heart, I didn't think we'd make it through the year. The Hex, I mean. Too many ways for it all to fall apart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 说句心里话，我真没想到我们能撑过这一年。六人组，我是说。有太多可能让一切分崩离析。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What are you doing that's so important?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你在做什么这么重要？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You think Arthur and Aoi will ever get back together? I mean I hope not. They were shit for each other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得亚瑟和碧还会复合吗？我希望他们不会。他们在一起不合适。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah! Too many screens in here, always blinding me at night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊！这里屏幕太多了，晚上总是被这些屏幕晃得睁不开眼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir + You = Amiryou.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔+你=阿米亻尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh I ate too fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，我吃得太快了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: My sister thinks the world of you, you know. And where you're concerned, I actually care what she thinks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道吗，我姐姐很看重你。而且在你的事情上，我真的很在乎她的看法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'd love to paint a mural of you out there in the streets. Drifter facing off against a bloody great Orowyrm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想在街上画一幅你的壁画。漂泊者对抗强大的奥金魇龙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am going to go take a long, hot bath in a dark room… soak out these aches. If you want to join me, I won't say no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我要去小黑屋里泡个热水澡……缓解一下疼痛。如果你想和我一起，我也不会拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oooh! Finer than silk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢噢！比丝绸还细腻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I think if I type fast enough I could email everyone in the world. HELLO WORLD!  It's Amir!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想如果我打字够快，我就能给全世界所有人发电子邮件。你好世界，我是阿米尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We're lucky that couch is strong, aren't we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们该庆幸那个沙发很结实，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir will be fine by himself, won't he? I don't have to watch over him 24/7, do I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔自己一个人会没事的，对吧？我不用整天盯着他吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I miss pubs. I don't suppose you've ever been in a pub. This place isn't the same. Too new. Too… pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想念酒吧。我想你应该没去过酒吧。这地方不一样。太新了。太多……披萨了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, what adventures have you been on today, my heart?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亲爱的，你今天都经历了什么冒险？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Just a touch?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 只是轻轻碰一下好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I DIDN'T hack ANY of your computers. Or did I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我没有入侵过你的任何一台电脑。或者我入侵过？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I was on the internet and and I - I found this website with a few images that gave me some ideas for later?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我刚上网，然后我——我发现了这个网站，上面有几张图片给了我一些想法，晚点要不要试试？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wonder what Entrati's up to now. Sleeping with one eye open, if he's got any sense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 不知道英择谛现在在搞什么鬼。如果他还有脑子的话，就该睁着一只眼睡觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Would you like me to steer your body around one day? Yes, I know it's not the same, but it would be fun. I'd get you in so much trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你想哪天让我来操纵你的身体吗？是的，我知道这不一样，但会很有趣。我会给你惹上大麻烦的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey! Have you seen Neenah? She got off somewhere. Always getting into trouble, that one…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿！你看到尼娜了吗？我不知道她去哪儿了。她老是惹麻烦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Not wrong to use a bullet as a bookmark, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 把子弹当书签也没什么不对吧，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do I regret destroying my only Atomicycle? No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我会后悔毁掉我唯一的一辆原子摩托车吗？不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's not that I don't think we'd be a great couple, I'm just... I'm just really not ready. I need to be able to say no and have you understand, ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我不是觉得我们不适合做一对很配的情侣，只是……我只是还没准备好。我希望能够拒绝并且你也能理解我，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah, that's not going to happen. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是啊，那是不可能的。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I don't know what sort of monster-shagging bucket list item you were hoping to tick off, but I am not available.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我不知道你希望在遗愿清单上划掉哪项"狩猎怪物"的项目，但我没空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wait? You think I'd be caught dead with you? I've got a reputation to maintain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 等等？你觉得我会和你在一起吗？我得维护我的名声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The time traveler's charisma was far too low to woo the champion Amir! Sorry I'm not good at rejections.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 时间旅者的魅力太低，无法迷倒冠军阿米尔！对不起，我不擅长拒绝人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: After what you said? Get the hell away from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 在你说了那些话之后？离我远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well, YES! Yes and Yes. This is what I wanted. Yes, let's start as us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 当然，好啦！好的。这也正是我想要的。来吧。让我们开始双人世界吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well. All right, then. You and me. Yes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。那好吧。你和我。是的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh. My Gods. Okay. I am tripping on endorphins right now. Yes! Yes, I will. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢。我的天啊。好啊。我现在都快被内啡肽迷晕了。好！好的。我答应你。好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah, babes - let's go. You 'n me, time to make everyone jealous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是的，宝贝们，我们走吧。你和我，是时候让大家都嫉妒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me? Really? Us? Oh. Ohhh. YES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我？真的吗？我们？哦。哦哦。好的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: OOokay… But we're gonna talk about this in private, yeah? Before you get in over your head… Now go - I'm busy - And you're making me blush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧……但我们私下再谈这个，好吗？在你昏头之前……快走吧——我很忙——而且你让我脸红了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh? Like, I can update my status?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢？所以，我可以更新我的感情状态了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Seriously? Are you sure about this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 认真的？你确定？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wait, are you serious?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 等等，你是认真的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I was wondering when you'd ask… But… you sure about this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我还在想你什么时候会问……但是……你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh wow, oh wow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哇噢，哇噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hm? You're either very drunk or very brave. Either way… You sure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯？你要么喝得烂醉，要么就是很勇敢。不管怎样……你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All right, but um… can you please never do that to me again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧，但是……你能不能别再那样对我了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All right, then. Let's give this another go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那好吧。让我们再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okay. I admit, I have missed being with you, but um.... Just… let's learn from how it went before. Please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧，我承认，我怀念和你在一起的时光，但是呃……就……让我们吸取之前的教训吧。好吗？拜托了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You learned your lesson, yeah? Remember I don't like having my time wasted. You don't get three strikes with Q.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你吸取教训了，对吧？记住，我不喜欢浪费时间。你不会有第三次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I just really should stand up for myself, I really should say 'no second chances' but yes, ok. A second chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我真的应该坚持自己的原则，我真的应该说"不给第二次机会"，但是好吧，给你第二次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: On, off, on, off, make up your damn mind, Drool -
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好，不好，好，不好，你他妈给我想清楚，糊糊——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Go away then. Did Arthur put you up to this? This is low even for him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那你走吧。是亚瑟让你这么做的吗？即便对他来讲，这也太低级了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Right. I'll forget you brought it up then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好。那我就当你没提过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Right. Do they have 'dick moves' where you come from? Because that was one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 对了。你来的地方那里有"傻逼行为"这东西吗？因为刚刚那个就是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You gotta stop with all this will-you-won't-you bollocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你别再胡扯什么你愿意不愿意了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you struggle with making decisions? I do, I mean I think I do. Can I get back to you on that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你做决定时会纠结吗？ 我会，我是说，我想我会。 我能过会儿再给你答案吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Run off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一边去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Arthur: field-strip done. Headin' out in a bit to clear me head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亚瑟：武器清理完毕。我要出去一下，清醒一下头脑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Eleanor, it don't help me havin' your toys eyeball my shooters like they wanna make friends. It's giving me the heebie-jeebies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 埃莉诺，你那些玩具盯着我的枪，好像想跟它们交朋友似的，搞得我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir: got a job for you. Shelters need deliveries. Get your game face on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔：我给你找了份工作。避难所需要送货。快去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo Lettie. Lemme know what we're short on, fold it into the scav order for the outer sectors. I'm headin' out in a bit, see what I can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟，莱蒂。告诉我我们还缺什么，顺便加到外围区域的搜刮清单里。我待会儿要出去看看能找到什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aoi! Before I forget: contact a mine has a lead on a clothing pallet he swears is legit shibukaji. If Eleanor's in range when I eyeball 'em I'll get her to pipe you a look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 碧！差点忘了：矿区有个联系人说有批衣服，信誓旦旦说是正宗的涩谷风。要是埃莉诺在附近，我盯着那批货的时候也让她给你看一眼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Big up yaself. Dress for the hitter you wanna be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 振作起来。打扮成你想成为的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nice enough shooter. But I reckon we can bling it, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 枪不错。但我觉得我们还能给它镶点钻，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Get you sorted wit' threads, bling, ink, ya feel me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 给你整点衣服、首饰、纹身墨水，明白我的意思吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, what you tryin' to do after this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么，这之后你打算做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Look, don't try to speech me. Just tell me what ya want, and I'll tell ya what I'm askin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 听着，别跟我闲扯。告诉我你需要什么，直奔主题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wanna ask me about a ting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 想问我什么事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You're breaking up with me? As in me! You must be joking, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你要和我分手？和我分手！你一定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I didn't think I'd be hearing this. I - I don't think I can hate you but, I just, please leave me alone for a second.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我没想到会听到这些。我觉得我不能恨你，但是，我只是，请让我一个人静一静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okay. I won't lie, I feel like complete shit right now. You'd best not talk to me for a little bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。我不想说谎，我现在感觉糟透了。你最好先别跟我说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fine. Then there's nothing else to say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。那就没什么好说的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Suit yourself. You'll learn you made a mistake real quick. They always do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 随便你。你很快就会发现自己犯的错误。他们总是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I- I- Yeah… I understand…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我——我——好吧……我明白了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fine. You done? I'm busy. Get lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。说完了吗？我很忙。滚吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I need you to be certain. Are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我需要你确定。你认真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Be very careful. Are you certain you want to do this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 想清楚了。你确定要这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What? … R-really? Wha - What did I do? Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 什么？……真的吗？我——我做了什么？你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I want you to be real sure of the next words to come out of your face, Drool… you do not get a second chance with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我希望你能确定你的下一句话，糊糊……你跟我就没有第二次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I… I really think you should walk away from me right now, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我……我真的觉得你现在应该离我远点，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah. Figures. I'm your disposable doting dipshit once again. Why did I think it would be any different this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是啊。没错。我又成了你的那个可有可无的傻瓜。我怎么会觉得这次会有所不同呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Right. Joke's on me, I suppose. Becoming a bit of a tired old joke, though, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没错。我想小丑变成我了。变成了一个老掉牙的笑话了，不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo! I was being mighty nice forgiving you the first time. This time? We're done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟！我第一次原谅你是出于好心。不过这一次？我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I… okay, but this was your second chance, and… you're not gonna get a third.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我……好吧，但这是你的第二次机会，而且……你不会有第三次了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ff- Get lost, you stupid… little… - get out of my face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我——滚开，你这个傻……小……，从我面前消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you're joking, it's not funny. Don't do this yo-yoing ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你是在开玩笑，那一点都不好笑。别这么摇摆不定，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: With all my love and respect, this is not something you joke about. Please don't jerk me around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 恕我直言，这可不是开玩笑的事。请不要耍我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well that's good, but I don't know why you'd say it if you didn't mean it, and please don't do it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那很好，但我不知道如果你不是真心的，为什么要这么说，请不要再这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Came to your senses. Oh. Good. Now piss off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 清醒过来了。噢。那就好。现在滚蛋吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: OK. Ok.. This - This feels mean of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。好吧。这——这让你看起来很过分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I will do you a favor then, and pretend this moment of stupidity never happened, yeah? Now go. I'm busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那我就帮你个忙吧，就当这蠢事从未发生过，好吗？现在走吧。我很忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You'll be seeing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你还会见到我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey. Try not to get that ass beat? I like it as it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，别让屁股挨揍了好吗？我喜欢它现在这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Clocking off in a minute. See you back home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一分钟后打卡下班。回家见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hit me up if you wanna take a run at something. Got me some steam needs releasing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你想试着做些什么，就来找我。我需要发泄一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hasta pronto, cariño.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Hasta pronto, cariño.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 爱你哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: See you back home, sweetie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亲爱的，回家见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Y'know me. All about moments. Make this one last a little longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道我的。我只在乎瞬间。让这一刻再持续得久一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: (sighs happily)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: （幸福地叹了口气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: C'mon, you goin'? Ya killin' me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊，你要走了？我会想死你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Anytime, babycakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 随时欢迎，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You know I be thinkin' 'bout you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道我会一直想你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How'd I get so lucky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我怎么会这么幸运？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You know these hands don't feel right when they ain't on you. Aaah where you goin'?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道吗这双手没放在你身上就感觉别扭。啊你要去哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey. Why you always smell so good? Damn. Could bottle that shit up, for real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿。为什么你总是这么香？该死的。真想把这味道装进瓶子里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Miss your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 想你哟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: And I carry you still on my bloodstream's current.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我的血流中仍有你的身影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Later, cutie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 待会儿见，小可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: "If ever two were one, then surely we." 'Til later, darlingheart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: "如果两人合二为一，那一定是我们。" 晚点见，亲爱的宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mm hmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Don't be late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 别迟到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: See you at home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 回家见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 爱你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Later, lover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 晚点见，爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 爱你噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, and if you happen to come across a bottle anywhere? I'm cooking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢，对了你有没有在哪里见过一个瓶子？我在做饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: See you tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 晚上见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You, me, tonight. Read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今晚，只有你我。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: See you tonight. Don't be late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今晚见。别迟到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You and me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你和我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Be careful out there. If you got killed I'd never forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 在外面要小心。如果你被杀了，我永远都不会原谅你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thank you, Eleanor. It's under control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 谢谢你，埃莉诺。一切都在控制之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir, this is your cooldown warning. Dopamine levels are good. Now is the time to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔，这是你的冷却警告。多巴胺水平稳定。现在是工作时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Arthur, inventory done. Talk later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亚瑟，仓库清点完毕。待会儿聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo Quincy! I'm putting together a game of Fables & Frontiers. You want in? Quincy? Quincy? Okay, I'm just gonna put you down as 'Zorgon Dwarf-Exploder, Cleric.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟，昆西！我在准备一场《寓言与边疆》的游戏。你想加入吗？昆西？昆西？好吧，那我就把你记为"牧师佐贡—矮人爆炸者"了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sorry about your coins, Amir!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔，抱歉拿了你的硬币！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Quincy, I need you to talk to our civilian operatives about updating their surveillance detection routes. I need to know which of them have drawn attention, and who's on them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 昆西，我需要你和我们的平民特工谈谈关于更新侦查路线的事。我需要知道哪些人引起了注意，谁在监视他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Quincy, I sense a wave of warmth and affection for you… from the people of this neighborhood. What ever did you do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 昆西，我感觉到这附近的人们对你的……热情和爱戴。你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir, mercy run. Grab a pack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔，快跑。带上装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, oh!  Gah, Eleanor, you always give great advice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，哦！唉，埃莉诺，你的建议总是那么棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: C'mon, Eleanor. Do that synaesthesia thing again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来嘛，埃莉诺。再示范一下那个共同感觉吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir, I've got updates for civvie stations in the outer sectors. Hand-delivery only. That's you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔，我要给外区的市民中心发送最新消息。只能由专人送达。就是你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Lettie, a small child nearby is suffering an infection. If you can spare the antibiotics I can lead you to her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 莱蒂，附近的一个小孩受到了感染。如果你有多出来的抗生素，我可以带你去找她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Man, not now, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 伙计，现在不行，埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Lettie's always looking after everyone, but who looks after Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 莱蒂总是在照顾大家，但谁来照顾莱蒂呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You can shut me out all you want, Lettie, but in the end I'm gonna make friends with you til you beg for mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你可以把我拒之门外，莱蒂，但最终我会和你交朋友的，直到你求饶为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Lettie: thanks for the help. Appreciate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 莱蒂：谢谢你的帮助。非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aoi. I can guarantee that On-lyne remain safe and well, despite appearances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 碧。我可以保证线上时代仍然安然无恙，尽管看起来那个样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Quincy, you got plans tonight? Civvie operative might need oversight. SDR picked up a tail. Could be something, could be nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 昆西，你今晚有安排吗？有个市民特工可能需要监督。侦查路线捕捉到跟踪迹象。可能有问题，也可能只是虚惊一场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: One of these nights I'll work up the guts and ask Aoi to dance. Ha, ah, she'll kill me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 总有一天晚上我会鼓起勇气邀请碧共舞。哈，啊，她一定会杀了我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, Quincy, is there a reason you always have the air of someone attending their own funeral? Pfeh. What is it with the hot ones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 昆西，你为什么总是一副参加自己葬礼的样子？啧。这些美人都是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Great work on the threat assessment, Aoi. Let's have you run the others through it at the briefing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 威胁评估做得很好，碧。让你在简报会上给大家讲讲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Unconventionally beautiful though you may be, instrument of death, how joyful must be your singularity of purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 尽管有着不同寻常的美，但你作为死亡的工具，拥有如此纯粹的使命，想必是让你感到愉悦吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aoi when you got a minute I need a few simple tools fabricated. Nothing major.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 碧，如果你有空的话，我需要一些简单的工具。不会太复杂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fun games! Big prizes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好玩的游戏！丰厚的奖励！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let me brighten your day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我照亮你的一天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Situation isn't ideal but confidence is high. I'll take it.
