/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 情况并不理想，但信心十足。我会接受的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I've midwifed several weapons that may be of interest. They are quite keen to meet you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我催生了好几种武器，你可能会感兴趣。他们也很想见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Always something, always something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 总是有事，总是有事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Only the best Infested meatsuit technology this backwater town has to offer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 只有这个穷乡僻井的小镇能提供的最好的感染者肉装技术！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Whatcha in the mood for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今天心情怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We're making a difference. That's a rare feeling in this line of work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们正在做出改变。这种感觉在我们这行很少见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Less an armory, more of a pet store, this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这个地方与其说是军械库，不如说是宠物店。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need to get something off your chest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有什么话想说吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's deal!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我们做个交易！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We're saving lives here. No matter how rough it gets, remember that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们是在拯救生命。不管有多艰难，记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Here we are, in a place as exotic as this, yet every night it's pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们在这样一个充满异国情调的地方，每天晚上却只能吃披萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How's it looking out there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 外面情况怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh lovely bed, oh downy bed, with a spot for my head. How I long for your pillow, which feels like a big marshmallow. But it doesn't taste like one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，可爱的床，哦，柔软的床，还能摊平。我多么渴望你的枕头，感觉就像一个超大棉花糖。不过尝起来不像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I get that we're here for the common good, but losing music, clubs, dancing… that sucks crud through three miles of crazy straw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道我们是为了大家好才待在这里的，但没了音乐、夜店、舞厅……真的太惨了，惨得像用一根超长吸管喝烂泥一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Some of the west sector civvies want to throw us a parade, and I can't seem to convince them that kind of attention is a bad idea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 西区的一些市民想为我们举行一次游行，但我似乎无法说服他们，这种关注不是好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I sense the enemy's gaze upon this place of refuge. Their hunger to annihilate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我感觉到敌人对这个避难所虎视眈眈。他们渴望摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We're all just visiting; we own nothing. Civilization isn't a home; it's a hostel. Some previous guests were better than others. Tomorrow night a stranger will be sleeping in that bed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们都只是过客，一无所有。文明不是家，而是旅店。以前的一些客人比其他客人更好。明晚，又会有个陌生人睡到这张床上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Y'ever get the feeling Quincy's sister was raised as an only child?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你有没有觉得昆西的姐姐像是被当作独生女养大的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The minds of this city are an orchestra. Its music, at first discordant, in time reveals dark harmonies… building to a violent crescendo. How pretty it must have sounded, not so long ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这座城市的心灵就像一个交响乐团。它的音乐起初是不和谐的，但随着时间的推移，逐渐显现出黑暗的和声……最终达到一个猛烈的高潮。在不久前这听起来该是多么美妙啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: In a former life my job was to sew screaming meat back together in warzones. Day in day out. People got weird, burned out. But compared to *this* it was like having my hair braided at a music festival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 以前我的工作是在战区缝合尖叫的伤员。日复一日。人们变得怪异，精疲力竭。但和*这个*相比，那就像在音乐节给我编辫子一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What's shakin'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Smoosh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 咕叽

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So. Anything to report?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 所以。有什么要报告的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you ever wonder why you're in a situation like this, then you've forgotten just how contagious cruelty is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你想知道为什么会陷入这种境地，那你就忘了残酷有多么具有感染性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: This ain't so bad, am I right? The world is our oyster! And, now, also, it kinda looks like an oyster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这不算太糟，对吧？这是一个可以让我们随心所欲的牡蛎世界！现在，它还真有点像牡蛎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hard to imagine things being much worse, but… I wouldn't have met you otherwise. Hard to feel bad about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 很难想象情况会更糟，但……要不是这样，我也不会遇见你。对此我真的不觉得有什么不好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, baby. Let me turn this off. So, what's the latest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，宝贝。等我把这个关掉。那么，有什么新消息？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ever do you prove that one worth the possessing never can be. Where have you roamed, darlingheart?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你总是证明，那些值得拥有的，永远无法真正被占有。你去哪里漫游了，亲爱的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Look what you do to me, comin' 'round lookin' like that. S'a crime how you make me feel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看看你做的好事，穿这样走来走去。你给我的感觉简直就是犯罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I was thinking we could get matching t-shirts with each other's faces on it. Would that be weird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在想我们可以弄一些印着对方脸的情侣T恤。这样会不会很奇怪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If it isn't the best looking time traveler in the place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这不是这里最好看的时间旅行者吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mm. Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。我们谈谈吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Te ves bien, mi amor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Te ves bien, mi amor.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, babe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I swear I could get your face tattooed on the inside of my eyelids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我发誓我可以把你的脸纹在我的眼皮内侧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Girlfriend tax: one kiss. Pay up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 女友税：一个吻。交出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do go on. When you speak, sweet, I'd have you do it ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 继续说。亲爱的，当你说话的时候，我真想让你永远说下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mm, there you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯，你在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What is this beauty I see before me? How you doin', babe? You got somethin' for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我眼前的美人是谁？你好吗，宝贝？有什么东西要给我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So tonight we're gonna settle in with a family-size pie and I'm gonna show you my top three episodes of 'Warrior Queen Zasta'. It's the arc where her alien-prince half-brother discovers he turns into a sword when he's embarrassed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 所以今晚我们要吃一个大号披萨，我还会给你看看《战士女王扎斯塔》中我最喜欢的三集。在这一集中，讲的是她那位在尴尬时能变成剑的同父异母的外星王子的故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey. Thanks for last night. How's the day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿。昨晚谢谢你啦。今天过的怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yes yes, business, it's all very important. What is equally important, and I think you would agree, is taking the time to distract oneself with anything but. So, let's attend to your little shopping list after which you know where to find me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是的，是的，生意，这一切都非常重要。我想你也会认同，同样重要的是花时间让自己分心去做其他事情。那么，让我们来看看你的购物小清单吧，之后你就知道去哪里找我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: C'mere. I want some of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 过来。让我亲一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ooo! You looking good today. You change your hair or somethin'? C'mere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢！你今天看起来不错。你是换发型了还是什么？过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me? Oh you know. Just chillin', playin' it cool, like I do. Were you thinking about me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我吗？哦，你懂的。只是在放放松，耍耍酷，像平时一样。你是不是在想我啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, it's my favorite person.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，我最喜欢的人来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know what you're thinking. I can practically hear it in your vesicles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道你在想什么。实际上我都能听到你的心跳了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I gotta get outta here and get some clarity. ¿Me entiendes? Whatever it takes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我要出去一下，整理一下思绪。 ¿Me entiendes? 无论如何我都会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wassup, babe? Causin' trouble?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好呀，宝贝？在搞事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ooh, hey, I found this track it is definitely you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢，嘿，我找到了这首曲子，绝对适合你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah. My hero.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊。我的英雄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Later. You and me. Percussive maintenance. Now, what do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 晚点。你和我。一起来点"暴力调教"。现在，你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Look who it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看看是谁来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah. We're talking shop. Okay. No worries. But later, you want something, I don't want you asking. Read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊。我们在谈正事。好的。不用担心。但以后，你想要干什么的话，直接来找我。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello, love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Finally, someone I want to see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 终于有个我想见的人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Is everything all right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一切都好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's get a little privacy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我们找个私人空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Tell me what's on your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 告诉我你在想什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: For you? Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 为你？一直如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You ever have the same dream, over and over? I'm at this keyboard right, and I think I beat this game, and then…like, I'm floating above myself and I think you're there…yea you're there, and I have the strangest feeling I'm like leaving you right at the worst moment. Weird, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你有没有一直重复做同一个梦？我坐在键盘前，我以为我通关了，然后……就像是，我飘浮在自己上方，我觉得你也在那里……是的，你就在那里，我有一种最奇怪的感觉，好像我在最糟糕的时刻离开了你。很奇怪，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Always a pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 荣幸之至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know you can't tell me much about, y'know, how everything goes but… it does get better than this… right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道你不能跟我说太多关于未来事情的发展，但是……未来会比现在更好……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, check this out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，看看这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello, lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好啊，美人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Órale! A ver. Whatchu got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Órale! A ver. 看看你带了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Respect. How can I be of service?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 致敬。我能帮上什么忙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's funny. I only took the Omnia job because I thought the money might impress this girl I really liked, back home. Now, I'll probably never see her again. Now, maybe, she isn't even that girl anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 说来好笑。我之所以接受全科的工作，是因为我以为那份收入可能会打动我家乡那位心上人。现在，我可能再也见不到她了。现在，她可能也不再是那个女孩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wow. Have you done something with your look?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哇。你是换造型了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hmm Delicious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯，真是诱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gracias, show me something interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Gracias, 给我看点有趣的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Always got time for ya, you know that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道的，我总是有时间陪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, sweets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，甜心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello. To what do I owe the pleasure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好。什么风把你吹来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Good to see you, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 很高兴见到你，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo, what you sayin' fam? You cool?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟，你怎么样，家人？都好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Y'know, anytime you want a little multiplayer I'm up for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道，如果你想玩多人游戏，我随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Weird, I was just listening to this track and it reminded me of you. What's the latest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 奇怪，我刚才听这首曲子时想起了你。有什么新消息？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thank Sol. Tell me you've something interesting to brighten this day with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 感谢太阳神。告诉我你带来了什么有趣的事情来让我开心一整天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Te ves bien, my friend
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Te ves bien, 我的朋友

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Drifter. What you tryin' to do after?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 漂泊者。你等一下有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey hey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What you do still betters what is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你要做的，总是比已经做过的还要好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey! How's it hanging?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿！最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一直都在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah! Tell me something good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊！跟我说点好消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 跟我聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 又见面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Good to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wait 'til the rest of the mandem come. Hit the bar, tie one on, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 等着其他人过来。我们去酒吧喝个痛快，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Any time I think I've gotten better at this whole combat thing, I remember that time I saw Arthur operate a dude like a piece of machinery whose function was to destroy itself in three moves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 每当我觉得自己在战斗方面有所进步时，我就会想起那次看到亚瑟把一个人当作机器来操作，这台机器的功能是三步之内自毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What's on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你在想什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hola. ¿Cómo te va?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Hola。¿Cómo te va?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Wagwan? Y'say something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么了？你说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you ever go to a party and think about how many human skulls are in that room with you? Isn't that weird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你参加派对时，有没有想过房间里有多少人的头骨？这不是很奇怪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: My my. A thing of exquisite complexity, aren't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哎呀。我们都是复杂精致的存在，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Why we here? Speak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来这什么事？说说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Been meaning to ask, does "Dark Space 2050" ever get a second season?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一直想问一下，《黑暗空间 2050》会有第二季吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Old stuff, new stuff, I've got it all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 老货、新货、我全都有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What can I do for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我能为你做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need you some threads, somethin' fresh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你需要身行头，一些新东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: These days there's not a lot a person can rely on. But one thing I know for sure is that at 7 o'clock every morning I'll be wrenched awake by one of Lettie's rats aggressively making out with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 现在这个世道，人能依赖的东西不多。但有一件事我可以肯定，那就是每天早上七点，莱蒂的某只小鼠总会热情地"热吻"我，把我从睡梦中吵醒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What are we thinking? Dance? Moody? Pop?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 想听什么？舞曲？忧郁？流行？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well, well, well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好，好，好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's hear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 说来听听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You need some threads, unless you want to look like your Mum dressed you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你需要一些行头，还是你想看起来像你妈妈给你打扮的那样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nah, Quincy and I don't have beef. He's gold! Insomuch as his value fluctuates wildly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 不，昆西和我没有什么过节。他是金子！只是他的价值波动很大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, hey, check this out. Just came in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，嘿，看看这个。刚到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Interesting…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有意思……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Something I can do for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我能为你做点什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All good, no funny business. Everything's bless, seen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 都很好，没有什么奇怪的事。一切都很美好，看到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: One shot espresso in a tall glass, two lumps sugar, swizzle, add two-thirds ice, top with cola. Try it the next time you're feeling anxious. Calms me right down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 在高脚杯里放一份意式浓缩咖啡，放两块方糖，搅拌均匀，加入三分之二的冰块，最后倒入可乐。下次你感到焦虑时，可以试试这个。真的能立刻让我平静下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh! Hey! Didn't see you there. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢！嘿！没看到你在那里。嘿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Here you come, all rough-and-tumble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你来啦，成天打打闹闹的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Whatchu need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Top stuff, won't cost ya stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 尖货，不会花你很多钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Chat IRL? Cool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 面对面聊天？好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh. I was just thinking about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢。我正在想你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo fam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟，家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Weird to think that the world outside of all this is still just chuggin' along, huh? I wonder if Mystic Tomes 6 will be released this year.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 想到外面的世界还在一如既往地运转，真是奇怪，不是吗？我在想《神秘书册 6》今年会不会发布。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well look who it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看看是谁来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How can I help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我能帮上什么忙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Penny for your thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你在想什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No hay tos, I got a minute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没问题，我有空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You cool?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey hey hey! How's my favourite chronospatial freak show doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿嘿嘿！我最爱的时空怪人最近怎样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 跟我聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Good to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Pray tell, what entices you hence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 请问，什么吸引你过来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¿Qué onda?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¿Qué onda?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Step correct and I'll show you the A-grade shit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 过来，我给你看看 A 级的好货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Greetings and salutations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 问候和致意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: At your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 乐意效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ah. Our resident enigma.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 啊。这不是我们的神秘人物吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¿Qué pex?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¿Qué pex?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah, can sort you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯，我来帮你解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Genki desu ka?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I have a moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我有空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Más basura vieja, friend? Got more old junk for us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Más basura vieja，朋友？还有更多的旧破烂吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, wassup?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A lifetime of being charmed by you. Sign me up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 为你沦陷一辈子。有什么不好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I remember thinking: "I could die happy right now. But please, not yet."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我记得我当时想："我现在就可以幸福地死去。不过，再等等。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I felt the living heat of you rising like incense, like the first fires ever to warm the Earth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我感受到你的温度就像香的烟一样摇曳升起，像温暖地球的第一团火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Look at this then, us. This is my reward for being such a good boy, then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 看看这个，是我们。这就是我这么乖的回报？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mon Cheri. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亲爱的。永远在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Our own lovesong... on repeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 专属我们的情歌……循环播放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: That was the only victory worth fighting for. You.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那唯一值得为之奋斗的胜利。是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A hall of mirrors unfolding; two minds seeing through one another's awestruck eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一个镜像大厅正在展开；两颗心通过充满情感的眼睛看向对方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Here's to us, my heart…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 敬我们，我的心……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You're too good to me. Every part of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你对我太好了。所有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Find me a way to upload this memory forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 帮我找个办法，将这份记忆永久上传。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Anytime, anywhere, it's us. Together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 无论何时何地，都是我们俩。一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Standing there in your arms amid all the insanity, I was finally home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 站在你的怀里，置身于一切疯狂之中，我终于回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I felt your hunger for me and answered greedily. Our love was a savage and terrible thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我感受到了你对我的渴望，我也贪婪地回应你。我们的爱野蛮又恐怖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Happy New Year, sunshine, and all the ones to come…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 新年快乐，小太阳，未来的每一年也要快乐哦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A moment of peace. Trust me there's nothing I wouldn't do to protect this peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 片刻的宁静。相信我，为了守护这份宁静我愿意付出一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: New Year's Kiss, my new favorite flavor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 新年的吻，成了我新的最爱的口味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Anytime I hear any countdown, I'll blush. Thinking of this. Us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 每当我听到倒计时，我都会脸红。我会想起这时刻。还有我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: In that moment, with fireworks in the sky and hope in the air at last, I felt reborn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那一刻，烟花在天空中绽放，希望也终于在空气中弥漫，我感到了重生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: To be fully known. Accepted. Embraced. Desired. What more could I ever want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 能被完全了解。被接受。被拥抱。被渴望。我还能奢求什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am your fantasma - now and forever…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我是你的 fantasma ——现在直至永远……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: That enough for you? Always know where to find me for more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 够了吗？需要更多的话你知道在哪能找到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Even better than in the movies. Wow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 甚至比电影里的还要好。哇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: How did I get so lucky, so spoiled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我怎么会这么幸运，这么被宠坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I was so afraid. Even then. I never wanted to let you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我很害怕。即便如此。我也从没想过让你离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You knew every intimate inch of me. I was enraptured, shameless as a she-wolf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你熟悉我身体的每一寸。我完全被迷住了，像母狼一样没羞没臊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: This is one moment I hope never stops repeating…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我希望这一刻永远不会停止重复……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No mask here, no tricks. What we've got will be setting the standard for the future, seen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没有伪装，没有欺骗。我们所拥有的将为未来设定标准，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh yeah! That's right!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦耶！就是这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fine, I'll say it. I love you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧，我就直说了。我爱你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Feeling this safe, feeling this secure, it isn't something that I expected for me. But I'm glad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 感觉如此安全，如此有安全感，我从来没有期盼过这种事情。但我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Just thinking I'd make a shit father, but a really great uncle. The sort who takes you to the woods to blow things up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我觉得我会是个糟糕的父亲，但却是个很棒的叔叔。那种带你去树林里炸东西的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Did you want to heal me, or did you want me to make you as sick as I am? Even after all we've been through, I'm still not sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你是想治愈我，还是想让我把你变得跟我一样被感染？即使我们经历了这么多，我还是不确定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Magazines everywhere, I'm thinking you don't have many of those where you're from. So how's this headline sound: "Ready for your daily Vitamin Q"? Ha. Slick right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 到处都是杂志，我想你们那里应该没有多少这样的杂志。这个标题听起来怎么样："准备好每天服用维生素Q了吗"？哈。不错吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The truth is. Truth is. The glasses, they're just for show.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 老实说，其实，这副眼镜只是装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Being able to look up and see the world beyond the glass, it feels like we're in a safe pocket of something comfortable. I love looking out there and knowing I can turn around and look here, at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 抬头就能看到玻璃外的世界，感觉就像我们在一个舒适的安全口袋里。我喜欢看着外面，而且知道我可以转过身来就能看到这里，看到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We should get a distillery going, since we're here for good now. I could make my home brew. Nightingale's Old Kneecapper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 既然我们已经在这里定居了，那我们应该开个酿酒厂。我可以自己酿啤酒。南丁格尔的陈年尼尔卡布牌啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sometimes I send my mind out into the city and find a child who's having bad dreams, and I eat the bad dreams all up. One of them left me his best knee scab as a thank-you present. Well, you did ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有时，我会把自己的思绪发散到城市，找到一个正在做噩梦的孩子，然后把噩梦全部吃掉。其中一个孩子把他膝盖上结的最好的痂留给了我作为谢礼。既然你都这么问了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I think about how everything will continue without us - your Xipe Totec, Entrati, Tau… but my story ends here. Never changing. Like this. With you. Could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在想没有我们一切将如何继续，你们的 Xipe Totec、英择谛、Tau……但我的故事就到此为止了。永远不会改变。就像这样。和你在一起。可能会更糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's not forget to practice proper weapon discipline? Grip steady and firm, take a deep breath. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我们不要忘记练习正确的武器使用纪律？握稳武器，深呼吸。就这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's not really about being THE fastest. It's about being just fast enough that people want to play with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 关键不在于成为最快的。而是要快到让人们想要和你一起玩耍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I just never want anyone to fight over any of this. I love us, I love you, and I love my friends. That's my happiness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我只是不希望任何人因为这些而争吵。我爱我们，我爱你，我爱我的朋友们。这就是我的幸福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I promised myself I'd protect Eleanor forever. Nobody would ever hurt my sister again. Bollocksed that up nicely, didn't I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我答应过自己要永远保护埃莉诺。再也不会有人伤害我姐姐。我完全搞砸了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I wonder where she ended up, or if there's any of her left. We could have saved her, I think. We just didn't care enough. We thought she deserved what she got. Who were we to judge?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想知道她最后去了哪里，或者还有没有她的遗体、我想我们本可以救她的。只是我们不够关心。我们认为她罪有应得。但我们又什么资格说三道四？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me? Oh you know, wondering how long it'll be before Aoi accidentally crushes a gas tank and blows us all halfway to hell. Happy New Yeeaaar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我吗? 哦，你知道的，我在想还要过多久，碧就会不小心压坏油箱把我们都炸飞。新年快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Worst case scenario out there, I can get the job done with just a finger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 最坏的情况，我一根手指就能搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Without a screen between us I do think it's hard to say something that sounds cool smart neat and handsome but I'm trying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 当我们之间没有屏幕的阻隔，我确实觉得很难说出既酷又聪明、又有趣又帅气的话，但我在努力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know it's embarrassing, but I have to ask if you think I'm a good kisser. I just feel like I never want to stop, but I - I don't want to overwhelm you. Is that okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道这很尴尬，但我想问你觉得我吻技好不好？我只是觉得我永远不想停下来，但我——我不想让你受不了。这样可以吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Just hoping I get to go out riding with you someday. Horses, or Kaithes, or whatever they have wherever we end up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我只是希望有一天能和你一起出去。骑马，或者骑绝灵骥，随便什么都可以，也没有目的地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Why does a rancid dick like Viktor have to have such spectacular body art?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 为什么像维克托这种令人作呕的混蛋却有着那么惊艳的身体艺术？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sometimes I wonder… why us? Why did that Entrati asshole pick us for this bullshit of all people? What did he know that we don't and how?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有时我会想……为什么是我们？那个英择谛混蛋为什么就偏偏选中我们来做这种事？他知道什么我们不知道的事情，又是怎么知道的？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Storybooks. Been going through 'em since day one at school. Never felt that I'd be thinking about them now, but I'm reminding myself of that prince who did get his happy ending.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 故事书。从上学的第一天起我就一直在看。我从没想过现在会想起它们，但我在提醒自己，那个得到了幸福结局的王子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: People that wake up and start their day by hurting someone else just shouldn't wake up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那些一醒来就开始伤害别人的人，根本就不该醒来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you can, can you bring me a mixtape? From the future? I want to feel the music you feel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果可以，你能给我带来一盘混音带吗？来自未来的？我想感受你所感受到的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All this? This is so much more than I deserve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这一切？这比我应得的要多得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: There was a time when driving a six-inch nail through my frontal lobes genuinely seemed like the best course of action. Then you showed up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 曾几何时，我真觉得用一根六英寸长的钉子钉穿我的额叶似乎是最好的办法。然后你就出现了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hm... Do they have rats in the future? I mean, do you think they'd get along with my little muffins? Mm. Best not to find out. Don't need more mutants running around…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯……未来人们会养小鼠吗？我意思是，你觉得他们会和我的小松饼们相处的好吗？嗯，还是不要知道的好。不需要更多的变异人到处跑了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No judgment, but I do think some of those Zariman suits would look better on me. Or on the floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 恕我直言，但我确实觉得一些扎里曼套服穿在我身上会更好看。或是放到地上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Did they change the alphabet? In the future? Maybe instead of adding a letter, they should cut one. Yeah. Screw you P. Alhabet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 他们在未来改变了字母表吗？也许他们不应该增加一个字母，而应该减少一个。是的。去你的 P 字母。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I just hope I get to see live music one day. Getting lost in a crowd with you would be the type of memory that makes my heart beat faster and faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我只希望有一天能看到现场音乐。和你一起迷失在人群中，那将是一段让我心跳加速的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: When I look at the others, everything they have going for them, I just think: out of all of them, I got chosen. Me. You're crazy. But but don't change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 当我看到其他人，看到他们拥有的一切，我就会想：在他们所有人中，我被选中了。是我。你疯了。但别改变主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thinking about the Cathedral of the Luminaries. The architecture is so organic. All delicate plunging curves and stained-glass encrustations. It's like angelic Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在想双耀神教堂。建筑是如此的自然。细腻的曲线和彩色玻璃装饰。宛如天使般的科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you ever sit still? Blast in, blast out - blast in - blast out. You make me dizzy. Try walking once in a while, you're worse than Amir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你什么时候能安静坐下来？跑进跑出，跑进跑出。你让我感到头晕。偶尔走路试试，你比阿米尔还糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I got a bullet with his name on it. E.N.T.R.A.T.I. I'm holding on to it though. Maybe it'll be the last bullet I ever fire, then what, we can just be somewhere else. Someone else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我有一颗写着他名字的子弹。"英择谛"。我还留着。也许这是我射出的最后一颗子弹，然后呢，我们可以去别的地方。做别的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I really should be working on a campaign but I think it's okay to actually do nothing for once if by 'do nothing' means just being here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 虽然我本应在忙着组织一个活动，但我觉得如果"什么都不做"只是指待在这里，偶尔这样也可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you think the mannequins out there have a better butt than me? Think carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得外面的人体模型的屁股比我好看吗？想清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sorry. I was just thinking about how I had to watch all of them die, one by one. My head knows that didn't happen. We won. But I can still feel the despair down in my guts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 抱歉。我刚刚只是在想我不得不眼睁睁地看着他们一个个死去。我的大脑知道那不是真的。我们赢了。但我仍然能感觉到内心深处的绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know you worry sometimes about whether you're broken inside. I can't tell you you're not - that is not my place. But I do know you are absolutely deserving of my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道你有时会担心自己的内心是否崩溃。我不能说你不是——那不是我该说的。但我知道你绝对值得我爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You know where I found Tláloc the other day? With Eleanor. Sitting on her lap, like they were talking. It… was the most peaceful I've ever seen the little bitey bastard. I think I have something to bond with the witch about, finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道我那天在哪找到特拉洛克的吗？在埃莉诺那里。坐在她腿上，好像他们在说话。这……是我见过的那个爱咬人的小混蛋最乖的时候了。我想我终于有东西可以和那女巫聊聊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's about who you find, who has your back. I'm not writing any of them off, not even the kid. I think, well, I think we're proving something, aren't we? All of us. And I want to play my part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 关键是你能找到谁，谁会支持你。我不是在否定任何一个人，甚至是那个孩子。我觉得，嗯，我觉得我们在证明什么，不是吗？我们所有人都是。我想尽我所能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: With everything that's gone on it makes me wonder if I did actually see a ghost growing up that one time the tv turned on and no one was home. Ouuuu.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 经历了这么多事情，我不禁想，小时候那次电视机自己打开，而且家里没人的时候，我是不是真的见到了鬼。噢噢噢噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I've tried to make things other than cranes but they just end up looking wrong. I wonder if cranes just come naturally because they mate for life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我曾试着做一些鹤以外的东西，但最终看起来都不太对劲。我在想，鹤这么容易做，会不会是因为它们配对终生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You don't take nearly enough time for yourself. The world will not break if you set it down from your shoulders once in a while. Took me long enough to learn that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你留给自己的时间太少了。即使你偶尔放下肩上的担子，这个世界也不会崩塌。我花了很长时间才想明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Love getting shot at while I'm saving someone's life and then having them spit on me because I'm not a 'real Höllvanian'. Never gets old.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我喜欢在救人时遭到枪击，然后被他们吐口水，因为我不是"真正的霍瓦尼亚人"。这话永不过时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ok, don't tell anybody but, I caught Arthur smiling and laughing at one of Quincy's jokes the other day. You have quite the effect on people, sunshine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好了，别告诉别人，前几天我看到亚瑟听了昆西的一个笑话，笑得前仰后合。你对人的影响可真大啊，小太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I know some people out there trade in information. But wonder how the channels would light up if word spread about what we did last night? Would be easy to make them all jealous, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我知道有些人在交换信息。但不知道如果我们昨晚做的事传开了，频道里会有多热闹？很容易让他们嫉妒，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I can't change me, I just can't, I've tried. And one thing I've always wanted is an older brother who just really would play with me, show me that apples and trees don't fall far, ya know? And I know I know Quincy would shoot me before apple picking but, he's just that guy for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我改变不了自己，我就是改变不了，我试过了。我一直想要一个大哥哥，一个真正会陪我玩的哥哥，告诉我，苹果不会从树上掉太远，你知道吗？我知道昆西宁可开枪打我也不愿意去摘苹果，但他对我来说就是那个人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: One thing I will say is I haven't had a zit since this all happened. I do miss the pop, but I don't miss the eyesore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想说的是，自从这一切发生后，我再也没有长过痘痘了。我很怀念挤痘痘的感觉，但我不怀念那碍眼的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Caught myself daydreaming about the big country house with the enormous garage. I used to drive Aoi mental talking about that dream. I hope she finds someone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在做白日梦，梦见乡间的大房子和巨大的车库。说起这个梦，我以前说这个都快把碧逼疯了。希望她能找到她的另一半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I have seen some appallingly dark shit in people's minds. If I ever run out of here and just go screaming down the alleys, don't worry. Just wait patiently for me to come back. Because I always will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在人们的脑海里见过一些骇人听闻的阴暗面。如果我从这里跑出去，在小巷里尖叫，别担心。耐心等我回来吧。因为我总会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If somebody doesn't punch Entrati in the face for what he did to the Cavia, please find a way to let me be the one to do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果没有人愿意因为英择谛对科维兽的所作所为而给他脸上来一拳的话，请想个办法让我来下手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You think one of us should be out there trying to give the strays an education? Those kids, they've got a whole life to learn. If you don't mind, maybe I can take some time, show them the shadows don't gotta be so scary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得我们其中应该有人去给那些游荡者上课吗？那些孩子，他们还有一辈子要学呢。如果你不介意的话，也许我可以花点时间，让他们明白阴影也没那么可怕？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I think I never expected anyone to use the group chat I made but I'm so glad it happened. Having people that feel like they're in my corner for once is a real superpower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我从没想过会有人用我创建的群聊，但我真的很高兴这成为了现实。终于感觉有人在我这一边，感觉就像拥有了超能力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: My teeth are feeling a bit sharper, I think, I'm not sure if it's in my head. If I end up like Eleanor, can I bite you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我觉得我的牙齿好像有点锋利了，我不确定是不是我的错觉。如果我变得和埃莉诺一样，我能咬你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's daft eh? I was just thinking about Ordis, actually. What he'd look like if he was a person again. Little fella in a butler coat. Like a penguin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 太蠢了，是吧？其实我只是在想 Ordis，如果他变回一个人会是什么样子？穿着管家外套的小家伙。像只企鹅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I miss my piercings. Casualty of our enhanced healing faculties, alas. I liked hearing them rattle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想念我身上的穿孔们。是因为我们的愈合能力增强了，唉。我喜欢听它们的响声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's nice to get a break from the civvies. With how they collect bullet holes from the scaldra, you'd think it was their damn jobs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 能从市民那里得到片刻休息真是太好了。看他们从炽蛇军那挨枪子儿的样子，你还以为那是他们的工作呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I've made my peace with it. The clock. The calendar. Seeming more like a music track than an expiry date for us, right? Like we beat some game we didn't even know we were playing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我已经接受了。时钟。日历。对我们来说更像是一首音乐而不是一个期限，对吧？就像我们赢了一场我们甚至都不知道自己在玩的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm working on a new character for an Fables & Frontiers campaign and maybe you can tell me if the voice is okay? "Mmmm, let's get out there and clean up? Right then!". Oh wait, that's what Arthur just said to me on the earpiece. Damnit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我在为寓言与边疆的剧本创作一个新角色，你觉得这个声音怎么样？"嗯，我们出去清理一下如何？好的，现在就去！"哦，等等，这就是亚瑟刚刚在耳机里对我说的话。真是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mm? Wondering what you would look like stretched out on a, don't get me excited. You look like you still have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯？我在想你躺在床上的样子，别让我激动。你看起来还有事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ooh! How about this one? It bifurcates people laterally!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢！这个怎么样？它能将人横向劈开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Might I interest you in a gun that requires no skill to operate but a lifetime to master?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你会不会对一把不需要技巧就能操作但需要终生精通的枪感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No filler, all killer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 全都货真价实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Please let's have some fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 随便挑随便选。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, who's this for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那，这是给谁的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You feelin' this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有什么想法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ever wake up with a migraine, in a stranger's underwear, there's an exotic bird in the chandelier and you have no idea where you are? Me neither. Buy this one, it can shoot through entire libraries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你有没有醒来时头痛欲裂，发现自己穿着陌生人的内衣，吊灯上挂着一只奇特的鸟，而你不知道自己在哪里？我也没有。买这个吧，它可以射穿整个图书馆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Flip through the stacks, take your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 慢慢翻，慢慢看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You've an eye for the uncanny. What do you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你有一双发现不可思议事物的眼睛。你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Show me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Stasis is death, yeah. Change? Is life. Law of nature. Law of style. Fundamental.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 停滞就是死亡，没错。改变嘛，就是生命。是自然法则也是风格法则。是基础的认知。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Anything described as 'it's own reward' is probably not worth much, which is why all this stuff is really expensive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 被称为"本身就是奖励"的东西可能并不值钱，这就是为什么这些东西都非常贵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let me know if you need a hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要帮忙的话，告诉我一声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Shall we cause a spot of mischief?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们要不要去搞点事情？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's see whatchu got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我们看看你有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Listen. Me? I can only dress you. It's you gotta who's wear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 听着。我嘛。我只能帮你打扮。是你要穿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Y'know, if nothing here's working for you you could try Eleanor's stuff. Remember: it's only a nameless horror till you name it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道，如果这里没有合适的，你可以试试埃莉诺的东西。记住：这只是一种无名的恐惧，直到你给它起个名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Some good stuff in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 里面有些好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Idle hands, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 闲着呢，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I dress for who I am, right? And who I am starts where comparison ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我穿衣打扮为了自己，没错吧？跟任何人没有可比性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Alright! This stuff is so up your alley you're practically getting mugged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好的！这些东西真的太适合你了，简直就像是专门为你准备的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Get into it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 去找找吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I knew right away you'd be a good time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我一看就知道你会很开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nothin' wrong with a little vanity, innit?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有点虚荣心没有错，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I had a dream that Quincy was on a dinner date, sneezed mid-swallow and cannoned two feet of spaghetti out of each nostril. Anyway, need a gun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我做了个梦，梦见昆西在吃晚饭约会时，一边吞咽一边打喷嚏，结果两个鼻孔各喷出两尺长的意大利面。话说回来，需要枪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What are you in the mood for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 今天感觉如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Pretty is as pretty does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 人美心也美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So… what's on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 所以……你在想什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, what's your favorite cabinet? Caliber Chicks? That one frickin' rocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么，你最喜欢哪台街机？《火力女兵》？那个游戏太酷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need a little something to lift your day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要听点什么来振奋一下心情吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What do you say? A touch of the macabre?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你觉得呢？一丝恐怖的气息？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Huh. Got just the thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哈。这有适合你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ain't nobody beating Amir's high score.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没有人能打破阿米尔的记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I've been listening to this one track on repeat for days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这首歌我已经重复听了好几天了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah. Quincy-K all 'bout takin' what's fine 'bout all of this? And weaponizin' it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没错。昆西-克就是要利用这一切的好处。然后把它武器化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You need it, I got it. Aaas long as you need something best kept out of the hands of children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你需要什么，我这里就有什么。只要是那些不能让孩子们接触的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A world without music. Can you imagine? I'm so glad we managed to save this stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 一个没有音乐的世界。你能想象吗？我很高兴我们能保住这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I thought this would be right up your alley.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我觉得这正合你的胃口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Anything you fancy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有你喜欢的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Soooo… what are we thinking?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么……我们怎么打算？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, you will love these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，你会喜欢这些的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You may of course touch the merchandise. Only be aware it has a tendency to touch back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你当然可以触摸商品。只是要注意它们很有可能反击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Modern… classic… you know I got it all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 现代的……经典的……你知道我什么都有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If things ever get back to normal, first thing? A year at music festivals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果一切恢复正常，第一件要做的事是？参加一整年的音乐节。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So. Your idea of a good time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么，你认为什么是好时光？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: C'mon, cuz, spoil y'self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来吧，老兄，宠宠自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okeydokey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fine. Waste my time. Te lo juro por mi madre…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。浪费我的时间。Te lo juro por mi madre……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okay, okay, I don't want no smoke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好，好，我可不想惹麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Was it the smell? Look, the whole mall smells like this, I don't know what to tell you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是因为味道吗？你看，整个商场都是这个味，我也不知道该怎么跟你说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ay, pobrecito. Come back when you got something worth my time. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Ay, pobrecito. 等你有值得我花时间的东西再回来吧。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Soft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没劲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: All good, friendo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没事，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okay. Primerito: don't waste my time. Segundo? Do. Not. Waste. My time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。 Primerito: 别浪费我的时间。Segundo? 别。浪。费。我。的。时。间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gotta do what you gotta do, innit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 该做什么就得做什么，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Roger roger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A lie yuh a tell. Ah, move and gweh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你在撒谎。呀，赶紧走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fine, ya nah get none.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧，没你的份。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nuts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oi, this level of panache? That's effort, yo. Try it sometime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哎，这种程度的潇洒？哟，这需要努力。有空你来试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh aaaalright.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Alright. Calm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好。没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Not feeling it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没有喜欢的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Boo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What, yo card maxed out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 怎么，你的卡刷爆了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Playing hard to get, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 欲擒故纵，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Eh, you'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 呃，你还会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You're no fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你真没趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Go get yourself a payday loan then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那就去申请发薪日贷款吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, c'mon! This is the good stuff!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，拜托！这可是好东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Shame. I think that one liked you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 真可惜。那一个好像喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Shit like this flies off the shelves. Don't you sleep on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 像这样的东西很畅销。别再犹豫了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh-kay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh come on. Just a little one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢，不是吧。小的也不要吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Huh. S'a right mare gettin' a scrub to scrub up, know what I mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。叫个人好好打扮自己真是难如登天，你懂我意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well, maybe next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧，也许下次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Squeamish?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 胆小鬼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let me know, maybe I can get something in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 告诉我一声，也许我能帮你弄到些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Fortune favors the bold, sunshine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 幸运眷顾勇敢的人，老兄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What? This is cutting edge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 什么？这可是最先进的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We'll all be here when you come back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你回来的时候，我们都会在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ugh. You are killing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 唉。你真要了我的命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I suppose Quincy might be interested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我想昆西可能会感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你说了算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Very well. You'll find hand sanitizer just over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。洗手液就在那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okeydokey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好的好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Some relationships cannot be denied, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有些关系是无法否认的，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Excuses, excuses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 借口，全是借口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Que chido! Makin' friends wherever we go, aren't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Que chido! 无论我们走到哪里都能交到朋友，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No problema. This is a good thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: No problema. 这是可是好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Súper. Not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Súper. 不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ay, huele feo… did you find this on, near or in something that died? Ugh. We can use it, though. Unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: Ay, huele feo……你这是从死掉的什么东西上、附近还是里面找到的？呃。不过我们还是可以用的。真倒霉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Ay, que bueno! You have just made someone very happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Ay, que bueno! 你刚刚让某人非常开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Madres! ¡Muy bien! Nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Madres! ¡Muy bien! 不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thank you kindly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You got it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好嘞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: No problemo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sweet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 太好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okey doke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好滴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Everyone's a winner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 人人都是赢家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aaaaand here's your change.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好了，这是你的找零。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: ¡Buen hallazgo! Good find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: ¡Buen hallazgo! 好发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Arthur asks any questions, you found that, read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 亚瑟要是问起来，就说是你自己找到的，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: That'll make my connection happy. Bloke's got a family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那会让我的线人高兴的。那家伙是有家人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Nice piece, that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那个不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Alright, now get outta here before someone sees us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好了，趁没人看见，赶紧离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Took a lot of trouble to get that. Take good care of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 费了好大劲才弄到的。好好保管它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Pleasure doing business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 合作愉快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Alright. This never happened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。这件事从未发生过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: And that's all yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 这些都归你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Farewell, little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 再见了，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Enjoy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好好享用吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Au revoir, sweet thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 再见了，小可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Have fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 玩的开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Take good care of it, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好好保管它，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You're gonna love that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你一定会喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you feel that? The way it nestles into you? You've made a friend this day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你感觉到了吗？它依偎着你的感觉？今天你交了个朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I love that one. Enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我很喜欢那个。好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm glad I could have brought the two of you together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我很高兴能把你们俩聚在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: There y'go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 给你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am sure you'll do great things together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我相信你们在一起会成就伟大的事业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let me know what you think!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 跟我说说你的想法！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Ta ta, little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 再见了，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Sol, I wish the Major could see what her family are going through to get her back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 太阳神，我真希望少校能够看到她的家人为了救她回来都经历了些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: The Major was broken. Crawling. Any of us could have killed her then. But we all held back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 少校当时已经筋疲力尽。只能勉强在地上爬行。那时候我们任何人都可以杀死她。但我们都忍住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Whatever the hell is keeping Flare going, it's going to win this war for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 无论是什么让弗莱尔继续前进，它都会为我们赢得这场战争。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: My dad would have taken one look at Flare and written them off as a limp-wristed weakling. It's amazing how wrong he could be, my dad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我爸爸只要看一眼弗莱尔就会认为这是个软弱无能的家伙。他真是错得离谱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: There are more of us, aren't there? Others. Entrati had so many loops to do what he did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们之外还有其他人，不是吗？还有其他人。英择谛有那么多次循环来达成他的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I can't look at mythology like I used to, now I know what Entrati did to history. Dragons, golems, gorgons… makes you wonder, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我现在不能像以前那样看待神话了，因为现在我知道了英择谛对历史做了什么。龙、魔像、蛇发女妖……让人疑惑，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Minerva has plagues, Kaya has antimatter... yeah, Entrati was definitely planning more than just a nuke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 米尼娃拥有瘟疫，卡娅拥有反物质……是啊，英择谛的计划肯定不只有核弹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Libertatians! Always got to be the loudest in the room. But when the shit goes down, you know they've got your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 自由国人！总是房间里最吵的人。但每当有事情发生时，你知道他们会挺你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Why does thou sit upon my grave. And will dead lips to speak? Why does thou weep upon my grave. And will not let me sleep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 为什么你坐在我的坟墓上，让死去的嘴唇说话？为什么你在我的坟墓上哭泣，不让我安睡？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey! No drinking contests with the newcomers. I don't care how patriotic anyone's feeling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿！不要和新来的人比赛喝酒。我可不管谁的爱国心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yes. The bar is open. Don't make me regret it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 没错。酒吧开门了。别让我后悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Eleanor? If that guitar thing of Flare's has thoughts, I want to know what they are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 埃莉诺？如果弗莱尔的吉他有思想的话，我想知道那是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Amir, I want you and Kaya submitting joint scav dockets from here on in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 阿米尔，我希望你和卡娅从现在开始一起提交探索记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Quincy? We need a fresh tactical overview. The new four have some bloody useful tricks up their sleeves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 昆西？我们需要全新的战术概述。新来的四位有一些非常有用的秘诀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Lettie? If Velimir can keep the beer cold he can keep a morgue running. Tell him I said so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 莱蒂？如果维利米尔能冰住啤酒，他就能维持停尸房的运转。告诉他是我这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Uh… put me down as a 'maybe' for open mic night. Quincy knows why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 呃……把我列入"可能"参加开麦之夜的名单。昆西知道为什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hey, Kaya, once again, at Lettie's request: if you create a portal, close it again afterwards!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘿，卡娅，再次转告莱蒂的要求：自己开的虫洞自己关！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gentle reminder, everyone. Lettie's rats are not test subjects. They know what terminal velocity is and they don't enjoy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 温馨提醒大家，莱蒂的老鼠不是实验对象。它们知道什么是逃逸速度，而且它们并不喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text:
Entrati had backup plans, and four of them just came knocking. Now that the old Round Table bar's opened its doors again, we can afford to be hospitable. 

Hendricks and Volkov seem to know what they're doing, at least. I've always respected the Libertatian military, even if they do tend to show up late to the party. 

I don't even know where to start with the smart-arse kid and the rock prophet, though. 

Once I'm satisfied that we're secure enough here, I may well ask you to handle them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText:
英择谛有备用计划，其中四个刚刚来敲门。现在老圆桌酒吧又开门了，我们可以热情款待他们了。 

至少亨德里克斯和沃尔科夫似乎知道他们在做什么。就算自由军总是在派对中迟到，我还是挺尊敬他们的。 

不过，我实在是不知道该怎么应付这个自作聪明的小屁孩和摇滚先知。 

一旦我确保我们这里足够安全，我可能会让你来搞定他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well done. The team's got something for you on text.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 做得很好。团队在通讯软件上给你准备了点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hop on text for a second?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来跟我聊一会？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hop on text for a second? The team got you something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 来发短信聊一下？团队给你带了点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Games, salvaged tech, a whole pile of guns… Top score on any of the cabinets could score you something pret-ty sweet. Yep. Definitely the coooolest place in this whole mall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 游戏、回收技术、一大堆枪……在任何一台街机上获得最高分可能会让你得到一些相当不错的东西。是的。这绝对是整个商场最酷的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Need new music? I'm your gal. Got the latest and greatest, oldies and goldies. And some other stuff too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 需要最新的音乐吗？我就是你要找的那个女孩。这里有最新、最棒的音乐，也有老歌和金曲。还有一些其他的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It seems Höllvania's midnight garden has taken a liking to me, and its fruits are death. This is my harvest and, just quietly, they're trilling with happiness. I think they know you and they will be fast friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 似乎霍瓦尼亚的午夜花园很喜欢我，它的果实是致命的。这是我的收获，它们正静静地快乐着。我想它们知道，你们会很快成为好朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Techrot's awake. Hungry. Taking on a new form. I think… it's trying to become the On-lyne boys?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 科腐者醒了。饿了。变成了新形态。我觉得……它想变成线上时代男孩？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Okay. Aoi says: "Tell the Drifter they are now being hunted by On-lyne, only it's not them, it's the Techrot, it stole their shapes, oh sweet Lua, this is horrible. Emoticon. Emoticon. Emoticon."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好吧。碧说："告诉漂泊者他现在在被线上时代追杀，但那并不是真的他们，而是科腐者，它偷走了他们的外形，哦，月神啊，这太可怕了。表情符号。表情符号。表情符号。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It turns out Aoi's conspiracy theories were true. On-lyne really have been cloned and used to create Techrot parodies. I'm sorry to say you just attracted their attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 事实证明碧的阴谋论是真的。线上时代确实被克隆了，并被用来制成科腐者的仿品。很遗憾，你刚刚引起了他们的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Drifter. New Techrot Coda just hatched. Tracking your Void-saturated DNA signature. Has an expiry date of never. You might be stuck with this one for a while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 漂泊者。新的科腐终幕者刚刚孵化。正在追踪你那充斥虚空能量的 DNA 特征。没有过期时间。你可能要一段时间来对付它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If Amir's take on the situation is accurate, you're now being stalked by a knockoff clone of a popular late twentieth century boy band. If you need backup, you know where to find us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果阿米尔对情况的理解准确，那么你现在正被一个二十世纪末流行男团的山寨版追踪。如果你需要支援，你知道在哪里可以找到我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Viruses are dangerous, Techrot viruses are lethal. The one you just created has based itself on On-lyne for reasons I can't even pretend to fathom. But I doubt mimicking a boyband will make it any less of a headache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 病毒很危险，而科腐者病毒更是致命。你刚刚创造的这个病毒以线上时代为基础，原因我甚至无法理解。但我怀疑即便它模仿男孩乐队还是会令人头疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too. I always will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是。我永远都是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too. Simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是。就是这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm. Me too. Did you have some kind of celebration in mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。我也是。你想要怎么庆祝呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: My favorite little trigger to squeeze. Not too tightly wound today, are you? Since we have this, all this, maybe you need an inspection? Promise to keep it proper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我最喜欢扣的小扳机。你今天不会太紧张吧？既然我们有了这些，所有这一切，也许你需要检查一下？我保证会好好干的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thank you for loving me for me. For all of me. Every wrinkle in my brain feels loved loved loved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 谢谢你爱我，爱真实的我，完整的我。我的每一丝思绪都感受到满满的爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too, I'd be even more glad if we were more together over there on that couch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是，如果我们能更亲密地坐在沙发上，我会更高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You've given me a reason to be scared of dying, and that much more to live for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你给了我一个害怕死亡的理由，也给了我更值得活下去的理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Gods. Tell me about it. I was this close to taking holy orders a few years ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 老天。我深有体会。几年前我差一点就要接受圣职了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Y'know, sometimes, I'm still surprised. My mom always said I'd die alone. Joke's on her, now I guess I won't die at all, huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道吗，有时候我还是会感到惊讶。我妈总说我会孤独终老。看样子她被打脸了，现在我猜我根本不会死，呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Feels like we're starting our own 'Once upon a time' type story. Except we know that this gets a happily ever after on repeat, repeat and repeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 感觉我们要开始属于我们的"很久很久以前"式故事了。只是我们知道，这样的幸福生活会不断重复，重复，再重复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I love you. You're the first and last person I'll ever say it to, I know that already. I wasn't made to be loved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我爱你。你是第一个也是最后一个让我说出这句话的人，我很清楚。我本不是为了被爱而生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Aww, you're just saying that because you need me to fix your Tommy again, aren't you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你这么说是因为你又需要我帮你修"原摩"了，是不是？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thank the Gods for Höllvania's vibrant dating scene.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 感谢上天赐予霍瓦尼亚如此有活力的约会场所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Psh. You only love me for my prehensile tongue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嘘。你只喜欢我那个灵活的舌头而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm. Who knew you'd be a sucker for punishment, huh. Can't say I'm complaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯。谁知道你这么喜欢被虐，呵。我可不是在抱怨。
