/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Don't need my scope to see how right this all is. Sure, people might get the idea that I have a weakness now, that being you, but ha, who could take us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 不用我的瞄准镜也能看出这一切有多正确。当然，人们可能会觉得我现在有弱点了，那就是你，但是，哈，谁又能打败我们呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Woof woof! Dogs always seem so happy and this IS the happiest I've ever been so, woof?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 汪汪！狗狗总是看起来很开心，而这是我有史以来最开心的时刻，所以，汪汪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too....
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yeah. If I was someone else I'd be so jealous of me right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是啊。如果我是别人，我现在一定会嫉妒死自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So, how about we take Kalymos for a walk, go hunt some Legacytes, then shower down together afterwards?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 那么，我们带卡利莫斯去散散步，再去猎杀一些传承种，然后回来一起洗个澡，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Being a ghost isn't so bad… if it means I get to haunt your cute ass for the rest of eternity, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 做鬼也没那么糟……如果这意味着我可以永远缠着你这个可爱蛋不放的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Hmm.. Just glad, hm? Not "scared you can't keep up with me" or "worried you'll have trouble walking tomorrow"?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯……只是高兴，对吧？而不是"害怕你跟不上我"或者"担心你明天走路有困难"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You just want me to kiss you don't ya! Well, wish granted..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你只是想让我吻你，对吧！好吧，愿望成真了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I am so happy you said that. I feel the same way, and I also just feel worried sick when you're not here so come back, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我很高兴你这么说。我也有同感，你不在的时候我也很担心，所以你一定要回来，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So am I. What we've got here… it's really good. So let's not take it for granted. Make each day count.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是。我们这里的一切……真的很美好。所以我们不要认为这是理所当然的。让每一天都有意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I believe you. No mind-reading necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我相信你。不需要读心术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Never would have guessed we would wind up together… not in a million years. But, hey. I'm happy to be wrong, once in a while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 从没想过我们会在一起……再过一百万年也想不到。但是，嘿。我很乐意偶尔犯错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: It's more than alright with me. This is where I want to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我完全没问题。这就是我想去的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I'm the electron to your proton, and that's just science baby. Can't argue it. Look at all my sparks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你是质子，而我是你的电子，这就是科学，宝贝。没得争论。看看我的火花吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too, I was thinking maybe it'd be nice to watch the sunrise soon? Just lay under a techrot canopy and count the stars beyond before the sun hides them for another day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是，我在想也许早点看日出会不错？就躺在科腐者顶蓬下，数着天上的星星，直到太阳第二天升起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Thanks for saying it. I mean it. I could never get tired of hearing you say that to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 谢谢你这么说。我是认真的。你对我说这句话，我永远听不腻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Same here. Devils like us belong together. Cheers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也一样。像我们这样的魔鬼属于彼此。干杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: And I couldn't be happier. Though… I do wonder… Can you loop us? How many tries did - nononono I don't want to know!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我高兴极了。不过……我想知道……你可以让我们循环吗？你到底试了几次——不不不，我不想知道！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Mmm, not a minute I haven't loved. See I used to think I knew warmth when Sol woke me up. Now I know real warmth comes from seeing you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 嗯，我每时每刻都爱着你。我以前以为当太阳叫醒我的时候就知道什么是温暖。现在我知道真正的温暖来自于见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I can't think! Words aren't coming. Hm.. Yes. Just know this, this is right. Us. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我脑子一片空白！什么都说不出来。嗯……对。只要记住这一点，这是对的。我们。永远在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Let's take care of each other, let's make this together something that can't be taken away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 让我们互相照顾，一起创造无法被夺走的美好时光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me too. I'm so bloody glad we talk as much as we do. I bottled too much stuff up for too long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是。我真高兴我们能像现在这样无话不谈。很多事情憋在我心里太久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Well, why don't you get comfortable, and we can show our appreciation for one another properly?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 好了，你为什么不放松点，我们可以适当地表达我们对彼此的欣赏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Who knew that being trapped forever in a shithole would wind up being one of the best parts of my life…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 谁知道永远被困在这一烂地里会成为我生命中最美好的事情之一……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Still can't believe, out of all your options in the universe… I haven't managed to cock this up yet. But I always know how to make it right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我还是不敢相信，你有这么多选择……我还没把这个搞砸。但我总是知道如何把它做好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh, me too. Trust me. Me too. Bow chicka wow wow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 噢，我也是。相信我。我也是。嘿嘿嘿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Oh me too, me too. I just don't ever want to hurt you because of what I am now, my hugs can be a bit, well, intense?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 哦，我也是，我也是。我只是不想因为我现在的样子伤害到你，我的拥抱会有点，嗯，激烈？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You say stuff like that out of the blue, you just make me fall in love with you all over again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你突然说出那样的话，只会让我再一次爱上你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: If you ever lose sight of the wonder you are, I will gladly be your mirror.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 如果你看不到自己的伟大，我将是你的一面镜子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: And so am I… and I wonder - do you want it hard or soft tonight, mm? Your choice. I'll be nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是……我想知道你今晚想要来硬的还是软的？你来选。我会很温柔的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Me, too. You have any idea how cuddly you get when you sleep? Cutest damn thing I've ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是。你知道你睡觉的时候有多可爱吗？是我见过的最可爱的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Yes every part of me is glad. I LOVE the smell of you, I love your look, your taste, your … sound? And the touch. AH! So that's um... that's all 5 senses and let's go with the 6th Amir Sense of loving the way you think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 是的，我全身心都感到很高兴。我爱你的气味，我爱你的样子，你的味道，你的……声音？还有你的触感。啊！所以这就是……这是全部五种感官了，我们再加上阿米尔的第六感，爱你的思维方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: (I love you, forever, my crane)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: （我永远爱你，我的鹤）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: So am I. And so are the others. I was a moody old pain in the arse before you made an honest man of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我也是，其他人也是。在你把我变成一个诚实的人之前，我是个喜怒无常的老顽固。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: I hope you can forgive me for barging my way into your brain that first time. I do not feel good about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我希望你能原谅我那次擅自闯入你的脑海。我仍然对这件事耿耿于怀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: A strange family - a strange life. I don't know if this is the heaven Lua had planned for me, sunshine - but it's one I'm happy with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 奇怪的家庭——奇怪的生活。我不知道这是不是月神为我安排的天堂，小太阳——但我很满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: You 'n me, against the whole universe. Kinda love the sound of that, yeah? … Yeah okay and fine, the rest of them can come, too. I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你和我，对抗整个宇宙。挺喜欢这么说的，是吧？……好吧，好吧，其他人也可以来。我想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: We are cute aren't we? I'm okay with cute. Because we are the cutest… I checked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们很可爱，不是吗？我可以接受可爱。因为我们是最可爱的……我已经验证过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: (I love you)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: （我爱你）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Just how "glad" are you, hm? Do I get to send you to your next mission looking all disheveled and breathless?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你到底有多"高兴"，嗯？难道我要让你衣衫不整、气喘吁吁地去执行下一个任务吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Some of the others are jealous of me, you know. In case you needed something to feel good and smug about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 有些人嫉妒我，你知道的。以防你需要点什么来感到高兴和自鸣得意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: What a family we make, no? You, me, my little muffins, the hex, and that mutant freakin' cat that keeps- sorry. Heh. You're trying to be romantic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我们真是个美好的家庭，不是吗？你，我，我的小松饼们，六人组，还有那只该死变异的怪猫——抱歉。嘿嘿。你是想更浪漫一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Used to be worried, thinking if I wasn't the one playing, somebody was gunna be the one playing me. Never been so happy to be wrong…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 我曾经很担心，觉得如果不是我在玩别人，肯定会有人来玩我。从来没有像现在这么高兴自己错了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Happiness is only an Amir away, and I would never actually be away since then I WOULDN'T be happy so we solved it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 幸福只需要一个阿米尔的距离，而我永远不会真正离开，因为那样我就不会快乐了，我们就这样解决了这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.text: Do you know how distracting you are? How hard it is for me not to just grab you by the wrist and - Finish your work. Find me later. Show me how happy you really are to be with me, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMall.zhText: 你知道你有多让人分心吗？我很难控制自己不去直接抓住你的手再——去完成你的工作。待会儿来找我。让我看看你和我在一起有多开心，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: All targets eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 所有目标已被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Quick and efficient. A squad after my own heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 迅速高效。正是我心目中的小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot scrubbed. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者已清除。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Line em up, knock em down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 把他们排成一排，全部解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: High-ranking Scaldra have made the mistake of leading from the front. Put them in the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军的高层犯了一个错误，他们选择了在前线指挥。清除他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Detecting targets of opportunity: Scaldra middle-management. Cull 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 侦测到临时目标：炽蛇军中层管理。剔除他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We must be on their radar, 'cause Scaldra's deployed their muscle. Marking hardened units for elimination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们肯定已经在炽蛇军的雷达上了，因为他们派出了他们的重兵。正在标记那些须要清除的强化单位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Time to sow a little confusion in the ranks. Marking targets: Scaldra commanders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是时候在他们的军队里制造一些混乱了。正在标记目标：炽蛇军指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Trio of double-XL techrot up ahead. Cut 'em down to size.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 前面有三个超级大的科腐者。将它们砍成小块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Detecting big-boy techrot in the vicinity. Too dangerous to leave roaming. Take 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 检测到附近有大型科腐者。放任它们四处游荡太危险了。干掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ick. Nasty Techrot baddies up ahead. Do me a favor, and take out the trash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呸。前面有恶心的科腐者坏蛋。帮我个忙，把这些垃圾清理掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Time to get rid of the overgrown Techrot stomping around like they own this city. Pfft. Like they even paid taxes?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是时候清除那些到处乱窜的自以为是城市主人的超大型科腐者了。哼。搞得好像它们交过税似的？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Static easing. Signal returning. You did it. Mobile Voice radio is back on the dial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 静态杂音正在消失。信号恢复了。你成功了。移动语音广播重新上线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Number one with a bullet. Many bullets actually. Höllvanian resistance lives to broadcast another day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 排名第一。靠的还是无数的子弹。霍瓦尼亚的抵抗组织又可以再撑一天，继续广播！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Pump up the volume. We are coming in crystal clear all across Höllvania. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 调高音量。我们的广播已经清晰传遍霍瓦尼亚。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Looks like the broadcast is safe for now. Let's keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 看来广播暂时安全了。我们继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That little guy is struggling to recover. Try taking out some jammers so it can route more power to its prop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那个小东西正努力恢复中。尝试摧毁一些干扰器，让它能将更多电力用于推进器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Balloon's in recovery mode. Take out the jammers to speed it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 气球处于恢复模式。摧毁干扰器来加速它的恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Balloon's taken too much damage. It's doing its recovery mode thing. Smashing jammers will hurry it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 气球受到太多伤害。它正在进入恢复模式。摧毁干扰器可以加快它的恢复速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ack. Recovery mode. Quick, kill any jammers, that'll get it moving faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哎呀。进入恢复模式了。快，摧毁所有干扰器，这会让它恢复得更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't let anything happen to the balloon. Smash jammers to widen the signal window so the balloon can move faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 不要让气球发生任何事情。破坏干扰器以扩大信号范围，这样气球就可以移动得更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Here we go. Take down anything trying to hurt the balloon. And take out any jammers in the area, that'll let the balloon speed up a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 出发。消灭任何试图伤害气球的目标。并清除区域内的所有干扰器，这样气球就会稍微加快一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's the Mobile Voice balloon. Keep it clear of all attackers and  bust up any signal jammers you find to keep it moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那是移动语音气球。清除所有攻击者，并摧毁所有你发现的信号干扰器，让它继续移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, you found the balloon. Keep it safe, and smash any signal jammers. I do not want to go back to listening to Viktor droning on all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，你找到气球了。保护好它，并摧毁所有信号干扰器。我不想再回去听维克多一整天的长篇大论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's time for the Hex to learn that movement isn't free. RRRRRRRRats! On the streets! Of my city! Ah-gain! Erect the barricades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是时候让六人组明白，行动是需要付出代价的！啊啊啊老鼠！再次！出现在街上！在我的城市里！设置隔离墙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Move the H-09 into position. Cover flanks with ferrocite barricades. Nothing touches my baby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 将 H-09 移到指定位置。用铁基隔离墙掩护侧翼。什么东西都不准碰我的宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Barricades up. Nothing gets through ferrocite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 设置隔离墙。没有任何东西能穿透铁基隔离墙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Quickly, the Hex have been spotted. Engage the barricades, seal the sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 快点，已经发现六人组了。架起隔离墙，封锁这个区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ferrocite barricades? Need something to cut through those, but it won't be easy. Step one, acquire a Transponder from someone with rank.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 铁基隔离墙？需要一些东西来打破它们，但这并不容易。第一步，从有头衔的人那里获取应答器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sol damned! Ferrocite barricades, nothing you got can get past those. Except… Okay. First step, get your hands on a Scaldra Commander's Transponder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 该死的！铁基隔离墙，你用什么都无法突破。除非……好吧。第一步，先拿到炽蛇军指挥官的应答器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ferrocite barricades? That's new. Okay, you need Thermian explosive, to get that, take out Scaldra until you find an Emergency Transponder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 铁基隔离墙？这倒挺新鲜。好吧，你需要热熔炸药，要获得这东西，你得干掉炽蛇军，从他们身上找到紧急应答器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Need gas? Some troops carry gas cans if you catch my drift...murder them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 需要汽油吗？如果你懂我的意思，有些部队会携带汽油罐……干掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: These gas cans are nearly empty. Scaldra must be running low on fuel too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这些汽油罐几乎空了。炽蛇军的燃料肯定也快用完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra units have our gas cans. They just don't know it yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军部队有我们的汽油罐。他们自己还不知道呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra often carry emergency gas cans. You could ask them nicely to borrow? Or not nicely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军经常随身携带应急汽油罐。你可以礼貌地向他们借用？或者不用那么礼貌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now we're cooking with gas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这下跑起来才叫带劲儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Heck yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 太对了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That should grease the wheels a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这下感觉跑得顺滑多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I was just going to suggest you do that. I was. Really.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我正想建议你这么做呢。真的，真的是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Good call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That'll help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这会有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now you're thinking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你终于会动脑子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Just what we needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 正是我们所需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ding! CD ready. Grab and go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 叮！光盘已刻录好了。拿起来走人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's done! Take the CD, we do not have time for a sleeve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 完成了！拿起光盘，我们没时间套保护套了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's it. Make sure you don't scratch it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 就是这样。小心别刮花了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: CD's done. Who's grabbing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 光盘已经好了。谁来拿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: No time for marker art. Pocket that CD and run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 没时间画光盘封面了。把光盘塞进口袋，快跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aannnnd… DONE. Pick that CD up and go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 然后……完成了。快拿起光盘走人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Checking parameters… CD Burn is a go. Look for gas cans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 正在检查参数……光盘刻录可以开始。去找汽油罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: 2x burn speed??? Pfff. Start grabbing gas cans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 刻录速度只有 2 倍？？？呸。快去拿汽油罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ready? One compact disc coming up. Find fuel for the generators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 准备好了没有？一张光盘即将完成。去找燃料给发电机加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: CD is writing. Server power dropping. Need to fuel that generator. Find gas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 光盘正在写入。服务器电量正在下降。得给发电机加油了。去找汽油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Damn cuz. You missed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 该死，老表。你晚了一步了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Supplies destroyed. Pick up the pace next time, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 补给箱自毁了。下次快一点，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot's proper pissed off. Hitters coming out of every nook and crook. I say; let 'em come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者气疯了。打手从各个角落涌出来了。我说，就让他们来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Fam, techrot's well mad. Situation's 'bout to get proper mental.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 家人，科腐者疯子们太癫了。情况快要控制不住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Yo! Supply cache clocked you. Efervon Charge or two, will melt that lock proper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哟！补给储藏箱已经开始计时了。一两个艾弗旺炸药就能完全融掉那把锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Supply cache flipped into self destruct. Get worksy. A few Efervon Charges should pop it. But know this, open that thing and the Techrot'll get riled up crazy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 补给箱进入自毁状态了。快点行动吧。用几个艾弗旺炸药应该就能打开它。但要记住，一旦打开，科腐者就会蜂拥而至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: There's a Scaldra server up ahead, need its manifest file, we're talking hundreds of megabytes. That's right. We need to burn a CD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 前面有一台炽蛇军服务器，我们需要它的清单文件，大概有几百兆。没错。我们需要刻录一张光盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Next stop: data server. It's full of juicy, juicy data, but it's not like we can just copy it onto a floppy; too big. Nope you need to help me burn a CD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 下一站：数据服务器。里面存满了大量有用的数据，但我们不能简单地将它复制到软盘上；数据太大了。不，你得帮我刻录一张光盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's time to burn… a compact disk! A nearby data server contains megabytes of Scaldra comms logs. Get to the server I'll trigger the write.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是时候刻录……一张光盘了！附近的数据服务器含有数兆大的炽蛇军通讯日志。到达服务器后，我会启动写入程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Need you to burn a CD for me at that data server by keeping it powered. NO- it's not the unreleased On-lyne demo songs. This is tactical information critical to our mission! I got the demo days ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 需要你保持服务器运行，并在那上面帮我刻录一张光盘。不，这不是线上时代未发布的样本歌。这是对我们任务至关重要的战术信息！我几天前就已经拿到了样本歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ugh, bloody hell. Nothing ever comes easy in this town, does it? But you did good today. Now get yourself out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃，该死。在这座城里，没有一件事情是容易的，不是吗？不过你今天表现不错。现在赶紧离开这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now it's dead. Viktor has no idea what he's up against. Head home. Rest up. We've got more to do tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在它报废了。维克多根本不知道自己面对的是什么。回家。好好休息。明天我们还有很多事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Take note: the biggest baddies are known to carry passkeys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 请注意：众所周知，大坏蛋通常会携带钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Look for heavy units, they may carry keys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 留意那些重型单位，他们可能携带钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: High ranking units may have their own keys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 高级单位可能拥有自己的钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Take out heavy units, they're often issued passkeys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 消灭重型单位，他们往往有钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You proper sent the techrot back to the stone age.  Now bring it home, fam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你真是把那些科腐者送回了石器时代。现在回家吧，家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You got the worst of it. Now come on home, fam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你已经经历了最糟糕的部分。现在回来吧，家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Over-and-out, fam. Job's a good'un. Nice one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 通讯结束，家人。任务完成得很漂亮。真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Quitting time, fam. Bring it home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 下班时间到了，家人。回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ain't nobody 'gon mess with the Hex now. Not Scaldra, not techrot. Ya' feel me? Now extract yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在没人敢惹六人组了。炽蛇军不敢，科腐者也不敢。你懂吗？现在就撤离吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Wow. Remind me to never get on this squad's bad side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哇哦。提醒我千万不要得罪这个小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Whoa. Slow down. They've had enough. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哇哦。慢点。他们已经够呛了。至少现在是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Whoa. Did you even leave anything for Amir's squad?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哇哦。你们有没有留点什么活给阿米尔的小队？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Enemy resistance has been severely weakened, hopefully that gives the local civies some breathing room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 敌人的抵抗能力已被严重削弱，希望这能给当地居民一些喘息的空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Halfway there, on the job. No quit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 任务完成了一半，继续行动。别放弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Line em up and cut em down. We're half done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 把它们排成一排，然后砍下来。我们已经完成一半了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Yo, Techrot signals down to fifty percent. Take 'em to zero.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哟，科腐者信号下降到百分之五十。把它降为零。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You're clearing 'em out. Bet it smells better n'all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 把它们清理一下，我敢打赌，这样闻起来会好一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ain't no man gettin' bested by no techrotted fax machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 才不会被科腐者感染的传真机打败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra purge-squad thought to sweep the block, got smoked. So, we're cleaning up their whole damn mess. Make things right. Seen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军的清洗部队本来打算清扫这个街区，结果被干掉了。所以，我们得来收拾他们留下的烂摊子。让一切回归正轨。看明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot's off the charts. Full-grown, full-blown. Scaldra patties can't do nothing 'bout it. It's all on us. You wanna play exterminator, fam? Yea, get in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者已经失控了。完全成型。彻底爆发。炽蛇军那帮软脚蟹一点办法都没有。全靠我们了。想当灭虫专家吗？家人，那就上吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra came here, tryna fix a mess they made. Wet boys took one look and legged it. We gonna fix this. We gonna make the block right. Feel me? Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军来到这里，是想收拾他们自己留下的烂摊子。连杀手看了一眼就吓得逃了。我们来解决这个问题。我们会把这个街区恢复正常。懂我意思吗？我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra ops came to purge the block. Tried and died. Now? Quarantine. Civvies got no chance 'less we do the purge ourselves. Hear me? Cutters and shooters gripped. Time to hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军的特工本来是来清理这个街区的。尝试过但都死了。现在呢？封锁隔离。除非我们自己动手清理，否则市民们根本无法生存。听到没有？握紧刀具和枪械。狩猎时间到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sector's vexed. TVs gone mental mashin' up everything they see.  Bout time come we discipline the horror. All of em, we put em in the ground, feel me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这片区域都乱套了。那些电视机像疯了一样，见什么砸什么。是时候收拾这些恐怖玩意儿了。全都干掉，你懂吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The city was a dangerous cesspool, until one squad took matters into their own hands and swept away the filth. That squad's you guys, now make with the bang, bang.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这座城市曾是一个危险的脏地方，直到有一队人挺身而出，清理了这些污秽。那队人就是你们，赶紧开枪吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Clowns to the left of me, mutated consumer electronic monstrosities to the right. Uh… you get the picture, eliminate nearby resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我左边是小丑，右边是变异的消费电子怪物。呃……你明白了，消灭附近抵抗的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Civvies are pinned down in this sector. Scaldra on the surface and Techrot down below. Clear the area. Give them some breathing room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这个区域的市民被困住了。炽蛇军在地面，而科腐者在地下。清理这个区域。给他们一些喘息的空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This area is crawling with hostile forces. Scaldra, Techrot, doesn't matter we need to take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这里到处都是敌方势力。炽蛇军、科腐者，不管怎样，我们都需要消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Spore levels critical. There's no coming back from this. Get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 孢子浓度达到危急值。已经无法挽回了。赶紧离开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Head directly to extraction. Do not pass go, do not collect 200 Höllars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 直接去撤离点。别经过"起点"，那 200 霍币奖励也别想了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I'm calling it. Nothing more you can do. Just get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我要结束任务了。没什么可以做的了。赶紧撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Game over, man. Game over. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 游戏结束，伙计。游戏结束。赶紧到撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Contamination is total. There's no saving it now. Get out while you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 污染已经完全蔓延。现在无法挽救。趁现在还能撤，赶紧走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Man, they don't make PPE strong enough to handle what you're breathing in. Extract. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 伙计，他们制造的防护装备根本防不住你吸入的这些东西。立刻撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You've done enough. Marking extraction. I mean, you could do more. A lot more. You've really just done the minimum at this point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你已经做得够多了。正在标记撤离点。我是说，你还能做更多的。很多很多。其实你刚才做的只是最基本的部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Extraction is ready. I can't ask you to fight any longer… but… if you wanted to fight longer… I wouldn't say no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 撤离点已经准备好。我不能让你再继续战斗了……但……如果你想继续战斗……我也不会阻止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Marking extraction. Use it when you need it, but only if you need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 正在标记撤离点。可以在需要的时候用，但只限于需要的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Extraction's open. But it wouldn't be very much fun if you left now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 撤离点已经开启。但如果你现在离开，就会少了些乐趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You've hit this mission's minimum threshold. But you didn't come down here to do the minimum, did you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你已经达到了这个任务的最低要求了。但你来这里可不是为了达到最低要求的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Okay. Marking extraction. You can pull the ripcord whenever you need to. I won't judge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好吧。已标记撤离点。你可以随时撤离。我不会评判。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Seek out Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 去找卡利莫斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Find Kalymos. Let her know you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 去找卡利莫斯。让她知道你已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos awaits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯在等你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Uh oh, Aoi, looks like my squad's winning this thing. Whatcha gonna do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃哦，碧，看来我的小队要赢得这场比赛了。你打算怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey Aoi, hope you like pineapple on your pizza, cause my squad just took the lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，碧，希望你喜欢比萨上的菠萝，因为我的小队刚刚领先了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: All the girls I've dated, they both said I'm the fastest. So it should come as no surprise that my squad is winning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我约过的所有女孩子都说我是最快的。所以我的小队现在赢了一点也不奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't look now, Amir. We just took the lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 别看了，阿米尔。我们刚刚领先了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Try not to choke on all our dust, little buddy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 别被我们扬起的灰尘呛到了啊，小伙子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't let this get you down, Amir. My squad is just really, really good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 别灰心，阿米尔。我的小队真的真的很厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: My code is… working! Hell-scrubbers primed. Techrot regurgitating. Watch out for Scaldra, they want those Scrubbers back to protect their own bases.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我的代码……成功了！地狱净化器准备好了。科腐者正在反刍。小心炽蛇军，他们想要回这些净化器来保护他们的基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's working. Hell-Scrubbers are starting to emerge. Gotta hand it to the little guy, he knows how to talk to the appliances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 起效了。地狱净化器开始出现。不得不佩服这个小家伙，他知道怎么跟这些设备对话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: What's the matter, Techrot, got a little tummy ache? Hell-Scrubber coming up. Scaldra noticed too. They're coming for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 怎么了，科腐者，肚子有点疼吗？地狱净化器来了。炽蛇军也注意到了。他们来找你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Amir's code injection is like activated charcoal to the Techrot. Makes 'em puke these Hell-Scrubbers right back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔的代码注入就像是给科腐者吃了活性炭。让它们立刻把这些地狱净化器吐出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Code injected. Hell-scrubbers emerging. Oooh,  Scaldra just noticed what we're up to and they are p-i-s-s-ed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 代码注入成功。地狱净化器开始出现。噢，炽蛇军刚刚注意到我们的行动了，他们可——生——气——了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I hear Scaldra want these things back, but not even Scaldra is willing to come down here with all this rot. Good thing you're not as smart as Scaldra. Now get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我听说炽蛇军想要回这些东西，但炽蛇军也不愿意来这种周围是科腐者的地方。幸好你没有炽蛇军那么聪明。现在，开始行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: While Scaldra is distracted, I'm taking the opportunity to make some new acquisitions. Like this. Don't worry, I'll share.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 当炽蛇军分心的时候，我趁机搞了一些新玩意儿。就像这个。别担心，我会分享的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Turns out it's not just Hell-Scrubbers coming out of the rot, there's some stuff we might be interested in. Like this. See, my ass is out here on the line too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 看来科腐者中冒出来的不仅仅是地狱净化器，还有些我们可能会感兴趣的东西。就像这个。看，我也在这冒着险呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Find an Emergency Transponder. I don't see another way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 找到紧急应答器。我看不出还有其他办法了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You need to find an Emergency Transponder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你需要找到一个紧急应答器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot Pheroglands. Grab them, and take them to Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者费洛蒙腺体。拿着它们，并把它们带到卡利莫斯那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Grab those Pheroglands and let Kalymos have a whiff of them. That will help her find our target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 拿那些费洛蒙腺体，让卡利莫斯闻一闻。可以帮她找到我们的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Pheroglands. Reeking, saturated with hormones, and a sure sign a Legacyte is nearby. Kalymos wants a sniff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 费洛蒙腺体。散发着恶臭，充满荷尔蒙，这是附近有传承者存在的明显迹象。卡利莫斯想闻一闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Citizens, an object lesson in extremist self-delusion: the, uh "Hex"? Is it? High on their own supply they mean to murder the Scaldra commander devoted to keeping the infestation from your beds. But fear not. They march themselves towards purification only. Cameras rolling? Excellent. Watch and learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们，这是极端主义者自我欺骗的典型例子：呃，"六人组"？是吗？他们沉浸在自己的幻想中，打算谋杀那位致力于防止科腐者进入你们床铺的炽蛇军指挥官。但不用害怕。他们只会走向净化。摄像机在拍摄？很好。好好看，好好学。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This isn't your city. We're here to evict you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这不是你的城市。我们来是为了驱逐你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Arthur, Aaaaaarthur. How does it feel? I wonder. To send your friends to die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亚瑟，亚——亚瑟。感觉怎么样？我很好奇。让你的朋友们去送死，是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I'd ask you the same, but I don't believe there's anyone who'd rightly call you friend, Viktor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我本想问你同样的问题，但我不相信有谁会正经地称你为朋友，维克多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Arthur Nightingale, if it weren't for the disease that disfigures your body and soul you'd be just one more dead idealist in a pile of dead idealists whilst I am Höllvania's very raison d'être. Scaldra looks to me, not just for leadership, but inspiration. While you… you're a few slender chromosomes away from corpsehood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亚瑟·南丁格尔，如果不是那个让你身体和灵魂都扭曲的病，你也不过是堆积在一群死去的理想主义者中的一具尸体，而我则是霍瓦尼亚存在的唯一理由。炽蛇军需要我，不仅是为了领导，也是为了启发。而你……你离变成尸体只差几根纤细的染色体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh Viktor, you really are the most insufferable prick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，维克多，你真是个最令人无法忍受的混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh… You've really kicked the hornet's nest now. Full Alert active. Hope you know what you're doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦……你现在真的是捅了马蜂窝。全面警报已启动。希望你知道自己在做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Security at Full Alert. Brilliant. You know, you could have kept things simple. In and out. Job done. Why do you always have to make things so complicated?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 安全系统处于全面戒备状态。太棒了。你知道，你其实可以把事情弄得简单一点。进进出出。任务就完成了。你为什么总是把事情搞得这么复杂？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Security at Full Alert. One tank not enough for you? You had to call in all of Scaldra? Tell you what - make it out alive and I'll buy you a beer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 安全系统处于全面戒备状态。一辆坦克不够你的吗？非得叫整个炽蛇军来吗？告诉你吧——要是能活着出来，我请你喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ooo, you trying to get fancy? They've detected your breach and raised the security level. Breach their systems again and their resistance is only going to get more fierce.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，你是在耍花招吗？他们已经检测到你的入侵并提高了安全级别。如果再次入侵他们的系统，他们的抵抗只会更加激烈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Bold move. Security level just ratcheted up. If you got a death wish, this is one way to get your wish granted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 大胆的举动。安全级别刚刚提高了。如果你有求死的愿望，这确实是一个实现愿望的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You deliberately trying to make this harder? Keep breaching their security and you'll get exactly what you're asking for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你是故意让事情变得更难吗？持续攻破他们的安全系统，你就会得到你想要的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It has been broken. Harvest it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它已经被击溃了。收割它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now, consume the beast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在，吞噬这头野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hurry, harvest now. End this generation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 快点，赶紧收割。结束这一代。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Amir's intel suggests the armor's weakest around the vents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔的情报表明，装甲最薄弱的地方是在排气孔周围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Um… Try hitting the exhaust vents. Worked in a movie I saw once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嗯……试着打排气口。我在电影里看到过这种方法管用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's gotta have a weakness. Try the vents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它肯定有一个弱点。试试排气孔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aim for the vents. Just above the treads.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 瞄准排气孔。就在履带上方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The vents! Shoot the blasted vents!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 排气孔！射那些该死的排气孔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Priming another Hell-Scrubber for regurgitation. Disgusting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 为再次反刍准备另一个地狱净化器。恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Serving up another Hell-Scrubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又一个地狱净化器准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Reactivating code. And success. Keep your eyes up for another Hell-Scrubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 正在重新激活代码。成功了。请密切关注下一个地狱净化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another Hell-Scrubber getting puked up… Although it's only puke if it comes out of the Techrot's… mouth… but that's not a mouth. Blghh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又一个地狱净化器正被吐出来……不过，只有从科腐者的……嘴巴里出来才算呕吐……但那根本不算嘴巴。哕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hell-Scrubber coming up near you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 地狱净化器就在你附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hell-Scrubber ready for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 已经给你准备好地狱净化器了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another Hell-Scrubber is wherever you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 另一个地狱净化器就在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Baby's gurgling. New Hell-Scrubber bubbling up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 宝宝在咕噜咕噜响。新的地狱清洗器正在冒出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: One scrubber, side of spores, coming up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一个净化器，外加孢子，来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: They won't miss this. Actually… they probably will. Probably a lot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 他们可能不会在意这个。其实……可能会吧。而且会很在意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You got any use for this??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这个对你有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Check it out. All your base are belong to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 来看看。"你们的基地现在都是我的了"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I'll set this aside for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我会帮你留着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Cha-ching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 发财啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This might just make it all worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这可能让一切都变得值得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You're fighting to make Höllvania more livable, but also for this little goodie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你战斗是为了让霍瓦尼亚变得更宜居，也为了拿到这个小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I know it's not your birthday but… what more could a time traveler from the far distant future want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我知道今天不是你的生日，但是……对于一个来自遥远未来的时间旅行者来说，还有什么比这更棒的呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Psst. You keep fighting, and I keep yoinking. See?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘘。你继续战斗，我继续捡漏。怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sure, sometimes I get a little depressed, but then I remember that I get to scavenge for lost treasure in the festering pus of an overgrown cyst. So yeah…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 当然，有时候我会有点抑郁，不过一想到自己可以在这个长满脓包的巨大囊肿中寻宝。所以，也还行吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: More goodies for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 更多好东西给我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: ¡Qué padre!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: ¡Qué padre!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Can you believe they just left this in an armor plated heavily guarded safe? Yoink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你能相信他们居然把这个放在一个装甲严密、戒备森严的保险箱里吗？拿走拿走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, what do we have here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，这里面有什么好东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ooh! This should come in handy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 噢！这个应该很有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ah, could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 啊，还不算太坏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra really needs to keep better tabs on their stuff… "Someone" keeps stealing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军真应该好好地看管他们的东西……"有人"一直在偷它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I'll add this to the pile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我把这个也加到战利品堆里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Got a present for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 给你带来了一份礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Bingo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 太棒啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't mind if I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那我就不客气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's not my birthday, but I'll take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 虽然今天不是我的生日，但我还是会收下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Picked up a five finger discount on this bad boy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这玩意儿是我顺手牵羊捡来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: There's more where this came from. Just need time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 还有更多的东西，只是需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh wow, I am learning some new bad words on the Scaldra comms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，哇，我在炽蛇军通讯中学到了一些新的脏话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, don't say I never did anything for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，别说我从没为你做过什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Busy day of work ahead of us so I'm splitting you up. Aoi, Amir, you each take a squad. Time's crucial; squad that finishes objectives last gets to play Big Bytes pizza chef tonight. Let that put some pep in your step.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 今天会特别忙，所以我让你们分开行动。碧、阿米尔，你们每人带一个小队。时间紧急，最后完成目标的小队要在今晚扮演超级比特披萨厨师。希望这能给你们加把油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aoi, Amir. You have your objectives. Need them done fast and need them done right. First squad to get their work done gets pizza dinner tonight. The second squad to get their work done is making their pizza. Understood? Get moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 碧，阿米尔。你们有各自的任务。需要快速完成，还要正确完成。第一个完成任务的小队今晚晚餐可以吃披萨。第二个完成任务的小队要自己动手做披萨。明白了吗？快行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Okay Aoi and Amir, think your squads need a little incentive for today's jobs? Fine. This is a race. Squad that finishes last makes pizza for the winners. Big Bytes counter, cap, apron and all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好吧，碧和阿米尔，觉得你们的小队今天需要点额外的动力吗？很好。这是一场比赛。最后一名的队伍为获胜者做披萨。站超级比特柜台、戴上帽子、穿好围裙什么的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Transmission strength is waning. If you take out the jammers that balloon can move a little faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 信号强度正在减弱。如果你破坏掉那些干扰器，气球就能稍微移动快一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: They're jamming our signal and it doesn't even taste like strawberries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 他们在干扰我们的信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Signal jammer is causing the balloon to reduce velocity to manage the signal vector- eh… just smash the jammer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 信号干扰器正在使气球减速以调整信号向量……呃……直接摧毁那个干扰器吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Signal's dipping. Find the jammers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 信号在减弱。找到那些干扰器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Jammers nearby! The sooner you take them out, the sooner Mobile Voice will be safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 附近有干扰器！你越早消除它们，移动语音气球就越安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stay on top of those jammers, squad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 小队，紧盯那些干扰器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Good. Keep her safe while she sniffs out the Techrot's darling Legacyte.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 很好。在她嗅出科腐者的宝贝传承种时，保证她的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's it, Kalymos! Good girl! Now, we are not going to let any harm come to that precious feline, are we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯，就是这样！真乖！现在，我们可不能让那只宝贵的小猫受到伤害，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos will have the Legacyte's trail soon. Ensure her safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯很快就会发现传承种的踪迹。确保她的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos is hurt! She's recovering, but you need to protect her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯受伤了！她正在恢复，但需要你保护她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos! Quickly now. To her side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯！快点。到她身边来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos! She needs you now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯！她现在需要你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: She hurts. You must protect her or she cannot help you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 她受伤了。你必须保护她，否则她帮不了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos is working hard to find the Legacyte for us, so the least we can do is protect her, don't you agree?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯在努力为我们寻找传承种，至少我们可以做的是保护她，你说对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: They've hurt her. Rally to her side while she recovers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它们伤害了她。在她恢复期间，待在她身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos is in pain. She cannot track the Legacyte unprotected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯很痛苦。她无法在无人保护的情况下追踪传承种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos has its scent. Keep her safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯闻到它的气味了。保护她的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another Legacyte has finished gestating. Kalymos has the scent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 另一只传承种已经孕育出来。卡利莫斯闻到气味了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I feel the birth of a new Legacyte.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我感受到了新的传承种的诞生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: And again, the Techrot spawns a Legacyte. It has learned. It is stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又来了，科腐者创造了一个传承种。它学到了东西。它变得更强大了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The Techrot is relentless, its stamina unending. We must match its resolve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者不知疲倦，它的体力永无止境。我们必须与它的决心抗衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Amir's getting strange readings from that tank. You better finish it off quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔从那辆坦克中得到了奇怪的读数。你最好快点把它解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I've got a bad feeling. Finish it off fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我有种不祥的预感。快点把它解决掉吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Running out of time, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 时间不多了，碧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aoi, how could you think you'd be faster than me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 碧，你怎么会觉得你比我快呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Who's hungry? I know I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 谁饿了？我知道我饿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's okay, Amir. There's no shame in being second best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 没关系，阿米尔。当第二名没什么可丢人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Looks like we continue to be on a one way trip to Winsville.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 看来我们还在通往胜利之城的单行道上呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Aoi, did you need my squad to slow down so your guys could catch up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，对不起，碧，你需要我让我们小队慢下来，让你们追上吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Just so you know, Aoi, I like two cans of pineapple on my pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 顺便说一下，碧，我喜欢我的比萨上放两罐菠萝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Would you look at that, Amir, we're still in the lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 瞧瞧这个，阿米尔，我们依然领先。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hate to break it to you, Amir, you guys are in second place. Also known as last place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 很遗憾告诉你，阿米尔，你们现在是第二名。也就是最后一名。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Catch up, Amir. I want this to be fair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 加油，阿米尔。我希望这场比赛是公平的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You let it get away! Kalymos has completely lost the scent. There is nothing more you can do. Come home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你让它逃了！卡利莫斯完全丢失了气味。你什么也做不了了。回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The beast has fled. It'll go into hiding and no new Legacyte will gestate. Nothing more to do but head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 怪物已经逃跑了。它会躲起来，不会再孵化新的传承种了。除了前往撤离点，没有什么事可以做的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's gone. This mission is a total loss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它已经逃走了。这次任务彻底失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It is on the move. It must not escape or we'll never find it again, and this mission will be a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它在移动。绝不能让它逃走，否则我们将再也找不到它，这次任务就会失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's trying to run! Stop it. Escape is failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它在试图逃跑！快阻止它。逃脱就是失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It flees. Stop it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它在逃跑。阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The beast seeks sanctuary. Give it no quarter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那野兽想寻找庇护。不要手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's on the run. Give chase.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它在逃跑，追上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The Legacyte tries to flee.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传承种试图逃跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's scared and wants to escape. Finish it first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它害怕了，想要逃跑。先解决它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos found the Legacyte. Harvest it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯找到了传承种。收割它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Our faithful Kavat has roused the prey. Bring it down and drain it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们忠实的库娃已经惊动了猎物。将它击倒并抽干它的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: There it is. The Techrot's latest debutante. Take it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 就是它了。科腐者的最新成员。把它解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another stirs. What horrific adaptations has this one developed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 另一个又出现了。这次它发展出了什么可怕的适应能力？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Your target has surfaced! Take it down before it dives back into the mulch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你的目标出现了！在它钻回覆盖物之前，赶紧把它消灭掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: She has done it. Legacyte in the area. Your rightful prey. Take it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 她做到了。传承种就在这片区域。你应得的猎物。拿下它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A beast as voracious as the Techrot itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一只和科腐者一样贪婪的野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Legacytes are not your average Techrot conglomeration of electronics and biomass. They are more evolved, more akin to Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传承种并非普通的由电子设备和生物质组成的科腐者聚合体。它们更加进化，更类似于战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The Techrot learns from you, and others like you. It sees your powers and copies them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者从你和你一样的人身上学习。它看到你的能力并加以模仿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot; it consumes, and it learns. And the only thing we can do is try to destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者；它吞噬，它学习。而我们唯一能做的，只有尽力消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It is done. Either flee to extraction now, or if you have it in you, ask Kalymos to find the next Legacyte. Remember, the Techrot evolves quickly, and your next battle will be harder still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 任务完成。现在可以逃往撤离点，或者如果你有能力的话，可以让卡利莫斯寻找下一个传承种。请记住，科腐者进化得很快，你的下一场战斗将更加艰难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sweet Lua! I can see it. All that was taken from Höllvania and her people. Funneled into this… monster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 月神啊！我看到了。所有从霍瓦尼亚和她的人民那里夺走的，然后汇聚成这个……怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: With every Legacyte we cut down, a new one instantly emerges. How deep does this go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们每砍倒一个传承种，就会有新的立刻出现。这水到底有多深？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Do not mourn for the Legacyte. It is but one appendage of the sprawling Techrot mass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 不用为传承种哀悼。它只是科腐者庞大群体中的一个附属物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It will learn from what you just did to it. Harvest again, but know it will be tougher next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它会从你刚刚对它做的事中吸取教训。再收割一次，但要知道，下次它会更强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: So we reclaim what the Techrot has taken from us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 所以，我们要夺回科腐者从我们身上夺走的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos is ready to hunt again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯已经准备好再次狩猎了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Our feline friend yearns for another hunt. Will you oblige?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们的猫咪朋友迫不及待地想要再次狩猎。你愿意帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Remember, we harvest the Techrot's offspring to protect humanity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 请记住，我们收割科腐者的后代是为了保护人类。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The next one will not be easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 下一个就不会那么简单了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We are teaching the rot how to fight like a Warframe. Yet I see no other way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们在教会科腐者如何像战甲一样战斗。但我找不到其他办法了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Your stamina is quite impressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你的耐力真的很令人印象深刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: With each Legacyte I can hear the Techrot's screams grow louder. Make it hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 随着每只传承种的出现，我都能听到科腐者的尖叫声越来越大。让它痛苦吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: How many more can you bring down? How long can you last?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你还能击倒多少个？你能坚持多久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Surely this is the last, unless… heh. Do I sense the fighting urge still burning in you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这应该是最后一个了，除非…… 呵呵。我是不是感觉到了你的战斗欲望还在燃烧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: If you need to leave, know that Legacytes this far evolved can rarely sustain themselves for more than a couple of days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 如果你需要离开，要知道，进化到这种程度的传承种，通常撑不过几天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We thank Sol for this bountiful harvest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们感谢太阳神给我们带来如此丰收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This will help our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这将对我们的事业大有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: What you take now, will help us in the future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你现在拿走的东西，在未来会对我们有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Kalymos is ready for more. Are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 卡利莫斯已经准备好再次出击了。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Lockbox up ahead. Scaldra doesn't trust its people, so the box needs multiple keys to unlock. Find the keys and get that box open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 前面有一个保险箱。炽蛇军不信任自己人，因此这个箱子需要多把钥匙才能打开。找到钥匙并打开那个箱子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A mysterious box. Multiple keys and a self-destruct sequence. Will one squad walk away with the treasure, or will it all go up in smoke?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一个神秘的箱子。需要多把钥匙，还有一个自毁程序。这个小队会带走宝藏，还是会将一切都化为乌有？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Seeing a lockbox. You know the drill. I've marked approximate key locations on your map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 看到一个保险箱。你知道该怎么做。我已经在你的地图上标出了钥匙的大致位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ooh. Scaldra lockbox on radar. That means goodies! Keys can be found in the marked vicinity. Taking out enemies will help me narrow down their location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦。雷达上出现了炽蛇军的保险箱。这意味着有好东西！钥匙在标记点的附近可以找到。消灭敌人将帮助我找到它们的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You got a passkey. Take it to the lockbox before it goes poof.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你拿到了一把钥匙。在它自毁之前把它带到保险箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: These passkeys have a self-annihilation protocol when held by unauthorized personnel. Spoiler alert, that's you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这些钥匙被未授权的人持有时会自行销毁。剧透警告，你就是那个人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's the first passkey. Timer's ticking, use it or lose it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这是第一把钥匙。时间不等人，赶紧用，否则就没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Passkey! Hurry or you'll end up like my second-cousin who liked to play pranks with fireworks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 钥匙！快点，不然你的下场可能会和我那爱玩烟花恶作剧的二表哥一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Well what do we have here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，这里面有什么东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Phew. Can you imagine if it was empty? That would be a bummer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呼。你能想象如果是空的会怎样吗？那会很扫兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Cha-ching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哗啦啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This belongs to the people anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 反正这是属于人民的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey Squad, we need to pick up the pace. Chop chop. Come on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，小队，我们得加快速度。快点。加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: If Aoi wins this thing, she'll never let me forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 如果碧赢了这场比赛，她会一直提这件事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Can't you go faster. I could go faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你们不能快点吗？我可以更快哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Guys! We got to pick it up. I hate pineapple on my pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 伙计们！我们要加把劲。我讨厌在披萨上放菠萝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Squad. We cannot lose to Amir. The gloating will never stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 小队。我们不能输给阿米尔。否则他会一直嘚瑟下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Pick up the pace!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 提速！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Come on home. I'll start prepping the dough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 快回来吧。我要开始准备面团了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's all over, squad. I know you tried. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一切都结束了，小队。我知道你尽力了。赶快撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, we helped the people of Höllvania and that's what counts. Get to the extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，我们帮助了霍瓦尼亚的人民，这才是最重要的。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Amir is NEVER gonna let me live this down. Time to come home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔会一直拿这事开玩笑。该回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I wonder, Hex. If we stick your lifeless putrid heads on a stake in my town square, as our ancestors did, do you think that will scare off the rest of the Techrot? I am unsure, but it's worth a shot don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我在想，六人组。如果我们像祖先那样，把你们毫无生气的腐烂的头插到我城市广场的旗杆上，你觉得这能吓跑其他科腐者吗？我不确定，但值得一试，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: About as effective as anything else you've done to stop the Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 就和你做的其他事一样，这招对科腐者一点用都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Nightingale, nightingaaale. Do you think the citizens of my fair city will rise up and follow your beautiful song? Have you looked in the mirror. You are as hideous as the blight they cower from. You are a common thrush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 南丁格尔，南丁格尔——你觉得我这座美丽城市的市民会奋起追随你美丽的歌声吗？你照照镜子看看。你和他们畏惧的灾难一样丑陋。你不过是只普通的画眉鸟罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: This pillock is going to get this entire town killed. Mark my words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这个傻子最终会害死整座城市的人。记住我说的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Some see the Techrot as a disaster. I see the opportunity to remake this city, my city. No more of the laziness, the blasphemy, the mental rot. This is my chance to cleanse, to purge, to make this city powerful once again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 有些人把科腐者当作灾难。而我看到了重塑这座城市的机会，属于我的城市。不再有懒惰、亵渎和精神腐化。这是我净化、清除、让这座城市再次伟大的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Never waste a crisis, right Viktor? Oh, how I wish you understood just how outmatched you were, and I don't mean by us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 永远不浪费危机，对吧，维克多？哦，我多么希望你能明白，你是多么的不堪一击，而我说的可不是我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I am not fooled, Hex. You and the Techrot are one and the same. You are freaks. Terminally so. Your death will be a mercy. It will be an absolution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我可不会上当，六人组。你们和科腐者是一样的。你们是怪物。永远是怪物。你们的死才是对你们的仁慈。一种解脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A mercy would be you shutting up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 仁慈就是你闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A formidable effort. Do you think you can do more next time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 真是出色的表现。你觉得下次你还能完成更多吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Unbelievable. You were unstoppable. Hmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 难以置信。你真是势不可挡。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Your physical fortitude is matched only by your mental fitness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你的身体素质与你的心理健康同样优秀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: What drives you so hard? Those Legacytes never stood a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是什么让你如此拼命？那些传承种完全不是对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You have dealt the Techrot a great blow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你已经对科腐者造成了巨大的打击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Splendid hunting all round.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 总体来说狩猎非常出色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The Techrot is in agony. A cause for celebration. Cheers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者正处于痛苦之中。值得庆祝的事情。干杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I don't know who is more satisfied with this outing, myself… or Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我不知道谁对这次出游更满意，是我……还是卡利莫斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aoi, Amir, what in Sol is going on out there? What happened to your squads?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 碧、阿米尔，那边到底发生了什么事？你们的小队怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It is harvest time. Your crop? The Techrot Legacyte. An evolving beast that consumes untold resources during gestation. Harvest enough of them and perhaps we can deplete the Techrot. Kalymos is prowling nearby. She'll guide you to your target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 收割的时间到了。你的收获是什么？科腐者传承种。这是一种不断进化的生物，在孕育过程中会消耗无数的资源。收割足够多的传承种，也许我们就能耗尽科腐者的力量。卡利莫斯正在附近潜行。她会引导你找到目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Good morning, Höllvania. How are all we today? Good? Excellent. To the point: you have become weak and you crave what only I can supply - discipline. The H. Oh. Nine. They are, by contrast, strong. They are fierce. And they are unyielding. True. Soldiers NOW: we begin the first step in returning this city to the strength and glory she once knew. Under my watchful gaze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 早安，霍瓦尼亚。大家今天过的怎么样？还不错？很好。言归正传：你们已变得软弱，渴望我所提供的东西——纪律。H。0。9。相比之下，它们很强悍。它们很凶猛。而且它们坚不可摧。没错。士兵们，现在：我们开始迈出第一步，让这座城市恢复昔日的力量和荣耀。在我的严密监视下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That bastard wants to flatten this city just to be king of the rubble. Need you to break past Scaldra barricades and turn Viktor's tank into a scrap heap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那个混蛋想要把这座城市夷为平地，只为了成为废墟上的王。需要你突破炽蛇军的隔离墙，把维克多的坦克变成一堆废铁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We shall starve the Techrot of vital nutrients by forcing it to create Legacyte after Legacyte. Fair warning: each beast will be stronger than the last. If you are still game, follow Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们将迫使科腐者不断制造传承种，来消耗它们的关键养分。提醒一下：每一只怪物都会比上一只更强。如果你还想继续，就跟着卡利莫斯吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: As a beehive works tirelessly to support its Queen, the Techrot hoards resources to grow and evolve its Legacytes. We will harvest its precious Legacytes and nip its growth in the bud. Follow Kalymos. She will track your prey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 就像蜂群不知疲倦地为其蜂后工作一样，科腐者会积累资源来培育和进化其传承种。我们将收割它们珍贵的传承种并将其扼杀在萌芽状态。跟随卡利莫斯。她会追踪你的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: H-09 Tanks by the glory of Lua… etcetera etcetera… cleanse this city.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: H-09 坦克，以月神的荣耀……等等……净化这座城市。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Bollocks. His tanks are here to tighten his stranglehold on Höllvania. Marking a tank. Let's ruin his day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 胡说八道。他的坦克是来加强他对霍瓦尼亚的控制的。正在标记一辆坦克。让我们来毁掉他的一天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Citizens: loss of property or persons is forever the price of protection. Do not obstruct the tanks. Höllvania endures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们：财产或人员的损失永远是保护的代价。不要阻挡坦克。霍瓦尼亚永存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: "Price of protection." Viktor writes the cheques and the people of Höllvania pay with their lives. Get in there and take those tanks out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: "保护的代价。"维克多开的支票，而霍瓦尼亚的居民则用他们的生命来支付。冲进去，摧毁那些坦克。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Our soldiers stand as liberators, their rifles? Keys. Thought, your prison. Celebrate the tanks which safeguard your hovels and byways. Cheer as those who celebrate death pop beneath their tracks. Höllvania endures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们的士兵是解放者，他们的步枪？而是钥匙。思想才是你们的牢笼。赞颂那些保卫你的棚屋和小路的坦克。当那些庆祝死亡的人被坦克履带碾过时，为他们欢呼。霍瓦尼亚永存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Is that so? Alright, Hex, how about we show Viktor where we stand. Trash that tank.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 是这样吗？好的，六人组，不如我们向维克多表明我们的立场。毁掉那辆坦克。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Höllvania. Your house is in disarray, my trust in you spectacularly misplaced. Tear your orbs from the bloodless glow of whatever screen has you transfixed and witness what becomes of those who stray. H-09s: showtime. Oh… and have fun with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚。你的家园一片混乱，我对你的信任放错了地方。从那些让你目不转睛的屏幕上移开你的视线，看看那些背离我们的人会变成什么样子。H-09 坦克：表演时间到了。哦……好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hear that? If only we'd all bowed to that massive ego earlier, we wouldn't be in the mess. Huh, well, way I see it, no reason to start now. Let's take out his tank.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 听到了吗？如果我们早点向那个自负的家伙低头，就不会有今天的麻烦了。不过，好吧，我觉得现在也没必要开始低头了。干掉他的坦克吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: After the untimely disappearance of our beloved Major Rusalka, it falls to yours truly, to set Höllvania straight. Scaldra, deploy the H-09.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 在我们敬爱的鲁莎卡少校不幸失踪后，责任就落在了我身上，来让霍瓦尼亚恢复正轨。炽蛇军，部署 H-09。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Disappearance? So they don't know where she is either. Time to press our luck, your target is Viktor's beloved H-09.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 失踪？看来他们也不知道她在哪里。是时候碰碰运气了，你的目标是维克多心爱的 H-09。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Gotta solid move: abandoned supply cache. Now listen up: if you get close, it'll clock you, and start a countdown. Bust into the cache before it's smoked. Seen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 得到可靠情报：废弃的补给储藏箱。听好了：一旦你靠近它，它就会开始倒计时。在它自爆之前冲进去。明白？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra supply cache in the area. You get near, it will start ticking. Self-destruct. Need to be quick to get the goods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这里有炽蛇军的补给储藏箱。靠近后，箱子会开始倒计时。然后自毁。需要快速行动才能获得补给品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't look now but you got a Stormfall squad coming your way. Want to find out what Thermian rockets will do to that thing's armor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在别去看，但有一支风袭部队正朝你们过来。想看看热熔火箭炮对那东西的装甲有多大效果吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Got another report from Amir, that tank's armor plating is made of Ferrocite. Know what that means, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又收到阿米尔的报告，那辆坦克的装甲板是由铁基做的。你知道这意味着什么，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall, descend upon them. Show no quarter. Show no mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队，降落在他们身上。毫不留情。决不手软。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Our prize must survive. Our plans depend on it. Stormfall, eliminate these, these rats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们的宝贵资产必须保全。我们的计划依赖于它。风袭部队，消灭这些老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall, do your thing. Make it brutal or don't bother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队，做你们该做的事。狠一点，否则别浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Enough! Stormfall, may Sol guide you to greatness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 够了！风袭部队，愿太阳神指引你们走向伟大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall. Deploy. Give our lady Lua something to weep over tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队。部署。让我们的女神月神今晚为此哭泣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You are trying my patience with these antics. Stormfall troops. Make these heathens go away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你们在搞这些小把戏来挑战我的耐心。风袭部队。让这些异教徒消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hex, I keep kicking you OVER and OVER again like a big dumb dead horse and you DON'T learn and I'm tired, I'm so tired. Stormfall, please, save me the bother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 六人组，我一遍又一遍地踢你，就像踢一匹死马，你就是不学乖，我累了，真的累了。风袭部队，请你们，让我省省心？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Huh, It's the Hex again? Really? Okay. I want you to ask yourself. Could this have been a paratrooper thing? Could Stormfall deal with them? Yeah? Ok.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 啊，又是六人组？真的吗？好吧。我想让你自己问问自己。这会是伞兵干的事吗？风袭部队能对付他们吗？嗯？好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: These things are no better than pond scum. Unclean and unholy. Stormfall - purge them from my city, will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这些东西和池塘里的浮渣没什么两样。肮脏又邪恶。风袭部队——把他们从我的城市里清除出去，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Why do you find it so difficult to get rid of these... these slugs? Throw more troops at them. Shall I write it on your hand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 怎么就这么难摆脱这些……这些鼻涕虫？再派些部队去对付他们。是要我写在你手上吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Is there a unit ready? Good. Deploy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 有部队准备好了吗？很好。部署。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Once again my hour of meditation has been disturbed. My sancta sanctorum has been decimated. You will suffer for this. In a million future lives of surpassing wretchedness! Stormfall units, descend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又一次，我的冥想时间被打扰了。我的圣殿被摧毁了。你们将为此付出代价。在未来无数的痛苦生命中！风袭部队，降临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall unit, my children, as you prepare to descend from on high, take a moment to read the Prayer to Sol which you can of course find on your Credo card. We are not dying in a state of sin today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队，我的孩子们，当你们准备从天而降时，先花点时间阅读一下你们的太阳神祷文，当然，你们可以在信条卡上找到它。今天，我们不会带着罪死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall, have faith that your sacrifice today in the name of Sol and Scaldra will not be in vain… A place has surely been prepared for you in the Hall of Heroes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队，请相信，你今天为了太阳神和炽蛇军做出的牺牲不会白费……英雄堂里已经为你们准备好了位置。
