/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall, you are going up against the most dangerous breed of Techrot, The Hex. Best of luck to you. Good hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队，你将要面对的是最危险的科腐者品种，六人组。祝你们好运。祝你们狩猎愉快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I have explained it to you until I am bleeding from the eyes. The answer is right there in front of your gawking moon-cheese of a face. SHOOT. THEM. UNTIL. THEY. STAY. DEAD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我已经解释得眼睛都快出血了。答案就摆在你那张傻乎乎的脸面前。开枪。开到他们死透为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hex… why do you insist on refusing your medicine? Has it escaped you that I command a literal army? Stormfalll Paratroopers engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 六人组……为什么你这么固执地拒绝吃药？难道你们没意识到我指挥的是一支真正的军队吗？风袭伞兵，准备出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Citizens! Fear not. We have the situation under control, as I speak, the planes you hear above your head are delivering elite troops to neutralize The Hex. Rest assured, this criminal organization will be eliminated. With extreme prejudice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们！不要害怕，我们已经掌控了局势。就在我说话的同时，头顶上的飞机正将精英部队送来清除六人组。放心，这个犯罪组织会被彻底消灭。绝不留情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall paratroopers inbound. Wrestle those RPGs from their cold, dead, hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭伞兵即将到达。赶紧从他们冰冷的尸体上抢走那些火箭炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall squad deploying. Watch the skies, intercept and capture a Thermian RPG.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队正在部署。留意天空，拦截并夺取热熔火箭炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That did it. Stormfall squad coming. You want their Thermian weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 做到了。风袭部队来了。你要的是他们的热熔火箭炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Stormfall Squad inbound. Lock and load, these are the big boys, 'cause they don't trust the rookies with the heavy hardware.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 风袭部队即将到达。准备上膛，这些可是大人物，因为他们不放心让新兵拿这些重型武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Battery maxed. Routing excess power to the burn. We're talking 4, 8, maybe even 16x speed, baby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 电量已满。将多余电力用于刻录。我们说的是 4 倍、8 倍，甚至 16 倍速，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: 100% power. We're overclocking the burn now, keep those gas cans coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 电量 100%。我们现在正在超频刻录，继续送来汽油罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We're at full power! Any excess fuel will boost the burn speed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们已经在全功率运行了！任何额外的燃料都将提升刻录速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Look at you squad, you maxed out the gennie. Routing excess power to burn speed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 看看你们，小队，你们已经让发电机输出最大化了。正在把多余的电力用来提高刻录速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ah, server's gone dark, there's still time to salvage the burn. Look for a gas can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 啊，服务器断电了，我们还有时间去挽救这次刻录。快找汽油罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Server says: Power failure. Systems down. Bring me petroleum gasoline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 服务器显示：电源故障。系统已关闭。给我带点汽油来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Gas, people, we need gas!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 汽油啊，大伙儿，我们需要汽油！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You think that server is going to power itself? Come on squad, find some jerry cans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你以为那服务器能自己供电吗？快，小队，去找些油桶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Anyone stealing food or medical supplies from Scaldra units will be. Shot. On. Sight. Tell me: can I make myself any more clear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 任何从炽蛇军单位偷窃食物或医疗用品的人都会被当场枪毙。告诉我：我还需要说得更清楚吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Dear Citizens; Scaldra units have been notified that travel after curfew is a capital offense. Please adjust accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亲爱的市民们：炽蛇军单位已收到通知，宵禁后外出属于死罪。请做出相应调整。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Höllvania, I am… so disappointed. After all I have done, after all my sacrifices, you insist on prolonging your suffering by helping these... these slugs, the Hex. What did I do to deserve this disloyalty? Why must you spit in the face of Sol?! Of Lua?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚，我真是……太失望了。在我做了这么多，牺牲了这么多之后，你们却坚持要通过帮助这些……这些六人组鼻涕虫来延长你们的痛苦。我到底做错了什么，得遭受这种不忠？你们为什么要对着太阳神、月神吐口水？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hex, I wish I could say that I tried my hardest to find a middle ground, a way to work together, an acknowledgement of our common enemy, but to be quite honest, I didn't even try. Because you are scum and you need to be put down. All there is to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 六人组，我真希望我能说我尽力找到了一个折中的办法，尝试合作，承认我们的共同敌人，但说实话，我根本没有尝试过。因为你们是渣滓，必须被消灭。事情就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hex, I simply cannot wrap my head around what you think your end game is! I have an army with Sol and Lua on my side. You are heathens doomed to rot in hell! What do you hope to possibly achieve?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 六人组，我简直无法理解你们到底想要达到什么目的！我有一支军队，就连太阳神和月神都站在我这边。你们是注定要在地狱里腐烂的异教徒！你们到底想要实现什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Höllvania, you'll get all you deserve in the end. Repent - I beg of you. Turn away from technology. Turn away from sin! Kneel before the faith, accept the cleaning fires, and your soul shall be saved!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚，终有一天你们会得到应有的报应。忏悔吧——我恳求你们。远离科技。远离罪恶！在信仰面前跪下，接受净化之火，你的灵魂就会得救！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Entrati. I know you can hear this. I will find you. When I do, it will not be pleasant. It will not be with grace, it will not be with kindness. This is a promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 英择谛。我知道你能听到。我会找到你的。当我找到你时，绝不会是什么愉快的事。不会有恩典，不会有仁慈。这是我的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Exciting news for all of you citizens. Despite all that has happened in this city, I have agreed to let On-lyne play their much anticipated New Years Eve concert. That's right, bop your cares away to the modern sounds of… must I read this? Very well… Zeke, Packet, Drillbit, DJ RoM, wait, that's his name???? Really? And Hard- Really? And Harddive. For one night only the curfew is lifted. Please enjoy it as if it were the… Party… of… your… life…time…"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们，激动人心的消息来了！尽管这座城市发生了这么多事，我还是同意让线上时代在除夕夜举办他们备受期待的演唱会。没错，用现代音乐来忘掉烦恼吧……我真的要念这些吗？好吧……兹克、数据使者、钻头小子、打碟王，等一下，他的名字真的是这个？？？？真的吗？还有硬——真的吗？还有硬盘。就这一晚，宵禁解除。请尽情享受，算是你们……"终生……难忘……的……派对"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: My fellow citizens, I require your assistance in an important matter. We seek an individual. He goes by, "Doktor Friday". If you can hear me, Doc? We just want to protect you. Everything will be fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亲爱的市民们。我需要你们在一件重要的事情上提供帮助。我们正在寻找一位名为"星期五博士"的人。博士，你能听到我说话吗？我们只是想保护你。一切都会好起来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It has come to my attention that some of you have not purged your homes of electronic vulnerabilities. Repent in the name of Sol. Then, for your own safety, and that of your own family, please get rid of those devices!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我注意到你们当中有些人还没有销毁家中的电子设备。请以太阳神的名义悔改。然后，为了你自己和你家人的安全，请处理掉这些设备！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Efervon gas is highly toxic. Should you encounter a plume, avoid breathing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 艾弗旺气体含有剧毒。如果你遇到其烟雾，请避免吸入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A gentle reminder that the curfews are for your protection. To be a scofflaw is to, well… threaten the wrath of the gods, who will surely answer with hellfire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 温馨提醒，宵禁是为了保护你们的安全。违抗宵禁就等于……挑战神的愤怒，而众神必将用地狱之火来回应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Dear Citizens. News of a criminal gang of heathens operating openly within this city may be upsetting for you, especially at this time. Please know that Scaldra spares no effort to bring these Hex thugs to justice. Remember - it is up to you to report suspicious activity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亲爱的市民们。有消息称，有异教犯罪团伙在本市公开活动，这或许会让你们感到不安，尤其是在这种时候。请大家放心，炽蛇军会不遗余力地将这些六人组暴徒绳之以法。请记住——举报可疑活动是你们的责任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It has been brought to my attention that some of you are concerned the popular musicians "On-lyne" may be unable to perform a concert scheduled for New Year's Eve. I have faith that with your continued support and cooperation, our situation will be much improved by then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我注意到，有些人担心流行组合"线上时代"可能无法在除夕夜按计划举行演唱会。我相信，在你们的持续支持和合作下，到那时我们的情况将会得到很大改善。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Any citizens with information regarding the whereabouts of the fugitive Doctor Albrecht Entrati. AKA, Doktor Friday, are required to present that information to the nearest Scaldra officer. Individuals found to be harboring or otherwise aiding this fugitive will face military tribunal and stand before the wrath of Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 任何市民，只要知道逃犯阿尔布雷希特·英择谛博士，又名星期五博士，的下落，都必须向最近的炽蛇军军官提供相关信息。被发现窝藏或以其他方式协助该逃犯的人，将面临军事法庭审判，并接受太阳神的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Höllvania! My Höllvania. You are a city that has survived the Radiant Khan and her steppe hordes, the black plague, great wars and worse famines. You can survive the Techrot too… If… And only if… You do exactly as you are told. Survival is a choice. Choose wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚！我的霍瓦尼亚。你是一座经受住了辉煌可汗及其草原部落、黑死病、战争和更严重饥荒的考验的城市。你也可以在科腐者中存活下来……如果……并且只有如果……你们大家按照命令行事。生存是一种选择。请明智选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: WHY is it so HARD to stay home during curfew? Scaldra cannot protect you if you insist on being in the line of fire. Do you understand? This is for your protection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 为什么在宵禁期间待在家里这么难？如果你们执意冒险，炽蛇军就无法保护你们。明白吗？这是为了保护你们的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Citizens. The pack of infested heathens known as the Hex are not your friends, they are not your neighbors, they are slugs. Do not be fooled by their human visage. They are violent and contagious. Do not talk to them. Do not accept their assistance. Do not eat the food they distribute. Report all sightings immediately. Why do I have to say this out loud? Why do I have to struggle to help you protect yourselves?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们。这群名为六人组的感染异教徒，并不是你们的朋友，也不是你们的邻居，他们是鼻涕虫。不要被他们的人类外表所欺骗。他们暴力且具有传染性。不要和他们说话。不要接受他们的帮助。也不要吃他们分发的食物。一旦发现他们请立即报告。为什么我还需要大声说这些？为什么我要费力地帮助你们保护自己？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Again, and again, and again, we go through this! People of Höllvania, you are beginning to make me think you do not hold the faith. Destroy these false idols you clutch, these electronics - they are destroying you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一次又一次，我们经历这样的事情！霍瓦尼亚的人们，你们让我开始怀疑你们是否还有信仰。毁掉你们所执着的这些假偶像吧，这些电子设备——它们正在毁掉你们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Lua will weep tears of silver for all those who fall in cleanliness, honor, and dignity. Hell waits for all others. Which will you choose, Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 月神会为所有在圣洁、荣誉和尊严中牺牲的人流下银泪。而地狱将等待着所有其他人。霍瓦尼亚人，你们将选择哪一个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A message from Scaldra HR. Due to circumstances outside our control, most likely witchcraft, I, Viktor Vodyanoi have taken command of Scaldra from Major Rusalka. I vow to continue her work protecting the order and sanctity of this sacred city. And, like all of you, I pray she reappears safe and sound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 来自炽蛇军人事部的通知。由于一些我们无法控制的因素，很可能是巫术，我，维克多·维德诺伊已从鲁莎卡少校手中接管了炽蛇军的指挥权。我发誓会继续她的工作，保护这座神圣城市的秩序和圣洁。并且，就像你们所有人一样，我祈祷她能平安归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Citizens, I am afraid I must inform you of a strict curfew is now in effect. Sol willing, I do believe that with diligence this Techrot inconvenience will be gone in only a matter of weeks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 市民们，我很抱歉必须通知你们，现在已经实施严格的宵禁。愿太阳神保佑，我相信凭借我们的努力，这次的科腐者麻烦能在几周内就结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Due to the Techrot problem, and for your protection, I remind you that all forms of electronic communication are now forbidden. I urge you to use this opportunity to return to the old ways, as Sol and Lua intended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 由于科腐者问题，为了你们的安全，我在此提醒大家，现在禁止所有形式的电子通信。我敦促大家利用这个机会回归传统，正如太阳神和月神所期望的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Out of an abundance of caution, you, good citizens of Höllvania, are instructed to immediately smash and burn any of the following: computers, fax machines, photocopiers, cellular phones, pagers, modems, printers, mimeographs, televisions, video players, portable cassette decks, and "boomboxes." If you are unable to destroy these vulnerabilities please contact the nearest Scaldra officer for assistance. Failure to comply is an act of willful endangerment of your fellow citizens, and will be punished as such.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 为了最大程度地保证安全，你们，霍瓦尼亚的善良公民，请立即销毁并焚毁以下物品：计算机、传真机、复印机、手机、寻呼机、调制解调器、打印机、油印机、电视机、视频播放器、便携式卡带机和"音响设备"。若无法销毁这些物品，请联系最近的炽蛇军军官寻求帮助。未遵守此规定将被视为故意危害他人安全的行为，并将受到相应处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: My fellow citizens, I know you must be scared. Even as we prepare for the potential impact of Y2K, another digital curse plagues our fair city; Techrot. A virus both biological and electronic. A blight we do not fully understand but with which you must fully commit to fighting. You must destroy your electronics. You will never be safe as long as devices remain in your homes. Have faith, and all will be well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亲爱的市民们，我知道你们一定很害怕。就在我们为千禧年的潜在影响做准备的同时，另一种数字诅咒正在困扰着我们美丽的城市：科腐者。这是一种生物性与电子性并存的病毒。一种我们尚未完全了解的灾祸，但你们必须全力与之抗争。你们必须销毁你们的电子设备。只要这些设备还留在家中，你们就永远不会安全。请相信，一切都会好起来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: My fellow citizens. We live in confusing times. Please, pay no attention to the modern folk-myths of the vigilante group called The Hex. No such individuals exist. Scaldra alone fights Techrot. Scaldra alone protects Höllvania. Thank you for your ongoing cooperation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亲爱的市民们。我们生活在一个混乱的时代。请不要相信关于所谓的自卫组织"六人组"的现代民间传说。这样的人物根本不存在。只有炽蛇军在与科腐者作斗争。只有炽蛇军在保护霍瓦尼亚。感谢大家一直以来的合作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That did it! Armor plating must be Ferrocite. Do it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 成功了！装甲板一定是铁基。再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Intercept and protect the Mobile Voice broadcast balloon. I want to be able to turn on my radio without hearing Scaldra, Scaldra, Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 拦截并保护移动语音广播气球。我希望打开收音机不再只听到炽蛇军、炽蛇军、炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Mobile Voice, you know, resistance radio, their broadcast balloon is under attack. They need our help. Fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 移动语音，你知道的，抵抗组织的电台，他们的广播气球正在遭受攻击。他们需要我们的帮助。快去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A Mobile Voice broadcast balloon has been discovered and is taking damage. Get there and provide support. This city deserves better than unrelenting Scaldra propaganda.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 发现一个移动语音广播气球，它正受到攻击。赶紧过去提供支援！这座城市值得更好的信息环境，而不是炽蛇军无休止的洗脑宣传。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A Mobile Voice broadcast broadcast balloon is under attack. Help them. This one's personal. Music is everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 移动语音广播气球正在遭受攻击。去帮助他们。这次是私人恩怨。音乐就是一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Get to the marked Sensor Cluster. I'm running a script to harvest Techrot chatter. Trying to figure out how rot communicates. Go there now. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 快到标记的传感集群去。我正在运行一个脚本来收集科腐者的通讯信息。试图弄清楚科腐者是怎么交流的。现在就去那里。快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ugh… One of my Sensor Clusters is under attack. Guess the Techrot don't like me harvesting their packets. Destination marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃……我的一个传感集群正在遭受攻击。看来科腐者不喜欢我搜集他们的数据包。目的地已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Okay. So one of our "Sensor Clusters" is getting beat up. You know how long it took me to source all those parts. Make sure they stay safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好的。是这样，我们的一个"传感集群"正在遭受攻击。你知道我花了多长时间来搜集所有这些部件。确保它们的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: A Sensor Cluster is under attack?! Must have picked up something important. Get down there and protect it. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传感集群正在遭受攻击？！肯定是截到了重要信息。赶快去那里保护它。现在就去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scan complete. And ohh… That information is… concerning. Ah we'll deal with that later. For hoo-ray, you did it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 扫描完成。哦……这些信息……有点令人担忧。啊，我们之后再处理。好了，太棒了，你做到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scan is… done. Woah. The techrot did not appreciate that. Reminds me of the last time I went to the doctor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 扫描……结束了。哇。科腐者似乎很不爽。这让我想起上次去看医生的情形。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Finished. What a relief. You know how long it took me to find all those parts for Amir?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 完成了。真是松了一口气。你知道我花了多长时间才找齐阿米尔所需的所有零件吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Let's go! Sensor cluster intact. Scan complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们走！传感集群完好无损。扫描完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sensor rebooting! Take out Jammers and it will reboot faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传感器正在重启！破坏干扰器来加快重启速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Too much damage. Scanning halted. Standby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 损伤严重，扫描中断。保持待命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sensor Cluster just crapped out on us. It'll reboot faster if you take out Jammers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传感集群刚刚出故障了。如果你拆掉干扰器，它将重启得更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sensors down. Maybe while it reboots you all can brainstorm ways to keep it from taking so much damage?!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传感器故障。或许在它重启时，你们可以动动脑子，想办法让它少受点损伤？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Jammers are interfering with the sensor sweep. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 干扰器正在干扰传感器扫描。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Signal… losing… strength… must smash… jammer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 信号……正在……减弱……必须摧毁……干扰器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Jammers in the area. Seek and destroy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这个区域内有干扰器。找到并摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sensor Jammers. Slowing us down. Smash those things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 传感干扰器。正在减慢我们的速度。摧毁这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Protect the unit until it finishes its scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 保护这个装置，直至它完成扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's my cluster. Thing of beauty! It is imperative that it can finish its scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那是我的传感集群。真是太美了！必须让它完成扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Protect sensor cluster so it can finish its scan of the Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 保护传感集群，使其能完成对科腐者的扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That cluster is gathering crucial data on the Techrot. It must be allowed to finish its scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这个传感集群正在收集有关科腐者的重要数据。必须让它能顺利完成扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hell-Scrubber activated. Contamination dropping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 地狱净化器启动。污染水平正在下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Breathing easier? I wouldn't get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呼吸顺畅了些吗？别习惯这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ain't that like a shot of adrenaline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这就像是打了一针肾上腺素？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: After months subsumed by Techrot, those Hell-Scrubbers still work? Who'd-a-thunk-it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这些地狱净化器在被科腐者吸收了几个月后，居然还能正常运作？谁能想到呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: So uh, breathing a little easier?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那么，呼吸顺畅了些吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Levels dropping. That bought you some time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 污染水平正在下降。这给你争取了一些时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ahh... Did I forgot to mention that the scrubbers are prone to spore build-up that can spontaneously form a creature that'll absolutely bump your therapist up a tax bracket? Shoot off any build up and you shouldn't have a problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 啊……我是不是忘了说，净化器上很容易堆积孢子，可能会突然形成一个绝对能让你的心理医生提升纳税等级的生物？把堆积物清除掉，你就不会有问题了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You know how mold can grow on your water filter if you don't clean it enough? Well… uh... Shoot any buildup off the Hell-scrubbers unless you want to get unsubscribed from life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你知道如果你不经常清洗滤水器的话，上面会长霉吗？嗯……呃……清除掉地狱清洗器上的所有堆积物，除非你想"取消生命订阅"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: These scrubbers are prone to spore growth. You don't shoot it off and it could become fatal. For the scrubber and you? Comprende?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这些净化器容易滋生孢子。如果你不把它射掉，对净化器和你都可能是致命的。Comprende?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Remember that chili con carne I left in the fridge for two months? Let the Hell-Scrubbers sit too long and they'll spawn the same sort of thing, but, you know, with a crap-ton of predatory hardware. Shoot off any build-up before it converts you to past-tense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 还记得我在冰箱里放了两个月的辣椒肉酱吗？如果让地狱净化器放置太久，它们也会产生类似的东西，但是，你懂的，那东西里面充满了攻击性机械部件。在它们将你变成过去时之前，赶紧清理掉所有堆积物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You know why they call them Hell-Scrubbers? 'Cause if you don't shoot off build-up fast enough you gonna learn what hell is like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你知道为什么它们称其为地狱净化器吗？因为如果你不快速清除上面的堆积物，你就会明白什么是地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You gotta nurse these scrubbers. Keep 'em clean. Too much spore build-up and you got 'code white' on your hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你得好好照看这些净化器，保持它们的清洁。孢子积累太多，你就得面临"净化器暴走"的问题了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Spores collecting on that Scrubber. You need to shoot them off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那个净化器上正在积聚孢子，你需要把它们射掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Knock those pus sacks off that scrubber before they sprout a head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 在这些脓包长出头之前，把它们从净化器上清除掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey. You think I'm playing? Shoot that build-up off now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，你以为我在开玩笑吗？现在就去把那些堆积物打掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scrubber overwhelmed. Spores… coalescing… into… mutant form. Do something!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 净化器不堪重负。孢子……正在凝聚……变成……变异体。快做点什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scrubber's getting choked out. Fix it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 净化器快要被堵死了。快去处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Need you to stay on top of those scrubbers. You see growth? Shoot it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你得时刻留意这些净化器。看见孢子堆积物了吗？立刻射击清理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You're gonna lose that scrubber, bucko! If the build-up gets any worse it's gonna start making decisions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 伙计，你这净化器快保不住了！如果堆积再严重些，它就要开始自主作决定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scrubber going critical. Fix it or lose it to the Techrot… which will be the least of your problems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 净化器要出问题了。赶紧修理，否则它会被科腐者夺走……那还算小问题呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Situation critical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 情况危急。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Do something about it that Scrubber before it does something to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 在那个净化器对你下手前，赶紧做些什么处理它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Deal with that scrubber build-up. Stat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 立刻处理那个清洗器上的堆积物。立刻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey! I need 20 cc's of fix your damn shit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿！我需要注射 20 毫升的"赶紧修好你那破玩意儿"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I said shoot the pus of that… Ughhh. Too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我说过要射掉那个脓包的……呃。太晚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I warned you. I totally warned you. And now it wants to have a conversation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我警告过你。我绝对警告过你。现在它想跟你对话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now you get to do things the hard way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在你只能选择困难模式了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I told you. I told you to clean your Hell-Scrubbers. Now look at what you deal with. Gosh, do I sound like my mom?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我已经告诉过你，要清洁你的地狱净化器。现在看看你要面对什么。天哪，我这是在变成我妈了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh… Welcome to the 'find out' phase.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦……欢迎进入"发现"阶段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Great. You lost a scrubber, but that's the least of your problems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 太好了。你失去了一个净化器，但那还是个小问题呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Spore count is approaching terminally unfun levels. Activate another Hell-Scrubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 孢子数量即将达到致命水平。启动另一个地狱净化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Contamination is off the charts. You need to hustle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 污染指数爆表。你得加快速度了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Playing it a little close, no?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 玩得有点冒险了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You got a minute to get a Hell-Scrubber working
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你还有一分钟的时间来启动一个地狱净化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Sixty seconds to critical. Activate a scrubber, set off some SporeX, or get the hell out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 距离危急状态还有 60 秒。启动净化器、引爆一些 X 孢子滤弹或赶紧撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Spore contamination is getting out of hand. Start holding your breath!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 孢子污染越来越严重。赶紧屏住呼吸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Take that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 尝尝这个滋味！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Uh oh. Did we do that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃哦。这是我们导致的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: What's the matter, Amir? Squad having trouble all of a sudden?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 怎么啦，阿米尔？小队突然遇到麻烦了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: There should be a rule against this… but there isn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 应该有有条规矩来禁止这种事的……但偏偏没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Smell that? Smells like… Pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 闻到了吗？闻起来像……披萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: In your face, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 打脸了吧，碧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: They didn't even see it coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 她们完全没料到会有这个结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oops.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Okay, squad. Saddle up and bring your appetites, Aoi's making pizza tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好了，小队。上车，带上你的空肚子，碧今晚要做披萨了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Squad Amir! That's you. Listen up. We do our objectives fast, and we do them right, and then Aoi puts on an apron and a tiny little hat and makes us pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔小队！就是你们。听好了。我们快速完成任务目标，而且要完成得正确，然后碧就会穿上围裙，戴着小帽，给我们做披萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We're going to fight them in the streets! We're going to fight them in the sewers! We're going to fight until Aoi makes us a deep dish with triple cheese.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们要在大街上和他们战斗！我们要在下水道里和他们战斗！我们要战斗到碧给我们做出三层芝士的厚底比萨为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Listen up, squad. You do what I say and you'll come out of this alive. You do what I say fast and you'll get to eat the most delicious pizza of your life. Any questions? No? Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 听好了，小队。按照我说的去做，你就能活着出来。你按我说的迅速行动，你就能吃到你这辈子最美味的披萨。还有问题吗？没有？很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Arthur's outlined three crucial objectives for us to clear. Stakes could not be higher: my dignity is on the line. I do not want to go behind the Big Bytes counter tonight. Understood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 亚瑟为我们列出了三个需要完成的关键目标。赌注极高：我的尊严岌岌可危。今晚我不想站超级比特柜台后面。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Okay squad, you are the biggest, baddest warriors under Sol. You're gonna go out there and you're gonna be faster than lightning. And then the lightning will make us a pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 好了，小队，你们是太阳神之下最强大、最凶猛的战士。你们出去后，要比闪电还快。然后闪电会给我们做披萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hope you've been practicing your dough spinning, Aoi, cause you're going to be slinging some 'zas tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 希望你一直有在练习抛面团，碧，因为今晚你要甩披萨啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: For this squad, victory was never in question.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 对于这个小队来说，胜利从来都不是问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: The real treasure is the friends we made along- Nah… it's the pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 真正的宝藏是我们一路上结交的朋友——不对……应该是比萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Second place, first loser. Don't worry Amir, you're the number one pizza chef in my books.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 第二名，就是第一名的输家。别担心阿米尔，在我心中你是第一名的披萨大厨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Wooo-hooo, squad, you did it. Hope, you're hungry because Amir's slinging pies tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呜呼，小队，你们成功了。希望你们都饿了，因为阿米尔今晚要甩披萨了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Winner, winner, pizza dinner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 大吉大利，今晚吃披萨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: More ferrocite. You know what to do, call in another squad of Stormfall and get your greedy mitts on their RPGs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 更多的铁基隔离墙。你知道该怎么做，叫来另一支风袭部队，用你贪婪的双手把他们的火箭炮抢过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another barrier. Viktor really want to keep us out. Get your hands on a thermian RPG and take it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又一道隔离墙。维克多是真的想把我们挡在外面。去拿个热熔火箭炮，把它打掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh look, another barrier. Does Viktor really think this will stop us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，看，又一个隔离墙。维克多真的认为这能阻挡我们吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, don't forget, some Scaldra carry personal SporeX charges for their own safety. Not that they'll do them much good with you around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，别忘了，有些炽蛇军会随身携带 X 孢子滤弹来保护自己。但有你在，估计它们帮不上什么忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Some Scaldra have been issued SporeX charges. Little bursts of filtration. Keep an eye out, they might save a life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一些炽蛇军配备了 X 孢子滤弹。它们能在短时间内有过滤效果。留意一下，它们或许能救命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hey, be on the lookout for SporeX Charges. Every little bit counts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嘿，注意找 X 孢子滤弹。就算只有一点也能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Crack enough Techrot and you're bound to find a few SporeX Charges. Perfect for emergencies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 消灭足够多的科腐者后，肯定能找到几颗 X 孢子滤弹。紧急情况下非常有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scaldra tried to kill spores in your area, but the Techrot just ate their Hell-Scrubbers for lunch. Let's see if we can make the Techrot give 'em back with a little code I've named puke.spew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 炽蛇军试图清除你这片区域的孢子，但科腐者竟然把他们的地狱净化器当午餐吃了。试试我写的"呕吐"代码，看能不能让科腐者吐出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You wanna clean rot, you're gonna get those pretty hands dirty. First, I run Amir's fancy little comp-sci project to force the Hell-Scrubbers to the surface. Next, I need you to keep 'em clean and for as long as you can. Got it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 如果你想清理科腐者，你就得把那双漂亮的手弄脏。首先，我会运行阿米尔的那个复杂的小程序，迫使地狱净化器出现。接下来，我需要你尽可能地保持它们的清洁。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Spore contamination rising. Gonna tickle the Techrot with a little bit of code I wrote. Make it spit up the Hell-Scrubbers that Scaldra lost when they tried to purge this area. Oh boy, Scaldra is going to be so P-O'd when they see us using their kit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 孢子污染程度正在升高。我打算用我写的一点代码来刺激一下科腐者。让它吐出炽蛇军试图净化这片区域时丢失的地狱净化器。哦天，要是炽蛇军看到我们用他们的设备，一定会气炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Today, the patient is Höllvania herself. She's choking on Techrot spores, and they're spreading. Scaldra built Hell-Scrubbers to purge the rot but those idiot niños couldn't keep them clean. Rot just absorbed them. I'm hoping you're a little better at your job. Find the first Scrubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 今天，病人是霍瓦尼亚本身。她被科腐者孢子堵住了喉咙，而这些孢子正在扩散。炽蛇军制造了地狱净化器来清除科腐者的孢子，但那些小白痴根本没能保持它们的清洁。这些净化器反而被科腐者吞噬了。我希望你能做得比他们好。找到第一个净化器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Diagnosis: Spore contamination. Treatment: Hell-Scrubbers. Side-effects may include :release of deadly spores, homicidal filter buildup, and Scaldra troops trying to kill you for messing with their stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 诊断：孢子污染。治疗方案：地狱净化器。副作用可能包括：释放致命孢子、致命的过滤器积累，以及炽蛇军部队试图杀死你，因为你动了他们的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Keeping this short and sweet. Go into the heart of the infestation. Recover the lost Hell-Scrubbers. Keep them clean. And when the timing is right, you fire them off and you kill the Techrot at source. The spores.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 长话短说。深入感染核心。找回丢失的地狱净化器。保持它们清洁。当时机合适时，启动它们，从源头上消灭科腐者。也就是孢子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oh, hey Aoi, almost didn't see you in our rear view mirror.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哦，嘿，碧，差点没在我们的后视镜里看到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Aoooiiiiee. Don't know if you noticed this yet. But we just took the lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 碧~~~不知道你们有没有注意到。但我们刚刚领先了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Squad Amir rounds the corner, they're taking the inside track. Can they do it? Yes they can. Squad Amir takes the lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 阿米尔小队绕过拐角，他们选择了内侧道。他们能做到吗？当然可以，他们能做到。阿米尔小队领先。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Oops. Caught you napping, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哎呀。抓到你打瞌睡了，阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Vroom. Too slow, bro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嗖。太慢了，老弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's what I'm talking about!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这才对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's healing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它在自愈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Tank's healing itself. Just like we do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 坦克在自愈。就像我们一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Techrot regeneration. You'll need to find a way to make the damage stick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 科腐者再生。你得想办法让伤害保持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: H-09, put the Hex in their place. Six feet underground should suffice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: H-09，把六人组放到他们该待的位置。地下六尺就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: H-09, destroy this plague and all those who would spread it. You have your orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: H-09，消灭这场瘟疫，以及所有传播瘟疫的人。你已经接到命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We built a machine worthy of the tanks of my father's wars… and invulnerable to techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们打造了一台堪比我父亲战争中的坦克的机器……并且对科腐者免疫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: All of Höllvania bear witness to the weakness of the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 全霍瓦尼亚，来见证六人组的软弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Slimeball eeeeliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 已消灭可恶的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Another one bites the dirt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 又一个倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ding, dong, you're dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 叮咚，你死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Obsoleted and deleted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 淘汰并删除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Slam. Target down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 砰。目标倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Confirmed kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 确认击杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Scratch one rotten bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 干掉一个讨厌的混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ouch. That one hurt to watch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 哎呀。那个看得我都替他疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: What? What have you filthy, wretched, diseased creatures done to my... my beautiful tank?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 什么？你们这些肮脏、可恶、病态的生物对我的……我美丽的坦克做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: No. No no no NO NO! NNOOO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 不。不不不不不不不！不不不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's not within spec?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这不在规格范围内吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ernest? Be a dear and fetch me the engineering team? Oh and Ernest, my revolver. It's in the desk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 欧内斯特？麻烦你去叫工程团队来好吗？哦，还有欧内斯特，我的左轮手枪。在桌子里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's hideous. And… so strong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 它很骇人，但……非常强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Well. Live and learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 嗯。活到老学到老。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ah, Viktor, Viktor, Viktor, what have you been downloading?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 啊，维克多，维克多，维克多，你到底下载了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's not Viktor's tank anymore. Doesn't mean it doesn't want you less dead. Take it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 那不再是维克多的坦克了。但这并不代表它希望你活着。干掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Ugh! Looks like Viktor forgot to update his antivirus software. Now you gotta clean up his mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃！看来维克多忘记更新他的杀毒软件了。现在得你来收拾他的烂摊子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Now do you see what you're dealing with, Viktor. You can't control this. You can't manage it, or exploit it. Hex, let's show Viktor how it's done, finish that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在你知道你在面对什么了吧，维克多。你控制不了它。管理不了它，也利用不了它。六人组，让我们向维克多展示一下怎么做，解决掉那个东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Uh, just, look for the soft bits and hit it there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 呃，就，找软的地方打。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Something tells me that thing won't like it if you pop its zits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 有种预感，如果你挤掉它的脓包，它一定会不喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Running out of time. Get to the scrubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 时间不多了。去净化器那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's getting toxic out there. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 外面变得有毒了。快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You got thirty seconds to pull through or I'm pulling you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 三十秒内搞定，不然我就把你带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Thirty seconds and you're swimming in spore soup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 三十秒后，你就要泡在孢子汤里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Do something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 赶紧做点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Tick, tick, tick. Time's running out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 滴答滴答滴答，时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's a virtual tie! Go. GO. GO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 几乎是平手！快。快。快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Still too close to call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 胜负依然难分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's anyone's match at this point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在谁都有可能赢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I need to see some hustle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 给我拿出点拼劲来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: It's too close to call, let's put some distance between us and them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 太难分胜负了，我们得和他们拉开距离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: I'm sorry. I thought you were HUNGRY! My mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 抱歉。我以为你饿了呢！我搞错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Get your hands on a Thermian RPG and shoot down the barrier. Don't make me ask you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 拿起热熔火箭炮，把隔离墙打掉。别让我再说第二遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Grab a Thermian RPG, point it at the barrier and pull the trigger. Simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 拿起热熔火箭炮，瞄准隔离墙并扣动扳机。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: You're not making any progress. See if you can find a Thermian rocket?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 你进展太慢了。去找个热熔火箭炮试试？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: That's our ticket. Now get to a comms terminal. Use that to call in reinforcements… for them. Hey, never said this would be easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这就是我们的门票。现在去通讯终端。用它来呼叫……给他们的增援部队。嘿，从来没说过这会很容易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Congratulations on your promotion commander. Now, get to a Comms Terminal and use that thing to call-in Stormfall paratroopers. Yeah, you heard me right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 恭喜你晋升指挥官。现在，去通讯终端，用那个东西呼叫风袭伞兵。是的，你没听错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Come on. You're never gonna get through that barrier without Thermian RPGs. And to get those you need to call in the only units that get issued them. Understand? Take an Emergency Transponder to the terminal and call in reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 拜托。没有热熔火箭弹，你永远也突破不了那隔离墙。你得呼叫唯一配备了它们的部队。明白了吗？拿起紧急应答器前往终端并呼叫增援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We did it. Head back to Central.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 我们做到了。回商场吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Time to blow this pop stand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 该撤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Squad, time to head home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 小队，该回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Extract yourselves, you beautiful and capable squad, you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 撤离吧，你们这个美丽又能干的小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: We have got this thing in the bag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 这胜利已经在我们的囊中了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Don't let up now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 现在还不能松懈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Visualize the pizza. You want the pizza. Pizza is for winners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 想象那个比萨。你想要那个比萨。披萨是为胜利者准备的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Eyes on the prize, team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 一心要想着奖品，小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Focus. We have this thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 集中注意力。我们能赢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.text: Hustle. Hustle. Hustle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineMiss.zhText: 加油。加油。加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那你为什么要拼命阻止我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那你为什么要拼命阻止我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那你为什么要拼命阻止我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那你为什么要拼命阻止我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Did you forget? Albrecht's going to burn them all anyway!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你忘了吗？无论如何阿尔布雷希特都会把他们全部烧掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: She showed up after the hack. Uh. Look. Marty. Maybe we got off on the wrong-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 她是在入侵系统后出现的。呃，听着，马蒂。也许我们一开始没处好——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Arthur! I can't! I can't! Arthur! Ar-!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 亚瑟！我，我做不到！我做不到！亚瑟！亚瑟——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Viktor. That's no way to treat our little tourist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 维克多。这样对待我们的小游客可不太合适。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Master, my master. Why hast thou abandoned me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 老爷，我的老爷。您为什么抛弃我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: All that matters is I'm here now. There, there… my faithful man-cat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我现在在这了，这才是最重要的。好了，好了……我忠诚的猫仆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: But is it really you? After all these years I've - UGH! Master! You're hurting me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 但真的是你吗？这么多年过去了，我——啊！老爷！你弄疼我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Ha! That's it, isn't it? The poison to your plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 哈！就是这个，对吧？破坏你计划的毒。
哇哦。就像马蒂·麦佛利一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: If it's bullshit, I'll feed Marty here to the Techrot myself. But the clock's running out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 如果这是胡说八道，我就亲自把马蒂喂给科腐者。但留下的时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: The nuke kinda makes sense, actually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 核爆好像能说得通，其实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Well, you're on point, Marty. But you try any of those head-games again and there won't be much left for Lettie to stitch back up. You read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好吧，你说的有道理，马蒂。但你要是再玩什么入侵我脑子的把戏，就是莱蒂也缝不好你了。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Here is the breach. With each cycle, more seeps into her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 这就是缺口。每一次循环，渗进她的只会更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You do it. I'm not your puppet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你自己来。我不是你的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You do it. I'm not your puppet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你自己来。我不是你的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You do it. I'm not your puppet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你自己来。我不是你的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You do it. I'm not your puppet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你自己来。我不是你的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: But it's not really her that's doing this…
But it's not really her that's doing this…
But it's not really her that's doing this…
But it's not really her that's doing this…
What? Then how'd I be any different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 什么？那我又有什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What? Then how'd I be any different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 什么？那我又有什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What? Then how'd I be any different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 什么？那我又有什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What? Then how'd I be any different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 什么？那我又有什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: If you cannot sacrifice even this much… how will you do what comes next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 如果你连这点牺牲都做不到……接下来的事情该如何面对？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Are you more a child than your other? Do you think I am not haunted by these choices?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你比另一个你更幼稚吗？你以为我没有被这些抉择困扰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺，我只是来帮忙的。这取决于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: He's ash in seconds. No need for misery. Come. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 几秒后他就会化为灰烬。没有悲伤的必要。来吧。现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Murmur expelled. Tau is in sight. They've given their lives for this. Make it count.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 低语者被驱逐。Tau 就在眼前。他们为此献出了生命。让这一切有意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Isn't it great? Amir got these from the hack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 是不是很棒？阿米尔黑进系统时弄到的！
阿米尔！吵的我无法思考了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor… Aoi… I... I got them into this mess. Maybe you can help me get them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺……碧……我……是我害得她们陷入这困境的。也许你能帮我把她们救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: …T-T-T-Tenno. If you are seeing this your loop has been altered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: ……Ten-Ten-Ten-Tenno 战士。你看到这个，说明你的时间循环已改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You and I are trapped here. Soon the Murmur will crawl through the cracks and devour this world and its possibilities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你和我都被困在这里。很快，低语者就会从裂缝中爬出来，然后吞噬这个世界和它的可能性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Our only means of escape… our only hope to contain this horror I have created… will require a spark of energy rare in this timeline. You know what this means.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们唯一的逃生手段……遏制我所创造的这场恐怖的唯一希望……将需要一种在这个时间线中罕见的能量火花。你明白这意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Do not allow Arthur and the Hex to stop this. I realize what I am asking… but you of all people understand what is at stake. For the sake of everything before and to come… at midnight tonight… the 'bomb' must go off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不要让亚瑟和六人组阻止这件事。我知道我在要求些什么……而你也比任何人都更清楚这之间的利害关系。为了过去和未来的一切……今晚午夜……"炸弹"必须爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Check me out, givin' kit to Entrati's Cybercop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 看看我，竟然在给英择谛的网络警察提供装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Naw. More like V-1000. Sent to smoke us all, am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不。更像是 V-1000。派来干掉我们所有人的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Brrr! We got a blizzard coming in! Well, the On-lyne boys had better get the lip balm ready before the big show, or it's gonna be a chappy New Year!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 冷！暴风雪来了！好吧，线上时代的男孩们最好在演出前准备好润唇膏，否则这个新年都要冻干巴了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: So you just puppet this thing? Whole lot of metal in there…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 所以你就像木偶一样操纵这玩意？里面的金属真不少……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Arthur's taking a chance on you. You hurt him, and I'll twist you inside out. Try not to scratch the paint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 亚瑟在冒险给你一次机会。你敢伤害他，我就把你从里到外拧成麻花。别刮花了油漆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We found him, Marty! Come on!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们找到他了，马蒂！快来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Nice score you got us here, Arthur. But you know what? I've had my fill of the circus. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 亚瑟，你带着我们走到如今真的很了不起。但你知道吗？我已经受够我生活里这些狗血剧本了。我不玩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Quincy… c'mon man! Maybe we don't need Marty to stop this? Don't-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 昆西……拜托！或许我们用不着马蒂来阻止这一切？不要——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: -North's your best bet. Mountains might be a chance against the fallout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: ——往北边走是你的最优选。山区或许能抵挡住辐射尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We'll still follow you, brave king. But this half-assed plan's gone full-guano. Amir's Y2K thing won't even work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们仍然会追随你，勇敢的国王。但这个半吊子计划已经彻底泡汤了。阿米尔的千年虫主意根本行不通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Yeah. I should have said. Controller's air-gapped. Good policy actually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 是啊。我应该说出来的。控制器是被网闸隔离的。这其实是个不错的网络策略。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Off net. We'd have to 'full-on' the reactor and patch it direct. Only about four thousand Scaldra to the six of us. Bad odds, güey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 就是断网状态。我们必须"全员出动"前往反应堆并直接修复连接。差不多四千个炽蛇军对我们六个。机会渺茫啊，güey。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Five of us. Arthur, maybe it is time to bail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 只有五个人。亚瑟，也许是时候放手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: There's an army beneath our feet. You all know it. My loving brother just needs to ask. I know he's itching to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们脚下有一整支军队。这你们都知道。我亲爱的弟弟只需要开口。我知道他已经迫不及待了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor… Arthur, don't you dare. She's barely hanging on as it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺……亚瑟，你敢。她已经快撑不住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You said it yourself, Lettie. Bad odds. Eleanor. I'm asking. Please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你自己说的，莱蒂。机会渺茫。埃莉诺。我在开口问。拜托。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Please? A grand New Year's Eve, indeed. Okey-dokey, Arthur. Who's on point?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 拜托？你真当这是除夕许愿夜啊。那好呀，亚瑟。谁来打头阵？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Princess Lucina Zoological Gardens. Free admission on New Year's Eve… if you can get past the Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 露西娜公主动物园。在跨年夜免费入场……如果你能突破炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: So what do you want me to do, Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 所以你想让我怎么办，莱蒂？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Maybe, we cut our losses like we should've done weeks ago. We pack up and get the hell out of this estercolero before it's turned to ash. Just an idea!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 也许，我们早在几周前就该及时止损了。在这里化为灰烬之前，我们打包离开这个 estercolero。这只是个想法！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You don't have a problem with a few hundred thousand going up in smoke?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 几十万人化为青烟，你也不介意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Anyone still stuck here is Techrot anyway. Sometimes you have to amputate, Aoi. And cauterize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 反正还困在这里的人都是科腐者了。有时候你必须截肢，碧。然后烧灼治疗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Didn't come out here to cut an' hide. If Doctor E won't stop this, then I say we do it. Am I right Amir? AMIR?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不是来这里玩捉迷藏的。如果英博士不能阻止，我们来阻止。我说的对吗，阿米尔？阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: So where's Entrati? You said this was a loop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 所以英择谛在哪儿？你说过这是个时间循环。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Not anymore, is it? Your Boogeyman changed the rules. You're toast like the rest of us now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 这不再是循环了，是吗？ 你的恶魔改变了规则。你现在和我们一样完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Seems so. But that means we can change it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好像是。但这意味着我们也可以改变规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Seems so. But that means we can change it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好像是。但这意味着我们也可以改变规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Seems so. But that means we can change it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好像是。但这意味着我们也可以改变规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Seems so. But that means we can change it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好像是。但这意味着我们也可以改变规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Or maybe you're gonna bail on us, Arthur? Forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 还是说你要抛下我们，亚瑟？别想了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We're in this mess because of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们陷入这种局面都是因为你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I'm coming too! Guys? Uh… am I sensing some tension here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我也要去！伙计们？呃……我怎么感觉这里的气氛有点紧张？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: No one's bailing. I got us into this, and if it kills me, I'll get us- fine. Aoi, Amir, Quincy on backup. Lettie, you and Eleanor hold the fort here, keep the gennies running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 没有要抛下谁。是我害你们陷入这个局面，我就算是死也会让大家——行吧。碧、阿米尔、昆西支援。莱蒂，你和埃莉诺留守这里，维持发电机的运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Scaldra think they've contained the outbreak here. But the Techrot here is different… more… patient. Biding their time...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 炽蛇军以为他们已经控制了这里的疫情。但这里的科腐者不同……更……耐心。在等待时机……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Bad form to arrive early. And without your mystery date? I thought they taught Britannic men better…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 早到可不礼貌。而且你的神秘约会对象没来？我还以为不列颠尼克男士会更有教养……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Viktor, you love this city.  Y2K is gonna haywire the plant.  Call off your dogs for the night and help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 维克多，你爱这座城市。千年虫会让核电站出事故的。今晚先把你的爪牙都叫回去，帮我们一把。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Y2K? Ozone? Acid rain? And I took you for a warrior. Air support, you are go for drop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 千年虫？臭氧？酸雨？我一直以为你是个战士。空中支援，准备空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Mediocre display. Not worth my time. Enjoy your picnic in the park, children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 表现一般。不值得我浪费时间。祝你们在公园野餐愉快，孩子们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Wait here. I do this alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 在这儿等着。这件事我一个人做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I'm sorry we put you up to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 很抱歉我们让你做这种事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: She won't come back from this.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那我们任何人也都无法回头。
我们一直在等待。我们被分离的。姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Sisters. Wicked. Always jealous to be queen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 姐妹们。可恶。总是嫉妒想当女王。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Vines feeding it. Maybe I trace them back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 藤蔓在喂养它。也许我能追溯至他们的源头？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I Queen of these. First sister from trees.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我，他们的女王。树林的第一个姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We got chatter on Scaldra comms! They've been moving a V.I.P. at regular intervals. It's gotta be Dr. E., right? Meet me across town.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们收到了炽蛇军的通讯信号！他们每隔一段时间就会转移某个重要人物。一定是英博士，对吧？到城镇的另一端和我会合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: See, Viktor. They can't resist the wiggling worm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 瞧，维克多。他们无法抗拒虫饵的诱惑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那车队是个陷阱。我怀疑英择谛在——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那车队是个陷阱。我怀疑英择谛在——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那车队是个陷阱。我怀疑英择谛在——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 那车队是个陷阱。我怀疑英择谛在——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: -If there's a chance he's on it, we have to try. Only he can stop this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: ——如果他有几率在里面，我们就必须试试。只有他能阻止这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: -Just haul arse to Aoi. Rest of us will catch up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: ——你就只管赶到碧那里。我们其他人会赶上的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Convoy approaching the Mehra Tunnels. That's the place to hit them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 车队正在接近梅拉隧道。那就是伏击他们的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I'm just a pretty face, Arthur. Oh sh—
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我只是个花瓶，亚瑟。哦，该——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Get these assholes off my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 把这些追着我的混蛋赶走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Still not used to… whatever this is. Here, let's ditch the cycles for something less… conspicuous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 还是不习惯……这个什么玩意。好了，我们把摩托车丢下，换个什么不那么……显眼的车。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Pick the bones out of that!
So you're the new lapdog, kiddo? Tell me, Toto, what's he done to earn your loyalty?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 小鬼，你是新来的走狗？告诉我，托托，他做了什么让你如此死心塌地？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Not the jealous type! but! if I can't have him…! you can't either.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不是我嫉妒！但是！如果我得不到他……！你也得不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: The Doktor's dashing patient-zero in the flesh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 博士那潇洒的零号病人亲自现身了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: -Shame. But my Scaldra have their orders:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: ——真遗憾。但我的炽蛇军已经领命：

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Pity. We could have been allies, kiddo. My Scaldra: Put that thing down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 可惜了小鬼。我们本可以成为盟友。我的炽蛇军：把那东西击倒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Wake up, brother. He comes. A crownless king, clad in gold. A pallid beast… tap-tap-tapping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 醒醒，老弟。他来了。无冕之王，身披金衣。苍白野兽……哒——哒——哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Arthur, this place is swarming with Scaldra!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 亚瑟，这地方到处都是炽蛇军！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hold there. She'll get it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 坚持一下。她会把它打开的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What's going on down there? Eight-squad? Eight-squad report! Get Efervon units down there now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 下面怎么了？第八小队？第八小队报告！让艾弗旺部队马上到那里去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor, hold here. I'll clear the gas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺，坚持一下。我这就把毒气排掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Sir, the sub-floors have been breached. Requesting backup!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 长官，地下楼层已被突破。请火速前来支援！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: No! This is what they want. Hold!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不！这就是他们想要的。坚持住！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We're going to have to risk it.
You are proper shit at directions, Arthur. Heads down while I do my job, arright mate?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你可真不会指路，亚瑟。我干活的时候你低着头，好吗伙计？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Show off. Better make a move, though. They'll get on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 别炫耀了。赶紧换个位置。他们迟早会盯上你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I can only type so fast!
Uh. Is that supposed to happen?
Amir?! Aoi, can you do something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 阿米尔？！碧，你能做点什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What do you want me to do?
We're not going to make it, man. I can't even compile in time-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们不行了，伙计。我甚至跑不完编译——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text:
[3]
Are you more a child than your other?
[4.8]

[8.2]
Do you think I am not haunted by these choices?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText:
[3]
你比另一个你更幼稚吗？
[4.8]

[8.2]
你以为我没有被这些抉择困扰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor is the first to die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺是第一个死掉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Entrati?! Get me out of here!
Entrati?! Get me out of here!
Entrati?! Get me out of here!
Entrati?! Get me out of here!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我已经看够了，阿尔布雷希特！
我已经看够了，阿尔布雷希特！
我已经看够了，阿尔布雷希特！
我已经看够了，阿尔布雷希特！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Not that old dog. This is me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 不是那条老狗。是我做的。
亚瑟！我做不到！我做不到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: These gifts you have: a piece of me. Given freely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你拥有的这些礼物：是我的一块碎片。无偿赠送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: But those before you were butchers. Flayed flesh… for stolen stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 但在你之前的人都是屠夫。剥下的血肉……只为了偷取星辰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: But those before you. They did not ask. They butchered me. My flesh fed their greed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 但在你之前的人，他们从未问过。他们剝下我。我的血肉填饱了他们的贪欲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I don't want more of that shit in my system!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我不希望我的身体里有更多这种东西了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Stow it, Lettie! Amir. Talk to me. Is your plan ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 闭嘴，莱蒂！阿米尔。告诉我。你的计划准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Uh… almost. Just needs a transponder onsite. Any Scaldra console down there should do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 呃……差不多。只需要一台现场的应答器。那里任何一个炽蛇军控制台都应该可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hell-Scrubbers! Giant air filters to capture Techrot spores. I've commandeered their deployment system. Just need you to keep them pumping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 地狱净化器！用来捕获科腐者孢子的巨型空气过滤器。我已调用了它们的部署系统。只需要你让它们继续运转就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Quincy and Marty, keep the air clean while the rest of us search the tunnels for a terminal. You too, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 昆西和马蒂，保持空气清洁，同时其他人在隧道中寻找终端机。你也是，莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I start turning like Eleanor, I'll be haunting your ass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我要是变得像埃莉诺那样，我就会一直缠着你不放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Likkle Amir knows all about these opps and their systems. A proper boss like you is smart enough to figure it out, innit, Marty?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 小阿米尔对这些玩意和它们的系统了如指掌。像你这样的大人物应该能搞明白，对吧，马蒂？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor, you sensing any civilians down here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 埃莉诺，你感应到地下这里有平民吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: So. Wherever they're hiding out, it's above ground. That's a mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 所以。不管他们藏身何处，都是在地面上。这就放心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Coming! What. No no no no no. That's... not a terminal, Arthur. Not any more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 来了！什么。不不不不。那……不是终端机，亚瑟。不再是了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Oh, shit. Aim for the head!
See this is why the Major wears a freakin' face mask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 看，这就是为什么少校要戴一个怪异的面具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Oh, please. You're as infected as the rest of us, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 噢，拜托。莱蒂，你的感染程度跟我们其他人一样。
是吗？去查查 "潜伏感染" 吧，小贱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Drop your linen and start grinnin' - I'm in!
Hold. Sensing a Scaldra force on the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 停一下。感应到地表有炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Even Scaldra got more sense than to come down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 甚至连炽蛇军都知道不该下到这里来。
再看看吧。有情况通知我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: All right, fam - Quincy-K's impressed with the new kid. Might just be the real deal. Shaved 'em good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 好了，家人们。昆西-克对这个新来的小子印象不错。说不定这位有真本事。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Root access confirmed. Höllvania Public Utilities I am in you! Huh? MP3s?!-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 已确认超级用户权限。霍瓦尼亚公共设施我进入了你！啊？MP3？！——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: What did you do, Amir? Come in? Comm's dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你做什么了，阿米尔？请回答？通讯断了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Cut the chatter. 19 hours til we're popping corks, or vaporized. We get Entrati and put a stop to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 别闲聊了。19 小时后我们就要么开瓶庆祝，要么被蒸发。我们要找到英择谛并阻止这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Höllvania. The eve of a new millennium brings with it great change. The war criminal Albrecht Entrati, father of the Techrot plague, has at last been captured. His co-conspirators, the terrorist cell known as 'Hex', will soon be brought to justice. Tonight, we will fill the great… Void of suffering. A New Year… A new era! Höllvania will be great once again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚。新千禧年的除夕，将伴随着重大的变化。战犯阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，科腐者瘟疫之父，终于被抓获。他的同谋者，被称为"六人组"的恐怖组织，也将很快被绳之以法。今天晚上，我们将填满巨大的……苦难虚空。新的一年……新的时代！霍瓦尼亚将再次伟大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Right, we're the terrorists. Love what you've done with the place, lady.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 对，还叫我们恐怖分子。你对这个地方所做的一切真棒，女士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Lotta heat here in the opp-block, Arthur. You sure Marty's lead isn't just a setup? You holding something back, heroboy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 对面街区火力很猛，亚瑟。你确定马蒂的线索不是个陷阱？你是不是隐瞒了什么，英雄仔？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Amir, you said the nuke story made sense. This Y2K shit real?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 阿米尔，你说核爆的故事道理上说得通。千年虫事件是真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Of course it's real. Some glitch in the old control software. Probably written in COBOL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 当然是真的。旧控制软件里面的故障。可能是用 COBOL 语言写的吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Holding cells ahead. Big moment for you, Marty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 前面就是牢房。你的重要时刻来了，马蒂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: You better have him. Marty? Is Entrati there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 你最好找到他了。马蒂？英择谛在不在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 他不在了。它已经突破。在改变事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 他不在了。它已经突破。在改变事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 他不在了。它已经突破。在改变事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 他不在了。它已经突破。在改变事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Bollocks! Get your arse out of there! Quincy, Aoi, we need fire support!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 该死！快离开那！昆西、碧，我们需要火力支援！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I told you this was a set-up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我早告诉你这是个陷阱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Eleanor is the first to die.

[1.4]

[3.7]
We're not going to make it, man.
[7.7]
I don't… have… time.
[11.6]
Maybe, we cut our losses like we should've done weeks ago. 
[16.1]
What's he talking about, Marty?
[19.1]
I told you this was a set-up!
[22.6]
I can't! I can't! I can't! 
[26.1]
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText:

[3.7]
我们不行了，伙计。
[7.7]
现在……不是……发作的时候。
[11.6]
也许，我们早在几周前就该及时止损了。 
[16.1]
他在说什么，马蒂？
[19.1]
我早告诉你这是个陷阱！
[22.6]
我做不到！我做不到！我做不到！
[26.1]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: And I thought we were becoming friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我还以为我们会成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text:
[3.3]
Your heart would struggle to move them.
[6.9]
It had to grow…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText:
[3.3]
你的心很难撼动他们。
[6.9]
它必须成长……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text:
[3.6]
…with others.
[8.8]
Carry this power with mercy, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText:
[3.6]
……是与他人一起。
[8.8]
请仁慈地运用这份力量，Tenno 战士。
……是与他人一起。请仁慈地运用这份力量，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Well that burned a few calories!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嗯这可烧掉了不少卡路里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Man ain't nothin' without his mains. Respec'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 一个人没有伙伴，就什么都不是。致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Right here by your side. Now and always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 就在你身边。现在如此，永远如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: I'm not afraid to die… but I'm glad I didn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我并不怕死……但仍然很庆幸我没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hey! After this we go for dinner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嘿！这个结束后我们去吃个晚饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: We're not going to make it, man. I can't even compile in time-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 我们不行了，伙计。我甚至跑不完编译——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟，我们离开这里。我们俩一起。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟，我们离开这里。我们俩一起。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟，我们离开这里。我们俩一起。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.text: Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NinetyNineQues.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟，我们离开这里。我们俩一起。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Roots and fruits ain't the only organisms Nef's merks have been messing with. Yeah, they're going after the Vallis critters too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 奈富的雇佣军不止骚扰过果子和根。对，他们还想攻击谷底的小动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Right then. Got a whole list of chores for ya', culminating in a jailbreak. Sound good? Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 好了，我这儿有一堆活儿要交给你，最后的大戏是一场越狱。听起来不错吧？那就这么定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Nef's always been messing with people, but in my estimation, people got it coming. The Vallis' creatures on the other hand, they don't deserve his ire. We're gonna cut 'em a break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 奈富总是喜欢折腾人，但依我看，那些人确实活该。至于山谷的那些生物，它们不该受他的气。我们要让它们过得轻松点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Look at you, yah cute little mucker. You're welcome down in the Deepmines anytime, you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 看看你这小可爱。深矿随时欢迎你来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: The circle can be brutal sometimes, but it can also be cute as a button. You did good saving this little fella.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 生命循环有时很残酷，但有时也特别可爱。你救下了这小家伙，干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Be free, little guy. Who needs a zoo when you got the wonders of the Deepmines?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 去吧，自由的小家伙。有深矿这样的奇迹在，谁稀罕奈富那破动物园？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: The Taxmen are using the Vallis animals for all sorts of sadistic business. Think you can put an end to all that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 税务官们正在利用山谷里的动物进行各种残忍勾当。你觉得你能阻止这一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Turns out, Nef's bloody 'science' lab has a backdoor into the Deepmines. Doing all sorts of nasty experiments on the Vallis animals up there. Think you could sneak in there and put a stop to all that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 原来，奈富那帮该死的科学家在实验室里开了条直通深矿的后门，对山谷里的动物搞各种见不得光的实验。你能不能潜进去，了结这所有的烂事？
