/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Let's put a stop to Nef's palace zoo plan once and for all. Let's rescue some critters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 让我们彻底终结奈富的宫殿动物园计划吧。去把那些小动物救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Corpus. It is my delight to announce the most wonderful addition to my Palace of Prosperity. A zoo!! But not just any zoo, a zoo of playful chimeras. Hybrid creatures that my wonderfully creative scientific team is developing as we speak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: Corpus！请容我宣布，我的繁荣宫殿将增添一座最美丽的存在：动物园！！这并非凡俗之园，而是会由我那天才科研团队此刻正在研发的嵌合体所组成的动物园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Well that's mucking terrifying isn't it. We won't be letting that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 真特么吓人，不是吗？放心，我们绝不会让那种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Hello Genetics Research Division. How are my chimeras coming along? My zoo is waiting. I want my Virminkodon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 遗传学研究部的各位，我的嵌合体进展如何？我的动物园等不及了！我要我的弗鸣库伯顿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: A what???? We gotta get those critters outta there before Nef's mad scientists sew them together. But first I need you to do something for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 什么玩意？？？？我们得赶在奈富的那帮疯科学家把小动物拼接成怪物之前，把它们救出来。不过在此之前，我需要你先替我办件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Researchers! Why? Why? Is it taking so long to create my zoo hybrids? Do you need more specimens? Or do you need more motivation?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 研究员！怎么回事？为什么？我动物园的嵌合体要拖这么久？你们是缺样本，还是……缺点激励手段？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Those scientists could be trying to understand why the fruits and roots are keeping them alive. Instead they're mangling innocent critters to make freaks for Nef's Zoo. First things first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 那些科学家本该去研究果子和根为何帮他们维持生存，可现在却在虐待无辜的小动物，为了奈富的动物园把它们拼接成怪物。先说正事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Guts. You cleared them out without 'em getting so much as a foothold. Mucking inspiration you are, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 真有胆。你把他们清理得干干净净的，连站立足的机会都没给。你真够让人振奋的，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: That's the last of the merk-merks. Poor muckers didn't stand a chance against you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 这是最后一个雇佣兵了。那群可悲的家伙根本没机会打败你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Long as you're around these pests won't make any progress. Let's see if you can hit the next job just as fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 只要你在附近，这些害虫就不会有任何进展。看看你能否以同样快的速度完成下一个任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Clear out what's left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 清除剩下的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Almost there. Finish 'em off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 快完成了。干掉剩下的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: They're out of reinforcements. Clean 'em up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 他们没有增援了。清理掉他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: It's hard work, tending to a garden. But I can tell ya' first hand that it's all worth it in the end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 照料花园很辛苦。但我可以亲身告诉你，最终一切都是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Looks like you cleared the pests. Appreciate the toil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 看来你把害虫都清理干净了。感谢你的辛劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: All done. Don't worry, they'll do more good feedin' the substrate than they would helpin' Nef.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 全部搞定。别担心，他们滋养基质比替奈富干活强多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Buncha Taxmen massing. Whatever it is they're planning, it ain't good. Keep em' out of the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 一群税务官正在集结。不管他们在计划什么，肯定不是什么好事。让他们离开这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Corporate's got merks converging nearby. Get in there and stand your ground until they stop coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 企业让雇佣兵在附近集结。快进去，要坚守阵地，直到他们停止进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Merk-merks swarming like invasive pests. Time to show 'em whose garden this is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 雇佣兵像入侵的害虫一样蜂拥而至。是时候让他们看看这是谁的花园了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Half of 'em down. Fruits and roots are feeling better already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 干掉一半人了。果子和根已经好多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Just crossed the fifty percent mark, mate. Squash the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 刚刚才消灭了百分之五十的人，伙计。把剩下的也拍扁吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: One half gone, one half to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 已经除掉了一半，还剩一半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: More of 'em on the way. Keep swattin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 还有更多的人在过来。继续加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Corporate just don't know when to call it quits. More riffraff inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 企业就是不知道什么时候该收手。越来越多的杂兵正涌过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: More zits on the way, and they don't seem pleased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 越来越多的脓痘出现了，而且他们看起来不太高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: You're gonna have to put down a few invasives to get our target to show his ugly mug. Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 你得放倒几个害虫，才能让我们的目标露出他那副丑陋的嘴脸。赶紧行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Bossman's hiding in his office. Take out some merk-merks, make him pop out to see why they're not making quota.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 头子躲在办公室里不出来。干掉几个雇佣兵，让他出来看看为什么他们没完成配额。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: These management types aren't much for getting their hands dirty. But take out some of their expensive merks, and I guarantee you they'll come running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 这些管理层不太喜欢亲自下场。不过，要是能干掉一些他们重金雇来的雇佣兵，我保证他们会马上跳出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Raknoid skulking somewhere close. Knock some heads and it'll come running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 蛛形机正潜伏在附近。揍几个人，它自己就会跑过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: You know what'll make it poke its ugly head out? A bunch of dead corpus. Try it and see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 你知道什么会让它把丑陋的脑袋探出来吗？一堆死掉的 Corpus。试试看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Cause a ruckus and see if you can get 'em to scuttle out here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 闹出点动静，看看能不能让他们蹦出来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: He barely saw it coming. That's a message Nef can't ignore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 他几乎没料到会发生这一切。这是奈富无法忽视的消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Lightning quick you are. Mighty impressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 你真是快如闪电。很令人印象深刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Even the bossman had to be impressed with how quickly you got that job done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 甚至连头子都要对你完成工作的速度感到惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Got a pest 'needs dealing with. And by pest I mean middle-management. Coming down here doing corporate's dirty work. Not the kind of bottom feeder I appreciate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 有只害虫要收拾。我指的就是那帮中层管理。跑来替企业干脏活。这种爬虫可不是我想见到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Corporate's new manager. Don't like 'em. Don't like what he's up to in the garden. You take care of him for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 企业新来的经理。我不喜欢他，更不喜欢他在花园里干的那些破事。能不能替我解决掉他？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Not all invasive weeds are plants. Some got legs, guns, and ranks. Need to be pulled all the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 入侵的杂草可不全是植物。有些长了腿，扛着枪，还戴着军衔。但一样都得拔掉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Place looks better already. Come on up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 这个地方看起来已经好多了。上来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Knew I could count on you. Reckon Nef can't say the same for his former toady.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 我就知道可以信赖你。不过奈富嘛，他那条老狗可没这么给力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Ah, look at that, all done. I hope they didn't put up too much of a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 啊，看吧，都完成了。希望他们没让你太费劲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: One more job for you today and it's a big one. Corpus boss-man's been giving the roots and fruits no end of trouble. Find him and finish him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 今天还有个活儿交给你，而且是个大活儿。Corpus 的头头一直在给根和果子制造无尽的麻烦。找到他，干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Still got one in you, yeah, I know ya do. Got a corpus boss man, needs a full repo, if you catch my meaning. Marked him for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 还能再干一票，是吧，我知道你能。有个 Corpus 的头子，需要被彻底索回，你懂我的意思吧。我给你标记出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Marked a weed I need you to pull. Fruits and roots don't like em, and neither do I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 标记了一棵杂草，需要你拔掉。果子和根不喜欢它们，我也不喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: What is going on down here? Where is my palace? You haven't even broken ground yet. It's time for a shake up. Meet the new boss. He won't be as nice as the old boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 下面到底怎么回事？我的繁荣宫殿呢？连地基都还没动工！该动真格了。来见见新老板吧，他可不会像以前的老板那样好说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Let's give that new boss an early retirement. But first… the task list.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 让那位新老板提前退休吧。不过在那之前……先来看看任务清单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: My Palace of Prosperity will be an impenetrable fortress where no Narmer, Grineer, or even Corpus usurper will dare to enter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 我的繁荣宫殿将会是一座坚不可摧的堡垒，不管是合一众、Grineer，还是妄图夺权的 Corpus，都休想踏足半步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Too bad for him, you're already inside. Let's get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 他惨了，还不知道你已经进来了。干活吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: This place stinks! Filth grows everywhere. Commander! Kill it all. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 这地方臭气熏天！到处都是污秽。Corpus 指挥官！把它们全都清除掉。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Too much yapping and not enough listening. That's his problem. Your final target is that commander. On the way, I got some other work for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 只会说不会听。这就是他的问题。你的最终目标是那个指挥官。路上我还给你安排了点别的活儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Back to the earth they go. Good on 'em. Finally found a way to help out down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 他们入土为安了。对他们来说是好事！终于找到办法帮忙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: All the roots and fruits ever wanted was abundance. Too bad for that mucker he never learned to share.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 根和果子想要的不过是丰饶。可惜的是，这蠢货一点都不懂得分享。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Bossman eliminated. Betcha' the Taxmen won't be feeling nearly as bold after that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 头子被消灭了。我敢打赌，税务官们看到这事儿肯定吓破胆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Corporate's trying to muscle in with some stronger invasives. Roots and fruits got no defense against these new guys. 'Cept you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 企业正试图用更强大的害虫强行介入。根和果子根本无法抵御这些新来的。除了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Nef's new head lackey is down here cracking the whip on all those merks. Time to return the favor. Take him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 奈富的新任头头走狗正在这里鞭策那些雇佣兵。是时候还手了。干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Nef's got a new bossman working down here. Hand picked to wipe out the roots and fruits. And they will, unless you get to 'em first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 奈富派了个新头子来这里工作。他被精心挑选来消灭这些根和果子。除非你先下手为强，否则他们一定会得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: No arachnophobia for you. You got right in there. Good job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 看来你没有蜘蛛恐惧症。直接就上了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Did that thing owe you money? Could have sworn that was personal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 那玩意儿欠你钱吗？我敢发誓，那肯定是在报私仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Absolutely vicious. Remind me to stay on your sunny side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 太残暴了。提醒我以后一定不要得罪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Mucking imposter masquerading as a creature of the circle. Ain't part of nothing, and now is nothing. Sorry to raise me voice, I get worked up about the circle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 混蛋冒充生命循环里的生物。它根本就不属于任何地方，现在也什么都不是了。抱歉我刚才声音大了点，一提到生命循环我就容易激动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Gib-faced muckers think they can go around making a mockery of organic life without a lick of consequence. Thanks for proving 'em wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 那些丑脸混蛋以为他们可以肆意嘲弄有机生命，而不必承担任何后果。谢谢你证明他们错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: That's it. If corporate were smart, they'd stop sending those damn things down here, but they ain't... so doubt that this'll be the last of 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 搞定了。要是企业的人有点脑子的话，他们就不会再把这些该死的东西送到这里来了，但可惜他们没有……我敢说这不会是最后一批。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: New pest in the garden. Mucking invasive Raknoid's trampling all the fruits and crushing the roots. Don't need to tell you what needs doing, do I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 花园里又来害虫了。入侵的蛛形机把所有的果子都踩烂了，根也给压坏了。不用我说你也知道该怎么做了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: We got a Raknoid. Pretending to be part of the circle when it's nothing but nuts and bolts. Stomp that faker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 我们这儿来了一个蛛形机。它装作是生命循环的一部分，可它其实只是些螺母和螺栓。揍扁那个骗子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Got a Raknoid situation that I need you to take care of, mucking thing has been causing issues all over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 有个蛛形机问题需要你来帮忙处理，这东西到处制造问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Here it comes. Get stomping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 它来了。踩扁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: There's the damn pest! Send 'em to the dirt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 这该死的害虫来了！送它们入土。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Always so predictable. Take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 还是那么容易预测。把它解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Bigwig finally decided to show their face. Take 'em out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 大佬终于决定露面了。干掉他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: There's the stinkin' son of a Virmink. Eliminate the mucker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 那是弗鸣克娘养的臭儿子。除掉这个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.text: Bossman's here. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DA.zhText: 头子来了，你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DB.text: Oh a Spring Popper? A bundled out stack of explosives got nothing on anyone that eats one of those.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DB.zhText: 哦，春爆菇？一堆炸药都比不上吃下一颗这种菇的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DB.text: You ate a Spring Popper? Hope you're ready for some fireworks, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DB.zhText: 你吃了春爆菇吗？希望你准备好迎接烟花啦，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.text: Winter Spear? Don't think this is a time for sledding, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.zhText: 冬矛菇？难道你觉得现在是滑雪橇的好时候吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.text: Bundle up, Winter Spears will chill you faster than the coldest day in the Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.zhText: 穿暖和点，冬矛菇比山谷里最冷的一天更快地让你冻僵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.text: Guts, a Borica? Those'll dissolve you down to nothing if you're not careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.zhText: 糟了，是波利卡菇？一不小心，它们能把你溶化成乌有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.text: A Borica? Let's hope it can't eat through that there suit of yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DC.zhText: 波利卡菇？希望它不会把你的那套衣服吃掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: I'm impressed, mate! Drone barely has a scratch on it. This is going to be mighty useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 我太惊喜了，伙计！无人机几乎完好无损。这玩意儿肯定很有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: You kept the drone in tip-top condition, just like Nokko would'a done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 你让无人机保持了最佳状态，就像 Nokko 所做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Shrooms are done with the drone. Couldn't see a lick of paint out of place on it either, well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 蘑菇已经搞定无人机了。而且连一点漆都没掉，做得真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: That's all of it, good work mate. That buzzer can do a lot of good now that it's under our control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 好了就这样，干得漂亮，伙计。现在那个蜂鸣无人机在我们控制之下，它能发挥很大作用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Roots and fruits are done. That thing'll come in mighty handy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 根和果子都弄好了。那东西会派上用场的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Shrooms've got full control of the buzzer drone. Not a thing corporate can do about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 蘑菇完全控制了蜂鸣无人机。企业的人什么都做不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Should've known those muckers wouldn't let us go without a fight. Keep 'em off the drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 我早该想到那些混蛋不会让我们轻易撤退。别让他们碰无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Corporate would rather destroy their own tools than let us have control. Don't let 'em touch our new toy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 企业宁愿毁掉自己的工具，也不愿让我们掌控。别让他们碰我们的新玩具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Ah Guts. Taxmen incoming. Keep that buzzer safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 啊，糟了。税务官来了。保护好那台蜂鸣无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Roots and fruits are all over that thing. Lots to learn. Lots to learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 那东西上面全是根和果子。有很多东西要学。真的很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Roots and fruits have control. Make sure nothing happens to our new buzzer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 根和果子已经掌控了无人机。确保我们的新蜂鸣无人机不会出问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Now that the buzzer's down, those 'shrooms will get to work tinkering with its ticker. Do me a favor and keep it safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 现在蜂鸣无人机已经被打下来了，那些蘑菇要开始捣鼓它的核心了。帮我个忙，看紧它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Corporate seems to have left a buzzer droning all by its lonesome. Could be useful for us. Knock it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 企业好像留下了一个蜂鸣无人机。也许对我们有用。把它打掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Look at these Taxmen, leaving their drones floating around. Bring that thing to the ground. We'll make it ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 看看这些税务官，任由他们那无人机在天上到处飘。把那玩意儿弄下来。它就是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.text: Buzzer drones. Shoot 'em, flip 'em, and make 'em do the opposite of whatever they're doing right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DD.zhText: 蜂鸣无人机。射掉它们，翻转它们，让它们做跟现在完全相反的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Thunder-button? Be careful around sensitive electronics for the next while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 雷纽菇？接下来一段时间要小心敏感电子设备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Got places to be? That Thunder-button'll get you there… Quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 有地方要去吗？那颗雷纽菇可以带你去……速度飞快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Used to think I did hard work that others couldn't. Then I realized there was a difference between couldn't and shouldn't, and I stopped doing that work. Today, I need you to deal with muckers who wouldn't learn that lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 我以前觉得我能完成别人做不到的工作。后来我意识到"做不到"和"不应该做"还是有区别的，然后我就没再干那些活了。今天，我需要你来对付那些就是不肯学乖的混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Roots and fruits miss Nokko. See, it's hard to live and grow when you got an army of merks trampling all over you. Need you to fight for them like Nokko used to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 根和果子很想念 Nokko。你看，当有一群雇佣兵在你头上横冲直撞的时候，想要生存并长大是很难的。我需要你像 Nokko 以前那样，守护它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Too many merk-merks trying to turn the garden into some sort of gilded bunker for his majesty Nef Anyo. Put an end to all that, will ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 一群雇佣兵非要把花园变成奈富·安尤的镀金堡垒。收拾掉他们，行不行？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: You made quick work of them. Plenty of fertilizer for the roots and fruits. They'll appreciate that. Come see me if you need more work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 动作利落！果子和根有大把肥料享用了。它们会感激你的。要是还想找活儿干，就来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: You can't get rid of invasives for good, but you can slow 'em down. And today, you gave the roots and fruits a fighting chance. Go put your feet up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 害虫是清不完的，但你能拖慢他们的步伐。今天，你让果子和根有了反抗的机会。去歇歇吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Hear that? It's almost peaceful down here. Don't rest too easy though, always got more work for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 听见了吗？下面总算安静了一些。不过别以为能轻松太久，我手里还有大把活儿等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Do what Nokko used to do and send them a message. Take out as many invasive Corpus as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 像 Nokko 当年那样，给他们点颜色瞧瞧。能干掉多少 Corpus 害虫，就干掉多少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Here's the problem with invasives. You got one, you got ten. Once you got ten, you got a thousand. So… Let's thin 'em out a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 那群害虫就是这样。一个变十个，十个变一千。所以……我们得先削减点数目。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Like I always say, the deepmines is a garden. And like any garden you gotta pull the weeds. And by weeds, I mean Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 就像我常说的，深矿就像一座花园。可花园里总有杂草。杂草就是 Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Why? Why is my beautiful project so far behind schedule? Can the fierce Corpus not eradicate some meager fungus? It's time you gave unto the Void once more… With your lives if necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 怎么回事？为什么我美好的项目进度落后这么多？勇猛的 Corpus 连一点真菌都铲除不了？是时候再次向虚空奉献了……如有必要，不惜牺牲你的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Ah, there he is. Corporate's head priest. Need you to give him a human resources deficit, but first I got some other jobs for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 啊，他出现了。企业的首席祭司。我需要你给他来点人力资源赤字，不过在那之前，我还有些别的活儿要你去做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: It's overtime time. Double the crews. Double the eradication. My Palace of Prosperity must be built.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 加班时间到了。人员加倍。清除任务加倍。我的繁荣宫殿必须建成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Yeah, what he said, only… the exact mucking opposite. First things first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 是啊，就像他说的，不过……正好特么反过来。眼下先干正事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Excuse me, Corpus. Why does my palace's new atrium still look like a forty day old sandwich?? Clean this place up immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: Corpus，我请问。为什么我宫殿的新中庭看起来还是像个放了四十天的三明治？赶紧把这里打扫干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: If Nef wants the Deepmines cleaned, let's start with his invasives. But first, I've got a couple other things need doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 既然奈富想要清理深矿，那就先从他的害虫开始吧。不过首先，我还有几件事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: You cleared 'em out right quick. Merk-merks will think twice before they come 'round these parts again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 你很快就把他们清理干净了。那些雇佣兵以后再来这地方可得三思了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Almost scary how quick you work. Got another task for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 你工作速度快得吓人。又给你安排了个活儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Real glad you ain't on Nef's side, speedy as you are. Heard something interesting from one of the Taxmen before they croaked. Time to move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 真庆幸你没站在奈富那边，毕竟你速度这么快。在税务官死前，我听到他们说了些有趣的事。该行动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: That's the last of 'em. Don't worry 'bout the invasives, they get to join the circle. They'll be much more productive that way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 这是最后一个了。别担心那些害虫，他们会加入这个生命循环。这样他们的效率会更高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: You've broken 'em. Feel that? It's more peaceful down here already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 你已经打垮他们了。感觉到了吗？这里已经安静多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Taxmen eliminated, and some fresh eats for the roots and fruits. Quite helpful really.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 除掉了税务官，还给果子和根送了一些新鲜的口粮。说真的，很有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Looks like we got a fresh batch of invasives moving in. Let's mulch 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 看起来我们又迎来了一批新害虫。让我们把他们变成肥料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Taxmen are getting too comfortable 'round these parts. Go thin 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 税务官在这些地方待得太舒服了。去减少他们的人数吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Merk-merks are causing havoc left and right. Would ya kindly weed out some of them muckers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 雇佣兵正在到处制造混乱。你能不能把这些混蛋清理掉一些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: You're about halfway there. Keep knocking 'em down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 你已经完成一半了。继续打倒他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Merk-merks ain't looking too hot. Double up your body count and you'll be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 雇佣兵看起来不太好。再多放倒一倍的人数，你就能收工了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.text: Keep it up, mate. Once you cut down the other half you can move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DE.zhText: 坚持下去，伙计。一旦你干掉另一半，你就可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: Look at that. You found some Fergolyte. Fresh grub for the Prince.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 看看那个。你找到了一些铁离石。给王子菇的新鲜口粮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: Fergolyte? I got a hungry Prince back in the airlock that would feast on that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 铁离石？我的气密舱里有一颗饥饿的王子菇，它肯定会大快朵颐的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: Oh looks like you got a spot of Fergolyte. Feed that to the Prince.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 哦，看来你弄到一点铁离石了。把它喂给王子菇吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: Ah Fergolyte? They say the soil remembers. They say a lot of things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 啊，铁离石？它们说土壤有记忆。不过它们什么都说得出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: Whatcha got there? Fergolyte. Bring that back to the airlock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 你那儿有什么？铁离石。把它带回气密舱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.text: That's Fergolyte. I know one little fruit that won't grow in anything but.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DF.zhText: 那是铁离石。我知道有一种小果子，只能在这上面长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DG.text: The name should tell ya everything you need to know: Reeking Puffball.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DG.zhText: 这个名字应该够形象的了。臭屎菇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DG.text: Reeking Puffball'll make you smell worse than a Horrasque's dung.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DG.zhText: 散发着恶臭的臭屎菇会让你的气味比惑瓦斯克的粪便还要难闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DH.text: Feeling the heat? Blister Stalks are spicy enough to give me the sweats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DH.zhText: 感觉热吗？疱杆菇辣得我直冒汗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DH.text: A Blister Stalk eh? That's a spicy one.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.text: An Ironwood? Might feel like you've been dropped on your head for the next bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.zhText: 铁木菇？接下来的时间可能会让你感受到砸脑袋似的猛烈冲击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.text: You ate an Ironwood, looks like. Watch out! That one hits hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.zhText: 看来你吃了一颗铁木菇。小心它冲击力很猛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.text: Oh that? Yeah, that's The Prince or will be if we can manage to grow it, needs fergolyte, but that's rare in the Deepmines these days, I tell you. Ain't been able to find any of that since well, I don't remember. Some say The Prince makes ya dream funny. I say that's just nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DI.zhText: 哦，那个啊？没错，那是王子菇，或者说，如果能把它种出来的话才算是。它需要铁离石，不过我跟你说，那东西在深矿里现在可不常见。我都记不清上回找到是什么时候了。有人说，王子菇会让人做奇怪的梦。我觉得那是无稽之谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: A Ferrofungus? Looks like it's 'shields down' for our Corpus friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 铁真菌？看来我们的 Corpus 朋友们的"护盾要不行了"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Ferrofungus? Get ready to attract a lot of new friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 铁真菌？准备好吸引许多新朋友吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Let me guess. The Tenno? Send reinforcements. Kill the betrayers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 让我猜猜，是 Tenno？增派援军。杀了叛徒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: What is the hold up? I don't care what the problem is. Fix it. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 还在拖什么？不管出了什么问题。马上，给我解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Hello, Tenno, I know you can hear me. It's just one fungal colony. There are others on Venus. Why waste your time on this one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: Tenno，我知道你在听。这只不过是一个真菌群落罢了。金星上多得是，何必在这里浪费时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Corpus, the Void sees you. It sees you holding back. What more can you give? Remember: my success will be your success. Whether you find those riches here, or in the great beyond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: Corpus，虚空注视着你们。它看到你们仍在退缩。你们还能奉献什么？记住：我的成功，就是你们的成功。无论财富是在此地，还是在那无尽彼岸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: The Void despises filth. The Void adores order and cleanliness. Do you wish to receive the Void's gifts? Then wipe this place clean!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 虚空厌恶污秽，崇尚秩序与洁净。你们想要得到虚空的恩赐吗？那就把这里清理干净！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Merk-merks are built for hunting, but you? You're a forager through and through. They never stood a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 雇佣兵是天生的狩猎者，但你呢？你是天生的采集者。他们根本就没有机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Didn't let a single drop of Syzygy get taken. I see why the fruits and roots like you so much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 连朔望花的一点能量都没被抢走。我终于明白为什么果子和根这么喜欢你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Imagine the look on Nef's face when his merk-merks show up without a lick of Syzygy. Could bring a tear to my eye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 想象一下，当奈富那些佣兵们空手而归，连一丁点朔望花都没弄到，他脸上会是什么表情。简直要让我笑哭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: One down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 搞定一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: One less bloom for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 他们现在少了一朵花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Foraged safe and sound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 安全采集。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Guts, Muckers got some!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 糟糕，让这些混蛋抢到一些了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: They got some Syzygy! Don't let 'em get anymore, mate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 他们搞到一些朔望花了！别让他们再抢到别的了，伙计！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Invasives made off with some energy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 害虫们带着一些能量逃走了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: That's the last of 'em. I doubt they'll be able to do much with the energy they got. Thanks mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 就剩这些了。我怀疑他们靠那点能量也做不了什么。多谢了，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Good work mate, doubt them gib-faced buffoons got anywhere close to the amount of Syzygy they needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 干得好，伙计，我敢说这些丑脸小丑离他们需要的朔望花数量还差得远呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Looks like foraging season is over. A bountiful harvest for you means slim pickings for them. Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 看来采集的季节已经结束了。你的丰收意味着他们的颗粒无收。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Got a hunch that a few Syzygy are about to fruit nearby. Find em'. Then stay close while keeping the merks away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 感觉附近有几株朔望花快要结果了。找到它们。然后守着它们，同时避开那些雇佣兵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: The Syzygy blooms for minutes, releases its energy and then dies. Get close to 'em and capture their energy before the taxmen get anywhere near.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 朔望花会绽放几分钟，释放能量，然后凋零。趁着税务官还没靠近，赶紧靠近它们，收集它们的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: For the love of... Just heard the merk-merks are foraging for Syzygy. You got to get to them first. When you do, stay close til they're done blooming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 我的天啊……我刚听说雇佣兵们正在采集朔望花。你得抢先一步找到它们。找到之后，一定要守着它们，直到它们开完花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: 'Nother cluster of Syzygy blooming. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 又有一簇朔望花开花了。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: More fungi ready for ya'. Get that energy before the merks do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 又有更多的真菌已为你准备就绪。赶在雇佣兵之前获取能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: More about to bloom. Don't let the Taxmen pluck 'em first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 更多花朵即将开花。别让税务官先把它们摘下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Don't listen to that trash, mate. Corporate just wants a little fungal remediation, is'all. Get in. Get out. Get paid. Easy credits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 别听那些废话，伙计。企业想做点真菌治理，就这么点事。一进。一出。就是一笔。钞票轻松到手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Right? Something messing with our gear? Sure you ain't been snacking on these mushrooms, mate?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 嗯？是不是有东西在破坏我们的装备？你确定没把这些蘑菇当零嘴吃，伙计？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Job sure would be easier if these mushrooms weren't so mucking pretty to look at.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 要是这些蘑菇没特么这么惹眼的话，这工作可就轻松多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Watch the spores! Get back to the airlock you MUCKERS! Run! What the hell is that??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 小心那些孢子！快回气密舱，你们这群蠢货！快跑！那到底是什么玩意？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Hey. For Sol's sake who let a mucking kid down here? Hey! Get back here. Stop mucking about with our gear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 嘿。我的老天爷啊，是谁让这小屁孩到这儿来的？嘿！给我回来。别再乱碰我们的装备了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: You little mucker. You dumped me muckin' accelerant. Huh, smart little mucker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 你这个小混蛋。你把老子的助燃剂全他妈倒了。哼，还挺聪明的小混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: No corporate. No co. Nokko. I'm gonna call you Nokko.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 不属于哪家企业。就是 "No co"。Nokko。那我就叫你 Nokko 吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: All this fungi… I swear it's filtering the waste from the towers. You take the fungi away and Venus goes all fire and brimstone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 这些蘑菇……我敢说它们正在净化塔里的废料。你要是把这些蘑菇清理掉，金星就会变成一片火海。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: It has come to my attention that some Solaris are refusing work orders in the deepmines. Such insubordination will be dealt with swiftly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 我注意到部分索拉里斯人拒绝执行深矿区的作业指令。此类不服从行为将受到严厉处置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: No. Mr. Anyo, sir! I will not comply. I'm shutting down the elevator. Nothing more goes up and nothing more comes down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 不。安尤先生！我拒绝执行。我要关掉电梯。谁也别想上去或下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Well look at you, Nokko. You ain't some leftover freak that some Orokin mucker made in a lab. Don't know how or why, but somewhere along the line you became the roots and fruits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 看看你，Nokko。你可不是什么 奥罗金混蛋在实验室里弄出来的残次怪物。不知道怎么回事，但在某个阶段，你变成了根和果子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: I should have never sent Solaris to do the job of Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 我真不该派索拉里斯人去执行 Corpus 的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Nokko! They're coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: Nokko！他们来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: I'm blowing the mineshaft. No more coming in. No more getting out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 我要炸了矿井。谁都别想进来。也别想出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Just you and me now, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 现在只剩你和我了，小子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Okay. Nokko. Your garden is safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 好了。Nokko。不会再有人来花园了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: (Happy noises)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: （欢快的声音）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: It's getting dark, Nokko. I don't think I can help you much longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 天色变暗了，Nokko。我想我帮不了你多久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: (Sad Nokko noises)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: （悲伤的 Nokko 声音）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: Goodbye, Nokko.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 再见，Nokko。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: (Warm low sigh)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: （温暖的低叹）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.text: You're trying to tell me, that I, good old Nightcap, died down here ages ago? Haha. You better be careful, The Prince can play tricks on you. He's a funny fella, just like Nokko. But you gotta keep your head on straight. Trust me, you ain't careful, this place will turn you all sorts funny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DM.zhText: 你是想告诉我，我，善良的老夜帽，很久以前就死在这了？哈哈。你最好小心点，王子菇会捉弄人的。他是个有趣的家伙，就像 Nokko 一样。但你得保持头脑清醒。相信我，要是你一不小心，这个地方能把你整得神志不清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Ohhhh. Look at that, mate. That's a prime sample, that is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 哦哦哦。看看这个，伙计。这可是优质样本啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Whoa. I haven't seen one of these since. Since… Well, since a long time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 哇哦。从那以后我就没见过这种东西了。自从……嗯，很久之前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Doesn't get any better than that, now does it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 没有比这更好的了，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Oh, you're making me jealous mate. Out there in wild, fingers in the soil, just seeing what you can find. I'd be out there too if it wasn't for corporate messing the whole thing up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 哦，伙计，你可真让我嫉妒。能在野外动手翻翻土，然后看看能找到什么。要不是企业把一切搞砸了，我也早出去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Dreamers. Ever think about what lives below the surface? An entire universe that we step on everyday. Quietly toiling away, making life above possible. Until some bigwig with a plan says, 'sterilize this filth.' Well, Dreamers, that's exactly what's about to happen in the Deepmines below Fortuna. Unless somebody drops in to help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 梦回者，你可曾想过地表之下栖息着怎样的生命？那是我们每天踩在脚下的完整世界。它们默默劳作，才让地上的生活得以延续。直到某个满脑子算计的大人物下令：「把这些脏东西全清掉。」没错，梦回者，这正是福尔图娜地底深矿即将面临的遭遇。除非，有人愿意挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: There's a buzz in Fortuna. Something's changing. Something's growing. In the basement below the basement. And that something is calling out for help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 福尔图娜流言四起。有东西变了……有东西在滋长。在那更深的地底。有东西在呼救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: You ever wonder, who speaks for the dirt? For the untold millions of organisms living beneath your feet? Mushrooms, fungus, microbiota? The creatures that keep the circle of life turning. Nowhere is that life more fragile than the Orb Vallis. That's where I'm hearing it from. A voice in the darkness calling for backup. Dreamers. Are you going to answer that call?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 你可曾想过，谁会为尘土发声？为那些栖息在你脚下，数以百万计的无名生灵发声？为了那些蘑菇、真菌、微生物群？那些维系生态循环运转的生灵。没有哪处比奥布山谷更脆弱。正是在那里，我听见了它们的声音。黑暗中有一道声响在呼救。梦回者，你会回应这声呼唤吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Hearing strange reports from Fortuna, Dreamers. Mushrooms sprouting where they've never sprouted before. In the walls, the machines, in the toxic wastes. They say they're hearing something coming from the vents that lead down to the old decommissioned Deepmines and it sounds like laughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 梦回者，我收到了福尔图娜传来怪异的报告。蘑菇在以前从未长过的地方萌发。墙壁里，机器中，甚至是有毒废料上。有人说他们听到了从废弃深矿的通风口中传来的声音，听起来像是笑声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Mushrooms. Some can kill you, others make a great salad, and still others, they can spread your mind out until you're not sure where you end and where the universe begins. But not everyone respects their local fungi, Nef Anyo has called for their eradication from the Deepmines below Fortuna so he can build his Palace of Prosperity. If you ask me, someone needs to head down there to show Nef where to shove his new palace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 蘑菇。有些能致命，有些很好吃，还有些能让你神游天外，让你分不清自我与宇宙的界限。可是并非所有人都敬畏他们当地的真菌。奈富·安尤已下令，将福尔图娜地底深矿里的蘑菇彻底根除，只为建造他新的繁荣宫殿。要我说，该有人下去帮个忙，把那座宫殿狠狠塞进奈富的屁股里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.text: Nora here, Dreamers, and tonight we're truly hearing from the underground. Down below the Vallis lies a deep, deep mine, and down in that mine live some special little guys doing no harm to nobody. Enter a certain tinpot hemorrhoid by the name of Nef Anyo. He wants to build a shining Palace of Prosperity in that dark, damp garden. No regard at all for the folks who have roots down there. You gonna stand for that, Dreamers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DN.zhText: 我是诺拉，梦回者，今晚我们听到的是来自地下的真实声音。在山谷的下方，有一座很深很深的矿区，那里住着一些特别的小家伙，他们与世无争。后来一个名叫奈富·安尤的泼皮无赖闯了进来。他想在那座阴暗潮湿的花园里，建造一座金碧辉煌的繁荣宫殿。完全不顾及那些早已在那里扎了根的生命。你能咽得下这口气吗，梦回者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Dull Button? Good in soup and that's about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 淡纽菇？用来做汤不错，就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: You chose a Dull Button. They have a flavor, if you boil 'em long enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 你选了一颗淡纽菇。煮得够久的话，它们才会有点味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: You let them do what? Tenno, I will find you. Mark my words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 你放任它们干了什么？Tenno，我一定会找到你。记住我的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: You cannot stop progress. I will sterilize this cesspool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 你们无法阻止项目的推进。我会把这片烂泥塘彻底消毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Who is this… "Nightcap"? He's not on any work lists or debt ledgers. Find him and end him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 这个……"夜帽"是谁？他不在任何工作名单或债务账簿上。去把他找出来，处理掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Tenno, you used to protect the Orokin Seven, now you fight for this… festering scum. How far you've fallen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: Tenno，你曾守护着奥罗金七人众，如今却为这……腐烂的败类而战。你堕落到什么地步了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Corpus. You can't even conquer a hole in the ground? What am I paying you for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: Corpus。你们连地底下的一个洞都征服不了？那我付钱给你干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: What is with these Tenno and their obsession with promoting weakness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 这些 Tenno 为何如此痴迷于推崇软弱？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: You think you've won today, Tenno? My resources are bottomless. I will spend you to death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 你以为你今天赢了吗，Tenno？我的资源取之不尽，用之不竭。我会把你耗死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Mess with my operations again. I dare you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 有种再来破坏我的行动试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Do I not deserve a space where I can be safe, Tenno? Your Lotus hid the moon in the Void for you, and you won't let me have this? Shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 难道我不配拥有一个安全的地方吗，Tenno？你的 Lotus 曾为了你将月球藏在虚空中，而你却连这都不愿给我？真是可耻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: By the Void, Tenno. Why are you so scared of a great man doing great things? I pity you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 虚空啊，Tenno。你为何如此惧怕一位伟人成就伟业？我真可怜你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: Thorn tooth? Things might get a little prickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 刺牙菇？事情可能会变得有点扎人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.text: A Thorn tooth is the fruit you want when you're looking to make a pincushion outta someone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DP.zhText: 当你想要把某人做成针垫时，刺牙菇会是你想要的果实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Oh mate. You ate a Gamma Berry didn't ya? Oh well, little radiation never hurt no one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 哦，伙计。你吃了伽玛莓吧？算了，一点辐射又不会怎样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Ah, a Gamma Berry? Mutations should be temporary, 'least I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 啊，伽玛莓？突变应该是暂时的，至少我是这么认为的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Those Virmink couldn't have had a better protector than you. Not a scratch on 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 那些弗鸣克不可能有比你更好的保护者了。它们毫发无损。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Walk in the park. Those critters almost looked like they were having fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 小菜一碟。那些小动物看起来很开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Totally unharmed. Nokko would be proud of that effort, he would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 毫发无损。Nokko 一定会为你的努力感到骄傲，他会的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Nef's captured some Vallis animals, some nonsense about a zoo for his new palace. Get 'em out and escort the beasties to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 奈富捕获了一些山谷动物，还扯什么要在他的新宫殿里建动物园。把它们救出来，然后护送这些动物到安全的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Nef's taken some top-side critters hostage. Free those Virmink, and see that they get out safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 奈富抓走了一些地上的小动物。去救出那些弗鸣克，确保它们安全逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Gib-faced muckers are kidnapping Vallis animals for some sort of zoo? Cut 'em loose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 那些丑脸混蛋绑架了山谷的动物，准备建个动物园？放它们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Safe and sound back in the Vallis wilderness. Nicely done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 平安返回山谷荒野。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Good work. Just like Nokko would'a done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 干得好。简直就像 Nokko 那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Roam free, fluffballs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 去尽情撒欢吧，小毛团们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: You really legged it out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 你跑得可真快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Proper jailbreak that was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 这才是真正的越狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Done already? You been drinking your go go juice. Don't stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 这就完成了？看来你喝了加速药水吧。别停下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: I'd say that lucky mucker owes you but I don't think they need anymore debt. Let's just call that a freebie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 我想说，那个幸运的蠢货欠你人情，但我觉得他们的债已经够多的了。这次我们就当是白送吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: You piked 'em right out of there. We got more work coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 你把他们从那儿救出来了。我们还有更多工作要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: One less repo on Nef's ledgers. Let's keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 奈富的账本上少了一个索回对象。我们继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Taxmen just arrested a topside worker for debt crimes. Let's cut that chap a break and set 'em free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 税务官刚刚逮捕了一名涉嫌债务犯罪的地表工人。我们去给那家伙一个机会，让他重获自由吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Word is, Nef's got a Solaris locked up down here for heavy debt. Let's pop 'em free before their tinker winds up on a shelf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 据说，奈富把一个索拉里斯人关在这里，因为这人欠了巨额债务。趁他还没沦落到脑子被摆上架，赶紧把他救出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Fruits and roots tell me there's a rig jockey in a cage around here. Got time for a little jailbreak?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 果子和根告诉我，这附近有个笼子里关着个技工。有时间去劫个狱吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Sprodling's secured. What a relief! Now that that's taken care of, let's see what other Corpus nonsense we can spoil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 菌宝安全了。真是松了一口气！既然已经事情已经解决了，那就看看还能破坏 Corpus 其他什么乱七八糟的东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Don't worry little fellas, you're safe now. Okay. Next order of business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 小家伙们别担心，你们现在安全了。好的。继续下一个任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: You're safe little Sprodlings, but no more playing round the merks, you hear me? Gotta be tough on the little ones, for their own good, you know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 小菌宝，你们没事了，但别再跟这些雇佣兵玩了，听见了吗？对小家伙们严厉一点是为了你们好，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Good as the day they sprouted. Bounce on little ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 和它们发芽的那天一样精神。跳吧，小家伙们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: I thought for sure they were done for, can't thank you enough Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 我还以为它们肯定要完蛋了，我真是太感谢你了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Look at them bouncing around like they never got kidnapped by an army of morally corrupt mercenaries. Good on yah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 看看它们蹦蹦跳跳的样子，就像没被一群道德败坏的雇佣兵绑架过一样。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Who puts Sprodlings in cages? Mucking Nef and his band of morally compromised geneticists, that's who. Crack 'em free, will ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 是谁把菌宝关进笼子里的？就是那帮道德败坏的遗传学家，就是那个混蛋奈富。把它们解救出来，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Red alert. Nef's goons have captured some Sprodlings. I'm not saying they're gonna put them in the juicer, but if you rescue them first, they won't have a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 红色警报。奈富的暴徒抓走了一些菌宝。我不是说他们会把它们丢进榨汁机，但如果你先把它们救出来，他们就没这个机会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Taxmen have gone and nabbed a few of me favorite Sprodlings. Let's rectify that, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 税务官抓走了几个我最喜欢的菌宝。我们是不是该去纠正一下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Couldn't even blink before you healed 'em all. Mighty impressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 眨眼之间，你就把它们全部治好了。真厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: The Sprodlings are bouncing back to health in record time. Here's hoping they're more careful about what they eat next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 菌宝以创纪录的速度恢复了活力。希望它们下次吃东西能长点心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: You're quicker than you look, mate. Sprodlings would hate to play ya in hide and seek, that's for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 你比看上去要快得多，伙计。菌宝肯定不会想跟你玩捉迷藏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: That's all of 'em. Here's hoping they can stay safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 就这些了。希望它们平安无事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: You got all the Sprodlings hopping again. That's good to see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 你让所有的菌宝又蹦跶起来了。真是太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: All me Sprodlings are back where they belong. Now let's see if we can hit back at Nef.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 所有菌宝都回到了它们该去的地方。现在我们看看能不能反击奈富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Word in the garden is that a few of Nokko's Sprodlings got into Nef's fungicide. Need you to find 'em and give the jolt of life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 花园里传来消息，Nokko 的几个菌宝掉进了奈富的杀菌剂里。需要你找到它们，并给它们注入活力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Nokko's little Sprodlings help in keepin' me garden safe but Nef's poison has been taking its toll. Find those tykes and nurse 'em back to health.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: Nokko 的菌宝帮我守护着花园，但奈富的毒药对它们造成了伤害。找到这些小家伙，好好照顾它们，让它们恢复健康。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Ah, this one, this task's important. Nef's poison water is making the Sprodlings sick. Need you to find them and get them jumping again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 啊，这个，这个任务很重要。奈富的毒水让菌宝生病了。你需要找到它们，让它们恢复活力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Happy? Now get back to gardening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 开心吗？现在回去打理花园吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Off they go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 它们走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Think that one liked you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 我觉得那只喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: I reckon' our little prince there is a bit famished. He'd love some fergolyte, if you got some.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 我觉得咱们这小王子菇都有点饿过头了。你要是有铁离石的话，他会很想吃的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: Hear that? Guess you don't. Our prince is telling you he's hungry again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 听见了吗？看来你听不见。我们的王子菇是在告诉你他又饿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.text: I think The Prince is ready for some more Fergolyte if you can get your mitts on some.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DR.zhText: 我想王子菇已经准备好要更多铁离石了，如果你能弄到的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Good hustle. That's the last of the energy cells AND merk-merks. Ah, Nokko, would be proud of you, he would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 干得漂亮！这是最后的能量电池和雇佣兵了。啊，Nokko，他会为你感到骄傲的，一定会的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Just like the old days with Nokko. Reckon that hurt the bottom line almost as much as it hurt them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 就像当年和 Nokko 在一起的时候一样。我估计他们受到的利润伤害几乎和受到的身体伤害一样大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Without power down here taxmen'll be working double time to keep Nef happy. Let's see if we can't make things worse for 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 要是地下断了电，税务官们就得加班加点地干活哄奈富开心了。我们正好再给他们添点堵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Corporate only cares for their bottom line, and what you just broke? Looked proper expensive. Fancy some more mischief?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 企业只关心自己的财产，而你刚才破坏的东西？看起来真贵。还想再搞点恶作剧吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Muckers'll have a hard time hurtin' the roots and fruits in the dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 只要是在黑暗中，混蛋们就很难伤害到根和果子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Corporate can't operate down here without energy, just like the Vallis can't do without the roots and fruits. Here's hoping they realize that eventually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 没有能源，企业就无法在这里运转，就像山谷没有了根和果子一样。希望他们最终能意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: There they are. Lazy as usual. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 他们在那里。还是那么懒。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Found 'em? Time to cause some damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 找到他们了吗？是时候搞一些破坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Cells are in your neighborhood, looks like. Scuttle 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 看起来，电池就在你附近。赶紧把它们运走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Corporate's using power cells to help run their labs. Time to make like Nokko and turn the lights out. Get to a terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 企业正在使用电池来维持实验室的运转。是时候像 Nokko 那样把灯关掉了。去终端机吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Invasives are powering their tech with mounted power cells. Time for a blackout. Find a terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 害虫们正在用装载式电池给他们的科技设备供电。停电时间到了。去找一个终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Corporate needs power cells to keep the lights on. Roots and fruits prefer the darkness. So find a terminal and we'll give 'em what they like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 企业需要电池来让灯亮着。而根和果子更喜欢黑暗。所以，找到一个终端机，我们就能满足它们的需求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: A Devil's Cap? Wicked little 'shroom, that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 魔鬼帽？那是一种邪恶的小蘑菇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.text: Devil's Cap? Combat's about to get real messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DS.zhText: 魔鬼帽？战斗即将变得惨烈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Vomval Trumpet, eh? Don't believe everything you see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 轰击号角菇，嗯？别相信你看到的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Was that a Vomval Trumpet? We all better hold on tight, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 那是轰击号角菇吗？那我们最好抓紧了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Chose a real nasty little fella to eat, mate. Luckily a Muck Bonnet's toxin wears out quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 你还真是选了个超恶心的小家伙吃，伙计。还好，泥帽菇的毒素消得快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Muck Bonnets ain't pleasant. You're in for a rough ride until it works through yah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 泥帽菇可不是什么好东西。你一路都会不好受，直到它的劲儿过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Not as easy as I would have hoped, but the supplies are ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 这并不像我期待的那么容易，但物资是我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Won't make it far in life without provisions and preparation. It would do Nef some good to remember that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 人生若没有充足的供给和准备，就无法走得很远。或许奈富应该记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Merk-merks won't be happy being ransacked like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 雇佣兵被这样洗劫一空一定会很不高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Should've known it was too good to be true. Taxmen incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 我早该知道最近的情况好得不真实。税务官要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Guts. Counted our bolarolas before they hatched. Corporate inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 该死。算盘打错了。企业那帮家伙来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Looks like the merk-merks are on to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 看起来雇佣兵已经发现我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Done already. Did the merks even know you were there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 搞定。那些人有意识到你在那里吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: I'm in awe, mate. See if you can make the next job look that easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 我太佩服你了，伙计。看看你接下来的工作能不能也这么轻松搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Taxmen keeping their supplies out in the open. They should be more careful. Someone might take 'em. Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 税务官就这样把物资放在外面。他们应该小心点的。因为可能会有人顺走，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Seems the taxmen left their supplies out without a lick of cover. Must be their offering for the communal shed, how nice of 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: 看来税务官把物资直接放在外面，一点儿掩护都没有。这些肯定是他们用来捐给公共棚屋的吧，真是好心人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.text: Corpus rank and file ain't the sharpest, but keeping supplies unguarded? Teach 'em to take better care of their things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DT.zhText: Corpus 的喽啰脑袋真不灵光，竟然让物资无人看管？教教他们怎么保管自己的物品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Doesn't take much, you know. Little food. Little water. Roots and fruits want to grow. It's what they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你知道的，不需要太多。给点食物。给点水。根和果子就会想长出来。这就是它们的天性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Coolant waste. Industrial waste. People waste. You name it, I've got fungi that'll be more than happy to gobble it up for ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 冷却液废料。工业废料。人类废料。不管是什么，我都有真菌乐意帮你消化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Who does this Nef fella' think he is? Coming to the Vallis pretending he alone can make it green when the roots and fruits have been doing that work since time immemorial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 奈富这家伙算哪根葱？跑到山谷里来装模做样，还自称只有他才能让山谷绿起来，而根和果子老早就开始做这件事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: There was a time before, you know. Don't mean before the Corpus, or before Orokin. I mean before the firestorm took over Venus. I think the fruits and roots remember that. Least, 'like to think they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你知道吗，很久以前有过这么一段时光。不是指 Corpus 之前，也不是指奥罗金之前。我指的是火焰风暴席卷金星之前。我想果子和根还记得那段时光。至少，我倾向于觉得它们记得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: So, what's with the get'up, is it Naberus or something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 所以，这身行头是怎么回事？是庆祝纳贝流士还是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Mushrooms. Some's good for you. Some's bad. Some's somewhere in between.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 蘑菇。有些对你有好处，有些有害，有些则介于两者之间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You see Nokko out there, you be nice, little guy's me old mate, he is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你要是在外面看到了 Nokko，对他好点，小家伙可是我的老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Corporate got new plans for the deepmines. Here's the thing about plans though, all sorts of things blow your plans up. Specifically explosives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 企业搞了新的深矿计划。可计划嘛，总会被各种因素搅黄。尤其是炸药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Yeah, I got me a whisper network. Walls got ears y'know. If something happens in the deepmines, I'm the first to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 对了，我弄了个私信网络。隔墙有耳，你懂的。如果深矿里有什么动静，我肯定第一个知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: We were all doing just fine down here till Nef and his merk-merks showed up. Cleaning up? That's what the roots and fruits do. Get rid of them and you can see how quickly this turns upside down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我们在这里本来过得挺好，直到奈富和他那帮打手出现。清理？那本就是根和果子的工作。没了它们，你会看到这里的一切很快就会天翻地覆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: That Nef Anyo bloke's trying to sham some sort of glow-up for the deepmines. Deepmines are doing just fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 奈富·安尤那家伙正试图打着焕新的旗号来搞深矿。可深矿一直好好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You find it bright in here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你有没有觉得这里很明亮？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Hey, who's this Narmer I keep hearing about? Sounds like a bunch of gib-faced dung muckers to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 嘿，我一直听人说的合一众是谁？听着像一群粪堆里的丑八怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Sometimes, it feels like I've been down here forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 有时，我感觉我已经在这里待了很久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: That door there? Used to open to the Deepmines. But corporate and I had a bit of a labor disagreement and it just stopped working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 那扇门啊？以前是通向深矿区的。但我和企业闹了点劳资纠纷，这门也就坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: I do miss the surface. Wonder what Fortuna's gonna look like when they finish construction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我还真挺想念地面的。不知道福尔图娜建成后会是什么样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: So, ready to do some gardening?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 那么，准备好整些园艺活了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Felt like, for a while, that Nef was going to leave me garden alone. Then that mucker comes mucking around again. Good thing I got you to help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 有一阵子，我感觉奈富好像要放过我的花园了。结果那家伙又来捣乱了。还好有你来帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You'll look for Nokko when you're out there, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你出去的时候会帮我找 Nokko 的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Busy day in the garden. Lots of jobs. You finish one, come back, I got more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 花园里今天忙得很。好多活儿。你干完一个，回来，我还有更多活儿给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Fruits and roots can usually take care of themselves, but against these invasives? For that they need some help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 果子和根通常可以自己照顾自己。但要抵御这些害虫的话？它们需要一些帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: So, Nef wants to build some sort of 'Palace of Prosperity' down here? What in the life-giving dirt does that mean? The deepmines is already a palace for the roots and fruits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 这么说，奈富想在这里建造某种"繁荣宫殿"？这究竟是什么意思？深矿已经是果子和根的宫殿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Deepmines is a community. Organisms living for each other. Don't reckon we're gonna let one mucker ruin that so he can sit down here by his lonesome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 深矿是一个共同体。各种生物为了彼此而生。我们可不会任由一个想要独占这里的混蛋毁掉这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Yeah, I got a bit of work for you. Head down to the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 是的，我给你安排了点活儿。去深矿看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Just get outta bed? The garden's buzzing, mate. Let's get doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 刚起床？花园里热闹极了，伙计。我们开干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: If you see Nokko out there, you give him my regards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 要是你在外面碰见了 Nokko，请代我向他问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Okay, let's stop wasting time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 好了，我们别再浪费时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: We are way past due to get these jobs done. Chop, chop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 早就该干完这些活儿了。快点，快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: No biggie. Not everyone's cut out for a hard day's work, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 没什么大不了的。我想，不是每个人都适合干一整天苦活吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You sure? Fruits and roots could really use your help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你确定吗？果子和根真的需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Suit yourself. Got all sorts of jobs waiting for you should you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你请便。要是你改变主意了，还有各种各样的活儿等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Some say some of the more peculiar looking fruits can widen your thinker. Don't work nothing for me… but if it works for you, a bit of advice: You make your mind go wide? Be wary of who you let put ideas in it. A wide mind is a trusting mind, and not all muckers can be trusted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 有人说，一些长相奇特的水果可以开阔你的思维。对我来说，这并没什么用……但如果它对你有用，我得提醒一句：你确定它让你的思维变开阔了？可得小心那些给你灌输想法的人。思维开阔就意味着信任，但并非所有的混蛋都值得信任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Each species is like a person. It's up to you to come to know them all. What do they like? What don't they like? How do they help each other? Help you? And maybe most of all, how can you help them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 每个物种都像个不同的人。你可以自己决定要不要了解它们。它们喜欢什么？不喜欢什么？它们是如何互相帮助的？能怎样帮助你？或许最重要的是，你能如何帮助它们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Taught me'self how to draw making this guide. Got pretty good if I do say so me'self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 为了写这份图鉴，我还自学了绘画。我觉得自己画得挺不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: The… uh… The fruits and roots… You… uh… You don't hear 'em in your head too, do yah? Just checking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 那……呃……果子和根……你……呃……你脑子里没听到它们的声音吧？只是确认一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You got your fruits, above ground. And your roots, below ground. The fruits is the pretty part. The roots though, that's where the magic is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 果子在地上，根在地下。果子是美丽的部分，而根，才是神奇之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Talkin' mushrooms? Well, sorta. They don't talk to me like, 'oi, mate let's grab a drinkie'. I still got my marbles. But if you look, and listen close? They got something to say and I can hear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 会说话的蘑菇？嗯，算是吧。它们不会直接跟我说："喂，伙计，我们去喝一杯吧。"我脑子还清醒着呢。但如果你仔细观察，仔细听，它们在说话，我能听出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: When I first got sent down here corporate told me the fungal colony was some Orokin mess. Escaped from a lab and all that. But I don't know, the roots and fruits, they feel older than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我刚被派到这里的时候，企业那群家伙告诉我，那片蘑菇群是奥罗金搞出来的烂摊子，说是从实验室里逃出来的。但怎么说呢，那些根和果子，感觉比那要古老得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: The mistake some muckers make is thinking they're the only mucker in existence. Roots and fruits know more about each other than they do about themselves. You wanna survive down here? You gotta come to know the roots and fruits. I used to keep a field-guide, collected all sorts of info. Got destroyed the last time corporate got all spicy down here. You help me build it back up? I can help you come to know them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 有些混蛋太愚蠢，以为自己是世上唯一的混蛋。根和果子彼此了解甚于了解它们自己。你想在这里生存下去吗？你就必须了解根和果子。我本来有本野植图鉴，里面收集了各种资料。不过上次企业在这里闹事的时候，被毁掉了。你能帮我重新弄一本吗？这样我就可以帮你全面地认识根和果子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: If you see Nokko out there, give 'em me best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 要是你在外面碰见了 Nokko，请代我向他问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Right then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: That all? Carry on then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 就这样？那你忙你的吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Always here if you need me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 需要我时，我随时都在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Take care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 保重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Be careful out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 在外面要小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Anytime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 随时找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Ah. Nokko. Alive and well. Here to mess with corporate for old time's sake?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 啊。Nokko。还活得好好的嘛。这是又想重温当年找企业麻烦的美好时光吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Look who it is. Lovely to see you back little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 看看这是谁。很高兴看到你回来，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Nokko! Felt like the fruits and roots were telling me you were doing just fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: Nokko！感觉果子和根在告诉我你过得挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: I can hardly believe it, Nokko. What brings you into the airlock? You gonna be me gardener today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 真是难以置信，Nokko。你怎么跑到气密舱来了？今天你就来当我的园丁吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Nokko! You up for a bit of mischief? Corporate won't leave well enough alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: Nokko！你想搞点恶作剧吗？反正公司就是不懂要收手，老要瞎折腾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: A visitor? Nokko? Let me get the lights.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 有人来了？Nokko？我去开下灯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Oh. You're not Nokko. So you're who they sent down to help? Could have been down here a lot sooner, what with these invasives sprouting up again. Invasives don't make for a happy garden. Nokko used to do the weeding. Nokko did all sorts of gardening. Sweet kid he was. Still wonder what happened to that scamp. That's the circle for you though. You can be my gardener. You'll do just fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 哦。你不是 Nokko。那你就是他们派来帮忙的人？要是早点来就好了，毕竟这些害虫又开始冒出来了。害虫可不会让花园好受。Nokko 以前负责除草，什么园艺活儿都干。他真是个乖孩子。我还在想那小家伙后来怎么样了。不过，这就是命吧。你来当我的园丁好了。你肯定能行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Welcome back. Always good to have a mate in the deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 欢迎回来。在深矿里有个伙伴总是好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You're not gonna… uh… You're not gonna tell corporate I'm down here are ya? Nah… I know a cove when I see one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你不会……呃……你不会告诉企业那群家伙我在这里吧？不会的……我一眼就能看出谁是同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Aye. What can I help you with there, mate?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 好的。有什么我可以帮你的吗，伙计？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: When corporate doesn't listen. We make 'em listen. Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 当企业不听的时候，我们就得让他们听。对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Say, you wanna talk gardening… foraging… outfitting. You come to the right place, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我说，你想聊聊园艺……采集……装备。你来对地方了，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: All of the deepmines, that's me garden. And you, you're me gardener.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 整个深矿，都是我的花园。而你，就是我的园丁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Can't let invasive pests into your garden, 'cause your garden, it ain't got no line of defense against them. 'Cept you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 不能让那些害虫入侵你的花园，因为你的花园对它们没有任何防御。除了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: The longer I'm down here, the less I want to go back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我在这里待的时间越长，就越不想回去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Sure, I can leave, just don't wanna. Feel rooted to this place, I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 当然，我可以离开，只是我不想。我感觉自己已经扎根在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Everything here's been collected in the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 这里的所有东西都是在深矿中收集的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Take what you need, leave what you don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 拿走你需要的，留下你不需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Yeah, I suppose I'd be up for a trade? See anything you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 恩，我觉得我们可以交易一下？你看到什么需要的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: 'Appreciate you keeping my, y'know, existence on the hush hush. Don't know exactly what dosh I owe, but imagine it's quite the sum, what with the miracle of compound interest and all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 谢谢你对我的……你懂的……我的存在保密。我不知道我到底欠了多少钱，但想想那数额应该不少，毕竟还有复利之类的奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You keep this between you and I, yeah? No need to let the taxman know we've been exchanging goods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 这件事只有我们俩知道，好吗？没必要让税务官知道我们一直在交换货物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: This is what I got. All things I've thought could come in handy at some point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我就只有这些了。都是些我觉得会在哪天派上用场的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You've been fighting for the fruits and roots, so I'll let you share in their bounty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你一直在为果子和根而战，所以我会让你分享它们的成果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: So, you ever seen a tree? Never had the fortune to me'self. But I reckon I'd like to come to know a tree someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 话说，你见过树吗？我自己可没这福气。不过我想，总有一天我能去了解一颗树的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: It's all good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Maybe next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 也许下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Good on you. Don't buy anything you don't need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 好样的。别买任何你不需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Aye. This'll help me, yeah. Been a spell since the last payday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 哎呀。这对我可太有帮助了， 真的。自从上次发工资以来，已经有一段时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Ah. I'll be putting this toward me debt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 啊。我要用这笔钱来偿还我的债务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: That's what I would'a picked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 换成是我，我也会选这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Violet's Bane?? You must not like these muckers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 紫罗兰灾星？？你一定不喜欢这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: A Violet's Bane? That's enough to make someone sick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 紫罗兰灾星？这足以让人恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: You need to sit down? You look a bit wobbly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 你要坐下吗？你看起来有点虚弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: So… Learn anything? Or is that all nonsense?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 那……学到什么了吗？还是说这都是无稽之谈？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Like I said, nothing to it. Now, you wanna get back out to the garden?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我就说嘛，没什么大不了的。那现在，你想回花园吗？
