/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: I call that a Nonono, as in, I won't go near the things. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 我管这叫不不不菇，意思是我不会靠近那些东西。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.text: Oh. You took a Nonono? Try to stay away from those me'self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/NokkoColony/DV.zhText: 噢。你吃了不不不菇？我一般都敬而远之。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/OperatorMissio.text: Setting waypoint.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/OperatorMissio.zhText: 标记这张地图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/OperatorMissio.text: Marking the map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/OperatorMissio.zhText: 标记这张地图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: That was expertly done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 手法真利落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: You're quite handy with a blade, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 你这刀工还挺利索的嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: That… that smell… is quite something… isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 这……这味道……还真够冲的，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: I find a use for every part of the beast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 它的每一个部位，我都能物尽其用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Let's… uh… open 'er up then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 那咱们……呃……把它剖开吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Kruna metta. Allow me to help... with that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 既然如此，这活儿就让我来……搭把手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: These will be received gratefully. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 这份心意大伙儿会记在心里的，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: The people acknowledge your generosity, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 乡亲们都感激你的慷慨，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: This will feed many. Thank you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 这能填饱不少人的肚子。谢谢你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: If you have any fish to spare, I will see they reach the tables of our poor and infirm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 要是你手头有多余的鱼，交给我吧，我会替你分给咱们这儿穷苦和病弱的乡亲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Can you spare a fish or two for the people of Cetus, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 能给希图斯的乡亲们匀出一两条鱼吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: We have many who go without. A fish or two would make their dinner table a less somber affair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 咱们这儿连饭都吃不上的人可不少。只要一两条鱼，就能让他们的饭桌上多点笑脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Different fish need different bait, and Fisher Hai-Luk is your one-stop shop. Swazdo-lah, stranger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 钓什么鱼就得下什么饵，渔人海露这里应有尽有，一步就帮你配齐。你好，陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: This one will feed the whole family. And the cousins too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 嚯，这一条够养活一大家子了，喊上亲戚朋友都管够！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: By the Unum. Is that… I can't remember the last time this species was seen in our waters. What did you use for bait?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 乌努母神在上，这难道是……我都记不清上次咱们这片水里出这种鱼是什么时候了。你到底用的什么饵？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Hmm... Medium size. Good length. Teeth… Still too big.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 我看看……中等个头，长度也可以，就是这牙口……还是太大了些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Now this is something special. A rare catch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 这可是个稀罕物，难得的好货！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Just a wee one. Nothing to fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 一条小鱼，没什么好害怕的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Look at that. Don't see many of these anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 瞧瞧这个，这年头可不多见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Ah! You're still alive! I'm so happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 啊！你还活着！我可太高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Fisher Hai-Luk happily places herself at the service of Cetus' champion!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 渔人海露非常乐意为希图斯的勇士效劳！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Lok heb, surah! It's wonderful to see you again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 欢迎你，我的朋友！能再见到你真是太好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: A bad day fishing's better than a good day working. Swazdo-lah, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 当一天空军，好过当一天牛马！你好啊，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Lok heb, surah! Let's get you fitted out and ready for the big blue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 欢迎，朋友！我这就帮你把行头配齐，去征服大海吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Hello! It is my aim to ensure you fully enjoy your time upon the water, which is absolutely not filled with unknowable horror.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 你好呀！我的宗旨就是让你在海上玩得尽兴，那片海里绝对没有什么不可名状的危险哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: I should have been a plumber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 早知道我就修水管去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Well… all right, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 呃……行吧，随你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Check back tomorrow! New stock regularly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 明天再来看看吧！我这儿经常上新货！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Come again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 下次再来啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: I… hope to... see you again. Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 希望你……下次再来光顾，回见

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: A fine selection! Be well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 眼光真好！祝你顺利！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.text: Let's see what you've got... Wait, you have no fish? Well what are you waiting for, go catch some!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHaiLuk.zhText: 让我瞧瞧你捕到了什么……等一下，你……一条鱼都没有？那你还愣着干嘛？赶紧去抓啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Hok would love to help. Perhaps if you return with some weapon parts he could assemble a fine blade for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 霍刻当然乐意效劳。要是你带一些武器组件回来的话，我就能帮你打点像样的武器，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Supply the parts and I shall create the weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 只要拿来组件，武器自然会替你造好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Without the proper components, alas, I am helpless to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 哎呀，要是没有合适的组件，我可无能无力呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Perhaps the most important part of the weapon. Choose wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 这可能是武器最重要的部件。可得挑仔细了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Take your time, take your time.
Grip and Link must, of course, be chosen with utmost care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 握柄和环接部肯定要精挑细选。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Hok does marvelous work, does he not? Marvelous, ootz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 霍刻这手艺，妙不妙？真是妙极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Not too shabby. Pedlek helped with some of the smaller touches, so my apologies if it falls apart in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 还不赖。派德莱帮着处理了几个小地方，所以要是它在你手里散了架，我先给你赔个不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Pedlek! Fetch this customer their… oh, there it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 派德莱！把这位客人的武器拿……哦，原来在这儿呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: There is no rush. Hok has… all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 别着急。霍刻……有的是时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: It is important to make the right choice, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 没事儿没事儿，肯定要选对了才要紧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.text: Pedlek! Fetch me my lunch while this customer… browses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokAss.zhText: 派德莱，听见没！去把我的午饭拿来，这位客人还……挑着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokBro.text: A-ha! You desire the Zaw weapons Hok is so famous for. Allow Hok - I am Hok - to sell you blueprints for weapon parts! Forge them in your Foundry, and then return here so that Hok may construct a fine weapon for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokBro.zhText: 哦嚯！原来你想要霍刻名震希图斯的铸武武器！来吧，那就让霍刻——也就是我——卖给你武器组件的蓝图！先在铸造厂打造组件，做好后再回来找我，霍刻就替你打造一把上好的兵刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokBye.text: Remember, Hok has new specials everyday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokBye.zhText: 别忘了，我这儿天天都有特价好货上新。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: Dah-dap, surah. Your contribution to our defense is gratefully accepted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 谢谢，朋友。我们由衷感激你对希图斯防务作出的贡献。那我就收下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: Ai yo. Dah-dap, surah. The militia thanks you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 啊呀，谢谢，朋友。我代表民兵感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: You are too kind, surah. Dah-dap. Dah-dap utz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 朋友，你太慷慨了。谢谢，非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: The militia will only accept battle-hardened Zaws, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 民兵只接受经过实战检验的武器，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: If the steel is tested, the militia will gratefully accept. Otherwise… not so much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 要是这把武器经受过检验，民兵会感激地收下。否则……恐怕不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.text: We cannot arm recruits with anything less than battle-hardened weapons, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokCon.zhText: 朋友，我们不能让新兵拿着没经过战斗检验的武器上战场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: A name to strike fear into the hearts of the wicked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 这名字能让坏人闻风丧胆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: You are quite the poet, Tenno. Beautiful.
Test your blades in battle. Return to me once their worth is known. Only then will Hok gild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 带你的兵刃去见见血，清楚它有几斤几两再回来找我。到那时霍刻才能帮你镀金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: If your weapon is tested then Hok shall gild it - but not before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 你的兵刃要见过血，霍刻才能为它镀饰——在那之前免谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: Untested metal is unfit for gilding. Return to Hok once the worth of that blade has been proven, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 没见过血的生铁不配镀金。等你证明这把兵刃的价值，再回来找霍刻吧，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: Such beautiful lines. She requires only… a name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 多么迷人的线条啊，她现在只缺……一个名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: It is ready, waiting to come to life at your touch. Will you name her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 她已经准备好在你手中焕发生机了。你要为她赐名吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: Your blade, Tenno. Name her, and bring her to life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 拿好你的兵刃。给她命名，赐予她生命吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: You see her for what she is. Truly you share a bond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 你看到了真正的她。你们之间缘分不浅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: Her nature is her own. As you say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.zhText: 她有属于自己的天性，正如你所说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokFor.text: Of course, surah. She is yours.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Ai yo. What a day: Hok has been busier than a one-armed mime with a skin rash. What may I provide?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 啊哟，今天累死了。霍刻比浑身长跳蚤的独臂猴还忙活。您想要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Oof. That last customer? Nice guy but couldn't hit water if he fell out of a boat. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 呼，刚才那个客人？人倒是不错，就是准头太差，给他个木桩他也砍不中。您要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Ah, swazdo-lah. Both the world and his wife are on Hok's back this accursed day. How may he improve yours?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 啊，你好。今天真倒霉，全世界都跟我过不去。您有什么需要？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Ai yo! Cetus' favorite Tenno! Welcome! Welcome!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 啊呀！希图斯最受欢迎的 Tenno！欢迎欢迎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Aaaaah… surah. A joy, as always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 啊！朋友，见到你还是一如既往的高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Swazdo-lah, Tenno! Your presence makes joy fountain from Hok's eyeballs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 欢——迎，Tenno！怎么办呢，一看到你，霍刻就打心底里高兴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: No excuses, Pedlek! Last time there was a dead squirrel floating in it! I am a bright star surrounded by an accretion disk of cretins and ding-dongs. How may I serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 少找借口，派德莱！上一次那里漂着一只死松鼠！我明明是一个天赋异禀的天才，怎么身边尽是这种蠢货。算了，我能帮您些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Haha! I do not like your chances, Pedlek, for you are barely symmetrical! Oh. Swazdo-lah. How may Hok serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 哈哈！我可不看好你，派德莱。就你长得这副歪瓜裂枣的样子！哦，欢迎。霍刻能为您做点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Pedlek! Did your mother jump around whilst pregnant? Those aren't pets! They're carnivorous as ffff... ...far as I know. Hello there. How may Hok serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 派德莱！你妈怀你的时候是不是天天上蹿下跳？那不是宠物，它是吃肉的，它们非常凶……你好啊，霍刻能为您效劳吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: No, Pedlek, I will not be attending your poetry recital! Hok would rather get a plate in his head and collect magnets. How may I serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 不，派德莱！我绝对不会去听你的狗屁诗歌朗诵会！霍刻宁愿头上装块铁板去吸磁石。您需要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: I will not tolerate this behavior, Pedlek! You look like a jerk and have a crappy face! Swazdo-lah. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 我实在是忍不了你了，派德莱！你就是个彻头彻尾的混蛋，还丑得要命！您好，需要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: That money in your sock, Pedlek, is for bail! Swazdo-lah. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 记住，派德莱，你袜子里的钱是留着赎身用的！您需要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: Knock it off, Pedlek! You laugh like an electrocuted hamster. Oh. Swazdo-lah. How may Hok serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 闭嘴吧，派德莱！你笑起来简直像个触电的仓鼠。噢，您好，我能够为您效劳吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.text: By the Unum, Pedlek. It would be wiser to simply fire you and use your face to make squid biscuits. Oh. Swazdo-lah. How may Hok serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokInt.zhText: 乌努母神在上，派德莱。我还不如把你直接开了，然后把你的脸拍得跟鱿鱼饼一样扁！噢，您好，霍刻能够为您做些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: Really? Step into the winner's circle occasionally, friend^ we'd love to have you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 就这样？偶尔也体验一下成功人士的感觉吧，朋友。我们随时欢迎你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: So you've just wasted my time is what your face is telling me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 我算是看出来了，你就是来浪费我时间的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: Are your eyes in your pockets? You'll not find the equal of Hok's merchandise elsewhere!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 你的眼睛是长在屁股上吗？天底下再也找不到比我这还好的货了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: Walk like there's a knife in your boot, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 是不是感觉整个人都威风了，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: Keep swinging 'til they're more red than… well… anything else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 接着挥，别停。直到她红得不能再红。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.text: Getting old isn't for the weak. Be well, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokOut.zhText: 岁月不饶人呐。保重，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokSpe.text: Big special today. Hok knows you're interested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokSpe.zhText: 今天大减价。霍刻知道你有想法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokSpe.text: Today's special is a thing of such beauty that I had to slap Pedlek for looking at it indecently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DHokSpe.zhText: 今天的特价商品美到我不得不赏派德莱几巴掌，省得他用下流的眼神看它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.text: Handy with a gun or blade? Cetus needs you. Let's talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.zhText: 用得惯枪，还是耍得惯刀？希图斯正缺人手。咱们聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.text: Offworlder. I'm hiring combat talent. Let's talk rates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.zhText: 异世者，我这儿正招打手呢。来谈谈价钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.text: Job board's filling up, offworlder. Help Konzu clear the slate, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.zhText: 公告板都满啦，异世者。帮孔尊清清任务，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.text: Offworlder. Help push the Grineer away from Cetus. You do a good deed, I pay you for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuB.zhText: 异世者，帮我们把克隆尼从希图斯赶走。你行善积德，我照付你酬劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuF.text: Swazdo-lah, offworlder. Interested in working for me? Gotta prove yourself first. Head out on the plains and show me what you can do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuF.zhText: 你好，异世者。有兴趣帮我办点事吗？你得先证明自己的实力。去平野上走一趟，让我瞧瞧你的真本事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuF.text: Hmmm… Not bad. I have work for someone with your talents. Lots of work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuF.zhText: 嗯……还不赖。凭你的身手，我这些活儿你基本都能干。有你忙的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 孔尊最喜欢的打手来了。欢迎，杀手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: Right on time, surah. I see you. Let's get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 来得正是时候，朋友。我看到你了，咱们开干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: Ai yo. You are bright in the Unum's sight, surah. Magnificent. Magnificent, utz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 哎呦，朋友，在乌努母神的眼中，你光芒耀眼。了不起，太了不起了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: Ah, our most esteemed surah! Welcome!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 啊，我们最尊贵的朋友！欢迎你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: You pay me in red, I pay you in silver.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 用他们的项上人头来换你的奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: Got something. Heavy hitter like you needs a little snack, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 来活儿了。狠人也需要轻松娱乐一下，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.text: I give you coordinates. You go in, you work, nobody but you comes out. Good?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuI.zhText: 我给你坐标，你过去，把事做完。只有你能从那里活着走出来。成不成？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.text: It would be my honor to help you toward grace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.zhText: 能帮你成就辉煌是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.text: We Ostrons would be honored to accept your sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.zhText: 奥斯特朗人很荣幸接受你的奉献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.text: You upping your rates on me?
You gonna make me use offworld talent? Come on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuN.zhText: 啊，你非要逼我去雇别的异世者吗？得了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuO.text: Kruna metta, advise us as to your need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuO.zhText: 如果你有任何需要，请尽管吩咐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuR.text: The Unum smiles upon you, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuR.zhText: 乌努母神在对你微笑，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuR.text: One hand washing the other: indivisible.
The lessening of your burden also lightens ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuR.zhText: 替你卸下一分重担，我们肩上也轻一分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuT.text: One more off the docket. Hop to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuT.zhText: 板子上又少了一单。去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuT.text: Couldn't get anyone to take that on. Early lunch for Konzu.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DKonzuT.zhText: 正愁没人肯接呢。孔尊我能早点吃午饭咯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: Lok heb, surah. It is good to see you again! How may I help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: 欢迎你，朋友。很高兴又见到你！想看点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: A joy to serve you, Tenno. As always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: Tenno，能为你效劳，向来是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: Dah-dap, Tenno^ for all that you do for Cetus. It is wonderful to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: 谢谢你，Tenno，感谢你为希图斯做的一切。见到你真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: Others have one price for locals and one for offworlders. Me? I give you the local price, every time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: 别人做买卖，都是本地人一个价，外星客一个价。在我这儿，统统按本地价给你算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: Free advice with or without purchase, surah. I'm here to help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: 买不买没关系，我都可以免费提供建议，朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.text: Best prices and free advice, surah. To me you're a local.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakI.zhText: 公道的价格，免费的建议，朋友。怎么接待本地人，我就怎么接待你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: You'll find spirit jars at most of the bars. Order something, leave a coin. It keeps the souls of the Orokin happy, and you've paid for the next person who can't afford a drink. sho-lah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 大部分酒吧里都能见到灵罐。点杯喝的，放个铜板进去，这样既能安抚奥罗金人的亡魂，还能顺便请下一个喝不起酒的倒霉蛋喝上一杯。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: I've worked all kinds of jobs in all kinds of places. Never met a good person, or a bad one. It's just folks, friend. Everyone's just folks. sho-lah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 我在各种各样的地方，干过各种各样的活儿。从没见过什么纯粹的好人，也没见过什么纯粹的坏人。大家都一样，朋友，都是混口饭吃罢了。再见啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: Buy three bags of termite droppings. It'll keep you going long after you should have keeled over and if that's how you react to nibbling termite crap? You're gonna love my desert survival tips.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 买三袋白蚁粪吧。就算你累得快趴下了，它也能让你再撑一会儿。怎么，光是让你吃口白蚁屎你就这副表情了？那你肯定会迷上我其它的沙漠求生小妙招。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: Those urns outside doors? Don't drink from them. They're yoong-baht. We leave them for traveling monks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 你想问门外的罐子？千万别喝里面的水。那是雍巴，专门给行脚僧准备的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: Beyond Cetus you'll encounter the occasional Ostron who built themselves a bridge across a river. They'll charge you to use it. It's how some of these families support themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 出了希图斯，你偶尔会碰到在河上建桥的奥斯特朗人。他们会向路过的人要过桥费。那是人家养家糊口的营生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: When you've made peace with the world then everything becomes a game, friend. This place will teach you that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 当你和这个世界和解，一切就都成了一场游戏，朋友。待在这里你迟早会懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: The Eidolons have done something to the water out there. Touch it and you'll get the shock of your life. Plus it's loaded with gut parasites! Sho-lah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 夜灵对外面的水源动了手脚。碰一下保准电得你魂飞魄散。而且里面全是肠道寄生虫！天呐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: The Eidolons have done something to the water out there. Touch it and you'll get the shock of your life. It is free of parasitic gut larvae though! Sho-lah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 夜灵对外面的水源动了手脚。碰一下保准电得你魂飞魄散。不过，里面倒是没有肠道寄生虫！天呐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: Visitors go crazy for kubuchi. They think drinking it makes them a local. But just between you and me^ it tastes like hot garbage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 外地游客好像都特别爱喝库布奇酒，觉得喝了这东西就算本地人了。但悄悄跟你说啊，那玩意儿喝起来跟泔水没两样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: The Eidolons. Beautiful creatures of the night, graceful in their own way. Go anywhere near them and they'll crush you like a turd. Here y'go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 夜灵只在夜里出没，它们有自己独特优雅的姿态。但你要敢靠近，它们就会把你一脚踩扁。东西拿好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: Dah-dap, surah. Here you go. Have you seen the Tower? The Unum within does not move, or see. But She hears, and feels... and speaks. Sho-lah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 谢谢你，朋友，东西拿好。你见过那座高塔了没？乌努母神就在里面，她既不能动也看不见，但她听得到，能感知……还能说话。再见啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.text: See a man with a blank mask and no adornment? That's a widower. All of his bright things would have been cremated with his wife. Beautifully sad, really. He won't laugh for a year. Here y'go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DNakakO.zhText: 看见那个戴着素白面具、毫无装饰的男人没？那是个鳏夫。他所有颜色鲜艳的物件都陪着亡妻火化了。说真的，挺凄美的。他接下来这一整年都不会再笑了。东西拿好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.text: Closeness, or nearness. Push, or pull. Hold, or release. Which will it be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.zhText: 贴近，抑或旁观。推开，抑或拉回。紧握，抑或放手。你要作何抉择？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.text: Which string will you pluck? Which note will you sound? Play well and the universe dances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.zhText: 你会拨动哪根琴弦？又会奏响哪个音符？倾心演奏吧，宇宙亦将为你起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.text: Which of us will give, Tenno, and which of us will take?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkOt.zhText: Tenno，你我之间，谁是给予者，谁又是索取者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoA.text: From memories of a past that is yet to be, the Unum knows you as a terror to the Eidolons. This has been waiting for you. To deliver upon them a terrible ruin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoA.zhText: 乌努母在那些尚未发生的记忆中预见，你必将成为夜灵的梦魇。这件武器一直在等你，等待你给它们降下灭顶之灾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoA.text: We have had and shall have, a long association, Tenno. I know our conversations well. Sho-lah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoA.zhText: 我们相识已久且有着长久的羁绊，Tenno。这段对话早已熟稔于心。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: The choice is made. We are here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 抉择已定，你我在此交汇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: The sum of consequence to consequence resolves, here, in this extension of your will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 万千因果的交汇，在此刻，在你意志的延伸中尘埃落定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: You end here, at this choice: the inception point of who you will become. Behold the product of that becoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 你的旧我终结于此次抉择，而这亦是你蜕变的起点。凝视这蜕变后的结晶吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: Here we create the instrument with which you might co-author the future. The amp, Tenno, will magnify your power and your will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 我们将为你打造这件器具，让你借由它去谱写未来。Tenno，增幅器会强化你的力量，以及你的意志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: The amp is an extension of your will. No part of it may be chosen lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 增幅器是你意志的延伸。它的任何一个部件，都不可轻率择定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: The amp: your primary tool in control and defeat of the Eidolons. The stylus with which you shall inscribe your name in the pages of future history.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 增幅器是你压制并击败夜灵的主要利器，也是你将自己的名字镌刻在未来历史篇章上的锋锐刻笔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: Every choice closes off an infinite number of possible futures. The amp you craft, then, is unique in all the multiverse. Where you end and it begins… an unanswerable question. Research. Craft. Assemble. Strive to answer the unanswerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 每一次抉择，都在收束无数种可能的未来。因此，你亲手锻造的增幅器，在多元宇宙中亦是独一无二。你的存在于何处终结，它的存在又从何处开始……这是一个无解之谜。去研究、去锻造、去组装，努力去解答这无解的谜题吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: Time is relative. Choose when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 时间是相对的。准备好了再做抉择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: I see permutations tumbling, resolving behind your eyes. Beneath your skin. Exquisite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 我能看见无数种可能性，在你的眼底翻涌、落定，在你的肌肤之下游走。真是绝妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.text: Once, long ago, I would look backwards, feeling for the fading tendrils of our might-have-beens. But those avenues are closed now. Too far gone. Instead I comfort myself with the music of the universe… and the sense of her close by. Her choices brush against me, like the arm of a passing stranger, and I am… happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoC.zhText: 很久以前，我也曾频频回望，试图去捕捉我们本可能拥有的未来中，那些正在消散的痕迹。但如今，通向那些未来的轨迹已然断绝，一切都无可挽回。所以，我转而用宇宙的旋律来慰藉自己……去感受她近在咫尺的气息。她的人生抉择与我擦肩而过，就像路过的陌生人轻轻拂过我的手臂，而这……已足以让我感到幸福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: This has served you well. Has that time passed? Released it may yet serve a greater plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 这件增幅器已助你良多。它的使命，是否已至尽头？放手让它离去，或许能成就更宏大的图景。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: You release, it falls, to create one last, outward spreading cascade. Causality awaits your decision. This amp may arm another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 你若放手，任其坠落，便会荡开最后一圈向外的涟漪。因果正等待你的抉择。这件增幅器，或许还能为他人所用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: Some paths end. Others circle back on themselves. Release this amp, that it might serve another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 有些轨迹会走向终结，有些则会回归原点。交出这件增幅器吧，让它去为他人效力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: Gratefully received back into the weave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 因果之网，已欣然接纳了它的回归。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: Do you feel that? Consequence brushing consequence. Already the future shifts her expression.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 你感觉到了吗？因与果轻轻碰撞。未来，已换上了新的面容。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.text: Drop a stone, a ripple. Drop a grain, nothing of consequence. Come to me with stones, Tenno: instruments of tested power, and I will accept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoD.zhText: 投石入水，激起涟漪。撒下微尘，却无波澜。带着石子回来见我，Tenno，带上那些历经考验的利器，我自会接纳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoF.text: We have, and shall have a long association, Tenno. I know this conversation well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoF.zhText: 我们相识已久且有着长久的羁绊，Tenno。这段对话早已熟稔于心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: Ah, the history you will have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 啊，属于你的历史，正缓缓展开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: Tenno separating from simple nexus at Quill Onkko Primary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: Tenno 正与一级夜羽昂克的单节点断开连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: Ah. A desire for greater agency. I can assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 啊，你渴望更强大的力量，我能助你一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: This has served you well. Cement that bond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 它一路助你良多，去巩固这份羁绊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: A bold reaching toward consequence. How shall this be remembered?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 你向着因果大胆迈出一步。这一步，将如何被后世铭记？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: Infinite possibilities fall away as this declaration codifies itself into a single, clear path. Name it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 你的抉择一经定下，无数的可能便就此消散，凝聚成唯一一条清晰之路。为它赐名吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.text: No effect without a cause. No reward without an earning. No name without a legacy. Return once the amp has proven itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoG.zhText: 有因必有果，无功不受禄，未建功业者不配留名。待这增幅器证明了它的价值，再回来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: You are an instrument most perfect, Tenno^ tuned to the pitch of the Unum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 你是一件最完美的「乐器」，Tenno，能与乌努母神的旋律完美共鸣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: What things are and what they should be are indivisible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 事物之现况与其之必然，本不可分割。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: We are bound: family to family, clade to clade, as children of the all-seeing Unum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 我们彼此相系，家族连着家族，部族连着部族，皆为全知的乌努母神之子民。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: You were anticipated. Our interaction begins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 你的到来，早在预见之中。你我的交集，于此刻开启。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: Consequence to consequence brings you to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 因果相扣，将你带到我面前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: Eidolon seer-zhwong intercepted at isolate node sahd by Tenno sahd-pahk. But first: interaction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: Tenno 三十八号将于孤节点三号拦截夜灵四十二号。但首要之事是，建立交集。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: We are each one viewpoint within the myriad that comprises the Unum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 我们每个人都是构成乌努母神那万千视界中的一环。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: We watch, we anticipate, we intercede.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 我们观察，我们预见，我们介入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.text: We shall make use of you.
You will make the necessary sacrifice. Inevitably.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoI.zhText: 你将做出必要的牺牲。这是不可避免的因果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: It is time. Utter the name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 时机已至，呼唤它的名字吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: The past is dead. Name the future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 过去已然消亡。为未来赐名吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: Yes. The name I have always known.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 没错，是我早已知晓的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: It could never have any other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 它注定只有这唯一的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: A name whispered by the universe itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 从宇宙的低语中传来的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.text: As a note of music, carried from a distant room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoN.zhText: 宛如一枚音符，从遥远的彼方飘荡而来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoS.text: Saya… if he… if Onkko… if I could have shown her… how catalogs of possible futures fanned out from the moment I could choose... could have chosen to stay. None of them end… ended well. None save one. This one. The one where I left. This future ends so well for her. For Konzu, for Cetus. As eviscerating a choice as it was, it was the only one I could live with. Some day, I swear, this is… this was… this will be borne out. Speak of this no more. To be crushed by the singular excruciates. What's done is done. Enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoS.zhText: 萨娅……如果他……如果昂克……如果我能让她看到就好了，看到从我本可以抉择，本可以选择留下的那一刻起，无数种可能的未来是如何交织铺展开来的。它们没有一条会有好结局，无一例外，唯独我选择离开的这一条除外。在这个未来里，她能得到圆满，孔尊也是，希图斯也是。这个抉择尽管令人肝肠寸断，却是我唯一能承受的结局。总有一天，我发誓，这……这一切曾经……这一切终将得到印证。别再提这件事了，被那唯一压垮，实在太过折磨。事已至此，多说无益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoS.text: That will prove beneficial. For you, and for us.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Your weapons have no effect on its shields. Try something else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 你的武器无法撼动它的护盾，另寻他法吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Sunrise nears. Sentient retreats. Strike now, for in moments the future decides itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 黎明将至，Sentient 即将撤退。此刻进攻，转瞬之间，未来即将定局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Next you attempt to take control of it.
Those devices draw energy from Vomvalysts. Make use of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 这种装置可以吸收轰击使的能量，好好加以利用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: The Teralyst retreats, but remains close by, wary of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 兆力使虽然撤退，但仍在附近徘徊，对你满怀戒备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: And now, a massive sentient energy spike in your area. I advise you to be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 此刻，你所在的区域涌起一股巨大的 Sentient 能量。务必小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Smaller sentients rush to the Eidolon's aid, healing it. Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 小型 Sentient 正涌向夜灵，为其疗愈。立即阻止它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Sentient energy contained. You are closing on victory. Act now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: Sentient 能量已被遏制，胜利近在咫尺，动手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: That device is insufficient. You are directed to secure and employ additional Eidolon lures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 仅凭那一个装置远远不够。你需寻得更多的夜灵诱饵，加以部署。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.text: Energy spike. I advise falling back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkkoT.zhText: 能量涌动，建议立即撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkoSt.zhText: 这些定能助你一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkoSt.text: Allow us to improve your efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DOnkoSt.zhText: 请容我们助你事半功倍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumFi.text: Name's Suumbaat. If you want to draw wealth from a cliff-face then I've got what you need to do it. Mining tools, scanning gear, that kinda stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumFi.zhText: 我叫松巴。要是你想从石头里抠出金子，找我就对了。采矿工具，勘测设备，我这应有尽有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.text: Hey, kid. Tell me something good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.zhText: 喂，孩子，说点好消息来听听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.text: Hey, swazdo-lah, kid. Always got time for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.zhText: 喂，你好啊，孩子。我随时有空招呼你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.text: Oof. Sight for sore eyes. Finally, someone worth talking to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.zhText: 哦嚯，见到你真好。总算来了个能说上话的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.text: The trick to doing the impossible is to get out there and bloody well do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.zhText: 点石成金的秘诀就是走出去转，豁出去干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumIn.text: So, you want to get rich.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.text: Move along then. I'm not running a social club.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.zhText: 快走吧，我这儿是做买卖的，不是让你来唠嗑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.text: You're lucky I don't charge you for time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.zhText: 我没打表收你钱，算你走运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.text: Do I look young enough to spare two minutes on nothing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.zhText: 我这把老骨头，哪有工夫陪你瞎耗两分钟？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.text: Prove everyone wrong, kid. Get lucky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.zhText: 去证明他们错了，孩子。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.text: Good luck out there. Watch for kubrow.
Little advice. Every kid thinks they're tough 'til they're trying to outrun an Eidolon. Be smart. Don't mine at night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DSuumOu.zhText: 给你句忠告。每个毛头小子都觉得自己硬气，直到被夜灵追得撒腿逃命。放机灵点，别在夜里采矿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Listen. The territorial voicing of the Condroc: carrion-eater and opportunistic scavenger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 听，秃鹰宣示领地的鸣叫声。它以食腐为生，也很懂得伺机捡现成的食物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Kuaka. The elder cousin of the Vallis Pobber, but unlike that herbivorous rodent the Kuaka possesses an irritable temperament and will eat almost anything. But, precisely as its cousin, the Kuaka will bolt at the first hint of danger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 库阿卡，是山谷泡博的远亲，但与那种食草啮齿动物不同，库阿卡性情暴躁，几乎什么都吃。但就像它的远亲一样，库阿卡一察觉到危险的苗头，就会立刻溜之大吉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Mergoo. An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and by large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 秋沙鸟，一种模样滑稽的鸟类，常见于沿海地区和大型水域附近。发现水中掠食者时，秋沙鸟便会在空中盘旋、放声鸣叫。不少奥斯特朗渔民，都靠这些奇怪的小鸟捡回一条命。因此，杀死秋沙鸟会被认为极其不详。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Vasca Kavat. An invasive, nocturnal species carrying the symbiotic Vasca virus. They are stealthy, and extremely aggressive. Be careful. And one last thing: should any kavat companions be… bitten… you should secure an antidote quickly. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只噬血型库娃。一种具有极强侵略性的夜行动物，身上携带着共生噬血病毒。它们行踪隐秘，攻击性极强。务必小心。还有，如果你的库娃同伴不慎被它们咬伤，应当立即使用解毒剂。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Hunter, this particular Bau is close to going full Nephil. A timely catch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 猎手，这只特别的博奥亚种马上就会成长为拿非尔。抓得正是时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Look at the fight in this one. The viral load in its veins must be immense. I'll prepare a double-dose of curative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 瞧瞧这家伙的狠劲儿。它血液中的病毒载量一定高得惊人。我会准备双倍剂量的治疗剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: How many animals have been drained by this Bau? How many nests and lairs wiped out? Still, we cure and persevere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只博奥亚种究竟吸干了多少动物的血？又毁掉了多少巢穴？即便如此，我们还是会治好它，并坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A weak little Ostia no more, are you? Well, before the week is out you'll be back to being a regular kavat - and happier for it I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 看来你已经不再是那只虚弱的小奥斯蒂亚库娃了，对吗？好吧，不出下个星期，你就会变回一只普通的库娃。那时候你肯定会比现在快乐得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I do love kavats. I hate what this loathsome virus makes of them. I'll be glad to cure this Bau, and find them a more suitable home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我真的很喜欢库娃。这种恶心的病毒把它们变成了那副模样，真可恶。我很乐意治疗这只博奥亚种，再替它找个更合适的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A common Condroc. Carrion makes up nearly the entirety of their diet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只常见的秃鹰。它们的食物几乎清一色全是腐肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Common Condroc could never be called glamorous, but their role is a necessary one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 普通秃鹰绝对称不上光鲜亮丽，但它们在生态中的作用不可或缺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: They've learned not to scavenge Grineer camps, but fisher-folk still take potshots at them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 它们已经学乖了，不再去克隆尼的营地找食吃。可渔民见了，还是会朝它们放冷枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Scavengers prevent the spread of disease and pathogens. The Business is wise to collect them… but why? Surely he could not be populating some far-away Moh of his own?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 食腐动物能防止疾病和病原体的传播。「操盘手」选择收集它们是明智的……可他究竟为什么这么做呢？难不成他要在某个遥远的平野，打造他自己的生态圈吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Traditional Ostron hunters and bridge wardens still use the feathers of the Condroc as fletching for their arrows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 传统的奥斯特朗猎人和守桥人，至今仍用秃鹰的羽毛制作箭羽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A rare Emperor Condroc. Note the warm golden plumage. Hear that robust call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只罕见的帝王秃鹰。留意它那身温暖的金色羽毛，再听听这雄浑的鸣叫声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: This rare Emperor Condroc would be the leader of several Condroc committees. What could have lured them away from their aerie? No matter. This is our good fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只罕见的帝王秃鹰，照理说应该统领好几个秃鹰亲卫队。到底是什么把它引离了鹰巢呢？罢了，算我们运气好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Emperor Condroc. A rare sight. You must not miss this opportunity, Tenno. Should it take flight, it will retreat to its aerie and be lost to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 帝王秃鹰。难得一见。Tenno，绝不能错失这次机会。它一旦飞走，就会回到自己的鹰巢，彻底脱离我们的视线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Rogue Condroc. Scavenging ways abandoned, this one prefers fresh meat and hunts it. Unusual behavior for a Condroc, but not unheard of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只游荡秃鹰。它已经抛弃食腐的习性，转而偏爱鲜肉，并会亲自猎杀。这对秃鹰来说还真是不寻常，但也并非闻所未闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A loner. Extra effort will be made to re-socialize them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 离群的秃鹰。要想让它重新适应集体生活，得花上不少心思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A group of Condrocs are known as a committee. This one has no time for such things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 秃鹰聚集成群时，被称作亲卫队。不过这只明显没时间考虑这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Rogues often wipe out entire colonies of Kuaka and even Mergoo. The Condroc's role is that of scavenger. The Rogue has lost its purpose. It would be better to… no? I could… Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 游荡秃鹰经常会消灭掉整个库阿卡聚落，甚至连秋沙鸟群也不放过。秃鹰本就该承担食腐者的职责，可这只明显背弃了自身在生态中的位置。最好还是把它……不行吗？我其实可……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The stomach acid of the Condroc is useful as a powerful antiseptic. Perhaps you have need? No? Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 秃鹰的胃酸可以制成强效防腐剂。没准你用得上，不用？那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Female.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 雌性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Note the pale coat, indicative of a subspecies that spends most of its time belowground.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 注意它苍白的毛皮。这说明这个亚种绝大部分时间都生活在地下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: An Ashen Kuaka. They don't like the light. Let's move this along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只灰白库阿卡。它们不太喜欢光亮，别让它久留在这里，动作快些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: An efficient ratter, the Ashen Kuaka. Very helpful in controlling introduced pests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 灰白库阿卡是高效的捕鼠能手。在控制外来害兽方面功不可没。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Ashen Kuaka makes for good eating, Tenno, but if preservation is your mission so be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 灰白库阿卡其实很好吃，Tenno。但既然你来是为了保育，那就按规矩办吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A rare pleasure, my little friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 难得的荣幸，我的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Note the superficial similarities to the Ashen Kuaka, but this specimen's eyesight and digestive tract have evolved to serve a rodent that almost never visits the surface world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 注意看，它在外形上和灰白库阿卡颇为相似。不过这只啮齿动物的视力和消化系统已经演化得更适应地下生活，毕竟它从不踏足地表。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Ghost Kuaka are birthed in collectives far, far belowground. There they live on grubs and roots. This may be their first visit to the surface. I will do what I can to make the experience a pleasant one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 幽灵库阿卡诞生于极深地下的群落，以幼虫和根茎为食。这可能是它第一次来到地表。我会尽我所能，让它们的这段经历舒适一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Plains Kuaka. Nature's janitor. Slow-roasted and paired with hot chimurr is a personal favorite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只平野库阿卡。大自然的清洁工。慢火烤熟，再配上一杯热腾腾的赤穆茶，我的最爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A foul-tempered omnivore - but key to maintaining ecosystemic balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一种脾气暴躁的杂食动物——却也是维持生态系统平衡的关键一环。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Population levels of the Plains Kuaka are in no danger of dipping, and this one's services are required elsewhere. So, off they go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 平野库阿卡的种群数量远未到需要担心的地步，而别处正需要这家伙。送它启程吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Another Kuaka. You are aware the female of the species becomes fertile immediately after giving birth, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 又一只库阿卡。你知道这动物的雌性刚一分娩，就会立刻恢复生育能力吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I once knew a hunter who, in dire straits, walked many days using two of these animals as shoes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我曾经认识一名猎人。在走投无路的时候，他把两只库阿卡套在脚上当鞋，硬是走了好几天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Properly skinned and sewn a Kuaka can make for a useful improvised waterskin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 库阿卡若能妥善剥皮、缝制，可以做成相当实用的应急水囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Male.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 雄性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Coastal Mergoo. Fisher-folk honor them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 沿海秋沙鸟。渔民们十分敬重它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ah, these little ones do make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 啊，这些小家伙总能把我逗笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Coastal Mergoo. Perhaps the most common seabird in these parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 沿海秋沙鸟。大概是这一带最常见的海鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Mergoo flocks deprive smaller mammals of nourishment. I am content to remove a few; however you see fit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 秋沙鸟群会抢走小型哺乳动物的食物。若你认为有必要处理掉几只，我并不反对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Note its grasping foreclaws. Mergoo will often swoop in, clutch some small target and fly off before anyone's the wiser.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 注意它那双用来抓取的前爪。秋沙鸟经常急速俯冲，然后抓起一只小猎物，还没等任何人反应过来就飞没影了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I've seen Grineer troopers divert from objectives to hunt and kill these particular specimens. For the plumage. Very hard to find these days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我亲眼见过克隆尼士兵擅自偏离任务，只为了猎杀这种稀有个体。就为了它们身上的羽毛。如今已经很难见到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Splendid Mergoo! Lords and ladies of the nest these ones. Highly prized mates, for obvious reasons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只璀璨秋沙鸟！它们可是巢群中的上流阶层，自然也是备受追捧的伴侣。原因显而易见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: It is well you have saved this one. Populations of Splendid Mergoo have been in sharp decline since the arrival of the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 你救下了它，真是太好了。自从克隆尼到来后，璀璨秋沙鸟的数量便一直在锐减。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I'll note the area, keep an eye out for the nest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我会记录这片区域，多留意附近是否有它的巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Mergoo, woodland plumage. Perhaps the adaptation is an attempt to elude the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 林地羽色的秋沙鸟。这种适应环境的伪装，或许是为了躲避克隆尼而进化出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I've often seen a Woodland Mergoo dart from foliage to zap an insect from the air. Cunning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我常看见林地秋沙鸟会借着树丛的遮掩，猛地窜出来叼走空中的昆虫。真聪明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Should you find yourself lost and starving, watch the Woodland Mergoo. They often know of ant colonies and grub nests. Useful protein in emergencies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 你要是在野外迷失方向，又饥肠辘辘，就跟着林地秋沙鸟。它们总能找到蚁群和幼虫的巢穴。紧急情况下，那可是能救命的蛋白质来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A rare and hateful guest, this one. I think your welcome on the Plains has been well overstayed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 真是个罕见又可恶的家伙。它在平野上待得够久了，也该走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: This Nephil has been Vasca so long its digestive tract can no longer tolerate solid food. Just… blood. Rehabilitation will be difficult for this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只拿非尔亚种被噬血病毒感染太久了，它的消化道已经无法消化固体食物。只能吸食血液。它的康复过程会很艰难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: This poor, wretched thing has been utterly overtaken by the virus, with no recollection of having ever been kavat. It now exists only to spread the virus. But I will bring them back to themselves. I swear. They will love the sun once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只可怜又痛苦的小家伙已经完全被病毒侵蚀了，甚至不记得自己曾是一只库娃。现在的它，仅仅是传播病毒的载体。但我一定会让它们恢复正常。我发誓，它们会重新爱上阳光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Your time in the sunless lands are at an end, my anguished friend. I will lead you home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 饱受折磨的朋友啊，只能躲避阳光生存的日子终于结束了。我会带你回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Nephil Vasca. Look what the virus has done to a once-noble animal. It will be an honor to return this beast to itself. The curative is ready and waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 拿非尔噬血型库娃。看看这病毒，把昔日高贵的动物摧残成什么样子。能让这头野兽恢复本性是我的荣幸。治疗剂准备好了，就等你送来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: In its prime, this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只正值壮年。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Adult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 成年个体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Full-grown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 完全成年了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: If they are engineered from fertilization, and if the virus is doctored, Vasca can be trained, even domesticated. Wild specimens? Very different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 要是从受精阶段就开始加以人工培育，同时对病毒进行改造，感染了嗜血病毒的库娃也可以被训练、甚至被驯化。至于野生个体？完全是另一回事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ostia Vasca. I am researching a means to inoculate wild kavats against the virus, but… with little success as yet. Thank you for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 奥斯蒂亚噬血型库娃。我在研究一种方法，帮助野生库娃接种疫苗，来抵抗病毒感染，但是至今收效甚微。这次真是万分感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The local wildlife will appreciate this unnatural predator being taken out of circulation. I will administer a Vasca curative as soon as they arrive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 当地的野生动物想必会感谢你，把这种畸形的掠食者清出了生态圈。它一送到，我就给它注射噬血治疗剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Yet another Ostia Vasca. For every one we remove it seems two more appear. Almost as if in response to our efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 又一只奥斯蒂亚噬血型库娃。不管我们怎么清理，这玩意儿好像越清越多。就像专门跟我们对着干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: You know, every now and then a melancholy Offworlder will arrive, thinking to get themselves Vasca-infected as a means to live forever. Too many novels, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 其实，时不时就会有忧郁的异世者跑来，想故意感染噬血病毒，从而获得永生。我只想说，这帮人真是小说看多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: You've caught us a lively one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 你给我们带来了一只活泼的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: This little one has endured hardships. No more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这小家伙受了不少苦。都过去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: An impeccable example of the species.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 堪称这个物种无可挑剔的典范。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: So full of life, this one. It shall do well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 生命力真旺盛，它肯定没事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Oh dear. This one has not had an easy road. Evidence of not just battle scars, but burns… even shrapnel. This is why the Grineer must be expelled. The conflict threatens all life on the Eidolon-Moh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 可怜的小家伙。它一路走来确实不容易。不只是打斗留下的伤疤，还有烧伤……甚至嵌着弹片。这就是为什么必须把克隆尼赶走。战火威胁着夜灵平野上的每一个生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Breathtaking. I've rarely seen such a beautiful specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 令人屏息。我很少见到如此漂亮的个体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Eyes clear. Strong vital signs. Easy movement. Excellent. I'll take it from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 眼睛清澈。生命体征强健，行动自如。太棒了。接下来交给我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Easy now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 别紧张。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ha. They don't like you, Tenno. If only they knew you've likely saved their life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 哈，它不太喜欢你，Tenno。要是它知道，是你救了它一命就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ah yes. Impaired vision. Evidence of skin plucking. Some respiratory distress. A timely intervention on our part. I'm moving this one to the front of the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 啊对，视力受损，皮毛有被拔过的痕迹。轻微的呼吸困难。幸好我们及时干预。我得把这只放在最前头优先处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A very young specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 非常幼小的个体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A juvenile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 还是只幼体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: An immature specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 尚未完全成熟的个体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The common, garden-variety Condroc. Their primary diet is carrion, though they can hunt when they need to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 最普通不过的秃鹰。它们主要以腐肉为食。不过真在必要时，也会亲自捕猎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A rare privilege, Tenno: you behold the Emperor Condroc. This one will have several Condroc committees under their thrall. A superlative example of the species, worthy of the title 'Emperor.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这是难得的荣幸，Tenno。你眼前的，正是一只帝王秃鹰。它统领着好几个亲卫队。堪称这一物种的巅峰典范，无愧于「帝王」之名。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: This Condroc has gone rogue from their committee. It happens, once a Condroc gets a taste for the hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这只秃鹰已经脱离了它们的亲卫队。秃鹰一旦尝过亲自捕猎的甜头，有时就会变成这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Bau Vasca. An uncommon find. An Ostia Vasca drains many animals, including other Vasca, to survive long enough to become Bau. One look into its eyes will tell you: it barely remembers the animal it once was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 博奥噬血型库娃。并不常见。一只奥斯蒂亚噬血型可以吸干很多动物，甚至包括其它噬血型库娃。它们要是活得足够久，就会转化成博奥。看到它的双眼你就会明白，它几乎彻底失去本性了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The rare Nephil Vasca. The apex manifestation of Vasca virus colonization, compelled by the viruses imperative to spread and consume. The Nephil knows little but hunger and death. They can be cured and rehabilitated, but it is a long, long road. We had best get started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 罕见的拿非尔噬血型库娃。这是噬血病毒彻底感染后的终极形态。在病毒的驱使下，它们会不断地传播病毒、吞噬猎物。拿非尔亚种只懂得饥饿与死亡。它们能够康复，也可以适应正常生活，但那会是一个相当漫长的过程。我们最好马上开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Ostia Vasca. Still coming to terms with its… condition. Left unchecked it will become an apex predator - or die - in a matter of weeks. Most do. Many Ostia are out here, concealed, stalking… fighting for nourishment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 奥斯蒂亚噬血型库娃。它还处于……病毒的适应期。如果放任不管，几周之内它就会变成顶级掠食者，或者死去。它们绝大多数都会死，还有些游荡在外，潜伏着、追踪着……为争夺食物而厮杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: So. The Business has given you his blessing. Here on the Eidolon-Moh, what you call the Plains, balance is threatened. Once I would have tasked you with culling out-of-control populations in order to support failing ones. But, for now, those days are gone. My partner has chosen to devote resources to relocation instead, and I must grudgingly admit the program is proving effective in restoring a healthy balance to the Moh. Let us begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 这么说，「操盘手」已经认可你了。这是夜灵平野，也就是你们口中的平野，这里的生态平衡正受到威胁。过去，我会让你狩猎数量失控的种群，好让日渐衰退的种群得以恢复。不过至少眼下，那些日子已经过去了。我的搭档选择将资源投入迁移安置，而我虽然不情愿，但也不得不承认，这项计划对恢复平野的生态平衡还是有帮助的。我们开始行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: We are agents of balance, you and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 你和我，都是维系平衡之人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Things live, things pass. To the turning of the wheel, we bear witness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 万物繁衍生息，又归于尘土。生命的车轮滚滚向前，我们都是见证者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Through strife and predation, the species of the Eidolon-Moh struggle to survive. We correct the balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 夜灵平野的物种，在厮杀与掠食中挣扎求生。我们是来纠正这种失衡的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A new day, a new purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 新的一天，新的使命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Do you feel it, as I do? We are bonded to this place. This planet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 你是否与我一样感同身受？我们与这片土地、与这颗星球，早已彼此相系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Business is dedicated to saving animals, while I am dedicated to saving my people. A land out-of-balance feeds none.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 「操盘手」一心拯救动物，而我一心守护族人。失去平衡的土地，无法哺育任何生灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: The Eidolon-Moh houses me, feeds me, uses me to keep herself in balance and, when I am no more, shall find a use for me still. I have no need for walls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 夜灵平野容我栖身，供我果腹，也借我之手维系自身的平衡。等我不在人世的那天，她依然会让我归于这场循环。而我已不需要高墙庇护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Before the Grineer my master and I would conduct a yearly cull, to keep the Eidolon-Moh in balance. After the Grineer… that was no longer necessary. Quite the opposite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 克隆尼到来之前，我和导师每年都会进行一次物种淘汰，以维持夜灵平野的生态平衡。自从克隆尼来了之后……这便不必要了，反而需要多加保护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Sometimes we fail, despite our best efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 尽管我们拼尽全力，但有时依然会失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: And so it goes. I'm sorry, little friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 生命便是如此。对不起，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: That is unfortunate. But we should try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 实在遗憾。但我们应该再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ashen Kuakas are seen infrequently, spending time, as they do, rooting through tunnels and dens of reptiles and rodents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 灰白库阿卡很难得一见，毕竟它们大部分时间都待在地道里，或在爬行动物和啮齿动物的巢穴中翻找食物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: An exceedingly scarce Ghost Kuaka - so named for their rarity, and preponderance for disappearing. This is a rare opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一种极其罕见的幽灵库阿卡——它们数量稀少，而且又能来去无踪，因此得名。这是个千载难逢的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Plains Kuaka. They play a key role in pest control, thereby protecting the young of other species and keeping the ecosystem balanced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只平野库阿卡。它们是控制害兽的重要一环，既能保护其他物种的幼崽，也维系着生态系统的平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Prepare the tranquilizer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 准备好麻醉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Tranquilizer ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 准备好麻醉枪了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Ready the tranquilizer. Be swift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 准备好麻醉枪。要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A Coastal Mergoo. You'll see these everywhere along shorelines and around large bodies of water.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一只沿海秋沙鸟。在海岸线和大片水域周围，随处都能见到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Regal, is it not? The Splendid Mergoo is a highly social specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 霸气外露，是吧？璀璨秋沙鸟是极爱群居的品种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: A less common variant, with plumage that makes it difficult for a hunter to spot them amongst the foliage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 一种不太常见的变种秋沙鸟，它的羽色与枝叶融为一体，猎人很难发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: I am in partnership with a… certain individual. On Venus. 'The Business,' they call him. If he thinks you are up to the task of conservation, he will equip you appropriately. Then we shall talk, you and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 我与某个……专门的人合伙。在金星上，人们称他为「操盘手」。要是他认为你能胜任保育的任务，自然会给你准备合适的装备。到那时，你我再来详谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Observe. Animal sign.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 仔细观察。有动物的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Our quarry has passed this way. Your echo-lure, it is prepared?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 猎物刚从这里经过。回声诱饵准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Look there. Sign. We are in someone's territory now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 看那儿，足迹。我们踏进了它的领地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: If I may: you appear to have chosen the incorrect lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 恕我直言，你似乎选错了回声诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: Your prey will not respond to that song. A different lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 猎物肯定不会对这种叫声有反应。换个诱饵试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.text: That's the wrong tool for the job, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaHun.zhText: 工具用错了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: An honor to groom the beasts that serve the Tenno. Master Teasonai is forever at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 能为陪伴 Tenno 征战的猛兽梳理毛发，是我的荣幸。提松奈大师随时为您效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: An honor, as always, Tenno. What do your beasts require this day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 一如既往，这是我的荣幸，Tenno。您的动物伙伴今天有什么需求？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: I am humbled, protector of Cetus. Allow Master Teasonai to repay your service with my own. What might your animals require?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 希图斯的守护者，您的光临简直让这里蓬荜生辉。请允许提松奈大师用手艺回报您的付出。您的动物们需要什么服务？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: I was mentored in my craft by a man who lived upon the Eidolon-Moh for many years. It has been a gulf of time now since Sigor Savah departed the Plains. Where he is… I do not know. Though I very much wish I did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 传授我这门手艺的导师，曾在夜灵平野生活多年。自从西格·萨瓦离开平野以来，已经有一段时间了。他身在何处……我不知道。虽然我非常希望我能知道他的行踪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: Space and resources are finite. But The Business, he only smiles and tells me "Teasonai, it is a big universe." Sigor Savah would have had no time for such nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 土地和资源终究是有限的。但是「操盘手」，他只是微笑着跟我说：「提松奈，宇宙大得很。」换作是西格·萨瓦，他可没工夫说这种空话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: Some in Fortuna knew my mentor. I have asked The Business if he had the honor. He only said that Sigor Savah sounded like he had been a man of… enviable clarity. A strange response.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 福尔图娜有些人认识我的导师。我问过「操盘手」是否有幸与他结识。他只说西格·萨瓦听起来像是个头脑清晰的男人……好令人羡慕。真是个奇怪的回答。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: The Business: strange that he frowns upon my methods - of taking animal life in order to preserve it - while he himself applies the same principles… to people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 奇怪的是，「操盘手」对我牺牲少数个体来保全某个物种的做法不屑一顾。而他自己却将同样的法则用在了人的身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: The Business has no stomach for the population control necessary in maintaining a balanced ecosystem. I fear for whatever sanctuary he is building.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 为了维持生态平衡，对种群数量加以控制是不可避免的，可「操盘手」却始终下不了这个决心。我担心他正在建造那个所谓的保护区。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: Yes, I am able to groom your animal. What is your desire?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 啊……没错，我可以为你的动物打理毛发。你有什么想法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: Do you seek to enhance your beast's appearance, perhaps for lower visibility on the hunt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 你是想要让动物看起来漂亮点，还是想要让它在狩猎时不那么显眼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: I can groom for aesthetics, stealth, visibility… or to terrify. Show me the animal and I will advise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 无论是为了美观、隐匿、醒目……还是为了震慑敌人，我都能打理出来。让我看看你的动物，我可以给点建议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: I have lived upon the Eidolon-Moh all my life. Nurturing and culling go hand-in-hand. Live here long enough; you will understand that also.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 我这一生都在夜灵平野生活。培育和淘汰是相辅相成的。在这住得够久，你就会明白这个道理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: The Eidolon-Moh has weathered the introduction of many invasive species, but none more destructive than the Grineer themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 夜灵平野挺过了许多外来物种的入侵，但危害最大的，非克隆尼莫属。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: The Business speaks poetically of the grandeur of the Orb Vallis. I should like to see it for myself, but the cold would not be to my liking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 「操盘手」把奥布山谷的壮美描绘得如诗如画。我倒想亲眼瞧瞧，但我受不了那里的苦寒天气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.text: When The Business first sent me these small stuffed animals I took it as evidence of a mind in decay. However… on reflection… I see now that he has a greater understanding of people than I could ever aspire to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaInt.zhText: 当「操盘手」第一次把这些小毛绒动物寄给我时，我还以为他是上了年纪脑袋不灵光。然而……后来细想我才明白，他对人性的洞察比我预想的还要深。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaOut.text: I trust this meets with your approval.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Ostron/DTeaOut.zhText: 相信这肯定能合你心意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.text: Operator, Ordis has been thinking. Now that you are here in the flesh we should make the orbiter more comfortable. Ordis has identified an old storage space you could use. Standby while I TORCH THIS JUNK... dispose of my old belongings. Out with the old and in with the new, right Operator? Construct this Domestic Habitation Segment to extend life support to your new room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.zhText: 指挥官，Ordis 一直在想，既然您现在是用肉身在轨道飞行器里活动，我们该把这变得更舒适些。Ordis 标记出了一个旧的储藏间供您使用。请在我点燃这堆垃圾……处理老旧物品时稍待片刻。旧的不去新的不来，对吧，指挥官？请建造这个家居模块来将维生系统扩展至新的房间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.text: Well, what do you think? Not too shabby, yes? Ordis hopes the Operator enjoys this new room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.zhText: 怎么样？还不赖吧？Ordis 希望指挥官喜欢这间新房间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.text: Your Habitation Segment is complete and the new room is ready. Ordis cannot contain his excitement. Will you go there now, Operator? Will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.zhText: 您的家居模块完成了，新房间也准备就绪。Ordis 已无法抑制他内心的激动。指挥官，可以请你现在就去看看吗？快去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.text: When that Domestic Habitation Segment Ugh... get married why don't we? is complete Ordis will renovate your new space. Ordis loves nesting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PersonalQuarte.zhText: 等家居模块呃……我们何不结婚呢？完成后 Ordis 会为您把新房间装潢一遍。Ordis 喜欢家的感觉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: You know, Konzu doesn't get emotional. But this place? Cetus is more than our home, Tenno: it is the center of our universe. My uncle, he died protecting his. And you, you fought to protect ours. My uncle's voice, still echoes - a warning. But this place? Our voice? Will echo forever. As a welcome. A beacon to anyone who needs a home. Okay, a little emotional maybe. The Unum chose well when she sent you to us. Dah-dup. Now, get back to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 说实话，孔尊我不轻易感情用事。但希图斯呢？这里不仅是我们的家园。Tenno，它是我们整个宇宙的中心。我的叔叔，他以死保护了希图斯。而你，也为了守护这里而战。我叔叔的声音至今仍在宇宙中回响——那是一声警告。可这里呢？我们的声音也会永远回荡下去。作为一声欢迎，化作一座所有渴望归家之人点亮的灯塔。好吧，我好像有点动情了。乌努母神把你送到我们身边，真是太英明了。多谢。好了，继续干活吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Infestation. My Uncle, Hinmun, sold minerals aboard a market near Eris. Quite popular with deep-system traders. At least it was. They were broadsided by one of these boils. It spread fast. They could have run, risked taking it with them. Instead, they turned off life-support and blew-out escape pods. Decades later, it still orbits Eris. Writhing. One voice repeating the same message over and over, "We are death. Leave us, and do not look back." My Uncle's voice. Fail here, Tenno, and that will be the fate of Cetus: to be a warning for the living, from a place where none may tread.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 感染者。我的叔叔辛姆，以前在阋神星附近的太空市集船里卖矿石。那里很受深星系贸易商的欢迎。至少曾经是。后来，一颗这样的毒瘤撞上了他们的船舷，感染迅速蔓延开来。他们本可以逃，哪怕冒着把瘟疫一同带走的风险。可他们选择切断维生系统，炸毁所有逃生舱。几十年过去，那艘船还在阋神星的轨道上漂浮着，蠕动着。只有一个声音，日复一日地重复着同一句话：「我们已死。离开我们，别回头。」那是我叔叔的声音。要是我们这次失败了，Tenno，希图斯也会沦为同样的下场——化作无人能够踏足的死地，成为留给生者的警告。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Tenno, a meteoroid is on an impact trajectory with Earth. Ordis' calculations have it making planetfall just beyond Cetus. More troubling still^ it appears to be alive. Stay vigilant, I will update you as I learn more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: Tenno，一颗陨星正朝地球撞来。奥迪斯计算得出它将在希图斯郊外坠落。但更棘手的是……它似乎是活的。保持警惕，一有新情报我会立刻通知你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Tenno, a meteoroid is on an impact trajectory with Earth. Stay vigilant, I will update you as I learn more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: Tenno，一颗陨星正朝地球撞来。保持警惕，一有新情报，我会立刻通知你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The meteoroid has crashed down outside Cetus! Konzu reports that it is indeed some sort of organic boil. At the moment it poses no direct threat. Still, I need you to be ready to act on a moment's notice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 陨星已坠落在希图斯郊外！孔尊报告称，那确实是某种活体毒瘤。目前它尚未构成直接威胁，但你还是要做好准备，随时出动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: I have received word from Konzu. The Infested boil that once threatened the Plains of Eidolon - it has grown back, uglier and more putrid than ever. Remain on standby, I may need you at a moment's notice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 我收到了孔尊的消息，那颗曾威胁夜灵平野的感染毒瘤居然又长出来了，还比以往更加丑陋腐臭。时刻待命，我随时需要你出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Tenno, Konzu needs your help! The Ostrons have sighted Infested lifeforms emerging from the boil. We need to deal with this thing immediately. Report to Konzu in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: Tenno，孔尊需要你的帮助！奥斯特朗人看见感染生命体正从毒瘤中涌出。必须立即解决这个威胁。去希图斯，向孔尊报告情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: First the stars went wrong… and now the air. Can you smell it? Master Teasonai… his animals… they smell it, too. Sweet, like a wound gone bad. These days none of us sleep easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 先是星象乱了套……现在空气也不对劲了。你闻到了吗？提松奈大师……他的动物……也都闻到了。甜得发腻，就像伤口腐烂的味道。这些天没人能睡个好觉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: When the sun is low, scouts report seeing things - shadows - moving inside the boil. Stay close, Tenno. Stay close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 日落时分，探子报告称看到瘤子里有东西在蠕动，只看到了影子。别走远，Tenno。千万别走远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Vay Hek! He has toxin enough to destroy the boil, but no. He wants it to flourish. Why? To see the Infested succeed where he has failed: to see them destroy Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 韦·海克！他明明手握足以摧毁毒瘤的毒素，却偏要放任它滋长。为什么？他就想让感染者替他完成没做成的事——彻底摧毁希图斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Dark times, killer. In times past we've lost entire markets - entire clades - to the Infestation. That cannot happen here. Cetus must survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 黑暗的日子又来了，杀手。过去，我们因为感染瘟疫失去了整座市集……甚至整个氏族。这种事绝不能在此重演。希图斯必须活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: I've put Nakak in charge of supply distribution, until this strangeness is at an end. See what she has for you. We're all in this one together, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 在那毒瘤彻底消失之前，我已经把物资配发交给娜卡负责。去看看她给你准备了什么。这一仗，咱们一起扛，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: During these dark nights Cetus is grateful for your help. Nakak will keep you supplied until we beat this. Go see her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 在这段晦暗的日子里，感谢你对希图斯的鼎力相助。娜卡会继续为你提供补给，直到我们渡过难关。去找她吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: First Vay Hek thinks 'I will let this plague run wild over Cetus.' Then he thinks, 'I will use poison to exterminate the Infestation once its work is done.' The Quills see doom in his plan, for Grineer and Ostron alike. The boil needs to be destroyed now, before it becomes unstoppable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 一开始韦·海克先是盘算：「我要让瘟疫席卷希图斯。」接着又想：「等一切结束后，我就用毒素消灭这些感染者。」夜羽认为他的计划是场灾难，克隆尼和奥斯特朗人无一能够幸免。必须立刻摧毁感染毒瘤，等它变得无法控制就为时已晚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The Infestation... I was beginning to think it would never touch us here. That it was a thing that happened out there. To others. Naive. I need you to take Vay Hek's toxin and kill the boil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 我一开始以为……感染瘟疫永远都不会殃及希图斯。以为那只会发生在远方，发生在别人身上。我太天真了。我需要你拿走韦·海克的毒素，毁掉那颗毒瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The toxin has triggered peristalsis. Antibody production has escalated. Prepare for a massive immune response.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 毒素引发了蠕动。抗体正在加速生成。准备迎接一场剧烈的免疫反扑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Fools! You tried to POP its GLISTENING MAGNIFICENCE, but you just made it angry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 蠢货！你们妄想戳破这闪耀的宏伟奇迹，却只徒劳地激怒了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Keep trying to cleanse these plains, you'll only die in a SHOWER of FECULENT DEFEAT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 继续白费功夫净化平野吧，你们只配死在恶臭溃败的血雨中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: No. NO. NOOOOO!!!
You have NOT WON, MAGGOTS! YOU HAVE NOT WON!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 你们还没有赢，蛆虫！你们还没赢！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Well you got a reaction. Big as a house and half as smart. Knock it on the head, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 看来你真把它惹毛了。个头大如山，脑袋木如砖。去，给它脑门开个瓢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The boil's immune system has manufactured a Hemocyte to deal with the toxin threat. Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 毒瘤的免疫系统生成了一只免疫血胞体，用来应对毒素威胁。消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: A Hemocyte: the product of the boil attempting to fight off the toxin. Kill it to weaken the Infestation further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 免疫血胞体是毒瘤为了抵抗毒素而生成的产物。干掉它，进一步削弱毒瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Tenno maggots! You try to protect these rats, but you will fail and fail!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: Tenno 蛆虫！你妄想保护这些老鼠，但是你注定会一败涂地！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: That, uh… that was some allergic reaction you kicked off. Quite a sight, Tenno. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 那，呃……你引起的过敏反应真激烈。场面真壮观，Tenno。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Top shelf work, surah. But it was not enough. Not yet. Hit it again, and keep hitting it 'til there's nothing but a hole in the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 干得漂亮，朋友。可这还不够，远远不够。继续攻击，死命攻击，直到把那炸成个坑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: You are not welcome on Konzu's Plains, snot-thing. Nice work, Number One Gun. We're breathing easier back here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 孔尊的平野不欢迎你，恶心的鼻涕怪。干得好，头号杀手。我们这边可算能松口气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Vay Hek has his best troops securing this toxin. Proceed to the bottom of the mine, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 韦·海克派出了最精锐的部队来看守毒素。前往矿坑最深处，Tenno。
