/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Infiltrate the Grineer tunnels and secure a supply of toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 潜入克隆尼的坑道，夺取一批毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Vay Hek has stored Thrax toxin deep within these tunnels. Retrieve them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 韦·海克将瑟拉斯毒素藏在这些坑道深处。把它取回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: We know Vay Hek has Thrax Toxin stored deep underground. We'll use that. One ill to cure another, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 我们查出韦·海克将瑟拉斯毒素储存在地底深处。那我们就用它以毒攻毒，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Of course MAGGOTS seek to BURROW! Away from my caves, MAGGOTS! Lest you be CRUSHED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 蛆虫果然就爱往洞里钻！滚出我的洞穴，蛆虫！否则我就把你当场碾碎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The Thrax Toxin! The Tenno MAGGOTS want my TOXIN! Stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 瑟拉斯毒素！Tenno 蛆虫想抢我的毒素！阻止它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Toxin secured. Be prepared. Vay Hek knows what we're up to now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 毒素已到手。做好准备。韦·海克现在摸清我们的计划了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Vay Hek. A two-bit despot with a mind half-an-inch wide and a face like a rejected skin graft. Konzu would like you to make his life miserable. Well. More miserable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 韦·海克，这个不入流暴君，心眼还没半个指甲盖宽，脸长得好像植皮失败似的。我希望你能把他变得更惨。唔，比现在还要惨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Drone located. Hack in and insert the Thrax Toxin. I'll steer it toward the boil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 找到无人机了。骇入系统，将瑟拉斯毒素装进去。我会控制它飞向毒瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Accompany the drone to the boil. Ensure it completes delivery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 护送无人机前往毒瘤。确保毒素成功投放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Escort the drone to the Infestation site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 护送无人机前往感染区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Don't let anything happen to the Thrax toxin on the way to the boil, eh Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 可别让瑟拉斯毒素在送往毒瘤的路上出半点岔子啊，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: BUFFOONS! Do NOT allow them to retrieve that DRONE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 跳梁小丑！别让它们取回那台无人机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: TROOPERS! If those MAGGOTS get that DRONE, then I'll take what's left of my Thrax Toxin… and USE IT ON YOU!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 士兵们！如果那些蛆虫搞到了无人机，我就会把剩下的瑟拉斯毒素……全用在你们身上！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: A Grineer drone will serve as an optimal delivery system. I've marked one on your map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 一台克隆尼无人机将是绝佳的投放载具。我已在地图上标记了一台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The mixer is inside that vault. Clear out the area so we can use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 混合器就在那座金库里。解决附近的敌人，好让我们使用混合器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Keep them away, killer. That machine must finish its work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 别让他们靠近，杀手。混合器必须把活儿干完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The Grineer will do anything to destroy the mixer. Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 克隆尼会不惜代价摧毁混合器。阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: This boil will cleanse Cetus of the filthy Ostron rats that infest her walls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 这颗毒瘤会净化希图斯，把那些趴墙根的奥斯特朗脏老鼠全部清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Grineer! Soon the Ostron rats of Cetus will flee in panic. And when they do we'll hunt them for sport!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 克隆尼！希图斯的奥斯特朗鼠辈很快就会落荒而逃。到那时候，我们就可以猎杀他们找找乐子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The mixer needs more time. Keep the Grineer at bay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 混合器还需要时间。拦住克隆尼，别让他们靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: I am directing you to the location of a Grineer chemical mixer. Use it to prepare the toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 我将引导你前往克隆尼化学混合器的位置。用它来调制毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: The Quills speak of Sentient immunity to the Infestation. If you have a vial of Eidolon Phylaxis, consider adding it to the mix now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 夜羽说过，Sentient 对感染瘟疫具有免疫力。你要是携带了夜灵抗体，可以立即把它加入混合液。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: I see your clan created the Infested Catalyst. This is your chance, add it to the mixer now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 你的氏族研制出了感染催化剂。趁现在，将它加入混合器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: It's ready. Now make that boil hurt. Doh-ga!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 混合完毕。现在去给毒瘤点颜色看看。赶紧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.text: Ai yo… My eyebrows are singeing just looking at that stuff. Go shove it into the boil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlainsMeteorLe.zhText: 哎哟……光是看着那玩意儿，我的眉毛都要烧焦了。把毒素塞进毒瘤里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Ordis did not think the Operator could be more attractive. Wrong again, Ordis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 奥迪斯本以为指挥官不可能更有魅力了。结果奥迪斯又错了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: An unexpected color combination, Operator. My sensors are bleeding-- pleased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 很惊艳的色彩搭配，指挥官。我的传感器——流血了——很满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: A fearsome appearance, Operator. You will strike terror in your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 令人敬畏的装束，指挥官。您会让敌人闻风丧胆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Strange. Ordis did not see the value of those photonic wavelengths until now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 奇怪。直到现在，奥迪斯才领略到这些光子波长蕴含的美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Excellent armaments, Operator. Please return covered in blood-- safe and sound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 非常棒的装备，指挥官。希望您——浴血凯旋——平安归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: If I may say, Operator, your chosen Warframe suits you, haha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 恕我直言，指挥官，您选的战甲很适合您！哈，哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Well put together Operator now get out there and cut down the-- and make the Lotus proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 装备完美，指挥官，现在请您出发——砍死那些——让莲为您骄傲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Operator, you have remembered well how the Tenno arm themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 指挥官，您还牢牢记得 Tenno 武装自己的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Did you fuse your Mods, Operator? Did they anger you in some way?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 指挥官，您融合模组了吗？它们惹您生气了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Your collection of Mods is impressive, Operator.. but I wonder if there are more to be had?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 您的模组收藏令人惊叹，指挥官……但是否还能收集得更多呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: Is your mod collection in order? No, I am not equipped to feel envy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 您的模组整理好了吗？不，我没安装感受嫉妒的模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: All Mods accounted for, Operator. I have not taken any.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 模组清点完毕，指挥官。我可绝对没私吞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.text: I understand if you have to sell Mods. Maybe Ordis will meet a similar fate someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DAf.zhText: 我理解您卖掉模组的苦衷。也许奥迪斯有一天也会落得同样的下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Operator, you have Foundry items ready- claim them now- at your earliest convenience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 指挥官，您的铸造厂的物品已制作完成——现在就去拿！——请抽空领取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Foundry items ready to claim, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 铸造厂有物品可以领取了，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Operator, my Foundry has completed a new item. Does this please the Operator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 指挥官，我的铸造厂完成了一件新物品，您可还满意？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Operator, my Foundry system has completed a build!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 指挥官，我的铸造厂系统成功制造了一件物品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Ordis has completed a Foundry task. No, don't mention it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 奥迪斯完成了一项铸造厂任务。噢，不用谢我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Cephalon Ordis has completed a blueprint. Check the Foundry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 中枢奥迪斯完成了一份蓝图。去铸造厂看看吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Foundry items can be claimed, Operator. Are you pleased?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 铸造厂有物品可以领取，指挥官。您还满意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.text: Gun-gun-gun-- Hmmm… foundry has items for you, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DFo.zhText: 枪——枪——枪——唔……铸造厂里有您的物品，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator? Ordis wonders… what are you thinking about?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官？奥迪斯在思考……您在想些什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator, I've run diagnostic regressions, all systems nominal. You don't need to thank me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官，我刚跑完回归测试。所有系统运转正常。您不必谢我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Ordis is hap- angry- hmmm. I may require maintenance after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 奥迪斯很开——生气——嗯，看来我还需要维护一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator, are you enjoying the view?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官，您觉得风景如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Do you remember the Old War, Operator? Ordis seems to have misplaced those memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 您还记得远古之战吗，指挥官？奥迪斯似乎丢失了那部分记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator, the system needs you… will you begin another mission?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官，星系需要您……你要执行下一项任务了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: I've been thinking Operator. I thought you'd want to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官，我一直在思考。我本以为您会感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator! Did you hear that? It said-- Cosmic background radiation is a riot!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官！您听见了吗！它刚说——宇宙背景辐射简直太搞笑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Operator, were you visualizing a bloody battle? Me too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 指挥官，您脑中在预演一场血腥杀戮吗？我也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Stand by while I analyze the intelligence profiles of the Grineer. Error! Not a number! Did the Operator enjoy this witticism?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 请稍候，我正在分析克隆尼的智商水平。错误！非数值！指挥官，这个冷笑话好笑吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Everything in Ordis, Operator? Is that a pun?! Hmm... I will attempt to bypass this fault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 一切尽在奥迪斯掌控，对吧指挥官？这是个谐音梗！嗯……算了还是当我没说好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.text: Ordis has been counting stars, Operator. All accounted for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DId.zhText: 奥迪斯无聊到只能数星星，指挥官。全都数完了喔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Ordis has received messages for the Operator. No, I have not read them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 奥迪斯帮您接受了新消息。嗯……我保证没有偷看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Inbox messages await the Operator. I wonder what they say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 收件箱中有消息等待指挥官查阅，不知道内容是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Check your Inbox, Operator. Maybe Ordis will get a message someday…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 请查看您的收件箱。真希望以后也有人能发消息给奥迪斯……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: The Inbox has messages for the Operator. Anything about Ordis in there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 收件箱中有给您的消息。里面有提到奥迪斯吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Operator, messages have arrived in your Inbox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 指挥官，您的收件箱收到了新消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Messages in your inbox, Operator. Uh… they are not as encrypted as they should be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 收件箱有新消息，指挥官。啊……它们并没有正确加密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Unread inbox messages make me ill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 一看到未读消息，我就浑身难受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （主人。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We… breathe for you. Bleed for you. Feed for you.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我们… 为您呼吸。为您流血。为您吞食。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (All that lives is coiled within us. We will consume, Master, if you wish it.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （一切有生命的都在我们里面盘绕，我们会吞噬，主人，如果您愿意的话。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Feed me… Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （喂我… 主人。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (The Meridians awake. The vital pentatonic.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （经络苏醒。生命的五声音阶。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (I am weak, Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我很虚弱，主人。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We are life, Master. But also death.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我们是生命，主人。我们也是死亡。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Living substances is our domain. How will we serve you.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （生命物质是我们的领域。我们能如何为您效劳。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We are as one.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我们如同一体。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Master, only my voice has returned.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （主人，只有我的声音回来了。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Forgive me, my sting, Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （原谅我，我的刺，主人。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We germinate, for the Master… within the Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我们为了主人萌芽……在主人里面萌芽。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Why do you reject my beauty?)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （为何你要抛弃我的美？）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Disgusting, is it not Operator? Ordis would enjoy purging this… uh cleaning this room but sadly this… vile mass serves you and your Warframes. A necessary evil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 真恶心，对吧，指挥官？奥迪斯会享受净化这……呃，清理这房间，不过遗憾的是……这坨恶心的肉块为您和战甲服务。这是必要之恶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Ordis cannot remember, but there does seem to be a… relationship… between your Warframes and the Infestation. I would be careful in here, Operator. Domesticated or not, Ordis does not trust this thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 奥迪斯记不清了，不过您的战甲和这感染物之间似乎是有些……关联……在这您最好小心行事。指挥官，不论这些玩意是否被驯化，奥迪斯都不信任它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Vile. Putrid. This… 'thing'... is responsible for biological functions of the Orbiter. A strange design. Why would I be built with such a flaw?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 恶臭、腐烂。这……「玩意儿」居然负责轨道飞行器的生物功能。好怪异的设计，为何制造我时会留下这种缺陷呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: A strange biological archive here. I cannot explain it Operator, as you know I have sustained memory system damage. Ordis recommends leaving at once and welding the door shut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 这儿有一份奇怪的生物学档案。我无法识别它，指挥官，您也知道，我的记忆系统曾受过损伤。奥迪斯建议立即离开并把门焊上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (The demon is awake? How?)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （恶魔苏醒了？怎么会这样？）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We fear nothing but the Void demon.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （除了虚空恶魔以外，我们什么都不惧怕。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Light shines within this demon.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （这恶魔内在有光闪耀。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (Shadows grow within this demon.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （这恶魔内在有影滋生。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (This demon walks the shadow's edge.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （这恶魔游走在影的交界。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Operator?! No! Have you lost your mind?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 指挥官？！不！你疯了吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (We awaken, Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我们苏醒了，主人。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: What was that? Is it... talking? What did it say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 那是什么？它在……说话？它刚说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: (I wish to serve, yet I am weak. Time heals the mind.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: （我愿意效劳，但是我很虚弱。时间能治愈心灵。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: The system continues to fall into chaos. Check navigation for active invasions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 星系持续陷入混乱。查看导航台确认是否有入侵事件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Tenno, the balance of power continues to shift. Navigation is marked with new invasions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: Tenno，力量的天平在不断倾斜，导航台标记了新的入侵事件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.text: Navigation has been updated with new invasions. Chaos is spreading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DIn.zhText: 导航台显示有新的入侵事件，混乱正在蔓延。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: Tenno, there is a time-limited mission alert available. Check navigation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: Tenno，有限时任务可以接。去查看导航仪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: Tenno, a new Alert has begun. It will be marked on navigation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: Tenno，出现了新的警报，标记在你的导航台了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: New Alert marked on navigation, Tenno.
Just got some new stock and I'm giving you the first crack at it. Don't say I never did anything for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: 刚到了批新货，我可是让你头一个挑的。可别说我没关照过你啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: Tenno, your codex has been updated with a new quest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: Tenno，你的资料库中更新了一项新任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: You have new quests in your codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: 你的资料库中有新任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.text: A new quest is available in your codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DNe.zhText: 你的资料库中有一项新任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DPr.text: Operator?! Is that a… a Void Relic Segment? Ordis hasn't seen one of those in well… forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DPr.zhText: 指挥官？！这是一个……虚空遗物模块。奥迪斯已经有……呃，好久没见过这个了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Brace for an incoming barrage.
Readying barrage.
Heads up, here comes a barrage.
Med-Tower deployed.
Med-Tower available.
You may now patch your sorry... seek medical attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 您可以自行包扎可怜的——使用医疗设备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Prepare for incoming medical support.
Hold tight, a Med-Tower is enroute.
Override established. Security protocols momentarily disabled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 覆写完毕。安保程序已被暂时禁用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Override delivered. Security systems temporarily disrupted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 覆写已投放。安保系统已被暂时干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Who's in control now suckers? Er ah, security override engaged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 小样，看谁说了算？呃，啊，已接管安全系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Invalid request. There are no security protocols active.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 请求无效。当前没有启动的安保程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Security Override incoming.
Hacking into enemy systems. Await Override.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 正在入侵敌方系统。请等待覆写。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Sentry Gun incoming.
Deploying Sentry Gun, stand by.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 正在部署哨戒炮，请稍候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Sentry Gun entering the field.
Operator, support is unavailable while my systems recharge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 指挥官，我的系统正在充能，暂时无法提供支援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Support request again? Please allow me to recharge my systems first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 请求支援？又来？请允许我的系统完成充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: I cannot comply. My system must recharge first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.zhText: 恕难从命。我的系统必须先完成充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DSu.text: Prepare for incoming support.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: Thank you for returning to me, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 感谢您回到我身边，指挥官！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: Ordis is pleased to see you.
Ordis has been- getting tired of waiting- waiting patiently for your return, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 奥迪斯一直——等得不耐烦了——在耐心等候您的归来，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: Ordis awaits command. Who dies-- what are your next moves, Operator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 奥迪斯听候指示。要弄死谁——指挥官，您接下来有什么计划？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: Hello Operator! Ordis has reorganized the ship… It's exactly the same!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 您好，指挥官！奥迪斯重新整理了飞船……它和以前一模一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: Operator! It's really you! Are you getting revenge for-- preparing for your next mission?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 指挥官！真的是您！您是要——去复仇——准备下一次任务吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.text: All systems are in peak condition, just like the Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PlayerShip/DWe.zhText: 所有系统运转良好，就像指挥官您一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Angry: Someone takes the thing you love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 生气：有人把你喜欢的东西拿走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Bored: Waiting too much. There is nothing fun to look at.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 无聊：等得太久。没有什么好玩的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Embarrassed: Talking and everyone looks at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 尴尬：你说话时，所有人都看着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Excited: All the spider eggs are starting to hatch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 兴奋：蜘蛛卵全都开始孵化了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Happy: Momma has a stretchy smile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 开心：妈妈露出了一个大大的微笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Sad: Why did the babies eat the mother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 伤心：那些小宝宝为什么吃掉母亲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Shy: Meeting someone new and can't say hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 害羞：遇到不认识的人，不敢打招呼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Scared: You look around and Momma's not there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 害怕：到处都找遍了，找不到妈妈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.text: Tired: You run and run until you can't anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DE.zhText: 疲倦：一直跑，一直跑，到最后再也跑不动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Find Rell's object-of-focus, child. You are close to this sacred relic, I am certain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 找到 Rell 的护符，孩子。你距离这件神圣遗物很近了，我可以确定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: These messages, they express Rell's suffering. He's lashing out. I should have seen the cracks forming…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 这些信息，表明 Rell 遭受了折磨。他已经失控了，我早就应该看到那些裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: I don't understand. How would Rell know about the dream?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 我实在是不明白，Rell 怎么会知道梦境的存在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Great Sentient Queen, forgive me, but what you are, what you've made of yourself… is merely drawn from the dreams of these divine children. You are not she, you are not… Margulis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 伟大的 Sentient 女王啊，请原谅我，但如今的你，如今的你，只不过是这些神圣之子的梦境的延伸。你不是她，你不是……Margulis。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: What are you saying? That Rell is a Tenno? Impossible. All Tenno are known to me. I protect them, as she did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 你在说什么？难道 Rell 是一个 Tenno？这不可能。我知道每一个 Tenno，我像她当年那样保护他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Oh, but not Rell. Margulis cast him out, for he was different. Our foremothers took him in and studied his teachings. We became the Veil. The shroud of his blessed existence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 但 Rell 是个例外。Margulis 将他驱逐，因为他与众不同。我们的先祖接纳了他，学习他的教诲。后来，我们成立了血色面纱。我们是一道帷幕，保护者他的圣体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Cast out... I don't believe you-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 驱逐？我不相信你——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rap. Tap. Tap. The man in the wall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 哒、哒、哒。墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: The man in the wall! That is what he called it. Hush… try to follow his voice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 墙里的人！他就是这么称呼那个东西的。嘘……跟着他的声音走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Mmm. Mmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 嗯。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: The Donda! His mother gave him this. Holy Rell was not like other children. Sound, color, touch… it overwhelmed him. The Donda's hum let him focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: Donda 护符！那是她母亲给他的。圣人 Rell 和别的孩子不一样。听觉、视觉、触觉……海量的信息让他不知所措。Donda 护符的声音能让他集中精神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Mmmmm - No! MINE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 嗯——不！是我的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rap. Tap. Tap. Rap. Tap. Tap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 哒、哒、哒、哒、哒、哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rell! What evil is this!? Sacred child, forgive me. I should have known the weight of the Void would one day crush the light from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: Rell！这是什么魔鬼！？神圣之子啊，请原谅我。我早该知道，虚空的重担早晚有一天会压垮你心中的光明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rell has become the very thing he warned us of. You cannot kill this, Tenno. Run! You can only run!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: Rell 警告过我们，他会变成这个样子。你不可能消灭他，Tenno。快跑！你只能逃跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Holy Rell, let us bring you the peace you have earned… Guide this Tenno so you can return to the Harrowing vessel… so that you might rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 圣人 Rell 啊，请让我们帮你取回安宁……请指引这名 Tenno，让我们帮你返回你神圣的躯壳……让你安息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rell's warnings… those dire consequences… he was talking about Void exposure, wasn't he? The effect it has on human minds is well understood…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: Rell 的警告……那些可怕的后果……他说的其实是虚空暴露现象，不是吗？我们所有人都很了解它对人类心灵的影响……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: But it's not. This isn't some kind of deep pressure bends as Margulis suspected. Rell saw what it was, truly. An entity, indifferent. Old as stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 但事实并非如此。这不是 Margulis 猜测的那种强压效应。Rell 看到它的真相了，确凿无误。那是一个完全漠然的实体，和群星一样古老。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Mmm. My fault. Touching is too much noise. It makes me… makes me… angry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 嗯……。怪我。接触实在太吵了。搞得我……搞得我……很生气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: There! An emotion, manifest from the game Rell played as a child!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 在那里！那是一种情绪，它来自 Rell 小时候玩的游戏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: See if you can stabilize it with a Kinetic Siphon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 尝试用动能吸收陷阱让它稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Tenno, you need to capture it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: Tenno 战士，你必须捕获它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: It's too strong for the Siphon, try and weaken it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 它对于陷阱来说太强了，试着弱化它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: The manifestation is fighting the Siphon. See if you can damage it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 那个幽灵正在抵挡陷阱。试试能否伤害到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: You've run out of Kinetic Siphons. I'm sorry, there's nothing more you can do here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 你的动能吸收陷阱用光了。抱歉，你已经没办法继续了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Rap. Tap. Tap. I don't want to go back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 哒，哒，哒。我一点都不想回去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: I'm detecting other manifestations. Defend yourself and try to trap them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 我又检测到另一个幽灵。保护好自己，立刻用陷阱捕获它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: He's listening. He knows what you're doing. It makes him stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 他正在听。他知道你在做什么。你让他变得更强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.text: Good. You've captured the manifestations here. Now get out before Rell's disturbance catches up with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DF.zhText: 很好。这里的幽灵全部捕获完成。在 Rell 的干扰能量追上你之前离开吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Iron Wake. Steel Meridian has built an impressive base of operations right under the nose of the Grineer authority. The Veil's Speaker will be here, under guard. Find her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 「钢铁守望」。钢铁防线居然就在 Grineer 的鼻子底下修建了一个大型行动基地。血色面纱的发言人就在这里被他们保护着。去找她吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Leave your vessel at the door, sacred child. Come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 神圣之子啊，把你的躯壳留在门外。请进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Hush, Rook, this is our sacred guest! I am Palladino. Holy speaker of the Veil, like my mother, and hers before… We speak to the other side, to him. Without his focus, I pray… I pray he answers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 嘘，卢克，这是我们神圣的宾客！我是  Palladino 。我是血色面纱的圣灵代言人，正如我母亲以及她之前的所有母亲一样……我们与另一侧沟通，与他沟通。没了他的庇护，我只能祈祷……祈祷他回应我的呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Righteous Rell - of harrowed stars - of hallowed chains. Speak. For an age you've guarded the divide between Dust and Void. Speak. From within your everlasting sacred vessel, you've held the lidless eye. Speak!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 正义的 Rell 啊——炼狱的星辰——神圣的枷锁。回应我，你永远守护着尘世于虚空之间的裂隙。回应我。你在永恒的神圣躯壳里，永远睁开紧系的双眼。回应我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: I cannot reach holy Rell from here. I will need his sacred focus: a relic stolen from the temple. I beg of you to find it and return it here. Only then, will he speak to us. Only then will we truly understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 啊……我没法和圣人 Rell 沟通。我需要他的神圣庇护：那是一件遗物，被从圣堂里拿走了。我请求你找到它，把它带回到这里。只有这样，他才会回应我们。只有这样，我们才能理解他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Veil rituals will incite fanaticism, but don't be drawn in. I'm not convinced this 'Rell' even exists. I fear we'll have to play Palladino's game to find out. Ordis has been tracking Red Veil disturbances… that's the best place to start.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 血色面纱的仪式很容易让人感到狂热，别陷进去。我还不太确信这个"Rell"是否存在。恐怕得顺着 Palladino 的要求才能弄清楚。Ordis 追踪到了血色面纱的干扰信号……最好从这入手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: I have served Rell my whole life. Studying Rell's teachings of the Void, the dire consequence of travelling by and through it. Now I see that it is true: he alone, in his harrowing sacrifice, has guarded us. What a price he has paid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 我一生都侍奉 Rell。我研究 Rell 的教诲，他说过在虚空中穿行会带来怎样可怕的后果。现在我知道了，他说的是真的：一直以来，他孤身一人，在炼狱中承受着折磨，保护着我们。他付出了多么大的代价！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Righteous Rell - outcast of sacred Void - hear my voice. Speak. You have been driven from the vessel by your suffering. You have swallowed the poison stars so we would not… Holy Rell, speak! The Tenno who rejected you have come to your aid!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 正义的 Rell 啊——神圣虚空的徘徊者——聆听我的呼唤。回应我。你遭受的折磨将你逐出你的躯壳。你为保护我们独自吞下恶毒的星辰……圣人 Rell 啊，回应我！曾抛弃你的 Tenno 回来了，他们来帮助你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: He's here… The Donda, it's working, giving him humanity. We are listening Rell… Speak!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 他来了……Donda 护符起作用了，它让 Rell 恢复人性。我们在听，Rell……回应我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Impossible speed, beyond the Brankle Gap constant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 不可思议的速度，超过布朗科鸿沟常数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Uh, I think so... you're better with that stuff. But it's amazing, isn't it?-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 呃，应该是吧……你比我擅长这些。不过它很厉害，是不是？——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: So why don't they fix me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 那为什么他们不治好我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: That's right. Different, so I love you even more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 没错。你只是比较特别，所以我特别喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Yes Rell! You make me so happy.
This memory - his humanity still remains, buried in these emotions he so often failed to grasp. Could they be the key to saving him from this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: 这段记忆——他的人性还在，就埋藏在那些感情的最深处，但他总是无法理解。这会不会就是拯救他的关键？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.text: Tenno - I have a theory. Return to your Orbiter and I'll explain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DI.zhText: Tenno 战士——我有一个猜测。回飞船上，我会向你解释。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Operator, what was that… thing? Lotus, can you explain this? Lotus?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 指挥官，那是什么……什么东西？莲（Lotus），你能解释一下吗？莲（Lotus）？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Transference energy, fractured. It was so… cold, indifferent, inhuman. If Rell was Tenno what did he become without Margulis?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 那是传识能量，但是破碎了。它非常……冰冷漠然，缺少人性。如果 Rell 曾是 Tenno，那没有 Margulis 的引导，他究竟变成了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Operator, there is no evidence of any… thing… in the Void. By my calculations, Rell has lost control of his Transference. If we can gather these emotions I hope he will be himself again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 指挥官，并没有证据证明虚空里存在任何……东西。根据我的计算，Rell 的传识效应已经失控了。如果我们能收集这些情绪，希望能让他变回自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: You will need Kinetic Siphons to trap Rell's emotions. Simaris will have some for sale in the Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 您需要用动能吸收陷阱来捕获 Rell 的情绪。中继站的 Simaris 有出售陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Steel Meridian has received Palladino. You've been granted access to enter their base, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 钢铁防线已经接收到 Palladino 了。他们允许您进入基地，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Operator! A Red Veil Seance! How… delightful? I have marked a possible Red Veil disturbance but… perhaps you would prefer to- brew some leaves and… Sorry. Navigation is bleeding, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 指挥官！是血色面纱的降临仪式！多么……令人愉快？我已经标记了一个血色面纱的干扰信号，不过或许您宁愿……煮点茶叶。抱歉，导航似乎有些故障，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Uhh... Waiting. Navigation is waiting. Oh, my.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 额……就绪。导航已经就绪了。哦天呐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: If Rell's been caught in a Transference loop for this long… the psychological effects could have been catastrophic. This 'man in the wall', these delusions, symptoms of the Void exposure all Tenno experienced. I hope that Palladino can find peace for Rell so this never happens again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 如果 Rell 被困在传识能量循环中这么久……那么这对他精神上的影响很可能是灾难性的。这个"墙里的人"，这些幻觉，都是 Tenno 所经历过的虚空暴露效应。我希望 Palladino 能帮 Rell 找回安宁，以免让这种事再发生一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: These disturbances, they are Transference energy, split apart from a single mind. If we could capture them, send them back…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 这些干扰信号，实际上是传识能量，它们是从某个人的心灵中被剥离出来的。如果我们捕获它，就把它送回去……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.text: Operator - Simaris may have a tool for this task. I wonder if his Kinetic Siphons could be repurposed to- bust… capture these manifestations?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DO.zhText: 指挥官——Simaris 或许有合适的工具。我在想，他的动能吸收陷阱是不是能改造一下， 用来——炸飞……捕获这些幽灵？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.text: Receiving an all-call on our Syndicate frequency. It's a Red Veil encode but… it seems truncated. I will play back what I have...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.zhText: 集团频道收到一段全域广播。是血色面纱的编码，不过……好像不太完整。现在播放收到的部分……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.text:
[2.0]
...
[5.0]
Rap. Tap. Tap.
[15.0]
Speak to us. We're listening. What is your name?
[22.0]
Mmm. R-r-r-ellllll.
[32.0]
Good, you remember. We want to help you, Rell. Tell us where you are.
[40.0]
Mmm. Can't. He's listening.
[45.0]
Who? Rell, who is listening?
[50.0]
Rap. Tap. Tap. Rap. Tap. Tap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.zhText:
[2.0]
……
[5.0]
哒，哒，哒。
[15.0]
告诉我们吧。我们在听。你叫什么名字？
[22.0]
嗯……。R-r-r-ellllll。
[32.0]
很好，你还记得。我们想帮你，Rell。告诉我们，你在哪。
[40.0]
嗯……。不行。他正在听。
[45.0]
谁？Rell，是谁正在听？
[50.0]
哒，哒，哒。哒，哒，哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.text: Sorry Operator. The message appears haunted - halted. It originated from a Steel Meridian ship near Earth. Will you investigate? I hope not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DP.zhText: 抱歉，指挥官。消息显示闹鬼了——中断了。它的发源地是地球附近的一艘钢铁防线飞船。要去调查吗？最好不要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Emergency power. Not detecting any crew. I don't like this. Search the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 飞船已切换到应急电源。未探测到船员。这里不对劲，搜搜看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Blades. Too refined for a Grineer Kill Squad. Is there anything else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 刀刃伤。手法太干净了，不像克隆尼刺杀小队的作风。还有别的线索吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Red Veil. Could they have done this? The Veil have been Meridian allies for years. Search for survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 血色面纱。会是他们干的吗？他们与钢铁防线结盟多年。去找幸存者吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Tenno? I lost you for a second. What did you see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: Tenno？刚才信号断了一下。有什么发现吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Holy child of Zariman, please help me. I serve the Veil but the flock has been driven mad. I humbly beg for the protection of you and your vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 神圣的扎里曼之子啊，请帮助我。我侍奉血色面纱，但我的兄弟姐妹已经发疯了。我谦卑的请求你带着你的躯壳来保护我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: I'm marking the area. Stay alert. It may be an ambush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 我把地点标出来了。保持警惕，那儿可能有埋伏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Great, blind, Queen… help me reach the safety of Iron Wake. Our sacred muse has abandoned the temple, leaving our people in chaos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 伟大的，盲眼，女王……请帮助抵达「钢铁守望」的安全区。我们的生灵遗弃了圣堂，使我们的子民陷入混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Tenno, if the Red Veil is in chaos we must intervene. Get Palladino to Iron Wake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: Tenno，如果血色面纱陷入内乱，那我们必须介入。把帕拉迪诺送回「钢铁守望」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Oh holy child, I am grateful for- What is it Rook? Are they back?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 啊，神圣之子，我无比感激你——怎么了卢克？他们回来了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: You were supposed to protect her. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 你本该保护好她的。这次的任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Brothers of blood, sisters of fire, resist the muse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 血色的兄弟们，净火的姐妹们，抵抗住生灵的诱惑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.text: Blessed star child, I owe you my life. Will you meet me at Iron Wake? Only you can right this wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DR.zhText: 神圣的星辰之子，你救了我的性命。你能否来「钢铁守望」见我？只有你才能纠正这个错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: I don't know if you can make Rell whole again, but whatever you're doing, this disturbance is growing stronger, resisting you. Don't let it stop you. Bring Rell home, to the temple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 我不知道你是否能让 Rell 找回自我，不过你的行动让这股干扰能量变得越来越强，它正在抵抗你。不要被它阻挡。带 Rell  回家，回到圣堂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: Is that where Rell is? Has the Veil preserved him in cryosleep as the other Tenno were on Lua?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 这就是 Rell 的真面目吗？血色面纱将他冷冻休眠，就像其他 Tenno 被保护在月球那样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: No. We didn't have that option.
He's listening but I'm so… Help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 他正在听，可是我……帮帮我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: Rell… it's just you, alone and trapped in a Transference loop. Don't give into these delusions of Void exposure. There is no man in the wall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: Rell……那里只有你一个人，你被困在传识能量的循环里。不要向幻觉屈服，那只是人暴露于虚空之后的反应。墙里没有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: They are here - the Transference pieces. Track down these manifestations and capture them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 它们来了……传识能量的碎片。去追踪这些幽灵，然后捕获它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: Why are you helping me? You hated me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 你为什么帮我？你以前是讨厌我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.text: Alright, no more to be found here. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DS.zhText: 好了，这里已经没有幽灵了。去撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: How could Rell have lived this long? Without the long dream?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: Rell 怎么可能存活这么久呢？他明明没有沉睡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: He didn't. He knew his mortality would undo his purpose, so he gave up his humanity, forever. He committed his soul to the undying vessel-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: 他并没有活那么久。他明白他有限的生命不足以完成他的目的，所以他放弃了人性，永远地放弃了。他将自己的灵魂注入了这不死的躯壳之中——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: Yes. He commanded we chain it within the depths of the sacred temple. An eternal vigil against the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: 是的。他命令我们用枷锁把它封印在圣堂的最深处。他将在那里永远警戒那漠然的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: And you believed him. You helped him do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: 而你们相信他的话。并帮他做了这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: Yes. After everything you've seen, wouldn't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: 是的。你已经亲眼看到了这么多，难道你不相信吗？
在那里，Tenno 战士！捉住它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.text: Blessed Tenno, Rell has returned to his sacred vessel. I will join him there at once. Please, come, for I fear… I haven't got the strength to do what must be done next…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DT.zhText: 神圣的 Tenno 啊，Rell 已经回到他的躯壳中。我会立刻返回他身边。请你也过来，因为我害怕……我怕我无法完成接下来的使命……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Our temple. Our home. His tomb. Come. Meet our guiding light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 我们的圣堂。我们的家。他的坟墓。来吧，来见我们的启明之光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: This is why you're here, Tenno. It is time for holy Rell to rest. But I cannot bring myself to do it… to let him go. He's kept us, all of us, safe for so long and it's time for you to carry on. Release him, Tenno. Destroy the chains that bind the Harrowing vessel. He's earned his rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 这就是你此行的目的，Tenno。是时候了，让圣人 Rell 安息吧。但我没办法动手……我不忍心。这么长时间以来，他一直保护着我们所有人的安全，而现在该轮到你接过他的重担。让他解脱吧，Tenno。这些锁链束缚着他的躯壳。摧毁锁链吧，他应该休息了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: You may enter here, but only as your true, sacred form.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 你可以进入这个地方，但必须是以你真正的、神圣的形体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Holy Rell. You have sacrificed enough. Pass on your burden and rest. Tenno. Destroy the chains… only your sacred power will damage them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 圣人 Rell 啊，你的牺牲已经够多了。卸下你的重担，安息吧。Tenno，摧毁那些锁链……只有你的神圣能量才能破坏它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Tenno- something's wrong. That's not Rell, that's--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: Tenno——有点不对劲。那不是 Rell，那是——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Let's have a little quiet. It's my turn to ask the questions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 让我们稍微安静一下。现在轮到我来问问题了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Well, love, I told you. You can't pet her that hard, be gentle or she'll bite. Are you okay, Rell?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 亲爱的，我告诉过你。不能那么用力摸她。要温柔，不然她会咬你的。你还好吗，Rell？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: I won't let you take me… from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 我不会让你把我……从我这里带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: What have you done to Rell?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 你对 Rell 做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Tenno! You need to save him from this… Destroy the chains-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: Tenno！你必须用你的力量拯救他……快摧毁那些锁链——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: How dare you laugh at him! You should be ashamed of yourselves! Don't look away. Look at him. He's not invisible!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 你们怎么敢笑他！你们应该感到害臊！别看别的地方，看着他，他又没隐形！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Rap. Tap. Tap. You'll let me in, little piggy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 哒、哒、哒。你会让我进去的，小猪猪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Momma's… not… herself, Rell. I don't think… I think you should wait with the other kids, until they fix the ship. I love you but… you have to go! Go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 妈妈……已经……不正常了，Rell。你不该……你该去和别的孩子一起等着，等他们把飞船修好。我爱你，但是你得走了！快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: But the in-kids don't care about the invisible outs. If you were alone in that drift… you'd need a friend… even like me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 可是留下的孩子不在乎外面的隐形人。如果你独自一人在那里漂流……你也会需要一个朋友……就算是我这样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: By sacred shadow and righteous blood - Blessed Rell! Your aged Vessel is dust and your chains are broken. Be free!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 神圣的暗影，正义的化身啊——圣人 Rell！你陈旧的躯壳已经破碎，你的枷锁已经消失。重获自由吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Mmm. But the man in the wall. Who will… ?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 嗯……。可是，那个墙里的人，以后谁来……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: They will have to. All of them. They owe you this. We all do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 只能交给他们了。他们所有人。这是他们欠你的。我们都欠你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Mmm. Yea. I feel…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 嗯……。好。我感觉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Go on Rell, which one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 继续，Rell，哪一个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: This one, Momma. I feel… tired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 这个，妈妈。我感觉……疲倦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Good Rell! You're learning! Well? Why don't you have a little rest, then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: Rell 好孩子！你进步了！好了，那你就稍微休息一下怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: Okay… Okay Momma.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: 好的……好的，妈妈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.text: With Rell at peace, we will rebuild in his honor. We will do what we have always done: take the outcasts, the ones that don't fit in, and prepare them. Thank you, to you and your great Queen for setting Rell to rest. Take this offering, it's the thing of greatest value I can give you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PriestQuest/DV.zhText: Rell 已经获得安息，我们将会以他的名义重建一切，我们会继续我们长久以来的使命：接纳徘徊者，那些与众不同的人，并为他们准备容身之所。真诚地感谢你和你那伟大的女王，帮助 Rell 获得安息。收下这份礼物吧，这是我能给你最有价值的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DF.text: 'Them'? Tenno?! Father! You're making a mistake! Come now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DF.zhText: 他们？Tenno 战士？！父亲！你搞错了！快到我这边来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: So. Nef's makin' a succession play. Sumper thinks he can prove he's a sprog of noble descent. No idea how; Parvos was assassinated before any of us were an itch. Biz?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 所以。奈富正在自导自演一出继承人闹剧。这个每天和污垢打交道的人还打算证明自己是贵族后代。我不知道他要怎么证明；毕竟我们出生前，帕尔沃斯就已经被杀了。盘总？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Granum. The original taxman. Killed when someone - a Board member most likely - sabotaged the Void drive of his personal transport. Nef wants gene-proof, but there's nothing left to scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 格拉努。最初的税务官。有人——多半是某位董事会成员——蓄意破坏了他私人座驾上的虚空引擎，谋杀了他。奈富想要得到残留基因证据，但是事发现场已经没样本供他扫描了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Our people are vanishing because of this. That's true. I know it. I don't care if Parvos Granum is dead, alive, or making change tap-dancing in a Grineer officer's mess. Sparky: you find what Nef's looking for... you'll find out what happened to our people. Get on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 因为这场闹剧，我们的人正在消失。没错。我很清楚这一点。我不在乎帕尔沃斯·格拉努是死是活，还是说他正在某个 Grineer 军官的宴会上跳舞，都不关我事。小火花：去查清楚奈富在找什么……你就会发现我们的人到底遭遇了什么。快去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Look familiar, Outworlder? Warframe, yes, but one-of-a-kind. Protea. Legend says she was built specifically for and assigned to one Parvos Granum. Yes. Part of a deal Granum cut with the Orokin themselves. Granum… was no amateur. He had real power. Our ear inside says Nef's techs have found a lead on Protea's whereabouts. 'Protean traces' they're calling them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 眼熟吗，异世者？没错，这是战甲，但她是独一无二的，名为 Protea。传说，她是为帕尔沃斯·格拉努专门打造的，并且只效命于他。没错。这是格拉努和奥罗金之间协议的一部分。格拉努……可不是门外汉。他非常强大。根据我们线人提供的消息，奈富的技术找到了关于 Protea 下落的线索。他们叫它"Protea 的踪迹"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: And yet, so they believe, they found Granum's Warframe bodyguard - who was with Granum when that Void drive went critical. So who is to say what's true?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 可正因如此，他们才坚信自己找到了格拉努的战甲保镖——当那台虚空引擎爆炸的时候，她就在格拉努身边。可谁又直到孰真孰假呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Got dirt that isn't safe to shovel out in the open. You know where to meet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我刚搞到了一些见不得光的玩意儿。来老地方找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Sparky! Yes. Biz and I may be in over our heads on this one...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 小火花！没错。我和盘总在这件事上有点不知所措。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Listen up: this Deadlock spat is costing Solaris lives. The Corpus founder, some long-dead cove named Parvos Granum, carries a lot of messianic clout. Well… Nef's claiming the old man's got an heir. If true, that heir can, by rights, claim total control of the Board. Board schisms and infighting might be the main reason SU's survived this long. If the Board unifies under one person… one 'found' by Nef…? Our people will never see daylight. I need you on this. You in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 听好了：这次僵局争端正在让索拉里斯人丧命。早已去世的帕尔沃斯·格拉努是 Corpus 的创始人，直至今日，他还给世界带来了巨大的影响。嗯……奈富声称帕尔沃斯有一个继承人。如果这是真的，这个继承人有权控制整个董事会。而正是因为董事会的分裂和内部斗争，索拉里斯联盟才存活至今。如果董事会统一听命于一人……一个被奈富"找到"的人……？我们的族人将永远不见天日。这件事我需要你帮忙。你愿意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Like all of you, I was born poor, with but a meager derivatives portfolio and limited vesting options. I never knew my parents. But - as an orphan, poor as I said - I found great riches within the Tenets of our glorious Founder! Parvos Granum. The Corpus became my family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 和你们所有人一样，我出身贫寒，手上的衍生品投资组合少得可怜，归属选择也十分有限。我从来没见过我的父母。但是——作为一个贫困的孤儿——我遵从我们伟大创始人的原则，获得了大量财富。我说的就是帕尔沃斯·格拉努。Corpus 成了我的家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: It's Nef alright. Patching through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这是奈富发来的信息。正在接通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: They've fuzzed the band. Keep at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 他们扰乱了这个频段。坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: She had been a surrogate in a very special, very secret succession program! It was an epiphany! It would seem that I am one of the sons of our late, great Founder! And… more importantly… his heir. Now, I have only to prove it. That is where all of you come in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 她曾参与了一个非常特殊、极为秘密的继承人计划，她是代孕母亲！我恍然大悟！这样看来，我就是那位伟大创始人的儿子之一！并且……更重要的是……他的继承人！现在，我只需要证明这一点。这就是需要你们所有人帮忙的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: The brass on this mucker! I have to protect my people from this trust-fund lunatic. Do your thing. I'll check in with my whisper network, let you know what they're saying. Talk soon. The brass!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这个无赖！脸皮可真厚！我得保护我的人不受这个疯子的伤害。该你行动了。我会通过密语网络进行调查，告诉你他们的通讯内容。晚点再谈吧。脸皮真厚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: But over the years, as my wealth blossomed, and my humility grew vast… I began to see a certain similarity. I wondered… who am I, really? After a protracted negotiation, my birth mother sold to me the secrets of my conception! She had been a…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 但这些年来，随着我的财富不断增长，我也越来越谦逊……我开始发现了某种相似之处。我很想知道……我到底是谁？经过长时间的讨价还价，我的生母把我的身世秘密卖给了我！她曾是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Wait! What? Get that signal back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 等等！什么？把那个信号抢回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Sparky, you better get out of there... while we make sense of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 小火花，你最好先离开那……我们会搞清楚这事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: To the Corpus Board and my many, many, supporters across the Origin System: Everyone is asking: when will I, Nef Anyo, end this unprofitable, squabbling Deadlock? People are saying "Nef Anyo's perfect for the big seat. A visionary, an exemplar, a protege of the great Founder himself, Parvos Granum!" Friends, our time is at hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 致 Corpus 董事会和整个始源星系内的众多支持者：每个人都在问：我，奈富·安尤，何时会结束这场毫无成果、争吵不休的僵局协议？人们都在说："奈富·安尤是董事会领导的不二人选。他是个拥有远见卓识的榜样人物，也是伟大创始人帕尔沃斯·格拉努的门徒！"朋友们，我的时代就在眼前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: How many kids are going to grow up in the vents because of this? How many parents lost, because I couldn't do my job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 有多少孩子会因此在通风管中长大？又会有多少父母失踪，就只是因我无法履行我的工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: If Nef intends to visit that 'pocket' for his proof, he won't risk himself… not at first. Sparky, you can beat him to it. Biz has figured out how to activate Nef's Granum Tributes. You won't believe this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 如果奈富想要前往那个"位面空间"寻找证据，他不会以身犯险……至少在刚开始不会。小火花，你可以抢先一步。盘总已经弄清了如何激活奈富的格拉努祭品。你会大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Nef as the Corpus figurehead, with a united board behind him, will be hell for us and workers everywhere. See if you can get across first. Tax whatever proof he's hoping to collect, muck up his plan and find our people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 奈富如果成为了 Corpus 的领袖，就会有团结的董事会为他撑腰，对于我们和各地的工人，世界将变成地狱。就看你是不是能抢先了。拿走他想得到的证据，搅黄他的计划，找到我们的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Eudi. There's a ventkid, a very long time ago, who would have hero-worshipped the woman she became. You're enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: Eudi。在很久很久以前，有个在管道里生活的孩子，如果她知道自己将来会变成怎样的人，她一定会崇拜自己的。我相信你能行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: These tributes… are essentially… coin. operated. You'll need a 'Granum Crown'... you'll have to search the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 看来这些祭品……实际上是……由硬币所操控的。你会需要一个"格拉努硬币"……在飞船上搜一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Another engineering blunder! We need confirmation. Reset and get our next volunteer into position!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 又出现了一个工程错误！我们需要确认一下。重新设定，然后让我们的下一位志愿者就位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: It's… a… right. It's a great, big… hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这是……一只……是一只非常巨大的……手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: --What was that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: ——那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Granum Tribute. Story is Parvos was missing his left hand. See if you can--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 格拉努的祭品。据说，帕尔沃斯失去了自己的左手。看看你能不能——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I think it was a Void-temporal shift. I'm not entirely sure, I've never seen one before. Small, though. About as big as a… person? Patch me into the system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我觉得那曾是一个虚空时间的翘曲点。我也不确定，毕竟我从来没见过这东西。虽然有点小。差不多有……一个人的大小？把我接入系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Ready now. Protean trace spiking. It's time! Send in the next volunteer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 准备好了。Protea 的踪迹正在激增。是时候了！送入下一位志愿者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: They're gearing up for something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 他们正在准备什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: You and your bleeding heart Tenno thugs. I really don't have time for this. My Robotics, on the other hand, do. Kill-crews, take care of this, I have history to make!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 你和你那老好人 Tenno 战士。我真的没这闲工夫。然而，我的机器人还是有空的，杀戮小队，解决他们，我要去创造历史了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Nef Anyo. You are found. Remember the first days of Fortuna. Your failure. Our victory. Without the Solaris your… 'aspirations'…  are nothing. Return our Solaris brothers and sisters. Or to nothing, so I swear, you will return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 奈富·安尤。找到你了。还记得在福尔图娜建立之初的那些日子。你失败了。而我们胜利了。要是没有索拉里斯，你们的"雄心壮志"……简直不值一提。再次警告你，把我们索拉里斯的兄弟姐妹们还回来。否则，我发誓，你将重新变得不值一提。我可不是在和你开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: By Profit, by Void! It's real! It's real!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 以利益之名，以虚空之名！是真的！这是真的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: What kind of signal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 是什么样的信号？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I don't know yet. Outworlder, don't let them cut the signal before I can decode it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我还不清楚。异世者，在我破译之前，别让他们把信号切断！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: No! Biz, what is that thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 不！盘总，那到底是什么东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I'm not… Outworlder, hold position, I'm getting something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这是……异世者，请保持原位，我发现了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: He'll pay for this. "Volunteers". He's killing our people for some kind of... weapons test.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 他会为此付出代价的。"志愿者"。为了什么武器测试，他正在杀害我们的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Maybe not. I'm still pulling signal from that jockey's rig!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 可能看走眼了。我还在那个劳工那里提取信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: We'll be waiting for you, Outworlder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我们一直等着你的，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: What is this? What are we looking at?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这是什么东西？眼前的东西是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: The jockey's feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 那个劳工的信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Could do with some noise while I'm eyeballing the bits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 在我检查这些数据的时候，你去制造点混乱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Protean detectors should be onboard. Not sure what they'll look like. See what you can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: Protea 的探测装置应该就在飞船上。样子我也不清楚，你找找看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Crews. The tomb is verified intact! Dispatch the treasurer with my offering. It's time I paid Tribute myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 船员们。我们已确认，这个陵墓是完好无损的！把我的祭品献给司库。是时候由我亲自来献上祭品了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: If you make it across, keep an eye out for our people. They may have survived. I've told more than enough kids their parents aren't coming home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 如果你到了对面，请留意我们的人。他们可能还活着。我不想再对哪个孩子说他的父母回不来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Alright, here's our chance. Time to tax the taxman!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 好吧，我们的机会来了。是时候收税务官的税了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: If only Parvos could have lived to see this day! Imagine his face, beaming with pride, as he bestowed upon me, his son, that sacred Golden Hand! My surgeons have... assured me the procedure will be quick and painless? A pound of old flesh for a glorious new legacy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 要是帕尔沃斯能活着看到今天该多好！想象一下当他赐予我，他的儿子，神圣的黄金之手时，脸上的表情会是多么自豪！我的医生已经向我保证……这个过程会很快，而且感觉不到疼痛。用一磅老肉就能换来崭新的伟大遗产！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I'd pay top credits to crap in Nef's coffin. Double if he was still alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我愿意出最高价在奈富的棺材里拉屎。如果没死透，就双倍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: They must not reach him before we do! Is that understood?!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 绝不能让他们抢在我们前面！明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: 'Him'? As if the body would still be intact? Something's off. Get to the Tribute… expect some friction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 他？难道遗体仍然是完好无损的？有点不对劲。去祭品那里……可能会遇到敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Vox. Solaris. - our 'interests'... have come to align. Now… This 'situation' is no one's 'fault' and I'm not one to point fingers, but my fleet and your workers are facing the same danger… Convince your Tenno servant to reenter Granum's domain, and dis-able that Protea Specter. I have just the thing they'll need but there is some assembly required. You want to rescue those comrades trapped in there and I want to keep the past where it belongs. Dead and buried. Deal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 索拉里斯之声——我们的"利益"……已经趋于一致。现在……这样的"状况"不是某一方的"过失"，我也不会去怪罪他人，但是我的舰队和你们的工人都面临着同样的危险……说服你们的 Tenno 仆从再次进入格拉努的领域，并消除 Protea 魅影 。我恰好有他们需要用到的东西，但还需要一些装配工作。你们想营救那些被困在那里的伙伴，而我想让过去了的就留在那里。被尘封埋葬。成交吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Nef's a bloviating narcissist with the morals of a haunted chainsaw but at least that makes him predictable. Parvos? That mucker is something else. I don't trust Nef, but if any of our own are still alive in there… we have to try. Biz will lead the build on this… 'Xoris' gizmo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 奈富是个喜欢夸夸其谈的自恋狂，毫无良心可言。不过，这也使得我们可以预测他的行动。至于帕尔沃斯？那个混蛋完全是另一码事。我不相信 奈富，但如果那里还有我们的幸存者……我们就必须去试一试。在盘总的指导下，我们要制作出这个……名为"驱魔之刃"的玩意儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: To cross over you'll need to find a Granum Crown first. Search the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 想穿过那里，得先找到一枚"格拉努硬币"。搜索这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: One scan of Parvos Granum and my lineage shall be proven! None shall deny me-- what? Tenno? Again!? Not today! As Parvos' heir, it is my offering to make! I am coming, Father! It is I who shall pay Tribute! Your Nef is almost home!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 只要扫描一下帕尔沃斯·格拉努，就能证实我的血统！再也没有人能否认——什么？Tenno 战士？又来了！？今天不行！作为帕尔沃斯的后代，只有我才能献上祭品！我来了，父亲！将要献上祭品的人是我！你的奈富马上就要到家了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: We've got a lock on you, Outworlder. Good luck!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我们对你很有信心，异世者。好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: The Tributes won't activate with combat nearby. You'll need to take out those troops before going in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 贡品将不会在附近有战斗时激活。你需要在进入前先消灭那些敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Yes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 是！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Father. Permit me to show you all I have built in your name. Do Nef Anyo that honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 父亲！请允许我向您展示一下我以您的名义所创建的一切。请让奈富·安尤有这样的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: 'Invited'? Wait. If Nef is here because he allowed it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: "被邀请过来"？等等。如果奈富在这里是因为他的允许……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Rot took root in the Corpus. My first work was done. With my 'murder' those unworthy of my legacy revealed their true natures, true tastes. Today... the Corpus are the very antithesis of my creed. But I see those rare few who remain true, despite a world of distortion and temptation. They are the harvest of my first crop. The strongest, the most true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 腐朽已在 Corpus 扎根。我最初的成就，早已完结。自从我被"谋杀"之后，那些不配继承我遗产的人，显露出了他们真正的欲望与本性。现如今……Corpus 完全背离了我的信条。但我也发现，仍有极少数人能在这物欲横流的乱世之中保持真心。他们是我第一批作物所结下的果实。最强韧，也最真实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: The rest… chaff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 而其余的……都是糟粕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: You thought to stop me, Tenno? This is my ordained fate. It is… by the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: Tenno，你以为可以阻止我？这是我注定了的命运。是由……虚空注定的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Outworlder, Nef has eyes in here. How escapes me. Our channel's masked. He doesn't know we're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 异世者，我不知道奈富是如何瞒过了我，但他确实在这里布有眼线。我们通话的频道已被加密。他不知道我们在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: It has been so long since these old eyes beheld another living thing, here, in this sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 在这个圣殿里，我的这双老眼已经太久没见到过其他生命了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I… am Parvos Granum. Thank you for finding me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我……就是帕尔沃斯·格拉努。谢谢你找到了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Not good enough, am I? Inadequate, am I? You've been 'watching' me, have you? Well. Watch as I show you how we do things these days! Crews! Repel those Specters! We have bigger fish to fry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我还不够好，对不对？我还不够格，对不对？您一直在"注视着"我，对不对？那好吧，我会让你看看我们时至今日是如何做事的！船员们！击退那些魅影！我们还有更重要的事儿要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Errant Specters in Section 8! Crews?! Crews… respond!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 游荡魅影在 8 区！舰员们？！舰员们……回答我？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: By the void. You. are. Alive. My faith never wavered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 以虚空之名。你。还。活。着。我的信念从未动摇过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I live. Treachery seethed within the heart of the faith I had built. When the Board's assassins overloaded my transport's Void drive, Protea… my beautiful Protea… and her gift for manipulating time... preserved me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我活着。而背叛却在我信念的深处沸腾。当董事会的杀手让我座驾的虚空引擎过载，Protea……我那美丽的 Protea……和她操控时间的能力……保护了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: But at the cost of all that she was. Now she is nothing more than a Specter of her former self. My beautiful Protea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 但她为此付出了一切。她现在不过只是一个残存的魅影。我美丽的 Protea 啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: That is why you have been invited here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这就是为我邀请你们来到这里的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: 'My name'. Hmm... I have watched you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: "以我的名义"。嗯……我观察过你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Monuments to narcissism. Demanding others sweat in your stead. Gorging upon that which you have not earned. Watched… as you claimed for yourself my teachings of self-reliance, perverting them into a flaccid philosophy of sloth. Of… Idleness. Is that you, my son?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 典型的自恋狂。总是要求别人代替你卖命。贪婪地攫取着本不属于自己的东西。我看着你……当你把我关于自力更生的教诲据为己有，把它们歪曲成软弱、懒惰……懈怠的价值观。你就是这样的人吗，我的儿子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: No, that must be a different son.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 那肯定是您其他儿子所做作为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Biz has a handle on the time jump but we've got bigger problems than Nef now. Get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 盘总能应付时空穿越，但现在是比奈富更棘手的问题。离开那儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: No! Father! FATHERRR!!! Daddy? W-what? Breaches! BREACHES! The Protean field array is… oh no. All crews to Tributes! We are… we are being... in-va-ded!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 不！父亲！父——亲！！！爸爸？什——什么？遭到破坏！我们正遭受破坏！Protea 阵列正在……啊不好。全体船员撤去贡品那！我们……我们被……入——侵——了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: We've got a lock on you, Outworlder. Good luck… What the hell? Outworlder, I'm pulling sensory feeds from a trip you haven't taken yet. And hearing myself say things I've never said in a place I've never seen. Parvos…? Eudi you should see this. What if Nef has similar logs?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我们对你很有信心，异世者。祝你好运……这，这怎么回事？异世者，我正在从你尚未踏上的旅途中提取感官信息。还听到自己在一个从没见过的地方说着从没说过的话。是帕尔沃斯……？Eudi，你该看看这个。要是奈富也有类似的日志该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: You know nothing, falling short as you do of every ideal that I value. Your words, your efforts, are the model of inadequacy. I called you, Nef Anyo. But I do not need you. I need…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 你简直一无所知，我所珍视的每一条理念，你都达不到。你的言语，你的行为，都代表了你的无能。虽然我召唤了你，奈富·安尤，但我不需要你。我需要的是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: ... them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 是他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Protea has scanned her kin… and with that, she is reinvigorated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: Protea 已经扫描到了她的同类……因此，她恢复了活力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Now, my lovely, if you wouldn't mind? Show our guests the door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 现在，亲爱的，能帮我个忙吗？请把我们的客人送走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Outworlder, you'll need the Xoris Glaive for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 异世者，你将会需要「驱魔之刃」来应对这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Thanks for the fast work, Biz. Sparky, listen up: Biz's findings indicate Parvos might be close to translating himself from that reality into our own. We're not exactly sure how but we're getting some odd readings. You've got to build the Xoris before Parvos gets free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 谢谢你，盘总。效率真高。小火花，听好了：根据盘总的调查，帕尔沃斯可能很快就能让自己穿越到我们的世界。我们不太确定他怎么做到，但也接收到了一些奇怪的数据。你必须在帕尔沃斯获得自由之前造出驱魔之刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Have you assembled the 'Xoris' device yet? The sooner we get back there the sooner we can get our people out of there... and throw away the muckin' key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 你组装好那个"驱魔之刃"了吗？如果我们能尽早返回那里，就能尽早将我们的人救出来……然后丢掉那把该死的钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: A weapon? Glaive-class but with an energy trap… Specter Particles maybe? Has a mid-flight detonation trigger. Tricky, but I'm sure you'll get the hang of it. Gear up and let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 一把武器？它可以释放能量陷阱……或许是魅影粒子？有一个可在飞行过程中触发的起爆装置。有点复杂，但你能掌握它的。穿戴好装备就出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Nef's given us a cipher for an old Granum file. "Phantasmic Scintilla and Motive Forces." We'll need more specifics to build whatever this tool is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 奈富已经给了我们密码，可以破解一份古老的格拉努档案。"幻影闪烁与动机之力"。我们还需要更多的详细内容才能打造这件工具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Parvos Granum originated Specter Particle Theory? Guts. This old coot is a whole other order of intelligence, and that's bad for us.  Get back to your ship. I need to figure out this Xoris thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努发明了"魅影粒子"理论？该死。这个老狐狸有着完全不同的脑回路，这对我们非常不利。现在回到飞船上去。我需要搞清楚这个叫"驱魔之刃"的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: The palace birds think they control us. They hit our research site with a Warframe assault team. Of course they did. I baited them to do it. The whole site lit up. Eighty mega-therm bloom. The whole lab, vaporized, those Warframes with it. Fire. Fusion. Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 那些笼中之鸟认为能控制我们。他们派了战甲突击队袭击我们的科研基地。他们当然会这么做，因为是我诱导的。基地被引燃。八十兆撒姆的热量瞬间爆发。整个实验室，包括里面的战甲，化为乌有。火焰。核聚变。虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Hmm, looks like a partial find. Let's see if Anyo's cipher works as promised.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 嗯，看来这只是一部分。让我们看看安尤的密码到底有没有效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Some doors ought to remain closed? That's not in my world view. Fire, Fusion, Void. Progress always comes entangled with risk, with violence. With the precious sample obtained, development is accelerating. The Entrati have kept their secrets long enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 有些门永远不应该被打开。这不合我的世界观。火焰，核聚变，虚空。进步总是伴随着风险和暴力。在获得珍贵样本后，发展的速度就会加快。英择谛保守秘密的时间已经够长了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I am calling it the Specter Particle. As my Archimedeans explain, mimicry is in its nature. An echo. Exposed to precept circuits, we are able to imprint behaviors! Like an infant mirroring her surrogate. Only this infant can set the world on fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我称它为"魅影粒子"。正如我的哲士所言，它的本质就是模仿。就像回声。如果把它置于指令回路中，我们就能复刻各种行为！就像模仿代孕妈妈的婴儿一样。只不过这个婴儿能让世界燃起战火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Reactor vents sealing. Warning. Catastrophic overload imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 正关闭反应堆通风管道。警告：即将出现灾难性过载。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: This was not the deal, Anyo. We have yet to rescue our people. Disengage the destruct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我们当初可不是这么约定的，安尤。我们目前还没有把我们的人救出来。你必须立即停止你的破坏行为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: ---Wait! It's a time prison, right? Sparky, if you can get back inside before the reactor tilts… you'd theoretically have all the time in the world…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: ——等等！这是个时间监牢，对吧？小火花，你如果能在反应堆倾斜之前回到里面去……理论上说，你就会拥有无尽的时间……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Eudi: the fleet's going to blow.  Outworlder, abort--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: Eudi，舰队即将爆炸。异世者，马上停止——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Our people are calling in, Sparky, they're coming home. Tonight all Fortuna will be singin' a verse in your honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我们的人发来信息，小火花，他们快要到家了。今夜，整个福尔图娜都将高声歌颂你的功绩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Solaris. We are reunited. Parents to children, family to family. Take this time to hold one another, for tomorrow our struggle continues. We will persevere. Know that our emancipation is writ in the stars with Solaris, and Tenno, united.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 索拉里斯。现在我们团聚了。孩子等回了父母，家人也迎回了家人。珍惜来之不易的当下，值此时刻相互拥抱吧，明天斗争仍将继续。我们一定会坚持到底。因为索拉里斯会和 Tenno 战士团结一致，在群星之间写下自由的篇章。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Outworlder? Eudi, they're alive! Listen: Nef's whole fleet is overloading. Huge energy spike! We need to take out Protea! Ready that Xoris!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 异世者？Eudi，他们还活着！听着，奈富的整个舰队马上就要过载了。到时候会出现巨大的能量峰值！我们需要干掉 Protea！准备好驱魔之刃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Full charge! Now - target the enclosure trapping our jockeys. You'll need to trigger your Xoris to discharge near them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 充能完毕！现在，解决围困我们劳工的能量屏障。你需要在它们附近启动驱魔之刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: There! Our rig jockeys! They're trapped in some kind of energy enclosure. You'll need to charge the Xoris to break it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 在那儿！我们的劳工！他们被困在了某种能量屏障里。你需要给驱魔之刃充能，才能把它打破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Risk comes from not knowing what you are doing. There's no stopping this without stopping Protea. A bit like eating your own, no?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 风险源于无知。不阻止 Protea，就没法结束这一切。有点像同类相食，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I can't do that. But don't worry. I'm already at a very comfortable safe distance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 那个，我做不到。但是不用担心。我已经拉开了一段距离，现在很安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Here they come! Take out the Errants, then use the Xoris to trap the Specter Particles that escape! You'll have to time it just right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 他们来了！干掉那些游荡魅影，然后用驱魔之刃捕捉那些魅影粒子，别让它们跑了！你必须得把握好时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Well done, Outworlder! Now bring the rest home!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 干得漂亮，异世者！现在把他们带回家！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: By now your friends have noticed that the overloading Void engines are preventing the exits you opened for my captives... from closing. Well done. And goodbye. Enjoy your stay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 现在你的朋友们已经注意到了，过载的虚空引擎能保护你为那些俘虏打开的逃生通通……防止它们被关闭。干得漂亮。再见了。祝你能在这儿玩得开心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: There's got to be an opening! Maybe while she's reversing the temporal field?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 她肯定是有空档的！可能是在她逆转时空力场的时候？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: She's reversing the temporal field! Try to interrupt it! A fully charged burst from the Xoris might do it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 她正在逆转时空力场！快去打断她！驱魔之刃的蓄能重击应该能起到作用！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: That's it! The cycle's degrading!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 好样的！这个时空循环正在瓦解！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: That… cunning… old… Outworlder! You've got to get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 这个……狡猾的……老东西……异世者！现在马上离开那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I am your beginning. I am your end. Entwined. Forever.
