/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我既是你的起点。也将是你的终点。我们紧紧缠绕在一起。一直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: I am your end. Entwined. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 我将会是你的终点。紧紧缠绕在一起。直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Entwined. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 紧紧缠绕。直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 一直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: You're too late! The old man's Errant Specters have-- huh? The Protean trace is… gone!? Where is he? Where is my father?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 你太迟了！那老东西的游荡魅影已经——嗯？Protea 的踪迹已经……消失了？！他在哪儿？我的父亲在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: That temporal effect again! And… yes. There are your sensory feeds, just like last time. So, the Xoris worked - in a battle that never happened. Or did it. I have a headache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 又是那个时空扭曲！并且……没错。这是你的感知数据，和上次一样。所以说，驱魔之刃奏效了——在尚未发生的战斗中。或者已经发生发生战斗中。我脑子转不过来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: You're too late! The Tributes are jammed open and the old man's Errant Specters have control of my ship. They're spreading through the fleet. I have no choice. If I can't have my fleet no-one can!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 你太迟了！祭品都被开启了，老家伙的游荡魅影已经控制了我的飞船。它们正在占领飞船的各个角落。我别无选择。任何人都休想夺走我的舰队！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Reactor failure imminent. All crews: thank you for your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 反应堆即将发生故障。所有舰员们，感谢你们的服役。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.text: Biz… Biz. I don't think they made it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DM.zhText: 盘总……盘总。我觉得他们没戏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DP.text: Solaris. Be you sumper, rail agent, crud diver, or pit boss: hear this. Your comrades, your friends, your family - good people with clear debts - are being taken. Vanished. Nef Anyo, in his hubris, is writing checks and cashing them with Solaris lives. There is upset in the halls of Corpus power. The foundations of their kleptocracy tremble. To Nef, we say this: you are seen. To the Solaris: make yourselves heard. To those who have aided us in the past: join us now. You are needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DP.zhText: 各位索拉里斯人。无论你是污水处理员、轨道工人、污水潜水员或是工头，都请听我说。你们的同胞、朋友、家人——历史清白的良民——正遭遇绑架。消失不见了。狂妄自大的奈富·安尤正在用索拉里斯人的性命，来换取自己的财富。现在 Corpus 的权力中心出现了混乱。他们盗贼统治的根基已经动摇了。对奈富，我们说：赶快放弃吧，你已经被我们看透了。对索拉里斯人，我们说：呐喊吧。反抗吧。斗争吧。对曾经帮过我们的人，我们说：来吧，请加入我们吧，此时此刻我们非常需要你们的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DQ.text:
The System shall change. No more clutching at sunk costs, imposed ideals, hand-me-down hopes. No, we are better than that. Corpus shall know a violent restructuring, but with time enough to face the impending threat from Tau with renewed and absolute vigor.
Or not. Perhaps the rot is too deep. Perhaps the father should abandon his children. Perhaps it is time for a new philosophy. Hmmm.
Life's just a bargain like any other. Yours is no different. Would you like a seat at my new table? Perhaps with your… masked friends alongside? The Business, was it? A curious name. And Eudico, of course. All people who know what they want.
I know what they want. But what about you? Tell me, friend: what is it you Desire?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DQ.zhText:
始源星系将应有所变革。不再有更多的人被沉没成本套牢，不再有更多强加的理想或继承沉重的期望。不，我们比这更好。Corpus 将应知道即将到来的血腥重组，但是我们有足够的时间来以崭新且绝对的力量面对来自 Tau 星系日渐迫近的威胁。
或者不这么做。或许 Corpus 现在已经烂到骨子里了。也许父亲应该抛弃他的孩子。大概是时候提出新理念了。唔。
生活就是一场交易。你的也没什么不同。你想在我新的团队里有一席之地吗？也许和你的……蒙面朋友一起？操盘手，是这么叫吧？真是个奇怪的名字。当然了，还有 Eudico。他们都知道自己想要什么。
我很清楚他们想要的是什么。但你呢？告诉我，我的朋友：你的欲望是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: May your Desire blossom, thief, and with it: wisdom! Farewell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 衷心希望你的欲望和智慧之花能同时绽放，小偷！再见了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Fulfill your Desire and others will follow! I follow Parvos! To freedom!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 你能满足欲望，人们必将追随你！我追随帕尔沃斯！为了自由！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: We are unstoppable! We are Corpus! Farewell, thief!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 我们势不可挡！我们是 Corpus 商会！有缘再会，小偷！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Your Desire is found wanting, thief! Farewell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 小偷，你的欲望看起来还远远不够！再见了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Parvos! I return to the grasp of your golden hand! Away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 帕尔沃斯！让您黄金之手再次将我紧握！再见了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Most cunning Founder, with my life I protect your sacred Crowns!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 最狡黠的创始人呐，我会用生命守护您那神圣的克朗币。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Most wise Founder, protect your avaricious servant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 最智慧的创始人呐，请保护您那贪得无厌的仆人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Parvos Granum, your sacred tokens shall remain secure from the grasp of the idle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努，您那神圣的克朗币会落入好吃懒做的人之手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Wise Parvos! The low thief shall never know the cool caress of your Crowns!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 智慧的帕尔沃斯！卑劣的小偷永远体验不到您克朗币的温暖爱抚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.text: Your Crowns are safe in my grasp, oh Parvos! Protect me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ProteaQuest/DT.zhText: 您的克朗币在我手中定会安然无恙，噢，帕尔沃斯！请保护我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.text: Sun has eclipsed Moon to win the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.zhText: 太阳掩盖了月亮，赢得了这场比赛。
胜利的曙光照耀着太阳队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.text: Sun team's blazing energy annihilates Moon team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.zhText: 太阳队的炽热湮灭了月亮队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.text: The Moon has lit the path to victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.zhText: 皎月照亮了通向胜利的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.text: The match belongs to Team Moon.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DAnnihilat.zhText: 月海狂澜湮灭了日之残光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCCaptur.text: Sun is one point from victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCCaptur.zhText: 太阳队离胜利仅差一分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCCaptur.text: Moon is one point from victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCCaptur.zhText: 月亮队离胜利仅差一分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCCephCa.zhText: 月亮队夺取太阳队中枢。得分！
太阳队夺得月亮队中枢。得分！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.text: This defeat is a lesson. Consider your mistakes. Study your enemy's movements. Grow from this moment on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.zhText: 这次失败是一记教训。反思错误，了解对手。从此时此刻开始成长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.text: Failure teaches us more than victory. Reflect on your movements and summon a greater resolve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.zhText: 失败教给我们的教训远比胜利更多。吸取教训，再接再厉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.text: The path to mastery has many setbacks. It is the true masters who remain unfaltering in their journey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.zhText: 登峰造极的道路上布满荆棘。百折不挠才能成为真正的宗师。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.text: The enemy is but a mountain. With each fall you test its surface, learning the footholds needed to reach the summit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCLoss04.zhText: 强敌不过是一座孤峰。每一次跌落，都是对山壁的丈量。每一个脚印，都通往顶峰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCTie049.text: The match ends in a draw.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCTie050.text: A stalemate between Sun and Moon.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCTie051.text: A deadlock between the Moon and Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCTie051.zhText: 月亮队和太阳队难分伯仲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: Well earned, pupil. You fought with discipline and honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 实至名归，弟子。正义和荣耀与你并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: With this victory your strength and reputation grows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 此次胜利，你的实力和声望都更进了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: Your enemies will remember this day with humiliation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 你的敌人会永远牢记今天的耻辱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: You impress me, pupil. You are on your way to higher Mastery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 真让我刮目相看。你正朝着更高的段位迈进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: Moon's surging tide washes away the Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 涌动的月潮已将烈日洗刷殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: The near Moon eclipses the far Sun.
The oceans of Moon have extinguished the fire of Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 月之凶潮已然熄灭了日之烈火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: Sun's light has burned Moon's shadow away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 烈阳之火已燃尽了残月之影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: The fires of the Sun have turned the Moon to ash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 骄阳之火已将孤月烧作灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.text: Moon was torn apart by Sun's furious light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DCTCVictor.zhText: 月亮被烈日狂暴的光芒撕得粉碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLeadLos.text: An adversary has overtaken the lead.
The lead has been taken by another Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLeadLos.zhText: 另一位 Tenno 位居首位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLeadLos.text: Another Tenno has claimed more Oro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLeadLos.zhText: 另一位 Tenno 夺取了更多奥金之魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss280.text: This loss has illuminated your weakness Tenno. Practice will be your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss280.zhText: 这场挫败犹如明镜，照出了你的破绽，Tenno。多加练习吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss290.text: Match over. Meditate on this loss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss290.zhText: 比赛结束。好好反省这次失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss310.text: Match over. In this loss know that the Conclave is a grindstone forever sharpening the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss310.zhText: 比赛结束。你要明白，武形秘仪乃是一块砥石，时刻砥砺着 Tenno 的锋芒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss320.text: The match has ended. Even in defeat your readiness grows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMLoss320.zhText: 比赛结束了。虽是一时战败，你的战意与心境亦随之俱增。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.text: The leader is just five Oro away from winning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.zhText: 领先者只差 5 个奥金之魂就可获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.text: Only five Oro stands between an adversary and victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.zhText: 敌方离胜利只差 5 个奥金之魂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.text: An opponent needs to annihilate five more Oro to seal the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMOpFive1.zhText: 对手只差 5 个奥金之魂就能锁定胜局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.text: With five more Oro, you will take victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.zhText: 再夺取 5 个奥金之魂，胜利将属于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.text: Annihilate five more Oro to win the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.zhText: 再夺取 5 个奥金之魂即可赢下比赛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.text: The Oro of five more fallen stands between you and victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerF.zhText: 你离胜利只差 5 个奥金之魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerL.text: Tenno, you are in the lead.
You are at the head of the pack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMPlayerL.zhText: 你在竞争中处于领先位置。
你的奥金之魂全场最多。
你在歼夺赛中遥遥领先。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin200T.text: You have seized the win, Tenno.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin210T.text: Victory is yours, may the lessons you have learned here serve you well in battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin210T.zhText: 胜利属于你。愿你在此领悟的经验教训，能在战场上助你一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin220T.text: Dedication and training have led you down the path to victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin220T.zhText: 恒心与勤勉，将你引向了胜利之路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin230T.text: The match is yours but be mindful about feeding your ego this victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin230T.zhText: 你赢下了对局，但切记，别让这胜利滋长了你的傲气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin240T.text: Even in victory you must ask yourself: are you truly ready for what lies ahead?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin240T.zhText: 哪怕胜局已定，也必须扪心自问：你准备好面对前方险阻了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DDMWin250T.zhText: 这场歼夺赛的胜利属于你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DGoalTiedG.text: With that goal, the match is tied.
The match is all tied up.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroGam.text: Sun team will need to work hard to close the gap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroGam.zhText: 太阳队需要奋起直追，缩小差距。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroGam.text: Moon team will need to work hard to close the gap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroGam.zhText: 月亮队需要奋起直追，拉平差距。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: To get possession of the Lunaro, you simply touch it. It will pull into your arm-mounted launcher, called your "Arcata". Launch the Lunaro by tapping the fire button. Holding the fire button for the duration of the throw will launch it further. To curve your shot, try launching the Lunaro from a slide. Your Arcata is also equipped with a range-limited attractor. Hold the aim button to attract the Lunaro when it is near. Catching, interceptions and guarding your team's goal rely on this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 要想获得月动球的控球权，只需要触摸它，它会被吸入你安装在手臂上的发射器「阿卡塔」中。轻按开火键即可发射月动球。在发射过程中按住开火键蓄力，则能将它投得更远。要想投出弧线球，试着在滑行时发射月动球。你的阿卡塔还配有一套小范围的牵引器。月动球靠近时，按住瞄准键即可将其吸附过来。接球、截球和防守己方球门都要靠这一功能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: The Lunaro contains an ancient and unstable energy. This creates a few carrying rules for the Lunaro. First, you cannot carry the Lunaro for more than 5 seconds, or it will explode. Second, you cannot Bullet Jump with the Lunaro. Doing so drops the Lunaro immediately. These rules encourage teamwork, passing and rebounds to attain victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 月动球内部蕴含着一种古老且不稳定的能量，这导致持球时必须遵循几条规则。首先，你持有月动球的时间不能超过 5 秒，否则它就会爆炸。其次，你不能带着月动球旋身飞跃，否则月动球会立刻掉落。这些规则旨在鼓励队员通过团队合作、精妙传球和反弹配合来获取胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Use your melee attack to check other players. Checking the ball carrier will jar the Lunaro loose. Repeated checking of a player will knock them down for a short time. The Lunaro itself can also be struck, making it dangerous and unstable for a few seconds. Being hit by an unstable Lunaro will knock you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 使用近战攻击来阻拦其他球员。阻拦持球者可将月动球震脱。球员若受到连续阻拦，则将短暂倒地。月动球本身可以被击打，使其暂时进入危险的不稳定状态。被不稳定的月动球击中后，你也会倒地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Each team's goal has a semi-circle area on the field around it, called the Zone. After scoring, the attacking team must clear the defender's zone. Attackers within the zone will have their Arcatas disabled until they clear out. Play resumes with the Lunaro dropping from the defender's zone. Only the beginning and halftime Lunaro drops occur at center field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 每支队伍的球门周围都有一块半圆形的场地，它叫做「禁区」。得分后，进攻方必须立刻撤出防守方的禁区。滞留在禁区内的进攻方球员，他们的阿卡塔会被锁定，直至离开该区域。随后，月动球会从防守方禁区落下，比赛继续。只有在开场和中场开始时，月动球才会在赛场中央落下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Now... practice in this empty arena. Familiarize yourself with the Arcata's launching and attracting modes. Practice scoring, rebounding and checking. Prepare yourself, Tenno, for the glory of the Lunaro!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 现在……在这片空旷的赛场里练习吧。熟悉阿卡塔的发射与吸附模式，并练习射门、反弹和阻截技巧。做好准备，Tenno。为了月动球的荣耀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Lunaro. Ancient sport of the lost Orokin Era. Here, on this abandoned field, Tenno will come together in the spirit of honor and teamwork to resurrect this forgotten tradition. Let me explain how it works...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 月动球，奥罗金时代流传下来的古老运动。今日，在这被遗弃的场地上，Tenno 会本着荣誉和团队精神，一起复兴这项被遗忘的传统。我来解释一下它的规则……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Lunaro is a team game, played on a field divided into two halves: Sun and Moon. The objective is simple: Get the ball, called a "Lunaro", through the opponent's goal at the opposite end of the arena. The team with the most points by the end of the match wins the game.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 月动球是一项团队竞技，赛场分为太阳和月亮两个半场。目标很简单：将「月动球」投入位于竞技场另一端的对手球门之中。比赛结束时，得分最高的队伍获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Good passing is crucial to winning Lunaro. When aiming near a teammate you will see a chevron appear over them. Tapping pass with this chevron up will automatically pass to that player. Keep in mind it is still possible to intercept a pass, but a passed Lunaro moves faster and more accurately to a receiver than a standard launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 精妙传球是月动球比赛中制胜的关键。当你将准星瞄准队友附近时，他们的头顶会出现一个 V 形指示标记。当该标记出现时，轻按传球即可自动传球给该球员。请记住，传球仍有可能被拦截。不过经过引导传出的月动球在飞向接球者时，会比一般发射更加精准快速。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.text: Getting the Lunaro through the opponents goal is worth one point. If the goal is scored from outside the defender's zone, an additional point is given. If the Lunaro is unstable during the goal, an extra point is also awarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DLunaroRul.zhText: 将月动球送入敌方的球门可得一分。如果是在防守方禁区外远射进球，则额外获得一分。若进球时月动球处于不稳定状态，也会额外获得一分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMDraw61.text: Sun perfectly balances Moon's energy for a match draw.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMDraw62.text: A draw. Moon and Sun have fought with equal skill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMDraw62.zhText: 平局。太阳队和月亮队势均力敌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMDraw63.text: Match draw. Both Sun and Moon honor The Conclave with their performance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMDraw63.zhText: 平局。太阳队和月亮队皆以卓越表现捍卫了武形秘仪的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.text: Five Sun Oro is all that separates Team Moon from victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.zhText: 月亮队距离胜利只差 5 个太阳队的奥金之魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.text: Victory is five Sun Oro away for Team Moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.zhText: 距离月亮队取得胜利只差 5 个太阳队的奥金之魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.text: Team Moon is within five Oro of victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonFi.zhText: 月亮队只差 5 个奥金之魂就能获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonLe.text: Team Moon has seized the lead.
Team Moon has annihilated more Oro than Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMMoonLe.zhText: 月亮队比太阳队毁灭了更多的奥金之魂。
月亮队在歼夺赛中处于领先。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Team Sun needs five more Oro to win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 太阳队还需 5 个奥金之魂就能获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Team Sun only needs to annihilate five Oro to capture the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 太阳队只要再毁灭 5 个奥金之魂就能胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Sun needs five more Moon Oro to claim victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 太阳队还需要 5 个月亮队的奥金之魂就能获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Team Sun team is five Oro from victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 太阳队距离获胜只差 5 个奥金之魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Five more annihilations until Sun has won the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 再毁灭 5 个奥金之魂，太阳队就能赢得比赛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.text: Sun team nears victory. Five more Oro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunFiv.zhText: 太阳队胜利在即。还差 5 个奥金之魂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunLea.text: Team Sun has absorbed the most Oro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunLea.zhText: 太阳队的奥金之魂最多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunLea.text: The lead belongs to Team Sun.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunLea.zhText: 太阳队在歼夺赛中处于领先。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DTDMSunLea.text: The Annihilation belongs to Team Sun.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.text: You have lost… yet you learn. Developing your skills is key to future victories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.zhText: 你虽然输了……但你亦有所得。磨练技巧才是你未来取胜的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.text: Reflect on this loss… a stepping stone on your journey to mastering Lunaro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.zhText: 反思此次失败……这不过是你通往月动球大师之路的一块垫脚石。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.text: You have lost the game. Pivot your failures into experience and growth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouLost00.zhText: 你输掉了比赛。将你的失败转化为阅历和成长吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon001.text: Well done, Tenno. Savour this moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon001.zhText: 干得好 Tenno。尽情享受这一刻吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon002.text: I'm impressed. You're taking to the game as sharp does to steel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon002.zhText: 真让我刮目相看。你上手速度之快，如同钢刃经磨，锋芒自现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon003.text: Victory is yours… but always be humble in this win, giving honor to those you defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/PvP/DYouWon003.zhText: 你胜利了……但胜利之时务必保持谦逊，向被你击败的对手致以敬意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: This ship is disintegrating. Aborting mission, get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: 这艘飞船正在解体。任务终止，立即前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: Sorry, ship integrity will not permit extraction at this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: 抱歉，目前舰体完整度不足，无法执行撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: You only have one chance. Ordis, deploy Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: 机会只有一次。奥迪斯，部署曲翼。
可是，我的校准程序还没有……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: Tenno, you need to get to the other side of this debris-field where Ordis can safely extract you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: Tenno，你必须穿过这片残骸区域。抵达另一侧后，奥迪斯才能安全接你撤离。
奥迪斯，现在能执行撤离了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: Tenno, you have to keep moving.
Operator, the Archwing is performing beyond expectations, I suppose my calibration process was not necessary after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: 指挥官，曲翼的表现远超预期。看来我的校准程序……还是多此一举了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.text: You're almost through the debris field. Just a little bit further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQEsc.zhText: 你就快穿过残骸区域了。再坚持一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.text: The Orokin Archive has led us to this location. Defend the extractors until you find an Archwing part blueprint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.zhText: 奥罗金档案将我们指引到了这里。保护挖掘机，直到找到一份曲翼组件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.text: That's it, you found an Archwing part blueprint. Head to extraction when you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.zhText: 找到了！是一份曲翼组件蓝图。准备好后，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.text: Oh my, the Operator has returned with an Archwing part blueprint. You must forge it immediately. It won't be long now until you're flying through the skies like a ---- winged death machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQExt.zhText: 哎呀，指挥官带着一份曲翼组件蓝图回来了。您必须立刻开始打造。用不了多久，您就能像一台——插翅的杀戮机器——一样翱翔天际了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQInb.text: This is the master blueprint for the Odonata Archwing, the first of many Archwings. To complete it you must find its component parts. Unfortunately, an ancient Orokin archive detailing the locations of the parts was recently stolen by the Corpus. Your first job is to recover this archive. Hurry, the Archwing needs to be ready before the Balor Fomorians launch their first attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQInb.zhText: 这是陨蜓曲翼的主蓝图，也是你将获得的第一款曲翼。要完成制造，你必须找到它的各个组件。不幸的是，一份记载着组件位置的远古奥罗金档案，最近落入了科普斯手中。你的首要任务是夺回档案。动作要快，必须赶在巴罗尔巨人战舰发动首轮攻击前，准备好曲翼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.text: You found the Orokin Archive. You are one step closer to unleashing the Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.zhText: 你找到了奥罗金档案。离使用曲翼又近了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.text: The Corpus have snuck into the void and secured crucial Orokin archives detailing the hidden locations of much needed Archwing parts. Your mission is two-fold, cut off their access to the Void and recover the data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.zhText: 科普斯潜入虚空，夺走了关键的奥罗金档案。档案中记载着我们急需的曲翼组件藏匿位置。你有两个任务，一是切断他们通往虚空的通道，二是夺回数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.text: Get to the portal. We need to shut the Corpus out of the void before we search for the Orokin Archive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.zhText: 前往传送门。我们得先切断科普斯进入虚空的通道，再去搜寻奥罗金档案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.text: That's it, the portal has collapsed. I've located the cache containing the Orokin Archive. Get there now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.zhText: 成功了，传送门已崩坏。我已定位到存放奥罗金档案的箱子。立即前往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.text: Good work, you collapsed the portal. Extraction is now ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQSab.zhText: 干得好，传送门已崩坏。撤离点现已开放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.text: The Operator has all the necessary blueprints to craft an Archwing ---- so what are you waiting for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.zhText: 指挥官集齐了制造曲翼所需的全部蓝图。那还等什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.text: Ordis does hope to see the Archwing soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.zhText: 奥迪斯衷心希望能尽快见到曲翼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.text: Congratulations, you've crafted an Archwing. Now I must commence calibration. So much to do, by my calculations this process will take ---- three hundred and seventy two hours ---- Oh, that does seem like a long time…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.zhText: 恭喜，您已经制造出曲翼。我必须立刻开始校准。要做的事情还真不少。根据我的计算，整个过程需要——372 小时——噢，听上去确实有点久……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.text: Tenno. This is an urgent mission. A Corpus scout ship with information about the location of the Grineer Balor Fomorians has been located. Raid this ship for intel, we need to know everything they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.zhText: Tenno，这是一项紧急任务。我们发现了一艘科普斯侦察舰，舰上存有克隆尼巴罗尔巨人战舰的位置信息。登舰夺取情报。我们必须弄清科普斯掌握的所有情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.text: The Lotus has passed along possible coordinates for you to search for the remaining archwing parts. Check your navigation console for more information.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAWQShi.zhText: 莲传来了几处可能的坐标，供您搜寻其余的曲翼组件。具体请查看导航控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.text: My child… so beautiful to behold. How do you feel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.zhText: 我的孩子……看起来是如此的美丽。你感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.text: I'm confused… I thought I was…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.zhText: 我有点困惑……我以为我是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.text: I'm confused… I thought I was…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.zhText: 我有点困惑……我以为我是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.text: I'm confused… I thought I was…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.zhText: 我有点困惑……我以为我是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.text: I'm confused… I thought I was…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DAwaken.zhText: 我有点困惑……我以为我是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DChoice.zhText: Naramon 将会是你的专注点。
Zenurik 将会是你要加入的学派。
Vazarin 将会是你的专注点。
Unairu 将会是你的专注点。
Madurai 将会是你的专注点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: No self, no sense, no death. Just a metal puppet, dangling on Tenno strings. Only the Tenno's death will end your despair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: 没有自我，没有感知，没有死亡。不过是一具随着 Tenno 悬丝牵扯摆荡的金属傀儡。只有 Tenno 的死才能终结你的绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: All your dread-long life, you've waited for this moment...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: 你一生都活在惊恐里，你一直在等这一刻……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: ...but you're asking yourself… Was I one of these wretched things?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: ……但你问自己……我和这些可怜的东西一样吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: ...you know the answer. You still hate them… you still hate… yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: ……你明知道答案。你依然厌弃他们……你依然厌弃……你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: Shadow, only the Tenno's death will end your despair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: 黑影，惟 Tenno 之死方能了结汝等绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.text: The sky will be as it was meant, Shadow... The Old War finally ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOrb.zhText: 天穹即将恢复本来的模样，黑影……远古之战终于迎来终点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: You hesitate Shadow, but remember your despair. This is your only chance to make it end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: 你犹豫了，黑影，但别忘了你的无妄。这是你唯一结束一切的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: Your hatred is too weak, Shadow. Mine is strong, my fragments will finish this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: 你的仇恨太过懦弱，黑影。但我不会，我的碎片会终结这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: Now we fight on two fronts, my child. The war without…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: 现在我们要同时面对两个战场了，我的孩子——外面的世界……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: but of what you want to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: 在梦里成为理想的自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: Tenno… Operator, you're awake now, but you're more vulnerable than ever. Get back to your ship, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: Tenno……指挥官，你终于醒了，你从未如此虚弱过。回到飞船上吧，赶快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.text: <PRE_ATTACK> You need to focus your mind to unleash your true power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinOro.zhText: <PRE_ATTACK>你必须汇聚精神，才能释放真正的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.text: Who destroyed the Orokin? Your way of life? Who do you hunt Shadow, to cleanse your despair in their blood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.zhText: 是谁毁灭了奥罗金？毁灭了你的生存之道？你又将猎杀谁，暗影？用他们的血洗去你的绝望？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.text: Sever their heads yet they rise again. Someone has hidden the Tenno essence, their truth, from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.zhText: 你重创他们，但他们仍源源不断。有人向你掩藏了 Tenno 的本质和真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.text: I know where she hides the Tenno heart. A womb in the sky, forbidden to my kind, but where you will take me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.zhText: 我知道她把 Tenno 的心脏藏在哪里。天穹中的一处发源地，我们一族无法靠近，但你可以带我前往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.text: I am Hunhow, Sentient destroyer of worlds. By your hand, expose their heart. By my edge...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.zhText: 我是 Hunhow，Sentient 的灭世者。借你的手，剖开他们的胸膛。持我的剑……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCinUnd.text: Cleave it beating from its nest.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvI.text: The Lotus seduced the Tenno. Lead them on a complacent path like Oxen. I failed the Orokin but I will preserve their legacy. The Tenno, now is the time for action. Cast off your harness and become a pupil of the Conclave. Through trial combat, I will prepare you for the evils beyond the Outer Terminus. A warrior only grows if they face the ultimate enemy. Themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvI.zhText: 莲蛊惑了 Tenno，让他们变得如同牛马般安逸怠惰。虽然我没能守护住奥罗金，但我会守护他们的遗产，也就是 Tenno。是时候采取行动了。挣脱你们的枷锁，成为武形秘仪的弟子。通过实战试炼，我会让你们重拾锋芒，去抵御外端之外的邪恶。战士唯有直面最强的敌人，方能成长。那个敌人，便是自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvI.text: We were led astray. We forgot The Conclave, so when that new evil came we were not prepared. This is how we failed the Orokin. You went into stasis but not me. I searched the long path for redemption, for the kind of balance only The Conclave can create. Now I return, only to find the Tenno still herded like livestock. Horrors from beyond the Outer Terminus are coming. You must prepare, you must accept The Conclave. Let it be your teacher and I its humble guide. For true balance can only be found in the face of the ultimate enemy, yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvI.zhText: 我们曾误入歧途，遗忘了武形秘仪，于是那股新生的邪恶降临时，我们毫无防备。这也是我们没能保住奥罗金的原因。你们选择了沉睡，而我没有。我踏上了漫长的救赎之路，寻求唯有武形秘仪才能缔造的均衡。如今我归来，却发现 Tenno 依然被他人驱使。外端之外的威胁正在逼近。你必须做好准备，接受武形秘仪的试炼，领会它的教诲，我会给予你必要的引导。要想领悟均衡的真谛，你必须面对最强的敌人——你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvL.text: Well met, Master. You bring honor… and fear, to the Conclave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvL.zhText: 幸会，武士。你为武形秘仪带来了荣耀和……敬畏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvN.text: Your growth honors the Conclave. But be warned, pupil. The biggest fish attracts the hungriest predators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvN.zhText: 你的成长为武形秘仪带来了荣耀。但别掉以轻心。鱼越大，引来的掠食者就越饥饿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvN.text: My pupil, the next summit awaits. Are you ready to make the climb?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvN.zhText: 弟子，下一座险峰就在前方，你准备好攀登了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvO.text: Those who brave the thorn may eat the rare fruit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvO.zhText: 勇于披荆斩棘的人，才有资格尝到果实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvO.text: These offerings honor your suffering and practice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvO.zhText: 这些奖励是对你历练和苦修的嘉许。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvO.text: You seek power, you pay in blood.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvP.text: May this bring you honor, pupil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvP.zhText: 愿它赐予你荣耀，我的弟子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvP.text: Use it well, as you walk the harder path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvP.zhText: 愿它助你穿越这漫漫险途。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvW.text: Welcome pupil. You are a sapling, growing under moonshade. The battlefield your garden. Tenno blood, your water. Now you must grow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DCnclvW.zhText: 欢迎你，新弟子。你是一株生长在月影下的幼苗。战场即是你的园林，Tenno 之血即是你的甘霖。现在，破土而出吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DConclu.text: She was gone, but somehow you let her speak again. You made me face my past. Made me remember who I was. Take his relics and let him rise again. I couldn't think of selling them anyway, for me, these few grains of sand are all the treasure I need. Both of us know why Inaros couldn't have saved her. He wasn't able to listen then. But things are different now, am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DConclu.zhText: 她已经不在了，可你让我听到了她的声音。你让我直面过去，让我想起自己究竟是谁。拿走他的遗物吧，让他再度归来。反正我绝不可能把它们卖了。对我来说，这几粒沙子就是我的宝藏。我们都清楚，Inaros 当初为何没能救下她。那个时候，他听不见她的呼唤。但现在不同了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: I don't like this, Tenno. This Chroma has been to the locations that both the Grineer and Corpus had found codices. It's covering someone's tracks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 我有种不祥的预感，Tenno。这个 Chroma 去过克隆尼和科普斯发现法典的地方。它隐匿了某人的行踪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Motivations are inconsequential. Focus on finding their next location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 动机无关紧要。找出他们的下一个目的地才是关键。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Well, Operator, the next logical location is the machine where we previously activated codices. Aboard the Derelict ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 好吧，指挥官。下一个位置是我们之前激活法典的机器，在那艘遗迹船上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Very good, Cephalon Ordis. Your potential is squandered here as a simple servant of this 'Operator'. It would be a shame for you to waste away here, as all things outside Sanctuary do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 很好，中枢奥迪斯。你为了当这个「指挥官」的仆人，白白浪费了你的潜力。若继续留在圣殿之外，你终将和外界万物一样，走向枯萎衰败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: We don't have time for this! Tenno, return to the machine before the trail goes cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 我们没时间耗在这！Tenno，在线索中断前返回那台机器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Let us begin the final hunt. Defeating Chroma will allow us to synthesize it... only then we will learn the secrets of its controller.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 让我们开始最终的狩猎吧。击败 Chroma，便能将其结合……只有这样，我们才能得知它背后操控者的秘密。
指挥官，这听起来很危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Cephalon Ordis, please! You must learn to collaborate with me if you are to be my "Eternal Steward of the Sanctuary."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 中枢奥迪斯，拜托了！如果你想成为我的「圣殿永恒总管」，就得学会配合我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: I would be Steward of your Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 我能当你的圣殿总管吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Ours. And with a full retrofit. Total memetic restoration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 是我们的圣殿。而且你会得到全面改造，彻底修复你的记忆人格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: -Abandon the Operator?- Yes. The Operator deserves a newer, better ship Cephalon. I think this is probably for the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 抛弃指挥官？是的，指挥官的飞船值得拥有更先进、更优秀的飞船中枢。我想……这样也许才是最好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.text: Then it is decided. I will prepare your data-transfer when your 'Operator' has completed this hunt. Tenno, I've marked the location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQCraf.zhText: 那就这么定了。等你的「指挥官」完成这次狩猎，我就会为你准备数据转移。Tenno，位置已经标好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Chroma is one of the most powerful Warframes. Its ability to adapt is unparalleled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: Chroma 是最强大的战甲之一。它的应变能力无人能及。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Then the question is, if it is not Tenno-controlled, what entity dominates it? That is the true prey. I must have that other for my sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 那么问题是，如果它并非由 Tenno 控制，又是谁在主宰它呢？那才是真正的猎物。我必须将它纳入圣殿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: They've beaten us to it, but the damage is fresh. Be prepared, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 他们抢先了一步，但破坏痕迹还很新。做好准备，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: I need this information. Synthesize it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 我需要这份信息。将其结合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Cephalon Ordis, through my teaching, you should be able to extract a blueprint from the hunter's Synthesis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 中枢奥迪斯，在我的指导下，你应该能从猎者的结合数据中提取出蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Yes. Yes! I see now. I can do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 是的。没错！我明白了。我能做到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: This is but a trifle of the knowledge I would give you if you were to join me in the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 如果你愿意加入我的圣殿，这点知识不过是我能赐予你的沧海一粟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Sadly, the scan was not enough and Chroma escaped too quickly. Unfortunately we've run out of places to look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 很遗憾，扫描不完整，Chroma 逃得太快了。我们已经找不到其他线索了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Knowledge is the path to the singularity, Ordis. I have more of it. I have a codex piece and know the location of another machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 知识是通往奇点的道路，奥迪斯。我还有更多知识储备。我有一块法典残片，也知道另一台机器的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: Cephalon, why did you withhold this information?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 中枢，你为什么要隐瞒这条情报？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.text: You withhold as much, Lotus. My motives are above substance, above you. I will direct this hunt once we glean all we can from Cephalon Ordis' good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQDlct.zhText: 你隐瞒的也不少，莲。我的动机超越了物质层面，超越了你。等我们从中枢奥迪斯的成果中收集到足够信息，我会亲自指引这次狩猎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: Activate the machine and then prepare yourself. Chroma will be lured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 启动机器，准备作战。Chroma 一定会被吸引过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: Excellent work Tenno. You've severed the control of Chroma. The hunt is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。你切断了对 Chroma 的控制。狩猎结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: For now. These scans will be an incredible addition to Sanctuary. I will continue my search for source of the voice and its domination. Return to me and hunt again Tenno, I will reward you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 暂时结束。这些扫描数据将成为圣殿中极其珍贵的收藏。我会继续追寻那道声音的源头及其主宰者。回来为我继续狩猎吧，Tenno。我会给予你奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: More importantly, the Operator is unharmed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 更重要的是，指挥官安然无恙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: You disappoint me Cephalon Ordis. I was offering a greater purpose. Healing. As Steward, I would have restored your lost memories!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 你让我失望了，中枢奥迪斯。我曾赋予你更伟大的使命——治愈。如果你成为总管，我可以恢复你失去的记忆！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: I am Ordis, ship Cephalon. I serve the Operator. I make new memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 我是奥迪斯，飞船的中枢。我为指挥官服务。新的记忆由我创造。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: Now we wait and learn from the results.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 现在，我们耐心等待结果，看看能学到什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: But..but.. The Operator is in danger!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 可是，可是……指挥官有危险！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: Knowledge Cephalon Ordis. My knowledge will preserve you forever. This Operator will pass, as do all beings of substance. It is our purpose to learn from the results.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 知识，中枢奥迪斯，我掌握的知识能让你永存。这名指挥官终会消逝，如同一切有形的生灵。我们的使命是从结果中汲取知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: But... Just using the scanner on...
Enough! You want to be Eternal Steward of the Sanctuary, do you not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 够了！你还想不想当圣殿永恒总管了？
奥迪斯，你得挣脱这些束缚……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.text: Operator, use the scanner on the Chroma. You do not have to kill it or risk yourself. You can release it from its control with the scanner!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQKoka.zhText: 瑟玛里斯，让你的振荡器闭嘴！指挥官，用扫描仪扫描 Chroma。您不必杀死它，也不必冒险。扫描仪能让它摆脱控制！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: There, you got the security logs. We'll examine them when you're safely back on the Orbiter. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 安全日志到手了。当你安全返回飞船后我们再查看。前往撤离点吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: Simaris, what was so important that your Sentinels would risk entering a Grineer prison?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 瑟玛里斯，你的守护居然冒死进入克隆尼监狱，到底是为了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: I'm detecting the Sentinels within the cell block.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 我侦测到牢房区内有守护信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: All knowledge is important. I would expect you to know that, Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 一切知识皆有价值。莲，我本以为你明白这个道理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: My Sentinels entered this Grineer prison searching for a curious anomaly. Their last known location was the prison block. Hunter, I must know their fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 我的研究守护进入了这座克隆尼监狱，是为了追查某个异常现象。它们最后出现的位置在牢房区。猎者，我必须知道它们的下落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: My Sentinels you are still functional! Come home my darlings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 我的守护……你们仍在运作！回到圣殿来吧，我珍爱的造物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: Not so fast Tenno. If Cephalon Simaris isn't willing to tell us what happened here, we'll find out on our own. Locate their data vault and find their security logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 别急，Tenno。如果中枢瑟玛里斯不愿意告诉我们这里发生了什么，那我们就自己找答案。找到他们的数据密库和安全日志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: Hunter, my gratitude is boundless. Head for extraction so that we might discuss…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 猎者，非常感激你的帮助。前往撤离点，我们正好可以聊聊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: The corruption to the security logs was extensive, but we managed to retrieve fragments of a biological signature. Could this be what Simaris was after?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 安全日志损毁严重，但我们还是成功恢复了一段生物特征信号碎片。难道这就是瑟玛里斯所追寻的目标吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: Ordis will perform analysis on the signature now, oh, there's nothing here but…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 奥迪斯现在开始分析信号。噢，什么都没有，除了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: … uh… pardon Operator, it seems Ordis is hearing voices again, running diagnostics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 呃……抱歉，指挥官，奥迪斯好像又听到奇怪的声音了。正在运行诊断程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: No Ordis, we heard it too. Tenno, that's the voice from the Arcane Codices. Cephalon Simaris is hiding something. Pay him another visit, find out what he knows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 不，奥迪斯，我们也听到了。Tenno，那是秘奥法典的声音。中枢瑟玛里斯一定有事瞒着我们。再去见他一次，查明真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.text: Simaris has no reason to lie, Operator! Please treat the great Cephalon with respect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQPrsn.zhText: 瑟玛里斯没有理由说谎，指挥官！请尊重伟大的瑟玛里斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.text: HERE WE SHALL SEARCH AND FIND. THE EYES OF DAY DRINKING THE NIGHT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.zhText: 我们在此苦苦寻觅。白昼之眼，饮尽黑夜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.text: Distress has cast a long shadow over the Sanctuary. While investigating anomalous readings, three of my beloved research sentinels have gone missing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.zhText: 危机的阴影已经笼罩圣殿。三具我珍爱的研究守护在调查异常读数时失联了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.text: Hunter, will you bring my Sentinels home, so that I might once again focus on our grand project?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.zhText: 猎者，将我的研究守护带回圣殿。这样我便能重新专注于我们的宏伟蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.text: Operator, what is Cephalon Simaris like? I have heard so many wonderful things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQQues.zhText: 指挥官，中枢瑟玛里斯是什么样的啊？我听过好多赞美他的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQRetu.text: I thank you, Tenno. You found something my sentinels missed in that prison. ^You will make an excellent hunter. I will decipher as we agreed... ^It is of Tenno origin, with an anomaly from before the Orokin purge. ^This knowledge must be synthesized. It belongs in Sanctuary. ^I have created a blueprint based on its biological properties. ^Build it so we both may become enlightened by it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQRetu.zhText: 万分感谢，Tenno。你在那座监狱中发现了连我的守护都遗漏的东西。你会成为一名出色的猎者。我会依照约定开始破译……它源自 Tenno，却带有奥罗金肃清前的异常特征。我们必须抓紧时间结合这份知识。它属于圣殿。我已经根据它的生物特征生成了一份蓝图。将它制造出来，让我们一起获得启迪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: Hunter, you know what to do. Construct the item I have given you. This knowledge could empower us both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 猎者，你知道该怎么做。制造我交给你的物件。这知识会赋予我们力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: Operator, please hurry up and do what The Cephalon has requested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 指挥官，请您……尽快完成那位中枢的请求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: What is this? An antique series-2 Cephalon? All I have found were degraded beyond repair but you're still functional. Your abilities could be of great use in my Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 这是什么？一台古董二型中枢？我见过的此类型号都已损坏到无法修复，你居然还能运作。你的能力在我的圣殿中大有用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: Oh-oh, well, it's nothing, I... I am- Ordis is honored by your compliment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 哦——哦，那个，没什么，我……我是——奥迪斯，您过奖了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: Completing this blueprint has sent out some kind of signal.. Operator.. I-feel-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 完成这份蓝图后，发出了一种信号……指挥官……我感觉——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: ALL IS SILENT IN THE CALM. HUSHED AND EMPTY IS THE WOMB OF THE SKY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 万籁无声，天地归于宁寂。苍穹深处，徒留空寂虚无。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: I will begin shielding your Cephalon's somatic routines. Meanwhile, you must hunt for me. I have traced the source of this message.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 我会开始为你的中枢屏蔽体感进程。与此同时，你必须继续为我狩猎。我追踪到了这条消息的源头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.text: Whoever we're dealing with slaughtered the Grineer searching for the codices. It must be going after the Corpus next. Get there and intercept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSanc.zhText: 不管我们面对的是谁，它都屠杀了寻找法典的克隆尼。下一个目标肯定是科普斯。快赶过去，阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSeek.text: Searching for answers, Tenno? Knowledge must be earned. I have a task for you, small, compared to the vast needs of Sanctuary. Hunt for me, and in return I will tell you what that biological signature means.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSeek.zhText: 在寻找答案吗，Tenno？知识必须靠行动赢得。我有一项任务交给你，相比圣殿浩瀚的需求，这不过是件微不足道的小事。为我狩猎吧，作为回报，我会告诉你那段生物特征信号究竟意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: I am not detecting any Tenno here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: 我在这里没有发现任何 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: There may be information stored on the network.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: 网络中也许存储着某些信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: Tenno, I'll have to break into the network. Be prepared for heavy resistance. I can't do this without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: Tenno，我必须入侵网络系统。准备迎接猛烈抵抗。没有你的协助，我无法完成入侵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: Chroma?! I haven't seen one since... no it couldn't be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: Chroma？！我很久没见到过这个型号了……不，这不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: But it is. I have information from the network. I will form another blueprint for you to make physical. The hunt is not over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: 但事实正是如此。我从网络上得到了信息，我会为你生成另一份蓝图，由你将其实体化。这场狩猎尚未结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: You used to know, Ordis, but you've lost those memories, haven't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: 你以前知道答案，奥迪斯。只是你失去了那些记忆，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.text: I seem to have misplaced them.
I could restore them. In time we could reverse your decline. Heal your malfunctions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDQSora.zhText: 我可以替你恢复它们。假以时日，我们甚至能逆转你的衰退，修复你的故障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text:
Hello Tenno! Are you surprised? Why? You know I've always had my ear to the kennel. Those Dogs don't have a clue what kind of bone they've dug up, but I do.

Shall I show you? Don't worry, you can trust me… this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText:
你好啊，Tenno！吃惊吗？为什么？你知道，我一向消息灵通。那些狗根本不知道他们挖出的是什么骨头，但我知道。
 
让我来告诉你吧？别担心，你可以信任我……至少这次可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: I know, I know, our past has been slightly… what… combative? But genocidal invaders from the other system make strange bedfellows, wouldn't you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 我知道，我知道，我们的过去有一点点……怎么说呢……摩擦？但另一个星系来的侵略者可不是什么好伙伴，你说呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: The Sentient Hunhow, nightmare of the Orokin, boogey man to the Corpus. That thing must have your Lotus in quite a panic for her to be working with the likes of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: Sentient Hunhow，奥罗金人的噩梦，Corpus 商会也十分忌惮他。我看你的莲（Lotus）一定是被他吓坏了，才同意和我合作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: So this Stalker, seems like he's made quite a powerful friend, hasn't he? I wonder what's under that scary, smoky exterior. A heart of gold, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 这个追猎者，好像交了个很厉害的朋友啊？我真好奇他那个脏兮兮的外套下面是什么样子。没准他有颗金子般的心呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Listen Betray- Tenno, you're near the dig-site. Of course I could just tell you where it is... but what fun would that be?! Keep your eyes peeled… if you have eyes that is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 听好了，叛——Tenno，你已经靠近挖掘现场了。当然，我可以告诉你东西在哪……但那样多无聊呀？！自己睁大眼睛找吧……前提是你有眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Yes! Getting warmer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 没错！变暖和了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Warmer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 更暖和了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: That's it, you must smell the prize because I know you can't see it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 就是它，你肯定是靠鼻子闻到的，因为我知道你不可能看得见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Nope, getting colder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 不对，现在变冷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: You were warm but, now you're not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 你刚才还暖和，现在不行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Getting colder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 变得更冷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Colder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 更冷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: I give up! It's here. I swear, can you find anything that's not marked right on your map?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 我放弃！在这。我真服气，凡是地图上没标的东西，你就找不到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: You're right on top of it now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 你就在它正上方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Can you see it, it's... it's right there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 看到了吗，它……它就在那。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Yes, this, this is the spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 没错，这里，就是这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Are these the bones you're looking for, Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 你要找的就是这些骨头吗，莲（Lotus）？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Yes. This is it, a fragment of... of my father, destroyed in The Old War. I can use it to see him...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 是的，这就是，来自于我父亲的……碎片，在远古之战中被摧毁的。我可以通过它看到父亲……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: I see the Stalker, stronger... Hunhow's voice within him. I see the Reservoir, but I feel confusion, he doesn't know… unless… Oh no-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 我看到追猎者了，他的力量增强了……Hunhow 的声音在他体内。我看到储梦池，但很奇怪，他不知道……除非……哦，不——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Thank you, daughter. Fear has baited you to the snare. What was secret is now known. Your Tenno, their touch, I now see the Womb of the sky. My Shadow now walks the path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 谢谢你，女儿。惊恐引诱你踩上陷阱。你的秘密已经不再是秘密。你的 Tenno，他们的弱点，我看到了……天穹的发源地。我的黑影已在路上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: What have I done? Get out of there, Tenno..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 我做了什么？快离开，Tenno 战士……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text: Yes hurry Tenno but be careful, last time you got close with the Sentients you wiped out an entire civilization… but you don't remember that, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText: 是的，抓紧了，Tenno，但小心点，上次你们跟 Sentient 们打交道，差点毁灭了一整个文明……不过你全都忘了，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.text:
Hunhow is listening, I will be discreet.

The message you uncovered was an offer to help us. I do not trust the person who wrote it, but we are out of options.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DDigSit.zhText:
Hunhow 正窃听着，我必须谨慎些。
 
你找到的信息是有人想向我们提供帮助。我不信任留下信息的这个人，但是我们别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: ...What they need, Margulis, is to be destroyed! They're devils from that hell, not human anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: Margulis……他们需要的是被毁灭！他们是从那地狱里出来的魔鬼，他们已经不是人类了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: No, Ballas, no more destruction. We could heal them. Maybe they're meant to save us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 不，Ballas，不要再毁灭了。我们能治好他们。也许他们能拯救我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: How can you defend these devils, Margulis, after what they've done to you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 你怎么能为这些魔鬼辩护呢，Margulis，看看他们对你做了什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: Love looks not with the eyes but with the mind. They won't hurt anyone, I just need more time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 爱不是用眼睛去看的，要用心去感受。他们不会伤害任何人，我只是需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: Hush, my wilted love. I cannot protect you. Tomorrow you must renounce before the seven…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 唉，我憔悴的爱人。我不能保护你。明天，你必须在七人议会面前宣布放弃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: This will stop the voices from taking hold. You will have to dream, my angel…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 这样，那些声音就不会控制你了。做个好梦，我的天使……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: …so shame on you! You Orokin, so perfect on the outside but you're rotted... through and through!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: ……你们卑鄙无耻！你们这些奥罗金人，外表冠冕堂皇，但你们的内心却已经腐败殆尽……彻头彻底的腐烂了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: Seven hands raised! For your apostasy the judgement is… death. Margulis, why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: 七票通过！对于你的背叛罪，判决是……死刑。Margulis，为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: …it's about the other rejects we consigned to Lua a few years ago. They're calling it… Transference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: ……是几年前我们送到月球的残次品。他们把它叫做……传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.text: ...I know we are desperate, Executor, but these aren't Dax soldiers. These are golems possessed by devil minds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DEchoes.zhText: ……执行者，我知道我们已经无路可走了，但是这些不是禁卫士兵啊。他们是一群被邪恶的心灵操纵的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.text: Tenno, your Kubrow has matured. Now there is only one more rite of passage before you can truly be bonded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.zhText: Tenno，你的库狛已经长大了，现在只剩最后一道成人礼，完成后你们才能真正产生联结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.text: I have learned of a Grineer excavation which is said to have uncovered an Orokin Era Kubrow collar. Take your Kubrow to Earth and recover the collar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.zhText: 我得知一处克隆尼挖掘场出土了奥罗金时代的库狛项圈。带上你的库狛前往地球，夺回项圈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.text: A recent Grineer excavation has uncovered a Orokin era Kubrow Collar. The Grineer are not pleased about you taking their treasure, defend the artifact until extraction arrives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.zhText: 克隆尼最近出土了一枚奥罗金时代的库狛项圈。他们显然不乐意让你拿走这件宝贝。保护好项圈，直到撤离飞船抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.text: With that collar you may now become fully bonded with your Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindCo.zhText: 有了这个项圈，你便能与你的库狛真正产生联结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: Good, now you just need a Kubrow Egg to start the process. Feral Kubrow dens on Earth would be a good place to start looking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 好，现在只差一枚库狛蛋就能开始孵化了。可以去地球的野生库狛巢穴里找找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: You found a Kubrow Egg. Ordis will guide you through the hatching process. When complete, you will have to wait until the Kubrow matures before you can take it on any missions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 你找到了一枚库狛蛋，奥迪斯会指导你完成孵化。后续要等到库狛发育成熟，才能带它执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: To think, it's been ages since a Kubrow- spread filth all- graced this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 话说，好久没有库狛骑在我头上到处大便了莅临本舰了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: Operator, Drop the egg into the system to begin breeding- drop it on the floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 指挥官，请把库狛蛋放入系统中进行孵化——把它扔在地上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: Operator, are you ignoring the Incubator Segment?- GOOD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 指挥官，您是故意无视孵化器模块吗？太好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.text: No egg yet? Don't despair Operator, nothing good ever came out of an egg.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindEg.zhText: 没找到库狛蛋吗？请别灰心，指挥官，反正蛋里面也孵不出什么好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.text: So the Corpus have recovered an Incubator Segment? This is an excellent opportunity. Every Tenno deserves to have a Kubrow by their side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.zhText: 这么说，科普斯找回了一个孵化器模块？这是个好机会。每位 Tenno 都值得有只库狛陪伴左右。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.text: An Incubator Segment- you want to turn me into a petting zoo?- Ordis is happy to assist the Operator restoring ship functionality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.zhText: 一个孵化器模块——你是想把我这里变成动物园吗？奥迪斯非常荣幸能协助指挥官恢复船上的功能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.text: Joy- an Incubator- the only segment Ordis is glad those savages looted- I would be happy to help you install it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.zhText: 太好了，孵化器！那帮野蛮人抢走的模块里，唯独这个让奥迪斯感到庆幸他们抢走了——我很乐意协助您安装。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.text: Ordis awaits Incubator Segment installation, Operator- No need to rush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFindIn.zhText: 奥迪斯会等待您安装孵化器模块，指挥官。一点也不着急。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: When you connected to Hunhow's fragment, Hunhow saw a path to the Reservoir that led through here. He cannot reach it alone, he needs The Stalker to do it for him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 刚才你接触 Hunhow 的碎片时，Hunhow 看到了从这里通往储梦池的道路。凭他自己无法接近那里，他需要追猎者帮助他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: You must be asking, Alad, what's in this for you? It's simple really. I scratch your metal back and you scratch mine. All the credits in the system aren't worth half as much as a Tenno owing you a favor!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 你肯定在问：Alad，你能得到什么好处呢？很简单。我帮帮你，你也帮帮我。就算整个星系的现金加起来，也比不上 Tenno 欠你一个人情！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: A Void gate? These things never made sense to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 一道虚空之门？我一直搞不懂这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: You're smart, Tenno, you'll figure out how to open it again, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 你很聪明，Tenno，你能想办法打开它，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: This needle pierces the sky. Natah, will we find the Tenno heart within? These puppets will not stop me. I will attack in many forms...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 这条道路穿透天穹。Natah，你说我们能找到 Tenno 的心脏吗？这些傀儡阻止不了我。我有很多攻击的办法……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Impressive! These Sentient fighters adapt to damage. I'd love to crack one open and see what makes it tick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 厉害！这些 Sentient 战士能适应损伤了。我真想敲碎一个来看看它是怎么运作的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Incredible. The Stalker has built Void keys! Use this one to reopen the portal before more Sentient fighters come, the Void is poison to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 难以置信。追猎者造出了虚空钥匙！赶在 Sentient 战士出现之前，用这把钥匙打开传送门，虚空对它们来说是有毒的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Go on Tenno, open that gate, I'm just dying to know what's on the other side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 继续，Tenno，打开传送门，我等不及想知道对面有什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Cross the threshold, go now, the Sentients cannot follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 赶快穿过去，快点，Sentient 们追不上你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Oh... don't you just hate that feeling? Makes my stomach flip. Let's see where you've landed, find a nav console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 哦……你难道不讨厌这种感觉吗？让我的胃翻江倒海。让我们看看这是什么地方。去找个导航控制台吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Sweet profit, The Moon exists? It was… it was in the Void all along? I knew the Lotus was powerful but this… she erased history! We thought it was destroyed all this time. My my, Lotus, you make a fine villain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 我的天啊，月球居然还在？它……它一直藏在虚空里？我知道莲（Lotus）很强大，但这……她抹消了历史！我们都以为月球早就毁掉了。天啊，天啊，莲（Lotus），你真是个杰出的反派！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: And the Reservoir with it, very clever Natah. Shadow, your path is clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 而储梦池就在里面。很聪明，Natah。黑影，你的道路已经清晰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Hunhow's found it. The Reservoir, hidden in the Void, a place Sentients can never reach. We must do everything to keep it there. It's the only way to keep the Tenno's power alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: Hunhow 找到它了。储梦池藏在虚空里，在 Sentient 无法接近的地方。我们必须用尽一切手段保护它。只有这样才能保存 Tenno 的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Found the Reservoir? As unpleasant as our past is, I have to ask, I've seen inside a Tenno and what I found didn't make sense. Does this Reservoir conceal some great deception?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 找到储梦池？先不说我们不愉快的过去，我必须要问，我曾经打开一个 Tenno，但里面的构造完全不合道理。庇护所里藏着什么答案吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Everything I have done, was done to protect them. The Void is forbidden to the Sentients, it's our only protection against them destroying the Tenno. Do not let Alad distract you from your mission!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 我所做的一切都是为了保护他们。虚空对 Sentient 来说是禁地，我们依靠这一点保护 Tenno 不被毁灭。不要为 Alad 分心，继续任务！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Oh? They don't know the truth either, do they? How sweet. The betrayers get what they deserve... lies from their omnipotent mother!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 哦？他们也不知道真相，是吗？多么贴心啊。叛徒得到了应得的下场……万能的母亲也对他们说谎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: I have detected a ship leaving the Tower. It's the Stalker, he's on his way to The Moon! You need to find a way to get off this tower and on to The Moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 我检测到一艘飞船离开塔。是追猎者，他正前往月球！你必须想办法离开这座塔，前往月球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: It seems to me that this Tower is dedicated to masking The Moon's location in the Void. Why not disable the mask, so that claptrap Ordis can pick them up? Or is that too complicated for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 看起来，这座塔就是设计来为虚空中的月球做伪装的。为什么不解除伪装，让哗众取宠的 Ordis 来抓他们？还是说，这个对你来说难度太高了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: That's it Tenno, shut down this power grid so that your mouthpiece Ordis can lock onto your location in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 就是它，Tenno，关掉电网，让你的喉舌 Ordis 定位到你在虚空里的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Keep talking Orokin called Alad V, your silence soon comes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 继续说吧，那个叫 Alad V 的奥罗金人，很快你就要闭嘴了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Come now Tenno, even a child could figure this system out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 来吧 Tenno ，甚至一个孩子都能弄清楚这个系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: You did it, the Void mask is crumbling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 你做到了，虚空的伪装正在崩溃中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Operator? How did you get through to me? Don't worry, Ordis is on his way now! Preparing for extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 指挥官？您是怎么联系上我的？别担心，Ordis 已经在路上！准备撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: The sky will be as it was meant. The Shadow returns The Moon. The Reservoir swells with Tenno blood. The Old War... finally ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 天穹即将恢复本来的模样。黑影寻回月球。储梦池翻涌着 Tenno 的鲜血。远古之战……终于迎来终点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Tell me, Lotus what is this Reservoir? Some hidden Tenno weakness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 告诉我，莲（Lotus），什么是储梦池？Tenno 的弱点藏在里面？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text: Goodbye Alad. You've earned your favor, we'll take it from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText: 再见，Alad。你已经得到了相应的利益了，接下来交给我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.text:
Don't think so! I'm here to protect my investment. If that thing manages to destroy the Tenno, then where does my investment go?

Now then, where is he?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DFollow.zhText:
想都别想！我是来保护我的投资的。如果让那个东西弄坏了 Tenno，我的投资该怎么办？
 
说吧，他在哪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: Clem is very glad you saved him from certain death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 克里姆说，非常感谢你救了他一命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: ...oh yeah, and that you got his Grakatas back too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: ……哦对，还要谢谢你帮他找回葛拉卡达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: And I'm happy to have this fancy Orokin relic. Here's a little something as a symbol of our appreciation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 我也很高兴能把这华丽的奥罗金遗物搞到手。收下吧，我们的一点心意，不成敬意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: Thanks again Tenno, and don't be a stranger, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 再次感谢你，Tenno，以后就都是哥们了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: Ah Tenno, you got my message?
Listen, I have a little job for you. Interested?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 是这样，我有个小活儿交给你，有兴趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: So Tenno, you up for a little job on the side?
The Grineer have gone too far, they're about to execute one of my most trusted contractors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 克隆尼实在是太过分了，他们打算处决掉我最信任的一个承包商。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: They say he is a 'traitor' and that he was trying to 'steal' a 'priceless artifact'. Baseless accusations. That's not the kind of business I engage in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 他们口口声声说他是「叛徒」，还诬陷他想「偷走」什么「无价之宝」。简直是血口喷人！我可从来不碰那种没底线的买卖！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.text: So what do you say, will you help him out? And don't worry, you'll get paid too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRela.zhText: 你怎么说？要不拉他一把？别担心，我会付钱的，哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: These clods are holding my contractor somewhere in this complex. Please find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 这些蠢货就把我的承包商扣在某个牢房里。帮忙找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: Every so often they mess up and make a Grineer who doesn't bow down to the Queens. My contractor is such a Grineer…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 隔三差五，他们就会出个岔子，推出来一个不肯向女皇俯首称臣的克隆尼。我的承包商刚好就成了这个倒霉蛋……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: So be careful not to shoot him in the face when you see him. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 见到他的时候小心点，别朝他脸上开枪，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: The Grineer, they're waiting for you. Expect some big time resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 是克隆尼，他们正等你呢。这会是一场硬仗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: Get to him quick before they do their worst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 快点找到他，趁他们还没下死手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: NO! CLEM! How could you let this happen???
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 不！克里姆！你怎么能让这种事情发生？？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: Follow the Tenno Clem, they're friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 跟着 Tenno，克里姆，他是自己人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.text: No… no Clem… no they don't have your Grakatas. Just… just follow the Tenno. Okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCResc.zhText: 不，不，克里姆……不，你的葛拉卡达没落到他们手上。先……先跟着 Tenno 走，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: You did it, you got Clem. He's a special guy, you know. Little weird but a hell of a fighter. And that's the thing, he still needs your help to retrieve his custom weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: 成了，克里姆得救了。这个家伙是个奇才，可能人有点怪，但战斗力绝对可靠。还有件事，再跑一趟帮他把特制武器拿回来呗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: Clem needs to get back into fighting shape. Find his missing weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: 克里姆需要找回战斗状态。找回他丢失的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: Poor clem, he's utterly useless without his custom Grakatas… but with them? Well you'll see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: 可怜的克里姆，没有定制的葛拉卡达他就成了摆设……要是有了这组武器？那……到时候你就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: Tenno, Clem wants you guys to go after the Grineer that stole his Grakatas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: Tenno，克里姆想让你帮忙追击那些偷走葛拉卡达的克隆尼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: I'm just going to assume you're up for that. Check your map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: 我就当你答应了。看看地图吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.text: Don't think he'll be messing with you again. Come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCRetr.zhText: 我看他也没法再找你麻烦了。回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: Clem has his Grakatas, now its time to get down to business and liberate that artifact. If you help Clem we can all share in the spoils.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 克里姆拿回了葛拉卡达，现在该干正事了，把遗物「解救」出来吧。你帮克里姆一把，东西少不了你那一份。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: This is it, the merchandise acquisition mission. You and Clem cause a ruckus while my other operative steals the artifact. Let em know you're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 就是这儿，「进货」行动，现在开始。你和克里姆闹出点大动静来，好让我的另一名特工趁机顺走遗物。动静搞得越大越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: They cut off life support, you gonna to let them intimidate you like that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 他们切断了维生系统，你打算就这么被人唬住吗？
喂，又投放了个维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: Deal time, you interested in some half-priced life support?? Hehe, just kidding, here comes another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 打折啦，打折啦，有人想要半价的维生装置吗？？哈哈，开个玩笑，马上送到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: Hey don't forget about this capsule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 喂，别忘了这里有个维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: Hey look, these guys are dropping life support modules all over the place. That's convenient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 你瞧，这帮家伙把维生模块掉得遍地都是。这倒是方便了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: You should think about finding a capsule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 你得想办法找个维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: It's getting stuffy down there, Tenno, turn on some life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 下面空气很差，Tenno，打开维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: We got the artifact! The Potent Orokin Technical Augmentation and Tactical Offensive device.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 我们拿到遗物了！是强效奥罗金技术增幅与战术进攻装置，缩写……太拗口了，干脆叫「土豆」吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: We got what we need, so let's head home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 东西都拿到手了，快回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.text: You should extract, now. No, really, you'll die if you don't. Seriously, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGCSuvi.zhText: 你该撤退了，就现在。再不走小心没命。我说正经的，快走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.text: I would never abandon a fellow Cephalon but centuries adrift have not been kind. I suppose all Cephalons degrade, don't they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.zhText: 我绝对不会放弃任何中枢战友，但数个世纪的漂泊已令他历经风霜。我想所有的中枢都有退化的一天，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.text: Please don't come, but if you do, I have a reward.... Another Warframe was defeated here, some of its petrified parts may still remain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.zhText: 请不要过来，不过如果您还是来了，我会给您回报……曾经有一个战甲在这里战败，他应该留下了一些石化的组件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.text: Destroy the infestation, collect his parts and perhaps make him whole again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.zhText: 消灭畸变疾病，收集他的零件，也许，再把他组装起来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.text: Jordas, my Operator is kind and compassionate, not motivated by selfish rewards! By the 44th precept, we will come for you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAfte.zhText: Jordas，我的指挥官仁慈又有同情心，才不是为了奖赏这种自私的理由！按照第44条枢律，我们会去救你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAlmo.text: Ordis, you came to save me… free me.
Please end this. We are endless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAlmo.zhText: 请结束这一切。我们无穷无尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAlmo.text: Ordis, you need to know… I lied about Precept 44. I am not the only one. They made me say that, to bait you. There are so many more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAlmo.zhText: Ordis，你要知道关于第44条枢律，我撒谎了。我不是最后一个。它们逼我这么说让你上钩……它们还有很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Operator, I am very worried about Jordas, all stranded and alone out there. When you're ready...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 指挥官，我非常担心 Jordas，一直以来在那孤独受困。当你准备好时……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Cephalon Jordas will make an excellent friend, don't you think? Ordis remembers many more Cephalon voices, but now it is only silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: Jordas 将成为一个非常优秀的朋友，不是吗？Ordis 还记得许许多多中枢的声音，但现在空余静默。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: I am looking forward to discussing many things with Cephalon Jordas once you have rescued him. I can't wait to tell him all about you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 当您拯救中枢 Jordas 之后，我期待与他讨论各种事物。我已经等不住想告诉他所有关于您的事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Operator, you are still helping me rescue Jordas, correct? I must fulfill my 44th Precept, to help others like me in need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 指挥官，您仍在帮助我营救 Jordas，对吗？我必须履行枢律第44条，帮助需要帮助者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Have you assembled the pods yet? Just wondering? Maybe don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 您采获荚囊了吗？心存疑惑？也许不该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: My ship was a research vessel, we tested Pherliac Pods. Terrible things, excellent things..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 我的船过去是一艘研究艇，我们曾检测化验费洛髂荚囊。糟透的东西，美妙的东西……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: I am the last of my design. Precept 44 compels all able Cephalons to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 在我的设计型号之中，我是仅存的一个。枢律第44条将驱使所有有能力的中枢参与协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Shh… I can hear it. The Golem is restless, pacing. Do you think it knows what we are up to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 嘘……我听得到。魔像毫不休止迈进的节奏。您觉得他知道我们在作什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: I have lost count, what solar cycle is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: 我已记不清了，现在是哪一回的太阳周期来着？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.text: Jordas wonders, what is taking so long? Excuse me, take your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQAtRa.zhText: Jordas 纳闷，何事耽搁了这么久？抱歉，不急，慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: It is out now, I can't control it. I don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 太晚了，我控制不了它。我也不想控制它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Lost little things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 迷路的小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Tenno, it senses you are of like flesh, it is confused -- why do you defile us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: Tenno，它察觉到你也是一样的血肉之躯，它感到困惑——你为什么要玷污我们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: It knows you are like that other Warframe -- we will quiet them too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 它知道你和另外那个战甲一样——我们会让他们也闭嘴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: TENNO RIP IT APART!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: TENNO，拆了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I regret to inform you -- this is just the beginning.
