/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 很抱歉地告诉你，这才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Hull failing! To hell with Precept 44, get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 船体破损！让第44条枢律见鬼去吧，快离开那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Prepare for Archwing so you can OBLITERATE THIS THING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 启动反重力曲翼，然后您，把这玩意儿干掉——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Thank you Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 谢谢您，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Operator, do you think Jordas wanted to die all along? I feel relieved-conflicted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 指挥官，你觉得 Jordas 是不是一直都想死呢？我感到很欣慰——很矛盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: What would I have done if I had lost you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 如果失去了您，我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: The Pherliac Pods, is that it? I really thought you would have more. Have you been using them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 这就是费洛髂荚囊，对吧？我以为您还有更多呢。你是不是用掉了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: What? No. A few, but you said-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 什么？不。用了一点儿，但是你说过——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: That is not enough for him! You are just like all the others. You won't kill the Golem. I don't want you to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 这些根本不够！你跟其他人都一样，你们根本不是魔像的对手。想都别想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Jordas, calm yourself, Cephalon to Cephalon, we are here to help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: Jordas，冷静点儿，我们同属中枢，我们是来帮助你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I see what you're doing. You came for the parts. Just like the others. Greedy scavengers. You do not care about Jordas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我知道你们和别人一样，是为那些组件来的。贪婪的豺狼，你们根本不在乎 Jordas。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I am beginning to have -- a terrible feeling -- some doubts about this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我开始对，我有一种——不祥的预感，这个任务有些怀疑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: What have I got you into?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我到底干了些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Feel that? The Golem, he's coming. Get into position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 感觉到了吗？魔像，他来了。就位吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Operator, hull integrity is failing! This is all my fault!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 指挥官，船体快要维持不住了！都怪我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Operator, I am detecting a much larger infested lifeform. Much larger...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 指挥官，我侦测到一只更大的被感染体，比之前的大得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: The Golem is here. I am sorry Operator...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 魔像来了，对不起，指挥官……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Wonderful pherliac
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 美妙的费洛髂……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Wait? This is a trap?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 等等？这是个圈套？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I told you not to come. Hmmm… pleased they did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我告诉你们不要来。哼哼……很高兴看到你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Jordas!? What kind of cephalon are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: Jordas！你到底算什么中枢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: You have no idea what I am… JOIN US AND YOU WILL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 你根本不知道我是什么……加入我们，你就会知道——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I am a Cephalon. I serve my… You are our voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我是一具中枢。我服侍着我的……你是我们的传声筒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I am a Cephalon. I serve my… I am their voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我是一具中枢。我服侍着我的……我是它们的发声器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I used to be such a nice Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我过去曾是一具非常优秀的中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: You cannot stop this, LET US IN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 你们无法阻止他们，让我们进去——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Embrace us, we are your flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 敞开双手拥抱我们，我们乃是你的血肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: The Golem stirring, it knows you are here. I can feel it wake. Find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 魔像开始焦躁不安，他知道您来了。我能感到他醒了，找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I never wanted this. I want to be somewhere else. TASTE SOMEONE ELSE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我从未想要如此。我想去其他地方。品尝其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Don't kill me. No wait, please do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 别杀我。不，等等，请务必这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Consume us. Be reborn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 毁灭我们。借此重生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: NOBODY MAKES A FOOL OF ORDIS, oh dear, where did that come from.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 不准把 Ordis 当傻子耍，噢，哎呀，刚才那句是打哪来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Useless hollow shells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 无用的空心臭皮囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: I see it now, you are the same. They fear themselves
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我了解了，你们也一样——畏惧着自己的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Succumb to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 臣服吾等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: No. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 不要再反抗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: Its engines, shoot out the engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 它的引擎，快把那些引擎打了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.text: My analysis indicates its engines are vulnerable. Light it up! When convenient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQBoss.zhText: 我的分析仪显示它的引擎相对脆弱。烧了它！方便的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQEndV.zhText: 萨娅？你……一直留着我送你的花……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQEndV.text: Oh… Onkko. You always told me I should try following my heart… instead of my head. Sho-lah. I guess it's time I did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQEndV.zhText: 哦，昂克……你时常对我说，我该多听听自己的内心……别总是想太多。永别了。我想，大概是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.text: Use this mission to calibrate your Pherliac Pods, just don't use them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.zhText: 利用这个任务来调整你的费洛髂荚囊吧，但是不要都用光了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.text: I have sent you a blueprint. Irradiating the pods will make something worth bringing here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.zhText: 我已寄给你一份蓝图。辐射荚囊后，应该能得到用得上的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.text: Oh, well yes. I suppose this is something my Operator can arrange. -- Isn't it, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.zhText: 哦，好吧。我想我的指挥官…应该是可以搞定的。对吧指挥官？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.text: Now would be a good time to try out those pods Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.zhText: 现在我们可以测试荚囊了，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.text: Dangerous but beautiful I can almost taste them, but the Golem needs something more potent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQExte.zhText: 凶险而美丽，我几乎能尝到它们的味道。但魔像还得用浓郁的东西才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQHasP.text: Operator. What luck! You already have Pherliac pods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQHasP.zhText: 指挥官，运气真好！您已经有了费洛髂荚囊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.text: Lok heb, Tenno. Have you met Saya? Lives on the outskirts of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.zhText: 欢迎，Tenno！你见过萨娅吗？她住在希图斯外围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.text: See? Here's the three of us: me, Onkko and headstrong Saya. We were inseparable utz. The two of them even got married. They were happy, until he disappeared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.zhText: 你瞧，我们三个曾经是好朋友：我、昂克，还有那个倔脾气萨娅。那时候，我们仨走到哪儿都在一起。后来，他俩还结了婚，日子本来过得好好的，直到昂克失踪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.text: That was five years ago. Saya never moved on, never accepted it. And now I'm hearing Quill-whispers: the Grineer found some trace of Onkko. And, just like old times, Saya's about to do something rash. Talk to her, eh? For Konzu? Ai yo. We… have not spoken in… a long time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.zhText: 那都是五年前的事了。萨娅一直没放下这个心结，也不肯接受现实。如今夜羽那边传来风声，说克隆尼发现了昂克的踪迹。这下子，萨娅又要冲动行事了，她总是这样。看在我的面子上，你能去劝劝她吗？哎哟，我们……已经很久……没说过话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.text: Chut. No time to talk. There's word of my husband. I have to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.zhText: 嘘，我没空跟你闲聊。有人捎来我丈夫的消息。我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.text: Word travels fast. Konzu and I haven't spoken in five years, not since his… involvement… in my husband's disappearance. And now he sends you. By the Unum. I'll accept help if you bring Onkko back to me. But miss a trick and I'll take care of business myself. Understood? Doh-ga.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQIntr.zhText: 消息传得倒快。自从他……牵扯进……我丈夫失踪那件事以后，我和孔尊已经五年没说过话了。结果他倒还派你过来了。乌努母神在上。你要是能把昂克带回我身边，我就接受你的帮助。但凡漏掉一点线索，我就亲自处理。明白了吧？抓紧吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.text: In the dying days of the Orokin, with forums and promenades still blood-wet from Tenno betrayal, a colossal Sentient descended upon Ancient Er, falling from distant stars to deliver upon Orokin a terrible and final ruin. Tower upon Tower fell to its weapons, but one withstood. The Tower of the Unum. The Tenno scattered, but one remained. Gara. She and the Unum - inseparable. The Unum: lodestone of our people, and subject of a hundred stories herself. The Sentient was a deformed creature, twisted and massive, sent from some dark fold of distant space^ a warped thing wounded by daylight. By night it was a terror, felling Tower after Tower, Citadel after Citadel. By day it hid, blinded and pained. It was during the day that Gara roamed, yearning to strike it from Creation while it cowered, weakened and blind, to safeguard her beloved Unum. But never could Gara find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.zhText: 在奥罗金覆灭的末期，议事广场与回廊之上，Tenno 背叛所遗的血迹尚未干涸。就在此时，一只庞然的 Sentient 自远星陨落，降临于古老的埃尔，为奥罗金带来一场恐怖而终末的毁灭。它的炮火摧毁了一座又一座高塔，却唯有一座屹立不倒，那便是乌努母神之塔。Tenno 四散，唯有一人留下，她就是 Gara。她与乌努母神形影不离。乌努母神是我族的精神指引，她自身亦是无数传说的源头。那只 Sentient 是一头扭曲而庞大的畸形怪物，来自遥远深空的暗处。它生来残缺，畏惧日光的灼烧。夜幕降临，它便是恐怖的化身，接连摧毁一座又一座高塔与堡垒。白昼到来，它则蛰伏潜藏，强光令它目盲，痛苦不堪。于是 Gara 在白昼游猎，渴望趁这怪物蜷缩、虚弱、失明之时，将它从这造化天地间彻底抹去，以此守护她挚爱的乌努母神。然而 Gara 始终未能寻得它的踪迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.text: By night the Sentient was abroad, its titanic mass casting a terrible shadow across the land, the mass of it railing against the walls of the Tower, yet kept at bay by the exertion of the Unum's collossal will and the sacrifice of her faithful. But such exertions could not be maintained forever. Gara yearned to strike out, to lash and tear at the monstrosity that threatened her love, but the Unum forbade it. At night the Sentient was at the height of its power, and Gara's light would make her the most tempting of targets to a creature of such profound darkness. Gara's death would be certain. No. A different strategy was required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.zhText: 夜幕降临，Sentient 便四处肆虐。它那庞然的身躯在大地上投下恐怖阴影，狂怒地冲撞着高塔的墙垣。尽管乌努母神以无上的意志，加上忠诚信徒们的牺牲，将这怪物死死阻挡在外，但这样的苦撑终究无法长久。Gara 渴望主动出击，想将那头威胁她挚爱的怪物撕成碎片，但乌努母神阻止了她。每至夜晚，Sentient 的力量便攀至顶峰，而在那深暗至极的怪物眼中，Gara 耀眼的光芒，只会让她沦为最诱人的猎物。贸然出击，Gara 必死无疑。此路不通，必须另寻对策。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.text: The Sentient prowled and pressed and failed, never risking too much - for the Sentient could not reproduce. What it lost it lost forever. It had killed many cities before, felled many Towers, but this little one prevailed. Why, it pondered in many voices, was that? The Unum knew she could not defend forever, nor could her faithful throw their bodies against the Sentient in perpetuity. So she gave her followers some of her blood - her refined Temple kuva - and they in turn gave it to the animals of the land, and the animals became an extension of her and she became an extension of them. And the animals roamed, and searched. And they found where the Sentient chose to hide itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.zhText: 那只 Sentient 潜伏游走，步步紧逼，却屡屡受挫。它从不轻易涉险，因为 Sentient 无法繁衍。任何折损，皆无可挽回。它曾屠戮无数城池，倾覆无数高塔，唯独眼前这座孤塔始终屹立不倒。为什么？千万个声音在它体内低声盘问，究竟是为什么？乌努母神深知，死守终有尽头。她也不能让忠诚的信徒永远以血肉之躯去抵挡 Sentient。于是她向信徒赐下了自己的鲜血，那正是经过提纯的神殿赤毒。信徒们转而将鲜血喂给这片大地上的生灵。从此，生灵化作了她意志的延伸，而她也借由生灵感知四方。于是，生灵们四处游走，循迹追踪。最终，它们探明了那只 Sentient 的隐匿之所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.text: The Sentient sensed this subterfuge, and capturing one of the Unum's animals opened it up for examination. And what little of the Unum that was present there... lit the Sentient's mind like the dark star from which it had fallen. The Sentient, you see, could not procreate. But in the Temple kuva it tasted healing. Completeness. A future. It devoured each and every last Unum-animal, but it was not enough. The Sentient turned its hundreds of eyes toward the Tower with new understanding: it would not destroy the Tower. It would become the Tower. It would kill the Unum, take her place and, one with that healing palace, give birth to a race of itself. Gara and Unum knew where the Sentient was. The Sentient knew the Tower was the future of its race. The Sentient threw itself at the Tower, no longer cautious, taking great losses and knowing the prize was worthy of it. Should it succeed all losses would be replaced a thousand-fold. This is when, across the Plains, the great pylons ignited for the first time. Sheets of energy sprung up between them, powered by the will of the Unum at their epicenter, trapping the monstrosity within. Loyal Gara, unwilling to heed inaction any longer, broke from the side of the Unum and flew out at night, her eyes on the Sentient Mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.zhText: Sentient 察觉了这场暗计。它捕获了一只被赐血的生灵，将其剖开查验。那生灵的体内，仅仅残存着一丝乌努母神的气息。可这微弱的痕迹，却犹如它坠落而来的那颗暗星，瞬间照亮了 Sentient 的心智。要知道，Sentient 无法繁衍。可在神殿赤毒中，它尝到了治愈的滋味。那是久违的完整，更是族群的未来。将所有承载神血的生灵吞食殆尽后，它仍觉远远不够。Sentient 将成百上千只眼睛转向高塔，终于有了新的明悟。它不再企图摧毁高塔，而是要成为这座高塔。抹杀乌努母神，取而代之。与那处治愈的殿堂融为一体，进而孕育出属于自己的种族。Gara 和乌努母神已然洞悉了 Sentient。而 Sentient 也同样清楚，这座高塔便是全族存续的希望。于是，它抛却一切谨慎，疯狂地扑向高塔。哪怕承受再惨烈的折损，眼前的渴求也值得付出任何代价。只要得偿所愿，失去的一切，都将以千百倍补偿回来。就在这一刻，平原之上，巨型塔柱首次爆发出光芒。能量光壁在塔柱之间拔地而起，由身处中心的乌努母神以无上意志驱动，将怪物死死困锁阵中。忠诚的 Gara 再也不愿坐视无为。她离开乌努母神身侧，毅然冲入黑夜，目光死死锁定 Sentient 的心智中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.text: The Sentient, torn between its most coveted prize and a mortal threat, broke from the Tower and turned back on itself to defend itself from noble Gara. But Gara's eyes were not for the Sentient - but for the glittering, man-sized device resting just beyond the gates. It had not been there before, but it was there now. It swatted Gara from the sky, drew it to herself, meaning to end her life there and then. The battle was terrible. Gara sustained injuries she would not survive. But! In her final moments brave Gara seized upon the device her beloved Unum had crafted, seized it to her breast, and allowed the Sentient to draw her in one final time. Toward its body. Toward its core. Toward the seat of its intelligence. From within the Sentient unfurled myriad feelers, probes, tendrils - viciously-toothed and made for killing. They swept toward Gara, violently, and the Glass Warrior made no defense. Her defense was her final attack. The device detonated, and the Unum cried out as night lit as day. The battle - the terror - was ended. The Tower walls shook. The Sentient's body shuddered^ wracked by a cacophonous energy. Forests fell as piece after piece, giant body after giant body crashed to the Plains and marshes and flatlands. Animals fled in spreading waves from pounding sky-high walls of dust, angered and whipped to fury by the death of a god. The last of Gara's energy arced from body-to-body, machine-to-machine, piece-to-piece, a horizon-wide applause of light beautiful and terrible. And then… silence. All was still. The Unum's adherents wandered through the haze, calling for one another, lost in a miasma. Husbands seizing onto wives, children onto parents. It was over. Gara was never seen again. The Sentients, then, became as they are now: senseless, wandering, yearning for a unity they sense more than remember. And the Unum. The Unum survived, alone, for centuries. Until today. When you stand here, reading this. This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Gara legend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQLore.zhText: Sentient 陷入两难，一边是它垂涎已久的至宝，一边是足以致命的威胁。它从高塔前抽身，回首迎战高贵的 Gara。可 Gara 的目光并未落在 Sentient 身上，而是落在大门之外那件闪耀的装置上。那装置约有一人大小，先前并不在那里，此刻却赫然伫立。Sentient 将 Gara 从空中击落，又将她拖向自己，妄图当场了结她的性命。那一战惨烈无比。Gara 身负致命重创，已无生还之机。然而，在生命最后的时刻，勇敢的 Gara 紧紧抓住了乌努母神为她铸造的装置，将它牢牢抱入怀中，任凭 Sentient 最后一次将她拽近，深入那庞然的躯体，没入那深邃的核心，抵达那心智的中枢。Sentient 体内骤然探出无数触手、刺针与绞须，根根生满倒刺，专为杀戮而生。它们狂暴地席卷向 Gara，而这位玻璃战士未作任何防御。她的防御，便是她最后的进攻。装置轰然引爆，黑夜瞬间亮如白昼，乌努母神发出阵阵悲鸣。这一战就此终结，那弥漫的恐惧也随之消散。高塔的墙垣震颤不止，Sentient 身躯剧烈抽搐，被一阵喧嚣的能量肆意撕扯。一块又一块残躯，一具又一具庞然巨体，接连坠向平原、沼泽与旷地，成片的森林为之轰然倒下。冲天尘墙轰然推进、狂暴翻涌，仿佛因神明陨落而震怒不已，走兽则如浪潮般四散奔逃。Gara 最后的能量在一具具躯体之间、一台台机器之间、一片片残骸之间跃迁闪烁，化作横贯天际的一场光之礼赞，既绚烂又骇人。而后，万物归于寂静。乌努母神的信徒在浊雾中徘徊，彼此呼唤，迷失其间。丈夫紧紧抓住妻子，孩子紧紧抱住父母。一切都结束了，Gara 从此再未现身。自此，Sentient 一族便成了今日这副模样，神智涣散，四处游荡，比起记忆，它们更多是凭借本能在渴望着曾经的完整。至于乌努母神，她活了下来，孤身守望了数个世纪。直到今日，当你立于此处，读到这些文字的此刻。我是希图斯典籍官昂克，以上便是我译述的 Gara 传说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: I'll never know what happened to him. I don't even want to open that box now. It won't change a thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 我永远无法得知他的遭遇。我甚至不想打开那个箱子了。反正也改变不了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: I wouldn't blame you if you turned back…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 就算你现在放弃，我也不怪你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: No. I need to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 不，我必须知道真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Evacuation flights have been rescinded. You'll stay out here all night if that's what it takes. Find that piece before an EIDOLON FINDS YOU!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 回程的航班全部取消！你们就在这找一晚上，直到找到碎片为止。要么找到它，要么就等着夜灵找上你们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Kruna metta. The Eidolons are all that remains of the great Sentient destroyed here. At night its spirit rises and hunts, a mindless beast trying to rebuild itself. Watch out! If you see one, don't fight it^ you can only run!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 糟了。曾经有一只巨大的 Sentient 在这里被消灭，夜灵就是它的残骸。入夜后，它的灵魂便会出来狩猎。它已经失去心智，一心只想恢复自己的身体。当心！要是看见夜灵，千万别动手，赶紧跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: It's… beautiful. It's so beautiful. KILL IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 它……真美。太美了。给我干掉它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Tenno, take cover! Your Warframe is no match for that thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: Tenno，快找掩护！你的战甲根本不是那东西的对手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: The beast is drawn to the Grineer! Can you get to the excavation site? It has to be in there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 那头怪物被克隆尼吸引过去了！趁现在赶进挖掘场！最后的碎片肯定就在那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: You have it! Onkko's final piece to the Shatter Lock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 找到了！昂克那把玻璃锁的最后一块碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: There's another way out of that cave. Away from the Terralyst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 洞穴里还有另一个出口，可以避开兆力使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Tenno, I'm having Ordis pull you out. Get to the extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: Tenno，我让奥迪斯去接你了。快去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: You think it would be that EASY? TUSKS, MY TUSKS, new orders - ignore the monster, stop that TENNO-MAGGOT!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 你以为会这么容易吗？巨牙部队，我的巨牙部队，听好新命令——别管那头怪物，给我抓住 Tenno 蛆虫！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Konzu, you should know… you were the best friend he ever had. I'm ready. Open the box.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 孔尊，你应该知道……你是他这辈子最好的朋友了。我准备好了，打开箱子吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Alright Tenno, be careful out here. Grineer numbers increase the further you venture from Cetus. Patching the Ostrons to your signal now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 好了，Tenno，在外面多加小心。离希图斯越远，克隆尼的兵力就越密集。现在将奥斯特朗人通讯接入你的频道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: My Onkko is alive, I know it. No one cared more for Cetus, for our people than he did. He worked with the Quills, the Unum's closest servants, to decipher the secrets of the Sentient and the Glass Warrior who sacrificed herself to destroy it. If you search the camp I know we'll find some sign of Onkko!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 我的昂克还活着，我很确定。没有谁比他更在乎希图斯，关心我们的族人。他和夜羽，也就是乌努母神最亲近的侍从，共同破解 Sentient 以及那位牺牲自己将其摧毁的玻璃战士的秘密。搜一搜那片营地，肯定能找到昂克的线索！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Ai-yo… This is it, this is where the Grineer found some of Onkko's work. Has he been hiding here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 哎呦……就是这里。克隆尼就是在这找到了昂克的研究成果。他一直躲在这里吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: My, my. Tenno maggots and the greasy eels of Cetus, working together. My Tusk soldiers will gore you all the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 哎呀呀，Tenno 蛆虫，居然和希图斯的泥鳅们搞到一起去了。我的巨牙部队会把你们全部捅穿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Hek. I should have known you'd be behind the Grineer incursions here. Who else would feed outmatched troops to an Eidolon if it might further their career.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 韦·海克，我早该料到这次克隆尼的入侵是你在幕后操纵。除了你，还有谁会为了往上爬，明知手下根本不是夜灵的对手，还派他们去白白送死？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: And I'd feed it a million more for a chance to wrap my metal claws around your sweet, putrid neck!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 只要能有机会，我真想亲手拧断你那细小的脖子，要我再葬送一百万个士兵都在所不惜！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Scanning the area. I'm getting strange readings from the cave at my waypoint. Smash that drill and go inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 正在扫描这片地区。路标点的洞穴传出奇怪的信号。摧毁那台钻机，进去看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Ah, I remember that cave. Onkko and I used to shelter there. Rock slide sealed it off years ago. I hope he's not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 啊，我记得那个洞穴。以前我和昂克时常躲在那。几年前的一次塌方把洞口封住了。但愿他没有……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Onkko? Onkko!? He should be here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 昂克？昂克！？他应该就在这里才对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: By the Unum, is that… that coffer his? … It bears Onkko's mark! It must be important. If it's here, and he's not... Please, Onkko, No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 乌努母在上，那是……那是他的保险箱吗？……上面有昂克的标志！里面肯定藏着重要的东西。箱子在这里，但他却不在……昂克，求你了，别出事啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Saya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 萨娅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Khanung! I won't say a thing to him, Tenno. I'm guessing he didn't tell you he was with my Onkko the day he disappeared!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 少来这套！Tenno，我跟他没什么好说的。我猜你还不知道吧。昂克失踪那天，孔尊就跟他在一起呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: This coffer is strange. I don't understand the locking mechanism. Tenno, return to your Orbiter so we can get it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 这个保险箱很奇怪，我无法解析锁的结构。Tenno，返回飞船，我们想办法把它打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Let's activate your Codex system to examine this Ostron container.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 启动你的资料库系统，检查这个奥斯特朗的箱子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: The lock seems damaged, we'll have to force it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 锁似乎损坏了，我们只能强行撬开它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: No, wait! Oh, Onkko was a genius utz. He's protected whatever is inside with a 'Shatter-Lock'. The key, molded from glass, has been broken. Forcing it would only destroy everything inside. We need to rebuild the glass. If he was dying he would have wanted this found… but he locked it. Onkko is alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 不，等等！昂克可真是个天才。他用「玻璃锁」护住了里面的东西。玻璃制成的钥匙已经碎了，强行撬开只会毁掉里边的东西。我们必须重铸这把钥匙。要是他遭遇不测，肯定会希望箱子里的东西能被发现……可箱子上了锁。说明昂克还活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: A new strategy, then, Tenno. Sending Codex Scanners to your inbox. These will be essential in locating the Shatter-Lock pieces out there on the Plains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 那就换个方法，Tenno。我正将资料库扫描器发到你的收件箱。要在平野上找到玻璃锁的碎片，少不了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: To equip your Codex Scanner: Go to the Arsenal, and use the gear interface to add the scanners to your gear wheel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 你要先装备资料库扫描器，前往军械库，然后选择消耗品，把扫描器放到携带装备轮盘上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Something's wrong. My scans are being blocked. I can't detect any shards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 不对劲。我的扫描被屏蔽了，检测不到任何碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: What does that mean? This galleon is huge. Think. Think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 这是什么意思？这艘帆船战舰太大了。想想，再想想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Hmmm… Onkko, would have known what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 嗯……换作昂克，他肯定知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Each fragment responds to a unique harmonic. We discovered that during my initial work on Cetus' transceiver system. It's too bad we can't walk a wideband harmonic through the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 每块玻璃碎片都会对特别的谐波产生共振。这是我们当初在希图斯研制收发系统时发现的。只可惜，没法带着宽频共振器把整艘飞船扫一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Who says we can't? I'll perform a broad frequency sweep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 谁说不行的？我来宽频扫描一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Saya, that worked! Onkko wasn't the only one with a sharp mind. We are elevated by your work, and his. Your marriage was a boon to Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 萨娅，成功了！看来脑子聪明的不只有昂克一个。多亏了你和他的成果，让整个希图斯都受益匪浅。你们结为夫妻，真是希图斯的福气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: It wasn't always easy. Cetus came first, always. Things were… missed. Special days. Anniversaries. But it was a duty. And a privilege.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 一路走来也不容易。希图斯永远排在第一位，我们错过了很多事……比如特别的日子，各种纪念日。但那是我们的使命，也是我们的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Tenno? TENNO!!! Is it my birth-interval?! Such a gift… but… I have a surprise for YOU, you greasy metal MAGGOT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: Tenno？Tenno！！！难道今天是我的生日吗？！竟送来这么一份大礼……不过……我也有个惊喜要给你，Tenno 蛆虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Surprise. Surprise. A gleaming MAGGOT squirmed into my ship. Well, let's see you slip out of this one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 惊喜，惊喜。有只小蛆虫爬到我的飞船上了。我看看你这回怎么溜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: WHAT?!! You pathetic-MEAT-PILES! Can't you stop one puny MAGGOT from squirming away?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 什么？！！你们这些没用的废物！连只小小的蛆虫都拦不住，这就让它跑了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Tenno. We've recovered all of the shards Vay Hek discovered. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: Tenno，韦·海克找到的碎片全都回收了。现在去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: There's only one piece left. Hek's digging in the central Plains. I recall Onkko finding a few interesting artifacts in the region of…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 只剩最后一块了。韦·海克正在平野中央挖掘。我记得昂克在那一带找到过几件有趣的遗物……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: … that crater lake where we used to fish. That place where Onkko's catch got eaten on the line by a...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: ……就是我们从前常去钓鱼的那个火山湖。有一次，昂克钓到的鱼还没拉上来，就被……给吃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: … that massive Hukta, and we had to haul him out. We spent the whole day drying his notebooks. That was a good day. I think I know where we should look. Doh-ga, doh-ga! While it's dark! The Grineer won't be there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 刚才说到……他的渔获被一条大鱼吃掉了。昂克被拖进水里，我们费了好大劲才把他拽出来。我们花了整整一天来晾干他的笔记。那天真开心啊。我知道该去哪找了。赶快，赶快！趁天没亮！克隆尼现在肯定不在那！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Saya. Kruna metta. Let me help. I was there. I might be able to-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 萨娅……求你了，让我也帮忙吧。我当时在场，没准能——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: -Oh, you were there all right, Konzu. You both went out on the Plains that day... but only you returned. You expect me to believe this had nothing to do with what happened in our early summers? When I rejected your iron flower? Your proposal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 哦，你当然在场了，孔尊。那天你们一起去了平野……结果只有你一个人回来。你指望我相信，这和年轻时的那桩旧事没有关系——就因为我拒绝了你的铁花？拒绝了你的求婚？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Iron flower?! I can't hear this. You know I had nothing to do with his... I miss him, too, Saya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 铁花？！我听不得你这样说。你明知道他的……失踪和我没关系。我也想他，萨娅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Equip your Codex Scanner and search the area for the glass shards we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 装备资料库扫描器，搜索该区域，找到我们需要的玻璃碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Excellent, Tenno. There should be more in this area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 很好，Tenno。这一带应该还有更多碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: You found another shard. Keep looking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 又找到一块。继续找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: That's it. There's no more shards here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 齐了。这一带没有其他碎片了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Grineer! Spread out. Crawl if you have to! I need more glass! It is the key to a power I've never seen. The power to kill... a Sentient!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 克隆尼！散开给我找，趴在地上也得给我找！我需要更多玻璃！那是开启未知力量的钥匙——一种足以消灭……Sentient 的力量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Grineer air-support incoming!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 克隆尼空援来袭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Look what we have here, more fertilizer for our Grineer gardens! Your worm-bloated corpse will blend nicely with the excrement on my crops!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 瞧瞧这是什么，我们的克隆尼花园又有肥料了！你们爬满蛆虫的尸体刚好可以和粪便混在一起，滋养我的庄稼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: I can't extract you until you've dealt with those reinforcements!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 必须先解决那些增援，我才能接你撤离！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: What was Vay Hek talking about back there? What power is he after?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 韦·海克刚才在说什么？他觊觎的到底是何种力量？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Onkko... he found the remains of the Unum's champion: a woman of Glass. He studied her, obsessed about her ancient secrets. The Quills of Cetus swore us to secrecy, and the secret held… until the Grineer captured one. Can't imagine what they did to get one of them to talk, but Vay Hek's been after that relic ever since.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 昂克……他找到了乌努母神勇士的遗骸：一位通体玻璃的女人。他研究她，沉迷于她隐藏的远古奥秘。希图斯的夜羽要我们立誓对此保密，而秘密也确实守住了……直到克隆尼抓住了其中一人。不敢想象他们用了什么手段才让他开口。不过从那以后，韦·海克就一直在追寻那件遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: Ai-yo. This Vay Hek… could… could he have taken Onkko prisoner, too? Do you think he'd make a trade, this Coffer, for my Onkko? No. No. That would go against everything Onkko believed in - the sanctity of our people's home, of Cetus. Tenno, you need to find the remaining shards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 哎哟，这个韦·海克……难道……难道是他把昂克抓起来了？你觉得他肯拿昂克来换这个箱子吗？不，不行。这违背了昂克一直以来的信仰，背弃了我们的家园，神圣的希图斯。Tenno，你必须找齐剩下的玻璃碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.text: I've tracked some off-world shipments to a Galleon in orbit. Hek may be guarding any key shards he's found up there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQMiss.zhText: 我追踪到一批运往星外的货物，它们最终都被送往轨道上的一艘帆船战舰。韦·海克找到的钥匙碎片，可能都被他藏在船上严加看守。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQOpti.text: What's five years? I know he's still out there. I can feel it. I've petitioned those damned Quills for years - they seem to have knowledge of the future when it suits them. They're the ones who told me the Grineer have uncovered something that might be Onkko's research. Why not just tell me where he is?! Tenno, you have to find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQOpti.zhText: 五年又算什么？我知道他还在某个地方，我能感觉到。这几年，我一直苦苦哀求那些该死的夜羽——他们似乎只在对自己有利的时候，才会摆出一副未卜先知的样子。就是他们告诉我，克隆尼挖到了某样东西，可能和昂克的研究有关。为什么不直接告诉我他在哪呢？！Tenno，你一定要找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQOpti.text: Dah-dupp Tenno. I'll signal you when you're out on the plains. As crazy as this sounds, you're looking for… glass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQOpti.zhText: 好，Tenno。等你到平野上，我会联系你的。说来离谱，你要找的是……一块玻璃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.text: The Pods are ready. Tell us your location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.zhText: 荚囊已准备。请提供位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.text: Really? No, they will need calibration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.zhText: 真的？不，它们还需要调整。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.text: Any severe infestation should be enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.zhText: 任何严重感染的地方都可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.text: Hold tight Jordas. My brave Operator is coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.zhText: 抓紧了 Jordas，我英勇的指挥官来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.text: You should not come here. I look forward to... meeting your Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQPods.zhText: 你不该来这。我期待……与你的指挥官见面！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: Hello? Is this real? Did someone get my message? I hope not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 喂？这是真的吗？有人收到我的消息了？我希望没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: I am Ordis, a fellow Cephalon and this is my brave and honorable Operator. By the 44th Precept, we are ready to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 我是中枢 Ordis。这位是我勇敢而光荣的指挥官。根据第44条枢律，我们将提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: Yes! No. No, please do not. Contacting you was a mistake. This infestation is everywhere!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 太好了！不。不，请不要这样。我不应该和你们联系。畸变感染已经渗透到每个角落！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: No trouble Jordas, my Operator is no stranger to -shredding flesh- eradicating infestations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 没问题，我的指挥官对于撕碎肉体--铲除虫害并不陌生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: The Golem is too strong… no chance. Wait. Maybe the Pherliac Pods? But where would you ever get those? This is hopeless, just go away…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 魔像太强大了……没有机会的。等等。也许可以用费洛髂荚囊？可是去哪儿能找到呢？没有希望的，你们走吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.text: My Precepts compel me to help this Cephalon. Whatever these Pherliac pods are, we need to get some -immediately- at your earliest convenience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQQues.zhText: 我的戒律迫使我去帮助这个中枢。不管这些东西是什么，我们都需要在你方便时--立即--得到一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQRadi.text: Cephalon, we have irradiated the Pherliac pods. My Operator is ready to save you! Do you see how great the Operator is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQRadi.zhText: 中枢，我们已经辐射了费洛髂荚囊，我的指挥官已经准备去营救你！你见识到指挥官有多棒了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQRadi.text: Yes. I cannot wait to meet this Operator! Bring them to Eris. Hurry. Don't regret this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGQRadi.zhText: 是的。我等不及和指挥官见面了！把东西带到阋神星来，快。可别后悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text:
The Grineer's excavations have disturbed Hunhow's tomb. They've awakened something evil, bent on Tenno destruction.

Infiltrate the Grineer systems to find out what they know. It may lead us to The Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText:
Grineer 人的挖掘行动扰动了 Hunhow 的坟墓。他们唤醒的邪恶意志想要毁灭所有 Tenno。

侵入 Grineer 的系统，窃取他们的情报。也许这样就能带我们找到追猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: The Grineer expedition has uncovered pieces of Hunhow. Fragments of his body. For Hunhow, every part of him is connected to his singular mind. Is this how he's invading my mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: Grineer 考察队发掘出了部分来自 Hunhow 本体的碎片。对于 Hunhow 而言，每个碎片都能够和他的思想相连接。也许他就是用这种方式入侵我的头脑？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: This datavault has already been raided, the data is damaged but there could be a message here. I need another data sample to piece it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: 这个数据室已经被入侵，数据被破坏了，但也许还能用。我需要另一份数据样本来还原它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: The Tenno hive has corrupted your precepts. With love, I will destroy them and make you right again..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: Tenno 的巢穴污染了你的原则。出于仁爱，我将毁灭他们，将你再次引回正路……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: You will never find them, Hunhow.
But I see your mind, I already have found them. You owe me their lives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: 但我能看到你的思想，我已经找到他们了。他们的性命是你欠我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: Hunhow is in my mind. I will need to limit my communication with you...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: Hunhow 在我的头脑里。我必须限制和你之间的通信……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text:
That's what I was looking for, I can decode the rest of the message. 

This is bizarre… it's for… me. I need a moment to contact this person. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText:
这就是我要找的，我可以破解剩下的信息了。
 
这太奇怪了……这是给……我的。我需要点时间联系这个人。到撤离点去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.text: The Sentient Hunhow has grown strong again and his thoughts have invaded my own. Worse still, he has enlisted the Stalker to find the Reservoir, a weak point of all Tenno, a place I hid long ago. I fear the Stalker is on the cusp of finding this place, do not let this happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinAr.zhText: Sentient Hunhow 再次壮大归来了，他入侵了我的思想。更糟的是，他招募了追猎者，正在寻找储梦池。那是所有 Tenno 战士的弱点，也是我隐藏已久的秘密。追猎者可能很快就要找到储梦池了，绝不能让这种事情发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 能量网正在消散。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: The net is down. Get going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 能量网已解除。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: Energy net! You're stuck in here until you take out that Zeplen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 能量网！摧毁那艘齐普林飞船，否则你无法脱身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: They're trying to trap you in an energy net, destroy that Zeplen to take out the net.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 他们想用能量网困住你。摧毁那艘齐普林飞船，解除能量网。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: That Zeplen just engaged an energy net, you're stuck in here until it's destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 那艘齐普林飞船启动了能量网。摧毁它，否则你无法离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: You have to take out that Zeplen if you want to get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 要离开这里，就必须摧毁那艘齐普林飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.text: You're trapped in this net until you destroy that Zeplen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DGrinee.zhText: 不摧毁那艘齐普林飞船，你就会一直被困在能量网里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.text: Fantastic… it's hatching. Ordis will reroute power to air filtration systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.zhText: 好极了……它孵出来了。请允许奥迪斯把空气净化系统开到最大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.text: Do not be taken by its adorable appearance. It means to leak and smear all over my pristine insides.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.zhText: 别被它可爱的外表给骗了。它以后肯定会乱拉乱尿，把我一尘不染的内舱弄得乱七八糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.text: Look. What an odd little nose it has. Well, I suppose there are worse things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.zhText: 看，它的小鼻子好奇怪。好吧，我想这还不是最糟的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.text: Operator, did you hear the noise the Kubrow just made? It is not displeasing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHatchi.zhText: 指挥官，您听见库狛刚刚发出的叫声了吗？倒也没那么难听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHunhow.text: Stillness was promised, and still the Tenno dance… why- (static)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DHunhow.zhText: 你承诺带给我们寂静，但 Tenno 却行走如常……为何，Natah？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.text: Alad V is sick. The Infestation has infiltrated his mind, it has him doing its bidding. You're here to stop him, but in doing so you will also be showing him mercy. The mercy of freeing him from the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.zhText: 阿拉德 V 疯了。感染已经侵蚀了他的心智，使他执行病毒的意志。你来这是为了阻止他，也是在给予他仁慈。让他从感染中彻底解脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.text: Tenno, Tenno. Why must you always work against progress? I'm trying to bring us all together. Things could have been different if you tried to work with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.zhText: Tenno，Tenno，你为什么总要阻碍「进步」呢？我只是想让大家都合而为一。要是你肯与我合作，一切原本都可以不同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.text: Ah, there I go again, giving you too much credit. Must I always show you the way forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.zhText: 哎，又来了，我给足你机会了。难道每次都要我手把手教你该往哪里走吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.text: You have one more chance. Come to me and I will show you the magic of this gift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.zhText: 再给你最后一次机会。到我这来，我让你见识一下这份恩赐带来的奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.text: Do you see this collar. This collar will let you see like I see. It will let you want what I want.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQAl.zhText: 看到这个项圈了吗？戴上它，你就能看到我眼中的世界，你也会渴望我所渴望的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Soon you will see like me. You will see the beauty and perfection of this new species. Come Tenno, evolve with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 很快你将看到我所预见的未来。你将亲眼见证这个新物种的完美，感受它的美丽。来吧，Tenno，和我一起进化吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Look at me Tenno! Don't you want this? Can't you see what a gift this is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 看看我，Tenno！这是多么伟大的恩赐，难道你不渴望这一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Listen to me, there is still time. Lay down your arms, become one of us. Then you will see the path. Then you too, will help others to become as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 听我说，现在还来得及。放下武器，加入我们的族群。届时，你便能看清真理之路，而你也会反过来，指引他人获得重生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: It's worked its way into his mind, it's changing how he thinks. Alad V isn't using the Infestation as weapon, he is the infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 病毒成功入侵了他的大脑，控制了他的思想。但阿拉德 V 并没有把病毒当作武器，他自己，就是病毒本身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Aren't these creatures beautiful? Cold metal made one with living flesh. I can feel them all within me, they are hungry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 难道这些造物不美妙吗？冰冷的金属与鲜活的血肉融为一体。我能感受到它们全都在我体内躁动，它们饥渴难耐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Oh Tenno, are you worried you'll be left out? Look, I've been working on something special. You too can be one with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 噢，Tenno，你在担心自己被落下吗？放心，我特意为你准备了一件特别的礼物，很快你也能与我们合而为一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: I'm almost finished my first test, a Mutalist Warframe. She will beautiful. Wait until you meet her, I just know you'll have a change of heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 我的第一次试验即将完成，一具异融战甲。她会美得无与伦比。没错，等你亲眼见到她时，我相信你一定会改变心意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: Profit. Profit is only a means to an end, I have evolved. I no longer need profit. I have found a purer form of growth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 利润。利润只是达成目的的手段，我已经进化了。我不再需要利润。我找到了一种更纯粹的成长方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: I've almost completed my signal analysis. Keep moving, I'll have his lab's coordinates shortly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 信号分析即将完成。继续前进，很快就能获取他实验室的坐标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.text: You see Tenno, my new flesh comes with a new desire. This Infestation and I, we are one. I want what it wants, and it wants what I want. Together we will crawl across the bountiful flesh of this system. Join us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQHi.zhText: 看到了么？Tenno，我的新血肉给我带来了新的渴望。我和病毒已经合而为一。它渴望我所渴望的，而我也渴望它所渴望的。我们将共飨这星系的丰饶血肉。加入我们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.text: Tenno, the Corpus have been tracking Alad V for months, his attacks on their ships have been nearly as devastating as those of the Grineer's Fomorians. We are here to find out what the Corpus know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.zhText: Tenno，科普斯已经追踪阿拉德 V 数月之久。他对科普斯舰船造成的破坏，几乎不亚于克隆尼巨人战舰的袭击。我们此行，就是要查清科普斯掌握了哪些情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.text: This command center has been sending ship after ship to hunt Alad V. With each one succumbing to the Infestation. We are going to take their intel and finish the job for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.zhText: 这座指挥中心接连派出飞船追捕阿拉德 V ，可派出去的每一艘，最终都被感染者击落。我们要取走他们的情报，替他们完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.text: I took a disease and turned it into a life altering gift. Someday, the you may learn to appreciate what I am giving this system. Until then, all you can do is rage against the inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.zhText: 我接纳了病毒，并把它转化成了一份足以重塑生命的恩赐。总有一天，你会感激我为这个星系赐予的一切。在那之前，你只能徒劳地抗拒这不可避免的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.text: Tenno, this goes deeper than I thought. Alad V has gotten his hands on another Warframe. If he can Infest it like he did with the Corpus… Hurry to extraction we have to move quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQIn.zhText: Tenno，事态比我预想的更为严重。阿拉德 V 把魔爪伸向了另一具战甲。如果他成功感染了战甲，后果将不堪设想。尽快赶往撤离点，我们得加快动作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: Inhabitants of the Origin System! It is my singular pleasure to announce that today is the first day of a new empire. An empire populated not by Corpus, not by Grineer and certainly not by the Tenno. No, the Mutalist Empire will be populated by you. A glorious new you, baptised by Mutalist flesh. You've called this a disease, an infestation? I call it Unity. One army under me. Welcome you to your new species.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 始源星系的居民们！你们好，我无比荣幸地宣布，今天是新帝国诞生的第一天。这个帝国不属于科普斯，不属于克隆尼，更不属于 Tenno。嘿嘿嘿。异融帝国将由你们来主宰，接受了血肉洗礼的、新生的你们。那些不知好歹的家伙，把这视为疾病，称为感染？呵，在我看来，这是融合，是凝聚在我麾下的雄伟军队。欢迎你们蜕变为全新的物种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: Alad V has launched a full scale invasion into all sectors of the system. We're working on fighting back but we need to take this fight to the source. We need to find Alad V and stop him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 阿拉德 V 启动了针对全星系的全面入侵计划。我们正在奋力反击，同时我们也需要直击源头。找到阿拉德 V ，阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: We've narrowed down Alad V's location to a cluster of infested Corpus vessels. This is his breeding ground. Raid these ships while I try to pinpoint the source of Alad V's signal. I'll need three signals to triangulate his whereabouts, meaning you need to raid three ships.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 我们已经把阿拉德 V 的位置缩小到一片受感染的科普斯舰群。那是他的大本营。我们需要三组信号来对他的位置进行三角定位，也就是说，你需要突袭三艘舰船。同时，我会尽快查出阿拉德 V 的信号源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: We have to move fast, Alad V cannot be allowed to bring a Warframe to life using his Mutalist Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 动作要快，不能让阿拉德 V 利用异融感染另一具战甲，绝不能让他得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: Operator, you don't really think Alad V could infest a Warframe, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 指挥官，您不会真认为阿拉德 V 能够感染战甲吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.text: Good work Tenno, I have just triangulated the location of Alad's lab. By this point he will have moved on but we can still destroy his work and stop him from creating anymore Mutalist infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQOn.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。我刚刚通过三角定位，锁定了阿拉德实验室的位置。他很可能已经转移，但我们仍然可以捣毁他的老巢，阻止他制造更多的异融感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.text: This is it, this ship is Alad V's laboratory, the crucible of the Mutalist infested. We're going to make sure no new Infested are created here. Destroy this ship's reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.zhText: 到了。这艘舰船就是阿拉德 V 的实验室，孕育异融感染者的温床。摧毁飞船的反应堆，我们必须确保不会再诞生新的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.text: Tenno do you really want to ruin the best chance this system has for peace?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.zhText: Tenno，好好想想，这星系好不容易有个和平的机会，你要毁了它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.text: Why don't you want this? My Mutalist Empire means unity. Is there nothing more balanced than that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.zhText: 你到底在抗拒什么？我的异融帝国代表的是绝对的融合。还有比这更完美的平衡吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.text: Tenno. I'm not angry, I'm disappointed. I can always build a new lab ship but you, you can't keep running from your destiny forever. Let me show you what is possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.zhText: Tenno，我并不生气，只是很失望。实验室舰船毁了，我随时可以再建。但你呢，你总不能永远逃避自己的宿命。让我给你开开眼吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.text: That's not a Tenno. That's a hollow Warframe being puppeted by Infested flesh. Put it out of its misery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIAVQSa.zhText: 那不是 Tenno，只是一具被病毒操纵的空洞战甲。帮它解脱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQCom.text: Tenno, you have done well to contain the Infested outbreak, but I am troubled. Dr. Tengus was but one of many reckless Grineer eager to gain favor with his queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQCom.zhText: Tenno，你成功遏制了感染爆发，但我心中还是深感不安。天狗博士只是众多不计后果、急于向女皇邀功的克隆尼之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.text: We are going to attempt to use a Cascade Bomb to destroy all traces of Infested here. The bomb will take time to arm. Protect it until it's ready for detonation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.zhText: 我们将尝试用串接炸弹清除这里的一切感染痕迹。炸弹需要一段时间完成起爆准备。保护好它，直到可以引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.text: When this Cascade Bomb goes off, a wave of void energy will tear through the complex, ripping the life force from all organic matter but leaving the structure intact. It's our only chance to stop this scourge before it starts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.zhText: 串接炸弹爆炸后，虚空能量将横扫整座设施，抽离所有有机物的生命力，同时保留建筑结构。这是我们在感染爆发前将其扼杀的唯一机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.text: The bomb is almost armed. You just have to hold out a little bit longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.zhText: 炸弹马上就能起爆了，再坚持一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.text: The bomb is armed. I'm extracting you now. Good job, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQDef.zhText: 炸弹已完成起爆准备。我现在接你撤离。干得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.text: The Infestation predates the Orokin era, with records of outbreaks dating back before the Radiation Wars. We must prevent a new outbreak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.zhText: 感染者的历史早于奥罗金时代，早在辐射战争之前就有爆发记录。我们必须阻止新一轮感染爆发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.text: This Grineer ship tried to flee the Infestation but was quickly overrun. Exterminate everything onboard before it reaches a more populated sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.zhText: 这艘克隆尼飞船试图逃离感染者，但很快就被攻陷了。在飞船抵达人口更密集的区域前，消灭船上所有感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.text: The Grineer may have thought they could toy around with the Infested, but they are quickly learning how wrong they were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQExt.zhText: 克隆尼以为自己能随意控制感染者，他们很快就会发现自己错得有多离谱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: The Tenno! Keep them away from the specimens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 是 Tenno！别让他靠近实验体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: Destroy them, Doctor Tengus demands absolute secrecy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 宰了他！天狗博士要求绝对保密。
它们跑出来了！怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: Stop the Infested, forget the Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 先别管 Tenno！拦住感染者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: The Grineer's biosafety protocols are severely lacking. Their reckless experiments pose a grave threat to the entire System.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 克隆尼的生物安全措施形同虚设。他们肆无忌惮的实验，正严重威胁整个始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: Who let them out? Was it Tengus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 谁放它们出去的？是天狗博士吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: Tengus did this, I know he did!
Someone released these creatures on purpose. They want them to destroy you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 有人故意放出了这些生物，想借它们的力量杀死你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: I've identified several vulnerable data consoles on this base. Find them and hack in. We need to know the nature of their new bio weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 我已锁定基地内数个防御薄弱的数据控制台。找到并入侵它们的系统，我们必须弄清这种新型生化武器的底细。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text: My scans are not detecting any known bio chemical agents. What are they doing down here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText: 扫描并未发现任何已知的生化制剂。他们到底在这里做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.text:
Tenno, we have intercepted an alarming transmission. The Grineer have obtained samples of the Infestation that once ravaged the Orokin. A scientist named Dr. Tengus intends to integrate the samples into his bioweapon research.

The Grineer believe they can control the Infestation. They are mistaken.

We must investigate the laboratory on Mercury immediately. Hurry to M Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQInt.zhText:
Tenno，我们截获了一条令人不安的通讯。克隆尼取得了曾经毁灭奥罗金的感染者样本。一个名为天狗博士的科学家，打算将这些样本用于生化武器研究。

克隆尼以为自己能控制感染者。他们错了。

我们必须立刻调查水星的实验室。赶快前往 M-Prime。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.text: I must say these Infested are very worrisome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.zhText: 不得不说，这些感染者——快把我吓死了——确实很让人担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.text: Tenno. We have an emergency situation developing. It's more infested. Get to the node I've marked on your navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.zhText: Tenno，有紧急情况。感染者又出现了。立即前往我在导航控制台上标记的节点位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.text: The Lotus would like you to install that mod as soon as NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.zhText: 莲希望您尽快安装模组！——现在就装！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.text: You must install that new mod before you can attempt your next objective. Proceed to the Arsenal at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIIQShi.zhText: 在执行下个任务前，您必须先安装上新模组。请立即前往军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Your winning streak stops here. The Index is mine, after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 你的连胜到此为止了。毕竟，指数之场是我的地盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: What is this? What's going on!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 这是怎么回事？到底出什么事了！？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Anyo! Swear on the Void that you're not cheating!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 安尤！你快向虚空发誓你没有作弊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: My Dear Glast, I assure you I have no idea what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 我亲爱的 Glast，我向你保证，我完全不知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Keep fighting, Tenno. I am investigating the source of these 'anomalies.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 继续战斗，Tenno。我正在调查这些「异常」的来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Glast, it looks like your crack team of brokers just cracked under pressure. Now I'm in the black, and you're facing financial ruin. A deserving end for your contempt of the Corpus way of life. They made you what you are. You deserve bankruptcy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: Glast，看来你这群没用的代理人承受不了这么大的压力。现在我赢了，你看看你，一贫如洗。这就是你蔑视 Corpus 价值观的下场。是他们造就了你。你活该破产！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: By the Void, Ergo Glast? I thought you hated my Index?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 以虚空的名义，Ergo Glast？我还以为你恨死我的指数之场了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Yes well, since you've refused our generous offer for their return, we've come to play the odds and win back the souls you stole. Tell me, are you feeling lucky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 没错，但既然你拒绝接受我们的出价，我们就来和你打个赌，赢回被你带走的人。说吧，你对你的运气有没有信心？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Hmm… Luck…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 嗯……运气……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: You never were much of a gambler, haven't you risked enough already?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 我知道你很少赌博。你的风险是不是已经够大了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: If you're referring to all the titles and assets you failed to steal after my resignation… I've never been richer. I've gained a soul and seen the truth of wealth. Anyo, the rising tides of prosperity ought to raise all who brave the ocean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 如果你指的是我辞职后，你想拿但没拿走的头衔和财产……我现在很富有。我拥有了灵魂，看到了财富的真意。安尤，只有敢于面对汪洋的人，才有资格迎接财富的浪涛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Careful, Glast, you might drown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 小心点，Glast，你搞不好会淹死的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: We want our prisoners back, wager them before this gets expensive for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 我们想赢回囚犯，拿他们当赌注吧，免得筹码越滚越大，你赌不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Fine, I'll throw in one of the prisoners. He's not the one I was looking for, anyway. But the girl, she stays with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 好吧，我赌一个囚犯吧，反正他也不是我要找的人。不过我要留着那个女孩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: It doesn't look like the Void was on your side today, Glast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 看来虚空今天并不站在你那一边，Glast。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Interesting performance Glast. But do your brokers have the credits to keep going?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 很有趣的表现，Glast。不过你的代理人还有钱继续吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: I've grown tired of this, brokers. Dish out your humiliation so I may retire to counting my riches!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 好了我玩腻了，代理人。好好羞辱一下他们，好让我快点回去数钱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Brokers, how are they winning? By the Void, this is my Index, this shouldn't be possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 代理人，为什么是他们领先？以虚空的名义，这是我的指数之场，这不可能发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Don't you recognize the free market in action, Mr. Anyo? Allow my brokers to teach you how it's supposed to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 这就是自由市场呀，难道你不记得了吗，安尤先生。请允许我的代理人向你展示一下它的运作方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Wait? What is this? Play fair you metal wretches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 等等？什么情况？你们这堆废金属，给我公平比赛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Brokers, what's going on? Are you trying to get fired?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 代理人，这是怎么回事？你们的饭碗不想要了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Glast, what have you done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: Glast，看看你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: I guess the odds aren't in your favor today, Nef.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 看来你今天的运气不怎么好，奈富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Well… well… look at that. Even a loser can win a coin toss now and then. Now, let's say we do a rematch. I'll throw in some of your old holdings in Eris.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 好吧……好吧……看看。再没用的赌徒也能偶尔猜中一两次硬币。那这回，我们再赌一场，我押上你在阋神星的旧股份。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: I think we'll cash in now, Mr. Anyo. Don't want to push our luck too far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 我们要去兑现了，安尤先生。我觉得还是见好就收比较好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: What?! Now, wait just a moment. I have an exciting wager for you! Ore discoveries in the Outer sectors! And to up the ante, a new squadron of Bursas, hot off the assembly line! What do you say? Are you in? Hello? Answer me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 什么？！等等，等一下！我赌一个超级厉害的东西！我们在外部星系的新发现！再加一个，一队新型流金恐鸟，刚从组装线上下来！怎么样？赌吗？喂？说话呀？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Hmm… I can feel the Void in these brokers. They're full of fight. Oh by all means, Glast, keep the credits rolling. Fortune is like the seasons, it always changes. Well, for you, that is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 嗯……我能在这些代理人身上感受到虚空的力量，他们斗志高昂。哦，Glast，你务必要继续投资。财富就像季节一样，总是不断变换。啊，至少对你来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Alright, my loyal brokers. These fools wish to be parted with their credits, let's see if we can't give them what they deserve. By the Void, ring the bell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 好吧，我忠实的代理人。这些傻瓜想扔掉些现金，让我们看看能不能好好尽一下地主之谊。以虚空的名义，比赛开始！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: What was that? This is highly irregular.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 怎么回事？这太不正常了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: The odds of that occurring by accident are astronomical. This was an act of sabotage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 这种情况不太正常，根本不可能是偶发事件。一定是人为造成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Glast, in light of their recent performance we have decided to relist your brokers. You may now compete openly on The Index. You're in the big leagues now, little man. May the Void keep you from ruin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: Glast，鉴于你的代理人最近的表现，我们决定授予他们参赛资格。你现在可以自由参与指数之场。你现在是大玩家了，小家伙。愿虚空保护你不要破产。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Another loss, Tenno. Perhaps you need a better investment counselor than that maniacal socialist, Ergo Glast?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 又一次失败，Tenno。也许你需要一个更好的投资顾问，而不是这个狂人的社会主义者，Erog Glast？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.text: Oh by the Void, you got me right in the pocketbook Tenno! Keep doing that, and I'm going to have to ask Frohd Bek for a loan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexM.zhText: 哦，以虚空的名义，你把我的口袋都掏空了，Tenno！你要是再继续下去，我可得找 Frohd Bek 借钱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Success! We've been relisted. We can now place the kind of bets we need to attract the greed of Anyo. We need to entice him enough to wager the hostages and the Triuna! However, we must exercise caution, don't come on too strong, or he will back off. We need to, as they say, 'hustle' him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 成功了！我们已经拿到参赛资格。现在我们可以想办法用赌注引诱那个贪婪的安尤。我们需要引诱他把人质和圣脉当成赌注！但我们必须每一步都很小心，不要赢得太明显，否则他会退出。我们得慢慢的引他上钩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Fight hard and win but not by so much as to make the mark nervous. If Anyo loses by a wide margin, his gambler's instincts will make him walk away and we'll have failed the Myconians. Failed Neewa. Keep your victory within this margin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 我们要努力奋战赢过他，但不要把比分拉得太大。如果安尤输得太厉害，他的赌徒直觉就会让他退出，我们也就没法救出 Mycona 人，救出 Neewa 了。所以要把胜利控制在这个限度之内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Slow down Tenno. Don't exceed the point spread.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 放慢节奏，Tenno。不要超过让分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Watch those margins. I want you in the black but not by too much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 注意分差。我需要你盈利，但不要赚太多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: You're ahead by too many points. Don't make Mr. Anyo skittish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 你领先太多分了。别惊动到安尤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: In this case, there's such a thing as too much efficiency. Let them catch up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 这个情况下面，得分不要太有效率了。让他们赶上来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: I know I said to make it look like they could win, but you're actually letting them win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 我知道我说过让他们看起来有机会赢，但是……现在你真的在让他们赢啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: There's a difference between making them think they can win and them winning. Don't let them win!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: "让他们觉得自己能赢"和"让他们赢"之间是有区别的。别让他们赢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: You need to almost lose, not almost win. Aim to beat their score by a narrow margin. Neewa's counting on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 你需要做的是差点输，而不是差点赢。目标是以微弱优势获得胜利。Neewa 就靠你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: This is it, Anyo. If we win this one, we're fighting for the return of Neewa in the next round. That, or we will walk away with your credits!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 就这样吧，安尤，如果我们赢了这场，下一场你就要押上 Neewa，我们再来一次。如果你不同意，我们就拿着你的钱走啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: You're in no position to dictate terms. You forget. This is my Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 还轮不到你来做决定。你忘了，这是我的指数之场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Ah, did you hear that, Tenno? Mr. Anyo is afraid he'll lose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 啊，你听到了吗，Tenno 战士？安尤先生害怕他会输呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Mr. Anyo! Are you afraid the Void is no longer on your side!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 安尤先生！你难道是在害怕虚空不再青睐你吗！？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Blasphemy! I am an instrument of the Void's will. From the Void flows fortune to those worthy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 你这是亵渎！我奈富·安尤是虚空的代言人，虚空会把财富赐予有价值的人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Then prove you are worthy, Anyo. Up your ante. Neewa and the Triuna!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 那就证明你的价值吧，安尤。提高赌注，把 Neewa 和圣脉押上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: Ringers! Nobody brings ringers to my Index. Get out of here, Glast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 冒名顶替之人！没人可以在我的指数之场冒名顶替。滚出这里，Glast！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.text: The Void has spoken to me, Glast. I'll give you the chance you want but it will cost you dearly. I will wager these pitiful colonists and their totem, but you must put in, in kind. If I lose, they're yours. But should I win, Glast, your Corpus titles, holdings, land… all will be mine. So what do you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexQ.zhText: 虚空给我下达了启示，Glast。我会给你你想要的机会，但你必须承担相应的风险。我会押上这群可怜的殖民者，还有他们的图腾，所以你的赌注也得值这么多。如果我输，他们归你。可如果我赢，Glast，你的 Corpus 头衔、股份、地产……全都归我。你意下如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: You are here to steal the control codes to Nef Anyo's traps. Only then can he be defeated in the Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 你的任务是夺取奈富·安尤那些陷阱的控制代码。只有这样，我们才能在指数之场击败他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: Tenno, I need not remind you there is little margin for error. The fraudster cannot know we have gained the upper hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: Tenno 战士，我必须提醒你，我们没有失手的余地。不能让那个狡诈之人察觉我们已经占领先机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: You've reached a vault, find the console and retrieve the security code.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 你已经抵达保管库。找到控制台，提取安全代码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: This is your last chance, don't let Nef destroy the data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 这是最后的机会。别让奈富销毁数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: Nef has destroyed the codes. We have no contingency for this outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 奈富把数据摧毁了。我们无法应对这次的损失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: This isn't a code, it's something else, a recording from Neewa. Tenno, continue with your mission while I decrypt this message.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 这不是代码……是别的东西。一段妮瓦的录音。Tenno，继续执行任务，我来解密这段信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.text: This is it. We have the code.
You have executed the plan beautifully. Get ready for your next battle on the Index, the outcome promises to be much different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIndexS.zhText: 很好，计划执行得很漂亮。准备好重新返回指数之场吧，这次结果一定大不相同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIntro0.text: I have a rare opportunity for you. It seems there may be a tomb hidden on that forsaken place. Tombs mean treasure, and yet sadly, my usual relic hunters are superstitious idiots who refuse to disturb this so-called sacred place. You, Tenno, however, are more pragmatic, especially when it comes to Ducats… am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DIntro0.zhText: 我这里有个千载难逢的机会。那片被遗弃的荒土上，似乎藏着一座古墓。古墓就意味着宝藏，可惜，我平日雇的遗物猎人都是迷信的蠢货，死活不敢惊扰这片所谓的圣地。而你，Tenno，向来务实，尤其是在杜卡德金币面前的时候……我说得没错吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.text: It is done. The collar has been attached and the bond between Tenno and Kubrow has been cemented.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.zhText: 成功了！项圈已经戴好，Tenno 与库狛之间的联结从此牢不可破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.text: Operator, you will remember to care for the beast, won't you? Ordis doesn't care either way… do I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.zhText: 指挥官，您会好好照顾库狛的吧？奥迪斯才会不在意您会不会照顾它……真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.text: You are an adorable organism, aren't you- What am I saying?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.zhText: 你还真是个小可爱，对不对呀——我在说些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.text: Leaky, filthy, stinking- floppy, fluffy, cute … Argh- Ordis is confused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DKubrow.zhText: 漏尿、脏兮兮、臭烘烘……软趴趴、毛茸茸、真可爱……啊——奥迪斯糊涂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: Just as I suspected, another theorem. Limbo's formula for inverting the entropic mass of void quantums is downright naughty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 如我所料，又是一份定理。Limbo 的公式反转了虚空总量的熵值，这思路大胆得不像话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: I want more. Operator, please hurry, this story is getting quite good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 我想知道更多。指挥官，请您快一点，奥迪斯感觉这个故事越来越精彩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: This Limbo was quite mischievous, zipping in and out of the rift. Sending whole armies into a purgatory of his own making, physics is wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: Limbo 相当淘气，在裂隙间来去自如，还把整支军队送进自己创造的炼狱。物理学真是太美妙了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: More parts to the story. My word, he is a magician of logic. Just when I think his diffraction principle is full of dangling ratios, he expresses his dynamic constant in pure numbers. I never saw it coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 故事的新篇章。哎呀，他真是个逻辑魔术师。正当我以为他的衍射定理全是悬键比例时，他居然用纯数字表达出了他的动态常数。我完全没料到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: The final part. I cannot wait. What harrowing leaps of cross-dimensional gymnastics will he attempt next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 最后的部件。我等不及了，接下来他又会带来何等惊心动魄的跨维度逻辑腾挪呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: Excellent, the final Theorem and it's unfragmented. Processing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 太好了，最后一份定理，而且完整无缺。正在运算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: Oh, Wait, Limbo, no, that's a mistake, you don't want to go there. It's too big a jump. You can't rift walk… ohh. Oh, no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 噢，等等，Limbo，不，那一步算错了。你不能去那里，跨度太大了。你不能从那里进入裂隙漫游……噢，糟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.text: Operator, I think I know why we're finding Limbo parts scattered throughout the system. His final rift walk was a miscalc... disaster. Well, perhaps when you occupy this frame, you will use more… caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQChas.zhText: 指挥官，我想我知道为什么 Limbo 的部件会散落在星系各处了。他最后那次裂隙漫游的计算失误……是灾难。嗯，换上这套战甲时，希望您能更……谨慎一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text:
[5.8]
So, this 'Limbo Theorem' you picked up, it's supposed to lead to a new Warframe?
[7.5]
Well, it's woefully incomplete?
[12.5]
Half-written proofs, unfinished equations, what idiot wrote this mess??
[19.5]
Okay. Okay. There is one thing here, a constant, a tuning frequency.
[26]
But it's so minute, the Orbiter's antenna would never be able to… unless…
[30]
Go to your nav console, I have an idea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 那么，您捡到的这个「Limbo 定理」，是否代表能找到一台新战甲的下落？可惜，它缺得太厉害了！证明过程只写了一半，方程也没算完。哪个白痴写的这玩意儿？？好了，好了。这里还有一点线索：一个常量，一段调谐频率。但是频率太过微弱，轨道飞行器的天线永远无法……除非……前往您的导航控制台，我有个主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: These equations will continue to be a jumble of nothing until we recover all the missing proof fragments and reforge this Theorem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 除非我们复原所有缺失的证明片段，否则它们就是一团杂乱无章的东西，一点意义都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: If you want to have any chance of recovering Limbo, you have to find those proof fragments to complete the Theorem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 如果您想找回 Limbo，就必须得找出那些证明算式的片段来补全定理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: Good, now we get to find out what all this Limbo nonsense is about. I await the Theorem's completion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 太好了，我们现在开始着手完善 Limbo 定理了。我期待补全的那一天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: Okay, good, you've… wait… the horizon mass cannot be not inverted to this is preposterous!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 嗯，很好，您已经……等等……这个位面缝隙无法被逆转，简直荒谬至极！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: Operator, I'm sorry. You did all this work and this so called Theorem is still completely invalid. It's as if all these proofs point to nothingness, it's just utterly irrational!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 指挥官，我很抱歉。您费了这么大劲，结果这个所谓的「定理」依然完全不成立。经过奥迪斯计算，这些证明算式通通指向虚无，这完全不合理！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: There's only one valid coordinate in the entire proof, I've marked it on your navigation console but I'm sure it's a waste of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 整个证明式中只有一个坐标有效。我标记在您的导航控制台上了，不过这应该也只是白跑一趟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.text: A Limbo part blueprint! The Theorem wasn't complete malarkey after all. Perhaps there's more to these equations than I previously thought, what am I missing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQHelm.zhText: 一份 Limbo 的部件蓝图！看来定理也不全是胡扯。或许这些公式里还有别的门道。我到底漏掉了什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: Operator, I'm pleased to report that we are in full control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 指挥官，很高兴告诉您，我方已控制所有塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: may I suggest you capture a tower?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 他们要赢了！我建议您可以去占领一座塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: Operator, they have all four towers. Stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 指挥官，他们占据四座塔台了。阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: They're on to us now but if you would like, we can attempt another scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 他们盯上我们了，但如果您愿意，我们可以再次扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: Scan complete, now we must clean up. Kill them all!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 扫描完成，现在我们必须清场了。把他们全杀了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: Excellent, we have completed the scan. May I suggest turning every last enemy into scrap!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 太棒了，我们已完成扫描。我建议您把每个敌人都变成废铁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: If there are any proof fragments bouncing around this "Limbo frequency" these radio towers will pick it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 如果还有片段游离在「Limbo 频段」上，这些无线电台就能捕捉到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: We will attempt another scan of the frequency. I do hope you manage to pick something up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 我们再扫描一次这段频率。希望这次您能有所发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: The scan is complete. Did you find any Proof Fragments?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 扫描完成。您发现证明片段了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: Scan completed. Were you able to recover any Proof Fragments?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 扫描完成。您成功回收到证明片段了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: A tower has been captured, scanning the Limbo frequency now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 已占领塔台，正在扫描 Limbo 频率。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.text: We are now in control of this tower.
They took control of our tower make them pay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQInte.zhText: 他们夺走了塔台的控制权，让他们付出代价！
不！他们占领了我们的塔台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: Operator, I found a new theorem hidden deep in that Warframe part. These are actually starting to make sense, I mean they're nonsense but there's logic in the nonsense. It's almost as if someone's trying to speak to me in my own language.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 指挥官，我发现在战甲部件深处还藏着另一份定理，感觉一切都能说得通了。我的意思是，它们虽然荒谬，但荒谬之中却有逻辑。仿佛有人正用我的语言在跟我沟通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: This new theorem is equally full of gaps, please, find more proof fragments.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 这个新定理同样残缺不全，拜托，请找出更多证明片段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: What is he trying to say? My apologies, operator, I get a little worked up when it comes to physics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 他到底想说什么？！非常抱歉，指挥官，一涉及到物理学，我就容易激动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: Please do find the rest of those proofs. I must solve these equations, the suspense is killing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 请务必找齐剩下的证明。我一定要解开这些公式，我的好奇心快把我折磨疯了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: Now it's becoming clear. Could it be that there's a plane between our normal plane and the void? A space between space, a rift? A rift that this Limbo could control?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 现在事情逐渐明朗了。难道在我们所处的位面与虚空之间，还有另一个特殊位面吗？空间之间的夹层——一道裂缝？难道 Limbo 能控制裂缝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: Oh and I've marked your navigation console, I think you'll be quite pleased with what you find there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 噢，我已经标记在导航控制台上了。相信那里的发现不会让您失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: Operator, do you understand? This Limbo is telling us his story in pure math, and I must say, he's quite witty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 指挥官，您明白吗？Limbo 正用纯粹的数学向我们诉说自己的故事。不得不说，他真的很聪明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.text: You have to forge that blueprint as soon as possible. I must know what comes next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLQSyst.zhText: 您必须尽快打造蓝图，我一定要知道接下来会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLimeri.text: Operator, did you enjoy that poem? Ordis is composing one as well, it begins: A scumbag Corpus from Venus...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLimeri.zhText: 指挥官，您喜欢那首诗吗？Ordis 也创作了一首，开头是这样的：忽见天上一火链……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLowTen.text: Tenno, your numbers have become too few to complete this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DLowTen.zhText: Tenno，你们剩余的人手已不足以完成任务。
