/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: In his gluttony, Mr. Anyo took more than Mycona's most promising youth, he left the colony defenseless. Three gateways lead into the colony. They all need to be shut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 那名安尤先生的贪婪毫无止境。他不仅劫走了麦科那的孩子们，还破坏了殖民地的防御。一共有3条通道通往殖民地，必须全部关闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: For generations, the Myconians have kept these creatures at bay using something they call the Triuna. A powerful force and an ancestral secret, it pacifies Infested, making life amongst the scourge somehow possible. Without it, their way of life is threatened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 很长时间以来，Mycona 人一直用一种叫做"圣脉"的东西抵挡怪物。那是一个古老的秘密，它能平息畸变体的攻击性，让人能在疾病当中生存。没有了它，他们的生存方式岌岌可危。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: See those Infested tumors? Growing with malignancy as greed did among the Corpus when I was there. The Myconians can't close the gates until these growths are destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 看到那些畸变肿瘤了吗？它只知道无休止地增长。当我还在 Corpus 商会的时候，他们的贪婪就像这肿瘤一样恶毒。必须摧毁这些赘生物，否则 Mycona 人没法关闭大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: The colonists are going to force the security gate closed. Don't let the Infested get to them. Don't let greed win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 殖民者正在准备强行关闭大门。不要让畸变体伤害到他们。不要让贪婪获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: There's only one colonist left. If they're killed… Their way of life… A whole culture… Tenno, keep them safe!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 只剩下一个殖民者了。如果他们死光……他们的生存方式……他们的全部文明……Tenno，保护好他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: One door has been closed, two remain. Carry on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 关掉一道门，还剩两道。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: When that gluttonous freak, Mr. Anyo, attacked this colony he went straight for the Triuna. He left these people defenseless and for what, profit? Typical Corpus mindset.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 那个贪婪的疯子，我是说安尤先生，进攻殖民地的时候，他直奔圣脉而去。他让这些人变得无依无靠，而他的目的是什么？利益？Corpus 都是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: Here's the second security gate. Destroy the Infestation, so the colonists can force it closed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 这是第二道安全门。打败畸变疾病，让殖民者关闭大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: That's it. Now make sure the Myconians can finish the job and close the gate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 好了。现在保护好这些 Mycona 人，让他们关闭大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: Progress! Only one more to go.

These people are survivors. Over generations, they've adapted, learning to live among the Infestation. To earn a living, as all should have the right to do, never asking for charity. Like the Perrin Sequence, they were Corpus once, but they too sought future free from the corruption of boundless greed. If only Mr. Anyo shared this vision.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 这些人生存不易。经过很长时间，他们才适应与疾病共存的生活方式。他们自力更生，从来不祈求外界怜悯。他们绝对有权生存下去。他们也曾经是 Corpus 的成员，就像佩兰数列一样，但他们也抛弃了商会里无尽的贪婪和腐败。如果安尤先生也有这种眼光该多好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: You know what to do, take out the growths.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 你知道怎么做，摧毁那些赘生物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: Here come the Colonists. Make sure they can finish their job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 殖民者来了。确保他们完成操作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: You did it. The Myconians are safe… but only for the moment. Get back to your ship, and I'll explain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 成功了。Mycona 人已经安全……但仅限于眼下。回飞船上吧，我会慢慢解释。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.text: The colony is sealed, but it's still crawling with Infested. Clear them out so the Myconians can have their home back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMisSec.zhText: 殖民地已经封锁了，但里面还是爬满了畸变体。把这里清理干净，帮 Mycona 人夺回家园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Operator, what in stars could this possibly mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 指挥官，这个在星系里到底是什么意思呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text:
Three parts, three acts, three riddles for thee -
to revive the one wielding fantasy
Ancient gods so cruel, once ruled from on high
Can you name their peak where the land meets the sky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText:
"为您准备了三个部件，三幕演出，三道谜题。
去复活那位运用幻想之力之人
曾高高在上的上古神明如此残忍
阁下可知何为大地与天空接壤之处的最高峰？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: I found this inscribed on that Orokin Artifact you just crafted. You should check your inbox for more information.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 我在您刚制作的奥罗金神器上发现这行铭文。您可以查看收件箱了解更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: There's strange energy in the area. A void imprint, an old one. I'm getting faint visuals - memories. Continue the mission while I investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 这片区域有股异常能量。是虚空印痕……非常古老。我看到了一些模糊的画面——是记忆。继续执行任务，我来调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: The Void imprint... it's old. I see... Worm ships coming out of punch! A Warframe fighting Sentients... shields are failing... Sorry, Tenno, I'm not sure what that was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 这个虚空印痕……非常古老。我看见……虫形战舰跃迁而出！一具战甲正在与 Sentient 交战……护盾正在崩溃……抱歉，Tenno。我还无法确定刚才看到的究竟是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: I see the Sentients crashing down on her, dying in overwhelming numbers. Now she's out of energy, I'm telling her to go but she's laughing, tearing their heads off as they swarm. I have recovered something from the memory... a blueprint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 我看见 Sentient 如潮水般扑向她，又成片倒下。现在她的能量耗尽了，我让她撤退，可她却在笑……敌人蜂拥而上，她就一个个扯下它们的头。我从这段记忆中找回了一样东西……一张蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Tenno, this is an important discovery - a Warframe design that was thought lost. Have Ordis construct that blueprint, it could give us a clue to where the next memory is hidden.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: Tenno，这是个重大发现——一份早已被认为失传的战甲设计。让奥迪斯制造这张蓝图，它或许能指引我们找到下一段尘封的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Operator, exciting news. Ordis found another inscription on Mirage's helmet. Allow me to recite it:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 指挥官，好消息。Ordis 在 Mirage 战甲的头盔上发现了另外的铭文。让我给您读：

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text:
To build the one you think witty,
seek the nymph who sang oh so pretty.
She lured him in with her song and a grin,
his wife must've thought it a pity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText:
为了打造阁下心目中睿智的形象，
去寻找拥有美丽歌喉的神仙女郎。
她以歌声和笑容俘获他的心房，
他的妻子肯定醋意满腔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: For closer inspection, I've placed the inscription in your inbox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 为了检查，我已将铭文添加到了收件箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: I'm sensing another void imprint. It's dark. I see the glow of restraints around the Warframe. I'm trying to surge the revive system but I can't, I'm too far away. A great, faceted eye watches her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 我感应到了另一个虚空印痕。这里很暗……我看见战甲周围亮着束缚装置的光。我试图强行启动复活系统，但做不到……我离得太远了。一只巨大的复眼正注视着她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: I tell her I won't lose her. That I have another ship on its way. She is smiling because she knows I am lying... Tenno... the second blueprint has been recovered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 我告诉她，我不会失去她。我说另一艘船正在赶来的路上。可她在笑……因为她知道我在撒谎。 Tenno……第二张蓝图也找到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Construct the Warframe component so we can decipher the next clue. Though I must admit, Tenno, I'm not sure I want to know what happens next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 制造这个战甲部件，我们才能解开下一条线索。但我必须承认，Tenno……我不确定自己是否真的想知道接下来发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Operator, another Mirage inscription:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 指挥官，又有关于  Mirage 的铭文：

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text:
One more act before your prize is caught.
An ancient sea creature, take a whirl or not?
Look for the monster that swallowed sailors of yore.
Make a mistake and you're sunk. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText:
离阁下的奖赏仅剩一步之遥。
一个古老的海洋生物，有没有把阁下吓倒？
寻找那吞噬古代水手的怪物。
任何失误都将使勇士葬身海潮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Ordis has placed all the information in your inbox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: Ordis 已将所有信息放入您的信箱中了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: I see the eyes open and the heat blinds me. I hear her comforting me, telling me not to despair as the Warframe disintegrates and I lose her, forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 我看见那只眼睛睁开，炽热的光芒令我目眩。我听见她反过来安慰我，告诉我不要绝望……而她的战甲逐渐崩解。我就这样……永远失去了她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Tenno, the last piece of her... of Mirage... has been recovered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: Tenno，她最后的一部分……Mirage 最后的遗物……也找到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: Tenno, that was the last of the imprints. Forge this Warframe in honor of these memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: Tenno，那是最后一道印痕了。铸造这具战甲，让这些记忆得以延续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text:
Three acts complete, the end draws near,
soon Mirage will cause enemy fear.
A memory lost, to be reborn,
This new warrior rises, duty sworn."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText:
三幕表演完毕，结局即将到来，
很快 Mirage 将使敌人畏惧。
失去记忆，以获新生，
全新勇士即将崛起，誓要承担使命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.text: That was the final inscription. Ordis is almost sad there won't be more. Almost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMissio.zhText: 这就是最后的铭文了。就只有这些了，Ordis 有点不爽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.text: A Balor Fomorian Core! We can use this to draw out Vay Hek. Make sure it reaches extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.zhText: 是巴罗尔巨人战舰核心！我们可以用它引出韦·海克。务必将其护送至撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.text: Protect this core, Tenno. There is much we can glean from how the Balor Fomorians are powered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.zhText: Tenno，保护好核心。我们能从巴罗尔巨人战舰的动力原理中获得大量情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.text: Tenno. So obedient. Doctor Tengus could learn so much from your insides... So I've brought his creations to extract them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.zhText: Tenno，真是听话啊。天狗博士肯定很想研究研究你们的内脏哈哈哈哈…… 所以我带来了他的造物，来亲自动手「取样」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.text: The core will help greatly in defending against future Fomorian attacks, but we must return to our purpose. Hek has retreated to Phobos. Track him down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DMsnTwo.zhText: 这枚核心将大幅提升我们未来抵御巨人战舰袭击的能力。不过，别忘了真正的目标。海克已经撤往火卫一。别让他逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.text: Stop them, Shadow. Do not let the child's power rejoin the sky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.zhText: 阻止他们，黑影。不要让孩子的力量重回天穹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.text: I don't know how much time you have. Descend into the heart of your Orbiter, there you will find the Somatic Link.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.zhText: 我不知道你还有多少时间。去飞船下层的核心区吧，在那里找到活体连接器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.text: Get past him, get to the Link.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.zhText: 想办法绕过他，去装置那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.text: Focus your energy, get past the Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.zhText: 专心汇聚能量，绕过追猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.text: Focus, Tenno, use your energy to breathe life into the Somatic Link.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DOrbite.zhText: 集中精神，Tenno，把你的能量注入活体连接器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.text: Time is credit, Tenno, so we'll forgo the usual formalities. We have a dire problem, you see, concerning the Mycona people. Have you heard of them? Hmmm… I see… Well, they are quite resourceful, unusual really. The Mycona earn their living by harvesting the biological products of the Infested! A dangerous trade and we Perrin have always given them fair value for their goods… but I've received disturbing news. That cleric of greed, Nef Anyo, has raided their colony, making off with more than just the resources they depend on. It seems he took—well, here, look at this...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.zhText: 时间就是金钱，Tenno 战士，所以让我们省略客套话吧。我们遇到一个严重的问题。你听说过 Mycona 人吗？嗯……好吧……他们是一群很聪明的人，而且很特殊。Mycona 人靠收获畸变体的生物产品为生！这是一门很危险的手艺，所以我们佩兰数列总是给他们公道的价格……但最近，我收到一些令人不安的消息。那个贪婪的传道者，奈富·安尤，抢劫了他们的殖民地。除了掳走大批物资，他还……唉，你自己看吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.text: The dark-eyed man smashed our colony gates and kidnapped us. Locked us in here. But I don't care. It's mom and dad I'm worried about. Without the gates, the Mumblers will be coming. They'll get sick, they'll start to mumble too. That can't happen! Papa says I'm blessed, so maybe I should pray? I'll pray for the Tenno to come. I'll pray for the Tenno to save my family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.zhText: 有个黑眼圈的人打破殖民地大门，把我们抢走了。把我们关在这。不过我不在乎。我只担心爸爸和妈妈。没有了大门，低语者会进来的。他们会生病，他们也会开始低语。这样可不行！爸爸说我是特殊的，所以我是不是应该祈祷一下？我祈祷 Tenno 出现，祈祷 Tenno 来救我的家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.text: That's Neewa. She was taken along with several more Myconian children. Those who remain are under siege from the Infestation! Before we can rescue Neewa and the other captives, we must first restore the Myconian's defenses. Our financial strength is useless against the mindless horde, we need Tenno muscle. Will you help Neewa's people?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.zhText: 这是 Neewa。她，还有好几名 Mycona 儿童都被掳走了。剩下的人正在被畸变疾病围攻！在援救 Neewa 和其他囚犯之前，我们必须先修复 Mycona 的防御设施。面对这些没有思考的怪物，我们的财力毫无用处。我们需要 Tenno 出手。你是否愿意帮助 Neewa 的人民？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.text: Such generosity! I knew the Myconians could rely on you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPerrin.zhText: 多么慷慨！我就知道 Mycona 人可以指望你，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.text: Inaros, it's an honor to serve you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.zhText: Inaros，能为您效劳是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.text: It brings joy to my heart to see Inaros in action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.zhText: 亲眼目睹 Inaros 再现神威，我太激动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.text: Tenno, you honor my people with your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DPostQu.zhText: Tenno，你的战甲为我族带来了莫大的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I know. Forgive me. This is who you really are. A Tenno. More than human… but once a child like any other. What do you remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我懂。原谅我，这才是真正的你——Tenno。你不是普通人……但你也曾经是个普通的孩子。你都记得什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: A jumble of words, numbers... I must have known everything about Tau. Our teacher loved when I corrected her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 很多词语，还有数字……我肯定对 Tau 星系了如指掌。我们的老师特别喜欢听我纠正她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: A jumble of words, numbers... I must have known everything about Tau. Our teacher loved when I corrected her.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: The soft lines of a hand, my mother's, I think. We were watching the stars, awaiting the jump to Tau. She was afraid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 一双温柔的手，我想是我的母亲。我们一起看星星，等待跳跃到 Tau 星系。她很害怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I remember everyone was laughing outside an airlock. This kid had a boy by the throat. I didn't think it was funny at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我记得他们在气匣外面笑。有个孩子掐着一个男孩的喉咙。这一点也不好笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: Memories. From your time aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, before the Void-Jump accident. It was years before the ship was recovered. It was drifting dead in space, all her crew gone… except the children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 这些记忆。从你登上扎里曼 10-0 号开始，直到虚空跳跃事故之前。很多年以后，飞船才被发现。它在太空中漂流，所有船员都失踪了……除了那些孩子们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I didn't want to live anymore. I felt guilty that I was alive, but we could do things, extraordinary things. ^Maybe there was a reason we survived?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我不想再活下去了。我对自己还活着感到内疚。但我们能做到一些事情，一些非凡的事情。也许那就是我们活下来的理由？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: We were just kids but... they were afraid of what we could do. ^When they tried to treat us like rats I stood up to them. ^I wasn't going to let them divide us after what we'd been through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我们只是孩子，但……他们害怕我们的力量。他们把我们当成老鼠，所以我反抗了。我们已经经历过这么多，我不会再让他们把我们分开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: We were dangerous, broken. ^Every time they tried to fix us, someone always got hurt. ^I wish I could have saved them. ^I wish I could have taken their fear away.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: You were so brave - but the Orokin were afraid of you. The Void had changed you and you couldn't control it, no one could. They were about to destroy the orphans of Ten-Zero but Margulis... she loved you, she found a way...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 你表现得很勇敢，但奥罗金人害怕你们。虚空改变了你，你控制不了自己，谁也不能。他们想销毁天元号的遗孤，但 Margulis……她爱你们，她找出一个方法……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: She put us into the dream, brought us peace. ^I remember we could still hear her voice, raging at the leaders for their mistreatment of us. ^When they executed her… well… I could not let that go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 她让我们沉入梦境，找回平和。我记得，梦里也能听到她的声音，她为了保护我们高声反抗那些大人物。后来他们判她死刑……我……我不能放过他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: We couldn't help it, the outbursts. ^We hurt her, blinded her, but even then, she never abandoned us. ^In the dream we found peace, and she sang to us in that cold, dark...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我们控制不了力量。我们伤害了她，弄瞎了她的眼睛，但她没有舍弃我们。在梦里，我们找回安宁。梦里很冷，很暗，她给我们唱歌……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: The Orokin murdered Margulis - used her work to create 'Transference'. Your mind - projected into a surrogate, strong enough to withstand your power. It felt like waking up, but it was just a lucid - second dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 奥罗金人杀了 Margulis，用她的成果造出"传识系统"。你的心灵被投射到替身里，它足以承受你的力量。感觉就好像从梦中醒来，但那只是一个清醒的梦中梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: And so you became Tenno. Serving the Orokin… but bound by honor. As the Tenno grew, they founded great schools. The Tenno Ways. Do you see yours?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 因此你成为了 Tenno。服从于奥罗金……但有着自己的荣耀。随着 Tenno 壮大，他们创立了许多博大精深的学派。Tenno 之道。你看到了属于自己的那条道路了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I see a tree, of many branches, the Naramon Way. Our discipline focused on Knowing The Enemy. ^We believed that to truly understand a foe would confer the greatest advantage upon a warrior.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我看见一颗巨树，它是那么枝繁叶茂。那是 Naramon 之道。我们的信条在于了解敌人的一切。我们深信知敌之道，才可以做到百战不殆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: But we have so much more to do. Here in the Orbiter Transference will be even stronger. Command the Warframes… Make whole, this shattered world you've been given. Are you ready, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 但我们还有更多事要做。在这艘飞船上的传识效应将比以往更强。继续操纵战甲吧……把这个破碎世界修复完好。准备好了吗，Tenno 战士？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: Yes, Lotus. I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 是的，莲（Lotus）。我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: Yes, Lotus. I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 是的，莲（Lotus）。我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: Yes, Lotus. I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 是的，莲（Lotus）。我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: Yes, Lotus. I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 是的，莲（Lotus）。我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I need to think through it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我需要再考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I need to think it through again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我需要再考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I need to think through it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我需要再考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.text: I need to think it through again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DQuesti.zhText: 我需要再考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapO.text: I have tracked Maroo to this Corpus outpost. Bring her to me for questioning. Be as persuasive as necessary, she may not want to come with us but it's in her best interest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapO.zhText: 我追踪到了麦罗的下落，就在这座科普斯前哨站里。把她带回来审问。必要的时候，好好「劝劝」她。她可能不愿意跟我们走，但这都是为了她好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapO.text: The Arcane Codices have been a mystery ever since they were uncovered decades ago. They appear to be part of a set that was incomplete until the Grineer found this final code. Without the full set nobody can agree on what exactly they are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapO.zhText: 秘奥法典自数十年前被发现以来，始终是个谜团。它们似乎属于一个完整系列，而克隆尼找到这最后一部法典，才让它们得以补全。不集齐完整的一套，没人能确定它们究竟是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapT.text: Maroo, I am the Lotus. I come as a friend. You are in mortal danger and you need to come with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapT.zhText: 麦罗，我是莲，是你的朋友。你现在有生命危险，必须马上跟我们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: The Grineer have plunged these depths and awakened an old evil submerged here. Capture the Sergeant, he will know where this tomb is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: Grineer 潜入深海、惊醒了淹没在此的古老邪物。捕获那名中士，他知道古墓在何处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: Teshin! You don't have the authority. You are endangering the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 泰辛！你没有这个权限。你这是在拿 Tenno 的安危冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: So… the petals have opened once more. But why now? Afraid of what we'll find?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 看啊……花瓣再次盛开了，但为何是在这个时刻？是怕我们即将迎来的事物？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: I had to cover my tracks. But I see that Teshin has been leading you into an even greater danger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 我不得不掩盖自己的踪迹。但看来，泰辛正把你卷入更大的危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: The beast soon stirs, Lotus, revealing much. It will awaken and become whole again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 伏兽躁动在即，莲（Lotus），真相逐渐明朗。它很快就会苏醒并再次崛起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: You know this one, don't you?
He knows where the tomb is - apprehend him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 这名中士知道古墓在哪里－擒住他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: We have our target. Advance to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 我们逮到目标了，往撤离点迈进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: Speak, Lotus. The pieces are set. It is your move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 说吧，莲（Lotus）。拼图的最后一块已经拼上，轮到你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.text: Tyl Regor must be stopped from entering the tomb. I have to risk exposure to stop him. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQCapt.zhText: 必须阻止泰尔·雷工进入那座墓穴。我不得不冒着暴露的风险来阻止他。去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: A focused blast could release the magma flows beneath and rebury the tomb. Protect the bomb during its lengthy arming process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 一次定点爆破可以引出地下岩浆，让墓穴再次被掩埋。保护炸弹，直到漫长的启动程序完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Destroy this tomb? Destroy our history? Vandals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 破坏这座古墓？破坏我们 Grineer 的历史？你们这些破坏者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Those who pilfer meat from lions are either foolish or starving, which are you Regor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 那些想从狮子眼前拿肉的人，不是愚蠢就是饥饿所迫。你属于哪一种，雷工？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Natah, why did you betray me? Why did you not finish the sequence you started? Why did you stop at the last?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: Natah，你为何要背叛我？你为何没有完成你发起的程序？你为何要在最后停下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: What is it talking about Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 它在说关于莲（Lotus）的什么事情？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: We crossed the gap, wombs in ruin, to bring an end to this. We severed the worlds, let them destroy me, why is the sequence not complete?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 我们穿越裂隙，牺牲我们的母体，为这一切带来终结。我们切断了通道，让他们摧毁了我，为何程序仍未完成？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Most intriguing, Lotus, do you two have a history?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 太吸引人了，莲(Lotus)，你们两个之间有历史啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: My own daughter. The last of my womb. How can you do this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 我的女儿，我最后的母体，你怎能这样做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Lotus. What are you not telling us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 莲(Lotus)，你还有什么没告诉我们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Focus Teshin. We need focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 泰辛，集中精神。我们现在必须专注。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Hold on Tenno, it's almost armed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 撑住 Tenno。炸弹就快引爆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: You betrayed us. As I awake, so will they. They will say you're riven and want to reclaim you. I will not be able to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 你背叛我们。一旦我苏醒，它们也会醒来。它们会说你分裂了，并收回你，我无法阻止它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Finish the sequence and I will forgive you. Fail at this and you will be reclaimed by your own Father.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 完成程序，我就会原谅你。在此失败，你将会被你的父亲收回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Natah? Lotus? You cannot hide this past any longer-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: Natah？莲(Lotus)？你不能再继续隐瞒这段过去——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: There are gaps. I had my mission and I have completed it. All but the last sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 我的记忆有些缺失。我曾肩负使命，也完成了它……除了最后一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: To destroy the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 摧毁 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: The war was over. So I hid them away in the second dream. I could not destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 战争结束后，我把他们藏进了第二场梦。我无法下手摧毁他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: And yet you were born to. So tell me... What made you stop? To reject your nature?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 然而你必须摧毁他们。所以，告诉我……你为何收手？抗拒你的本性？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: All missions to the Origin system required a sacrifice. Me and my kind become barren when crossing the gap. It is the one flaw that we never overcame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 所有前往始源星系的任务，都必须付出代价。我和我的同族穿越那道鸿沟后，便会失去生育能力。那是我们始终无法克服的唯一缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Natah wanted children of her own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: Natah 想要有自己的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.text: Natah was the daughter until I destroyed her. Now I am the Lotus. Now I am the mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQDefe.zhText: 娜塔曾是女儿，直到我亲手终结了她。现在，我是莲，也是一位母亲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInbo.text:
Oh, so you tin-suits want to know about that Arcane Codex? Heh, is that all?^ 
Okay here goes. Tyl Regor offered up big time credits for me to pull the code from some strange machine on an Infested Orokin Derelict.^
Thing is, I never much liked the Grineer, so the code I pulled ain't the code I gave em. Heh, I guess they've finally figured that out?^
I bet you're looking to get your hands on the code? Too bad, I already sold em to the Corpus… Now, if you were to make it worth my while? Maybe I'd tell you where they're keeping it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInbo.zhText:
哦，你们这帮铁皮罐头想了解秘奥法典？呵呵，就这？
好吧，听好了！泰尔·雷工开出高价，让我去被感染的奥罗金遗迹里，从某台奇怪的机器上把代码弄出来。
问题是，我向来就看克隆尼不太顺眼，所以我给他们的代码根本不是我拿到的那个。哈哈，估计他们终于反应过来了？
我猜你们也特别想拿到代码吧？可惜，我已经把代码卖给科普斯了……不过嘛，你们要是能给我点开口费，也许我可以向你们透露它的去处……怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Operator, I've been looking into these Arcane Codices. Did you know the Corpus are in possession of three codices and the Grineer two?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 指挥官，我一直在调查这些秘奥法典。您知道吗？科普斯有三部法典，克隆尼有两部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: And now the Tenno have one too. Nobody has ever examined them all together, that's our plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 现在 Tenno 也有一部了。但还从没有人把这些法典集齐后一起研究过，这就是我们的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: The Corpus seem think they'll lead to some lost Orokin treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 科普斯似乎认为，这些法典能指引他们找到失落的奥罗金宝藏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Ordo, did you say treasure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 小奥，你刚刚是说宝藏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: It's Ordis, and while just a theory, it is plausible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 是奥迪斯，虽然只是推测，但确实有迹可循。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Either way, it's right up my alley.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 无论如何，这活儿都正合我的胃口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Operator, have you looked at these codices? They're absolutely beautiful. Composed with such elegance and grace, I have never seen anything like them. Is there even an Operator capable of writing anything so perfect?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 指挥官，您仔细看过这些法典了吗？它们简直精美绝伦。如此精致优雅，我从没见过这样的代码。就算是指挥官，也不一定能写出如此完美的东西吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: But you still have no idea what they mean, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 但你还是不知道它们是什么意思，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: No, not really, pfft… well, I wouldn't expect the likes of you to understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 是的，确实不明白。切……好吧，我也不指望你这种人能听懂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Operator, these make sense now! This is machine code, meant to interface directly with a machine. Pity that machine has likely rusted into dust by now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 指挥官，一切都说得通了！这是机器代码，需要与机器配套使用。可惜那台机器现在多半已经锈成渣了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: ORDO? Did you say something about a machine?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 小奥，你刚才是提到了机器吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Ordis' name is Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 奥迪斯的名字叫奥迪斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Yah, yah. Listen, that first codex in the derelict, I pulled it from some sort of machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 好，好。听着，我在遗迹里找到的第一部法典，其实是我从某种机器里拔出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Hmmm, I wonder, if we load the complete set of Arcane Codices back into that machine, would the code still execute?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 嗯，我在想，如果我们把全套法典重新加载到那台机器上，代码是否还能运行？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: We're about to find out. Tenno, get ready to go into the void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 很快就知道答案了。Tenno，准备好进入虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: So you're saying there was no treasure, no cure for cloning syndrome, no lost Tenno Cephalon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 所以你的意思是，那里没有宝藏，没有治愈克隆衰败症的方法，也没有失踪的 Tenno 中枢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Ordo, there was nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 小奥，那里什么都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: That really is a shame Maroo, I am sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 真可惜，麦罗，真替你难过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Nah, I'm used to it. When you don't run with any the major factions or syndicates, the big pay days are few and far between. I'll manage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 算了，早习惯了。不跟这些大势力或者集团混，本来也没什么机会发大财。混口饭吃总不难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.text: Listen, I can't say it hasn't been fun, but with the Arcane Codices gone, I think it's safe for me to venture back out into the wild. Cya, Tin-Suits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQInte.zhText: 听着，虽说这一趟挺有意思，但是既然秘奥法典已经没了，现在也该准备重新回去闯荡闯荡了。回见，铁皮罐头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.text: This is unexpected. After decades of searching, the Grineer finally uncovered the last of the Arcane Codices only to lose it to some thief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.zhText: 真是没想到，经过几十年的搜寻，克隆尼终于挖掘出了最后一部秘奥法典，结果却落到了别人手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.text: Tyl Regor must be livid, which means this Maroo is real trouble. I need to have a word with her before the Grineer do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.zhText: 泰尔·雷工肯定会大发雷霆。看来这个麦罗惹上了大麻烦。在克隆尼找到她之前，我得先和她谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.text: Arcane Codices, why have I never heard of them? Ordis needs to do some research.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQIntr.zhText: 秘奥法典？为什么奥迪斯从没听说过呢？我需要去查一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: The ghost you saw is of a menace long thought dead. They study us, study our enemies. Let us sharpen our knowledge of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 你所见到的幽灵，属于早被认为死去的威胁。它观察我们，也观察我们的敌人。我们必须进一步了解它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: Are these ghosts mere echoes of the past? Or are they more sinister, harbingers, calling for the old beast to awake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 这些幽灵单纯只是过去的回音？还是某种更加邪恶的先兆，在用声音唤醒远古恶兽？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: Here, this console will serve my purpose. Unlike your Lotus, I will not keep its secrets from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 就是这儿，这个控制台正合我意。与莲不同，我不会对你隐瞒真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: Exercise your training, defend the console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 展现你的修练成果，防守这个控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: I have what I seek. Move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 我得到了想要的东西，启程吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: My task is complete but the puzzle calls for one last piece. Advance to the final console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 我的任务已经达成，但这幅拼图还缺最后一块，朝最后一个控制台迈进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: This is it, the answers we seek lie within.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 就是这个，我们在寻求的答案就在其中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: Use this combat to sharpen your blades, I predict you will need them in coming battles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 让这场战斗磨砺你的刀刃，我预感往后的战斗你用得着它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: I have found that which wanted to be hidden. Advance to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 我发现了那些想刻意隐藏的东西，朝撤离点迈进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: This Grineer is smarter than the others. More volatile. We need to be cautious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 这名克隆尼比其他同类更聪明，也更暴躁。我们得谨慎些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.text: Find his Sergeant, pupil. He will lead us to this 'tomb'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQMobi.zhText: 找到他的中士，弟子。他能带领我们找到这座「古墓」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPost.text:
Tenno! You seal my tomb… you kill my tubemen. Not acceptable behavior… our differences need to be settled. 

So, you know where I am, come get me… just try.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPost.zhText: Tenno！你封印了我的古墓……你干掉了我的复制人。无法接受这种行为……我们之间的纠纷需要有个结果。那么，你知道我在哪里，来找我吧……来试试啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPost.text: Tenno, you know where Tyl is. When you are ready, destroy him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPost.zhText: Tenno，你知道泰尔在哪里。准备好后，去除掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPreQ.text: Tenno? What did you see? My data stream went dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPreQ.zhText: Tenno？你看见了什么？我的数据传输刚才中断了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPreQ.text: I am sensing some signal masking. It will take some time to decypher. Concentrate on your mission for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQPreQ.zhText: 我检测到了某种信号屏蔽。破解需要一点时间。先专注于眼下的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: Tenno, I don't know if we got the answers we come for, but there's nothing more here for us. Exit the Derelict and head for extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: Tenno，我不确定我们是否找到了想要的答案，但已经没必要留在这了。离开遗迹，前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: What? Where's my damn treasure. I was told there would be treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 什么？我的宝藏到底在哪？不是说好会有宝藏的吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: Whatever that was, it wasn't here for our benefit or yours. Only time will tell what we've just uncovered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 不管那是什么，对你我来说都没有任何好处。只有时间能给出答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: There it is, the machine I pulled the final Arcane Codex from. You've got the full set of codices, upload 'em and say hello to treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 就是那台机器。我从里面拔出了最后一份秘奥法典。你已经拿齐整套法典了，把它们全部上传，然后跟宝藏打个招呼吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: All is silent and calm. Hushed and empty is the womb of the sky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 万籁无声，天地归于宁寂。苍穹深处，徒留空寂虚无。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: The machine, it's gone. Tenno watch out.
Tenno, Maroo is the only person who has been on the inside of that derelict and lived to tell about it. She'll guide you through this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: Tenno，麦罗是唯一一个进入过遗迹内部，还能活着回来的人。她能帮助你完成这次任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: This is it. Your Lotus has promised me a cut of whatever treasure you find, so don't you tin-suits go messing this one up. Get to the void portal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 就是这儿了。你的莲答应过我，找到什么宝藏都有我一份。所以你们这些铁皮罐头可别搞砸了。进入虚空传送门吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: Maroo, I said 'if' there is any treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 麦罗，我说的是「如果」有宝藏的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: The Orokin were all about treasure, weren't they. The only question is, how much?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 奥罗金不就好这一口吗？唯一的问题在于，到底有多少？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.text: The Grineer have been trying to get inside this derelict for days but The Infested keep tearing them to shreds. Your Lotus seems to think you'll do better… we'll see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQRaid.zhText: 克隆尼这几天一直想闯进这座遗迹飞船，但都被感染者撕成了碎片。你们的莲好像觉得你们能做得更好……那就走着瞧吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: It doesn't seem very interested in you. Try to get a scan of what it's collecting, it may reveal its purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 它似乎对你不感兴趣。试着扫描它正在收集的东西，或许能查明它的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: I'm not getting a good feed. Is there an object they're pulling data from? Scan it for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 传回来的画面不清晰。它们是不是在从某个物体中提取数据？扫描一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: I'm not getting a signal but if you've found a drone, scan it before it notices you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 我接收不到信号。如果你找到了无人机，趁它还没发现你，立刻扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: Tenno, I need you to scan another drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: Tenno，我需要你再扫描一台无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: Good! I'm putting the stream together now - it's … it's an Oculyst? That means… I'm sorry, Tenno, stay safe-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 很好！我正在拼合数据流——这是……全视使？也就是说……抱歉，Tenno，小心——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: Hello? Did the Lotus just abandon the Operator get cut off? I have extraction ready. I think you should hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 哈啰？刚刚莲（Lotus）切断通讯抛下指挥官了吗？我已经在撤离点准备好了，我想，您最好赶紧动身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: Operator. Ordis knows what it is like to be abandoned. Don't worry, someone has offered to help us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 指挥官，Ordis 明白被抛弃的感觉。别担心，会有人来帮助我们的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.text: So, pupil, the spring has ended. The Lotus blossom has snapped shut, her true nature revealed. Now we shall see if codependence can be broken. Let us begin to unravel her long-hidden truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQScan.zhText: 那么，弟子，春天结束了。绽放的莲（Lotus）骤然合起花瓣，其本性已然显露。此刻我们将一同见证彼此的信任是否会裂解。让我们解开她深埋许久的真相吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyA.text: Smooth one tin-suit. Now, hurry up and get the data before it's destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyA.zhText: 挺有两下子嘛，铁皮罐头。抓紧时间，在数据被销毁前，赶紧弄到手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyA.text: Now you've gone and done it. Get to that console, quick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyA.zhText: 这下你可闯祸了。快去那个控制台！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyD.text: Too slow. Good thing there's another vault. Try not to mess things up next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyD.zhText: 太慢了。好在这里还有另一个密库。下次可别再搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyE.text: You've explored all the vaults and found that Arcane Codex. Your Lotus told me to tell you to get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyE.zhText: 你搜遍了所有密库，找到了那部秘奥法典。你的莲让我传话，叫你尽快去撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyE.text: You've got the codices and there is nothing more for us here. Get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyE.zhText: 法典到手了，我们在这里没别的事了。去撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyF.text: You managed to fail every vault. Maybe you're just not cut out for this type of work, tin-suit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyF.zhText: 你居然能把每个密库都搞砸。也许你根本就不适合干这行，铁皮罐头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyF.text: You have failed too many data vaults, the Codex has been destroyed. This mission is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyF.zhText: 你失败了太多次，法典已被销毁。任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyL.text: Again, really? You know we're here to take the data, right? You've got one more chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyL.zhText: 又来？说真的，你知道我们是来偷数据的对吧？你只剩最后一次机会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyN.text: The data vault is nearby. Do your best and try not to trip the alarms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyN.zhText: 数据密库就在这附近！尽力而为吧，可别触发报警。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: Listen up ya tin-suits, with the Grineer itching to torture the life out of me, I've accepted your Lotus's offer of protection. In return, I'm gonna help your sorry behinds find that Arcane Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 给我听好了，铁皮罐头们。克隆尼巴不得要把我折磨死，我就勉为其难接受了你们那个莲提供的庇护。作为回报，我会帮你们这群倒霉蛋找到那部秘奥法典。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: Maroo tells me that the Grineer are storing their two Arcane Codices on this Galleon. You need to find both to complete this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 麦罗告诉我，克隆尼把他们的两部法典藏在了这艘帆船战舰上。你必须集齐两者才能完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: We've tracked down the remaining Arcane Codices to this Corpus facility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 我们一路追踪，发现剩下的秘奥法典就在这座科普斯设施中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: My Tenno are quite capable, Maroo. Perhaps you would prefer it if we dropped you off outside the nearest Grineer mining asteroid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 麦罗，我的 Tenno 都很厉害。还是你更希望我们把你扔在最近的克隆尼采矿小行星附近？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: Wow, she always this much fun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 哇，她一直都这么爱说笑吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: Fine... here's the business. The Corpus are keeping the Codex in one of these fortified data vaults, you gotta break in and take what's yours without triggering the data destruction sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 行吧……说正事。科普斯把法典藏在了某个加固数据密库里。你得潜进去然后拿走你要的东西。但同时，不要触发数据销毁程序，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: The Grineer claim the Arcane Codices will help them to a cure for cloning decay syndrome. I think that might be wishful thinking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 克隆尼声称秘奥法典能帮助他们找到治愈克隆衰败症的方法。我看他们是在异想天开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: There are three data vaults and three Codices. Proceed with caution, if Corpus security destroy even one of these fragments this mission will be a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 这里有三间数据密库和三部法典。谨慎行事，只要科普斯安保系统毁掉任何一部，任务就失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.text: We have all the three codices, you may extract now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyO.zhText: 三部法典都到手了，现在你可以撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: Nice recovery. Had me worried for a second there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 漂亮的补救。刚才可真让我捏了把汗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: Well, it weren't pretty but you got what we were looking for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 好吧，虽然狼狈了点，但你要找的东西总算是到手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: Surprisingly impressive, you found the codex and the Corpus are none the wiser.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 还真有两把刷子，你找到法典了，科普斯还被蒙在鼓里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: There's the codex. There might be hope for you after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 那就是法典。看来你还算靠得住嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: Good work. You found an Arcane Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 做得好。你找到了一部秘奥法典。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.text: That's it. That's the Arcane Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyR.zhText: 就是它。这就是秘奥法典。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyV.text: You got that Codex. Why don't you see if the Corpus are hiding anything else in the other vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyV.zhText: 既然法典到手了，干脆顺便看看科普斯在其他密库里还藏了什么宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyV.text: Time to see if there's anything else in the remaining data vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSpyV.zhText: 是时候去看看剩下的密库里有什么好东西了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Get to the waypoint, I will give you further instructions when you get there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 前往路标点。到了那里，我再给你下一步指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: You've reached the waypoint. Access this system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 你已经抵达路标点。接入这个系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Knew it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 我就知道！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Little lizards can't resist another chance to get their sticky hands in my jar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 一般来说小蜥蜴们就是无法抗拒这种事情，就是把它们的那双黏黏滑滑的小手伸进我罐子里的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Tyl's cut off life support. Hold on Tenno. I am readying extraction but this will take time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 泰尔·雷工切断了维生装置。撑住，Tenno。我正在准备撤离，但还需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: The Sentient… the destroyer? The liberator? Depends on who you ask… But this, this thing is certain: I will have its secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: Sentient……毁灭者？哼，还是解放者？这取决于你问的是谁……但是，这一点是可以肯定的，那就是我将拥有它的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Pupil, maintain your balance. The enemy is zealous for your death, let them find only their own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 门徒，保持平衡。敌人疯狂执着于你的死亡，让他们见识自身的灭亡吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Funny, isn'it Tenno? I'm cracking open the Sentient's tomb and sealing yours at the same time. Not laughing? I dunno, I find it funny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 十分有趣，不是吗，Tenno 战士？ 我打开了 Sentient 的古墓，与此同时也顺手阖上了你的棺木。难道不笑一个嘛？ 我不是不懂，我觉得这句话很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: It's not a tomb Regor… it's a cage. If you open it-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 那不是古墓，雷工……那是牢笼。如果你打开它——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Is that Teshin? So the pseudo-Tenno lives… still drunk on your own honor? Shocked it hasn't rotted you through yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 你就是、就是那个 Teshin？ 所以……哼哈哈哈，所以那个假 Tenno 战士现在还活着啊……还沉溺于你的荣耀之中？ 我真的很惊讶你还没有因此而腐朽啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: So… the Sentient… nasty thing. Came from where? Who cares. They smashed the Orokin… freed us! How, how'd they do that? I want to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 所以……Sentient……这讨厌的东西，是从哪来的？ 谁在乎。它们毁了 奥罗金……解放了我们 Grineer！它们是怎么做到的，我想知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Drilling… hundreds of hours and just cracking through the sarcophagus now. Open wide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 不断地钻……不停地钻……钻了数百小时候后终于打开了石棺，现在，把它挖开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Entering, it's massive, empty. But where are they? Did they escape? Wait… what's this…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 进去了，这里很巨大、是空的，但它们呢？ 它们逃了？ 等等……这是什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Don't do it Regor…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 别去碰，雷工……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Look! Exilus, some primordial Forma? An engine for self-manipulation, what will it do for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 看啊！延展块，好像是一些最原始的塑性块？这是能自我控制的启动装置，这对我来说有何用处？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: What has he found?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 他究竟找到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: What was that…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 那是什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Not alone… who's there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 不只一个……谁在那里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Natah… where are you? You cannot hide from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: Natah……你在哪里？你躲不掉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: All of you, retreat, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 你们都后悔去吧

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Natah who have you become? Does this form remind you of what you once were? Time has carried my seed so very far from the branch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 你变为何人了，Natah？这副模样让你想起过去的身份了吗？时间已将我枝桠的种子带向了无边的远方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Extraction ready. Leave now. Get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 撤离准备完成。立刻离开。快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Pupil, what is your Lotus hiding? Who is Natah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 弟子，你的莲（Lotus）在隐瞒些什么？ 谁是Natah？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: My name, my old name. It is not who I am now. We need to focus on now, not history. We need to seal the tomb. A blast capable-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 我的名字……我过去的名字。那已经不是现在的我了。我们必须着眼当下，而不是过去。必须封住那座墓穴。只要爆炸威力够强——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: The Sentient is awake, Natah. It will not be contained for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: Sentient 苏醒了，Natah，这困不了它多久的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.text: Do not call me that. Containment will buy us time. Go now, Tenno, I will explain more when you reach the site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSQSurv.zhText: 别那样叫我。先封锁墓穴，多争取一点时间。快去 Tenno。等你抵达以后，我会再向你解释的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: Hunter, this target is my current obsession, I must know its every detail, will you oblige my passion?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 猎者，这个目标让我夜不能寐，我必须了解它的每一个细节。你愿意成全我的求知欲吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: I have a thirst for knowledge that only synthesis can satisfy. This being is the current object of my curiosity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 只有结合才能满足我对知识的渴求。眼前这生灵，正勾起我此刻的好奇心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: This specimen is shrouded in mystery, will you enlighten us with its imprint?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 这个样本蒙着一层神秘的面纱，你愿意用它的印痕，为我们带来启迪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: Synthesis will be the light that illuminates this creature, with your help of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 神圣的结合之光将会照亮这个生灵。当然，这需要你的协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: This fine specimen could be the next addition to the Sanctuary. Help me discover its secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 这个优秀的样本将成为圣殿的一员。既然如此，帮我揭开它的秘密吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: I knew we had a shared passion hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 我就知道我们志同道合，猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: Good, even while others are blinded by petty morality, you recognize the virtue of the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 很好，即便旁人都被琐碎的道德观蒙蔽了双眼，你却还能洞见圣殿的真谛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.text: The Sanctuary and I await your contribution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancAc.zhText: 圣殿与我都静候着你的奉献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.text: Your hunt is finished. Pay me a visit to receive your reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.zhText: 狩猎已经完成，可以回来找我领取你的奖赏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.text: You have completed the synthesis I require. Return to the relay to claim your reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.zhText: 你已经按照我的要求完成了结合仪式，返回中继站领取你的奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.text: You are always reliable Hunter, come receive what is owed to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.zhText: 你一向踏实可靠，猎者。来我这领取你应得的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.text: I see your hunt was a successful one. Visit me to claim your reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCo.zhText: 看来你狩猎成功了。来我这里领取奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: That's it! It will be a perfect specimen. Trap it so you can Synthesize it for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 就是它！它会成为完美的样本。困住它，这样就能帮我完成结合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Alright hunter, I will reward you, should you perform synthesis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 好吧，猎者，你要是能完成结合仪式，那我就能赐予你丰厚的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: There it is, ripe for Synthesis! Tame this creature so you may perform the Synthesis I require.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 就在那儿了，适合结合的好苗子！驯服这个生灵，然后完成结合仪式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: No-no-no NO! You've wasted this specimen. Was I wrong to entrust Synthesis to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 不不不，不！你已经浪费了这个样本。我是不是不该委托你完成结合仪式？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Disappointing. A dead specimen is useless to Sanctuary. Are you not up to this task?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 令人失望。死去的样本对圣殿毫无价值。难道你无法胜任这项任务吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: What have you done? Synthesis only works on the living! Can you control your murderous impulses for the good of Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 你做了什么？结合仪式仅对活着的生灵有效！为了圣殿的大业，你就不能克制一下嗜血的冲动吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Killing goes too far! Have I been unclear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 杀死生灵就是越界！难道我的指令还不够清楚吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Tenno, I am detecting a Synthesis target. Use the Synthesis scanner to track the creature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: Tenno，我监测到了结合目标。快用结合扫描器追踪那个生灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: The hunt is on, Tenno. The Synthesis scanner is detecting a potential target. Use it. Search for traces of the target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 狩猎开始了，Tenno。结合扫描器刚刚检测到一个潜在目标。用它追踪目标留下的踪迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: There is a Sanctuary target here, hunter! I sense it. Track it with the Synthesis scanner, don't let it escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 这里有圣殿的目标，猎者！我感觉到它就在周围。快用结合扫描器追踪，千万别让它跑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: I have it, thank you! Continue this hunt, Tenno, and enlightenment will follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 已接收，感谢！继续狩猎吧，Tenno，启迪自会随之而来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: You impress me hunter. This specimen will be studied for integration into Sanctuary. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 你让我印象深刻，猎者。这个样本将接受研究，并被纳入圣殿。万分感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: An excellent specimen, hunter. This will advance Sanctuary's goal of preservation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 出色的样本，猎者。这将推动圣殿保存万物的大计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Good! I have received the Synthesis. You are an efficient hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: 做得好！我已接收到结合数据。你真是一名高效的猎者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.text: Tenno, do not damage it further! Use the Synthesis device!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancCr.zhText: Tenno，不要再伤害它了！使用结合装置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Patience, hunter. I must set my mind to condensing your collected specimens into the Exemplar. Only this single template of perfection will live forever within Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 耐心些，猎者。我必须专心把你收集的样本凝缩为典范。只有这个完美的模板能在圣殿中永存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Hunter, please leave me to my work. I am filtering through the material you provided. I will honor our arrangement after I have formulated the archetype from these specimens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 猎者，请让我安静工作。我正在筛选你提供的材料。等我用这些样本构建出原型后，自然会履行我们的约定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Soon, Hunter. Soon I will impart the wisdom you've earned. For now you must not disturb me in the final stages. These samples must be mixed and compressed. Only the perfect aggregate will be immortalized in Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 快了，猎者。很快我便会传授你赢得的智慧。现在处于最后的阶段，千万不要打扰我。这些样本必须混合凝缩在一起。只有完美的聚合体，才配在圣殿中获得永生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Behold the proof that the Tenno are excellent hunters. But I do need more specimens to construct the 'ideal' for Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 看吧，这便是 Tenno 堪称优秀猎者的证明。但我仍需要更多样本，才能构筑出「理想」状态的圣殿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Sanctuary awaits this being. Continue with the Synthesis so I may fashion the exemplar for this digital oasis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 圣殿等候这个生灵多时了。继续结合仪式吧，让我为这片数据绿洲塑造出它的典范。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Do not disappoint me, hunter! Do your part and I'll do mine. I require more Synthesis of this being. Sanctuary depends on your actions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 不要让我失望，猎者！履行你的职责，我也会兑现我的承诺。我需要进一步结合这种生灵。圣殿的未来就寄托在你身上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Our mission is to preserve these beings of substance, immortalize them. It is not a trivial task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 我们的使命就是保存这些有形之物，并赐予它们不朽。这项任务意义非凡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: I have selected a new specimen for Sanctuary. It is time for you and your kind to hunt again. Knowledge will be your reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 我为圣殿选了新的样本。是时候让你和你的同伴再次狩猎了。知识将是你们的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: The Sanctuary must grow. It must preserve. It must endure. Hunt this being for me and I will enlighten you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 圣殿必须扩张，必须保存，更要长存。为我捕捉这个生灵，我便会赐予你启迪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.text: Cast off your ignorant veil, Tenno. Collect your arms, your allies, and hunt this creature for me. I will reward you, should you perform Synthesis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancGl.zhText: 揭开你那无知的面纱吧，Tenno。拿起武器，集结盟友，为我捕获这个生灵。只要你愿意为我完成结合仪式，我必将给予你丰厚的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancIn.text: I am Cephalon Simaris, the destroyer, the immortalizer. This is my Sanctuary. It will enlighten you, Tenno, should you assist me in performing Synthesis. ^You will hunt the creatures I require and transform them into beings of the Sanctuary. That is Synthesis. ^Is this murder? No. All beings of substance die, eventually. But only those forgotten are truly dead. ^The end of the Orokin wiped-out untold knowledge. Through Synthesis we can rebuild and preserve. Create memory-immortals within this data oasis. ^Will you become enlightened, Tenno? Will you hunt for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancIn.zhText: 我是中枢瑟玛里斯，既是毁灭者，也是不朽缔造者。这里就是我的圣殿。Tenno，若你协助我完成结合仪式，圣殿将赐予你启迪。你需要去猎捕我所需的生灵，并将其转化为圣殿的一部分。这便是结合。这算谋杀吗？当然不。一切有形之物终有一死。唯有被遗忘，才是真正的死亡。奥罗金的覆灭抹去了数不尽的知识，但通过结合，我们能够重建并保存一切。在这片数据绿洲中，缔造永恒的记忆体。Tenno，你愿意获得启迪吗？你愿意为我狩猎吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancLo.text: You are a true hunter. Where would the Sanctuary be without you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancLo.zhText: 你是真正的猎者。若没有你，圣殿该如何立足？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancLo.text: The multitude of creatures you have immortalized would cry out in thanks. If they could.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancLo.zhText: 如果还能说话，那些经由你获得永生的万千生灵，一定会齐声向你致谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.text: I can see you are hungry for the knowledge of the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.zhText: 我看得出，你渴望圣殿的知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.text: What will you donate to the Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.zhText: 你打算为圣殿献上什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.text: Show me your dedication to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancNe.zhText: 向我证明你对圣殿的奉献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancPs.text: Knowledge must be earned, Tenno. I will share what I know but you must prove yourself deserving. Hunt this creature for me, perform Synthesis and you will be enlightened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancPs.zhText: 必须付诸行动才能赢得知识，Tenno。我会分享我所知的一切，但你必须证明自己配得上。为我捕获这个生灵，完成结合，你将获得启迪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: It seems you have lost the fortitude that the Sanctuary requires of its hunters. A shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 看来你已失去了圣殿猎者必须拥有的坚韧品质。可惜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: You must have reasons for abandoning the Sanctuary, ask yourself, are they valid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 你背离圣殿，想必自有理由。不过请扪心自问，你的理由真的站得住脚吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: Not to worry, there are other hunters more suited to this task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 无需担心，自然还有其他猎者比你更能胜任这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: Unfortunate. You should know that I now regret seeking your assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 太可惜了。我想说的是，我现在很后悔当初开口求你办事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: The Sanctuary will go on without you, but can you go on without the Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 圣殿没有你，依然会延续。但你没有圣殿，又能走多远？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: What offerings will this item help you bring to the Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 这件物品会帮你为圣殿带来何种奉献？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: May this aid you in the Synthesis of many creatures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 愿它协助你完成更多生灵的结合！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: This is how I can help you, help the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 我能帮你的就这些了。接下来轮到你为圣殿效力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: These can make you an even stronger hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 这些会让你成为更强大的猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: What a pity this creature will forever be unaware of its contribution to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 真可惜，这个生灵永远不会知晓，自己对圣殿作出了怎样的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: Do you ever wonder why only the hunter is rewarded when it is the specimen who gives all to the Sanctuary? I find it best to discard such thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 你是否想过，明明是样本向圣殿献出了一切，为何领赏的却是猎者？这种念头，我看还是尽早抛在脑后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: You are a trustworthy hunter, come back later and I will have a new target for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 真不愧是值得信赖的猎者。下次我会再给你指派新的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.text: I can tell, you find thrill in the hunt. Come back later for a new target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancRe.zhText: 看得出来，你从狩猎中感受到了快感。稍后再来找新的目标吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.text: A full Synthesis has been completed. I thank you Tenno. You may explore the Sanctuary for new knowledge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.zhText: 一次完整的结合仪式已完成。我向你致谢，Tenno。你现在可以步入圣殿，探索崭新的知识了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.text: My Sanctuary is calling for a new creature. Will you help me by Synthesizing a sample population? I should not need many, perhaps a million.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.zhText: 我的圣殿需要一种新的生灵。你愿意协助我结合一个样本种群吗？别怕，我要的不多，大概一百万个就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.text: I have a new target for Synthesis. Which fortunate specimens will be chosen for immortalization in the Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancSy.zhText: 我锁定了新的结合目标。就是不知道哪些幸运的样本会被选中，在圣殿中获得永生呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.text: I can see you are hungry for knowledge but that hunger must be matched by patience. Return later to see if a new target has been selected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.zhText: 我能感受到你的求知若渴，但是这份渴望，也必须配以同等的耐心。稍后再来，看看新目标是否选定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.text: I must determine a new target, this task cannot be rushed. Leave me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.zhText: 我必须选定新的目标，此事万万急不得。你先退下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.text: Time is required to analyze your previous contribution. I will have a new target for you in the near future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.zhText: 分析你先前的贡献需要时间。我很快就会为你指定新目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.text:
Hunter, you have worked hard, captured millions of imprints to be combined into 'ideal' specimens for the Sanctuary. In light of your tireless contributions, I have decided to expand your role. Every day I perform preliminary synthesis to determine what creature will join the Sanctuary next. 

Do you want to see the Sanctuary grow as quickly as I do? Then join me in this task by visiting the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancUn.zhText:
猎者，你一直勤勉尽责，捕获了数以百万计的印痕，为圣殿的「完美」样本做出了不少贡献。鉴于你坚持不懈的付出，我决定扩大你的职责。每天，我都会运行初步的结合仪式，以决定下一种进入圣殿的生灵。

而你是否像我一样，渴望见证圣殿飞速壮大？是的话，就赶紧来圣殿，和我一起完成这项伟业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancWe.text: Ah, I see we are of like mind. The Sanctuary will be your project too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSancWe.zhText: 啊，看来我们的思维趋于一致。你也能成就圣殿的伟业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: Tenno, you will make an excellent hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: Tenno，你将成为一名出色的猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: I can see you are hungry for the knowledge of the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: 我看得出，你渴望圣殿的知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: You may explore the Sanctuary for new knowledge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: 我允许你探索圣殿，寻求未知的真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: Return to me and hunt again Tenno. I will reward you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: Tenno，回到我这里，再次狩猎吧。我会赐予你奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: You are a worthy hunter, Tenno.
It is time for you and your kind to hunt again. Knowledge will be your reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: 是时候让你和你的同伴再次去狩猎了。知识将是你们的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: I will share what I know, but you must prove yourself deserving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: 我会告诉你我知道的一切，但你必须先证明自己配得上这份知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.text: Knowledge is the path to the Singularity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSanctu.zhText: 知识是通往奇点的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The Stalker is heading toward the Void Control room. Track the-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 追猎者正在前往虚空控制室。追上他——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Collapse the Void, Shadow, so that my Fragments may attack. The Tenno hearts will beat their last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 瓦解虚空，黑影，这样我的碎片就可以进攻了。这将是 Tenno 之心最后的脉搏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text:
No, if the Void is collapsed, the Reservoir will be destroyed and you and the rest of the Tenno will be lost.

Get to the Void Control Room and stop the Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText:
不，如果虚空崩溃，储梦池也会毁灭，你和所有 Tenno 战士都会灭亡。
 
快去虚空控制室，阻止追猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Hiding The Moon in the Void, quite the magic trick Lotus. But Tenno, you must be asking yourself, where is this heart, if not in my chest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 把月球藏在虚空里，真是好计谋啊，莲(Lotus)。但是，Tenno，你不得不扪心自问，如果你的心脏不在你的胸膛里，它又在哪呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: It is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The Moon will soon be crushed by the weight of the Void. The sky will be as it should be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 月球很快就会被虚空压碎。天穹即将恢复本来的模样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Void Collapse? Oh no, it would be such a shame to lose The Moon so soon after finding it. Of course, you could just put it back in its rightful place, couldn't you Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 虚空崩溃？哦不，我才刚刚找到月球，现在就让它毁灭也太可惜了。当然，你有本事把它放回原处，不是吗，莲（Lotus）？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text:
I didn't want to have to do this but the collapse is imminent, if the Reservoir is to survive we need to pull The Moon out of the Void. 

Here, help me disrupt Void Compasses to reorient The Moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText:
我不想这么做，但虚空崩溃在即，如果要拯救储梦池，我们必须把月球拉出虚空。
 
来这儿，帮我干扰虚空罗盘，重新定向月球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Activate that console and I will begin my work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 开启控制台，让我开始行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: There are three Void Compasses that steer The Moon within the Void. I will disconnect them from the central system to gain control. Supply them with power from your shields while I finish my task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 在虚空内有3个虚空罗盘引导着月球。我会切断它们与中央系统的连接来夺回控制权。你要用自己的护盾给它们提供能量直到我完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Natah, you trust this Orokin blood who would chisel weapons from our bones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: Natah，这个奥罗金后裔曾扬言要用我们的筋骨雕凿武器，你居然还相信他？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Get close to the Void Compass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 靠近虚空罗盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The next Compass needs power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 下一个罗盘需要能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Keep moving, another Compass needs your shield's power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 继续，另一个罗盘需要你的护盾能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: You cannot stop the inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 你无法阻止必然的宿命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The Void Compasses are all disrupted but there is one more step. Get to the Pendula, hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 虚空罗盘全部干扰完毕，但还剩最后一步。前往锤摆系统，快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: What was that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 刚才那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Orokin, the noise you make will cease now, and forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 奥罗金人，你的噪音现在该停下了……永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text:
Uh Oh. Hunhow's found me. Sorry I can't stick around to see how this all ends but I've got to save my own skin.

Don't forget our deal, Lotus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText:
啊哦。Hunhow 发现我了。抱歉，我没法留到最后，我得先保住自己的小命。
 
别忘了我们的交易，莲（Lotus）！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: These Pendula keep The Moon stable in the Void. Power them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 锤摆系统维持着月球在虚空里的稳定。切断它的能源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Security Eye! Watch out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 警戒之眼！小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Wait, the Security Eye just destroyed a Pendula. Try and trick it into taking out the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 等等，警戒之眼刚刚破坏了一个锤摆。试着引诱它干掉剩下的锤摆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: That's it, they eye is taking out the Pendula. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 就是这样，利用警戒之眼破坏锤摆。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: Last one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 最后一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text:
It's done. The Moon is falling out of the Void. Hold on, this will not be a smooth ride. 

Get to extraction as quickly as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText:
完成了。月球正在从虚空中脱离。小心点，这个过程会很颠簸。
 
尽快前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The Moon. Somehow Ordis actually remembers the last time I was here. Concern for the Operator is at critical levels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 月球。不知究竟是为什么，Ordis 还记得上一次来到这里的事情。对指挥官的担心上升到临界水平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text: The suspense is killing me! Lotus you have to tell us your secr- Hey, don't cut me off-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText: 别再吊我胃口了！莲（Lotus），你必须告诉我你的秘——喂，不许切断——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.text:
Within The Moon, lies the Reservoir, the secret to your Tenno power. But this secret is dangerous, it drove the Stalker to madness. Forgive my deception, I was only trying to protect you from the same fate.

Now it is time to protect yourselves by ensuring The Moon remains within the safety of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveMo.zhText:
在月球上，隐藏着储梦池，那是 Tenno 力量的秘密。但你的秘密很危险，它让追猎者疯狂。原谅我向你隐瞒，我只是想保护你免遭受同样的命运。
 
现在，你必须确保月球留在虚空里，才能保护你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.text: We saved The Moon from a Void collapse but Hunhow can now attack the Reservoir directly. He must not reach this sacred place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.zhText: 我们从虚空崩溃中拯救了月球，但 Hunhow 现在能直接攻击储梦池了。不能让他碰到这个神圣的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.text: Shadow, bleed the Reservoir until it is desert dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.zhText: 黑影，让储梦池流血直到流干为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.text: Lotus, join with me, destroy your shame. Become the one I love, become Natah once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.zhText: 莲（Lotus），回到我身边吧，弥补你的耻辱。变回我最爱的你，变回我的 Natah。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.text: The Moon is back in normal space but the Reservoir is in more danger than ever. Hunhow will send his fighters and the Stalker is still coming for you. Move now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSaveRe.zhText: 月球已经回到了正常空间，但储梦池反而比以前更加危险。Hunhow 会派出他的战士，而且追猎者还在追捕你。立即行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: Sentient fighters can adapt to your attacks. Hit them with something else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 战斗单位会适应你的攻击。用其他方式攻击它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: It has developed immunity to your attacks, try something different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 它免疫了你的攻击，换种攻击方式对付它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: The Sentient has adapted to your damage, surprise them with something new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 已经适应了这种伤害。换种手段攻击它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: The Sentient mind has scrambled the systems. Eliminate all Sentients before I can continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 的意识干扰了系统。消灭它们，否则我无法继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: The Sentients are causing too much interference, you have to deal with them before we can go on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 的干扰太强，Tenno，你必须先解决它们，才能继续任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: This isn't working, it's the Sentients, take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 这样行不通，是 Sentient 搞的鬼，干掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: Sentient forces eliminated we can continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 部队已被消灭，我们可以继续了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: That's it, they're all gone, we can resume our mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 很好，它们不在了，我们可以继续任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: Oculysts! If they scan you, Sentient fighters won't be far behind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 全视使！一旦被它们扫描到，Sentient 战斗单位很快就会赶来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: Those Oculysts are scanning for targets
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 那些全视使正在扫描目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: Sentient scouts! If they detect you fighters will soon attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 侦察单位！一旦被它们发现，战斗单位很快就会发起攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: They know you're here. Prepare for Sentient fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: 它们知道你在这里。准备迎战 Sentient 战斗单位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: The Sentient has detected you. Fighters incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 发现你了。战斗单位正在赶来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.text: The Sentient is on to you, look out for troopers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DSentie.zhText: Sentient 盯上你了。小心它们的部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: You fought with a generous spirit Tenno but now we must work to free the Myconians and return their Triuna. The Sequence offered to pay Anyo an exorbitant ransom, but he laughed it off. He doesn't need the money. So we have no choice but to exploit Anyo's weakness. His love of gambling. Our only chance of freeing these people is to challenge Anyo and his brokers in The Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 你的慷概值得称赞，Tenno 战士，但我们必须继续努力解放 Mycona，夺回他们的圣脉。佩兰数列提出用高额赎金换回囚犯和圣脉，可安尤不为所动。他不需要钱。所以，我们别无选择，只能利用安尤的弱点。他酷嗜赌博，所以解放 Mycona 人的唯一机会，就是在指数之场里挑战安尤和他的代理人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Slow down Glast. My Tenno have already offered immense help and now you want them to enter The Index? This is dangerous work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 等等，格拉斯。我的 Tenno 已经帮了大忙，现在你还想让他进入指数之场？这太危险了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Fair, but the Myconians aren't asking for charity. Their ancestral understanding of the Infestation comes from an Old War relic. A relic that I know, will be of extreme interest to you. Return their Triuna, and the relic will be yours. Fair compensation for the risk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 你说得有道理，但 Mycona 人并不是不知感恩的人。他们世世代代对畸变疾病的了解都是来自一件远古之战遗物。我知道，这件遗物肯定对你非常重要。只要你夺回圣脉，遗物就是你的。这样的回报足以补偿你们的风险。
