/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: To beat Mr. Anyo at his own game, we must first show him that we are worthy competitors. Only then will he let us enter the upper echelons of this foul Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 要在安尤先生自己的游戏里打败他，我们必须先让他明白，我们是值得重视的对手。只有这样，他才会允许我们进入更高一层的指数之场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Ergo's suspicions are correct, Nef cheated. I have identified the systems responsible for these cheats. I need you to break into Anyo Corp's servers and steal the control codes for his traps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 埃尔戈的怀疑是对的，奈富作弊了。我已经锁定了控制作弊的系统。你需要入侵安尤集团的服务器，夺取那些陷阱的控制代码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Papa said I was born special. "Neewa..." he said, "you're not just our child, you are the Triuna, our protector!" I guess no one asks to be the Triuna. It was just… my turn… but without me, the Mumblers will take all of our families. They'll be mushed together like smudged ink. Lost forever. I have to get out of here. I have to get home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 爸爸说，我生下来就很特别。他说："Neewa……你不仅是我们的孩子，你还是圣脉，是我们的保护者！"我想，没人会主动成为圣脉，只不过……这次轮到我了。但如果没有我，低语者就会来抢走所有人。大家都会死掉。所以我必须出去。我必须回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Neewa is the Triuna!? That's why Nef's so interested in her. Suddenly this all makes sense. The Myconians had concealed her abilities to protect her. But, why give a child such a burden?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 妮瓦就是圣脉？！难怪奈富对她这么感兴趣。这下全都说得通了。麦克纳人一直隐瞒她的能力，是为了保护她。可为什么……要让一个孩子背负这种重担？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: My dear Glast, why are you so eager to tempt ruin for a little girl? You'll soon see how the Void favors my fortune above yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我亲爱的 Glast，你为何甘愿为一个小女孩自毁前程？你很快就会看到，虚空更青睐我的财富，而不是你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Wealth has no purpose until turned against suffering. I'd wager more if I had it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 财富毫无意义，除非用来平息痛苦。如果我还有财产，我都会投进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: The dark-eyed man came today. He tapped the bars and said soon we'd be put to work. Fine! I screamed at him, "Only if you tell us what's going on. Are my parents safe?" He just laughed at me and said something about the Void. I wonder what the Mumblers would do to his face?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 那个黑眼圈的人今天来了。他敲着栏杆，说我们马上就要派上用场了。好吧！于是我对他大喊："你可以告诉我们外面怎么样了。我的父母安全吗？"他笑话我，说了一堆虚空什么的话。应该让低语者修理一下他那张脸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Glast, why is Nef so interested in Neewa, what are you not telling us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 格拉斯，奈富为什么这么在意妮瓦？你还有什么事瞒着我们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: I can only assume Anyo is trying to bait us back to the Index. Thankfully his gambling is a compulsion. We must win her back, for the Myconians.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我只能推测，安尤想引诱我们重回指数之场。幸好他的赌瘾已经病入膏肓。为了 Mycona，我们必须赢回 Neewa。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Hmmm… I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 嗯，原来如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: I'm willing to bet one or two of these useless children if it means a chance to bankrupt your bleeding heart Perrin Sequence. All those executives will surely come crawling back to me. Fodder for the Index!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我可以赌一两个没用的孩子。我要让你那脓包的佩兰数列破产。到时候你手下所有执行官都会跑到我这来跪下求我。好啦，为指数之场下注吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Tenno, I trust Ergo Glast, but a colony that survives amid the Infestation? It seems impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: Tenno，我相信埃尔戈·格拉斯。但一座殖民地竟能在感染者包围中安然无恙？简直是天方夜谭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Lotus, you may now return the child to her people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 莲（Lotus），现在你可以把这个孩子送回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: She could be cured. Why return her? So she lives a shortened life, surrounded by monsters?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 她明明可以被治好。为什么还要送她回去送死？为什么让她在怪物包围中，度过如此短暂的一生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Surrounded by family, her people, who honor her. Are you really going to impose your own values on these people you don't understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 让她活在家人和同胞当中，受到他们的尊敬和爱护。你真的要把你的价值观强加给一群你无法理解的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: She only thinks this is what she wants. What you call tradition others call indoctrination. If she comes to the relay and is cured, she'll be free to return to her people if that's her choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 她只是以为自己想要这样的生活。你们称之为传统，在别人眼里就是洗脑。如果她来到中继站接受治疗，等她痊愈之后，要是还想回到族人身边，那才真正是她自己的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: And the Myconians? Without the Passing, their way of life will end forever. Their skills, their traditions, wiped out by a powerful outsider.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 那 Mycona 人怎么办？没有传承仪式，他们的生存方式就永远结束了。他们的技艺、他们的传统，都将被一个强大的外人消除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: They'd have to adapt, yes. We'd do our best to protect them, as we do for all that suffer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 没错，他们必须作出改变。但我们会尽力保护他们，就像保护所有遭受苦难的人一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Tenno, you've lived through similar obligations. What would you choose for Neewa?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: Tenno，你也曾背负过类似的使命。若由你决定，你会为妮瓦选择怎样的命运？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: This is a strange place, so clean. Everyone is nice to me, so I guess I'll get used to it. I'm still weak from the treatment but I feel stronger every day. I don't know what I'm going to do now. I guess anything I want. I miss my Papa and my family, but I sure don't miss the mumblers. Thank you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 这是一个陌生的地方，真干净。所有人对我都很友善，我想我会习惯这里的。接受治疗以后我还是很虚弱，但我感觉日渐有力起来。我也不知道现在我要做什么，也许我可以做任何想做的事。我想念爸爸和家里人，但我一定不想念呢喃者。感谢你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: I know our ways might seem strange to outsiders but they're our ways. I would never choose to be anything but Myconian. To be their Triuna for as long as I can. Thank you, Tenno, for keeping my family safe when I couldn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我知道我们的方式在外人看来很奇怪，但那毕竟也是我们的生存之道。如果让我选择，我还愿意做 Mycona 人。我愿意尽可能长地作为他们的圣脉。感谢你，Tenno，感谢你在我无能为力的时候保护我的家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: I've returned to my people… but… I've decided I will be the last Triuna. I want a future where all of the children can be happy. A new tradition. Papa is so proud of me. "The last Triuna and greatest of all. The one that changed Myconians forever."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我回到同胞中间了……但是……我决定我就是最后一个圣脉。我希望未来所有的孩子都能过得幸福。这就是我们的新传统。爸爸将为我自豪。「最后一个圣脉，是有史以来最伟大的。她永远改变了 Mycona 人。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: How much longer can I go on for? The Passing will come in a few years with no one to take the Triuna from me. I'll just be gone, surrounded by rusting robots, and the Triuna will be lost forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 我还剩下多少时间？传承仪式只剩几年了，还没有人来继承圣脉，我会死在这里，被一堆生锈的机器人埋起来，以后永远也没有圣脉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Ergo, what is this, "Passing"? What do you know about the Triuna?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 埃尔戈，这个所谓的「传承」到底是什么？你对圣脉有多少了解？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Triuna is the Myconian's chosen one. It passes from one to the next in a simple ceremony. A pin prick on the finger is all it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 圣脉是 Mycona 人的圣子，它由一个人传给另一个人。仪式很简单，用针扎一下手指就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: A disease?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 一种疾病？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Yes, likely. The Myconians may be carriers with ancestral resistance to the Infestation. Or they are merely keepers of the flame, perpetuating a weaker strain through this ritual.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 对，差不多。Mycona 人很可能从祖先那里继承了对感染的抗性。又或者，他们是一群守护者，保护着一个小小的火种，通过仪式把它传承下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: The Infested fear hybrids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 感染者畏惧混合体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: They do. And so the Myconians harvest them without violence. That is their way of life. Eventually, the Triuna succumbs to the burden and so they must pass it on. And on. Lighting a new torch before the other fades away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 是的，所以 Mycona 人才能平安地收获畸变体。这是他们的生存方式。最终，圣脉会承受不了负担，所以必须把它传承下去，一代接一代。在火种熄灭之前，点燃下一把火炬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Fades? You mean dies. We could cure her before that happened!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 消逝？你是说死去。我们明明可以在那之前治好她！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Of what? An extraordinary gift? No Triuna would ever want to lose that. They live in honor, to serve their people, for the greater good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 治好什么？治好这难得的天赋？没有哪个圣脉会想要放弃它。他们是光荣的，他们为同胞、为大义献身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: But they're only children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 可他们还只是孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: It's over Glast. I have everything I want. Neewa is mine, and the Sequence's President is in ruin! You have nothing to wager that interests me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 结束了，Glast。我想要的东西都在我手里。Neewa 是我的，而且佩兰数列的主席完蛋了！你已经拿不出值得一看的赌注。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Hah, the Myconians do. An Old War relic will be our wager. In a way, a product of the Void, something you have... more than passing interesting for, am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 哈，可是 Mycona 人有。我们赌一件远古纷争遗物。从某个角度来说，它就是虚空的造物，也是你最在意的东西，我说得对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Don't kid yourself… I… What? It's disgusting. It's… beautiful! Those colonists would wager this?! Don't those idiots realize how much this is worth?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 别开玩笑了……我……什么？真是讨厌。真是……太美了！那些殖民者愿意赌这个？！一群蠢货，他们知不知道这个值多少？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: All or nothing, held in escrow. Are you in, Nef?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 把所有赌注都押上，交给第三方保管。赌吗，奈富？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.text: Hmmm… yes. By the Void, I'm in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DShipPo.zhText: 嗯……好。以虚空的名义，我赌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: I could have never foreseen this, that Vessel, it contains primitive etchings that seem to be a sort of blueprint. Was a Warframe entombed there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 太出乎我的意料了，这只瓮上居然有原始的蚀刻，好像是某种蓝图。难道那里埋着一具战甲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Look at it. It's exquisite. There's an inscription: "Prove you are him, destroy the ones who oppress." Destroy who? Does this smudged glyph represent some enemy? You will have to carry that Vessel into battle and prove yourself if we are to unlock these secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 看哪，多么精致。这里有一行铭文：「证明你就是他，消灭压迫者。」消灭谁？这个脏兮兮的浮印画的是敌人吗？你需要带着这只瓮上战场，证明你自己，这样我们才能解开它的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Whatever that Vessel wants you to do, I'm certain it's somehow connected to that smudged glyph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 无论瓮要你做什么，我敢肯定，都和上面的浮印有关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: I don't know how this happened, but the glyph on that Sacred Vessel, it's changed. I suggest you stay on this path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 我不知道究竟是怎么回事，不过礼葬瓮上的浮印变了。我建议你朝这个方向走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The glyph, it's changed. You must be fulfilling some primitive rite of passage…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 这枚浮印，它变了。你似乎完成了某种古老的仪式……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The vessel, it's responding to your actions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 这只瓮，正在回应你的行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Tenno, look, the glyph. It's completely clear. And there's a new inscription: "Return for him." Return to the tomb so we can get past this superstitious nonsense and on to something worthwhile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: Tenno，看啊，这枚浮印，完全清晰了。这里有一行新的铭文：「回到他身边。」回到古墓，让我们告别这些怪力乱神，去找些值钱的东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: You can feel the filth and the grit in every breath. This desolate rock is the former colony of backward-thinking sky worshippers. Their stories are worth as much as the sand around you. Nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 哇，每一口呼吸都夹杂着秽物与沙砾。这颗荒凉的岩星曾是一处殖民地，住着一群思想落后的拜天者。他们的故事就跟你脚下的沙子一样，一文不值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The Grineer took 'pity' on their miserable existence years ago, returning this so-called civilization to the sand. Yet, for some elusive reason, their relics have become quite fashionable and thus valuable. Rare antiquities, that's why we're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 很多年以前，克隆尼大发「慈悲」，将他们那悲惨的所谓文明重新送回了黄沙。但不知为何，他们的遗物后来竟成了时兴货，身价也随之水涨船高。我们来这儿的目的就是这些珍稀的古董。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Ignore these glyphs, nothing but nonsense about their so-called god-king. Inaros, is it? How quaint - the only thing heaven-sent from Inaros will be the price his relics fetch at auction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 不要管那些浮印，不过是在胡扯他们那位所谓的神王。好像是叫 Inaros？多么古朴可笑——Inaros 唯一称得上「天赐」的，恐怕只有其遗物在拍卖会上拍出的天价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: A Burial Vessel! It will contain precious relics… There, there - you're not defiling a tomb, you're creating wealth!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 一只礼葬瓮！里面肯定装着珍贵的遗物……好啦，好啦——这不是亵渎古墓，这是创造财富！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Hush my little dune. You don't need to be scared. There, there, that's right, shake out the sand, but remember, not all of it... and I'll tell you the story.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 嘘，我的小沙丘，不用害怕。来吧，来吧，很好，抖掉沙子，不过不要全都抖掉了……我来给你讲个故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Tenno - what is this? How are you doing that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: Tenno——这是什么？你怎么办到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Long ago, the lands of our colony were cursed, soaked in fear. The Golden Skymen would come and take our children away… Young and old alike, cowered before them, afraid to lose their most beloved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 很久以前，我们的殖民地被诅咒了，惊恐笼罩着大地。金色的天人来抢走我们的孩子……男女老少都胆战心惊，生怕失去自己最爱的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: That voice… Tenno, stop this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 那个声音……Tenno，快让它停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: But then he came. The Fear-eater. The skykiller. He was called… Inaros!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 可后来，他出现了。他赶走惊恐。消灭天人。他是——Inaros！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Return to your ship, we must examine this vessel further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 回飞船上去，我们必须进一步检查这只瓮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: I'm beginning to think this Inaros myth was drawn from… an actual Warframe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 我开始觉得，Inaros 的传说可能来自于……一具真实存在的战甲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Oh I see. Another glyph? Another challenge. See if you can figure out which enemy it represents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 噢，明白了。又一道浮印？又一个挑战。看看你能不能弄明白它这次描绘的是哪种敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: This wretched place, why did I even come here? I keep telling myself it was the treasure but… Push it back, stupid Baro, there's no wealth in these memories. Tenno, we need to open that next chamber. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 这个鬼地方，我当初为什么要来这儿？我一直告诉自己，我要找到宝藏，可……忘了它吧，巴罗，你个蠢货。回忆里没有宝藏。Tenno，我们得打开下一间墓室。去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: I'll be grateful when this is over, I cannot stand this barren place. Even the Orokin could not enlighten those sand skates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 等这事结束，我都不知道自己会有多高兴。我实在受不了这个鸟不拉屎的地方。就算是奥罗金也教化不了那些沙鳐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Remember, we're here for relics, not stories, so I'd appreciate if you kept your Tenno soma-void-resonance… 'thing' to a minimum. I've had enough of this culture to last a lifetime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 记住，我们要找的是遗物，不是故事。Tenno，劳烦你尽量收敛一下那种你体内与虚空共鸣……之类的「东西」。我真的会感谢你。这里的故事我已经听够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Take the Vessel to the door. What happens?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 把礼葬瓮带到门前。看看会发生什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Little one, after this you must sleep…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 孩子，听完这个故事，你就该睡觉了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Not again...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 又来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Inaros began not as our King, but as our enemy, a warrior of the Golden Skymen. But for each child the Skymen took away, Inaros grew ever more angry - until one fateful night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 一开始，Inaros 不是我们的王，而是我们的敌人。他是金色天人的战士。但每次天人把孩子带走，Inaros 都很生气——直到那个注定的夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Another child had been taken and the villagers had gathered in a mourning circle, weeping... until they heard a small voice. By the dunes! It was the child, returned! As he approached the people gasped in horror as they saw that he was drenched in blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 又一个孩子被带走了。村民们聚在一起，为他哭泣……然后他们听到一个小小的声音。孩子回来了！但他走近的时候，人们却很害怕，因为他的身上沾满了血迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: His father rushed to the boy and embraced him - and saw that he had no wounds. Whose blood is this, he asked? The boy looked to the sky and said - this is the Blood of the Skymen. This is the work of Inaros.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 孩子的父亲冲过去，抱住他，却发现他没有受伤。他问，这血是谁的？孩子仰起头，看着天空说——是天人的血。这是 Inaros 的功劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: By the sand and stars, the Skymen raged. They set upon Inaros with their armies but none could prevail... for he commanded the sand, he commanded death. Inaros ate their fear and became stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 以沙漠和群星的名义，天人发怒了。他们派军追捕 Inaros，但无功而返……因为他掌控沙漠的力量，掌控生死大权。Inaros 将他们的惊恐，化为自己的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: None of this… none of this could be true. Could it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 这些……这一切都不可能是真的吧，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: And so they left us, and took with them our fear. On that day, Inaros became our King and, in a great whirlwind of sand, ascended to watch over us from his throne in the sky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 于是他们离开了，带着惊恐离开了。从那天起，Inaros 成了我们的王。在一阵沙石的旋风中，他升上天空，从天空的王座守望我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: What if? It… It can't be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 可万一呢……啊不，这不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: That voice, return to your ship. I… I must collect myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 那个声音……回飞船吧。我……我得缓一缓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The story isn't just a myth, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 这故事并非只是传说吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Look at this sacred vessel, one of four, just as she described. And the challenges, you must prove you're Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 看这只礼葬瓮，四只中的一只，就和她说的一样。而那些挑战，都是为了证明你是 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The Grineer are returning in force! Tenno, I don't care about the money anymore, just stop those dogs from getting Inaros!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 克隆尼部队又来了！Tenno，钱已经无所谓了，必须阻止他们带走 Inaros！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: By the Void, the Grineer have picked up our scent. They'll take me … uh - it … Inaros! You have to stop these animals at once!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 虚空在上，克隆尼发现我们了。他们会把我带走……啊——它……Inaros！你必须阻止这帮畜生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: So where is she? That voice? I… I think I need to hear the rest. I think I've needed to hear this for a long time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 那么她在哪？那个声音？我……我想我得听完剩下的故事。我想，我期待这一刻很久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: And so for years we lived in peace and our little dunes were our own to keep. But the sands of peace are ever-shifting. Years later a plague came to the desert. The Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 又过了很多年，我们一直生活在和平中，我们的小沙丘再也没被带走过。但沙漠永远都在流动。很多年后，疾病......疾病来到沙漠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Desperate, our people called out to sky: Inaros! Inaros! But they could not wake him… and so they were consumed by the ravenous horde. With all lost, the few remaining villagers gathered in the mourning circle to prepare for the end... when suddenly, a storm rose about them… A colossal spiral storm of sand, piercing the sky! The villagers huddled, trapped within the storm's eye as the beasts charged them... In moments the beasts were torn apart and the Infested plague was swept away, never to be seen again. As the storm subsided the people ventured out into the desert, hoping to catch a glimpse of their saviour, their beloved Inaros...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 我们的祖先无妄了，他们向天空呼喊：Inaros！Inaros！但他们唤不醒他……于是他们被怪物吞食了。幸存的一小部分人聚在一起，准备迎接末日……这时，突然挂起狂沙的风暴……巨大的沙柱直通天际！村民们被保护在风眼里，而怪物被飞沙撕成碎片。疾病消失了，再也没有出现过。风暴平息后，人们走进沙漠，他们想看一眼救世主，敬爱的 Inaros……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Get ready!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 做好准备！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: They found his glorious metal body, broken and still, lying in the sand. Did they mourn? No. They knew his spirit had returned to the sky to watch over them, once again. They gathered his body to keep it safe from thieves and raiders. They placed the pieces within the sacred vessels and entombed them in secret… knowing that one day Inaros would reclaim his body and rise again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 他们找到他壮丽的钢铁身体，残破不堪的躺在沙漠中，他们可曾哀悼？没有。因为他们知道他的灵魂已经回归天空，继续守望着他们。他们收集他残破的身躯，细心看管起来。他们把他的遗体放进礼葬瓮，埋藏到秘密的地方……他们知道，Inaros 终会复生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: So now my sweet dune, you have no need of fear. Take these grains, and keep them under your pillow. Inaros will watch over you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 好了，我亲爱的小沙丘，不要害怕。拿好这些沙子，放到枕头下面。Inaros 会保佑你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Find extraction. We're done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 前往撤离点。这里的事了结了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Cut them down, make them fear this place. The Grineer should be swept away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 杀光他们，让他们畏惧这里。克隆尼全部都该死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Quickly, my sweet dune, they're coming…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 快，我的小沙丘，他们来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: I tried so hard to forget.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 我一直都在努力忘掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: Quickly, in here. Don't make a sound, Baro. Here. Hold these grains in your hand, tight. Inaros will protect you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 快来，这里。不要出声，Baro。来。拿好这些沙子，握紧。Inaros 会保佑你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: It wasn't me I was worried about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 我担心的从来不是自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: What do you want? No. You have no right! No - it's just me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 你们想要什么？不。你们没有权利！不——这里只有我。不不——没有别的了！不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: But Inaros never came.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 但 Inaros 始终没有出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: You've shown me why I came here, Tenno. Not for riches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: Tenno，你让我明白自己来这里的目的，不是为了钱财。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: The doors are closing again. Prove that you are worthy of Inaros's strength. One last time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 门又关上了。证明你配得上 Inaros 的力量吧。最后一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.text: My mother's call will be answered. Inaros will rise again. Come home, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/DVessel.zhText: 母亲的呼唤终会得到回应。Inaros 必将归来。回家吧，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbDetec.text: You are found. Strike without hesitation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbDetec.zhText: 你被发现了，无须迟疑，出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbDetec.text: Now you must take the more brutal path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbDetec.zhText: 现在你得走上更加残暴的道路了，

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbGrine.text: Ready yourself, a formidable enemy approaches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbGrine.zhText: 做好准备，强大的敌人来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbLkdnT.text: All exits have been sealed, what will you do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbLkdnT.zhText: 所有的出口都被封上了，你会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbLkdnT.text: They think you are caught. Educate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbLkdnT.zhText: 他们认为成功困住你了，让他们见识你的能耐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.text: The enemy remains blind to your intrusion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.zhText: 敌人仍未得知你的入侵行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.text: The livestock graze unaware of the eagle soaring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.zhText: 放牧的家畜永远无法理解展翅翱翔的老鹰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.text: You are the hunter, unseen in their midst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Quests/LbUndet.zhText: 在他们之中，你是无法被察觉的猎人，

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Aurax Crewship. Issuing first assignment: Destroy Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 傲金战舰。现在下达第一个任务：摧毁航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: We need all the guns we've got. Loose the Aurax Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们得用上我们拥有的一切火力。派出傲金战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Aurax Crewship reports ready to engage, and not a moment too soon. Fire at will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 傲金战舰报告：已准备就绪；时机正好。自由开火，无需顾忌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Aurax Crewship entering the field! Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 傲金战舰正在进入战场！太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Anchor beam disengaged. Aurax Crewship systems online. Attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 已解除定锚光束。傲金战舰系统已上线。开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Order the Aurax Crewship to launch immediately! Attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 命令傲金战舰立即启动！进攻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I don't care if it's 'not ready', power up that Aurax Crewship and get it into the fight!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我不管它是否"未准备好"，启动那艘傲金战舰并把它投入战斗中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: One more ship may tip the balance. Fire up the Aurax Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 多一艘战舰可能会扭转局势。发射傲金战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Time to find out if our Aurax Crewship was worth the investment. Order it to engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 是时候弄清楚，我们的傲金战舰算不算一笔划算的买卖。命令它参战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Anchor beam disengaged. Aurax Crewship systems online. Attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 已解除定锚光束。傲金战舰系统已上线。开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Sending an agent to block that signal manually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 正在派出特工去手动屏蔽信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Agent underway. Datagrid locked. Finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 特工正在行动中。数据已锁定。总算搞定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Agent! Keep that signal blocked at all costs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 特工！无论如何，都要一直屏蔽那个信号！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Signal jammed. Excellent work, agent. Now kill them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 敌军信号已被干扰。干得好，特工。现在杀了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Countermeasures specialist on the field. Signal choked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 反制系统专员已前往战场。已阻塞敌军信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Agent in the zone. Intruder signal blocked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 此区域内的特工。侵入者信号已被屏蔽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Specialist jamming agent deployed. Our datagrid is safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 已部署干扰专员。我们的数据安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Block the signal, agent. Destroy the boarders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 特工，屏蔽信号。消灭登舰敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Out of options. Deploying special operative. Throttle that signal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 没办法了。部署特种作战人员。封锁那个信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Countermeasures specialist on the field. Signal choked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 反制系统专员已前往战场。已阻塞敌军信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Carrier Platform! Order all Aurax pilots to their ships! Immediate launch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 载机平台！命令全体傲金飞行员登上他们的战斗机！立刻行动！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want those Aurax fighters in the air yesterday!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 这些傲金战斗机应该昨天就起飞了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: The Tenno are not equipped to deal with elite Aurax fighters. Carrier Platform, launch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Tenno 不具备对付傲金战斗机的能力。载机平台，发射！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Carrier Platform. Your Aurax fighters have a special assignment. Eliminate Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 载机平台。你的傲金战斗机有一项特殊任务：歼灭那艘航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Carrier Platform! Clear launch bays! Launch Aurax fighters!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 载机平台！清理起航区！傲金战斗机出动！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Aurax fighters will rip that Railjack apart. Carrier, send them in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 傲金战斗机将会把航道星舰撕成碎片。载机平台，把他们派出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: That Orokin relic won't last long against Aurax fighters. Carrier, you are clear to launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 那个奥罗金老古董和傲金战斗机对战不会撑太久。载机平台，你可以发射了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: This has gone on long enough. Carrier, launch Aurax fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 这已经拖得够久了。载机平台，出动傲金战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Command to Carrier Platform! Aurax fighter wing, eliminate Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 下令给载机平台！傲金战斗机，灭掉航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Carrier Platform! Clear launch tubes! Launch Aurax fighters!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 载机平台！清理发射管道！傲金战斗机出动！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Railjack interfering. Deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 航道星舰正在进行干扰。搞定它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tenno in the sector. Terminate them. Priority one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Tenno 在该区域内。消灭他们，这是首要目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: This is Granum space. All units target the freeloaders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 这是格拉努空间。想要占便宜的人，会被群起而攻之。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All Corpus: remind the Tenno whose territory this is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体 Corpus，提醒一下 Tenno 这里是谁的地盘？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All Corpus craft. Engage enemy Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体 Corpus 飞行单位，与敌方航道星舰展开交战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: If those looters want a fight we'll give them one. Engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 如果这些掠夺者想打一架的话，我们奉陪到底。行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch fighters. Arm torpedoes. Give them hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射战斗机。装填鱼雷。给他们点颜色瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All forces target the Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体部队，攻击航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Railjack is within range. Blast it to fragments.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 航道星舰处于射程内。把它炸开花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All Corpus craft. Engage enemy Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体 Corpus 飞行单位，与敌方航道星舰展开交战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: My drones are down and the Tenno signal is back up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我的无人机失灵了，Tenno 的信号恢复了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: The Tenno have unjammed their damn signal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Tenno 已经解除了受到的信号干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: What. Happened. To. My. Drones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我的。无人机。到底。发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: How am I meant to block their signal without my drones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 没有无人机，我怎么能屏蔽他们的信号呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You were supposed to keep those jamming drones operational!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们本应该让那些干扰无人机继续运作的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Jamming drones, report in. Jamming drones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 干扰无人机，汇报情况。干扰无人机呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Why is their signal no longer blocked?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 为什么他们的信号没在被屏蔽了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Our datagrid is exposed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们的数据暴露了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Those drones were our datagrid's best defence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 那些无人机是保护我们数据的最佳武器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You were supposed to keep those jamming drones operational!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们本应该让那些干扰无人机继续运作的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: We need assault teams. Prep Crewship for launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们需要突击队。准备派出战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Let's make this personal. Send in a Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 这次我们要对人不对事了。派出一艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Deploy a Crewship!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 部署一艘战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Corpus Marines, board a Crewship and engage them hand to hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Corpus 陆战队，登上一艘战舰，并与他们展开搏斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want more firepower out there. Launch one of our Crewships!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要更强的火力。派出一艘我们的战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Our forces need support. Launch another Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们的部队需要支援。出动另一艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Conflict is escalating. I want another Crewship on the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 冲突正在升级。我要战场上再多一艘我们的战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Marines to Crewship hangar bay on the double! Immediate launch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 作战队员迅速前往战舰起航区！立即出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Unassigned Crewship located. Deploying immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 已定位未分配任务的战舰。立即部署。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want more firepower out there. Launch one of the Crewships!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要更强的火力。派出一艘战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All pilots to your ships! Clear launch tubes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体飞行员就位！清理发射管道！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want every fighter we've got out there. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要所有的战斗机都出动。现在就去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Intensify bombardment. Launch secondary fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 加大轰击力度。出动支援战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Fighter wing commanders! Mobilize and attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 战斗机中校！动员部队，发起进攻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch reserve fighter wing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射后备战斗机部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want to see fighters from one side of the sky to the other!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要看到整片星域都布满我们的战斗机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch whatever fighters we've still got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射我们剩下的所有战斗机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Fighters, launch! That Railjack can't hold out forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 战斗机，发射！那艘航道星舰不可能一直撑下去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Clear the ports. Cancel maintenance. All fighters. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 清理发射港口。取消维护作业。全体战斗机，出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch reserve fighter wing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射后备战斗机部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver ready? Fire comet shard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站准备好了？发射冰陨碎弹！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver, commence bombardment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站，开始轰炸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver, target that Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站，瞄准那艘航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Hit that Railjack with a comet shard. Ice them up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 用冰陨碎弹攻击那艘航道星舰。把他们都冻住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver, blast that Railjack with a comet shard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站，用冰陨碎弹轰击那艘航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver! Target Railjack. Stop them in their tracks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站！瞄准航道星舰。让他们停下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver loaded with comet shard. Blast them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站已装填好冰陨碎弹。轰击他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Command to Icedriver. Hit the Railjack. Full charge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 下令给驱冰站。攻击航道星舰。最大限度装填！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver! Prepare to loose payload. Target Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站！准备好开炮。瞄准航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Icedriver, blast that Railjack with a comet shard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 驱冰站，用冰陨碎弹轰击那艘航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Divert all available power to artillery. Fire main beam when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 将所有可用的能源都部署到光能炮上。准备好后就发射主炮光束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: They're in range of the big guns. Hit them with the main artillery beam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 他们在炮台的射程内。用主炮光束攻击他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Full power to main artillery beam. On my mark... FIRE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全部能源部署至主炮光束。听我号令……开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Charge capacitors. Give them a taste of the main artillery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 对电容器充能。让他们尝尝主炮的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Fire main artillery beam! Let's finish them off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射主炮光束！让我们终结他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Full power to main artillery beam. On my mark... FIRE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全部能源部署至主炮光束。听我号令……开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: We need heavy ordnance. Fire torpedoes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们需要重型武器。发射鱼雷！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Gunnery crews! Launch torpedoes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 枪炮船员！发射鱼雷！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Arming torpedoes. Locking on to their signature. Firing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 装填鱼雷。锁定其特征。发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch torpedoes! Let's see them evade that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射鱼雷！让我们看看他们能不能躲过这一击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Torpedoes locked. Target in range. Firing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 鱼雷已锁定。目标进入射程。发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Torpedoes primed. Stand by to salvage their remains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 鱼雷已就位。随时准备回收他们的残骸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Let's soften them up. Torpedoes, fire at will!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 让我们来削弱他们。鱼雷，随意开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Arm the warheads. Fire full salvo. Take them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 武装好弹头。开火齐射，把他们拿下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want torpedoes armed and dispatched now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我现在就要鱼雷装备上并进行发射！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Torpedoes locked. Target in range. Firing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 鱼雷已锁定。目标进入射程。发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Let's take the fight to them. Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 让我们主动出击吧。发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Launch Ramsleds. Kill them hand to hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 发射冲锋艇。通过近身搏斗击杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Altering tactics. Launch Ramsleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 改变战术。发射冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: That ship is nothing without its crew. Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 那艘战舰没了舰员就什么也不是。发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Locating breach points! Launching Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 正在定位突破点！发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: A bonus for whoever captures that ship. Ramsleds away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 无论谁捕获那艘战舰，都能获取一份奖励。冲锋艇已出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Marines! Charge personal shields and get to your Ramsleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 陆战队！给你们的个人护盾充能，并前往各自的冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Ramsleds, launch! Bring me that Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 冲锋艇，发射！把那艘航道星舰给我掳回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want boots on the deck. Clear the tubes and launch Ramsleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要全体队员都到甲板集合。清理发射管道，发射冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Locating breach points! Launching Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 正在定位突破点！发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Send the Railjack some Aurax units from the Autofactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 从自动装械厂里派遣些傲金作战单位，让那艘航道星舰知道厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: The Autofactory has Aurax Moas and drones to spare. Get them to Ramsleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 自动装械厂里有闲置的傲金恐鸟和无人机。把他们装备到冲锋艇上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I want Aurax robots on that Railjack. Autofactory! Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我要傲金机器人踏上那艘航道星舰。自动装械厂！发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Time for an Aurax field test. Send a robot boarding party from the Autofactory!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 是时候测试一下傲金作战单位的实战能力了。从自动装械厂里派遣一批机器人登舰小队！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Autofactory! Show the Tenno the Aurax units you've built. Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 自动装械厂！让 Tenno 见识见识你建造的傲金作战单位。发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I think they need to sample our wares. Autofactory! Deploy Aurax robots! Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我想他们需要对我们的产品进行抽查。自动装械厂！部署傲金机器人！发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Send them some Aurax robots from the Autofactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 从自动装械厂里派遣些傲金机器人，让他们知道厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Situation justifies use of Aurax robots. Autofactory? Send boarders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 战况证明部署傲金机器人是合理的。自动装械厂？派出登舰部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Autofactory! I want Aurax robots in Ramsleds, now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 自动装械厂！我要冲锋艇载满傲金机器人！就现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Autofactory! Show the Tenno the Aurax units you've built. Launch Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 自动装械厂！让 Tenno 见识见识你建造的傲金作战单位。发射冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: That'll slow them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 那能让他们减速。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Ah! Got them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 啊！打中他们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Did we break your concentration?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我们分散了你的注意力吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Interrupted their signal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 已中断他们的信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Disruption pulse successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 干扰脉冲奏效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Pulse connected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 脉冲已命中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Intruder signal impeded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 侵入者信号已受阻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Yes. Burn their neurons!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 对。烧掉他们的神经元！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Fry them to a crisp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 把他们炸得酥脆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Disruption pulse successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 干扰脉冲奏效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: If they get back to that Railjack, the unthinkable may happen! Stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 要是让他们返回那艘航道星舰的话，可能会发生难以想象的事！阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Massacre those Tenno before they leave the ship!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 在那群 Tenno 离开战舰之前屠尽他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You have failed again and now they are leaving. Stop them. This is your last chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们又失败了，现在他们正在撤离。阻止他们。这是你们最后的机会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Your incompetence has left us vulnerable! Get after the Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们的无能让我们腹背受敌了！追击那群 Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All crew, engage the Tenno. Do not let them escape!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体舰员，都去和 Tenno 交战。别让他们跑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: What I will do if you fail to stop those Tenno is nothing compared to what Parvos will do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 如果你没能阻止这些 Tenno，那么相比起帕尔沃斯将要做的事，我要降下的惩罚根本不值一提。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tenno attempting to escape. This is your final chance to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Tenno 试图逃脱。这是你们进行阻止的最后机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I am offering total debt erasure for ANYONE who stops those Tenno from escaping!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 无论是谁，只要能阻止 Tenno 逃走，我都将为其免除所有债务！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: If those Tenno are not stopped there is a very real chance that we will all soon be dead!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 如果不阻止那些 Tenno，那么我们很有可能马上就会死掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All crew, engage the Tenno. Do not let them escape!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体舰员，都去和 Tenno 交战。别让他们跑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array, open fire. Give them hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列，开火。给他们点颜色瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array? Blow that Railjack out of the sky!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列？把那艘航道星舰炸出这个星系！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array, you have them. Fire at will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列，他们是你的了。随你怎么开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: They're still active. Cyclops Array! Open fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 他们还在行动。天目阵列！开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array, lock weapons on Railjack! Destroy it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列，把武器锁死瞄准在航道星舰上！消灭它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Those fools are still within the range of the Cyclops Array! Open fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 那些笨蛋还在天目阵列的射程内！开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: A few hits from the Cyclops Array should finish them off. Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列只要命中他们几发，应该就能干掉他们。开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array, obliterate them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列，消灭他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Railjack is nearing Cyclops Array. Order them to fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 航道星舰正在接近天目阵列。命令他们开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Cyclops Array, lock on Railjack! Destroy it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 天目阵列，锁定航道星舰！摧毁它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You let them get on board. Do not compound your failure by leaving them alive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们让他们登舰了。别再放他们活着离开来加重你们的失败了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Your orders are extremely simple! Locate the intruders and kill them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们的任务非常简单！找到侵入者并消灭他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: If those Tenno are not eliminated, there will be no bonuses for anyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 要是不除掉那群 Tenno，那么所有人都得不到任何奖金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Oh for Void's sake. Troops! Find them, kill them, and do not speak to me until it is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 噢，看在虚空的份上。士兵们，灭掉他们，在完成任务之前不要来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You failed to prevent the Tenno from boarding. Intercept them at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们没能阻止 Tenno 登舰。立即拦截他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I wanted them dead. They are not only alive, they are on my ship. Fix that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我想让他们死。结果他们不仅活着，还跑到我的舰上。把这问题解决了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tenno have somehow been allowed to board us. Unacceptable. Wipe them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Tenno 不知为何被允许登上了我们的战舰。无法接受。把他们消灭掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Helmets on, shields up, and exterminate those Tenno rats! MOVE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 带上头盔，开启护盾，然后消灭那些 Tenno 耗子！动起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Intercept those Tenno! Any damage they cause will be deducted from your salaries!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 拦下那些 Tenno！他们所造成的任何损失将会从你们的工资里扣除！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: You failed to prevent the Tenno from boarding. Intercept them at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 你们没能阻止 Tenno 登舰。立即拦截他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Push all shields to the limit! Tether Power Plant to full output!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 把所有护盾提升至极限！群舰蕴能站调整为全力输出！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tether Power Plant, give us full shield enhancement!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 群舰蕴能站，给我们提供全护盾增强！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tether Power Plant. Amplify field resonance. Boost all shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 群舰蕴能站。扩大共振范围。增强所有护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Give all shields as much charge as they will bear. I want that Tether Power Plant working overtime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 给所有护盾提供尽可能多的充能。我需要那个群舰蕴能站超额运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Instruct the Tether Power Plant to fortify all shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 命令群舰蕴能站强化所有护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Push all shields to max. Keep going! Defend the Tether Power Plant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 把所有护盾推到极限。继续！保卫好群舰蕴能站！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All units prepare for shield supercharge. Ensure the Tether Power Plant is protected!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体部队，准备好迎接护盾超载。保护好群舰蕴能站！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Tether Power Plant has supercharge ready. All units, stand by to overload shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 群舰蕴能站已预备充能就绪。全体都有，准备接收过载护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: All units prepare for shield resonance amplification! Tether Power Plant, deliver charge boost!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 全体部队，准备好迎接立场共振激增！群舰蕴能站，给我们助力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Instruct the Tether Power Plant to fortify all shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 命令群舰蕴能站强化所有护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Aurax troop consignments are in their Ramsleds and itching for a fight. Freightlinker! Send them in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 运送的傲金部队已抵达冲锋艇，并渴望殊死一战。运联站！送他们上战场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Freightlinker. Launch Ramsleds. Put the Aurax to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 运联站，发射冲锋艇。该让傲金作战单位大展身手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Freightlinker! Launch Ramsleds. Show them what Aurax troops can do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 运联站！发射冲锋艇。让他们见识一下傲金部队的厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: They want our shipment? Very well. Freightlinker! Send Aurax troops to board them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 他们想要我们的货物？很好。运联站！派出傲金部队强登他们的星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Freightlinker, you are clear to deploy your Aurax units. Ramsleds, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 运联站，可以部署你的傲金作战单位了。冲锋艇，出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Corpus Aurax troops, this is what you trained for. Freightlinker, send the Ramsleds in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: Corpus 傲金部队，你们所受的训练就为了这一刻。运联站，派遣冲锋艇过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: I'm commandeering those Aurax troops. Freightlinker, send Ramsleds at the Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 我正在指挥那些傲金部队。运联站，派遣冲锋艇到航道星舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Freightlinker is carrying specially-trained Aurax troops. Clear them for Ramsled launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 运联站载有经过特殊训练的傲金部队。准备好发射冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Get our Aurax forces off the Freightlinker transport and into their Ramsleds! Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 让我们的傲金部队离开运联站并进入他们的冲锋艇！就现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.text: Troop transport Freightlinker, you are clear to deploy your Aurax units. Ramsleds, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackCorpus.zhText: 承运部队的运联站，可以部署你的傲金作战单位了。冲锋艇，出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Cowards! You came here to fight. So let's fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Cowards! You came here to fight. So let's fight.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Stop messing about. Face me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Stop messing about. Face me!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Friend! I've been so impatient to meet you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Friend! I've been so impatient to meet you again.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Remember the first time? They spiked me with Kuva, said kill Tenno skoom. Or die by their magic. Good times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Remember the first time? They spiked me with Kuva, said kill Tenno skoom. Or die by their magic. Good times.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Your voltage ran through me. My organs fried. My mind shattered. You killed me. And I grew stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Your voltage ran through me. My organs fried. My mind shattered. You killed me. And I grew stronger.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: I built a small empire, you tore it down. Obliterated my fleet. Killed me over and over. And still I grew stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: I built a small empire, you tore it down. Obliterated my fleet. Killed me over and over. And still I grew stronger.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: This ship is the culmination of my effort, its power surrounds me. I am untouchable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: This ship is the culmination of my effort, its power surrounds me. I am untouchable.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: You taught me this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: You taught me this.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: How many of my Grineer have you made feel this pain?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: How many of my Grineer have you made feel this pain?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Electrocution. It hurts, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Electrocution. It hurts, doesn't it?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: It's time, contact the surface and engage the Disruptor Field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: It's time, contact the surface and engage the Disruptor Field.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Clever tricks, friend, but you know I've seen them all before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Clever tricks, friend, but you know I've seen them all before.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Used to be scared of dying, now I relish your blade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Used to be scared of dying, now I relish your blade.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: The kuva in my veins always tingles as you near. Do you feel it too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: The kuva in my veins always tingles as you near. Do you feel it too?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Each time, I felt the great expanse of nothing. What do you feel when you die, Friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Each time, I felt the great expanse of nothing. What do you feel when you die, Friend.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: I've seen you take many forms, but this one is by far my favorite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: I've seen you take many forms, but this one is by far my favorite.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: What's that- You can't- WAIT- NO- ARHGHHHH!!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: What's that- You can't- WAIT- NO- ARHGHHHH!!!!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Interceptors! I said protect the generators. Follow your orders!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Interceptors! I said protect the generators. Follow your orders!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Seize that pretty little Railjack. Deploy Ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Seize that pretty little Railjack. Deploy Ramsleds!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Lock on! Launch torpedoes! Let the fun begin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Lock on! Launch torpedoes! Let the fun begin!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: I am the greatest thing you ever created, and you're trying to destroy me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: I am the greatest thing you ever created, and you're trying to destroy me.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: When will you learn? I'm immortal… just like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: When will you learn? I'm immortal… just like you.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.text: Think you're smart, do you? Fight me and find out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailJackKingpi.zhText: Think you're smart, do you? Fight me and find out.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding party eliminated. Ship secured. Back to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰敌人已被全歼。战舰确保安全。返回工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Return to stations. We can clean up later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 返回指定地点。我们可以稍后清理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ship secured. De-escalating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰确保安全。降低警戒等级。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shelve the bloodlust. Boarders repelled. Back to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 收起杀心。登舰敌人已被击退。回到工作岗位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cannot blame them for trying. Ship secured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 不能责怪他们，他们太弱了。战舰安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarders neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰敌人已被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ramsled teams neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冲锋艇队伍已被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ship secure. Everyone in one piece? Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰安全了。大家都还好吧？好样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ship secure. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰安全了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Explosive defused. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 爆炸装置解除。辛苦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hm. Flaked 3-hexokoltan wired to a mechanical timer. Cute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 嗯。3-六钶钽薄片连到了一个机械计时器上。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crisis averted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 危机解除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Done. Back to business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 完成。回到正事上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That would have done serious damage. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那应该会造成严重破坏。干得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hm. Poorly made. Whoever put this together is lucky to still have fingers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 嗯。粗制滥造。组装这个东西的人手指能完好绝对是幸运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Good job. None of us were ready to get spaced just yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 干的不错。现在我们还没有人准备好被隔离起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hm. Rush job. Improvised. This thing would have barely scratched the paint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 嗯。临时工即兴发挥干的活。这东西几乎不会划坏舰体涂料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: our time is half up. Defuse that bomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我们的时间只剩一半。解除那个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Explosive timer down 50%. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 爆炸倒计时已达 50% 以下。抓紧时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Time is short. Find that bomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 时间有限。找到那个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are wasting time. Defuse that bomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们在浪费时间。解除那个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Timer down to 25%. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 爆炸倒计时已达 25% 以下。抓紧时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are cutting this fine. Defuse that explosive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你把时间卡得太紧了。解除那个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are out of time. Neutralize that explosive now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们没时间了。现在解除那个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Countdown has almost expired. It is now or never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 倒计时即将结束。再不拆除就来不及了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Explosion imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 即将爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All hands: brace for decompression.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有人，为战舰减压做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Breach sealed. Railjack integrity restored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 裂口已修补。航道星舰完整性已恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Astroframe integrity preserved. Good job. Return to duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星体框架的完整性保全了。干得好。回到工作岗位上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crisis averted. Mission continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 危机排除了。继续执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Repressurizing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 重新加压中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Let us move things along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 让我们继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，加把劲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: time is wasting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，时间不等人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Complete the objective quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 快速完成目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: hunt for anything we can use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，搜集一切我们能用的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: Find material and supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，查找材料和物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We need resources and supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们需要资源和物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，返航。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: return to the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，返回航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: requesting your immediate return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，请即刻返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: you are needed back on the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，你们需要回到星舰上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Command sent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 军令已发送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Command relayed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 军令已转达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Order sent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 命令已发送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Order relayed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 命令已传达

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Directive sent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 指令已发送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Directive relayed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 指令已转达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已发送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Relayed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已转达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Message sent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 消息已发送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship reactor has detonated. Pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰反应堆已经炸毁。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boom. Crewship eliminated. Focus on remaining targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 轰。战舰已摧毁。注意力集中在剩下的目标上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship down. That clears up some space.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰已经被摧毁了。清理出来不少地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have one less crewship to be concerned with. Direct attention to remaining targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们又少了一个战舰的威胁。把注意力转移到其他目标上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship has gone bye-bye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 可以和战舰说再见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scratch one crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 击伤一艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Translating in 3… 2… 1… Grab something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 穿梭倒计时 3……2……1……抓稳了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: 3... 2... 1... Translate.
3... 2... 1... We are out of here.
Bring me those stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 摘下星星送给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Let's stretch those wings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 让我们张开翅膀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shot locked. We are five-by-five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一切正常。正按计划预定的方向发展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Derelict boarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已登陆遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno on board derelict.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno 登陆遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Eyes open. We do not know what is on that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 睁大双眼。我们不知道那东西上有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: This is where the celestial meets the terrestrial. Derelict boarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 这里是天空与陆地交界的地方。已登陆遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: take what you can and get out. Remember what happened last time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，尽力而为，并确保安全撤离。记着上次发生的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Derelict on scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Abandoned derelict nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 被遗弃的遗迹船就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sensor readings indicate nearby derelict.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 传感器读数显示附近有遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: we have a derelict vessel on scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我们的探测范围内有一艘遗迹船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Derelict spotted. Your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已发现遗迹船。等待你的决策。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a dead ship in range. Possible wreckage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们的探测范围内有一艘废弃船只。可能是残骸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Electrical hazard. Shield integrity compromised. Repair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 电力事故。护盾完整性受损。维修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shield system shorting. Omnis required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾系统短路。需要万用工具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Electrical fire. Shield strength kneecapped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 电路起火。护盾强度被屏蔽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Repair order: Electrical systems. Shield strength compromised.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 维修命令：电力系统。护盾强度受损。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shields weakened. We are shorting out. Repair the electrics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾被削弱。星舰正在短路。维修电路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Omni crew required: electrical damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 需要持有万用工具的舰员：电路损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Subsystems repaired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 辅助系统已修复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shield strength returning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾强度恢复中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Electrical hazards grounded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 电力事故已解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cancelling repair order. Shields energizing. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 维修命令取消。护盾正在恢复能量。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Electrics returning to full strength.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 电力系统正在完全恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grab something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 抓稳了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fires extinguished. Scrubbing atmosphere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 灭火完成。正在净化空气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fires extinguished. Oxygen levels normalizing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 灭火完成。正在将氧气水平正常化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Flames extinguished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 火焰已被扑灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fire alert: resolved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 火灾警报：已清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fire crew stand down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 消防舰员撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: fire on board. Location marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，舰上失火。已标记位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fire crew: attention needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 消防舰员们，请注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Alert. Fires. Alert.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警报。战舰起火。警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are burning. Deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们这失火了。快灭火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们这失火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fires.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 失火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missiles en route. Evade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹接近中。躲避。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missile impact imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹冲击迫在眉睫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missiles incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹来袭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All hands: brace for missile impact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有舰员撑牢了，准备迎接导弹冲击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missile launch detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 检测到导弹发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breached!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体出现缺口！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a breach!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们有一个缺口！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull: breached. Life support: failing. Equip an Omni and patch that leak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体：已出现缺口。生命维持状态即将失效。装备一个万用工具并且修补外漏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breach. Immediate repair required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体出现缺口。需要立即抢修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breached. Venting atmo. Situation critical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体已出现缺口。气体正在泄漏。情况危急。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breach. We are breaking apart. Immediate repairs
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体开裂。我们正在四分五裂。需要立即抢修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breach. Repeat: hull breach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体出现缺口。重复：舰体出现缺口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: patch that hull breach immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，立刻补上舰体上的那个缺口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breach ongoing. Equip your Omni and rectify this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体缺口还在。装备你的万用工具来修复它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Patch that breach or this Railjack is a memory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 补上那个缺口，否则只能追忆这艘航道星舰了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Not to nag, but in short order everything that is inside this ship will be outside this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 不是我啰嗦，只是很快，战舰里的所有东西都将跑到战舰外去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Omni required at hull breach. This is not a drill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体裂口需要万用工具。这不是演习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Taking hull damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull integrity: failing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体完整性：下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull integrity: critical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体完整性：临界状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull shredded. Crew: seconds remain to repair this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体受损。舰员们，需要赶快修复这艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull integrity critical. Preparing to abort mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体完整性处于危险状态。准备好中止任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull collapsing. I am out of options. Preparing to abort mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体正被摧毁。我别无选择。准备好中止任务。
