/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Railjack integrity critical. Hull breach imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 航道星舰完整性处于危险状态。舰体面临出现缺口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull: critical. Breach: imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体：危险状态。缺口：即将产生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull breach imminent. If I wanted a hole I would install a window.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体即将出现缺口。如果我想要一个洞的话，我会安装一个窗户。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull rupture. Breach risk. Omnis needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体破裂。有出现缺口的危险。需要万用工具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Repair order: Hull rupture. Omnis, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 维修命令：舰体破裂。万用工具，出动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a hull rupture. Full-on breach imminent. Repair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们的舰体有一处破裂。星舰面临出现缺口。维修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull integrity alert. Hull rupture. Catastrophic decompression imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体完整性警报。舰体破裂。灾难性减压即将来袭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull rupture. Seal before we suffer a full blow-out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体破裂。在我们彻底爆裂之前先密封一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Rupture. Explosive decompression imminent. Seal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 破裂。面临爆炸性减压。封闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority repair order: hull ruptures. Decompression risk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 优先维修指令：舰体破裂。存在减压风险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull ruptures sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体破裂已密封。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ruptures sealed. Good job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 破裂密封完成。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sealant applied. Hull integrity stabilized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已施加密封材料。舰体的完整性已稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Compression levels stabilizing. Ruptures sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 压力水平趋于稳定。裂缝已封闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Normalizing interior pressure. Ruptures sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 内部压强正常化中。裂缝已封闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Breach risk contained. Ruptures sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 出现缺口的风险已遏制，裂缝已封闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Intruders on board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰上有入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Repel boarders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 击退登舰敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Intruders have entered the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 入侵者进入了航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: boarding party is packing explosives. Neutralize them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，登舰敌人携带爆炸装置。消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding party intends to sabotage this ship. Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰敌人试图破坏这艘战舰。阻止它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: intruders have planted a timed explosive device.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，入侵者已布下定时爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I detect airborne cyclohexanone. There is an explosive device aboard this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我检测到空气中的环己酮。这艘战舰上有一个爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: a timed explosive has been placed. Find and deactivate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，一个定时爆炸装置已设置。寻找并且拆除它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: a section of hull has been rigged to explode. Prevent this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，舰体的一个区域将要爆炸。阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Bomb aboard. Defuse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 炸弹已部署。拆除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sabotage alert: defuse explosive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 破坏警报：解除爆炸装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno deployed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno 已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno disembarking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno 正在离舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A Tenno has exited the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一名 Tenno 已经离开了航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Dropping Tenno out of airlock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 从气密舱送出 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Decrypting archives… Crew, you might find this interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 解密档案……舰员，你可能会发现这很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Infested. Watch your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Infested。小心身后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Infested: A hideous malfunction of biology. Rectify that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Infested，是生物的可怕异变。净化它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Welcome back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 欢迎回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno, on deck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno，回到星舰上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Welcome aboard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 欢迎登舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Permission to board, granted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰许可，已批准。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All hands, make ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 全体舰员，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: ready when you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All systems functional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有系统均正常运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ready to depart, on your order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 出发准备完毕，就等你一声令下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am glad you are back. Cephalon Ordis certainly has many, many... opinions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我很高兴你回来了。中枢 Ordis 的确有很多，很多的……意见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Systems check: complete. Ready to launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 系统检查：完成。随时可以启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: War is a lifetime's scholarship. The enemy no finer teacher.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：战争是终生的学问，敌人是最好的老师。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: carbon accretion cleared from nacelles. Control surfaces recalibrated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，积碳已从吊舱中清除。控制平面已重新校正。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: I have fine-tuned the confluence aggregator. Expect an uptick in orgone efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我已经对汇合聚合器进行了微调。预计能量效率会得到提高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: pressure within catalytic arteries has been optimized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，催化反应主干道内压力值已得到优化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: orgone accumulator has been resealed. Negentropy risk at safe levels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，能量积蓄器已重新被封装。负熵风险在安全范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: I am ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: the opposite of a small truth is a lie. The opposite of a great truth is another great truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：事实的另一面是谎言。而一条伟大真理的另一面则是另一条伟大真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: it is difficult to understand the universe if you only study one planet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：只研究一颗行星是无法真正理解整个宇宙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: if we make our opponent flinch, we have already won.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：如果我们能让敌人畏惧退缩，那我们就已经赢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: if we do not control the enemy, the enemy will control us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：如果我们没能控制敌人，敌人就会控制我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Meditation: that which can be destroyed by the truth, should be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 沉思：那些能被真理摧毁的东西，就应当被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fission tanks scrubbed, grounded and flushed. Ready for service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 裂变槽已完成清理、打磨和冲洗。随时可以启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cogitators defragged and optimized. Warfighting algorithms iterated and updated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 数据分析器已完成整理与优化。战斗算法已进行迭代与更新。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Deploying remote support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 部署远程支援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Team. Standby for air support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 全体注意。待命等候空中支援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Team. Standby for offensive support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 全体注意。待命等候进攻支援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Your efforts proved inadequate. Reflect upon this. Mission aborted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 前功尽弃。去自我反省。任务中止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have lost the day. Mission logged as failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们战败了。任务记录为失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Failure. Aborting mission. This performance must be examined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 失败。中止任务。这次的行动需要好好检讨一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Mission failed. This is... suboptimal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 任务失败。这真是……不理想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am scrubbing the mission. We are done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我要抹除这次任务。这里没有我们的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am pulling us out. We have lost the day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我要让大家脱离这里。我们失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am pulling you out. There will be other days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我来救你出来。以后有的是机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I was unprepared. I will consider this and improve. Come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我还没做好准备。我会反省检讨并改进。回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You were unprepared. This is on me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你还没做好准备。这是我的责任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Get out of there. We can try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 离开那里。以后有的是机会再来尝试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Aborting. Better to fail the mission than fail you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 撤离。宁愿任务失败也不想失去你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Our losses can be replaced. You cannot. I am pulling you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们的损失可以被弥补。但我们不能失去你。我来救你出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Archwing slingshot: loaded. Tenno in the barrel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 曲翼弹射器：已拉满。Tenno 准备发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have been boarded. This is our home. Defend it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人已经上舰。这是我们的家园。保卫它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Intruder alert. Full squad, small arms. I want those amateurs off my ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 侵入者警报。满编小队，轻装武器。我希望那些不入流的敌人离开我的战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are boarded. Aim for the head and may the saints look away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人登上我们的船了。瞄准头部开火，毫不留情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Visitors: your short lives are about to become crap dipped in misery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 访客，你短暂的一生都将陷入痛苦不堪之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have been boarded. And here is the B Team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人已经登上了我们的战舰。这里是 B 小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Oh look. A boarding party. Crew, if you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 哦，看。一组登舰小队。舰员们，如果你们愿意搞定他们的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A clumsy breach. Our invaders possess more enthusiasm than talent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一次笨拙的突破。我们的入侵者心有余而力不足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: we have been boarded. Tell them we're not buying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，敌人已经登上了我们的战舰。告诉他们我们不吃这套。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I see… tearing… across five dimensions. Reality is about to invert and grow teeth. We have waited too long. Return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我看见……五个维度上的……撕裂。现实似乎即将逆转且变得更糟。我们已经等了太久。请返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: My systems have become unreliable. Full cohesion loss in short order. I will not be with you for much longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我的系统已经变得不靠谱。内聚力即将完全丧失。我们很快就将向彼此告别。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Kuva Lich confirmed. Close in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已确认赤毒玄骸的存在。向其逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Kill confirmed. Galleon decapitated. Return to Railjack. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 确认击毙。帆船战舰已被击溃。返回航道星舰。快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer crewship has a Tenno at the helm. Watch your fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有 Tenno 在驾驶 Grineer 战舰。不要误伤友军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have captured the enemy crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们已经俘虏了敌方战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy crewship under our command.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方的战舰在我们的控制之下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship captured. Drive it like you stole it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰已俘获。开着它赶紧跑路吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship captured. Tenno in the saddle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰已俘获。Tenno 坐上了驾驶位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are on their boards. Look alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们已被敌方侦测到。赶快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer interceptors alerted. Contact imminent. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 截击机警报。即将短兵相接。祝好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Incoming fighters. Get to stations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战斗机来袭。各就各位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Multiple bogeys. Man the guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 若干不明飞行物。炮手就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fighters on attack vector. Gunners: fire at will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战斗机在攻击范围内。炮手，任意开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Incoming attack craft. Crew: light them up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 攻击机来袭。舰员们，点燃它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fighters on scope. Take them down wholesale.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现战斗机。将它们一网打尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: They have launched fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 他们派出了战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Detected: single-person attack craft. Prepare to engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 检测到：单人攻击机。准备迎战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Alert: enemy fighters have been scrambled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警报：敌方战斗机已经紧急起飞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Bogeys on scope. Good hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现不明飞行物。祝你狩猎成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fighter launch detected. Bogeys closing in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 侦测到战斗机起飞。不明飞行物从四面八方逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fighters incoming. Keep them off the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战斗机来袭。让他们离我们的战舰远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Incoming ramsleds about to ring the doorbell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冲锋艇很快就要送上门来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ramsled launch detected. Looks like a party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 检测到冲锋艇已发射。看来这是一个小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ramsleds inbound. Prepare to repel boarders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冲锋艇已登舰。准备击退登舰敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ramsled launch. Optimists inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冲锋艇发射。高估自己的敌人要上场了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ramsleds inbound. Roll out the welcome mat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冲锋艇已登舰。铺设欢迎地毯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Unwelcome visitors inbound. Prepare to repel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有不受欢迎的访客想进来。准备击退他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno: kill him. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno：杀了他。现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: void sinks manifesting in quantity. We need that target dead yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，虚空陷裂大量出现。我们应该昨天就做掉那个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All systems integrated. Reactor: still offline. This ship needs power. I search for what is missing. The harder I look, the less I see. Tenno, be my eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有系统已整合。反应堆：仍然失效。这艘飞船需要动力。我在搜索缺少的东西。我看得越仔细，我看到的就越少。Tenno 战士，帮我看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Where the negative resides my mind is dissonance. All I know is... Lua. Will you go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在不可能存在之处，我难以保持清醒。我知道的就只有……月球。你，会去那儿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Nav is ready for coordinates. I urge: Lua. Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导航已就绪，随时可以输入坐标。我强调：月球。月球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Railjack will be waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 航道星舰将会待命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I behold nothingness. You are in the right place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我，看到了虚无。你，来对地方了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Stop. Something has occurred. The periphery of absence... I felt it tremble. A desire to be filled. To be known. You hold a key. Return to the Orbiter. I believe you have found my answer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 停下。情况有变。在虚无的边缘……我感觉到了它在颤抖。一种渴望，亟待满足，需要被人认知。你的手里有一把钥匙。返回轨道飞行器吧。我相信，你已经找到了我要的答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are close to resolution. I can... feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们距离答案，只剩一步之遥。我能……感觉得到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Take what you have found to that which I cannot find. The negative will be proven. My end shall be at an end. Begin our beginning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 将你找到的东西带到我无法找到的地方去。我感知不到的存在将得到验证。我，也将走向终结，迎来新的开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Something moves: an infinite zero. Impossible. Perception failure. Recalibrating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有东西移动了：无数个零。这不可能。认知已失败。正在重新校正。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All systems... clear. Reactor online. Whatever you did, we are spaceworthy. Proceed to navigation. You have earned this. Railjack online. Let's take her out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有系统……已就绪。反应堆已就绪。无论你做了什么事情，我们都能航天飞行。进入导航。这是你应得的。航道星舰已经准备就绪。让我们带她离开吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shields: full.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾：满载。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shields: 50%.
Shields: down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾：消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shields have collapsed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾已被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shields are stripped. Hull exposed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 护盾已被剥离。舰体已经暴露无遗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: There: that's the commander. Get them dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那里：那就是指挥官。干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Commander spotted. We need that target dead yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现指挥官。我们应该昨天就干掉那个目标的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are right on the target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你正对着目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The commander is right there. Do your thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 指挥官就在那里。做你的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Grineer commander could not be made to heed a warning against building an asteroid base here. We can only make him wish that he had. Get over there and redecorate it from the inside. Him too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 司令官执意要在这里建造一个小行星基地。我们只能让他后悔他当初做的决定。进入基地内部来重新装饰一下，以及让指挥官本人改头换面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Asteroid base. Its commander is a known war criminal, lives on vobi butter and smells like a blown-up men's room. Take him out. Leave an air freshener.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 小行星基地。它的指挥官是一位臭名昭著的战犯，靠沃比黄油度日，并且散发出厕所堵塞时的气味。消灭他。保留一丝清新空气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A Grineer commander is using this asteroid base to broadcast propaganda. You could eat a dictionary and crap more sense than he makes, but he still needs to go. Infiltrate and terminate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一名 Grineer 指挥官正利用该基地进行宣传。你可以生吞一本字典，然后说出比他的宣传更加没头没脑的话，但他还是需要去死。秘密潜入并终结他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: There is an asteroid base in this sector. It serves as a point-of-coordination for forces in surrounding sectors. Infiltrate the base, terminate the commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 这个区域有一个小行星基地。它被用来协调联系周边区域的敌军。潜入基地，终结其指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Base commander terminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 基地指挥官已被终结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scratch one base commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 消灭一名基地指挥官

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target terminated. Move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标已被终结。前往下个地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Good night, princess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 晚安，公主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Asteroid hierarchy crippled. We are good to go. Mission wrapped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 小行星的指挥结构已被破坏。我们可以离开了。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Asteroid commander done and dusted. Sector clear. We are done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 小行星指挥官已化作骨灰与尘土一起飞扬。区域已经安全。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hearing chatter referencing a shift in command. The Queens already have a replacement en route, but this will set them back a while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 通信语音提到命令有被修正过。女皇已经派出了一个替代人物，但这将耽误他们一小会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer commander: terminated. That is all we needed to achieve in this sector. Time to move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 指挥官：已终结。这是我们在该区域所要实现的一切。继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Strange. That asteroid base was not here before. Target and kill its commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 奇了怪了。那个小行星基地之前不在这里的。将其作为目标并击杀那里的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: a new asteroid base. Nip this in the bud. Infiltrate and terminate the commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，一个新的小行星基地。将其扼杀在萌芽阶段。秘密潜入并终结那里的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Asteroid Base. We cannot leave this here. Infiltrate the base and terminate the commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 小行星基地。我们不能对此置之不理。潜入基地并终结那里的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Asteroid base on scope. Get over there and terminate the commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现小行星基地。过那边去并终结那里的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Captain identified. Neutralize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰长确认。消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That is the captain. Hit delete and come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那就是舰长。按下删除按钮，然后回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Eyeballing galleon captain. Drop the hammer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰舰长进入视野。锤下去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship on scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer crewship has translated in-sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 战舰已穿梭至此区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have company. Grineer crewship on-scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 客人来访。Grineer 战舰出现在视野范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Gatecrasher. Grineer crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 不速之客。Grineer 战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heads up: Grineer crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 注意：Grineer 战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Looks like we kicked the nest. Grineer crewship has punched in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 看来我们捅了马蜂窝。Grineer 战舰来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Alert: enemy crewship has translated into the sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警报：敌人战舰穿梭至区域之内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Alert: enemy crewship on-scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警报：监测到敌方战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy crewship has arrived. They are powering weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方战舰已抵达。他们在启动武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: They called some friends. Enemy crewship has punched in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 他们召集了些友军。敌方战舰已经开始涌入了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The enemy have called in a crewship. Situation evolving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人召集了战舰。事态正在发生变化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reading large translation signature: crewship. The enemy have reinforced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 读取到大规模战舰移动。敌人的增援到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crewship reinforcement has arrived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战舰增援已经抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Key components marked. Destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已标记关键部位。破坏它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Away crew, wrecking time. Destroy marked components.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 外勤舰员，破坏的时候到了。破坏已标记的组件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Marking sensitive systems. Trash the place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在标记机密系统。将这个地方变成废墟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighters are routing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方的战斗机正在溃败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighters on the run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方的战斗机正在撤逃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We broke them. Skies are clear of fighter cover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们击退了他们。空中没有战斗机掩护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Fighters neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战斗机已被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighters are falling back. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方战斗机正在撤退。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy morale has broken. Fighters are peeling off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方士气低落。战斗机正在撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Remaining fighters are being called off. Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 残留的战斗机正在撤退。太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighters down fifty percent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已经消灭了五成敌方战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy squadrons halved. Maintain pressure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方舰队已经减半了。继续施压。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am seeing a lot of fighter shrapnel. Pilot morale: destabilizing. Continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我看到了许多战斗机碎片。飞行员士气：不断动摇。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighter support has been halved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方战斗机增援已经减半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy pilots are panicking. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌军飞行员开始惊慌失措了。加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy fighter cover halved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方战斗机掩护减半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Maintain anti-fighter cover. They are about to break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 继续给战斗机施压。他们就要溃败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Radiator down. Away crew, expose the next radiator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 散热器已被破坏。外勤舰员，找到下一个散热器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: One down. One to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已破坏了第一个。还有一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: One radiator down. Make it two.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已破坏了一个散热器。再多破坏一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Expose the second radiator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 暴露第二个散热器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Need Tenno on the inside. Breach their systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 里面需要 Tenno。破解它们的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Get inside and extend the radiators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 进去并且暴露散热器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: One of you needs to get in there and breach their systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你们中的一个要进去那里并破解它们的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All is quiet. Crew: you may stand down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一片寂静。舰员们，你可能可以放松一会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient structure secured. Mission complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 构造确认获得。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient threat: eliminated. Grineer threat: eliminated. Mission: successful. Stand down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 威胁：已消灭。Grineer 威胁：已消灭。任务：成功。休息一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All threats neutralized. Sentient structure secured. Closing out the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有威胁均已消除。Sentient 构造确认获得。任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient forces decimated. Objective complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 部队已被消灭。目标已完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: No further Sentients are incoming. Objective complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 未发现 Sentient 后续部队。目标已完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient reinforcement has halted. Objective complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 已停止派遣增援单位。目标已完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: Something on sensors. A structure. Sentient. Prepare to board, sweep and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，探测器上检测到了什么东西。一个建筑。Sentient。准备登舰，并进行完整的歼灭行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient structure. That is what drew the Grineer's interest. Crew: infiltrate and sterilize. Leave no Sentient operational.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 的建筑。这引起了 Grineer 的兴趣。舰员：潜入清理。不留任何 Sentient 活口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That... thing... Sentient. I saw them during the Old War. Board immediately. Sterilize to prevent the Grineer from exploiting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那…东西…Sentient。我曾在远古之战见过它们。马上登陆。清理干净以免Grineer滥用了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Anomaly revealed. A sentient structure. Board it. Kill everything that moves. Go now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现异常。一个Sentient建筑。在它上面登陆。消灭所有活动的东西。去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Grineer are expressing interest in unusual energy readings nearby. Investigate and deny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 对附近的异常能量读数表示出了兴趣。展开调查并制止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer chatter references a nearby anomaly. Investigate and disrupt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 通信语音提到附近有一处异常。展开调查并破坏它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Unusual. Energy readings I have not seen since the Old War. Investigate and clear out any hostiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 太不寻常了。自从远古之战后我就没见过这样的能量读数了。展开调查并清除任何敌对势力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer have eyes-on... something. I do not like the sound of this. Investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 一直监视着……某样东西。我不喜欢这样的声音。去调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A Grineer expedition is moving with speed toward an empty point in space. Strange. They know something. Investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一支 Grineer 探险队正朝着太空中的一个空白点快速移动。奇了怪了。他们应该知道些什么。展开调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon Captain down. Support down. Sector clear. Closing mission dossier. Requesting new orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰舰长被击毙。支援队伍被击毙。区域清理干净。结束任务档案。正在请求新指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Captain terminated. Closing mission. Crew: avail yourselves of up to, but no more than, five minutes downtime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰长已被消灭。任务结束。舰员，调整一下自己，但是休息时间不能超过 5 分钟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Captain terminated. Enemy routed. Reminds me of the old days. Closing mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰长已被消灭。敌人被击溃。让我想起了过去。结束任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon has translated in-sector. Carrying a high-priority target: the captain. Infiltrate and terminate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰已穿梭至此区域。舰上有一名高优先级的目标：舰长。潜入并消灭该目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon on-scope. Assassinate the captain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现帆船战舰。刺杀舰长

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon. Our shipboard weapons will be ineffective. Board and kill its Captain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰。我们舰载的武器即将失效。登上该战舰并击杀舰长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon has entered the fight. This changes things. Updating target manifest: Galleon Captain. Board and kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰参与了战斗。这改变了一切。更新目标清单：帆船战舰舰长。登舰并击杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: I need volunteers to board that galleon and kill its captain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我需要有人自愿登上那艘帆船战舰，并杀死其舰长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Radio chatter reports galleon captain terminated. They are rudderless. Excellent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 无线电通讯的报告显示帆船战舰的舰长已被消灭。他们现在群龙无首。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Captain terminated. Galleon in disarray. Objective complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已消灭舰长。帆船战舰内部混乱不堪。任务目标完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Galleon Captain is off the board. A perfect outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 帆船战舰舰长已不在舰上。完美的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer galleon in-system. High-value personage aboard. Infiltrate and terminate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 帆船战舰来了。舰上有高价值人物。潜入并且消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer forces massing alongside that galleon. Hm. Bodyguard detail. Their captain is nervous. Let's get them dead. Infiltrate and terminate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 强制它们的手下沿着那艘帆船战舰集合。嗯，贴身保镖。它们的舰长很紧张。我们来杀死它们吧。潜入并且消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer galleon plus support. Too big to take down, but you can get in. Find whoever is in charge of that thing and take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 帆船战舰加上它们的支援。目标太大而难以拿下。不过你可以进去。找到负责指挥的那群敌人并且消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Primary target: Grineer galleon with support. Get on board. Locate the one calling the shots. Kill them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 首要目标：被支援的 Grineer 帆船战舰。登上它们的战舰。找到它们的头目并杀死它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy in retreat. Sector secured. Drawing a line under this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人撤退。区域确认安全。就此告一段落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sector secured. Enemy have turned tail. Mission complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 区域确认安全。敌人消失不见了。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The enemy is no longer a viable threat. Your tactics were sound. Resolving mission brief. Nav ready for new heading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人不再对我们产生威胁。你的战术很合理。只花了一点时间就完成了任务。导航已经指向下个方向了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer in disarray. Sector secured. Mission: successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 陷入一片混乱。区域安全确认。任务：成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Not a bad warm up. Objectives met. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 作为热身还不错。目标已完成。前往下个地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy forces beheaded. Threats neutralized. Closing mission. Next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌军群龙无首。威胁已被消除。任务结束。进入下一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy infrastructure neutralized. Filing mission as complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方基础设施已被摧毁。任务归类为完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy in retreat. Surviving Grineer will spread the word. Mission resolved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌人撤退了。幸存的 Grineer 将会四散而逃。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shatter Grineer operational capacity in this sector. Targets marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在这个区域粉碎 Grineer 的作战能力。目标已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: This is a raid. Eliminating priority targets and defensive units will negatively impact enemy cohesion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 这是一次突袭。消灭首要敌人和防御单位，这样会对敌人的凝聚力产生负面影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy forces on scope. Delete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现敌方势力。抹除他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Targets on the board. Good hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标在舰上。祝你狩猎成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Entering operational theater. Hit them until they do not get up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 进入作战大厅。打它们，直到它们不能站起来为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer in-sector. Let's change that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 在里面。让我们改变这个事实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Bad guys. Hit them in the knees.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 坏人们。攻击他们的膝盖要害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Clear this sector. A decisive first strike will increase odds of victory by 147%.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 清理该区域。决定性的第一轮攻击将使胜率提高 147%。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Looks like the Grineer are feeling lucky. Good hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 看起来 Grineer 觉得自己挺走运的。祝你狩猎成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer. Hit them where it hurts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer。攻击他们的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer dry dock. They are working on something. I want to know what. Infiltrate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 干船坞。我想知道他们到底在那里干什么。执行潜入行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Strange place for a hangar. Find out why it is here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 设置停机库的地方很奇怪。弄清楚它为什么会在这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Interesting. Grineer hangar. Here for a reason. Find out that reason and steal it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有意思。Grineer 停机库。在这里一定是有原因的。查明原因然后把它窃取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Prototype destroyer, on lockdown. Rupture the hangar's core to disable lockdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 原型机驱逐舰，被锁起来了。撕裂停机坪的核心来解锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Prototype craft. One-of-a-kind. It would be terrible if someone stole it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 原型机飞行器。独一无二。如果有人窃取将非常可怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Experimental Grineer war vessel: locked down tight. Take it for a spin, I want to read its logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 试验型 Grineer 战舰：处于严密封锁之下。带它出来遛一圈吧，我想看看它的运行记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: R&D facility. Steal the command crewship. I want copies of everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 研发设施。偷走那里的指挥战舰吧。我需要所有数据的副本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ship stolen. Downloading navigation data. Nice work Hotshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已窃取战舰。正在下载导航数据。大佬，干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: These specs will make for interesting reading. Do what you want with that ship. I have what I need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 这些设计图里有相当不错的的情报。至于那艘战舰，随你怎么处置吧。我已经得到了需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You can cool your jets. Downloading specs. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 让你的战舰熄火吧。正在下载设计图。辛苦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All research acquired and copied. Excellent work. We can get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 所有研究数据都已获取并复制。很好。我们可以离开这里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: It will take some time to parse these millions of files. Meantime, enjoy your new jets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我需要一些时间来分析这数百万页的文件。在此期间，你可以好好享受一下你的新战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: R&D acquired. We know people who can make good use of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 研发数据已获取。我们这儿有能够充分利用这些数据的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: a missile battery is disrupting civilian traffic in this sector. This intimidation cannot be allowed to stand. Marking objectives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，导弹炮台干扰该区域的民用通讯。这种威胁是不能容忍的。正在标记目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A missile battery is operating in this vicinity: a clear first step in Grineer efforts to control this sector. Neutralize it. Be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在这附近有一个正在运作的导弹炮台：很明显这是 Grineer 试图控制这个区域所做的第一步。消灭它们。小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: missile battery. Standard op. If we do not dig the Grineer out now they will reinforce and then it becomes a whole other thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，导弹炮台。标准操作。如果我们现在不铲除这里的 Grineer 势力，他们将会得到增援，然后那就变成另一码事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Grineer call their missile batteries 'a persistent reminder of Grineer superiority and dominance'. I call them practice. Objectives marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 把他们的导弹炮台吹嘘为"一个 Grineer 优越性和统治性的象征"。我将其称之为儿戏。目标已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew, get inside that missile battery. Objective: expose the core's radiators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，进入那个导弹炮台。目标：暴露核心散热器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target: missile battery. Orders: infiltrate. Objective: expose radiators. Destroy core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标：导弹炮台。命令：秘密潜入。目的：暴露散热器。摧毁核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missile battery. It has to go. Standard op: infiltrate and slag the core. Execute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹炮台。必须摧毁。标准操作：潜入并销毁核心。请立即执行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That is the problem with missile batteries: they are packed with explosives. Cook-off gutted the place. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 这就是导弹炮台的问题：它们装有炸药。爆燃烧毁了这个地方。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That last shot cooked off every missile rack they had. Target neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 最后一击爆燃了他们的所有导弹发射架。目标已被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hit and run. Good job. Let's move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 游击突袭。干得好。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missile battery internals slagged. Everyone in one piece? Let us move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹炮台内部已被销毁。大家都还好吗？该执行下一个任务了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: There she goes. Missile battery down. Take a breath and redirect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在那。导弹炮台被击毁。喘一口气，转移目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scratch one high-payload kinetic kill station. I have no idea how these chumps keep paying for those. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 损坏一个高载荷动力击杀台。我不知道这些笨蛋是怎么不断地支付维持那些东西的。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Targets eliminated. Missile battery neutralized. I will notify the Ostrons. They can turn it into a rec center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标已被消灭。导弹炮台已失去它原本的作用。我将通知 Ostron 人。他们会把这里变成一个娱乐中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Missile battery is toast. Contacting nearby Solaris craft. They could use the parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 导弹炮塔已被摧毁。告知附近的 Solaris 飞船。那里的部件可能对他们有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Objectives fulfilled. Local scavengers will have that place stripped in a matter of cycles. No further action needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标完成。当地的拾荒者将在一个周期内把那个地方拆个干净。没必要采取进一步的行动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Grineer forces routed from system. Missile battery rendered non-viable. Sector secured. Closing dossier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 势力从星系溃败而逃。导弹炮台已无法再被利用。区域确保安全。正在结束档案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a Pulse Turbine reinforcing enemy fighters. I need an away crew on the inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们有一个脉冲涡轮可以加强敌方战斗机。我需要一名外勤舰员潜入内部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have a Pulse Turbine strengthening enemy craft. Get on board and shut it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们有一个脉冲涡轮可以加强敌方战机。登上再摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: New target: Pulse Turbine. Infiltrate, disable reactors, neutralize core. As long as that turbine is running the enemy is emboldened and our progress impeded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 新目标：脉冲涡轮。潜入，废弃反应堆，消灭核心。只要涡轮运转起来，敌人就会有恃无恐，我们的进程就会受阻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Pulse Turbine, reinforcing enemy units. Who is going in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 脉冲涡轮，加强敌方单位，谁要进去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Pulse Turbine rendered inoperative. Let us see how the enemy handles an even playing field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 脉冲涡轮失去作用。我们看看敌人在公平的竞争环境下发挥得如何。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbine nixed. Our enemy has lost the advantage. Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 涡轮已失效。我们的敌人失去了优势。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The pulse turbine is still. Enemy forces are destabilized. They are unused to meeting an enemy on equal terms. Cowards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 脉冲涡轮已停转。敌方部队陷入混乱。他们并不习惯平等地与敌人战斗。懦夫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbine fragged. Secondary targets eliminated. Grineer fleet is backing off. Good work. We are making a difference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 涡轮已被摧毁。次要目标已被消灭。Grineer 舰队正在撤退。做得好。我们做了一件大事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbine offline. The Queens will not be happy. Good. Closing out the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 涡轮已失效。女皇们不会高兴的。好极了。任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbine offline. I will spread the word that this sector has re-opened. Solid work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 涡轮已失效。我会传递这个区域重新开放的消息。干的漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Closing the file on that pulse turbine. Good work. They will be back, but for now this sector is clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 关闭那个脉冲涡轮上的文档。干得好。他们会回来的，但是截至目前，这个区域安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Grineer placement of a pulse turbine is a display of power intended to intimidate. We do not do intimidated. Operational objectives updated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 放置的脉冲涡轮是为了彰显军力来进行恐吓。我们不要被他们吓倒了。行动目标已更新。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A nearby pulse turbine is strengthening the Grineer fleet. Strategically, for us, this could be a pain in the neck. Take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在附近有一个脉冲涡轮正在强化 Grineer 舰队。从战略上来说，这确实让我们很头疼。将它抹除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: time for housekeeping. Take out the Grineer pulse turbine and any resistance you encounter. Send a message.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，大扫除的时间到了。摧毁 Grineer 脉冲涡轮以及任何你遇到的抵抗。传递一个信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: in the interest of sector security I have marked a nearby Grineer pulse turbine. Take it down, then knock the slats out of anything left standing. In the interest of sector security.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，为了区域安全，附近的一个 Grineer 脉冲涡轮已被我标记。摧毁它，然后将板条从废墟上敲下来。为了区域安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Radiators destroyed. Away crew, go for the core.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 散热器被破坏。外勤舰员，前往核心处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Core is vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 核心的防护消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Destroy the core. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 立刻摧毁这颗核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Opportunity: core is exposed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 机会来了：核心已暴露。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller neutralized. Suggest we move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星舰杀手炮台已经摧毁。我们可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform down. Sector cleared. That should make things easier for civilian traffic. Closing out the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星舰杀手炮台已经被干掉了。这个区域安全了。这应该可以帮助民用通讯恢复正常。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy forces pacified. Shipkiller platform neutralized. Mission resolved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌方军队已停止活动。星舰杀手炮台已摧毁。任务已解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform identified. This is a priority target. Infiltrate, and disable. It is impossible to say how many innocents may have already lost their lives to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 确认发现星舰杀手炮台。这是优先打击目标。潜入，令其失效。不知有多少无辜生命都惨死在它的炮火之下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Eyes on shipkiller platform. Clearing the sector will be difficult while it is operational. Take it out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现星舰杀手炮台。它的存在，会对这片星区的清理工作形成阻碍。将它摧毁吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform sighted. Priority target. I need Tenno on the inside, yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星舰杀手炮台已进入视野范围。这个目标需要优先处理。我需要 Tenno 潜入其内部，越快越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scratch one shipkiller.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 干掉一个星舰杀手炮台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform neutralized. A grateful sector thanks you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星舰杀手炮台已经摧毁。整个星区都会感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform offline. Permanently. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 星舰杀手炮台已永久失效。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shipkiller platform spotted in-sector. This is now a priority target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现附近有星舰杀手炮台。它现在是首要目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: energy signatures indicate the presence of a Grineer shipkiller platform. Infiltrate and neutralize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，能量信号表明 Grineer 星舰杀手炮台就在附近。秘密潜入来摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Grineer have deployed a shipkiller platform to this sector. That explains the lack of civilian radio traffic. Take it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Grineer 在这个区域部署了星舰杀手炮台。原来这是民用微波通讯这么稀少的原因。摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Exterior weakpoint exposed. Open fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 外部弱点暴露。开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Bingo. Crew, trash that radiator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 对了。舰员，将那个散热器变成垃圾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Radiator naked. Hit them with all we have got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 散热器暴露。用尽一切来击中它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Radiator exposed. Open fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 散热器暴露。开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: There it is. Blast that radiator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在那里。炸掉那个散热器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Lay fire on that enemy crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 向那艘敌方战舰开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Archwing, handle those fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 曲翼，干掉那些战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Away party, take that platform.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 离舰小队，占领那个平台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Away crew, infiltrate and disable crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 离舰舰员，潜入并破坏战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Gunner: report to artillery station.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 炮手，到火炮控制台报道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Commandeer that enemy vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 夺取那艘敌方战舰的控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Threats in-bound, take the guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 受到威胁，准备射击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are short on munitions. Get to a Forge Terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们的弹药不多了。快到锻造终端机那里去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We need a pilot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们需要一名飞行员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Hull integrity compromised. We need repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰体完整性受损。我们需要修理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scuttle enemy vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 击沉敌方战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are now equipped with an Omni. The Omni is a combination tool. Use it to extinguish fires, seal hull breaches and for a fast recall to the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你现在已经装备了万用工具。它拥有多种功能。你可以用它来扑灭大火、密封舰体裂口，以及迅速返回航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Anchor Station detected. Neutralize it before it launches an Aurax Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 监测到定锚站。在其发射傲金战舰之前消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Strategic target: Anchor Station. Payload: Advanced Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 战略目标：定锚站。载荷：最先进的战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority target: Anchor Station. Infiltrate and disable to prevent Crewship launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 首要目标：定锚站。潜入并关停它，以避免其发射战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Objective: Collapse the anchor field to set that Crewship adrift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标：瓦解锚定力场，让那艘战舰飘向太空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Anchor field collapsed. Crewship is adrift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已瓦解锚定力场。战舰已飘向太空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Anchor Station in range. Prepare away crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 定锚站已在可视范围内。外勤舰员做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Nearing Anchor Station.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在接近定锚站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cyclops Array in sector. The big guns. Get them before they get us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 此区域内有天目阵列。看看那些重装火力。在他们消灭我们之前干掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cyclops Array on scope. One hit will ruin our day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现天目阵列。只要被打中一下，我们就完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: nearby Cyclops Array poses existential threat to this Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，附近的天目阵列给这艘航道星舰造成了生死存亡的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Infiltration successful. Silence the guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功潜入。摧毁那些枪炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cyclops Array is junk. High five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 天目阵列现在是一堆破铜烂铁了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: The Cyclops has fallen. The skies are ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 天目阵列倒下了。这片星域是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Cyclops Array within boarding range. Do your thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 天目阵列已进入登陆范围内。是你们大展身手的时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Close enough. Crew: board and neutralize Cyclops Array.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 够近了。舰员们，登上并摧毁天目阵列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding crew: you are up. Put that cyclops to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰小队，该你们一展身手了。让那个天目阵列陷入沉睡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Carrier Platform in-sector. Aurax pilots are no joke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 此区域内有载机平台。傲金飞行员可不是吃素的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Detecting Aurax fighter patrols. Origin: Carrier Platform. Strategy: Eliminate Carrier Platform.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 监测到傲金巡逻战斗机。来源：载机平台。战略：摧毁载机平台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Alert. Carrier Platform scrambling Aurax fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警报。载机平台正在发射傲金战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Infiltration successful. Ground these fighters. Permanently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功潜入。让这些战斗机，永。远。停。飞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Carrier junked. Aurax fighters grounded. Too bad so sad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 载机平台已经是一片残骸了。傲金战斗机都被困住了。哎呀太惨了，真可怜呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scratch target. Carrier Platform is a graveyard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 干掉了目标。载机平台现在成了一片乱葬岗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Carrier Platform is off the board. Come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 载机平台已经无法使用。回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Carrier Platform in boarding range. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已进入载机平台的登陆范围。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Nearing Carrier Platform. Punch their doorbell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在接近载机平台。把他们的场子狠狠砸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Neutralize Carrier Platform. Make it quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 摧毁载机平台。速战速决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有点用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We can use that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们可以用到那个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Shiny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 闪闪发亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reading nearby ice mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 读数显示附近有座冰矿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ice mine on scope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现冰矿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Looks like the Corpus have an ice mine in this sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 看起来 Corpus 在这个区域有一座冰矿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are in. Eyes open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功进入。留神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Do not get turned around in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 别迷路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are in. Stay in touch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你上来了。保持联系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno pathfinder has successfully boarded. Remaining crew: sending you in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno 探路者已经成功登舰。其他舰员们，该你们上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding operation successful. Sending full away crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登舰行动成功。派出全部外勤舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tenno is in. Locking. Sending away crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Tenno 已到达。锁定中。派遣外勤舰员。
五、四、三、二、一、零。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Mark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 预备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Security node destroyed. Target remaining nodes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 安保节点已被破坏。定位剩余节点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Node disabled. Continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 节点已不可用。继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Node destroyed. Continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 节点已被摧毁。继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Transport complete. Break a leg.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 传送完成。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew transport complete. Will rendezvous upon mission success.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员传送完成。将在任务成功后会合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Caution. Void Sink detected aboard that vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 注意：在那艘战舰上监测到了虚空陷裂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: Void Sink formation detected near you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，我在你们附近监测到了虚空陷裂的形成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Void Sink forming. Eyes open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 虚空陷裂正在形成。打起精神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Void Storm rolling in. Batten down the hatches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 虚空风暴滚滚而来。封住舱门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Attention. Void Storm imminent. This will get a little bumpy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 大家注意：虚空风暴即将来临。这将会有些颠簸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Void Storm intensifying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 虚空风暴愈演愈烈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Storm is becoming more severe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 风暴越发严重了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Storm is Category Five. Five is the worst by the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 风暴等级已升至第五级。顺便说一句，第五级是最严重的那种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Void Storm amplifying. Complete the mission ASAP.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 虚空风暴正在扩大。尽快完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Warning. Void Storm is strengthening. We are tempting fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警告。虚空风暴正在增强。我们这是在试探命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Void Storm escalating. Stabilizing is proving difficult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 虚空风暴正在扩大。极难维持星舰的稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Suggestion: to avoid turbulence find cover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 建议：为躲避疾风湍流，找寻掩体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Pro tip: debris provides ample cover from Void turbulence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 专家提示：在虚空的疾风湍流中，漂浮的碎片是很好的掩体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbulence subsiding. Next time hide behind a rock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 疾风湍流减弱了。下一次躲在岩石后面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Caution. Turbulence building.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 小心。疾风湍流正在变强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Turbulence imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 疾风湍流迫近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority target: Autofactory. Robotic battle-proxies assembled on the fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 首要目标：自动装械厂。现场组装机械战斗单位的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: An Autofactory is reinforcing this sector with Aurax robotics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有个自动装械厂正在通过傲金机器人增援这一区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A nearby Autofactory will pump out Aurax-level robotics unless dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 需要尽快处理掉附近的一个自动装械厂，要不然它会不停地生产出傲金级别的机器人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: You are in. Initiate line shutdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功进入。关闭生产线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Autofactory decommissioned. Aurax robotic proxies are off the board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 自动装械厂已被关闭。傲金机器人已无法使用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Production: derailed. Robotic threat is negligible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 生产线：已被打断。机器人的威胁可忽略不计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Aurax robotic production: offline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 傲金机器人生产线：已下线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Autofactory. I need volunteers to take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 自动装械厂。我需要谁自愿把它拿下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Away crew: prepare to board Autofactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 外勤舰员，准备登上自动装械厂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Neutralize target: Autofactory. Expect resistance. Have fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 需被消灭的目标：自动装械厂。可能会遇到抵抗。尽情享受战斗吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: strategic targets disabled. Time for the main event.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，已关停战略目标。好戏开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority targets neutralized. Next up Capital Ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁优先目标。接下来要摧毁敌方旗舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Proceed to the primary objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 向首要目标推进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Strategic targets eliminated. Time for the main event.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已消灭战略目标。好戏开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority targets neutralized. Next up Capital Ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁优先目标。接下来要摧毁敌方旗舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Proceed to your primary objective. This is not a drill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 继续向首要目标推进。这不是演习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Excellent. Now shut that place down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 好极了。现在，把那里彻底关闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Everyone in one piece. All right. Kill the lights. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 大家都毫发无损。好了，把灯灭了。快去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: All right. Playtime is over. Trash the joint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 好了。游戏时间结束了。毁掉这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Primary code set decrypted. Must solve secondary code set to permit system shutdown. New terminal marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已解密一级密码。必须要解出二级密码才能关停整个系统。已标记新的终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: First code set decrypted. Move on to secondary terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 首套密码已解密。前往二级终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Primary decryption successful. One set to go. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一级密码已成功破解。还剩一套密码。行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Decryption complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 解密完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Secondary decryption complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 二级密码解密完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Done. Time to shut her down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功。该关停她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Decrypting. Protect the terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在解码。保护终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Thank you. This will take a minute. Defend this terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 谢谢你，这个过程需要一分钟。保护好这座终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Working. Intercept enemy interference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 解码中。拦截敌军的侵扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Decrypting secondary codes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在破解二级密码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A matched code set. Analyzing solutions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一套相辅相成的密码。正在分析解决方案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Secondary access codes encountered. Need more time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已找到二级访问密码。还需要点时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I am in. Stay light on your feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我进去了。注意脚下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Phase one complete. Prepare for possible countermeasures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已完成第一阶段。准备好对付他们的反制系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus v4-Alpha protocols. How retro.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Corpus 阿尔法协议，第四版。真落后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Disable priority targets prior to boarding the Capital Ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 在登上主力战舰之前，先关停首要目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Disable all priority targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 关停所有首要目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: disable priority targets before hitting that Capital Ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 船员们：在攻击敌方旗舰前，先关停优先目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Override terminal located. Pull the plug.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已定位覆写终端。给他们断电。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Work complete. Bailing. Get to the override terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 任务完成。回撤中。前往覆写终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Done. One last thing: get to the override terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 搞定。最后一件事：前往覆写终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Jamming drones. Yay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 干扰无人机。呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Progress halted. Jamming drones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 进程已被中止。是干扰无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Those jamming drones are a serious problem. Progress halted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那些干扰无人机相当棘手。进程已被中止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Countermeasures are interfering with my progress. Rectify.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反制系统正在干扰我的进程。纠正进程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Countermeasures have been activated. Destroy them. I cannot work like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反制系统已被激活。毁掉它们。我没法在这种情况下工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Countermeasures. Progress halted. Please assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反制系统。进程已被中止。请协助我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are free. Engines thawed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们自由了。引擎解冻了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are clear of ice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们已经彻底清除了冰块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Update: we are ice-free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 当前状况通报：我们的星舰上已经不再被冰块困扰了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver in sector. Comet-shard munitions are fully capable of slowing this Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 此区域内有驱冰站。冰陨碎弹完全可以拖住这艘航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A direct hit from a Comet Shard will ice our propulsion systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 如果被冰陨碎弹直接命中，我们的推进系统将被全部冻住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver. Comet Shard munitions freeze what they hit. That includes us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 驱冰站。被冰陨碎弹击中就会被冻结。这也包括我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding successful. Kill that Icedriver.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 成功登陆。摧毁那座驱冰站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Comet Shard shot down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冰陨碎弹被击落了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Incoming Comet Shard destroyed. Near miss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁来袭的冰陨碎弹。有惊无险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Comet Shard destroyed. Good shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁冰陨碎弹。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are iced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们被冻住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Comet Shard. Direct hit. Railjack slowed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 冰陨碎弹，我们被直接命中。航道星舰被减速了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Deep freeze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 深度冻结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Someone left the fridge door open. Back to the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 有人没关上冰箱门。回到舰上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 驱冰站已摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver goes boom. What a mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 驱冰站已轰然化为碎片。真是一团糟啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver in range. So are we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 驱冰站已进入射程。但是我们也进入了它的射程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Icedriver has pinged us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 驱冰站已对我们开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We are within firing range of that Icedriver. Check it and wreck it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们在那座驱冰站的射程内。压制其火力，并摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Mission success. Take five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 任务完成。休息五分钟吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Effective. Efficient. Fun. Plotting escape route.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 可用、高效、不无聊。正在绘制撤离路线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Every day in every way you are getting better and better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 每一天，你都在以各种各样的方式变得越来越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Your operational arena is the interior of that Corpus Ship. Find the target, keep it intact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 你可以在 Corpus 战舰内部大展身手了。找到目标，保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Coming up on Corpus Vessel. Board and protect the target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在接近 Corpus 战舰。登陆并保护好目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: On approach. Gear up. You are on bodyguard duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在接近。全副武装，你正在执行安保职责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Approaching Corpus vessel. Board and safeguard the target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在接近 Corpus 战舰。登陆并保护好目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Find objective. Protect. Exfiltrate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 找到目标。保护好它。然后撤出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Infiltrate Corpus ship and defend objective. Heavy resistance is assured. Are you excited. I am excited.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 潜入 Corpus 战舰并保护好目标。可以预计到会受到强力阻挠。你兴奋吗？我挺兴奋的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Lotus will take it from here. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Lotus 会接手之后的事。祝你好运。
