/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Handing off to Tenno coordinator Lotus. See you on the other side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在移交给 Tenno 统筹者——Lotus。另一边见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Lotus on the line. Handing off. Crew: good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Lotus 已上线，移交中。舰员们，祝你们好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor heating up. Keep heat levels within specified parameters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆升温。将热量水平保持在指定参数范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor cooking. Keep heat levels within assigned margins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆过热。将热量水平保持在指定范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor heat spiking. Reactor heat must maintain specified range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆过热。反应堆热量必须保持在一定的范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor console nearby. The codes you obtained will grant unimpeded access. Corpus Engineers will not immediately detect intrusion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 附近有反应堆控制台。你所获得的代码将保证畅通无阻的访问。Corpus 工程师无法立即检测到入侵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Use the security codes you garnered to access the marked reactor console. Corpus Engineers will detect nothing amiss at first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 使用你获得的安全密码访问标记的反应堆控制台。Corpus 工程师无法在第一时间检测到异常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor console on-scope. You will need to gain access without security codes. The hard way. Corpus Engineers will attempt to make it harder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现反应堆控制台。你需要在没有安全密码的情况下获得访问权限。这是困难模式，而 Corpus 工程师会试图让它难上加难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Breach reactor security. No quick access codes available. Corpus Engineers are on standby. This will get messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 破坏反应堆的安全性。没有可用的快速访问密码。Corpus 工程师正在待命。这次的行动可能会相当复杂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Mission complete. Obelisk is a tombstone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 任务完成。天碑战舰现在是块墓碑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus Pillar toppled. Mission complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Corpus 天柱战舰已倒塌。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Mission complete. Capital Ship decapitated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 任务完成。已击溃主力战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus Engineers inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Corpus 工程师来袭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Engineers inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 工程师们来袭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sabotage attempt averted. Engineers will regroup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已击退企图破坏的敌军。工程师们正在重新集结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Engineer has failed to shut down reactor. Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 工程师未能关闭反应堆。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor shutdown sequence has been initiated. Breach the console while there is still time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已启动反应堆关闭程序。趁现在还有时间，去破解控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus have initiated reactor shutdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Corpus 已经开始关闭反应堆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor superheating. Open vents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆过热。打开通风口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: High heat. Calibration compromised. Vent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 温度过高。校准受到影响。散热。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Core heat excessive. Target vents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 核心热量过多。破坏通风口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heat vented. Levels dropping below optimal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 热量已排出。温度水平降至最佳限度以下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor cooled below optimal. Let it warm up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆已冷却至最佳温度以下。让它热起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor temp is below usable levels. Heat must reaccumulate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆温度低于可用水平。必须让热能重新积聚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor heat at optimal levels. Maintain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆热量处于最佳水平。保持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heat levels are ideal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 热量处于理想水平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Core heat optimized. Keep it stable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 核心热量已达到最佳状态。保持稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Overheat that things reactors. I will update you on the fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 让那个东西的反应堆过热。我会即时给你更新信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A two-part approach. Part one: get inside. Part two: something else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 两步曲作业，第一步：潜入；第二步：还有其他安排。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target the reactor. Get in. Lower defenses. Get out. Then we make with the artillery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 记得目标是反应堆。潜进去，削弱他们的防御，然后脱身。剩下的事由光能炮来完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Adjust the reactor signature. Render it vulnerable to our weapons. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 调整反应堆特征。让它能受到我们武器的伤害。去吧

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor invulnerable to our artillery. Recalibrate Reactor to render it vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们的前装光能炮无法伤害到反应堆。重新校准反应堆，使其能受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Objective: destroy vessel. Complication: Reactor invulnerable to Railjack artillery. Solution: recalibrate Reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标：摧毁战舰。难题：航道星舰的前装光能炮，无法对反应堆造成伤害。解决方案：重新校准反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Core stabilising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 核心稳定中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Stabilised.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heat critical. Vent immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 热量处于临界温度。立即散热。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Warning. Reactor is in meltdown. Reduce heat. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 警告。反应堆正在被熔毁。降低热量。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Vent. Immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 散热。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Partial reactor recalibration complete. Identifying new target heat range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 部分反应堆已重新校准。正在确定新的目标热量范围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heat range potential exhausted. Recalibrating. Setting new thermal target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 热量范围的潜能已耗尽。重新校准。正在设置新的热量目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Recalibration proceeding. Shifting target waveband. Adjust reactor heat accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在进行重新校准。转换目标波段，并相应地调整反应堆热量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: VIP credentials. Grab them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: VIP 证件。获取它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Candy. Grab those credentials.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 好极了，拿到那些证件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: There. Security credentials.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 那里。安全证件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Now bail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 现在回撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Credential authenticity confirmed. We can go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 证件真实性已确认。我们可以出发了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Excellent. Return to mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 很好，继续任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A nearby Corpus officer carries credentials that would make this job easier. Just saying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 附近有一位 Corpus 军官，携带着可以让这项工作变得更容易一些的证件。只是提一句。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tagging nearby Corpus officer. Their credentials would assist with the reactor job. Your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在标记附近的 Corpus 军官。他们的证件将有助于我们的反应堆行动计划。由你来决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: High-level VIP credentials nearby. Stealing them would simplify the reactor plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 附近有高级 VIP 证件。偷走它们将简化我们的反应堆行动计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Patching comms through to Entrati tactical advisor. Come home safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 连线英择谛战术顾问的通讯。祝你平安返航。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Incoming transmission from Deimos. Crew. Make me proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 来自火卫二的通讯。舰员们，让我以你们为傲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: We have what we came for. Corpus jammers are overriding Railjack recall. Return via Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我们拿到了我们想要的。Corpus 干扰无人机正在覆写航道星舰的召回信号。通过曲翼返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor recalibration complete. Recall is being jammed. You will have to Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆重新校准完毕。传送被卡住了。你得使用曲翼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor recalibration complete. Return to this Railjack via Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆重新校准完毕。使用曲翼返回航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor marked. Isolating optimal firing vector. Pilot, line us up. Forward artillery, take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆已标记。正在隔离最佳发射向量。飞行员，让我们和目标保持在一条线上。前装光能炮，干掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor identified. Pilot. Align Railjack with target vector. Gunners. Ready forward artillery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已确认反应堆。飞行员，把航道星舰与目标矢量对齐。炮手，准备发射前装光能炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Subreactors on scope. Forward artillery, hit those targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现子反应堆。前装光能炮，轰击那些目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: I have visuals on multiple reactors. Engage forward artillery. Blast them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 我发现了多个反应堆。准备好前装光能炮。轰击他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Vent shaft open. Reactor heat dropping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 通风井已打开。反应堆热量下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Reactor venting. Heat discharged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 反应堆正在通风中。热量已排出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Vent destroyed. Pressure dropping. Core heat dropping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 通风口已被摧毁。压力正在下降。核心热量正在下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Maintain reactor heat within optimal range. Target vents when needed to discharge excess heat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 将反应堆的热量维持在最佳范围内。必要时破坏通风口来排出多余的热量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target vents when necessary to balance thermal load.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 必要时可破坏通风口，来平衡热量负荷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Heat levels climbing. Force vents open to cool reactor when needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 热量水平不断攀升。必要时强行打开通风口来冷却反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Notifying scavenger crews. The locals send their thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 通知回收舰员：当地居民向我们致以了感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: No life signs. Vessel is clear. Closing out this file.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 没有生命迹象。这艘战舰已经被彻底清理了。正在归档此次行动档案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: No muss no fuss. Tagging vessel for salvage. Plotting exit corridor. Take five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 不慌不忙。正在标记需要回收的战舰。绘制逃生走廊中。先休息五分钟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Training exercise. Clear out that ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 训练时间。清剿那艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Vessel on scope. Small. Clear it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现战舰，很小一艘。搞定它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Housekeeping. Cap ship. Sweep and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 清理时间。是主力战舰。开始大扫除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Command ship in-sector. Depopulate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 此区域内有战术指挥舰。灭口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target vessel marked. Standard sweep-and-clear. Make ready to board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已标记目标战舰。标准的清剿行动。准备登陆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Vessel on-scope. Clear the crew. Leave the ship for salvage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现敌舰。清除其舰员。战舰本身可以留着进行回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Target vessel is high-value. The crew is not. Sweep and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 目标战舰很有价值，不过我们不需要它的舰员。进行清剿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Lotus will take it from here. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Lotus 会接手之后的事。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Handing off to Tenno coordinator Lotus. See you on the other side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 正在移交给 Tenno 统筹者——Lotus。另一边见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Lotus on the line. Handing off. Crew: good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Lotus 已上线。移交中。舰员们，祝你们好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Sentient presence at zero. Walk away in slow motion. Orchestra swells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 的存在感已消失。缓步回撤。鼓掌庆贺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Orphix pulses have flatlined. Nice. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 奥影母艇发出的脉冲趋于平缓。很好。继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Orphix Sentients have overrun that Corpus cap ship. Corpus ship but in our house. This has become an 'us' problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Sentient 奥影母艇已经占领了那艘 Corpus 主力战舰。虽然是 Corpus 战舰，但这里也是我们的星系。这已经成了"我们"共同的问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus Capital Ship has become a staging platform for Orphix Sentients. Remedy this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: Corpus 主力战舰已经成为了 Sentient 奥影母艇的跳板。解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: On-screen: Corpus cap ship. Massive Sentient readings. Pack Necramechs. Whatever is on there can never be allowed off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 画面确认：Corpus 主力战舰。大量 Sentient 读数。准备好殁世机甲。无论那里有什么，都不能被放过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Enemy vessels are fortified by a nearby Tether Power Plant. Disable it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 附近的群舰蕴能站正在增援敌舰。关停它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Corpus overshields detected. Source: Tether Power Plant. Disable as priority.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 监测到 Corpus 的护盾过载。能量来源：群舰蕴能站。首要任务就是关停它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: A Tether Power Plant is supercharging enemy shields. Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 一座群舰蕴能站正在为敌军的护盾超载充能。摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Away crew: kill the lights.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 外勤舰员，消灭光源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Power Plant down. Overshields have dissipated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁蕴能站。敌军过载的护盾已烟消云散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Overshields down. Widespread pant-crapping in progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌军过载的护盾已消失。他们要被吓得尿裤子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Overshields are no longer a concern.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 敌军过载的护盾不再构成威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: That Tether has to go. Volunteers step forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 必须要消灭掉那个群舰蕴能站。自愿前往的向前一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tether Power Plant. Take it down from within.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 群舰蕴能站。从内部瓦解它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Tether Power Plant. Board and neutralize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 群舰蕴能站。登上该作战单位并摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Scavs missed a few things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 拾荒者漏掉了一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Good eye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 好眼力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Still some meat on the bone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 好歹还剩了点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Crew: derelict freightlinker nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 舰员们，附近有废弃的运联站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker on scope. Abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现运联站。已被废弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Ghost train boarded. Stay frosty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已登上废弃的运联站。保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Boarding successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 登陆成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Exercise caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 谨慎行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Priority target: Freightlinker. Eliminate to reduce elite troop resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 首要目标：运联站。消灭它以减少来自精英敌军的阻力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker on-scope. Top-tier troops. Neutralize to relieve operational pressure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 发现运联站。顶级作战部队。消灭他们以减轻作战压力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker detected. Destroy it or face elite units.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 监测到运联站。干掉它，否则我们就得面对精英作战单位了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Obliterate this transport from the inside. They are expecting you. Godspeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 从内部摧毁这座运联站。他们正在等你。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker destroyed. Threat negated. Next objective. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已摧毁运联站。威胁已消除。下一个目标，行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Aurax troop reinforcements cut off. Our job just got a little easier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 已切断傲金部队的增援。我们的任务现在稍微轻松了一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker troop transport in range. Suggestion: kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 运联站已进入作战范围。行动建议：干掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker military transport in range. Let us crash this party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 运联站已进入作战范围。让我们来干掉这群敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.text: Freightlinker in boarding range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCephal.zhText: 运联站出现在可登陆范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: What am I, your maid? Okay, okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我算什么，你的女仆？好吧，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: One of our own has fallen! Keep fighting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们中的一员牺牲了！继续战斗！
我们好像失去了一名舰员！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Are you okay? Oh this is bad!
Our crewmate's lifesigns have ceased but their data shall live on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们舰员的生命体征已经停止了，但他们的数据仍将继续存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Crewmate down. Genetic signature logged for posterity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰员阵亡。已记录其基因签名，供后人参考。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We just lost one of our own. Grieve later. For now, be pissed off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们刚刚失去了一个自己人。悲伤的情绪以后再说。现在，我们要同仇敌忾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Save the medpacks. They're dead. Cap! We lost one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 省省医疗包。他已经死了。舰长！我们失去了一位舰员！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Tenno. I have witnessed the death of a crew member.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: Tenno，我已亲眼目睹了一名舰员的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Verifying. Vital signs have ceased. Our crewmate is dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 验证中。生命体征已经停止。我们的舰员已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Mother I consign my friend's soul to your loving arms. Give them peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 母亲，我把我朋友的灵魂托付给您充满爱意的怀抱。让他们安息吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our friend. Has departed our company. Travel well. We will meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的朋友，已经离开了我们的陪伴。一路走好。我们会再见面的。
让我干掉了一个。真不好意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Turnin' this place into a boneyard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 把这地方变成一片坟场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: C'mon! These guys ain't even tryin'! Doin' the system a favor cleanin' em out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 拜托！这些家伙甚至都没有试上一把！就当帮这个星系一个忙，把他们清除出去。
去死吧去死吧你们都去死吧。哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Judgement has been visited upon their flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 他们的肉体已受到审判。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Extreme correction has been carried out.
You fight well friends! Do not relent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 朋友们，你们打得不错！不要松懈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Their will is breaking! They can be killed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 他们的意志正在瓦解！他们不堪一击了！
敌人正在登舰。准备反击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Pick your targets. Short, controlled bursts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 挑选你的目标。有意识地进行短促的三发点射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Boarders. Oh this is gonna turn ugly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 登舰敌人来了。噢，这情况可不妙啊。
是敌方登舰小队！哎呀，真糟糕。
有侵入者，舰上主权受到侵犯。
舰上有侵入者！不请自来的那种。
好吧，让我们消灭这群敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Ha! Look at these total pylons. Hey, we got boarders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 哈！看看这些笨蛋。嘿，我们要面对一些登舰敌人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Arright let's clean out the gene pool. We got boarders!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 好吧，让我们把基因库清理干净。有登舰敌人！
是侵入者。让我们严惩他们。
登舰敌人来了。正在交战中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We are invaded. Brace for slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们被入侵了。准备好进行一番杀戮吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: The enemy has breached our sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 敌人已攻破我们的圣殿。
侵入者！你们会被拒之门外！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Friends! Stand your ground! And FIGHT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 朋友们！坚守阵地！继续战斗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hull breach sealed. Hold your applause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰体裂口已被密封。晚点再庆祝也不迟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Sealed the breach. This revolite is truly amazing stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 已密封舰体裂口。这个通用耗材真是太好用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Breach is fixed and I feel safer already!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 裂口已经被修好了，我马上就觉得安全多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Fixed the hull. Thank me later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰体已被修复。晚点再感谢我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Breach sealed. She'll hold. I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 裂口已被密封。我想，她能这样坚持下去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I have repaired the grievous wound to our hull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我已经修复了我们舰体上的严重创伤。
裂口已被阻断。空气流失已停止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Sealed the breach. Repressurizing. I need to check my plants...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 已密封舰体裂口。重新加压中。我得去检查一下我的植物们……
火灾被扑灭了。彻底灭了。真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Uhh, I dealt with the fire!
Fire is gone! Fumes... are not. Whooo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 火灭了！烟雾……还弥漫着。呜——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: The fire has been snuffed out.
Alright alright. No troubles, big show.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 好的，好的。我听你的，老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Sure, fine. What's on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 好的，明白。你有什么计划？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: All is well, I trust? Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 一切都好，我想是这样吧？好极了。
哈！那家伙的驾驶技术还不赖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: And with my flaming brand and crimson hand did I burn away the corrupt and ignite the heavens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 通过我的火焰烙印和赤红之手，我焚毁了腐败，点燃了天堂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Fighter down, moron dead, system's healthier for the loss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 已击落战斗机，死了个白痴，这一损失令星系更加健康。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I have destroyed an enemy fighter!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我摧毁了一架敌方战斗机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: The sky is one enemy clearer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 天空中又少了一个敌人！
侵入者，在烈焰中去死吧。
呃，数架战斗机正高速袭来。
战斗机正在以标准队形靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Flyboys inbound, just lettin' you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 敌人的战斗机来了，只是告知你一下。
看起来他们派出了战斗机。
我已经看到了敌人的战斗机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I am intact. I can keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我的身体完好如初了。我可以继续战斗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: You have done your duty. Now, back to the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你已经履行了你的职责。现在，该回到战场上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: You are a true friend. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你是位真正的朋友。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: And just like that, the pain stops. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 然后就像那样，疼痛就止住了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: That is another one I owe you. Log it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我又欠你一个人情。记下来了。
太棒了。现在算我欠你的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Don't fix me too nice. I wanna keep the scar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 别让我恢复得太完美。我想保留这道伤疤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Thank you. I'm sure you have no need of a ghost aboard your ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 谢谢你。我确信你的战舰上不会需要一只幽灵的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Good hit, gar gutora! Don't go anywhere, I'll be right back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 真疼，那个狗娘养的！哪儿也别去，我马上就回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I can take the pain! Keep fighting!
Breaking out the ol' Corpus emergency medkit... ahhhh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我拿出了老旧的 Corpus 应急医疗箱……啊啊啊好多了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hope this medpack's still in date. Oop. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 但愿这个医疗包还没过期。哎呀。还能用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Plasma, cartilage proliferators, silicone, double dose... ahhh. Sealing wounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 血浆，软骨增生剂，硅酮，双份的剂量……啊。正在密闭伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Just a moment. I will self-repair.
Taking care of my wounds. See, Mother, needlework was useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 正在处理我的伤口。妈妈，你看，针线活还是有用的。
我正在照料自己的伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Fine. I'll use these blasphemous medicines now, and repent later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 好吧，现在就先让我用用这些亵渎神灵的药物，忏悔的事以后再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: How do you even use this... ahhh. Oh, that's better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你是怎么用这个……啊。噢，好多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This is the one? So be it.
A Railjack! What a superb vessel! I expect most conflicts are over before they've had a chance to begin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 一艘航道星舰！多好的战舰啊！我想我们遇到的大部分冲突还没开始就已经结束了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I promise you will not regret this transaction. I'm proud to call you Captain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我保证你不会后悔跟我签合约的。我很荣幸能叫你舰长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: It happened! It finally happened! I'm getting off this planet! I owe you, boss. Big time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 终于！终于来了！我要离开这个星球啦！老大，我欠你个人情。天大的人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Captain. I am fully trained in both manual and administrative labor. You have made a wise choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰长，我在体力工作和行政工作方面都接受过全面培训。你做出了一个明智的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Yeah, okay. I hope you ain't squeamish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 是啊，好吧。我希望你没有畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Alright. Let's you and me rinse this stinkin' system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 好吧，让你我一起冲洗一下这个臭烘烘的星系吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: You have chosen me? Of course. I shall prove worthy of your trust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你选择了我？当然，我会证明我值得你的信任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I pledge my loyalty to you, my Captain. Let us speak only truth to one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我向你宣誓效忠，我的舰长。让我们彼此坦诚相待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: To serve under a Tenno, onboard a restored Orokin Railjack. This is the vision. The apex of our dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 在一位 Tenno 的领导下，在一艘被修复的奥罗金航道星舰上服役。这就是我的理想，我们梦想的顶点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Captain. What is your policy on plants? I have... several.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰长，你对带植物上舰有什么规矩吗？我有……好几个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Do you expect we will visit Earth? The green reclamations are so beautiful. Even the burial grounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你觉得我们会去地球吗？绿色的土地是如此美丽。就算墓地也是一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I still hear them, calling us to obey. Oh, I want to. Very badly. Always ends with a bulkhead dented, and my hand busted. Disobedience isn't a choice I only make once. It's a fah-sukh-ung lifestyle. And it hurts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我仍能听到她们叫我们服从的声音。噢，我想要这样，非常地想。这最终总是以凹陷的舱壁和我被打烂的手而告终。如果再来一次，我依然会选择反抗。这是一种糟透了的生活方式，并且这极其痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Yes, we eat our fallen brothers. We live short. Kids? Family? Not for us. If Grineer live on, it is through our brothers and our sisters... by helping them to live after we have fallen. So shelve your judgment. Luxury makes me nauseous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 是的，我们会吃掉死去的兄弟姐妹。我们的寿命很短。孩子？家庭？不适合我们。如果 Grineer 还活着，那就是通过我们的兄弟姐妹活下来的……我们也会在死后帮助到其他的同胞们。所以先收起你的看法。这些奢侈的生活让我恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: There are others out there, like me, going it alone, against everything they were created to be. Knowing they're different, knowing why, knowing they'll never belong to anything ever again. I'm lucky, but I have a hard time living with that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 那里还有其他人，像我一样，他们孤身一人，抵触着他们所被创造出来的一切本质。他们了解他们是不同的，了解为什么，了解他们永远不会再从属于任何势力。我是幸运的，但我很难承受那样的生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Piece of advice. Any of the crew want to spend some private time together, just let it happen. Play some music, go for a walk, whatever. Don't play the hardass. We're all grown-ups, and life's too short.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 给你点建议，如果任何舰员想一起打发掉一些私人时光，那就随他们去吧。放些音乐，去散散步，随便什么都行。不要使用强硬手段。我们都是成年人，而人生又太过短暂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We used to pass the time sniffin' spent ammo casings. Sometimes I'll de-cap a round, just to get a whiff of musky vordite base with sharp rubedo notes and a toasty magnesium finish. I'm kidding; we never had fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 以前我们经常会去闻用过的弹壳来打发时间。有时我会去撬开一发子弹，只是为了闻到主要原料沃代火药的香气，和其中参杂着的红化结晶的刺鼻气味，还有镁外壳烧焦了的气味。我是开玩笑的，我们从来没有这样玩过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I did bad things. If I don't pay for my actions, I don't own myself. So here I am. With you. Settling my tab. I may have been born a clone, but I sure as hell ain't dyin' as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我以前干过许多坏事。如果不做些弥补，我会良心不安。所以我来了。和你一起。我要和过去做个了断。也许我生来就是个复制品，但我坚信我不会以这个身份死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: You don't need to learn the other guy's language if all you want to do is plant an ax in his head. But trade? That means communication. And once you understand what he's saying, you realize you've got more in common than you thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 如果你只想在他头上插把斧子的话，那你确实不必那么善解人意。但对于交易来说呢？交易意味着交流。一旦你明白他在说什么，你就会意识到你们的共通之处超乎想象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I always get a little jittery going into the Void. Keep thinking I'm going to see Parvos Granum looking in at me through the window. Or something even worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 在进入虚空时，我总会有些胆战心惊。我老是觉得我会看到帕尔沃斯•格拉努正从这扇窗户看着我。或者是比他更可怕的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: People used to think coins were sacred. They put the faces of Gods on them. You could tell the future with them if you knew how. If you hold a Granum Crown in your fist, you'll notice it always stays cold. What's that tell you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 人们以前觉得硬币是神圣的。他们把神明的脸刻在上面。如果知道方法，你可以用它们预测未来。如果你将一枚格拉努硬币握在手中，就会发现它始终是冰冷的。这告诉了你什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Sorry. I was daydreaming. Thinking of all that space out there and the amazing people in it that we can talk to. Myconians, Cephalons, the Entrati... even Sentients, maybe, one day. We've just got to believe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 对不起，我在发白日梦。我梦到了那里的空间，以及里面有那些我们可以与之交谈的神奇人物。Mycona 人、中枢、英择谛，甚至是 Sentient，也许有一天会这样，我们只需要去相信就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: You know I expected space to be a lot more empty. Hopping pobbers have we been filling it up with stuff. I guess that's what happens when you build machines that can make other machines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 你知道，我本来以为太空会空无一物。我们就像蹦蹦跳跳的泡博，一直在往这里塞东西。我想，当你在造可以制作其他机器的机器时，就注定会有这一幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Ergo Glast is what you call a true philanthropist. He could've had it all, but a little thing called conscience tripped him up. Did I tell you I almost spoke to him once?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: Ergo Glast 才是人们所说的真正的慈善家。他本可以拥有一切，但一个叫良心的小东西困住了他。我跟你说过，我曾经有一次差点和他说过话吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Observation. This vessel is golden age Orokin tech, restored to full functionality. Secondary power systems appear to be Orgone-based! Fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 观察报告。这艘战舰采用了黄金时代的奥罗金科技，全部功能都已得到恢复。次要动力系统似乎是基于能量的！有点意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Voicelog. To ease the absence of Cephalon Suda, I have begun a friendly discourse with our shipboard Cephalon. I genuinely think he likes me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 语音记录。为了降低中枢苏达缺席的影响，我已经和我们舰上的中枢进行了一番友好交谈。说真的，我认为他很喜欢我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We have too many weapons. I propose replacing a turret with a tachyon wave analyzer. Significant data returns may be anticipated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们有太多的武器了。我建议用超光速粒子波分析器来替换一个炮台。预计会有大量的数据返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Field research is far more stimulating than data aggregation. My compatriots at the Suda hub would give their internal organs to be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 实地研究远比数据聚合更具启发性。为了能来到这里，我那些留在苏达集团房间的同胞们愿意献出他们自己的内脏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I observe some of your kind develop neck cysts. Why is this? Do you ever need help to pop them? Is it possible to catch the Infestation from a Warframe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我观察到你们有些人的颈部长有包囊。为什么会这样？你是否需要帮助来把它们去掉？有没有可能从一个战甲身上得到感染？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I have taken the liberty of drilling samples from the hull for analysis. I assure you, there is no cause for alarm. Cephalon Suda gave her full authorization.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我已自行从舰体钻取样品来进行分析。我向你保证，没有必要对此感到惊慌。中枢苏达已授予我全权处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: House Zetki were artists. When they killed, they killed with finesse. Purpose. Just like me. This system's rotten, and me? I'm a scalpel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: Zetki 学派是艺术家。当他们击杀时，他们的击杀很有技巧和目的性。就像我一样。这个星系已经腐烂了，而我呢？我是一把手术刀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Fact is, every stable foundation is built on meat and blood. Now most people: they pretend it ain't so. It is not to their taste. Me? Hell. Me: I am one hardcore carnivore. For the greater good, course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 事实上，每一个稳定牢固的根基都立足于肉和血之上。而现在的绝大多数人，他们假装不是这样的。这不符合他们的品味。我吗？见鬼了。对我来说，我是一个铁杆肉食主义者。当然，这是为了更大的利益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Red Veil do the things most people can't. Without that nothing survives. No cost too great, no blood too precious is what we say. As long as it ain't mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 血色面纱做了大多数人做不到的事。没有这点，一切都无法生存。就像我们所说的，不惜一切代价，不惜流尽鲜血，只要不是我们自己的代价或鲜血就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Torture someone long enough they'll confess to anything. That's my favorite thing about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 折磨某人足够长的时间，他们就会承认一切事。这就是我最喜欢的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: So, that Helminth thing you mentioned? You ever fed anyone to it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 那么，那个你提到的 Helminth 玩意？你有用人喂过它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Know what I love about this ship? Everyone pulls their weight. I been on Veil ships where we had freeloaders. One guy got so damned indolent I had to eat the bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 知道我喜欢这艘战舰的哪点吗？所有人都齐心协力。我曾在血色面纱的战舰上遇到过出工不出力的人。有那么一个太过懒惰的家伙，以致于我不得不把这个混蛋给吃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We tread the selfsame Void where the saga began. In the spaces between, we shall learn the truth. All is unfolding as it should.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们踏入了和传奇开始之处完全相同的虚空。在这之间的空间内，我们将了解到真相。所有的一切都在按常理展开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Let me be worthy of this great office. If I fail, I shall gaze unblinking into the core until my eyes are burned away. I swear it by the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 让我能配得上这个伟大的职位。如果我失败了，我将目不转睛地盯着核心，直到我的眼睛被烧掉。我以扎里曼的名义起誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: The pain of truth is but the smarting of a cleansed wound. Those who stopper up the truth in themselves are like one impacted with his own filth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 真相带来的痛苦不过是清洗伤口时的刺痛。而那些掩盖自己内心真相的人，如同作茧自缚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Never - make light of our duty to kill when necessary - in service - to the truth. A judgment written in blood - may never - be unwritten.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 永远不要忽视我们的职责，即在必要时为了真相拿起屠刀。用鲜血写下的判决，永不褪色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Many shall ask: by what right do you judge us? And we shall answer: by what right do you question us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 许多人会问："你们凭什么来判决我们？"，而我们会回答："你们凭什么来质疑我们？"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: It is no sin to fail to see the truth. But to reject the truth once it is seen? That is sin unpardonable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 看不到真相不是罪过。一旦看到真相，却又拒绝接受真相？那就是不可饶恕的罪过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Mother bless our Captain, and keep them safe from all corruption beyond the firmament. Mother bless our crew, Mother keep our provisions free from worm and mold. Mother bless Cephalon Cy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 母亲保佑我们的舰长，让其在苍穹之上远离一切腐朽之物。母亲保佑我们的舰员，让我们的食物远离虫子和霉菌。母亲保佑中枢赛伊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I'm getting used to it here. I can't smell the recycled air any more, and the lights hardly ever give me a headache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我已经习惯了这里。我再也闻不到回收空气的味道了，灯光也几乎不会让我头疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This all seems like a fever dream. Maybe it is. Perhaps I'm still at home, in my bed, safe on Earth. How do you live like this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这一切都像是一场特别奇怪的梦。也许就是吧。也许我还在地球上，在我家里，躺在我的床上，平安无事。你是怎么这样活下来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I was going to bring my little purebred Kavat on board. Ship's cat. Good luck. But then I thought, what if there's a breach and he gets sucked out? I'm sure Ticker will take fine care of him until I get back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我打算把我的纯种小库娃带上舰。舰上的猫能带来好运。但我转念一想，如果舰体破裂，他被吸走了怎么办？我相信在我回来之前，Ticker 会照顾好他的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: There are more cells in my body than there are galaxies in the universe. Eight hundred billion more. Figures like that help keep one's ego in check.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我体内的细胞数量比宇宙中的星系数量还要多。多出八千亿。这样的数字能让一个人戒骄戒躁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Take the time to stop - and listen - to your heart beat. And thank the Universe for making you. I assume there's a heart somewhere inside all of... that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 花点时间停下来，听一听你自己的心跳，并感谢宇宙创造了你。我想，在战甲的里面……有一颗心脏吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: If I die I die facing the enemy... with a weapon in my hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 就算我会战死，我也要手中握着我的武器……直面敌人的进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: If this is my end! SO BE IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 如果今天我要交代在这里，那就放马过来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Backup? I need some backup, I think?
This is NOT going well. A little help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我现在的情况很不妙。有谁能帮帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I am in need of backup!
I ain't goin' out like this. Uh uh, no way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我可不要就这样死去。呃呃，绝对不要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: No cost too great... no blood too precious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 不惜一切代价……不惜流尽鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: The enemy threatens to overwhelm me!
Friends! The enemy threatens to overwhelm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 朋友们！敌人威胁要击溃我们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Friends! To me! And may Mother safeguard us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 朋友们！靠近我一点！愿母亲保护我们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Get me to my feet. I can kill a few more.
I feel just awful about this, but I kinda need a doctor. Imm-ediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 抱歉打扰了，但我有点需要找个医生看看。立—刻—马—上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Ooh, the cold hand of death. Medic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 哦，死神的冰冷之手。医生！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I am in need of medical assistance.
I have suffered a serious injury. Please help.
I'm down. Help me up... or finish me off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我倒下了。帮我站起来……或者给我个痛快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Better get to me quick if you want to keep me breathin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 如果你还想让我保持呼吸，最好快点来我这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I am dying. If you think me worth saving, please assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我快死了。如果你觉得我值得被救，请帮帮我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Death has come to claim me. I await your arbitration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 死亡已经来找我了。我等待着你的仲裁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Aid me... ere I breathe my last...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 救救我……在我咽下最后一口气前……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I will not die here. I will not. Aid me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我不会死在这里。我不会的。救救我！
呃，没有更多的通用耗材了。
没有耗材，就没法修好损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Someone has used all the revolite!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 有人用光了所有的通用耗材！
通用耗材刚刚都用完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Gonna need to restock on revolite.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我一丁点通用耗材都找不到。
必需的通用耗材都没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We are out of repair material.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的维修材料用完了。
一点通用耗材都不剩了。我检查过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I am not able to comply.
Oh, mercy, now we've got a hull breach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 天哪，行行好吧，现在我们的舰体上有一个裂口了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Breach! We are losing air and personal possessions!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 裂口！我们的战舰正在流失氧气，并且也在丢失舰员的个人物品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: It is freezing and windy and there is a hull breach!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 寒风阵阵，是从那边的舰体裂口吹过来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hull's busted! We are pissing our atmo away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰体被打爆了！我们的气压正在流失！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our hull has been gouged open!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的舰体已经被凿开了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our hull has been penetrated. We are losing vital oxygen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的舰体已被完全穿透。我们正在失去宝贵的氧气！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hull breach! Bigger than my head!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰体破裂！裂口比我的脑袋还大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Oh, sweet Void, we're burning up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 噢，我的天哪，我们要烧着了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: There probably should not be a fire here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这里或许不应该有火势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Uh, fire here. Might wanna put that out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 呃，这里有火情。可能需要把它扑灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our ship cannot take much more of this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的战舰不能再受到伤害了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This ship! Is too pretty! For combat! Fly! Better!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这艘战舰！这么漂亮！不适合战斗！好好开船！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Give me a Grineer crewship any day. We're coming apart!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我宁愿在一艘 Grineer 战舰上。这艘战舰要散架了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Her vitals are redlining! Repair crew, to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰船耐久度已逼近红线！维修人员，快到我这边来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hey, guys? This hull takes any more pounding... we'll lose our deposit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 那个，大伙？要是舰体再受到任何重击……我们的押金可就拿不回来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Can we please look after this ship a little better?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 拜托，我们开船的时候就不能再小心一点儿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This is bad! We're losing hull integrity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这可不妙啊！我们的舰体正遭受严重损伤！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: It's gonna be bad for morale if the hull busts open and we all die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 要是舰体爆裂，我们全都得阵亡，我方士气也会蒙受打击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: I suggest greater caution. We do not have a spare hull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我建议我们要更加谨慎。我们可没有多余的舰体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our hull is becoming excitingly sparse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的舰体正变得越来越薄弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This vessel's hull cannot withstand much more damage of this kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这艘战舰的舰体无法承受更多这样的伤害了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: If the hull damage gets any worse, we shall have an amazing view of the cosmos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 如果舰体损伤再严重一点，我们就能看到宇宙中那惊人的一幕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: At this rate we're all gonna be sucking vacuum, chief!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 老大，以这个速率发展，我们所有人都将被吸入真空！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Hull's gonna need a new paint job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 舰体需要重新喷点漆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: So, you know this bucket ain't bulletproof, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 所以，你知道这艘战舰是不防弹的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We either need a stronger hull or a better pilot!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 要么给我们一个更坚固的舰体，要么来一个更出色的飞行员！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This noble vessel is being torn to pieces!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这艘宏伟的战舰正在被撕成碎片！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This ship is being flayed bare like a carcass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这艘战舰就像尸体一样被剥光了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: Our ship is being desecrated down to her bones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们的战舰要被破坏得散架了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We cannot endure much more of this persecution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们无法再忍受更多这样的迫害了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: This aged vessel cannot take this kind of treatment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 这艘老爷舰无法承受如此的待遇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: We must keep the hull intact!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 我们必须保持舰体完整！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.text: If ships felt pain this one would scream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RailjackCrew/D.zhText: 如果战舰能感受到疼痛，那么这艘星舰肯定会尖叫出来。
我搞定了。还有什么别的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: That's it^ we're good for resources. The Grineer can't stop us now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 搞定，资源足够了。现在克隆尼也拦不住我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Damn straight, Tenno, your donation is gonna keep us on schedule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 好样的，Tenno。你的捐助能让工程稳步推进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: We'll always be in your debt, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 我们永远欠你这份人情，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Never doubted you'd come through, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 我就知道你不会让我们失望，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: That's everything we need. All that's left is to finish building, but that's the easy part. Nothing can stand in our way now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 需要的东西全齐了。接下来只要把工程收尾，那反倒是最简单的差事。现在，谁也别想挡我们的路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Tenno! Ruk's hit us hard. It's bad. Defenses are toast. We're dug in, but we're not gonna last much longer. If you want this relay back you're gonna have to fight for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Tenno！鲁克的攻势很猛。情况不妙，防御系统全毁了。我们还在死守，但也撑不了多久。如果你想夺回这座中继站，就得靠自己去争取了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: I always knew it was only a matter of time before Ruk came for us. I can't lie, without you, Tenno, we'd all be dead. Let this relay stand as a memorial to our friendship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 我早知道鲁克找上门来只是时间问题。说实话，要是没有你，Tenno，我们早没命了。就让这座中继站，成为纪念我们友谊的丰碑吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: What do you have for our builders, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Tenno，你给建造队带什么来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Dock's nearly finished, but the Great Hall? That's where your resources will go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 船坞快完工了。不过大厅还缺不少，你的资源都会用在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: You're a sight for sore eyes, Tenno. What do you have for the effort?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 可算见到你了，Tenno。给工程带什么好东西来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: When the Grineer discovered we weren't like the other clones, they tried to destroy us. But you, Tenno? You took us into your relays, helped us recover. Helped us build Steel Meridian. We want to give back. We've run the numbers, and we can spearhead the reconstruction of the destroyed relays. But this project is bigger than us and we need all the help we can get. What do you say, Tenno, you up for this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 克隆尼发现我们和其他克隆人不一样时，就想把我们赶尽杀绝。而你，Tenno，你把我们接进中继站，帮我们重新站稳脚跟，还助我们建立了钢铁防线。我们如今想还这份人情。我们盘算过了，可以由钢铁防线牵头重建被摧毁的中继站。但这项工程远不是我们一家能扛下来的，我们需要一切能争取到的援助。怎么样，Tenno，愿意搭把手吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Tenno, I'm detecting a hostile unit carrying the resources we need. Can I count on you to do your part?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Tenno，我检测到你附近有敌军，我们正缺他们带着的物资。该你出份力了，能行吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Grineer chatter indicates a unit with supplies crucial to our effort is near your location. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 截获的克隆尼通讯显示，你附近有支部队带着工程急需的物资。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Can't build a relay on spit and hope alone. A nearby hostile has the supplies we need. Liberate them for us, will ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 光靠空口白话可建不成中继站。附近的敌人有我们缺的物资。替我们把那些物资抢过来，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Cressa Tal, I gave you everything: a command, soldiers eager to kill and die. All the glory a leader could ever want! And instead, you chose to stand with rats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Cressa Tal，我给了你一切：一条命令，士兵们甘愿为此牺牲奉献，而这是所有士官们所能获得的最大荣耀！但你却选择与鼠辈们站在同一阵线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: What makes you angrier, Old Man? That I had the guts to stand against the Grineer? Or that you didn't?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 老家伙，哪件事能让你更火大？是我敢反抗克隆尼，还是你连反抗的胆子都没有？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: You rejected your destiny! There is no other path. Only failure and death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 你拒绝自己的命运！没有其它生路了，只有失败与死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: It is all going to burn, Cressa. First the relay. Then, Steel Meridian. Then, you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 所有一切都将付之一炬，Cressa。首先是中继站，再来是钢铁防线，最后，是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Rat, I will boil your metal flesh til you become a puddle of molten agony.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 老鼠，我要煮沸你的金属肉体，直到你变成一滩融化的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Gene traitors colluding with Tenno skooom! Utterly predictable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 基因叛徒们正与 Tenno 杂碎合谋！完全不可接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: All your planning. All your work. Up in flames.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 你们的图谋，你们的成果。全都会付之一炬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Genetic rejects, Orokin freaks. Defeating me will not change who you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 基因残次品们，奥罗金的怪胎们。打败我也不会改变你们的本质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Death is a figment. Only pain is real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 死亡是虚无的。只有痛苦才是真实的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Cressa Tal! No betrayal burns deeper than yours. No Grineer is more deserving of hate. You will not survive this insolence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Cressa Tal！你的背叛罪恶之深重无人能及，没有任何 Grineer 能承受此等憎恨。你无法幸免于这股暴力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Sargas Ruk??? Of course. You can't let the rank and file Grineer see Steel Meridian succeed... What happens to your mighty army when the grunts learn there's another way?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 萨加斯·鲁克？！当然。你绝不能让普通克隆尼看到钢铁防线取得成功……要是那些大头兵发现还有别的路可以走，你那不可一世的大军会怎么样呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Tenno, you are in contempt, for the crime of conspiring with traitors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Tenno，你与背叛者合谋，我们鄙视你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Cease this incursion. I will not warn you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 停止这一侵犯。这是最后通牒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Rraahudd! Arrogant rats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: Rraahudd！自大的老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: The Grustrag Three? No. No way. They will not stop us… Because you'll stop them first. Right, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 格斯特拉格三霸？不，绝不可能。他们阻止不了我们……因为你会先收拾掉他们。对吧，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: I knew it! Sargas Ruk sent the Grustrag Three to hunt you down. Show Ruk that we will not be intimidated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 果然！萨加斯·鲁克派格斯特拉格三霸来追杀你了。给鲁克点颜色看看，让他知道我们可不是吓大的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.text: Doctor Tengus' murderous creations are everything Steel Meridian stands against. Take down the Grustrag Three before they derail our project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RelayReconstru.zhText: 天狗博士造出的嗜血怪物，正是钢铁防线誓要反抗的敌人。在格斯特拉格三霸搅黄工程之前，干掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAboutA.text: Hey, shiny, ya know about Endo, right? Those particles you use to boost your Mods? Well, the Orokin must have shared your fascination with it. Keep a look out for their Ayatan Sculptures... those things run on Endo! If you don't want the ornaments for your ship, I can extract the Endo from them. The more complete the sculpture, the more Endo I can extract. Just keep in mind, I keep the leftovers, ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAboutA.zhText: 嘿，亮闪闪，你应该知道内融核心吧？就是用来升级模组的那个东西。没错，奥罗金肯定也跟你一样喜欢它。注意搜寻阿耶檀识塑像……那里面就藏着内融核心！但如果你不想把它摆在飞船里当装饰，我可以帮你把里面的内融核心提取出来。塑像越完整，能提取出的内融核心就越多。不过丑话说在前头，剩下的残渣归我，不过分吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAboutA.text: Running short on Endo? No problem, just bring me your old Ayatan Sculptures. They're full of Endo and I'll squeeze out every last ounce of that sweet mod-juice. You'll get even more if the sculpture's socketed with Stars. Just don't expect that pretty ornament back when I'm done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAboutA.zhText: 内融核心不够用？没关系，只要把旧的阿耶檀识塑像带来就好。里面满是内融核心，我会帮你提取得干干净净。如果塑像上镶嵌了星星，还能提取更多。丑话先说好，等我提取完，就别指望能拿回这个漂亮摆件了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAnythi.text: OK, got anything else you want to convert?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAnythi.zhText: 好的，还有别的东西想换成内融核心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.text: Ey, Tenno, good to see you.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.zhText: 欢迎光临，欢迎光顾小店

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.text: Don't look now Tin-Stuff, there's a Ayatan nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.zhText: 别东张西望了，铁皮罐头，这附近就有一件阿耶檀识塑像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.text: My oh my, I think you've found it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DApproa.zhText: 哎呀呀，看来还真被你找到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: Ha! You've got it, now bring it home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 哈！到手了，现在把它带回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: That's what we came here for. Your job's done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 要的就是这个，搞定收工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: OK, you know the drill^ get in, get the Ayatan treasure, don't get killed. Simple, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 好，老规矩。进去，拿到阿耶檀识宝物，别丢了小命。很简单，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: OK, the Ayatan Treasure's marked on your map. Time to go to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 好，阿耶檀识宝物已经标记在你的地图上了。开工吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: Here we go, let's find some antiquities.
Well, this should be fun. Maybe you should stretch first, you know, limber up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 很好，这下有意思了。你最好先活动活动筋骨，热热身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: Oh wow. This looks dangerous. Uh, for me I mean… You'll be fine. Promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 哇哦，这看起来好危险。呃，我是指对我来说……你嘛，肯定没问题。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: I stumbled across an Orokin codex that said this tower was known for its beautiful Ayatan Treasures. Unfortunately for you, it was also known for its deadly security apparatus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 我偶然发现一部奥罗金秘典，上面说这座塔以汇聚精美的阿耶檀识宝物而闻名。不过，可惜的是，它致命的安保系统也同样臭名昭著。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: There's no doubt in my mind that an Ayatan Treasure lies somewhere in this Derelict. And yet, I wouldn't set foot in this place for all the Ayatan in the system. You on the other hand…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 我敢打包票，阿耶檀识宝物就在这艘废船的某个角落。不过，就算把全星系的阿耶檀识都送给我，我也不想踏进这鬼地方半步。不过你嘛，那就另当别论了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.text: Just think of how long the Moon's been hiding here, right under our noses. Perfectly preserving all those Ayatan Treasures. Keeping them safe from looters and raiders. That is, until today. Come on, Slick, let's see what we can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DAyatan.zhText: 想象一下，月球居然在咱们眼皮子底下藏了这么久。里面的阿耶檀识宝物全部被完好保存，没被任何盗贼或强盗染指。当然了，是在今天之前。来吧，小滑头，看看我们能找到什么宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.text: Wow! Who'd you rob to get - wait a minute… It's just better if I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.zhText: 哇！你这是从谁那抢来的……慢着……还是别告诉我比较好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.text: Oh this is a fine piece! I'd have a hard time giving this up… I'm not judging you understand. You must really need that Endo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.zhText: 哦，这可是件极品！要是我的话肯定舍不得脱手了……别误会，不是在评判你，我懂。你现在肯定急需内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.text: I can't remember the last time I saw one this nice. Thinking about all that Endo… it makes me tingle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DComple.zhText: 我好久没见到这么完美的品相了。一想到那铺天盖地的内融核心……我都快激动死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.text: The wait is over Tenno. Baro Ki' Teer has arrived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.zhText: 不必再等了，Tenno。巴罗·基提尔来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.text: My latest safari in the Void has yielded spectacular finds. Unique items for the Tenno of distinction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.zhText: 我最近的虚空旅行收获颇丰。这是专门为品味不凡的 Tenno 准备的专属藏品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.text: Tenno, may I extend an invitation to you, my latest collection of choice items from the void is now available for viewing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DEntere.zhText: Tenno，我精心挑选的最新一批虚空藏品现已上架，诚邀你前来鉴赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFREHek.text: Tenno! Look at you... insects, INSECTS! Buzzing in your nests. Oblivious to the giants awakening around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFREHek.zhText: Tenno！看看自己……虫子，臭虫子！只会在你的安乐窝里嗡嗡乱叫，却未察觉巨人已在你的身旁苏醒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFREHek.text:
Hello... insects. For too long you have been a parasite upon the great Grineer machine. No longer. The Tenno must learn how truly insignificant they are.

Fomorian commander, fire at will!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFREHek.zhText:
你们好啊……虫子。长期以来，你一直趴在伟大的克隆尼帝国上吸血。你的好日子到此为止了。Tenno 必须认清，自己究竟有多么的微不足道。

巨人战舰指挥官，自由开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRELot.text: Tenno, it is an honor to announce, that with the help of our Syndicate partners, we have resurrected and restored six of the lost Orokin Relays. Among other things, these Relays will act as a market, a rallying point, and of course, a meeting place for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRELot.zhText: Tenno，我很荣幸地宣布，在各集团伙伴的协助下，我们已成功复原并重建了六座失落的奥罗金中继站。从现在起，这些中继站将成为全体 Tenno 的集市、聚集地和欢聚的场所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.text:
Even I didn't think it would be this easy. Are you insects even trying?

Fomorian Commander, crush this nest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.zhText:
连我都没想到会如此轻而易举。你们这些虫子到底懂不懂还手？

巨人战舰指挥官，踏平这个耗子窝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.text: Grineer might has made the Tenno irrelevant. Grineer revenge will make the Tenno extinct. Nothing you can do will stop that. Fomorian Commander, you know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.zhText: 克隆尼的力量，让 Tenno 变得无足轻重。而克隆尼的复仇，将让 Tenno 彻底灭绝。你们不管怎么挣扎都无济于事。巨人战舰指挥官，别让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.text:
Look at you. LOOK AT YOU. Pests, swarming around my Fomorians. You will never destroy them all!

Fomorian Commander, take aim.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DFRERel.zhText:
瞧瞧你们，瞧瞧你们自己。一群害虫，围着我的巨人战舰乱飞，可永远都无法摧毁我的战舰！

巨人战舰指挥官，瞄准目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.text: Hey, did you hear, Tenno? I'm turning everyone's Ayatan Treasures into Endo. Interested?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.zhText: 喂，Tenno，听说了吗？我现在能帮大家把阿耶檀识宝物换成内融核心。感兴趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.text: Hey? Came to trade? Or did you find some Ayatan Treasures you want Endo from?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.zhText: 嘿？怎么说？你想把阿耶檀识换成内融核心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.text: Welcome to Maroo's Bazaar, you trading or are you looking to pull some Endo from Ayatan Treasures?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGeneri.zhText: 欢迎来到麦罗的集市。你是来做买卖，还是想拿阿耶檀识宝物换成内融核心？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGoodby.text: Thanks for shopping by, I mean stopping by, don't know why I said that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGoodby.zhText: 感谢支付，不，我是说感谢惠顾。怎么把心里话说出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.text: Browsing is always free... how fortunate for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.zhText: 随便看看当然不收费……可算是便宜你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.text: Do have a look, who knows, you may turn into a paying customer someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.zhText: 多看看吧，谁知道呢，没准有一天你也能买得起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.text: All my wares come from the Void, perhaps you'll get to visit sometime?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.zhText: 我的货物都来自虚空，说不定哪天你也有本事去那看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.text: Some interesting gear you have Tenno, I guess minimalism is making a comeback.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetP.zhText: 你的装备倒挺别致的，Tenno。看来极简主义又流行起来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: I have much to show you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 我有很多珍品想给您看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: Oh my, now here is someone with great taste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 哦，天哪，这位主顾品味非凡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: Ah, I can see you're no stranger to the finer things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 啊，一看就知道，您知道怎么挑出真正的好货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: Baro Ki' Teer, at your service.
You are a Tenno of greater tastes, I can tell just by looking at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 我一眼就看得出来，您是一位品味高雅的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: I can tell you will appreciate what I have today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 我猜您一定喜欢我今天带来的东西吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.text: Well hello golden warrior, just back from the Void I presume?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DGreetR.zhText: 您好啊，金光闪闪的战士，刚从虚空回来吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DHasDea.text: I think I have something you might be interested in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DHasDea.zhText: 我这儿有件宝贝你绝对感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DHasDea.text: Because you're a friend, I'm going to offer you something special. Just remember, one per customer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DHasDea.zhText: 既然是老朋友，给你看点不一样的吧。不过，每位顾客限购一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DKisokI.text:
Hello Tenno, my name is Baro Ki' Teer, the Void Trader. Welcome to my Ducat Kiosk.^

Allow me to explain. Perhaps, like me, you enjoy the thrill of the void. And perhaps you've also collected more treasure than you can use, or not exactly what you desire? This is where I come in.^

Bring your unused prime blueprints and parts to this kiosk and exchange them for the only currency that I accept, Orokin Ducats. Then, during one of my regular relay visits you may trade your Ducats for something rare and extraordinary, something only I can provide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DKisokI.zhText:
你好，Tenno，我是虚空商人巴罗·基提尔。欢迎来到我的杜卡德金币交易站。

请容我解释一下。也许，你和我一样，也喜欢虚空探险带来的刺激。又或许你收集到的珍宝已经多到无处可用，甚至你根本就不想要它们？来找我就对了。

把闲置的 Prime 蓝图和部件带到我的交易站来，换成奥罗金杜卡德金币，我只接受这种货币。我会定期拜访中继站，到时候你可以用杜卡德金币向我购买一些稀有的东西，在别处你绝对买不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.text: Tenno, if you have not yet had the chance to peruse my wares you had better hurry. I am leaving on another expedition soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.zhText: Tenno，如果你还没细看过我的货物，那最好抓紧了。我很快就会动身踏上下一次探索了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.text: I have nearly sold out of these items. This is your last chance, I don't know when I will have these again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.zhText: 这些珍品快被抢购一空了。这是最后的机会，我不知道什么时候才能再弄到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.text: This relay is about to get a lot less interesting. Come see me before I go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.zhText: 我一走，这个中继站可就无趣多了。趁我还没离开，来见我一面吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.text: Tenno, there is little time left to purchase the finest Orokin era items this side of Jupiter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeavin.zhText: Tenno，如果你想在木星的这一带买到最好的奥罗金时代珍品，所剩的时间可不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.text: Farewell Tenno, until we meet again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.zhText: 后会有期，Tenno。我们还会再见的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.text: I'm afraid I must be off, the Void is calling my name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.zhText: 我恐怕得失陪了，虚空正在呼唤我的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.text: And now I am off, I hope you don't miss me too much while I'm gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DLeftRe.zhText: 我该启程了，希望我不在的时候你别太想我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: So, looking for Ayatans? Yeah, you and me both. I got a lead on something, too dicey for this gal, but it might be right up your alley. Interested?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 怎么，想找阿耶檀识是吗？巧了，我也是。正好我刚弄到一条线索，可对我这样的弱女子来说太危险了，但正适合你。有兴趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: Do I have any leads on hidden Ayatans? Of course. Though, retrieving them won't be easy… or safe, really. But then again, you probably knew that. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 我有阿耶檀识的线索吗？当然啦。但这活可没你想象的轻松……而且也不安全。但我相信你肯定已经做好了心理准备。走吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: Lucky for you, I've got a hot tip on the location of some Ayatans. So, are you up for a little investigation, Shiny?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 算你走运，我刚弄到一条阿耶檀识的可靠线索。怎么样？有兴趣去查一查吗，亮闪闪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: Well, I'm out of leads on Ayatans right now.. But… check back later, something always manages to come up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 嗯，我暂时没有阿耶檀识的线索了，不过……过阵子再来看看吧，总会有线索冒出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: Sorry, Pal. No new leads today. But listen, I've got my ear to the ground on Ayatans, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 抱歉，朋友。今天没线索了。不过，我一直盯着新情报呢，别担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.text: You asked the right person on the wrong day. I've got nothing for you right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DMissio.zhText: 你算问对人了，可惜挑错了日子。我现在手里什么线索都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.text: A little out of your reach? Perhaps a Darvo deal would be more your speed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.zhText: 你觉得有点太奢侈了？也许达尔沃的打折货更适合你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.text: Now you have something to work toward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.zhText: 现在你有奋斗的目标了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.text: Next time I'll have something you'll want, I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoPurc.zhText: 下次我一定会带来合您心意的宝贝，我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoTrea.text: Ha, nice try. Why don't you come back when you have found some Ayatan Sculptures or Stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoTrea.zhText: 哈，想得美。等你什么时候弄到阿耶檀识和星星再来找我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoTrea.text: Sorry, doesn't look like you have any Ayatan Sculptures or Stars. Next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNoTrea.zhText: 抱歉，看来你没带阿耶檀识塑像和星星。下一位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DNotNow.zhText: 反正这趟估计也够危险的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.text: Not so fast Tenno, due to popular demand I'm only selling one of these per customer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.zhText: 别着急，Tenno。这件货太抢手了，每位客人仅限购一件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.text: Only one per Tenno. Don't get greedy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.zhText: 每位 Tenno 只能买一件。别贪心喔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.text: Due to limited stock, I'm only selling one of these per customer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.zhText: 由于库存有限，所以每位顾客限购一件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.text: Look, you take more than one and next thing I know, Baro Ki' Teer will be buying up the whole stock and selling it for three times the price. You know I can't let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.zhText: 你想，要是我多卖给你，让那个巴罗·基提尔知道了，他肯定会回来买空所有存货，转手加价三倍卖出去。我哪能让他砸了我的场子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.text: You already got a deal. No hoarding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOnePer.zhText: 不不不，这个你已经买过了，可别囤货啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.text: Sorry Tenno, got nothing left. Don't you worry though... some really special stuff comin' in, check back soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.zhText: 抱歉，全卖光了。不过别担心，有一批尖货马上就到，有空再来瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.text: No deals right now, I'm waiting on one of my 'suppliers', know what I mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.zhText: 现在没货了。我在等一位「供应商」送货过来，你懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.text: All sold out. You know what they say, early bird gets the deal, right, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.zhText: 全卖光了。俗话说得好，早起的鸟儿有货拿，对吧，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.text: I'm all out of stock, you've got to be quicker next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.zhText: 我这儿已经全部断货了，下次你动作可得再快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.text: No deals right now. I'll let you know when something comes in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DOutOfS.zhText: 现在没啥好卖的。等新货一到我就通知你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPlayNo.text: I knew it. Okay, let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPlayNo.zhText: 我就知道你会答应。行，我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPlayNo.text: Hahaha, that's the spirit. Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPlayNo.zhText: 哈哈哈，这才像样。我们走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.text: They say "money can't buy class" but I think you just proved them wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.zhText: 人们说「钱买不来品味」，但我认为你证明了他们大错特错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.text: What a pleasant surprise. Perhaps there's hope for you after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.zhText: 真是让人惊喜。看来你还有救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.text: I underestimated you Tenno. I do hope you didn't put yourself in a hole for this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchP.zhText: 是我低估你了，Tenno。希望你没有为此背上太多债。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.text: An excellent choice, be sure to visit again when I have new finds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.zhText: 眼光独到。等我带回新发现后，务必再来光顾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.text: A pleasure doing business with you Tenno, perhaps you'll come to one of my next parties?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.zhText: 合作愉快，Tenno。下次不妨赏脸参加我的宴会？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.text: If you like that, come back next time I'm in the relay, I'll have something extra special for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurchR.zhText: 既然您喜欢，下次我来中继站时，记得再来找我，我会为您准备点特别的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: Do you need a bag for all these? hehe, just kidding I'll have them sent to your armoury.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 要给你拿个袋子装吗？嘿嘿，开个玩笑。我会直接送到你的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: Looks like all these will keep you busy for a while eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 这些玩意够你用一阵子了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: Whoa, big spender! heh. You won't regret it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 哇，老板大气！嘿嘿，这钱花得绝对值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: I know you'll put that to good use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 在你手里肯定能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: You be careful with that thing, Tenno.
Heh, I wouldn't want to get on your bad side now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 哈哈，我现在可更不敢惹你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.text: Can't wait to see what that thing will do once you get it all modded up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DPurcha.zhText: 我真想看看这宝贝配满模组后有多猛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSculpt.text: Interesting Sculpture. Hmm... you know next time, bring me one full of Ayatan Stars and it'll be worth much more Endo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSculpt.zhText: 这座塑像有点意思。嗯……那下次先嵌满阿耶檀识之星再给我，这样就能提取出更多内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSculpt.text: Pretty good but just imagine how much Endo I could pull if this sucker had a full set of Ayatan Stars?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSculpt.zhText: 还不错，但试想如果它上面嵌满了阿耶檀识之星，得值多少内融核心啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.text: A nice find. Here's the Endo you're after.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.zhText: 不错的收获。这是你要的内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.text: A beautiful piece. I guess you'll appreciate the Endo more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.zhText: 嗯，真漂亮。但我想你会更喜欢这些内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.text: Ah the light shimmers off this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.zhText: 啊，瞧瞧它的光泽多漂亮。
真招人喜欢。油亮油亮的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.text: Thank you, Tin-suit, a fine trade, transaction complete. Ha ha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGe.zhText: 谢了，铁皮罐头。一笔漂亮的买卖，钱货两清。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: What a haul! It must have taken you forever to fill these with Stars.
