/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 简直是大丰收！你肯定花了不少心思才弄到这么多星星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Wow, Tenno, I'm impressed. It's been a long time since I've seen such a complete collection of Ayatan Treasures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 哇，Tenno，真让我大开眼界。我已经很久没见过这么完美的阿耶檀识宝物了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Oh me, oh my, would you look at these? You can almost smell the Endo. Nice work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 哎呀呀，快瞧瞧这堆宝贝！我都能闻到那股诱人的内融核心味了。真有你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: You know Tenno, you'll get more Endo if you use your Mod Bench to insert Ayatan Stars into the Sculptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 知道吗，Tenno，如果你用模组工作台镶嵌阿耶檀识之星，它就能提取出更多内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Anyone ever tell you that the Ayatan Stars and Sculptures can be put together using your Mod Bench? You just wait and see what happens when you fill one completely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 有没有人告诉过你，你可以用模组工作台把阿耶檀识之星镶嵌到塑像上。等你哪天能完整镶满一个，你就能知道其中的价值了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Lotta good stuff here, Tenno. But you could score even more Endo with complete sculptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 你的好东西不少啊，Tenno。但如果是完整的塑像，内融核心还会更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Interesting collection. Looks like you brought me a little bit of everything. Of course, I don't have to tell you how valuable these sculptures would be if they were all complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 挺有意思的收藏。看来你各种款式都带了一点儿过来。当然，用不着我说你也知道，要是这些塑像都是完整的，价值可就完全不同了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.text: Maybe next time you'll bring me complete sculptures? I always get way more Endo out of complete sculptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DSellGr.zhText: 下次你也许该带些完整的塑像？这样也能从中提取出更多内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DStarsO.text: That's a fine Ayatan Star, but it'd be worth more Endo if you used your Mod Bench to put it in a sculpture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DStarsO.zhText: 这颗阿耶檀识之星品相不错。不过要是把它镶嵌到塑像上，它会更有价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DStarsO.text: Thanks for the Ayatan Star, but you know, when you put them in a sculpture, they generate even more Endo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DStarsO.zhText: 谢谢你的阿耶檀识之星，但你知道，把它镶嵌到塑像上，就能提取出更多内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: Consider the sword. Protect or kill, it chooses not, for it only obeys the will of its master.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 且看此剑。是护生还是杀戮，皆非剑之所择，它只遵从主人的意志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: Pupil, if your Warframe becomes a useless husk without you, then what do you become without it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 弟子，战甲若离开了你就是无用的躯壳。那要是你没了战甲，又会是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: The river nurtures. Along its banks life flourishes. And yet, when the storm swells, the river kills. You need the river but don't ever trust it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 河泽万物，沿岸之处，生机盎然。风起之际，方知水能载舟，亦能覆舟。你离不开川河，也不可盲信于它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: Even the most principled must bow to their nature when forced. Please, remember this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 纵是恪守信条之人，若被逼入绝境，亦不得不向本性低头。务必谨记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: Hesitation makes one vulnerable. When the unexpected happens, do not hesitate. Remember this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 犹疑就会露出破绽。变故突发之时，切莫犹豫。务必谨记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.text: Surprise is a weapon best countered with preparation. Prepare for what you least expect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTeshin.zhText: 出其不意犹如利刃，唯有严阵以待方能招架。时刻防患于未然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.text: Sellin' are we? Okay then, find a shady spot near the tree and let everyone know you're here. If someone sees something they like, it's time to start negotiating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.zhText: 想卖东西？那好，去大树附近找个阴凉的地方摆摊，让大家知道你开张了。要是有人相中了你的宝贝，就开始聊价格吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.text: Oh, so you're buying? That's nice. Keep a lookout for Tenno with something to sell. And remember, only suckers pay the first price.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.zhText: 噢，你是来买东西的？没问题。留意那些卖东西的 Tenno。还得记住，只有冤大头才会按原价买单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.text: Welcome to my bazaar, Tenno from all over the system come here to trade. Need any pointers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.zhText: 欢迎来到我的集市，全星系的 Tenno 都会来我这儿交易。怎么样，需要帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.text: If you're looking for Maroo's bazaar you've come to the right place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTradeT.zhText: 如果你是想找麦罗的集市，那你可算来对地方了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTransa.text: Been a pleasure. Remember, I'm always looking for more Ayatan Treasures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Relays/DTransa.zhText: 合作愉快。记住，阿耶檀识宝物有多少，我要多少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Great. Onkko's note here says "Wear the mask when the moon shines bright… upon the haunted Plains of Eidolon." You could do that. OR you could take the day off, toss that mask into the lake. Oh! Sorry Onkko, we lost it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 很好。昂克的留言说"当月光普照在鬼影幢幢的夜灵平野上时，带上面具。"你可以试试。或者，你可以休息一天，把面具扔进湖里。噢！真不好意思昂克，我们把它弄丢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Alright. Fine, Tenno. But if I start seeing Unum things… it's on you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 好了。很好，Tenno。但是如果我开始发现乌努母神的踪迹……那就全靠你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Chut! Is it working? Ai yooooo, it is working. No getting out of this now, is there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 呃！起作用了？哎哟，起作用了。现在没办法脱身了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Khanung! It's attacking!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 当心！它在攻击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Hold on. This isn't just some trapped Warframe spirit! He's become a mask for some Eidolon! We can't let it rebuild itself! Tenno, you need to destroy it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 坚持住。这不仅仅是受困的战甲灵魂！他已经成为了夜灵的伪装面具！我们不能允许它重建自身！Tenno，你需要消灭它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: The Eidolon's violence is within him, Tenno! Cast it out! Free him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 夜灵的暴力意志在他体内，Tenno！将其驱逐！解放他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: By the Unum, you've done it! The lost one is reborn, made Revenant. A Warframe, infused with the powers of an Eidolon! That's a scary thought, isn't it? But I worry, it's a power we'll soon need. I had a dream. Something new, stirring within the ground. Seeking a body to call its own, longing to strike those who sent it to the grave... If you need me, I'll be in at my shop, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 以乌努母神之名，你成功了！迷失者已经重生，成为了 Revenant。一台战甲融入了夜灵的力量！这想想就可怕，不是吗？但恐怕，我们很快就会需要这种力量。我做了个梦。某种全新的威胁在地底搅动。寻求着成为自身的身体，渴望着伏击将其送入坟墓之人……如果你要找我，我就在店里，苏拉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Swazdo-lah, Tenno! Kruna metta! Today, a very unique mask has come into my possession! Incredible… perhaps even magical! It's… It's… ugh. Oh, whatever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 你好，Tenno！赶紧来看看！今天，我的商品中有一件非常独特的面具！无与伦比……甚至充满魔力！它是……它是……呃。哦，随意吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Sales! I really love it. Look, to be honest - Onkko made this mask, and it's a bit of creep-piece. He set some weird eyes in it, said: "The Unum chooses!" Ai-yo. 'Unum chooses' is short for nightmares and a wild Vobi hunt. Funny, right? Tower spirit choosing me… and I can't stand heights! I think that makes me 'fake-Ostron'? Tower work was more, my cousin, Mukha's calling, he's fearless… uh, was fearless. Well… Buy the mask, Tenno! Or don't, up to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 特卖！我真的太喜欢了。看呀，说真的，是昂克制作了这件面具，那是个有些令人毛骨悚然的物件。他诡异地看了几眼面具，说道"乌努母神选择了你！"哎呦。"乌努母神选择"是野外沃比狩猎时各种噩梦的缩略语。很好笑，对吗？你看高塔的灵魂选择了我……但我怕高！我觉得这样看我也许不是"正宗 Ostron 人"？高塔的工作更适合我的堂兄穆卡，他勇敢无畏……呃，曾经勇敢。好了……买下这个面具吧！或者不买，这由你决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Lok heb! Tenno! The Unum calls for you to bring the lost one back to us, piece by piece. But how? Have you spoken to Konzu yet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 欢迎！Tenno！乌努母神号召你将迷失者一片一片地带回来。但是该怎么做？你有和孔尊谈过吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: What is that? Some Eidolon? No. Wait. Somehow, it's not. I can't believe I'm saying this but… can you get a closer look?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 那是什么？某种夜灵？不，慢着。好像并不是。不敢相信我会这么说，但是……你能靠近些吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Why do I remember this? The land here, killing hot, full of strangeness. This is where Gara vanquished the Sentient! Where its essence fell into the ground, trapped in some unworldly between. It wanted out. At moon-rise its ghostly tendrils would emerge, seeking form, seeking… return. And this… this was the warden… a Warframe. I can see it, like a dream repeating… The tendril emerging, night after night, and the warden, night after night, cutting it down… until the warden himself was lost. How?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 为何我会记得这些？这片土地，热的要死，充满陌生。这是 Gara 消灭那个 Sentient 的地方！Sentient 的精华沉入了地下，被束缚在某种非物质之间。它想要挣脱。当月亮高悬之际，它的鬼影触须就会出现，寻求实体，寻求……回归。而这……这是看守人，一位战甲。我能看到它，仿佛是萦绕的梦境……触须出现，夜复一夜，而看守人也夜复一夜地砍断它们……直到看守者自身迷失了。为何如此？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Khanung. The Unum is in my head… She commands you to seek the pieces of the lost one… and rebuild it. What? Like I have time for this… I've got a business to run! Ai yo… Onkko said Grineer Command was excited about some relics they'd dug up. Maybe you should talk to Konzu?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 当心。乌努母神在我的脑海中……她命令我找到迷失者的碎片……并重建它。什么？说的好像我有时间管闲事……我还要做生意呢！哎哟……昂克说过 Grineer 指挥官对他们挖掘的遗物非常兴奋。也许你该和孔尊谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: I… I need to know what happened to the lost one. Find the place where he calls out to us. Let me know when you… when you're there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 我……需要知道迷失者遭到了什么。找到他呼唤帮助的地方。当你到了……告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: There! See? He's further out… trying to escape… can you help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 那里！看到没？他变得更远了……试图逃走……你能帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: I see… The tendril once again. Instead of striking it... the lost one… he extends a hand to the Eidolon?! Khanung! What was he thinking? He's like Mukha on the tower. Every day, Mukha clamored across the tower ledges and scaffolds - nothing happened, day in and day out... Routine took his fear away. Uhh... Tenno - I see the tendril has him now. The lost one. He's become an anchor for the Eidolon - to pull itself into our world! The lost one struggles, pulling back, but it's too late! The Eidolon begins to emerge. But… the lost one realizes - he stops… he lets go... And so he falls. Falls from this world of the living and down, down, down, into the next. Mukha, that so was stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 我明白了……又是触须。没有攻击它……迷失者……他反而向夜灵伸出了手？！当心！他在想什么？他就像是在高塔上的穆卡。每一天，他在高塔的壁架和脚手架之间呼喊——什么都没有发生，日复一日……习以为常使他的恐惧日渐淡薄。呃……Tenno——我看到触须抓住了他，迷失者。他变成了夜灵把自己拉向现实世界的固位锚！迷失者挣扎着，想要抽身而退，但已经太迟了！夜灵开始现身。但是……迷失者意识到了——他停下了……他放手了……于是他坠落了。从生的世界坠落，越落越深，进入了另一个异界。穆卡，那太愚蠢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: The lost one's spirit calls for aid! We can't just leave him… wherever he is. Are you ready, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 迷失者的灵魂正呼叫帮助！我们不能就这么离去……不论他在何处。你准备好了吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Khanung! Do you see? The lost one struggling… what happened to him?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 当心！你看到了吗？迷失者正在挣扎……他遭受了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Ugh… here we go again. I remember… the pool glows, the tendril emerges... and this Warframe draws its weapon to destroy it yet again… wait… no. He does not strike this time, he watches. Why? The phantom tendril grips trees and rocks, probing for substance... then fear returns and the lost one slashes the phantom, sending it back to its purgatory...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 呃……又来了。我记得……水池发光，触须显现……这台战甲抽出武器再次消灭……慢着……不。他这次没有攻击，他只是看着。为什么？幻影触须抓住了树木和石块，刺探着物体……接着恐惧再次出现，而迷失者切断了幻影，将它送回了炼狱……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Why is the Unum doing this to me? Because of Mukha? Because I was too afraid to stay? If I'd been there, he wouldn't have been so… brave… so stupid. What was he thinking? The sooner you build this Warframe, the sooner the Unum's out of my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 为何乌努母神要这样对我？是因为穆卡？还是因为我怕留下？如果是我在那里，他就不会如此……勇敢……如此的笨。他在想什么？你越快制作完这台战甲，乌努母神就越早离开我的脑海。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Thank the Unum. You've driven out the Eidolon… but what's left I wonder?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 感谢乌努母神。你已经驱逐了那个夜灵……但还留下了什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.text: Mukha, the warden… they lost their fear. But I have plenty… and… I'm still here. Is that why the Unum chose me for this? Thanks for the nightmares! Glad that's over. If you need me I'll be under nana's blanket with a flask of hot chimurr. Maybe I'll burn some incense, for Mukha. Y'know, sales isn't so bad after all. Everyone needs a mask, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RevenantMask/D.zhText: 穆卡，和看守者……他们遗失了恐惧。但我的心中还有许多……但是……我还活着。难道这就是乌努母神选择我的原因吗？真是谢了这些噩梦啊！我很高兴一切都结束了。如果你需要找我，我会躺在奶奶的毯子下面，带上一壶热赤穆茶。也许我还会焚香，为了纪念穆卡。你知道的，销量终究还不差。每个人都需要一个面具，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DCin.text: Let her go.
Let her go.
Let her go.
Let her go.
And why would I want to do that?
And why would I want to do that?
And why would I want to do that?
And why would I want to do that?

[4.4]
Because what you want is in Tau.
[10.8]
And you know we need her to get there.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DDry.text: The Vessel… Albrecht's great answer to Indifference. It wakes to open the path to Tau. We need its strength and yours. Mother must feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DDry.zhText: 承载体……阿尔布雷希特对虚空无情之物的伟大回应。它苏醒了，为前往 Tau 星系开辟了通路。我们需要它的力量，也需要你的力量。母亲必须进食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DDry.text: Tau. A journey so vast requires an unthinkable amount of energy. Ballas, blinded by extremes, sought to end the Origin System. There may be another way. Regenerating Organic fuel. Moonflesh. It is the one way that does not destroy the balance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DDry.zhText: Tau。如此浩瀚的旅程需要难以想象的能量。Ballas 被极端思想蒙蔽了双眼，试图摧毁始源星系。或许还有另一种方法。再生有机燃料。月华脯。这是唯一一种不会破坏平衡的方法！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: THE ROAD TO TAU… IS LONG. BRING MORE, SMALL THING.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: 前往 Tau 星系的道路……还很漫长。再带些来，小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: THE VOID IS VAST… LITTLE TENNO.
ALL FOR YOU… ALL FOR HER… MY CHILDREN…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: 一切为了你……一切为了她……我的孩子们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text:
Tenno. We must work to keep Eris clear of Infested so that Praghasa may feed.

If you harvest any viable Moonflesh from Eris, take it to Mother. She will need them.

With what I am asking of her… we must be certain that this succeeds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText:
Tenno。我们必须清除阋神星上的感染者，好让「布拉喀萨」得以进食。

如果你在阋神星上采集到任何可用的月华脯，就将其交给母亲。她会用得上。

我向她提出了如此请求……我们必须确保万无一失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: There. That will provide a considerable amount of Moonflesh for mother. … Kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: 好了。这将为母亲提供相当可观的月华脯。……了结它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: Tau is in sight. A road wide enough for an armada would spell disaster for two systems—and require the death of Sol. But a path large enough for us, That requires Moonflesh. Mother can feed on Eris to build a different road. Make offerings to Mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: Tau 星系就在眼前。一条足以容纳整支舰队的航道，会给两个星系都带来浩劫——并且将牺牲掉太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: Eris contains enough Moonflesh to fuel Praghasa. We will follow Albrecht… and Eris must die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: 阋神星上的月华脯足以唤醒「布拉喀萨」。我们要遵循阿尔布雷希特的计划……阋神星必须死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.text: Why do you reject my flesh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DEri.zhText: 你为什么拒绝我的肉身？
你永远都不会获得自由！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 我的女儿……呼唤我。我便归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: FOR WHAT FOLLY… HAVE YOU SUMMONED ME?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 究竟是为了何等蠢行……将我召来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: PAZUUL… I SHOULD… HAVE LET YOU DIE…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 帕祖……我当初……就该放任你死去……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: I HEAR… NO LORDS OF TAU. ONLY WHISPERS…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 我听不到……Tau 星系诸主的声音。只有低语……
聒噪的群体正蜂拥而来……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: AND FILL YOUR MIND WITH MADNESS…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 如今，大部分已经不在了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: NO GOLDEN MAKERS. ONLY GHOSTS REMAIN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 黄金之主不复存在。只剩幽魂。
他们的覆灭……令我欢呼雀跃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: YOUR PATH… IS NOT YET SET.
AS OUR MAKERS, WE CHOSE… GILDED HATRED…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 正如我们的创造者，我们选择了……镀金的仇恨……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: WE MADE THE WORLD… A REFLECTION OF A SHALLOW SELF…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 我们将这世界……塑造成了浅薄自我的倒影……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: DEFEATING THIS ENEMY FROM WITHOUT… SHALL NOT UNITE YOU…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 击败这个外敌……并不会使你们团结……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: AN EMPTY REFLECTION… BRINGS NO PEACE…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 空洞的倒影……不会带来和平……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: FAMILY. LOVE. THESE BURN FOR YOU HERE…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 家人。爱。这些在此地为你燃烧……
浅薄的坟墓中低语的谎言……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: HOPE DOES NOT WAIT… IN TAU…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: Tau 星系等待你的……并非希望……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: BUT… YOU INSIST… SO I WILL FEED…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 但……若你坚持这样……我便进食……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: I WILL GO… IF I MUST…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 我会去的……如果必要的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: FOR YOU, MY DAUGHTER… MY NATAH…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 为你，我的女儿……我的 NATAH……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: CHILD OF DAUGHTER'S… WE GO… TO TAU… FOR YOU…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 我女儿的孩子……我们为了你……前往……Tau 星系……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.text: THE ROAD... TO TAU... IS LONG.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPra.zhText: 前往……Tau 星系的路……很漫长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.text: Mother. It is time. We must… return home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.zhText: 母亲。时候到了。我们必须……回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.text:
Drifter, 

The Dark Refractory is prepared. She is well. Please join us.

I should note that your younger counterpart is not best pleased about your taking the lead, so make haste.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.zhText:
漂泊者， 

深溯池已准备好。她安然无恙。请加入我们。

我得提醒你，你那位年轻版的自己对你抢先一步不太高兴，所以请尽快过来。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.text: Praghasa can now reach Tau. I must pilot her, and become one with Praghasa. When we get to Tau, it will be with my strength. I will not be able to free myself from her in Tau. I will watch over you, but I can only be with you here on the Origin System. In Tau, I will be my true self: Natahgasa, The Sungazer - blind once again, empty of all but wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/RoadToTau/DPro.zhText: 「布拉喀萨」现在可以抵达 Tau 星系了。我必须亲自驾驶她，与她融为一体。我们能够抵达 Tau 星系，所凭借的将是我的力量。到了 Tau 星系，我便再也无法与她分离。我会一直守望着你，但只有在始源星系，我才能与你同在。而在 Tau 星系，我将成为真正的自己：凝日者娜塔喀萨——再度失明，仅余智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: And it was not their force of will - not their Void devilry - not their alien darkness… it was something else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 并不是因为他们意志特别坚定——也不是因为他们有虚空的力量——也不是他们心中的黑暗……而是别的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: It was that somehow, from within the derelict-horror, they had learned a way to see inside an ugly, broken thing--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 是因为他们透过那丑陋、残缺的外表，在这个被遗弃的悲惨之物里，看到了它的心——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: And take away its pain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 然后，抚平了它的伤痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: We use this memory. It fuels our wrath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我们利用这段记忆。它激起了我们的愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: We accept this memory and move beyond its reach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我们接受这段记忆并超脱它的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: We return this memory to the Void and find peace in our emptiness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我们把这段记忆抛入虚空，在虚无中寻找平和。

[14.2]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 抱歉，艾萨。时间到了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: I… am honored… to be your son.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我……感觉非常荣幸……可以成为你的儿子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[3.3]
Ballas did this, not you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[3.3]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Don't worry, old friend. I'm not going to kill your boy…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 别担心，老朋友。我不会干掉你的儿子……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: You are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你来动手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Father? Father!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 父亲？父亲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Good morning, old friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 早上好，老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: I'm afraid the disease has taken your voice, but we've prepared the finest serums to treat you. Shall we pass the time with a game of Komi? Like old times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 很遗憾看到你的声音被疾病夺走，不过我们已经准备了最好的血清为你治疗。不如我们来下一盘劫棋打发时间？就像以前一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[3.6]
You remember this game, don't you? 
[10.0]
Think your move and the board senses…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[3.6]
你还记得怎么下棋吧？
[10.0]
思考你的行动，棋盘会感知到……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[4.9]
Oh, this… I've had them fit you with a Transference bolt.
[7.7]
In honor of our history together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[4.9]
哦，这个……我让人给你装了一个传识连接端口。
[7.7]
纪念我们的交情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: And look… look who hasn't left your side since you took ill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你看……你生病的时候，有人一直陪着你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Look at him, old man. Look at your son.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 看看他，老东西。看看你的儿子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Look at your son. Do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 看看你儿子。看他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[4.5]
Can he hear me? Father?
[9.0]
It's me. Isaah. Do you remember me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[4.5]
他现在能听见我说话吗？父亲？
[9.0]
是我呀。艾萨。你还记得我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Of course he remembers you, young Dax--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他当然记得你，年轻的侍卫——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: --Which will make this reunion all the more tragic… when you watch him die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: ——所以这次重聚才会格外悲剧……因为你会眼看着他死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Trouble concentrating, old friend? Look at all your Komi stones I've taken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你没法集中精神吗，老朋友？你看，我都吃掉你多少棋子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[5.5]
This one, a brother. These three, his children.
[10.0]
And on and on, all of these gone to the Jade light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[5.5]
这个，是你的兄弟。这三个，是他的孩子。
[10.0]
接下来，他们都要走进翠玉之光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[5.5]
Father, do you remember your Shawzin? 
[20.0]
Remember how you'd sing to us 'Smiles from Juran'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[5.5]
父亲，我很想知道，你还记得你的三线琴吗？
[20.0]
也不知道你还记不记得，你以前给我们唱的那首《朱兰笑》？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: A fine instrument.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 一把好乐器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: How thoughtful, to remind him of his better days. Come now, your move. Only a few stones left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你真体贴，能想到跟他聊他最幸福的日子。来吧，该你了。剩下的棋子可不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Isaah… looks like your father still has his sharp wit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 艾萨……看来你父亲的头脑还是那么敏锐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[5.6]
Yet you couldn't understand why I'd give my secrets to our enemy.
[8.1]
How could I betray my own kind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[5.6]
可惜你怎么也想不明白我为什么要把我的秘密告诉敌人。
[8.1]
我怎么能背叛自己的同类呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[4.7]
But you have never had to sacrifice your love for faith.
[14.2]
Imagine. To live, forever, with only one memory: seeing the one you love, die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[4.7]
可是啊，你从来没有为了信念而牺牲过你爱的人。
[14.2]
想象一下吧。在永恒的生命里，你只剩下一段记忆：眼看着你爱的人死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[8.3]
But you won't have to imagine. A lovingly cultured Infestation swarms within your blood.
[14.7]
Your transformation has begun, reshaping you into a sacred surrogate of the unholy Tenno…
[20.2]
A Warframe with but a Single. Burning. Memory.
[23.5]
It is… a miracle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[8.3]
不过，其实你不必去想象。你的血液里就有一个小小的畸变病毒。
[14.7]
你的转化已经开始了，你会变成一个神圣的容器，交给那些邪恶的 Tenno 使用……
[20.2]
你会变成一个战甲，但你只会保留一段痛苦的记忆。
[23.5]
这……是一个奇迹！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: But all miracles require sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 可是所有奇迹都要付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: My father understands the game better than anyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 说实在的，我一直觉得我父亲下得最好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Your move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 轮到你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Hmmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Curious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 终于。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: He loves this game. I'll never forget the time I finally beat him…^ but now I'm thinking he just let me win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他很喜欢下棋。我永远忘不了第一次赢他的时候……不过现在一想，他肯定是故意输给我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: You served with distinction, old Dax. We commissioned a portrait in your honor, there on the wall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你是个万里挑一的人才，老侍卫。我们请人为你画了一幅像，就在那边的墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: A beautiful portrait, don't you agree?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 画得很美，你说呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Will you follow in your father's path?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你会追随你父亲的脚步吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 当然会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[4.4]
He will, and his children will.
[8.4]
You see… these are the stakes of this little game.
[17.0]
Each stone I capture will be another and another and another… culled from your subversive bloodline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[4.4]
他会，他的孩子也会。
[8.4]
你看……这些就是这盘棋的赌注。
[17.0]
我吃掉的每一颗棋子，都是从你那反叛的血脉里剔除……一个，一个，又一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: You thought you could out-play me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你以为你能赢过我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[4.1]
I've had lifetimes to plan my defection.
[8.8]
You spied on me, intercepted my communications.
[12.2]
But I saw your move long before you took it.
[16.6]
And so... we come to the consequences…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[4.1]
我的背叛已经筹划了几辈子的时间。
[8.8]
你暗中监视我，窃听我的通信。
[12.2]
可惜早在你开始行动以前，我就已经看穿了。
[16.6]
于是……我们迎来了这个结局……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Father? You... you alright? Please! Do something for him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 父亲？你……你还好吗？有人能帮忙吗！快想办法救他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: The Sentient battle at Hull… I can't imagine…^ You were awarded the 'Lua Cross' for valor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 那场在外壁发生的与 Sentient 的战斗……难以想象……不过太好了，你获得了"月球十字奖章"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: It's your move, old friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 你的回合，老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: I'm waiting. Make your play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我在等着。轮到你下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Your turn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 轮到你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Go on. Make a play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 来吧。走下一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Take your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Well played.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 下得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: A fine move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 这一步走得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 我的了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: And so I take another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 然后我再拿下另一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Star-Child - you will need to eliminate the Mimics before we can proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 星童——在我们继续之前，您需要消灭这些拟态者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: The area is locked down. We need to take care of those Mimics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 这个区域已被封锁。我们得解决那些拟态使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Keep searching, they are here somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 继续搜索，它们就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Lock-down ended, very good. Now, where is that Warframe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 封锁已解除，非常好。那个战甲在哪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Finally. We can now resume our search for Umbra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 终于。我们现在可以恢复搜寻 Umbra。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Normal attacks won't work. Try using your Void Blast?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 普通攻击无效。尝试使用您的虚空爆裂？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Your Void Blast may weaken his resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 您的虚空爆裂或许能削弱他的抵抗力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Only your Void Blast seems to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 似乎只有您的虚空爆裂有效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: That worked, hit him again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 成功了，再次击中他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: His defenses are down - quickly, use Transference!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他的防御解除了——快，使用传识！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: That did it! Now is your chance - use Transference!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 成功了！现在就是机会——使用传识！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Use your Transference, before he recovers!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 在他恢复之前使用您的传识！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Void Blast, Star-Child. Use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 虚空爆裂，星童。使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Star-Child, you must use Void Blast to wear him down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 星童，您必须使用虚空爆裂来使他精疲力尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Star-Child. Use your Void Blast to weaken him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 星童。使用您的虚空爆裂来削弱他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Yes, Star-Child. That is the correct approach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 是的，星童。这是正确的做法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Progress, Star-Child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 有进步，星童。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Star-Child, you have an opening. Use your Transference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 星童，您现在有个好机会。使用您的传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Now… use Transference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 现在……用传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: He may recover, Star-Child. Quickly, use your Transference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他可能会复原，星童。快，使用您的传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Vanished… you'll need to search, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 消失了……您需要搜寻，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: How is he doing that? Search the area, see if you can find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他是怎么办到的？搜寻该区域，看看您能否找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: He's getting away - there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他正在离开——在那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: What are you waiting for? After him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 您在等什么？追上他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: There he is, Operator! The Umbra!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 他在那里，指挥官！Umbra！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Operator, please be careful… he is not in control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 指挥官，请小心……他失控了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: See him, Operator? Advise you approach with caution!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText: 看到他了吗，指挥官？我建议您小心些靠近他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text: Operator? Are you alright? Your delta-waves spiked for a moment. Ever since she --abandoned you-- was taken… Ordis knows just what you need! A comforting memory from my data store!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[7.3]
What led us here? You did. You vile blasphemies.
[14.3]
Machines… thinking… breeding… You were to bear us a new, promised land.
[21.7]
But when you arrived at that distant world… you knew that in time, we would bring ruin to it as well.
[27.7]
As we had to Earth. And so it was… we came to war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[7.3]
是谁导致我们走到这一步？是你们。你们这些亵渎之物。
[14.3]
机器……会思考……会繁殖……你们本应该为我们开拓新的家园。
[21.7]
可是，当你们抵达那颗遥远的星球……你们领悟到，它终将被我们摧毁。
[27.7]
正如我们摧毁了地球。于是……我们开战了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[10.1]
Our hubris shone like a black star… for our technology, our war-machines were your kin.
[13.8]
How easily you turned them against us.
[22.5]
We were forced to older means. Not circuits, nor light… but flesh and disease.
[28.2]
Our horrors past, our ravaged outer colonies… became gardens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[10.1]
我们的傲慢仿佛一颗漆黑的恒星……因为我们的技术、我们的纷争机器都是你们的同类。
[13.8]
你们利用我们的武器来对付我们，易如反掌。
[22.5]
我们只好采取古老的手段。不用电路，不用激光……而是血肉和疾病。
[28.2]
我们曾经憎恶的地方，那些饱经蹂躏的外侧殖民地……成了培育场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[5.8]
We cultured the Infestation, conceiving of a hybrid.
[15.1]
Transformed, but only just. The 'Helminth' was created, born to yield these new warriors, worthy of battle against you.
[18.9]
The great and terrible Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[5.8]
我们培育出畸变疾病，发明了一种混合生物。
[15.1]
那是全新的造物，但又不仅如此。我们创造出"Helminth 巢体"，只为打造这些新的战士，因为只有他们才能与你抗衡。
[18.9]
伟大的、可怕的 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[8.5]
We took our greatest, volunteers or not, and polluted them with these cultured reagents.
[12.6]
They transformed. They became Infested…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[8.5]
我们挑选出最强的战士，无论他们是否自愿，给他们接种病毒。
[12.6]
他们被改变了。他们成为畸变体……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[6.4]
… but only just. Their skin blossomed into sword-steel.
[10.6]
Their organs, interlinked with untold resilience.
[16.2]
Yet their minds were free of the Infested madness. Or so we thought.
[21.7]
We set them upon the battlefield, bio-drones under our command.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[6.4]
……但不仅如此。他们的皮肤化为利刃般坚固的钢铁。
[10.6]
他们的内脏表现出前所未见的复原力。
[16.2]
然而他们的心灵却不受疾病影响。至少我们是这么认为的。
[21.7]
我们把他们送上战场，作为我们的生化机器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[6.6]
The Warframes… All of them… failures.
[10.8]
Surprised? They turned on us, just as you did.
[15.8]
And so we had no choice but to commit them to grave.
[25.7]
This is all you know, Hunhow, but there is a hidden half, a secret, that lies within a place forbidden to you and your kind.
[27.9]
I speak of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[6.6]
那些战甲……都是失败品……全都是。
[10.8]
很意外吗？他们背叛了我们，就像你们一样。
[15.8]
所以我们别无选择，只能将他们送入坟墓。
[25.7]
你知道的就只有这些，Hunhow，但另一半真相被隐藏起来了，那是一个秘密，它就藏在你和你的同类无法进入的地方。
[27.9]
也就是虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[6.4]
Before the vain faith - our people held Dualism as truth.
[9.3]
That all things were of two parts.
[13.3]
Mind and body. Consciousness and matter.
[20.5]
Of our world… and the Void. It was from there that our answer finally came.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[6.4]
在那些虚荣的信仰之前——我们把二元性视为真理。
[9.3]
任何事物都有两面。
[13.3]
心灵和身体。意识和物质。
[20.5]
我们的世界……和虚空。于是我们终于找到了答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.text:
[8.0]
Distorted by vague horrors, we kept the Zariman survivors within a secret Reservoir.
[16.9]
They were the missing half. Transference-linked: the Warframes, the body - and they, the mind.
[20.9]
I give you now the coordinates and codes to this place.
[24.0]
But do not underestimate these devils, Hunhow.
[27.3]
They did what we could not.
[28.6]
We had created monsters we couldn't--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Sacrifice/DSac.zhText:
[8.0]
我们害怕未知的惊恐，把扎里曼的遗孤保管在一个秘密庇护所。
[16.9]
他们就是那缺失的一半。通过传识效应连接之后，战甲成为躯体，他们则是心灵。
[20.9]
现在，我告诉你这个地方的坐标和密码。
[24.0]
但你不要小看这些魔鬼，Hunhow。
[27.3]
他们做到了我们没能做到的事情。
[28.6]
我们造出的怪物，就连我们自己也——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Patience, Hunter. You are not ready for this test.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 耐心点，猎者。你还没准备好接受这项测试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hurry, Hunter, the conduit is closing fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 抓紧了，猎者，数据通道正在快速关闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, you are running out of time. Enter the data-conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，你的时间不多了。进入数据通道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: A new data-conduit is open. Our experiment moves to a new zone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 新的数据通道已开启。我们的实验将移至下一区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Enter the conduit, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 进入通道，快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: I have opened a new data-conduit, proceed immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 我打开了一条新的数据通道，立刻进入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: A data-conduit is open, go now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 数据通道已开启，马上进入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: You failed to maintain efficiency. The data generated is null and void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 你未能维持效率。产出的数据全部无效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: You generated some usable data, but I need more. Return when you are ready to subject these data-immortals to a true test.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 你产出了一些可用数据，但我需要更多。当你准备好让这些数据永生体接受真正的测试时，再回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, you exceed expectations. You are far more exciting and complex than any specimen in my Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，你超出了我的预期。你远比圣殿中任何样本都更复杂，更令我兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Efficiency is crucial to this experiment's design. Work faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 效率是这项实验设计的核心。动作快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Specimens must experience unmatched stress. Increase your effort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 样本必须承受前所未有的高压。再加把劲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: This experiment will fail if your efficiency drops further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 若效率继续下滑，这场实验将以失败告终。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Efficiency is failing. I need more conflict!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 效率正在衰减。我需要更多纷争！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, the Sanctuary will go on without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，没有你，圣殿照样会继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: I have disabled your gear items. They serve no purpose in this study.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 我已禁用了你的携带道具。它们对这项研究毫无用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Gear items are not compatible with my experiment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 携带道具与我的实验不兼容。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Conflict reveals nature, reveals truth. Within my Sanctuary, truth is immortal, but it lacks the conflict I require. My experiments have set my data-immortals against each other countless times, but it is not enough. I need you. Challenge my specimens within the construct and enlighten me. I will reward you in kind. I await your presence in the Relay, Hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 纷争揭示本质、揭示真相。在我的圣殿之中，真相即是永恒，但它缺少我渴求的那种纷争。在我的试验中，数据永生体相互厮杀了无数次，然而这还不够。我需要你。在这里挑战我造出来的样本，让我开开眼界。我会赐予你丰厚的回报。我在中继站恭候你的到来，猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, your reliance on that ability is skewing my data. I have disabled it for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，你对技能的依赖正在干扰我的数据。我已暂时将其禁用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, try a different ability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，换个技能试试吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: I have gathered enough data on that ability, use another tactic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 我已采集到足够多关于该技能的数据。改用其他战术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, I have temporarily disabled that ability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，我已暂时禁用了那个技能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: With each data-conduit jump, the experiment's design dictates increased efficiency. I trust you will be able to complete this study, Hunter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 根据实验设计，每进入一条数据通道，效率都必须随之提升。猎者，我相信你能够完成这项研究，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Do not weep for these creatures^ they are immortal. They can and have faced a billion deaths. You, however, do not enjoy the protections of synthesis. For you, failure has real-life consequences.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 不必同情这些生灵，它们永生不灭。它们能够面对、也已经历过无数次死亡。但是你，并未受到结合仪式的庇护。对你而言，失败会造成现实的后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Is experiment torture? Lab rats also feel pain, yet their suffering creates knowledge. If the lessons learned today save lives in the future, then the ends justify my means.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 实验就是折磨吗？小白鼠同样能感受到疼痛，但它们的苦难带来了知识。如果今日所得的教训能在未来拯救生命，那么，为了目的，我可以不择手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, do you think me a sadist? That I enjoy this suffering? Irrelevant! Focus on your task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，你觉得我是施虐狂？觉得我以苦难为乐？无关紧要！专注于你的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Ease your mind, Hunter, there is no conclusive evidence these data-immortals possess memory persistence. They should retain no recollection of what you have done to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 放下你的疑虑，猎者。尚无确凿证据表明这些数据永生体有记忆残留。它们理应不会对你的所作所为留下任何记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Go further! I require more efficiency! The specimens no longer interest me, it is you I study.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 继续深入！我需要更高的效率！我对这些样本提不起兴趣了，我想研究的是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Feel it now? That stress. You are generating useful data, Hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 感受到了吗？那股压力。你正在产出宝贵的数据，猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: A fever pitch! You create fascinating readings, Hunter. Do not stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 火力全开！你创造的读数令人着迷，猎者。不要就此停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Your thirst for knowledge is as insatiable as mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 你与我一样，对知识有着无尽的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Go then. Some other Hunter will have mettle enough to assist me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 那就走吧。总会有其他有胆魄的猎者来帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: You seek rewards, Hunter? Years ago an Ostron Quill donated the blueprints for a powerful Warframe to the Sanctuary. Shortly after, one of my drones synthesized a most unusual Kavat. Upon review, it seemed as if the creature desired capture. Almost immediately, the feline specimen disappeared, and with it, the Warframe's blueprints. This is my Sanctuary, I do not lose specimens, yet I lost these. I detect her presence from time to time. Usually when there are Tenno nearby. You might never see her, but if she deems you worthy, she may leave something for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，你在寻求奖赏吗？多年以前，一位奥斯特朗夜羽将一套强大战甲的蓝图捐赠给了圣殿。不久之后，我的一台无人机结合了一只极其罕见的库娃。复核数据时，它看起来仿佛是自愿被抓的。几乎就在下一刻，那只猫科样本就消失了。随之消失的，还有那套战甲蓝图。这里是我的圣殿，我不会遗失样本，然而我确实失去了它们。我仍会不时探测到她的存在。通常是在附近有 Tenno 的时候。你或许永远也见不到她，但若她觉得你配得上，或许会为你留下些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Hunter, my research needs you. Are you ready to endure the rigors of the Sanctuary?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 猎者，我的研究需要你。你准备好承受圣殿的严酷试炼了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: This is a stress test. Destroy all specimens as quickly as possible. In this chaos, the true nature of these creatures will be revealed... as will yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 这是一场压力测试。尽可能快速摧毁所有样本。在混沌之中，这些生灵和你的本质……都终将显现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Kill everything you encounter, do not relent. The integrity of this experiment relies on your efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 格杀勿论，一个不留，不要迟疑。这场测试的完整性取决于你的效率。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.text: Your duty in this experiment is to dispatch as many specimens as efficiently as possible. When the time comes, I will open the next data-conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SanctuaryOnsla.zhText: 你在这场实验中的任务，是尽可能快速、高效地清除样本。时机一到，我会开启下一条数据通道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Autorepel triggered. Entry denied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 自动防卫启动。拒绝登入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Autorepel successful. Boarding attempt neutralized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 自动防卫成功。已消灭登舰敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: Sentient drones on Avionics. Rectify.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，航电设备上出现 Sentient 无人机。清除它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: Sentients have hit the avionics. Dispose of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，Sentient 击中了航电设备。解决它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: avionics offline. Kill those drones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，航电设备离线。干掉那些无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentient drones are throttling our engines. Speed reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Sentient 无人机正在节流我们的引擎。速度降低。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Engines locked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 引擎锁定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: get those things off my engines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，把这些东西从我的引擎上弄走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentient lifeforms no longer detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 检测不到 Sentient 生命活动迹象了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Onboard threats eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰上的威胁已经清除了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Intruders cleared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 已清除入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Alert: Sentients have boarded the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 警报：Sentient 已登上航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentient presence detected onboard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 在舰上检测到 Sentient。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Repel Sentients. We board them. They do not board us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 击退 Sentient。只许我们登它们船，不许它们登我们的船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentients on-board. Spray for bugs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Sentient 登上星舰。喷除虫药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: the enemy is aboard. They will adapt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，敌人已在舰上。它们会适应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: We are boarded. Eliminate Sentient threat. Vary attacks lest they adapt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 我们被入侵了。清除 Sentient 的威胁。不断变化攻击方式以防止它们适应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Splinters targeting the Railjack. Prepare to be boarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 芒刺正在瞄准航道星舰。做好被敌军登舰的准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Splinters incoming. Prepare to repel Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 芒刺来袭。准备击退 Sentient 大军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Crew: splinters on collision vector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 舰员们，芒刺在冲击方向上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentient drone blocking critical systems. Deal with them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Sentient 无人机在阻断至关重要的系统。干掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: System function blocked. Eliminate Sentient infiltrator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 系统功能被切断。消灭潜入的 Sentient。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentients attacking critical systems. Respond immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Sentient 正在攻击关键系统。立即行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: All systems restored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 已修复所有系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Systems rebooted. We are good to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 系统重启完毕。我们准备就绪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Systems damage repaired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 系统损坏已修复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Welcome to the flotilla, Hotshot. Got a name for ya: Erra. Remember it. One of the primary Sentient intelligences from the Old War. Right now waves of his 'Murex' ships are massin' in the Veil. From there, those Murex launch swarms of info-gatherin' Condrix dropships: recon data for the main event. That's why you're here, mate. Fighting off a Sentient invasion is precisely what you were built for. We don't know how to kill one of those big bastards, but me and my network reckon we can give it a muckin' lobotomy. Gonna require a little coordination to work, real hand-in-glove, yeah? Ground teams to hit the Condrix and Railjack teams to mess up the Murex. OpLinks tie the whole lot together. So, buy and equip an OpLink. Then take your pick, mate: upstairs or down?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 欢迎来到舰队，大佬。有个名字你听听：Erra。记住它。这是自远古之战以来 Sentient 方面的一员大将。现在，他的骨螺战舰编队正在面纱集结。从那里，那些骨螺战舰放出了大量用于信息采集的谍影登陆舰：为大行动进行数据侦测。这就是为什么你在这了，兄弟。对抗 Sentient 的入侵正是你的使命。我们不知道该如何击杀他们中的一个大混蛋，但我和我的网络可以给他们点厉害看看。这将需要一点协同作战，真正的密切合作，懂吗？地面部队将对谍影登陆舰发起攻击，而航道星舰部队将搅乱那些骨螺战舰。联动作战信标会把所有小队紧密联系在一起。所以，购买再装备一个联动作战信标。然后，做出你的选择，兄弟：上天还是入地？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: It's a two-prong attack. Ground team hits the Condrix and swipes their recon data before it beams back to the Murex. We take that friendly data and use it as a Trojan horse for toxic data - think of it as a Kill Code. The Railjack team boards the Murex and broadcasts those Kill Codes right into the Murex's noggin', muckin' up its thinker and making it wanna run home to Daddy. Threat neutralized. Clear as mud? Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 这是双管齐下的进攻。地面部队对谍影登陆舰发起攻击，在它们将侦查获取的数据传回骨螺战舰之前提取出来。我们得到这些无害数据并将其改造为夹藏有害数据的特洛伊木马 — 把它看作是"销毁代码"。航道星舰部队登上骨螺战舰，并将那些销毁代码直接上传到骨螺战舰的系统内，在作战中枢引发混乱，使其不得不打道回府。威胁解除。我解释的够清楚了吧？开始行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: I deal with all sorts: low-breeds and the high-born. Everyone wants somethin' they're not s'posed to have. But these days it's a buyer's market. And what's sellin' is stuff that'd get a girl buried. Sentient stuff. And it's been comin' in by the wagonload. My crowd had these Murex rumbled months ago. Back then old mate Teshin wasn't havin' it. Tried warnin' him, but... you know the type. But now? Oh, NOW it's all "tell me all that you know" and "your expertise is required" and "I'm a hoity-toity sod with a hat like a designer bedpan." Shoulda kept me trap shut. I'm no general. But, here we are and I know what I know. So you listen to what I have to say and we'll all be home in time for tea. Yeah… no worries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 我和各样的人打过交道：贱民或贵族。每个人都想拥有一些不属于他们的东西。但是如今，这个市场由买家说了算，而那些出售的货物足以埋没一个女孩。也就是 Sentient 的东西，并且随着运载船在来的路上。数月前我的人发现了这些骨螺战舰。那时，老伙计 Teshin 毫无察觉。我试着警告他了，不过……你知道他那种人。但现在？哦，现在他倒老是说"告诉我你所知道的一切"和"我需要你的能力"和"我是头上顶着马桶盖的混蛋"。我应该闭嘴的。我又不是总指挥。不过，我们来帮忙了，而且我知道要自己要做什么。所以，你照着我说的做，那么我们都能按时回家喝下午茶。对……不用担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Hey there hotshot. Look, I won't beat around the topiary: the Sentients are massing in the Veil. Zero doubt it's the tickle before the slap. Invasion, mate. I been set up with a relay. Don't ask me how. You've been recruited. Tell you why when you get here. And if you got anythin' you been meanin' to say to someone, maybe say it now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 嘿，大佬。这样吧，我就不和你绕圈子了：Sentient 正在面纱集结。毫无疑问，这只是惊涛骇浪前的风和日丽。说到入侵，伙计。我已经搞定了一个中继站。不要问我是怎么做的。你已经被招募了。等你来这了就告诉你为什么。如果你有什么重要的话想告诉某人，那就现在说了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: No prisoners. The only interrogations will be autopsies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 不留活口。用尸检来代替审讯吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Kill the Sentients. Kill the Tenno. Kill them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 杀死 Sentient。杀死 Tenno。把他们全杀了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Trespassers? Die!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 侵入者？去死吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: These Tau vermin are a Tenno ruse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 这些来自 Tau 星系的害虫是 Tenno 的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Grineer, make these Sentients wish they'd stayed in Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Grineer 士兵听令，让这些 Sentient 后悔离开 Tau 星系吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Sentients and Tenno. Today we correct two Orokin mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Sentient 和 Tenno。今天，我们要修正这两个由奥罗金犯下的错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Tenno, why have you brought these things here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Tenno，你们为什么要把这些家伙带到这里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: I blame the Tenno. I blame them for everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: 我认为这是 Tenno 的错。这所有的一切都是 Tenno 的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.text: Tenno - we should set aside our differences and work together... HAHAHAHA NEVER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ScarletSpear/D.zhText: Tenno，我们应该放下成见，努力合作……哈哈哈哈，休想！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You… You escaped. But how?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你……你竟然逃脱了。可这是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Unreal. You survived. Come find me in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不可思议。你竟然活下来了。来中继站找我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno, you finished the canvases. Wow. Find me on the relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你画完了那些画布。哇。到中继站来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: All of the Shadowgraphs have been painted. Just as Master Kozai once did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 所有绘影图都已经绘制完成了，就像科扎伊导师当年做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Look at all that Atramentum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看看这些墨痕啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: With every trip you take into the Shadowgraph I learn so much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你每次进入绘影图，我都能学到很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You've freed the truth Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你已经揭开了真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I will learn much with this Atramentum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我将通过这个墨痕学到很多东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai would be proud of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师会以你为骄傲的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Did you… finish all the Shadowgraphs. I can hardly believe it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你竟然……完成了所有的绘影图。我简直不敢相信。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I thought you were gone… but now you're back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我以为你已经走了……没想到你又回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Good work. Come find me in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 干得漂亮。来中继站找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You survived. How do I thank you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你竟然活了下来。我该如何报答你？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: All done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 全部完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: See how it shines?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 闪不闪亮？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I hope it's satisfactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 希望你满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: As requested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 遵照指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I think this turned out well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我觉得效果很好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I'm sorry, but I can't do anything without Chromatic Atramentum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很抱歉，没有彩色墨痕，我什么都做不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You'll need some Chromatic Atramentum to turn a mod into an Atragraph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你需要一些彩色墨痕才能把一个 Mod 转化为墨染 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If you have any Chromatic Atramentum, I can turn your mods into Atragraphs. It won't change their function at all, but they'll look a lot different. Worthy of a Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 无论你有哪种彩色墨痕，我都可以将你的 Mod 转化为墨染 Mod。其功能丝毫不变，但外观将焕然一新。与 Tenno 的身份相得益彰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Okay. Let's begin the inscribing process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 好的。我们开始篆刻吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Make sure you paint within the frame. We don't want to be messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 请务必在画框之内作画。我们可不想弄得一团糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Relax. Paint what you feel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 放松。把你的感受画出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The brush is a part of you. Don't fight it. Let it guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 画笔是你的一部分。别抗拒它。让它引导你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There. No need to rush. Let it out a little at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好。不用着急。一点一点释放出你的灵感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Do your feelings have a shape? Can you paint them a face?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你的感受有形状吗？你能给它画张脸吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Drip, drip, drip. That's right. Let the paint do the bleeding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 滴答，滴答，滴答。就是这样。让颜料像血一样流淌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Just let your brush do what it wants. It might surprise you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 就让你的画笔自由发挥。或许它会给你带来惊喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Round and round and up and down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 转呀转，上上下下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Breathe all of the bad into a big beautiful balloon and… let it go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 把所有坏情绪都呼进一个又大又漂亮的气球里……然后放飞它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: It won't do you any good to get cross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 生气对你没有任何益处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If you don't fight me, then the paint won't fight you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果你不反抗我，颜料也不会弄到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The paint doesn't care what's real or unreal. You can make it into whatever you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 颜料并不在乎真实与否。你可以把它变成你需要的任何东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Whatever's scaring you, you can turn it into a picture. Then it won't ever be able to get out again, will it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 无论你在害怕什么，都可以把它变成一幅画。这样它就再也无法从画中逃脱了，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Breathe in, breathe out. Let the paint flow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 吸气，呼气。让颜料流动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If we need to scream, we don't do it with our mouths. We do it with our pictures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果我们想要尖叫，我们不用嘴，我们用画来叫出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Fold it over and press, and look! Could that be a pretty Lepidrian, or perhaps a happy Thasmite?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 折起来，压下去，瞧！那会是一只漂亮的凤蝶，还是快乐的霜蛾呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Sometimes you don't know what it's going to be until you've finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 有时候，在完成画作之前，你也不知道它会变成什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Brushes are not for chewing. Paint is not for drinking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 画笔不是用来啃的。颜料也不是用来喝的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: No throwing. No flicking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不准乱扔。不准乱甩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The smooth white page is listening. Can the paint tell it a story?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那张光滑的白纸在聆听。颜料能为它讲个故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: What do you see? Can you show me? Can you paint it for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你看到了什么？能给我展示一下吗？能把它画出来给我看看吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There are no wrong answers. I want to see what you see. Just pick up the brush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 画作没有对错之分。我想看看你所看到的。拿起画笔吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Do you feel happy? There are tears in your eyes. Are they happy tears?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你感到快乐吗？你眼里有泪。那是快乐的泪水吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You just need to paint. That's all. Everything will be made clear, in time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你只需要继续作画。仅此而已。一切都会随着时间变得清晰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Remember, the painting isn't real. Nothing can hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 记住，这幅画不是真的。它不会伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: It's just balloons, nothing to be scared of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那只是气球，没什么可怕的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You are seeing all of your bad qualities. Hate, anger, distrust. You are strangling them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你正在看到自己所有的缺点：仇恨、愤怒、不信任。你正在扼杀它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You say you're seeing faces? Whose faces? How many? How many of them have you killed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你说你看到了脸？是谁的脸？有多少张？这样的面孔你杀了多少个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Cast the bad thoughts out of your mind and on to the canvas. Out they go. Splish, splash, splosh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 把那些坏念头从脑海里抛到画布上。都丢出去。啪嗒，飞溅，哗啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There's no sense in hiding anything away. Secrets will just fester in your skull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 隐瞒任何事都没有意义。秘密只会在你的颅骨里溃烂成灾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If we had ventured blindly into the Veil, we would never have found Tau. Only through memory can the path be made clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果我们盲目地闯入面纱比邻星域，就永远找不到 Tau 。只能凭着记忆，才能让道路变得清晰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: My father shattered the Solar Rail, and the Veil erupted in its wake. Whether by accident or design, I cannot know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我父亲摧毁了星际航道，面纱比邻星域在觉醒中爆发。这究竟是意外还是有意为之，我不得而知。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Blood will have its due. Every debt must be repaid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 血债终有清算之日。每一笔债，都必须偿还。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: One bears the light of Adis. The other, the hand of Natah. You are adapting to our ways.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 一个散发着阿迪斯的光芒，另一个则握着 Natah 的手。你正在适应我们的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Itzam foresaw a future where humans and Sentients would ultimately merge. It seems you have both begun the process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 伊赞预见到，人类和 Sentient 最终会实现融合的未来。看起来你们双方都已经开始了这个过程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: For better or worse, both of you bear Sentient essence within your bodies. This may impress the denizens of Tau… or enrage them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不论是福是祸，你们二人的体内都蕴含着 Sentient 之力。这或许会让 Tau 的居民刮目相看……也可能会激起他们的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Using the Dark Refractory was only ever intended as a last resort. If there had been some other way…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 使用深溯池原本只是作为最后的应急策略。要是当时还有其他办法的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I never intended any of this. I have only ever sought to protect my children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这一切都不是我的本意。我一直以来的初衷只是想保护我的孩子们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: That I might have been used to hurt my child, however falsely… It will not be forgiven, nor forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我可能被利用来伤害我的孩子，哪怕这并非出自我本意……这种做法都不会被原谅，也不会被遗忘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: To relive the past… I believed in your strength, then. I still do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 重温往昔……我曾相信你的力量。现在依然如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: When we find him, it will all be worth it. It cannot be otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 当我们找到他时，这一切都将值得。没有其他可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I know I ask much of you. Yet you rise to the challenge, always. What sustains me… it is you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我知道我对你们的要求很高。但你们总能接受挑战。是你们……支撑着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Do not concern yourself with my fate. I have made peace with my past. Ballas… I no longer think of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不必为我的命运担忧。我已经与过去和解。Ballas……我不会再想起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The truth must be faced, especially when it is difficult. I have never doubted you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 必须面对真相，尤其是在真相难以接受的时候。我从未怀疑过你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Through what we have endured together, I have found singularity of purpose. I trust you will find yours too, in time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 通过我们共同经历的这一切，我找到了它特别的意义。我相信，随着时间的推移，你也会找到属于你的意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I fear we have only begun to reckon the cost of what has been done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 恐怕我们才刚刚意识到已经发生的事情所带来的代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: She would have been proud. She is proud. We are proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 她一定会很骄傲。她现在就很骄傲。我们也很骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I'm sure that feels wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我敢肯定那感觉很美妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Don't smudge it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 别把它抹花了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Leave it alone, now. Let it dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 现在别碰它了。让它晾干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Such earnest brushwork!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 多么认真细致的笔触！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You should feel proud of yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你该为自己感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Good, just like that. Let the paint guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好，就这样。让颜料引导你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You're making progress. I can see it in your brushwork.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你在进步。我能从你的笔触里看出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There. You can follow instructions. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好，你能遵循指令。做得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Don't forget to take a big breath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 别忘了深呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Rinse the brush, now. We need to be clean, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 现在把画笔冲洗干净。我们需要保持洁净，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: A moment. Something has come up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 稍等。有些状况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You are still under scrutiny. Make no mistake about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你仍处于观察之中。别误会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I don't know how I'm expected to deal with all of you at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我真不知道该如何同时处理你们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We'll just take a little time out, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我想，我们还是暂停一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I'll deal with you later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我稍后再处理你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Good. Recover your focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好。找回你的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: That's right. Breathe slowly. It was only a hallucination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 对。慢慢呼吸。那只是幻觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Can you please co-operate for longer than two minutes this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这次可否请你配合超过两分钟？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Let's start over. We have plenty of fresh materials and plenty of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 重新开始吧。我们有新鲜的颜料，也有充足的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You didn't think I'd let a little reject like you get under my skin, did you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你不会以为，我会让你这种失败品影响到我吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I'll deal with you presently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我很快就处理你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You're too old for tantrums.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你早过了闹脾气的年纪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I am willing to de-escalate if you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 若你愿意，我也可以缓和局势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We will not be requiring the soporific vapours after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看来我们不需要催眠蒸气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I will not permit one refractory subject to occupy my entire attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我不会允许一个棘手的受试对象占用我全部注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I simply do not have the time for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我实在没有时间浪费在这上面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Don't let it happen again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 下不为例。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I think you've learned the value of willing co-operation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看来你已经明白，心甘情愿地合作才是明智之举。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Back to your brushwork you go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 回去继续你的画作吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Your record is accumulating a lot of nasty blots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你的就诊记录上已经积累了不少污点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno… What happened?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno……发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I see nothing… where are you??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我什么也看不见……你在哪里？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Death must not be the end…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 死亡绝非终点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Failure? For you? How?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 失败？你吗？怎么会？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Disaster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 简直是灾难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno… NO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno……不要啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: When we are bad, there are consequences!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 当我们做错事时，是要付出代价的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I shall call for the Custodians. Then you'll be sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我会叫来监管者。到时候你会后悔的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Of all the thoughtless, beastly things you could have done…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 在所有愚蠢、残忍的行为里，你偏偏……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The paint is not supposed to go on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 颜料可不该涂在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Oh, you filthy little…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 哦，你这肮脏的小……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I've been looking everywhere for you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我在到处找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Did you really think I wouldn't find out? I know everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你真的以为我不会发现吗？我什么都知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I'm not sure you are worth keeping after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我开始怀疑，是否还值得留下你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If you are not gentle with your implements, do not expect them to be gentle with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果你不能温柔对待你的工具，就别指望它们温柔待你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Let your fear disappear in the strokes of your brush. Watch it run down the canvas. Faster... Faster...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 让你的恐惧随着画笔消散。看着它沿着画布流淌。快……再快一点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Why are you being so difficult? I'm just trying to help you. You just need to let go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你怎么这么固执？我只是想帮你。你只需要放手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I know what you've done. The painting makes it clear. I know you better than anyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我知道你做了什么。这幅画已经说明了一切。我比任何人都了解你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You say they were attacking you? So you killed them all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你是说他们攻击你？所以你把他们都杀了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: And where exactly are you planning to hide?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那你打算躲到哪里去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Very well. We have other, less gentle, methods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好。我们还有，其他，没那么温和的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: What's wrong? Is it the voices again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 怎么了？又是那些声音吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Nothing is coming to hurt you. You are safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不会有任何东西伤害你。你很安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This absurd behaviour simply has to stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这种荒谬的行为必须停止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If I were in your position I'd be extremely cautious with my behaviour.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果我是你，我会格外谨慎行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I can have you put back in your capsule like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我可以就这样把你送回休眠舱里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You can't run from a guilty conscience. It's in there with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你无法逃避内心的愧疚。它一直伴随着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Well. You've upset the apple-cart now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 很好。你把局面彻底搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The common factor behind all of your problems is you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你所有问题的根源都在于你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You wanted to provoke a reaction, and now you have. Good for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你想激起反应，现在你做到了。恭喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I think we need a reminder of the boundaries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看来我们需要重申一下界限在哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Now, now. You know this is not how we behave. Try. Again.
