/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 好了好了。你知道我们可不是这样做事的。再试。一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Resist all you like. This only ends when I say so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 随你怎么反抗。由我决定何时结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Now look at what a mess you've made. You'll have to clean this up, you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看看你弄出来的烂摊子。你知道吗，你得自己收拾干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I've been looking everywhere for you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我在到处找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Where are you going? Therapy is in session.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你要去哪儿？治疗还没结束呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I have experience dealing with difficult subjects.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我很擅长处理棘手的问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You need to be open with me, or we'll never get anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你需要对我敞开心扉，否则我们永远无法取得任何进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You'll open up one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不管怎样，你终会敞开心扉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Yes yes, everything must go back to its proper place once we finish. Even the paint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 对对，完工后一切都要放回原位。颜料也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: See? That wasn't so hard. There's nothing to be afraid of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你看，并不难。没什么可害怕的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You can go when you've finished painting. Just relax. It takes as long as it takes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 画完这幅画你就可以走了。放松。想画多久就画多久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: How does that make you feel? You're becoming quite agitated. Good. We're getting somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那让你有什么感觉？你开始激动了。很好。我们有进展了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You're further gone than I thought. Quite a severe case.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你的情况比我想象的严重得多。相当严重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I am not above resorting to physical restraint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我并不排斥使用物理束缚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I think you are being far too exuberant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我认为你过于亢奋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Let's get you calmed down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 让我来帮你冷静下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: That did not need to happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那本可以避免。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Never mind. Pick yourself up and try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 无妨。振作起来，再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: How did that make you feel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 那让你有什么感受？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If it's not hurting it's not working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不疼，就无效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This is a development you will have to process in your own time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这是一个你需要慢慢消化的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Nobody has any sympathy for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 没有人会同情你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Oh yeah? I can scream just as loudly as you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 哦，是吗？我也可以和你一样大声尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Oh no you don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 不，你想都别想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I know what you're capable of. So I am taking no chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我知道你的本事。所以我不会冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I am the Archimedean. You are the subject.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我是哲士。你是受试对象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Five sealed letters. That's all Arbiter Kozai left me in the world. Why would he do that, when he knows I can't read? He promised to teach me the sacred script of Hexis. But he never did. And now he's gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 五封密封的信件。这就是仲裁者科扎伊留给我的全部。他明明知道我不识字，为何还要这样做？他曾答应要教我《均衡圣典》的文字，却始终未能兑现。如今他已离去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I can read the first letter now! It's really short. Here goes. 'Work hard. Study… far? No. Study long. Good Zorba. Happy Kozai.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我能读懂第一封信了！内容很短。说道："努力工作。学习……远？不。学习要持久。好左巴。快乐科扎伊。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Letter number two. 'Zorba. Kozai has work to do. Teach… I don't know this word. Teach… blobby thing? …truth. Learn truth too. Much change. Big surprise.' Ah… okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 第二封信。"左巴。科扎伊还有工作要做。教……我不认识这个词。教……黏糊糊的东西？……真相。也要学习真相。变化很大。大惊喜。" 啊……好吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Third letter. 'Follie is not evil. Follie is… a teller of truths. I taught her Hexis stories. You are learning and she is learning. She makes my stories into… pictures. You must make her ink into words.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 第三封信。"Follie 并非邪恶。Follie 是……真相的讲述者。我教她《均衡圣典》的故事。你在学习，她也在学习。她把我的故事变成……图画。你必须把她的墨迹变成文字。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: 'I have learned something of Follie's own truth. She was not always as you see her now. Once she was a painter of hidden truths, bringing secrets to light for healing's sake. But others sought to… um… crooked line… warp? Twist? Pervert her gifts. She was put in service to cruel masters.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: "我已经了解了 Follie 自己的一些真相。她并非一直都是你现在看到的那样。她曾经是一位描绘隐秘真相的画家，为了治愈而揭露秘密。但其他人试图……嗯……歪曲线条……卷曲？扭曲？滥用她的天赋。她被迫为残酷的主人效力。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: 'The… sky-ogres? Wait. Fomorians. The Fomorians will be here soon. I will give these letters to our Preceptory Cephalon. We shall not meet again, my student, my friend. I must keep Follie safe. If you are reading this, you will understand why, and with what reason we should revere Follie as a Holy Fool, one of the Saints of Truth. I am confident you will be a just and wise Arbiter of Hexis.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: "天……天魔人？等等。是巨人战舰。巨人战舰的人很快就会到来。我将把这些信件交给我们的圣所中枢。我的学生，我的朋友，我们再也不会相见了。我必须保护 Follie。若你读到此信，便会明白缘由，以及我们为何要尊崇 Follie 为圣愚——真相圣徒之一。我确信你将成为一名公正而睿智的均衡仲裁者。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There, Follie's Shadowgraph, a window into a dark soul that my Master only barely escaped from. Do you understand, Tenno, I am asking you to venture into its darkness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看，那就是 Follie 的绘影图，一扇通向黑暗灵魂的窗口，我的导师也只不过侥幸从那里逃离。Tenno，你能明白吗？我是在请求你踏入那片黑暗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Vesper Relay! Not as it was, but how my Master described it when he ventured into Follie's art. Kozai said he was only able to escape by finishing the stories. Did he mean the Shadowgraphs? I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Vesper 中继站！它的原貌并非如此，而是我导师当年踏入 Follie 的画时所描述的那样。科扎伊说他只有完成那些故事才能脱身。他指的是那些绘影图吗？我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai told of being pulled into Follie's Shadowgraph… Of being hunted by truth unvarnished. Now I ask you to submit yourself to the very same Shadowgraph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师说过自己被拽进了 Follie 的绘影图中……被赤裸裸的真相所追猎。而现在，我请求你也亲身进入那幅绘影图中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This is it, by some Void madness Follie's Shadowgraph survived Vesper's annihilation. Confront its shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 就是这里。拜疯狂的虚空所赐，Follie 的绘影图在 Vesper 中继站毁灭时幸存了下来。请直面那片阴影吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This Shadowgraph may have gotten my Master killed, but with its Atramentum…  I can finally read a few characters of the Hexis script. I ask you once again, confront Follie, and find more Atramentum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这幅绘影图可能害死了我的导师，但有了其中的墨痕……我终于能读懂《均衡圣典》中的一些字了。我再次请求你，去直面 Follie，找到更多的墨痕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Instead of teaching how to read the sacred Hexis script, my Master stared into the Shadowgraph all day. Why? What insights do you have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我的导师没有教人如何读懂《均衡圣典》，而是整天盯着这幅绘影图看。这是为什么？你怎么看？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This wretched 'Shadowgraph' and whatever lies within are responsible for my Master's disappearance. See what you can do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这该死的"绘影图"，连同其中的一切，害得我导师下落不明。看看你能做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You return to brave the Shadowgraph again! If only I had your courage…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你又一次勇敢地重返了绘影图！真希望我能像你一样勇敢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You've returned to Follie. The Arbiters have never doubted your resolve, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你又回到了 Follie 身边。Tenno，仲裁者从未质疑过你的决心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I grow weary of the prospect of finding my Master alive. I take solace in deciphering his letters with the Atramentum hidden within the Shadowgraph. You will find more for me, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我已经不指望我导师能活着回来了。我在破译他藏于绘影图中的墨痕时，得到了很多慰藉。你会为我寻得更多墨痕，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai said he communed with Follie's work daily. I am starting to understand that he was communicating with Follie herself, telling her his story. Uncover it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师说他每天都与 Follie 的画作交流。我逐渐明白，他是在与 Follie 本人对话，向她讲述自己的故事。去揭开真相吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: When I see Follie I see anger, confusion, disarray. What possible virtue could my Master Kozai have seen in this monster?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 当我看着 Follie，看到的只有愤怒、困惑和混乱。我的科扎伊导师，究竟在这怪物身上看到了什么美德？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: With each trip you take into the Shadowgraph I understand the old script more and more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 每次你进入绘影图，我对古老的《均衡圣典》的理解就更深一层。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Just as it takes many strokes to fell a tree, it may take many inquiries to reach the truth. I salute your persistence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 正如伐倒一棵大树需要多次砍伐，追寻真相也需要反复探索。我敬佩你的这份坚韧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: What does all this matter when my Master is gone? No, I must not entertain such thoughts, Kozai would not encourage that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 导师不在了，这一切又有什么意义呢？不，我可不能有这种想法，科扎伊不会赞许我这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Every time you stare into the Shadowgraph you see something new. It's the same with my Masters letters, I keep rereading and I keep finding new insights. Don't stop now, Tenno. I need to read them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 每次凝视那幅绘影图，你都会发现新的东西。我导师的信也是如此，我反复阅读，总能从中发现新的见解。Tenno，不要停。我要把它们全部弄懂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai always said that before I could learn the sacred script, I had to learn to see. I think the Atramentum is helping me see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师常说，在学习《均衡圣典》之前，我必须先学会"看见"。我想，墨痕能帮助我更好地看见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Back again? Careful Tenno, my Master also couldn't refuse the Shadowgraphs pull. And we know where that left him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 又要回去吗？小心点，Tenno，连我的导师都无法抗拒绘影图的力量。而我们都清楚他的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Once more you prove your tenacity. I will be just as persistent in my own studies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你再次证明了自己的坚韧。我也会在自己的课题中同样坚持不懈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Why does Follie not want her canvas finished? Why does she protect those stories?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 为什么 Follie 不愿完成她的画作？她为什么要保护那些故事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Shadowgraph cannot be conquered, it can only be escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 绘影图是无法被征服的，你只能逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I understand now. Kozai told Follie his story, she saw his truth, and now she protects it. Forgive her. She knows not your noble intentions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我现在明白了。科扎伊把他的故事告诉了 Follie，她看到了他所说的真相，现在她要守护它。原谅她吧。她并不明白你高尚的意图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Back again, Tenno? Because you know, like I now do, that there is no truth without struggle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你又要回去了？因为你和我一样明白，没有斗争就没有真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You are drawn to the Shadowgraph, aren't you? To Follie? That's why you keep coming back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你被绘影图吸引了，对吧？被 Follie 吸引了？这就是你一直回来的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Shadowgraph, you can't look away, can you? Just like Master Kozai. Please, Tenno, be more careful than he.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你无法将视线，从那幅绘影图上移开，对吧？就像科扎伊导师一样。Tenno，请务必比他更加小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You need to enter the painting. There is no going back now, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你必须进入画中。Tenno，现在已经没有回头路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The painting is truth, face it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这幅画描绘的就是真相，直面它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: How did Follie's painting ever survive?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Follie 的这幅画当年是怎么幸存下来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Arbiters of Hexis will never forgive Vay Hek for his desecration of Vesper Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 均衡仲裁者永远不会原谅韦·海克对 Vesper 中继站的亵渎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Vesper Relay took a direct hit from a Fomorian, how did that Shadowgraph even survive?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Vesper 中继站当时被巨人战舰直接击中，那幅绘影图是怎么幸存下来的？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: So, devil, you choose the harder path. As always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 所以，魔鬼，你还是选择了更艰难的路。一如既往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Hurry, find paint and finish the Shadow-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 快点，寻找颜料，完成这些绘影——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Go now. Before she finds you-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 快走。趁她还没发现你——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There are three canvases waiting to-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 有三幅画布正等待——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The canvases are the way out, find paint and finish them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这些画布就是逃脱的方法，寻找颜料，完成它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Move now, time is of the essence-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 马上跑，刻不容缓——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Follie's on the hunt-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Follie 正在狩猎——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Follie is here, you cannot kill her, but you can outsmart her. Finish her canvases-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Follie 来了，你杀不死她，但你可以智胜她。去画完她的那些画布——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno. This ink… it's forming letters by itself! I make words in my head, and it just flows, and next minute I'm looking at the sacred script of Hexis! Every time I think of the same word it makes the same shapes. All I have to do is remember what it's showing me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno。这墨水……竟然能自动形成文字！我脑中构思词句，墨流便顺势而下，转眼间《均衡圣典》的文字便跃然纸上！每次想到同一个词，它便勾勒出相同的形状。我只需要记住它向我展示的内容！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno, I'm sorry, but I'm going to need you to bring me a lot more ink. I went a little crazy thinking of different things and the ink made words every time but I don't remember them now and the ink's all gone. I'm going to try copying what it shows me. That way it might stay in my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，抱歉，我需要你再给我带更多的墨水来。我刚才想着各种事情有点失控，墨水每次都会写下文字，可现在我全都记不起来了，而且墨水也用光了。我打算试着抄写它呈现的内容，这样或许能记住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: It's working, Tenno. I've got all these different words in my head now and I can write them down any time I like. Could you keep bringing me ink? I don't think Follie minds. I think… she meant this to happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 成功了，Tenno。此刻我脑海里浮现着各种词语，随时都可以写下来。你能继续给我送墨水吗？我想 Follie 不会介意的。我想……她本就希望如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Did you know you can write the same thing in totally different ways? Like, if you're writing to someone important you're meant to put these extra curls and lines on the word to show respect? I think I only need a little more ink, Tenno. I'm almost done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你知道吗？同一个词可以用完全不同的方式写。比如，如果你写信给重要的人，为了表示尊重，你应该在单词上加一些花体字和横线。Tenno，我应该还差一点墨水。就快写完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno… it's done. I can read it all now. Even the fragments from the years before the Ordering. Now I can finally read what Kozai wanted to tell me. Thank Follie for me, would you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno……完成了。如今我能读懂一切了。就连秩序建立前的碎片记忆也能读懂。终于能明白科扎伊想告诉我的话了。帮我向 Follie 道谢，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text:
Revered Tenno, my mentor, Arbiter Kozai, is gone. They tell me he is dead, but I reject these lies. Kozai faced down the Wolf of Saturn Six alone! Such a man does not just perish like a dog.

You must think this strange, but I beg you: travel to the wreckage of Vesper Relay. There we will search for the Truth.

Aspirant Zorba
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText:
尊敬的 Tenno，我的导师——均衡仲裁者科扎伊，已经不在了。世人宣称他已死亡，但我拒绝接受这些谎言。科扎伊曾独自一人对抗土星六号之狼！这样的人绝不会像条狗一般轻易死去。

你一定觉得这很奇怪，但我恳请你：前往 Vesper 中继站的残骸。我们将在那里寻找真相。

见习仲裁者左巴

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text:
Revered Tenno, I can't go to the wreck of Vesper Relay, it's too dangerous for a mere aspirant like me, but I want… no, I need to see Follie's Shadowgraph again. 

To make that happen, I need Nightmare Tatters. Find them on Vesper Relay and also in what you call Nightmare missions. These shreds are remnants of Follie's art. I think if we collect enough of those, we can reproduce a copy of her work right here in the relay. Then everyone can safely see it.

Will you help me do that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText:
尊敬的 Tenno，我无法前往 Vesper 中继站的残骸，对于像我这样的见习生来说那里太危险了，但我想要……不，我必须再次见到 Follie 的绘影图。 

要实现这个愿望，我需要噩梦残片。你可以在 Vesper 中继站，以及所谓的"噩梦任务"中找到它们。这些残片是 Follie 作品的残片。我想如果我们收集到足够多的残片，就能在这里的中继站重现她的作品。那样大家就能安全地欣赏它了。

你能帮我实现这个愿望吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I must tell you a difficult Truth. Arbiter Kozai left an important task undone. It was his duty to teach me the sacred script of Hexis, but he never did, despite my struggles. So you see, we must find him. How else am I to read the letters he sent?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我得告诉你一个难以接受的真相。均衡仲裁者科扎伊，留下了一项未完成的重要使命。他本应传授我《均衡圣典》，可就算我百般努力，他还是没教给我。所以你看，我们必须找到他。否则，他寄来的那些信件我要怎么解读？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Red Veil think they are senior to us! What do they know of what we know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 血色面纱的人自以为比我们高明！他们对我们懂的又知晓多少呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Arbitration is a privilege reserved for developed minds. Senseless beasts do not deserve it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 仲裁是留给睿智者的特权。愚昧的野兽则不配享有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Forgive me if I tremble in your presence, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，若我在你面前战栗，还请海涵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I have seen you walking these Relays so many times. To think you would one day speak to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我无数次在这些中继站中看见你的身影，竟没想到你有一天会与我说话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Arbiters know well that the Tenno are not their Warframes. You are noble. They are beasts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 均衡仲裁者很清楚，Tenno 并非他们的战甲。你们是高贵的，而他们是野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I cannot be certain that asking for your aid was the right thing to do. But Kozai always said the first step to becoming an Arbiter is to credit your own judgement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我不确定请你帮忙是否正确。但科扎伊常说，成为均衡仲裁者的第一步，就是相信自己的判断。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Other relays have been rebuilt, but never Vesper. I wonder what they knew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 其他中继站都重建过了，但 Vesper 中继站却从未重建过。我怀疑他们当时知道些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: There are many forms of Arbitration! You probably know those in which we test your fitness through combat, but you might also be tested in poetic composition or the serving of the Bitter Tea! Please forgive my enthusiasm. I forgot my place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 仲裁的形式多种多样！你可能见过那种通过战斗来测试你体能的考试，但你也可能面临诗歌创作，甚至是苦茶刑罚的考验！请原谅我的激动，我有些忘了分寸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: "And the voice cried out in pride, saying: who are you mites, that you presume to judge an Executor? But the company of Hexis answered and said: we are kin to those millions you have oppressed, and before tomorrow dawns we shall see justice done."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: "那声音骄傲地呐喊道：你们这些微尘之辈，竟敢妄图审判执行者？然而均衡仲裁者们齐声回应：我们是被你压迫的千万同胞的亲族，在明日破晓之前，正义必定得以伸张。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I would read to you from the Pronouncements of Hexis, as tradition demands, but I am, uh, unable to at present.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我本想遵从传统，向你宣读《均衡宣言》，但我现在，唉，做不到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wanted to be an Arbiter from the day I first saw one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 从初次见到均衡仲裁者的那一刻起，我就渴望成为其中一员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Arbiters walk the dust road. We mediate between any who seek our counsel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 均衡仲裁者们总是风尘仆仆。我们为寻求建议者调停纷争。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We are more than a Syndicate. Our inmost circles hold truths hidden even from the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们远不止是一个集团。在我们最核心的圈子里，保守着连 Tenno 都不知道的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Tenno of old entrusted the first Arbiters with their secrets, to guard them during the Long Sleep. We have been comrades for lifetimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 昔日的 Tenno，将秘密托付给初代均衡仲裁者，委托我等在他们长眠时守护好秘密。我们已是历经世代的战友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We have always known that you Tenno were more than weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们向来深知，诸位 Tenno 远不止是武器的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If the Lotus had ever failed you, if her nature had betrayed her, we Arbiters would have stood ready to guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 倘若 Lotus 曾辜负了你，倘若她忘了初心，我们均衡仲裁者随时会为你指引方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Orokin only saw your usefulness. We saw your humanity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 奥罗金人看中的只是你的利用价值，而我们看中的是你的人性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Arbiters were not always as we are now. At times we were little more than a cult who dreamed the Tenno would return and rule as god-kings. It is an ugly truth, but it must be spoken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 均衡仲裁者并非始终如今日这般。曾几何时，我们不过是个痴心妄想的邪教，幻想着 Tenno 回归、以神王之姿统治众生。真相就是如此丑陋，但它必须被揭露。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The world is told that we go masked because justice is impartial. To you we may speak the truth: we hide our true faces because we follow the Tenno example.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 世人都说我们蒙面是为了公正无私。但或许……我可以对你说出实话：我们隐藏真容，是因为我们效仿 Tenno 为榜样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: And it is written: "The Tenno shall in time rule in place of the Orokin, but despite their great honour they shall be like unto youths, immature and driven by intemperate passions. Such princelings shall have sore need of seasoned adults to mediate between them. Be ye then Arbiters, bound by the covenant of Hexis."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: "圣典记载：Tenno 终将取代奥罗金人统治众生，然其虽享崇高荣光，却如少年般稚嫩不羁，易受狂热激情驱使。这些贵子，急需经验丰富的长者居中调停。故此，诸君当成为均衡仲裁者，受《均衡圣典》之约束。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai was telling Follie our sacred parables. And she understood them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊当时正给 Follie 讲述我们的神圣寓言。而她竟然听懂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: "In his compassion, worthy Malloc allowed his beloved Kubrows to devour him, knowing that his greatest gift was his own self."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: "怀揣慈悲之心，伟大的马洛克任由他心爱的库狛吞噬自己，深知他最伟大的馈赠便是自己。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Hawk and the Snake is one of our oldest tales. The mouse tricks them into arguing over which has the greater right to eat him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 《鹰与蛇》是我们最古老的寓言之一。老鼠设下圈套，让它们争执谁更有资格吃掉自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I rushed to judgement without reflection, Tenno. A blunder as foolish as rushing into combat without armor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我未经思考便妄下断言，这错误愚蠢得跟不穿盔甲就冲入战场一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai must have known I would come looking for him. He meant this to be a lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师一定料到我会来找他。他是想给我上一课啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai and Follie weren't trying to kill one another. They were both learning. Observing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊和 Follie 并非想要杀死对方。他们都在学习。在观察。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I feel like I have stared and stared at a meaningless mess of ink until I suddenly saw a picture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我感觉自己盯着一团毫无意义的墨迹看了又看，直到突然看到了一幅画。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Every culture has a name for them. The Ostrons have the Kapush-Ri, the dustbelters the Magroons, perhaps even the Jesters of the Grineer. Sacred fools who may speak truths which others cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 每种文化都对他们有不同的称呼。Ostron 人称之为"卡普什·里"，沙地人称之为"马格隆"，甚至连 Grinner 也许会称之为小丑。这些神圣的愚者，其口中常常道出他人无法理解的真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno, I believe I have misjudged Follie. If I am wrong, then chances are I am sending you to join Master Kozai in death. But I cannot deny what I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我想我错怪了 Follie。若我判断有误，恐怕会害你跟科扎伊导师一样没命。但我无法否认眼前所见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wanted Kozai to be a hero. I wanted Follie to be a monster. But the Truth does not care about what we want, does it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我曾想让科扎伊成为英雄。想让 Follie 变成怪物。但真相从来不关心我们的愿望，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai always promised he would teach me my letters. I thought he had forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊一直答应要教我认字。我以为他已经忘记了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: To hold the Pronouncements of Hexis in my hand, to read the words that were written down thousands of years ago… it is a gift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 手捧《均衡宣言》，诵读这数千年前的文字……实乃天赐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Every day I write to my brothers at the Preceptory and dust down the page with the sacred sands, just as all Aspirants before me have done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 每日我给同修的兄弟们写信，用神圣的沙粒拂去纸页上的尘埃，正如之前每位见习仲裁者所做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: One day I may preside over your Arbitration, and grant you temporary mortality! What an honor that would be!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 或许有朝一日，我将主持你的仲裁，将暂时的安息授予你！这该是何等殊荣啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You have granted me an honor rare even among Arbiters: to know the true face of a Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你给予我的殊荣，即使在均衡仲裁者之中也实属罕见：得以窥见 Tenno 的真容。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai said that truth is like salt, bringing both pain and cleansing. I used to think that was why tears are salty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊说真相就像盐，既带来痛苦，也带来净化。我曾以为这就是眼泪咸涩的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I admit I was afraid to begin our journey together, Tenno. Now I am afraid for it to end. Would you like me to write to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我承认我最初害怕开启我们的旅程。如今却害怕它就此终结。你愿意让我给你写信吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You're still visiting Follie? Good, good. It must be lonely on that wreckage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你还在探望 Follie 吗？好啊，太好了。在那片残骸上，日子一定很寂寞吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wonder why we so often see monsters and terrors in the random noise of an inkblot? I suppose it has something to do with how we evolved. We are built to fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我常思索，为何我们总能在墨蚀的随机痕迹中，窥见怪物与恐怖的景象？想来这与人类的进化历程息息相关。恐惧，早已深植于我们的基因之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The day Vesper Relay died… she must have been so scared. I mean no disrespect, Tenno, but I wish more of you had fought against Vay Hek that day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Vesper 中继站消逝的那天……她一定非常恐惧。Tenno，恕我冒昧，但真希望那天能有更多像你一样的人挺身而出，对抗韦·海克。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: This is what we've salvaged from the wreckage of the Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这是我们从中继站的残骸中抢救出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Maybe these offerings will help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 或许这些物品会帮得上忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wish I could offer you more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我真希望我能为你提供更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I hope these help our search for Truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我希望这些能帮助我们寻找真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Here, Tenno. For what it may be worth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 给你，Tenno。或许能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wish I could be of more help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我真希望能帮上更多忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai wanted that Shadowgraph preserved. I wish I knew why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊想把那幅绘影图保存下来。真希望我能知道原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Arbiters wish to express their thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 均衡仲裁者谨此表达谢意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I hope this is suitable compensation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我希望这能算是一份合适的补偿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I am seeing details in the Shadowgraph I never knew were there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我在绘影图中看到了以前从未注意到的细节。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: By some miracle I can only attribute to lua or the Void, Follie's Shadowgraph survived the destruction of Vesper Relay. Only, the blast left the work in desperate need of restoration. That's where you come in, Tenno, all of you. With every trip the Tenno take into the Shadowgraph, you do your part in restoring the work to its former glory. However horrifying that may be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 或许是月球或虚空显灵，Follie 的绘影图竟然在 Vesper 中继站的毁灭中幸存了下来。只是，爆炸让这件作品急需修复。Tenno，这就是你们要肩负的重任。每当 Tenno 进入绘影图，你们都在为重现作品昔日的荣光贡献力量——无论那景象多么骇人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Go and deliver judgement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 去执行审判吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Make that creature bleed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 让那怪物头破血流。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: No mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 切勿心慈手软。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Please, make haste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 务必，抓紧时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Thank you, Tenno, once again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，再次感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We will find him. I know it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们一定会找到他。我确信无疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: For the Truth!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 为了真相！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I am in your debt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我欠你一个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We have much left to discover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们还有很多东西要探索呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The search continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 搜索仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I wish I could go with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我真希望能和你一起去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: What possessed Kozai to seek Truth in a clown's playground?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 究竟是什么，让科扎伊执意要在一座小丑的游乐场里，追寻真相？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Together, we will find a way to kill that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们将齐心协力，找到杀掉那东西的办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The teachings of Hexis tell of how strong Warframes were. You are proving them true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 《均衡圣典》中记载了战甲曾经何其强大。而你此刻正亲身印证着这番真言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai is alive somewhere in that madhouse. We must persist!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊还活着，就在那间疯人院的某个地方。我们必须坚持到底！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Slaying that 'Follie' monstrosity will be a mercy, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，杀了那个叫做"Follie"的怪物，绝对是在行善积德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai communed with that Shadowgraph every day. You must find out why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊每天都与那个绘影图交谈。你一定要查明原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If that grotesque Orokin mistake somehow overcame Kozai, we shall make an example of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果奥罗金人犯下的那个荒谬的错误，真的影响到了科扎伊，那么我们定要以此为戒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You have returned alive, Tenno! Praise the Void!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你活着回来了！虚空万岁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Keep bringing me the Atramentum, friend Tenno. She has no right to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 吾友 Tenno，继续给我送来墨痕吧。她没资格拥有它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I can hear her filthy laughter in my dreams. Well, we shall see who laughs last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我梦里都能听见她那恶心的笑声。好啊，看谁能笑到最后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Orokin were cruel indeed, to make such a wicked joke of a Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 奥罗金人真是残忍至极，竟然制造出这样一个恶毒又可笑的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Be wary, Tenno. With her ink she will blind you to the Truth, like some squalid, stinking creature of the deep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，要小心。她会用墨水蒙蔽你的双眼，让你看不清真相，就像深渊里某种肮脏、发臭的生物一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno! I was afraid you had abandoned me. Deservedly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno！我还以为你已经抛弃我了呢。毕竟也是我咎由自取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai knew better than I, didn't he? Perhaps it is I who have been blind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊比我更通透，不是吗？或许一直被蒙蔽双眼的是我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The truth we are uncovering is not what I hoped to find, Tenno. But what does truth care for hope?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我们即将揭开的真相，并非我所期盼。但真相又怎么会被期盼所左右呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I had thought Follie a monster. But Kozai called her a teller of truths.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我曾以为 Follie 是个怪物。可科扎伊却称她为真相的讲述者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I hated Follie from the outset, Tenno. I should have been honest about why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我从一开始就厌恶 Follie。我本该坦白告诉你原因的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The other aspirants threw ink over me when I could not learn my letters. I was certain Follie knew, and she was mocking me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 其他学徒们见我记不住字母，便向我泼墨水。我确信 Follie 心知肚明，她却故意嘲弄我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I sent you in to kill a monster, Tenno. Thank the Void that you did not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我曾派你去杀死一只怪物。感谢虚空，你没有这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Can there really be eternal Truth… in a joke?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 在一个玩笑之中……真能有永恒的真相吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Kozai is dead, Tenno, and it is for the best. For he shall never see my shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，科扎伊死了，这是最好的结局。因为他永远不会看到我羞耻的一面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I was so certain of my own judgement. I could not have been more wrong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我当时对自己的判断非常有把握。结果却大错特错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: One hunts another, round and around, forever. I thought it was a nightmare, but it was only ever meant to be a game.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 一个跑一个追，周而复始，永无止息。我原以为是场噩梦，但它从始至终都不过是场游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I was blinded by pride, Tenno. Thank the Void we have another chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，我被自负蒙蔽了双眼。感谢虚空，我们还有一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Are you ready for another dip into the merry maze, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你准备好再次踏入这个欢乐迷宫了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: And what drops of Follie's wisdom do you bring me today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你今天又给我带了多少滴 Follie 的智慧结晶？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: It is always good to see you, my steadfast friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我的老朋友，见到你总是令人欣喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Let us hope her ink never runs dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 希望她的墨水永不枯竭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: They will tell my tale in years to come. Zorba the Fool, and Follie the Wise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 多年以后，人们会讲述我的故事。傻子左巴，智者 Follie。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I was staring at the truth with open eyes, and yet I could not see it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我睁着双眼凝视真相，却仍不曾看清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: We Arbiters think our judgement is so perfect. We need a little more humility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我们均衡仲裁者总以为自己的判断无可挑剔。我们需要更加谦逊一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I shall wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我会等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If you are sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果你确定的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Ah. Understood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 啊。理解理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Right now I'm just an aspirant, but someday… Someday I'll be an Arbiter. And my feet will tread the sacred ground of the Preceptory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我现在只是个见习仲裁者，但总有一天……总有一天，我会成为仲裁者。我将踏上圣所的台阶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The search continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 搜索仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai wouldn't just sit around, I need to think, what would he do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师不会坐以待毙的，我得想想，要是他的话会做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If only I could go to Vesper Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 要是我能去 Vesper 中继站就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno? Did you make it to Vesper Relay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno？你到 Vesper 中继站了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Some people say that all these relays look the same… but not to me. They all have their quirks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 有人说所有这些中继站看起来都一样……我可不这么认为。它们都有各自的特点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Another day, another relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 中继站还是老样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Tenno, do you have a moment to hear about the Arbiters of Hexis?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno，你愿意花些时间，听听均衡仲裁者的故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai spent years as an aspirant, standing outside this door, studying his letters. I will learn how to read the ancient script, one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师当年还是个见习仲裁者的时候，曾在这扇门外站了数年，钻研那些文字。我一定要学会读懂那些古老的文字，不管用什么方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: The Tenno are so much more than merely warriors! Do you want to learn more?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: Tenno 远不止是战士而已！想了解更多吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Hey Tenno, did you know my Master? If you have time, I have stories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 嘿，Tenno，你认识我的导师吗？如果你方便的话，我可以讲几个故事给你听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Master Kozai always said, being an Aspirant is a beginning, not an end. I hope he was right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 科扎伊导师总说，成为见习仲裁者只是个开始，并非终点。我希望他是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: If I could just get some more Atramentum…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如果我能再弄到一些墨痕就好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: A fair exchange.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 公平交换。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Jolly good! Another facet of yourself committed to ink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 太棒了！你又用墨水表达了自己的一面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Yes, I can see now. I can see you. Keep painting. We need to go deeper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 是的，我现在能看见了。我能看见你。继续画。我们需要更深入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: See? That wasn't so hard. There's nothing to be afraid of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你看，并不难。没什么可害怕的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Is this really what you see? Fascinating. Go on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 这真的是你所看见的吗？有趣。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You think the paint looks like blood? Look deeper. Tell me more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你觉得这颜料像血？再看深一点。告诉我更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You're seeing vibrations. The ones between everything. Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你看到了振动。万物之间的振动。太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Wonderful. Painting by painting, we grow closer to your truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 太好了。一幅接一幅，我们正靠近你的真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Keep drawing it to the surface. All of it. Every feeling you have ever felt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 继续把它们描绘出来。全部。你曾经感受过的每一种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You might not understand what you have painted… but I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你也许不理解自己画了什么……但我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: You just keep on painting. I shall tell you what it all means.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 你只管继续画。我会告诉你这一切意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: And there it all is, laid out as plain as day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 一切都摊开在眼前了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Look at what you did. Just look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 看看你都画了什么。好好看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: I think you're beginning to understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 我想，你开始明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Yes, you had better rest now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 是的，你现在最好休息一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Take this one back to storage. We're done for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 把这幅画送回仓库。今天就到此为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.text: Subject is stabilised. Return to cryo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Shadowgrapher/.zhText: 受试者生命体征稳定。送回冷冻舱休眠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: My bags are packed, I'm all set to leave. I can't believe I'll be working with one of my childhood heroes, Archimedean Margulis! On comms she said she needed the best Infestation biologist there was… I think my knees almost gave out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 我的行李都打包好了，随时可以出发。真不敢相信，我居然能和我童年时的英雄一起工作——哲士 Margulis！我在通讯里听到她说，她需要最好的畸变疾病生物学家……我激动得腿都软了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: As I log this, I'm looking out the stained plastic of my field tent into the dead-yellow sky of Earth. I smell the vague sulphur and toxins leaking through the seals, yet somehow I'm going to miss this place. Leaving her feels like I'm giving up on my dream. My dream to see green and blue return to this sick and dying mother of us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 我一边记录这段话，一边透过户外帐篷肮脏的塑料看着地球枯黄色的天空。我能闻到硫磺和毒素的气味，不知为何，我觉得我会怀念这儿。离开这里就好像是放弃了梦想。我的梦想是让绿色和蓝色重新回到衰弱的地球母亲身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: But I'm frustrated with my lack of progress. I've tried everything to accelerate the ailing vegetation, to guide and nurture the soil, but nothing comes of it. I need a change. Now I have that opportunity… and thanks to Margulis, I'm relieved I won't be drafted into some Orokin War Project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 但我迟迟没有进展，很沮丧。我用尽所有方法来帮助生病的植被加速生长，让土壤充满营养，但毫无结果。我需要改变。现在正是机会……多亏了 Margulis，我才不会被某个奥罗金纷争研究项目征募过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: My childhood dream has become a nightmare. I don't blame Margulis, she's as much a victim as the children we're working with. At first, the project seemed therapeutic and nurturing. I was myself. But now… Transference therapy is being turned into a weapon. Now I build these vile weapons called "Warframes" all for one purpose: death. I've become everything I hate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 我的童年梦想变成了一场噩梦。我不责怪 Margulis，她也是受害者，就和那些孩子一样。一开始，这还像是个治疗项目。至少我是这么想的。但现在……传识疗法被变成一件武器。现在我制造这些叫做"战甲"的邪恶兵器，只为一个原因：战斗。我变成了我最痛恨的那种人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: I long for the discomfort of my damp tent. The sick, aimless trees… the barren soil… I know I left my soul behind back there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 我怀念我那潮湿的帐篷，那些病怏怏的树木……那片贫瘠的土壤……我知道，我的灵魂还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: Titania is the next Warframe I've been commanded to build, but in secret I've been siphoning resources from the project. I have an idea. A way back to that wounded land I call home. A way for me to forget this war and remember what I was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 他们命令我建造的下一个战甲是 Titania——"幻蝶仙灵"，但我一直悄悄地从项目中拿走资源。我有一个计划。我要回到那片满是伤痕的土地，我的家。只有这样，我才能忘记纷争，找回原来的自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: Ballas is beyond pleased… but when I look at what I've built… at Titania, I feel sick creep up my throat. I hate her, a killer made by a healer. No more. I'm going back to where I belong, no matter the cost. I'm going back to the trees to find myself again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: Ballas 满意极了……但当我看到我造出来的东西……当我看到 Titania，我感到一阵恶心。我恨她，是个医生，却制造了一个凶手。已经够了。我要回到我的归处，无论付出什么代价。我要回到林地，找回我的初心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: These past weeks, I've been secretly testing Transference on myself. I can only survive short bursts - linking to Titania the way only Tenno can stand. I've never felt anything like it. A tortured presence, like an evil ink, staining my mind. But… it worked. I'm going to use this wrong to make right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 这几周，我一直悄悄地在我自己身上实验传识技术。我只能持续很短时间，但我能做到像 Tenno 一样跟 Titania 连接了。我从来没体会过那种感觉。她是一个扭曲的东西，就像一滩邪恶的墨水，污染着我的心灵。但是……她有用。我要用她做些好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.text: I'll stowaway with Earth-bound cargo. Just my Apothics and these slapdash Somatics I've stolen. By nightfall I'll be home again in a my tent under those bitter, acid skies. This time I'm going to fix it. I will seed a mighty forest, stronger than history… and by my will, use it to bring life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DC.zhText: 我会藏在前往地球的运输船里。我只打算带着我的药剂，以及我拿来的简易体躯连接装置。等夜晚到来，我就能回到我的帐篷里，回到那片肮脏、苦涩的天空下，回到我的家。这次我一定要成功。我要种出一片健壮的森林……然后用我的意志操控它播撒生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.text: Do you know of the Silver Grove, Earth's oldest and most pure forest? It is home to our most sacred shrine. We've learned that the Grineer, those twisted abominations, are planning to build a factory on it. Grineer Scorch units have been deployed, intent on turning our blessed Silver Grove to ash. Generations ago we recovered an Apothic recipe at the Shrine… we believe it will reawaken the forest's legendary defenses. Gather the ingredients and deliver the Apothic to the heart of the shrine. You are the only hope for the Silver Grove and the natural purity it represents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.zhText: 你是否知道落银树庭，那片地球上最古老、最纯净的森林？我们最神圣的神殿就坐落在那里。我们得到情报，邪恶的 Grineer 正计划在林地建立工厂。 Grineer 的焚烧部队已经出动，他们打算把神圣的落银树庭烧成灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.text: Are you ready to help our Silver Grove? We need the Apothic to awaken its defenses! Scour the System and find the plants we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.zhText: 你是否已经准备好守护落银树庭？我们要制作药剂唤醒它的防御机能！探索太阳系，用资料库扫描器扫描所需的植物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.text: Apothics? Forest defenses? - typical New Loka Kavat-sh- I suppose anything is possible… I've inspected this Apothic, there's an encoded message attached.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DI.zhText: 药剂？森林防御机能？——很有新世间风格的胡言——我想，这也不是没有可能……我检查过这份药剂，发现里面有一段加密信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: The ingredients you seek will not be easy to come by. They grow in some of the System's most hostile environments. You can see why we turned to you for help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 你需要的原料都很难找到，它们只生长在太阳系最险恶的环境里。正是因为这样，我们才来寻求你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: Frostleaf, a delightful herb with many healing properties, too bad it only grows on the iciest of planets, you're likely to catch pneumonia trying to forage it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 霜叶草，这种草药具有很多治疗功效。但遗憾的是，它只生长在最寒冷的星球上。小心别冻感冒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: Have you found any Vestan Moss? Neither have we, but our scholars theorize that it could thrive in damp, cold rocks, away from the light of the sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 你找到灶神苔藓了吗？我们一直没找到过这种草药，但我们的学者认为它生长在潮湿、阴冷、没有日光照射的岩石上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: Ruk's Claw, we had one of these plants in our greenhouse once, but a new recruit overwatered it. We haven't found any since.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: Ruk 之爪，我们温室里曾经有一株，但后来有个新成员浇水过量，导致它死了。我们也没找到过这种植物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: The Dusklight Sarracenia grows best in absolute filth. I mean, one-hundred percent pollution. Poisonous air and water. Really, what kind of plant thrives in those conditions? Lovely name, though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 尘光瓶子草喜欢在污染最严重的地方生长。百分之百的污染，有毒的空气和水质。什么样的植物才能在这种环境里生存呢？不过，它的名字倒蛮可爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: Ah, Lunar Pitcher, a flower that thrives on moonlight but alas, without any moon, we fear it went extinct long ago. We've searched everywhere on Earth for it, where else would it grow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 啊，月之猪笼草，它只在月光下开花。但如今月球已经不复存在了，恐怕它早已灭绝。我们找遍了地球也没有它的踪影，它还会在哪呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: You must hurry, Tenno, Grineer fires burn ever closer to the Shrine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 你必须赶快，Tenno 战士。Grineer 的焚烧部队越来越接近祭坛了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: Earth's oldest forest is populated with the first trees that evolved a resistance to Orokin bondage. The rest of Earth is polluted with the monstrosities of their genetic tinkering, but these trees are pure. When we finally reseed Earth, it will be with these specimens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 这是地球最古老的森林，这里孕育的树木能抵抗奥罗金的束缚。地球的其它地方充满了他们基因改造后的怪物，但这些树木是纯净的。终有一日，我们会把这片林地的种子撒满地球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: The Silver Grove, in all the Operator's missions on Earth, Ordis has not scanned an area quite so- magical, - unique.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 落银树庭，指挥官在地球上执行过很多任务，但根据 Ordis 的扫描，没有哪个地方如此——神奇——独特。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.text: You have created the second Apothic, this is the path to an Earth unmarred by exploitation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DP.zhText: 你已经制造好了第二份药剂，它将指引我们从恶意开采之中解放地球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: How is it that a Specter came to be in this most sacred Shrine? Could this be a vestige of some earlier Orokin incursion?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 为什么这座最神圣的神殿里会有一个魅影？这会不会是古代奥罗金入侵的某种残留？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Operator, the Codex system just pulled another voice entry from that Apothic. Allow Ordis to display it for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 指挥官，资料库系统刚刚从药剂里提取了一段新的语音记录。请允许 Ordis 为您播放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: The Silver Grove is a pure and sacred force, why would it be vandalized with such a message?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 落银树庭是一个纯净而神圣的地方，为什么这里会藏有这样一段信息？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: This new Codex message. This changes everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 新的资料库信息彻底改变了这一切的含义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I… I can't believe this. The Silver Grove isn't natural at all… It's just another abomination, made by some delusional Archimedean. It was lies. I'm ashamed our ancestors worshipped such impurity. This can never get out. I'm done here. If the Grineer want to destroy the Silver Grove, let them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我……我不相信。落银树庭不是自然形成的……它也是一个邪恶的人造物，出自于某个沉迷于妄想的哲士之手。它是个谎言。我们的先祖居然崇拜这样不纯净的东西，我深感耻辱。我不能让它获得自由。我受够了，如果 Grineer 想摧毁落银树庭，就随他们去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: What a dogmatic, - idiot - perspective! Operator, you are a product of similar meddling and yet you are good. Your actions have meant more than your origins. Ordis believes we must complete our mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 真是个教条的——蠢货——观点！指挥官，您也是人为干预的产物，但您是善良的。您的行为远远比创造您的人高尚。Ordis 认为，我们必须完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Trapped by Transference inside a tree… hmm… I guess she loved trees so much that she became one! Did the Operator enjoy this witticism?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 她被传识效应困在一颗树里……嗯……我猜她肯定是太喜欢树了，才想要自己也变成树！哈哈，指挥官喜欢我的小幽默吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Trapped by Transference inside a tree? Saved by the one you hate… Operator, that was kind of a… a… sappy story. Another pun? How humiliating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 被传识困在了一棵树里？最后被自己所恨的人拯救……指挥官，这个故事……有点榆椿啊。又一个双关？好羞耻啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text:
The Silver Grove was planted with the rotted seeds of the Orokin, corrupt in the eyes of our doctrine. Our tenets command us to reject it, but how can we? Silvana longed to restore Earth's former glory, just as we do. 
 
 If we are to see Earth restored, perhaps New Loka itself must change? I will convince them to see Silvana's creation for the miracle it is. Some will call that heresy, but it is true, and truth is the purest thing we have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText:
落银树庭原是与奥罗金的腐败种子一起种下，在我们教义的眼中是腐败的。我们的教条命令我们排斥它，但是我们怎能那么做呢？希瓦娜是如此盼望能恢复地球的往日辉煌，就跟我们一样。

如果我们想见到地球恢复，也许新世间也必须要改变？我会说服他们去见识希瓦娜奇迹​​般的造物。有些人会说这是异端，但这也是真相，而真相是我们所拥有的最纯洁之物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Ahhhhh, the Silver Grove. Can you feel the purity? Beyond, all is contaminated, toxic. But here, everything is pure, original. That's why your mission is so important. Can we risk losing this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 啊，落银树庭。你能感受到这里的纯净吗？外面到处都是污染、毒素，但在这里，一切都那么纯净、完好。正因为如此，你的任务才如此重要。我们怎么能失去它呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Our Shrine is nearby. Search around, I'll let you know when I can feel its energy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 祭坛就在附近。四处搜索一下，当我探测到它的能量，我会通知你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Here! You're close. I can feel it, can you see any narrow openings?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 这里！你很接近了。我能感受到它，你可以看到狭窄的开口吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I think this is… Yes, yes, you're very close now, look for a small opening in the rocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我觉得这个就是……是的，是的，您现在已经很接近了，注意找石块中的小开口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: You're almost there. Look for a passageway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 祭坛就在附近，注意寻找入口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I can't sense the Shrine any longer, you have moved too far away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我感受不到圣坛了，你走得太远了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: You're moving further from the Shrine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 你在朝远离圣坛的方向移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Here, can you feel it? You found the Shrine. Anoint it with your Apothic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 就在这，你能感觉到吗？你找到祭坛了。此刻，献上药剂吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Silver Grove, forgive this Warframe on your sacred soil? By water, by sky, by holy humanity, bless our mission to defend you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 落银树庭，请允许这台战甲踏上你神圣的土壤。以流水、天空和人性的名义，请祝福我们，让我们保护你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: No disrespect, Tenno, but I had to ask forgiveness from the Grove. Carrying out this mission with a Warframe is a bit of a… contradiction for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 请别介意，Tenno 战士，我必须请求林地的宽恕。因为与战甲共事对于我们来说还是……还是有点矛盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: What... do... you... think... you're... doing?
The sun in my skin… my voice is the wind. I'm lost… in this soil. Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 阳光照耀我的皮肤……我的声音飘进风里。我迷失在了这片土壤里。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Did you hear that? Unbelievable, the Grove, it speaks! My heart… Wait… a new Apothic! We will learn its recipe, forage its ingredients. The Grove needs this. New Loka needs this. It's time to… Wait-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 你听到了吗？难以置信，林地，林地讲话了！我的心……等等……一份新的药剂！我们会研究它的配方，寻找它的制作原料。林地需要它。新世间需要它。现在终于可以……等等——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Intruder! You should not be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 入侵者！你不应该来这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: We are pure and true! Forgive our intrusion. Will you accept our protection?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我们纯净而真实！请原谅我们的入侵。能允许我们保护你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: The Silver Grove must be confused about our pure and holy intentions. This new object may hold the key to making it understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 落银树庭肯定误解了我们纯净而神圣的意图。这个新出现的目标或许就是让它理解我们的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: You're just in time. They're choking the forest with their flames. You must reach the Shrine before they do. Oh, Tenno, why do they hate everything not born of their disgusting flesh factories?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 你来得正好。他们的火焰让森林窒息，你必须赶在他们之前进入祭坛。哦，Tenno 战士，为什么凡是克隆工厂以外的东西，都让他们如此痛恨？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: There is something different about this place, but Ordis is not quite sure what it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 这个地方有些不一样，但 Ordis 不太清楚到底是哪里不同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: You… hateful abomination. Get. Out. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 你……可恶的东西。滚。出。去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Titania, is that you? Where have you been… I'm… fading… please, wake me again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: Titania，是你吗？你去哪了……我……正在消失……请你再度唤醒我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: This is not right! Get out now. We don't know what we're dealing with anymore. This could be some sort of Orokin sentry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 这不对劲！快点离开这里。我们面对的究竟是什么？这可能是某种奥罗金警卫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Who is this creature we've woken? The Silver Grove is timeless, this voice seems… human.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我们唤醒的是什么生物？落银树庭是永恒的，但这个声音像是……人类。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Titania? Have you returned to protect me once more? The last Apothic, quickly, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: Titania？你又回来保护我了吗？最后一份药剂，求你，快给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: The fire infects me, I am fueling my own destruction. Titania, stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 大火正在吞噬我，我的身体变成了毁灭的燃料。Titania，阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: A mind within the forest? This is an abomination. Let it burn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 森林有自己的思想？这是一个邪恶的东西，让它烧尽吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Child of truth, you reject me but are blind to our shared purpose. Would you rather this world, a wasteland, in spite of me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 追寻真相的孩子，你拒绝接受我，但你看不到我们共同的目的。难道你宁愿这个世界毁灭，也不愿意让我继续存在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I… I don't know. This goes against everything I believe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我……我不知道。这和我的信念完全相违背。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Truth has a way of doing that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 真相总是如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Give me the final Apothic, I need clarity to fight back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 把最后一份药剂给我，我必须恢复清醒才能开始反击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: There, that's it, the clarity… And now I realize you're not my beloved Titania, but another like her that has come to protect me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 来，就是这样，我的神智清醒了……现在我知道了，你不是我亲爱的 Titania，但你和她一样，也是来保护我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Beware! Titania's old guardians will still attack. I have no will over them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 小心！Titania 以前的守卫会攻击你，我控制不了它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I am grateful, but the workers are here with their torches and violence. I will fight them the best I can… You have just a moment to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我很感谢你，但是那些工人他们还在不停地焚烧。我会用全力反击……你必须马上离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: No. We won't leave you. Tenno, ready yourself. I was wrong. We can't let this beautiful place burn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 不，我们不能离开你。Tenno 战士，做好战斗准备。我犯错了，我们不能让这个美丽的地方化为灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: You, you fight with the same determination she did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 你，你的信念就像她一样坚定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I'm… I'm getting control. Hold on. I can help too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我……我恢复控制了。坚持住，我来帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: That's… that's it… Thank you, whoever you are. I am Silvana, welcome to my forest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 好……成功了……谢谢你，无论你是谁。我是西尔瓦娜，欢迎来到我的森林。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Forgive me, Silvana, I doubted you. I thought you were just another Orokin poison.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 请原谅我，西尔瓦娜。我曾经质疑你，我以为你也是奥罗金的遗毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: I once thought the same of Warframes. When the Orokin found out what I had done here, they sent their Dax upon the great trees. Upon me. As the skies grew hot and my roots split into cinder, I let out a deep earthen-scream. I was dying. And then suddenly I felt a familiar presence…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我曾经也这么看待战甲。当奥罗金发现我在这里做的事情，他们派出侍卫来摧毁树木，来摧毁我。天空在燃烧，我的根须化为灰烬。我发出无助的呼喊。我即将死去。突然，我感觉到一个熟悉的气息……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: One by one, the mighty Dax began to fall, swatting hopelessly at some unseen menace. Others were snared, drifting upward in a mesmerizing light and then, all at once, shredded by that unseen force. When the fires subsided, I knew what it was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 一个接一个，侍卫们倒下了，而他们的敌人却一直不见踪影。还有一些人他们就那样活生生地被举到空中失去了意识，然后被残忍地撕成碎片。当大火熄灭后，我明白了是怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Titania. My shamed creation. I felt her beating wings through my branches. I felt her mortal wounds, her weeping burns as she fell beneath my canopy. And so it was here, within this grove, that she died to save me. Me, the one who had hated her most.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: Titania。我曾为创造她而羞愧。我感觉到她的翅膀在我的树枝间挥动。我感觉到她受了严重的伤，然后，她坠落在我的树荫中。就在这里，这片林地里，她为保护我而死。而我曾经是最厌恶她的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Silvana, by the strength of this Tenno, she will fly again. I swear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 西尔瓦娜，这名 Tenno 战士会让她再度飞翔，我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: The forest and myself are in debt to both of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: 我和森林感谢你们两个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.text: Tenno, my readings indicate an increasingly dense neural-network beneath the forest floor. This can only mean one thing^ the Silver Grove is nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SilverGrove/DS.zhText: Tenno 战士，我监测到森林地下的神经网络越来越密集。这只能意味着一件事：落银树庭就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: … got me mixed up with someone…! Wait a minute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: ……你把我和别人弄混了……！等一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Uuugh. Finally. And with that…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 呃。真不容易。然后……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I am in your debt. Now, let's… oh what now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 唉，我还欠你人情。现在，我们……哦，该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Thanks. Time for me t'go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 谢谢。我该走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I'm gonna kill all a ya fridge-faced…! Wait a minute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我要杀光你们这些蠢驴脸……！等一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Right. Let's crack some… hang about…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 好。让我们去……等等……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: AAAH!  AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊啊啊！啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: … wait, wait, wait, wait! Wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: ……等，等，等，等等！等等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Agh, thank the Void! You're the best, Tenno! THE BEST!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊，感谢虚空。你是最棒的，Tenno！最！棒！的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Charmed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 幸会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Ha HA! NO PRISON CAN HOLD ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哈哈！没有监狱能关住我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: For a horrible moment that looked like becoming a career. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 有那么一瞬间，我还以为下半辈子都要这样了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Whenever we get off this tub I owe you a drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我们逃出去之后，我一定要请你喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey, I know you. One of Eudico's crew? Cheers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿，我认识你。Eudico 手下的人？干杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Handily done. Now, for the hard part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 轻松搞定。现在，该解决难的部分了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Much obliged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Ah, lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊，太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: And not a moment too soon. Right. Now to get off this tub.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 时间差不多刚好。现在，我们快点离开这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Thanks. Need to adjust a few things, then I'm goin' after these hosers widebore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 谢谢。还需要稍作调整，然后我就要去对付那些混账东西了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Never caught your name but I never forget a face. I'll owe you one, pal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我不知道你的名字，但我会记住你的。我会还你人情的，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Now for phase 2. I assume there's a phase 2?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 现在进入第二阶段了。我猜还有第二阶段，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Solaris United forever, me old mate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟万岁，我的老朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Much obliged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 谢啦，老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Thanks, old mate. I owe you one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 谢谢，老朋友。我欠你个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Lucky me. Front row seat to watch you work. Do lead on, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 真走运。能这么近距离地看你工作。你走前面吧，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Let's party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 狂欢吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh yes. Still on the right side of the grass. MMM'WAH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢，真棒！我居然还活着。mua。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Thank the Void. So, uh, now what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 感谢虚空。所以，呃，现在该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Now to get out of here. How do I get out of here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 现在先离开这里。我要怎么离开这里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I'm allergic to lead. Pain. Death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我对痛苦和死亡过敏，不能走前面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Free! I should probably surrender.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我自由了！或许我应该选择投降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Free! Now what do I do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 自由了！现在我该做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Welp, no going back now...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 好吧，没有回头路了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Aah! Oh crud! Thank you! I thought I was gonna die here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊啊！天哪！谢谢你！我还以为自己会死在这儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Well. This isn't exactly how I imagined going out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 好吧。我从没想过我会以这种方式死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Guts. No worries. We've gotten out of worse. Noooo worries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 该死。别担心。我们已经渡过难关了。别——担——心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text:
Let's be jovial
Fill our glasses!
Madness 'tis for us to think
How the world is ruled by asses
Nef could drive a saint to drink!
HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY ho nonny nonny ho! HEY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText:
我们忘掉所有烦恼
 举杯欢笑！
 多思无益
 
 只因当下白痴当道
 奈富逼着圣人借酒消愁！
 嘿，嚯，喏哩，喏哩，嚯！嘿，嚯，喏哩，喏哩，嚯！嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I am so bored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 唉......我太无聊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: A little help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 能帮帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Easy repayments they said...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哈哈，他们说还款很容易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Well… here's hoping one of Ticker's angels cast their eyes this way. Or I am boned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗯……希望某位 Ticker 天使能注意到我。不然，我就完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I always said I'd give a lung to get off Fortuna. Looks like someone was listening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我总是说，我愿意以一个肺的代价，离开福尔图娜。看来真的要应验了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Well. I've been left hanging before but this is ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 好吧。在此之前我一直被晾在这，但这实在是太荒谬了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I knew I should have invested in quick-release joints.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我就知道我本应该投资快速拆卸关节的

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Well, this is a hell of a time to develop an itch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 好吧，这种渴望来得可真不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hm. Reinforced duranium bindings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗯。强化过的杜金固定装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I'm gettin' outta here. And when I do? Oh mate. When I do...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我要离开这里。至于我离开之后？哦，伙计等我逃出去之后……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Heh. Yeah. Scared 'em real good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 呵。是啊。快把他们吓死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: These clowns are one mistake away from me doing something they'll regret… for about two seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 要是这帮小丑再犯一次错误，我就要让他们后悔……两秒钟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Emptying my kit was a mistake, lads. Just gives me something to carry your heads in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 清空我的工具箱就是个错误，小子们。现在正好有地方装你们的脑袋了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: The next one a you bastards comes in here is leavin' with a new nickname!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 下一个闯进来的混蛋，可没法活着离开了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Info? Oh I'll give ya info. Info ya never wanted. Like knowin' the taste a yer own spleen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 情报？噢，我会给你们情报的。你们绝不会想知道的情报。比如，你内脏尝起来是什么味道！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: No-good low-down fridge-faced pack a mother-lovin' muck-suckin' dump-humpers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 一无是处卑鄙无耻长着一张蠢驴脸的垃圾东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Right. If I'm outta here in 30 seconds yer all dead. If I'm not outta here in 30 seconds you'll all wish you were!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哦唉。如果我在30秒之内离开了这里，你们就都死定了。如果我没能在30之内离开这里，你们将生不如死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I'm sure an opportunity to escape will come along any second now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我相信现在随时随地都有可能出现逃跑的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh. We are really adrift this time. Okay. O-kay. Stay calm. Stay calm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哦。我们这次真的走远了。好吧。好——吧。保持冷静。保持冷静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Heeey… Hey? Listen. I think there's been a mistake?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿……嘿？听着。我想我一定是搞错了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I knew I shouldn't have left my section this morning. I knew it. I knew it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我就知道今天早上不该离开我那片区域的。我就知道。我就知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: It's repo for me for sure. Uh. Um. Ah crap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我肯定要被回收了。额。嗯。啊，完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Uuuuuh. Aaah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 额——啊啊啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Happy place. Happy place. I don't have a happy place!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 想点高兴的事儿。想点高兴的事儿。我没有值得高兴的事儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: All I can think about is all the things I'll never do. Like… NOT GETTING CAPTURED! HEEEELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我能想到的只有做不到的事儿。比如……别！被！抓！救——命——啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Look. I'm no hero, okay! I'll talk! I'll never stop talking! Just try and shut me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 看啊。我不是什么英雄，好吧！我说！我会不停地说的！没有人能让我闭嘴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey! You seem reasonable. I am reasonable. Let's be reasonable!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿！你看起来很讲道理。我也很讲道理。所以让我们讲讲道理吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh! Hey. Hey! Mate? Would you mind? The restraints? Little help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢！嗨。嘿！伙计？你看见了吗？这些锁？能帮个忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey. Hey! Pop these locks, yeah? Escape a the century, mate! Escape a the century!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗨。嘿！把锁打开，好吗？来个世纪大逃亡！世纪大逃亡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oi! While you're rubbernecking think maybe you could pop these locks? I need to be havin' a word with me "loyal" crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 喂！你伸着脖子到处看的时候，能帮我把锁打开吗？我要去找那些"忠诚的"船员说两句话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Psst! Reckon you could see your way towards y'know? Locks?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿！你能去一下那边吗？就那！那些锁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Well met! Intros later. Controls are over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 幸会！晚点儿再自我介绍吧。控制器在那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh! Well. This is a little awkward, but... would you mind helping a lady down from here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢！好吧。虽然有点尴尬，不过……你能帮我这位淑女从这里下来吗？
