/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh. Hello. Move along, nothing to see here. Ha! I'm kidding, of course. Get me the hell down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哦。你好。走吧，没什么可看的。哈！我在开玩笑呢。快让我下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Ah! About time! So what are you? Ticker, Solaris U, my crew hired you or am I just a lucky, lucky girl?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊！正是时候！所以是谁派你来的？Ticker、索拉里斯联盟？还是我的船员？或者说，这次是本姑娘走运？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh at last! I feel like I was born in this thing. The controls are over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢，终于来人了！我感觉快死在这东西里面了。控制器就在那儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: What? Who are you? Clearly not Corpus. Good enough for me. Get me the hell off this thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 什么？你是谁？肯定不是 Corpus。那就行。快帮我把这玩意儿解开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey, old mate. Let a cove down, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿，老朋友。放个人下来，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Tenno. 'Bout time. Let's wreck the joint. You an' me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: Tenno 战士。正是时候。我们来把这个地方砸烂吧。咱们一起！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Nice. Switch is over there. Let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 漂亮。开关在那边。大战一场吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: You're a sight for dodgy optics. Pop that lock and let's take some heads.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 见到你可真好。把锁打开，我们去砍掉几个脑袋吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey. Howsabout you pop these locks and let a brother stretch his… fists?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗨。不如你把这些锁打开，让兄弟我活动活动自己的……拳头？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Ha! Ah yeah. Here we go. Control's over there, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 哈！啊，真棒。这就对了。控制器就在那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oi. Pop these locks sharpish, chek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 喂！马上把这些锁打开，行不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: I never take charity but if Ticker sent ya… I'll make an exception this once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 我不会白白接受你的恩情，但如果是 Ticker 派你来的……我就破例一次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hm. Nice ta meet a fellow soldier. Control's over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗯。很高兴能见到另一名战士。控制器就在那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oi! Tenno. Here on business or pleasure? Pop these locks wouldja?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 喂！Tenno 战士。你是来这里干正事的还是来消遣的？把这些锁打开，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey. HEY! Ya gotta let me down so I can clear this up, chekchek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嗨。嘿！你得先让我下来，我才能给你解释清楚，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Don't hurt me! Oh, wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 不要伤害我！哦，等等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Ah! I can explain everything! Wait, you're not Corpus. Did Ticker send you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 啊！我可以把一切都解释清楚！等等，你不是 Corpus。是 Ticker 派你来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey, I'll do whatever you want, okay? Just flick that switch over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿，不管你说什么，我都照做，行不？只要把那边的开关拨动一下就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey! Listen. They're gonna do somethin' REAL bad to me. You gotta get me outta here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿！听着。他们会在我身上做一些非常不好的事。你必须帮我离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey! HEY! Pleasepleaseplease just get me down from here, okay? They could be back at any moment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿！嘿！求求你了，把我从这里放下来，行吗？他们随时都会回来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Hey! Friend? Me old cove? Let a fella down, would you? Switch over there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 嘿！朋友？我的老伙计？把我放下来，行不行？开关在那边？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh! OH! A Tenno. Oh I'm glad to see you! You gotta get me down from here, me ol' mucker! You gotta get me down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢！噢！一位 Tenno 战士。哦，看到你真是太高兴了！你一定要把我放下来，我的老朋友！你一定要把我放下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Tenno? TENNO?! Oh yes! YES! Help me. Helpmehelpmehelpmehelpme! Help me. HELP ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: Tenno 战士？Tenno 战士？！噢，太好了！太好了！帮帮我。帮帮我帮帮我帮帮我帮帮我！帮帮我。帮帮我啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.text: Oh! Oh thank the Void! Thank the Voooooid…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisDeadloc.zhText: 噢！哦，感谢虚空！感谢虚——空……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Welcome aboard, Operator! --Operators?! This is a Sigma Series RailJack… a multi-crew Interceptor! Engineering, Tactical, Weapon systems all await your command.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 欢迎登舰，指挥官！指挥官……们？！这是一艘西格玛系列航道星舰……可供多人协同操作的拦截舰！工程、战术与武器系统，全部听候您的调遣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: I have locked on to an Obelisk in Orbit… high above the Vallis… Awaiting launch sequence. Are you ready for this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 我锁定了山谷高空轨道中的一艘天碑战舰……发射程序随时启动。您准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: There are many emergency exits aboard this spacecraft, Operator! Please take note of the one nearest you. In the unlikely event of a violent decompression, safety lights will illuminate in the floor to guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 本舰设有多处紧急出口，指挥官！请记住离您最近的那一个。万一——当然，发生的概率微乎其微——出现剧烈失压，地板上的安全指示灯会亮起，为您指明逃生路线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Rough air ahead, we're in for some chop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 前方气流紊乱，要颠簸一阵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Ascent complete, Operator, you have the helm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 升空完成，指挥官。现在由您掌舵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Enemy Capital in this sector. Be advised: They have alerted the fleet. Reinforcements are inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 本星区发现敌方主力舰。请注意，他们已经向舰队发出警报，增援正在赶来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Hull damage! Get them off us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 舰体受损！快把他们赶走！
舰体破裂！维生装置逐步失效！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Operator, fleet reinforcements converging on this sector. We must complete the mission before they arrive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 指挥官，敌方增援舰队正在向本星区集结。我们必须赶在他们抵达前完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Fleet reinforcements are imminent! T-minus 2 minutes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 敌方舰队增援即将抵达！倒计时 2 分钟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: 1 minute until reinforcements arrive. We need to get out of here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 增援还有 1 分钟抵达。我们得马上离开这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Shield coil located, you will need to infiltrate and disable it from within.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 找到护盾线圈了。您得潜入舰内，从内部关闭它。
就是现在，指挥官！千万别打偏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: My interceptors will take good care of you Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 我的拦截机会好好招待你们，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: They're onboard??? In the name of profit, cast them to oblivion!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 他们登舰了？？？以利润之名，把他们打入虚空！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.text: Ready my emergency skiff. The Void still has plans for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/SolarisVenus/D.zhText: 准备我的应急艇。虚空对我……另有安排。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: This Sacred Rail must be protected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 必须守护这条神圣的航道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Leave this place or be returned to the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 离开此地，否则便送你回归虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: I am a Warden of the Solar Rails. I am your death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 我就是星际航道的守护者，也是你的死神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Only the sacred may pass. Heathens will perish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 唯有神圣者才能通行。异端必将覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: How dare you enter my home? I guard the Rail with my shadow-life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 胆敢擅闯我的领地？我以暗影之命守护航道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: The Solar Rails bind our System. I will not see it undone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 星际航道维系着整个星系。我绝不容许它被毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Are you seeking a return to the Void? Challenge me and find destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 你想回归虚空吗？来挑战我吧，我会让你自取灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: I am entrusted to protect this most sacred temple. A pathway into the Void. Flee or be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 我受命镇守这座至圣殿堂——这条通往虚空的航道。逃吧，否则就被吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: I have pledged my shadow-life to defend the Solar Rails.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 我立誓献上暗影之命，只为了捍卫星际航道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: I will purge your weakness from my Rail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 我必将把你这弱者从航道中清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Another intruder… another corpse for the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 又一个入侵者……又一具献给虚空的尸体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Only those worthy may enter. You face certain death to oppose me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 唯有够资格者方可进入。与我为敌，必死无疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: I am a being of the Void. Created to oppose you. Leave now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 我是虚空的造物，为阻挡你而生。现在离开还来得及。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.text: Come no further if you value your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/CbJu.zhText: 要是还想活命，就别再向前半步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.text: Oh hello Tenno... why the long face? Worried about your friends? Hmm... it is true that they were unwilling, but rest assured, participation in the Zanuka project is a very prestigious honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.zhText: 哦，你好啊，Tenno……怎么回事啊？看着闷闷不乐呢？在担心你的朋友们？嗯……他们确实不太愿意，不过你放心，能参加 Zanuka 计划就是一项莫大的荣幸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.text: Are you sure you can't just let this go? We would make great partners you know. Produce great profits. Hmm... not interested? That's too bad. For you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.zhText: 你真的不能就此罢休吗？我们可以成为最佳搭档，一起合作赚大钱！怎么……没兴趣吗？太可惜了，你真不识时务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.text: Tenno, look. I believe so strongly in my Zanuka prototype that I'm willing to give you a demo. It will be quite the opportunity, most people don't get to see the future... before they die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.zhText: Tenno，看吧。我对我的 Zanuka 原型机是相当有信心的，很乐意让你见识一下。这可是个大好机会，非常难得！大部分人还没看到未来就……送了命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.text: With Alad V taken care of, no more Tenno will be sacrificed in the name of his progress. Our operatives are recovering those still held within V's labs. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starchart/DAla.zhText: 除掉 Alad V 之后，不会再有 Tenno 战士因为他的计划而丧生，我们的特工正在营救那些关押在 Alad 实验室的同伴，你干得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: We've got two families: biological and logical. Roky taught me that one. Star Day is for both those families... and anyone else besides.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我们有两种家人：一种由血缘决定，一种由自己选择。这是小洛教我的。星日不仅属于这两种家人……更属于每一个你愿意去爱的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: 'Star Day' is a Ticker tradition... begun for just one special person. Now... I give it to the world. If you want to know the story, you'll find it scattered across the Vallis. Today is too happy a day to tell it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 「星日」原本是提克尔自己的习惯……最初只为一个特别的人而设立。如今，我把它送给全世界。想知道这个故事，就去山谷各处找找吧。今天这么开心，我就不煞风景了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Two Ostrons are freed during a daring operation, marry, have a child. I'm sure you'll be pleased to know that the young 'Tenno' Helnung is doing quite well and taking after their mother on the scaffolds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 两名奥斯特朗人在一次大胆的营救中重获自由，后来结为伴侣，还有了孩子。你听了应该会很高兴：小「Tenno」赫尔农现在过得很好，在脚手架上的身手，也有几分其母亲的风采了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: It's trite, but it has to be said: be brave with that heart of yours, Stardust. At the end of the day, those we love are what matters. Don't leave things unsaid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 这话虽然老套，可我还是不吐不快：对自己的心坦率一点，星尘。说到底，我们爱的人才是最重要的。有些话，别等到为时已晚再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: The only family that extraordinary creatures such as we are permitted is the family whom we choose - and a fine family that is. Here's to us, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 像我们这样的异类，命里准许拥有的家人，往往只有自己亲手选择的那些——我们选得可真好。干一杯，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: You raised yourself. You'll have questions, and nobody will be there to answer them. I want you to know: I'm here, Stardust. I won't always have the answer, but I will listen, and what I tell you will be true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 你自食其力成长至今。一路上一定有过无数疑问，却没人替你解答。我想让你知道：星尘，我在这。我未必总能回答，但我会倾听。只要是我说出口的，必然都是真话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Spotted Biz and Little Duck boarding her rail tractor, bound for parts unknown. I guess they celebrate today in their own way. Lot of history, those two. They'll work it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我看见比兹和小鸭子登上了她的航道牵引机，不知道驶向了哪里。估计他们是在用自己的方式庆祝今天这个日子。那两个人之间，有太多纠葛了。他们总会把话说开的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Nobody's as hard on Eudico as Eudico. She's made mistakes, and her demons are loud. I try to dazzle 'em with love. Millions are alive today because there's a light in there that people believe in. We don't often see things as they are, so much as we are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 对尤迪科最狠的，永远是她自己。她犯过错，心中的梦魇也没少烦她。我就拿爱晃花它们的眼。今天还有千千万万人活着，只因为她心里那束光，值得大家相信。我们眼中的世界，往往不是它的原貌，而是我们内心的倒影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Everybody's hurting, Stardust. Some of them hurt you. That's a given. Secret to a happy life? Find the ones worth hurting for. Happy Star Day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 人人都带着伤，星尘。有些人也会伤害你，暗箭难防。想知道幸福的秘诀？那就是找到那些值得你去吃苦头的人。星日快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Star Day celebrates life and love and the value of those closest to us. Heaven may have nicer weather, but you can't beat Hell for the company. Here's to you, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 星日庆祝生命，庆祝爱，也提醒我们珍惜最亲近的人。天堂的风水或许不错，可要论一帮对脾气的人，还得是地狱。敬你，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Love isn't just for lovers, Stardust. It's for friends, family, your bestest Kavat. Love is an act of forgiveness, a tender look, a silent understanding. Today is about all of us and knowing that we have more binding us together than. Pushing. Us. Apart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 爱可不是恋人专属，星尘。它也属于朋友、家人，还有你家最最棒的库娃。爱可以是宽恕，是含情脉脉的凝望，或是心照不宣的默契。今天这日子属于大家，同样时刻提醒我们：让我们彼此相依的，远比那些想把我们拆散的力量，要强得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: I was never much one for looks or physique. I longed for those who sang songs only I could hear. Falling into the eyes of someone like that, a girl feels like she's getting away with something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我向来不太在意皮相或身段。我渴望的是，那个能和我同频的人。在对方的眼神里沉溺……会让姑娘觉得，好像等到了自己的白马王子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: I have loved, and I have lost. "Their absence has gone through me like thread through a needle," as someone once said. All that I do is stitched with their color.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我爱过，也失去过。有人曾说：「他们的离去，犹如细线穿过针眼。」从此，我所做的一切，都缝上了他的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Words and deeds are seeds, Stardust. They may seem like nothing in the moment, but they can fall from you and begin growing in others. Fortuna used to be barren, is what I'm saying. You've given us an orchard. Happy Star Day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 言语与行动都是种子，星尘。当下看着可能微不足道，却会从你身上落下，在别人心里生根发芽。我是说，福尔图娜曾经是一片荒地。而你，送给了我们一整座果园。星日快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Star Days are all about the things that keep these planets spinning. Love, Stardust. Love in all its forms. The love of a planet for the stranger who turned their fortunes around. That would be you, Stardust. Give love away, and it multiplies. We rarely know what we mean to others. Ticker means to change that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 星日庆祝的，就是让所有行星不停转动的那股力量。那就是爱，星尘。各种各样的爱。比如一颗星球，爱着那个替它扭转命运的异乡人。没错，就是你，星尘。把爱传递出去，会化作千万份温暖。我们几乎不知道，自己对别人来说到底有多重要。提克尔今天就要让你见识一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Starrrrdust! You made it! It would not do to stand Ticker up on this of all days. Your big day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 星尘！你来啦！要是敢在今天放提克尔鸽子，可太说不过去了。今天对你来说非常重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Happy Star Day, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 星日快乐，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Treat yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 犒劳一下自己吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: We'll be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我们会一直在这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: See you soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 好嘞，回头见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: It sometimes feels a shame that it took a time of conflict for the Solaris to know you. I suppose it's true what they say: that a certain darkness is required if one is to see the stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我时常会感觉遗憾，索拉里斯人偏偏要在这样动荡的岁月里才认识你。不过那句话或许没错：唯有熬过最深的黑夜，才能看见璀璨的繁星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: One life preserver. One ocean. One turtle. The probability of you existing is the same as that turtle sticking its head out of the water and through the middle of that life preserver. On the first attempt. One chance in ten to the power of two-million-six-hundred-and-eighty-five million. That's your lucky number, Stardust: one followed by 2.685 million zeroes. A miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 一个救生圈。一片海洋。一只小海龟。你的存在就像那只小海龟第一次尝试把头探出水面，就刚好穿过了救生圈中间一样罕见。这样的概率是十的两百六十八万五千次方分之一。星尘，那是你的幸运数字：十的两百六十八万五千次方中的唯一。真是个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: When we help someone, our brain opens up a floodgate of all the best, most lovely brain chemicals. That'll get a person through almost anything, bank it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 当我们帮助别人，大脑就像开了闸，瞬间涌出所有最让人快乐的物质。那股劲儿，足够支撑一个人熬过几乎任何难关。信我的，准没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: The children tell stories about you. About friends of theirs that you helped to better lives far from here. They have a pride in them now that I'd never seen before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 孩子们会讲起你的故事。讲你怎样帮助他们的朋友离开这里，在遥远的地方过上更好的日子。如今他们眼里有了我从未见过的骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: I see a little bit of me in everyone, Stardust. Hard not to love once you know we are all the Universe in drag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我在每个人身上，都能看到一点自己的影子，星尘。一旦明白我们都只是宇宙盛装登台时的不同扮相，又怎会不爱呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Life will hurt you, Stardust. But you have to love, you have to feel. It's why we're here. When I die, there'll be a smile on this face for all the glorious mistakes I made... so many of which were doors to Heaven itself. His name... was Volan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 生活难免会让你受伤，星尘。可你依然要去爱，去感受。我们活这一遭，为的就是这个。等我走的那天，我脸上一定会带着笑，为我犯下的那些灿烂又荒唐的错误……有些错，甚至为我推开通往天堂的门。他的名字……叫沃兰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: One reason to love people like you, Eudico, Biz? When we had all given up for so long, you lot came along and said: "Let's see what happens if we don't." And the whole world turned 90 degrees in a brighter direction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 知道为什么我会爱你们吗——你、尤迪科、比兹？因为当我们的希望熄灭了太久太久，你们却站了出来，问了一句：「要是我们不放弃呢？」于是，整个世界就这么天翻地覆，终于照进了光亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: Know this: your name lives on the lips of those who love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 记住：只要还有人爱着你，你的名字就会一直被他们挂在嘴边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.text: We are the combined effort of everyone we have ever loved, Stardust. And we've loved some good people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Starday/DStard.zhText: 我们今天之所以成为这样的自己，是一路爱过的每一个人共同成就的，星尘。而我们爱过的，都是很好的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 今天是你逼我们出手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: Maybe this will change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 或许这样能让你回心转意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: You have strayed too far from the path. May this correct you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 你已在歧途上走得太远。愿此惩戒能将你引入正途。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: Your lack of Honor has brought this upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 你背弃了荣誉，才招致了这场灾祸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: You are a waste and must be erased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 你毫无价值，必须被抹除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: I am adding this to my data under the heading: consequences.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 我正将当前事件录入数据库，条目归属于——代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: We Perrin always collect our debts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 我们佩兰数列向来有债必收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: We've decided you are bad for business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 评估得出，你对我们的事业不利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: How dare you go against us. You will be purged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 竟敢与我们作对。你将被彻底净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: You are part of the corruption and we are forced to act.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 你已经被腐化了，我们不得不采取行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.text: The impure, the unworthy have no future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DCo.zhText: 不洁与卑劣之人，没有未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DDi.text: You have stepped from the path. Tread carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DDi.zhText: 你偏离了正道，谨慎行事。
又一堆无用的有机碎屑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DDi.text: Are you betting against us, Tenno?
You've become part of the problem.
It is not too late to cleanse yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DDi.zhText: 现在净化自己，还为时不晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.text: You've turned your back on a lot of innocent people Tenno, but what do you care?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.zhText: Tenno，你背叛了那么多无辜的人。可你又怎么会在乎呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.text: A shame to see such potential squandered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.zhText: 如此潜能白白挥霍，真是遗憾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.text: A perfect specimen of wasted life.
The probability of us working together has converged on never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.zhText: 我们往后合作的可能性已无限趋近于零。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.text: An enemy in any form is still a target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.zhText: 敌人无论以何种形式出现，终究都是目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.text: You're just like the rest. Tainted and ruined beyond salvation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DHa.zhText: 你和其他人一样，污秽不堪，无可救药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: This war's chewin' up the weak and innocent. No one stands up for them but Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 这场纷争吞噬了弱小无辜的人。除了钢铁防线，没人为他们挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: The Arbiters of Hexis seek truth through trial, and discipline. The Tenno will surpass their former masters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 均衡仲裁者通过试炼与纪律来探求真理。Tenno 终将超越昔日的主宰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: You are curious. So am I. Cephalon Suda could help you unfold this strange map of existence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 你渴望知识，我也一样。中枢苏达能帮你探索这片奇异宇宙的奥秘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: You are filled with questions. That is what makes you surprising. Cephalon Suda likes surprises.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 你满脑子都是疑问。正因如此，你总能让人眼前一亮。中枢苏达向来喜欢惊喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: The Perrin Sequence reject the Corpus doctrine that conflict is opportunity. We see the numbers differently. A shared prosperity can bring a shared peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 佩兰数列摒弃科普斯所谓「冲突即商机」的教条。我们对数字有不同解读。共同繁荣，方能共享和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: The old ways speak of a cleansing fire. We of the Red Veil must burn away this corruption to begin anew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 古老的教诲昭示着一场净世之火。我们血色面纱必须焚尽这些腐化，才能浴火重生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.text: New Loka believes that true humanity is the only path to cleanse ourselves of this suffering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DIn.zhText: 新世间坚信，保持纯粹的人性，才能洗脱苦难、净化自身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.text: I was wrong about you. You're a hero to these people… and to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.zhText: 我错怪你了。你是这些人的英雄……对我来说也是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.text: You set the example for the rest of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.zhText: 你为我等众生树立了榜样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.text: You would make an excellent Cephalon, Tenno!
We stand behind you. Let's build a brighter future!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.zhText: 我们会做你最坚实的后盾，一起建设更光明的未来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.text: You are a fire. As feared as you are respected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.zhText: 你将化身净世之火，令人畏惧，也受人尊崇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.text: Your humanity is a beacon for all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DLo.zhText: 你纯粹的人性，是照亮众生的灯塔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: Alright, I'm impressed. You might make a difference in people's lives after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: 好吧，有两下子。看来你还真能改变那些可怜人的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: If this continues I might care if you come to harm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: 照这样下去，我可能会开始在意你的安危。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: Congratulations Tenno on your promotion. Much deserved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: Tenno，恭喜你晋升了。实至名归。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: Are you gonna help these people out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: 嘿，你打算帮这些人一把吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: You are on the verge of a new truth.
Advancement imminent. I require more data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: 晋升在即。我需要更多数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: We must raise more capital to pursue our goals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: 要实现我们的目标，必须筹集更多资金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.text: Give what you can Tenno, to help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DNe.zhText: Tenno，尽你所能，助我们一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.text: Here's what we can do for you.
Alright, what can we help you with?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.zhText: 好吧，我们能为你做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.text: What can we do to help your journey?
Perhaps these will show you the path...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.zhText: 这些或许能为你指明道路……
有没有你觉得好奇的东西？
希望你会对这些感兴趣。
我们能提供的就是这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.text: These are bargain, just for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.zhText: 只有你能享受这些特惠价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.text: With these you may punish our enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.zhText: 这些能帮你惩罚我们的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.text: We offer these to aid you, Tenno.
Use these to cleanse the unclean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DOp.zhText: 用这些来净化不洁之物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.zhText: 好吧，但你欠我们个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.text: I hope you put it to good use.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.zhText: 能帮上忙是我们的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.text: You scratch our backs, we'll scratch yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.zhText: 你帮了我们，我们自然会礼尚往来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.text: Our enemies will fear you with that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.zhText: 有了它，敌人将闻风丧胆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.text: Use it to spread our way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DPu.zhText: 用它来传递我们的理念吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Nice work. I like what I'm seeing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 干得好，你的表现我很满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Your mission was interesting to me. I express gratitude for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 我对你的任务很感兴趣。对此，我表示感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Impressive performance, Tenno. We won't forget this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 表现出色，Tenno。我们将铭记你的恩情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: You are a bright light, Tenno. You have our deepest thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: Tenno，你如光芒般耀眼。我们无比感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Well done, Tenno. You truly are honorable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。你确实值得尊敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Tenno, Your actions reveal an inner fire. Your enemy's fear grows today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: Tenno，你的一举一动都迸发出了内心的烈焰。你的敌人又对你多了几分畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Ok Tenno, a lot of people are depending on you to get this done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 好了，Tenno，很多人都指望你来完成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Your path has led here. Prove yourself, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 道路将你引领至此。证明自己，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: What an interesting place. I appreciate you doing this task for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 真是个有趣的地方。感谢你替我执行这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Your calculated survival probability is encouraging… good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 根据计算，你的生还概率相当可观……祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: It is time for those against us to pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 那些反对者今天该付出代价了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.text: Will you help us Tenno and our cause?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DSy.zhText: 你会协助我们成就大业吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.text: Alright, you're in. I hope you prove me wrong, I've been burned before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.zhText: 好吧，算你一个。希望你能证明是我看走眼了，我以前可没少吃亏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.text: Now begins your path to truth and power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.zhText: 从此刻起，你将踏上通往真理与力量的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.text: The odds are in our favor now.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Syndicates/DWe.zhText: 欢迎加入我们的大家庭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 猎物开跑啦，哈！你们说呢？我们要开导开导这位 Tenno 吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tantivy! Tantivy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 猎物开跑！猎物开跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The shields, Adis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些护盾，阿迪斯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The shields, Adis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些护盾，阿迪斯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The shields, Adis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些护盾，阿迪斯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The shields, Adis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些护盾，阿迪斯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I got it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 交给我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yarata! Now, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Yarata！就是现在，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Good work. All crews, prepare to launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 干得好！全体人员，准备出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Good work. This treaty's going to live, Galastra, and you don't get to tear it up.  Dropships inbound!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 做的好。这份誓约会保住，加拉斯特，你休想毁掉它。运输舰进港！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Valdur. My old pet. Better count your flock again, dog, and keep your ships on the ground. Else I'll be set to carving your lost lamb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 瓦杜尔。我的老走狗。你最好再数一遍你的羊，狗东西，把你的船都留在陆地上。否则我就宰掉你那只走失的羊羔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Empty threats. Dropships inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虚张声势。空投艇即将抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: He's alive, Ayatan. The man who made sure I was up and dressed every morning. He lit candles with me in my mother's memory. He taught me to be kind, even if I forgot. I thought he was dead, necralized, but all this time he's been there under my feet! Oh Loid, why didn't you come to me sooner? Were you ashamed that my father abandoned us both?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿耶檀识，他还活着。每天早上，他都督促我起床穿衣。他和我一起点燃蜡烛，缅怀我的母亲。他教导我要善良，即使我有时会忘记。我以为他已经死了，变成殁世械灵了，但这么多年来，他一直都在我的脚下！哦，洛德，你为什么不早点来找我？你是不是因为我父亲抛弃了我们俩而感到羞愧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You know… I had this broken-down mech I was going insane trying to fix. Swapped out the light-board, flushed the atria, hell I even stripped the casings and resparked the coils. Nothing. Know what it was? The spine was cut. Sheared right through. Hairline. I never even noticed. Well, now I know why nothing my wife did to find her father ever made a damn bit of difference. How could it? He cut her off. I gotta look after her, Ayatan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你知道吗……我之前有个坏掉的机甲，我发了疯拼了命想修好它。我换了灯板，冲洗了中庭，甚至把外壳都拆了，重新点亮了线圈。结果还是不行。你知道问题出在哪吗？它的脊柱断了。直接被剪断了。就那么一条细线。我之前竟然都没注意到。好吧，现在我终于明白，为什么我妻子为了找到她父亲做了这么多，都没有用。怎么可能会有用？是他自己亲手剪断联系的。我得照顾她，阿耶檀识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ayatan. Do you know what the motto of the Entrati family is? 'No God Above Knowledge'! So what does it say about our family when Albrecht Entrati himself deliberately withholds the knowledge of his fate from his own daughter? His own grandchildren? Isn't that the most stinking, raw hypocrisy you ever heard in your life? Frickin' Orokin bullshit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿耶檀识。你知道英择谛家族的座右铭是什么吗？"知识至上"！那么，当阿尔布雷希特·英择谛本人故意向自己的女儿、自己的孙辈隐瞒自己的命运时，这又说明了我们家族什么呢？这难道不是你这辈子听过最恶心、最虚伪的那一套吗？简直就是该死的奥罗金狗屁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have never pitied my mother so much as I pity her now, Ayatan. Through all these miserable years she nursed hope. Even when it turned bitter and acrid, burning her bones from within. Finally, blessedly, she let it go, and now… now she hears her father could have told her the truth at any time. He just didn't want to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿耶檀识，我从未像现在这样怜悯过我的母亲。这些年来，她饱受苦难，却始终怀抱希望。即使希望变得苦涩难耐，灼烧着她的骨髓，她也从未放弃。终于，她决定放手了，而现在……现在她却听说，她的父亲本可以随时告诉她真相。他只是不想说而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Well. I am not shy about admitting that I have been played, dear. Especially when the person doing the playing is so clearly a master at it. Those inscribed panels Albrecht left for us to read, all that guff about how he was giving up and letting himself perish, and all the while he was whooping it up down below with his manservant! The temerity! Best prepare yourself, sweetling. If Albrecht is alive, then that thing he unleashed is still out there, too. Every light casts a shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好吧。亲爱的，我并不害怕承认自己被耍了。尤其当耍我的人如此老练的时候。阿尔布雷希特留下的那些刻着字的木板，上面全是些他放弃抵抗、准备赴死的鬼话，而他自己却在下面和他的男仆逍遥快活！真是放肆！你最好做好心理准备，宝贝。如果阿尔布雷希特还活着，那么他放出来的那个东西也还在外面。任何光都会投下阴影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: These are dark days. It is good to see you, Ayatan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 黑暗笼罩的时期，很高兴见到你，阿耶檀识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I admit I chafe under Roathe's 'protection', but I understand the need for it. The Indifference is abroad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我承认我对罗瑟的"庇护"感到不满，但我理解这种庇护的必要性。虚空无情之物已经来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am glad you never knew me as 'Euleria'. That name bore too many expectations of greatness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我很庆幸你从未在我还是"欧拉瑞娅"时就认识我。那个名字承载了太多伟大的期望了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So much I thought lost forever was merely mislaid. Perhaps it is not too late to rebuild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 很多我以为永远失去的东西，其实只是放错了地方。也许重建一切还不算太晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Finally, with Loid back among us, we have a true example of what it means to serve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 终于，随着洛德的回归，我们有了真正服务他人的榜样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So many memories are coming back now. So many regrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好多回忆涌上心头，好多的遗憾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I saw the Void as a phenomenon to be treated scientifically! Now I am told my father unleashed a monster, and my book of children's stories has come to life?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我一直把虚空视为一种需要科学研究的现象！现在却有人告诉我，我父亲释放了一个怪物，而我的儿童故事集竟然变成了现实？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Loid tells me you had issues of your own during the recent Narmer Conflict. I am gratified to learn you did not abandon us to defend the Heart alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德告诉我，在最近的合一众冲突中，你也遇到了自己的难题。得知你没有抛弃我们独自保卫"心"，我感到非常欣慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So, my husband's preoccupation with the ruins is explained. He was containing these 'Murmur'. Once again I have been lied to, for my own supposed protection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所以，我丈夫为什么总沉迷于那些废墟，现在终于有了解释。他一直在压抑这些"低语者"。而我又一次被骗了，还打着保护我的名义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Our work on Deimos has never been more important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们在火卫二上的研究工作，从未像现在这样重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I guess you finally met the Murmur. I've been doing my best to keep them locked away down there. Had to take out the odd stray personally. Couldn't let the family know, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看来你终于见到低语者了。我已经尽力把它们关在下面了。虽然偶尔会有漏网之鱼，我不得不亲自处理掉。当然，这事不能让家族的其他人知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Now, Roathe is a man who knows the value of a well crafted weapon. Never mind the whole 'treason' thing, that was blown way out of proportion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 罗瑟深知精良武器的价值。至于什么他"叛国"的事，完全是小题大做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's only getting more dangerous out there, Ayatan. Let me kit you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿耶檀识，外面越来越危险了。我来给你准备装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Loid told me about this 'Indifference'. What it's been feeding off. This family must have been a banquet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德跟我提过那个"虚空无情之物"，以及它靠什么存活。这个家族对它来说一定是一场盛宴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sorry if the Arcocanids have been giving you a hard time. Tough little suckers, aren't they? Gotta hand it to 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果弧犬让你吃尽苦头，我很抱歉。这些小家伙真够顽强的，不是吗？不得不佩服它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Kaelli's making me a new arm! She thinks I don't know. I gotta get her something just as nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 凯莉正在给我做个新胳膊！她以为我不知道。我得送她一件同样棒的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Did I tell you Ballas sent one of his Narmer Murexes sniffing around here? Vome and Fass blew it clean out of the sky! Only thing they hate worse than each other is having their territory invaded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我有没有跟你说过 Ballas 派了一艘合一众骨螺战舰来这儿嗅探？"秩序"和"混乱"把它直接打下来了！它们俩最恨的就是领地被入侵，比互相憎恶都恨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You've got people looking out for you, right? Watching your back? Well you better, 'cause there's only so much we can do while we're grounded on this rock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有人在照顾你，对吧？有人在背后支持你？最好是这样，因为我们都被困在这颗星球上，能做的事情毕竟有限。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oooh. I am not getting any younger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，我年纪不小了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht made Roathe part Warframe. Now that is one hell of a way to win a grudge match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特把罗瑟一部分变成了战甲。这真是赢得复仇之战的绝佳方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: My grandfather is running away from something, it seems. I only wish it was me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的外祖父好像在逃避什么。我真希望他逃避的是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Give Kalymos a pet from me, would you? I've missed her so much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 帮我摸摸卡利莫斯好吗？我太想她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Join us, embrace us, don't ever erase us…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 加入我们，拥抱我们，永远不要抹去我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let me just have a little look-see at how that frame of yours is articulated… aha! Don't mind me. Little craft project on the side, you know? You know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 让我稍微看看你的战甲是怎么活动的……啊哈！别介意。做个小手工，你知道的。你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Loid taught me so much about taste. He was the most discerning man I knew. Until he hooked up with my grandfather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德教会了我很多关于审美的知识。他是我认识的最有品位的人。直到他和我外祖父在一起之后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The whispers, the knocking… they're getting louder, aren't they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些低语声、敲击声……它们越来越大声了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I don't care what the others say. Roathe is perfectly charming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不在乎别人怎么说。总之罗瑟非常迷人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Interfering with the flow of time, hmmm? Exciting! What have you been up to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 干扰时间流逝？嗯？真刺激！你最近在忙些什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I don't care how you get him to me, I need that Norg. Can you imagine how succulent his brain is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不管你用什么方法，把他弄到我面前，我需要那条诺格。你能想象他的鱼脑有多美味吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do you know what brave deeds we did in the Narmer War, Ayatan? None! We hid! Thanks for that, Mother!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿耶檀识，你知道我们在合一众战争中做了什么英勇事迹吗？什么也没做！我们躲起来了！谢谢你，母亲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Loid has only become more ravishing with age. A pity the years have not been so kind to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德随着年龄增长愈发迷人。可惜岁月对我并不那么仁慈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: They're making the exact same mistakes with the Indifference that they made with the Infestation. Shun it, judge it, shut it out. They're afraid of what it might say to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他们对虚空无情之物的态度，和对待 Infestation 的态度如出一辙：避而远之，评判它，把它拒之门外。他们害怕它会告诉他们什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A nun, a priest and a devil have moved into our basement, and I don't get to play with them? I may die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 一个修女、一个神父和一个恶魔搬进了我们家的地下室，我居然不能和他们一起玩？真要我命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht and Gerivaine… it was an arranged business, you understand. Compatible genes, genius offspring guaranteed. No love in the mix to complicate things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和格丽维娜……这是一桩包办婚姻，你懂的。基因匹配，才能保证生出天才后代。没有爱情掺杂其中，免得事情复杂化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Grandfather wasn't just a rejected scientist. He was a rejected poet, too. I've done my part to keep up the tradition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 外祖父不仅是位被排挤的科学家，也是位被排挤的诗人。我也算是努力将这份"传统"发扬光大了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How delightful that the most tightly buttoned of all of us turned out to be the only one exhibiting any passion in this dismal pit. Very good, Loid. Very good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真令人高兴，我们当中最拘谨的人，竟然是唯一一个在这阴暗的深渊里流露出热情的人。很好，洛德。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you're ever possessed by self-pity, I recommend speaking to Tagfer. Sweet Hades, what that poor beast has been through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果哪天你陷入自怜自艾的情绪中，我建议你和标弃谈谈。我的天哪，这可怜的家伙经历了太多苦难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Life continues to be hell, and unfortunately I can't end it, because I don't think any of my vital organs are vital any more. You can tolerate my existence for a little longer, can't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 生活依然是地狱，很不幸我无法结束这一切，因为我觉得我的器官都已经不再重要了。你们还能忍受我再活一段时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I can tolerate Albrecht abandoning the family, but hurling dumb animals into the Void was a coward's act.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特抛弃家庭我可以容忍，但把无辜的动物扔进虚空简直是懦夫的行为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The boy whose body I wear has no grave, no family, nobody to mourn for him. You Tenno were right to end this. Don't ever doubt it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我所穿着的这个男孩的身体，他没有坟墓，没有家人，没有人为他哀悼。你们这些 Tenno 结束这一切是对的。永远不要怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht Entrati made his bed, in several unfortunate senses, and now we are all going to have to lie in it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自作自受，无论是哪一层意义上来说，现在我们所有人都得跟着一起承受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I knew there had to be another set of chambers beneath these! How else is one to explain all the draughts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我就知道下面肯定还有另一组房间！不然怎么解释这些穿堂风呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Roathe had a certain reputation in the court. Him and that Executor Nitokh. Thick as thieves, they were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 罗瑟在宫廷里颇有名气。他和那个执行者尼托关系密切，简直形影不离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You see, dear, the trouble with poor Albrecht was that he could never see other people as anything but secondary players in his own personal drama.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 亲爱的，你看，可怜的阿尔布雷希特的问题在于，他总是把别人看作是他个人戏剧中的次要角色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I did admire Roathe's mastery of imperial protocols. He always knew exactly how to comport himself if the Emperors ever summoned him for counsel. You lot just slaughtered them, of course. Shocking manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我确实很佩服罗瑟对帝国礼仪的精通。如果皇帝们召见他征求意见，他总能恰到好处地应对。而你们当然是直接把他们给杀了。真是惊人的礼仪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If the failure of the Heart didn't tempt Albrecht out of seclusion, I doubt his daughter's abject misery could.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果"心"的崩溃都没能将阿尔布雷希特从隐居中逼出来，那我怀疑他女儿的悲惨境遇恐怕也做不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Isn't Bird 3 delightful? Utterly without guile. I can't think of a creature whose company I enjoy half so much! Other than you, dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 鸟三是不是很可爱？它一点也不狡诈。除了你，亲爱的，我实在想不出还有什么生物能让我如此享受和它在一起的时光！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Their relationship was against the Legems, true. But in a society obsessed with hierarchies, it was hardly possible not to transgress some rule or other with every step one took.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他们的关系的确违背了法律。但在一个等级森严的社会里，几乎每走一步都难免会触犯某些规则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Our circle has expanded, it seems. I look forward to hearing all about the goings-on 'below stairs'!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看来我们的社交圈扩大了。我很期待听到"楼下"发生的一切！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What I wouldn't do for a decent cup of tea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 为了喝上一杯好茶，我什么都愿意做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text:
They are changed, Tenno. Terribly changed. 

For so long I have refused to look at them, coward that I am. But you have only ever known them as they are now, and you never turned away. So I put aside my shameful fear and I tried to see them through your eyes. It was the correct choice. 

I always told myself I was serving them out of duty. No. I have served, and shall serve, out of love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
他们变了，Tenno。彻底变了。 

长久以来，我一直不敢正视他们，因为我是个懦夫。但你见过他们现在的样子，你却从未转身走人。所以我放下了羞耻的恐惧，试着透过你的眼睛去看他们。这是正确的选择。 

我总是告诉自己，我为他们服务是出于责任。不。我过去、现在、将来都出于爱而为他们服务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Can you believe we used to be at war?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你能相信我们之间曾经发生过战争吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What your parents say, if they here?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 修那条巨轨，就是故事。先是当劳力。然后，拆开来当零件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Disgusting, isn't it? Orokin gold - wasted! I wonder… which of you would this aberration attack first?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真恶心，不是吗？奥罗金的黄金——就这么白白浪费了！我倒想知道……你们当中，谁会先被这个怪物攻击？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Again? Okay, don't sweat it. I've got your back.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bad place. Golden-cursed. Long-ago precepting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不祥之地。金色的诅咒。古老的训诫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Coming, hive-kin!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Okay, fine. Your people's stories had a point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 行，没问题。你们的故事有道理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No history taught in those Tenno schools? Peace cannot abide the machines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那些 Tenno 学校连历史都不教吗？和平容不下机器的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're the only ones keeping this war alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 明明是你们让这场战争持续至今的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're the only ones keeping this war alive.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The promise of a home. So lightly surrendered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 一个家的承诺。就这么轻易地放弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let him go!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Of course! When he's good and ready, child. Sentient TQ-776VL! Repel intruders! So desperate for orders without your xenoflora.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 自然会放！等他准备好的时候，孩子。Sentient TQ-776VL！驱逐入侵者！离了你的异星花，就这么想要得到命令吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You can't "heal" a core override, child. This only ends one way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 孩子，核心覆写是无法"治愈"的。结局只有一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Adis can't heal a core override, and I can't patch up a dead treaty! This has to end here. That's an order.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: 'Xenoflora'. Flowers. The only real alien life we've ever found, and the Sents scarf them down like kubrow chow! Just as well for us they did, eh, Tenno? Suddenly they've all got minds of their own, so no more hivemind, so no more war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "异星花"。那些花。这是我们至今唯一真正发现的外星生命，而那些 Sentient 却把它们当库狛粮一样往嘴里塞！不过他们这样也好，对吧，Tenno？突然间，他们都拥有了自己的思想，所以不再有集体意识，也不再有战争。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I see them.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Take out that gun, Tenno. We're getting pounded!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The sword that was consigned to the Void and forgotten. IORO-SHOLOHV: VEXORIC! For Lua. And for what remains of humanity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那把被遗弃于虚空、被人遗忘的剑。IORO-SHOLOHV：断命！为了月神。也为了残存的人类！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text:
Greetings, Child. 

Infuriating, is it not? To one day wake up and find holes poked in what was formerly a perfectly retentive mind. 

I have no interest in commiseration of your War stories; you did what you did. Instead I come to offer you an incentive, if only for a short while.

You know of the Dark Refractory, yes? It allows one to traverse their memories, no matter how inaccessible they may have been rendered. 

Use it. Explore the deepest depths of your war-torn psyche. Show me the limits of the Device. Do so and you will earn my very own Marks of Valiance. But act with haste Operator, for my magnanimity sets like Sol itself. Come visit me within "La Cathédrale" afterwards, and I shall show you what being in the good graces of an Orokin can buy you.  

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
问候你，孩子 。

真让人恼火，不是吗？有一天你醒来，发现原本记忆力极佳的头脑被戳得千疮百孔。

我对同情你的战争故事不感兴趣；你做了你该做的。相反，我是来给你一点激励，哪怕只是一小会儿。

你知道深溯池，对吧？它可以让人穿越自己的记忆，不管那些记忆被渲染得多么难以触碰。

使用它。探索你饱受战争摧残的心灵最深处。让我看看这种设备的极限。做到的话，你就能得到我的英勇标记。赶快行动吧，指挥官，因为我的宽宏大量就像太阳神下山那么快。之后到"大教堂"来找我，我将告诉你得到奥罗金人的赏识能给你带来什么。

你诚挚的,
副摄政总司令罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text:
Greetings once more, Child.  

Regrettably, for myself at least, this vein of the Dark Refractory has exhausted its gold. As delightful as it has been to watch you trade your mental faculties for the dregs of my once-enviable treasury, it seems there is nothing of any more value for me to glean from that machine. Yes, that means there will be no more Marks of Valiance. 

Don't stop your mental flagellation on my account, however! I am sure that there is still much for you to gain from your little Tenno war therapy sessions. I already know we lost, after all.

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
再次问候你，孩子。

遗憾的是，至少对我来说，这深溯池的脉络已经耗尽了它的黄金。虽然看着你用你的心智来交换我曾经羡慕的宝藏渣滓，我还是很高兴的，但似乎我再也无法从那台机器里找到比这更有价值的东西了。是的，这意味着再也不会有英勇徽章了。

不过，不要因为我而停止你的精神鞭笞！我敢肯定，从你的小 Tenno 战争治疗课程中，你还能学到很多东西。毕竟，我已经知道我们输了。

此致,
副摄政总司令罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's Galastra, Executor. Her Anarchs now occupy every one of the known world-seeders. Many of our bloom nurseries lie in ashes! Tokh-Amn itself is threatened! We believe she may be receiving assistance. Executor Nitokh is helping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 执行者大人，是加拉斯特。她的自由派已经占领了所有已知的世界播种器。我们许多的花源苗圃都化为了灰烬！就连托安也岌岌可危！我们怀疑有人在暗中帮她。那人应该是执行者尼托。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The moon Perita is soon to be sovereign Sentient territory, per article 92. "All Orokin forces to withdraw." Remain and we violate the treaty, depart and we abandon a friend in need! What, then, would you have me do about Galastra?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 根据第 92 条规定，佩里塔月球即将成为 Sentient 的主权领土，"所有奥罗金军队必须撤出"，留下等于撕毁誓约，离开等于见死不救！那你说，我要如何处理加拉斯特？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have spoken to my fellow Archimedean. Your… consort? It appears the world-seeders have a weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我已和我的哲士同僚，也就是和您的……夫人聊过了。似乎那些世界播种器有个弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: When I told Executor Ballas of the peril Tokh-Amn was facing, I little thought he would place me in charge of its defense. In this sacred place, the minds that had begun to grow on our long journey finally flowered. Tenno, Adis, in the spirit of Tokh-Amn I bind your souls together. Be the example we look to, the living truth of peace. The two of you have already been tested deeply, beyond any grade or metric. I have nothing left to teach. I deem you both Tauron Adept. May your union never be sundered.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A rogue Executor and her lapdog. We need to get Itzam out of there now. I'm sending a shuttle. You clear a landing zone!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是个叛变的执行者和她的走狗。我们得立刻把伊赞转移出去。我这就派一艘穿梭机过去。你去清理出一块着陆区！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Are they alive?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他还活着吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Barely. Cataleptic state. Vitals marginal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 勉强活着。处于僵直状态。生命体征极弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What do they see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他看到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No way to tell without joining them, wherever they are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不知道，除非我们接进去，不然没法知道他在哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Shuttle has locked on. Entering lower atmosphere. Not long now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 穿梭机已锁定。正在进入低层大气。很快就要到达目的地了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Shuttle inbound. It's taken some hits. Just make sure it sets down in one piece.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 穿梭机即将抵达。它受到了一些撞击。请确保它能安稳落地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 没时间了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Thank you, Tenno. You two have been a singular headache at times, but I admit I shall miss our classes. Perhaps you might consider returning next year, to speak to the new students.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，谢谢你。你们俩有时候挺让人头疼的，不过我还是会想念我们一起上课的日子。或许你可以考虑明年回来，给新学员们讲讲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Just can't keep them alive, can you, kiddo? Everyone who cares for you ends up dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 小鬼，你就是救不了他们，对吧？所有关心你的人最后都死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You might not think so, but you two did a damn good job. While you were keeping Galastra busy, Ballas and the bigwigs up here have been hard at work. They're signing the treaty in just under an hour. Itzam couldn't have had a better memorial than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你们或许不这么想，但你们俩做得真的很好。你们在牵制加拉斯特的时候，Ballas 和这里的高层们一直在全力推进。再过不到一小时，他们就要签署誓约了。这个结果对于伊赞来说是最好的纪念了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text:
Galastra tried to steal the life of my love. For that alone she deserves death. But the complete extinction of the Tau blooms, which she plans to bring about, would hurl us back into a state of war. 

With the collusion of Executor Nitokh and her lackey Roathe, she has sequestered herself and her followers within the world-seeders, the armored Zariman Ova of old. But they have a flaw. A destruct sequence.

This Ayatan holds the trigger codes. Deliver it to the world-seeder's heart and turn Galastra's fortress into her funeral pyre.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
加拉斯特企图夺走我挚爱的生命。仅凭这一点，她就该死。但她若让 Tau 的花朵灭绝，这将使我们再次陷入战争。 

在执行者尼托及其爪牙罗瑟的勾结下，她将自己和她的追随者封在了世界播种器——那些古老的扎里曼装甲卵之中。幸好这些卵有一个缺陷：自毁程序。

这个阿耶檀识携有触发代码。将它送进世界播种器的核心，将加拉斯特的堡垒变成她的葬身之地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No admittance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 禁止入内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Give 'em hell for me, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 小子，替我狠狠教训他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your people faced extinction, you found wisdom, and now you rise. Peace is trembling in our hands. Let us boldly grasp it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你们的族群曾面临灭绝，你们找到了智慧，如今你们崛起。和平就在我们手中颤动。让我们勇敢地抓住它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Void knows how, but they've found us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不知怎么的，他们已经找到我们了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bring me my Ascaris!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 把我的蛔虫装置拿来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You think… you are the only ones… to command the Frames?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你以为……只有你们……能驾驭战甲吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Control frames, but no Tenno? Galastra burn herself up for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 控制战甲，但没有 Tenno？加拉斯特肯定会自焚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Play the wolf, Tenno. Cut down the suckling lamb and join the side that's going to win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，去做狼吧。斩杀那些还在吃奶的小羊羔，加入即将胜利的一方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Peace isn't won with flowers and songs! You only get peace… through sacrifice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 和平不是靠鲜花和歌声换来的！和平只能通过……牺牲才能获得！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I'm going to die on my estate, here on my moon, surrounded by weeping grandchildren and howling Kubrows. Not now. And not by your hand!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我要死在我的庄园里，就在我的月球上，被哭泣的孙辈和嚎叫的库狛围绕。不是现在。更不是死在你手上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What is happen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 发生什么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's… me. I can't do this. I don't want to do this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是……是我。我做不到。我不想这么做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你并不在 Tau。这只是一段记忆。它已经发生过了。我很抱歉，但我们无法改变这一切。

It's okay. I'm here. My light goes with you.
[9.6]
Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
[6.8]
没关系，我在这里。我的光会一直与你同在。
[9.6]
直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We're losing them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他快不行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bring them back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 把他救回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I can't! They've gone too deep!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我做不到！他陷得太深了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Murmur. Breaking the perimeter seals. Flooding the labs. It's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是低语者。突破了外围的封锁。涌进了实验室。一切都完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tenno, I must ask you to pace yourself! Nobody doubts your strength, but the Dark Refractory places a murderous burden on the user. If you persist in your current state, there is a real risk that we will lose you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，我必须请求你放慢节奏！没有人怀疑你的力量，但深溯池会给使用者带来致命的负担。如果你再这样下去，我们很可能会失去你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I've not seen this kind of Murmur activity since the day my Albrecht left us. It's like… religious hysteria.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 自从我的阿尔布雷希特离开我们那天之后，我就没见过这种低语者的动静了。简直就像……宗教狂热。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Only a few remain, Tenno. Deal with them and then rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，只剩几个了。解决掉他们，然后休息吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Prep the machine, Loid. I have to go back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德，准备机器。我得回去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This will be your last trip. If the process is not completed this time, you will never come back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这将是你能回去的最后一趟。如果这次仍然无法完成，你就回不来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Adis. I deserve to know...

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: My child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: In the name of the Seven, the Lady Margulis and I welcome the delegates of the Sentient Collective. How brightly Perintol's odd little star shines now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以七人众之名，我和 Margulis 夫人在此欢迎 Sentient 群体的各位代表。佩林托星型之姿如今竟如此耀眼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tell me, Tenno-brat. Why do you still serve the Orokin? Do you really trust them to keep their word?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno 屁孩，告诉我，你为什么还要效忠奥罗金？你真的相信他们会信守承诺吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's not too late to see the light, Tenno. Even for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，现在弃暗投明还不算晚。即使是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The blind… lead the blind… and it all ends… in chaos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 盲人……给盲人领路……最终只会让一切……走向混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Terraforming initiated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 地球化改造启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Good. Your final evolution. Kill me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 很好。你已经完成了进化。杀了我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Why would Adis ever want to be like you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿迪斯怎么可能会想变得和你一样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Converting atmosphere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 大气转化中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Why am I sleepy?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You've had a very hard day, my angel, and we have a long journey back to Lua. The Dream will keep the voices from taking hold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的天使，你今天过得太艰难了，回月球的旅途还很长。梦会挡住那些占据你心神的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're going to make me forget. Aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是想让我忘记这一切，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're going to make me forget. Aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是想让我忘记这一切，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're going to make me forget. Aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是想让我忘记这一切，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You're going to make me forget. Aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是想让我忘记这一切，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I will not have them accuse you of treason. If they come for you, they will have to go through me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我绝不会让他们给你扣上叛国的罪。如果他们要来抓你，就必须先过我这关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: But Ballas… if he did this… he'll kill y-you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 可是 Ballas……如果这件事真是他做的……他会杀了你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: But Ballas… if he did this… he'll kill y-you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 可是 Ballas……如果这件事真是他做的……他会杀了你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: But Ballas… if he did this… he'll kill y-you…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: But Ballas… if he did this… he'll kill y-you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 可是 Ballas……如果这件事真是他做的……他会杀了你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We have already had our revenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们已经报仇了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You were used. Just as she was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你只是被利用了，就像她一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We can finally begin to heal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们终于可以开始疗伤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tau is in sight. It will not be the place that you or I remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tau 就在眼前。这地方已不再是你我记忆中的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text:
My child,

Like you, I mourn for the peace that might have been. But we cannot make the past our prison. We look backward only to learn where we are going.

Adis Truth-Bloom possessed a power rare among Sentients: the power to heal our kind. If another like him exists, we must find them.

Loid has granted us full use of the Dark Refractory. Use it. Your chaotic memories of Tau must be entered, tamed and understood.

Your memories of the Warframe Uriel have enabled Loid to reconstruct his blueprint. A difficult task, as the Orokin attempted to destroy all copies. Use Uriel with caution if you use him at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
我的孩子，

和你一样，我也为本该拥有的和平而哀悼。但我们不能让过去成为我们的牢笼。我们回顾过去，只是为了找到前进的方向。

"真理绽放"阿迪斯拥有 Sentient 中极为罕见的力量：治愈我们族群的力量。如果还有其他像他一样的存在，我们必须找到他们。

洛德已授予我们完全使用深溯池的使用权。去好好利用它吧。你必须进入、压制并理解你在 Tau 上的混乱记忆。

你对战甲 Uriel 的记忆使洛德得以重建他的蓝图。这是一项艰巨的任务，因为奥罗金人曾试图抹除所有的存档。如果你要使用 Uriel，请千万小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Adis Truth-Bloom, have you adapted to the Tenno Ways?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "真理绽放"阿迪斯，你适应 Tenno 之道了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: When the applications of Tauron are applied to Naramon's theories, what is the expected outcome?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 当 Tauron 的实践方式运用到 Naramon 的理论时，预期的结果会是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A new Somatic connection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 产生新的活体连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A new Somatic connection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 产生新的活体连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A new Somatic connection.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A regression in stability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 造成稳定性的倒退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's a trick question.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这道题是个陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这道题是个陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's a trick question.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这道题是个陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A somatic connection new, power increase many?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 会产生新的活体连接，力量增加很多？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Stability regress! Great badness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 稳定性倒退！大事不妙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Cannot be done! You are tricking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不成立！你在设陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No cheating! If you are tested by the Seven, we must show your evolution to their ways.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不许作弊！如果你要接受七人众的试炼，我们就必须展现出你已逐渐契合他们的专精之道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No cheating! Especially when the answer is grievously incorrect! Would you embarrass us so before the Seven?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不许作弊！何况你那答案也错得太离谱了！难道你要在七人众面前让我们丢脸吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So… the Seven are coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所以……七人众要来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So… the Seven are coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所以……七人众要来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So… the Seven are coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所以……七人众要来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So… the Seven are coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所以……七人众要来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The treaty is not as finished as we would wish. The conditions laid upon our stewardship -
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 誓约尚未如我们所愿定下。强加在我们管理权之上的附带条件——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Anarch strike is underway! Tauron students, to deployment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 自由派发起了突袭！全体 Tauron 学员，立刻出动！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let's go, "truth-bloom!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "真理绽放"，我们出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let's go, "truth-bloom!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "真理绽放"，我们出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let's go, "truth-bloom!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "真理绽放"，我们出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Let's go, "truth-bloom!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "真理绽放"，我们出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Adis did not choose name!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿迪斯没有选择名字！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It is strange to me how much the devil has taken to Bird 3… should we be concerned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我很奇怪恶魔怎么这么喜欢鸟三……我们应该担心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh - take your time. I am just enjoying your company.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，别着急。我只是很享受和你在一起的时光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do you know if the Cavia have any favorite treats? I would like to make them something…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你知道科维兽有没有特别喜欢的零食吗？我想给他们做点什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Has anyone polished Monsieur Necraloid lately? It does not seem so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 最近有人给殁世械灵先生抛光过吗？好像没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Monsieur Loid may seem hérissé to some, but to me, he seems… sad. Il y a en lui une profonde solitude…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 洛德先生对某些人来说可能看起来很 hérissé，但对我来说，他似乎……很悲伤。Il ya en lui une profonde solitude……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I would ask who that devil believed he was - but he has no problem telling anyone who will listen. At length.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想问问那个恶魔自认为是谁——他居然能毫不犹豫地逢人便讲，而且讲得滔滔不绝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do love all of the jouets and bibelots in this futur étrange!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我非常喜欢这个 futur étrange 中的所有小玩意和小摆设！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Look at all you come wearing, so fanciful. Tellement amusant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 瞧瞧你这身打扮，真是太奇特了！太有趣了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The strange woman I have seen - the Lotus? She… unnerves me. And makes my heart ache. I do not understand why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我见过的那个奇怪的女人——Lotus？她……让我感到不安，也让我心痛。我不知道为什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ah, allow me to explain - a Sœur of Sol and your strange weapons, oui? When Monsieur Loid spoke of the Old War and the souvenirs from within, it reminded me of the sagas of the Luminaries - of the monks who would hone their souls to blades. This, I know. And this? I can teach. Come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊，请允许我解释一下——一位太阳神修女和你那些奇特的武器，oui？当洛德先生谈起远古之战及其遗留的物品时，我便想起了双耀神教的传奇故事——那些将灵魂磨砺成利刃的僧侣。这个，我懂。至于这个？我可以教。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Behold; COGRON the Hammer of Unairu. Once hidden in the Void, now it is yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看哪，这就是 Unairu 之锤——克戎。它曾隐藏在虚空中，如今已属于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: NIDRI the Vazarin Staff is now yours, but beware - gifts of the Void must be carefully wielded. Merci, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 义决，这个 Vazarin 之杖现在是你的了，但要小心——虚空的馈赠必须谨慎使用。Merci，里昂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Il revient sain et sauf! And with THARA, the bow of the Madurai! Thank you, Sol, for these blessings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Il revient sain et sauf! 以及 Madurai 之弓狂勇！感谢太阳神赐予的这些祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: He bears LORAK, the grimoire of Zenurik! I pray it did not whisper to you, Father Lyon. Such secrets are périlleux.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他带着落书，Zenurik 的魔典！里昂神父，我祈祷它没有对你低语。这样的秘密是 périlleux 的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: VEXORIC, the Naramon Blade! Returned to us like a ballad of olden times, come to life! Rest now, Lyon, dearest brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 断命，Naramon 之刃！如同古老的歌谣般重现人间，焕发新生！安息吧，里昂，我最亲爱的兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your uncertainties have ended. His have not. That is why Lyon must be the one to make this journey. Lyon, return to us with the mighty Hammer of Unairu!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你的疑虑已经消除，他的疑虑却依然存在。因此，里昂必须是踏上这段旅程的人。里昂，带着强大的 Unairu 之锤回来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Father Lyon knows the shifting horrors of the Void… that path is well-worn for him. Go, Lyon - find in its mists the Staff of Vazarin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 里昂神父深知虚空……变幻莫测的恐怖，这条路对他来说早已驾轻就熟。去吧，里昂——在迷雾中寻找 Vazarin 之杖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: One must fly like the arrow to find the Bow of Madurai, or so the Scriptures tell us. Lyon, mon frère, le Néant est dangereux.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 圣经上说，人必须像箭一样飞翔才能找到 Madurai 之弓。里昂，mon frère，le Néant est dangereux。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: In the Void, it seems the knowledge of all possibilities still lives, n'est-ce pas? And those forbidden words are written on the pages of the Grimoire of Zenurik. Father Lyon - the time is nigh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在虚空中，似乎所有可能性的知识依然存在，不是吗？而那些禁忌之语，就写在 Zenurik 魔典的字里行间。里昂神父——时候将至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: As we would cleave the Void, so you would do with your enemies, n'est-ce pas? Lyon, they seek the Sword of Naramon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 就像我们劈开虚空一样，你也会对付你的敌人，不是吗？里昂，他正在寻找 Naramon 之剑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Keep your demons to yourself, Roathe! Lest you are once more goading me into a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 管好你的恶魔们，罗瑟！别再挑衅我打架了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do not blame me. They are like kavats - drawn to the person they know they will annoy the most.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 别怪我。他们就像库娃一样——总被最能惹恼他们的人吸引。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Must you incessantly be the source of noise, Marie? I am trying to think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 玛丽，你非得不停地制造噪音吗？我正在思考。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I know your wounds are precious to you, Lyon. But you should let me tend to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我知道你的伤口对你来说很珍贵，里昂。但你应该让我来处理它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: When Lua wept, did Sol offer to sear those seeping eyes shut?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 当月神哭泣时，太阳神是否提议要灼烧那渗泪的眼眸直至闭合？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Careful with that tail, Devil, or I may tie a knot in it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔，小心你的尾巴，不然我就要把它打个结了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: And if you wake with a shaven head, Marie, you will know why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 玛丽，如果你醒来时发现自己被剃了光头，你就知道为什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: By Sol I bless the day and all its labours!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以太阳神的名义，我祝福这一天以及所有的劳作！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: By Lua I bless the night and all its respite!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以月神之名，我祝福黑夜及其所带来的宁静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: By the Void I wish these two would shut up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以虚空之名，我真希望这两个人能闭嘴。
