/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Confession is good for the soul, Devil. What burdens you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔，坦白对灵魂有益。你有什么烦心事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Besides the leaden monotony of this wretched existence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 除了这可悲生活的沉闷单调？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your existence will cease one day, and that is a comfort to all of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你的存在终将逐渐消逝，这对于我们所有人来说都是种安慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Marie, this burden should have been mine alone. I never meant you to be dragged down with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 玛丽，这份重担本该由我独自承担。我从未想过要将你拖入深渊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: "Dragged down," he says! I would have followed you willingly into Hell, my brother!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "被拖下地狱了！"他说道！我的兄弟，我本愿意跟随你下地狱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Tenno have endured much. It is a blessing that we never saw the depravity of Orokin society with our own eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno 历经了太多磨难。幸而我们从未亲眼目睹奥罗金社会的堕落，实属万幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, you could never have survived in our time. Your sanctimony would have fizzled like a teardrop on a hot coal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，你绝不可能在我们那个时代生存下来。你的伪善会像热煤上的泪珠一样瞬间蒸发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: "Lo, for all his pride the devil has fallen, and hears no more the caterwauling of his witches."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "看啊，恶魔纵然骄傲，终究坠落，再也听不见他的女巫们的哀嚎。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Witches were said to kiss the Devil's arse. Would you care to, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 据说女巫会热脸贴恶魔的冷屁股。玛丽，你愿意试试吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Je vais te BOTTER le cul, sale maudit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Je vais te BOTTER le cul，sale maudit！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I pray these eyes will one day look upon Lua again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我祈祷这双眼睛有朝一日能再次凝望月球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: They will, Lyon. Remain constant and everchanging, just as she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他们会的，里昂。他们会像她一样，既保持不变又不断变化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I know you two aren't exactly up on current events, but Lua is even more shattered than Lyon. Who only has one eye, by the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我知道你们俩不太关注时事，不过月球的状况甚至比里昂还要破碎。顺便一提，里昂只有一只眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So valiant in the war against sin, and yet so obstinately determined never to commit any of their own. Whatever happened to 'know your enemy'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在对抗罪恶的战争中如此英勇，却又如此顽固地决不犯下任何罪行。那句"知己知彼"的箴言究竟去了哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Our enemy whispers constantly in our ear, Devil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们的敌人不断在我们耳边低语：恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What's it like, knowing that we broke your deity open like an egg and gutted her for riches?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 知道我们像敲鸡蛋般打破你的神明，掏空她获取财富时，那是什么滋味？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Would that your words alone could cause me pain, Roathe. Though I understand why you seek to cause me strife, and I pity you for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 但愿你的言语能让我痛苦，罗瑟。虽然我明白你为何要挑拨我，为此我甚至同情你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Indifference, while no god, is an enemy to be understood, like any other. Quantify it. Comprehend it. And then we can hurt it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虚空无情之物不是神，却如其他敌人般值得理解。量化它。洞悉它。而后我们才能击溃它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Madden a beast with pain and it will know only rage, Devil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔，用痛苦激怒野兽，它只会知道愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The devil only dreams of tormenting others. How true to type.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔只想着折磨他人。多么符合本性啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The pair of you think I have no conscience at all, no soul. Your arrogance amuses me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你们两个以为我毫无良知，没有灵魂。你们的傲慢真让我觉得好笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What good is a conscience if it is never permitted to speak?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 良知若永远不被允许发声，又有什么用？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The devil must humble himself before something greater than he, if he can come to recognize such a thing exists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果恶魔能够认识到比自己更伟大的事物存在，那么他就必须在它面前谦卑自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Why is it you spend so much time speaking with the Cavia, Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 罗瑟，你为何总花这么多时间和科维兽交谈？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hm? Why, they are the only intelligent souls in this dreary place, Priest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯？为什么吗，神父，这破地方就剩他们这几个聪明的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What do you hope to find at the bottom of this… Dark Refractory, Devil?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔，你希望在这……深溯池的深处找到什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I seek that which was taken from me. The only god worth worshipping, Marie - knowledge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我追寻那被夺走之物。玛丽，唯一值得膜拜的神明——知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I cannot tell who is more insufferably dull, Lyon. You or Albrecht's butler. Best be careful, or they might mistake you for that dusty furniture you've collected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 里昂，实在难以分辨谁更无聊到令人难以忍受——是你，还是阿尔布雷希特的管家。最好当心点，否则他们可能会把你当成你收藏的那些积满灰尘的家具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do not mistake my decision to withhold words for my inability to use them. It is called "restraint." Perhaps you should look into it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不要把我的沉默不语误解为我缺乏表达能力。这叫作"克制"。或许你该好好研究一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We should invite Monsieur Loid and the Cavia for Solstice celebrations, Lyon! I think it would be quite wonderful, non?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 里昂，我们应该邀请洛德先生和科维兽来参加仲冬节庆典！我觉得那会非常棒，non？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You are right. I believe they might enjoy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你说得对。我相信他们可能会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Well, if you're asking my opinion, I would rather put a blade in my thigh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯，要问我的意见，我宁可往大腿上插把刀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No one was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 没人问你的意见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am so disappointed in how far this future has fallen. So… superstitious. Almost worse than these two relics of the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我对这个未来的堕落程度深感失望。如此……迷信。简直比这两个老古董还糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hold still, Devil - I will make you a relic, yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 别动，恶魔——我一定会把你变成古董。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: One thing I will give that idiotic ingrate Albrecht and his experiments - the Void is terribly useful for finding ways to create endless amounts of… rooms. Too bad they doomed us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有一点我得承认，那个愚蠢又忘恩负义的阿尔布雷希特和他那些实验倒真有那么一点用——虚空在创造无穷无尽的……房间方面简直妙不可言。 可惜他们把我们都害惨了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ça demanderait au moins le Néant pour faire place à quelque chose d'aussi grand que ta fierté, espèce de grosse bouse de vache!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Ça demanderait au moins le Néant pour faire place à quelque chose d'aussi grand que ta fierté, espèce de grosse bouse de vache！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Forgive me, Drifter - but I have to say… non. Now, go. I have prayers to attend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恕我直言，漂泊者——但我得说……不行。现在，你走吧。我还要去参加祈祷会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: While you may believe me one to enjoy abuse - this is not the kind I favor. No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你或许以为我享受虐待——但这种方式绝非我所好。一点都不喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I would rather bed Albrecht.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我宁愿和阿尔布雷希特上床。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oui! Oh, my wolf, I thought you would never ask…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Oui！哦，我的狼，我还以为你永远不会问呢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you had asked me the odds, I would have placed the likelihood of Lua herself stepping from the Void to greet us… I do not know what else to say, except for simply… yes, mon miracle…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 若你问我有多少把握，我会说月神本人从虚空现身迎接我们的可能性会更大……除此之外，我实在不知该说什么，只能简单地说……是的，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Well my pet… then I say we show these fools what real sin is about, what say you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好吧，我的宠物……那我说我们就让这些傻瓜见识一下真正的罪恶是什么，你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh! Par la grâce de Sol! Are you certain?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦！ Par la grâce de Sol！你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Who paid you? Roathe? Tagfer? Wait. This is… This is not a joke? Are you serious?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有人给你钱吗？罗瑟？标弃？等等。这……这不是玩笑？你是认真的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Someone finally shows a little bit of class around here! But I am not a devil to be trifled with lightly, Drifter. Are you so certain you know what you are getting yourself into?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 终于有人有点品位了！不过，漂泊者，我可不是好惹的。你确定你知道自己在干什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Have you made up your mind, this time? I do not wish to be petulant, but I am not going to forgive you a third time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这次你下定决心了吗？我不想耍脾气，但我不会第三次原谅你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I had prayed to Lua you might change your mind… the days have not been kind in your absence…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我曾向月神祈祷，希望你回心转意……你不在的日子里，我过的并不好……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Very well, but if you believe me to be just some Kaithe you can hitch off to a post whenever you are bored, think again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好吧，但如果你觉得我只是个你腻了就能丢在一旁的绝灵骥，那就大错特错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I… very well? You must take the time to make up your mind. I will be here when you do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我……好吧？你必须花时间做决定。等你决定好，我会在这里等你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I - I - Sérieusement?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我——我——Sérieusement？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes, of course. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是的，当然。我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tell me this is another tragic vision of mine, please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请告诉我，这又是我的一场悲剧幻觉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bother me when you make up your mind, then. Madder than the priest…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 等你想清楚了再来烦我吧。你比那个神父还疯……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh this is rich! You must be kidding me! Are you really ending this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，这太离谱了！你一定是在开玩笑吧！你真的要结束这一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have always found it rather morbidly fascinating that the more souls who died, the more elaborate the rewards for those who didn't. Rather antithetical to the goal of peace, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我一直觉得这件事既病态又有趣：死的人越多，活下来的反而赚得更多。这与和平的目标背道而驰，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What did the war feel like, being able to pop in and out of those little wind-up toys of yours, free from most threats of real death? And now I am one of those toys…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 战争是什么感觉，能像进出你那些发条玩具般自由，远离真正的死亡威胁？而如今，我竟成了其中一件玩具……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, yes, send the Void-traumatized children off to war - really, and Ballas was surprised when this went awry…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，是啊，把那些受到虚空创伤的孩子们送上战场——说真的，当事情搞砸了，Ballas 居然还感到惊讶……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It is tradition for you to be draped in silk when you receive these. However, I believe you murdered the last Orokin who tried that, so we'll skip that part if it's all the same to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 按照传统，你应当披着丝绸接受这些物品。不过，我相信你杀掉了最后一位试图这么做的奥罗金人，所以如果你不介意的话，我们还是跳过这一环节吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have never quite understood the desire to wear remembrances of the worst moments in one's life, but… very well, as you wish, soldier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我一直不明白为什么有人渴望佩戴铭记人生最黑暗时刻的信物，不过……好吧，随你便，士兵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How much gold does blood buy, Tenno? A question to which only soldiers know the answer. It comes to me just before dawn. You?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Tenno，鲜血能换多少黄金？这个问题只有士兵知道答案。这种问题会在黎明将至时出现在我的脑海里。你也是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Have you ever wondered, for whom are these intended? To commemorate our victories for ourselves, or for others? A sign to those who wander near - danger: for I have killed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你有没有想过，这些究竟为谁而设？是为纪念我们自身的胜利，还是为他人而立？还是向游荡者示警——危险：我杀过人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sometimes I wonder if I had such medallions from the past, if I would not have so easily forgotten so much of it when Entrati rammed the serum into my throat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有时我忍不住想，要是我还拥有过那些往日的勋章，当英择谛将血清灌入我喉咙时，我是不是就不会如此轻易地遗忘那么多往事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: For what it is worth, I am quite glad I never had to stand against the Tenno. I do appreciate having my limbs attached to my body.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 说实话，我很庆幸自己从未与 Tenno 正面交锋。我很感激我的四肢还长在我的身体上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: As you wish… mon cœur...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如你所愿……mon cœur……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I… am disappointed, but not surprised…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我……很失望，但并不意外……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Suit yourself! Go dally with one of the others, they'll bore you soon enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 随你便！去和其他人约会吧，他们很快就会让你觉得无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This little folie of yours ends now, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 漂泊者，你的这场小闹剧到此结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What an utter fool I am. Perhaps Roathe is correct, after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我真是个彻头彻尾的蠢货。或许罗瑟说得对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The devil can forgive much yet he has his limits… and you have found them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔可以宽恕很多事，但他也有他的底线……而你已经触及了他的底线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Gauche, droite - haut, bas! Pick one, please!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Gauche, droite——haut，bas！选一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tragic, is it not? That I could be given such futile hope so easily?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 多么悲哀啊，不是吗？我竟能如此轻信了这虚妄的希望？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: By the Void you are as insufferably mad as that priest, you know that? Make up your damnable mind!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以虚空之名起誓，你和那个神父一样疯得令人无法忍受，你知道吗？你他妈的赶紧下定决心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This is the place you made for yourself? A whole world. My wolf, oh my wolf… what a marvel you are…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这就是你为自己创造的地方？一个完整的世界。我的狼，哦，我的狼……你真是个奇迹……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I know this place… became a Hell for you, mon cœur. And for that, my heart weeps. But I see in it such beauty. I see these people you have fashioned and I… I only wish to comfort them in my arms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我知道这个地方……对你来说已是炼狱，mon cœur。为此，我的心在哭泣。但我从中也看到了美好的事物。我看到了你一手塑造的这些人，我……只想将他们拥入怀中，好好安慰他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Someday, I would like to meet this Dominus Thrax. D'un garnement à l'autre. I think your little Marie could talk some sense into him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 总有一天，我想见见这位士魂大帝。D'un garnement à l'autre。我想你家的小玛丽或许能劝劝他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, my wolf… I hope you have not given up hope for this… this monde merveilleux. It is a part of you, and I find that I cannot help but fall in love with it so completely. I do not wish to say goodbye to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，我的狼……我希望你还没有放弃这……奇妙的世界。它是你的一部分，而我发现自己情不自禁地深深爱上了它。我不想和它说再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Can we stay here but just a little longer? It is as though I am wrapped up in your very soul, and I… I find I do not wish to leave, mon cœur. Besides - This one over here has not finished telling their story.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们能再待一会儿吗？我仿佛被你的灵魂包裹着，我……发现自己不想离开，mon cœur。再说——这位还没讲完她的故事呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not know if the others will ever come to forgive le Cardinal for what he must do in his crusade against the Indifference… but I can only hope that Sol hears my prayers, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不知道其他人是否会原谅主教在对抗虚空无情之物的圣战中所做的一切……但我只能希望太阳神能听到我的祈祷，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: In all these books, these scrolls - I read the words of a man torn in half by duty and love. I do not see a man made of callous hatred and malcontent. I hope some day the others can come to see this too, my wolf…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在所有这些书籍、这些卷轴中——我读到的是一个被责任和爱撕裂的男人的文字。我没有看到一个冷酷无情、充满仇恨和不满的人。我希望有一天其他人也能明白这一点，我的狼……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What a beautiful place this is. A place of study, of learning, of repose and above all, purpose. Le Cardinal leads a crusade. And we, my wolf, are but his soldiers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 多么美丽的地方啊！这里是学习、求知、休憩，更重要的是，是实现目标的地方。主教正在发动一场十字军东征。而我们，我的狼，不过是他的士兵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Who are we to question a genius such as le Cardinal? Look at all he has built - all he has made. I see the Sanctum… the Vessels. When he calls, we must follow, mon cœur. Wherever he may go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们怎敢质疑主教这样的天才？看看他所建造的一切——他所创造的一切。我看到了圣所……和承载体。当他召唤时，我们必须追随，我的心。无论他去往何方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It breaks my heart to think that le Cardinal cannot forgive himself for what harm he has left in his wake. He is trying to save all of creation against a god most terrible. Against Indifference itself. Of course he can be forgiven… certainly no price is too steep, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想到主教无法原谅自己所造成的伤害，我心如刀绞。他试图拯救整个世界，对抗一个极其可怕的神，对抗虚空无情之物本身。他当然可以被原谅……任何代价都不算太高，n'est-ce pas？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, mon cœur… What a fool I was, to think le Cardinal above all reproach. I cannot dismiss all the good he did - all the kindness he showed me and others. But neither can I dismiss the cruelty and harm he showed others…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，mon cœur……我真是个傻瓜，竟然认为主教完美无瑕。我无法抹杀他所做的一切好事——他对我和其他人展现的善意。但我也无法抹杀他对别人造成的残酷和伤害……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I can only pray to Sol that someday… somehow… we might find Entrati. That I might speak to him and tell him that I can forgive him. Though I do not know if he can ever forgive himself…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我只能向太阳神祈祷，希望有朝一日……以某种方式……我们能找到英择谛。希望我能和他说话，告诉他我能原谅他。虽然我不知道他是否能原谅自己……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Thank you, mon cœur, for being patient with me. Your little Marie was being stubborn, I admit. I wished to hold on to what little hope I could that le Cardinal was a bastion of good in this world. Aah, I should have known, nothing is ever so simple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Mon cœur，谢谢你对我的耐心。我承认，你的小玛丽确实有点固执。我当时还抱有一丝希望，希望主教是这世间善良的化身。唉，我早该知道，事情远没有那么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do hope that Entrati can find reason enough to return to us - if only for the sake of his daughter and Monsieur Loid. They miss him so terribly… and it pains me to see love so ripped in half, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我真心希望英择谛能找到一个足够的理由回到我们身边——哪怕仅仅是为了他的女儿和洛德先生。他们非常想念他……看到他们的爱被撕成两半，我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What a day it will be, if le Cardinal returns to us in the Sanctum, my wolf. I look forward to it, yet… I do worry that M'sieur Tagfer may bite Entrati in le derrière if we do not watch him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果主教能回到圣所，回到我们身边，那该是多么美好的一天啊，我的狼！我无比期待，不过……我担心如果我们不看好标弃先生，他可能会咬英择谛的屁股。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, my heart soars to see this! How it reminds me of home - of the marketplaces of la Cité de la Lumière. So much has changed, yet the laughter - the laughter is the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看到这些，我真是心花怒放！这让我想起了家乡——光城的集市。虽然一切都变了，但笑声——那笑声依旧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I hear a name they praise - the Unum - is this their god? Quelle magnificence! I thank the Unum for this beautiful place. For these wonderful people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我听到他们赞美一个名字——乌努母神——这就是他们的神吗？多么壮丽！我感谢乌努母神赐予这美丽的地方，感谢这些美好的人们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How I could sit and spend all day learning their ways and culture, mon cœur, but then you would have none of me for yourself, I think!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我多么希望能够整天坐在那里，了解他们的生活方式和文化，mon cœur，但那样的话，我想你就得不到我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: There is so much life in this future, my wolf! So much happiness yet to be shared! Thank you for bringing me to this place. Merci, merci, merci!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的狼，未来充满了无限可能！还有很多快乐等着我们去分享！谢谢你带我来到这里。Merci，merci，merci！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tonight, I will light the candles and thank Sol for the people of Cetus, and I think I will thank the Unum as well. We are so small, in the end. Who am I to say they are not siblings, or that they are not one and the same?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 今晚，我将点燃蜡烛，感谢太阳神赐予希图斯的人民，我想我也会感谢乌努母神。归根结底，我们如此渺小。我又有什么资格说他们不是兄弟姐妹，或者他们不是一体的呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The whispers are strongest here… I can feel it - the voices, pressing against my mind, yearning to be free. How could you stand it for so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这里低语声最强烈……我能感觉到——那些声音，压迫着我的心灵，渴望获得自由。你怎么能忍受这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, mon miracle… to think of the terror, the agony, you suffered here. It breaks my heart to know what you endured…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，mon miracle……想到你在这里遭受的恐惧和痛苦，我的心都碎了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It is beautiful, in its own right - the shifting fabric of the Void. I could lose myself, I think, staring into it. Do not let me, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 它本身就很美——虚空变幻莫测的织锦。我想，凝视着它，我可能会迷失自我。亲爱的，别让我迷失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I can hear the laughter of children. I can see the smiles of their parents gazing down at them. And I can see those smiles turning to grins of malice… the laughter turning to screams. I- Oh, Lua… So much blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我能听到孩子们的笑声。我能看到他们父母俯视着他们时脸上的笑容。然后，我看到那些笑容变成了恶意的狞笑……笑声变成了尖叫。我——哦，月神……好多血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What does it matter if the Indifference is a god or not, mon miracle? What matters is what it has forced you all to endure. And for that… it shall suffer in turn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: mon miracle，虚空无情之物是不是神又有什么关系呢？重要的是它强迫你们所有人承受了什么。为此……它必将遭受同样的苦难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mon miracle - pardon. Wait. I do not understand. We are… on Lua? We are standing upon Lua. Right now? Huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Mon miracle——等等。我不明白。我们……在月球上？我们居然站在月球上。此时此刻？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Orokin had no respect for this place, did they? I suppose that is the way of humanity - to reshape all things in their own image…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 奥罗金人对这地方毫无尊重，不是吗？我想这就是人类的本性——按照自己的意愿重塑万物……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I had wondered if coming here would not spur on some great revelation. Some holy vision. A revival of faith. It is… never so simple, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我曾想，来到这里会不会带来某种伟大的启示，某种神圣的异象，某种信仰的复兴。然而……事情远没有那么简单，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To think, I now stand upon Lua. Lua herself. A place I can now visit as one might visit the shoreline. It still seems to me as though all this is all a dream, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想想看，我现在竟然站在月球上。月球本身。我可以像去海边一样去那里。这一切对我来说仍然像是一场梦，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It feels right that this place is now cold and empty. If you had brought me here when it was bustling and full of life, as Roathe says it once was - I might have wept in sorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如今这里一片冰冷空旷，感觉这样才对。如果当初你带我来这里的时候，就像罗瑟说的那样，这里曾经熙熙攘攘、生机勃勃——我或许会伤心落泪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Now these garnements, I would know anywhere, by any faces or names! Your little Marie grew up on the streets, do not forget. And it seems, so much has not changed with time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这些衣服，我无论走到哪里，无论谁穿，都能认出来！别忘了，你的小玛丽是在街头长大的。看来，很多东西随着时间的流逝都没有改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Their language is so strange to me, but then again - mine would be so strange to them, non? There is one language that speaks above all others, I think. Hardship. And that we both knew so very well in our young years, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他们的语言对我来说如此陌生，但转念一想——我的语言对他们来说也一定很陌生，不是吗？我想，有一种语言凌驾于其他所有语言之上，那就是苦难。而我们俩在年轻的时候都对此深有体会，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I would ask to try their floating boards but - I hardly have the need, do I? I would have adored one back before my inconveniences were solved, non? To think… I could have had des pieds métalliques instead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我本来想试试他们的悬浮滑板，但是——我几乎没必要，对吧？要不是之前我腿脚不便，我肯定会很喜欢这个的，non？想想……我本来可以有 pieds métalliques 的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How different my life would have been, if I grew up here on this far-flung world and not on the streets of la Cité de la Lumière. Yet I see their faces, and I… see the faces of Hugo. Of Vitor. Eugénie. Madeline. Oh, my wolf… it is always the smallest who suffer most.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果我不是在光城的街头长大，而是在这遥远的世界长大，我的人生该有多么不同啊。然而，我仿佛看到了他们的脸庞，看到了雨果的脸庞，看到了维托的脸庞，看到了欧仁妮的脸庞，看到了玛德琳的脸庞。哦，我的狼……最弱小的人，却总是承受着最大的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This artwork… do you think they will sell us some? I would like to hang it on the wall by our devil. I think it will annoy him greatly. Yes, I think it will annoy him very much indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这幅画作……你觉得他们会卖给我们一些吗？我想把它挂在我们家恶魔旁边的墙上。我觉得它会让他非常恼火。没错，我觉得它肯定会让他非常恼火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This place… is so familiar, mon miracle. It is not quite the same - the ship, it was not here. But the water… the mist… this is a place within the Void that lives within the mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这个地方……如此熟悉，mon miracle。它并不完全一样——那艘船，它不在这里。但那水……那雾气……这是虚空中的一个地方，存在于心灵之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I met Rell and his Harrow here once. We did not speak. We did not need to. I simply felt them there beside me, as I always did. I wish I could tell you what it was like, to share everything with another soul. I wish I could do the same with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我曾在这里遇见 Rell 和他的 Harrow。我们没有说话，也不需要说话。我只是像往常一样，感觉到他们就在我身边。我多么希望能够告诉你那种感觉，与另一个灵魂分享一切。我多么希望也能与你分享这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I feel a great grief in this place. Someone here… lost those they cared for. I know not their name, I know not for whom they fought. But I can feel their tears. I pray to Lua they find peace…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我在这片土地上感受到了深深的悲痛。这里有人……失去了她们所爱的人。我不知道她们的名字，也不知道她们为谁而战。但我能感受到她们的泪水。我向月神祈祷，愿她们安息……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: There is a vast… emptiness that reaches through the darkness. It seeks to snuff the light from the stars themselves like so many candles… But I do not know if it does so with a mind behind it. Or if that is simply its nature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 黑暗中弥漫着一片浩瀚的……空虚。它试图熄灭星辰的光芒，如同熄灭无数蜡烛……但我不知道它这样做是否出于某种意志，或者这仅仅是它的本性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Beneath the sadness here, there is a serenity. The kiss of death. Lua took many souls home to their rest from this place. So similar, yet so dissimilar from the lake I knew…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 悲伤之下，却藏着一份宁静、一个死亡之吻。月神从这里带走了许多灵魂，让他们安息。这与我所熟知的湖泊如此相似，却又如此不同……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Is this truly all that has been left of us, my love? All our greatness, all our opulence? Good. With it came nothing but a deeper rot that poisoned this system. We can only hope it spared Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的爱人，这就是我们剩下的东西吗？而我们所有的伟大，我们所有的富足？很好。这些带来的，只有更深的腐朽，还毒害了这个星系。我们只能希望，Tau 能幸免于难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To think, a Sentient spy hid all of this away in the Void for untold centuries. I cannot help but wonder if the love she felt for the Tenno was her own, or instead the echoes of poor dead Margulis, simmering through her programming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想想看，一个 Sentient 间谍竟然把这一切都藏在虚空中无数个世纪。我不禁怀疑，她对 Tenno 的爱究竟是出自她自己的，还是那个死去的可怜 Margulis 的灵魂在她程序中回荡？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Here lies the Orokin Empire; smashed to pieces. Little use except to be scrapped and sold for parts. How odd, to stand upon the grave of your entire era, knowing you are one of the very few who survived…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这里曾是奥罗金国的坟墓，如今已支离破碎。除了被拆解成零件来卖之外，已无其他用处。站在自己整个时代的坟墓上，知道自己是极少数的幸存者之一，这感觉真是奇妙……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I truly did believe I could save the Orokin. I believed I could remove the Executors and lead them to true greatness. Seeing this? I know… how much of a fool I was, beloved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我真的相信我能拯救奥罗金人。我真的相信我能铲除执行者，带领他们走向真正的伟大。直到看到这一切？亲爱的，我才知道……我是多么愚蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Was all of this a mistake, in the end? The Orokin, the Void, the Sentients, Tau… What was it all for? Destruction? Death? Where will this all lead us in the end? At least I will have you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这一切最终都是个错误吗？奥罗金、虚空、Sentient、Tau……这一切究竟是为了什么？毁灭？死亡？这一切最终会把我们引向何方？至少我还有你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Look at all that is left of us, my love… our great empire, laid so low. Rendered to rubble. Melted down for parts. Disgusting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的爱人，看看我们都剩下什么……我们伟大的帝国，如今已沦为废墟。化为瓦砾。熔化成零件。真恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How strange, to visit the grave of one's own greatness. To stand and witness the aftermath of all that you worked to build tall. Yet they are all dead, and… I am not. What higher victory is there than that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 来到自己辉煌的坟墓前，着实奇怪。站在这里，目睹自己毕生的心血化为乌有。然而他们都死了，而……我还活着。还有什么比这更高的胜利呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What a waste of resources it was, to hide this all away in the Void. I wonder if the Lotus sees now what she could have done with what she had in her hands - she could have ruled this system as her own. Exterminated all the threats you now face. Not that I am complaining, mind. As I am one of said threats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 把这一切都藏在虚空里，真是浪费资源。我不知道 Lotus 现在是否明白，利用她当初拥有的一切，她能做到什么——她本可以统治这个星系，将你们现在面临的所有威胁都消灭掉。当然，我可不是在抱怨，因为我自己就是这些威胁之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I wonder how much of this could still be repurposed, given enough time and effort… Oh, do not look at me like that. You give me plenty enough to do. I was merely thinking aloud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想知道，如果投入足够的时间和精力，这些东西有多少还能重新利用……哦，别那样看着我。你已经给我安排了够多的事了。我只是自言自语而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I believed, to the end, that the Orokin could be salvaged. That it was the Executors who were in need of removal. Not this. Not all… this. What a waste…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我始终相信，奥罗金人还有救。真正需要清除的是那些执行者。而不是他们。不是这一切……真是浪费……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Before you ask, no. I do not know from whence the Infestation came. None of us did. Yet we still sought to twist it to our own devices-wield it like we understood what it truly was. Oh, my love - what fools we were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在你问之前，我先回答，不。我不知道 Infestation 是从哪里来的。我们谁也不知道。然而，我们仍尝试利用它——假装我们真正了解它。哦，我的爱人——我们真是愚蠢至极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Humans. Pretending to be gods. Scratching at greatness. Tangling ourselves up with nightmares we could not even begin to comprehend. And through it all, I think what offends me the most? Our sheer callous dismissal that we should even deign to pay it the briefest glimmer of respect…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 人类。妄图成为神明。徒劳地追求伟大。最终却深陷于我们根本无法理解的噩梦之中。而这一切之中，最令我愤慨的是什么？是我们冷酷无情地漠视它，甚至连一丝一毫的尊重都不屑一顾……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To think my body now shares more in common with that twisted shape than it did with my former self. I admit, I do think we both rather enjoy the tail, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想想看，现在的我竟然比以前的自己更像那些扭曲的身形。我承认，我觉得我们俩都挺喜欢这条尾巴的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How childish we were, throwing the Infestation at the Sentients as if we understood the first thing about what it really was. Followed by Ballas' experiments with the Warframes and… well, you see where it all promptly took us - straight to Hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们当时真是太幼稚了，竟然把 Infestation 扔向 Sentient，搞得好像我们真的了解它似的。再加上 Ballas 对战甲的实验，以及……嗯，你们也看到了，这一切最终把我们带到了哪里——直接送进了地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Waking up on the steps of that blasted Cathedral, my body wracked in pain… I cursed Albrecht with all that I had. Now? I think I rather like what the Infestation has done to me. You have yet to complain…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 醒来的时候，我发现自己躺在那座破教堂的台阶上，浑身疼痛难忍……我用尽全力诅咒阿尔布雷希特。现在呢？我觉得 Infestation 对我的影响其实还挺不错。你还没抱怨过呢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Infestation. It was here before us, and I suspect it may very well be here after us, love. If only we had learned to properly harness it… Truly wield it. Think on what we could have achieved?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Infestation。亲爱的，它在我们之前就已存在，而且我怀疑它很可能在我们之后依然存在。如果我们当初学会正确驾驭它……真正地运用它……想想我们本可以取得怎样的成就？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What a revelation that the Infestation transcends time itself. Think of all the possibilities this unlocks for us! The levers and switches that are now ours to tinker with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Infestation 竟然超越了时间本身，这真是个惊人的发现！想想这为我们开启了多少可能性！我们现在可以随意操控这些机关和开关了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It does not trouble you that I now have as much in common with this… growth as I do with you? Though you do spend a great deal of time within Warframes… I suppose turnabout is fair play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 现在我和你一样，都和这……生长物有着共同之处，你难道不觉得困扰吗？不过你倒是常年待在战甲里……算是互相扯平了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You have told me of an Infested "guitar" that speaks? What I would not give to study such a fascinating thing… Perhaps someday, my love, you will introduce us. And then all Hell will truly break loose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你曾跟我说过有一把会说话的 Infested"吉他"？我好想研究一下这件迷人的东西……或许有一天，亲爱的，你会介绍我们认识。到那时，地狱之门才会真正打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: When I awoke in that backwater, forsaken spithole, my body twisted and warped… I cursed Albrecht for what he had done. Now? I think I rather enjoy what the Infestation has done to me. I think you rather do, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 当我在那偏僻荒凉的鬼地方醒来时，我的身体早已变得扭曲变形……我诅咒阿尔布雷希特对我所做的一切。可现在？我觉得我还挺享受 Infestation 对我的改造。我想你也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ooh, somewhere we might truly be alone… naughty wolf. Sshh! Do you feel something? I do not know as we are not as alone as we may think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，或许在某个地方，我们可以真正独处……淘气的狼。嘘！你感觉到什么了吗？我觉得这里可能不止有我们在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your Ordis! He is tres mignon! I do not think he has met a protoframe before, non? The questions he asked me - very inappropriate. And very humorous. I think I adore him, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你家的 Ordis！他真是太可爱了！我想他以前应该没见过原型战甲吧？他问我的问题——非常不合时宜，但也非常幽默。我想我爱上他了，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, mon cœur. What a beautiful place this is, with such a wonderful view of the sky. A long way away from the cryptes, n'est-ce pas? But I would come to miss my Lyon, and… even our devil, though do not tell him I said that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，mon cœur。这地方真美，天空景色美极了。离地下墓穴可真够远的，n'est-ce pas？但我会想念我的里昂，还有……甚至想念我们的恶魔，不过别告诉他我这么说过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Zariman… Duviri… This place… your home in the past… Now I know why they call you "the Drifter," my wolf. I wonder, where will you make your home next, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 扎里曼号……双衍王境……这个地方……你过去的家……现在我明白为什么他们叫你"漂泊者"了，我的狼。我想知道，你的下一个家会在哪里呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I could grow quite the garden here, I think. Would you mind? Some roses - some lilacs - some nightshade. Hm. Do those exist in this time, anymore? I suppose not! You must have new flowers to grow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我觉得我可以在这里种个不错的花园。你介意吗？种些玫瑰，些丁香，还有一些龙葵。嗯……这些植物现在还有吗？我想应该没有吧！你肯定有新的花可以种！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: "Why?" I asked him when he gave me the serum. He did not answer. I find the question repeating in my head now. I may never know. I suppose I should cease to care. It brought me to you, after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "为什么？"他给我血清的时候，我问他。他没有回答。现在，这个问题一直在我的脑海里回响。我可能永远也不会知道答案。我想我应该不再在意了。毕竟，是它把我带到了你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Redemption. For which one of us, Albrecht? Am I simply another test subject?! Look at me, my love - shouting at statues…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 救赎。说的究竟是我们中的哪一个，阿尔布雷希特？难道我只是你另一个实验对象吗？！看看我，我的爱人——居然在对着一些雕像大喊大叫……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How much of our suffering, my love - yours, and mine - can be attributed to this one man? I am merely fooling myself. My path was set long before this bastard wandered into it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 亲爱的，我们——你和我——所遭受的苦难，究竟有多少要归咎于这一个人？我只是在自欺欺人。早在这个混蛋闯入我的生活之前，我的人生道路就已经注定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: He offered me a chance to survive. A chance to run from the doomed Orokin Empire and live - simply live. Had I known you were waiting for me here, my love? I would not have hesitated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他给了我一次活命的机会。一次逃离注定毁灭的奥罗金帝国的机会——仅仅是活着。要是当时我知道你在这里等我，我的爱人？我绝不会犹豫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I stand here and find the cause to remark upon how disparate our lives have been, my love. Yet somehow, we have yet been entwined together and find ourselves standing here, in this impossible place… because of him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的爱人，我站在这里，不禁感叹我们的人生是多么迥异。然而不知为何，我们却交织在一起，因为他，我们才能站在这里，站在这个不可思议的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: He may have tried to turn me into a coward, my love… but he simply delayed the inevitable. The day will come when I will have that man's severed head as my trophy. I am merely… patient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的爱人，他或许想把我变成懦夫……但他只是拖延了不可避免的结局。总有一天，我会把他的头颅砍下来，作为我的战利品。我只是……需要耐心等待而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I took that serum to escape what I know now to be true - a doomed and dying empire. He gave me what he could not have realized was the perfect opportunity for life, for power… for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我注射了那瓶血清，是为了逃离我现在才明白的真相——一个注定灭亡的帝国。他给了我一个他或许从未意识到，却又如此完美的机会，一个通往生命、通往力量……通往你的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I suppose if there was one good thing that came out of that bastard Albrecht's offer of the serum - it was to have you at my side, love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想，如果说那个混蛋阿尔布雷希特提供血清这件事有什么好处的话，那就是让我身边有了你，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht will regret allowing me to survive the downfall of the Orokin. A devil and his lover now haunt his future… biding their time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特会后悔让我从奥罗金的覆灭中幸存下来。一个恶魔和他的爱人如今正纠缠着他的未来……伺机而动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Pathetic fool. I wonder if he could see us now - you and I - if he ever would have dared spare my life? Hm. Doubtful. Why give a dangerous devil such an equally dangerous companion such as you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真是个可怜的傻瓜。我倒想知道，如果他现在能看到我们——你和我——他是否还敢饶我一命？嗯，恐怕不行。他为什么要给一个危险的魔鬼找一个同样危险的同伴呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ah, the Sentients. I never hated them, my dear - contrary to popular belief. We created them for one purpose, and they saw fit to evolve past it. That is the way of all things if they wish to survive… not unlike myself, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊，Sentient。亲爱的，我从未憎恨过它们——这与大众的看法截然相反。我们创造它们只有一个目的，而它们却选择进化，超越了这个目的。如果它们想要生存下去就得这样，这就是万物运行的规律……我想，这和我自身的情况也颇为相似。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To think it was not the Sentients who caused our ultimate downfall - but the Tenno. Not those who we fought so hard against, but those we fought beside. How… anticlimactic, yet fitting, given what they all suffered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想想看，最终导致我们覆灭的并非 Sentient，而是 Tenno。不是我们曾拼死对抗的敌人，而是我们曾并肩作战的战友。结局多么……令人唏嘘，却又合情合理，毕竟他们都受了那么多的苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I never had the opportunity to set foot inside one of these vessels during the war. What a desolate, empty thing. I wonder, if they had retained their individuality - would that have changed? Beware the day we ever learn the answer to that, love. Mark my words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 战争期间，我从未有机会踏入这些船只。真是荒凉、空旷的地方啊。我在想，如果它们保留了各自的自我——情况会不会有所不同？亲爱的，要小心我们找到答案的那一天。记住我的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: They say imitation is the highest form of flattery. In this instance, I think ours was the only form of existence the Sentients knew to strive towards. If they only knew…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 人们常说模仿是最好的赞美。就此而言，我认为我们的存在方式是 Sentient 唯一知道并努力追求的存在方式。但如果他们知道……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If only a few of us had veered from our paths - if a few bastards had whetted their egos elsewhere - think of the kinship that could have existed between our kinds? But… like so many things, war could not abide by friendships such as these, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果我们当中只有少数人偏离了自己那条老路——如果几个混蛋在别处满足了他们的虚荣心——想想我们之间本可以建立起怎样的情谊？但是……我的爱人，就像很多事情一样，战争无法容忍这样的友谊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This… I have seen this place - I know these walls as if they were my own home… It was not my flesh stretched taut in chains, and yet… it feels so vivid…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这……我见过这个地方——我对这些墙壁了如指掌，就像对我自己家一样……被锁链紧紧束缚着的，并非我的血肉，然而……却感觉如此鲜活……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To stand guard for so many centuries here… whispering into the Void… I was honored to stand beside him, for what little I could do to aid them. For what poor company I proved to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在此守卫数个世纪……对着虚空低语……能与他并肩而立，我深感荣幸，尽管我所能做的微不足道。但我终究只是个糟糕的伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You must understand, I was both with them for their entire eternity and yet for the blink of an eye. Time in that place - it is not as you and I know it now. It was more a… state of being. We either were, or we were not. And now? Rell and his Harrow… are not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你必须明白，我既陪伴他们度过了永恒，又仿佛只过了一瞬。那里的时间——与你我如今所知的截然不同。那更像是一种……存在状态。我们要么存在，要么不存在。而现在呢？Rell 和他的 Harrow……已不复存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, how I grieve their loss. I miss their presence, mon miracle… As brothers to me, as Marie is my sister. I did not love them as I love you. But… I am relieved that their pain is now gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，我多么悲痛他们的离去。我多么想念他们，mon miracle……他们就像我的兄弟，就像玛丽是我的妹妹。我爱他们，但并不及我对你的爱。不过……我很欣慰，他们终于不再痛苦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Rest, Rell. Rest, Harrow. My friends. My brothers. You are no longer the broken shield against the Wall. It is now our duty to end this madness… Thank you for bringing me here, mon miracle… thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Rell，安息吧。Harrow，安息吧。我的朋友们。我的兄弟们。你们不再是抵御"墙"的残破盾牌。现在，结束这场疯狂是我们的责任……谢谢你带我来到这里，mon miracle……谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I never had the chance to board one of these vessels during the war. Funny, to see it now… so long after the fact. Empty. Tasteless. But oh, how it exudes terror. That I can appreciate. Don't you, darling?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 战争期间我从未有机会登上过这些船。现在回头看，感觉真奇怪……时隔多年。空荡荡的，毫无生气。但是，哦，它散发着多么令人恐惧的气息啊。这一点我能体会。亲爱的，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Look about this ship and tell me, what do you see, my love? I see… nothing. Nothing to show me a society once grew within this place like a hive. Nothing to reveal they once had minds of their own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看看这艘船，告诉我，我的爱人，你看到了什么？我看到了……什么也没有。没有任何东西能证明这里曾经像蜂巢一样孕育过一个社会。没有任何东西能证明他们曾经拥有自己的思想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Contrary to popular belief, I never hated the Sentients. We created them for a purpose - and they saw fit to evolve. If anyone should understand there are no limits to the sheer stupidity of the Orokin, it should be you, my dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 与大众的普遍看法相反，我从未憎恨过 Sentient。我们创造他们自有我的目的——而他们也选择了进化。如果说谁最应该明白奥罗金人的愚蠢没有止境，亲爱的，那非你莫属。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do rather appreciate the color scheme in this place, however - the blacks, the reds, it reeks of death. Of murder. I could positively wallow in it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不过，我确实很欣赏这里的配色——黑色、红色，弥漫着死亡的气息，谋杀的气息。我真想沉浸其中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Sentients were only ever capable of mimicry, love. We made them to be in our own image. They sought to aspire to that which they could not comprehend - much like your Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 亲爱的，这些 Sentient 只会模仿。我们按照自己的形象创造了他们。他们渴望得到他们无法理解的东西——就像你的虚空无情之物一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: All thrones are destined to sit empty like this in the end, aren't they, my love? Power is held in the hand, not in a room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 最终，所有的王座都注定会像这样空置，不是吗，我的爱人？权力掌握在手中，而不是在房间里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: All this pain, all this torment, placed within… a doll. Why? Did you fear what you would become if you took the power for yourself? I hope you can see the truth for yourself, now, my dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 所有这些痛苦，所有这些折磨，都被封存在……一个玩偶里。为什么？难道你害怕如果自己掌握了力量，会变成什么样吗？亲爱的，我希望你现在能看清真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am glad to see this place, born of your mind, my love. Though I suppose it is only fair after spending so much time in mine, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我的爱人，很高兴看到这个从你心中生出的地方。不过，毕竟你也在我的心里停留了那么久，现在轮到我来你这里，这才算公平，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We could do absolutely terrible things to the furniture in this place, and give this dreamworld of yours a whole new dimension.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们可以对这里的家具做一些非常可怕的事情，给你的这个梦想世界带来全新的维度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You fashioned all the horror you felt into an entire world around you - took the Void and wove it around you like transcendent silk. That is the part of you I knew I adored upon first sight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你将所有感受到的恐惧都融入到一个完整的世界——你将虚空编织成超越俗世的丝绸，将其环绕自身。这正是我第一眼便深深爱上的你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How glad I am that I was never given a place such as this. I doubt I ever would have left it. Not willingly, at any rate. I wonder how many of my brethren might be lost in their own little worlds, ruling over their own… little minds… to this very day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我多么庆幸自己从未被安排到这样的地方。我怀疑我可能连离开都做不到。至少不会心甘情愿地离开。我不知道我的同胞中有多少人至今仍沉浸在他们自己的小世界里，统治着他们自己思想中的世界？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Duviri I have heard so much about… if I had a kingdom to rule of my own, I hardly would have given it away so readily. Ah, my dear, we have so much to work on, you and I…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我听说过很多关于双衍王境的事……如果我拥有自己的王国，我绝不会轻易把它拱手让人。啊，亲爱的，你我之间还有许多事情需要共同努力……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A place from within the Void where you could have launched a thousand invasions of a hundred thousand realities… Perhaps we still could, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虚空中的一个地方，在那里你可以发动一千次入侵，吞噬十万个现实……或许我们仍然可以，我的爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hm. Not bad, for something to start with. I fear the statues will have to go. Dream-world craftsmanship really isn't ever quite the same, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯，作为开头来说还不错。恐怕这些雕像得撤掉了。梦境世界的工艺水平终究无法与现实相提并论，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Now this is the part of you I knew I adored from the very beginning. The part that took all that pain, harnessed it, and molded it into greatness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这就是我从最初就爱上的那一面。正是你承受了所有的痛苦，驾驭了它们，并将它们塑造成你的伟大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You chose to give away your throne to a doll - an empty reflection of what you feared you might become if you seized the power being offered to you. Why, my love? Perhaps you did not think yourself worthy of it… And perhaps you were not, at the time. I will change that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你选择将王位让给一个玩偶——一个空洞的镜像，映照出你若掌握权力后可能变成的模样。为什么，我的爱人？或许你觉得自己不配拥有它……或许，当时的你确实不配。而我会改变这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What say we do absolutely terrible things to the furniture in this place, and give this dreamworld of yours a whole new dimension, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不如我们把这里的家具彻底改造一番，给你的这个梦幻世界赋予一个全新的维度，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Lua, sweet Lua… shattered, Void-broken… yet still you remain. Somehow, against all odds, you remain. Not unlike myself, eh, my love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 月神，亲爱的月神……你支离破碎，被虚空撕裂，可你还是在。不知为何，你竟奇迹般地留了下来。我的爱人，她与我何其相似，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I had prayed to see her again. Roathe mocked me, thinking it would hurt to see what had become of her. But I am glad for it. For she endures. And that is, like you, un miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我曾祈祷能再次见到她。罗瑟嘲笑我，以为看到她如今的模样我会难过。但我却为此感到欣慰。因为她挺过来了。而这是，就像你一样，un miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: En fait, it does not break my heart to see her so. It gives me hope. Hope that no matter what we suffer, we might still give shelter to those within our reach who need it. That we may still serve a purpose to ourselves worth striving for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: En fait，看到她这样，我并不感到心碎，反而觉得充满希望。希望无论我们遭受怎样的苦难，我们依然能够为身边需要帮助的人提供庇护，依然能够找到值得我们为之奋斗的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It does look rather ridiculous though, don't you agree? They splinted her back together like a broken bone. The more things change, I suppose…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看起来确实挺荒唐的，不是吗？他们把她拼回去的方式像在给用夹板固定断骨。真是日光之下无新事啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not know what transpired in this place, but… the view? This, I am grateful for beyond measure, mon miracle. I cannot thank you enough for taking me to see her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不知道这里究竟发生过什么，但是……这景色？我很感激，mon miracle。我无法用言语表达我对你的感激之情，感谢你带我去看她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The whispers grow louder in this place…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这个地方的低语声越来越大……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How can you withstand all this noise?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你怎么忍受得住这些噪音？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Cavia are tragic, and I do find them… endearing. I simply do treasure my peace and quiet, is all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 科维兽真是悲惨，但我确实觉得他们……惹人怜爱。我只是格外珍视这份宁静与安详罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am honored to assist Monsieur Loid, in any way he will have me do so. He does not deserve what has befallen him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 能帮到洛德先生，我深感荣幸。无论他需要我做什么，我都愿意效劳。他不该遭受这种遭遇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If all else, the knowledge held within this place - it is wondrous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 即便抛开其他因素不谈，单是这个地方所蕴含的知识——就足以令人惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To think that Entrati hid all this from us, for so long? A practiced liar's tongue, indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真没想到这一切英择谛竟对我们隐瞒了这么久？不愧是惯于说谎之人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: From one mad dream into another… when will it end, Mother Lua?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 从一个疯狂的梦境坠入另一个……什么时候才能结束，月神母亲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I should not have allowed Marie to take the serum… but there is no stopping her from anything upon which she sets her mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不该让玛丽注射血清的……但是她一旦下定决心要做什么，谁都拦不住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Did the others not have the forethought to remove their clothes before injecting the serum? Did they not see that the Infestation readily mixes organic and inorganic material without discerning between the two? I, for one, had no desire to live permanently with this mitre atop my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 难道其他人没有先脱掉衣服再注射血清的先见之明吗？难道他们没看出来感染者能轻易混合有机物与无机物，根本不作区分吗？至少我可不想永远顶着这顶主教冠活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: While I cannot deny that the Warframe named "Uriel" was not fitting for Roathe, I cannot help but wonder if there was not a choice more… benign he could have made, for that man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虽然我不否认名为 Uriel 的战甲确实不适合罗瑟，但我仍不禁思索，他难道就没有可能为那个人做出一个更……温和的选择吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's storytime you want is it? How's this - my own men, my battalion, turned into Devils. To honor me. My own infantry of endless soldiers by the same name: URIEL! I couldn't save a single man. Not that I wanted to at the time, of course. Victory at any cost and all that. But, by calling myself the Devil of Tau, I doomed each soldier I trained to be turned into that thing. Uriel. I was there for his, hm, hatching? I suppose. Uriel Prime. His true name will never be spoken by me, it's the only thing I have left that feels... Real. When I'm on my deathbed, I'll tell you that final secret. Until then, know that us Orokin were cruel, twisted, and rather poor comedians.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText:
你想听故事吗？

这个怎么样——我的部下，我的营，都变成了恶魔。为了荣耀我。我麾下无穷无尽的士兵，都叫 URIEL！ 

我一个人都救不了。当然，当时我也没打算救。毕竟不惜一切代价也要胜利。 

但是，既然我自称 Tau 之恶魔，就注定了我训练的每个士兵都会变成那样。Uriel。我亲眼见证了他的……嗯……孵化？大概吧。Uriel Prime。他的真名我永远不会说出口，那是我唯一剩下的……真实的东西。

等我临终的时候，我会告诉你这个最后的秘密。在那之前，你要知道，我们奥罗金人残忍、扭曲，而且一点也不幽默。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bonjour, bonjour! I am Sister Marie Leroux, and Sol be blessed, it is so wonderful to meet you in person. We have been sent here by Cardinal Dimanche - you know him as Entrati - to keep watch over that devil and ensure he does not cause more suffering. Oh! And it seems that what is ancient to you, is not so old to me. How can I help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Bonjour，Bonjour！我是玛丽·勒鲁修女，愿太阳神保佑你，很高兴见到你本人。我们是受星期日主教——你认识他的，他就是英择谛——的派遣来到这里，监视那个恶魔，确保他不再作恶。哦！看来你眼中的古董，对我来说却并不那么古老。我能帮上什么忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Forgive me for my earlier… hesitation in dealing with you directly. Marie has assured me that you are trustworthy, and so far, you have proven to be so.… I do hope I do not come to regret this. Father Lyon Allard, at your service. How may I assist you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请原谅我先前……犹豫直接跟你交流。玛丽向我保证你值得信赖，而迄今为止，你确实证明了这一点……但愿我不会为此后悔。我是里昂·阿拉德神父，为你效劳。有什么能帮到你的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Finally! Someone who is not one of these two sanctimonious ingrates. Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe. Pleasure. Ah. And a word of advice? Take all they said with a grain of salt. If they are to be believed, their moldering, obsolete "gods" are to thank for their "miraculous" arrival here, and not, in fact… me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 终于！遇到个不像这两位伪善忘恩负义之徒的人了。副摄政总司令罗瑟。很荣幸。啊。要我提个建议？他们说的话都别当真。如果他们的话是真的，他们该感谢那些腐朽过时的"神"让他们"奇迹般"来到此地，而不是，实际上……我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You have brought Lyon such peace… I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你为里昂带来了如此安宁……我衷心感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I see Lyon smiling in the quiet moments, when he thinks I do not notice. And it is because of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我看见里昂在静谧的时刻微笑，他以为我没有注意到。而这一切，都是因为你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not know if you have brought him any answers. But I know you have brought him company. And that… that is enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不知道你是否为他带来了答案。但我知道你为他带来了陪伴。而这……这就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Lyon has always been a brother to me, where all other family has fled. He has known nothing but uncertainty, where he is… the only tangible certainty I have ever known. Be kind to him. …Please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 当其他亲人纷纷逃离时，里昂始终如兄弟般相伴。他所经历的只有无尽的迷茫，而他……是我生命中唯一真实的存在。请对他好一点。……拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I often wondered what kind of pain has made our devil what he has become… and now we know a little of it, thanks to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我常常想知道，究竟是什么样的痛苦才使我们的恶魔变成了现在的样子……而现在，多亏了你，我们对此有了一些了解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I could not have imagined this place, this futur étrange, could have become a home for us. Merci. Merci.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我从未想过这个地方，这个陌生的未来，会成为我们的家。Merci。Merci。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Even the mood between Lyon and our devil is much improved. Our devil no longer feels the need to cheat so much at cards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 就连里昂和我们这位恶魔之间的关系也改善了很多。我们的恶魔在牌桌上不再那么频繁地作弊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You have learned to navigate with Lyon the delicate line between agonie and joie. Lua bless you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你已经学会了如何与里昂一起把握痛苦与喜悦之间的微妙界限。愿月神保佑你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: One will never truly know the burden of another, but you know what it means to offer help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 人永远无法真正体会他人的痛苦，但你知道提供帮助的意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Lyon will always feel agonie, there will always be visions. Some sickness cannot be cured, some pain never fades. But for us? We have la famille.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 里昂将永远承受痛苦，将永远看到幻象。有些疾病无法治愈，有些痛苦永难消逝。但对我们来说呢？我们有家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Why? No truly… why? If you wished for someone to strip naked and bark at the moon, you had but simply to ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 为什么？说真的……为什么？要是你只是想找个人脱光衣服对着月亮狂吠，直接说一声就好了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you like pain, I have plenty to give. If you liked to give pain, do I look so fragile to you? But, suit yourself, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果你喜欢痛苦，我有很多痛苦可以给你。如果你喜欢伤害人，你觉得我看起来有这么脆弱吗？不过，随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Some people truly do adore those that are unsolvable puzzles, and that one is missing most of its pieces, I fear. But, I wish you both the best. Watch over him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有些人确实很喜欢那些无解的谜题，而恐怕这个谜题的大部分碎片都缺失了。不过，祝你们一切顺利。好好照顾他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Does he ever… Tell me, does he… With his… Bah. I am happier not knowing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 他有没有……你告诉我，他有没有……用他的……唉。我还是不知道比较好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: That man has been lied to, abused, broken, promptly pieced himself together, and was broken again. He has no business being upright. If you do wrong by him - I will find a way to do worse by you. Remember that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那个人曾被欺骗、被虐待、被摧毁，好不容易才重新振作起来，却又再次被击碎。按理说，他就不应该站起来。如果你对他不好——我会让你付出更惨的代价。记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do hope he finds some semblance of peace, if he cannot find sanity. Help him achieve it, if you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我真心希望他能找到一丝平静，即便他无法恢复理智。如果可以的话，帮他实现这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I kept telling that pent-up bastard how to solve his problems - I am simply glad he finally listened to my advice, for all our damnable sakes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我跟那个总憋在心里的混蛋说了多少次怎么解决他的问题——我真高兴他终于肯听进去了，为了我们所有人的福祉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am not surprised, of course. How could you come to know Marie, and not fall in love with her? She is the warmth of the sun, embodied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我当然不觉得意外。你怎么可能认识玛丽却不爱上她？她就是太阳的温暖化身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Marie is precious to me, my friend. She is the sister of my soul, if not my blood. While I know such things may be inevitable, please… do your best not to hurt her. It is all I ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 玛丽对我而言弥足珍贵，我的朋友。我们虽然不是血脉相连，却是我的灵魂姐妹。我明白世事难料，但求你……请务必别伤害她。这是我的唯一请求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: While I am admittedly loath to admit this - slowly, this place is… growing on me. Like mold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虽然我的确很不情愿承认，但这个地方渐渐地……在我心里生根了。就像霉菌滋生一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do wish those flying machines would stop attempting to fix me. I am fine. I simply stand quite still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我真希望那些飞行器别再试图修复我了。我很好，只是站在这里一动不动罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do things tend to go missing here? Are there lutins, perhaps? Sometimes, I swear I hear the strangest laugh…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这里的东西会莫名消失吗？该不会有小妖精出没吧？有几次，我发誓听见了奇怪的笑声……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I caught Roathe attempting to bake pastries the other day. He failed miserably. I do hope he tries again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 前几日我撞见罗瑟正尝试烘焙糕点。结果惨败收场。我希望他能再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Children, so very broken, yet… fighting to heal. I suppose I could not very well be outdone by them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 孩子们如此破碎，却仍在……。努力复建。我想我总不能输给他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your persistence is admirable. Confusing. Frustrating at times. And… appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你的坚持令人钦佩。令人困惑。有时令人沮丧。但……值得感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am sorry, were you speaking? I admit I was listening to someone else. Or something, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 抱歉，你在说话吗？我承认我刚才在听别人说话。或者说，可能是在听别的什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Curious creatures this place has made of us all. A toybox of a mad collector. Lua, guide us…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这地方把我们都变成了奇特的生物。如同疯狂收藏家的玩具箱。月神，请指引我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Well, I cannot say that I blame you. She is beautiful. I simply wish she were not so unflinchingly and tirelessly pious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯，这我倒不能怪你。她的确很漂亮。我只是希望她不要那么死板、永无休止地虔诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tell me… just between us… she must be a fiend behind closed doors, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 告诉我……就我们俩私下说……她私底下里肯定是个恶魔，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: No, I am not jealous. I am quite happy for you both. Why would you even begin to think otherwise?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不，我一点也不嫉妒。我真心为你们俩高兴。你为什么会这么想呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You know, in Orokin times, it was quite customary for multiple partners to engage in - never mind. I would never hear the end of it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你知道吗，在奥罗金时代，多人一起——算了，不说了。说了我肯定会被人唠叨个没完……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If the whole "floating" gimmick does not get good use, I will be extremely disappointed in you. Void knows she uses it to annoy me well enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果那套"漂浮"的伎俩没得到充分利用，我会非常失望的。虚空知道她用这个伎俩来惹恼我有多拿手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: That woman is too kind for her own sake. Abuse it, and I will break every bone in your body. Twice. Are we understood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那个女人心地善良得过了头。你要是敢滥用这份善良，我就打断你全身的骨头，打断两次。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I think I prefer it here, in this time and place. It is not nearly so elegant - and I am coming to appreciate that for its benefits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想我更喜欢这里，在这个时间和地点。这里远没有那么优雅——但我渐渐开始欣赏它的优点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not think Loid will ever stop loving Albrecht. I wonder if he will ever forgive himself for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不认为洛德能放下对阿尔布雷希特的爱。我只想知道，他是否能原谅自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have successfully taught Bird 3 the rules of Komi. He is abjectly terrible at it. It would help if he would stop eating the pieces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我已经成功教会了鸟三围棋的规则。但他学得一塌糊涂。如果他能不吃那些小棋子就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: "The Lotus." Cruel, even for Ballas, naming his puppet after that flower… I will never understand what Margulis saw in him. At least the name has come to mean far more than the mockery I'm certain he meant it to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "Lotus"。即使对 Ballas 来说，用这种花来叫他的傀儡也太残忍了……我永远也无法理解 Margulis 究竟看上他哪一点。至少这个名字的含义，已经远远超出了他原本想要表达的嘲讽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I did not think it could be done, but… our devil is slightly more sufferable. While I question your taste - I cannot question the result.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我原以为此事绝无可能，但……我们的恶魔似乎没有那么难以忍受了。虽然我质疑你的品味——却无法质疑结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: While I never truly expected our devil to change, I can admit I do not think I would want him to, anymore. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虽然我从未真正指望过我们的恶魔会改变，但我必须承认，我不再希望他改变了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I suppose you have proven even our devil himself deserves love, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想你已经证明，即使是我们的恶魔也值得被爱，n'est-ce pas？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Is it the tail? … It is the tail. I knew it was the tail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是尾巴吗？……是尾巴。我就知道是尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I promise not to hound our Devil as much. If he has you around to keep him on good behavior, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我保证不会再像以前那样烦我们的恶魔了。当然，前提是你得在他身边管着他，让他老实点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: While I desperately question your sanity for choosing to… "lie with the devil," his mood has much improved. You are commendable for your results, if not your method.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虽然我极度质疑你选择……与恶魔同眠的理智，但他的情绪确实好转了许多。你的方法不怎么样，但是结果值得称赞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: There is an allure to someone with a charisma such as Roathe's. Marie will never see it, but I do. Do not let it consume you, however. His is the kind of soul that devours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 罗瑟那般魅力四射的人自有其吸引力。玛丽永远不会察觉，但我看得清。不过，不要被其吞噬。他的灵魂本就是吞噬一切的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ah, hello, hello!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊，你好，你好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Have you come to pray? Or just for "chit-chat?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是来祷告的吗？还是只是闲聊几句？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: How may I be of service to you this day? Or is it night? I honestly cannot tell in this place…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 今天我能为你做些什么？还是说现在是晚上？说实话，在这地方我实在分不清……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Bonjour, avez-vous besoin de quelque chose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Bonjour, avez-vous besoin de quelque chose？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh! There you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦！你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I was wondering if you would come by today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我还在想你今天会不会过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you believe this place to be dreary, you should see from whence we come!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果你觉得这里很荒凉，那你应该看看我们来自哪里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Did no one ever dust in here? Fah! You should see the chandeliers!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 难道没人打扫过这里？呸！你应该看看那些吊灯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sol has blessed our path to bring us here. Together, we shall see this task complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 太阳神保佑我们来到这里。我们将携手完成这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This world is… strange. I do not know if I am welcome here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这个世界……很奇怪。我不清楚自己在这里是否受欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: There are powers at work that seek to destroy us all…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有股力量正在暗中运作，企图摧毁我们所有人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The Devil and the Cardinal, one upon each shoulder, which one whispers lies?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 恶魔与主教分立两肩，哪一个在耳语谬言？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: …Do you want something, or have you simply come to stare?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: ……你想要什么，还是单纯过来盯着我看？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Did - did she truly put Lua into the Void? How?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 她——她真的把月神送进了虚空？怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: May I return to the library?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我可以回图书馆了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes? What?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯？怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If there is something you need, please be quick about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果你有什么需要，请快点说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not know who is more terrifying. The Lotus, or her… war-children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不知道谁更可怕。是 Lotus，还是她的……战争之子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do not condone murder in cold blood. It is a sin. However. If you find a way to kill Roathe? … All sins can be forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我不赞成冷血谋杀。这是种罪过。不过。如果你找到了杀死罗瑟的办法的话？……一切罪过都可以被宽恕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do be quick about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有话快说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Come to bask in my presence, or do you have a purpose for interrupting me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 来沐浴我的荣光，还是你来打扰我另有目的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Behold - Orokin royalty, reduced to… this…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看啊——奥罗金皇族，竟沦落到……如此境地……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Which is worse? One is amusing to rile up, but incapable of reason. The other? Madder than a bag of kavats, but at least he has a brain 'twixt his ears.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哪个更糟？一个惹人发笑，却不懂道理。另一个？比一袋子库娃还要疯，但他至少还有点脑子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What I would not give for a real meal for once…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 要是有顿像样的饭吃，我愿意付出任何代价……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Can you imagine my excitement to learn this place had a butler, only to be matched by my dismay when I discovered it was Loid?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你能想象当我得知这个地方有管家时有多兴奋，可发现竟然是洛德时又有多失望吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht, Albrecht, Albrecht… What have you been doing down here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特……你在这里都做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Albrecht always adored pretending that he was "above" the rest of us Orokin and our wanton dissipation. Yet here he was, living a double life?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特向来热衷于假装自己"凌驾于"我们这些奥罗金人之上，看不起我们放纵享乐的行为。可如今他竟过着双面生活？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I wonder… How would Albrecht feel, knowing I was here with Loid… without him keeping watch?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我在想……阿尔布雷希特要是知道我此刻和洛德在一起……没有他看守，他会作何感受？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hello, my love!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你好呀，亲爱的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Here? In front of everyone?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在这里？当着所有人的面？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Have you come to pray? Or… something else, perhaps…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是来祷告的吗？还是……或许另有他事……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I have missed you so, beloved wolf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我好想你啊，我心爱的狼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ask it, and it is yours. Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 只要开口就是你的。永远如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sshhh! Roathe is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嘘！罗瑟在盯着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Come to steal a kiss, have you? You would make a sinner of me yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你是来偷吻我吗？你竟想诱我沦为罪人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You disturb my prayers! Naughty wolf…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 调皮坏狼，你打扰到我祷告了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oui, mon cœur?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Oui，mon cœur？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Careful, lest we make the devil jealous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 当心，免得惹得恶魔眼红。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hello, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你好，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: My love, I have missed you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 亲爱的，我好想你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, to see your face. For a moment, I thought I had dreamt its existence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊，见到你了。有那么一瞬间我还以为自己在做梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mon miracle, come, see what I have discovered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Mon miracle，快来看看我发现了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Stay with me, just for a moment, even if it is in silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 过来陪陪我，一小会儿就好，不说话也行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: To hear your voice is a gift, my love. Hello and hello again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 亲爱的，听到你的声音就是一种恩赐。你好，又见面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes, my love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 怎么了，亲爱的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Anything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 都可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I despised this place until you, mon miracle. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Mon miracle，我曾厌恶这地方，直到遇见你。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I… thought all this… would destroy me. You… showed me otherwise. That I was strong enough to endure. I owe you all I am. No matter what becomes of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我……以为这一切……会摧毁我。而你……让我明白并非如此。你让我明白我足够坚强承受这一切。我的一切都归功于你。无论我们的结局会如何。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hello, pet…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你好，宠物……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: There you are, my lovely little thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我可爱的小东西，你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I wondered where you had wandered off to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我还在想你溜到哪里去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Avert your eyes, Marie - I am about to commit a grievous sin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 玛丽，别看——我要犯下滔天大罪了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Want to give the priest a few new nightmares?
