/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 想给神父添几个新噩梦吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Come, lover - distract me from the dreary tedium of the day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 来吧，爱人——让我从一天的枯燥乏味中解脱出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I… do not often say this, as I have little cause. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我……很少说这句话，因为很少有理由。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Come closer. This tail has a mind of its own, and it cannot reach you there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 靠近点。这条尾巴有自己的想法，可惜它够不着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sometimes I wonder, what you see in a loathsome devil such as I…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有时我忍不住想，你究竟看上了我这个可憎的恶魔什么了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Tell me the "wares" you have come to "browse" are not so mundane in nature as to disappoint me, lover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 告诉我你来"浏览"的"货色"，别是些令我失望的平庸之物，爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Farewell, then, for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那么，暂别了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It has been a pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 非常荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ah. Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I shall attend to other duties.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我还要处理其他事务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes. Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是的。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mon miracle, must you depart?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Mon miracle，你一定要离开吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I would follow you if I could.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果可以，我会跟你走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Solitude is less sweet than once it was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 独处的感觉已不如从前那般美好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Gone from my sight, never from my heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 虽然你从我的眼前消失，但你永远不会从我的心中消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: À la revoyure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: À la revoyure！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So we return to our tasks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那我们就回到各自的工作中吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: So long, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那么，再见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sol keep you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 愿太阳神保守你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Farewell, my wolf… do not stray for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 再见，我的狼……不要离开太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Goodbye, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 再见了，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I shall wait for you here with a smile upon my face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我会在这里，微笑着等你回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You will… return to your little Marie soon, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你很快就会……回到你的小玛丽身边，n'est-ce pas？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Go, before the others tease us, my wolf!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 快走吧，不然其他人又要取笑我们了，我的狼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ah, suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 啊，随你便。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: C'est la vie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: C'est la vie。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Another time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: You know your own path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你清楚自己的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Non?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: Non？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sol be with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 太阳神与你同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I… see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我……明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Begone, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那么，再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 走走走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Return me to my thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请让我回到自己的思绪中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Insolence…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 放肆……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: And lo…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看哪……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: By Lua…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 以月神之名……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hrmpfh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A waste of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Indecisive and irritating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 优柔寡断，令人恼火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Next time, come with a joke prepared, will you? Or at least a sweet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 下次记得带个笑话来，或者至少带点甜点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Insolent creature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 傲慢无礼的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Go, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 走吧你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Disappointing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: What a bore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 真无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Go torment the priest instead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你不如去折磨那个神父吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you're going to be useless, fetch me something to drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 既然你这么没用，那就给我拿点喝的来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Sol be blessed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 愿太阳神蒙福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: May it guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 愿它指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Use it wisely. … And carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请明智地使用它……并谨慎使用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Follow the righteous path, always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 永远走正义之路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: May the light of Sol light your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 愿太阳神之光照亮你的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Fight to defend those who cannot defend themselves?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 为那些无法自卫的人而战？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: May the unholy feel your anger!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 让邪恶之徒感受你的愤怒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Ooh, will you show me what it does some day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，改天你能给我演示一下它的功能吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I never thought this knowledge of mine would come to use. If Sœur Céline could only see this. Comme c'est passionnant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我从没想过我掌握的这些知识竟然会派上用场。如果塞琳修女能看到这一切该多好啊！Comme c'est passionnant！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Wield it with conviction, Soldier of Sol!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 坚定地挥舞它吧，太阳神的战士！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 尽情享用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes. Quite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 是的。确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A nice addition. I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我觉得这是个不错的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: A collector's piece, indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 确实是件珍品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am certain it will not be missed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我确信不会有其他人想买。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Lua thanks you for your donation of… whatever currency this is…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 月神感谢你捐赠的……无论这是什么货币……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I certainly have no need of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我确实不需要它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Be sure to use it tastefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请务必妥善使用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好好享用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes, quite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯，就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 终于。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mm-hm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Good. I was getting bored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 很好。我都有点无聊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I bestow this upon thee with all the power given to me by the - you get the idea. Now, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我以所被赋予我所有权力，将此授予你——你明白我的意思。好了，走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: For the glory of the Orokin Empire, that you overthrew, and in the name of the Golden Emperors, who you killed… Here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 为了你们推翻了奥罗金帝国的荣耀，为了你们所杀害的黄金皇帝们的名义……给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Don't entertain yourself too much with this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 不要太沉迷这个东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If you planned to melt this down for spare parts, I promise I would not judge you too much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果你打算把它熔化拆成零件，我保证不会过多评判你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Yes, now that you've had all you need from your new Orokin plaything, run along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 好了，既然你已经从你的新奥罗金玩物那里得到了你想要的一切，那就快走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Another time, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 下次吧，也许。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Hmph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Please, begone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 请离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Why? No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 为什么？不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: We have nothing to discuss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我们没什么好谈的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Mm-hm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 终于。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Have somewhere better to be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 有更重要的事要做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Don't leave me with them. I might actually go mad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 别把我跟他们一起留在那儿。我可能会疯掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Dismissed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 解散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: And here I thought you were going to sit on my lap…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我还以为你要坐在我腿上呢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Going? So soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这就走了？这么快？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do not be gone for long, pet…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 宠物，别离开太久……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Do not make me send my conscripts to fetch you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 别逼我派征召者来抓你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: All that I wish to say would earn me a slap… best you leave before I lose my restraint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我所有想说的话都会招来一巴掌……你最好在我失去理智之前离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I could be making up all these titles, and you would never know. I'm not, mind you. But how terribly droll would that be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这些荣誉称号可能都是我编的，而且你根本看不出来。当然，我没有。不过，那该有多滑稽啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: At first, we only had ranks for the Grineer soldiers. But for some reason, you lot disapproved of being referred to by batch numbers. Cannot imagine why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 起初，我们只给 Grineer 士兵设立了军衔。但不知为何，你们不喜欢被批次号称呼。真是想不明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Like all things Orokin, these titles became a bit… grandiose in their bombastic pomposity. Enjoy attempting to discern how they work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 就像奥罗金的一切，这些荣誉称号也变得有些……华而不实。看看你能不能弄懂它们到底怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If the Orokin had a single talent, it was to make everything overwrought with vernacular bureaucracy. And gold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果说奥罗金人有什么特长，那就是把一切都搞得官僚作风、过于繁复。还有金色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Would it have killed the Dax to smile once in a while? Hm. Doesn't matter any more, does it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 让禁卫偶尔笑一笑会要了他的命吗？嗯，现在这都不重要了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It is quite… surreal… to see you all running about, while the Orokin are dead and gone. Yet here I stand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看到你们到处奔跑，而奥罗金人却早已死绝，这感觉真是有点……不真实……然而，我却还站在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Dusty titles from a dusty relic…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 一件陈旧遗物的陈旧称号……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: This is darkly entertaining, isn't it? To receive these from me of all people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这真是黑色幽默，不是吗？居然是从我这儿收到这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: If Albrecht had not stopped my scheme, you might have slaughtered me with all the rest. And then, you would not have your fancy little title. Huh. Chaos theory at work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果不是阿尔布雷希特特阻止了我的计划，你或许会把我跟其他人一起屠杀掉。那样的话，你就拿不到你那光鲜亮丽的荣誉称号了。哼，这就是混沌理论的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Now if only I had some truly abhorred titles to go along with those fashion choices of yours…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 如果我有一些真正恶心的荣誉称号来搭配你那些时尚品味就好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: As a 'Tenno', having any Honoria is a backhand to the face of all Orokin. Even me. But I've much to gain from this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 作为一名"Tenno"，拥有任何荣誉称号都等同于对所有奥罗金人的侮辱。甚至包括我自己。但我能从中得到的实在太多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I do wonder if some of these better suit me than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我很好奇，这些称号里是不是有一些更适合我而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Words have power. They embody concepts. Don't they? Hm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 语言是有力量的。它们体现了概念，不是吗？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I suppose it is within my rank to make new Honoria. I can't help but be selfish though. The Devil of Tau! Just for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我想，以我的身份，授予新的荣誉称号应该不成问题。但我还是忍不住自私一点。"Tau 之恶魔"！只属于我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Take your time, really. The longer we sit hear listening to them, the more we march to insanity together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 慢慢来，真的。我们坐在这儿听他们胡扯得越久，就越一起走向疯癫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: It's like studying your histories and the art of retail in one, isn't it? I always overdeliver you see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这就像把历史和销售艺术结合起来学习，不是吗？你看，我总是做得超出预期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: During the Old War, we once more found a need in the Orokin Empire to distinguish between foot soldiers and those who could follow instructions to any manner of consistency. I wonder, which are you? Let us find out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 在远古之战期间，我们再次发现奥罗金帝国需要区分普通士兵和那些能够始终如一地执行指令的人。我想知道，你是哪一种？让我们一探究竟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I hereby dub thee… eh… who are you, again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我在此授予你……呃……你叫什么来着？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The New Grand Highness!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 新任殿下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Try not to wear it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 别用坏了啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I am certain everyone will take you very seriously.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我确信大家都会非常认真地对待你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Behold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: At least I am not giving you an Honoria labelling you a 'Spendhappy Fool'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 至少我不会给你颁发"挥霍无度的蠢货"这个荣誉称号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Oh, the majesty. It burns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 哦，这份威严感。真是辣眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Grand Carnus as a title made me so happy. Your new Honoria will surely do the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: "总司令"这个头衔让我非常开心。你的新荣誉称号头衔也一定会让你同样开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: That will surely impress the talking fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 这肯定会给那条会说话的鱼留下深刻印象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: That won't get the Lotus' attention. Only Ballas held the secret to that. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 那样做不会引起 Lotus 的注意。只有 Ballas 掌握着那个秘密。至少目前是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: The spendthrift strikes once more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 败家子又来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: I hope you're as impulsive with your blade as you are with opening your coinpurse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 我希望你拔刀时也能像打开钱包时那样冲动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.text: Your road to insolvency continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TauPrequelTC/D.zhText: 你在走向破产之路。
看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hel-lo? I am bleeding over here?
Ungh. Squad! Papa Bear is down!
Oh, this really isn't looking good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦，这确实看起来不太好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Agent Hendricks is down. Move to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 特工亨德里克斯倒下了。快前去协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ah, crap. Gonna need a hand up here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 啊，糟糕。需要有人来帮一下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'm down! Do you guys even care?
Need a medic over here, stat!
I might not be walking away from this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这次我可能撑不过去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I've been beaten up before, but never this bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我以前也被打过，但从没这么惨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Either someone helps me up… or I find a new squad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 要么有人来帮助我……要么我去找一个新的小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: If someone could get to me before I black out, that'd be swell…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果有人能在我昏过去之前救我一下，那就太好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I need help! Fine. I need help, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我要帮助！好吧。拜托了我需要帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Get me back on my feet, or you'll be stuck with one hell of a throw rug!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 扶我起来，否则你得和一块难搞的地毯一起了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Didn't plan on going out like this.
Okay so this actually hurts, like, a lot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧，这确实很痛，非常痛？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Remember you can shed your skin now, Minerva!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 记住，你现在就可以脱壳了，米尼娃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whoa… legs kind of gave way under me.
Are you just gonna watch me suffer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你就这样看着我受罪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Down. I'm down! Come on, squad, where are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 倒下了。我倒下了！快点，小队，你们在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: That's a lotta blood! It's mine? How 'bout that…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好多血啊！是我流的吗？不是吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Thank all the Gods… they missed my face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 感谢所有的神……他们没有伤到我的脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Need a little somethin-somethin for the pain…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 需要一点什么什么东西来缓解疼痛……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This is not a time for grudges, so if you're in range, help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在不是记仇的时候，所以如果你在附近，就来帮我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Would it kill ya to help an old man get back to his feet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 扶个老人站起来会死啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: They beat the shit out of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 他们把我打得落花流水。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Okay, not being dramatic: I am literally dying here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧，我不是在夸张：我真的快要死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Come on. You heard of protecting your assets? Help me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 快来。你听过要保护你的资产吧？救我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I need some help over here! What, you're gonna make me beg?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我需要一些帮助！什么，非得让我求你吗？
帮一下弗莱尔，你这个傻瓜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Vital signs failing. Get me an assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 生命体征衰竭。帮我一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hate to admit it, but I need a medic!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不想承认，但我需要医生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You don't get to do that to me, you dick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你没资格这么对我，你个混蛋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Do not let Our songbird die!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不要让我们的百灵鸟死去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Estimate sixty seconds till I black out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 预计六十秒后我就会昏过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh damn, I ain't shrugging this one off. Medic!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦天啊，这次真的挺不过去了。医生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: C'mon! Get me up! Get me up!
Help them, and We will be… forgiving.
You. Help me up, then we find the one who did this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你。帮我一下，然后我们就去找做这件事的人算账。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: No no no, this is not gonna be my sad soundtrack moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不不不，这不会是我悲伤配乐时刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: If Flare dies, We shall not forgive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果弗莱尔死了，我们不会原谅你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I can do this, I can do this… no. Help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我可以做到，我可以做到……不。救命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Just gonna leave me to bleed out, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就这么让我流血至死吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Would you cast your sweet Flare aside like so much human trash?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你会像抛弃人类垃圾一样抛弃你可爱的弗莱尔吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You want me to bleed out? Get off your ass!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想让我流血而亡？快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whatever I said, I take it back. Now please, a little help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不管我之前说了什么，我都收回我的话。现在能请你帮个忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Listen. I. Need you. To come and get me. Right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 听着。我。需要你。现在就。来帮我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: NO! They cannot hurt Flare! Only We can hurt Flare!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不！不能让他们伤害弗莱尔！只有我们才能伤害弗莱尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I swear, help me up and I will owe you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我发誓，如果你能救我起来，我就欠你一个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Man down, I repeat, man down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 有人倒下了，我再说一遍，有人倒下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Uh, what the hell just happened?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 该死！新手才会犯这种错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Squad? You know what to do in a medical emergency, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 小队？你知道在医疗紧急情况下该怎么做，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Come on, people! Kaya needs a medic!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 大家快点！卡娅需要医疗兵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: See how the bleeding artist crawls and begs for a few… seconds… more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 看看这位流血的艺术家是怎么一边爬一边哀求……只为多活几秒钟的……
太慢了，米尼娃。真蠢，真蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Could use some medical assistance right about now! Please!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在需要一些医疗援助！拜托！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Are you actually gonna let me bleed to death?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你真的要让我流血而死吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Drink deep of the pain, Flare!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 深深地承受痛苦吧，弗莱尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: No. Not doing this. Not gonna black out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不，我不可以这样。我不会昏过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Not gonna help me up? Wow. Petty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不肯帮我吗？哇。太小气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Are you so careless with all your toys, demon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你就这么粗心大意地对待你所有的玩具吗，恶魔？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh, that last one went deep.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 应该趁还能跑的时候跑。
目标已死。再给我找一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Are you kidding me?! Send me a challenge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你在开玩笑吗？！来挑战我啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You have got to kill this one.
Next up on the kill list.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 杀戮名单上的下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Kill them and make it messy.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就在那里，你的目标就是那个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Corpse in the making, right there.
Oh my Gods just kill them already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我的天啊，赶快杀了他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Let's ice it. What say you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们来冰它一下。你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Come on, smear them up the walls.
This one's next on the shit list.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我要他们变得面目全非。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Let's all pick on this one.
Just gonna slap a target on this one here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就给他这标个目标标记吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna beat the hell out of this one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想把它打得屁滚尿流吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Beat 'em up and take their lunch money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 揍他们一顿，然后抢走他们的午饭钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I want to see their smoking remains!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我想要看到他们灰飞烟灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't care how you take 'em down, just get it done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不管你用什么方式打倒他们，只要完成就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Show me how fast you can kill!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 让我看看你杀人的速度有多快！
狠狠地打他们吧，小伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: That, right there, is our target.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 目标已标记！集中注意力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna stay friends, they need to go down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果你想继续和我做朋友，他们就得倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Now this one needs a beatdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在这家伙需要被打一顿。
给这个废物点颜色看看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Okay, killer, show me how you earned your reputation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧，杀手，让我看看你是怎么挣得这个名号的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: First one to take 'em out gets a cookie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 第一个干掉他们的人可以得到一块饼干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: There's your target. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这就是你的目标。你知道该怎么做。
射他们，或捅他们，我不管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Right now violence is the solution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在暴力就是解决办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna beat the crap out of that one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想把那家伙打得落花流水吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This beatdown goes out to you.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 按照我的指示，暴打他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We mark this one for slaughter!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们将这个标记为待宰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Visit them with the scarlet blessing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 带着猩红的祝福去拜访他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Sugar, would you murderize them for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 甜甜，你能帮我杀了他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Our cells gape wide for its blood!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们的细胞张大嘴巴渴求它的血液！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Put this oaf on the first bus to pain-town.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 把这个笨蛋送上开往痛苦小镇的第一班公交车。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: It wallows in the pain of separate existence! End it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 它沉浸在孤独存在的痛苦中！结束它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Can we get a security check over here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们可以在这里进行安全检查吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Need some marker tape down here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这里需要贴一些胶带标记！
找一个侦察员来看一下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Anyone else see what I'm seeing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 有人看到我看到的东西了吗？
查看你的界面元素界面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna go check this out?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们感觉到了一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You press this thing and it marks the map, see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你按下这个东西它就会标记地图，看到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How about I just show you where to go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 要不我直接告诉你去哪里？
弗莱尔认为我们应该进行调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Didn't I look dangerous to you?
When you need a job done right…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当你想要把工作做到位时……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Anyone want to say a few words for, uh, 'Random Jerkoff'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 有谁想为"这位混蛋"说几句话吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't mind getting my hands dirty.
Now that didn't go the way you were hoping, did it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 事情并没有按照你希望的方式发展，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Couldn't take a hint, could ya?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 又一具一脸惊恐的尸体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't ever think you can break me.
Bodies piling up around me yet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 尸体又在我周围堆起来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: What, you thought this was all an act?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 怎么，你以为这一切都是演的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Really? You were so easy to break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不是吧？你也太容易被打倒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yea, that was as much fun as it looked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嗯，这看上去很有趣，真做了更有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We don't play nice with tyrants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们才不会和暴君和睦相处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh, I'm sorry, you were saying?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦，不好意思。你刚才说什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This ends our brief and unpleasant relationship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们短暂而又不愉快的关系就此结束。
你尝试了，但失败了。再见。
好了找到了，坐骨神经在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You went up against an apex predator - what did you expect?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你在和顶级掠食者对抗——你以为会发生什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Gonna take a pressure washer to clean that up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 要用高压清洗机来清理它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You just gotta know where to hit 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你只要知道从哪里击中他们就行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Shoulda stepped aside when you had the chance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当你有机会走的时候就应该走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I got some under my nails. Ew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 有些卡在我指甲里了。呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'd kick 'em, but these are my good boots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我想踢他们，但我这可是双好靴子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Our sweet hands are slathered with their death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们可爱的双手沾满了他们的死亡！
抱歉，昆西。这次人头算我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Eh, it was a mercy kill.
We shall sing them a funeral dirge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们将为他们唱一首挽歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We shall write your memorial in neon and vomit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们将用霓虹灯和呕吐物写在你的纪念碑上！
这白痴让自己破绽百出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: And that's why you gotta practice your takedowns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这就是为什么你必须要练习摔倒技巧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: When did I get so frickin' dangerous?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我什么时候变得如此危险了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Decompose forever in the sarcophagus of Our song!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 在我们的歌声石棺中永远腐朽吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You know what's funny? There's always some vital part you can rip out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你知道什么好笑？总有你可以撕掉的重要器官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Let the angel rats gnaw upon your remnants!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 让天使鼠群啃食你的残骸吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: One more for my board, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 战绩榜上再添一人，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Gotta tell Minerva about that kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 得告诉米尼娃这个击杀的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The wicked children shall be kicked out of Paradise!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 邪恶的孩子将被逐出天堂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You tried to harm Our sweet Flare!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你竟敢伤害我们可爱的弗莱尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Stay the hell out of my personal space!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 别再侵犯我的私人空间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Rolled over you like a glacier!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 像冰川一样从你身上碾过！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You shall never take them! Never!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你绝对不能杀他！绝对不能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Were you trained by a drunk? What's wrong with you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你是被某个醉汉训练过吗？你怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Any who seek to part Us will burn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 任何试图分裂我们的人都会被烧死！
该死，他们的防守太弱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Metal, bone, it all shatters if you hit it right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 金属、骨头，只要击中要害，都会全部碎裂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna dance with demons, you better keep up the pace!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想与恶魔共舞，你最好跟上步伐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh, c'mon, at least make me break a sweat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦，拜托，至少让我出点汗吧！
你以为我们已经完了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Took one for the team there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我这是为团队出了一份力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I am so gonna repay you for this. Pinkie promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我一定会报答你的。拉勾勾。
啊，这才是那种经典疗法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We are more than just flesh.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 无论你喝什么，我都会买单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We won't be silenced that easily.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们不会那么轻易就沉默。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I totally owe you a solid.
I'm not indestructible. Guess I needed reminding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 原来我也不是坚不可摧的。看来该长点记性了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You fixed me up real nice.
Mosh pit rule: if they're down, get 'em up. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 冲撞区规则：如果有人倒下了，就扶他们起来。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hell yeah. Let's go. I have scores to settle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 太好了。走吧。我要去算旧账了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: So be honest: when they took me down, did it look cool?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 所以说实话吧：他们把我放倒的时候，我看起来酷吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Just forget you saw that, okay?
Try and tear me down, assholes.
They won't take me down that way twice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不会让他们用同样的招式打倒我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This bear was only playing dead.
Little acts of kindness change the world.
You screw up, you get up off your ass, you get back to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你搞砸了，你就站起来，重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How in hell did I let that happen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我怎么会让这种事发生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Please don't turn this into a teachable moment.
Ms Garcia? Book me in for a full checkup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 加西亚小姐？帮我预约一次全面检查吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: And now we process what we did wrong. Iteration, baby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在我们来看看我们做错了什么。反省，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'm grateful for your prompt assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我很感激你的及时救助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: No hugs! Well. Maybe a quick one. C'mere!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不能拥抱！好吧。也许可以快速抱一下。过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yet again We clamber forth from the pit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们又一次从深渊爬了出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'm not that easy to kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我不是那么容易被杀死的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You should see the other guy! … heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你应该看看另一个人！……呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Coulda had a force field, but noooo. Frickin' Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 本来可以有一个防身力场，但没有。该死的英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I respect it. Thanks for the help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我对此表示敬意。谢谢你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Not ready for the glue factory yet.
You take me down, you better finish me off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果你把我打倒了，最好把我彻底干掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: That's a tailoring expense I didn't need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我没想到要花笔裁缝费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Did you see who got me? Are they dead yet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你看到是谁打倒了我吗？他们死了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Appreciate the hand up. These surfaces are filthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 感谢你的帮助。这些地方太脏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna tell my driver to be more careful next time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你要不要告诉我的司机下次小心点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We shall feast upon those who would silence Us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们将吞噬那些让我们闭嘴的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I hope you've had your shot - I'm a walking biohazard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我希望你已经打过疫苗——我就是个行走的生物危害源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Pounded me like a freakin' steak.
That was horrible and I do not wanna talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 那太可怕了，我不想再提了。
可爱的恶魔！被祝福的恶魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You just denied the enemy a kill. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你刚刚阻止了敌人的击杀。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Meh, I went through worse in high school.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 无聊，我在高中时经历过更糟糕的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Body fluids everywhere. And not in a fun way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 到处都是体液。而且一点也不好玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whooo! Gotta love those sweet, swirly healing… thingies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哇哦！我真的喜欢这些甜蜜的、旋转着治愈的……小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'm in the mood for a little payback.
Well, I'm the reason humanitarian warfare protocols exist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嗯，我就是人道主义战争协议存在的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You got a cold front moving in. Hi.
You wanna burn this shithouse down?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想烧掉这个破房子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hope you know what you're doing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 希望你知道自己在做什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How about a refreshing chemical peel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 做一次清爽的化学焕肤怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Sit back, let Papa take care of it.
Hey, you wanna play with antimatter?
Everything truly delicious in life is bad for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 生活中所有好吃的东西往往是不健康的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I offer you poison, of an excellent vintage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我送你毒药，是上好的毒药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Breaking out the big guns, huh?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 来吧。我们的观众在等着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You, uh... mind if I take notes?
Minerva Hendricks. 'Saryn'. You know my reputation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 米尼娃·亨德里克斯。'Saryn'。你知道我的名声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Welcome to the party at the end of the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 欢迎来到世界末日的派对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't care if it's dangerous so long as it's not boring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 只要不无聊，危险与否都无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: If you're calling on me, this must be serious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 既然你都来找我了，那肯定是出大事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Someone called in the professionals, yea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 有人请来了专业人士，没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Please, allow me to introduce myself.
I can call up the shit that makes stars go boom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我可以召唤那些让星星爆炸的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How should I put this? I specialize in groups.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我该怎么说呢？我擅长处理大量的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I got a dozen different chemicals slam dancing in my blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我的血液里有十几种不同的化学物质在猛烈地舞动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Let me do the talking, ok?
Let's make the kind of statement that people don't walk away from.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们来干一票大的，大到人们无法忽视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ok. So, bar-room scrap, or international diplomatic incident?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好的。那么，这是酒吧斗殴事件，还是国际外交事件？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whose mess do we get to clean up this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这次我们要收拾谁的烂摊子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Who left the asylum doors open?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 是谁把精神病院的门打开了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You are now rockin' with the Kaya 'Nova' Velasco!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你现在正与卡娅·维拉斯科——"Nova" 一起摇滚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whatever we get up to is gonna be on your conscience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 无论我们做什么，你来负责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I don't care who started it - I'm finishing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我不在乎是谁开始的——我会去完成它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You want 'em to go fast? Slow? Or just… boom?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你想让他们变快？变慢？或者直接……爆炸？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Unfold like a rose beneath the poison skies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就像有毒天空下绽放的玫瑰一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Dunno how long I got left, so make the most of me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我不知道我还能撑多久，所以充分利用我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Servin' you up a cold one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 给你送上一杯冰镇啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You wanna see the molecules twinkle?
Agent assigned. Let Velimir know I'm on the case.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 已指派特工。告诉维利米尔是我在负责这个案子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Congratulations, you just shot to the top of the social pyramid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 恭喜你，你已跃居社会金字塔的顶端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The people want a show, so let's give 'em one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 人们想要一场表演，那我们就给他们一场表演吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Aww yeah. It's Velimir! In the flesh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 噢，是的。真的是维利米尔！是本人哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Okay, who do ya want erased from history?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧，你想让谁从历史上抹去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Do you feel it, pumping in your head?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你是否感觉到，它在你的脑海中跳动？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The most toxic creatures always have the most striking appearances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 最毒的生物总是有最引人注目的外表。
好吧，这种情况……已经像滚雪球一样越滚越大了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hi, I'm Kaya, I'll be your doomsday device today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嗨，我是卡娅，今天我是你的末日装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I put the 'toxic' in intoxicating, dearie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我可是"迷人"里最"致命"的那部分，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You ready for some heavy duty solutions?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你准备好采取一些强硬解决方案了吗？
让我们把这地方夷为平地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Our flesh will burn as one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们的肉体将一同燃烧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Call ahead. Clear any civilians out of our path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 先打个电话。疏散我们路上的所有平民。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't go easy on me. I'm built for the rough jobs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 别对我手下留情。我生来就适合干粗活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Sure you wanna take the risk? I'm pretty volatile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你确定要冒这个险吗？我很不稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ah, Flare… sweetest flower in the savage garden.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 啊，弗莱尔……荒野花园中最美丽的花朵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: No noncombatants. I'm a killer, not a monster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不动非战斗人员。我是杀手，不是怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We've got atomic powers and whimsical depression!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们有原子能，也有异想天开的抑郁症！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The sweetest poison in the finest of vessels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 最精致的容器里盛放着最甜蜜的毒药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yeah yeah, whizz boom whatever, let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 是啊是啊，"嗖嘣"什么的，我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ahh, they don't make 'em like me any more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 啊，像我这样的人早就绝版了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Where in hell have you been?
Yeah. I'd wanna look like me too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 是啊，我还是像我自己最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ok, you all strapped in back there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好了，你的安全带系好了没有？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Welcome back. I was starting to lose it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 欢迎回来。我开始失去理智了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: C'mon, spooky friend. Let's get this done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 来吧，幽灵朋友。让我们做成它。
好的。飞行员已登机。起飞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I wish I could remember the music I hear when you're gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我真希望我能记得你离开后我听到的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Aaaand all my little power meters just spiked. Yay Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我所有的功率仪表都飙升了。虚空万岁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How do you not weigh anything? Gods, I'd kill for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你怎么那么轻？天啊，我要是能这样就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You snuggle down nice and cosy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你就好好地、舒服地窝着吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yeah. Come on in. Hold me together.
Ooogh. Feels like swallowing a live goldfish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 噢。感觉就像吞了一条活金鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We are back to optimum efficiency!
Snug as a bug in a rug.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 像地毯里的虫子一样舒适。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You really wanna take the wheel of a burning car?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你真的想操纵一辆着火的汽车吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Think you can walk in these shoes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你以为你能穿着这种鞋走路吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Buckle up, because that's a prime specimen of Libertatian manhood you're driving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 系好安全带，因为你操纵的躯体是自由国男子气概的典型体现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ohhh, wrap around my brain like a blanket.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 噢，像毯子一样裹住我的大脑。
让我们重新量子纠缠吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yea, let's get one thing straight. There is no one that can do what we do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 是的，让我们明确一点。我们做的事别人做不到。
看看我这位可怜的漂泊陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Careful! This is the only body I own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 小心点！这是我唯一拥有的身体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: What do you suppose goes through their heads, when they see us coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当他们看到我们来的时候，你猜他们会想到什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Back to giving piggyback rides to a ghost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 回到背着幽灵到处跑的日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You know how much trust it takes for me to do this, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你知道我有多信任你才会这么做，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Do you feel how strong this plague-bearing body has had to be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你能感受到这具承受瘟疫的身体有多强壮吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: It gives me goosebumps all over when you do that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 每次你这样做我都会浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I knew you wouldn't leave me for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我知道你不会离开我太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Sure, take control of the walking nuke, what could go wrong?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当然，操控下行走的核弹，还能出什么问题呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hey how about we stop and go get a burger? What do you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嘿，我们停下来吃个汉堡怎么样？你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Welcome back to the party in my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 欢迎回到我脑海中的派对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This is only happening because I'm cool with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你能这样做单纯是因为我没反对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Do not seek to quench Our fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不要试图扑灭我们的火焰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Must be like diving into a hot tub brimming with strychnine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 一定就像跳进一个充满士的宁的热水浴缸一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Join Us, lesser voice. In harmony.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 加入我们吧，渺小的声音。一起和谐共鸣吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Wrap yourself around my spinal cord and hold on tight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 缠绕在我的脊髓并抓好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: 'Dear diary: got possessed by the space devil again.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: "亲爱的日记：又被太空恶魔附身了。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The genie is back in the bottle.
Aww. Come on back in, little hermit crab.
Flare is well. We have not devoured them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 弗莱尔很好。我们还没有吞噬他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I know you'll handle this body with respect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我知道你会以敬意地对待这个身体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Get comfy, kid. There's work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 放轻松，孩子。还有工作要做呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This is a loan. Got it?
Descend the spiral into Our boiling bliss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 让我们顺着螺旋沉浸到沸腾的狂喜之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh Gods I love how the crazy just poofs out of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦天啊，我喜欢疯狂从我体内喷涌而出的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: The mighty bloodstream of the Void washes you back to Us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 虚空的强大血流将把你冲回到我们身边！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Rough jaunt? Let me secrete you some dopamine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 旅途艰难？让我帮你分泌一些多巴胺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You're like an infection yourself, sugar. Hard to shake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你自己就像感染，甜甜。难以摆脱。
我感觉到你了。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You are now in control of some top quality Libertatian army surplus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你现在操控的是高品质的自由军物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Can you feel your self-esteem rising?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你能感觉到自尊心在不断提升吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Raise Them up, hand in ungovernable hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 高举他，手牵着无法被束缚的手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Try to ignore the pain from any old war wounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 尽量忽略那些战争创伤所造成的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: C'mooon, give the biceps a flex!
You are now breathing on manual.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔，看看谁回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Order me a double Hibernian over ice when this is done, would you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 完事后，你能给我点一杯加冰的双份爱尔兰啤酒吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hope you like the taste of cigar smoke, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 希望你喜欢雪茄的味道，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Please don't get us killed, ok?
You and me and the baby makes three…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你和我加上宝宝就是三个人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I trained this body hard. Now we both get to benefit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我有努力锻炼身体。现在我们双方都受益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Rough, tough and gruff. All yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 粗犷、坚韧、低沉。全部属于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You spread your wings, my friend.
Well. Hope it wasn't getting too traumatic for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧。希望这不会给你带来太大的创伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hmm. Feels like I lost a few pounds.
The starlight wanderer has taken flight.
Now where in hell were you hiding?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在你到底躲到哪儿了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You're leaving me alone here? With her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你要把我一个人丢在这儿？让我一个人和她在一起？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Love the theory - the reality is kind of messed up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 理论很好——在现实里却有点乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yes. I have earned a break.
You okay if I clock out for a few?
Is that an angel I see?
Do you have, like, zero mass?
Hope I wasn't suffocating you. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 希望我没有让你感到窒息。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Well damn. Feels kinda empty in here without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哎呀，没有你，这里感觉有点空荡荡的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: If you gotta go, you gotta go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果你必须走，那就走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Dude. Do the thing with the beam!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 伙计。使用那个光束技能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Please. You don't have to escape! You weren't being dissolved!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 拜托。你不必逃跑！你不会被溶解的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You come, you go, you know you treat this body like a frickin' hotel!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你来，你走，你知道你对待这个身体就像对待一个该死的旅馆一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I might do some crazy shit without you keeping me in check.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 如果没有你管束我，我可能会做出一些疯狂的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I need to know how you work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我需要知道你的运行原理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You come back when you're good and ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当你准备好了再回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Appreciate it. A guy needs his brain all to himself sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 非常感谢。一个人有时需要独处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Could I… maybe… run some tests on you… sometime?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我可以……对你……做一些测试吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Shrug me off like a second skin, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就像第二层皮一样把我蜕下，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You headin' out? Okay! Have fun out there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你要出去了吗？好的！祝你玩得开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I may start screaming. Best get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我可能会开始尖叫。你最好习惯一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Not the weirdest thing I've ever barfed up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这还不是我吐出的最奇怪的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Huh. I feel empty. Not sure I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 嗯。我感觉很空虚。我不确定我是否喜欢这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Well, I shoulda brought a book.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 因为创作理念不同而离开？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You ever wonder what that feels like for me?
I appear to have lost my passenger.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 去当突击队员，嗯？明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Flare will be just fine with me, sugar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 弗莱尔和我一起很好，甜甜。
飞行员已经弹出。保持当前位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: There ya go. Just shrug me off like a big old overcoat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 行吧。就这样甩开我，就像甩掉一件旧大衣一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hardcore science really is the same thing as magic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 硬核科学真的和魔法一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yeah. You go take a nice long walk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 行吧。你去好好散散步吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: There you are! Flesh… and blood.
And out of the cocoon came a beautiful butterfly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 一只美丽的蝴蝶从茧中破茧而出！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh. Just as I was getting used to having you in my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦。我才刚开始习惯你在我的脑海里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Now that's some spooky shit you can do there, gotta tell ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在你做的事情有点瘆人，我跟你说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You get in over your head, come get me, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 要是搞不定，来找我，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Give our regards to the Smiling One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 请代我们向笑面人问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I assume this maneuver is for sound tactical reasons?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我猜你这个操作是出于合理的战术理由？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: What the... What kind of energy even is that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 什么鬼……到底是什么能量？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You're nothing but cobwebs and starlight!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 飞行员已进入渗透模式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Huh! Look at you, all dressed and ready to go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哈！看看你，都穿好衣服准备出发了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Dude, I can't believe you got to study phasics!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 老兄，我真不敢相信你居然会学习相位学！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Raggedy ghost, go play by yourself for a while.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 啊，我这看似无害却致命的货物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Think you stepped on my liver on the way out. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我想你出去的时候踩到我的肝脏了。谢谢啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Fine, I'll wait here and go through old exam papers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好吧，那我就在这儿等着，翻翻以前的考卷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You never needed this flesh anyhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 反正你也不需要这具肉身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: No time for pleasantries. Do what you must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 没有时间寒暄。做你必须做的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I will be right here, okie dokie?
I don't like how I feel a little bit crazier without you in my head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我不喜欢这感觉，你不在我脑子里的时候我反而有点发疯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Fascinating. I must ask Ms Velasco to explain how this all works.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 太有趣了。我得请维拉斯科小姐解释一下这一切是如何运作的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Just gonna leave me here, huh? Well oh-kay! Your decision!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 就这样把我丢在这里，嗯？好吧！你决定吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Get it done and get back. We're strongest as a unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 把事情做完然后回来。团结才是最强大的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Don't be long, ok? Hey, you know I worry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 别让我等太久，好吗？嘿，你知道我会担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Hey, we got volunteers for fertilizer detail!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 看来我们找到自愿成为堆肥的人了！
我想我们把他们惹毛了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh my Gods, get to cover!
Can you kids keep it down?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你们这帮孩子能保持安静吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: They've sent us more cannon fodder!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 他们给我们送来了更多的炮灰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You are dangerously close to pissing me off!
These fools are just begging for an infection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这些蠢人只是在自寻烦恼。
总让事情变得这么复杂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Pick a target and start blasting!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你们这些混蛋想烧起来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: One at a time or all at once, it ends the same way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 一次一个，或者一次全部，结果都一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: This bunch has gotta be fresh out of bad guy bootcamp. Wow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 这群人肯定是刚从坏人训练营出来的。哇噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Whoever they are, they have no clue who they're dealing with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 不管他们是谁，他们都不知道自己在和谁打交道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Yeah, try and jump us, see how that works out for ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 来啊，试试看对付我们，看看结果怎么样。
我们尝到了暴力的滋味！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Why don't we turn this chance meeting into a massacre?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们为什么不把这次偶然的相遇变成一场大屠杀呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ah, the ambrosia of imminent death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 啊，死亡即将来临，这真是美味啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: And now you melt away like Velimir's snowflakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 现在你们就像维利米尔的雪花一样融化了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I spy some clowns who haven't read my dossier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我发现有些小丑还没有读过我的档案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Let their screams be a song!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 让他们的尖叫变成一首歌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You'll run out of ammo long before I run out of spores!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 在我用完孢子之前，你们的弹药早就用完了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Is the frickin' circus in town?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 该死的马戏团进城了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Are we gonna have a problem?
This is about to get messy and upsetting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 事情要变得混乱和闹心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Time to get our knuckles bloody.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 是时候打得满手是血了。
难道他们不感激我们吗？
正在制造一个让敌人呛住的制扼点……字面意义上的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We want everybody on their feet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们希望每个人都站起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Remember my face… while yours is melting off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 当你的脸融化时……记住我的脸 。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Can we kill these guys, please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们可以杀了这些家伙吗，求求了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Do you not know who you're up against?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 难道你不知道你的对手是谁吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh yeah. Piss off the toxic spore lady. That'll end well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 哦，对。惹怒那个有毒孢子女士。这样会有好结果的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Oh, you are in for it now.
We could crash and burn so bright…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们可以坠落并炽烈地燃烧……
这样就能保住我的腿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Ok! Let's fire this thing up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 好的！我们来启动这辆车吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I applaud your taste in transport.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我很欣赏你在交通工具上的品味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: You sure it'll take my weight?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你确定它能承受我的重量吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: How fast can that thing go?
We could just drive this back to the mall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我们可以直接把它开回商场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: We yearn to be borne upon it!
Wind in my hair sounds good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 风吹过我的头发听起来很美妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: I'm technically not supposed to drive… ah screw it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 严格来说，我不应该开车……啊，去他妈的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Where did you find that thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 你在哪里找到那东西的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Blaze Us a trail, darling demon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 为我们开辟一条道路吧，亲爱的恶魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.text: Why didn't you fire that thing up sooner?
I've gotta get me one of those.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreG.zhText: 我也要去弄一个这样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So a time traveller and a rock-n-roll mutant walk into a bar. And the mutant says 'hey, my friends all got executed, can we go back and save them?' But the time traveller says 'well, if we save them then you never go on the run and hide out at the mall, so we never meet and they can never get saved.' So it goes, right? Anyways, I'm Flare. Good to meet you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 当一位时间旅行者和一位摇滚变种人走进一家酒吧。变种人说："嘿，我的朋友都被处决了，我们可以回去救他们吗？"但时间旅行者说："好吧，如果我们救了他们，那么你就不会逃跑，也不会躲在商场里了，那样我们就永远不会相遇，他们也永远不会得救。"就是这样，对吧？不管怎样，我叫弗莱尔。很高兴认识你，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, funny story. Our cover identity was meant to be 'corporate sales reps'. So Minerva and I rock up in Höllvania with a ton of merchandise, pockets full of bribe money, replica Scaldra weapons in a hidden compartment in case a coup needs to go down, ya know, usual stuff. Then we got Infested, met Entrati, yada yada, corporate story goes out the window. So now I'm eating cold ravioli out of cans and sitting on a shipping container full of honestly kinda random stock. Ya know, I could cut you a deal if you're interested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 讲个有趣的事，我们本来的掩护身份是"公司销售代表"。所以米尼娃和我来到了霍瓦尼亚，带着一大堆商品、口袋里塞满了贿赂用的钱、还有藏在暗格里的仿制炽蛇军武器以防政变发生，你懂的，干我们这行的必要品。然后我们被感染，遇到了英择谛，等等等等，公司的掩护故事就泡汤了。所以现在我吃罐头里的冷意大利饺子，还有一个装满了杂七杂八的货物的集装箱。如果你感兴趣，我可以和你交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I don't know how much Nightingale's told you, but Velimir and I were assigned to Höllvania to achieve one key objective: secure, and if necessary terminate, major Neci Rusalka. Since we'd be working undercover, our supervisors fitted us out with authentic Scaldra weaponry at massive expense. Now that everything's gone to hell in a handcart, we're selling them off cheap. Our loss, your gain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我不知道南丁格尔告诉了你多少，但维利米尔和我被派来霍瓦尼亚是为了完成一个关键目标：逮捕、并在必要时除掉内奇·鲁莎卡少校。由于我们是秘密行动，我们的上司斥巨资为我们配备了正宗的炽蛇军武器。现在一切都乱套了，我们正低价出售这些武器。损失的是我们，便宜的是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay. So. The timeline is a frickin' mess. Luckily, young Kaya Velasco has harnessed the power of Archimedea! Now she and her rag tag team of social rejects conduct insanely dangerous research so one day we can set things right. You want in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧。所以。时间线完全一团糟。幸运的是，年轻的卡娅·维拉斯科已经掌握了科研的力量！现在，她和她那群被社会排斥的底层团队进行着极其危险的研究，以便有一天能纠正这一切。你想加入吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Well hello! Velimir Volkov the Second, and this is Minerva Hendricks. My, uh, partner. Business partner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你好！我是维利米尔·沃尔科夫二世，这是米尼娃·亨德里克斯。我的，呃，伴侣。商业伴侣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Frankly, our only concern is the current whereabouts of Neci Rusalka. Kaya Velasco is helping with the practicalities. If you need incentives, we have them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 坦白说，我们唯一关心的是内奇·鲁莎卡目前的下落。卡娅·维拉斯科正在帮忙处理实际问题。如果你需要奖励机制，我们可以提供。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Uh, stranger danger! Sorry, you're cool, I get that, I just… can't talk to you yet. Gotta wait until the Britannic dude gets the stick out of his ass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 呃，小心陌生人！抱歉，你很酷，我明白，我只是……现在还不能和你说话。得等到那个不列颠佬不再那么讲究规矩的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ah… no disrespect, but you're gonna need security clearance. Apologies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 啊……无意冒犯，但你需要安全许可。很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: When Nightingale gives you the green light, report back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 等南丁格尔批准了，你回这里汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You give me hope, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你给了我希望，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Just by existing you prove there's a way out of this, for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你的存在证明了我是有出路的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Seeya. I'll try not to die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 再见啦。我尽量不死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 回头见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'll be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我会待在这的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If I'm gone, don't panic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果我不在，别慌张。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We'll keep a spot for ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们会给你留个位置的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, be safe out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，在外面注意安全啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, look after yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，要照顾好自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Report back soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 请尽快回复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: All right. Later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧。稍后再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: See your space face later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 一会再见你这张太空脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Us weirdos gotta stick together.
