/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们这些怪人必须待在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Remember, We are your flesh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 记住，我们是你的血肉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Entwine… forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 交织缠绕……永永远远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Say hi to Lotus for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 替我向 Lotus 问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I gotta give you that vase for Maroo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我得把那个花瓶给你，是送给 Maroo 的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Seeya!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Catch ya somewhen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 有空再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look after yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 照顾好自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You're one of the real ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你是真正的英雄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Thanks for believing in me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 谢谢你对我的信任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Later, bestie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 再见，闺蜜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let's hang soon, ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们尽快再见面吧，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Seeya. Kinda wanna be ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 再见。真想成为你这样的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: May the wind be ever at your back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 祝你一路顺风！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, my friend. Go gettem, tiger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的，我的朋友。去吧，老虎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Always welcome here, you know that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这里永远欢迎你，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Don't be gone long, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 别离开太久，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whatever will Vel and I get up to alone?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维尔和我独处时会搞什么花样呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Travel safe, soldier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 战士，一路平安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Still not dead or crazy. How 'bout you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还没死，也没疯。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yo, Drifter!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哟，漂泊者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Lizzie, play nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 丽兹，乖一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ready for a deep dive into causality?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 准备好深入研究因果关系了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hello, stranger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你好，陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You don't have to keep up with the science jargon, y'know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你没必要了解那些科学术语，知道吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ah, the time-dancer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 啊，时间的舞者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, paradox!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，悖论！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Speak to Us, demon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 跟我们说说话吧，恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: 'Sup, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你好吗，漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, what can Höllvania's finest foster parents do for you today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那么，霍瓦尼亚最好的养父母今天能为你做些什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Dude, I am so glad it's you I get to work with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哥们，真高兴我能和你共事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay okay, what can we get you? Sideboards or shotguns? Recliners or rifles? Bazookas or…. Bazookas… you get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的好的，我们能给你提供什么？餐具柜还是霰弹枪？躺椅还是步枪？火箭筒还是……火箭筒……你懂我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: All set?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 准备好了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You know, I'm not really a bartender.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你知道，我其实并不是一名调酒师。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hiya, freaky space friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你好，怪异的太空朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, what'll it be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，会是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How are you the most normal person I know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我认识的人里最正常的怎么偏偏是你？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Welcome to where the old soldiers wash up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 欢迎来到老兵的归宿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You here on business?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你来这有事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, Lizzie, look who it is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，丽兹，看看这是谁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Dunno how we're ever gonna thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不知道我们该如何感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Any time you wanna collaborate…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 无论何时，如果你想合作的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Blessed demon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 受祝福的恶魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Well! Fancy seeing you here in 1999!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧！真没想到 1999 年还能在这里见到你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We are One. We welcome you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们是一体的。我们欢迎你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Told you I'd make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 告诉过你我会做到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You are embraced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你被拥抱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Good to see you, bud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 很高兴见到你，兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's no Larunda Relay, but it's home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 虽然这里比不上水神中继站，但这里是家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Heyyy, babe, look who's here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，亲爱的，看看谁来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Dude. The future. Rocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哥们。未来。太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What can Pappa Bear getcha?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 熊爸爸今天能给你什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: SU forever, am I right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 索联永存，我说得对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velimir, my love? Company.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔，亲爱的？我们有客人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: 1999 seems to be holding stable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 1999 年似乎保持稳定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hope you can stick around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 希望你能一直待这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hi, fellow time traveller!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗨，时间旅行者同伴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Always got time for you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 漂泊者，我永远有时间陪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: These are my people. My beautiful freaks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这些都是我的人。我美丽的怪物们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Dear diary. Still stranded in the late 20th century.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 亲爱的日记。还停留在 20 世纪末。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Gonna have to cut prices again. People just don't wanna buy furniture in a lockdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 又要降价了。封锁期间人们就是不想买家具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You gotta live, if only to piss off all the people who wanna see you dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你必须活下去，哪怕只是为了气死所有那些盼着你死的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ugh, my life is literally a prison.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 唉，我这日子简直就像坐牢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Great, all the more custom for my side of the trade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那好，我这边的生意越来越好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'm done running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我不会再逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is a mall of the dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这是一个毫无生气的商场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Tactical solutions are available to discreet buyers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 为谨慎的买家提供战术解决方案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You wanna help us stick it to the man?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你想帮我们反抗到底吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Taking signups for the timeline maintenance team! Make a difference in your community!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 时间线维护团队正在招募！为你的社区做出贡献！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: She means guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 她指的是枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is where you get to find out what people really stand for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 在这里你可以了解到人们真正的立场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Remember how romantic this city was the first time we came?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还记得我们第一次来到这座城市时它有多么浪漫吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: At least I've got Peely Pix! Lots… and lots… of Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 至少我还有易撕贴纸！超级多……和超级多……的易撕贴纸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The demon is abroad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 恶魔来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yea, I had to close up your stomach wound with a staple gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊，我不得不用订书机把你肚子上的伤口缝起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Finally I get to go for coffee without getting stink-eye and bitchy comments! Because everybody's dead!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我终于可以不用忍受别人的白眼和吐槽去喝杯咖啡了！因为所有人都死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: My sweet Flare!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我甜甜的弗莱尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We need to get after her, Velimir. She's still our responsibility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔，我们得追上她。我们要对她负责到底。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Who would've known that baking soda volcano in third grade would lead to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 谁能想到三年级时的小苏打火山会引发这样的后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Call them up for the last dance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 叫他们来跳最后一支舞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So we keep on working with Kaya until something turns up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所以我们继续和卡娅合作，直到有新发现！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Aoi you are not adorable and you are not my babysitter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 碧，你不可爱，而且你也不是我的保姆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: After the plague, the burning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 瘟疫之后，是焚烧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Well I coulda fixed this place up better than Captain Teabag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯，要修缮这里的话，我的手艺可比茶包队长强多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Heyyy, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You're insulting our hosts, and you're embarrassing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你在侮辱我们的主人，真让我难堪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Here we go round the temporal loop…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们回到了时间的起点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You need luxury goods? Fine furnishings? I'll fix you right up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你需要奢侈品？精美家具？我马上给你搞定！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I have genuine Scaldra hardware, clean, untraceable. No credit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我有炽蛇军正品硬件，干净整洁，无法追踪。现金交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: YOU. You knew all along, right? That I'd make it? Because when you left for 1999, I was already here, wasn't I? But you let me figure it out for myself, without helping. Thanks. For not spoiling how my story ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你。你一直都知道，对吗？知道我会成功的？因为当你去了 1999 年时，我已经在这里了，不是吗？但你让我自己摸索，没有提供帮助。谢谢。谢谢你没有剧透我的故事结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's a mall. A space mall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这是一个商场。一个太空商场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That dude has, like, flesh arms and a robot head!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那家伙有肉臂和机械头！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What do you people even do for money? Do you take Höllars?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你们这些人到底收什么样的钱？你们收霍币吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh my Gods, that was a Cephalon. Amir is gonna die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我的天哪，那是一个中枢。阿米尔死定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah, I'm the Kaya Velasco, the woman who broke the time barrier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是的，我就是卡娅·维拉斯科，那个打破时间障碍的女人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Pourin' one out in memory of literally everyone I ever met.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 为纪念我遇到的每一个人，我干一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Uh… bye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 呃……再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Well, if you gotta leave...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧，如果你要离开的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yes. Run along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好了。快走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Flare is Ours, demon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 弗莱尔是我们的，恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Here's what we got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这就是我们手头的货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Everything I could scrape together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所有我能凑到的东西都在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Just a few personal treasures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 只是一些私人珍藏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Mmmm. Merch stand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯嗯。商品摊位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They left Us so very little.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他们给我们留下的太少了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: All that remains of the dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 梦醒后留下的所有东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: First apartment? I gotcha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 第一次有自己的公寓？我帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What do you do when they move out and take their stuff? Ya buy more stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 当他们搬出去后拿走他们的东西时，你会怎么做？买更多的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: In every dream home… you know how it goes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 在每个梦想之家里……你知道的，也就这么回事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Sure you could furnish an apartment with this, but you could also build a maze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 当然，你可以用它来布置公寓，但你也可以建一个迷宫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Here's what I got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这就是我手头上的货了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Feast your eyes, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 开开眼界吧，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If you ever need to build a barricade out of arcade cabinets, well I'm your guy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你哪次想用街机柜台搭建路障，找我就对了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Need a couch? Cosy but big enough to snuggle on? Know what I mean? Say no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 需要沙发吗？舒适又大到可以躺在上面？明白我的意思吗？不用解释了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Entrati left you a brick cell, bud. Now you owe it to yourself to make it your own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 英择谛留给了你一间牢房，伙计。现在你去把它变成自己的小窝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: No more Drifting. Time you settled down tiger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不再漂泊了。是时候安定下来了，老虎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Have the home you always wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 享有你梦寐以求的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra weapons. Untraceable. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军武器。无法追踪。拿去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: These should level the playing field somewhat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这些在某种程度上应该能让竞争环境更公平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Take Viktor's troops on with their own arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 用维克多的武器库对付他们自己人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look what I've got. Efervon-based weaponry. Banned in most civilized countries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 看看我得到了什么。艾弗旺武器。这在大多数文明国家都被禁用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Brutal, efficient and reliable. Don't let the pedigree put you off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 野蛮、高效、可靠。不要被它的历史唬住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Here. Be discreet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 给你。小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: There's a certain savage justice in taking the oppressor down with their own weapons. Don't ya think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 用压迫者自己的武器来打倒他们，有一种野蛮的正义感。你不这么认为吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look, this conversation never took place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 听着，这次对话从未发生过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra must be stopped by any means necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 必须不惜一切手段阻止炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Fine, we went to a lot of trouble to keep these out of the hands of Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧，我们费了很大劲才没让炽蛇军拿到这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let's do business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 开始做生意吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You need a minute?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你需要再考虑一会吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We shall wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们会等着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Now what if Amir wants to come for game night and there aren't enough chairs, huh? Imagine the look on that little guys face!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 万一阿米尔想来参加游戏之夜，但没有足够的椅子怎么办？想象一下那个小家伙脸上的表情！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Fine, okay, but the time is gonna come when you'll wish you'd bought that traffic cone from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧，好吧，但总有一天你会后悔没从我这里买那个路锥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你还会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That's okay. It ain't going anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 没关系，它自己也跑不掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Your decision, bud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你决定，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, no pressure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的，别有压力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 随便吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Need to measure the space first? No problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 要回去先测量下尺寸吗？没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Need time to think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还要再想一下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Take all the time you need, it's your space.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不急不急，这地方是你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: But they're so shiny!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 但是它们好闪亮啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Story of my life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我日常习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Alllrightythen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You just wanna browse, you go ahead and browse. Have fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 想先看看不买也没关系，请便。玩的开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Fine, I get to keep them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧，我留着它们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Maybe Minerva has something more your speed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 也许米尼娃有更合适你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Come back when you've made your mind up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 等你拿定主意了再回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Understood. Another time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 明白。下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You know I'm taking a risk here, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你知道我这是在冒险，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Need to reschedule?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 需要重新安排吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 懂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Nightingale vouched for you, so I assume you know what you're doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 南丁格尔为你担保，所以我想你知道自己在做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: When you're ready, come see me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 准备好了就来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Were you just making conversation?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你来只想聊天吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If it was furniture you were after, talk to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你是来看家具的，那就跟他谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Keep it real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 货真价实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: In the bag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 已经搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oooh, good choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 噢，好眼光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Delightful!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 愉快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Excellent choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 选得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'll have it shipped right over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 马上发货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okey-dokey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好滴好滴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It ain't clutter if you love it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你喜欢它，它就不是杂物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You are living like royalty, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我的朋友，你这气派简直像皇室一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Thank you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, party at your place?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 看来要在你家聚会了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hours of adhesive entertainment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 数小时的粘合剂娱乐时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Roger, let me just ring that up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的，马上帮你结账。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Did you get any rares?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你得到什么稀有物品了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Enjoy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 尽情享受吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Have fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 玩的开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hope you got what you're after.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 希望你得到了你想要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: There ya go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Very good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Beckett should have any necessary tech specs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 贝克特应该具备所有必要的技术规格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I believe that concludes our business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我觉得我们的业务到此结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hm. Time for a drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯。是时候喝一杯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: No documentation. Obviously.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 收据这种东西，不存在的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 真棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Proud to be of service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 很荣幸能为您服务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Remember Peely Pix? Those delightful stickers are what we've been using to mark unique spatio-temporal connections as we uncover them. You choose the Peely Pix you want, stick 'em to your mission plan, and you'll get a bit of help from somewhere else on the timeline! Any time you find a whole unopened pack, bring it to me and we'll open it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还记得易撕贴纸吗？这些可爱的贴纸是我们用来标记独特时空连接的。你选择想要的易撕贴纸，把它贴在任务计划上，你就能从时间线上的其他地方获得一些帮助！如果你找到一整包没开封的贴纸，把它拿给我，我们一起打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Not just glittery nostalgia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不仅仅是闪闪发光的怀旧情结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's okay to like these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 喜欢这些也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: These are kind of a fixation of mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这些都是我的癖好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How's your collection coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你的收藏进展如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Cute things with ominous implications. Relatable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 可爱的事物却暗藏不祥的寓意，我深有体会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Not exactly scientific, but they're what I had.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 虽然不怎么科学，但是我只有这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look! Pretty!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 看！真漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Still with the lingering bubblegum odour.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还残留着甜甜的泡泡糖味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The sticky never seems to wear off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这种粘性似乎永远不会消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let me know if you're hunting that one elusive Peely Pix!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你正在寻找那张难以发现的易撕贴纸，请告诉我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Stick 'em on your binder, your wall, your personal timeline...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 把它们贴在你的活页夹、墙上或你的个人时间线上……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They can hurt you, they can break your body, but they can't make you lie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他们可以伤害你，可以摧残你的身体，但他们无法逼你撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You gotta tell the truth on that stage. Use whatever craft you need to make it sing, but don't ever fake it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 上了舞台，就得说真话。用尽一切技巧让它更出彩，但绝对不能弄虚作假。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The glare and the glitter were never a mask. They were a message. Look at me, see me, because I'm not changing myself for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那些光芒和闪耀从来都不是面具。它们是一种宣言。看着我，看清我，因为我不会为你改变自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I reckon we're gonna burn up one day, like a hero on the solstice bonfire. It's funny how the crowd always wants a sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我想我们终有一天会化为灰烬，就像冬至篝火上的英雄一样。有趣的是，人们总是想要看到牺牲者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Every artist needs a devil on their shoulder… or a monkey on their back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 每个艺术家都需要肩头有个心魔……或是背上压着重轭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Sickness, fever, heat and madness. Love sings the same lyrics as disease.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 疾病、发烧、冲动和疯狂。爱情和疾病唱着同样的歌词。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They were always Ours. Marked out from birth. Just as you were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他永远都是我们的。从出生起就被标记了。就像你一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: When the dreamers wake and the lidless eyes turn upon them, We shall sing the last number of the night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 当梦回者醒来，无睑之眼转向他们时，我们将唱出今晚的最后一首歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velimir. Enough with the cutesy little ice crystals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔。够了，别再玩这些可爱的小冰晶了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Don't know what you mean. Drifter's not complaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不知道你在说什么。漂泊者可没抱怨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You really think Neci will want to see you again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你真的认为内奇想再次见到你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Gods forbid we don't give her everything she wants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 但愿我们能给她想要的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Are you going to keep picking at those bar snacks?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你还要继续慢慢地吃那些酒吧小菜吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I dunno. Are you going to keep riding my ass about it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我不知道。你还想继续跟我兜圈子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: When she finally gets up, that bar stool's gonna have a truly epic butt print.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 等她终于站起来时，那张吧台凳子上肯定会留下一道史诗般的屁股印。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ignore him, Drifter. It's an easy feat to learn. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 漂泊者，别理他。这很容易学会。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Being stuck here with you reminds me of my RTI training.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 和你一起困在这里，让我想起了抗审讯训练的那段日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That so? Reminds me of the time I got locked in a chemical toilet and rolled downhill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是吗？也让我想起了我被锁在化学厕所里和厕所一起滚下坡的那次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Well you see, Drifter. It was her voice that first captivated me. Like a rusty nailgun marinated in cooking sherry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯，你看，漂泊者，先吸引我的是她的声音。听上去像一把泡过料酒的生锈钉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ah, Velimir. The soul of a poet trapped in the body of a frat-house couch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哈，维利米尔。你真是诗人的灵魂被困在兄弟会的沙发里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You need to think about what we're going to offer Neci if you ever want to get her back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你想把内奇救回来，你得想想我们拿什么打动她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: She had the respect of every single Scaldra goon in this city! What do you suppose made her want that so bad?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 她可是这座城市里每一个炽蛇军恶棍都尊敬的人。你觉得她为什么那么想要这些人的尊敬？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whatever happened to you and me, Minerva?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 米尼娃，你和我之间到底发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You know damn well what happened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你很清楚发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Believe it or not, Velimir was quite the operative, once. Until his priorities shifted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你可能不信，维利米尔曾经是个出色的特工。但后来他的重心变了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You're goddamn right. Becoming a parent is meant to do that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你说得太对了。成为父母自然让人改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look, Minerva. You hate me. I get it. So leave. Nobody's forcing you to stay here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 听着，米尼娃。你恨我。我明白。那就走吧。没人逼你留在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Not a hope. We made this mess together, we'll fix it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 没得选。我们一起造成了这个烂摊子，我们就要一起解决它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: He used to love buying me chocolates. Funny how he doesn't do that any more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他以前很喜欢给我买巧克力。搞笑的是他现在再也不这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Found out it was poisonous to dogs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 后来发现它对狗有毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Go easy on the Old Fashioneds, Minerva. You know Kaya could call on us any time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 别喝太多了，米尼娃。你知道卡娅随时会需要我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah. Wouldn't want to let her down too, now would we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊。我们也不想让她失望，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Would you frost my glass a little, good sir?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 先生，能帮我的杯子加点冰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: One frosted ass, coming right up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 冰镇冷饮，马上就来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How did a bum like me end up hitched to a queen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 像我这样一个流浪汉，怎么会和女王结婚？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Staying power, honey. That big old glacier just ground me down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 亲爱的，是耐力。那座大冰山把我压得喘不过气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Mmm. My feet are aching after that last run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯。跑完最后那一趟，我的脚都疼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You, uh, want me to take care of that? I can close up for a few.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你，额，要我来处理吗？我可以先关门一会儿

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Do you see what a beauty I get to look at all day, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你知道我整天看到的都是什么样的美景吗，漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh, he plays the romantic. But we both know what base and wicked thoughts are circling in that fishbowl of a brain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，他装得挺浪漫。但我们都知道，在他那鱼缸般的脑袋里打着什么下流邪恶的念头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: He's devoted to me, Drifter. Like a loyal pet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 漂泊者，他对我死心塌地的。就像只忠诚的宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What can I say? I crave my belly rubs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我能说什么呢？我就爱被挠肚肚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I know they're our friends, but if any of those Hex try putting the moves on you, there's gonna be trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我知道他们是我们的朋友，但如果那些六人组中的任何一个想对你动手，那就会有大麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So crass and yet so charming. My very own thawed-out caveman.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如此粗鲁，却又如此迷人。简直是我专属的解冻原始人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Don't keep us busy too long, Drifter. We do have other business to attend to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 漂泊者，别让我们忙太久。我们还有其他事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Aww. She's acting coy. Isn't she cute when she does that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哎呦。她装怕羞。她这样是不是很可爱？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You want some ice on those bruises?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你想要用冰敷敷那些伤口吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What a contrived way to ask me to undress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你还真会想到方式叫我脱衣服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ya know, Quincy's been doing good work with the local kids. A lot of them have been left without parents. If Neci never comes back…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你知道，昆西一直在帮着照顾当地的孩子。他们中许多人失去了父母。如果内奇再也回不来了的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let's make that decision when the time comes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 到时再做决定吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I never meant to be a soft touch. I just loved seeing our kid's eyes light up when I said 'yes'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我从没想过要做一个心软的人。我只是喜欢看见我们的孩子在听我说"可以"时那双闪闪发亮的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh honey, kindness isn't a weakness, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦亲爱的，善良不是弱点，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So you know how if you keep on rewinding a video and playing it back, the quality gets worse and worse and one day it just breaks? Same deal with the timeline. We need to do some serious research to find and fix the weak spots in the tape. Then you can keep on looping and, y'know, stop the entire cosmos going to shit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你知道，如果你不断倒带一段视频并播放它，它的质量会越来越差，总有一天它会坏掉吗？时间线也是一样的。我们需要做些认真的研究，找出并修复磁带中的弱点。然后你就可以继续循环，并且，你知道的，阻止整个宇宙走向毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, get your loadout ready because once you're locked in, I can not pull you out without the whole run going to hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好了，准备好你的装备，因为一旦锁定，我就不能把你拉出来，否则整个行动就完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Got a set of crisis events lined up for you. Make sure we get a gold star on each one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 有一系列危机事件等着你。确保我们每件事都做到最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velimir and Minerva are ready when you are. Stand by for temporal shenanigans!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔和米尼娃已经准备好了，就等你了。准备迎接时空的恶作剧吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Come on, let's bring the house down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 来吧，让我们炸翻全场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We're not even half way through this set list.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们甚至还没有到这份歌单的一半呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Not gonna quit now are ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你不会现在就退出吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We were just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们才刚开始呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We could dip into our back catalog.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 要不我们翻翻老作品看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Should we stay or should we go. Hmm… That could actually make a good song.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们是走是留呢。嗯……这听起来像是首不错的歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let's give it another go, sugar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们再来一遍吧，甜甜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We want more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们想要更多！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You cannot be spent, demon! Not while We seethe!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你可不能倒下，恶魔！我们仍在沸腾！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Come on. You know little Viktor wants to hear an encore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 来吧。你知道小维克多想听安可曲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hear that? They still want more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 听到了吗？他们还想要更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We got lots more in US.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们还有大把的能耐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Flare, are you trying to become a martyr?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 弗莱尔，你就这么想当烈士吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Martyr? You think you can kill me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 烈士？你觉得你能杀得了我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You want to help Höllvania? When you couldn't even help your bandmates?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你想帮助霍瓦尼亚？在你连自己的乐队成员都帮不了的情况下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Trying to get under my skin? You of all people should know, my skin is much thicker than it used to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 想激怒我？你应该知道，我现在的脸皮可比以前厚多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What's so dangerous about a little rock & roll, Viktor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维克多，来点摇滚乐又有什么危险呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Does he fear the corrupted youth will rise?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他是不是担心那些堕落的年轻人会起来反抗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Little Viktor whimpers. We made him the fool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 小维克多在哭哭啼啼。我们让他出丑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It was all in good fun. Until it wasn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 一开始只是图个乐。直到后来笑不出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The fugitive Flare has brought filth to Höllvania. Filthy ideas. Filthy music. Filthy Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 逃犯弗莱尔给霍瓦尼亚带来了污秽。污秽的思想。污秽的音乐。污秽的科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You said you were a fan. It's not our fault you didn't listen to our lyrics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你说你是粉丝，你没听我们的歌词不是我们的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Little Viktor wants to play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 小维克多想玩玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I already told him, we don't have any room in this band for hack wannabes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我早就告诉过他了，我们乐队不收没本事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We make music. He's killing the city. Tell me again who the real monster is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们创作音乐。而他正在毁灭这座城市。再告诉我一下，谁才是真正的怪物？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Demon protects, Viktor devours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 恶魔守护，维克多吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: A gracious shout out to my lovely friends providing security today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 向今天提供安保的可爱朋友们致以诚挚的谢意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They're killing it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他们太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Höllvania! I need you to know: You are loved. You are needed. You are not disposable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚！我需要你知道：你是被爱着的。你是被需要的。你不是可有可无的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Reject The Smiling One!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 拒绝笑面人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Send in a Screamer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 派出尖啸者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Enough of this. Ready a Screamer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 够了。准备派出尖啸者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let's show Flare what real vocals sound like. Release the Screamer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 让我们向弗莱尔展示一下什么才叫真正的主唱。释放尖啸者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Regretting your decisions, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 后悔你的决定了吧，弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Looking a little worse for wear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你看上去有点狼狈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra. They're weak. Push.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军。他们变弱了。推进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Should have quit while you were ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 早就该见好就收了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Security! Little help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 保安！帮个小忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Get those guys out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 把那些家伙赶出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We must all suffer for our art?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们非得为我们的艺术受苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I've endured nastier critics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我曾遭受过更加恶毒的批评。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The show will go on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 表演还会继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We like the hurting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们喜欢疼痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Give Us more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 给我们更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Do not scratch Our enamel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不要刮伤我们的瓷漆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Blood made Us. Blood fuels Us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 鲜血造就了我们。鲜血驱使着我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Still in tune, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还在调上吗，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We quiver in harmony with our sweet Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们与亲爱的弗莱尔一同共鸣颤抖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Sound check?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 能听清吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: One, two, three. Can't kill We.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 一、二、三。杀不死我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Think that will shut us up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你以为这样就能让我们闭嘴吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Little Viktor is so desperate We can smell it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 小维克多非常绝望，我们可以嗅到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Alright Velasco, you got me. What's so important about a concert?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧维拉斯科，你说服我了。音乐会有什么重要的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Something with as many eyes on it as Flare's concert is gonna twist up the timeline like whoa. Make sure they keep playing until my readings are done. And… grab me some promo merch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 像弗莱尔演唱会那样万众瞩目的活动，一定会让时间线变得混乱。确保他们一直表演到我的读数结束。还有……帮我拿些宣传周边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Temple and the Rippers gig in Solstice Square, Neci was here? In the time before the time we're in now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: Temple 和撕裂者乐队在至日广场演出时，内奇在场吗？在我们目前所处的时间循环之前的某个循环？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Exactly. Major entanglement event. You keep Flare alive and shredding, I'll track the fraying timeline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 没错，重大纠缠事件。你要保证弗莱尔活着并继续演奏，我来追踪破碎的时间线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Wow. So many lives changed track because of this one event. Timeline spaghetti.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇。很多人的生活因为这件事改变了轨迹。乱成一团时间线意面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: "If you remember it, you weren't there."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: "如果你还记得，说明你不在场。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Nice job. Flare's safe. Readings were pretty meh, but I got a bootleg and some peelies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 干得漂亮。弗莱尔安全了。读数虽然一般，但我还是拿到了盗版唱片和一些贴纸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Good to know I'm risking my neck in a noble cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 很高兴得知我卖命是为了这个崇高的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You ever, like, wonder if Techrot utilizes Void energy at the molecular level? Like, if we could prove that was true… We need evidence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你有没有想过，科腐者能不能在分子层面利用虚空能量？如果我们能证明这一点……我们需要证据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'm up for whatever, Velasco, as long as it can help us find out what happened to Neci.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我愿意做任何事，维拉斯科，只要它能帮助我们找出内奇出了什么事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: People think the consequences of time travel are all like, 'Oh no, mom and dad never kissed and now I don't exist.' Cute but no. How about cracks in the spatiotemporal fabric followed by the breakdown of reality as we know it. That's what we're trying to prevent here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 人们认为时间旅行的后果都是，"哦，不，爸爸妈妈没有亲吻过，所以我不存在了。"这很可爱，但不是真的。时空结构出现裂缝，我们所知的现实随之崩溃。这正是我们试图避免的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, if stomping all this Techrot keeps 'reality' intact. I'm here for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，如果弄死这些科腐者可以让"现实"保持完整，那算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ms Velasco, we have already terminated half the designated targets. I do hope your note-taking is keeping up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维拉斯科女士，我们已经消灭了一半的指定目标。我希望你的笔记能跟上进度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Confirming extermination proceeding as planned. Midpoint reached. No significant issues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 确认歼灭进程按计划进行。已到达中点。无重大问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh dude, if you could see what I'm seeing. Chronometer going absolutely nutzoid. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，伙计，真想让你看看我都看到了什么。精密记时表完全疯了。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Elimination quota has been met. Did you get what you needed, Velasco?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 歼灭指标已满足。你得到你想要的东西了吗，维拉斯科？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Um… Well… I think we need to gather more evidence. Stage two, here we come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嗯……好吧……我认为我们需要收集更多的证据。第二阶段，开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Techrot screaming on multiple wavelengths, timeline flaws standing out like zits on a cheerleader… interesting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者在多个波长上尖叫，时间线上的瑕疵就像啦啦队队员脸上的粉刺一样明显……真有趣！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Just so long as this was all worth the effort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 只要这一切都值得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's lab day. Yay. Here's the dealio: you get those Hell-Scrubbers online and I monitor their sensor clusters for any signs of Void encroachment? Cool? Cool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 今天是实验日。太好了。事情是这样的：你把那些地狱净化器带上线，我负责监控它们的传感集群，看是否有虚空入侵的迹象。好吗？好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yah, chemistry was more my thing, but… you lead the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好。我更擅长化学，但是……你带路吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: These Hell-Scrubbers have been marinating in Techrot for gods knows how long. Get them to work again and that's bound to prime the timeline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这些地狱净化器在科腐者中浸泡了天知道有多久。让它们重新运转，这肯定会整理好时间线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whatever you say, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你说了算，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh gah...Sure wish Scaldra had put up this kind of fight before they lost their Hell-Scrubbers the first time around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 真是的……要是炽蛇军在第一次失去地狱净化器之前也这么奋力战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You call that a spore cloud? I'll show you a spore cloud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你管这叫孢子云？我给你看看什么是真正的孢子云。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whoa. Um… Minerva. There's something here. Not sure what but something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇。嗯……米尼娃。这里有些东西。不确定是什么，但肯定有东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Always better than nothing. What's next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 总比没有好。下一步是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That's a wrap, did you get what you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 结束了，你得到你需要的东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I got a lot of noise. And I'll need a lot more noise to see if there's a pattern. Then maybe I can find something. Easy peasy, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我听到了很多噪音。我需要更多的噪音来判断是否有规律可循。这样我也许就能找到一些东西。很简单，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is, like, the concert of 1999. The temporal ripples from this one event are off the charts. Plus, Flare is way hotter than any of those silly On-lyne boys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这就是 1999 年那场演唱会。这一事件带来的时间涟漪已经超出了正常范围。而且，弗莱尔比那些傻乎乎的线上时代男孩们要帅得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: At least I can understand what those boys are singing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 至少我能听懂那些男孩在唱什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What's the plan, Kaya? Security detail?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 有什么计划吗，卡娅？要我做安保吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's just a hunch, but Neci saw an instance of this concert before she disappeared. You keep the show going and I'll watch the chronometer for any fluctuations that might be related to her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这只是一种预感，但内奇在失踪前曾看过这场音乐会。你让演出继续进行，我负责观察计时器，看有没有任何可能与她有关的波动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: My 10th-grade science teacher tried to fail me because I refactored the Hails conjecture to reflect non-deterministic modalities. And she was all like, 'we're learning the periodic table'. And I was all like, you're so stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我十年级的科学老师试图让我不及格，因为我重构了海尔斯猜想以反映非确定性模式。她当时说，"我们正在学习元素周期表"。而我当时想说，你真蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hello! Kaya! Reading Hell-Scrub towers ahead. Will proceed as if that's the plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 卡娅！读数显示前方有地狱净化器。就当作是计划的一部分继续了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: First experiment: Hell-Scrub. If there are Peely Pix on any of these exhumed bad boys, I'll detect them and mark the timeline continuum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 第一个实验：地狱净化。如果这些被挖出的坏蛋上有任何易撕贴纸，我会检测到它们并标记出时间线连续体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Wait? When would you have put Peely Pix on a Hell-Scrubber? You know what, it's better if I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 等等？你什么时候会把易撕贴纸放在地狱净化器上？算了，我不知道最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ugh… I can smell the Techrot from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 呃……我在这里都能闻到科腐者的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh god, try smelling it from our position. Burnt plastic is potpourri compared to this stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 天哪，你得来我们这儿闻闻。与这种东西相比，烧焦的塑料简直就是香水。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Let me get this straight. You detect one of your little stickers on a Hell-Scrubber, and you can use that to track changes in the timeline?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我得问清楚。你在地狱净化器上检测到你的一个小贴纸，然后就可以用它来追踪时间线的变化？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You ever written, like, so hard that you could still read what you wrote four pages down in your notebook? Peely Pix are like that, but with time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你有没有就是特别用力写字，以至于笔记本的四页之后还能看清自己写的东西？易撕贴纸就是这样，但是用于时间的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: And that's time. Hell-Scrub complete. Remind me again why it has to be this hard?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 时间到了。地狱净化完成。这件事为啥非得这么难？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah, that's because easy things don't leave dents in space-time. Duh. Next mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好，那是因为简单的事情不会在时空上留下痕迹。 懂吧。下一个任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hell-Scrub objective met. You sure this is worth it, Velasco?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 地狱净化的目标已经达成。你确定这值得吗，维拉斯科？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Every time a new legacyte gets created I see a tiny temporal surge. Statistically significant? I'll know when I can spot a Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 每当有新的传承种生成时，我都会看到微小的时间激增。这有统计学意义吗？当我看到易撕贴纸的时候，我就会知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Get your equipment ready. The cat and I will deal with the Legacyte.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 准备好你的装备。我和猫会去对付传承种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If you harvest a Legacyte under the precise conditions outlined in my model we should see… something. I don't know what, but I'll know it when I see it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果你在我的模型中描述的精确条件下收割传承种，我们应该会看到……一些东西。我不知道是什么，但当我看到它时，我会知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Does the Techrot mourn its lost children? Let's go, Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者会为失去的孩子哀悼吗？走吧，卡利莫斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look, we're basically devouring the Techrot's young here. Can you blame it for wanting to change history?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 看吧，我们简直是在追杀科腐者的幼崽。难怪它们想改变历史。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The hivemind isn't happy with me, Kaya! I hope this is worth it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者集体对我很生气，卡娅！我希望这是值得的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh. Okay. Didn't expect those results but… But… but… Okay I know what to do next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，好吧。没想到会有这样的结果，但……但……但……好吧，我知道下一步该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Far be it from me to undermine the confidence of youth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我可不会让年轻人失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh man, when you took out that Legacyte, you wouldn't believe the data spike I saw. Do I know what it means? No. But we're not done yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 噢，天哪，当你干掉那个传承种时，你不会相信我看到的那些数据飙升。我知道这意味着什么吗？不知道，但我们还没完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It means something's pushing back against what we're trying to do here. Next target, Kaya. Go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这意味着有东西正在阻碍我们。去下一个目标，卡娅。加油！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra signals are messing with all my equipment. The jerks! Will you, like, take a bunch out and see if that clears things up? I really need clean data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军信号干扰了我的所有设备。真是混蛋！你能不能，就是，干掉一群，看看能不能解决问题？我真的很需要干净的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra termination assignment accepted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 已接受歼灭炽蛇军的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ugh. I hate Scaldra. All their signal jammers and comm pollution are messing up my instrument readings. Wipe 'em out and we get glorious radio silence. At least for a minute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 唉，我讨厌炽蛇军。他们所有的信号干扰器和通讯污染都让我的仪器读数变得一团糟。消灭他们，我们就能享受片刻的宁静。至少一分钟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Until Viktor's tantrums start. I'm on it, Ms Velasco.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 至少到维克多开始生气时。我会处理这件事的，维拉斯科女士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Enemy numbers dropping. Scaldra opposition are as relentlessly mediocre as predicted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 敌人数量下降。炽蛇军的抵抗正如预测的那样，平庸无能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ms Velasco? Half the Scaldra force has been permanently silenced. Check your signals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维拉斯科女士？过半炽蛇军部队已清除。检查你的信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'm catching something through the fuzz, sounds like… chanting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我在模糊的杂音里捕捉到了一些东西，听起来像是……吟唱？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Did you get what you needed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你得到你需要的东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velasco, tell me that was worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维拉斯科，告诉我这值得吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The bigger the target, the wilder my chronometer goes. We need to find the biggest target in town: a Scaldra Efervon tank.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 目标越大，我的计时器就越疯狂。我们需要找到城里最大的目标：一辆炽蛇军艾弗旺坦克。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You want us to take out one of Vodyanoi's fancy new tanks? Yeah, I think we can oblige.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你想让我们干掉维德诺伊的一辆新式坦克吗？好的，我想我们能做到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We got orders. Hard-target. The kid needs us to scrap one of Viktor's new toys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们收到了命令，是个硬茬。那个孩子要我们废掉维克多的新玩具 。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: An Efervon tank? Oh, I thought she'd never ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 艾弗旺坦克？哦，我还以为她忘了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whoa. Needle on the Chronometer just went flat. Whatever you did, it settled the timeline right down. But… Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇。计时器的指针突然归零了。不管你做了什么，它都让时间线稳定下来了。但是……为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Viktor is now short one armored nightmare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维克多的装甲怪物又少了一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh wow. You guys are my heroes. You killed it out there, I have so much data to sift through. Now the real fun begins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 噢，哇哦，你们是我的英雄。你们的表现太棒了，我有很多数据需要筛选。现在真正的乐趣开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Remember when I used to take you out dancing? Wasn't so long ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 还记得我以前带你出去跳舞吗？这还不是多久之前的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Don't get any ideas. We've got a job to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 别胡思乱想。我们还有工作要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I can't believe what's going on. The Peely Pix, the chronometer, everything's going crazy. Something is special about this moment. You can't let anything happen to Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我简直不敢相信眼前的一切。易撕贴纸、计时器，一切都乱套了。这一刻有些特别。你不能让弗莱尔出任何事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The show will go on. We'll make sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 演出会继续下去。我们会确保的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Woo. Yeah. So good. Man. Flare is just… I can't even. Just so good. And oh yeah. So are you guys. Thanks for all your help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇。耶。太棒了。天哪。弗莱尔简直……我无法形容。真是太棒了。对了，你们也是。谢谢你们的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah. Our pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的。我们荣幸之至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: PLAY FREE DOVE!!!! Wait… why we stopping??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 演奏《自由鸽子》！！！！等等……我们为什么停下了？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Come on. Show's over, Vel. Time to go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维尔，表演结束了。该回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is it. The final experiment. And this one's a doozy. I need you to clear the area of Scaldra. I can't say exactly why. I just know the math checks out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 就是它了。最后的实验。这个实验非同小可。我需要你清除区域内的炽蛇军。我不能确切地说出原因。我只知道计算结果没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I was never much for math, but I trust that you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我从来都不喜欢数学，但我相信你喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The Scaldra in the area, they're already dead, at least, like, they were. But now they're not, and that's a big problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这个区域里的炽蛇军，他们已经死了，至少，像是，他们曾经死过了。但现在他们没有死，这是一个大问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Wait, you're saying we already deep-sixed these guys and if we don't put 'em down again, the wheels come off the universe? That tracks. Vel, let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 等等，你是说我们已经把这些家伙打死了，如果不再次拿下他们，那宇宙就崩溃了？有道理。维尔，我们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, Scaldra. You could have just gone home and left Höllvania in peace, but you had to show here, didn't ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，炽蛇军。你们本可以老老实实回家，让霍瓦尼亚平静下来，但你们非要出现在这里，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: At least the Techrot are mindless drones. What's your excuse, Scaldra?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 至少科腐者都是些没头脑的蠢货。炽蛇军，你们有什么借口呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whoa. Good job we did this. There's a serious Indifference cavity forming in early November. We better make extra sure to wish the Nightingales a happy birthday this year.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇。我们做得很好。11 月初有个严重的虚空无情之物空洞。我们今年最好确保为两位南丁格尔送上生日祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Job done, and we're clocking out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 任务完成，我们打卡下班了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Roger that. Okay, Drifter, you ought to be able to loop without pitching us all into oblivion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 收到。好了，漂泊者，你应该能循环而不会把我们和整个时间线都毁了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Homestretch. Take out a whole lot of Techrot, I need the Hivemind all worked up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 最后冲刺。消灭大量科腐者，我需要集体意识全部兴奋起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey Minerva, remember when I'd get you all worked up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，米尼娃，还记得我让你兴奋的时候吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Just try and focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 试着集中注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is the final stage in my research. It's super duper critical that you don't stop kicking Techrot butt. Understood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这是我研究的最后阶段。千万不能停止攻击科腐者，这点非常关键。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Loud and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 清楚明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look. I trust the kid, Vel, I do, but this is some heavy voodoo. What if, I don't know, what if we can't make things right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 瞧。维尔，我相信那孩子，真的，但这是某种厉害的巫术。如果，我不知道，如果我们不能把事情做好呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Then we go down trying. But we do it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那我们就试到最后一刻。我们一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Things are getting pretty heavy down here, Kaya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这里的情况越来越糟了，卡娅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I know. I know. Just… Hold on. This is the last mission. I swear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我知道，我知道，只是……坚持住。这是最后一个任务。我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You did it. You fully did. Holy frig. I have so much data to sift through now. My gods, I love you guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你们做到了。你们完全做到了。天哪，我有很多数据需要筛选。我的天，我爱你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Our pleasure, kid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 乐意效劳，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Extermination quota fulfilled. We're heading for exfil, Velasco.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 歼灭任务已完成。维拉斯科，我们正在撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Gods, I thought you were so dead. When can we do this again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 天哪，我以为你们死定了。我们什么时候才能再来一次？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: And for our last mission, a Hell-Scrub!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们的最后一个任务那就是，地狱净化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh boy. Just what I wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 天哪。这正是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, one last experiment. This is going to be a tough one so, stay frosty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的，最后一个实验。这次会很艰难，所以保持冷静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Very funny, Kaya. Never heard that joke before. Frickin' kids these days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 非常有趣，卡娅。以前从没听过这个笑话。这年头的小屁孩啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Minerva. You know whatever we do here, it's not going to bring Neci back, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 米尼娃。你知道无论我们在这里做什么，都不会让内奇回来的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I know, but maybe we can stop the same thing from happening again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我知道，但也许我们可以阻止同样的事情再次发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, Kaya, you think that with your research into all this timeline stuff that there's a chance we could stop Neci from ever joining Scaldra?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，卡娅，你认为通过你对所有时间线的研究，我们有机会阻止内奇加入炽蛇军吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I'm sorry, Minerva, it's like there's a wall between us and 1998. There's no going back further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 对不起，米尼娃，我们和 1998 年之间好像有一堵墙。回不去更早的时间线了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Guys, I'm picking up some strange readings. What just happened?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 伙计们，我读到了一些奇怪的读数。刚才发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah. Turns out that tank was a real can-of-worms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊。那辆坦克可真挺棘手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velimir, what did you do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔，你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh, so this is my fault too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，所以这也是我的错吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: And done. Like, I gotta say, you kicked the timeline right back into shape!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 完成了。就像是，不得不说，你让时间线恢复了原状！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That's a wrap for lab day. You know, I think I'm getting the hang of this whole Archimedean thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 实验日到此结束。你知道吗，我觉得我已经开始掌握整个科研什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: What's the deal with all these Peely Pix? Don't we have more important things to worry about?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这些易撕贴纸是怎么回事？难道我们没有更重要的事情要操心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: First off, Peely Pix are awesome and collectible and I don't need a reason. Secondly, because you asked, they're like timeline breadcrumbs. Each one marking a moment. And when I find one, like on a Hell-Scrubber, we know we've been here before. So make with the scrubbing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 首先，易撕贴纸非常棒而且值得收藏，我无需任何理由。其次，既然你问了，它们就像时间线的记号。每一个标记一个时刻。在我发现一个时，比如贴在地狱净化器上，我们就知道我们曾经来过这里。所以，开始净化吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Next on the docket, a Hell-Scrub.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 下一个项目，地狱净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Jeez you're not kidding. I'm going to need a Hell-Scrub after this mission. Gods, so much Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你不是在开玩笑吧。这次任务之后，我得去净化自己了。老天啊，这么多的科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I always thought science was a lot more stuffy than this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我一直以为科学比这要沉闷得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's not science, it's Archimedea!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这不是科学，这是科研！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Gods damn. This is a workout. Should have stretched.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 天哪。这真是一场锻炼。我应该在这之前热身的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You better be getting what you need, Velasco.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维拉斯科，你最好能拿到你需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh my gods, we did it. I mean, for today. The timeline is still a total mess and there's a lot we don't understand, but we did it for today. Yay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 噢我的天哪，我们做到了。我是说，今天做到了。时间线仍然一团糟，还有很多我们不明白的地方，但今天的部分完成了。耶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yay. I need a drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊。我得喝一杯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Good run, all. We identified some real doozies on the timeline. So as long as Drifter never feeds pizza to a Legacyte on a Tuesday, we oughtta be good...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 大家表现不错。我们在时间线上发现了几个有趣的事情。只要漂泊者在周二不给传承种喂披萨，我们应该就没事……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, Velasco, I got a question. Was the Techrot part of the original timeline or is this all Entrati's doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那么，维拉斯科，我有个问题。科腐者是原始时间线的一部分吗？ 还是这都是英择谛干的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I… I don't really know. The timeline is murky, and history doesn't really survive the loop. Either-way it's a load-bearing event and we have to keep it contained. My research is showing that the Legacytes are a huge part of that, so take out as many as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我……我真的不知道。时间线很模糊，历史也无法在循环中重现。无论如何，这是一次承载事件，我们必须控制住局面。我的研究表明，传承种是其中重要的一部分，所以尽可能多地消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Look, we know the Helminth is connected to the future. And we know the Techrot Hivemind and the Helminth are, like, distant cousins or whatever. So if we eliminate the Hivemind's Legacytes, we starve it of energy and we start to repair damage to the timeline. In theory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 听着，我们知道 Helminth 与未来有关。我们也知道科腐者集体意识和 Helminth 就像远亲什么的。所以如果我们消除集体意识的传承种，就会让它能量耗尽，然后我们就可以开始修复时间线上的破损。理论上是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: In theory? Well, I've risked more on worse intel. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 理论上？好吧，我也不是没有为更不值得的情报冒过更大的险。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ya know I kinda like this kitty. Hey, what do you say about getting a cat for the bar?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我还挺喜欢这只猫的。嘿，你觉得在酒吧养只猫怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You know I'm allergic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我会过敏，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The Infestation, The Indifference, the messed up timeline, all the data says they're connected, but I can't figure out how. And if I don't figure this out everything just gets messed up and-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 感染者、虚空无情之物和混乱的时间线，所有数据都表明它们之间存在联系，但我无法弄清楚它们之间的联系。如果我不弄清楚，一切都会变得一团糟，然后——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whoa. Kaya. You didn't make this mess and if all you do is keep it from getting just a little bit worse, well that's a win in my books.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇哦。卡娅。这不是你造成的，如果你所做的只是让它变得稍微好一点，那在我看来就是一种胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: All Legacytes eliminated. Is our mission complete, Velasco?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所有传承种都被消灭了。维拉斯科，我们的任务完成了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Science is never complete. But there is so much more research to be done. This timeline isn't going to maintain itself, you know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科学永远不会终结。但还有更多研究要做。这个时间线不会自行维持，你知道吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, Velasco, all assignments completed as outlined. We are coming home. Velimir, all this timeline nonsense is making me thirsty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好了，维拉斯科，所有任务都按照计划完成了。维利米尔，我们要回家了，这些时间线的废话让我口干舌燥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How about Vel mixes you up an Old Fashioned. I know just how you like 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维尔给你调一杯古典鸡尾酒怎么样？我知道你喜欢什么口味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Is this what the kids are calling a mosh pit? I can see the appeal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这就是孩子们所说的冲撞区吗？我能理解它为什么吸引人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If anyone asks you don't know me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果有人问起，就说你不认识我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Neci saw this show?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 内奇看过这场表演吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah, but she got to see it when the Rippers were still alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是的，但她是在撕裂者乐队还活着的时候看的。
