/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I got something on the scope. What the-? Who… How… I don't know what that was. It could have been her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我在示波器上看到了一些东西。什么——？谁……怎么……我不知道那是什么。可能是她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Right. Well… That's part of the reason we're here, isn't it? No time to get sentimental.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好了。嗯……这也是我们来这里的原因之一，不是吗？没时间多愁善感了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That's a wrap. Nobody died that wasn't supposed to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 结束了。没有意外死亡的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Over already? I was just getting into it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 结束了吗？我才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Entrati was in deep with Scaldra when he started his timeline shenanigans. Clear this bunch out and we'll see what the readings tell us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 英择谛在开始他的时间线恶作剧时和炽蛇军有很深的关系。清除掉这群敌人，我们看看读数能告诉我们什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We get to intimidate them? Nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们可以恐吓他们吗？很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The Indifference was pulling the Major's strings, so it's got its fingerprints all over Scaldra. Take down a few and we'll see what shakes out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 虚空无情之物之前操纵着少校，所以它的踪影遍布整个炽蛇军。拿下几个人，看看能发现什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Guess Minerva was right. Neci was getting in with a bad crowd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我想米尼娃是对的。内奇和一群坏人混在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Pace yourselves. We got beaucoup empirical data to gather. But hey, look on the bright side, removing all safety and ethical checks has really sped things up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 注意节奏。我们还有大量的实验数据要收集。不过，往好的方面想，取消所有安全和道德检查确实加快了进度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How reassuring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 真让人放心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Killing Scaldra for science! Because we're the good guys. Go team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 为了科学，消灭炽蛇军！因为我们是好人。加油，同志们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Dude, you're helping to push back against a bunch of assholes! The science is a bonus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 伙计，你正在帮助我们对抗一群混蛋！科学只是锦上添花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay! The model's taking shape! All those little datapoints are adding up very nicely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的！模型已经成型！所有这些数据点都很好地整合在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Glad to be of service, princess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 很高兴为您服务，公主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So if this comes down to keeping the timeline we know and love, OR getting Neci back…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所以，如果这关系到保留我们所熟知和喜爱的时间线，或者让内奇回来……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If it comes to that, you better let me know, Kaya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 如果真的到那一步，你最好告诉我，卡娅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Before I can explain why we're here I need to explain Void emergence and its effects on temporal cohesion. Ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 在我解释我们为什么在这里之前，我需要解释一下虚空的出现及其对时间凝聚力的影响。准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: How about you sweat the details and I'll stick to dismantling Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 不如你来负责细节，我负责继续收拾科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, Marty, you came here through the Helminth, right? Bonkers idea! What if Techrot is entangled with the temporal dimension! I wanna see what happens to my chronometer readings when you take out a whole bunch at once. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那么，马蒂，你是通过 Helminth 来这儿的吧？这主意太疯狂了！如果科腐者与时间维度纠缠在一起怎么办！我想看看，当你一次性消灭一大群科腐者的时候，我的计时器读数会发生什么。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Now, isn't this stuff supposed to have a hivemind somewhere? You really want to risk pissing it off?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 对了，这些东西不是应该在某个地方有蜂巢群体吗？你真的想冒险惹怒它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, so the Techrot might seem a tiny bit more PO'd than usual. Don't be alarmed, it's part of my research.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，科腐者似乎比平时更生气了。别担心，这是我的研究的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Alarmed? I'd do this for fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 担心？我正是因为好玩才来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So you want all this Techrot junked?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所以你想把这些科腐者全部废掉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: And recycled, where applicable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 并且回收，在适当的情况下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Velimir, we are making slow, but real progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 维利米尔，我们正在取得缓慢但实实在在的进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Great! I'm happy for us. Sincerely. So who's next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 太好了！我为我们感到高兴。说真的。下一个是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hell-Scrub towers are little treasuries of valuable data! Fire 'em up and I'll jack into the datastream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 地狱净化器是珍贵数据的小宝库！启动它们，我就可以接入数据流。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oof. Looks like a crop duster's flown over the sector. Gonna need a lot lower spore count if we're going to proceed here. Scrub up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，看来有架作物喷粉机飞过了这个区域。如果我们要继续实验的话，需要降低孢子数量。开始净化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I seem to remember when these Hell-Scrubbers were "going to stop the rot in its tracks," we were so naive back then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我似乎还记得，这些地狱净化器本来是要"让科腐立刻停下"，那时我们太天真了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Not to get all conspiracy theory on you, dude, but Scaldra's not as down on the 'rot as they pretend to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 伙计，我不是在跟你玩阴谋论，但炽蛇军并没有像他们假装的那样讨厌科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Where'd you learn all this mumbo-jumbo anyway?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你到底从哪儿学到这些胡言乱语的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: When I'd talk to Entrati about particle physics and the Void, and I LOVE to talk about that stuff, he would just, like, listen to me blather on. But I could tell, by the look in his eye, when I had things right and wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 当我与英择谛谈论粒子物理和虚空时，顺便一提我超喜欢讨论这些话题，他会静静地听我滔滔不绝。但通过他的眼神，我能够判断出哪些是正确的，哪些是错误的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Techrot patterns are showing some freaky interactivity. Like iron filings on a magnetic field… but alive. Meet up with Minerva and let's finish the assignment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者模式呈现出一些奇特的互动性。就像磁场上的铁屑……但它们是活的。和米尼娃会和，然后我们完成这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Whoa. There's words in this. 'Ishlun Jass'... 'Murum Vull'? Can't make it out. Grab Minerva. One more experiment to run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哇哦，这里面有字。'Ishlun Jass'……'Murum Vull'？看不懂。去找米尼娃。还有个实验要进行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So, Minerva, you up for seeing a little live music?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那么，米尼娃，你想去看现场音乐会吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We're the security detail, aren't we? Oh well, you've taken me on worse dates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们不是安保人员吗？哦好吧，你带我去过更糟糕的约会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Last order of business. Flare's concert tonight. It needs to happen. If Viktor shuts it down, then there's no telling what that does to the timeline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 最后一件事。今晚弗莱尔的演唱会。必须举行。如果维克多取消，那么时间线会受到什么影响就不得而知了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Nobody touches a single immaculately placed hair on Flare's head. You've got my word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 谁也别想碰弗莱尔一根头发。我说话算话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, Kaya, we're going to get these Hell-Scrubbers up and running. You do- Um… Whatever it is you're doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好了卡娅，我们要启动这些地狱净化器。你要做的就是……你自己的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Already on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 已经开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Rub-a-dub-dub, who's up for a scrub.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 擦—擦—擦，谁想被净化？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Gods, you are so embarrassing sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 天哪，你有时真让人尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah, this is a world worth saving. Screaming fungus and demon appliances. Gotta make sure all this survives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊，这是一个值得拯救的世界。尖叫的真菌和恶魔电器。必须确保这些都能存活下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: People tell me it's better than oblivion…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 人们告诉我这总比遗忘好……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Kaya… I gotta ask, how is this 'science'? I'm scrubbing the freakin' streets over here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 卡娅……我得问一下，这怎么能叫做"科学"呢？这不就是扫大街嘛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Every teeny-tiny Techrot particle sucked up into those towers has a tale to tell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 每一颗被吸入这些塔中的科腐者粒子都有一段故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I think we sucked up some of the old O.R.O. research data. Damn, those people were into some shady shit. Move on. Let's wrap this up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我认为我们吸入了全科的一些旧研究数据。该死，那些人做了一些见不得人的勾当。继续吧。让我们结束这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This is a perfect opportunity to harvest Legacytes under test conditions! Three ought to do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这是一个在测试条件下收割传承种的绝佳机会！收割三个应该够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Couldn't you go down to the stream and poke frogspawn like a normal kid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你不能像正常小孩一样去河里捞蝌蚪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Fun fact. Legacyte ancestral memory runs across multiple timelines! Nobody knows how they do it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 说件有趣的事。传承种的祖先记忆跨越了多个时间线！没有人知道它们是如何做到的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So I get to round 'em up and sift through their brains. Eh, I guess it's honest work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 所以我要把它们收集起来，仔细检查它们的大脑。呃，我想这应该算得上是诚实劳动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, another one in the bag. Hey Kaya - are we learning anything from this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好的，又收集到一个。嘿卡娅——我们从中学到了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: So far, there's a Techrot outbreak in every single variant timeline. It's like it's… spreading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 到目前为止，在每个变体时间线上，都出现了科腐者爆发。就像它……正在蔓延。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I swear these things are getting smarter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我发誓这些东西变得越来越聪明了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They are! Each new generation learns from the mistakes of the last… don't you DARE turn that into a mentor speech.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 它们确实是！每一代都从上一代的错误中吸取教训……你休想把这变成导师训诫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Okay, now that last one was an ugly son-of-a-b.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 好吧，最后那个真是个丑八怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Yeah, reminded me of this kid in middle-school who used to pull my hair and then run away. Gods, if I could find him now. What were we doing? Oh yeah, next experiment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 是啊，让我想起了中学时那个经常揪我头发然后跑掉的孩子。天哪，要是现在能找到他该多好。我们刚才在做什么来着？哦，对，下一个实验！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Kalymos is happy. Is Kaya happy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 卡利莫斯很高兴。卡娅开心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hell yeah. Those poor Legacytes are like data piñatas. I know where we need to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 没错。那些可怜的传承种就像数据皮纳塔一样。我知道我们要去哪里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Tragically, the rippers are short one drummer. Scaldra, provide some percussion. Fire the mortars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 可惜了，撕裂者现在少了一名鼓手。炽蛇军，给他们点打击乐器。发射迫击炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra. Ready the mortars. This 'performance' ends now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军。准备好迫击炮。这场"表演"到此结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Mortars ready? Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 迫击炮准备好了？发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You. You. You. You. Going dowwnnnnnnnn. Ahhhhhh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你。你。你。你。要完了。啊啊啊啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Techrot, techrot, techrot, FILTH. AHHHHHHHHH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者，科腐者，科腐者，污秽。啊啊啊啊啊啊啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You're going to DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DEAD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你会死的。死。死。死。死。死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra is my LIFE. My service. My EVERYTHING. YEAAAHH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军是我的生命。我的职责。我的一切。耶啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: FORRRRR PUUUURITEEEEEE. YEAH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 为了纯净。耶啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Smash it, shake it. Kill it, break it. Crush it, take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 粉碎它，震动它。杀死它，摧毁它。碾碎它，夺走它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ready or not, here I COME.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 准备好没，我来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Techrot bleeds for me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 科腐者因我流血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Pray for a purge. Pray for a purge. Pray for a purge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 祈求净化。祈求净化。祈求净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Black sun. Blood moon. Oceans of pain are here for yooooouuuu!!!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 黑日当空。血月高悬。痛苦的海洋即将吞噬你！！！！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ripped sky. Tortured earth. Nothing born and everything dies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 撕裂的天空，受难的大地，万物不生，万物消亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I am your deafening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我是让你震耳欲聋的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Abolish the abomination. Kill its creation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 消灭这可憎之物。抹杀它的造物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Heretic… I am your salvation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 异教徒……我是你的救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Hey, guys. What's going on out there? Guys???
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 嘿，各位，外面发生了什么？各位？？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: I always say, "you learn more from failure than success." Did we learn anything?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我总是说，"从失败中学习到的比成功更多。"我们学到了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Oh man? This is going to way skew my data. And not in a good way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 哦，天哪。这严重扭曲我的数据。而且不是朝好的方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Really?? Gods, why does Archimedea have to be so hard???
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 真的吗？天啊！为什么科研要这么难？？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ugh, this is worse than the time I tried to make a Void Rift for the science fair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 唉，这比我那回在科学博览会上尝试制作虚空裂隙还糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Thank you, Höllvania!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 谢谢你，霍瓦尼亚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Höllvania! Never give up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚！永不放弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Höllvania, stay safe, stay strong, I love you all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚，保持安全，保持坚强，我爱你们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We're here all year!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们全年都在这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: It's been a riot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这真是一场狂欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: You picked the wrong side, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 你站错队了，弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Good. Now, Scaldra, erase all signs of this mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 很好。现在，炽蛇军，把这场混乱的所有痕迹都抹去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Ah… The silence is such sweet music.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 啊……寂静是如此美妙的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Say hello to your band mates for me, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 代我向你的乐队伙伴问好，弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: That guitar is mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 那把吉他是我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Höllvania!!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚！！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They wouldn't let you come to us. So we're gonna play this thing so loud that every corner of the city hears the sound of our resistance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他们不让你来找我们。那我们就把声音放到最大，让整座城市都能听到我们反抗的声音！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: They said that if we played, they'd kill us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 他们说如果我们演奏的话，就会杀了我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Just try!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 试试看啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: We are Temple and The Rippers, but we will never be silenced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 我们是 Temple 和撕裂者乐队，但我们永远不会沉默。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Rip it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 撕裂它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This one is for my bandmates who never got a chance to play for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这首歌献给我的那些从未有机会为你演奏的乐队伙伴们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: If the music lives, they live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 只要音乐在，他们就在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Shout out to all those freedom fighters listening on Mobile Voice Radio! I know you can hear us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 为所有收听移动语音广播的自由战士们欢呼！我知道你们能听到我们的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Rock over Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 摇滚吧霍瓦尼亚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Flare, you flaunted your Rot and your bandmates paid the price. Now you'll get your new friends killed too? How noble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 弗莱尔，你显摆自己腐化的样子，你的乐队成员因此付出代价。现在你还要害死你的新朋友？多么高尚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The "artist" Flare is a known agitator, willfully corrupted by Techrot. This cacophony ends. Immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: "艺术家"弗莱尔是个臭名昭著的反动分子，他甚至故意被科腐者腐化。这场骚动马上就要结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Flare, you are wanted for arrest, trial, and execution. By the sound of it, your agonized screeching has already begun. Perhaps we can crank it up a few octaves?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 弗莱尔，你将被逮捕、审判和处决。似乎你痛苦的尖叫已经开始了，也许我们可以把声音调高几个八度？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra, attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军，进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Move in now. Shut it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 立刻行动。终止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Scaldra, rally and attack. Stop the Hex. Stop Flare and what's left of the Rippers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 炽蛇军，集结进攻。阻止六人组。阻止弗莱尔和撕裂者的残余势力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: First Scaldra soldier to bring me that guitar gets a week of leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 第一个给我带来那个吉他的炽蛇军士兵将奖励一周的假期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Shut down this shameful insolence at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 立即制止这种可耻的放肆行为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: This isn't music. This isn't art. It's a blatant display of Techrot propaganda and I will not stand for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这不是音乐。这不是艺术。这是科腐者宣传的赤裸裸展示，我不会容忍这种行为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: The Techrot known as Flare is a fugitive, a degenerate, and a vile musician. Silence Flare NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 这个名为弗莱尔的科腐者是一名逃犯、一名堕落者，也是一名卑鄙的音乐家。立即让弗莱尔闭嘴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Höllvania, cover your ears. I will protect you from this, this sonic onslaught.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚，捂住你的耳朵。我会保护你们免受这种声波的袭击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.text: Flare. You abomination. You nasty chimera. You are choosing to rub our faces in your disgusting mutations. I will teach you shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TechrotEncoreM.zhText: 弗莱尔。你这个可憎之物。你这个卑鄙的怪物。你选择将你那令人作呕的变异体展示在我们面前。我会让你知道什么是羞耻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text:
[2.8]
It's Dec 31, 1999.
[6.6]
Let's SAY GOODBYE to the OLD YEAR with a track you all know and love
[9.2]
from GLOBAL sensation On-lyne!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText:
[2.8]
今天是 1999 年 12 月 31 日。
[6.6]
让我们用一首大家耳熟能详、深受喜爱的曲目挥别过去的一年
[9.2]
来自轰动全球的线上时代乐队！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Not again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 又来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: I'm on break, Arthur. Don't mess with my gametime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我在休息，亚瑟。别打扰我的游戏时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Need my Tommy keys, Amir. I'm not letting another lead on Entrati go to waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我需要我的"原摩"钥匙，阿米尔。我不会再让关于英择谛的线索白白浪费了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: (Grunts)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: （咕噜声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Sol help us if these arcade games wind up Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 求太阳神保佑，要是这些街机最后真被感染的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Over here! You! Yea, you! My moves are so hot, they have their own fans! You can't handle the heat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 快过来！你！对，就是你！我的动作太火了，连粉丝都有了！你可扛不住这样的热度！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: My keys better not be in that mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我的车钥匙可别在那堆乱七八糟的东西里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Learn to hotwire, geez!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 学学热接发动吧，天呐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Did you take my damn keys?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 你拿了我的钥匙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Don't distract me, boyscout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 别让我分心，童子军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: No disrespect, Quincy. Got places to be, is all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 没有冒犯的意思，昆西。我有要去的地方，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Someone is taking my stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 有人拿着我的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: How's she doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 她怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: If she wasn't your blood, she'd be on her own out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 如果她不是你的血亲，她在外就只能靠自己了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Got a lead on Entrati. Sewers. Arse deep in Techrot, most likely. I'm going after him, for all our sakes. Lettie, look, if you've taken my keys again...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 有英择谛的线索了。下水道。估计一屁股坐进科腐者堆里了。为了我们大家，我要去追他。莱蒂，听着，要是你又把我的车钥匙拿走了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Nah. I'm not going to let this slide that easily...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 不，我不会就这么算了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Hold up, hero boy. You're going after Doctor E all by yourself?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 等等，英雄小子。你是要独自一人去追英博士吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Yeah, you're not going without backup, Arthur. Forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 是啊，没有后援你不能出去，亚瑟。别想了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Yea, betcha didn't even pack a medkit?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 是啊，你肯定连医药箱都没带吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: I'm coming too. Guys? It won't be like last time, I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我也要去。伙计们？这次不会像上次那样，我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Saddle up. Let's ride the Devil down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 上车。我们追赶恶魔去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Iced 'em. Too slow, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 干掉他们了。太慢了，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Watch that Efervon! Shit's corrosive. Some scars I can't heal, you read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 小心那些艾弗旺！那玩意是会腐蚀人的。有些伤我是治不了的，你懂我意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: A slug dares to show its face at night?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 鼻涕虫竟敢在夜里露脸？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: I had it under control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我已经控制住局面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text:
[3.4]
Meet the co-star of your grand finale.
[7.1]
An H-04 Efervon Tank.
[8.3]
Enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText:
[3.4]
来见见你们压轴大戏的联合主演。
[7.1]
一辆 H-04 艾弗旺坦克。
[8.3]
好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Have it your way. By this time next year, nothing will remain of you slugs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 随你便吧。到明年这时候，你们这些鼻涕虫就连渣都不剩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Don't mind if I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 那我就不客气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: The vents above the treads!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 注意履带上方的排气孔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Requesting assistance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 需要支援！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Arthur! Pick up that Techrot and throw it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 亚瑟！把那个科腐者捡起来扔出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: I will always have your back. Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 我会永远支持你。永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Danger, HIGH VOLTAGE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 危险，高压电！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Found a hole in its shield, Arthur!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 找到它外壳上的破绽了，亚瑟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Thanks, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 多谢，昆西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Viktor? Drop them in. NOW.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 维克多？放他们进来。立刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Arthur! What the hell was that? Where are you? Come in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 亚瑟！那是什么鬼东西？你在哪儿？说话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: He's here. Deep in the Techrot. I'm going after him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 他在这。在科腐者的深处。我要去追他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Arthur! You're right by a security terminal - hmmm. I'd bet my butt it's got a Coda worm injector. You wanna risk it to control some Techrot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 亚瑟！你现在就在一个安全终端旁边——嗯。我敢打赌它有一个终幕者蠕虫注入器。你想冒个险用它来控制一些科腐者吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Well... let's find out, then. Needs must, and all that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 那么……让我们来看看吧。必要时，只能如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: What in hell...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 这什么鬼……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Entrati! What devils follow you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 英择谛！是什么恶魔在跟着你？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.text: Bring the hellfire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Di.zhText: 放马过来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Still too open. We need more chokepoints.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 还是太开阔了。我们需要更多的阻塞点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Bottled water. Like sodding gold dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 瓶装水。就像见鬼的金粉一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: We'll find you, Doctor. That's a promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 我们会找到你的，博士。说到做到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Dunno why we even bothered with that cleaning rota.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 不知道我们为什么要弄那个清洁轮值表。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Yeah, we can hold this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 嗯，我们能守住这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Stop sniffing around my head, Eleanor. If I want to talk, I'll talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 别再窥探我的思想了，埃莉诺。我想说的时候自会说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Question. Could I take Quincy down if he turned on me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 问题来了。如果昆西对我动手，我能对付得了他吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: Well Amir's still alive. That's a win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 好吧，阿米尔还活着。算是赢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: We need to keep Lettie on her feet. If she goes we all go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 我们得让莱蒂保持好状态。如果她倒了，咱们全都得完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.text: One day, Aoi. No more roadblocks and checkpoints. Just you and me and the bikes, open road for miles, all this bullshit far away. I swear to Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Tennocon2024Re.zhText: 总有一天，碧。不再有那些路障和检查点。只有你我还有摩托车，迎着一路开阔的道路，将所有屁事都抛在脑后。我向太阳神发誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text:
The Narmer beast is wounded, but still kicking. Every time a new head grows, we must chop it off.

Sending you after the latest veil-head boss, killer. You know what to do. Do-gah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText:
合一众这野兽虽然受打击，但依然存在。每一次它新长出来一个头，我们都得把它砍掉。

杀手，我会把你派到最新出现的面障头目那。你知道该怎么做的，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text: Never was much hope of reasoning with a Grineer. Even less hope when he's got a head full of blood-red Narmer visions. Ai yo. There'll be another one clapping on the veil he dropped, soon enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText: 从来就不用抱希望能跟 Grineer 讲通道理。当他的脑子里充满了合一众的血腥幻象时，希望就更小了。哎呦。我猜，马上就会有另一个人奔向他丢弃的面障了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text:
Narmer came after Cetus first. They crave to capture the Unum, and they have plenty of veiled-up die-hards to help them do it.

Lucky for us we have you, eh? Go and help those die-hards to die a little easier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText:
合一众最开始是冲着希图斯来的。他们渴望捕捉乌努母神，并且有许多激进的面障死忠信徒来帮助他们实现这一目标。

幸亏我们有你在，不是吗？去帮这些死忠信徒死得轻松一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text: Good work, killer. One day we will find out who is behind these new Narmer. And then? That person should pray we get to them before the Grineer do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText: 干得好，杀手。总有一天我们会找出这些合一众背后的操纵者。然后嘛？那个人最好祈祷在 Grineer 找上门之前就被我们抓住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text:
It is happening again. Once more they round us up, once more they clap their cursed veils on our faces.

Bring our people back, surah. Show Narmer we will never submit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText:
这样的事又来了。又有我们的人被带走了，他们又开始把被诅咒的面障拍在我们的脸上了。

苏拉，把我们的人救回来。让合一众知道我们永远不会屈服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text: It is a terrible thing to mourn for one who still walks and still breathes. We lost many to the veils, surah, and many more to grief. You have saved far more than one life today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText: 这是一件多么可怕的事情，为了一个还能够正常走路和呼吸的人哀悼。苏拉，我们因为面障失去了太多人，还有更多因为过于悲痛而离去。你今天救了不止一个人的性命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text:
Ah! The first face I saw on waking from that horrible dream!

She gives, we live. Never more true than now, eh, surah? We live. In spite of Narmer. And still the tower of Unum stands. The Quills are even saying she spoke to you.

Ah! Much to do, much to do. Come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText:
啊！那是我从噩梦中醒来之后看到的第一张脸！

因她赐予，我们活着。从来没有比现在更真实过，不是吗，苏拉？我们活着。尽管合一众仍旧存在。但乌努母神之塔仍旧屹立不倒。夜羽甚至说乌努母神曾和你说过话。

啊！还有很多很多要做的，快来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text:
Narmer holdouts are hoarding supplies. Weapons, drones... and veils, of course. 

Take the lot, surah. Do not leave them a helmet to piss in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText:
顽固的合一众信徒正在囤积物资。武器、无人机……当然了，还有面障。 

都拿走吧，苏拉。哪怕是一顶头盔也不要留下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.text: 'All as one', eh? All their hard-won gear is now ours! Ha! And does it make up for having our home scorched and cratered? We keep on, surah. What else is left for to us to do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DPln.zhText: 万众归一，嗯？现在他们来之不易的装备都是我们的了！哈哈哈哈！难道这就能弥补我们被烧焦和炸毁的家园吗？继续行动，苏拉。不然我们还能做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text:
[2.0]
We
[6.0]
are seasons
[7.0]
all of us.

[6.0]
Growing in the light
[7.0]
fading in the dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText:
[6.0]
在光明中生长
[7.0]
于黑暗中消逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text:
[5.0]
At once the same

[2.6]
For the... huh...
[2.9]
 
[4.7]
For my brothers.
Don't be afraid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不要害怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Eight squad! Eight squad! YOU MAGGOTS! REPORT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 第八小队！第八小队！你们这些蛆虫！报告情况！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: One for the reject pile, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 废品堆里又多了一件作品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Goodbye, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 永别了，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Let me go, child. Let me go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 放手吧，孩子。再见了，别管我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't! I won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我做不到！我不会放手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't! I won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我做不到！我不会放手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't! I won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我做不到！我不会放手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't! I won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我做不到！我不会放手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You cannot kill the devil, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你杀不死恶魔，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: ...but you can send it back to hell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ……但是你可以把它送回地狱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Call out, Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 禁卫，发出召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Cool water flows. The moon, behind a cloud...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 流水潺潺。云后见月……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Summon your devil. It's time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 召唤你的恶魔。是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Why? No! No! Valeria!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为什么？不！不要！Valeria！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: See the veil work. Turning his memories inside out. Making him see the things he's lost. Putting pain where it serves us. A lost love, perhaps... her life, cut short by the very Tenno he had sworn to protect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 看看面障的效果。前尘往事翻涌而现。让他看看自己失去了什么。让他的痛苦为我们所用。也许，是一个失去的爱人……她的生命，被他曾经发誓过要守护的 Tenno 战士终结了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不要！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: He'll give in soon. They all will... and this war will be over before it even begins. Not with bombs and blood... but with truth. They programmed you and your kind. Now it is our turn to program them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他很快就会屈服的。他们全都会……而这场战争将还未开始就会结束。兵不血刃……用真理致胜。他们从前操控着你和你的同伴。现在轮到我们操控他们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Call out, old man. Give her justice, give her peace!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 召唤吧，老家伙。还她公道，让她安息！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I-I can... see her... Tenno... why???
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我——我能……看见她……Tenno 战士……为什么？？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: There! You are so close! Detonate near enough, and your brothers shall live to fight another day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你看！你已经非常接近那里了！在近点引爆，你的兄弟们就能全部活下来再战一日！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For the Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为了女皇们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That's it. Detonate at the base of that Bloated Condrix. FOR GLORY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 就是这样。潜入那艘大号谍影登陆舰的底部，就在那里把它给引爆。为了荣耀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Brothers dead. Only Kahl one-seven-five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 兄弟们死了。只剩下卡尔-175。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: BROTHER? Brother. The WORMS have swarmed the sector, but we will prevail. Regroup on my beacon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 兄弟？兄弟。臭虫已经蜂拥而至，但我们将占据上风。在我的信标上重新集结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: This is for Madak! And Varn! And Big Bordul!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这是为了马达克！和瓦恩！还有大波多尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You are no Eidolons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你不是夜灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For the... Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为了……女皇们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I salute you One-Seven-Five. For the Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 175，我向你致敬。为了女皇们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For the... Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为了……女皇们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Searches! Must not see Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 侦察者！卡尔需要避开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Kahl sneak good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 卡尔潜行得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: One-Seven-Five! The Worms close in! Hurry Brother!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 175。臭虫逼近了！快点兄弟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: WORMS have jammed our exfil systems. All ships are grounded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 可恶的臭虫竟然干扰了我们的撤离系统。现在飞船全都无法起飞了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Mission? That Bloated Condrix swats us down like flies. We're grounded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 任务？那艘大号谍影登陆舰像在赶苍蝇一样把我们击败了。我们被摁在地上打。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pilot is dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 飞行员死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What is mission now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 现在任务是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Kahl stop. Tell Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 卡尔会阻止。告诉卡尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Impossible. Even if you could get close to that thing, they'd eat you alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不可能。就算你真的能接近那东西，他们也会靠近后把你给生吞活剥喽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Eat alive? What if food... is bomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 生……生吞吗？如果食物……是炸弹呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hmmm. Brother Kahl... yes! Find something with a high enough yield! Hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯。卡尔兄弟……是的没错！你们马上去找一些足够猛烈的东西！快去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: F-for... for the Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为……为了女皇们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Dargyn crash. Kahl help pilot. Kahl finish mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 轻型艇坠毁。卡尔帮飞行员。卡尔完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For the Queens. Now... run MAGGOT, RUUUUNNN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 为了女皇们。就现在……冲啊蛆虫，冲啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: How many hostiles ahead? I can't do this! Unless... I get a Striker Moa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 前方到底有多少敌人啊？我根本做不到！除非……我有一个突击恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Turrets look a little less scary now that I've got an Striker Moa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 现在我拥有了一只突击恐鸟，炮台看起来好像也不那么可怕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hello again, turrets. I've brought a friend this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们又见面了，炮台。这次我带了个朋友来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Attention crew, stand down, all stations. You'll be pleased to know that I, Alad V, have negotiated a peaceful... and profitable... transfer of power to our new--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 全体船员注意，所有站点，都停下。我有一个好消息告诉你们，我，Alad V，已经协商达成了一项和平……且有利可图的……权力交接，给我们的新……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --Fleet control...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——舰队控制……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Firing sync reengaged. Authorization: Corpus Tech First Class Veso-R. Take your shot. For Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 发射同步现已重新启动。开始授权：Corpus 一级技师 Veso-R。开火吧。为了利益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Just in time, too! Our new management is about to pay a personal visit. Be quick; I've got to stand down fire when they dock with us! Well done, Viko!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这来得正是时候！我们的新管理层即将以个人身份造访我们。搞快点；当他们与我们对接时，我必须解除火力！干得好，Viko！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hold fast to your stations, crews! Our glorious victory is close at hand! Oh, and, uh, any remaining techs aboard, narrow-band me at once!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好好坚守住你们的岗位，船员们！我们的光荣胜利已经近在咫尺了！噢，还有，舰上剩下的技工，立刻通过窄频向我报告！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Confirming tech aboard! Veso-R at your service, most gilded director, most...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 舰上技工确认报告！Veso-R 为您效劳，最富有的董事，最……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yes, yes, thank Profit! My command overrides aren't working. I need to break fire control from the fleet. Can you fix that, Veko?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 对，对，利益在上！我的命令重写不起作用。我需要夺取船队的火控系统。你能解决这个问题吗？Veko。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It's Veso, most lucrative and sagacious visionary. Yes, I can try. There's a trace conduit nearby, I can bypass it--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 最擅长捞金和最睿智的远见家，我叫 Veso。是的，我可以试试。附近有一个追踪终端，我可以破解它——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --Great, yes, do your thing. There's a nice bonus in it if you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——太好了，对，做你的活儿。办好了，你能拿到不错的奖金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hmm. A Breacher Moa could clear that debris. Wonder if the robotics dispensers are still functional?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯。破障恐鸟可以清除这些碎片。不知道机器人分配站是否还能用？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You see. This is why we need that command override back. The board just can't face reality. So what's your plan, Teso?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你看。这就是为什么我们需要把那个命令重写回去。董事会就是不能面对现实。所以你的计划是什么，Teso？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text:
[8]
Plan? You mean, I have to... Okay.
[13]
I guess... hit him in the knees? Trigger his a-attack routine?
[17.5]
That should leave his shields vulnerable. In theory...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText:
[8]
计划？您的意思是，我必须……好吧。
[13]
我猜……打他的膝盖？触发他的攻——攻击程序？
[17.5]
这应该会让他的护盾变脆弱。理论上是可行的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Clever. Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 聪明，动手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Am... am I a traitor to the Board? Yes sir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……我是董事会的叛徒吗？遵命，长官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Need to shield that Breacher Moa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快给那只破障恐鸟加上护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No, no, he got blown up too soon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不，不，他爆炸的太快了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: All his power is going to his attack. Shields: vulnerable. Beams:  incredibly dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他将集中全部力量用于攻击。护盾：脆弱。射线：极度危险状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Gotta blast those shields while I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我得尽可能地炸掉那些护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Drain those shields and that will force his self-repair routine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 耗尽这些护盾，这会迫使他进行自我修复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Aah! Why are you shooting at me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 啊！你为什么要对我开枪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Sir! Veso, here. Our robotics have gone rogue... the Sentients must have latched the grid!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 长官！我是 Veso。我们的机器人已经叛变了……Sentient 一定已经把电网锁定了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Someone has, yes. I'll pull some meat-crews to cover you. Just get me that override... um?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 没错，是有人这么做了。我会派一些肉盾来掩护你。只要你能给我重写它……嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Veso. Right. I've got a datapad, secure robot dispenser access... and a Plinx. Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我是 Veso。对。我有一个数据板、安全的机器人分配站权限……和一把漫射者。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Our... uh... victory is ever-nearer, crew! Your service and sacrifice will be richly rewarded, yes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 船员们，我们的……呃……胜利越来越近了！你们的服役和牺牲将获得丰厚的回报，没错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: If I don't stand down fire control soon, we'll all be sucking vacuum! Teko! What's taking so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果我不能尽快解除火控系统的话，我们就都会被卷走的！Teko！为什么弄了这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Sir? You want to disengage fire control from the fleet? I... I don't understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 长官？您是说您想解除舰队的火控系统？我……不明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Look outside! We're all about to be under new management! Now do your part, or I'll find a more forward-thinking replacement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 看看外面！我们就要迎来新的管理层了！现在做好你的本职工作，否则我会找一个更有远见的人替换你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: There has to be a way to protect that Breacher Moa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们必须想个办法来保护那只破障恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What if I shield that Moa?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果我用护盾护住它呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: A functioning shield drone dispenser? Oh, thank Profit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 一个完备的护盾无人机分配站？哦，感谢利益！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My shields should hold up, if I'm fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的护盾应该能撑得住，如果我够快的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: There is no shame in maximizing my shields and just running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 一边最大化我的护盾一边逃跑，这并不是丢脸的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No point trying to shoot my way through this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 只依靠自己开枪是行不通的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Their shields are too strong to shoot through! Maybe if I boosted mine somehow...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们的护盾太强了根本射不穿！或许我也可以把我的护盾加强一下……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: How tediously human. A slapdash alliance making a feeble last stand. If you all crave death in a final flash of glory - I am more than happy to oblige.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 多么乏味的人类。乌合之众在进行最后无谓的抵抗。如果你们都渴望在一闪即逝的荣耀中死去——我非常乐意提供协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Do you think there's a shred of Lotus left in Natah? All this time, it's been dying. A tumor scorched from its rotting hole.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 难道你以为 Natah 仍旧留有莲（Lotus）的一丝痕迹吗？一直以来，它都在消亡。就像一颗肿瘤烧焦在它那腐烂的洞里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Mothership in range. Problem: Slingshot damaged. Crew, hold position while I route a bypass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 母舰已在射程内。问题——弹射器受损。船员，在我进行修复时原地待命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Slingshot patched. Ready for launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 弹射器已修复。准备发射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin... I'll be awaiting your signal... so I can bring her home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin……我会等待你的信号……这样我才可以带她回家

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin... I'll be awaiting your signal... so I can bring her home.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'll clear the Orphix, and we'll do it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我会解决掉奥影母舰，然后我们一起行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That Corpus Pillar just took out a Murex!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那艘 Corpus 天柱战舰击败了一艘骨螺战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That Corpus Pillar just took out a Murex!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That Corpus Pillar just took out a Murex!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那艘 Corpus 天柱战舰击败了一艘骨螺战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The enemy's eye turns upon our allies. Quickly. Press onward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 敌人的目光转向了我们的盟友。动作快，大家向前挺进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们穿过防线了。你确定要这样吗？应该让我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们穿过防线了。你确定要这样吗？应该让我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们穿过防线了。你确定要这样吗？应该让我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们穿过防线了。你确定要这样吗？应该让我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No, Tenno. Your Warframe will be useless until I clear the Orphix fields. Then we will meet inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不行，Tenno 战士。你的战甲在清除奥影脉冲场前毫无用处。之后，在里面会合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: If hull integrity continues to drop, this will be a one-way trip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果舰体完整性继续下降，这将变成一次单程旅行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You will need to get closer to your mother's ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你需要做到靠近你母亲的战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Huh? Did you just--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯？你刚刚是不是——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Huh? Did you just--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯？你刚刚是不是——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Huh? Did you just--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯？你刚刚是不是——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Huh? Did you just--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯？你刚刚是不是——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Squadron incoming. The enemy is wise to our diversions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 中队来袭。敌人没有中我们的调虎离山之计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin. What if the Lotus won't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin。如果说莲（Lotus）她不愿意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin. What if the Lotus won't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin。如果说莲（Lotus）她不愿意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin. What if the Lotus won't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin。如果说莲（Lotus）她不愿意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin. What if the Lotus won't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin。如果说莲（Lotus）她不愿意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: If I must... I can make the harder choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果到了那个地步……我可以做出这个艰难的抉择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Cy, charge the slingshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 赛伊，给弹射器充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Cy, charge the slingshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 赛伊，给弹射器充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Cy, charge the slingshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 赛伊，给弹射器充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Cy, charge the slingshot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 赛伊，给弹射器充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: She and her Void brood toppled a golden age of order and honor. Do you really believe this chaos is freedom?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她和她的虚空族群推翻了一个光荣有序的黄金时代。你真的相信这样的混乱意味着自由吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Orphix fields are disabled. The Operator should be cleared to board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 奥影脉冲场已被禁用。指挥官应该可以不受阻碍地进入了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No. Too easy. Let me nudge the snares first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不，一切都太容易了。待我先探清虚实再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Observation: a power field requires a power source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 观察心得：一个失去了能量源就会停滞无法运转的力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ordis...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yes? Would you like me to dephase that for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 什么事？你想请我帮你把它给移走吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Swing away, Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin，放手干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ordis is still happy to help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Ordis 仍然很乐意提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Almost done, Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 就快好了，Teshin。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That's it. Come to me, old man. I am eager to show you how this war ends. Not with brutality, but with hope. Not with lies, but truth. A truth for all who are strong enough to believe. Even you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 就是这样。到我这里来吧，老家伙。我渴望向你展示这场战争会是如何结束的。不是用暴力手段，而是用希望。不是用谎言，而是用真相。一个所有意志足够坚定的人都会相信的真相。即使是你也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Tenno freed you from your oath, did they? Does that absolve them of their sins?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Tenno 战士将你从你的誓言中解救出来，是吗？这就能赦免他们的罪过吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Just one left, and Ordis will be able to safely signal the Operator to join!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 还剩下一个了，然后 Ordis 就能安全地向指挥官发出加入的信号！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I will decide when it is safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我会决定何时才算安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Orphix fields will be scattered--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 奥影脉冲场会被四分五裂——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Orphix fields will be scattered deep in the ship. Ordis can help you triangulate them--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 奥影脉冲场将四散在战舰深处。Ordis 会帮你做三角测量——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --Quiet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——安静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm only trying to--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 其实我只是想——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --I don't need your help. Switch off!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——我不需要你的帮助。立刻给我关掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hmm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ah! Please excuse Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 啊！请原谅 Ordis。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You shouldn't have come here. You have ruined us both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你不应该来这里。我们两个人都毁了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Teshin? Are you - LOSING IT - feeling unwell?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Teshin？你是不是——失去了理智——感觉不太舒服？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Devil sends their relic to do the deed. But then... we're both relics aren't we, old man?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 虽然恶魔派遣出了他们的遗老来做这件事。但是……我们都算是遗老，不是吗，老家伙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Too easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这太容易了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Grineer! Oh my. Ordis wonders what we are getting into.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Grineer！哦天哪。Ordis 想知道我们卷进了什么阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Deploying Teshin Dax. Cephalon Ordis to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 正在部署 Teshin 禁卫。由 Ordis 提供协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Wait. I do not need--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 等一等。我并不需要——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Wake up, sleepyhead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 醒醒，瞌睡虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You're going to want to see this. Watch the veil do its work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我想你肯定会喜欢这一幕的。快看，面障起作用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Two left. Just a simple choice between the horrible one and the terrifying one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 现在还剩下两个。一个可怕的、一个吓人的，哦，这可真是太好选了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Well now, children. Well now. One of you out there is slayin' dragons, and doing it in style. Keep those hits comin'... Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好了，孩子们。瞧瞧，现在你们当中的某个人正在外头屠龙，而且身手极为漂亮。继续给他们点颜色看看吧，哈哈哈……漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: By the stars...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 噢，我的天呐……太震撼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: More?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 还有吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Soon. Soon. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快了。很快就有了。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Soon. Soon. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快了。很快就有了。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Soon. Soon. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快了。很快就有了。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Soon. Soon. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快了。很快就有了。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: More!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 还、有、吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: That interference again! There's got to be an Archon nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 又来了，又被那个干扰了！这地方附近肯定有个执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For once I hope you're right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这一次我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For once I hope you're right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这一次我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For once I hope you're right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这一次我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: For once I hope you're right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这一次我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: A curious weapon, Drifter. You seem to have made a powerful friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 漂泊者，真是把奇特的武器。看来你有一个强大的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: They have me, Erra. Until you come to your senses. Ballas is not one of us. He is a parasite, adapting to whatever suits him. He is using you... and our kind. Surely you see that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Erra，吾与他们同在。待汝恢复理智之时，便知晓 Ballas 与吾等道不相同。他如似寄生虫一般，只吸收有利之物为其所用。此刻，他正在利用汝……和吾辈族人。想必汝已看在眼里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --see what? A century of your failures? Your betrayal of your own people? Narmer has given our people more than you ever could. Victory. When my Archons have crushed this scant-fly, you'll be back to rotting in the deep. Alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——看在眼里什么？你看到的是你连续一个世纪的失败？还是你对你自己族人的背叛？合一众给我们带来的可远远超过你能给的——胜利。等我的执刑官粉碎了这只小苍蝇，你将会回到深渊，独自腐烂下去，孤苦伶仃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm a little unsure about this. Last time she snapped at you, what will it be this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 其实我对这点不是很确定。毕竟她上次攻击了您，那这次又会怎样呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Unless she sprouts fangs I'm sure it's fine. Besides... there's still another Archon after this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 除非她长出尖牙，否则我确定没事。而且……之后还有另一个执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Unless she sprouts fangs I'm sure it's fine. Besides... there's still another Archon after this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 除非她长出尖牙，否则我确定没事。而且……之后还有另一个执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Unless she sprouts fangs I'm sure it's fine. Besides... there's still another Archon after this.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Unless she sprouts fangs I'm sure it's fine. Besides... there's still another Archon after this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 除非她长出尖牙，否则我确定没事。而且……之后还有另一个执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No biting this time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这次别咬了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No biting this time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这次别咬了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No biting this time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这次别咬了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No biting this time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这次别咬了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Who are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm... well... I'm not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……嗯……我不是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm... well... I'm not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……嗯……我不是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm... well... I'm not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……嗯……我不是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm... well... I'm not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……嗯……我不是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm Tenno! Zariman. All that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我是 Tenno！「扎里曼号」！是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I'm Tenno! Zariman. All that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我是 Tenno！「扎里曼号」！是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I stand before you... last of my kind. An orphan of Tenno massacres. But their violence did not end with me, did it? It carried on... to all of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我就站在你面前……我最后的族人。Tenno 大屠杀幸存的孤儿。但是他们的杀戮并没有在我这儿终结，不是吗？它还是持续到了……你们众人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Grineer languished in their torture-plexes. Ostron clades starved for Tenno tithe. Corpus pupils weeping Tenno praise under blade. Solaris souls blackened the skies of Tenno foundries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Grineer 在他们的折磨中萎靡不振。Ostron 之辈饱受 Tenno 战士的剥削。Corpus 之徒在刀刃下啜泣着歌颂 Tenno 战士。索拉里斯人的灵魂在他们军械加持的穹顶之下扭曲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ostron clades starved for Tenno tithe.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: But now is our time. An era of peace and security. The devils have been cast out. And by the Void... the Tenno shall never return!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 但是现在是我们的时代。一个充满和平与安全的祥和时代。恶魔们已经全部被驱逐出这片天地。并且最棒的是，虚空在上……Tenno 战士将永远不会回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 进行连接吧，我会把门打开……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Dah-dap, surah. Dah-dap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 谢谢你，苏拉。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Never will I submit to Narmer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我永远不会屈服于合一众。切……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Dah-dap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Unum. Did she send you? Does she live?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是乌努母神。是她让你过来的吗？她现在还活着吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You will rescue the others, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你一定会救其他人的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Do not succumb to the masks, surah. She gives, we live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 千万不要屈服于面障，苏拉。因她赐予，我们才活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Do not concern yourself with me, surah. Rescue the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 别担心我了，苏拉，不必管我。营救其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Kruna metta, my family, I must find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我求求你了，我的家人，我必须找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Release me, utz!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快放我出来！快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ai yo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 哎哟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Let's hope you're not too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 希望您来得不算太晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ah, guts! You've been rumbled! Right, leg it out the back before ya mumblin' with the rest! I've sorted your ship... and a little nugget for myself while I was there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 啊，该死！你暴露了！快点，在你跟别人一样自言自语之前，赶紧跑！你的飞船我已经备好了……那还有我给自己的一点小东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Fresh shipment of brain-busters... and there's one with your name on it. See... security's lax on account of how the only way inside is wearing one of those sticky things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 新一批次的降智面具……其中一个上面有你的名字。看……安保很松懈，只要戴上其中一件黏性玩意，你就能进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What? Op-- you-- you don't know what effect it will have on you. There's got to be a better way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 什么？你——你——你根本不知道那究竟会对你造成什么影响。肯定会有更好的办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: 'Fraid not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 恐怕没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Lovers... hold-outs... I just got word on the wave: Narmhead factory got hit. No doubt the handiwork of that Drifter we've been hearing about. Feels good to have a little bit of truth in the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 亲爱的……坚守阵地的人们……我刚刚得到消息：合一众面障工厂被端了。毫无疑问是那位漂泊者的手笔。世上总算还有一丝真理存在，感觉真不赖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Navigation is marked... but I hope you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 已经标记好星图了……但是我希望您能改变主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We found you within the derelict Zariman. Feral. Evil. Void in your heart... but Ballas... he saw a lost child in need of a father. As you recovered, he noticed me less and less. What good was I to him if you weren't sick?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们在「扎里曼号」的废墟里发现了你。充满野性、令人厌恶；你的心中充斥着虚空能量，那么冷酷无情……可是 Ballas……他看到的是一个需要父亲的孩子。随着你康复，他越来越少注意到我了。你要是没生病的话，我对他又有什么用呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I loved him, but he only loved you. The stasis dreams were the only choice I had. Your Zariman dreams of mother, father... I made them nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我曾是那样地深爱着他，可他却只爱你一个人。让你冷冻陷入沉睡是我唯一的选择。你那些关于「扎里曼号」的梦、关于母亲、还有你父亲的梦……是我让它们变成了噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: And it worked. You began to see Ballas not as the father but as the phantom of your nightmares... he confided in me. The deeper your madness, the deeper our love grew. Ballas was mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 它终于奏效了。你终于开始不把 Ballas 看作父亲，而是将他视作你那可怕梦靥中的幽灵……他把这些情况全部都倾诉于我。你表现得越是疯狂，我们之间的爱就越是深厚亲密。Ballas 是我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: But he could not be deceived for long. He saw through my deception, and my judgment was swift and true. He cradled you in his arms, saying: "Child--"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 但我没有办法永远欺骗他至天荒地老。他最终还是看穿了我的谎言，并给我降下了真实而迅速的审判。他就那样把你搂抱在怀里，说道："孩子——"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --Child, my child, forgive me. Wake from this horrid dream of hers. The world outside is waiting for you. These horrors of Zariman... are lies only to hold you ill. I... love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——孩子，我的孩子，原谅我。从她这场可怕的梦里醒来吧。外面有着广阔的世界正在等着你。那些关于「扎里曼号」的恐惧……全部都是为了困住你而编织的谎言而已。我……爱你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我不行了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我不行了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't...

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I can't...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我不行了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Oi! Focus! Jab that console, quick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 喂！集中精神！戳穿那个控制台，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ah... takes me back to the good old Tenno days... expect those brain-busters might be on backorder for a while. Been a pleasure lifting with you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 啊……我想起了有关 Tenno 战士的美好回忆……估计那些降智面具要缺货一段时间了。很高兴和你一起共事，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Allo allo - missing your brain-buster then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 哎呀呀——你的降智面具落家里啦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ignore her. We can't risk it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不要理她。我们不能冒这个险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Hah! Can't risk what? Jank-ciphered comms? Already blew it. But listen, if you're here to muck with Narmer, I'm keen to lift with ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 哈！不能冒什么险？劣质加密的通讯？早就搞砸了。但是听着，如果你是来和合一众鬼混的，我倒是很想送你一程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ready? Veil up, and I'll mark the shuttle uplink once you're inside. Think happy thoughts, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 准备好了吗？戴上面障进去后，我会标记太空梭的上行线路。想点开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pops my plugs to think that some people take the veil by choice! Warm lies are more comfort than cold, hard truths, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: "有些人自愿戴上面障"的想法真是惹毛我了！善意的谎言比冷酷的真相更让人暖心，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Vox Solaris collapsed under Narmer. You're on your own here. Keep your head down and get topside as quick as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 索拉里斯之声在合一众之下分崩离析。您只能靠您自己了。低调行事，并尽快赶到甲板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Wait. Deacons. They'll sense if you're not veiled. Give them a wide berth, or you'll be sucking black ooze before long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 等下。是执事们。如果您不戴面障，他们会感应到您。和他们保持距离，否则您将连骨头渣都不剩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Name's Little Duck. And you... you must be that stick in the spokes I've heard about. You weren't in with the Tenno back in the day, were ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我叫小鸭子。你嘛……你一定就是我听说过的那个家伙吧。你以前不是和那个 Tenno 战士同一个阵营的嘛？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Something like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 差不多那样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Avoid the Deacons, or they'll seal you in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 注意避开执事们，否则他们会把您关起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: 'Eh, need a ship, Corpus tags.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嗯，需要一艘飞船，Corpus 牌的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Need a ship, Corpus tags.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Then you'll be wanting to pay a visit to that bleeding brain-buster factory. I know a shortcut. Might grab yourself a K-Drive if you've got the legs for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那你肯定想去看看那个该死的降智面具工厂。我知道一条近路。如果有条件你可以带上你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Blending in nice, but I'd still give those Deacons a wide berth. Did you know they can detonate those veils if they smell a rat? Take your whole face off, that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 干得好，但我还是会离那些执事们远点。你知道吗，如果他们察觉到一丝异样，就会引爆那些面障？那样你的整张脸就都没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ya shammin' brainless real nice, but I'd give those Deacons a wide berth. They smell a rat, your Veil detonates. Take your whole face off an' no mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你装无脑装得真不错，，但我还是会离那些执事们远点。如果他们察觉到一丝异样，就会引爆你的面障。那样你的整张脸就都没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Are you serious?! It didn't occur to you that you might want to mention that before we put one ON?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你是认真的吗？！难道你就没从想过，应该在我们戴上面障之前，先和我们沟通一下，是否同意吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It did. And I didn't. Needed you focused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我有想过来着，但我没说。当时你需要集中精力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My child... so beautiful to behold. How do you feel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的孩子……你的样子可真美。你感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: How long does she have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她还有多少时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: How long does she have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她还有多少时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她还有多长时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: How long does she have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她还有多长时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Not long. You must hunt Erra's Archons at once and take from them their power over restoration. Given such a task before you, I suspect you'll be gone before she.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她已时日无多。汝需即刻覆灭 Erra 之执刑官，并夺其复生之力为吾等所用。不过此事危险重重，欲担此任，汝倒可能先行她一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Forgive me, but... this would be a lot easier if you could use that old... uh... Tenno... magic. How did you lose it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 恕我直言，但……如果您能用那个古老的……呃……Tenno 战士……魔法，那就容易多了。您是怎么弄丢的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I didn't. More like... I don't have it yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我没弄丢。更像是……我还没得到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I traced Eidolon signatures the best I could. These locations seem most likely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我已经尽力去追踪夜灵的踪迹了。这些地点似乎最有可能出现夜灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Shoutout to the unbelievers. The nay-sayers. The hard cases, the strays, the can-nots and the will-nots. The wide-awake children. Glad you're up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 向那些不信邪的人致敬，向那些敢说「不」的人致敬。那些硬骨头、漂泊流浪者，无能为力又不愿屈服的人。头脑清醒的孩子们。很高兴你们站起来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Even the Golden Lord of Lies cannot kill you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Tenno，最善妄言者黄金之主，亦无法将汝至于死地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: She lives, Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Hunhow，她还活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: No. She only lingers... and without her kind, not for long. Their search for her remains has long since begun. The Shadow can dispatch you swiftly. A mercy. The Archons will not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不，她不过是在须臾徘徊……倘若她无同伴助力，终是难以长久坚持。他们早已开始搜寻她的遗体。影子可痛快了结汝之残生。你可知这已是大慈大悲之举。执刑官可不会……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do they want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do they want?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do they want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The same as you... to raise the dead. Only they have the power to do it... unlike you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 便如汝之所愿……对死者行起死回生之术。不过他们确能做到……不似汝这般无用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You are just as incomplete as she is. No metal beasts. No Void fury. They will snap you in half and plant a veil on your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 汝与她二人皆有残缺，并非完身，现下汝无金属野兽助力，虚空之怒亦不见其踪。如此这般，他们定会将汝劈裂，随后为汝覆上面障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Not if you help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果你帮我，就不会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Not if you help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 如果你帮我，就不会了。
