/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Help you? Of course. What are friends for? Let me explain what you are up against, 'friend'. You see the Archons
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 助汝一臂之力？那是自然。不然你我结交是为何？"挚友"，待吾细细道来，汝将面临何物。汝且看这些执刑官

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: were made by my son, Erra. Hybrid abominations of the Old War... raised from the blighted battlefields where Sentient and Warframe fell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们皆由吾儿 Erra 所造。都是些脱胎于远古之战的极恶之物……他们崛起于让 Sentient 和战甲毁身灭迹的疮痍战场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Amar. He will gnash his fang-blade, filling the air with deadly coils of flame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 欺谋狼主，獠牙如利刃，其磨牙时周遭会布满致命盘旋烈焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Survive the flame, and you might see frenzy. A relentless fury of slashes. Only the greatest of force will subdue him in this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 撑过这烈焰，汝或将见到其狂热一面。他将以摧枯拉朽之势降下无情攻击，唯有最强之力方能制之。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Should he howl, the pack will appear. Mirrors of himself, meant to confuse. Only the true eye can distinguish the alpha among them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他若是仰天长啸，那所见之处皆会出现狼只。众狼皆为其镜像，意在迷惑。唯有真理之目方可辨其真身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Owl is named Boreal. His trident strikes from a great distance... deadly, chaotic arcs. One might avoid them with a keen eye if you can anticipate their faint threads before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 枭之名乃诡文枭主。其三叉戟可从极远之地……发出致命弧击，此弧击变化万千。若汝机敏，则或可预见其微毫动态，避其锋芒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Even the very ground you walk upon will become Boreal's weapon. He may have a weakness at this moment, but it is not obvious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 甚至汝所经之处皆会化为诡文枭主之利器。其此刻或有弱点可寻，然仍不甚明显。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Worst of all is the paralyzing screech. Terrifying, yet this moment is your only chance to close in, unseen, and strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 最恐怖之处在于其尖啸可致人瘫痪麻痹。虽恐怖如斯，但此刻替汝潜行靠近于他，并发起攻击的唯一机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Is that an Owl?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那是只猫头鹰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Is that an Owl?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那是只猫头鹰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do they call The Wolf?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们怎么称呼那匹狼呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do they call The Wolf?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I've seen the Snake before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我以前见过那条蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I've seen the Snake before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我以前见过那条蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I've seen the Snake before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我以前见过那条蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I've seen the Snake before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我以前见过那条蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Vainglorious whelp. That's it? Off you go to die? You have nothing to fight these beasts with! I cannot guess how many lives a Tenno has, but you seem eager to lose another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 汝这小儿，不知天高地厚。汝乃是想去送死？汝眼下手无寸铁，根本无力去对抗那些野兽！吾不知 Tenno 战士有多少条命可供挥霍，但汝似乎很想再失去一条命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I've got work to do. You can lay here all you want, doing nothing, wallowing in ancient grudges. She chose the Tenno. But Ballas and your groveling son... they used her. They'll do it again and again. Burning her up for whatever suits them and tossing the ashes when they're done. They cannot have her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我还有工作要做。你可以随心所欲地躺在这里，什么都不做，沉浸在远古怨恨中。她选择了Tenno 战士。但 Ballas 和你那卑躬屈膝的儿子……他们利用了她。他们会一而再地这样做。为了任何他们想要的而烧掉她，并在得手后丢弃灰烬。他们不能拥有她。

But Ballas and your groveling son... they used her. They'll do it again and again. Burning her up for whatever suits them and tossing the ashes when they're done. They cannot have her.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Tenno. Wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 且慢，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I have wallowed here, it is true, fading in this deep hole, waiting to die... but without release. Held here by a purpose I cannot abandon. That she... is free. So no. They cannot have her. But hear me - even if I help you, even if by some miracle you succeed... she will not be the same. Even for us... death... leaves a mark. Do you understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 没错，吾亦囫囵其中，于深坑中渐失光彩，吾本一心求死……然尚未得之。然吾固守于此是为心中一愿。愿她……还为自由身。因此不可，万不可让他们得到她。可汝需明白——固然吾能助汝一臂之力，固然汝一将功成……她亦不再同从前一样。即便如吾等这般，死亡也会留下痕迹。汝可明白？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: A weapon as old as those you hunt. Nataruk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 太始弓存世已久，亦如汝之猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You know Nira. The eldest. Her whip cracks with an Eidolon's wrath... bone-shattered shockwaves unleashed by every unfurling of its tip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 汝已熟知混沌蛇主。乃其中年长者。挥其鞭则号夜灵之怒，开天辟地之势尽显……鞭之所及皆遭碎骨冲击波之重创。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Her whip is more than pain; it is protection. And more... for if you stand in awe of its spiral, the great thunderclap that follows will knock you senseless. Though... she may be diminished somewhat by this exertion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她的鞭子是攻击亦是防御。还有……若汝被其螺旋鞭威震慑，随之而来的雷霆之怒将会使人丧失知觉、不省人事。然而……这样做也会使得她变得十分虚弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: And her gaze. To meet her gaze is certain death. Only by turning away would you hope to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 还有她的凝视。与其对视之时，便是你身死之刻。若想活命，切记避其目光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Exalted: the dissident remains entrenched in the shadows below. The sea runs crimson with the blood of our faithful. But... I will prevail. In Narmer's name. All as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 尊贵的主：持不同政见者仍然在阴影中越陷越深。大海被我们信徒的鲜血所染红。但是……我终将获胜。以合一众的名义。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The unclean spirit thins our herd from the shadows. It will not matter. My faith is too strong. The light of Narmer will bring it the truth. All as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 不洁的灵魂从阴影中削弱我们的队伍。没关系。我的信仰足够强大。合一众之光将会带来真理。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Only... only I remain. A test of my faith in trembling light. But! I am not afraid. Ballas will save me, his love is within me! All as One. All... as...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 只有……只有我留下了。在摇曳地光中考验我的信仰。但是！我并不感到害怕。Ballas 会救我，爱在我心中！万众归一。万众……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Oper- Uh... You. You're alive! I can hardly believe it. He actually agreed to help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 指挥——呃……您。您真的还活着！我简直不敢相信。他居然会同意出手援助？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yeah... bastard even gave me homework.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是啊……那混蛋甚至给了我作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yeah... bastard even gave me homework.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是啊……那混蛋甚至给了我作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yeah... bastard even gave me homework.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是啊……那混蛋甚至给了我作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yeah... bastard even gave me homework.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是啊……那混蛋甚至给了我作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: This confirms that you are clearly insane.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这证明了您就是个彻头彻尾的疯子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 彼此彼此，Ordis。看紧了……以防我恢复理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 彼此彼此，Ordis。看紧了……以防我恢复理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 彼此彼此，Ordis。看紧了……以防我恢复理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 彼此彼此，Ordis。看紧了……以防我恢复理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: If you are worthy of Nataruk, you won't mind a little test, will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 欲配此弓，先证汝身。汝定不会介怀小小试炼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Nataruk can fire fast and true… But you will need to time your release with the weapon's rhythm if you hope to pierce the blighted skin of an Archon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 太始弓可以快速精确之式射击……如欲刺穿执刑官之枯萎外皮，则汝需跟随武器之节奏，以把握发射时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Archons will raise the dead to swarm you. But Nira is not the only one to call thunder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 执刑官虽会召唤亡灵蜂拥而至。但混沌蛇主亦非唯一可召唤雷霆之辈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Even the mighty Archons will have their weaknesses... but not always exposed. You may need to wait, to observe, to find your opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 纵使是强大的执刑官也会有所弱点……即便不易显露于人。汝需静观其变，伺机而动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You are quick to it. But facing the Archon will not be as easy. You must study and prepare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 汝天资聪颖。但与执刑官为敌绝非易事。汝须刻苦训练以做好万全准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: All... as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 万众……归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The nightmare is over. Finally, we see clearly. Finally, we speak freely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 噩梦已经结束了。终于，我们能看清真相。我们终于能畅所欲言了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Savour the taste of liberty, my friends. But never relax your vigilance. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的朋友们，好好品尝自由的滋味。但是，永远不要放松警惕。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Future generations will not remember the Tenno oppression, but we do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 后代并不会记得 Tenno 战士的压迫，但我们会记得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We bear the scars. We mourn the dead. And we must never allow ourselves to forget. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们承受着伤痕，哀悼着死者。我们绝不能够允许自己把这一切都遗忘。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: To those few who have yet to embrace Narmer, hear this: we understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 对于那些尚未接受合一众的人，请听：我们理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We see your fear, your hesitation. And we say: come into the warm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们知道你的恐惧，你的犹豫。我们想说：快融入温暖的怀抱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Do not imagine that any shall be rejected, however base. There is room for you, too, in this better world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 任何人都不会被拒之门外，无论多么卑鄙之人。在这个更美好的世界里，也有你的一方天地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: But come sooner rather than later, for our pity will last only so long. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 但宜早不宜迟，我们的垂怜不会无度地持续。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: They breed in the midnight places, a pestilence. You have known them of old, told tales of their evil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 他们在暗夜之处繁衍生息，如瘟疫一般。你早就认识他们，听过他们的邪恶传说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Stand strong; stand together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们要顽强不屈；并肩而立。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: One cord alone may snap, but a rope woven of many cords may bind. All must do their part. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 一根绳子可能会扯断，但如果将许多根绳子编织在一起，就会很结实。所有人都必须尽自己的一份力。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I saw a System divided, and I brought unity. I wept over the orphans of war, and I brought peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我看到一个被分裂的星系，所以我带来了统一。我为战争中的孤儿哭泣，所以我带来了和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My ears rang with the cacophony of chaos, and I said: be still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的耳朵充斥着刺耳的嘈杂声，所以我说：静止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: This bounty I give to you freely. Not the spoils of conquest, nor the profit of trade, but the gift of a loving father. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我无偿赐你们这些赏金。不是征服后的战利品，也不是交易后的报酬，而是一个慈父的礼物。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Just as a crystal lens first brought the heavenly bodies within the sight of man, so does the Veil show us the world as it truly is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 正如水晶棱镜首先将天体带到人类的视野中一样，面障也向我们展示了世界的真实面貌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Seek out those who still walk amid the smoke of confusion and cry aloud for comfort. Take their hands and guide them into the light. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 寻找那些仍然行走在迷雾当中，并且大声哭泣寻求安慰的人。握住他们的手，引导他们进入光明。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: There are those who hate and fear the truth. And well they might. For the truth is a surgeon's scalpel, and has no mercy for what is foul and diseased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 有些人憎恨和害怕真相。这情有可原。因为真相是外科医生的手术刀，对待脏污和病灶它丝毫不留情面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Purge, and purge again, until only the truth remains. All as One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 洗涤，再洗涤，直到只剩下真相。万众归一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Students, eyes on your own screen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 同学们，看向自己的屏幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Quiet down, please. Stand for pledges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 请安静。起立念诵誓词。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You cannot kill the devil, Tenno! ...but you can send it back to hell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Tenno 战士，你无法杀死恶魔的！……但是你可以把它送回地狱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: By the glory and wisdom of the Seven I give my life--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 以七人众的荣耀和智慧之名，献出我的生命——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You wanna get detention again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 难道你还想被留校吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --To carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark. In this... we are one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——为了将我们统治的神圣之光引向最深的黑暗。在此……我们是一体的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --To carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark. In this... we are one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——为了将我们统治的神圣之光引向最深的黑暗。在此……我们是一体的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --To carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark. In this... we are one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——为了将我们统治的神圣之光引向最深的黑暗之处。在此……我们是一体的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --To carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark. In this... we are one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ——为了将我们统治的神圣之光引向最深的黑暗。在此……我们是一体的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Save all that chitter chatter for Tau! Our jump schedule has changed again so we're moving exams up with it! Everyone has studied their Temporal Axioms unit I assume?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 把你们的喋喋不休留给 Tau 吧！我们的跳跃时间表又变了，所以我们要把考试提前！想必每个人都学习过时间公理吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: T.A.? But we were meant to have Phasics!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 时间公理？但我们不是应该要学相位学吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: By my precepts, I've never had such an enthusiastic group of students! Now. Eyes on the main screen, and pay close attention!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 按照我的标准，我从未遇到过这么热情的一群学生！现在。眼睛盯着主屏幕，专心听讲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pardon the interruption. This is 'Zariman actual'. All decks, all stations, stand by for Reliquary field drill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 插播一则通知。这是"「扎里曼号」总指挥室"。甲板和站点上的全体成员，准备进行圣物实地演习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Students, please direct your attention to the windows, you may find this instructive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 同学们，请注意窗户，你们会发现这很有教育意义！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: --In ten...nine...eight...seven...six...five...four...three...two...
Temporal Axioms - Unit 6. The Prison of Linear Time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 让我们来看时间公理——第 6 单元：线性时间的监狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Presentism, the obsolete theory of linear time, posits that now is all that is real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 《现在论》，是一种过时的线性时间理论，它认为只有"现在"才是真实存在的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: In this frame, the Present Absolute, the now, moves constantly toward the future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 在这个参照系中，"绝对的现在"，也就是"当下"，不断地一步步向着未来移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: And leaves the static past behind, discarded, consigned to unreality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 而静止的"过去"则被丢在后头，被弃之不顾，被归于不存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The future remains to be discovered, but is less real than even the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那"未来"呢？它还仍有待被发现，但它甚至不如被抛弃的过去真实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We see the shadows on the cave wall but not the hands that cast them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们的双眼看到了智能洞穴墙壁上的影子，却看不到投射它们的手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Void offers humanity the truer telling of Eternalism. That now is merely a facet of a great block.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 然而虚空不一样，它为人类提供了《永恒论》更真实的描述。那就是"现在"只是一个巨大方块的其中一面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It is relative... and we can change the frame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 《永恒论》是相对的……也就是说我们可以改变参照系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The tyranny of the Present Absolute is overthrown. Tomorrow is now its equal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: "所谓当下"的暴政已经被彻底推翻了。那么明天也就和现在一样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My head hurts...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我头好疼……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: When are we ever gonna use this stuff?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们什么时候才能用上这个东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Question One. Which of the following is not one of the Theories of Time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 现在开始提问，问题一：以下哪个理论不属于时间理论？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Presentism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 《现在论》

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Futurism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 《未来论》

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Eternalism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 《永恒论》

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Incorrect. Were you paying attention during the lecture? Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答错误。你真的在课堂上集中精神了吗？再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Correct. Presentism and Eternalism are the principal Theories of Time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答正确。《现在论》和《永恒论》是主要的时间理论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Question Two. What is the principal failing of Presentism?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 问题二：请回答《现在论》的主要缺陷是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It considers the Present to be the only reality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 该理论认为只有"当下"是唯一存在的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It has never been endorsed by an Archimedean of unblemished standing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 该理论从未得到过任何一位哲士完人的认可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It lacks elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 该理论不够典雅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: It is not true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 该理论是错的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Correct. As the name implies, Presentism considers only the Present to be real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答正确。顾名思义，《现在论》认为只有"当下"是真实存在的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Incorrect. Prior to the discovery of the Void, many worthy Archimedeans of the past endorsed Presentism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答错误。在发现虚空之前，有很多知名的哲士完人都非常赞同《现在论》的错误理论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Partially correct. While elegance is a valid measure of worthiness, the primary failing of Presentism has to do with adequacy. Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答部分正确。虽然典雅是衡量价值的有效标准，但《现在论》的主要缺陷与充分性有关。再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Incorrect. We are not concerned here with absolute Truths, only with Truth as a relative scale. Demerit applied. Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答错误。在这里我们并不在乎事情绝对的真理，我们只在乎作为相对尺度的真理。记过处分。再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Question Three. Lintana's parents have been captured, but she has a choice. The button that opens her mother's cell door will flood her father's cell with deadly radiation, and vice versa. She presses one of the buttons. Under Eternalism, which of the following statements is universally true?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 问题三：林塔纳的父母被抓获了，但她有一个选择。打开她母亲牢房门的按钮将使她父亲的牢房充满致命的辐射，反之亦然。她按下了其中一个按钮。在《永恒论》里，以下哪项陈述是普遍成立的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Only one of her parents will survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她的父母中只有一位能活下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Only one of her parents will die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她的父母中只有一位会死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Her parents will survive. Her parents will die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她的父母会存活。她的父母会死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Incorrect. Versions of reality now exist in which each parent survives. Lintana is assigned to one of them, but the other is no less real and is theoretically accessible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答错误。真实存在的版本取决于是谁活了下来。林塔纳被分配到一个版本，但另一个版本同样真实存在，并且理论上是可行的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Correct. Versions of reality now exist in which each parent dies. Lintana is assigned to one of them, but the other is no less real and is theoretically accessible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 回答正确。真实存在的版本取决于是谁死了。林塔纳被分配到一个版本，但另一个版本同样真实存在，并且理论上是可行的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We must pull that oversized Sentient leech from atop the Tower of Unum! Help the others as you helped me, surah. I shall find a way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们得将那个巨型 Sentient 水蛭从乌努母神之塔的塔顶拉出来！请像帮助我那样帮助其他人吧。我会想办法的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pedlek? PEDLEK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 佩德莱（Pedlek）？佩德莱（PEDLEK）！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Master Teasonai is forever at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 大师提松奈永远为你服务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Lok heb, surah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 嘿，你好啊，苏拉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Fly, my friend. Stay out of their gaze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 飞吧，我的朋友。远离他们的视线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Surah... do not harm any whom you could save, kruna metta.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 朋友……我恳求你，不要伤害任何你可以拯救的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Surah, quickly now, come to the air dock. Hurry, utz!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 朋友，快点，快来飞艇码头。快点啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Unum. They plunder her Temple Kuva! Surah. Konzu begs you. Find a way to reinvigorate her. Before it is too late. Kruna metta!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是乌努母神。他们掠夺了她的神殿赤毒！朋友。孔尊恳求你。请你想办法让她复原。在为时太晚之前。求你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: She lives, surah. She lives!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她还活着，苏拉。她还活着！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My people. Today we begin a great ascension. For as long as I have lived, a chain has dragged behind me. Keeping Tau always beyond grasp. We made our sacrifices... but always with one foot lingering on the shore. Never willing to leave it all behind. Never willing to burn the boats and commit, completely, to that opposite shore. That is why these worlds must die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的子民们。今天我们开始达到新的高度。我的一生里，永远有一条链子拖在我身后。让 Tau 星系无法被掌控。我们是做出了牺牲……但我们总是让一只脚留在岸上。从不愿意彻底抛弃这一切。从不愿意破釜沉舟完全地投入彼岸。这就是为什么这些世界必须灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Murex trajectory increasing on vector heading zero by zero by zero. Right toward the main Narmer fleet passing Mercury. One against so many... there's no way she'll get through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 骨螺战舰的轨迹在矢量方向上零点零点地增加。正对着经过水星的合一众主舰队。以一己之力对付这么多……她不可能通过的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: This is not your fight, Tenno. Ballas is mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这不是你的战斗，Tenno 战士。Ballas 我来终结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You're not ready! He's manipulated you for so long... he'll just own you, like he owns every other Narmer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你还没有准备好！他操纵了你这么久……这么的久……他就只会控制你，就像他控制其他所有的合一众一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You're not ready! He's manipulated you for so long... he'll just own you, like he owns every other Narmer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你还没有准备好！他操纵了你这么久……这么的久……他就只会控制你，就像他控制其他所有的合一众一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你还没有准备好！他操纵了你这么久……这么的久……他就只会控制你，就像他控制其他所有的合一众一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: He put hooks in you that go deep. And you are not back to your fighting weight, lady.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是他引诱你陷进去的。而且你也还没恢复到你的战斗量级，女士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: He put hooks in you that go deep. And you are not back to your fighting weight, lady.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是他引诱你陷进去的。而且你也还没恢复到你的战斗量级，女士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You are warned. Keep to your place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这是一个警告。待在原地不要动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Contact! Contact! Narmer blockade ahead. She's completely outnumbered... outgunned... What? By stars, they're lowering shields! She still has some command of the fleet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 遇敌！遇敌！前方有合一众的阻拦。在人数和武器上她完全处于劣势……什么？天哪，他们正在降下护盾！她仍然可以指挥部分舰队！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: But not the one ship Ballas now controls. The great Sentient weapon of the Old War. Do you know what she was called? Praghasa. The Devourer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 但不是 Ballas 现在控制着的那一艘。远古之战里 Sentient 创造的伟大武器。你知道她曾经叫什么吗？「布拉喀萨」——吞噬者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yes, we know it. The ship that feeds on debris and derelicts to rebuild itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是的，我们知道。那艘飞船以残骸和遗迹作为养料来自我重建。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Please. You're not thinking straight. You need more time to heal...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 求你了。你没有理智地去思考。你需要更多的时间来恢复……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Please. You're not thinking straight. You need more time to heal...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 求你了。你没有理智地去思考。你需要更多的时间来恢复……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Please. You're not thinking straight. You need more time to heal...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 求你了。你没有理智地去思考。你需要更多的时间来恢复……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Please. You're not thinking straight. You need more time to heal...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 求你了。你没有理智地去思考。你需要更多的时间来恢复……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Look. You're not yourself. Not yet. We can find the last Archon, together...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 看。你还没有完全恢复。还没有。我们可以找到最后一个执刑官，我们一起……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Look. You're not yourself. Not yet. We can find the last Archon together...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 看。你还没有完全恢复。还没有。我们可以找到最后一个执刑官，我们一起……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Look. You're not yourself. Not yet. We can find the last Archon together...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 看。你还没有完全恢复。还没有。我们可以找到最后一个执刑官，我们一起……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: There is no time, no mercy for Narmer. Praghasa must be stopped before Ballas can fulfill her original purpose. Praghasa cannot be allowed to feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 已经没时间了，完全没有必要仁慈地对待合一众。当务之急，是必须在 Ballas 让「布拉喀萨」实现初衷之前阻止她。不能让「布拉喀萨」进食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do you mean? Feed on what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你的意思是什么？进食什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do you mean? Feed on what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你的意思是什么？进食什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你的意思是什么？进食什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ugh, what do you mean? Feed on what?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你的意思是什么？进食什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What do you mean? Feed on what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你的意思是什么？进食什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: The Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 是太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Tenno. On your six.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: ，在你的后方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Well met, Tenno but no time for reminiscing. We are under attack. Target-rich environment. Get on those guns!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 很感人的相遇，Tenno，但没时间追忆过往了。我们正在遭受攻击。到处都是敌军目标。快进入战斗部位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Murex shields down. She still has fangs. Time for the big gun. Get on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 骨螺战舰护盾已摧毁。她还是有獠牙的。是时候该让大炮上场了。开始行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Great shot, kid. That was one in a million.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好枪法，孩子。刚才那枪真是万中无一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: WE. ARE. --
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 万、众——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Crew: brace for shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 舰员们，准备应对冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Entering slingshot range. Orphix pulse fields detected aboard. Get a Necramech in the barrel. You will need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 进入弹射器射程。在敌舰上检测到奥影脉冲场。准备好殁世机甲。你会用上它的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Alright Cy. Get clear after launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好吧赛伊。发射后就撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Alright Cy. Get clear after launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好吧赛伊。发射后就撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Alright Cy. Get clear after launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好吧赛伊。发射后就撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Right. Get outta here once I'm aboard, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 对。我一上舰就离开这里，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Right. Get outta here once I'm aboard, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 对。我一上舰就离开这里，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 对。我一上舰就离开这里，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Gravimetrics are chaotic. At current rate, this Railjack will burn on approach. Weird: that thing appears to be eating the Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 重力测量混乱无序。按照当前的速率，这艘航道星舰将在靠近时被点燃。奇怪的是：那个东西看起来正在吞噬太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We have got to stop it. What if, what if we approach using the wrecked ships as cover?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我们必须要阻止它。如果我们使用失事船只作为掩护会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: We've got to stop it. What if we approach using the wrecked ships as cover?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Shoulda stayed in Duviri... hmm... could we tuck into the shadows of the wrecked ships for approach?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 唉，早知道就留在双衍王境了……嗯……我们能不能躲进失事舰只的阴影里方便接近？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Shoulda stayed in Duviri... hmm... could we tuck into the shadows of the wrecked ships for approach?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Priority: get close enough to execute slingshot maneuver. Time transitions with solar flare events for maximum cover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 优先事项：尽可能接近目标来寻找弹射的机会，利用太阳耀斑的间隙前进以获得最大效果的掩护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Crew: spaceframe integrity critical. This Railjack is cooking. Hug the shadows, or we are done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 船员们：空间飞行器的完整性即将不足。这艘航道星舰正在冒烟。靠近阴影处，否则我们就完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Shields burning away. Watch your vectors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 护盾已经燃烧殆尽。注意你的方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Crew: they do not make sunblock strong enough to save us from this. Get us out of the oven.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 船员们：没有足够强的防晒霜可以让我们逃脱这样的险境。让我们从烤箱里逃出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: This wreckage is burning up. We will not be shielded for much longer. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这个残骸正在被烧毁。我们无法躲避太久，Tenno，请继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My people. Long have you waited for the sign. I have delivered it! Look to the sky! It grows darker by the moment. That darkness gathers strength. Strength enough to open the Void and bear me onward to sacred Tau!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的人民们，你们等待这个征兆太久了。我已经让它出现了！请看天空！它变得愈来愈暗。黑暗正在积聚力量。这股力量足以打开虚空，并带着我向神圣的 Tau 星系前进！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Gravitational waves increasing. Helm will feel sloppy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 引力波正在持续增加。飞船会很难操控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What will become of you, my people, my flock? You will join me there, of course... but by another path. The path of sacrifice. The path of oblivion. Cleansed of all doubt, for you will peer into pitch of day and find the SUN is gone. Its heart rendered, beating in my hand... the cost of my passage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你们会变成什么样，我的子民，我的信徒？你们会和我一起去那里……当然，不过是通过另外一条路。牺牲之路。遗忘之路。消除所有的疑虑，因为在天亮时，你们会发现太阳已经消失了。它的心脏在我手中跳动……这是通道的代价！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What a glorious reunion! You and mother-dearest both come to send me on my way. I am ready, Tenno... are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 多么值得称道的重逢啊！你和你最亲爱的母亲都来送我上路了。我准备好了，Tenno……你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: When the Lotus reaches him, he will make her his puppet. Together, they will annihilate the sun. And so. My sister must...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 当莲（Lotus）到达他身边时，他会让她成为他的傀儡。他们将会一起消灭太阳。所以。我姐姐一定……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I know. Maybe if she was stronger, we wouldn't have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我知道。如果她再坚强点，我们就不用这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You HAD to have a 'child' - and with an open heart I gave you… this. And my reward? Being left to watch as all your love - MY. LOVE. - poured into the bottomless well of this… abominable child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你那时非要有个"孩子"——怀着仁慈之心我给了你……这个家伙。可我的回报呢？被留下来看着你所有的爱——属于我的爱——被无底洞般地倾注在这个……可恶的孩子身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I remember... my old self... dissolving... beneath your fingers. Shaping me. Directing me. Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我还记得……曾经的我……在你的指尖……溶化。你在塑造我。指引我。在月球上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Remember! Remember what he did to you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 快想想！想想他对你做了什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: 'Run'? Where should they run to? You've only destroyed everything!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: "跑"？他们还能逃到哪里去呢？你把这一切全部都毁了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Yes, let's discuss "what I did." I who have endured your torture of me. Your lies. Your betrayals. Without. Complaint. All for you. And this is my reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 好啊，让我们来说说"我做了什么"。我，忍受了你对我的折磨。你的谎言、你的背叛。我都毫无，怨言。一切都是为了你。而这就是我的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You... you... You lie. You are small
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你……你……你撒谎。你真是个小人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pitiful. I am loved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 小可怜。我是被爱着的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You are a mask. With nothing behind it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你只不过是一张面具。面具里什么都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Pitiful, broken thing. A puppet accusing her maker of... a lack of substance? Was it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 小可怜，残破的东西。一个傀儡在指责她的制造者……缺乏实质内容？是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Very well - she can take your punishment for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 非常好——她可以代替你接受惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Ballas! Stop! Spare them! Spare them... and I will be whatever you want.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Ballas！住手！饶了他们吧！只要你能饶了他们……你想让我成为谁，都行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Shut. Up. You are making me do this. And when this child is dead you and I will have words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 闭、嘴。这全都是你逼我的。等到这个孩子他死了之后，我会来找你好好的谈谈的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Her kind can't feel pain. All lies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 她是感受不到疼痛的。全是骗人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You never understood me, my vision. My future lies with Tau. Not here. Not with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你从未理解过我，我的展望。我的未来应该是在 Tau 星系。而不在这里。也不是和你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Stop... stop...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 住……手，住手

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: She has this coming. Do not interfere again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这本来就是她该承受的。不要再来干涉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I cast you from my sight. 'Lotus.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 离开这儿，不要在这里惹人烦。"莲（Lotus）。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I said STOP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我说了住！手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: AAAGH!
Very well: I give you my death - and yours as well. The unstoppable annihilation of every. Single! Last! Thing! Pleased? Satisfied? Are you now full up with death?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 那好的：我把这条命给你——再搭上你自己的。我将彻底地毁灭一切！毁！灭！所！有！一！切！开心了吗？你满意了吗？你现在总该沾满鲜血了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: My vision was only ever comprehensible to myself. My ambition beyond the grasp of... 'people'. Thus I have always been alone. Your death changes nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我的愿景从未被任何人理解过，除了我自己。我的雄心壮志，远不止掌控所谓的……"子民"。所以我一直都是孤独的。你的死亡并不会改变什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: People warned me against you, you know. Early on. Before the jade light. I should have listened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 有人警告过我关于你的事，你知道的。早些时候。在翠玉之光发生之前。我应该听进去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: What are you? Tell me that. What barren, disgusting thing have I let into my house and my heart? Tell me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你到底是什么？告诉我。让我知道我到底是把一个多么贫瘠、恶心的东西放进家里，并占据了我的心。告诉我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Child... run...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 孩子……快跑……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: And so the monstrosity dies... beautifully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 这个大怪物就这样死去……华丽落幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Alone at last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 终于，无人打扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: Ballas，我的爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Kiss... me...
Kneel! Kneel, and I will spare these worlds. Beg, and I will make you complete again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 跪下！向我下跪，然后我会饶恕这方天地。求我，然后我就会让你再次变得完整！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I had something different in mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我有一些不同的想法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I loved you once... you were so like her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我爱过你……曾经。你非常的像她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: You dreamed of a Margulis you could control. But she chose death over you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你所幻想着的是一个你可以控制的 Margulis。但她选择了死亡而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I... said... to... stay... out... of... this...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……说过……不要……插手……这个

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: But you can't, can you? Still desperate to save her from herself. You never truly knew her, did you? What she most needs?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Why do you make me do these things?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 你为什么要逼我做这些事呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Say "I love you, my master."

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: I... love you. My master.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 我……爱......爱你。我的主人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.text: Now... kill your child. For me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DTNW.zhText: 现在……杀了你的孩子。为了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Whoever's behind Narmer these days is using lone Raknoids to maintain a control network for the veils. Wreck the Raknoid. Kneecap Narmer. Let's get it done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 目前那个在背后操纵合一众的人，正在使用独立的蛛形机来维护面障的控制网络。我们要做的是摧毁蛛形机，屏蔽合一众的信号。让我们动手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Some take the veil by choice. A first taste of happiness, no matter how illusory, can be... well... more than you can ever let go of. But we cannot go back to sleep. No matter what.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 有些人是自愿戴上面障的。第一次尝到幸福的滋味，无论那是多么虚幻，都可能……好吧……远远超过你所能放下的事情。但我们绝对不能再沉迷下去了。无论怎样都不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Got a lock on a Narmer ops drone. Point-node for distributed tactical processing. We've got Narmheads moving in. But if we get the drone first, we can get the drop on them. Time's short, move out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 我已经锁定了一架合一众的行动无人机。它会瞄准节点作战术分析。合一众已来袭，如果搞定无人机，就能抢占先机。时间不多了，行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: If only lies were as easy to kill as the poor sods who believe in them. Drone's datamass is secure.  Thanks, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 真希望处理谎言能像解决那些可怜信徒一样容易。无人机数据块是安全的。谢谢你，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Big picture? Every scrap of metal we keep out of Narmer hands means one less veil, and one less Narmer. Nice work, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 这是在布局？我们每从合一众手里每抢走一块金属，就等于少一件面障，少一名合一众信徒。小火花，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Narmer can't rely on outside supplies so they're mining our resources to produce their veils. Get in there and take back our haul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 合一众无法依赖外部供应，所以他们正在开采我们的资源来生产面障。去吧，拿回属于我们的物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Narmer's veiling any Corpus they can get their hands on and Nef's filed it as a non-issue. It's down to us. If we don't stop this then Narmer expansion goes exponential and Fortuna's done for. Let's move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 合一众正在用面障控制了所有见过的 Corpus，而奈富认为不构成威胁。如果我们阻止的话，合一众的扩张会成指数增长。福尔图娜就完蛋了。行动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.text: Done. For now. Give me brain-shelving any day. At least I'd still be me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheNewWar/DVal.zhText: 搞定，目前算是。无论何时，我都宁愿选择大脑被回柜。至少我还是我自己。

[9.2]
Sparky. Did I... did they... did I do anything I'd be... ashamed of? 
[18.0]
There was only... that voice... and I was gone. The messed up part is...?
[31.0]
 I liked it. I never had to worry... or think... ever again. And I liked it.
[36.1]
With Ballas dead you'd think Narmer would be dusted. They're not. 
[39.0]
Some took the mask willingly and don't want to let it go. 
[46.6]
Now someone else is pulling the strings. Narmer's here. They're not going away.

小火花，我……他们……就是我有没有做什么……会让我感到羞耻的事？
[18.0]
我只记得……仿佛……有个……声音……然后我就不记得了。更糟糕的是……？
[31.0]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You no longer possess Transference. You no longer command the Warframes. You no longer are the Operator. You must be purged from this vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你已经不再有传识能力。你已经不再操控战甲。你已经不再是指挥官。你必须，马上离开这艘飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Non-operator, I'm sorry to inconvenience you, but I'm going to decompress the ship now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 前指挥官，很抱歉给您带来了不便，我要给飞船降压了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Former Operator, Ordis cannot keep missing like this! Get out of here before I Purge you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 前指挥官，很抱歉 Ordis 没办法这样一直失误！请您离开否则我得让你滚蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Ex-Operator, if you get to the navigation console, I may be able to detach the landing craft before I… before I kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 前指挥官，如果您可以到达导航控制台，或许我可以投放登陆舰，免得我……免得我消灭你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You are not the Operator. You will be purged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你不是指挥官。你即将被排除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Exterminate! Exterminate the non-Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 消灭！消灭！消灭前指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Operator! Cut the link... cut the link!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 指挥官！切断连接……切断连接！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Something is hiding in this asteroid field but before you can investigate you need to disable the security matrix. Ordis, are you certain this is the best angle of approach?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这个小行星带里藏着什么东西，但你必须先关闭防御矩阵，才能继续进行调查。Ordis，你确定这是最佳的飞行角度吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Well, outside this corridor lie burst scanners, severe radiation, proximity mines, GRINEER DEATH BEAMS so yes, Ordis recommends staying within the shipping corridor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 呃，这条通道以外的地方布置了很多连续扫描器、重度辐射、感应地雷、Grineer 死亡激光，所以，没错，Ordis 推荐您不要超出这条货运通道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Operator, watch that transport ahead. The scanner is only able to scan one side at a time. You can use that to your advantage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 指挥官，注意前方的运输舰。扫描器一次只能扫描到一个面，所以，您可以利用这个优势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You heard Ordis. Keep the transport between yourself and the beams. Do not let them touch you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你听到 Ordis 的建议了。让运输舰把你和激光隔开，不要让它接触到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: They're going to scan the top of the transport, get below it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 他们要扫描运输舰的顶侧，到下面去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Another scanner, to the right of the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 又一台扫描器，在飞船右面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Watch out to the ship's left, another scanner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 小心飞船左面，又有扫描器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: This is the last scanner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 啊，这是最后一台扫描器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You've been detected. They know you're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你被发现了，他们知道你在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Nicely done. They still haven't seen you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 做得非常好，他们没有发现你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You're clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 可以通过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Might I say that was smooth, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 请允许我说一句，您动作真流畅，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You're through. Land at the checkpoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你已经通过了，到关卡着陆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: This checkpoint is the central hub of the security-matrix. Shut it down so Ordis can fly you in undetected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这个关卡是防御矩阵的中央枢纽部分。现在马上把它关闭，以便 Ordis 帮助你潜入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: They're coming for you. Don't let them abort the shutdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 他们来了，别让它们中断关闭程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Ordis no longer detects any security.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Ordis 已检测不到安全设备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Good, but we can't take any chances, silence the remaining Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 很好，但是我们不能冒风险，解决剩下的 Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You are in the clear. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 道路畅通，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我警告过你了。如今你被困在这里，而女皇正在搜寻你。如今我不得不破坏 Margulis 的成果，打开大门……让你受苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Know this Tenno, that I am a Dax. A soldier of a lost era, the last of my kind. By Orokin hands we Dax were given great power, great strength… but an even greater weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 记住，Tenno，我是一名禁卫。我是旧时代的士兵，我是最后一位。奥罗金人赐予了我们禁卫强大的力量……但同时也给了我们巨大的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: To obey their command. To never defy the Kuva, the Scepter, the symbols of their dominion. No Dax can ever raise steel against an Orokin. Only you can do that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们必须听从他们的命令。永远不能反抗赤毒，反抗权杖，那是他们统治的象征。没有禁卫能对奥罗金人挥舞刀剑。只有你才能做到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Margulis lied to you, a lie of omission. She did not cure the Zariman children - she erased them. My only hope is that truth still lingers inside you, buried within your mind. The power and the misery… of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Margulis 她隐瞒了事实。她没有治好扎里曼的遗孤——她把那些孩子抹消了。我唯一的希望，就是事实还留在你的心里，藏在你灵魂的深处。虚空的力量……以及痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The Ayatan Sculptures are perpetually in motion, monuments of Orokin Continuity... immortality. But this one is halted and aging, needing you, as the Queens do. Will you give in to them? Or will you face the coil?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 灵感雕塑永不停歇，这是奥罗金延续秘仪的纪念碑……纪念永生。但这座雕塑停下了，它需要你，正如女皇需要你。你会屈服吗？还是选择面对尘世的痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What is that thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那是什么东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Those are Queens' braids. What are they up to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那是女皇的抽取管。她们到底想做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The child's hurting my Kuva Siphon! Queen's Immortal Guard… pfft… you're just a waste of food.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那个孩子正在伤害我的赤毒虹吸器！女皇的不朽护卫……呸，养你们就是浪费粮食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No! Listen, if you let the Kuva Siphon get damaged again, I'll grind the lot of you into miniature-dumplings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不！都给我听好了，如果你们再让赤毒虹吸器受到伤害的话，我就把你们全都剁成肉馅包饺子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My little rumple-dimples, why must you let them hurt my Siphon? Do you want me to get mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的小娃娃们，你们为什么要眼看着它们伤害我的虹吸器？你们想惹我生气吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I give you maggots the honor of eating from my scrap-trough and this is how you repay me? Unacceptable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你们这些蛆虫，我特别恩准你们从我的废料槽里吃饭，结果你们就这么报答我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Another failure! If you don't want to serve your Queen, you can always be served to her, on a platter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 居然又失败了！如果你们不想效忠女皇，你们还可以把自己盛在盘子里献身给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What are you overfed-swine doing? Protect the Siphon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你们这群愚蠢的肥猪，都在干什么呢？快保护虹吸器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What was I thinking?!? I never should have put my food in charge of something this important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我在想什么？！？我就不应该让一群食物负责这么重要的工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You're not guards. You're compost heaps with legs. Useless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你们不是卫兵，你们就是一堆肥料。真是废物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My Kuva! Do not let them do that again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的赤毒！别让它们再得逞，明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Arrg!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I said stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我说过了，阻止它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: That worked. Your Operator form is key. Target the other Kuva clouds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 成功了，Tenno 战士。你的指挥官形态是关键，继续破坏剩下的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Hurry. Use your Operator form to strike those Kuva clouds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 动作快，继续用这种方式，攻击剩下的抽取管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Don't let them do that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不要让它们那么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No. Protect the Siphon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不，保护虹吸器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What a waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 真是浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Your weapons aren't working. Try something else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你的武器没有作用，赶快试试别的方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You need a new approach, you're not making a dent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你需要试试别的做法，这样没有效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You're snoring, dreamer. My machines are tougher than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你在打呼噜呢，梦回者。我的机器可是坚固得很啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Boom, boom, BOOM! Look at those fireworks. But it's all for show, my Kuva Siphon is Warframe-proof.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 砰、砰、砰！看啊，好多烟花，可惜中看不中用。我的赤毒虹吸器不怕战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Distract the puppet. Make it dance and flail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 给我赶走那个傀儡，让它跳它的舞去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No time to ask questions, destroy that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 没时间问问题了，快破坏那个东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: That machine, it's using your energy to… This is bad. Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那台机器，它正在用你的能量……这可不行，必须破坏它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The chamber is almost full. How exciting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 机器里的赤毒就快满了。我非常期待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: More, I want more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不够，还不够！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Can you hear me sister? It won't be long now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你听到了吗，姐姐？就快要成功了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Double, double toil and trouble, the puppets dance while chamber bubbles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不惮辛劳不惮烦，釜中赤毒已成澜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What lovely energy. Every particle counts when we're making Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 多么美妙的能量。当我们制造赤毒时一滴都不能浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Listen to the chamber simmer. The longer that dreamer thrashes about the more Kuva essence we collect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 听啊，这来自机器的鸣响。梦回者越是挣扎，我们收获的赤毒就越多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My siphon! I can't believe how useless you all are. Report for execution at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的赤毒虹吸器！我真不敢相信，你们居然没用到这个地步。马上去找刽子手报到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You useless balls of festering flesh. You let them destroy my Kuva Siphon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你们这堆没用的烂肉。就这么让它们把我的赤毒虹吸器弄坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My Siphon! My Kuva! You're messing up all my plans. I don't like it. Not one bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的虹吸器！我的赤毒！你们搞乱了我的计划。我不开心。一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Good work, Tenno. We need to do everything we can to stop the Queens from gathering anymore Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 干得好，Tenno 战士。我们必须尽我们最大的努力阻止女皇收集赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You've destroyed the Queen's Kuva Siphon, we can't allow any of these to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你已经成功破坏了女皇的赤毒虹吸器，我们不能让它继续存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Sweet Kuva. Sister, it won't be long before I see your beautifully grotesque face again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 甜蜜的赤毒。亲爱的姐姐，我很快就能再看到你那张美丽的丑脸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Groompas, you've served me well. I shall enjoy a feast in your honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 很好，我很满意。我会大餐一顿庆祝你们的胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: And done, another batch of Kuva particles for my Sister. Every bit counts you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 成功了，又一批赤毒献给我亲爱的姐姐。一滴都不能浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: And with that I say goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那么现在该说再见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Siphoning complete. Guards, show the Tenno how much we appreciate their help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 抽取完毕。卫兵，向 Tenno 表达一下感谢吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You let them fill the Siphon! Tenno, we cannot allow the Queens to get enough Kuva to regain their power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你没有阻挡住他们抽取赤毒！Tenno 战士，我们不能让女皇收集到足够的赤毒，取回她的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Tenno, that can't happen again. The next time you see one of those things, destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Tenno 战士，下次不能再发生这种情况。如果再看见这种东西，把它销毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The Siphon is full. I cannot understate how much of a setback this is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 女皇的虹吸器已经满了。我得说这给我们带来了难以估计的损失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Wait, what is it doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 等等，它在干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Ick! I don't like it when the meatbag squirms out of its shell like that. Put it back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 呃啊！我不喜欢看那堆烂肉爬出铁壳，真是太恶心了。把它塞回去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The resonance frequency has changed, you're onto something, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 共振频率变了，你好像发现了什么，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What an ugly child. Yuck!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 怎么会有这么丑的孩子。呃啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Disgusting flesh-thing. Thoroughly unappetizing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 丑陋的肉体，真是太恶心了。让我完全没有食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Ugh. Look at that scrawny creature, where's the meat?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 唉呀，它瘦得只剩皮包骨头了，肉都哪去了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Look at this, a Dreamer's sleep-stumbling onto my Kuva Siphon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 哦，看啊，梦回者梦游到我的赤毒虹吸器这里啦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Listen. The machines are coming to life. There's kuva in the air!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 听好，我的机器已经启动了，空气里到处都是赤毒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Guardians, distract the child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 卫兵，给我赶走那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Relax child, you won't feel a thing. Promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 放松点，孩子，一点都不疼。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: A Yuvan theater, long abandoned. In ages past, I would have stood guard as the young and exotic were paraded through the mountain pass and marched by the viewing pane. They'd barter here, the Orokin. Withering and coughing- as they prepared for their Continuity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 青春厅堂，已废弃许久。在很久很久以前，我就站在这里看着年轻的异国人列队行过山口，并走过观察窗。他们奥罗金人就在这里进行交换他们形如枯槁，咳嗽着准备进行他们的延生仪式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: She doesn't want me dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 她不想让我死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: She doesn't want me dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 她不想让我死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: She doesn't want me dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 她不想让我死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: She doesn't want me dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 她不想让我死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No. The Queen doesn't want to kill you. She wants to become you. To burrow through your mind corrupting it with despair until only she remains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不。女皇不想干掉你，她想要成为你。她想钻进你的心灵，用无妄侵蚀你，直到只有她留下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No crew aboard, only the children… only the parricidal monsters they had become.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 飞船上没有船员，只剩下孩子们……他们已经变成了怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The endless Void, the gazing abyss, the bottomless ocean of horror… it coiled itself around your tender heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 无尽的虚空，回望的深渊，无边的惊恐……它缠绕上你柔软的心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I embraced it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我欢迎它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I embraced it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我欢迎它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I embraced it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我欢迎它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I embraced it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我欢迎它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I controlled it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我控制它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I controlled it.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我控制它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I hated it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我恨它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我恨它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: CUT THE LINK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 切断连接！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: CUT THE LINK! Transference overload in 5...4...3...2...1
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 切断连接！传识系统即将超载，5……4……3……2……1

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Operator, are you... well? That surge burnt out the Transference circuits. I will have to begin repairs immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 指挥官，您还……好吗？刚才的能量把传识回路烧坏了。我必须现在就开始修理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Operator? Is that… is that 'you'? Your brain activity flat-lined for a moment there… Can you speak? By stars, the Operator's mind is destroyed?!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 指挥官？那是"您"吗？刚才有一瞬间，您的大脑活动中断了……您能说话吗？群星啊，指挥官的脑子被弄坏了？！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Music? …Operator you are not making sense! The Transference surge must have affected you as well. Try to rest while I begin repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 音乐？……指挥官，您在胡说什么呢！传识能量异常肯定也影响到您了。请休息一下，交给我来修理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I… I'm fine. Just… just don't play any music. I need to think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我……我很好。不过……不要放音乐。我要思考。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I… I'm fine. Just… just don't play any music. I need to think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我……我很好。不过……不要放音乐。我要思考。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Understood. The Operator does not like… 'music'.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I have come, as you commanded, my Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 陛下，我听您的命令来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: And this is your offering?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 而这就是你的献礼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My sister needs the orphan child, not its Infested puppet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我姐姐要的是那个没爹娘的孩子，不是这个感染疾病的傀儡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The child? For what purpose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那个孩子？为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: To eat it, of course!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 吃掉它，这还用问！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Hush worm! Do not question your Lords, Teshin Dax. Bring me the orphan. Bring me my Yuvan.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 哦，不是它的错，小虫子。妈咪和爹地都不在它身边，没有人教它礼貌。只好由我们来教。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 传识能量急速上升，指挥官！您的战甲连接要断开了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You have some idea that you're invincible, don't you? Nestled away in that mad Cephalon's crib-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你觉得你是无敌的，是不是？你躲在那个疯疯癫癫的中枢的摇篮里……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: But you belong to me now. For you see, child, we conceived of these ugly, metal cysts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 但现在，你归我所有。你知道吗，孩子，是我们设计了这些丑陋的金属躯壳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We gave you your precious gifts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们给了你这些珍贵的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: And now, just as easily, we take them all away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 现在，我们要毫不费力将它收回！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What did you do, Dax? What did you do?! How did a child reject the Continuity?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你做了什么，禁卫？你做了什么？！一个孩子怎么可能抗拒延续秘仪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Forgive me, my Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 请原谅我，陛下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We hold the Scepter! We command you. We are--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们手里有权杖！你要听从我们的命令。我们——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Sister! The dreamer's come for us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 姐姐！梦回者来找我们了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Tenno, no! After everything you've endured to escape, why did you come back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Tenno，不要！你吃了那么多苦头才成功逃走，为什么还要回来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I came back for you.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 傻孩子。你真不识好歹，是不是？你居然亲自回来？你犯了一个大错。卫兵！干掉这个战甲，把我的新皮囊拿来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The red braids shield her. Destroy them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那些红色的管道在保护她。快摧毁它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Shut up you insolent Dax!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 闭嘴，你这个无礼的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Without her Sceptre, she is powerless. Break her shields and use your dash to steal it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 如果没有权杖，她将无能为力。打破她的护盾，利用冲刺把权杖抢走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You'll pay for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你会为此付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Long enough have I lived in these ugly Grineer bodies. I need new flesh… I deserve new flesh! Yours!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我在这些丑陋的 Grineer 身体里已经住了太久了。我需要新的身体……给我新的身体！你的身体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: By my Orokin blood, I command you, Teshin Dax, to kill this Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我以奥罗金的血脉命令你，禁卫 Teshin，干掉这个 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: No, I cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不，我不能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You must. By your oath eternal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你必须遵从你曾许下的永恒誓言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: That child I met on the mountain will surely die here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 若你还是我在山上遇见的那个孩子，必死无疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: That child is gone.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们是奥罗金人！我们创造了你！我们是你金色的主人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Come out, come out, little demon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 出来吧，出来吧，小魔头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I see now, how you cast me out. Simple, really. There's no room for me in that wicked, swarming head of yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 现在我懂了，你是怎么把我赶出来的。其实很简单，你那低等的脑袋里已经挤满了，没有我的空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Is this how you hunted the Zariman crew? Is this how you murdered your parents?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你就凭这个干掉了扎里曼的船员？你就凭这个干掉了你的父母？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Show yourself you little coward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 快快现身，你这个懦夫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What are you waiting for, Dax?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你还在等什么，禁卫？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: A chance to kill you… and now I finally have it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 一个消灭你的机会……这一刻终于到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Shall I, Tenno?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 小女皇已经召集了军队。回到飞船上去，让我来引开他们。快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Tenno? Tenno? I've been trying to get through. Are you... alright? Your Transference stream seems different, stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Tenno 战士？Tenno 战士？我一直联络不上你。你还……好吗？你的传识信号似乎变了，变得更强了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We have neutralized the Queens. Teshin… Teshin helped me. I'm heading to extraction now.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Thank the stars you're safe, Operator! I forbid you to leave the Orbiter like that again, it's just too much for an old Cephalon like me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 感谢群星，您平安无事指挥官！我不许您再像那样离开飞船，这对于我这样的老中枢来说刺激过头了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You rescued your Warframe! What a relief. But… Ordis wonders, are you still able to walk the ship as… yourself?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Impressive! Just think of the possibilities! You can help me clean up that Infested door!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Teshin thinks he knows better. Maybe he does? Maybe you needed to know to survive the Queens. But you are changed now.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What you did. You didn't have a choice. Tenno, you were only just a--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你做过的事，你没有选择。Tenno，当时你还只是一个——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Don't. Don't do that. Don't make excuses for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 不要。不要说那个词。不要给我找借口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Don't. Don't do that. Don't make excuses for me.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What's this? An Old War beacon? How exciting, Operator. You will want to investigate this… Oh. I'm sorry… did I interrupt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这是什么？远古纷争的信标？多令人兴奋呀，指挥官。您肯定想调查一下……哦，抱歉……我打扰到什么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Tenno, this is one fight your Warframe cannot win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Tenno，这场战斗，你靠战甲是无法取胜的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Remember the mountain. Remember your new strength.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 记住那座山峰，记住你全新的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: It's time to show the Queens' what they have awoken within you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 让女皇看看，她们从你灵魂深处唤醒了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Their weapons contain Kuva, it protects them from your Warframe but not from your Tenno powers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 他们的武器中蕴含着赤毒，它能阻挡你的战甲，但不能阻挡 Tenno 的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: They are protected by the Kuva in their weapons. Find a way to disarm them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 他们被武器中的赤毒保护着，想办法解除他们的武装。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Tenno, remember the Golden Maw and how you brought it to heel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Tenno，记住黄金喉兽，记住你是如何差遣它的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Let the Guardians feel your Pulse from the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 让禁卫尝尝你从虚空中唤来的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: They're vulnerable. Attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 他们变得虚弱了，进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The Guardians protect the braids, the braids protect the Queen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 禁卫们保护着那些管道，而管道保护着女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I can show you no mercy, show me none in return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我是不会手下留情的，你也不需要有所顾虑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Yes! From the moment I began training you, I have anticipated this moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 没错！从我开始训练你的那一刻起，我就在期待着这一刻到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You must not stop, defeat me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 呃…你不要停手，呃…打败我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You are a child no longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 呃…你…已经不再只是一个孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I am beaten.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我…被打败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I… Cannot go… On…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我不能再……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Teshin is trying to mask his location from us, but I have pinpointed a suspicious signal for you to investigate. Find him, we need answers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Teshin 试图隐藏了他的位置，但我已经追踪到了一个可疑信号，需要你去调查。去找到他，我们需要答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: All my scans for Teshin have converged on this location. Find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的探测结果全都汇聚在这个地点。找到他。Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: That's not Teshin, it's another one of his Specters. He's trying to shake us off the trail. Capture that Specter, we can use it to find the real Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那不是 Teshin，那是他放出的魅影。他在试图摆脱我们的追踪。抓住那个魅影，我们可以利用它找到真正的 Teshin。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Well done. Return to your ship, I will alert you when I've decrypted this Specter's control signature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 干得好。回到你的飞船上，等我破解这个魅影的控制信号之后，我会通知你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Teshin's Specter points to what should be an unpopulated asteroid field, but deep scans show the presence of a security-matrix. Someone is trying to hide something, I need you to find out what. Prepare your Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: Teshin 的魅影表明，他在一个无人居住的小行星带，但经过深度检测之后，我发现那里有一个防御矩阵。有人想要隐藏什么东西，我需要你去调查清楚。准备好反重力曲翼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Bring them to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 把它带给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What was that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: What was that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Queens?! The Grineer Queens? Tell me what--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 女皇？！Grineer 的女皇？你究竟——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Queens?! The Grineer Queens? Tell me what--

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I am warning you. You think you're safe behind this metal, but you're not. Not in the ways that matter here. Behind this, you're still just a child --
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我警告你。你以为躲在金属躯壳后面是安全的，但并非如此。至少在这里不是。离开了它，你还只是一个孩子——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Stop saying that.
