/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Follow me again, Tenno, and you will answer to my sword.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 如果你继续跟踪我，Tenno，你就要面对我的剑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I thought the Queens were just an invention of Grineer command. No one has ever seen them in the flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我还以为女皇只是 Grineer 高层编出来的。从来没人见过女皇的真面目。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: He's trying to shake us off the trail. Destroy his Specters and keep on him.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Massively fortified. The Queens have to be here. I'm going to infiltrate the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这里防御工事很牢固。女皇肯定在这。我要潜入基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Massively fortified. The Queens have to be here. I'm going to infiltrate the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这里防御工事很牢固。女皇肯定在这。我要潜入基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Massively fortified. The Queens have to be here. I'm going to infiltrate the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 这里防御工事很牢固。女皇肯定在这。我要潜入基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus, are you receiving me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus），能听到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus, are you receiving me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus），能听到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus, are you receiving me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus），能听到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus, are you receiving me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus），能听到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We're so glad you came.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们很高兴你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus? If you can hear me, something's tampering with the Transference stream. I'm going to locate the source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus）…莲（Lotus）？如果你能听到，有什么人在干扰传识信号。我要找到干扰来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus? If you can hear me, something's tampering with the Transference stream. I'm going to locate the source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus）…莲（Lotus）？如果你能听到，有什么人在干扰传识信号。我要找到干扰来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus? If you can hear me, something's tampering with the Transference stream. I'm going to locate the source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus）…莲（Lotus）？如果你能听到，有什么人在干扰传识信号。我要找到干扰来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Lotus? If you can hear me, something's tampering with the Transference stream. I'm going to locate the source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 莲（Lotus）…莲（Lotus）？如果你能听到，有什么人在干扰传识信号。我要找到干扰来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We have a gift for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们准备了一份礼物给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Get to work you rotten beasts! You flea flocking meat sacks! This Kuva is garbage! We need more or you're all going to the meat grinders for tomorrow's meal!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 干活呀，你们这些腐烂的畜生！养跳蚤的肉堆！这些赤毒都是垃圾！我们还要更多，如果做不到，你们就去绞肉机里变成明天的晚餐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My sister is sick you grey maggots! From now on, work details are doubled! Half rations until Kuva distillation is meeting production targets!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我姐姐病了，你们这些恶心的蛆虫！全都给我听好了！从现在起，工作量加倍！粮食减半！直到赤毒产量达标！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Continuity is fuelled by the Kuva. It's so very crucial-- oh why do I bother. Whippings will be increased until further notice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 延续秘仪全靠赤毒维持。它是那么重要——哦，我干嘛费嘴皮子解释。鞭打增加，直到进一步通知！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: We need more of the red stuff. If I could bleed it out of you I would! Get to work meat sacks, before I purge this entire work detail into space!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我们还要更多红色的东西。如果把你们切开就能淌出赤毒，我早就切了！快去干活，你们这些烂肉，别让我把这座工厂扔到太空里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I like to cook, are you surprised? I'm working on a few new recipes, appetizers mainly. Soups and the like. And you uglies are going to be the broth if you don't make enough Kuva for us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我喜欢烹饪，吃惊吗？我正在研究新菜谱，主要是开胃菜，比如汤之类的。如果你们弄不到足够的赤毒，你们这些蠢货就是我的肉汤！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: My dopey little Doompa Groompas! I love watching you work! Remember maggots - Kuva is the fuel of Continuity. So we have to keep working! You don't want to see me unhappy, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的小蠢货！我好喜欢看你们干活！记住了，虫子们——赤毒是延续秘仪的原料。所以，我们必须不断努力！你们肯定不想看到我不开心的样子，我说得没错吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Let's see, a few announcements: All dogs found taking more than their allotted breaks will be integrated into this evening's protein slurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 让我们看看，有几条新通知：所有小狗如果休息时间超过规定的话，将会全部用于今晚的蛋白浆原料！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Attention: there are only three valid reasons to cease working on the Kuva supply. One. A dreamer has arrived with a hideous metal puppet. You may pause your work to kill it. Two. You have died from exhaustion. Please remain dead until your body has been collected by food services. Three. Uh.. Three... I guess that only makes two reasons!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 注意：在赤毒工厂，只有以下三种情况可以停下工作。第一，有一个梦回者穿着恶心的金属傀儡来了，你们可以暂停工作去干掉它。第二，你们过劳死了，请不要乱动，等待工作人员回收尸体，用作食物供给。第三，呃……第三……算了，就两种情况吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Pardon the interruption. Due to difficult work conditions we've added a suggestion box to the distillery. To receive a suggestion on how to serve me better, simply open the box and stare directly into the plasma emitter. Workplace enlightenment will be yours! That is all, maggots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 请原谅我打扰一下。由于工作环境过于艰苦，我们在工厂新增了一个意见箱。如果你想要得到一个如何更好地侍奉我的意见，请打开意见箱，凝视里面的电浆发射器。工地的娱乐就是这么丰富多彩！完毕，虫子们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Recently, poor working conditions have been brought to my attention! I completely agree with you mangey filth-bags. Your work is very poor. Step it up or you'll be stepping into space!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 最近，我得知你们的工作环境条件很差！我完全同意你们这些肮脏的烂肉。你们的工作确实很差。要么加把劲，要么被扔到太空里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: The abysmal Kuva production was puzzling me until I realized: maybe it's the lack of positive reinforcement? No problem, maggots! We've reversed the battery packs in our reinforcement prods, effective immediately!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 赤毒的产量如此糟糕，实在是让我困惑不解。直到最近我才明白，或许是正面刺激太少了？没问题，蛆虫们！我们已经把补给舱的电池掉了个头，马上给你们刺激！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: It's the simple things in life I've come to cherish. A high protein meal. A shimmering vial of Kuva. A Warframe, bursting like a pustule, as its shot into space. Oh yum!!! Who's hungry?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我最珍惜生活中简单的东西。高蛋白的食物，闪闪发光的赤毒，战甲像脓包一样裂开，飞到太空里。多么美味！！！谁想尝尝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Hmmm! Let's see these new Kuva production charts! Oh. I see. On a completely unrelated note: all shift supervisors are to report immediately to food services. Time to see how your rations are made, from the inside!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 嗯！让我们看看新的赤毒产量表！哦，我知道了。说件完全无关的事情：所有值班的监工请立即到食品厂报到。你们可以参观一下你们的粮食是怎么生产的，内部消息！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Pardon the interruption but unfortunately we are declaring several redundancies today , across all departments. Say goodbye to: scheduled breaks, compensation and regular meals. We wish them all the best in their future endeavors!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 真是抱歉打扰大家了，然而不幸的是，我们在工厂内所有的部门都发现了大量的冗余。请大家向下列事项告别：休息时间，补偿金，还有三餐。祝这些东西一路走好吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: I am doing a great job! I am a valued member of this functional and productive Kuva team… Does this describe you? If so, I'd love to have some 'face-time' with you… just pull out the synergy pin of your service collar and count to four!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 我的工作真是太出色了！我所在的赤毒小队产量很高……以上描述符合你的情况吗？如果是，我很想面对面和你聊聊……没错，如果是，我很想面对面和你聊聊，然后把你的同步栓从项圈里拔出来，数到四！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: You lazy leeches! If I don't see drastic improvements in your work output I'll be forced to do some restructuring! How'd you like a spine for eyes?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 你们这些懒散的虫子！如果你们的绩效没有显著提升，我就只能把你们打回去改造了！不如用脊骨给你们当眼睛，你们觉得怎么样？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.text: Curious worker, K-9-7, writes: your majesty, what are some delicious ways to make protein slurry? Oh well, I'm so glad you took time out of your work detail to ask this! You've inspired a whole new line of meat pies! Gamey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TheWarWithin/D.zhText: 一位求知欲旺盛的工人 K-9-7写道：亲爱的陛下，怎么样才能做出好吃的蛋白浆？哦，好吧，我很高兴你用工作时间进行提问！你启发了我制作一套全新的肉饼配方！好臭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We wanted peace. The Anarchs chose death. Keep fighting, we have to finish the job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们想要和平，而自由派选择了死亡。继续战斗，我们必须完成这项任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Prime down. What a waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 已打倒 Prime 战甲。真是浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: It's done. I know that wasn't pleasant, but it was necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 事情办完了。我知道这并不愉快，但却是必要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They're hammering us hard. We need to strike back. There's a commandeered Prime in the area. Do what it takes to draw them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们正在猛攻我们。我们必须反击。附近有一名被控制的 Prime 战甲。不惜一切代价把他引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Commandeered Prime Warframes are the strongest weapons the Anarchs have. Fight fire with fire and draw one out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 被控制的 Prime 战甲是自由派最强大的武器。以牙还牙，引诱对方现身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ops has identified one of Galastra's commandeered Primes. Draw them out, and neutralize them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 行动小组已锁定一名加拉斯特控制的 Prime 战甲。将其引出并消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They're out. Put them out of their misery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他出现了。让他解脱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch Prime Warframe spotted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 发现自由派 Prime 战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Here it comes. Put them in the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 来了。把它埋进土里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You never cease to amaze me, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，你总是让我惊叹不已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The silence is beautiful. Now push forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 这种安静真美。现在，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Makvos down, and not a second too soon. Press the initiative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 马克沃斯炮倒下了，而且来得正是时候。要掌握主动权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Shoot cannon? Make big boom?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 射击大炮？制造巨大爆炸？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Cannon weak. Opportunity now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 大炮弱，机会来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Makvos cannon on brink. Job finish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 马克沃斯炮快撑不住了。任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Munitions exposed. Detonate now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 弹药已暴露。现在引爆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no opened munitions vent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no 打开了弹药通风口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Munitions vent exposed. Bad for Anarch, good for we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 弹药通风口暴露了。对自由派不利，对我们有利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs have captured a Makvos cannon and it's hitting us hard. Take it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派控制了一门马克沃斯炮，它正猛烈攻击我们。摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs captured a Makvos cannon and now it's shredding our rear echelon. Silence that gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派控制了一门马克沃斯炮，现在它正在撕碎我们的后方部队。摧毁那门炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hear that Makvos cannon? We're all mincemeat unless you can take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 听到马克沃斯炮的声音了吗？要是你不能摧毁它，我们都会变成肉酱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Armor too strong. Find codes, talk to vents, expose munitions, boom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 装甲太厚。找到密码，和通风口说话，暴露弹药，轰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Find codemaster. Expose munitions. Explode munitions?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 找密码管理员。暴露弹药。引爆弹药？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Expose munitions with codes? Which Anarch is codemaster?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 用密码暴露弹药？哪个自由派是密码管理员？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Valdur, the Ten-no captures a cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 瓦杜尔，Ten-no 夺取了一个储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Cache captured. Strong Ten-no friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 储藏箱已夺取。强大的 Ten-no 朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Supplies captured. Battle-kin to be much relieved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 物资已夺取。战斗同胞将大大松一口气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Capture cache, need stay close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 夺取储藏箱，需要离近点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Close get, to capture cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 靠近，以夺取储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs close, make gone, get cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派接近，让他们消失，夺取储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: That's the last of the caches. Got more orders for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 这是最后一个储藏箱了。你还有更多命令要执行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Caches captured. Marking your next target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 已夺取储藏箱。正在标记下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The only people who needed those supplies more than us were the Anarchs. They won't be happy. Let's pour salt in the wound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 唯一比我们更需要这些物资的只有自由派。他们肯定不会高兴。那就往他们伤口上撒盐吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs take the death-foods. Not good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派带走了死亡食物。这可不好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no! Cache for we, not for them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no！储藏箱是给我们用的，不是给他们用的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Too late, Ten-no. Enemy get that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，太迟了。敌人得手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch supply caches located. Get close and siphon them off for our side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 发现自由派的补给储藏箱。靠近并把物资转移到我们这边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs storing critical supplies nearby. Establish area control and siphon supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派在附近设了补给储藏箱。夺取区域控制权并转移物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Marking critical Anarch supply caches. Make them ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 正在标记关键的自由派补给储藏箱。把它们据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Transport is scrap. There will be no relief for the Anarchs today. Now make it count. Next objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 运输车已成废铁。今天自由派不会得到任何喘息之机。现在必须有所作为。下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You've cut off supply lines. Anarchs are hurting now. Seize this opportunity and push forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你们已经切断了补给线。自由派现在处境艰难。抓住这个机会，趁胜追击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Aww. What a shame. No dinner for the Dax Anarchs. Here's your new orders…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 哎呀，真可惜。自由派禁卫没晚饭吃了。这是给你的新命令……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Attention! Got an Anarch transport moving in. Do not let it reinforce the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 注意！有一辆自由派运输车正在接近。不要让它增援敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Transport incoming. Scrap it. No relief for the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 运输车来了。拆掉它。不能让敌人得到任何支援。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Transport full of weapons and ammo is enroute to enemy positions. Intercept and destroy. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 满载武器弹药的运输车正驶往敌方阵地。拦截并摧毁它。行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no! Repair pads! Destroy! Or transport never explode.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no！是维修点！赶紧毁掉！否则运输车永远不会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Repair pads. All over place. Must stop or else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 维修点。到处都是。必须摧毁它们，否则后果不堪设想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Target repair pads, Ten-no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，瞄准那些维修点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Dropships and their crews neutralized. But we're not out of the woods yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 空投艇及其机组人员已被消灭。但我们还没脱离险境。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They'll think before trying that maneuver again. Let's find a new way to punish these Anarchs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们下次再想用这招之前肯定会三思。我们得想个新办法来惩罚这些自由派。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Good luck replacing those. Use this opening, move forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 想补上那些可没那么容易。趁这个机会，向前推进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Alertness, Ten-no! Anarchs foot bound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，警觉！自由派到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Attackers released, trouble now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 攻击者放出，麻烦来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no, Anarchs fall from air like bloom-seeds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，自由派在空中飘落得像花朵种子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Reinforcements! Where in Sol's sky did they come from? Tenno… take them out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 援军来了！他们是哪儿蹦出来的？Tenno……干掉他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Dropships! Give those Sol-damned bastards hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 空投艇！给那些该死的混蛋们来点颜色看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: More coming! Take out assault squad! In the air or the ground. Doesn't matter to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 更多敌人来了！消灭突击队！空中的或地面的都行，对我来说无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Be alert, Ten-no, more come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 小心，Ten-no，更多人来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Watch! In blink Anarchs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 看！闪烁自由派。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Blink pads charge. More Anarchs come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 闪烁点正在充能。更多自由派来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Every time you grind those bastards into the mud and I feel a little twinge of pity, I remember what they did to my brothers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 每当你们把那些混蛋打得落花流水，而我心中涌起一丝怜悯时，我就会想起他们对我的兄弟们所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Boot's on the other foot now, isn't it, Galastra? Break off from this fight, Tenno. Your blade is needed elsewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 现在风水轮流转了，不是吗，加拉斯特？Tenno，退出这场战斗吧。还有别处需要你的利刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch pride was their death sentence. If only they had listened. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派的傲慢自大最终害了他们。要是他们当初听劝就好了。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: This is rout. Thin the Anarch ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 这就是溃败。削弱自由派的队伍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Now is the time. Punish the Anarchs and take out as many as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 现在正是时候。惩罚自由派，尽可能消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Make the Anarchs regret their disloyalty. Cut them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 让自由派为他们的背叛付出代价。把他们全部消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Turret up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 炮塔好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Gun active.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 枪支已激活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Free fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They've broken through. You need to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们已经突破了防线。你必须阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They're everywhere. Fight harder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 到处都是敌人。拼命打。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You're being overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你们被围攻了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You've repelled them. Now make them pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你已经击退了他们。现在让他们付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You've turned the tide. But you're not done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你已经扭转了局势，但你还没有完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Die in the dirt, anarch scum! Now's our chance…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派杂碎，死泥里去吧！现在是我们的机会了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs! We're under attack! Hold the line!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派！我们遭到攻击了！守住阵线！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They're storming our position. Hold the line!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们在猛攻我们的阵地。守住阵线！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: It's a raid! Shut it down! Repel the anarchs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 这是突袭！把它打下来！击退自由派！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We shed our blood for this land. We will not hand it over to the machines.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们曾为这片土地流血牺牲。我们绝不会将它拱手让给机器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: When peace means spitting on the bodies of our dead, then there can be no peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 如果和平意味着要唾弃我们亡者的尸身，那便再无和平可言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Did they tell you there was 'honor' in cutting down the bravest of the Dax?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们有没有告诉你，打倒最勇敢的禁卫也是一种"荣誉"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Oh, it's easy to be brave from inside your miraculous Warframes, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 哦，坐在你那神奇的战甲里，变得勇敢起来真容易，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You Tenno whelps have no idea how many of the Orokin support us in secret.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你们这些 Tenno 小崽子根本不知道有多少奥罗金人在暗中支持我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You're too stupid to realise the machines are playing you for fools.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你太蠢了，根本意识不到机器在耍你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The machines turned on you once. You're insane if you think they wouldn't do it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 机器曾经反过来攻击过你。如果你认为它们不会再次这样做，那你真是疯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Look at the faces of the Dax you slaughtered, Tenno. Maybe you'll recognize some former comrades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，看看你屠杀的那些禁卫的脸吧。或许你能认出一些以前的战友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You're fighting for your golden masters. We're fighting for a home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你们在为你们的黄金之主而战，我们为家园而战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: History will remember you as the twisted killers you were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 历史会记住你们这些变态杀人犯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Detector scrambled. Anarchs too many.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 探测器故障。自由派的人太多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Lose signal. Much interference, much Anarchs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 信号丢失。干扰严重，太多自由派。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Detector troubles. Offending Anarchs, remove.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 探测器出现故障。冒犯的自由派，清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ground scanners eliminated. We can maneuver in peace again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 地面扫描器已拆除。我们可以再次安心行动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Their intel systems have gone dark. Take the move forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们的情报系统已经瘫痪。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Well done. Those nosey bastards are about to get a nasty surprise. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 干得好。那些多管闲事的家伙马上就要倒霉了。动身吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: They've predicted our every move, and now we know why: ground scanners. Find them and scrap them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 他们预判了我们的一举一动，现在我们知道原因了：地面扫描器。找到它们，摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Find and destroy their ground scanners everywhere. Can't take a crap out here without some Dax Anarch taking pot shots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 把他们那些地面扫描器全找出来炸掉。在这儿连拉个屎都难，总有自由派禁卫来冷枪扫射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs have buried ground scanners everywhere. We're totally exposed until you dig them up and neutralize them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派在各处都埋设了地面扫描仪。你不把他们挖出来拆掉，我们就完全暴露在外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Mine field cleared. You saved lives today, Tenno. Keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 雷区已清除。Tenno，你今天拯救了很多人。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Mines neutralized. You got nerves of steel, Tenno. I'll give you that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 地雷已清除。Tenno，你真是胆识过人。这一点我得承认。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Dax used to deal with minefields by sending Grineer in. Disposable, you see. Next objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 以前禁卫处理雷区的方式是派 Grineer 士兵进去。你看，他们都是消耗品。下一个任务目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Mines! We're getting slaughtered on the advance. Destroy 'em, or if you're careful, hack 'em to neutralize the whole minefield more quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 地雷！我们在推进过程中伤亡惨重。摧毁它们，或者如果你够谨慎，可以入侵它们，更快地清除整个雷区。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Minefield just tore up an entire regiment. Get in close and hack 'em to neutralize the field quickly or just blow them up one by one. Don't matter to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 雷区把整个团都炸没了。要么近身砍杀，迅速清除雷区，要么逐个炸死。对我来说都一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: I've got an infirmary full of wounded thanks to this minefield. We're stuck until those mines are exploded or hacked. Understood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 因为这个雷区，我的医务室里挤满了伤员。在清除这些地雷或破解之前，我们寸步难行。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Enough! Let Ballas's nightmares face their own kind!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 够了！让 Ballas 的噩梦自食其果吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Those Warframes are all that make you special. See how you fare against one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你的与众不同都是因为这些战甲。看看你和它们对战会是什么结果！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Deploy a Warframe. A commandeered Prime or one of the insane ones, I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 部署一个战甲。无论是缴获的 Prime 战甲还是那些性能强悍的战甲，我都无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Would you care to face one of your former friends, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，你愿意面对你以前的朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Look what my Ascaris did to one of your Warframes. What happened to its Operator can happen to you, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 看看我的蛔虫对你的战甲做了什么。它的指挥官的遭遇，也可能发生在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You fawning fools think you're the only ones with Warframes. Allow me to educate you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你们这些谄媚的傻瓜以为只有你们才有战甲吗？让我来教育你们一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: I want fire, I want fury. Let a Warframe take the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我要烈焰，我要狂怒。让战甲驰骋战场吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: I've waited long enough. Let a Prime Warframe loose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我已经等得够久了。放出一台 Prime 战甲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Your Warframes cut down my comrades like cattle. See how it feels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你的战甲像屠宰牲畜一样屠杀我的战友。尝尝这种滋味吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The wise, kind Dactolysts were twisted into horrors. We owe it to them to remember what was done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 那些睿智善良的指节使被扭曲成了恐怖的怪物。我们有责任铭记他们所遭受的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The Dactolyst. A memory of how something pure was mercilessly tainted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 指节使。这是一段关于纯洁之物如何被无情玷污的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: I know what it is like to have your very mind deformed and broken. This Dactolyst stands for all its kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我知道精神被彻底扭曲和摧毁是什么滋味。这个指节使代表了其整个族群。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: On Perita you fought alongside the Sentients, but some were forced to be enemies. Relive those memories and reclaim them. After twelve minutes, memory becomes nightmare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 在佩里塔上，你曾与 Sentient 并肩作战，但有些人却被迫成为敌人。重温并找回那些记忆。十二分钟后，记忆将化作噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The buried past must be brought to light, and we have little time. Return to the days of the Perita Rebellion, when the Dax Anarchs turned former Sentient allies against you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 必须揭开被掩埋的过去，而我们时间紧迫。回到佩里塔叛乱时期，那时的自由派禁卫者挑拨离间，让昔日的 Sentient 盟友与你为敌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: I must send you back into a war you barely survived. Remember the battles you were forced to fight, however bitter the memory. Everything depends upon it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我必须把你送回那场你侥幸逃生的战争。记住那些你被迫参与的战斗，无论那段记忆多么痛苦。一切都取决于此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: In recovering these memories you have restored dignity to the dead and protected your past from corruption. Excellent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你找回了这些记忆，恢复了逝者的尊严，也保护了你的过去免遭玷污。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: It is vital to remember the war as it truly was. You have done admirably, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 记住战争的真实面貌至关重要。Tenno，你做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: All our people were betrayed in the Old War. The more we remember, the better our chance of a new peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 在远古之战中，我们所有民族都遭受了背叛。我们越铭记历史，就越有机会迎来新的和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You must confront the echo of The Hunhullus and what was done. There is no turning back now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你必须直面英魂统使的余波以及所发生的一切。现在已经没有回头路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You are out of time. The Hunhullus has found you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你时间不多了。英魂统使已经找到你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The dread of Tau takes shape. The Hunhullus is upon you. Your courage must not fail now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tau 的恐惧逐渐显现。英魂统使已降临。此时此刻，你绝不能失去勇气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The Indifference lurks where you dare not look - the hidden past. Relive your battles on Tau and banish the ghosts that haunt you. The Hunhullus awaits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 虚空无情之物潜伏在你不敢直视的地方——隐秘的过去。重温你在 Tau 上的战斗，驱逐萦绕心头的幽灵。英魂统使在等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Reclaim your memories from the Indifference. You have only twelve minutes to confront your past battles. After that… the truth must be faced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 从虚空无情之物的手上夺回你的记忆。你只有十二分钟时间直面过去的战斗。之后……你必须面对真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Tenno, defy the Indifference and awaken your memories of the Perita Rebellion. You have only 12 minutes before the memory of the Hunhullus itself will arise to drag you under.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，对抗虚空无情之物，唤醒你关于佩里塔叛乱的记忆。你只有 12 分钟的时间，否则英魂统使的记忆将会浮现，将你拖入深渊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Your past is once again your own. Bravely done, Tenno. Rest now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你的过去再次属于你自己了。勇敢地完成了任务，Tenno。好好休息吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You have won back your memories from the Void's corruption. Chaos has lost this battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你从虚空的腐蚀中夺回了记忆。混沌输掉了这场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You fought with honor, then and now. Well done, my child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你当时战斗得非常英勇，现在也是如此。干得好，我的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You have reached the nightmares below the surface. You must remember how you were forced to fight commandeered Prime Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你已经触及了表层记忆之下的噩梦。你必须记住，你曾被迫与被劫持的 Prime 战甲战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: When the Prime Vanguard attacked, it felt like betrayal. You must go through that agony again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 当先锋队发动攻击时，那种感觉就像是背叛。你必须再次经历那种痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The Anarchs were cruel, turning loyal friends into maddened enemies. Lay their tormented ghosts to rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派残忍至极，将忠诚的朋友变成了疯狂的敌人。让他们饱受折磨的亡灵得以安息吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Your memories were erased out of mercy, but if they are not recovered the Indifference will corrupt them. Descend into the hell that was the Perita Rebellion, and remember how even Warframes were turned against you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 因为怜悯，你的记忆被抹去，但若不加以恢复，虚空无情之物终将会腐蚀它们。深入佩里塔叛乱的炼狱，铭记就连战甲也曾背叛过你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Teshin began the recovery of your past. Now you must go further, no matter the cost. Remembering will be dangerous, but forgetting risks the loss of everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Teshin 已经开始了你过往的追寻。现在，你必须继续前进，不惜一切代价。回忆固然危险，但遗忘却会让你失去一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Dive deep, Tenno. Remember the peace that was sabotaged by greed and pride. Relive the tragedy you were forced to endure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，潜入记忆深处吧。记住那被贪婪和傲慢破坏的和平。重温你被迫承受的悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Even with Prime Warframes turned upon you, you were victorious. Honor these memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 即使面对 Prime 战甲的围攻，你最终还是取得了胜利。请铭记这些胜利的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Well done, Tenno. Remember the fallen. Gather strength for the battles to come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，干得好。铭记那些牺牲的人。积蓄力量，迎接未来的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The Indifference lies. It wants you to doubt yourself. But you have triumphed today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 虚空无情之物会说谎。它想让你怀疑自己。但今天你已经胜利了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Targeting array scrapped. Our troops are already on the move. Your work's not done though, get in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 制导阵列已毁。我方部队已开始行动。但你们的任务还没完成，立即就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Array dismantled. They're shooting blind. Push forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 阵列已拆除。他们现在就像盲人摸象。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Goodbye Anarch targeting array.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 再见了，自由派制导阵列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Progress stops. New access codes needed. You find?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 进度停止。需要新的访问代码。你找到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Node control interrupted. Must find new Anarch codes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 节点控制中断。必须寻找新的自由派代码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Stalled. New code needed. Find please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 停滞了。需要新的代码。请寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Node scrambled. Guns quiet. Make scrap now? Find new codes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 节点加密。枪声停。现在该制造废料了吗？寻找新的代码。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Corruption complete. Anarch targeting impossible now. Use authorization? Make permanent?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 腐败已成定局。自由派无法锁定。使用授权代码？一劳永逸？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Node is useless, for now. Time to initiate meltdown protocol?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 节点已经没用了。启动熔断协议吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Node collapsed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 节点已毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Rapid disassembly successful. Again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 快速拆解成功。再来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Node smashed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 节点已砸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We're pinned down. Anarch guns are hammering our rear echelon. Corrupt their targeting array, and then scrap the nodes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们被困在这里了。自由派的枪炮正在猛烈攻击我们的后方部队。先破坏他们的目标制导阵列，然后摧毁节点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Got an Anarch targeting array lining up shots for their big guns. Your job: disable, then destroy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派的制导阵列正在为他们的主力武器瞄准。你的任务：先使其失效，然后摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We can't mass assault troops because of Anarch pinpoint strikes. Need you to take out their targeting array and give our guys a fighting chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 由于自由派的精准打击，我们无法发动大规模突击。需要你摧毁他们的制导阵列，给我们的部队争取一个反击的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin safe. Hive-kin thank Ten-no. Tenno back to orders now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 安全了。同胞感谢 Ten-no。Tenno 现在返回执行命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Tenno friend saves hive-kin friend. Valdur has new orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno 朋友救了同胞朋友。瓦杜尔发来了新的指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Friend needed for fight. Ten-no help all hive-kin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 需要朋友一起战斗。Ten-no 帮助所有同胞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Kin breathes hive-life. Lives to fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族呼吸着蜂巢之息，活着就是为了战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Energy is life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 能量即生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Stay close to hive-kin, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，离同胞近点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Take seed-core to kin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 把种子核心带给同胞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Energy is aid. Bring to hive-kin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 能量即援助。带给同胞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hurry, Tenno! Hive-kin needs energy-core for live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 快点，Tenno！同胞需要能量核心才能生存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin in trouble. Needs help. Needs Energy Core. You help, Adis knows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同胞有困难，需要帮助，需要能量核心。阿迪斯知道，你帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no must help hive-kin. Anarchs attack, energy low. You must save.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no 必须帮助同胞。自由派攻击，能量不足。你必须救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Valdur! Adis need Ten-no! Hive-kin under attack. Anarchs drain energy. Death near. Help kin now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 瓦杜尔！阿迪斯需要 Ten-no！同胞正遭受攻击。自由派吸取能量。死亡临近。立即帮助同胞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Battery assembled. Transmitter hungry for power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 电池组装完毕。发射器耗电量很大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no made battery. Power transmitter now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no 做好电池。现在给发射器充能？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Battery crude, but work still. Put in transmitter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 电池简陋，但还能用。装到发射器里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch gear! Could battery make?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派装备！能制造电池吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch weapons outfit include cathode and anode. Battery make?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派武器套装带着阴极和阳极。做电池？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Adis detect cathode and anode parts on Anarchs. Ten-no use!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 阿迪斯检测到自由派上的阴极和阳极部件。Ten-no 用！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Data-transfer initiated. Well look at this, Tenno. Got new orders for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 数据传输已启动。Tenno，瞧瞧这个。有新的命令给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We have uplink! This changes everything. Get to the next rendezvous point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们上行链路已建立！这改变了一切。前往下一个会合点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Boom. Uplink successful. Can't let this data go to waste, marking next objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 成功！上行链路传输成功。不能让这些数据白白浪费，正在标记下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We've captured their tight-beam transmitter, and troves of intel with it. Seize battery parts from the enemy, and juice that thing to the max to send the signal back to HQ.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们缴获了他们的窄波束发射器，还有大量情报。从敌人那里夺取电池部件，把那玩意儿的功率调到最大，把信号传回总部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch tight-beam transmitter is under our control. Get it powered and we'll send their secrets right back to HQ.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派的窄波束发射器已在我们的控制之下。给它通电，我们就能把他们的秘密直接送回总部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Got critical intel loaded onto a tight-beam transmitter but it's gone dark. Find a way to power it to max.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 关键情报已加载到窄波束发射器上，但它突然没信号了。想办法把它的功率拉到最大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We're half way there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们已经完成了一半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Fifty-percent power, do not stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 已经到五成功率，现在不要停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We are so close, get more power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们离目标很近了，获取更多能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: That shuttle is ours and so is its cargo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 那艘穿梭机是我们的，上面的货物也是我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: The shuttle is safe. Flight logs indicate Anarch targets near your location. Get moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 穿梭机安全。飞行记录显示，自由派正瞄准你们附近。赶紧离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We've got the shuttle and its cargo. Ready for another fight?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们已经控制住了穿梭机及其货物。准备好迎接下一场战斗了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs airborne. Please protect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派正在空中。请保护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Damage mounting. Stop Anarchs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 损失不断增加。阻止自由派。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no, ship taking damage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，运输机受损了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Systems online. Engines start slow. Keep safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 系统已启动。发动机启动缓慢。注意安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Control got! Ten-no protect?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 控制权到手了！Ten-no 保护？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Adis is pilot now. Engines warming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 阿迪斯现在是飞行员。引擎正在预热。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Your objective is an Anarch shuttle. Hack in an uplink and Adis can fly it home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 你的目标是一艘自由派穿梭机。入侵上行链路，阿迪斯就能把它开回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Supply shuttles up ahead, chock full of key resources. Install an uplink and keep it safe until Adis can get it airborne remotely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 前方有补给运输机，满载关键物资。安装上行链路并保证其安全，直到阿迪斯远程操控其升空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Command needs a functional Anarch shuttle. Why? None of our Sol-damned business. We just need to get one into Orokin territory in one piece.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 指挥部需要一艘能正常运作的自由派穿梭机。为什么？这不关我们的事。我们只需要把它完好无损地送进奥罗金领地就行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: We need those Brach's badly. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们急需那些狂战使。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Glad we still have those Brachs on our side. Good job, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 很高兴我们这边还有那些狂战使在。Tenno，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin lives to fight!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同胞生来就是为了战斗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin, you are free. Follow Ten-no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族，你们自由了。跟着 Ten-no。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin. Fast move. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族。快走。走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Get those Brachs out here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 救那些狂战使出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Don't let a scratch get on those Brachs, we need them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 务必确保狂战使毫发无损，我们需要他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Got a squad of Brachs destined for core override. We can't afford that. Find them and break them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 有一群狂战使即将被送去核心覆写。我们承担不起这个后果。找到他们，把他们救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarch bastards have captured some of our Brachiolyst comrades. Need you to set 'em free before they give 'em a core override.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派的混蛋们抓住了我们的一些狂战使同伴。在那些人覆写他们的核心之前，你需要把他们救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no! Hive-kin stolen. Save before hive-kin cores changed to Anarch mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no！同胞被偷走了。赶紧去救，免得同族核心被转化为自由派的思维。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin in trouble. Must stop captor. Return kin to hive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族遇险了。必须阻止绑架者。将同族送回蜂巢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Scout just gave us critical intel but we've got to move fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 侦察兵刚刚给了我们关键情报，但我们必须迅速行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Thanks to Sol you got that scout back safe. We've got exactly what we need to make our next move, go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 谢天谢地，你把那个侦察兵安全带回来了。我们下一次行动需要的情报都有了，出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Sentient scout is safe and recovering. You, on the other hand, need to get back out into the field. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Sentient 侦察兵安全且在恢复中。而你，则需要重返战场。去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no, help needed. Hive-kin taken. Bring home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no，需要帮助。同族被抓了。带回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs stole hive-kin. Put in cage. Tenno do right thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派偷走了同胞。把他们关进笼子里。Tenno 做正确的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs have captured a Sentient scout. Get him out of there before they can convert him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派俘虏了一名 Sentient 侦察兵。快把他救出去，免得他们把他转化成敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: One of our scouts just got captured. I don't need to tell you what the anarchs are capable of. Get them out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们的一名侦察兵被俘了。不用我说你也知道那些自由派会做出什么事来。赶紧把他们救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin! Follow Ten-no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族！跟着 Ten-no。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Hive-kin go clear! Ten-no is friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 同族快撤！Ten-no 是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Ten-no make hive-kin safe for certain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no 会确保同族的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: All turrets firing, and not a moment too soon. I've got my work for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 所有炮塔都在开火，时机正好。我这边也有任务要交给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: You're a life-line Tenno. Hope you got another miracle in you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Tenno，你是我的救命稻草。希望你还能创造另一个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Those turrets are back in fighting shape. No time to rest, you're needed elsewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 那些炮塔已经恢复战斗力了。没时间休息，你还有别的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Turret hungry. Need reload.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 炮塔弹药不足，需要重新装填。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Turret need ammo immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 炮塔急需弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Will Ten-no give turret ammunition?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: Ten-no 会提供炮塔弹药吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Turrets running low. Ammo air-drops incoming. Keep the area clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 炮塔弹药即将耗尽。空投弹药即将到来。保持该区域畅通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Got air-drops inbound to resupply those turrets. Establish a permitter and keep those Sol-damned Anarchs out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 空投补给快到了，是给那些炮塔补充弹药的。马上建立防线，把那些该死的自由派挡在外面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Our turrets desperately need resupply. Ammo air-drop enroute. Keep the drop zone clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 我们的炮塔急需补给。弹药空投正在途中。保持空投区域畅通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: One more comes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 又来了一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Last drop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 最后的空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Just one more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 还有一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Anarchs block drop. Must remove.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 自由派会拦截空投。必须除掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: No drop until Anarch out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 除掉自由派之后才能有空投。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.text: Drop zone too hot. Clear you must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/TwelveMinWar/D.zhText: 空投区温度过高，你必须清理干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: How do. Need a shooter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 喂。需要枪么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: What you see is what I got. Shooters, mods, all untraceable 'cos they're all stolen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我所有的货你都看到了。枪，模组，都没了定位追踪功能，因为它们都是偷来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Passing this stuff onto you was the previous owner's dyin' wish. I assume. Any stains are purely decorative.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我猜，把这个东西传给你是它前任主人的遗愿。上面的所有血渍都纯属装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Guns, shooters, instruments of extreme violence. I don't do those things no more - promised me dear Mum I was done with all that. Facilitatin' on the other hand…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 枪支、枪炮，极端暴力的工具。我早就不碰这些了——我向我亲爱的老妈保证过我再也不碰这些东西了。不过只是帮你搞点好货的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno always welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 永远欢迎 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Good luck against Archon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 祝你顺利打败执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl got your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 有卡尔在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔会一直在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Good working with Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 和 Tenno 合作愉快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: How do. Handle's Chipper. Kahl says you're a good sort. Bloke's dim as a 2-watt bulb but you don't kill as many people as he has without learning a little somethin' about human nature. So: guns, bits and pieces. I also do mods. Did all me own, actually. Stuff goin' into debt when a fella's got a perfectly good workshop and a handsaw lyin' around. Neighbors did not like the screamin', not one bit let me tell you. Tell ya how I got me head off sometime. There's a story. Anyway, what can I get ya for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 喂。叫我切片哥。卡尔说你不是坏人。傻大个脑子简单跟二极管一样，但杀了那么多人，他也算的上了解人性。所以吧：枪，配件，边边角角。我也做模组。我身上的就是自己做的，其实。有这间完整的工作台和手锯，便不用欠债了。隔壁的可不喜欢我那时的尖叫，一点也不喜欢。找天再跟你说，我是怎么把自己的脑袋锯掉的。说来话长。好了，你要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Can only give ya what I got in stock. Me stock level depends on how well ol' Kahl and his imaginary girlfriend do on his little outings. Good week lotsa stock. Lotsa stock ya more likely to get what ya need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 只能有什么给什么。我的存货储备量取决于咱们的老卡和他假想女朋友在他的小郊游中的表现。小郊游收获多存货储备量就多。储备量够多你就更有可能得到你需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Mmhmm. Kahl ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嗯。卡尔准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. 'Bout time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哼。差不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Moving out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 出动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl itchy. Itchy to kill Narmer skoom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔手痒。痒到想杀死合一众杂碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl find Narmer worms. Kahl stomp Narmer worms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩找到合一众蠕虫。卡尔踩扁合一众蠕虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl ready to deploy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔准备出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔有事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl say we got veils to break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩说我们要破除面障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Good day today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 今天是个好日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Air smell... good. Clean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 空气质量……不错。很清新。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ah, brother, you finish chores?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 啊，兄弟，杂事办完了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: When Blue Girl calls, be ready, Brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 兄弟，当蓝女孩呼叫的时候，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Brother... clean up food. Or Kuaka come mess up everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 兄弟……把食物清理掉。不然库阿卡会跑来捣乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl go fishing! Not catch dinner. New boot though!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔去钓鱼！没弄到晚餐。但有新靴子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Narmer say Pazuul want to make new forest? Then Pazuul kill all people? Leave only animals? People animals too. Pazuul no make sense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 合一众说帕祖想制造森林？然后帕祖杀了所有人？只留下动物？人也是动物。帕祖没道理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Vay Hek try to kill forest but grow new brothers. Pazuul want grow new forest but kill brothers. Kahl just want to live in forest with brothers. Why that so hard?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 韦·海克试图毁掉森林，却培养新兄弟。帕祖想要造出森林，却杀死兄弟们。卡尔只是想和兄弟们一起住在森林里。怎么就这么难？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Grineer design? Wait. Did you make that weapon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Grineer 工艺？等等。这武器你做的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Used to be EMP ram. Kahl change.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 以前是电磁脉冲装置。卡尔改装了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: This won't kill any Narmer. The frequencies are all wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这玩意杀不了合一众。频率全是错的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: This 'Veilbreaker'. Not supposed to kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这个"破障者"。不是用来杀人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You really aren't like other Grineer, are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 看来你真的和其他 Grineer 不一样，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: How many Grineer Blue Girl know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩还知道有多少 Grineer？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Hey, matey. Boo! Ah you're a good sort aren't ya. Expected ya ta stick a knife in Kahl's back before long, but ya never did. Had me eye on ya, woulda hated killin' a good customer. Nah, reckon we're cut from the same cloth. We're real mates aren't we, yeah. Real mates. Don't ever forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嘿，哥们儿。嘣！你可真是个好人呐。我还以为你很快就会朝卡尔的后背捅上一刀，但你从来没这么做过。之前我一直盯着你，伤害你这样一个好顾客我可于心不忍。不，估计我们是同一种人。咱是真正的好哥们儿，必须的。好哥们儿。永远别忘了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Matey! Matey mate mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哥们儿！我的好哥们儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: See that bruiser over there? Reckon he's a plant. Best take him out, knees first I reckon. Safe side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 看见那边那个彪形大汉了吗？我猜他是个卧底。最好把他做掉，一箭射在他的膝盖上。预防万一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ever listen to that Nora bird on the wireless? On and on about the how's and why's? Why's it like this, why's it like that? Why? Why? Tell ya why, darlin'. Bad luck. Wrong place wrong time that's all she wrote.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 在无线电波里听过那只诺拉的叽叽喳喳吧？不停的在问怎么了，为什么？为什么这样、为什么那样？为什么？为什么？宝贝，我来告诉你为什么。倒了霉。错误的地点错误的时间，就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Corpus. Bloody Corpus. Namby pamby starched shirts. Like insultin' a bloke like me they do. Paid more than a few a visit in me time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Corpus。该死的 Corpus。一帮恃强凌弱的衣冠禽兽。他们光会侮辱我这样的人。来来回回观察我好几次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Miss me scars I do. Gunshot, vibroblade, icepick one in the lung one in the shoulder, plasma cutter to the knee, timing wire across the neck. Good little conversation starters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我很珍视我身上的伤疤。这处是炮弹炸的、这处是弧刃刀割的、肺部和肩膀处的是冰锥凿的，等离子切割机砍在了膝盖上，脖子上是被定时线勒的。这些都是打开话题的好开头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I remember the first fella pulled a gun on me. Told 'im I'd take it off 'im and stick it up his arse. So he shot me. Bit of a lesson there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我记得第一个用枪指着我的家伙。我跟他说我会把枪夺过来，然后把它插进他屁股里。于是他向我开枪。我算是长教训了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: See anything you like the look of?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 找到你喜欢的东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: People comin' an' goin', thinkin' they know what makes me tick. They don't know what makes me tick. Spend time alone with me an' a workshop maybe you'll learn what makes me tick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 人们来来往往，他们自以为了解我的作风。他们根本不知道。跟我在工作台相处一会儿，也许你就琢磨出了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Yeah. Glad to have me rough days behind me. In retrospect. Was good at it. But blood? Never did like the sight a blood. No thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 是啊。真高兴苦日子熬出头了。回首往事。还挺擅长那时候做的事。但要说血腥？我从来不喜欢见血。不，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: People think this war's gonna end. This war's not gonna end! Na-ah! To win a war, right, ya gotta want somethin' more than the other bloke AND ya gotta be okay with never livin' ta see it. Pfeh. These types too soft in my book. Lack commitment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 人们以为这场战争会结束。这场战争才不会结束！不会！想打赢一场仗，听好，你要比别人更渴求一些东西，而且，你还要接受无法活到那一刻。呸。这些人在我看来软弱至极。缺乏信仰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Round 'ere just watch for the odd low-flyin' knife and you'll be right. Sometimes I push back, give 'em a little touch up, "go on, get a bit a that inta ya". Give 'em a good hidin'. These Grineer got rocks in their 'eads, they don't like it but that's whatcha get, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 在这周围，你只需要注意那把偶尔低飞掠过的飞刀，就准没问题了。有时我会故意延迟，给他们一点信号，"继续，让你们稍微上头"。和他们捉捉迷藏。这帮 Grineer 脑子笨的像石头，他们不喜欢但又能怎么样，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Bafflin' that I make a livin' doin' this. They got a gun you got a gun, they got a knife you got a knife. So ya shoot and stab each other. Ridiculous. Still, if we didn't have guns an' knives I guess we'd just, I dunno, be hittin' each other with rocks. Human desire for rectification, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 费解的是我居然以此为生。他们有枪，你也有枪，他们有刀，你也有刀。所以你们互相射击、刺伤。荒唐至极。不过，如果我们没有枪和刀，我想我们也会伤害彼此，我不知道，估计会用石头打对方。人类对整治的渴望，不用多说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Howzit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Matey. What's on ya mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哥们儿。想什么呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Matey. No rubbish here, checked it all meself, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哥们儿。这里没有垃圾，我自己检查过了，对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: How'd I get the name? Let's just say... it's nothin' ta do with me sunny disposition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我怎么叫这个名字？咱只能说……这可跟我的阳光人设无关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Every firearm verified primo. Quite a rude shot meself, nothin' here I wouldn't trust me life to, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 每支枪械都做过顶级检验。我自己就是一把好手。这里每件武器都能保命，是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: How do matey. Whaddya think a the look a these? Go on! Pick it up, try it out! You'll be tickled pink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 喂，哥们儿。想看看这些吗？来吧！捡起来试试看！包你手痒痒的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Why am I here? Ah, y'know. Lack of oversight primarily. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我为什么来这里？啊，你知道的。主要是这里无人监管。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: C'mon, matey. Get over here, c'mon. Show ya what all the fuss is about. Ha ha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 过来，哥们儿。来这里，过来。告诉你这里在闹腾什么。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Grineer, eh? Look at the size of that mucker. Oof. I was in a dark alley I would not like the look of that. So, what can I do ya for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Grineer，嗯？看看那个混蛋的块头。呃。我要在一条黑暗的小巷里我可不想碰到。那么，你需要我为你做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Everyone wants to know why a Solaris is way out here... fraternizin' with Grineer. Didn't amputate all me parts for untraceables just to spill me guts to space kids, now did I? Stickybeak. So you want somethin' or what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 让人纳闷的是一个索拉里斯联盟的人为什么会出现在这里……竟与 Grineer 走得这么近。把自己的身体截肢并替换成了无法定位追踪的部件，最后还要白白跟太空的孩子们掏心掏肺，是吧？八卦精。你究竟想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Wasn't always in this line a work, no, ya little stickybeak. Just a, uh, let's say... a humble 'sanitary engineer'. Heh. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 也没有一直做这个活，并没有，你这个小八卦精。只是一个，呃，怎么说...... 一个低微的"环卫工程师"。呵呵，是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Most a these jokers just want somethin' that goes bang on one end and boom where they point it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 大多数这些小丑们只想要些一端"邦"的一声，一端向他们指的方向"砰"的一声的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Know what I like about the Grineer? They don't ask questions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 知道我最喜欢 Grineer 什么吗？他们从不问问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: C'mon over, matey. No need to be scared of ol' Chipper. C'mon. C'mon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 来吧，哥们儿。不用害怕老切。来吧。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: These pieces are all straight doers. Nothin' arty farty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这些都是实打实的真家伙。没什么花里胡哨的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Me guns are as good as me word and nobody question's Chipper's word. Nobody with a brain in their 'ead, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我的枪和我的话一样算数，没人质疑切片哥说的话。有脑子的人都不会，反正。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You don't get inta my line a work without collectin' a few death marks. That Corpus nonce over there asked me if I ever get scared. 'Get scared'? Mate, I sawed me own head off. If someone's gonna scare me they're gonna have do a lot worse than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 如果你还没被人追杀，那你跟我就不是一路人。有次那个 Corpus 傻缺问我我是否害怕过。"害怕"？兄弟，我可是把自己脑袋都锯掉了。要是有人想吓倒我，他们要做得比我更出格才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: The love a my life was a custom-gripped retooled Boar loaded with solid shells. Got me inta a lot a trouble that one did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我今生挚爱是一把通体改装加固的定制版野猪霰弹枪。它可给我闯了不少祸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Na-ah. I'm not mad. Just bad. To quote me late mum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没，我没有生气。用我妈妈的话说，只是感觉不好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Spose it was lucky, Kahl findin' me like that. Typically when I get lucky it ends with me shootin' me way outta town.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 说起来还真是幸运，卡尔能这样找到我。一般情况下，如果我运气好的话，我最后还得用枪一路杀出城外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Survival 101, sunshine. Beg for mercy, do somethin' weird… then shoot 'em in the head. Take advantage a the ol' processing lag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 朋友，生存课第一课。跪地求饶，耍耍滑稽...... 然后一枪射爆他们的头。利用好大脑处理信息需要的时间滞后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Don't mind ol' Horrek. Knew a few milk-drinkers just like 'im in the box. Those I shared a rack with, and their fellow imbeciles, thought of 'em as easy marks. But fellas like Horrek… ya get a lot more from 'em if ya just let 'em be. Better conversation too, and no mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 别介意老霍瑞克。认识几个和我一样乳臭未干的小子。和我睡过同一间床舱的人，以及他们的低能儿朋友，自以为他们好欺负。但是霍瑞克这样的老家伙...... 你最好随着他们点儿，反而可以从他们那儿得到的更多。聊的也更开心，而且不会惹事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Knew a bloke inside doin' five years for indolence. Always readin' the Corpus Tenets, any Granum material the guards would give 'im. I asked 'im: why? He just looked at me: 'Know your enemy'. What'd he do? Got out, got a job in the Corpus vault, murdered the entire branch with a pen. Hilarious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 认识一个因为偷懒服了五年刑的家伙。一直在翻阅 Corpus 的信条守则，和看守给他的格拉努资料。我问他：为什么？他只是盯着我："了解你的敌人"。他做了什么？出狱，在 Corpus 金库找了份工作，用一支钢笔谋杀了整个分行。笑死我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Did me time in Corpus isolation tanks, yeah, and lots of it. They just kept addin' weeks to me sentence. Not cos I earned it. Nah. Cos none a the Corpus screws wanted to be the one to open the door when I was done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我在 Corpus 的隔离罐中服过刑，是的，而且服了很久。他们只是不停地增加我的刑期。都不是因为我又犯了事。不。因为这些 Corpus 螺丝钉一个都不想在我刑满后打开我的门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Spent a lotta time in no-horse towns but this place takes the cake. Y'know, the kinda ratbag settlements so empty ya could fire a plasma cannon down their one street and not hit a soul. But if ya did you'd be doin' em a favor. Ha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 在名不见经传的小镇呆过，但这地方可是首屈一指。你知道，像那种鸟不拉屎，你可以在他们的大街上发射等离子炮都打不中一个人的地方。不过如果你这么做，你可就便宜他们了。哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl need to choose. Ugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔得选择。呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ah. In Grineer army Kahl only get one uniform. This is better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 啊。在 Grineer 军队中，卡尔只有一套制服。这个更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: What Kahl wear today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔今天穿什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ah. Kahl look good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 啊。卡尔看起来不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. Not too shabby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 呵。不会太寒酸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. Wait 'til Blue Girl see Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 呵。蓝女孩就等着看到卡尔吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text:
Vay Hek say Ostron Kahl enemy. But Ostron not enemy.

Queens say Tenno is monster. But Tenno not monster.

They lie. Narmer is enemy. Pazuul is monster.

And Vay Hek. Vay Hek scared of Pazuul. Queens hide in fortress. Cowards.

And Tenno? Tenno not coward. Tenno not hide. Tenno fight Archons. Tenno give home. To brothers.

Tenno is friend. Tenno... is brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText:
韦·海克说 Ostron 是卡尔的敌人。但 Ostron 不是敌人。

女皇们说 Tenno 是怪物。但 Tenno 不是怪物。

他们撒谎。合一众才是敌人。帕祖是怪物。

还有韦·海克。韦·海克害怕帕祖。女皇们躲在要塞。胆小鬼。

而 Tenno？Tenno 不是胆小鬼。Tenno 没躲。Tenno 打执刑官。Tenno 给兄弟们。带来了家。

Tenno 是朋友。Tenno……是兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: That Grineer lass is a strange one. Many times have I seen her... paddling. Splashing. Singing about fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那个 Grineer 姑娘是个奇怪的人。我很多次看到她……划桨、拍水花、歌颂鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka seems nice. I told her that we were taught the Grineer hated people like me. She told me I was right. See? Grineer helping Corpus. Who'd have thought? This place is great.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡看起来人不错。我告诉她，我们被教导 Grineer 讨厌我这样的人。她告诉我，我说的没错。看？Grineer 在帮助 Corpus。谁又会想到？这个地方真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I'm having all these feelings. I've never been allowed to have feelings. I think I'm having feelings about my feelings. And feelings about that. Wow. Being outside is a lot of work, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我有了所有这些情绪。我从来不被允许有情绪。我想我能感受到我的情绪了，以及对此的感慨。哇哦。呆在外面的世界真是艰难，对不对？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: We allll lift together...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我们共度时艰……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You don't see the animals going to war with each other. Nope. They all just get along. I wonder what they eat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你不会看到动物们互相争斗的。不会的。它们都相处融洽。我想知道它们吃什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Horrek, would you like help with...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 霍瑞克，你需要帮忙吗……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: NO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Okay then!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那好吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: First Jarka had the Queens in her head. Then Jarka had the Worms in her head. Then Kahl free Jarka. Now... nothing in Jarka's head but Jarka. Echo echo echo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡的脑子里先是有女皇们。然后加尔卡的脑子里有蠕虫。再然后卡尔救了加尔卡。现在……加尔卡的脑子里只有加尔卡。重复重复重复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka is lining up all her bad thoughts. She is putting a big sun above them so she can see them clearly. Then Jarka get her lovely Vulkar. Then shoot them one by one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡正在整理她所有的坏想法。她在它们上方放了一个大太阳，这样她就可以清楚得看到它们。然后加尔卡拿起她那可爱的金工火神。将它们一个一个射下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka is sleepy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡困了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka stood in her high watchtower and looked out into the night. And somewhere in the night the walking thing called out in a great big voice all lonely and sad. And Jarka wanted so much to call back to it and say hello, Jarka hears you, she is here too. She is lonely too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡站在她那高高的瞭望塔上，眺望着夜色。夜里的某个地方，那只行走的东西用洪亮的声音呼喊，显得孤独而悲伤。加尔卡非常想回应它然后打个招呼，加尔卡听到你了，她也在这里。她也孤独。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno. Tenno in the camp. Jarka has eyes on them. Tracking. Nobody engage. It will probably go away if we all pretend we have not seen it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno。营地中的 Tenno。加尔卡盯着他们。追踪。没有人打架。如果我们都假装看不见他们，他们可能会走开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Okay. Does everyone see the Tenno? Listen. Jarka has dealt with them before. Wait until it starts mining. Or fishing. Then attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 好吧。有人看到 Tenno 了吗？听着。加尔卡以前和他们打过交道。等他们开始挖矿。或者开始钓鱼。就开始攻击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kela de Thaym said Jarka's marksmanship was 'adequate'! The Kela de Thaym!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Kela de Thaym 说加尔卡的枪法"够用"！那个 Kela de Thaym！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka gets confused sometimes. She forgets this war is over now. She shot Kahl. But Kahl says it is okay. Jarka can stay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡有时会犯迷糊。她忘记了这场战争已经结束了。她向卡尔开枪。但卡尔说没关系。加尔卡可以留下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Horrek! Stew ready soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 霍瑞克！炖菜快做好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Chipper is funny. Sometimes Jarka gets two wrenches and plays Skeg drums on his head! The Queens! They must never know Jarka likes Skeg.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 切片哥很有趣。有时候加尔卡会用两个扳手在他的头上打管道乐鼓！女皇们！可不能让她们知道加尔卡喜欢管道乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Jarka wants to go back to the lake and float upside down like a fishy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 加尔卡想回到湖里，像一条鱼一样倒着浮在水里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: The Corpus boy is easy target. Very slow and very stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那个 Corpus 男孩是个活靶子。非常慢也非常蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Hey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 喂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Or is he? Perhaps it is all Jarka's clever trap. Perhaps anything that comes for the Corpus boy will DIE! Safer just to walk away, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 但他真的是这样吗？这可能都是因为加尔卡机智。也许任何接近 Corpus 男孩的人都会死！不参与会更安全，没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Many animal on Plains. Condroc and Kuaka, and Kavat. Used to shoot because they got in way. Now Horrek leave food out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 平野上有很多动物。秃鹰和库阿卡，还有库娃。以前因为挡路就杀它们。现在霍瑞克会把食物留在外面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I think it's... good... that you're helping out the local wildlife.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我觉得……挺好的……你们在帮助当地的野生动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Maybe Kahl tame some. Bring home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 也许卡尔会驯服一些。带回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Okay, Kahl, get comfortable. Because I need to tell you all about my brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 好吧，卡尔，放轻松。因为我得告诉你关于我哥哥的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue girl! Hai-Luk bring package! Kahl got fish you send from Deimos!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩！海露送来包裹！卡尔收到了你从火卫二送来的鱼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Did you like your Cryptosuctus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你喜欢那条墓沼隐龙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Oh, it very ugly. Kahl love it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哦，它好丑。卡尔喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Sometimes things have to become ugly to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 有时候长得丑一点才能活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl? Come in. Are you awake?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔？回答我。你醒了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl One Seven Five on-station.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔一七五 就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I had a terrible dream. Horrid. Guess you get those alla time...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我做了个可怕的梦。好烦啊。估计你老做这种梦吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Grineer never dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Grineer 从不做梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Hmm? Never? Even when you're floating... inna little tubes...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哈？从不？连你漂浮在……那些小小的试管中的时候……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You sleep. Kahl keep watch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你去睡。卡尔继续看守。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl. Camp need supply of Thrax Toxin in case Plague Star fall here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩，营地需要瑟拉斯毒素补给，以防瘟疫之星落到这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You need what in case of what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你需要什么来以防什么？
