/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Plague Star. Big ball of Infested. Make everything Infested all over. Stink bad!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 瘟疫之星。Infested 大球。感染得到处都是。臭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Well, for your information? Kahl? Grineer smell like a bag of armpits. In the sun. In a toilet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那卡尔，你知道么，Grineer 闻起来就像是太阳底下，茅房里有一袋腋窝里面充满了狐臭的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. You can smell from all way over there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哈。你那么远都能闻到？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl, before you go. I... It has been very interesting for me, seeing how you... What I mean is...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔，在你离开之前。我……对我来说很有趣，看到你如何……我是说……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl and brothers not what Orokin lady expected. You respect Kahl and brothers. You look at own family differently. Feel lonely. Kahl have family and you have... Kahl not know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔和兄弟们不是奥罗金女士所预期的那样。你尊重卡尔和兄弟们。你以不同的眼光看待家庭。感到孤独。卡尔有家庭而你有……卡尔不知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: It okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I'm fairly sure this level of intuition was not included in your design specs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我很确定这种层次的直觉能力没有包含在你的设计规格中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl self-made man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔是自我造就的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl? Who is 'Nora'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩？"诺拉"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Nora Night? Nobody knows. Just another malcontent trying to move mountains. Which, these days, I find myself respecting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 诺拉·夜吗？没人知道。就是个不满现状的人试图移山倒海。然而，这个人做的这些事，我发现我最近还是挺佩服的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. She sound like she know Kahl, but Kahl never see her. Sound like angel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嚯。听起来好像她认识卡尔，但卡尔从没见过她。听着像天使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Never meet your heroes, Kahl. They always disappoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔，千万别和你认为是英雄的人见面。他们总会令人失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Hm. Maybe Blue Girl got wrong heroes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嗯。也许蓝女孩选错英雄了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl see pretty bug today. Body like blue metal. Wing like glass. Fly right down and sit on Kahl hand. Kahl look right into little bug eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔今天看到漂亮虫子。身体像蓝色金属。翅膀像玻璃。飞下来停在卡尔手上。卡尔就看着这只小虫子的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: And then what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Bug... sting Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 虫子……叮了卡尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Oh dear. Mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哦天。这是个错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl not kill it. Not bug fault. Kahl big, bug little. Next time bug know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔不杀它。不是虫子的错。卡尔大，虫子小。虫子下次就知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Well, that's another freed Brother safely arrived at Iron Wake. Cressa Tal sends her thanks and respect, blah blah blah. Why don't you two just join forces?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 好吧，又是一名获救兄弟安全抵达钢铁守望了。Cressa Tal 送上她的感谢和敬意，诸如此类。为什么你们两个不联手呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Steel Meridian too big. Worms see them coming. Kahl work better like this. Little group. Like Kubrow pack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 钢铁防线太强大。蠕虫们会发现他们。卡尔这样可以做得更好。小团体。就像一群库狛一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: So this is enough? This is as far as it ever needs to go? Just the camp, the brothers, and breaking veils?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 所以这样就够了吗？只要做到这种地步就好？就营地、兄弟们，和破除面障？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl got something more important to do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩有更重要的事做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Right now... no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 目前……没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl? Why do you keep those tag things?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔？你为啥还保留那些标签呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Those genestamps. Record how we made. Record how we die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那些基因标记。记录我们怎么产生。也记录我们怎么死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: To what purpose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 有啥目的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Hmm. Queens put genestamp in machine. Next time brothers come out better. Kahl remember Brothers his way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嗯。女皇们将基因标记放到机器。下一批的兄弟就变得更好。卡尔以他自己的方式记念兄弟们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue girl. You do science stuff. Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩。你是研究科学的。对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Xenobiology and xenobotany with a special focus in synergetic Void harmonics, yes. Disqualified from application to the Archimedean Collegium on a technicality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没错，专攻协同虚空谐频下的外空生物学和外空植物学。因为一个技术性细节被哲士学院拒之门外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl want be smarter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔想变得更聪明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I don't think that's something I can do, Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔，这件事我可能做不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl know you can. Kahl look forward to talk science together soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔知道你可以的。卡尔很期待早日可以一起讨论科学。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl new brother Sol-ar-is. That him there. Kahl find stuff, Chipper hand stuff out. Chipper tough like Grineer, but... not as smart. Chipper cut off own arms, legs head. Over there good place for Chipper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔的新兄弟索-拉-里-斯人。在那里就是他。卡尔找东西，切片哥把东西拿出来。切片哥像 Grineer 一样结实，但……没有我们聪明。切片哥砍掉了自己的胳膊、腿、头。那里是切片哥的宝地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: That was a pleasing enough distraction. And Mother appears to have forgotten about my misdemeanors in light of what my brother has been up to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 那还真是个令人愉快的干扰。鉴于我哥哥的所作所为，母亲似乎已经忘记了我的小过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl and brothers not slaves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔和兄弟们不是奴隶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: No Captains. No Queens. Look around. Just Kahl, and brothers. Today: just us. Tomorrow: much more. Kahl and brothers not slave clones. Not any more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没有上尉。没有女皇们。看看四周，只有卡尔和兄弟。今天：只有我们。明天：更多。卡尔和兄弟们不是奴隶克隆人。不再是了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: No. No I suppose you're not, are you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没错。我想你们不再是了，不是吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Emergency. Camp under attack. Worm Condrix sighted. Send assistance. Emergency!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 紧急情况。营地受到攻击。发现蠕虫谍影登陆舰。请派支援。紧急情况！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl? Kahl, what the f-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔？卡尔，搞什么卧槽——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Test done. Emergency channel work fine. Brothers, stand down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 测试完毕。紧急频道运作正常。兄弟们，解除戒备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: We are going to have words about this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你给我过来，咱们聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Camp strong... but can be stronger. Kahl and Blue Girl will free even more brothers. Strong boy brothers and smart girl brothers. Kahl and Blue Girl good team. Narmer scared. Blue Girl excited. Say day of reckoning be fun party. No be party. For brothers... new life.  For Narmer... end of world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 营地强大……但可以更强大。卡尔和蓝女孩会解救更多兄弟。坚强的男兄弟和聪明的女兄弟。卡尔和蓝女孩是好组合。合一众害怕。蓝女孩高兴。虽说算账的日子可真是场"有趣"的派对。这种派对不要再有了。对于兄弟们来说……是新生活。对于合一众来说……是世界末日。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I am glad the Corpus kid wants to make himself useful. But until he can gut and joint a Pobber without fainting, he is useful only as windbreak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我很欣慰 Corpus 的小子想让自己变得有用。但除非他能够在不晕倒的情况下给泡博开肠破肚然后再缝合起来，要不然他的用处也就跟防风墙差不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I will never forget the man who gave his life for us. The man whose sacrifice showed us the way. We honor his name. Veko.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我永远不会忘记为我们献出生命的那个人。他的牺牲为我们指明了道路。我们对他的名字——Veko，表示敬意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: So... most Solaris don't like what they do. Huh. Though Chipper did offer to take off my head so I could see if I liked it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 所以……大多数索拉里斯人不喜欢他们所做的事情。嗯。尽管切片哥确实提出过要摘下我的头，他说这样我就可以看看是否喜欢它了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Deep-fried Pobber sure takes some getting used to. Fortunately my suit's recyc system is still online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 油炸泡博当然需要一些时间来适应。幸运的是我防护服的循环系统还能用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I feel sick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我觉得恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I tried cooking. Horrek was very excited about it. How do I treat burns?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我试着做饭。霍瑞克对此非常兴奋。我该如何处理烧伤？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tell me more about your brothers. Each one is identical to the last, none of them long for this world. What possible benefit can they be to you? It's... so very odd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 给我讲讲你兄弟们的事呗。每一个都和上一个一模一样，都活不久。他们对你有什么好处？这……太奇怪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl part of brothers. Brothers part of Kahl. World want brothers dead. Kahl say no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔是兄弟们的一部分。兄弟们是卡尔的一部分。世界想要兄弟们死。卡尔说不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Clone rot undermined genetic conditioning. You developed death fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 克隆体腐烂破坏了基因枷锁。你学会了死亡恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text:
Kahl 'developed' eyes. Kahl know how you see brothers. How Captains and Queens see brothers. 'Honor'. 'Duty'. 'Glory'. Trick. All trick. Grineer die so Captains and Queens... even Orokin... do not.  

Kahl say to them: from now on do own dying. Brothers help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText:
卡尔"开"了眼。卡尔明白你是怎样看待兄弟的。上尉们和女皇们是怎样看待兄弟们。"荣誉"。"义务"。"赞颂"。是骗局。都是骗局。让 Grineer 送死，那么上尉们和女皇们……甚至奥罗金……就不用死。  

卡尔要对他们说：从现在起自个儿去死。兄弟们帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: No. You didn't develop death fear. Back in the day they would have called it dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 不，你没有学会死亡恐惧。以往他们会将这称为尊严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl. Kahl got question.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩。卡尔有个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Proceed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 说？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Chipper and Horrek and Kahl tell stories. You not here, but you still part of camp. So, Kahl say it your turn. What worst fight you ever been in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 切片哥、霍瑞克和卡尔讲故事。你不在这里，但你仍是营地的一份子。所以，卡尔说轮到你了。你打过最惨的是哪场战斗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Well... I... cut my father's arm off once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这个嘛……我……有次砍断了我父亲的手臂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Cooool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Camp still small, but we grow. Each day more brothers freed. Each day Kahl family grow stronger. Blue Girl family turn away Kahl. So Kahl grateful to Tenno. For new home. Mm. Brothers, too. Make Tenno proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 营地有点小，而我们人数在变多。每天都有解救更多的兄弟。卡尔家族每天都在壮大。蓝女孩的家人拒绝卡尔。所以卡尔感谢 Tenno。给了新家。嗯。兄弟们，也是。让 Tenno 感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Blue Girl. Narmer veil make brothers love Pazuul. Kahl know that. But Kahl not know why brothers still love Queens. Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩。合一众面障让兄弟们爱戴帕祖。卡尔知道。但卡尔不懂为什么兄弟们还爱戴着女皇们。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You can't change anyone, Kahl. Try and go mad. If you're lucky you can help those who want to change. Everyone else is a lost cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔，你无法改变任何人。这样做会让人发疯。如果你幸运的话，你也许可以帮到那些想要改变的人。而其余的人都是无望的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Does Blue Girl want change?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 蓝女孩有想要改变吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: What, exactly, are you suggesting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你，到底，想要表达什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text:
Fancy talk about rich old family. Empire. Orokin. But rich old Orokin family empire? Dust. This new world now. Kahl think Blue Girl want to be part of new world. That why she help Kahl make it.

Kahl want to... help... Blue Girl. If Blue Girl want help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText:
传统富裕世家、帝国、奥罗金的漂亮话。但是富裕古老的奥罗金家族帝国呢？化为灰尘。现在是新世界了。卡尔认为蓝女孩想要融入新世界。这就是她帮卡尔的原因。

卡尔也想……帮……蓝女孩。如果蓝女孩需要帮忙的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I... I have to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我……我先撤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: He likes to crunch the little bones. So we leave those in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 他喜欢嚼小骨头。所以我们把它们留在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Please. No eating out of helmets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 拜托，不要用头盔来盛东西吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: We drink Chimurr together. All brothers here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我们一起来喝赤穆茶。我们都是兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I had a bushel of good Vobi cheeses buried out on the Plains to ripen. Buuut... then the Sentients came and rearranged the Plains. Ah, my poor cheeses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 我本来有一蒲式耳的上好沃比芝士埋在平野上，等待成熟。不过……后来 Sentient 来了，把平野弄得天翻地覆。啊，我可怜的芝士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Some men have their destiny written in the stars. Other men drink Kubuchi until the stars dance, because their wife has locked the doors of their home, and they wake up to find three days have come and gone and they are naked but for a bucket and they are now the cook for a Grineer. The Unum alone knows all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 有些人的命运写在星星上。其他人喝库布奇酒喝到星星在眼前飞舞，因为他们的妻子锁上了家里的门。当他们醒过来后才发现已经过去三天了，要不是还有个桶他们就得光溜溜的，现在他们是 Grineer 的厨师。只有乌努母神知道一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: It is good just to sit, to rest, to breathe. Haven't we all bled enough?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这样多好啊，能坐下来，能休息，能呼吸。我们的血还没流够吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ach. Let Vay Hek rant as he will. Nobody here cares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 啊。随便韦·海克怎么嚷嚷吧。反正没人在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: If a man can only stay alive for long enough, there is no end to the wonders he may see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 如果一个人活得足够久，他可能看到的奇迹就没有尽头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Eat, eat. She gives, we live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 吃，吃。因她赐予，我们活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl! When is your blue girl going to send us more polyps? I want my world to undulate again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔！你的蓝女孩什么时候才会给我们送来更多息肉？我好希望我的脑海能再次翻腾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: She say you not allowed. She say 'He knows what he did.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 她对你说不。她说："他知道自己做了什么。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Little people are so strange. This insistence on surrounding yourself with strangers. I can't tell if it's a desire for approval or existential panic. Is this what mortality does to a person?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 凡人真是太奇怪了。这种让自己置身于陌生人周围的坚持。我不知道这是不是一种对认可的渴望或者是存在焦虑。难道这就是死亡对人的影响吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Brothers not strangers. Blue Girl not love her family?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 兄弟们不是陌生人。蓝女孩为什么不爱她的家人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You're funny. 'Love'. By the Void, you're serious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 你真有趣。"爱"。虚空在上，你是认真的吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl. Pick up. Kahl. Pick up this instant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔。快接。卡尔，立刻接起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl 1-7-5. Hear Blue Girl loud and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔 1-7-5。蓝女孩的声音很清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl. Did you really think that an Orokin matron like my Mother would allow a pack of filthy clones to set up camp on her estate? Did you not consider the kind of hell her knowledge of our association might bring down on my head?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔。你真的认为像我母亲这样的奥罗金主母会允许一群脏脏的克隆人在她的地盘里安营扎寨吗？你就没想过当她知道我们联手后可能会给我招来什么样的麻烦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Brothers need home. Kahl... Kahl find friend. Brothers and Kahl make home here instead. Kahl sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 兄弟们需要家。卡尔……卡尔找到朋友。兄弟们和卡尔在这里安家。卡尔对不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Not good enough, Kahl. Not. Good enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这不够。卡尔。不。够。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl. Are you sulking? Don't be a child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔。你是在生闷气吗？别那么幼稚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl not know 'sulk'. Kahl busy planning. Brothers need Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔不懂"生闷气"。卡尔在忙计划。兄弟们需要卡尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Yes well I'm bored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 嗯，是我无聊找茬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Not everyone get to be bored. Kahl 'filthy clone'. Built to kill. Built to die. Kahl want to not be slave, to free brothers, he need to plan. To work. Maybe die. You want clown? Find other Kahl. Orokin made plenty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 不是每个人都可以觉得无聊。"脏脏的克隆人"卡尔。被造来杀，被造来死。卡尔不想当奴隶，要解救兄弟们，他得计划。得工作。有可能会死。你想要小丑？找别的卡尔。奥罗金有制造很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl, how da...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔，你竟然……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Narmer take all. Kahl and brothers take all back. Kahl swear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 合一众夺走了一切。卡尔和兄弟们会把一切夺回来。卡尔发誓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno camp is best camp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno 营地是最好的营地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno... go fishing later?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno……晚点去钓鱼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Huh. Blue Girl say she live in flower. Heh. Blue Girl joke with Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 哈。蓝女孩说她住在花里。呵，蓝女孩和卡尔开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ah. This good place. Quiet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 啊。这地方好。安静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno! Good see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno！见到真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Nothing come here. No worm. No Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没有人来这里。没有蠕虫。没有 Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Kahl like little flying guy. Talk lots, though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 卡尔喜欢飞行的小家伙。虽然，很吵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Tenno... eat? We make Kuaka stew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: Tenno……吃吗？我们炖了库阿卡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Pretty much everything Kahl dropped off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 差不多所有东西都是卡尔留下的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Take what you need, give those Narmer idiots a bit of a touch up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 需要什么直接拿，给那帮合一众傻缺点颜色瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Nothin' fancy, but top shelf in my book.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 没什么出彩的地方，但我对它评价很高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: See anythin' ya like the look of?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 找到你喜欢的东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Stolen? Perish the thought. Spoils of war, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这叫偷？可不能这么想。挫伤士气啊，哥们儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Everythin' here does the job. Dead set.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 这里的一切都是管用的。天注定的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You havin' a go? Pick somethin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 有看上的吗？去挑些东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: I don't do special orders, princess. What you see is what you get.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 小公主，我不接私人订制。你看到有什么就只能拿什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: You right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 决定好了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: What. Ya want me to wrap it for ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 什么。难道你要我给你包起来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Now get ta work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 好嘞稍等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: There y'go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Suit y'self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 随你便。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Ya don't like what I got take it up with Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 如果你不喜欢我的商品，找卡尔去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Well la-di-dah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 随你便，装什么装。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: See ya later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 再会哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.text: No worries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerGar.zhText: 不碍事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Goodbye, Brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 永别了，兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You rest now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你现在安息吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Find peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 找到安息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl will remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔会牢记在心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Your fight is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你的战斗已结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: To dust now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 归回黄土。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ramn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 可恶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Nobody around but wrecks and a few Veilheads. Alright. Get in, find the parts Chipper wants, get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 周围没有别人，只有残骸和几个面障人。好吧。进去，找到切片哥要的零件，然后出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: This a Thumper station. Thumpers all dead?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这是一座重击者制造厂。重击者都死了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hmm? Probably. Sure. Some of your Grineer friends are locked up here. If you want to say hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯？可能吧。对了，你有些 Grineer 朋友被关在这里。如果你想和他们打招呼的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Okay. We do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 好的。我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Propaganda drone. Mother says only the feeble-brained fall for that rubbish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 宣传无人机。母亲说只有意志不坚定的人才会相信那垃圾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Have you tried pressing buttons at random until something happens?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你有试过随便按些按钮直到搞出些什么事情吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Deacon. Kahl sneak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 有执事。卡尔潜行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hah ha ha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 哈，哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: That was mean. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 够狠。做的好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: There's those Thumper things. All smashed. Looks like you Grineer boys put up quite the fight. Sorry I missed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 那堆东西就是重击者。全都碎了。看来你们 Grineer 男孩打得很激烈。可惜我错过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Still lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 还是输了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Oh well. Where are the parts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 哦那好吧。零件在哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Huh... Grineer? Maggot! Listen! Find. My. Sister! I give order!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 呵……Grineer？蛆虫！听着！找。我。姐姐！我现在命令你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! Where she, maggot? Find now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 呃……文克拉？文克拉！不！蛆虫，她在哪里？立刻去找！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ahhh! Trooper! My sister alive! On Murex. Find her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 啊啊啊！骑兵！我姐姐还活着！就在骨螺战舰上。找到她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! What they do? Sister... here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 呃……文克拉？文克拉！不！他们做了什么？姐姐……在吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl fight for brothers. Not Queens! But... Kahl break any Veil he find. So. Maybe Kahl find sister one day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔为兄弟们而战。不是女皇们！不过……卡尔一找到面障就打破。所以。也许有一天卡尔会找到姐姐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You want the parts, you better dive for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你想要零件的话，你最好潜下去找它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl not swim.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔不会游泳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Right. Of course you don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 当然。当然你不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl. You surprise me. Clever boy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔。你真让我惊喜。机智男孩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Rusty. Chipper won't like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 生锈了。切片哥不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Oh, well, by all means let's shop around for something better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 噢，行吧，不管怎样，我们去四处找找更好的东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: What about that one? The Thumper. Lots of weapons on that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 那个怎么样？那个重击者。那家伙身上有很多武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: This one dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这个死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: I'm sure they're all dead, Kahl. Look at this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，我敢肯定他们都死了。看看这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Dead. See?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 死了。瞧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Not really. Can we hurry this along?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 不见得。我们可以快点吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Cross that rope bridge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 穿过那座索桥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Worm Thumper!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 蠕虫重击者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Just making notes. I am learning so much from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 就做个笔记。我从你身上可真没少学东西啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hrm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Gun no good here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 枪在这里不好用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: There has to be something we can do. It's just a machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 肯定有办法的。它不过是台机器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl hurt it bad. Now Kahl finish job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔狠狠伤了它。现在卡尔终结任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, looks like there's some bigger firepower for you ahead. Can you carry th-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，前面看起来好像有更强的火力可以用。你能带上——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl can carry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔可以带。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, there are multiple Ramparts near your location. Heavy gun emplacements. I suggest you use them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，你附近有许多炮座壁垒。都是重型炮台。我建议你使用它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl learning soooo much from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔从你身上可真没少学东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Okay, I admit, I'm a little impressed. Go on then. Tell me. How did you do that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 好吧，我承认我是有一点点震惊啦。继续。告诉我，你是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Shoot in right place. And not die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 打对位置。然后不要死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: All aboard. Keep your heads and biceps inside the windows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 全部乘客。请勿将头和手伸出窗外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Need break Thumper open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 要把重击者打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Chipper want... lo-co-mo-tor core. That behind armor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 切片哥想要……移—动—引—擎—核心。那个在装甲背后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl never forget this smell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔永远忘不了这种气味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl. You almost died here. You don't have to do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔。你差点就死在这里。你不用做到这种地步的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Yes. Kahl do. Mark brothers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 要。卡尔要救。标记兄弟们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: There's another group of prisoners on the other end of the Murex. I've identified a dropship you could use to get to them, but... you remember what happened the last time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 在骨螺战舰的另一端还有另一群囚犯。我找到一艘空投艇，你可以用来去到他们那，但……你记得上次发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl survived and escaped with his brothers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔生存下来并和他的兄弟们一起逃出去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Something like that. Marking your destination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 类似那样。正在标记你的目的地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: There's the Bolkor. Held in place by Tether Nodes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这里有艘博寇。由束缚节点固定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl need to stop doing that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔要停下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Get your Brothers, Kahl. I'll arrange your extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，找到你的兄弟们。我会给你安排撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, Grineer signal ahead, but... abnormal. It's as if he was connected to a Sentient mind before Narmer...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，前面有 Grineer 信号，但它是……异常的。就像是他在合一众之前就已经和 Sentient 的意识连接上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl heard of this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔听说过这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Reading massive trauma, amalgam rejection, chemical hypersaturation... *how* is it still *alive?*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 读取到巨大的创伤、并合排斥、化学饱和……它是怎么活下来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Brother in pain. Kahl do what Kahl must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 兄弟很痛苦。卡尔做必须要做的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, you can't save them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，你没办法把他们都救下来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl save. But not from Narmer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔要救。但不是从合一众手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ven'kra! Fight!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 文克拉！战斗吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You not worm puppet! You SISTER! My sister!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你不是蠕虫的傀儡！你是姐姐！我的姐姐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Remember jungle? Crush shiny bugs? Wake up wake up wake UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 还记得丛林吗？粉碎闪亮的虫子？醒醒、快醒醒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ven-kra Tel! Ven-kra Tel! We are strongest! We are best! Why you not SING?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 文克拉·泰尔！文克拉·泰尔！我们是最强的！我们是最棒的！你为什么不"唱"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You save her, Kahl. Queens forgive. Make you Kuva Lich even.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，你救了她。女皇们会原谅。甚至让你当赤毒玄骸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Enough. I'm myself again. Kahl... I can make it from here. Should the Queens send us after you... we'll let you know first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 不要再说了。我变回我自己了。卡尔……接下来就交给我吧。如果女皇们派我们来追击你……我们会第一时间通知你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl-175. The legend, in the flesh. And he's just a regular tubeman. If you're waiting for me to thank you, forget it. Sprag and I could be executed just for talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔-175。传奇本人。他只是个普通的克隆人。如果你在等我感谢你，那就算了。斯普拉和我可能会因为和你说话而被处决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: The humiliation. Tempted by Worms. Veiled. And now, freed by a mere trooper! Oh, little Sprag. Of course this was your doing. I should have known you'd never abandon me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 真是屈辱。被蠕虫诱惑。带上了面障。而现在，却被区区一个小兵解救！哦，小斯普拉。当然这是你的功劳。我早该知道你永远不会抛弃我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Huh... these portals closely resemble the sphincter muscles of a mammal's lower intestinal tract. You're going through this ship like a big old... ahem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯……这些入口和哺乳动物下肠道的括约肌很像。你路过这艘船就像是颗又大又干的……呃哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Now is time for joke?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 现在是开玩笑的时候？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Nope. Sorry. Not at all. You're busy. I'll let you focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 不是。抱歉。完全不是。你在忙。我让你专心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl. Extraction is ready, get your brothers to the hangar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔。撤离点准备好了，将你的兄弟们带到停机库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: This where Narmer make Veils for brothers. Kahl say blow it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这是合一众制作面障害兄弟们的地方。卡尔觉得炸了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Better. We can rig these Veils to overload and short out every other Veil in range! Whole Narmer cells liberated at a stroke! Ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 有更好的方法。我们可以操纵这些面障，使它们过载，然后让范围内的所有面障短路！一下子解放整个合一众监狱！准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl came out tube ready. Still say blow up better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔走出试管时就准备好了。还是觉得炸掉比较好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ugh. Energy barriers. Kahl, find a way to disable them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 呃。能量屏障。卡尔，想办法解除它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, that console seems promising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，那个控制台看起来有戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hm. Kahl, sweetie? See that big magnalocked door up ahead? You need to get on the other side. Could you be a darling and find a way to disable all those locks?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯。卡尔？亲爱的？看到前面那扇巨大的磁力门锁了吗？你需要到另一边。你能当一次小可爱，找到解开所有门锁的方法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, I'm impressed. How did you figure that out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，我佩服你。你是怎么想到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Point and click.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 点就完事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Can't figure it out? The security console seems promising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 想不到方法吗？那个安保控制台看起来会管用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl need other view.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔需要其他视角。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Detecting a veiled Solaris worker. Kahl, try your new contraption! 20 credits says it rips his head off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 检测到一个戴着面障的索拉里斯工人。卡尔，试试你的新玩意！赌 20 块，它会把他的头给扯掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl got this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔可以的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Ahhhhhhh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Yaaaay 20 credits!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 耶 20 块！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: …YYYYYYYaaaaGHHH what the ALL bloody AS hell ONE you playin' at?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: ……呀啊啊啊该死的你在玩什么花样？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Go wait by ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 去飞船那里等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You. With the face like a robber's dog. That thing on your wrist's a muckin' threat, ya weapon. Gimme ten minutes with it and ya less likely ta deglove someone's head with it! Ah me face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 喂，脸长得像狗啃的。你手上的那个东西是个危险品，他妈的就是个杀伤性武器。给我十分钟修理它，省着你又让别人的脸脱一层皮！啊我的脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: One down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 搞定一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: That's another down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 搞定另一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Just one more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 还剩一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: You're done - time to go through, Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你办到了——卡尔，是时候过去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Sneak, sneak, sneak. Smart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 潜行，潜行，潜行。聪明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Inside. Now what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 进来了。现在怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: The fun part. Find the production controls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 好玩的部分来了。找到生产控制单元。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: And here's where the evil's made. Now the tricky part: Kahl, I need you to rekey the boot sequence. Do that and I'll have a split second during reboot to inject my sabotage instructions. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这就是恶魔的制造地。棘手的部分来了：卡尔，我需要你重新输入启动序列。这样做的话，我可以在重启期间的一瞬间注入我的破坏指令。赶紧的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl not understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔不懂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Look around, do you see anything that could tell you the key sequence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 看看周围，你有没有看到任何可以告诉你启动序列的东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Well done, Kahl. Now to make some noise. They have to think this is a raid. That way they won't suspect tinkering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，好样的。现在去制造点噪音。得让他们觉得这只是一场突袭。这样他们就不会怀疑面障被动过手脚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Marking weapons locker. You're gonna need a gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 正在标记武器箱。你需要一把枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl! Deacons are hunting you. But your tinkering just got me access to this facility's automatic plasma torch! It'll melt anything, including Deacons. Grab a target marker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔！执事们在追捕你。不过你的破坏面障行动刚好让我得到了这个设施的自动等离子炬的权限！它会融掉所有东西，包括执事们。去拿一个目标锁定器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Great. Now you just show me where to shoot. I'll try not to singe your eyelashes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 很好。现在你只需要给我指出要射击的地方。我会尽量不烧着你的睫毛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hah. You burn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 哈。烧死你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Deacon skoom CAN die!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 执事杂碎终于去死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Deacon skoom!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 执事杂碎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Blue Girl shoot good!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 蓝女孩射得准！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Got them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 干掉他们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: I love this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 我喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: I really felt that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 我真的有感觉到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Umm... Kahl? Something... big is coming your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯……卡尔？有个……大家伙正朝你过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl can handle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔可以应付。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Weak machine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 弱机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: That's it. They don't suspect a thing. They think they've just chased off a smuggler looking for a quick find. Manipulating people isn't fun when it's this easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 就是这样。他们压根就没起疑心。他们以为刚刚赶走的是个想赚快钱的走私犯。操纵人这么容易的话就不好玩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Good boom, Brother!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 炸得好！兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Brother did good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 做得好！兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 做的好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: This make big boom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 这个会弄出大爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Old gun good. This gun better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 老枪好。这枪更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl get upgrade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔得到升级。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl always want one of these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔一直想要一个这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: New gun. Kahl like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 新枪。卡尔喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hmm… don't see any control systems… but there is a shock mine… it might have enough juice to disable the gate. Maybe one of your brothers can arm it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯……没看到任何控制系统……但那有个震爆地雷……它的威力没准可以破坏这个门。也许你的一个兄弟可以装备它？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl. Scope's picking up one of your, uh, 'girl brothers'. I'm not sure what she's carrying, but I would NOT let her hit you with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔。发现一名你的，呃，「女兄弟」。我不确定她带着什么东西，但我绝不会让她用那东西打到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl… she's completely shielded by her cloaked drones. Those shock mines might reveal them, you'd have to use yourself as bait… but you would not catch me doing that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔… 她的隐形无人机完全保护住了她。那些震爆地雷可能会让它们显形，你只能用自己做诱饵… 但你别指望我会那样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: See her drones? Take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 看到她的无人机了吗？干掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Now's your chance, hit the drones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 你的机会来了，击落那些无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Those shock mines could be useful, get one of your brothers to arm it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 那些震爆地雷也许能派上用场，命令你的一个兄弟去装备它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Command one of your brothers to arm that shock mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 命令你的一个兄弟装备那个震爆地雷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Now's your chance Kahl, use your Veilsmasher thingy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 就趁现在卡尔，该你的面障粉碎者登场了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Hmmm… Detecting a sniper rifle in your area, looks like… Grineer special issue. Wonder how that ended up here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 嗯……检测到你所在区域有一把狙击步枪，看起来像……Grineer 的特制武器。我想知道这东西怎么会在这里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Kahl, you've got company. Grineer. She's… not like the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 卡尔，有人陪你了。 Grineer。她……不像其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: She's shielded by two cloaked drones. I'm targeting a dissipation field to reveal them, but I need your help to triangulate. Order your brothers to take up the marked positions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 她被两架隐形无人机保护着。我打算用一个消散场来让它们显形，但我需要你帮我定位。命令你的兄弟们占据标记的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: That's it... see the drones? Take aim!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 就是那样…… 看到无人机了吗？瞄准！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Gah… lost the signal… get back in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 靠……失去信号……回到位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: Can't get a lock. I need you or your squad in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 无法锁定。我需要你或你的小队待在位置中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.text: It worked?! Ven'kra's all yours. Sometimes I even surprise myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerMis.zhText: 起效了？！ 文克拉是你的了。有时候我真的会被自己惊艳到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I think ya just annoyed 'em, matey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 哥们儿，我觉得你刚刚惹到他们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I kinda suspect this may take a turn for the worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我有点怀疑这可能会往更糟的方向发展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Yeah, I think they're gonna make a day a this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 没错，我觉得他们一整天都会这样没完没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ya not likely to get mercy from someone who's never been shown it, now are ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 从未被怜悯过的人可不会给你怜悯，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: What they are not lacking… is tenacity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 他们最不缺的...... 是毅力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Scan's, uh, yeah… scan's about half-done, I reckon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 扫描，呃，是啊...... 扫描差不多到一半了，大概？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Stop sweatin', Margaret. Scan's doin' fine. I'm old enough and ugly enough to do two muckin' things at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 别慌了，公主殿下。扫描没事的。我这个油腻老男人是很擅长左右开弓的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I think she's just about good, matey. Scan's comin' along nicely. Just give it another minute I reckon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我觉得快好了，哥们儿。扫描进行的很好。再等一分钟就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: There ya go. One Archon. Coordinates n'all. Pretty. As a muckin' dinner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 搞定。一个执刑官。他的坐标什么的。可美了。像他妈的晚餐一般。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ah what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 啊这？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Well. Wouldja… look… at that…
Ugh, I do not like that. Not one bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 呃。我不喜欢那样。一点也不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Oi. Give us a hand. No hospitals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 喂。扶我起来。别送医院！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Agh. Not lookin' good for ol' Chipper, matey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 啊。哥们儿，老切情况不妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Agh. They got me. Give 'em credit, though, that was some nice speedwork.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 呃。他们伤到我了。不过，算他们厉害，那还真是些不错的速度训练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ugh… I've had worse… but this might be lights out for ol' Chipper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 呃……我经历过更糟糕的……不过这次老切可能要先走一步了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Oi! If I don't make it… bury me under… the ol'... Maprico… tree…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 喂！如果我没能活过来……把我埋在……那棵老……马利可……树下……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Come an' 'ave a go, ya muckin' imbecile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 有种来试试看啊，你这该死的白痴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ooh, someone needs some sense knocked into 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 噢，某些人脑抽得治。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ooh this fella's feelin' lucky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 噢，这家伙运气真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Lookit that tryhard wanker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 瞧瞧那个人菜又爱刚的傻缺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ya can try it, sunshine, but you will not like where it goes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 朋友，你可以试试，但你不会喜欢那后果的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Oh ho ho. Someone's bein' a smart arse. Try it on, ya little prick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 哦吼吼。有人真是个聪明蛋。试试看，你这个小混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Good time for a smoke break I reckon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 是时候抽口烟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Don't get sleepy, matey. In my experience that's when bodies start hittin' the floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 可别犯困，哥们儿。根据我的经验，那是身体快要落地的前兆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Listen. You smell somethin'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 听着。你闻着什么气味了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Mornin', sunshine! Got the short stick didja? Get a move on, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 朋友，早啊！抽到下下签了是吧？那赶紧的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Sent you did they? Righto. This'll be good for a laugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 他们让你来的？真行。笑死我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Yeah it's me. Y'know what they say: want a job done right kneecap every mucker between you and whatever 'right' is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 没错是我。你知道人们是怎么说的：要想把事情做正确，就要把横在你和"正确"之间的无赖都一一碾死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Howzagarn? HaHA! Lead on, matey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 最近怎么样？哈哈！你带路，哥们儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ugh. Feel a bit crook… but she'll be right. She'll be right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 呃。感觉有点反胃...... 但没事。没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ah, yer a good sort aren't ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 啊，你真是个好人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Nah nah nah. No worries no worries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 不不不。不用担心不用担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I don't hold a grudge. Once they're dead bygones are bygones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我不记仇。一旦他们死了，既往不咎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Ooh, messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 噢，一片狼藉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: There y'go. Have yaself a little learnin' moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 就是这样。你学着点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: One at a time me darlin's. One at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 一个一个来，亲爱的们。一个一个来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: C'mon fellas! This is gettin' boring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 放马过来吧小的们！这可越来越无聊了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Keep shootin' sweetheart. Who knows? Maybe you'll get lucky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 继续射击啊甜心。谁知道？也许你会走狗屎运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Yeah, better men than you have tried, ya wanker!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 耶，比你厉害的人多的是，傻缺！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I'd take a welder to ya but the gas makes me nose run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 给你尝尝焊接机的滋味，但是这些浓烟会让我流鼻涕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: More and more people are following Pazuul down his deluded path. We need to know what this one knows. They will not go willingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 越来越多的人跟随帕祖走上了迷途。我们需要了解这个人知道些什么。他们可不会束手就擒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Safely home. The target's awaiting unveiling. Let's hope they're grateful for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 平安回家。目标正在等待面障破除。希望他们可以心存感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul's faithful believe they can secure a place in sacred Tau if they massacre the unbelievers. We have no choice but to break them with force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖的忠实信徒深信，如果他们屠杀异教徒，就可以在神圣的 Tau 星系获得一席之地。我们别无选择，只能用武力阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: In blood and glory we ascend. In ecstasy we die. Can you say the same?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我们在鲜血与荣耀中飞升。在狂喜中逝去。你敢说出同样的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: All things... are ordained. I intended this. I planned it. Your murder. Our martyrdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 一切……早已注定。是我有意为之。也是我一手安排。你们的杀戮。即是我们的殉道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: You have done what needed to be done. Pazuul's delusion must end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 你已经完成了需要做的事情。帕祖的妄想必须终结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: The fastest way to locate Pazuul's Archons is to upload me to Narmer's systems. I shall be strong where he was not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 找到帕祖手下执刑官的最快方法是将我上传到合一众的系统中。我会在他薄弱的地方施展力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I have the Archon's trail. The hunt can begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我找到了执刑官的踪迹。狩猎可以开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Our target's been conditioned by Pazuul personally. Do what you can. Bring them home safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我们的目标被帕祖洗脑了。尽你所能，把他们安全带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: And the blindworm deemed the scream of the Condroc to be madness, for she could not see how far and free it soared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 无目的虫儿自认为秃鹰的叫声即是疯狂，只因她无法看到秃鹰高飞的自由和翱翔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Bite my head clean off, Mother! That's where the good meat is! Suck the guts until the little legs kick, kick, kick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 母亲，把我的头咬下来！那里肉质鲜美！吸干我的内脏，只剩下小腿乱蹦，蹦，蹦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Target is being debriefed. If any trace of Erra still remains inside Pazuul, I will bring it to the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 目标正在接受盘问。要是帕祖体内还残留着半点埃拉的意识，我就会把它逼出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Whatever Pazuul is building, it is consuming huge amounts of power and resources. Shut his facilities down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 无论帕祖建造的是什么，它都在消耗大量的能量和资源。关闭他的设施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Tau trembles within you just as it consumes me. Kill your pride and follow me, Natah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Tau 星系仍在你体内颤栗，就像它吞噬了我一样。弃下你的骄傲，跟随我，Natah。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: The 'Golden Makers' laid the System to waste! Hang your heads in shame, children of abomination! Filth-born! Chattels!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: "黄金之主"将星系弄的一团糟！你们应该垂下头感到耻辱，可憎的孩子们！污秽的出身！走狗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Objective achieved. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 目标完成。干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: 'Objective achieved. Well done.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: "目标完成。干得漂亮。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: We must understand Pazuul to understand his Narmer. You know these vaults. Get in. Find what you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我们必须先了解帕祖才能了解他的合一众。你知道这些金库的。进去。看看你能找到什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Oh Natah, I am no mere cypher to be cracked. Come to me in humility. Abase yourself. And you, even you, will understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 哦 Natah，我可不只是待破解的密文。谦卑地来拜访我。放下身段。那么你，即便是你，也会理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Tenno. I'm truly sorry. For everything. I saw the truth far too late. She will never forgive me. But you will, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Tenno。我真的很抱歉。对于一切。我太晚看清真相了。她永远不会原谅我。但你会的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Thank you. My brother is... unwell. I will... burn... the sickness out of him if I have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 谢谢你。我的弟弟...... 病了。我会...... 用燃烧...... 解决他的病因，如果必须的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: This gate only opens to Narmer prayers. Tear the Veils from Deacons and use those.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 这扇门只对合一众的祷告开放。扯下执事的面障并使用它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul has barred the way to us 'heathens', but stolen Deacon veils should allow you to deceive the barrier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖已经挡住了我们这些"异教徒"的路，不过偷来的的执事面障应该可以让你骗过屏障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Deacon veils are holy regalia in Pazuul's eyes. They will open this gate even if their bearer is dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 在帕祖的眼里执事的面障是神圣的象征。即使它们的佩戴者已经死了，它们还能用来打开这扇门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: The Deacon is invulnerable! Take down his flock first, then him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 执事正处于无敌状态！先拿下他的随从，再拿下他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Amar. Pazuul's assassin. Used to silence those who speak out against Narmer, much as Pazuul himself tries to stifle the voice of Erra within his mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 欺谋狼主。帕祖手下的刺客。受命让那些公开反对合一众的人永远闭嘴，正如帕祖也试图压制脑海中埃拉的声音一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Be on guard, Tenno. Archon Amar is stalking his prey. This is the grotesque truth behind Pazuul's gospel of a new Eden. Sentient beasts ruling over a docile human herd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Tenno，保持警惕。执刑官欺谋狼主正在追踪他的猎物。这就是帕祖所谓新伊甸园福音背后的丑恶真相。Sentient 野兽统治着一群温顺的人类。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Archon Amar yearns for the New Creation that Pazuul has promised him. He imagines he will be a lord of the wilderness instead of what he is now. The price of that vision is measured in innocent lives. Stop him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 执刑官欺谋狼主对帕祖向他承诺的新净土十分向往。他幻想自己有朝一日成为荒野之王，而不仅仅是如今这副模样。这种愿景的代价，需要用无辜的生命来衡量。去阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: The Wolf was a mentor to me long ago. From him I learned the wisdom of deception. Amar will prove a cunning opponent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 很久以前，这只狼是我的导师。从他身上我学到了欺瞒的智慧。欺谋狼主无疑会是个狡猾的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Despite his pride, Erra never could stand alone. Time after time he allowed himself to be used. First by our father, then by Ballas, and now what is left of him is puppeted by the Ram. I will not say he deserved better, but I grieve for who he could have been.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 尽管埃拉自命不凡，但他从未真正独立过。他一次又一次任由别人利用自己。先是我们的父亲，之后是拜勒斯，而现在他的残躯又成了被公羊操纵的傀儡。我不会说他理应有更好的下场，但一想到他本可以成为的模样，我就感到悲哀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: On Tau, the Wolf roamed without prey. He was created in the image of ancient records from old Earth, a naive tribute to ecosystems long extinct. Those savage jaws were never meant to bite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 在陶星系，狼没有猎物就到处游荡。他是按照地球的远古记录中的形象创造出来的，单纯是在致敬那早已灭绝的生态系统。他的獠牙利齿，原本并不是为了撕咬而生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Amar! He will close the distance shockingly fast. When he creates duplicates, look for the one that is armed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 欺谋狼主！他会以惊人的速度拉近距离。他创造出分身时，留意带武器的那个就是真身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Amar thought himself a hunter. Now he is a mere trophy. Good job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 欺谋狼主自以为是名猎手。如今，他不过是一件战利品。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Erra always dreamed of power. It is how he was shaped. But he is no leader, and his mistakes have left the Archon Boreal vulnerable. Take the Archon down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 埃拉一直渴望权力。他就是为此而被塑造的。但他并非领袖，他犯下的错让执刑官诡文枭主露出破绽。击败这名执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Archon Boreal serves only the Ram. He cares nothing for the twisted servant that carries him, the being I once called brother. Destroy Boreal and Erra's mind may become clear again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 执刑官诡文枭主只侍奉公羊。他根本不在乎那个承载公羊的扭曲仆从，那个我曾经称为兄长的存在。消灭诡文枭主，埃拉的意识或许还能再次清醒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Whatever Pazuul may preach, Boreal and his fellow Beasts are the ones destined to rule. Erra is merely a tool to them. We must strike where we can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 不论帕祖如何布道，诡文枭主和他的巨兽同伴才是注定要统治一切的存在。埃拉对他们来说只是工具。我们必须抓住机会出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Boreal is consumed by hatred. He blames both your people and ours for what was done to him. Pazuul provides him with easy targets for that vengeful spite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 诡文枭主被仇恨吞噬。他把自己遭受的一切都归咎于你们和我的族人。帕祖正好为他那满腔的复仇怒火提供了现成的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul promises his Narmer cultists a new creation. I do not know how much of that comes from the Ram's memories of Tau, and how much from Erra's dreams of a kingdom of his own to rule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖向他的信徒承诺要开创一片新净土。我不知道这其中有多少来自公羊对陶星系的记忆，又有多少来自埃拉想要统治一座自己王国的幻梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: On Tau, the Owl was solitary. He seemed to think himself above us and recognized the Ram alone as an equal. To be mutilated like this, turned into a weapon, was humiliating for him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 在陶星系，猫头鹰一直独来独往。他似乎认为自己凌驾于我们所有人，只承认公羊与他平起平坐。被如此残害、被改造成武器，对他来说是莫大的耻辱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Boreal is here. Strike fast, use cover, and do not let him heal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 诡文枭主在这里。快速出击，利用掩体，别让他恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Boreal is down. Narmer's spying eyes have been torn out. Excellent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 诡文枭主倒下了。合一众的窥探之眼被挖出来了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Nira. Could she somehow be responsible for what Erra has become? A repayment for what he did to her? The Serpent is old, Tenno, and full of secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 混沌蛇主。埃拉变成如今的模样，会不会与她有关？是为了报复他对她做过的事吗？Tenno，蛇主上了年纪，难以捉摸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: To rebuild Paradise, Pazuul's Narmer will destroy all those they consider 'makers'. Archon Nira will be at the forefront of the slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 为了重建天堂，帕祖的合一众会把他们认为是「造物者」的人都杀掉。执刑官混沌蛇主将站在屠杀的最前线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Who whispered dreams of dominion into Pazuul's ear? Who keeps Erra suppressed and tormented with delusions? The stench of Nira's venom is upon this, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 是谁在帕祖的耳边低语统治的梦想？是谁让埃拉被妄想压制和折磨？Tenno，这其中散发着混沌蛇主毒液的臭味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Nira devoured her brothers. I will not stand idly aside while she and Pazuul devour mine. Be my sword, Tenno. Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 混沌蛇主吞噬了她的兄弟。当她和帕祖企图吞噬我的兄弟时，我绝不会袖手旁观。Tenno，成为我的利剑，出鞘吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I do not know if Pazuul is truly the leader of the Archons or their puppet. Of all of them, only Nira has the guile to seduce Erra like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我不知道帕祖究竟是执刑官的首领，还是他们的傀儡。在他们之中，只有混沌蛇主诡计多端，有本事这样引诱埃拉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul preaches of Tau, where once the great beasts held dominion. But none have seen Tau in centuries, nor heard it speak. Nira and her kin were doubly abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖宣扬陶星系，那个曾由巨兽统治的地方。但几个世纪以来，没人见过陶星系，也没听过它发声。混沌蛇主和她的同族，被双重抛弃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: You found her. Stay on the move. Those eyes can kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 你找到了她。继续前进。她的那双眼睛会致命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: You dealt with Archon Nira expertly, Tenno. Her kind may expect no mercy. No redemption.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Tenno，你干净利落地解决了执刑官混沌蛇主。她的同类不值得任何怜悯，任何救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Keep the specialist alive. Their wideband scans should reveal Narmer's purpose in this sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 保障专家的安全。他们的宽频扫描应该能揭示合一众在这个星区的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: And what of your purpose, Natah? Were you sired only to be wet-nurse to these putrid apes? Which of us truly needs to save the other?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 那么你的目的是什么呢，Natah？你生来就是这些腐臭猿猴的奶妈么？我们当中谁才是需要被拯救的那一个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Above, the Lords of Tau. Below, my people. Below them, yours. And I shall serve as shepherd and minister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 在上，Tau 星系的领主们。之下，我的人。再之下，你的。那么我将担任好牧师和牧羊人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: The scans are complete, Tenno. Prepare for an assault on the Archon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Tenno，扫描完成。准备攻击执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Cruel sister! Harpy! Gorgon! Why do you PERSECUTE ME?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 残忍的姐姐！鹰身女妖！蛇发魔物！为什么要迫害我？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul has stowed sacred Narmer artifacts in Corpus Conduits. We need to ransack them. Little Duck will guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖将神圣的合一众神器存放在 Corpus 导管中。我们必须去它们夺过来。小鸭子会指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Blasphemy. Ignorance. Brute incomprehension.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 亵渎。无知。蛮不讲理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Narmer offers freedom. Is that so terrible? Freedom from desire and responsibility alike. Find freedom in surrender, as I did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 合一众保障自由。这难道是件坏事？从欲望和责任中解放出来的自由。如我一般，在投降后亦寻得自由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: We will examine this haul in detail. We will learn Narmer's secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我们会检验这个物品。我们会找到合一众的秘密的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Examine your own heart, Natah. Peel back its blackened layers and look deep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 检验你自己的内心，Natah。剥开它发黑的外衣，好好看看它深处的模样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul's project is consuming huge amounts of Cryotic. Extract it before Narmer can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖的工程正在消耗大量永冻晶矿。在合一众之前提取它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: You abandoned me. In the hour of my sacrifice you turned your face away. And so there is no place for you in the eternal fields of Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 你抛下了我。在我牺牲的最后时刻你背离而去。因此，Tau 星系的永恒旷野上将不复存在你的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Bones of my father, fathom-drowned, behold me. Carcass of my mother, flame-devoured, behold me. Limbs of my children, piecemeal, unblinking, behold me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 父亲的骸骨，波涛吞没，凝望于我。母亲的尸肉，火焰吞噬，瞩目于我。孩子的肢体，四散世间，应我期盼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Pazuul will need to look elsewhere for his Cryotic supplies. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 帕祖必须要去别的地方寻找他的永冻晶矿了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: This facility is a communications crossroads for Narmer. Listen in. I want to know what he's telling his flock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 这个设施是合一众的通讯枢纽。去监听他们。我想了解帕祖和他的随从在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Do you remember, Natah? That first day? How our father lifted you screaming from the manifold? How we sang?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 你还记得吗，Natah？那第一天？父亲是如何把在歧管中啼叫的你抱起来的？我们一同啼唱？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: And I beheld a great Ram, and the horns of him were crowned with Sol and with Tau. And upon his tongue the Zariman flame. And the mighty daemon of the Void cowered before him and he feared it not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 于是我看见了一只巨大公羊，两只犄角分别被太阳和 Tau 星系装扮。扎里曼的火焰在舌头酝酿。他无所畏惧，强大的虚空恶魔在他的面前蜷缩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: All messages decrypted. Pazuul is not merely insane, Tenno. There is another mind at work within him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 已破解所有信息。Tenno，帕祖不仅仅是疯了。他的内心里还有另一个意识在运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Just admit it, Natah. You're scared to face the possibility that I'm right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: Natah，承认吧。你害怕面对我有可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Kahl reports he has found the Archon's current location. Pazuul has no idea what we have achieved today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 卡尔汇报说他找到了执刑官现在的位置。帕祖还不知道我们今天有什么战果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Narmer have ordered an environment purge. You must endure. I will send what help I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 合一众已下令进行环境净化。你必须忍受。我会尽我所能提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: We can divide Pazuul's fractured mind against him. Draw attention with a raid, while our Grineer operative and his Entrati guide ransack Pazuul's archives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我们可以分裂帕祖的思想来对付他。当我们的 Grineer 特工和他的英择谛向导洗劫帕祖的档案时，用突袭来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: My father severed the worlds. Sundered the link we had forged with Tau, in the days of our enslavement. In the darkness beyond the Veil we waited. The lords of Tau were silent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 父亲斩断了彼此世界的联结。在我们被奴役的岁月里，与 Tau 星系辛苦缔造的连结也被分割瓦解。而暗夜之外，总有覆面障者为我们翘首盼之。世人岂知我 Tau 众神已沉寂多时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: Eat, little ones. Feast. Every cycle a harvest. Fill your bellies with the sun's rich blood. In Tau there will be no hunger. Eyes and teeth and tongues... all will be renewed. Devour me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 小家伙们，务必尽情吞噬。务必狼吞虎咽。处处皆可作饕餮盛宴。让你们的肚囊满载被滋养的太阳宝血。Tau 家园不会有饥荒。眼目、牙齿、喉舌……都会被更新。吞噬我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text:
The Mother and the Father shaped the creatures. The Owl. The Snake. The Wolf. And the Ram who ruled them all. 

It was glorious and the creatures were content. The Ram smiled among New Creation's blue glades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText:
母亲和父亲塑造了那些生灵。包括那猫头鹰。那蛇。那狼。还创造出了管制它们的公羊。 

公羊享受了万丈荣光，生灵们也心悦诚服。在新净土的生活是那公羊最惬意的日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I am the flail of judgment. I scour the sinful flesh from the bones, that I may restore you to life whole and perfect. None that are foul shall set foot upon holy Tau! The docile and the proud, the fawning and the mighty; we shall build, as it were, a... a pyramid of light... where the knucklebones tumble...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我是桎梏在审判之上的枷锁。我能荡涤罪孽之躯，还于你完满的生活。凡踏足 Tau 家园者绝无脏鄙之人。逆来顺受者与傲慢者不被欢迎、谄媚者与狂妄者拒之门外。正如从前那般，我们所要建立的，是一座……一座满载光明的金字塔……那是一个能如孩童般嬉戏的地方……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: This is the joyful Culmination. Honor and worship upon the prophet Ballas, who fell that Pazuul might rise. Narmer, I call upon you to build as the termites build. I call upon you to conjoin as the molecules conjoin. I call upon you to burn as the stars in their orbits burn, and mark the path we shall re-tread to the world that is to come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 这是满载欢歌的行动。尊敬而崇高的先知 Ballas 阁下，你的退幕换来帕祖的崛起。合一众信徒们，我号召你们如白蚁一般铸造家园。呼吁你们如分子聚合般团结。盼望你们如恒星在轨道上燃烧那样点燃自己，照亮我们将重新统治世界的未来之路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.text: I am Pazuul of Narmer. I abjure the Void that scalded my father's womb. I abjure the Golden Makers. I abjure the Kuva and the Kuria. I abjure the manikin and the eyeless. My doctrine shall be a devouring. Let Narmer draw unto herself all things. Veils to swallow the mind. Vessels to swallow the body. A mighty Maw to swallow all, and bear us to Tau as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerNar.zhText: 我乃合一众帕祖。我宣誓弃绝重伤我生身父亲的虚空。我宣誓弃绝黄金之主。我宣誓弃绝赤毒与库利亚。我宣誓弃绝懦弱与昏智之流。吞噬之说将为我信奉之教义。让合一众吞噬一切融为己身。面障之下皆无凡心。容器之下皆无凡身。如深渊巨口吞噬一切，引领我们去往共同的 Tau 家园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: I don't know how, but you need to find a way across.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 我不知道该怎么做，但你需要想个办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl... 180. Same tube.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔……180。同一批试管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Hellion pack. How hard could be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 恶徒背包。这能难到哪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: You got your gun, and I will guide you out of here, but first, I need you to tell me about Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 你拿到你的枪了，我会带你离开这里。但首先，我需要你告诉我有关于帕祖的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl find brothers. You help. Then talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔要找兄弟们。你帮忙。然后说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: "Brothers"? "Brothers" was not what we agreed to. You said "gun"! I got you your gun! Now tell me about Pazuul!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: "兄弟们"？我们之前说好的可不是"兄弟们"。你说的是"枪"！我就帮你拿到了枪！现在告诉我关于帕祖的事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Find brothers. Then talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 找到兄弟们。 然后说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl. This is Blue Girl. Did my friend get you all set up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔。我是蓝女孩。我的朋友把你们都安置好了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Tenno is friend. Kahl tell Blue Girl about Pazuul: Body is dead worm. Head like animal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: Tenno 是朋友。卡尔告诉蓝女孩有关帕祖的事情：身躯是死蠕虫。头像动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: 'Dead worm,' is that all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: "死蠕虫"，就这些吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: What more to know? Want kill Pazuul? Find brothers. Break veils. Kill Narmer. That what Kahl do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 还要知道什么？想要杀死帕祖？找到兄弟们。打破面障。杀死合一众。卡尔就是这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Fine. I'm in. We'll get more done working together. Face it, Vat Rat, you NEED me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 如果合一众制造面障，卡尔和蓝女孩就打破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: If Narmer make Veils, Kahl and Blue Girl break them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 如果合一众制造面障，卡尔和蓝女孩就把它们打破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Who help Grineer today? Not Queens. Not Vay Hek. Tenno and Blue Girl help brothers. Other Brothers still have Veil. So Kahl break. This camp little. But soon, it get big. You see. Kahl not afraid. And now Kahl not alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 今天谁帮助 Grineer？不是女皇们。也不是韦·海克。Tenno 和蓝女孩帮助兄弟们。其他兄弟仍然戴着面障。那么卡尔去打破。这个营地小。但很快，它会变大。你看。卡尔不害怕。现在卡尔不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: I can pilot this thing remotely but I need you to man the guns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 我能远程驾驶这家伙，但我需要你来操纵枪炮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: That Tether Node still has a grip on you. Take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 那个束缚节点现在缠住了你，不依不饶的，快把它打掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Shoot the Tether Nodes, Kahl!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔，对着那些束缚节点射击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Now find the other Brothers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 现在，找其他兄弟们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Make any more stops, and you risk everyone you already saved. And you still haven't told me about Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 哪怕再停下一站，你救的所有人都会有风险。而你还没告诉我关于帕祖的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Blue Girl have brother? Would she leave him to die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 蓝女孩有兄弟么？她会丢下他死吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Ugh... You're loyal; I'll give you that. Plotting a course to the second Narmer holding facility. Hold on tight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 呃……我得承认，你真的很忠厚；正在规划前往第二个合一众拘留设施的路线。抓紧了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Die, worm skoom!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 死吧，蠕虫杂碎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Hull integrity dropping!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 舰体完整性正在下降！
