/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Losing control! Kahl!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 正在失去控制！卡尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Brothers! Get out!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 兄弟们！快走！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: It over. Kahl tell you about Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 结束了。卡尔告诉你有关帕祖的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Not now, Kahl. I'll see if there's another way to get you and your brothers out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 现在不行，卡尔。我在想办法能让你和你的兄弟离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔知道怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Ugh. Perfect. The field your brother is locked in is entangled with complex restraints. Get close. I'll use your signal to target a dissipation beam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 呃。真棒。困住你兄弟的力场被一道复杂的光束所控制。靠近点。我会用你的信号来瞄准一道发散光束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: That's everyone. Can we go now? Dropship marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 全员到齐。我们可以离开了吗？已标记空投艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: You're coming up on the Bolkor... and - of course -  it's held in place by a Tether Node. I've devised an eight-step plan to evade security and gain access. Step one-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 你现在正在登上的是博寇……而且——理所应当——它由束缚节点固定。我一共制定了八个步骤来绕过安全系统并且获得访问权限。第一步——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: No time Blue Girl, Kahl do!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 没时间了，蓝女孩，让卡尔来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: For the Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 为了女皇们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: No. Queens abandon us. Fight for brothers now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 不。女皇们抛弃了我们。现在为兄弟们而战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: We go now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 我们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Brother, wake up. Killing time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 兄弟，醒醒。杀戮时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Time to fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 是时候战斗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Your brothers wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 你的兄弟们正等着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Follow Kahl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 跟着卡尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Time for revenge, Brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 是时候报仇了，兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Need to get in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 需要去到位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Blue Girl need Kahl in that spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 蓝女孩需要卡尔在那个位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl need to be in two places.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔需要待在两个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Must send Brother to other spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 要派兄弟去另一个位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Need to split up. Kahl go there, brother go there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 要分头行动。卡尔去那里，兄弟去那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: So... about Pazuul? Maybe you should just tell me everything now, just in case this gets dangerous?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 那么……说说帕祖？也许你现在该告诉我所有事，以防情况往危险的方向发展？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: That's it! Triangulating distress beacon. There. The signal originates from the other side of the Murex. I hope they're not too frightened to talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 就是这样！正对求救信标进行三角定位。在那里。信号来自骨螺战舰的另一侧。我希望他们不要害怕到说不出话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text:
[4.6]
Nora Night keeps saying Narmer isn't dead.
[13.4]
Someone new is at the top. All she knows is a name, Pazuul.
[18.4]
Well, guess what, Tenno? I have a lead.
[24.9]
I detected a dot code signal; broadcast from inside a Murex.
[30.0]
It only says one thing over and over again.
[38.0]
"NEED REINFORCEMENTS". It's probably one of the freedom fighters Nora keeps talking about.
[43.3]
If they made it into a Murex, they have to know about Pazuul.
[46.3]
Come on, Tenno, say you'll help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText:
[4.6]
诺拉·夜 一直说合一众还在活动。
[13.4]
新的掌权人接手了。目前她也就只知道个名字——帕祖。
[18.4]
Tenno 战士，你猜怎么着？我有个线索。
[24.9]
我检测到一段点编码信号；是从一艘骨螺战舰的内部广播的。
[30.0]
它一遍又一遍地重读播放着一句话。
[38.0]
"需要增援。"着大概就是诺拉一直在说的自由战士之一。
[43.3]
如果他们已经进到了骨螺战舰的内部，他们肯定了解帕祖。
[46.3]
拜托了，Tenno 战士，答应我你会帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Whoa. The inside of a Murex... organic scaffolds... node-based circulation... but on a scale I never thought possible. The Medusa network means I'm scanner blind in here. Knock it out, and I'll pinpoint the location of our messenger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 哇哦。这就是骨螺战舰的内部……有机支架……节点式循环系统……而且这规模远远超乎了我的想象。但因为美杜莎网络的存在则意味着我进入了扫描盲区。摧毁它，然后我会定位我们信使的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: When Ballas and Narmer struck the system, I was ready to do something, anything... but no, the family said we had to 'guard the Heart of Deimos'. I spent the entire war laying low in the Necralisk, listening to Nora Night talk about those brave few fighters who were out there doing exciting things. Not this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 当 Ballas 和合一众攻击星系时，我本来准备要干点什么，哪怕是再小的事……但我并没有，我的家人说我们必须"守护火卫二的心"。我只好在殁世幽都低调隐匿，听着诺拉·夜说着那些少数的勇者在外面闹了个底朝天，而我就这样虚度了整场战争。这次不会这样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Tenno, I think that's the central hub of the Medusa network. Without a scanner feed, you'll need to figure out how to disable it on your own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: Tenno 战士，我觉得那是美杜莎网络的中央枢纽。在缺少扫描动态源的情况下，你需要自己弄清楚怎么关掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Don't be afraid. We're here to-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 不要害怕。我们是来——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl NOT Afraid. Kahl need brothers, Queens' send... Blue Girl?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔不害怕。卡尔需要兄弟们，女皇们派了……蓝女孩？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: A... A... A... A VAT RAT?! I can't believe I expected to find out who Pazuul is. I'm an idiot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 一……一……一……一只克隆实验鼠？！我都不敢相信我竟然还想找出帕祖是谁。我是个白痴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl know Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔知道帕祖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 你，认真的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl need gun. Find Kahl gun. Kahl tell about Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔需要枪。给卡尔找枪。卡尔说有关帕祖的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Of course, of course. 'Kahl,' was it? There... Marking a weapon signature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 当然了，当然了。"卡尔"，是吗？那里……正在生成武器标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: You could have said please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 你能说一声"请"就更好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Release field. Please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 请。解除力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Brother wake up. Kahl give orders now. Come!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 兄弟，醒醒。卡尔现在下令。来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: ... Kahl? Where you lead, Rogg follow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: ……卡尔？你到哪，罗格到哪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: A blockage? Not even a brutish Grineer fist can punch through that... think... think..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 堵塞物？即便是粗暴的 Grineer 拳头也无法打穿它……我想想看……想想看……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Blue Girl stop think, Kahl see Rogg has bomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 蓝女孩别想了，卡尔看到罗格有炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Grineer are good at destroying things. Shocking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: Grineer 竟然擅长破坏东西。真令人惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Vat rats are good at destroying things. Shocking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 克隆实验鼠擅长破坏东西。真令人惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl, I've called in a favor. Get to the hangar and you just might live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔，我叫了别人帮忙。去停机库，你们说不定还能活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Railjack just up ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 航道星舰就在前方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Tenno? Hmmm. Brothers trust Kahl, and Kahl trust you. Brothers, get in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: Tenno？嗯。兄弟们信任卡尔，而卡尔信任你。兄弟们，进去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Save teleport for wounded. Kahl walk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 把传送留给伤员。卡尔走路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: No teleport! Kahl go old fashioned way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 不要传送！卡尔要用老方法走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Blue Girl bring brothers aboard. Kahl check everything safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 蓝女孩带兄弟们上飞船。卡尔检查周围安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: We fight for no Queens. We fight for Brothers!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 我们不再为女皇们而战。我们为兄弟们而战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Hold tight, Kahl. Just a little bit longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 坚持住，卡尔。只要再撑一小会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Need to bomb node thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 需要炸掉结节。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Can brother bomb node thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 能炸掉结节吗？兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Blue Girl, where others?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 蓝女孩，其他人呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Grineer have a lot of brothers, Kahl. They're not all going to fit aboard my friend's lander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔，Grineer 有很多的兄弟。但不是所有人都够能挤进我朋友的着陆器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Get bigger ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 找艘更大的船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Scans show what appears to be a Grineer Dropship, but it might not even be operational.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 扫描显示似乎有一艘 Grineer 空投艇，但是它能不能运作都是个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl make work. First find all brothers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔让它干活。首先要找到所有兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: This one's just a Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 这只是个 Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: I as ttee. I as it yout petp!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 我自由了。我欠你一条命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Ugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.text: Kahl know what Veil like. Nobody deserve Veil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VeilbreakerQue.zhText: 卡尔知道戴上面障的感受。没有人活该戴上它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Dead or alive. My Queens care not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 我的女皇压根不在乎你的死活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Have you come to submit, or must I make you kneel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 你是自己投降，还是要我亲手逼你让你跪下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: The Void has called you here. Called you to glory, for the Sister Queens, and for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 虚空召唤你来到这里。召唤你走向荣耀，这一切是为了女皇，也为了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Not so frightening now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 看起来也没那么可怕嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: A trophy for my Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 献给女皇的战利品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Another prize for the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 又一件属于克隆尼的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Alert the Queens! My prize has returned to me. What's mine shall soon be theirs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 快去禀报女皇！我的战利品又回到了我手上。很快，这份战利品就会献给她们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Aaah, I knew you couldn't resist your destiny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 啊哈，我就知道，你无法反抗宿命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: About time you recognized your purpose. I, Vor, shall deliver your lifeless husk to my Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 是时候认命了。我，沃尔，会亲手把你这具躯壳献给我的女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Captain Vor and his Grineer clones will be dangerous foes, Tenno. Proceed with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: Tenno，沃尔上尉和他的克隆尼军队是极其危险的敌人。务必小心行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Vor has not forgotten the last time you faced him. Be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 沃尔肯定记得你们上次交手的事。小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Vor is a dangerous threat to the Origin System - and to you. He must be stopped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 沃尔不仅是始源星系的极大威胁，他也会将矛头指向你。一定要阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Tenno - well done. We can only hope this is the last we will see of Captain Vor…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: Tenno——干得好。但愿这是我们最后一次见到沃尔上尉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Finally, Captain Vor is no longer a threat to the Origin System. You have done well, Tenno. Head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 太好了，沃尔上尉终于不会再危害始源星系了。Tenno，你做得很出色。前往撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Good work. Vor has plagued this system for too long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 做得好。沃尔在这个星系作恶太久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: We end this now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 我们现在就做个了断！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: You fight for no one, Tenno! I fight for my Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: Tenno，你毫无信仰可言！而我，为我的女皇而战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: You and I were destined for this moment, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: Tenno，你我注定要在此刻对决！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: Come, little Tenno! Show me what you remember of the Old War.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 小 Tenno，来吧！让我看看你还记得多少关于远古之战的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: You are ready for what comes next, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: Tenno，看来你准备好迎接自己的下场了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.text: You will be my trophy! My glory!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DMer.zhText: 你会成为我的战利品！我的荣耀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DSta.text: Foolish Tenno, do you realize your Lotus has sent you to die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DSta.zhText: 愚蠢的 Tenno，你还没发现，你的莲就是派你来送死的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPH.text: Tenno, The Grineer rule the Origin System now. You are a walking relic. Pretty, but useless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPH.zhText: Tenno，如今整个始源星系都在克隆尼的统治之下。你只不过是个行走的老古董。虚有其表，毫无用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.text: Come for revenge? Arrogant fool. You could have been free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.zhText: 来寻仇的？狂妄的蠢货。你本可以重获自由的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.text: Tenno. Be careful. Even with the Ascaris Bolt's interference disabled, Captain Vor is a dangerous threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.zhText: Tenno，别掉以轻心。即使蛔虫装置的干扰已被解除，沃尔上尉对我们来说依然很危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.text: NO! This is not over, Tenno! I will have your corpse for my Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.zhText: 不！Tenno，这还没完！我一定会拿下你的尸体，献给我的女皇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.text: Tenno - the Ascaris Bolt. It seems to have gone inert the moment Vor vanished. You have defended Earth from a dangerous threat. Well done. Head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPM.zhText: Tenno——那个蛔虫装置。它似乎在沃尔消失的那一刻就失效了。你成功化解了这场危机，守护了地球。做得好。现在前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.text: You went to sleep in a system of Grineer slaves. You wake to Grineer warriors!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.zhText: 你沉睡时，克隆尼还是受人奴役的苦工。如今醒来，他们早已成为威震星系的战士！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.text: Let us see how you dance, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.zhText: 看看你还要怎么垂死挣扎，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.text: Asleep for so long, you will be no match for my defenses!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVPS.zhText: 你睡了这么久，连我的防御都打不穿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: This is where you die, Tenno!
You have shamed me for the last time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 你再也没有机会羞辱我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: I want to watch you die, Tenno!
My clone brothers will cheer your death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 我的克隆兄弟们会为你的死而欢呼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: I will wear your head as a trophy, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 我要把你的脑袋挂身上当战利品，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: Soon, all Tenno will be memories, and the Grineer will triumph!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 很快，所有 Tenno 都会成为过去，而克隆尼终将凯旋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: You will serve us, dead or alive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 不管是死是活，你都得为我们效劳！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: I will rip your limbs from your metal corpse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 我要把你的四肢从你那铁皮残躯上撕下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: I look forward to seeing what beats inside your ribcage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 真想剖开你的胸腔，看看里面究竟是什么在跳动！
这一刻我已经等了太久！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.text: Your corpse will be my glory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorRework/DVor.zhText: 你的尸首将成就我的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DCom.text: We need to figure out what Captain Vor has done to you and stop him. But we'll need help - I've found a communication segment we might salvage for your ship. When you are ready - activate your Navigation system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DCom.zhText: 我们必须查清沃尔上尉对你动了什么手脚，并设法阻止他。但这需要外援——我找到了可用的通讯模块。准备就绪后，就启动你的导航系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DInt.text: The Grineer are ravenous for this old technology, it is superior to theirs. Perhaps there are systems left in the Orbiter compartment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DInt.zhText: 克隆尼对这项古代技术垂涎已久，它远超他们现有的科技。没准轨道飞行器里还有些系统能用？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: You've done it Tenno. Vor's Ascaris is gone. You are free now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，你做到了，沃尔的蛔虫装置被摧毁了，你现在自由了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: But your work has just begun. The Origin System is in chaos and it needs you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 但你的任务才刚开始，始源星系已陷入一片混乱。Tenno，星系需要你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Vor was just a part of the Grineer machine… and we have seen that the Corpus have begun amassing weapons of their own. It is a dangerous time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 沃尔不过是克隆尼战争机器上的一颗小螺丝……长久以来，科普斯也在招兵买马扩张势力，如今的时代也岌岌可危。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Ordis will gladly assist the Operator in cutting a bloody path- in whatever mission they choose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 无论指挥官执行什么任务——杀出一条血路……奥迪斯都很乐意协助您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: We will be at your side. There will be others too. It is time for the Tenno to return. So… what mission will you do next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 我们会与你并肩作战，未来也会有其他人加入。是时候向星系宣告 Tenno 回归了。那么……接下来你要选择哪一项任务？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Your Foundry Segment is ready for installation, Operator- Will the Operator build a Cephalon to replace me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，您可以安装铸造厂模块了——您不会再造一个中枢来换掉我吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Foundry restored! Here the Operator will craft many powerful weapons and tools to- exact revenge for dismantling me- to expand your arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 铸造厂修好了！您可以在这里制作各种强力武器和工具，用来——报我被拆解的仇——扩充您的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Oh, no. Operator our component storage has been looted as well...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，不太妙，我们的部件仓库也被洗劫一空了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Typical Corpus, sure the blueprint is free but jack up the components! Operator, we will need resources in order to build the countermeasure blueprint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 典型的科普斯作风，图纸是免费的没错，但组件价格被抬得老高！指挥官，我们得去收集资源来制造反制器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Tenno I just received a very explicit message from your ship Cephalon. If you're looking for resources, why didn't you just say so?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，你的飞船中枢给我发了一条极其不堪入目的消息。你要找资源的话，直接开口不就好了嘛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: I know just the place but I demand an apology… my mother is no gymnast and she would never eat those things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 地儿我知道在哪，但你得先道歉……我妈可没那么骚，那种东西她更不会往嘴里含。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: You can go straight to- Operator, I am sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 你可以直接去下……对不起，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Wow. You may want to get a new ship Cephalon, when you can afford it… that one seems glitched. I've marked your Navigation with a place I know… good for resources… if you can stand the cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 哇，等你手头宽裕了，最好去换个新的飞船中枢……你那个感觉有点毛病。我给你的导航上发了个坐标……那有不少资源，前提是你能扛得住冻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: The detonator is charging up. You need to bring Vor down. He thinks he can capture you again. Don't worry. I will be with you. Let us show him how much you have learned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 蛔虫装置的引爆器正在充能，你必须击溃沃尔。他以为还能再抓到你。别担心，我一直在你身边，让他见识一下你真正的实力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Are you ready Tenno? Facing Vor is the only way to rid yourself of him permanently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，准备好了吗，只有跟沃尔决一死战，才能永远摆脱他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Operator, are you alright?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，您没事吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: This part of your journey is over Tenno. I admire you for your struggle but now… I am part of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，你的旅程结束了，我很佩服你的抗争精神……但现在，我已与你融为一体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Lotus, do something! Help the Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 莲，快想想办法！救救指挥官！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: We Grineer are millions strong, but with a flaw. We are diseased, rotting, sterile, but now we have you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 我们克隆尼大军遍布始源星系，但都带有基因缺陷。我们肉体不健全、早衰腐朽、无法繁衍，但现在有你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Operator, do not abandon me again. Build the countermeasure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，请您不要再抛下我了，快制作反制器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: I did this for my love, my Queens! They will forgive my insubordination when I deliver you to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 我做的一切，都是为了我挚爱的女皇！等我把你献上，她们一定会原谅我的抗命之举。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Our love will be reborn as we feed on your divine blood and our children will flourish without disease. And I will die, at last, at peace. Father. Grandfather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 当我们喝下你神圣的血液，她们会重新宠幸我，我们的孩子也将摆脱病痛、茁壮成长。而我，也终于可以安然离去。去见父亲……祖父……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: What do you think you are you doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 你这是在干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: What a waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 暴殄天物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Tenno. Tenno.. Good! You managed to disarm Vor's Ascaris! I thought… I thought I lost you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，Tenno……太好了，你成功拆除了沃尔的蛔虫装置，我还以为……要失去你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Oh no. The Ascaris had a tampering failsafe, its burrowed into you and armed itself. We'll need to find Vor before it detonates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 糟了，蛔虫装置设有防拆保险，它已钻入你体内并启动了自爆程序，我们得赶在它引爆前找到沃尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Get to Navigation - boarding a Grineer ship to access their personnel records will be the fastest way to find Vor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 快去导航台，登上克隆尼的战舰读取他们的人员档案，这是找到沃尔最快的办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Operator, what are you waiting for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，您还在等什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Ordis assumes 'finding' Vor implies violence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 奥迪斯认为「找到沃尔」就代表可以使用暴力吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Hello Operator, may I suggest you access Navigation and save your life? For my sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 指挥官，您好。请允许我建议您使用导航保命。当然，也为了保住我的命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Thanks for helping me out back there. I'm in your debt... and I often pay my debts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 谢谢你刚才救我回来。我欠你个人情……我，一般是有债必还的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: I recognize that device on your Frame… it's a restraint. We Corpus use something similar to keep our Robotics in line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 我认得你战甲上的装置……是抑制器。我们科普斯用类似的装置来让机器人乖乖听话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: So to settle my debt I'll give you a very expensive blueprint… for free! Because I like you… and well, a lot of my customers don't live long with these Grineer dogs chewing up the system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 欠你的人情就拿这张昂贵的设计图抵……不收钱！我看好你，再说了……那些克隆尼杂碎到处侵略，我的很多主顾都活不长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Here. Use your Foundry to build the countermeasure device from this blueprint. Good luck!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 拿去吧，去你的铸造厂制作反制器。祝你好运！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Vor's Ascaris is burrowing into your Warframe, I'm worried it will affect your mind… I can't lose you Tenno. We must restore the ship's Foundry immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 沃尔的蛔虫装置正在钻入你的战甲，我担心它会侵蚀你的心智……Tenno，我不能失去你，必须立刻修好飞船的铸造厂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: A nearby ore extraction colony will have the Foundry technology you need. I am certain they will share it with you. Its location has been added to your navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: 附近有一处采矿殖民区，那里有你需要的铸造厂技术。我相信他们不会拒绝的，殖民地的坐标已传输到你的导航里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.text: Tenno, we may have a problem, the colony is unresponsive. Get to the surface so we can see what's going on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DLis.zhText: Tenno，可能出事了，殖民地那边毫无回应。前往星球地表，弄清出什么事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DMis.text: When you are ready, proceed to the navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DMis.zhText: 准备好以后，就去导航控制台吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DMis.text: Operator, there is much to be done, please consult the navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DMis.zhText: 指挥官，我们还有很多事要做，请到导航控制台查看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Operator, you have returned! I am Ordis, ship Cephalon. A shadow of my former self. I cannot serve the Operator in such condition. Order me to self-destruct. I will understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 指挥官，您回来了！我是本船的中枢奥迪斯。但奥迪斯感觉飞船少了好多东西，无法继续为您服务了，请下令让我执行自毁程序吧，我会理解的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Look at this mess. Those savages! Components have been removed. The lower Orbiter compartments have no life-support. Why did the Operator abandon me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 看这一团糟！那帮野蛮人真可恶！部件都被他们拆走了。下层轨道舱的维生系统也失灵了，指挥官当初为什么要抛弃我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Arsenal management could be restored, if the Operator wishes it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 只要指挥官愿意，军械库随时可以恢复运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: You honor Ordis! Now I can supply the Operator with better modded firepower... Oh the violation! Those have been looted as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 这是奥迪斯的荣幸！我可以为指挥官提供更强的火力改装……噢，天哪！那些部件也被那些强盗抢走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Ordis hopes the Operator will punish the Grineer for dismantling it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 指挥官，请帮奥迪斯惩罚这些偷走部件的克隆尼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Orbiter void cloak engaging… Welcome back, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 正在启动虚空隐匿装置……指挥官，欢迎回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: The Operator has recovered a segment! Install it now- Ordis patiently awaits its installation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 指挥官找回了一个模块！立即安装——奥迪斯正耐心等待模块安装完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Get communications online. I must analyze what Vor's Ascaris is doing to your Warframe. This technology is beyond the Grineer, it must be Corpus in origin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 让通讯系统恢复运作。我必须分析沃尔的蛔虫装置对你的战甲做了什么。克隆尼研究不出这种技术，一定是科普斯的产物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Systems engaging. I suppose this will do- Ordis is grateful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 正在连接系统。这下应该行了……奥迪斯感谢您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: The Operator is now connected with other Tenno in the system. The Operator may now contact black market scumbags- contact arms-dealers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 指挥官已经和星系中的其他 Tenno 取得了联系。现在可以联系黑市败类了……呃，纠正，是军火商。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: Excellent idea Ordis. Tenno, we need to make contact with a Corpus defector sympathetic to the Tenno cause. They will of course, require compensation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 奥迪斯，好主意。Tenno，我们需要联系那位叛离科普斯的 Tenno 支持者。不过，对方会索要一些报酬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: You see what Ordis is referring to, Operator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 指挥官，您知道奥迪斯指的是什么吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.text: In this case compensation will not be credits… it will be freedom. I've updated Navigation. You will need to break him out of a Grineer Gulag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DOrd.zhText: 这次情况特殊，对方要的不是钱……是自由。我已经更新了导航坐标。你必须把他从克隆尼监狱里解救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I could have saved the Grineer but they cast me out. Maybe its not too late to draw your divine blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我本可以拯救克隆尼，但他们驱逐了我。也许现在抽取你那神圣的血液还为时不晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I will put you down like a rabid Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我会像宰疯库狛那样宰了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: This is our chance. Vor has been stripped of his elite guard, he is vulnerable. Take him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 机会来了，沃尔现在没有精英护卫，破绽百出。动手解决他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, look! The Ascaris detonator has just disintegrated, it's as if it was directly connected to Vor. You're done here, go to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，快看！蛔虫装置的引爆器刚刚崩溃了，看来它和沃尔是绑定在一起的。任务完成，去撤离点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Good, your ship is one step closer to completion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 很好，你的飞船马上就要修好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Soon the worm will be in your spine and I will control this Warframe of yours… I will purge your doting mother and bring you home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 蛔虫很快就会钻进你的脊椎，到时候你的战甲就是我的了……我会顺便把溺爱你的莲给灭了，然后带你回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You killed the last Grineer. If there are any colonists left, they will know justice has been done for their families. Time for extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你解决了最后一个克隆尼，如果殖民地还有幸存者，他们会知道有人为他们的家人讨回了公道。该撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I was afraid of this, the Grineer are here and I cannot find any signs of living colonists. You still have a job to do, find that Foundry Segment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 和我担心的一样，克隆尼来过，我没发现殖民地居民有生还的迹象。不过你还有任务在身，去找铸造厂模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You located the Foundry Segment, now pick it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你找到铸造厂模块了，拿上它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, you need to pick up the Foundry Segment before we can continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，我们必须先拿到铸造厂模块，才能继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Now there is one more thing you need to do. Eliminate all Grineer and provide justice for the colonists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 现在还有一件事情要做，消灭所有克隆尼部队，为死去的殖民地居民伸张正义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: This was once a prosperous independent colony, until the Grineer arrived...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 克隆尼到来之前，这片独立殖民地一直很繁荣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Queens fear you, but I will show them. My love will return when I deliver you to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 女皇忌惮你。但等我把你献上，我必将重获恩宠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno are you there? The signal cannot be boosted any further. Hurry, you are running out of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，你在吗？信号无法再增强了，快点，你的时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: It's ready - take the segment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 准备好了。去拿模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: A nearby communication tower coordinates Grineer attacks on the colonies. It will have the segment we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 附近有一座通讯塔，克隆尼用它来进攻殖民地。我们要的模块就在那儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The segment you need is in a nearby data vault. Infiltrate the vault and retrieve the segment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你要的模块就在附近数据密库里。潜进去，把模块取回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: As every moment passes, the Ascaris burrows deeper. Revealing you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 时间越久，蛔虫装置就会钻得越深。我会知道你所有的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: This data-vault is equipped with a variety of security measures. How you defeat those measures is up to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 这座数据库配备了多重安保措施。至于如何破解，得靠你自己想办法了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Activate the console so I can decouple the Communication Segment we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 启动控制台，我好将所需的通讯模块剥离出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You must protect the tower from Grineer until the decoupling finishes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 在剥离完成前，务必守住通讯塔，别让克隆尼碍事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Do not let the Grineer regain control of the tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 别让克隆尼夺回通讯塔的控制权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Ascaris is working… breaking through. I see the shadows of your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 蛔虫装置起作用了……它在侵蚀你的身体，我看到了你心底笼罩的阴影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Good work we have what we... wait...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 做得好，我们拿到了……等等……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, coordinates in this nav segment put the Galleon on a direct course to a convoy of colonists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，从导航模块中的坐标来看，这艘战舰正冲向一支殖民船队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You have a choice, you can extract now or you can disable this galleon and save the colonists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你有两个选择，立刻撤离，或是摧毁这艘战舰的动力系统，来拯救殖民船队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Saving the colonists could jeopardize this mission. I recommend you head straight to extraction but the choice is yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 拯救殖民船队会让任务难度大大增加。我建议你立即撤离，但决定权在你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The navigation segment is in the vicinity. Take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 导航模块就在附近，拿上它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You've reached the ships power systems. Destroy the reactor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你已抵达这艘战舰的动力系统，摧毁反应堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: That should take the pressure off the colonist ship but you need to get out of there! Get to extraction before the reactor goes critical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 这样应该能解除殖民船队的危机，但你必须立刻离开。在反应堆爆炸之前赶往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The systems on this Grineer Galleon can be made compatible with your ship. Find and extract a navigation segment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 这艘克隆尼帆船战舰的系统能和你的飞船兼容，找到并提取导航模块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You have murdered my sons and disgraced me before my Queens. But soon the Ascaris will complete its task and bring you to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你屠戮我的子嗣，让我在女皇面前颜面尽失。但很快蛔虫装置就会完成它的使命，把你带到我面前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Ascaris failsafe is attacking your systems. Your shield capacity has just been halved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 蛔虫装置的防拆机制正在攻击你的战甲系统，你的护盾容量已经减半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You're wasting precious time, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，你是在浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: This outpost belongs to The Corpus, a secretive but extremely powerful Merchant Cult known to be working with the Grineer. Darvo will fill you in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 科普斯是个神秘又强大的商会，这座前哨站就是他们的产业。据说他们和克隆尼暗中勾结，达尔沃会向你说明细节的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Legions of robots, mindless automatons, freaking lasers! These guys are bad news, but they're also loaded, which is why you're here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 他们有机器人军队，没脑子的自动机械，和可怕的激光武器！这些家伙很难搞，但他们身上的油水也多，你懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Technically this is stealing but don't let that bother you. The Corpus aren't exactly beacons of moral fortitude either. They sell anything to anyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 严格来说这算偷窃，不过别有心理负担。科普斯也不是什么好鸟。只要给钱，他们什么人都卖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Don't get me wrong, I like profit… a lot, but I don't sell my wares to the damned Grineer. That's unforgivable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 别误会，我也喜欢赚钱。但我绝不会把东西卖给克隆尼那些杂碎。那是底线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Keep moving there is more here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 继续，这里还有别的箱子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Good work but you're not done yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 干得好，但行动还没结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Find the next cache, you almost have what you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 去找下个箱子，资源快找齐了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Darvo's intel suggests that this outpost is host to several rich supply caches, raid the caches and take what you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 达尔沃的情报显示，这个前哨有不少补给箱，去搜一遍，带走你需要的物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Time for extract…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 是时候撤离了……你找齐了我们此行所需的物资……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Ascaris has reached your mind and rendered Lotus mute. You will return to me… over your own free will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 蛔虫装置已经侵入了你的意识，可以让莲消停一会儿了。你很快就会回到我的身边……这可由不得你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You have murdered my sons and disgraced me before my Queens. But soon the Ascaris will complete its task and bring you to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你屠戮我的子嗣，让我在女皇面前颜面尽失。但很快蛔虫装置就会完成它的使命，把你带到我面前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: A Tenno! Darvo may live a few more hours!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 是 Tenno！看来我可以多活一阵子了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Lotus must be desperate to send you fetching greedy fools from the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 莲肯定是走投无路了，才会派你来捞这种掉钱眼里的科普斯蠢货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Now the Ascaris has burrowed deep enough to give me influence. Shall we see how your shields work?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 现在蛔虫装置已经钻得很深了，足以影响到你了。来看看你的护盾还管不管用吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Ascaris is letting Vor control your shield! We must figure out how to remove it. Avoid taking damage while I try and block him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 沃尔正在借助蛔虫装置控制你的护盾，我们得想办法拆掉它，我来试着屏蔽它，你尽量别受伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Bypass the security so we can enter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 绕过安保系统，我们就可以进去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: This is the prison block. If you can avoid detection by the Warden it may be easier to get Darvo out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 这里就是监区了，如果能避开典狱长，救出达尔沃会容易得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I owe you for this Tenno. I will get my entourage to meet us in orbit once we're clear of this mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，我欠你一条命。等逃出去后，我会叫手下来轨道上接应我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, help me! I'm feeling actual, physical pain. Do something!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，快救救我！我现在浑身都痛。赶紧想想办法！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: It wasn't supposed to end this way. Tenno, please, do something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我怎么能死在这？Tenno，想想办法吧，求你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You can't leave Darvo behind, Tenno. Using your Warframe's revive system should get him moving again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，你不能丢下达尔沃不管。使用战甲的复苏系统，可以让他重新站起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno! This really hurts, I ain't kidding around. Do your thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno！我快痛死了，一点都没夸张。别留手了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Hey, is somebody out there? Listen, whatever you think I did, I swear, it wasn't me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 喂，有人在吗？我说，不管你觉得我干了什么坏事，我发誓，都是被人陷害的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Oh, thank you. I thought I was a goner. Let's keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 喔，谢了。我还以为自己死定了。接着走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Search these cells for Darvo. He has to be here somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 找到达尔沃的牢房，他应该就关在这附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The arms dealer is named Darvo. He's being held in the prison block on the other side of this factory complex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 情报显示，那个军火商名叫达尔沃，他被关在这座工厂另一侧的监区里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Darvo is out for himself, but he is sympathetic toward the Tenno. The Grineer must have found out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 达尔沃虽然自私自利，但他对 Tenno 抱有好感。克隆尼肯定发现了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: How many Grineer slaves died to build this place?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 克隆尼为了建造这个地方到底害死了多少奴隶？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Don't let Vor distract you. Focus on the mission, it's our only hope of figuring out this link with him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 别让沃尔扰乱你的心神，集中精力完成任务，才能搞清楚你与沃尔之间的联系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Extraction is ready. Remember your success here depends on getting Darvo out of there… alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 撤离点就绪，记住，任务成功与否取决于你能否把达尔沃活着带出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You've been spotted. Get ready for a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你暴露了，准备战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I see the Lotus has tried to wake you… pity she's too late!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 看起来莲是想要去唤醒你……可惜，她迟了一步！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You're my prize now, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你是我的战利品了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: No!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: We are taking this one with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 把这家伙给我带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: What has he done to you? I can't lose another Tenno. I'm surging your Warframe's power systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 他对你做了什么？不能再让 Tenno 离开我了。正在增强你战甲的能量系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Quick. Use your power. Defend yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 快！用技能保护自己！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Use your power, now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 快用技能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Salvage team, why have you not reported in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 回收队，怎么还没人汇报？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: An extraction ship is waiting for you. But the Grineer will be hunting you. Arm yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 撤离飞船正在等你。但克隆尼绝对不会放过你，把自己武装起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Quick, choose a weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 快，挑选一把武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: A Tenno's melee weapon honors their warrior tradition. When technology was turned against them, they adapted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno 的近战武器传承了古老的战士精神。当科技沦为敌人的武器，他们也找到了应对之道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: There's a cache of weapons ahead. Grab what you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 前面有个武器箱，挑一把称手的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno. Pick up a weapon. You are running out of time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，拿把武器。快没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Good. The extraction point is up ahead. Hurry before Vor finds out you've escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 很好，撤离点就在前面。快跑，别让沃尔发现你逃走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: You made it. There's the extraction ship!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你做到了。那就是撤离飞船！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: My decrepit heart is pounding! This one is stronger than the rest. Lock the area down! This Tenno is mine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我这颗腐朽的心脏激动得砰砰直跳！这个 Tenno 比以往的都强悍。封锁这里！这个 Tenno 是我的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Get out of there Tenno, you will have to face Vor another time… when you're fully restored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，快离开那儿，等你完全恢复后……再对付沃尔也不迟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Grineer, my sons, prepare the reinforcements. We need that Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 士兵们，准备增援！我们必须拿下这个 Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Queens want to destroy you, but I need to know more
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 女皇想把你给灭了，但我，想知道更多关于你的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, you cannot survive without arming yourself. Choose a weapon before we continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，赤手空拳的话可坚持不了多久。先选把武器，再继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I'm not sure what Vor has done to your Warframe but we cannot remove it now. Just keep going, your ship is up ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我不清楚沃尔对你的战甲动了什么手脚，但眼下还无法将其拆除。继续前进，你的飞船就在前面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: There it is, your ship. Hurry, Vor's reinforcements must be on their way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你的飞船就在那儿。快，沃尔的援军随时会到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Escape will only be possible with a primary weapon. Choose now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 必须装备主要武器才能突出重围。快选吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Your Parazon is a versatile tool. Use it to breach this panel and restart the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 你的灭骸之刃是一件多用途利器。可以用它破解这块面板，重启飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Stop touching me you - what? Are my sensors deceiving me? Operator, is that you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 把你的脏手拿开，你这——等等？是我的传感器出故障了吗？指挥官，是您吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Enemy reinforcements are here! Ship Cephalon, we require immediate extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 不好，敌人的援军来了！飞船中枢，我们现在必须立刻撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: The Operator is in danger? I will need a few moments to cycle the engines!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 指挥官有危险？请给我一点时间来启动引擎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, the ship is ready, it's time to leave
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，飞船准备就绪，立刻撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, are you afraid? You cannot hide from these old eyes. I've marked you. You will return to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，你怕了吗？你逃不过我的眼睛。你已烙下我的印记，终将落入我的手中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: There's the ship. It will require power. Activate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 飞船就在前面。系统需要供能，快启动它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Quick, get to the console, and release the lockdown. Do that, and I will guide you to your old ship. It's your only chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 快，用控制台解除封锁。完成之后我会指引你找到曾经的飞船。这是你唯一的生路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: Tenno, you need to go to the console to release the lockdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: Tenno，你必须前往控制台解除封锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.text: I've marked the console on your map. You need to access it to release the lockdown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DTut.zhText: 我在地图上标出了控制台的位置。你得用它来解除封锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DVor.text: We have what we came for, now get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DVor.zhText: 通讯模块到手了，现在前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DVor.text: The segment is yours. Head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DVor.zhText: 模块到手了。尽快前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DWal.text: A Tenno flows like fire over the battle terrain, do you remember how to dash up walls?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/VorsPrize/DWal.zhText: Tenno 穿梭战场犹如流火，你还记得如何蹬墙而上吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Crew: Corpus traffic detected within abandoned Voidspace lanes. Easy pickings. Void storms a possibility. Pack barf bags.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 舰员们，在废弃的虚空航道内检测到 Corpus 的踪迹。小菜一碟。可能会有虚空风暴。准备好呕吐袋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Transmission from the Tempestarii. Sevagoth reconstruction is possible. A task not to be undertaken lightly. Old warriors do not forget their debts. Prediction: we have not seen the last of the Tempestarii.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 来自「风暴使者号」的通讯。重新打造 Sevagoth 是可行的。这是一项不能轻易放弃的任务。老兵们不会忘记他们的债务。预测：我们还没有了解到「风暴使者号」的全部秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Who waits for the shadow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 等候幽影之人为何人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Vosphene glyphs. Hm. That takes me back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 荧音信号。嗯。这让我想起了过去的时光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: I see you, you bastard. I see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 我看见你了，你这个混蛋。我看见你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Contact Parvos Granum immediately. Get me authorization for multiphasic ordnance. Tell him I've found that damned ghost!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 现在立即联系帕尔沃斯·格拉努。让他给我多相火炮的授权。告诉他我已经找到了那个该死的幽灵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Evasive! Focus shields!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 闪避！集中护盾！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Isolating escape corridor. All hands: evasive maneuvers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 分离逃生通道。全体人员：采取闪避动作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Corpus Salvage team headed for debris field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: Corpus 回收队前往了碎石带。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Salvage team eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 回收队已被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Alert. Void storm imminent. Corpus reinforcements imminent. Obligatory withdrawal imminent. This escalated quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 警报。虚空风暴即将到来。Corpus 增援部队即将到来。强制撤退刻不容缓。事态已迅速升级。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text:
[3.9]
Captain Vala Glarios.
[8.4]
So pleased to meet you.
[12.3]
I should have expected Tenno rats among the flotsam.
[15.7]
Sequester that Railjack for Parvos!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText:
[3.9]
我是薇拉·格拉里斯舰长，
[8.4]
很高兴在这里见到你。
[12.3]
我早该料到这垃圾堆里会有 Tenno 耗子。
[15.7]
以帕尔沃斯之名，把那艘航道星舰拿下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Commence salvage. Void storm resurgence probable. Get the lead out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 开始回收作业。虚空风暴可能会再次来袭。动作要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Target out of phase. Weapons ineffective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 目标已超出当前相位。武器无效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Escape corridor locked. Grab something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 已锁定逃生通道。抓稳了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Crew: sensor glitch is back. Stay sharp. This may not be a bug.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 船员们：传感器再次出现故障。保持警惕。这可能不是程序问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Potential catastrophic sensor glitch. Visual confirmation required. Crew: did you see that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 传感器有可能出现灾难性的故障。需要通过视觉确认。船员们：你们发现故障了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Gunfight not an option. Isolating escape corridor. Anomaly detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 与敌方交火不可行。正在分离逃生通道。发现异常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Archive loaded. Our vessel was called The Tempestarii. Void rescue craft. Missing since the Old War.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 已加载档案。我们战舰曾被称为风暴使者号。是一艘虚空救援舰。远古之战后就失踪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Captain Glarios knows something about that vessel. Crew: infiltrate and recover Orokin-era naval records. Our ghost ship has a name. I want it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 格拉里斯船长知道这艘战舰的一些情况。船员们：秘密潜入并取回奥罗金时代的航行记录。我们这艘幽灵战舰是有名字的。我想知道它是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Duty lingers. Like pain in a phantom limb. Like the voices of a crew long-dead. The Tempestarii is suffering, searching for one final rescue. Saving us may enable her to complete her duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 然而，她的职责却一直挥之不去。就像是幻肢的疼痛。就像是早已死去的船员的声音。风暴使者号正在饱受煎熬，寻找着最后的救援。拯救我们或许能让她完成自己的职责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Exemplary service record. Rescue total: two-thousand-and-seventeen souls. Cited for bravery in the second and third Tharsis engagements. Multiple commendations. A legend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 这是一份杰出的救援记录。总共救援了两千零一十七条生命。因为在第二次和第三次萨西斯战役中的英勇表现，这艘战舰受到了多次表彰。是一个传奇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Lost during a Void-storm of unprecedented magnitude. Interesting. Final mission contains a black mark. Refusal to withdraw. Logs record final transmissions. Calling into the Void. Before being engulfed. She has been calling ever since. The Tempestarii went down saving lives. She still waits for an answer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 她在一场史无前例的猛烈虚空风暴中失踪了。有意思。在最后一次任务中，有一个污点。拒绝撤退。日志记录了最后的传送。在被彻底吞噬之前，她曾向虚空发出呼唤。并且从那以后，她就一直在呼唤着。风暴使者号为了拯救生命而被吞噬。而她仍在等待着一声回应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: You have been invited into an unknown realm. Tread lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 看来你受到了热情的"邀请"。你进入了一个未知之地。请小心前行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: The 'Shadow.' Concentrated Void energy. He is: not conventionally alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: "幽影"，是一种浓缩的虚空能量。他并不是我们传统意义上的，生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Their final rescue. The location data is corrupted. He cannot retrieve it. We can help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 他们的最后一次救援。位置数据已损坏，他无法将其恢复。我们能帮得上忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Data restored. Downloading coordinates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 数据已恢复。正在下载坐标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Brace. Brace. Brace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 注意。注意。注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Their shields are down! Oh, sweet Tenno. You went and lulled the beast to sleep for me! How kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 他们的护盾消失了！哦，亲爱的Tenno 战士。你让那头猛兽陷入沉睡，真是帮了个大忙啊！多么厚道啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Balls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 该死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: I was working in an exosuit when the Tempestarii destroyed Lucretia Platform. I drifted for days among the frozen fragments of my crew. My Sisters. I dreamed their dead, gaping mouths were singing with me yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 当「风暴使者号」摧毁卢克丽霞平台时，我正身着太空服进行作业。我和我舰员的冰封残骸一起漂流了许多天。我的姐妹们。我梦到了她们死后咧开着嘴，仍在和我一起歌唱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: My kind are all the only monsters this System needs, Tenno. We have no time for old ghosts. I shall rip that ship to pieces and eat its heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: Tenno，我的同类就是这个星系唯一所需要的怪物。我们没时间去搭理那些老旧诡舰了。我要把那艘船舰撕成碎片，并找出其中的奥妙来取而代之。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Forget capture! We'll sift through the wreckage instead. Tracers locked. Engage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 忘了捕获吧！相反，我们将从残骸中进行筛选。追踪器已锁定。开火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Back to the Tempestarii. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 回到「风暴使者号」。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Objective: Collapse the anchor field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 目标：瓦解锚定力场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Countermeasures charged. On your mark, unleash the storm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 反制措施已就绪。各就各位，放出风暴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Multiphasic beams have the Tempestarii imprisoned. Solution: junk the beam generator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 多相光束使得风暴使者号无法动弹。解决方案：摧毁光束发生器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Transmitting Orokin-era distress signal. Here goes nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 正在传送奥罗金时代的求救信号。看来，这里什么都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Who waits for the shadow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 待幽影者何人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Your golden masters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 汝之黄金之主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Countersign: unsatisfactory. Evasive maneuvers. Attempting to reopen communications.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 应答信号：不理想。进行机动闪避。正在尝试重新开启通信。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Comms channel reopened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 已重新开启通信频道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Who waits for the shadow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 待幽影者何人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: We, the lost souls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 吾辈，迷途者也。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: She hears us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 看来，她听到我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Tempestarii. All aboard are safe. Your mission: complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 风暴使者号。所有机能正常。任务：已完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: The Tempestarii has lowered shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 风暴使者号已经关闭了护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Crew. Your presence is requested aboard the Tempestarii.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 船员们。现在，请你们立即登上风暴使者号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: "Who waits for the shadow?" Possibility: friend-foe identification protocol. Loading Orokin-era distress countersigns. Prepare to disengage void-drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: "待幽影者何人？"这可能是识别敌我的程序。正在加载奥罗金时代的求救应答信号。准备关闭虚空引擎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: We are part of this story. We have a duty. Enter the Void. Search and rescue. We must complete the Shadow's final mission, together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 我们是这个故事的一部分。我们有责任。进入虚空。进行搜索和救援。我们必须一起完成幽影的最终任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Tempestarii is charging unidentified countermeasures. Stay in range. Swat down pests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 「风暴使者号」正在为不明反制系统充能。保持可攻击范围。扫除害虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Sisters! Hear me! Hound them to hell and back. By the hand of Parvos himself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 姐妹们！听我说！不论艰难险阻，都要追踪他们到天涯海角。以帕尔沃斯的黄金之手起誓！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: I wait for the shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 吾待幽影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Your shadow has come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 幽影已至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Sevagoth. A Warframe believed lost to the Void forever. His energy almost extinct. With his last spark of life, Sevagoth embraced his Shadow once again. And both were at peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: Sevagoth，一个被认为永远消失在了虚空中的战甲。他的能量几乎消失殆尽。在他一息尚存时，Sevagoth 再次拥抱了他的幽影。他们终于得到了安息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: With full honors, we committed the body of Sevagoth to that distant horizon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 带着对他的崇高敬意，我们把 Sevagoth 的遗体献给那遥远的天边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: He waited. We came. Here is to clearer skies. Record sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 他等待着。我们来了。愿今后天空变得更加晴朗。日志已封存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Sister...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 姐妹们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Cephalon Cy's report. Tempestarii. Final voyage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 中枢赛伊的报告。「风暴使者号」。最后的航行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Today a centuries-long journey ended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 今天，为期数个世纪的旅程结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Together we braved a turbulent Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 我们一起在动荡的虚空中奋勇前行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.text: Deep within, he who had been lost was found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/DW.zhText: 虚空深处，迷失的他被找到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/WraithQuest/Sl.text:
[1.6]

[25.6]
I was working in an exosuit when the Tempestarii destroyed Lucretia Platform. I drifted for days among the frozen fragments of my crew. My Sisters. I dreamed their dead, gaping mouths were singing with me yet.
[30.9]

[34.6]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Fam! Scope this! Glinty brought Yareli here! Didn't I tell you she was free now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 家人们！快瞧！闪闪居然把 Yareli 带来了！看，我就跟你们说她现在自由了吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Klokkit, Yareli! Here. In our Vents. You a real one, Glinty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 看，Yareli！就在这儿。在我们的管道里。你太够哥们了，闪闪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: When I was just a sprog, I smashed meself up something awful. Near ripped the servos clean out of me knees. Wasn't expected to heal. But Roky stayed there by me cot, tellin' stories of the Waverider. Some traditional, some I'm pretty sure she made up. Don't think I'd be here today if it weren't for her and her daft Yareli stories. Those feats, they're not for us; they're for someone like you, Glinty. Help me. Give me a story to tell her? A good one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 我还是个小屁孩的时候，有一次把自己摔得稀烂。那一下差点把我膝盖上的传动装置都扯出来。当时谁都觉得我好不了了。可小洛一直守在我床边，给我讲驭浪者的故事。有些是口口相传的，有些我敢肯定绝对是她自个儿瞎编的。要是没有她和 Yareli 的故事，我今天恐怕都没命站在这了。那些特技，不是我们能做到的，得靠你这样的人，闪闪。帮帮我，让我有个故事能讲给她听。一个够精彩的故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: We found her crashed hard at the base of the Harindi Gap. Board in bits. If her neuro conduit stays dark... she won't wake up. Only Nef's Augmentors got the skill to replug a neuro. And there ain't no hope of his help. Ah, sis, what were you doing?? We found this Graphica on her. No idea what it is. Locked it is. Can't read a lick of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 我们发现她的时候，她摔在哈林地峡谷的谷底，摔得很重，板子都碎成了渣。她的神经导管要是一直没反应……她就再也醒不过来了。只有奈富的义体改造师才有本事重新接通神经系统。但指望让他帮忙，简直是白日做梦。老姐，你经历了什么啊？？我们在她身上找到了这本漫画。不知道是什么玩意儿。整本都锁住了，一个字都看不见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Time's up, kiddlywinks. You can still save your... 'home'... and fix young Roky. Augmentors are standing by. Just transmit the unlocked Graphica.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 时间到，小鬼们。你们现在还有机会保住你们的……「家」，还能修好……你们的小小洛。义体改造师已经待命。只要把解开后的漫画传过来就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Can't believe you gone and did it, Glinty. Gave us her story. Y'know... Roky always said it'd be trouble the day I started thinking. If Nef wants that Graphica so bad? He can have it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 真不敢相信，你真的办成了，闪闪。居然真把她的故事带回来了。小洛常说，一旦我开始动脑子，麻烦就要来了。奈富既然这么想要这本漫画？那就给他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Oh, children. I understand your friend recklessly damaged her neuro-conduit? Uncle Nef can fix her right up, free of charge. If... you fulfill her end of the deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 噢，孩子们。我听说你们的朋友不小心弄坏了自己的神经导管？奈富叔叔可以大发慈悲，免费帮她修好。只不过……你们得替她把答应我的事办完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: See Roky, Yareli didn't give in. She fought Vulgran. Her fam stuck together too, didn't stab each other in the back. That mucker Nef's got the older sprogs mouthing off. Saying you 'tight with the taxman'. Saying you 'betrayed your logical fam.' Younger sprogs are listening too. If they wanna go, they can go. We'll be a fam of two, Roky. You 'n' me. Logical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 看啊小洛，Yareli 没有屈服。她正面迎战武戈兰。她的家人也紧紧抱成一团，没人从背后捅刀子。那个混蛋奈富，让那些老崽子开始嚼舌根了。说你「和收税佬是一伙的」。说你「背叛了自己选择的家人」。连小孩子都在听。他们想走，他们可以走。以后就你和我相依为命了，我们是彼此选择的家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Page one, unlocked! Can't wait to read the first-ever Yareli story! The one Roky could never tell me because nobody ever seen it. Roky? Dunno if you can hear me. But I'm gonna read you this. I hope you're listening, sis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 第一页，解开了！我等不及想读 Yareli 的第一篇故事了！小洛从没给我讲过这个故事，因为以前根本没人读过。小洛？不知道你能不能听到。我要给你读这个故事了。希望你在听，老姐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: So that's who Vulgran was! A mucking slave-driver! This ain't just some comic, Glinty. The legend of Yareli's been keeping orphans like us going for generations. It's our story. Roky must have wanted us all to have it. She was always the storyteller of the fam. Keep cracking those pages, Glinty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 这就是武戈兰的真面目！一个该死的奴隶贩子！这可不仅仅是一册漫画，闪闪。Yareli 的传说一直在我们这样的孤儿当中口耳相传。这是我们自己的故事。小洛肯定是希望我们都能记在心里。她一直都在给家人们讲故事。继续破解这些书页吧，闪闪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Hurry and klok that new page, Glinty. Roky's conduit's still ain't sparked, but I wanna show her Yareli's story the second her eyes are open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 快点解开新的一页，闪闪。小洛的神经导管还是没动静，我想等她一睁眼，就立刻把 Yareli 的故事讲给她听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Tick tock, lovable orphans. I haven't heard from that skip-diver Roky in quite some time. Is she not done unlocking my Graphica yet? So excitable. I do hope nothing happened to her. Your reward is waiting, child. My buyer is eager, and what she offers is worth more than mere credits to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 时间在流逝，可爱的孤儿们。我可有一阵没听到那个废品商小洛的消息了。她还没帮我解开那本漫画吗？真是个急性子的丫头，真希望她没出什么意外。你的报酬已经备好了，孩子。我的买家早就等急了，她能给我的，可比区区现金值钱得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Shammin' mucker! My sis was never in his pocket! Yareli's our fam, and Roky wouldn't sell her - especially not to the likes of him! Sis, don't matter how you got that Graphica, to the sumps with Nef. Roky, we stand by you. But... How did you get it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 满嘴喷粪的混球！我姐才不会当他的走狗！Yareli 是咱们家的人，小洛绝不可能卖掉她——更别提卖给他这种人！老姐，不管你是怎么弄到这本漫画的，让奈富滚一边儿去吧。小洛，我们挺你。可你……到底是怎么拿到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Boom, did you hear that, Roky? Glinty did it. Can't wait to read the next page to you. Can't believe you had Waverider #1, and you didn't tell me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 嘭，听到了吗，小洛？闪闪做到了。我等不及想给你读下一页了。真不敢相信，你居然有《驭浪者》创刊号，居然一个字都没告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Always been this way, innit. Muckers rakin' in dosh on the backs of regular coves. I reckon Roky nicked this from Nef somehow. Didn't tell us cause she didn't want heat on the whole fam. Well - Yareli's ours, our fam, not his. And we protect our own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 世道一直如此，不是吗？混混们只能骑在老实人脖子上捞钱。我猜这东西是小洛从奈富手里顺来的。她不告诉我们，是怕整个家都被拖进麻烦。好吧，Yareli 是我们的人，属于我们的家人，不是他的。而我们，绝不抛弃家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Deal's off. Something's spooked my buyer, and now I'm stuck with a useless Graphica I can't sell! Fortunately for me, the same buyer was interested in purchasing a controlling share of the rental rights to your vents. You piss-rats are her problem now. And... as for your broken little friend? Might I suggest selling her parts as salvage? You'll need the credits to pay your new landlady.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 交易黄了。不知道什么把我的买家吓跑了，现在这本卖不出去的破漫画砸我手里了！好在这个买家，有兴趣买下你们那片管道租赁权的控股份额。你们这群臭耗子，现在是她的麻烦了。至于……你那个坏掉的小姐妹？不如把她拆成零件当废铁卖了如何？毕竟你们还得凑钱给新房东交租呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Boom! Made that look easy! Roky's gonna lose it when she hears this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 嘭！这对你简直跟玩似的！要是小洛看到的话绝对会嫉妒死你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Just like Yareli, riding fancy. Getting chills thinkin' about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 就像 Yareli 一样，动作真漂亮。光是想想我就浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Glinty's kickin' it terminal! Do it for Roky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 闪闪这身手简直绝了！为了小洛，继续冲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Nice! Spirit of Yareli! Chek chek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 漂亮！这就是 Yareli 的精神！懂的都懂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Terminal, Glinty. Kicking it for Roky, you is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 帅炸了，闪闪。为了小洛滑起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Sweet. Respect from the Vent, Glinty! Ha HA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 很好。通风小子向你致敬，闪闪！哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: You be grindin' out there! Makin' Yareli proud! Makin' Roky proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 你板子耍得太帅了！Yareli 会为你骄傲的！小洛也是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Chekkit: Glinty's bashin' that run!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 瞧瞧，闪闪这趟操作太秀了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Glinty. You know the legend of Yareli, yeah? The Waverider? Inspo for k-driving. Total legend. Anyway. You won't believe what I got me hands on. I need your help. I did something stupid. Boon's gonna be livid. Givin' this one last shot, then I'll meet you in the vents. Tell Boon and you everything. Chek chek? Chek, chek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 闪闪，你知道 Yareli 的传说吧？驭浪者？那可是我们玩 K 式悬浮板的灵感源泉。真正的传奇。先不说这个，你绝对猜不到我弄到什么好宝贝。我需要你的帮忙。我干了件蠢事，阿布知道准得气疯。给我最后一次机会，我会在管道等你。我把来龙去脉都告诉你和阿布。懂不？妥了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Oh, hello dear. What a pity that all Nef Anyo's money could not buy him a morsel of taste nor a crumb of conscience. A man with the morals of a creeping scab, and just between the two of us, not a patch on the man his father was. One hates to do business of any kind with his sort, but you must understand, dear, that an old friend's life was at stake. Imagine failing to recognize the beauty of Waverider 1! Thinking of it as low, commoner art, seeing it only as a source of cash! What do you suppose he might have said if he'd known that there was something quite unexpected concealed in those pages? Well. More someone than something, if I'm being honest with you. This is for you, Tenno. The very, very old friend of mine I mentioned before, finally located. Bring her to life, if you'd be so kind? I think my young 'tenants' on Fortuna would like to meet her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 噢，你好，亲爱的。真是可惜，奈富·安尤有再多的钱，居然买不来一丝一毫的品味，也换不来半点良知。他毫无道德底线，就像一块烂疮。我悄悄跟你说——他连他父亲的半根头发丝都比不上。人人都讨厌跟他那种货色做交易。但你得理解，亲爱的，我的一位老朋友的生命正危在旦夕。他居然没能看出《驭浪者》创刊号的美妙之处！只把它当成不入流的艺术，只把它当成捞钱的工具！要是他知道那些书页里藏着某些完全出人意料的东西，你猜他会说什么？好吧。老实说，与其说那是某样东西，倒不如说是某个人。这些是你应得的，Tenno。我之前提到的那位非常，非常老的朋友，终于被找到了。你心地善良的话，那就让她重获新生吧？我在福尔图娜的年轻「租客们」，一定会很想见见她的。

they're unlocked... by performing... feats?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText:
闪闪！你解开封面啦。
那……那是 Yareli，
小洛的最爱。
这是第一本出版的《驭浪者》漫画！
这……这可是无价之宝。
反正对我们来说是这样。
其他的书页……
它们需要通过完成……高难度特技来解锁？
小洛跑到外面拼命，就是为了完成这些特技，把这本漫画解开？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Chekkit! Her conduit's lightin' up! Roky's awake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 懂吧！她的神经导管亮了！小洛醒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Boon? Had wild dreams, fam. Wiped out... Then... Yareli was there. She took me all across the Vallis... Boon. There's something I gotta tell you-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 阿布？我做了个疯狂的梦，弟弟。然后……Yareli 出现了。她带着我飞越了整个山谷……阿布。有件事我得告诉你——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: It's done. Me and Glinty, we stuffed Nef's deal. I sussed out exactly who his mystery buyer on Deimos was. Big Granny Blue was so happy to get a copy of Waverider #1 that she sent back some weird elixir for you, Roky. Sparked your neuro conduit back to life in seconds, it did! And guess what, she owns the vents now. We never have to worry about being turfed out of here ever again, Hah hah! Now prepare y'self, Sis. The Fam's got together and bashed you a new plank. Yeah, took 'em a minute... but those cheese brains realized you was just trying to keep us all away from Nef and his 'deals'. Fam's lucky to have ya, sis. You too, Glinty. You're straight logical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 全都解决了。我和闪闪把奈富的那笔交易搅黄了。我摸清了跟他交易的火卫二神秘买家的真实身份。那位蓝皮大妈拿到《驭浪者》创刊号的副本后高兴坏了，给你送来了一些奇怪的药水作为回礼，小洛。你的神经导管几秒钟就恢复了活力！她现在把那些通风管全买下来了。我们以后再也不用担心被扫地出门了，哈哈！你先做好心理准备，老姐。家人们聚在一起，给你打了一块新板子。是，他们是花了一点时间，但那帮榆木脑袋总算反应过来了，你拼了命只是想让我们离奈富和他的狗屁交易远一点。这个家有你真好，老姐。你也是，闪闪。你也是我们家的一份子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Glinty, is that who I think it is? For real for real?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 闪闪？那就是我心里想的那个人吗，真的吗真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Oh, mate. Glinty brought the Waverider! I know she got Merulina, but if you ever wanna try her with a regular board, like, one of mine? Store's always open!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 我的天，兄弟们，闪闪居然把驭浪者给带来了！我知道她有浪漪珊瑚，不过你什么时候想让她试试普通的板子，比如，我造的那些板子？小店随时恭候！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: Roky and I had a deal: unlock my Graphica, and I forgive the... years of back-rent you vermin owe me for squatting in my vents. Failure to fulfill that deal will result in debt, eviction, and... watching your beloved little Roky slowly fade away. Hurry. My buyer on Deimos grows impatient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 小洛和我有约在先，只要解开我的漫画书，我就免除你们这群寄生虫赖在我的通风管里欠下的……整整几年的房租！如果不履行，代价就是背上巨债、扫地出门，还有……看着你心爱的小小洛慢慢消逝。快点，我火卫二上的买家已经等得不耐烦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.text: What kinda deal is that? Ah, sis, you didna' have no choice. Gotta be smart like you woulda been. What choice do I have? Think. What'd Nef mean by a buyer on Deimos?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/YareliQuest/DY.zhText: 这算哪门子交易？啊，老姐，你当时根本没得选。我得像你一样聪明才行。可我还有什么招？好好想想，奈富说的火卫二买家是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: Remember that Void Angel you were messing with before? Here it is now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 还记得你之前惹的那个虚空天使吗？它现在就在这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: Here comes that Void Angel you woke up. Get ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 你唤醒的那个虚空天使要来了。做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: Here's that extra Void Angel you ordered, grubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 拾荒小子，这是你"订购"的另一个虚空天使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: That's a Void Angel in the making. Best be ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 虚空天使正在显现。最好做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: When that thing starts moving, and it will, you'd better know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 那家伙要动起来了，你最好做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.text: That was a dormant Void Angel. And now it's not dormant anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavAn.zhText: 那曾是个休眠的虚空天使。而现在它醒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.text: If you're not ready to fight, just keep walking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.zhText: 如果你还没有准备好战斗，那就继续到处逛吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.text: Only place to find decent weapons on this Void-forsaken ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.zhText: 在这艘被虚空遗弃的船上，这里是唯一能找到像样武器的地方。
买买买。杀杀杀。重复再来。
