/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.text: Always got time for a fellow enthusiast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.zhText: 对于同好我是相当有时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.text: Weapons with a touch of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBa.zhText: 带有些许虚空气息的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBy.text: If you die, I got dibs on your stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavBy.zhText: 如果你死了，我可要继承你的遗产。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.zhText: 从这开始就变得有意思了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.text: Try equipping an Incarnon weapon first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.zhText: 先尝试装备一把灵化武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.text: Don't go bothering me about this unless you got an Incarnon weapon in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.zhText: 除非你已经得手一把灵化武器，否则别来烦我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.text: Evolve what? Grubber. Hello! You don't have an Incarnon weapon equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavCh.zhText: 拾荒小子，你想进化什么？看清楚了！你可没有装备任何灵化武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavFi.text: I'm not here to be your friend. I'm not sure why I'm here at all. But I'll keep you alive. These? Used to be museum fodder. Ceremonial and all that Golden piss-talk. But now? Real weapons. Void-touched. Not fashion accessories. Not conversation pieces. They are for killing. We good?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavFi.zhText: 我在这不是为了和你做朋友的。我不知道我为什么会在这里。但我不会让你死的。这些吗？曾经是博物馆的用材。用于仪式和所有大型废话庆典。但现在？是真正的武器。染上了虚空的气息。不再是时尚配件。不再是没用的废料。它们现在是杀人武器。打听够了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: You got a killer rep, grubber. Happy to help you keep it that way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 你可是声名在外，拾荒小子。很高兴帮助你维护这个名声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: You ever get tired of the constant killing? Nope. Me neither.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 你厌倦了不断的杀戮吗？没有。我也没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: I watch you on the scope sometimes, y'know. Some of those moves... I thought only a Dax could pull them off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我有时会在望远镜上观察你，你知道的。其中一些动作……我以为只有禁卫才能成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Whoever trained you has nothing to reproach themselves for. You measure up in all the ways that matter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 训练你的人真的很称职。你在所有重要方面都达到了标准。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: I used to think that dying in the field was insurance against ever wearing out. Now I'm looking down the barrel of eternity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我曾经认为，死在战场上才不虚此生。现在我从枪管望过去只看到无尽的永恒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: If I ever start with the self-pity, please, drag me to the nearest airlock and throw me out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 如果我开始自怨自艾，拜托，一定要把我拖到最近的气密舱，然后把我扔出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: These new Grineer may not be bright, but they got a bond. Wish we had 'em back on our side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 这些新型 Grineer 可能并不聪明，但他们之间有着某种联系。真希望他们是站在我们这边的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Thank the Void I don't have kids. Thought about it, but... nah. Line ends here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 感谢虚空我没有孩子。我有想过，还是……算了。我这一支的血统到此结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Never married. Never found anyone I hated enough to condemn to a life with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我没结过婚。从没遇到过一个人，让我恨到足以罚他们跟我共度余生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: I thought loading myself with explosives and going out in a blaze of glory was the perfect way for a guy like me to go. But it didn't solve a damn thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我曾经想着身上装满炸药，出去扬名天下，是我这样的人最完美的死法。但这什么狗屁问题都解决不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Nothing's scared me in years. Except... that voice. Couldn't even understand what it was saying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 这么多年不存在让我害怕的东西。除了……那个声音。我甚至不理解它在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Getting pretty tired of humans. Might get myself a Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 等我实在厌倦了和人类打交道。我可能会养只库狛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Most of you kids made it. That's gotta be worth something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 你们这群小家伙中大多数都活下来了。这应该算点什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Grubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 拾荒小子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: I'll say this for the Zariman kids. They fought like demons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我要为「扎里曼号」的孩子们说一句。他们打起仗来像恶魔一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Grineer workers. With guns. Why would anyone be that stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: Grineer 工人。带着枪。怎么会有人这么傻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: It's a good thing we never made it to Tau. Too many weaklings on board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 幸好我们没能到 Tau 星系。船上的弱者太多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Can't believe the idiots who fitted out this colony ship thought we wouldn't need proper weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 简直不敢相信，那些为这艘殖民船提供配备的白痴竟然认为我们不需要趁手的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: This place is your home, grubber. You gonna let the Grineer and the Corpus help themselves to it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 这个地方是你的家，拾荒小子。你打算让 Grineer 和 Corpus 在这儿肆意妄为吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Can't do a Void-damned thing for the dead, but I mean to keep you from joining 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 对那帮死人我真的束手无策，但我不想你加入他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: They aren't making Grineer like they used to. The old ones could lose an arm and then keep on working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 现在的 Grineer 可大不如前。以前的款式可是少了条手臂还能继续干活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: A whole Empire, gone. Guess the Dax weren't so tough, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 整个帝国，消失了。想想那帮禁卫也不是那么难搞，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: This body of mine looks like flesh, but it ain't. You can hurt it real bad and it'll keep going. So trust me when I say these weapons have all been well tested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 我这副身体看着肉体凡胎的，但它不是。你可以把它毁得不成样子，但它仍会继续运作下去。所以相信我，这些武器都经过了良好的测试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Back in the day, Granum wanted me as an enforcer. Fat percentage and "special Corpus perks". But I told him where to stick it. I got standards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 先前，格拉努想让我成为一名执法者。油水丰厚外加"特殊 Corpus 津贴"。但我告诉他找别人吧。我有我的原则。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Don't bring your tales of sorrow to this door. You want tea and sympathy, go find Hombask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 不要把你的悲伤故事带进这扇门。你要是想要茶水和同情，去找霍姆巴斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Quinn and Yonta, down here in the garbage with the rest of us grubbers. Never get tired of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 奎因和扬塔，和我们这些捡破烂的一起躺在垃圾堆里。永远孜孜不倦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Goods are on the table. Let's talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 好货都在桌上。来聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Okay, what d'you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 来吧，你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Let's hear your requirements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 来聊聊你需要什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.text: Make your time count. You'll be a long time dead, grubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavIn.zhText: 珍惜你的时间，拾荒小子。比起死亡，人生不过是电光朝露。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavLo.text: Look, what do you want from me? 'Sorry I was such an asshole'? No. If I'd been less of an asshole, Margulis would have found a lot more dead kids on this ship. My way works. But... I'm glad I didn't scare you off. I'm pretty sure you've faced worse than me, anyway. Don't ever quote me on this, but... it's been an honor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavLo.zhText: 说吧，你想从我这儿得到什么？ "对不起，我真是个混蛋"？不。如果我不那么混蛋，Margulis 会在这艘船上发现更多死去的孩子。这就说明我的方法行得通。但是...... 我很庆幸我没有吓跑你。再说了，我很确定你遇到过比我更坏的人。永远不要说这是我说的，不过……这是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavNo.text: Admire all you like, but even my time shouldn't be wasted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavNo.zhText: 随便你看多久都行，但也别太耽误我时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavOp.text: Take a closer look if you need to.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavOp.zhText: 保证所有武器都经过了虚空洗礼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.text: Go forth and deal damage, grubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.zhText: 拿着它出去为非作歹吧，拾荒小子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.text: Once it's out of my hands, it's no longer my responsibility.
Reckon you can make that sing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.zhText: 我想你有办法让它唱歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.text: Take the time to build up a bond with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.zhText: 花点时间和它培养感情吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.text: Remember, these weapons aren't just hardware. They're alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DCavSa.zhText: 记着，这些武器不仅仅是装备。它们也活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.text: System's clean. Great work. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.zhText: 系统已经清理干净。干得好，继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.text: Job done. On to the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.zhText: 任务完成。前往下一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.text: This system's back online. Find us another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DData0.zhText: 系统已重新上线。去找另一台终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfOpe.text:
We can remember much of what happened. But the time of the... accident... is clouded for us, like cryo fog. It is as if the Void had to erase in order to create.

There's... material... the Angels secrete that functions like Aya. Yonta believes our lost memories are in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfOpe.zhText:
我们记得大部分之前发生的事情。但……那次事故……一直笼罩着我们，像霜雾一样迷离。好像必须抹去些什么虚空才能得以创造。

天使们产出的某种……材料……与阿耶精华有着相似的作用。扬塔认为我们丢失的记忆就蕴含其中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: Quinn is dead. Whatever guilt he bore should have died with him. So why does it still burn?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 奎因死了。无论他之前背负了什么愧疚之心，都应该随着一起离去了。可是为什么我的内心还有灼烧之感呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: Because we're not finished here. None of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 因为这里的事并没有结束，我们都还有心愿未了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: If we're talking redemption? Seems to me the dying's the easy part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我们是在谈论救赎吗？在我看来，死亡是最容易的部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: So this is our fate? Living out every day in a pantomime of contrition?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 所以这就是我们的命运？每天都活在忏悔的闹剧中？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: What, like you got something better to do? Quinn, wake up. Look at us. We're back to how we were! This ain't just a second chance, it's an eternity of second chances!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 怎么，难道你有更重要的事要干？奎因，醒醒。看看我们。我们又回到了原来的样子！这不仅是第二次机会，这是无限的第二次机会！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: Perhaps... Yes. Blame lingers... but so does duty. And who is to say that is not why we were recreated? The Indifference has awoken, and all of the Void's creations must find a light. Even ones we thought lost... in another time. Let eternity be our horizon. Until then: we shall Hold Fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 也许……是的。指责挥之不去……但使命也如影随形。谁能说这不是天将降大任于斯人？虚空无情之物已然苏醒，所有虚空创造物都必须寻找救赎之光。即使对于另一个时空的遗失之人。让永恒成为我们彼岸的地平线。在那之前：我们会坚守到底。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: The children barricaded themselves in. The parents were insane. Feral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 孩子们把自己关在了教室里。他们的父母都发疯了。充斥着野性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: But not us. And we couldn't forget our guilt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 但我们没有。我们无法放下这份愧疚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: So we tried to save the children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 所以我们尝试着去救下那些孩子们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: I watched the parents tear you to pieces, Hombask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 霍姆巴斯，我亲眼看见一对父母把你撕成了碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: Then when they threw themselves on you, you blew yourself up. And Quinn... the children didn't understand he was a friend. They blasted him to ash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 然后当疯狂的家长们扑向你的时候，你引爆了自己。还有奎因……那些孩子们没有意识到他是来救他们的。他们把他轰成了灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: And you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 那你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: An honor I did not deserve. I awarded myself the Jade Light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我收到了一个我本不应得到的荣誉。我给了自己翠玉之光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: They didn't go quietly, did they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 他们走得并不甘心，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: They all knew a big jump was coming. Not a safe, controlled sequence of bursts, but a single mad leap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 他们那时都知道要迎来一个大跳跃。不是一段安全可控的连续翻滚，而是一个疯狂的跳跃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: So the people found a thousand ways to say no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 于是大家找了一千个理由拒绝这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: And I denounced them as filthy traitors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我斥责他们是下流的叛徒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: You had no choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 那时的你别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: Eternalism dictates that we ALWAYS have choices. They believed me and now they're dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 永恒主义要求我们"永远"有选择。他们相信了我，现在他们都死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: I rounded the dissenters up. Made an example of the ringleaders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我逮捕了反对者。处理了带头的人来杀鸡儆猴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: You went about it like you were herding animals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 你像对待动物一样处理了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: I had my orders. YOUR orders. You may not have been Orokin, you pious bastard, but you were damn close. Liaison to the Expeditionary Command! Bearer of the Crystal Index!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 那是因为我收到了命令。你下的命令。或许你不是一名奥罗金，但你和他们也差不多了。你这个虔诚的混蛋，远征指挥部的走狗！晶辉名录的持有人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: My tablet. A swipe of my finger across a name... and the ship gained a new Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 在我的晶板上。只需我用手指轻轻扫过一个名字……这艘飞船就有了一个新的中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: The closer we came to the jump, the crazier it got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我们越临近跳跃，事态就变得越疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: I remember how everything changed when the agricultural biomes were hit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 我记得当农业生态圈受到袭击时一切都发生了变化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: And the people celebrated. Everyone thought we'd be going back home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 接着人们都在庆祝。每个人都以为我们会回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: But it just made the Orokin more determined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 但那只让奥罗金人变得更加坚定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: I thought I was saving us all, when I sabotaged the biomes. But then... the children began to starve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 当我破坏掉生态圈的时候，我以为我是在拯救大家。可是随后……孩子们开始饿肚子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.text: You don't blame the animal for gnawing its own leg off. You blame whoever set the trap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHfRan.zhText: 不要怪动物咬掉自己的腿，要找布下陷阱的人算账。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBa.text: Ahhh. You can never have too much stuff.
No contamination on any of this gear, at least not the dangerous kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBa.zhText: 这些装备中的任何一个都没受污染，至少不是危险等级的那种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBa.text: Come on by. Put your feet up.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBr.zhText: 这里麻雀虽小，五脏俱全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBr.text: Just let me know your budget, and we'll work magic together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBr.zhText: 只管告诉我你的预算，然后我们一起来将奇迹实现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBr.text: It's your Dormizone. You're in charge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomBr.zhText: 这是你的居住舱。你自己做主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomFi.text: Hey, welcome. If we'd ever made it to Tau, I was gonna be in charge of homesteading. Getting everyone kitted out for their new start, y'know? Well... you remember how that went. Shoot for the moon, land in a bucket of piss. So... in memory of the woman I was back when I was alive, I'm helping folks set up their homes here now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomFi.zhText: 嘿，欢迎来看我。如果我们顺利抵达 Tau 星系的话，我本来是要负责建造家园的。让每个人都为迎接新起点做好准备，知道吗？嗯......你记得后来发生了什么的。我们冲向了月球，落在一地狼藉里。所以......为了纪念我还活着的时候，我现在正在帮助人们在这里建立他们的家园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: You'll be here a while. Might as well look your best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 你会在这里待上一阵子的。不妨让自己看起来是最棒的状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: How come nobody ever asked me to sit for a portrait?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 怎么从来都没人要我留下一副肖像呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: Now, you mind your manners, and Prim here won't have to use her hose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 现在，你要注意你的举止，这样小春就不必拿出她的橡胶管了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: What can I furnish you with today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 我今天能为你提供什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: Everything you need to be comfortable and well dressed on a floating space tomb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 我这里有你在一艘漂浮的太空坟墓上，保持舒适整洁和穿着得体所需的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: You are looking damn well, considering. Here's to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 你看起来很棒，总体而言。敬我们一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: Damn Void gets into everything. Messes with your gear and messes with your head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 该死的虚空侵入了一切。弄乱你的装备，还有你的思想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: Not gonna run out of stock any time soon. This is a big-ass wreck. Loads left to salvage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 短时间内不会缺货了。这是一个超级大的残骸，有太多可回收的东西了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.text: How's your place coming along? Comfy enough for ya? You know you can always refit...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomIn.zhText: 你的住处进展如何？足够舒适吗？你知道的，你总是可以改造的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: Yes. I'm a reprobate. Void scum. Dripping from the drain of humanity. And you know what? I. Don't. Care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 是的，我是个弃子。虚空渣滓。正在一点点流失掉人性。不过你知道吗？我、不、在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: For IIII am the Queen of Junkheap Mountain and I bend the kneeee to none!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 因为我就是垃圾山女王，并且我绝不向任何人屈膝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: There's my buddy. They cut you from a different kinda cloth, didn't they? Shiny bright and tough as the devil's own ass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 我的好伙计。同人不同命，不是吗？你现在就像魔鬼的屁股一样闪亮又坚硬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: Always got time for you. You should have me over to that Dormizone of yours some time. I'll cook for ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 我总是有时间陪你的。你什么时候带我去你的居住舱，我给你做饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: I knew you were going to turn out to be a good 'un. Prim knew first. She's got a nose for the bad ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 我就知道你会成为一个好人。小春最先知道。她对坏人有敏锐的嗅觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: I wish all of the kids had turned out as sweet as you. Some of 'em, though... they miss the dark times. I could tell tales, if I had a mind to. Maybe when the time's right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 我希望所有的孩子都能长成像你一样。不过，他们有些人……还在怀念那段黑暗的时光。如果我想的，我也可以讲讲好听的故事。或许等时机成熟吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: I love it when you come around. It's like you're the kid I never got to pass on my own trauma to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 我喜欢你来拜访。你对我来说就像是我永远没机会把自己受到的创伤传递出去的晚辈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: Ya know... the best thing about the universe being infinite is that every little crumb of crap that's floatin' around gets an equal claim to be slap bang in the center of it. Even... me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 你知道……关于宇宙是无限的这一点最棒的事情是，每一个漂浮在周围的小碎屑都有平等的机会来宣称自己是世界的中心。即便是……我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: End of the day, we're all toys who've fallen off the shelf, carving out a new life among the dust and mouse bones. We ain't ever gonna get back up there, but y'know... at least we're free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 归根结底，我们都是从货架上掉下来的玩具，在尘土和老鼠骨头中开辟出新的生活。我们是永远不会回到那里的，但你知道的……至少我们是自由的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text: You really came through for us, kid. Brought back the me I thought was lost. Hope I'm worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText: 孩子，你真的为我们挺过来了。把我曾以为是那个迷失的我给带回来了。希望我值得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.text:
I opened the agri-biomes to space, y'know? Killed all the plants. Every last one. All withering death and frozen dust. I couldn't ever face that place again.

But... that was long, long ago. Turns out the biomes got resealed. Repressurized. I didn't know. Prim's drone friends, they've been working. Seeding. Tending. Caring. All this time. And I didn't know!

The biomes are green now. One day there's going to be a harvest. And I'm going to be here to see it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomLo.zhText:
你知道吗？我打开了农业生物圈的气密闸。杀死了所有的植物。一个不留。全是枯萎的死亡和冰冻的尘埃。我再也无法面对那个地方了。

但是……那是很久很久以前的事了。结果农业生态圈被封闭了起来。被重新增压。我都不知道。小春的无人机朋友，它们一直在运作。播种。抚育。照料。一直以来都是这样。而我却不知道！

现在这些生物群一片绿意盎然。总有一天会有收成的。我拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.zhText: 啊，我差点就能让你掏钱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.text: Damn, I need to up my selling game.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.zhText: 该死，我需要提高我的推销技巧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.text: Just don't ask Cavalero to assemble it for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.zhText: 别让卡瓦莱罗给你组装它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.text: There. Perfect excuse for a party.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.zhText: 好了。用于派对的完美借口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomOu.text: Get it home, set it up!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: Let's set you up with a whole new look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 让我们给你打造一个全新外观。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: No need to limit your imagination. These selections are Void-wild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 请放飞你的想象力。这些选项体现了虚空的天马行空风格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: You all ready for a transformation?
Think you look good already, huh? You're right. You do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 觉得你已经很好看了，是吧？你说得对。确实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: You take your time, it ain't going anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 你慢慢来，反正它也不会跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: 'Buy me! Buy me!' Listen to that. You made the stock sad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: "买我！买我！"快听，你伤了库存的小心心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: Not gonna make any mad impulse purchases, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 不会再冲动购物了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: You can never have too many fashion options.
This is your home, and if you want to design outfits all day, nobody can do a thing about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 这是你的家，就算你想整天呆在这设计时装，也没人能说什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: What look you going for? Sexy killer? That's what I'd do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 你想打扮成什么样？性感杀手？我要是你的话就选这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: Just because somethin' was never designed to be a fashion statement doesn't mean you can't use it as one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 就算它当时不是为这个目的设计的，不代表你不能将它开辟成一个时尚风格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: Any material's outfit material if you're brave enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 如果你足够勇敢，任何材料都能作为外观材质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.text: The Void gave us nightmares and monsters, but it also gave us amazing costume choices, so there's that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DHomVo.zhText: 虚空给了我们梦魇和怪物，但它也给了我们神奇的服装选择，这算是个好处吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.text: Housekeeping time. There's whole sectors of the Zariman whose systems rotted ever since the jump. I've prepped you a datamass that'll bring 'em back under our control, but you'll need to pop it in at the right nodes, and keep the system safe while it purges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.zhText: 大扫除时间。「扎里曼号」有一整片区域的系统自从虚空跳跃以来就已经腐烂了。我给你准备了一个数据块可以把它们重新归于我们的控制中，但你得把它放到正确的节点上，并且在它净化的过程中保证系统的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.text: We need to take back this ship one room at a time. That means getting back control of the network. That little datamass will scrub a whole sector clean if you can get it to the right port and let it work in peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.zhText: 我们需要按房间逐一收复这艘飞船。这意味着我们需要重新夺回网络的控制权。如果你能把这个小数据块送到正确的位置，并让它不受干扰地开始运行的话，那么它就能把整个区域都清理干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.text: Keeping our home in order means having control of the ship's systems. Right now, we don't have that. You're gonna have to go in with a datamass and manually bring consoles back online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DIntro.zhText: 让我们的家园保持整洁意味着我们需要拿到飞船系统的控制权。目前，我们还没有权限。你得带着一个数据块去到那里，然后手动让控制台上线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Impressive! You really studied The Palimpsest of Spacetime, didn't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 太棒了！你真的有好好学习《时空的重写性》，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Excellent work! You know, a lot of students struggle understanding reliquary field drives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 做得好！你知道，很多学生理解圣物装置起来都很费力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Well, it seems you've got the fundamentals of high-accuracy inertial navigation pretty well in hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 好吧，看来你已经熟练掌握了高精度惯性导航的基础知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I believe it was Archimedean Yonta who said, "If you possess a love of learning, then the whole cosmos is a classroom". Wait. No. That was me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我记得哲士扬塔说过，"你如果热爱学习，那么整个宇宙都是你的教室。"等等。不对。那其实是我说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I see we have some new faces joining us this semester. Let's all try our best to get along, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我看到这学期有些新面孔加入了我们。让我们都友好相处，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: If our most recent jump was a 99.999% success, what would you do differently next time to ensure that it was a 100% success?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 如果说我们最近一次的空间跳跃有 99.999% 的成功率，那么你如何确保它下次有 100% 的成功率？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Praise the Golden Masters for another glorious day of learning and adventure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 赞美黄金之主！又一个璀璨的学习和冒险的好日子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I must commend you for persisting with your education in spite of the current "unusual" conditions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 尽管我们目前正在经历着"不寻常"的情况，我必须表扬你仍旧坚持不懈地进行着学习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Remember: If you dream big and work hard, the blessed overlords may gaze upon you favorably!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 请牢记：如果你有远大的理想并为之努力，那么你就有可能受到黄金之主的青睐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I realize that Shawzin music is all the "craze" with you children, but let's not pluck away in lieu of our studies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 孩子们，我知道你们很"稀罕"三线琴音乐，但是也不能让它取代学习。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Oh no, nothing went wrong with the jump. It was merely a "bump in the road" to greater success.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 啊没事，跳跃没有出任何问题。刚才只是我们通向成功之路上的一个"突发事件"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: You're not skipping class for Lunaro, are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你不是要逃课去玩月动球吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Remember, student: learning is everywhere... except Tau; that's why we must bring enlightenment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 同学们，请牢记：随处都可以学到东西……除了在 Tau 星系。这就是我们必须给那里带去启蒙的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I think the best thing we can all do right now is concentrate on learning, OK?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我想我们现在能做的最好的事情就是专注于学习，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Attendance and promptness are important, not just in school but in life. That's a lesson Jenva and Mathon could stand to learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 出勤率和及时性都很重要，不仅是指在学校里，生活中也是这样。珍瓦和麦松可以好好学学这一课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Where are all your classmates? You know... Terolee and Nimian and Rell and the one with the, um, "unusually vibrant" hair?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你的同学都在哪？你知道的……特洛琳、尼米安、Rell，还有那个，唔，发型"异常鲜艳"的同学？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Never stop learning, child, because the universe never stops teaching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 孩子，永远不要停止学习，因为宇宙永远不会停止教授世人知识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Student, your assignment is overdue. Based on prescribed deductions, your grade is negative six-hundred forty thous- Oh dear, could that be correct?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 同学，你的作业交晚了。根据规定扣除分数，你的成绩是负六十四万——天哪，这是正确的数值吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Don't get too distracted, for it's only through hard work and determination that our sacred light will triumph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 不要太分心，因为只有通过努力和决心，我们的神圣之光才会胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Your organic brain's capacity for learning is virtually limitless, meaning every child has genius potential.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你的有机大脑有着无限的学习能力，这意味着每个孩子都具有成为天才的潜力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Zariman Ten Zero's school is the first to offer access to Albrecht Entrati's research archives. Aren't we lucky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 「扎里曼 10-0 号」上的学校是首个可供学生查看阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的研究档案的地方。我们很幸运，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: By the glory and wisdom of the Seven, if you put your mind to it, you can do it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 以七人众的荣耀和智慧之名，只要你用心去做，就一定能做到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I am so happy you're here! Now, have you seen where all the other students wandered off to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我很高兴你在这里！那么，你看到其他学生去哪儿了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Right on time, like always! I can't wait to see what we'll accomplish on the Zariman today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 一如既往，准时准点！我迫不及待地想看看我们今天将在「扎里曼号」上完成什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Now students, nobody's perfect... not even a Cephalon! It seems I have misplaced your Zarium Accolades. I know I had them safely stored, but something seems to have happened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 同学们听着，没有人是完美的……中枢更不是！看起来我搞丢了你们的耀金奖章。我知道我有把它们好好收起来，但似乎发生了一些事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Students, do any of you know where the Zarium Accolades are hiding? They don't seem to be where I left them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 同学们，你们知道耀金奖章藏在哪里吗？它们似乎不在我放置它们的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I am so glad you're here. I have a little task I need your assistance with. See you around the Zariman!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我很高兴你的到来。我有一个小任务需要你的帮忙。我们在「扎里曼号」见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Who's up for a scavenger hunt? It's for extra credit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 有谁想去寻宝吗？可以加分哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Wonderful! Your star is certainly on the rise, child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 太棒了！孩子，你绝对是一颗冉冉升起的新星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: During my long career, I've had the good fortune to teach many talented students, but you stand out in particular.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 在我漫长的职业生涯里，我有幸教过许多才华横溢的学生，你尤其突出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Splendid! I foresee an appearance on the Captain's List of Distinguished Students.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 棒极了！我预见到了一名将出现在"船长的优等生名录"上的学生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: You are learning your lessons so well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你学得真棒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Don't think your academic achievements aren't being noticed by the officers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 其实长官们已经注意到了你的学术成就。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: I am so encouraged by your progress. I'm sure the Golden Masters would be as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你的进步鼓舞了我。我确信黄金之主也会如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: As you can see: Being a student is the easy part; learning requires hard work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 正如你所见：做一名学生很简单，学习知识则需要下苦功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: My precepts state that I cannot have a favorite student, so I will just say that you rank among my favorite students.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 我的枢律说我不能有一个最喜欢的学生，所以我只能说你是我最喜欢的学生之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Well done! Who knows? Maybe someday, you'll walk the halls of House Entrati and access their great works!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 做的好！谁知道呢？说不定有一天，你能走进英择谛学派的大厅查阅他们的伟大成果！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: There you go! "A little progress each day adds up to big results!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 这不就行了！"不积跬步无以致千里！"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: By my precepts, I cannot directly compete with my fellow Cephalons, but I will merely observe that my students have earned more Zarium Accolades than Acetuma's have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 基于我的枢律，我无法直接与我的中枢同胞竞争，所以我只会观察"我的学生获得的耀金奖章比阿赛图玛的学生要多"这一现象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Ooh! I bet you can recite your antilogarithmic tables up to seven digits!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 哦！我敢打赌，你可以背出高达七位数的反对数表！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Someone's been doing their one-minute matrix decomposition drills!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 有人一直在做他们的一分钟矩阵分解练习！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Looks like you've got a good handle on your first-order differential equations!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 看来你已经能熟练解出一阶微分方程了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Do you have a Zarium Accolade for me? No? Well, I'm sure you just "temporarily misplaced" it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你有耀金奖章要交给我吗？没有？好吧，我确信你只是"暂时把它放错地方了"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Did you lose your Zarium Accolade? Try retracing your steps to the last place you saw it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你是否丢失了耀金奖章？请尝试回到你最后一次看到它的地方寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: No Zarium Accolade? Don't worry. It has to be around here somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 没有耀金奖章？别担心。它肯定就在附近的某个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Where's your Zarium Accolade?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 你的耀金奖章在哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Don't fret about losing your Zarium Accolade. Just remember things are often right where they're supposed to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 不要担心失去你的耀金奖章。请记住，东西会在原本的地方出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Very good indeed! A basic understanding of superfluid extra-dimensional physics will help you enormously in life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 非常不错！了解基本的超流体超维物理学将对你的生活有很大帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Ah, yes! Don't you think that the evolution of the common moonlight dragonlily is one of the universe's great miracles?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 啊对！你不认为常见月光龙百合的进化是宇宙中伟大的奇迹之一吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.text: Wow. Even I had a hard time with electrothermal atomic absorption spectrometry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMelic.zhText: 哇。即使是我，当初也很难理解电热原子吸收光谱法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.text: You just brought an entire sector back to functionality. I'm proud of you. Take a well earned break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.zhText: 你刚刚恢复了一整个区域的功能。我为你骄傲，好好休息一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.text: Old fashioned elbow grease and a bit of brute force can work miracles! Sector's ours. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.zhText: 老式的肘击和一点蛮力就能创造奇迹！这个区域是我们的了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.text: Systems are waking up across a whole sector. I'll send some cleaning drones in and get it ready for use. You did good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DMissi.zhText: 整个区域的系统都在苏醒中。我会派一些清洁无人机过来，把这里准备好给人用。你做得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Let all the System see that the Zariman is defended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 让星系中的所有人都看到「扎里曼号」被守护得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Shine that light of yours over here for a second.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 过来绽放你的光芒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Everyone pulling together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 大家齐心协力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The Zariman is holding steady.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 「扎里曼号」情况稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Come on. Plenty needs seeing to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 迅速些。还有许多要事需要处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Let's make this place work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 让我们把这个地方推上正轨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We need all the hands we can get.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们需要团结所有能帮到我们的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Go and visit Hell upon them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 去送他们进地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Remind them who the Zariman belongs to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 提醒他们「扎里曼号」属于谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Strike hard. No quarter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 严厉打击，绝不宽恕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Trusting you'll get it done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我相信你会完成它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We're all trusting in you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们都相信你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We stand or fall together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们共进退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Clear skies and steady rails to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 愿风和日丽，一路平安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: One hand for yourself, and one for the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 愿你与飞船同安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Travel well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 一路顺风。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Till next you return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 下次再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Glad you decided to stick around. This place, the Chrysalith, was meant to be a sanctuary. Now it's a war room. We're fending off Grineer raiders, Corpus salvage hunters, and of course, the Void Angels. Taking our home back is going to be a long, hard fight. I mean to make use of your exceptional talents wherever I can. Come and see me whenever you're ready for a bounty assignment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 很高兴你决定留下来。这个地方——羽化之穹，本该是一个避难，现在成了作战室。我们在抵御 Grineer 强袭者、Corpus 打捞猎人，当然，还有虚空天使。夺回我们的家园将是一场漫长而艰难的战斗。我会尽我所能发挥你的卓越才能。当你准备好接受赏金任务时，可前来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Every ship needs a figurehead. Executor Ballas presented us with sweet Gyra on the day of our departure. She spoke with her movement. Her dancing was meant to bring joy. But when we entered the Void... such madness, in one so gentle. The way you move now reminds me of her...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 每艘船都需要一个精神象征。在我们出发的那天，执行者 Ballas 向我们展示了甜美的盖拉。她的动作会说话。她的舞蹈是为了给人们带来欢乐。但当我们进入虚空时……如此温柔的人竟然有那般疯狂。现在你的一举一动都让我想起了她……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: This place is one bad decision away from heading straight back into hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 这个地方只要出一个差错便会直接跌回地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: While we sit here straddling the Rift, all possibilities are real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 像我们这样卡在狭缝两端，一切可能皆为真实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The Grineer keep throwing troops at the Zariman. Whatever the Worm's finding here, she wants more of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: Grineer 不断向「扎里曼号」派遣军队。无论蠕虫女皇在这里找到了何物，她总想着要更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Parvos Granum wants this ship for himself. We need to show him that she's taken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努想要将这艘船占为己有。我们得让他知道她是有主的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Please remember that your presence is enough to revive us. We won't ever leave you drained.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 请记住，你的存在就足以让我们振作起来。你尽力而为，不必力竭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The song tears at us slowly like hooks dragging through the flesh. Every time you silence one of them, it gets a little easier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 这首歌慢慢地撕开我们，就像钩子穿过肉体。每当你使其中一个静下来时，感觉会好受一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: This ship is now a fortress on the threshold, and we are her defenders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 这艘船就像是关口上的堡垒，而我们是她的守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Ready to deploy you wherever you can do the most good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 随时准备将你部署到最需要你之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The Albrecht Membrane is shot to hell. We're getting Void Flood alerts almost constantly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特膜质已变得残破不堪。我们不断地收到虚空洪流警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Void Cascades on multiple decks. We've got our work cut out for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 虚空覆涌从甲板上的多个位置倾泻而入。我们有的忙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Void Angels still trying to feed on the Reliquary Drive. How do we keep them out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 虚空天使仍然试图从圣物装置进食。我们怎么将他们赶走？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The tide is turning. I can feel it. We will reclaim this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 浪潮在转向。我能感觉到。我们会收回这个地方的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We have both been gifted a second chance. I perceive two Void silhouettes within you. Do you wonder which is the real one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们都得到了第二次机会。我感知到你体内有两道虚空的身影。你想知道哪个才是真实的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: All my days our Orokin overlords towered over us, and I woke to find their intended saviors had cut them down like overgrown weeds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 在我所有的日子里，我们的奥罗金霸主都高高在上，而我醒来时发现他们的救世主已经将肆虐杂草般的他们给割掉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: I share this eternity with every person I ever sentenced to be glassed. I can only hope theirs is a happier one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我与所有被我判决玻璃化之人一同分享这一永恒。我仅能希翼其永生不曾有苦痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: There are other debts than ours still to be paid. This is a place where great and terrible bargains were struck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 除了我们欠下的债务之外，亦有其余债务需偿还。此处见证了伟大的交易，与可怕的开端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: When the time comes to confront what waits beyond, we will stand with you just as you stood with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 当死亡之日来临，我们会陪伴在你身边，一如你曾与我们并肩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We are not altogether damned; we loyal few.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们并没有完全被诅咒，是因为我们几个人还保持忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: You will be tempted to look for familiar faces among the Angels. I beg you not to give in to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 你会很想在天使中寻找熟悉的面孔。我恳请你不要屈服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Look at us. A living dead man talking to a void-born paradox! This Universe surely is full of wonders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 看看我们。一个活死人在和一个虚空诞生的悖论者交谈！这宇宙着实充满了奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: I lost her twice. First to her gallant suitor, then to her father's ghost. By now she is surely dust with the rest of them. At least I can still listen to her voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我失去了她两次。第一次是因为她英勇的追求者，然后是她父亲的鬼魂。现在她肯定已经和其他人一起归入尘土了。但至少我还能听到她的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Ah. My favorite neighbor!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 啊。我最喜欢的邻居！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: There's my sturdy crewmate! Still ready to do what needs doing, even after doing so much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 看呐，是我坚韧不拔的船员！在贡献了如此多成就之后，仍旧准备好继续坚守岗位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Come, old friend. Let's get to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 来吧，老朋友。让我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: The struggle goes on, and we'll be the ones to finish it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 斗争仍在继续，我们会将其终结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Long before the Orokin, people believed in other gods. Invisible, often incomprehensible. But worthy of devotion. Because they invested life with meaning beyond a mortal lifespan. You and I walk in godless lands, my friend. We skirt the borders of a terror with no limit to its depth. And yet, I find I need no gods to bring meaning to my existence. You have done that. And if there were any gods to thank, I would thank them for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 早在奥罗金之前，人们就信奉其他神明。他们是无形的，也往往难以理解。但值得敬奉。因为他们给生命赋予的意义超越了肉眼凡胎。我的朋友，你和我都是行走在无神之地。我们绕过无穷恐惧的边界。然而，我发现我不需要神明来为我的存在带来意义。因为你已经带给我了。如果我有任何神明要感谢，那么我会为你而感谢他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Thank you for everything you've done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 谢谢你所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Shoulder to shoulder or back to back, the fight goes on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 肩并肩或背靠背，战斗仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: All four of us owe you a lot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们四人都欠你很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Save your strength for when it's needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 保存好你的力量，以备后用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: No problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Okay, I'll call on some of the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 好吧，我会去叫一些其他人来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Roger that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 收到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Pick your fights carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 慎重选择你的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Our stores aren't what they were, but this may be useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 我们的商店已经不是以前的样子了，但它还是能有所帮助的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: No point saving this stuff for Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 没必要将这东西留到 Tau 星系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Here's what we've got, such as it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 根据目前的情况，我们就只有这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: We should be doing more to recognise your work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 你的成就值得更多的认可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.text: Let's go forward in mutual trust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DQuinn.zhText: 让我们在相互信任中前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.text: There's a terminal! Plug in the thingy and keep it in one piece!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.zhText: 这有个终端机！插入那东西让它保持一体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.text: Terminal in sight. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.zhText: 发现终端机。你知道该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.text: You found a terminal. Pop the datamass in there and defend it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTermi.zhText: 你找到了一台终端。放入数据块并防御它免受侵扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Citizens. Colonists. In our name, you venture forth. In our honor, you will build. By our will, you are chosen. Our love is absolute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 公民们。殖民者们。靠着我们的名义，你们勇往直前。靠着我们的荣誉，你们将建造新的家园。以我们的意志之名，你们被选中了。我们的爱是纯粹的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: I, Executor Tuvul, would never condemn a mere citizen for being afraid. You stand upon the precipice. It is natural to tremble. But see that you set your jaws and hold your tongues. Do not infect others with your shameful misgivings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我，执行者涂沃，绝不会因为害怕而谴责一个普通的公民。你站在悬崖边上。自然会颤抖。但是请注意，你要咬紧牙关绝口不提。不要将你那可耻的疑虑传播给其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: We do not gamble with the lives of our beloved citizens. The jump will be over in a mere moment. Within this mighty metal heart, all of you are as safe as babes in arms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我们不会拿我们心爱的公民的生命作赌注。跳跃将在一瞬间结束。在这颗强大的金属心脏中，你们都像怀里的婴儿一样安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Since you citizens cannot be brave, since you refuse to stifle your infantile urges, howling and whining like ungrateful children, you shall be punished. Food is hereby restricted to one meal per day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 既然你们这些公民不够勇敢，既然你们克制不了自己的原始欲望，像忘恩负义的孩子一样嚎啕大哭，你们应该受到惩罚。因此饮食将限制为一日一餐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: We can see you, citizens. That is our burden. Our constant duty. We deserve to see your gratitude. Write it in smiles upon your upturned faces. Leave us in no doubt of your loyalty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我们可以看到你们，公民们。那是我们的负担。我们不变的职责。我们应该看到你们的感激之情。微笑着抬起你们的头。不要让我们怀疑你们的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Hear me, if you still can. Microscopic creatures live upon your skin, and yet you are oblivious to their existence. So it shall be with the Seven and yourselves. We wash our hands of you. The Zariman project is no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 听我说，如果你们还可以的话。微生物生活在你们的皮肤上，但你们却忘记了它们的存在。所以这也是七人众和你们的关系。我们要和你们划清界线。「扎里曼号」项目已不复存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: We stretched forth our Great Hands, shaped to match our generosity, and we gave. Such abundance! You citizens were to be the first to settle a new system! And now your bestial defiance has cast you into the pit. Come to those hands again, and you will find them closed to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我们向你们伸出了伟岸之手，因为我们如此宽宏大度，慷概赐予。如此富饶！你们这些公民本应成为首批定居新星系的人！而现在，你们的野蛮反叛带来了人间炼狱。现在你们还想再次紧握我们的双手，但你们会发现自己早已被拒之门外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: We are deathless, above you citizens as the mountain is above the ant, and yet we envy you, little people. How marvelous a thing it will be to dwell under an alien sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我们是不死之身，凌驾于你们公民之上，就像山峰在蚂蚁之上，然而我们却羡慕你们，市井小民。能够居住在外星太阳下将是一件多么美妙的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Whispers are the currency of the petty mind. Citizens who walk upright have no time for them. Root out treachery as you would root out a malignancy in your child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 流言蜚语仅能在小人之间传播。行得端正的公民们没有时间做这种事。像你会根除子女身上的肿瘤那样，除尽背叛行为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: On the eve of this great adventure, the first Void Jump beyond the cradle of the Origin System, we - the Orokin Seven - salute you, our brave citizen colonists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 在这次伟大冒险——跃出始源星系怀抱的首次虚空跳跃——即将进行的前夜，我们——奥罗金七人众——向你们致敬，我们勇敢的公民殖民者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: We have learned that some of you consider the jump too dangerous. Remember, citizens. The air you breathe aboard the Zariman is not free. It is a luxury you are permitted to indulge in, and like any privilege, it can be revoked. Be aware of this danger, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 我们了解到，你们之中有些人认为进行跳跃这件事太危险了。公民们，记住：你们在「扎里曼号」上呼吸的空气是有代价的。那是一种我们允许你们放纵享受的奢侈品，就像任何特权一样，它是可以被撤回的。你们也要意识到这种危险才好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: The future of the Origin system is... uncertain. Some think it is destined to burn. I still have faith, and you fortunate colonists are the reason. With your help. We will outgrow this crowded nest, spread our wings to the cosmos, and take flight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 始源星系的未来是……不确定的。有人认为它注定要燃烧。我仍然有信心，而你们这些幸运的殖民者就是原因。在你们的帮助下。我们将摆脱这个拥挤的巢穴，向着宇宙张开翅膀，然后翱翔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Those citizens who follow after you, secure in the comfort of an extrasolar Rail, will wish they had shared in your hardship. How reverently they will speak of those who blazed the trail! How prized your simple genetic stock will be!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 那些跟随在你们身后的公民，在舒适的太阳系系外轨道上安然无恙，希望他们能分担你们的艰辛。他们会多么恭敬地谈论那些开辟道路的人！你们的普通基因样本将会是多么的珍贵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: Citizens, be aware. You will never be out of our reach. If you squander this venture, you will know no forgiveness. We have your names; our loyal servants stand ready to punish your families at our word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 公民们，请注意。你们永远逃不出我们的手掌心。如果你们浪费了这次冒险，你们将不会被宽恕。我们知道你们的名字；我们忠诚的仆人将随时待命，按我们的吩咐去惩罚你们的家人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.text: How dare you fear? What do you imagine you have to lose? You citizens are born to die; such is your lot! But even such a death as yours may be meaningful if it serves Us. In this alone is your salvation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DTuvul.zhText: 你们怎么敢害怕？你们以为自己还有什么可失去的吗？你们这群公民生来就是为了迎接死亡的，这就是你们的命运！不过，即使是你们这般平常的死亡，如果能为我们七人众效忠的话，那么也可能会有所以意义。只有这样才是你们的救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Void readings are normal. That's nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 虚空读数正常。很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: If the Archimedean Seniors could see me now...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 要是哲士前辈们现在能看到我就好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Still not used to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我还是不习惯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Why does it feel like we're moving?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 为什么感觉我们在移动？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Talk to me. I won't eat you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 跟我聊聊。我又不会吃了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Membrane's still holding... for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 膜质仍旧坚挺……目前来说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Look at all the precious little nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 看看这些"可爱的"小梦魇们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: If you have specimens, I'm deeply interested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 如果你有样本的话，我很感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Let's see what twisted wonders the Void has created.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 让我们看看虚空创造了哪些扭曲的奇观。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Reconstruction of the past is possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 重塑过去是可行的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Whatever damage time has done, we can undo it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 无论时间造成了什么伤害，我们都可以修复它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Oh! Goodbye, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 噢！那么，再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I'll... see you later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我们……一会儿见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Yes. Goodbye for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 是的。后会有期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Before you ask, no, we can't move the ship. Something I wasn't sure existed has burst through the Albrecht Membrane, and right now the Zariman is plugging that hole. Pop her out, and we'd see Void Storms from here to Mercury. Which would be fascinating, if memorably horrible. Anyway. Feel free to bring me anything you think I might be interested in. That's all!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我知道你想问什么，不行，我们不能挪开飞船。某些我之前不确定存在的东西击穿了阿尔布雷希特膜质，然后现在「扎里曼号」正堵着那个洞。要是把她弹出来的话，我们就能看到从这里一直穿透到水星的虚空风暴。如果你喜欢难忘且可怕的记忆的话，那这个体验会很迷人。总之，欢迎给我带来任何你觉得我可能会感兴趣的东西。就这样吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Objects that have affected one another continue to affect one another even when they're separated. I've missed you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 相互影响的对象即使分开，也会继续相互影响着。我已经在想念你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I wonder if I'll still be here at the heat death of the Universe, pondering the blue twilight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我不知道我是否还会在宇宙的热寂中，沉思着蓝色的暮光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: You've seen things in the Deep Void too, haven't you? Lashing like dragons and bellowing like giants?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 你也见过虚空深处的东西，对吗？就像巨龙的冲击和巨人的咆哮？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: There will never be another Archimedean Symposium. No more waiting, petrified, to find out if it's you the Golden Lords are singling out this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 永远不会再有另一个哲士研讨会了。不用再提心吊胆地等着，看这次黄金之主是不是针对你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I think you'd have liked me, back when I was human. I mean, I hope you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我想当我还是人类的时候，你会喜欢我的。我的意思是，我希望你会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Rydal and Mohler, Kazirei, Suda, Tylan, Halako and Vrenn. All the shining Archimedeans. Where are they all now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 瑞德和莫勒、卡兹瑞、苏达、泰兰、 哈拉科和弗伦。所有闪耀着智慧光辉的哲士们。他们现在都在哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I'd figured it out! How the Zariman could jump all the way to Tau in one big bold leap, disabling the safeties in sequence. If I had it to do again, we could make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我想通了！「扎里曼号」如何能以一个大胆的飞跃一下子跳到 Tau 星系，依次禁用安全机制。如果让我再做一次，我们可以做到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I never liked to stay too long in the Reliquary Drive chamber, even when I was alive. I kept thinking I could see myself out the corner of my eye, grinning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我从不喜欢在圣物装置室呆太久，即使在我生前也是一样。我一直在想我是不是可以从眼角看到自己，在咧着嘴笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I had the Albrecht Entrati dream again. It's always the same. I ask him where he's gone, and he says 'Everywhere'. Then... he tears himself in half.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我又做了那个关于阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的梦。它总是一样的。我问他去哪儿了，他说"所有地方"。然后……他把自己撕成两半。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: There are whole decks, empty except for the Angels. They're singing, like something big is coming. So that's good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 整个甲板都是空的，除了天使在游荡。他们在歌唱，像是有什么大事要发生了。呵呵真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: The hours I spent struggling to understand Eternalism, and here you are, embodying it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我花了好几个小时去努力理解《永恒论》，然后你就体现了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: This place is like an embassy. Playing host to misfit realities that were never chosen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 这个地方就像一个大使馆。用来主持那些从未被选中的现实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: So many intersections. Planes and possibilities. Hazard and luck and intent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 这么多交集，位面和可能性。充斥着危险、好运和真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: They hunt you, don't they? The Angels? Do they ever say anything to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 他们在追捕你，不是吗？是天使们吧？他们有没有对你说过什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: It's funny how we're both Void constructs, sort of. Difference being that I'm dead. Not your fault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 有趣的是，我们都是虚空造物，算是吧。区别在于我已经死了。不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Do you ever just wish you were a Cephalon, so you could switch bits of you off?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 你有希望过自己是个中枢吗？这样你就能部分关机了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Please be kind. My head is very noisy right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 请对我好点。我的脑子里现在很吵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Somewhere there's a version of me who stayed behind on Lua, and I hate her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 在某个平行宇宙里，有一个我留在了月球，我讨厌她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Sharded causalities piled up in the Heilbronn margin, singularity refusing to play with any of them... oh, the Universe is a messy place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 碎片化的因果关系堆积在了海布隆的边缘，奇点拒绝与他们任何一个产生关联……哦，宇宙真是个混乱的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: It's worth it. All of the headaches and frustration and being wrong over and over is worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 这很值得。所有的头痛、沮丧、和一次又一次的错误都是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: This... is the first time being alive has really felt like being alive, for me. I'm intact. Recovered. Like some complicated, fragile relic gently lifted up from the earth and brushed clean of all the dirt. If I'm not careful, I could end up saying something very stupid and rash. So I won't. I'll just say thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 这……对我来说，是第一次真正体会到活着的感觉。我完好无损。恢复如初。就像某些复杂又脆弱的圣物，被轻轻地从大地中拎起，洗刷净所有的污垢。如果不注意，可能最后我会说一些非常愚蠢鲁莽的话。所以我不会这样做。我只会说声谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: I suppose you could always come back when you have something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我想当你有了某些东西后，你可以再回来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Very well. Keep your secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 很好。保守你的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: My patience is almost endless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 我的耐心几乎是无穷无尽的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Fascinating!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Ah, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 啊，感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.text: Let's open this up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DYonta.zhText: 让我们打开它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Good. Now it'll stay hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 很好。现在它会一直受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: That's the way. Break it down, body and soul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 就是那样。从肉身到灵魂，粉碎它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Yes! It won't be shrugging that off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 好！这样它就摆脱不了了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You weren't fast enough. Now it's healed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你速度不够快。它现在已经痊愈了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The Angel has almost recovered! Hurry this up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 天使几乎要恢复了！搞快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Grubber. The Angel is trying to retreat into the Void so it can heal. Follow it and stop it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 拾荒小子。天使正试图撤退到虚空里恢复。跟上并且阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Confirming a Void Angel at your location!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 虚空天使出现在了你的位置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reading Void Angel signature, heading right for the Reliquary!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 正在读取天使的信号，前往圣物装置中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: A Void Angel just woke up and is looking to snack on the Relic!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 一个虚空天使刚刚醒来，正要从圣物进食！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You can't hurt it while those dimensional orbs are out. Use your Void body to absorb them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 当那些次元球体出现时，你就不能伤害它。用你的虚空之躯吸收它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You got some Argozene. Go build.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你获得了一些氩烯，去建造军备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The more Argozene you have, the more armaments you can construct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你拥有越多氩烯，就能建造越多的军备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Dropping off an Argozene canister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 正在投放氩烯罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Topping up nearby Argozene.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 正在补满附近的氩烯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reckon you could use more Argozene.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 估计你可以使用更多的氩烯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Argozene canister inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 氩烯罐即将到达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Resupplying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 补给中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: More Argozene. Don't waste it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 还有更多氩烯。别浪费了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Exodamper down. You just gave them a clear path to the drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置损耗。你刚刚为他们的行动扫清了道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Exodamper disabled. Do a better job protecting the drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置已禁用。接下来要努力保护好圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Exodamper out of action. Watch that flank!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置已停止运作。注意旁边！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Took down an Exodamper. Gettin' stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 敌人拿下了一个抑制装置。也变得更强了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: One less Exodamper. That's a boost to the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 少一个抑制装置。就会让敌人更强了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Exodamper clear of hostile forces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置已不受敌对势力威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You kept that Exodamper standing. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你让那个抑制装置继续运作下去了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The Exodamper made it. But they'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置撑过来了。但他们还会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Do not let this wave of scum take out that Exodamper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 不要让这群垃圾破坏那个抑制装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: They're hitting an Exodamper. Hit them first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 他们正在攻击抑制装置。先打他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Exodamper under threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 抑制装置受到威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Get ready. Enemies inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 做好准备。敌人来袭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: They're throwing more losers at ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 他们在向你派出更多渣滓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Don't let up. More no-marks incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 不要放弃。更多炮灰要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Brace for a fresh wave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 迎接新一轮的攻势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Protect your Exodampers!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 保护抑制装置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Angels feeding off the drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 天使们在圣物装置上进食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Stop that Angel now or we're all finished!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 立刻阻止那个天使，否则我们就完了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Stop that Void Angel from feeding, Grubber!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 拾荒小子，阻止那个虚空天使进食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: That Angel is full up. It's over. Get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 那个天使汲取够了。都结束了。离开那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: That Angel compromised the Reliquary. Retreat and regroup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 那个天使破坏了圣物装置。撤退并重新集结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: It's over, damnit. The Angel has fed. This is my fault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 一切都完了，该死的。天使喂饱了。这是我的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: They are ripping that Relic wide open!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 他们正在撕开那个圣物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Relic's barely hanging on, Grubber. Hope you got a miracle in ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 拾荒小子，圣物勉强能撑下去。希望奇迹会发生在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Relic is almost destabilized. This is not sustainable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物的稳定性几乎被破坏殆尽。不能再这样继续下去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The Relic's taking a pounding, Grubber! You're meant to stop that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 拾荒小子，圣物受到重创！你得阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The Relic cannot endure this amount of punishment! Do better!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物无法承受这么多的攻击！给点力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: If they destabilize the Relic, this mission's a failure. It cannot defend itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 如果他们破坏了圣物的稳定性，这个任务就失败了。它又不能自己保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: They destabilized the Relic. We're done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 他们破坏了圣物的稳定性。我们完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary compromised. Get your stuff and clear out. We failed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置受损。带上你的东西去撤退。我们失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Guess it was all too much for ya. They won; we lost. Go lick your wounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 看来这对你来说太难了。他们赢了；我们输了。回去一个人舔伤口吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You let them destabilize the Relic, but it'll recover with time. Get out of there while you still have your skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你让他们破坏了圣物的稳定性，但它会随着时间的推移而恢复。趁你还能全身而退的时候离开那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary compromised. Nothing more you can do. Find self-extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置已受损。你在这里并不能做什么。自行撤退去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: It's over. Nothing more you can do right now. Self-extract and regroup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 都完了。你现在也无能为力了。自行撤退并重新集结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Squad incoming. Defend the Reliquary!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 小队来袭。保护圣物装置！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary is exposed! Enemies inbound!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置暴露了！敌人来袭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Enemy have exposed our Reliquary. Get it defended!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 敌人发现了我们圣物装置。保护好它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Another wave incoming. Reliquary is vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 又有一波敌人来袭。圣物装置不堪一击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Not done yet. More coming. Prioritize the Reliquary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 这还没完。更多敌人要来了。优先保护好圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You'll need Argozene. I'm sending you a canister now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你需要氩烯。我现在给你送一罐去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Good work, grubber. Here's where we divide the spoils. Extract if you want, or hold out for more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 拾荒小子，干得好。这是我们分配战利品的地方。如果你想的话可以撤离，或者继续下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You won us some breathing space and a share of what we were able to loot from them. Extract when you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你为我们赢得了一些喘息的空间，以及从他们身上能收获到的战利品份额。当你准备好就撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: They committed so many troops to this attack, they forgot to defend their crewships. Here's your share. You're clear to extract.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 他们为这次袭击投入了如此多的军力，从而忘记了防守他们自己的战舰。这是你的奖励分成。你现在可以安全撤退了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Corpus attack inbound. They're targeting the Reliquary, and the Angels will take notice. Build armaments, safeguard the Exodampers, and keep the drive stable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: Corpus 攻击来袭。他们的目标是圣物装置，这会引起天使的注意。建造军备，保护抑制装置，并确保圣物装置稳定运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Grineer are attacking the Reliquary Drive again. That's waking the Angels. Deploy Armaments and keep the Exodampers online. Protect that Drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: Grineer 又在攻击圣物装置了，他们的行动正在唤醒天使。部署军备并让抑制装置保持在线状态。保护好那个圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: The longer you hold the fort, the more we can loot from our would-be boarders. Hope you're having as much fun as I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你坚守阵地的时间越长，我们就能从尝试登船的敌人身上收获越多。希望你和我一样玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: While you're keeping them busy, we're helping ourselves to their stuff. You get a cut, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 当你在拖住他们的时候，我们正大肆搜刮他们的物品。当然，你也会得到你那份分成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: All the fighting down there in Oro Works is one hell of a useful distraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 奥金工场上的所有战斗都是一种非常有用的分散注意力的方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Look what uncle Cavalero found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 来看看卡瓦莱罗叔叔找到了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: I'll put this on the pile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 我会把这些和其他战利品放在一堆里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Don't let success go to your head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 不要让成功冲昏了头脑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Don't even think of throwing in the towel now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 现在就别想着认输！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Well, look at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 好吧，看看你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: You gotta wonder what possessed these goons, thinking they could gain mastery over the Void. Heh. Maybe some of them are possessed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 你一定想知道是什么支配了这些暴徒，甚至觉得他们可以掌控虚空。哈哈。也许他们中的一些人被支配了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: There's some kind of a fire in these no-hopers, pushing them. I can't work it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 这些毫无希望的人身上有火种一样的东西驱使着他们。我理解不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: These wasters are fighting like their lives don't matter. They're driven. I've seen that kind of fury on this ship before... once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 这些废物不要命地战斗。他们被操纵了。我以前在这艘船上……见过一次这样的愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Don't give these fools you're slaughtering a second thought. The Void's already starting to take them. I can feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 不要对这些傻瓜留情。虚空已经开始蚕食他们了。我能感觉到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary ahead. Exodampers blunt enemy capability. They'll target them first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置在前方。抑制装置削弱了敌人的能量。他们会先干掉抑制装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Enemies will hit our Exodampers first, so they can fight unimpeded. Then they'll target the Reliquary Drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 敌军会首先攻击我们的抑制装置，以便他们能畅通无阻地继续战斗。之后他们就会瞄向圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Defend the Reliquary, but don't neglect the Exodampers. Their fields keep enemies on the back foot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 保卫圣物装置，但也别忽视抑制装置。在抑制装置的区域内敌人处于劣势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Armaments in position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 军备已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Defensive ordnance complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 防御火炮锻造完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Armaments constructed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 已开始建造军备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Construction complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 建造完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Deployable defenses in place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 可部署的防御措施已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary is secure. You did good, Grubber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置已安全。拾荒小子，你做得很好。
