/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Reliquary is safe. Don't go looking all smug about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 圣物装置是安全的。不过不要为此沾沾自喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.text: Not bad. Room for improvement, but not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarAr.zhText: 不错。有改进的余地，但还不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Void Cascade is nearing the tipping point. You are about to face irreversible contamination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空覆涌已接近临界点。你马上会面临不可逆转的污染。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Cascade is approaching critical levels. Your time is running out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 覆涌正在接近临界水平。你的时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: The enemy has triggered the release of a Possessed Exolizer. Purge it before it pumps out even more Void Contamination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 敌人已经触发了一个受侵噬的无垢装置。在它释放出更多的虚空腐蚀之前将其清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Possessed Exolizer located. Purge it and make it work for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 已定位被侵噬的无垢装置。净化它并使它为我们效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Marking a possessed Exolizer. Deal with it while you still can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 正在标记一台被侵噬的无垢装置。趁你能力还够的时候处理掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: The Void Cascade has just hit a new level of intensity. Be careful. We have no idea what it could manifest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空覆涌已经达到了一个全新的强度。小心点，我们不知道它会显化出什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Contamination just spiked. Keep your wits about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 污染程度刚刚飙升。保持理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Readings are off the charts. I don't know what sort of nightmares you might encounter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 读数已破表。我不知道你会遇到怎样的梦靥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Void Contamination critical. Do these invaders have any idea what demons they have invoked upon us all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空污染指数已达到致命范围。这些入侵者知道他们召唤了什么样的恶魔出来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Spent Exolizer has been retired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 耗尽的无垢装置已退役。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer spent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置已耗尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: We are down an Exolizer. Working on backups.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 我们失去了一台无垢装置。正在处理备用装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: You're cleared to self-extract when you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 准备好后，你就可以自行撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: I've opened an Extraction route. Your choice when to use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 我开启了一条撤离路线。你可以选择何时使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Extract yourself when you need to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 记得在需要的时候撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: The Void Cascade has surpassed the tipping point. It's lethal now. Leave the area while you still can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空覆涌已经超过了临界点。达到致命浓度。在你还能离开的时候撤离该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Kid? Tenno? Say something. Can you hear me? KID!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 孩子？Tenno？说点什么。你能听到吗？孩子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Hey. Talk to me! Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 嘿，给我回话！噢不……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Hey... kid... you can't give up on me now. KID?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 嘿……孩子……你现在还不能放弃。孩子？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: That Possessed Exolizer is spitting out contamination. Use your Void power to purge it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 那个被侵噬的无垢装置正在释放出污染。用你的虚空之力来净化它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Our enemy has abandoned valuable supplies. This is yours now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 我们的敌人放弃了宝贵的物资。现在是你的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: The Corpus have triggered the deployment of Thrax Possessed Exolizers. Deployed altogether, they will cause an instant Void Cascade. I can stagger their deployment, give you time to purge them, so they can cleanse the ship instead of corrupting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: Corpus 触发了受凶魂侵噬的无垢装置部署计划。完全部署后，它们会立即引起一场虚空冲击波。我可以牵制他们的部署计划，为你赢得一些净化装置的时间，这样它们就可以净化飞船而非污染她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Grineer meddling with the Reliquary Drive has triggered a Void Cascade. Purge our Exolizers and keep them purged, so they can stop the Cascade getting out of hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: Grineer 对圣物装置的染指触发了一场虚空覆涌。净化无垢装置并使其保持净化状态，这样才能阻止覆涌失控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Any nearby attackers will degrade the Exolizer's performance. Clear them out to get the system working full-steam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 附近的任何攻击者都会降低无垢装置的效能。除掉它们来使系统全力运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: If you can kill Grineer close to the Exolizer, it'll pull the Void contamination right off of them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 如果你在无垢装置附近杀死 Grineer，它就能消除他们身上的虚空污染！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Now the Exolizer's purged, any casualties you inflict within its field will bring the contamination level down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置现在已经被净化了，你在它的影响范围内造成的任何伤亡都会降低污染程度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Contamination subsiding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 污染正在消退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Void Cascade losing steam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空覆涌正逐渐失去动力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Void contamination dropping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 虚空污染指数正在下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Cascade receding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 覆涌正在退去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer purged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 已净化无垢装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: That Exolizer is working for us now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 那个无垢装置现在是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer is ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置已上线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer suppressed. Purge it before it makes the contamination worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置被抑制了。在污染恶化之前净化它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: We just lost an Exolizer to possession. Get it back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 我们刚刚失去一台无垢装置。把它夺回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Contamination spreading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 污染正在扩散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Cascade intensifying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 覆涌正在加剧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Contamination levels going in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 污染水平正朝着错误的方向发展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: This cascade is growing out of control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 这个覆涌已逐渐失控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: This discovery might interest you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 你或许会对这个发现感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Enemy bounty secured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 已斩获敌人赏金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Struggle has its benefits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 争斗自有其益处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Ah. The Void has manifested something other than a nightmare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 啊，虚空显化了梦魇之外的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Our enemy's folly is your gain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 敌人之愚蠢即为你之收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: See what you make of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 让我们来看看你会怎么用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: That got their attention. Enemy forces moving to your location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 那引起了他们的注意。敌军正向你袭来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Destabilizing the Zariman is a foolhardy strategy. The Void has already started to degrade our enemies' judgment. You did well to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 破坏「扎里曼号」稳定性的策略可谓鲁莽，虚空已开始削弱敌人的判断力了。你阻止了他们，做得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: You did everything you could. I've secured enough cleansed Exolizers to keep the cascade at bay for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 你已竭尽所能。我获得了足够的洁净无垢装置来暂时阻止覆涌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Good work. You did all you could out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 干得好。你竭尽全力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: A Void manifestation is possessing an Exolizer. Stop it before it feeds the cascade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 一个虚空显化者正在侵噬一台无垢装置。在它馈入覆涌之前阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer succumbing to Void possession.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 一台无垢装置正在受到虚空的侵噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Exolizer under assault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 无垢装置正在遭受攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Keep those manifestations away from the Exolizers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 让这些显化者远离无垢装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.text: Those Void nightmares are hellbent on one thing: manifesting more nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarCa.zhText: 那些虚空梦魇一心只想着一件事：显化更多的梦魇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Don't slow down now. Body count can go way higher.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 现在不要慢下来。尸体数量还可以叠得更高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: So long as they keep coming, you keep killing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 只要他们继续上，你就继续杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: No flagging. You're my favorite little meat grinder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 不要松懈。你是我最爱的小绞肉机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Don't let your weapons cool down. Lots more fighting to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 别让你的武器凉下来。还有很多硬仗要打。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Greedy, plundering Corpus bastards have come aboard without permission. Mow them down without a second thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 贪婪、掳掠的 Corpus 混蛋未经许可就上船了。要毫不犹豫地把他们赶下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: These Corpus ain't here to trade. They're looking to steal, from us. Give 'em hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 这帮 Corpus 不是来做生意的。他们想从我们这里偷东西。让他们见鬼去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: We got a bunch of Granum clowns looking for easy salvage. We are nobody's free lunch. Bust some heads.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 有一堆格拉努小丑在白拿回收金属。我们这儿没有白吃的午餐。打爆他们的头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: These Grineer grunts are hunting for Kuva on our ship. Get in there and carve 'em up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 这些 Grineer 步兵正在我们的飞船上寻找赤毒。进入那里然后解决掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Boarding party. Grineer clones. Half rotten already. Wipe 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 登船小队。Grineer 克隆人。已经腐烂了一半。除掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Grineer only understand violence. Show them they don't belong in our home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: Grineer 只懂得暴力。让他们知道这不是他们的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Granum can mark this one down as a net loss. Corpus forces retreating. You did good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 格拉努这次妥妥地亏本了。Corpus 部队在撤退。你做得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Corpus goons are going back to daddy Parvos empty-handed. You sent 'em running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: Corpus 走狗空着手就回他们帕尔沃斯爸爸那了。你打跑了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Busted helmets and boots full of blood, all over the deck. Corpus are broken. I'm kind of impressed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 到处都是染血的残盔破甲。Corpus 被干翻了。我还真有点惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: Ahh, they finally got the message. Grineer are backing off. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 哎呀，他们终于开窍了。 Grineer 正在撤退。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: You broke 'em. Nice. Keep hitting 'em hard enough and eventually they get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 你把他们打垮了。漂亮。继续使劲打他们，最后他们就会明白的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.text: They wanted to do things the hard way, and now they're done. Grineer are pulling out. Great job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarEx.zhText: 他们想强取豪夺，现在没戏了。 Grineer 正在撤退。做得真棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I designed this system to deliver Vitoplast directly to Void Ruptures. Would have been nice if that design worked in practice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我设计这个系统是为了将修复凝剂直接输送到虚空裂口。如果这个设计在实践中有效，那就太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Vitoplast is everywhere except for where it should be. Grab some and stuff it in a rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 修复凝剂无处不在，只除了它应该在的地方。拾取一些修复凝剂，然后塞进一处裂口里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: For more Vitoplast, try looking up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 需要更多修复凝剂，到处寻找试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: In retrospect, engineering Vitoplast to float was a mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 回想起来，将修复凝剂设计为浮动状态是个错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Collect every bit of Vitoplast you can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 收集你能找到的每一滴修复凝剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Did you... have a chance to ask it where it came from before you killed it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你……有没有在杀死它之前问它是从哪里来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Interesting. They can be destroyed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 有意思。它们可以被摧毁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Well. That's one less Void abomination to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 好吧。这样就少了一个需要担心的虚空极恶之物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I do not know where that thing came from but it will not be going back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我不知道那东西是从哪来的，但它不会回去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Void Floods have a tendency to wash in terrible things. One of those things is approaching. Do be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空洪流会将大量可怕的东西冲刷进来。其中一个正在逼近。一定要小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: You may notice your combat conditions worsening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你可能会注意到你的战斗条件在恶化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Something just changed. Any fighting difficulties to report?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 情况刚刚发生了些变化。有什么战斗里遇到的困扰需要报告吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Void Saturation causing further complications.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空浓度正在导致情况进一步恶化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Should you need a break, self-extract at the marked location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 如果你需要休息，请在标记的位置自行撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: You can always do more. But if you can't, I have marked an extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你总是可以完成更多的。不过如果不行的话，我标记出了一个撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I have opened an escape lift for you. Use it... when you need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我为你开启了一架逃生电梯。在你需要的时候……使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Damn the Void. Not another one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 该死的虚空。又失败一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Oh. If we had an ethics board, I would definitely get written up for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 啊，如果我们的飞船上有个德育委员会，我肯定会因为这个被记上一笔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Tenno. Are you... oh dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: Tenno。你是……天哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I said get to extraction... Why does no one ever listen to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我明明说了快去撤离……为什么没有人听我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: The Angels have torn open another rupture. Fill it with Vitoplast before this whole ship goes topsy-turvy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 天使们又撕开了另一个裂口。在整艘船变得颠簸之前用修复凝剂来填上它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Oh look. You sealed a rupture. Not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 哦，看。你关闭了一个裂口。不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Wow. Vitoplast sealed that rupture! Just as I knew it would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 哇。修复凝剂封住了裂口！我就知道它可以的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Ruptured sealed. On to the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 裂口已封闭。前往下一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Rupture closed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 裂口已封闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I think you're carrying enough, don't you? Bring it to a rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我认为你已经有足够多了，不是吗？把它带到裂口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Don't get greedy. Take all that Vitoplast to a rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 不要贪心。将所有修复凝剂带到裂口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Don't think you can carry anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 不要以为你可以再携带更多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Think you got enough for now. Maybe feed it to a Rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你现在有的应该足够了。试着把它投喂给裂口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: That should keep Skittergirl away for a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 那样应该会让疾行女远离一会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: She's gone. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 她消失了，至少目前是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Think you taught Skittergirl a lesson? She never learns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你不会以为给了疾行女个教训吧？她从来都是记吃不记打。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Scratch one anxiety fueled poltergeist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 除掉一名被焦虑滋养的捣蛋鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: You've strayed from your squad and Skittergirl has taken notice. Watch your stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你已经偏离了你的小队，疾行女已经注意到了。看好你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Skittergirl likes to target stragglers. Like you. Right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 疾行女喜欢锁定落单的人。比如，现在的你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Observation: Skittergirl is stalking you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 观察心得：疾行女正在跟踪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: You lost Skittergirl. Wish I could do the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你摆脱了疾行女。真希望我也能摆脱她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Skittergirl has disappeared back to whatever corner of the Void she emerged from.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 疾行女消失了，回到了她从虚空里冒出来的某个角落里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Wish I could shake my anxieties as easily as you shook off Skittergirl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 真希望我能像你摆脱疾行女一样，摆脱掉我的焦虑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: I'm so very sorry about this. One of the fears the Void likes to manifest is childhood anxiety. Meet the repressed fears of teenage Yonta. I call her Skittergirl. She's a thief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 我对此感到非常抱歉。虚空最喜欢显化出的恐惧之一就是童年的焦虑。见见我扬塔少女时期被压抑的恐惧吧。我叫她"疾行女"，她是个小偷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: The Angels are clawing at the Albrecht membrane, creating Ruptures that will saturate the area with Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 天使们正在撕破阿尔布雷希特膜质，来制造出使这里充满虚空的裂口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Enemy activity has enraged the Void Angels. They're ripping the Albrecht membrane, exposing this entire ship to a Void Flood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 敌人的活动激怒了虚空天使。他们正在撕毁阿尔布雷希特膜质，把整艘飞船都暴露在虚空洪流里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Void saturation is approaching critical levels. Critical levels can kill you. Shall I explain further?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空浓度正接近临界水平。临界水平可以杀死你。我要进一步解释吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: The Void Flood has completely saturated this area. Failure to seal those ruptures immediately will result in... Well... Total failure. Not good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空洪流已经完全浸透了这片区域。若未能立即封闭这些裂口的话将导致……嗯……完全失败。不好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: You have reached maximum Void Saturation. This typically results in death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 你已达到最大虚空浓度。这很容易导致死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Maximum Void Saturation! Seal some ruptures or get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空浓度到达了最大值！将一些裂口密封或离开那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Void manifestations coming your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 虚空显化者正向你袭来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Watch out. The rupture has birthed something terrible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 小心。裂口产生了可怕的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Gather up nearby Vitoplast and bring it to the ruptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 收集附近的修复凝剂然后把它带到裂口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Skittergirl, you little twit. Get away from them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 疾行女，你这个小笨蛋。离他们远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Skittergirl. Stop. Oh. You are insufferable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 是疾行女。停下。啊，真受不了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Hey, Skittergirl! Stop. They're helping. More than I can say for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 嘿，疾行女！停下，他们在帮忙，这点比你强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Well. Look at you. Saving the Zariman. Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 很好，看看你，又一次，拯救了「扎里曼号」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Not bad for a day's work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 对于一天的工作来说还算不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.text: Ship saved, enemies overcome, research notes updated. What more could an Archimedean want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/DZarFl.zhText: 飞船得救了，敌人被消灭了，并且还更新了研究日志。一个哲士还会想要求什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Everview Arc. Ensure that children are supervised at all times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到永视弧域。请确保儿童始终处于看管之下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Halako Perimeter. The place for questions is the classroom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到哈拉科防线。教室才是提问题的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Archives may be consulted by appointment.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Halako Perimeter. Agri-biome access has been temporarily disabled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到哈拉科防线。农业生态圈的访问权限已被暂时禁用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Please remember to salute any dignitaries you meet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到涂沃主厅。请牢记：向你遇到的每位政要致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Aesthetic standards are being actively enforced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到涂沃主厅。美学标准正得到大力实施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Gaze upon what the favor of the Orokin may bring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到涂沃主厅。定睛仰望奥罗金所带给你的恩泽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Tuvul Commons. To witness the wisdom of our masters, simply look around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到涂沃主厅。要见证我们黄金之主的智慧，只需要环顾四周。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Tuvul Commons. Mastery of protocol is expected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到涂沃主厅。熟悉协议是理所当然的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway. By the will of the Seven do all things grow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。依七人众之意志，万物生长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway. We shall never comprehend how great are their gifts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。我们永远无法理解他们的恩赐有多么伟大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway. Admission to public poetry recitals is strictly limited.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。公共诗歌朗诵会的参与许可将受到严格控制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway. Cephalons are on duty in all zones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。中枢已在所有区域运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to The Greenway. The success of our voyage depends on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到翠径。我们航行的成功与否取决于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works. Unauthorized persons are not permitted near the Reliquary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。未经授权的人员不得靠近圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works. Report any mental aberration to your coordinator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。请向你的协调员报告所有精神失常的情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works. Unseal only those Requiems you are authorized to recite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。只能开封那些你已被授权背诵的安魂诗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works. Those who know no guilt hear no voices.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。毫无愧疚之心的人无法听到真理之音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.text: Welcome to Oro Works. Labour, and do not inquire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Zariman/LbRUAd.zhText: 欢迎来到奥金工场。劳作即可，毋庸置喙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: That's her. The real Kira. If you don't take her out here, she'll heal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 是她。真正的吉拉。如果你不把她带出去，她会恢复的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Kira's almost recovered. You need to put her down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 吉拉几乎康复了。你需要把她放下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Those orbs will redirect any damage you can do! Try throwing yourself through them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 这些球体会重新定向你所造成的伤害！试着让自己直接穿过它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Orokin only wanted ceremonial weapons on the Zariman, but for something as important as the Reliquary Drive, they built in two little security guarantees: auto-fabricating Armaments and Exodampers. Exodampers suppress enemy combat ability. We need to defend our Exodampers and our Reliquary with Armaments. Got that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 奥罗金让扎里曼号只能拥有仪式武器，但对于像圣物装置这样重要的东西，他们施加了两套小小的安全措施：那就是自动制造的武器与抑制装置。抑制装置能压制敌人的战斗力。我们要用军备武器保卫抑制装置与圣物装置。懂了吗?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Don't bother trying to hurt Kira's Angel form now. She's pulled her essence back into the Void. You're gonna have to follow her in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 现在别尝试伤害吉拉的天使形态。她将本质都拉回了虚空。你得跟着她进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: We use Argozene to build the Armaments. I marked an Argozene drop on your radar. Think you can manage to find it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们使用氩烯来制造军备，我在你的雷达上标记了一个氩烯空投。我觉得你应该能找到它，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You're a natural. Now, I'm sure you want to go crazy building armaments all over, but you cannot do that. You need to use sockets. Go find the socket that appeals to you most - your socket, the socket that was meant for you -  and build something dangerous in it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 你天赋异禀。现在，我敢肯定你想疯狂地到处建造军备，但你不能那样做。你要使用炮座。你要寻找最吸引你的炮座——属于你的炮座，为你准备的炮座——并建造一些危险的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Mercy me, I do believe you've got the hang of this, Grubber. One more thing. Enemies coming through Oro Works are always helping themselves to our Argozene, so feel free to take it from their cold dead hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 天哪，小破烂，我觉得你已经完全掌握了诀窍。还有件事，那些越过奥金工厂的敌人们总是在寻找着氩烯。所以，随时从他们冰冷的手上拿走它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 怎么回事？难道我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Dead? No... not you. This is not the homecoming we would have wished for you, but welcome home, all the same. Call me Quinn. We 'Holdfasts' are the last remaining crew of the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 死了？不……你没死。这并不是我们希望你回家看到的，但……欢迎回家，永远欢迎。叫我奎因就好。我们"坚守者"是扎里曼号仅存的船员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You can't be. The crew all died!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 你不可能是。所有船员都死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You can't be. The crew all died!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 你不可能是。所有船员都死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Void creates. Death is merely a blank canvas. We numbered five, not long ago. Poor Kira. The song broke down her resistance, she raised her voice in answer, and now she is one of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 虚空亦可创造。死亡仅是一张空白的画卷。不久前，我们还是五个人。可怜的吉拉。这歌声摧毁了她的意志，她加入了它们的合唱，成为其中的一员了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Wait wait wait. Are you saying that thing I just saw...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 等等，等等。你是说我刚刚看到的那个东西……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Wait. Are you saying that thing I just saw...

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: ... was Kira, yes. That form is what awaits us, should we fail to hold fast. The others were all like us, once. But in time they all drank from that bleak Reliquary, and now they scream in chorus to the Void. The Zariman must be saved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: ……是吉拉，是的。如果我们不能坚守下去，那么终将步其后尘。曾几何时，他们也同我们一样。但后来，他们都奔向了那阴暗的圣物装置，现在他们齐声向虚空尖啸。必须拯救扎里曼号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Saved? It's a graveyard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 拯救？这里就是一片坟场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Saved? It's a graveyard!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Do you have any idea how dangerous this ship is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 你知道这艘船有多么的危险吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Do you have any idea how dangerous this ship is?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Zariman has suffered. But she can still be a barricade against what is yet to come if you stand with us. Help us keep her out of the hands of invaders like these Grineer. When you are ready, come to the lower decks. A Void Cascade is already breaking down what you accept as... reality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 扎里曼号很残破。但是，如果你和我们一起，她仍然可以尽力抵挡即将来临的一切。协助我们一起让她逃出这群 Grineer 入侵者的魔爪。当你准备好了，就来下层甲板。虚空覆涌已击碎了你所认知的……现实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Listen, kid. Hombask here. Quinn means well but... there ain't no stopping this. We're hungry. Just like Kira was. Only a matter of time. Sooner Quinn admits that to himself. The better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 听着，小子。我是霍姆巴斯。 奎因是出于好意，但……这一切是无法阻止的，我们太饿了。就像吉拉一样，只是时间问题罢了。奎因若能越早认清这一点，就越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Quinn! You're still... you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 奎因！你还是……你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: We changed. Oh, we drew power, but from a very different source. You have noticed it's not just the Reliquary that can work miracles with the Void, yes? I wonder.... do you even know just how brightly you shine?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们变了。哦，我们汲取了力量，但出处完全不同。你已经注意到，不只有圣物装置可以用虚空创造奇迹，对吗？我想……你真的知道你有多么的耀眼吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You say that. But this place... I can't forget what it's put me through. Everyone through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 确实说的没错。但是，这个地方……我忘不了我在这的经历。大家的经历。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: So remember, like we remember Kira. There was a place in this park where she used to love to sit. I think perhaps it would suit a memorial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 所以要记住，就像我们记住吉拉一样。这个公园以前有个地方，她过去喜欢坐在那。我想也许能在那立个纪念碑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: We've lost too much time. Those idiotic Grineer are cracking the shield on the Reliquary Drive. The Angels are heading there to feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们失去了太多时间。那些白痴 Grineer 正在破开圣物装置上的护盾。天使们正去那觅食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: I'll stop the Grineer. And Kira too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我会阻止 Grineer。再加上吉拉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You're really going to try, huh? Okay. Cavalero can show you how to use the old deployable defenses. You'll need them.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Aren't you a fascinating anomaly. Anomalies? Right! Explanations. When consciousness and Void come together, it makes a thing. For example, me! Not nearly as fascinating as you, though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 哦，你真是一个迷人的异类。我说你们？对啊，这说得通。当意识和虚空融为一体时，会形成其它存在。比如，我！不过，我没有你们那样迷人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Kira called them 'Angels'. But then, what does that make us? We gestated in the belly of the Zariman beast, same as them, woke when we heard those words call us, same as them. But we aren't like them. And I'll be damned if we don't go down fighting. Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 吉拉把他们称为"天使"。但那样，我们是什么呢？我们同他们一样，孕育于扎里曼号的兽腹，也同他们一样，觉醒于虚空的低语。但我们不尽相同。我相信我们坚守到底是正确的。对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: You must understand: the Zariman is yours now. You inherited it, along with the duty to protect it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 你必须明白：扎里曼号是你的了。你继承了她，所以亦有保护她的责任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: I'm not afraid of responsibility. But this is where everything that could go wrong, went wrong.  Once we're done here, I'm done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我并不害怕承担责任。但这里是一切祸端的开始，不是嘛。我们处理完这里的事，我就离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Void Flood! Get to floor Sigma D-7. Archimedean Yonta will direct you from there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 虚空洪流！请到达西格玛 D-7 层。哲士扬塔将在那里指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Kid, when someone's gone, the part nobody talks about is that you have to choose how you're gonna remember them. There were people on this ship who loved you. You're never gonna forget what happened here. But you owe it to them, and yourself, to remember all the other days, too. Protect those memories. Protect the Zariman. When you're ready to start making this place a home, come see me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 孩子，当某人离去时，那些没有人告诉你的部分是，你需要做出一个选择，怎样去纪念他们。在这艘船上有很多爱你的人。你永远不会忘记这里发生的一切。但为了他们，也为了你自己，你也应该记住所有过去的日子。保护这些记忆。保护扎里曼号。当你准备好把这里当成一个家的时候，来找我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Zariman. There is no life aboard. And yet, all the System can hear it sing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 扎里曼号。船上并没有生命。然而，整个星系都能听到它的歌声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Zariman cries out, and I must let you answer. The pride of the golden makers now lies void-ridden, derelict. So arm yourself, child. Return to your lost home. Reclaim your birthright.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 扎里曼号在悲鸣，而我必须让你致以回应。昔日黄金之主的傲气如今在虚空中沉朽。孩子，全服武装吧。重返你失去的家园。夺回属于你的传承。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Zariman has returned to the Origin System for the final time, Tenno. She is your rightful home, but she is beset by the nightmares of the Void. It will be a daunting task, but if you are ever to reclaim her, it must be now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 这是扎里曼号最后一次回到始源星系，Tenno 战士。她是你实至名归的家园，但她却被虚空的噩梦所困。这将是一项艰巨的任务，如果想重新夺回她，就必须立刻行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: My child. I saw the chaos with my own eyes and brought many like you out of that hell. Now... I must send you back there. You are a child no longer, and you have a legacy to protect. Be swift. The Zariman awaits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我的孩子。我目睹了那场灾乱，也曾经把许多像你一样的人带出那个地狱。现在……我必须要送你回去。你不再是个孩子了，你有要去守护的使命。要快点。扎里曼号在等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: There's nothing left on that wreck but bad memories. But if I can keep it from hurting anyone else... I'll go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 那艘船骸上除了糟糕的记忆什么都没有。但如果我能防止它伤害到其他人……我会去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: This is about as bad as it could be. It's Kira... she's mutating. Heading straight for the Reliquary Drive. We won't be able to resist her song. She... knows us too well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 这可能是最糟糕的结果。是吉拉……她正在变异。正在前往圣物装置。我们无法抗拒她的歌声。她……太了解我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: This can only end one of two ways. We die, or we change. Promise me after we're gone, you'll take care of the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们只有两种结局。死亡，或者变异。答应我，我们走后，你会照顾好扎里曼号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Zariman's Automatic Vitoplast system is damaged and overwhelmed. Seems its designer, me, neglected to envision a situation like this. We need to resort to manual application. Gather up nearby Vitoplast and stuff it in the ruptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 扎里曼号的修复凝剂自动生产系统受损，而且不堪重负。似乎它的设计师……我，疏忽了会有这样的情况。我们需要手动修复它。去收集附近的修复凝剂并将其塞入裂口中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Yonta, I know you two never saw eye to eye, but Kira was right. This ship stood for something, once. Oh, the Orokin draped her in all their hollow pride and pomposity, but to the ordinary families, she meant hope. Earth was ruined, Mars arid, Lua fractured... Tau would have been a chance to begin again. "We shall not fear to take the leap Across the gulf to fare..."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 扬塔，我知道你和吉拉一向意见不合，但她是对的。这艘飞船曾有非凡的意义。啊，奥罗金贵族用空洞的骄傲、浮夸为她盛装，但它对普通家庭来说……代表着希望。地球受损严重，火星干旱，月球崩裂……陶星系本可以让我们重来。"我们应当无惧，从深湾上空飞跃而去……"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: "Though all betwixt is dark and deep, a home awaits us there." Yeah. We really thought we'd make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: "纵使所有道路都深暗无比，家园定在远方。"是啊，我们以为赢定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Angels are tearing through the Albrecht membrane. Void is flooding in through the ruptures they've created.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 天使们正在撕破阿尔布雷希特膜质。虚空正在通过他们制造的裂口涌入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: The Void can get creative in some pretty unpleasant ways. The deeper the Void Flood gets, the weirder it'll be for you. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 虚空会通过一些令人非常不愉快的方式发挥它的创造力。虚空洪流越深入，你就会感到越奇怪。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Do that enough times, and you'll keep the Zariman high and dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 坚持多做几次，就可以让扎里曼号保持良好的状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Only Void can destroy Void. Use your power to purge the Exolizer, and kill the Thrax inside it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 只有虚空才能摧毁虚空。用你的力量净化无垢装置，杀死里面的凶魂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: When the Grineer restarted the damaged Reliquary Drive they unleashed a cascade of Void contamination. Void manifestations from beyond the membrane. We've come to know them as "Thrax". They will attack and possess our Exolizers, making the units spread Void contamination instead of cleansing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 当 Grineer 重启受损的圣物装置时，他们引发了虚空的连环污染。这些虚空显现者来自膜质之外，他们是"凶魂"。他们会攻击并控制我们的无垢装置，让这些仪器传播虚空污染，而非净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: She's here. Our Kira. You... you have to stop her. You have to try.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 她在这。我们的吉拉。你……你必须阻止她。你必须试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Contamination's messing with Transference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 污染正在干扰传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Contamination's messing with Transference.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Damn it. The Void is taking this Exolizer. It's making the contamination worse. You wield the Void, try to purge it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 该死。虚空正在吞噬无垢净化器。这加剧了污染。你已驾驭虚空之力，尝试将其净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Cascade subsiding. I no longer detect new Void Manifestations. It is safe to stand down. Please, return to the Chrysalith.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 覆涌平息了。我没有检测到新的虚空显化者了。可以安全撤退。请回到羽化之穹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: We all bear the trauma of what happened on this ship, but do you remember her promise? To build a new world, without strife, violence or poverty?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们都承受着这艘船上的痛苦回忆，但你还记得她的誓言吗？建立一个没有冲突、暴力与贫困的新世界？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: We can talk about it some time when I'm not fighting for my life, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 我们可以等我杀出一条血路之后再说，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: These interlopers have barely set foot aboard the Zariman. Yet, the Void has seen something like them before. These half-made manifestations mirror them... but a different them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 这些入侵者几乎都没踏上过扎里曼号。但类似者却在虚空中出现过。这些半成品镜像映射了他们……但却是另一种"他们"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: They look... older. Bigger. Like ancestors, maybe? But how?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 他们看着更老了。体型也更大了。像是返祖了？这是为何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: They look... older. Bigger. Like ancestors, maybe? But how?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 都是些老套路。Grineer 阴魂不散，到处跟着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Remember that first harvest festival? Children laughing in the agro biomes. I weep for what could have been.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 还记得第一个丰收祭吗？孩子们在农业生物群里欢声笑语。我们本该拥有的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.text: Yeah. I remember the singing. Picking fruit under those warm lights. Hands stained purple with Lofler Berry juice. You really think things could have been different?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 是的，我记得……那歌声。在温暖的灯光下摘水果。双手被洛夫勒浆果汁染成紫色。你真认为事情发展会不同吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ZarimanQuest/D.zhText: 要扼杀覆涌，必须得在漫游的凶魂释能完成前，远离那个无诟装置

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Ability_SwapSuit.text:
View |SUITS|'s abilities

In game, Hold the button down when activating abilities to swap between Sirius & Orion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/Ability_SwapSuit.zhText:
查看 |SUITS| 的技能

在游戏中，使用技能时按住按键即可在 Sirius 和 Orion 之间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityAugme.text: Absorb Augment: Nyx can use weapons during Absorb and its duration is infinite, but it consumes <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| <ENERGY> Energy/s and its area of effect is halved.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityAugme.zhText: 聚合吸收增强：Nyx 可以在聚合吸收期间使用武器，并且技能持续时间无限，但每秒消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| <ENERGY> 能量，并且技能范围减半。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityAugme.text: Absorb Augment: Create a ring every 3s that drags in enemies at |PULL_STR|m/s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityAugme.zhText: 聚合吸收强化：制造一个每 3 秒会将敌方以每秒 |PULL_STR| 米的速度吸入的圆环。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityBoost.text: Boost the amount of damage you can absorb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityBoost.zhText: 增加你可以吸收的伤害数量

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityDesc.text: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AbsorbAbilityDesc.zhText: Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistDesc.text: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistDesc.zhText: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistDistill_A.text:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistDistill_A.zhText:
从 Lavos 体内迸发出催化探头，并把炽热的凝胶泼向对手。敌人身上每有一种元素异常状态，该技能的伤害便翻倍一次。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistPassiveAu.text: Passive Augment: Casting an Ability imbued with extra Elemental Damage applies that Element as a |VAL|% bonus to your weapons with guaranteed Status for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistPassiveAu.zhText: 被动增强：施放具有额外元素伤害的技能将会为武器附加 |VAL|% 该元素伤害，并必定触发其异常状态，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistPassiveAu.text: Increased Elemental Damage and Status Effects from last ability used
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistPassiveAu.zhText: 提升上次施放技能的元素伤害和异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistSerpent_A.text: Ophidian Bite Augment: Reduce Ability Cooldowns by |DURATION|s when at least |NUM_ENEMIES| enemies are hit. Ophidian Bite is granted |RANGE|% additional Ability Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistSerpent_A.zhText: 毒蛇之咬强化：击中至少 |NUM_ENEMIES| 名敌人时，减少技能冷却时间 |DURATION| 秒。毒蛇之咬获得额外 |RANGE|% 技能范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistSerpent_A.text:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistSerpent_A.zhText:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗 Lavos。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistTransmute.text: Transmutation Probe Augment: Probe returns to cast position after reaching max range, and remains nearby for |DURATION|s. Recall Probe by recasting. Recast again to end.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistTransmute.zhText: 炼制探头强化：探头在达到最大范围后会返回施放位置，并在附近停留 |DURATION| 秒。重新施放即可召回探头。再次施放即可结束技能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistTransmute.text:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistTransmute.zhText:
布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistVial_Abil.text:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistVial_Abil.zhText:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistVial_Abil.text: Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AlchemistVial_Abil.zhText: 前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshDesc.text: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshDesc.zhText: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。 Ash 擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshPassiveAbility.text: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshPassiveAbility.zhText: 敌人受到的 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态会让伤害增加 |DAMAGE|% 且持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshStormAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect and maximum number of targets.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AshStormAbilityBoo.zhText: 提高这种能力会增加其区域的效果和目标的最大数量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasDesc.text: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasDesc.zhText: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。Atlas 可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPassiveAbilit.text: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPassiveAugmen.text: Passive Augment: When above |ARMOUR| Rubble, Landslide costs no Energy, deals |DAMAGE|x Damage, and travels |SPEED|x faster.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPassiveAugmen.zhText: 被动强化：当 Atlas 高于 |ARMOUR| 碎石时，使用「土石坍方」不会消耗能量，并造成 |DAMAGE| 倍伤害，行进速度提高 |SPEED| 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPunchWeaponDe.text: Atlas' deadly fists, as utilized by his Landslide Ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPunchWeaponDe.zhText: Atlas 的致命拳头，由他的「土石坍方」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPunchWeaponPr.text: Atlas Prime's deadly fists, as utilized by his Landslide Ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AtlasPunchWeaponPr.zhText: Atlas Prime 的致命拳头，由他的「土石坍方」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AvalancheAbilityAu.text: Avalanche Augment: Allies within Affinity Range are coated in ice that grants |ABSORB| Overguard per enemy hit. Overguard increases by |ARMOR_PCT|% of your Armor once per enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AvalancheAbilityAu.zhText: 雪崩强化：用冰衣覆盖经验共享范围内的友军，每次命中敌人时为友军提供 |ABSORB| 超宏防护。每次命中敌人增加相当于护甲值 |ARMOR_PCT|% 的超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AvalancheAbilityBo.text: Increase the range of your Avalanche.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/AvalancheAbilityDe.text: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/AvalancheAbilityDe.zhText: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BallisticBatteryAb.text: Ballistic Battery Augment: The shot gains a +|CRIT_CHANCE|% Final Critical Chance bonus, based on the amount charged.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BallisticBatteryAb.zhText: 弹道蓄能强化：根据蓄能的程度，让下一发射击附加上 |CRIT_CHANCE|% 的最终暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BallisticBatteryAb.text: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BallisticBatteryAb.zhText: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BanishAbilityAugme.text: Banish Augment: Allies banished to the rift will have |HEALTH_PERCENT|% of their Maximum Health restored every second.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BanishAbilityAugme.zhText: 放逐强化：被放逐到裂隙的友军每秒会恢复他们最大生命值的 |HEALTH_PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BanishAbilityDesc.text: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BanishAbilityDesc.zhText: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BansheeDesc.text: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BansheeDesc.zhText: Banshee 的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BansheePassiveAbil.text: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a |RADIUS|m radius when casting Abilities, applying max <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BansheePassiveAbil.zhText: Banshee 施放技能时，会刺穿 |RADIUS| 米范围内敌人的耳朵，并施加最大层数的 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。此外，Banshee 的武器噪音也会减少。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardAltHelmetDesc.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Octavia
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardAltHelmetDesc.zhText: Octavia 的独特样式替换用头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardAmplifyAbility.text: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardAmplifyAbility.zhText: 从环境的分贝水平中获取能量，用来扩大 Octavia 和友军的伤害增幅。同时将附近槌音铮鏦的伤害和范围加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardCharmAbilityAu.text: Resonator Augment: Reactivate the ability to command Resonator to move to your aim point at |SPEED|% Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardCharmAbilityAu.zhText: 共鸣渲染强化：再次使用技能来命令共鸣渲染以 |SPEED|% 速度移动至你瞄准的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardCharmAbilityDe.text: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardCharmAbilityDe.zhText: 发射一枚滚球，利用音乐的渲染力令敌人跟随它。与槌音铮鏦相结合便可创造出一个徘徊移动的音波破坏球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardDesc.text: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardDesc.zhText: Octavia 将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Octavia Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardJamAbilityDesc.text: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardJamAbilityDesc.zhText: 给予随着 Octavia 的音乐做出相应动作的人各类增益效果。合拍的跳跃提供轻挑快板速度加成。跟上节拍的下蹲给予夜曲的隐匿增益。有节奏地射击可获得歌剧戏曲的多重射击加成。合拍的近战攻击给以强音奏鸣曲伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardMusicAbilityAu.text: Mallet Augment: Create an additional Mallet with <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|RANGE|% reduced range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardMusicAbilityAu.zhText: 槌音铮鏦强化：额外增加一个槌音铮鏦，但范围减少 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|RANGE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardMusicAbilityDe.text: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BardMusicAbilityDe.zhText: 随着节奏对附近的敌人造成伤害，并吸引他们的火力。施加在槌音铮鏦上的伤害会增加其杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerMeleePrim.text: These talons emerge when Valkyr Prime unleashes Hysteria.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerMeleePrim.zhText: 当 Valkyr Prime 释放狂化爆发时这些爪子就会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.text: Warcry Augment: While active, Warcry's duration is increased by |DURATION_INC|s for each Melee Kill.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.zhText: 咆哮强化：技能激活时，以近战击杀每个敌人能延长 |DURATION_INC| 秒技能持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.text: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.zhText: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Speed Increase 
Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BerserkerScreamAbi.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：速度提升减少
Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityAug.text: Blessing Augment: Gain Primary and Secondary Critical Chance for |DURATION|s for each percent you heal on allies up to |CAP|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityAug.zhText: 祝福强化：治疗友军可使主要和次要武器获得与治疗百分比相同的暴击几率，持续 |DURATION| 秒，最高获得 |CAP|% 增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases the duration of the invulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityBoo.zhText: 提高这种能力增加无敌状态的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityDes.text: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityDes.zhText: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerBarrierAbil.text: Tectonics Augment: Create up to |NUM_WALLS| walls with |HEALTH_MULT|% Health. Walls can no longer be turned into boulders.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerBarrierAbil.zhText: 大地构筑强化：制造最多 |NUM_WALLS| 堵墙，每堵墙各拥有 |HEALTH_MULT|% 血量。但无法变成圆石。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerBarrierAbil.text: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerBarrierAbil.zhText: 召唤一堵「大地堡垒」石墙，再次启用技能可使巨石滚动压倒前方的敌人。被敌人攻击的石墙会释放一个区域性的切割伤害，由其失去的生命值来维持。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerGazeAbility.text: Petrify Augment: Petrified enemies are scanned into the Codex and have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop additional loot when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerGazeAbility.zhText: 石化凝视强化：被石化的敌人会被扫描进资料库并在击杀时有 |CHANCE|% 几率额外掉落道具。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerGazeAbility.text: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerGazeAbility.zhText: Atlas 强硬的凝视将石化敌人并增加他们受到的伤害、治疗石头人，并创造出石化壁垒。当石化的敌人碎裂后，将掉出可以治疗 Atlas 的碎石。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerPunchAbilit.text: Landslide Augment: Leave a trail for |TRAIL_DURATION|s that petrifies enemies for |STONE_DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerPunchAbilit.zhText: 土石坍方强化：留下一道持续 |TRAIL_DURATION| 秒的痕迹，可石化敌人 |STONE_DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerPunchAbilit.text: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerPunchAbilit.zhText: 用爆炸性的滑行冲拳猛击敌人，最多重复三次，形成连击。三拳连击中的每一后续攻击都会增加攻击范围。土石坍方的每次命中都会减少能量消耗。可通过在土石坍方上装备 Mod 增加属性数值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.text:
Rumblers Augment: Create a single rumbler with |HEALTH_MULT|% Health and |DAMAGE_MULT|% Damage.
Reactivating will cause him to slam the floor and knockdown enemies in |DISTANCE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.zhText:
漫步石者强化：制造一个单体石者，具有 |HEALTH_MULT|% 的血量和 |DAMAGE_MULT|% 的伤害。
再次使用技能会让他猛烈撞击地面，并击倒周围 |DISTANCE| 米内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.text: Rumblers Augment: Atlas becomes a Rumbler with Rock Armor that grants Overguard and absorbs up to |ABSORB|% of damage to Max Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.zhText: 漫步石者强化：Atlas 化身为一名身覆岩石铠甲的漫步石者，获得超宏防护并且可以吸收相当于最大生命值 |ABSORB|% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.text: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrawlerSummonAbili.zhText: 召唤两个元素石头近战打手。召唤动作将石化临近 Atlas 的敌人。当它们的生命结束时，石头人将碎成一堆用于治疗的碎石。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenDestructAbil.text: The Vast Untime Augment: Creates a Rift that connects to enemies suffering from <DT_RADIANT_COLOR> Void Status Effect within |RANGE|m, doubling debuffs applied by The Vast Untime and maintaining <DT_RADIANT_COLOR> Void Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenDestructAbil.zhText: 超维炼狱强化：创造一道裂隙，连接 |RANGE| 米范围内带有 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空异常状态的敌人，使超维炼狱的易伤效果翻倍并维持 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenDestructAbil.text: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenDestructAbil.zhText: Xaku 的外层结构在毁灭性的爆炸中暂时舍弃，然后以全新的的骨骼形态疾步潜行于战场。受到 Xaku 身体碎片击中的敌人会更难抵御 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。在超维炼狱施放期间，Xaku 其他主动技能的持续时间将会冻结，技能终止时恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceAbili.text: The Lost Augment: The Lost gains |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength and |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency when cast. The effect stacks up to |MAX_STACKS|x. Casting the same ability back-to-back resets the effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceAbili.zhText: 失落之技强化：施放失落之技时提升 |STRENGTH|% 失落之技的技能强度和 |EFFICIENCY|% 失落之技的技能效率。最多可叠加 |MAX_STACKS| 次增益，若连续施放两次相同的失落之技则会重置增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceAbili.text: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceAbili.zhText: 循环切换三种失落之技。「指责」幻化出虚空裂缝，来让敌人堕落成为友军。「凝视」通过虚空卷须抓住目标，并在目标被释放时，捕捉伤害并对目标造成伤害。「否认」通过一束虚空能量来进行湮灭攻击，并消除 Sentient 抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceScrea.text: Gaze paralyzes an enemy and generates a radial debuff of the defenses of those who enter Gaze's range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenEmbraceScrea.zhText: 「凝视」可使一名敌人麻痹，并对进入「凝视」范围的敌人的防御能力产生一个范围减益效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameAltHelm.text: Xaku cuts a unique profile in this distinctive helmet assembled from the remains of several other, less fortunate Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameAltHelm.zhText: 这件由其他几位不那么走运的战甲的残骸所组装而成的独特头盔，被 Xaku 裁切出了独一无二的外形。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameChassis.text: Chassis component of the Xaku Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameDesc.text: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameDesc.zhText: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameHelmetC.text: Neuroptics component of the Xaku Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameHelmetC.zhText: Xaku 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Xaku Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFramePassive.text: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFramePassive.zhText: 在受到范围攻击时，减免 |CHANCE|% 的伤害，并有几率避开武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenFrameSystems.text: Systems component of the Xaku Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenGraspAbility.text: Grasp of Lohk Augment: When a stolen weapon deals damage to an enemy affected by The Lost: Gaze or The Vast Untime, Xaku heals by |HEAL|.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenGraspAbility.zhText: 虚空之握强化：当偷取的武器对受到「失落之技：凝视」或「超维炼狱」影响的敌人造成伤害时，Xaku 恢复 |HEAL| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenGraspAbility.text: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenGraspAbility.zhText: 虚空卷须偷取附近敌人的武器，以作为自己的浮空自瞄武器来使用。伤害输出会根据敌人等级增加。抢到的武器数量也决定了「失落之技：否认」的虚空射线的伤害倍数。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenRotAbilityDe.text: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BrokenRotAbilityDe.zhText: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.text:
Magnetize Augment: Recast on the target to detonate. Enemies hit have a |CHANCE|% chance to be disarmed.
Passive: +|RANGE|% Magnetize Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.zhText:
磁吸力场强化：对目标再次施放磁吸力场，将主动引爆。被击中的敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率被卸除装备。
被动：+|RANGE|% 磁吸力场范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.text: Boosting this ability increases the area of the magnetic field.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.zhText: 提高此能力增加磁场的范围

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.text:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.zhText:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕 Mag 运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）Mag 将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.text: Creates a magnetic field around a target that attracts any weapon fire that hits it and deals damage over time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/BulletAttractorAbi.zhText: 在目标上创造一个吸引武器火力的磁场，并造成持续伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CalibanDeluxeHelme.zhText: Caliban 奥菲欧的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CannonBarrageAbili.text: Tempest Barrage Augment: Each projectile has a |CHANCE|% chance of inflicting a <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CannonBarrageAbili.zhText: 暴风雨弹幕强化：每个技能产生的投射物有 |CHANCE|% 的几率造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CannonBarrageAbili.text: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CannonBarrageAbili.zhText: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiAi.zhText: 滞留空中时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiEx.zhText: 击杀 |COUNT| 名卓越者敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiIn.zhText: 击杀 |COUNT| 名受到 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态影响的敌人
击杀 |COUNT| 名受到 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态影响的敌人
击杀 |COUNT| 名受到 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态影响的敌人
击杀 |COUNT| 名受到 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态影响的敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiKi.zhText: 在 10 米内击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人
在 20 米外击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiSl.zhText: 滑行时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/Challenge_KoumeiWa.zhText: 壁面攀附时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityAugmen.text: Chaos Augment: Enemies entering the Effect Range will be inflicted with Chaos. Effect Range lasts for |PCT_CHANCE|% of the ability duration and shrinks over time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityAugmen.zhText: 精神混乱强化：进入效果范围的敌人会陷入混乱，有效时间为技能持续时间的 |PCT_CHANCE|%，且会逐渐缩小。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityBoost.text: Boost the range of the chaos you create.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityBoost.zhText: 提高您造成混乱的范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityDesc.text: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityDesc.zhText: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityPvPDes.text: With a powerful psychic blast, Nyx causes all affected to see other players as opponents and can damage/kill their teammates.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChaosAbilityPvPDes.zhText: 通过一个强大的心灵震爆，Nyx 使得被影响的单位将其他玩家视为敌人，并可能伤害 / 击杀队友。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirChorusAbility.text: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirChorusAbility.zhText: 循环奏响三首颂歌增强友军。《七人众之力》增加技能强度。《死亡使者》增加武器伤害。《坚韧之灵》增加护盾效率。击杀被审判的敌人可以延长颂歌的持续时间。
持续时间延长 / 审判

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirDamageAuraDes.text: You and your squad have increased Weapon Damage
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirDamageAuraDes.zhText: 增加你和你的小队武器伤害

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Jade Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirDesc.text: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirDesc.zhText: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEruptAbilityD.text: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEruptAbilityD.zhText: 以毁灭性的力量翱翔天际。使用次要射击引爆审判，造成翠玉之光爆炸。处于圣光审判影响范围内的敌人会增强爆炸效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEyesAbilityDe.text: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEyesAbilityDe.zhText: Jade 召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护盾和护甲。当谴责之瞳凝视友军时，可以将其远距离复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEyesAbilityDe.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Cannot revive allies.
Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirEyesAbilityDe.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：无法复活友军。
Jade 召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirHelmetAltDesc.zhText: 肯定 Jade 的神圣本性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Jade Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirLifeAuraDesc.text: You and your squad have increased Shield Regeneration and decreased Shield Recharge Delay
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirLifeAuraDesc.zhText: 增加你和你的小队护盾回复并减少护盾恢复延迟

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPassiveAbilit.text: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by |CHANCE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPassiveAbilit.zhText: Jade 对生与死的深刻理解赋予她两个光环 Mod 槽位。某些技能会施加"审判"，使敌人获得 |CHANCE|% 易伤，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPassiveBuffDe.text: Jade's Judgment increases your Health Regeneration
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPassiveBuffDe.zhText: Jade 的审判使你的生命恢复速度增加

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPoolAbilityAu.text: Light's Judgment Augment: Enemies damaged by the well have a |CHANCE|% chance per hit to spawn a Jade Light above them, damaging them for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPoolAbilityAu.zhText: 圣光审判强化：受到圣光之井伤害的敌人，每次被击中时有 |CHANCE|% 的几率在其上方生成翠玉之光，并对其造成伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPoolAbilityDe.text: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPoolAbilityDe.zhText: 创造一口圣光之井治愈友军并对敌人造成伤害。进入井中的敌人将被"审判"标记。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPowerAuraDesc.text: You and your squad have increased Ability Strength
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirPowerAuraDesc.zhText: 增加你和你的小队技能强度

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirRecipeHelpTex.text: Jade's main blueprint is awarded from the Jade Shadows quest. Component blueprints can be acquired from Brutus (Uranus) or purchased from Ordis in the Drifter Camp (Earth). The Jade Shadows quest must be completed to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChoirRecipeHelpTex.zhText: Jade 的主要蓝图可通过《Jade 之影》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可从布鲁图斯（天王星）获取，或在漂泊者营地（地球）的 Ordis 处购买。必须完成《Jade 之影》系列任务才能解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChromaDesc.text: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChromaDesc.zhText: 释放龙之力量。Chroma 使用火焰、电击、毒素和冰冻元素来造成高伤害，同时保持生存能力。以愤怒为翼，翱翔吧。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChromaPassiveAbili.text: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ChromaPassiveAbili.zhText: 展开翅膀以进行一次额外的跳跃和旋身飞跃。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.text: Shadows of the Dead Augment: Each Shadow within |RANGE|m take |LINK_PCT|% of the Damage done to Nekros in his stead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.zhText: 亡者幽影强化：距离 |RANGE| 米内的每个幽影会替 Nekros 分担承受 |LINK_PCT|% 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.text: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.zhText: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.text: Reduces respawn timer of Nekros and his teammates to 0.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CloneTheDeadAbilit.zhText: 将 Nekros 及其队友的重生倒计时降低为 0。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ConcreteLaserAbili.text: Crucible Blast Augment: Becomes a channeled ability consuming <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| <ENERGY> Energy/s that ramps up. While active Chyrinka Pillars trigger chain reactions and their duration is frozen. Mobility is greatly reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ConcreteLaserAbili.zhText: 堆芯迸发强化：成为一种导引技能，每秒消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY|<ENERGY>能量，并逐渐增强。激活的辐射柱体会触发连锁反应，并且其持续时间会冻结。同时大幅降低移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ConcreteWallAbilit.text: Containment Wall Augment: Strip |STRIP|% of armor and shields from struck enemies. Hitting |COUNT| or more enemies will restart the duration of any Chyrinka Pillars and empower them.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ConcreteWallAbilit.zhText: 核控壁垒强化：削减被击中敌人的 |STRIP|% 护甲和护盾。击中 |COUNT| 或更多敌人时重置辐射柱体的持续时间并增强它们。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityAugmen.text: Crush Augment: Crush gains +|SPEED|% casting speed. The armor of surviving enemies decreases by |ARMOUR|% and they are unable to move for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityAugmen.zhText: 粉碎强化：粉碎增加 +|SPEED|% 施放速度。幸存敌人的护甲减少 |ARMOUR|%，并且他们在 |DURATION| 秒内无法移动。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases its range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityBoost.zhText: 提高这种能力会增加它的范围

/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityDesc.text: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/CrushAbilityDesc.zhText: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathAltHelmetDes.text: Glory in the ghoulish splendor of a pierced skull.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathAltHelmetDes.zhText: 被刺穿的骷髅上透露出一种属于死亡的颓靡风光，令人为之沉醉。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathApparitionAb.text: Grave Spirit Augment: Immediately assume Spectral Form. |CHANCE|% chance for weapons and abilities to apply Doom. Kills outside of Spectral Form decrease its cooldown by |COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathApparitionAb.zhText: 墓灵强化：立即进入幽灵形态。武器和技能有 |CHANCE|% 几率施加厄运。非幽灵形态时的击杀会降低技能冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathApparitionAb.text: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathApparitionAb.zhText: 为 Dagath 的武器提供额外的暴击伤害。对被厄运诅咒的敌人效果加倍。遭受致命攻击时短暂地进入幽灵形态并逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathCurseAbility.text: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathCurseAbility.zhText: 用厄运诅咒附近的敌人。Dagath 对敌人造成的部分伤害会通过命定镰刃再次施加。敌人还会受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathDefaultArmou.text: Default armor set for the Dagath Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Dagath Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Dagath Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathHorseAbility.text: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathHorseAbility.zhText: 召唤绝灵骥幻影向前冲锋，对其冲锋路径上的所有人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。同时削弱被厄运诅咒敌人的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathPassiveAbili.text: There is a |PERCENT|% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be |ENERGY|% more effective on Dagath.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathPassiveAbili.zhText: Dagath 拾取能量球和生命球时有 |PERCENT|% 几率使效果提高 |ENERGY|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathSuitDesc.text: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathSuitDesc.zhText: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。Dagath 的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathVolleyAbilit.text: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathVolleyAbilit.zhText: 命定镰刃包围 Dagath 并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathVolleyDescri.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Slow.
Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DagathVolleyDescri.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：减速效果降低。
命定镰刃包围 Dagath 并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DarkExcaliburDesc.text: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DarkExcaliburDesc.zhText: 来自长夜暗影中的新型 Excalibur。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.text: Decoy Augment: If Loki takes fatal damage, Decoy absorbs the damage and swaps locations. Also increases Casting Speed of Decoy by |SPEED|%
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.zhText: 诱饵强化: 如果 Loki 受到致命伤害，诱饵会吸收该伤害并互相调换位置。同时提升了诱饵技能 |SPEED|% 的施放速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.text: Decoy Augment: |LINK_PCT|% of damage Loki takes is transferred to Decoy, and vice versa.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.zhText: 诱饵强化：|LINK_PCT|% 本体受到的伤害会转移给诱饵，反之亦然。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.text: Decoy Augment: Decoy can be cast on enemies. Enemies who attack that decoy receive |STATUS| random Status Effects, and the reflected damage is increased by |DAMAGE_MULT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.zhText: 诱饵强化：可以对敌人施放诱饵。攻击诱饵的敌人会被施加 |STATUS| 个随机异常状态，且反射伤害增加 |DAMAGE_MULT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.text: [PH] Accumulated damage done on target enemy with Decoy
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityAugmen.zhText: [PH] Accumulated damage done on target enemy with Decoy

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases the lifetime of the decoy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityBoost.zhText: 提高这个能力会增加诱饵的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityDesc.text: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityDesc.zhText: Loki 会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力。分身会根据附近敌人的数量获得生命值和护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityPvPDes.text: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire and absorbs a portion of nearby enemy health and shield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DecoyAbilityPvPDes.zhText: Loki 会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力，并吸取附近敌人的部分生命值和护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameAltHelme.text: Don the fearsome horns of a legendary commander. The mere rumor of Uriel’s alternate helmet inspired despair on ancient battlefields.
