/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameAltHelme.zhText: 戴上传奇统帅那令人胆寒的犄角。古代战场上的人们单单是听闻 Uriel 的替换头盔，就足以陷入绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameBrimston.text: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameBrimston.zhText: Uriel 和他的恶魔们创造出一个不断扩大的炽热硫磺圈。使用恶魔技能可以为此技能充能。每次连续命中都会增加造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Uriel Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDefaultS.zhText: Uriel 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDemonium.text: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDemonium.zhText: Uriel 取出他恶魔的灵魂，吸取他们的生命，然后驱使他们去寻找新的受害者。这些灵魂在接触敌人时会爆炸，使敌人容易受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDesc.text: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameDesc.zhText: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。Uriel 用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameFireBall.text: Infernalis Augment: Release Fireballs for |DAMAGE|<DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with larger volleys when grabbing Vythelas' Runes during flight. Hits from Fireballs slowly charge Brimstone.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameFireBall.zhText: 炼狱火强化：飞行期间可释放火球，造成 |DAMAGE|<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，拾取烙魔符文会使齐射规模更大。火球命中敌人会缓慢为硫磺充能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Uriel Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameInfernal.text:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameInfernal.zhText:
释放火焰光环，对附近敌人造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

在空中按下闪避即可化身为毁灭性的火焰流星飞行。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFramePassiveD.text:
Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)

GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)

VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFramePassiveD.zhText:
Uriel 统领、强化并守护着三位独特的恶魔。

缚魔：束缚并减缓敌人，将他们串联起来。对链条中任意敌人造成的伤害会转移到所有被束缚的敌人身上。（通过炼狱火解锁）

苦魔：吸附在敌人身上，造成持续伤害。如果被击杀，会生成一个痛苦之环。（通过恶魔再生解锁）

烙魔：在倒下的敌人身上刻下恶魔符文，拾取这些符文可以增加射速和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。（通过魔群解锁）

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameRemedium.text: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameRemedium.zhText: Uriel 治愈自己和他的恶魔。如果他的恶魔死去，他们将被复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameRemedium.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Reduced Healing and Gulphagor is removed
Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DemonFrameRemedium.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：治疗降低并移除苦魔
Uriel 治愈自己和他的恶魔。如果他的恶魔死去，他们将被复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_C.text: Blueprints for the Citrine Warframe and its components are acquired on Tyana Pass (Mars) upon reaching Mastery Rank 3, or from Otak in the Necralisk (Deimos). Players must complete the Heart of Deimos quest to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_C.zhText: Citrine 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图可在达到精通段位 3 级后在火星的 Tyana Pass 节点获得，或从火卫二殁世幽都里的奥塔处获得。玩家必须完成《惊惧之心》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.text: Garuda's main blueprint is awarded from the Vox Solaris quest. Component blueprints are acquired from Bounties on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.zhText: Garuda 的战甲蓝图可通过完成《索拉里斯之声》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可从金星奥布山谷的赏金任务中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.text: Component blueprints for the Gauss Warframe are obtained from Disruption rotation rewards on Kappa (Sedna).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.zhText: Gauss 战甲的部件蓝图隐藏在赛德娜 Kappa 节点的中断任务里。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.text: Blueprints for Grendel's components are acquired from Grendel Locator missions on Europa. Purchase Locators via Arbitration Honors from the Arbiters of Hexis in any Relay after unlocking Arbitrations.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_G.zhText: Grendel 的部件蓝图可通过欧罗巴上的 Grendel 定位装置任务获得。玩家解锁均衡仲裁者集团后，可在任意中继站里从均衡仲裁者集团的仲裁阁下处购买定位装置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_H.text: Harrow's main blueprint is awarded from the Chains of Harrow quest. Component blueprints are obtained from Spy and Survival missions on the Kuva Fortress, Defection missions, and Corrupted Void Fissure enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_H.zhText: 通过完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务获得 Harrow 的战甲蓝图。通过叛逃任务、虚空裂缝的堕落者敌人，以及赤毒要塞的间谍和生存任务获得其部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_H.text: Hildryn's main blueprint can acquired from Vox Solaris in Fortuna (Venus) after completing The War Within quest. Component blueprints drop from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_H.zhText: 完成《内战》系列任务后，可以从金星福尔图娜里的索拉里斯之声处获取 Hildryn 的战甲蓝图。其部件蓝图可从金星奥布山谷的剥削者圆蛛处掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_K.text: Khora's component blueprints are acquired from Sanctuary Onslaught missions. Players can access Sanctuary Onslaught after completing The New Strange quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_K.zhText: Khora 的部件蓝图可通过圣殿突袭任务获得。完成《新疑谜团》系列任务后即可进行圣殿突袭任务。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_P.text: Blueprints for the Baruuk Warframe and its components may be purchased from the Vox Solaris in Fortuna (Venus). Complete The War Within quest to access this Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_P.zhText: 可以从金星福尔图娜的索拉里斯之声处购买 Baruuk 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。完成《内战》系列任务即可拜访该集团。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_R.text: Revenant's main blueprint is awarded from the Mask of the Revenant quest. Component blueprints are acquired in Bounties on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_R.zhText: Revenant 的战甲蓝图可通过完成《Revenant 的面具》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可从地球夜灵平野上的赏金任务中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_W.text: Wisp's main and component blueprints are acquired by defeating the Ropalolyst on Jupiter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DetailedPurchase_W.zhText: 可通过击败木星上的蝠力使获得 Wisp 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerDeluxeHelm.zhText: Garuda 年兽的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerDesc.text: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerDesc.zhText: Grendel 将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Grendel Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerPassiveAbi.text: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DevourerPassiveAbi.zhText: 每名被吞噬的敌人可提供 |ARMOUR| 额外护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DoomSwordPrimeDesc.text: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DoomSwordPrimeDesc.zhText: 召唤一把由纯粹的光与力量锻造而成的刀剑。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DoomSwordUmbraDesc.text: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DoomSwordUmbraDesc.zhText: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.text: Vex Armor Augment: Taking |DMG_REQ| Damage will trigger a |RADIUS|m burst. Shield damage will cause a <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status effect while Health damage will cause a <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Status effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.zhText: 怨怒护甲强化：受到 |DMG_REQ| 伤害后会触发 |RADIUS| 米的震波。护盾受损造成<DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态，而生命受损则会造成<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.text: Vex Armor Augment: Chroma reduces the damage his squadmates within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range take by |VAL1|%. Squad kills restore |VAL2|% of his Health over |HEALDURATION|s and increases Vex Armor duration by |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.zhText: 怨怒护甲强化：Chroma 可使 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内队友受到的伤害减少 |VAL1|%。小队击杀时在 |HEALDURATION| 秒内恢复 |VAL2|% 生命值并增加 |DURATION| 秒怨怒护甲持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.text: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DragonScalesAbilit.zhText: Chroma 的护盾受损或使用近战武器击杀敌人时会强化小队的护甲。当他损失生命值或使用远程武器杀死敌人时，会增加小队的武器伤害，以弱点击杀则效果加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityAugment.text: Antimatter Drop Augment: Absorbs enemy bullets within |RANGE|m, increasing the power of the explosion from Nova’s particle of antimatter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityAugment.zhText: 反物质释放强化：球体会吸收 |RANGE| 米内的敌方炮火来增加 Nova 反物质粒子爆炸时的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityAugment.text: Antimatter Drop Augment: Creates a fully charged stationary orb that explodes after |DURATION|s or within enemy proximity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityAugment.zhText: 反物质释放强化：制造一个完全充能完毕但无法移动的球体，在 |DURATION| 秒后或敌人接近时引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityDesc.text: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/DropAbilityDesc.zhText: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityAugm.text: Eclipse Augment: While active, allies within |RANGE|m benefit from Eclipse.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityAugm.zhText: 黯然失色强化：使用技能时，|RANGE| 米内的队友能得到黯然失色的增益效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityDesc.text:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityDesc.zhText:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对 Mirage 造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加 Mirage 的武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityDesc.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Effectiveness
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage your Warframe takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase your Warframe's weapon damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EclipseAbilityDesc.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：效果减弱
（短按）暂时减少敌人对战甲造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加战甲的武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ElementalAttackAbi.text: Spectral Scream Augment: Upon deactivation, Chroma will launch an elemental projectile dealing |PROJ_DPS| Damage for each second the ability was active, to a maximum of |DAMAGE_CAP| Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ElementalAttackAbi.zhText: 光暴怒吼强化：光暴怒吼激活时每秒累积 |PROJ_DPS| 伤害。关闭后，Chroma 会将累积的能量放出，发出一枚最多可造成 |DAMAGE_CAP| 伤害的元素弹。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ElementalAttackAbi.text: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ElementalAttackAbi.zhText: 释放一股毁灭性的元素吐息。轻点技能键来在各个元素之间进行切换，按住技能键来施放技能。选中的元素会应用于 Chroma 所有的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberDesc.text: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberDesc.zhText: 操纵烈焰之力。Ember 的火焰会造成很高的伤害。即使战斗进入白热化时，她仍能保持冷静的头脑。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.text: Immolation Augment: Allies within Affinity range will receive |PERCENT|% of Immolation's Damage Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.zhText: 浴火献祭强化：经验分享范围内的友军可获得 |PERCENT|% 的浴火献祭伤害减免。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.text: [PH] Immolation Augment: Ember becomes a fireball when dodging during Immolation. It releases fireballs at enemies to nearby enemies and make them +|VULNERABLE|% vulnerable to <DT_FIRE_COLOR> Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.zhText: [PH] Immolation Augment: Ember becomes a fireball when dodging during Immolation. It releases fireballs at enemies to nearby enemies and make them +|VULNERABLE|% vulnerable to <DT_FIRE_COLOR> Damage.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.text: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberImmolationAbi.zhText: 通过火焰装甲来保护 Ember，随时间的推移保护效果会增强。计量表达到最大度数后会消耗能量。重新施放技能可以熄灭火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberInfernoAbilit.text: Inferno Augment: Enemies killed while under the effect of Inferno have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop an energy orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberInfernoAbilit.zhText: 地狱烈焰强化：受地狱烈焰影响的敌人在被击杀时，有 |CHANCE|% 的几率掉落一个能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberInfernoAbilit.text: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberInfernoAbilit.zhText: 召唤一颗燃烧的彗星坠落在 Ember 的前面，让扩散的火焰来吞没敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberPassiveAbilit.text: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EmberPassiveAbilit.zhText: 从每个在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内受到 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态影响的敌人身上获得 |STRENGTH|% 技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.text: Energy Vampire Augment: Excess Energy replenishes Shields by |SHIELD_PCT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.zhText: 能量吸取强化：吸收过剩能量的 |SHIELD_PCT|% 来补充护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration and the energy leech percentage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.zhText: 提高这种能力会增加其持续时间和能量偷取百分比。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.text: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbili.zhText: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EquinoxDesc.text: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EquinoxDesc.zhText: Equinox 从白昼与黑夜的边缘崛起。她的白昼形态提供攻击支援，她的黑夜形态提供防御支援。她在白昼与黑夜之间来回游走。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/EquinoxPassiveAbil.text: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/EquinoxPassiveAbil.zhText: |PERCENT|% 的生命球会转化为能量，同时 |PERCENT|% 的能量球会转化为生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburDesc.text: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburDesc.zhText: Excalibur 是战士精神的缩影。他炉火纯青的剑术可造成高额伤害。他是卓越武学的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburPassiveAb.text: Excalibur deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburPassiveAb.zhText: 当 Excalibur 持剑时，其伤害会提升 |DAMAGE|% 且攻击速度提升 |SPEED|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburUmbraPass.text: Passive Augment: Umbra's Ability Strength increases by |val|% but he no longer fights independently alongside his Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburUmbraPass.zhText: 被动强化：Umbra 的技能强度增加 |val|%，但不再与指挥官并肩战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburUmbraPass.text: Umbra exhibits sentience in combat without Transference control. Attacks |SPEED|% faster and deals |DAMAGE|% more damage while wielding swords.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExcaliburUmbraPass.zhText: Umbra 可以在不受传识控制的情况下自主战斗。持剑时，其伤害会提升 |DAMAGE|% 且攻击速度提升 |SPEED|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExplosiveDissolveA.text: Saryn pollutes the atmosphere with a lethally poisonous mist that corrodes all enemies in range. Deals additional Damage to enemies under <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExplosiveDissolveA.zhText: Saryn 以剧毒之雾污染空气，腐蚀范围内的敌人。依据敌人所受到的毒素与病毒影响受到额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExplosiveDissolveA.text: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ExplosiveDissolveA.zhText: 释放剧毒的瘴气，对范围内的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。受到孢子影响的敌人会遭到毒雾更深的感染。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyArchwingPisto.text: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyArchwingPisto.zhText: （英文：DEX PIXIA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这对强劲的手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityAu.text: Spellbind Augment: Hitting at least |COUNT| enemies with Spellbind grants Titania |ENERGY|<ENERGY>. The next cast has +|RADIUS|% Ability Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityAu.zhText: 迷尘强化：使用迷尘命中至少 |COUNT| 个敌人会为 Titania 提供 |ENERGY|<ENERGY> 能量。下一次施放技能有 +|RADIUS|% 技能范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityDe.text: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityDe.zhText: 把敌人扫到空中，使其丢掉武器；让附近的友军对异常状态免疫。长按此技能来使 Titania 获得免疫效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityPv.text: Opponents are forced to equip their Melee Weapons, nearby allies become immune to Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyDustAbilityPv.zhText: 敌人被强制装备近战武器，而且使得附近的友军免疫异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyFlightAbility.text: Razorwing Augment: Flight Speed increased by |INCREASE|% and Fire Rate increased by |FIRE_RATE_INCREASE|% for |DURATION|s when using abilities. Stacks up to 4x.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyFlightAbility.zhText: 剃刀之翼强化：使用技能时，增加 |INCREASE|% 飞行速度和 |FIRE_RATE_INCREASE|% 射速，持续 |DURATION| 秒。这个效果最多叠加 4 次。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyFlightAbility.text: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyFlightAbility.zhText: 缩小身体并进入飞行状态，同时剃刀蝶会攻击附近的敌人并放大他们所受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityA.text: Lantern Augment: Attracted enemies take |DAMAGE_PCT|% more Weapon Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityA.zhText: 幻灯强化：被引诱的敌人会受到 |DAMAGE_PCT|% 的额外武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityD.text: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityD.zhText: 制造一群剃刀蝶将敌人转换为一个具有强力吸引力的漂浮信标，在爆炸以前吸引那些不明事理的战友靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityP.text: Create a swarm of razorflies that lifts an opponent into the air and eventually exploding. Damaging suspended target will end the suspension prematurely and drop the target without dealing any damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairyLightAbilityP.zhText: 制造一群剃刀蝶将一个敌人抬到空中，并最终爆裂。若对被抬起的目标造成伤害则会提前释放目标，且不会造成任何伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairySoulAbilityDe.text: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairySoulAbilityDe.zhText: 当对一名敌人施放技能时，循环切换并从四种增益效果中选取出一种。「荆棘」减免来袭的伤害。「尘埃」降低敌人的精准度。「满月」增加同伴的伤害。「纠缠」使范围内的敌人减速。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairySoulAbilityPv.text: Staggers opponent and reduces their damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FairySoulAbilityPv.zhText: 令对手失去平衡，并降低他们的伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityAug.text: Fireball Augment: Hold to cast will grant all allies within |RADIUS|m an additional |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage to their attacks for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityAug.zhText: 火球强化：长按来施放技能，使 |RADIUS| 米内的友军攻击附加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 额外的<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases the initial <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityBoo.zhText: 提升此技能将增加初始 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityDes.text: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityDes.zhText: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityAu.text: Fire Blast Augment: Each enemy hit heals by |HEAL_MIN| to |HEAL_MAX| depending on current Immolation level. With Ember, over healing grants you Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityAu.zhText: 火焰冲击强化：根据当前的浴火献祭水平，每个被击中的敌人能恢复 |HEAL_MIN| 到 |HEAL_MAX| 点生命值。Ember 装备时，过量治疗为你提供超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityAu.text: Fire Blast Augment: Allies hit by the expanding ring of fire are cured of Status Effects and granted |DURATION|s of Status Immunity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityAu.zhText: 火焰冲击强化：受到火焰之环影响的友军会清除所有异常状态并获得 |DURATION| 秒异常状态免疫。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityBo.text: Boosting this ability increases the initial slam damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityBo.zhText: 提升此技能将增加初始震地攻击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityDe.text: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityDe.zhText: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityDe.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: No Overguard From Healing Flames Augment
Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBlastAbilityDe.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：治愈之焰强化 Mod 不提供超宏防护
猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FlightSwordDesc.text: Take flight with Razorwing and summon this formidable heavy blade.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FlightSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：DIWATA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这把强大的巨刃。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityAugme.text: Freeze Augment: Hold to cast will grant all allies within |RADIUS|m an additional |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage to their attacks for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityAugme.zhText: 冻结强化：长按来施放技能，使 |RADIUS| 米内的友军攻击附加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 额外的<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityBoost.text: Boost the amount of damage done with Freeze.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityBoost.zhText: 提升冻结造成的伤害量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityDesc.text: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FreezeAbilityDesc.zhText: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostDesc.text: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost's attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostDesc.zhText: 当 Frost 踏上战场时，敌人会感到一阵寒意。 Frost 的攻击可以提供群体控制、保护目标，并提高生存力。驾驭刺骨的冰雪之力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveAbilit.text: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveAbilit.zhText: Frost 技能造成的冰冻异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。Frost 从每个在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内受到 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态影响的敌人身上获得 |ARMOR| 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveAbilit.text: Frost gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance and +|DAMAGE|% Critical Damage against frozen enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveAbilit.zhText: 被动强化：Frost 攻击被冻住的敌人时获得 +|CHANCE|% 暴击几率和 +|DAMAGE|% 暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveBuffDe.text: Armor increase from nearby enemies affected by Cold Status
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrostPassiveBuffDe.zhText: 在附近受到冰冻异常状态影响的敌人可使护甲增加

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusAmmoAb.text:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon's magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusAmmoAb.zhText:
投掷两个元素弹药包，可立即为当前的武器填满弹匣，同时为武器附加所选的元素伤害和异常状态。重新装填会清除效果。狙击枪可获得额外伤害。

长按技能键以选择元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.text: Cyte-09's invisibility duration. Weak Point kills increase the duration and restore Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.zhText: Cyte-09 的隐身持续时间。弱点击杀可增加持续时间并恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.text: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.zhText: 向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗 Cyte-09。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Maximum Duration capped to 25 seconds.
Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusCloakA.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：最大持续时间限制为 25 秒。
向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗 Cyte-09。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Cyte-09 Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusDefaul.zhText: Cyte-09 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Cyte-09 Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusPassiv.text: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by |INCREASE|% up to |CAP|% for the duration of the current mission.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusPassiv.zhText: 弱点击杀将使 Cyte-09 的弱点暴击几率增加 |INCREASE|%，最高可达 |CAP|%，持续至当前任务结束。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusRecipe.text: Cyte-09's main blueprint is awarded from The Hex quest. Component blueprints are acquired from Bounties in Höllvania (1999) or from Amir Beckett in Höllvania Central Mall.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusRecipe.zhText: Cyte-09 的主要蓝图可从《六人组》系列任务中获得。组件蓝图可从霍瓦尼亚（1999）的赏金任务或霍瓦尼亚中央商场的阿米尔·贝克特处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusScanAb.text: Cyte-09's Weapons' Punch Through is significantly increased
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusScanAb.zhText: Cyte-09 的武器穿透大幅增加

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusScanAb.text: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusScanAb.zhText: 放置一根天线向前发射扫描波。被探测到的敌人会受到更高的弱点伤害，并可透过墙壁被看到。武器获得穿透。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusSniper.text: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusSniper.zhText: 召唤肃清者，Cyte-09 的显赫狙击步枪。命中弱点的子弹会弹射追踪附近的其它弱点。次要射击发射 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻榴弹，完全冻结敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusSuitDe.text: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/FrumentariusSuitDe.zhText: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：Cyte-09。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GaraShankWeaponDes.text: Gara's devastating Shattered Lash, created by her Shattered lash ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GaraShankWeaponDes.zhText: Gara 的琉璃碎击能造成毁灭性的打击，由她的「琉璃碎击」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GaraShankWeaponPri.text: Gara Prime's devastating Shattered Lash Prime, created by her Shattered lash ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GaraShankWeaponPri.zhText: Gara Prime 的琉璃碎击 Prime 能造成毁灭性的打击，由她的「琉璃碎击」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaBloodAbility.text: Bloodletting Augment: Garuda's equipped weapon is reloaded up to |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaBloodAbility.zhText: 祭血仪式强化：Garuda 装备的武器被重新装填，最多可到 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaBloodAbility.text: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaBloodAbility.zhText: Garuda 以她的生命值为代价换取能量并清除异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaClawsDesc.text: These nasty things come out when Garuda forgoes a melee weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaClawsDesc.zhText: 当 Garuda 舍弃近战武器时，这些讨厌的东西便会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaDesc.text: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaDesc.zhText: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。Garuda 以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Garuda Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaPassiveAbili.text:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaPassiveAbili.zhText: 每一个 Garuda 所击杀的敌人都会为她暂时增加伤害，最高达到 |DAMAGE|%。如果她没有装备近战武器，则会使用其利爪进行斩击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaShieldAbilit.text: Dread Mirror Augment: Become unkillable for |DURATION|s when Dread Mirror kills a target by ripping its life force.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaShieldAbilit.zhText: 恐惧魔镜强化：当恐惧魔镜割取一名敌人的生命之力并将其击杀时，可无敌 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaShieldAbilit.text: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaShieldAbilit.zhText: 从敌人身上割取生命之力以作为抵挡伤害的盾。蓄力可使抵挡的伤害化为爆裂破片。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaSiphonAbilit.text: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaSiphonAbilit.zhText: 以利爪构筑的祭坛刺穿敌人，为自己及队友吸取生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaUnstopplable.text: Seeking Talons Augment: Tap to perform a |RANGE|m AoE around Garuda. Garuda's Talons gain |CHANCE|% additional Combo Count Chance when hitting targets affected by <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaUnstopplable.zhText: 穿心利爪强化：点按以在 Garuda 周围进行 |RANGE| 米的范围攻击。当击中受 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态影响的目标时，Garuda 的利爪可获得 |CHANCE|% 的额外连击数几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaUnstopplable.text: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GarudaUnstopplable.zhText: 蓄力可扩大瞄准区域，接着对瞄准区域里的每一名敌人发射高速利爪；幸存的敌人极有可能受 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态影响。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeAltHelmetDesc.text: The crystalline interior shimmers like a fire from within.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeAltHelmetDesc.zhText: 水晶般的内部结构像从内燃烧的火焰一样闪闪发光。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeCrystalAbilit.text:
Prismatic Gem Augment: The gem now attaches to your free-moving companion. 
Passive : +|DURATION|% Prismatic Gem Duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeCrystalAbilit.zhText:
棱彩宝石强化：宝石现在会附着于你自由移动的同伴身上。
被动：增加 |DURATION|% 棱彩宝石持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeCrystalAbilit.text: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeCrystalAbilit.zhText: 放置一颗发射棱彩光束的宝石。宝石瞄准正受到 Citrine 和其队友武器伤害的敌人。其光束造成火焰、冰冻、毒素和电击异常状态。附近队友的触发几率和触发时间增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeFrameDesc.text: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeFrameDesc.zhText: 凝视这位水晶卫士。Citrine 的水晶可以在战场上支持盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeGrowthsAbilit.text: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeGrowthsAbilit.zhText: Citrine 召唤水晶分形。分形向前冲，寻找敌人。被分形触碰的敌人会因水晶生长而瘫痪。击中水晶生长以造成暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeGrowthsAugmen.text: Crystallize Augment: Enemies killed by crystalline growths stagger and spread the crystals to enemies within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeGrowthsAugmen.zhText: 晶化生长强化：被晶化生长击杀的敌人会使 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人失衡并对他们散播晶石。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Citrine Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodePassiveAbilit.text: Citrine grants nearby allies |BASE| health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by |HPS|, up to a maximum of |MAX|.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodePassiveAbilit.zhText: Citrine 使附近的友军每秒恢复 |BASE| 生命值。捡起生命球以增加 |HPS| 生命恢复速率，最多增加 |MAX|。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShardsAbility.text: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShardsAbility.zhText: 用造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态的水晶爆裂切割敌人并使敌人失衡。在此异常状态下的敌人有更高的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShardsAbility.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Strength
Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShardsAbility.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：强度减少
用造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态的水晶爆裂切割敌人并使敌人失衡。在此异常状态下的敌人有更高的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShellAbilityD.text: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShellAbilityD.zhText: Citrine 通过逐渐衰减的水晶外壳保护自己和附近的盟友。击杀和助攻可以增加外壳的防御能力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityAugme.text: Shuriken Augment: Hits expose weaknesses on enemies, reducing their Armor by |ARMOR_REDUCTION|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityAugme.zhText: 手里剑强化：敌人被击中后其弱点将被暴露在外，于 |DURATION| 秒内降低 |ARMOR_REDUCTION|% 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability greatly increases the damage dealt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityBoost.zhText: 提高这种能力将大大增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityDesc.text: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityDesc.zhText: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityPvPDe.text: Launches a homing blade of pain, dealing <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlaiveAbilityPvPDe.zhText: 发射一枚追踪的苦痛利刃，造成<DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassAltHelmetDesc.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Gara.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassAltHelmetDesc.zhText: Gara 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassDesc.text: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassDesc.zhText: Gara 以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。Gara 的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassFragmentAbili.text: Spectrorage Augment: Enemies that die within Spectrorage have a |PCT|% chance to drop an Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassFragmentAbili.zhText: 光谱盛怒强化：死于光谱盛怒内的敌人会有 |PCT|% 几率掉落一个能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassFragmentAbili.text: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassFragmentAbili.zhText: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gara Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassPassiveAbilit.text: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassPassiveAbilit.zhText: 当 Gara 施放技能时，有几率使周围的敌人陷入目盲状态 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassRingAbilityDe.text: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassRingAbilityDe.zhText: 创造一圈逐渐扩张的熔融玻璃环，进入环内的敌人将逐渐结晶化。当扩张完毕时，玻璃环将硬化并能阻挡外界火力。环可以从结晶化敌人的护盾和生命中获取额外的力量。使用「琉璃碎击」可以击碎玻璃环，并将尖锐的玻璃碎片击飞。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShankAbilityA.text: Shattered Lash Augment: When Gara breaks her Mass Vitrify ring with Shattered Lash, enemies struck by the glass suffer Splinter Storm at |PCT|% Strength.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShankAbilityA.zhText: 琉璃碎击强化：当 Gara 使用琉璃碎击打碎广域玻璃化的玻璃环时，被玻璃击中的敌人受到 |PCT|% 强度的玻片风暴伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShankAbilityD.text: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShankAbilityD.zhText: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShatterAbilit.text: Splinter Storm Augment: For each target affected, Splinter Storm heals |HEAL| Health/s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShatterAbilit.zhText: 玻片风暴强化：每有一个目标受到影响，玻片风暴每秒恢复 |HEAL| 血量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShatterAbilit.text: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GlassShatterAbilit.zhText: Gara 的护甲会分裂为碎玻璃组成的漩涡。置身其中的友军可减免敌人的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleAbility.text: [PH] Prism Augment: Prism has a |CHANCE|% chance to cause a random elemental Status Effect on every hit.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleAbility.zhText: [PH] Prism Augment: Prism has a |CHANCE|% chance to cause a random elemental Status Effect on every hit.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleAbility.text: Prism Augment: Prism follows above Mirage. Duration changed to |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleAbility.zhText: 棱镜强化：棱镜将会在 Mirage 上方跟随，持续时间变为 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleDesc.text: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrandFinaleDesc.zhText: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.text: Rip Line Augment: Rip Lines has no Energy cost while Airborne.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.zhText: 撕裂钩索强化：在空中施放撕裂钩索不消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.text: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.zhText: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.text: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrappleHookAbility.zhText: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelBowlAbility.text: Pulverize Augment: <SECONDARY_FIRE> to launch Grendel in your aim direction. Costs <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY|<ENERGY>. Crouch to slow down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelBowlAbility.zhText: 肉弹碾压强化：用 <SECONDARY_FIRE> 来将 Grendel 发射到准星指向方向。消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| <ENERGY>。下蹲可减速。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelBowlAbility.text: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelBowlAbility.zhText: Grendel 蜷缩成一个球，在此期间他会随时间流逝恢复生命值，并冲撞任何胆敢挡住他的人。跳跃会让 Grendel 朝地面猛砸，并产生一股破坏性的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.text: Nourish Augment: Clear Status Effects and gain |DURATION|s of Status Immunity for each victim in Grendel's stomach.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.zhText: 消化滋养强化：清除异常状态，并基于 Grendel 腹中的受害者数量获得每个受害者 |DURATION| 秒的异常状态免疫效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.text: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.zhText: Grendel 从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击 Grendel 或被 Grendel 攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Self-Heal Removed and Effect Reduced
Enemies that attack or are attacked suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage up to one stack and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelConsumeAbil.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：移除自我治疗和效果降低
攻击或者被攻击的敌人受到<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，最多叠加一层，同时能量源提供更多能量。这些增益也作用于队友身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelDevour2Abil.text: Feast Augment: Instead of Energy, consumes <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COST| Health on cast. Glutton grants an additional |ARMOUR| Armor per enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelDevour2Abil.zhText: 大快朵颐强化：施放技能时不消耗能量，而是消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COST| 生命值。每一个被吞噬的敌人可使吞天食地额外获得 |ARMOUR| 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelDevour2Abil.text: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelDevour2Abil.zhText: 将敌人囫囵吞入 Grendel 的腹内。按住技能键即可将腹内的敌人吐出，而这些敌人身上会覆盖着毒性消化液。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelPassiveAbil.text: Passive Augment: Each enemy consumed adds |BUFF|% <DT_GAS_COLOR> Extra Gas Damage to Primary and Secondary Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelPassiveAbil.zhText: 被动强化：每吞噬一个敌人，主要武器和次要武器就会增加额外 |BUFF|% <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelRegurgitate.text: Regurgitate Augment: Regurgitated enemies bounce up to 3 times, creating gas clouds that last |DURATION|s and inflict nearby enemies with <DT_GAS_COLOR> Gas Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelRegurgitate.zhText: 剧烈反刍强化：被反刍的敌人最多弹跳 3 次，形成持续 |DURATION| 秒的毒气云，并对附近的敌人造成 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelRegurgitate.text: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile that does bonus damage based on the enemy's Max Health. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GrendelRegurgitate.zhText: 将浸泡在 Grendel 体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物，并基于敌人的最大生命值造成额外伤害。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GunFuAbilityAugmen.text: Peacemaker Augment: Mesa can move at |SPEED_PCT|% Speed while using Peacemaker.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GunFuAbilityAugmen.zhText: 和平使者强化：在使用和平使者过程中，Mesa 能以 |SPEED_PCT|% 的速度移动。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GunFuAbilityDesc.text: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GunFuAbilityDesc.zhText: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreChassisCompone.text: Chassis component of the Gyre Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreEnergizedAbili.text: Cathode Grace Augment: Eliminating an enemy while Cathode Grace is active will release an additional discharge from Rotorswell with |PCT|% Damage and extend its duration by the same amount.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreEnergizedAbili.zhText: 阴极泰来强化：在阴极泰来激活期间消灭敌人会额外释放一道具有 |PCT|% 伤害的超旋链波电击，并同时延长超旋链波的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreEnergizedAbili.text: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreEnergizedAbili.zhText: 在短时内可获取提升的暴击几率和能量恢复，每击杀一名敌人都可以延长「阴极泰来」的持续时间。施放后进入技能冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreFrameDesc.text: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreFrameDesc.zhText: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，Gyre 的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreHelmetAltDesc.text: Complete the circuit with this alternative helmet for Gyre.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreHelmetAltDesc.zhText: 通过这款 Gyre 的替代头盔来联通电路。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreHelmetComponen.text: Neuroptics component of the Gyre Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreHelmetComponen.zhText: Gyre 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gyre Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreOverchargedAbi.text: Rotorswell Augment: |REDIRECT|% of damage received is redirected toward the instigator as <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreOverchargedAbi.zhText: 超旋链波强化：将受到伤害的 |REDIRECT|% 以 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害的形式反弹至攻击者身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreOverchargedAbi.text: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreOverchargedAbi.zhText: Gyre 的机械装置会以令人难以置信的速度高速旋转产生一个电场，并电击附近的敌人。当 Gyre 造成暴击后，被击中的敌人处会产生一个巨大的电流来攻击附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePassiveDescrip.text: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePassiveDescrip.zhText: 每个对敌人产生影响的电击异常状态使 Gyre 的技能有 10% 几率对该敌人造成暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePulseAbilityAu.text: Arcsphere Augment: Projectiles that pass through Arcsphere have guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status Effect and +|DAMAGE|% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePulseAbilityAu.zhText: 电弧球强化：穿过电弧球的投射物必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态和增加 |DAMAGE|% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePulseAbilityDe.text: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyrePulseAbilityDe.zhText: 发射一颗回旋球体，在撞击时造成大量伤害，并且可以定期对周围的敌人产生电击。在初始发射时一次性击中多名敌人来提升伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreRecipeHelpText.text: Gyre's main and component blueprints are acquired from Bounties on the Zariman after completing the Angels of the Zariman quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreRecipeHelpText.zhText: 完成《扎里曼的天使》系列任务后，可以从扎里曼号上的赏金任务中获得 Gyre 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityA.text: Coil Horizon Augment: Gyratory Sphere can be recalled. Enemies in its radius suffer |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage and chain other enemies. Enemies pulled into detonation suffer additional discharges.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityA.zhText: 旋爆视界强化：可以召回回旋球。其范围内的敌人将遭受 |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害，并使其他敌人受到连锁电击。被拉入爆炸范围的敌人将受到额外电击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityD.text: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSphereAbilityD.zhText: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/GyreSystemsCompone.text: Systems component of the Gyre Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthAmmoEffici.text: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthAmmoEffici.zhText: 提高你的武器弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthCompanionD.text: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthCompanionD.zhText: 治疗你的同伴，并让它立刻回到你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthEnergyShar.text: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthEnergyShar.zhText: 消耗能量治疗自身，并使每名友军获得等值的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthHackDescri.text: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthMaxStatusD.text: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthMaxStatusD.zhText: 施放一个脉冲，为敌人身上已有的异常状态效果叠加层数。<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态的伤害（不包括由「恶疾脉冲」自身产生的伤害）将被叠加，从而生成一个全新的异常状态效果，并重新计时

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthProcBlockD.text: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthProcBlockD.zhText: 赋予自身异常状态免疫效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthShieldArmo.text: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthShieldArmo.zhText: 牺牲护盾以在一段时间内增强护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStatusRush.text: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStatusRush.zhText: 将所有 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态浓缩为一个单次伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStrengthDe.text: Increase the strength of your next ability use.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStunDescri.text: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthStunDescri.zhText: 击晕一个敌人，对它造成的下一发伤害的一部分也将被应用于周围所有的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthTreasureDe.text: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelminthTreasureDe.zhText: 发射一道短暂的虚空火花指向离你最近的集团奖章、阿耶檀识塑像、稀有储存箱、未扫描的库利亚猫神器或碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelpRecipeSentient.text: Component blueprints can be acquired from Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and the Orb Vallis (Venus) after completing The New War quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HelpRecipeSentient.zhText: 完成《新纪之战》系列任务后，可以从地球夜灵平野和金星奥布山谷的合一众赏金任务中获取部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltBHelmetD.text: Love the light of dawn even as you know the shadow of death. A distinguished helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltBHelmetD.zhText: 即使你知道死亡的阴影，也要爱上黎明的光芒。 Styanax 的杰出头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltCHelmetD.text: Show bravery in the service of justice. An esteemed helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltCHelmetD.zhText: 为正义付出时表现出勇敢的精神。Styanax 的敬重头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltHelmetDe.text: Remember your courage with each step. An elite helmet for Styanax.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteAltHelmetDe.zhText: 将勇气铭记于心伴随你前行的每一步。Styanax 的精英头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteArmyAbility.text: Final Stand Augment: Each javelin that damages an enemy grants |OVERGUARD| Overguard to Styanax and |ALLY| Overguard to his allies within Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteArmyAbility.zhText: 终极之战强化：每一支对敌人造成伤害的标枪都使 Styanax 获得 |OVERGUARD| 超宏防护，并使他经验共享范围内的队友获得 |ALLY| 超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteArmyAbility.text: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteArmyAbility.zhText: 彰显力量与勇气。跃至空中并连续投掷崇敬标枪。标枪无论是否落地都可以对附近的敌人造成伤害。直接命中敌人将造成更高伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBashAbility.text: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBashAbility.zhText: 召唤豪勇，Styanax 之盾。挥舞豪勇击退敌人并减少他们的护盾和护甲。每击中一名敌人，Styanax 都会恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBash_Abilit.text: Tharros Strike Augment: Increases Critical Damage by |CRITICAL|% on enemies you hit. Critical Damage bonus is doubled for Spearguns.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteBash_Abilit.zhText: 豪勇之击强化：命中敌人时，暴击伤害增加 |CRITICAL|%。使用标枪时，暴击伤害加成翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteFrameDesc.text: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteFrameDesc.zhText: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Styanax Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteImpaleAbili.text: Axios Javelin Augment: A pair of Styanax Specters spawn to throw javelins, creating vortexes on impact. Impale an enemy to increase vortex duration by |VAL|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteImpaleAbili.zhText: 崇敬标枪强化：召唤一对 Styanax 魅影投掷标枪，命中时产生漩涡。穿透敌人可使漩涡持续时间增加 |VAL| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteImpaleAbili.text: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteImpaleAbili.zhText: 投掷一支崇敬标枪。当标枪将敌人钉在墙上时，周围的敌人会被拉近并遭受爆发式伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HoplitePassiveAbil.text: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HoplitePassiveAbil.zhText: Styanax 的暴击几率随着他的护盾量而提升，标枪武器可获得双倍增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRallyAbilit.text: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRallyAbilit.zhText: 将敌人的注意力引向 Styanax。他的决心会鼓舞附近的友军和自己，使其随时间恢复能量。Styanax 和他的队友每次杀敌助攻都会恢复护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRecipeHelpT.text: Acquire Styanax blueprint and component blueprints from Chipper in the Drifter's Camp after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HopliteRecipeHelpT.zhText: 完成 《破障者》系列任务后，可从漂泊者营地的切片哥处获取 Styanax 战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidDesc.text: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidDesc.zhText: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidPassiveAbil.text: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/HydroidPassiveAbil.zhText: 被 Hydroid 伤害的敌人更容易受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态的影响，首次触发降低护甲 |PCT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityAugm.text: Ice Wave Augment: Create a frozen trail for |DURATION| seconds. Enemies that touch it are inflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status every second.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityAugm.zhText: 冰浪强化：制造一道持续 |DURATION| 秒的冰痕。接触它的敌人每秒都会被施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityBoos.text: Boost the distance your Ice Wave travels

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityDesc.text: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IceWaveAbilityDesc.zhText: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityAug.text: Hall of Mirrors Augment: The damage of your doppelgangers is increased by |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% every time you kill an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityAug.zhText: 镜厅强化：每击杀一名敌人，你的分身所造成伤害增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityDes.text: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IllusionAbilityDes.zhText: Mirage 创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosDesc.text: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosDesc.zhText: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosPassiveAbili.text: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InarosPassiveAbili.zhText: 当 Inaros 受到致命伤害时，他会将自己封入石棺中，并化身为沙土攻击敌人，吸取他们的生命力来复活自己。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityAugme.text: Ravenous Augment: Nidus has a chance for additional Mutation stacks while in the infestation. The base |CHANCE|% chance increases with power strength, and multiple stacks are possible above 100%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityAugme.zhText: 贪婪强化：Nidus 在感染范围内时有 |CHANCE|% 几率获得额外突变适性叠层。此几率的基础数值可通过技能强度来提升，当此数值超过 100% 时叠层可多次叠加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityDesc.text: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestAbilityDesc.zhText: 异常贪婪的蛆虫群包围敌人并据以为食，直到敌人被「致病力」命中并在身上爆发感染为止。突变适性对蛆虫有增益效果，而每击中一名敌人会增加突变适性的累积。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityA.text: Parasitic Link Augment: Nidus and any ally he's bound to gain |HEALTH|% Max Health per Mutation during Parasitic Link.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityA.zhText: 寄生链接强化：寄生链接期间每次突变都会为 Nidus 和他链接的友军增加 |HEALTH|% 最大生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityD.text: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAbilityD.zhText: 以寄生链接绑定目标。施展对象为友军时，Nidus 与宿主的技能强度和武器伤害都会提升；连结至敌方时，宿主可为 Nidus 承受部分伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAugmentB.text: Temporarily maintain Health increase from Parasitic Vitality
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestLinkAugmentB.zhText: 暂时维持来自寄生活力的生命值增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAbili.text: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAbili.zhText: 如果 Nidus 在被击杀时拥有至少 |STACKS| 层突变适性，那么这 |STACKS| 层突变适性会被消耗掉；同时 Nidus 会获得 |DURATION| 秒无敌时间并恢复 |HEAL|% 的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAugme.text: Passive Augment: Nidus gains an additional |STACKS| max stacks of Mutation. Undying has a |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestPassiveAugme.zhText: 被动强化：给 Nidus 增加最多 |STACKS| 层突变适性 。「不死」被动技能有 |COOLDOWN| 秒的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationAltHelm.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Nidus.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationAltHelm.zhText: Nidus 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationDesc.text: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationDesc.zhText: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InfestationHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nidus Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotAltHelmetDe.text: This alternate helmet for Follie blends colors the way Follie blends reality.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotAltHelmetDe.zhText: Follie 的这款替换头盔正如其能融合现实般，交融着多种色彩。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotDesc.text: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotDesc.zhText: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者 Follie 赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotFestivities.text: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotFestivities.zhText: 将附近的敌人绑在漂浮的气球上，气球会向他们喷洒墨蚀。戳破气球，敌人会坠落到地面，飞溅的墨汁会对附近的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotGouacheDesc.text: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotGouacheDesc.zhText: 穿过墨色框架，在目标地点以无敌的飞溅的墨汁出现，对附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Follie Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintChange.text: Shadowgraph has been modified. Save changes before exiting?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintChange.zhText: 绘影图已被修改。退出前先保存更改内容？

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintClearC.text: This will delete all layers. Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintClearC.zhText: 这将删除所有图层。你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintContra.text:
You are saving a custom Shadowgraph. Showcasing your talent and creativity is important, but not at the expense of others. Your creations must adhere to the Warframe Community Guidelines.

Type '|WORD|' to agree.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintContra.zhText:
你正在保存自定义绘影图。展现你的才华和创意固然重要，但不能以牺牲他人利益为代价。你的作品必须符合《Warframe 社区准则》。

输入"|WORD|"即表示同意。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintContra.text: Your creations must adhere to the Warframe Community Guidlines.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintContra.zhText: 你的作品必须符合《Warframe 社区准则》。
提交？输入 |WORD| 即可确认。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintCopy.text: Copy layer color and opacity into currently selected layer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintCopy.zhText: 将图层颜色和不透明度复制到当前选定图层。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintDescDr.text: <WARNING> Click and drag to swap the Shadowgraphs of two abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintDescDr.zhText: <WARNING> 点击并拖拽以交换两个技能的绘影图。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintLayerM.zhText: 将图层 |FIRST| 移动到图层 |SECOND|

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetA.text: Cannot have an empty canvas. Reset to default and close?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetA.zhText: 画布不能为空。是否重置为默认设置并关闭？

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetC.text: This will reset the canvas back to its default state. Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintResetC.zhText: 这将把画布重置为默认状态。你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintShapes.text: <WARNING> Drag brush strokes onto the canvas to create new layers
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPaintShapes.zhText: <WARNING> 将画笔笔触拖到画布上以创建新图层

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPassiveDesc.text: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by |SLOW|% for |DURATION|s. Afflicted enemies have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotPassiveDesc.zhText: 墨蚀：Follie 的技能使敌人身上沾满墨水，使其移动速度减缓 |SLOW|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。受墨蚀效果影响的敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.text: Provides ammo for any weapon type.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.zhText: 可为任意类型的武器提供弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.text: Three Amphors of random elemental affinity to use as grenades or for Alchemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.zhText: 三个元素属性随机的元素瓶，可用作手榴弹或元素转换。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.text: Disrupts and controls enemies with Electricity Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookA.zhText: 利用电击伤害扰乱和控制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookC.text: A random conduit key to speed up Disruption missions.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookC.zhText: 随机生成的导管钥匙，用于加速中断任务。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.text: [PH] Paint a Dargyn vehicle into the world that you can use for navigation and damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.zhText: [PH] Paint a Dargyn vehicle into the world that you can use for navigation and damage.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.text: Inflicts Radiation status and damages enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.zhText: 使敌人陷入辐射异常状态并造成伤害。
分散敌人注意力并吸引火力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.text:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookD.zhText:
将 Follie 绘影集中的绘影图变为具有战术优势的道具。绘影图生成时会向附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

长按可打开绘影图轮盘。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookJ.zhText: 提供额外的向上移动力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookL.text: Provides extra support during Survival missions.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookL.zhText: 在生存任务中提供额外的生命维持。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookL.text: Surges those who use it with Void power.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookP.zhText: 为挖掘任务中的挖掘机提供动力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookR.text: [PH] Paint a Rampart into the world that you can use to mow down your enemies with scaling damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookR.zhText: [PH] Paint a Rampart into the world that you can use to mow down your enemies with scaling damage.
威力巨大的炽蛇军火箭发射器。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookT.text: Ensnares enemies and slows them down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookT.zhText: 困住敌人并减缓其速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSketchbookT.text: Points the way to nearby treasure.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Follie Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotTrompeLoeil.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Damage Reduction cap at 75%, and Inkblot will not be applied on enemies.

Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotTrompeLoeil.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：伤害减免上限为 75%，且墨蚀效果不再作用于敌人。

绘制墨像来吸收 Follie 和友军所受的伤害。在其下方的墨池会挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀墨池内的敌人可使 Follie 的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotTrompeLoeil.text: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotTrompeLoeil.zhText: 绘制墨像来吸收 Follie 和友军所受的伤害。下方墨池挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀墨池内的敌人可使 Follie 的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotWheelSwapDe.text: This will swap a default Shadowgraph to an unrelated item, are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InkblotWheelSwapDe.zhText: 这将把默认的绘影图转换为无关的物品，你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.text: Invisibility Augment: Weapon noise is reduced by |NOISE_REDUC|% while invisible.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.zhText: 隐形强化：隐形状态中，武器噪音减少 |NOISE_REDUC|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.zhText: 提高这种能力会延长其持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.text: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.zhText: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.text: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies. Camouflage is broken on receiving or dealing damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilit.zhText: Loki 伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。当受到伤害或造成伤害时，伪装效果解除。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameAuraAbili.text: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameAuraAbili.zhText: 在友军周围创造一道护盾光环。敌人会在靠近 Hildryn 时受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlastAbil.text: Balefire Augment: Fully charged direct hits restore |SHIELD| Shield to Hildryn. Impact with Nullifier Shields will destroy them and restore |NULLIFIER_SHIELD| Shield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlastAbil.zhText: 野火燎原强化：完全蓄力后直接命中目标可为 Hildryn 恢复 |SHIELD| 点护盾。击中虚能船员的护盾将摧毁他们并恢复 |NULLIFIER_SHIELD| 点护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlastAbil.text: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlastAbil.zhText: 蓄力并迸发毁灭性的闪电。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlasterDe.text: Charges up and releases bolts of Balefire.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameBlasterDe.zhText: 蓄力并放出闪电般的野火。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameDesc.text: Strength is Hildryn's virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameDesc.zhText: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameEruptionA.text: Aegis Storm Augment: Balefire has an Alternate Fire during Aegis Storm. The blast deals |PERCENT|% of Hildryn's Max Shield as additional damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameEruptionA.zhText: 神盾风暴强化：在神盾风暴期间，野火燎原具有次要射击。该爆炸造成的额外伤害等于 Hildryn 最大护盾的 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameEruptionA.text: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameEruptionA.zhText: 升上天空并对敌人降下野火火箭。附近的敌人会被炸向空中，且每隔数秒就会在他们身上生成一颗能量球。当护盾耗尽后敌人将被摔回地面。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameHelmetDes.text: The standard issue helmet for the Hildryn Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFramePassiveAb.text: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFramePassiveAb.zhText: Hildryn 的满护盾保险时间很长。在她的护盾耗尽后，她在 3.5 秒内免疫伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameStripAbil.text: Pillage Augment: Enemies affected by Haven will be set ablaze for |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and restore |SHIELD| additional <SHIELD>Shields to Hildryn.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameStripAbil.zhText: 掠夺强化：受「和平之地」影响的敌人将被点燃且受到 |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并为 Hildryn 回复 |SHIELD| 额外 <SHIELD>护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameStripAbil.text: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronFrameStripAbil.zhText: 掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除 Hildryn 和她队友的异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityAug.text: Iron Skin Augment: Recasting Iron Skin will cause it to detonate, dealing |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% of its remaining Health as <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage, and knocking down enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityAug.zhText: 钢化皮肤强化：再次施放此技能可引爆钢化皮肤，对敌方造成钢化皮肤剩余生命 |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% 的<DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害并击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases the damage negated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityBoo.zhText: 提高此技能可增加伤害抵抗量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityDes.text: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IronSkinAbilityDes.zhText: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ItemInventory_Slot.zhText: 增加 1 个殁世机甲槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IvaraDesc.text: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/IvaraDesc.zhText: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。 Ivara 善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/IvaraPassiveAbilit.zhText: 侦测周围 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityAu.text: Strangledome Augment: Enemies held in Strangledome have a |DROP_CHANCE|% chance of dropping additional loot.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityAu.zhText: 绞杀穹顶强化：被悬吊在穹顶内的敌人有 |DROP_CHANCE|% 的几率掉落额外战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityDe.text: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCageAbilityDe.zhText: 编织出一张活动的锁链穹顶，禁锢并勒住其中的敌人和胆敢接近的蠢货。在穹顶外部的敌人会借由试着射击他们的同袍来加速其死亡；使用长鞭利爪击打穹顶可使其伤害遍及至任何被困住的敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityA.text: Whipclaw Augment: Hitting |ENEMY_TARGETS| enemies will grant a |DAMAGE|% stacking Damage Bonus to subsequent Whipclaws. Bonus will decay after |DECAY_PAUSE|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityA.zhText: 长鞭利爪强化：击中 |ENEMY_TARGETS| 名敌人后会给予 |DAMAGE|% 叠加的伤害加成到之后的鞭击。加成会在 |DECAY_PAUSE| 秒后衰减。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityD.text: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraCrackAbilityD.zhText: 在欲聋的鞭打声中将敌人击退。装备在「长鞭利爪」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraDesc.text: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraDesc.zhText: Khora 有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityA.text: Venari Augment: Venari dies in Khora's place. Recovery timer increased to |TIMER|s. Killing enemies decreases the timer by |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityA.zhText: 薇娜丽强化：薇娜丽代替 Khora 的死亡。其恢复倒计时增加到 |TIMER| 秒。每杀死一名敌人会减少 |TIME| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityD.text: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatAbilityD.zhText: 命令薇娜丽专注于一名目标；按住技能来切换攻击，保护和治疗形态；若薇娜丽阵亡，使用此技能可以立即复活她。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatDesc.text: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraKavatDesc.zhText: Khora 忠诚的库娃。她永远的同伴和守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraPassiveAbilit.text: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraPassiveAbilit.zhText: 薇娜丽，这只凶猛的库娃，与 Khora 并肩战斗，并为她提供 |SPEED|% 的速度加成。如果被击杀，薇娜丽会在 |RESPAWN| 秒后复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraTwirlAbilityD.text: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraTwirlAbilityD.zhText: 使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraWhipclawWeapo.text: Khora's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraWhipclawWeapo.zhText: Khora 的致命显赫长鞭，由她的「长鞭利爪」技能召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraWhipclawWeapo.text: Khora Prime's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KhoraWhipclawWeapo.zhText: Khora Prime 的致命显赫长鞭，由她的「长鞭利爪」技能召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiBlockAbility.text:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiBlockAbility.zhText:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间获得无敌效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiBlockAbility.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Gain between 10 to 20 Omamori Charms but cannot gain the invulnerability.
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiBlockAbility.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：获得的御守护符数量在 10 到 20 之间，无法获得无敌效果。
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间提供无敌效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiChassisCompo.text: Chassis component of the Koumei Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Koumei Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiDesc.text: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiDesc.zhText: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiFortuneAbili.text: Omikuji Augment: Reduce Omikuji's Cooldown by |COOLDOWN|s when you kill an enemy with the weapon affected by Koumei's Passive.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiFortuneAbili.zhText: 御神签强化：当你使用受 Koumei 被动效果强化的武器击杀敌人时，御神签的冷却时间减少 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiFortuneAbili.text:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiFortuneAbili.zhText:
Koumei 预视到了一个美好的未来以及实现它的具体步骤。完成挑战即可获得王令。运气不好的掷骰结果会带来一种减益，但你可以长按技能键以放弃该御神签。

掷出三个六则可以直接获得王令，无需挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiHelmetCompon.text: Neuroptics component of the Koumei Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiHelmetCompon.zhText: Koumei 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Koumei Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiInstantRewar.text: Destiny aligns. Koumei seizes a Decree.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiInstantRewar.zhText: 命运降临。Koumei 取得了一个王令。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveAbili.text: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveAbili.zhText: 每隔 |DURATION| 秒，Koumei 的一件武器将会造成随机异常状态，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveMelee.text: Melee hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveMelee.zhText: 近战攻击会造成随机异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassivePrima.text: Primary Weapon hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassivePrima.zhText: 主要武器攻击会造成随机异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveSecon.text: Secondary Weapon hits apply a random Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPassiveSecon.zhText: 次要武器攻击会造成随机异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPuppetsAbili.text:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiPuppetsAbili.zhText:
像操纵牵线木偶一样操纵敌人的命运之线。Koumei 的骰子决定了 Koumei 面前的敌人将承受的异常状态数量。

掷出三个六会造成持续的额外异常状态，并将人偶戏效果延伸到 Koumei 背后的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiStringsAbili.text: Kumihimo Augment: <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|KILLAMOUNT| kills with weapons affected by Koumei's Passive give a loaded die that always rolls 6. Hold to cast empowered Kumihimo and consume all dice.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiStringsAbili.zhText: 命运编织强化：使用受 Koumei 被动效果强化的武器造成 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|KILLAMOUNT| 次击杀，将获得一个必定掷出 6 的骰子。按住施放强化的命运编织会消耗全部骰子。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiStringsAbili.text:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiStringsAbili.zhText:
编织命运之线。触碰命运之线的敌人会受到随机元素异常状态的影响。

投掷出三个六点会产生可以造成所有元素异常状态的线。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KoumeiSystemsCompo.text: Systems component of the Koumei Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityAugme.text: Tentacle Swarm Augment: Enemies held by tentacles have a |DROP_CHANCE|% chance at additional drops.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityAugme.zhText: 触角肆虐强化：遭触角抓住的敌人有 |DROP_CHANCE|% 的几率掉落额外道具。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityDesc.text: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/KrakenAbilityDesc.zhText: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.text: Hysteria Augment: Attack with Valkyr's Talons to leap onto targeted enemies up to |RANGE|m away. Gain +|PARKOUR_BOOST_PCT|% Parkour Velocity and +|SPRINT_BOOST_PCT|% Sprint Speed for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.zhText: 狂化爆发强化：使用 Valkyr 的利爪攻击，跃向最远 |RANGE| 米外的目标敌人。增加 |PARKOUR_BOOST_PCT|% 跑酷速度和 |SPRINT_BOOST_PCT|% 冲刺速度，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.text: Hysteria Augment: While Hysteria is active, each kill restores |SHIELD_PCT|% Maximum Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.zhText: 狂化爆发强化：狂化爆发启动时，每击杀一名敌人便可恢复 |SHIELD_PCT|% 的最高护盾值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.text: Hysteria Augment: Damage increased by |DAMAGE|%, Critical Chance increased by |CRIT|%. Hysteria lasts for |DURATION|s, and receives a matching cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityAu.zhText: 狂化爆发强化：增加 |DAMAGE|% 伤害，增加 |CRIT|% 暴击几率。狂化爆发持续 |DURATION| 秒，并有相应的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityDe.text: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandAbilityDe.zhText: Valkyr 露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。Valkyr 在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。
