/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandHysteriaA.text: Bonus Armor to Warcry during Hysteria
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandHysteriaA.zhText: 狂化爆发咆哮护甲加成

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandStanceDes.text: Valkyr is imbued with energy and becomes a ball of vicious rage, capable of unleashing a torrent of deadly claw attacks on unsuspecting foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LastStandStanceDes.zhText: Valkyr 成为充满能量的愤怒化身，对无防备的敌人释放致命爪击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavoPassiveAbility.text:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavoPassiveAbility.zhText:
能量球和通用补给球可使 Lavos 对异常状态免疫 |DURATION| 秒。

长按任意技能键，来在下一次施放时注入额外的元素伤害和异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosChassisCompon.text: Chassis component of the Lavos Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosHelmetCompone.text: Neuroptics component of the Lavos Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosHelmetCompone.zhText: Lavos 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LavosSystemsCompon.text: Systems component of the Lavos Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityAugm.text: Bastille Augment: Killing an enemy in Bastille extends the duration by 2s. Vortex's duration is increased by |DURATION_INC|% of its Maximum Duration for each additional Vortex thrown into it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityAugm.zhText: 力场牢狱强化：在力场牢狱内击杀一个敌人，可延长持续时间 2 秒。每投进牢狱一个额外漩涡，漩涡的持续时间都会增加其最长延续时间的 |DURATION_INC|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityDesc.text:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityDesc.zhText:
建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给 Vauban 和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。

长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityPvPD.text: Creates an energy-based containment field that slows down any opponents who enter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LevTrapAbilityPvPD.zhText: 制造一个能量牵制力场，减缓进入其中的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboDesc.text: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboDesc.zhText: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。 Limbo 通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboPassiveAbilit.text: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LimboPassiveAbilit.zhText: 闪避动作可以进入或退出裂隙位面。进入位面时会留下一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的小型裂隙传送门。身处裂隙位面之中时，能量会缓慢恢复，并且每一个在裂隙位面被杀死的敌人都会产生 |ENERGY| 点能量恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityAugment.text: Link Augment: Reduces Armor Rating by |ARMOR_REDUCTION|% on enemies targeted by Link.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityAugment.zhText: 链接强化：被链接敌人的护甲减少 |ARMOR_REDUCTION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityBoost.zhText: 提高这种能力会增加其持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityDesc.text: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityDesc.zhText: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityAugm.text: Undertow Augment: Allies can stand in the pool to regain |HEALTH_PERCENT|% Health every |HEAL_TICK|s. Hydroid will restore |SELF_HEAL|% Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityAugm.zhText: 水漩涡强化：队友站在漩涡池中每 |HEAL_TICK| 秒可恢复 |HEALTH_PERCENT|% 生命值。Hydroid 将恢复 |SELF_HEAL|% 的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityDesc.text: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityDesc.zhText: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityPvPD.text: Become a water trap, opponents that come into contact will be knocked down if they attempt to jump.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityPvPD.zhText: 变成一个水陷阱，接触到的敌人如果试图跳跃则将被击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquifyAbilityAugm.text: Plunder Augment: Plunder gains |ARMOUR|% max <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage and Armor, and heals allies within Affinity range for |HEALTH| Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquifyAbilityAugm.zhText: 劫掠强化：劫掠获得 |ARMOUR|% 的最大 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害和护甲，并恢复经验共享范围内的队友 |HEALTH| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiDesc.text: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiDesc.zhText: Loki 精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiPassiveAbility.text: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LokiPassiveAbility.zhText: 壁面攀附时间提升 |MULT| 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LuckyDragonAbility.text: Elemental Ward Augment: Allies that leave the radius will retain the effect for |DURATION_PCT|% of the remaining duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LuckyDragonAbility.zhText: 元素之护强化：队友在离开技能范围之后会保留其效果的 |DURATION_PCT|% 剩余持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/LuckyDragonAbility.text: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/LuckyDragonAbility.zhText: 根据 Chroma 的元素属性，制造攻击性的范围效果。而 Chroma 和附近的盟友会被这股防御能量保护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagDesc.text: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagDesc.zhText: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。Mag 通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityDesc.text: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityDesc.zhText: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityPvPD.text: Creates a whirling mass of energy that knocks down and damages nearby opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityPvPD.zhText: 制造一个涡旋的能量团，击倒并伤害附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagPassiveAbility.text: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MagPassiveAbility.zhText: Mag 会吸引附近的物品，以便捡取。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MerulinaDeluxeDesc.text: Call upon Yareli Pandea’s faithful companion.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MerulinaDeluxeDesc.zhText: 召唤 Yareli 盘古底的忠实伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MerulinaDeluxeName.zhText: 浪漪珊瑚 盘古底外观

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaDesc.text: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaDesc.zhText: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。Mesa 是该领域最快的拔枪手。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaPassiveAbility.text: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MesaPassiveAbility.zhText: 双持次要武器的射速提升 |SPEED|%，单持次要武器的装填速度提升 |RELOAD|%。未装备近战武器时，获得 |HEALTH| 额外生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.text: Mind Control Augment: Controlled target inflicts +|DAMAGE_INCREASE|% Damage and gains +|MOVEMENT_SPEED|% Movement and Attack Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.zhText: 精神控制强化：被控制的敌人造成的伤害增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|%，并增加 |MOVEMENT_SPEED|% 移动速度和攻击速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.text: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.zhText: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.text: Nyx invades the psyche of a target, making opponents appear as teammates and teammates as opponents. Target also cannot damage Nyx.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MindControlAbility.zhText: Nyx 入侵目标的心智，使目标表现为队友，而其队友表现为敌人。并且该目标无法对Nyx造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MirageDesc.text: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MirageDesc.zhText: Mirage 的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MiragePassiveAbili.text: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MiragePassiveAbili.zhText: 滑行持续时间延长 |DURATION|% 且机动动作的速度加快 |SPEED|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MolecularPrimeAbil.text: Molecular Prime Augment: Enemies hit by Null Stars are primed. When killed, primed enemies will restore a Null Star charge and have a |CHANCE|% chance of restoring two.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MolecularPrimeAbil.zhText: 分子填充强化：被湮灭流星群击中的敌人会被填充。被击杀时，受填充影响的敌人会生成一个湮灭流星群粒子，并且有 |CHANCE|% 几率将额外生成两个。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MolecularPrimeAbil.text: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MolecularPrimeAbil.zhText: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudAbility.text: Cloud Walker Augment: Allies within |RANGE|m of the cloud become invisible to enemies for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudAbility.zhText: 筋斗游云强化：在云层 |RANGE| 米范围内的队友会隐身 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudAbility.text: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudAbility.zhText: 化身为一缕云雾，漂浮穿越战场。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudReworkA.text: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyCloudReworkA.zhText: 化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗 Wukong 和他的分身。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathAbility.text: [PH] Defy Augment: While invulnerable, Wukong taunts nearby enemies. When the invulnerability ends, enemies within |RANGE|m are blinded for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathAbility.zhText: [PH] Defy Augment: While invulnerable, Wukong taunts nearby enemies. When the invulnerability ends, enemies within |RANGE|m are blinded for |DURATION|s.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathAbility.text: Escape death by receiving a boost of health when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathAbility.zhText: 被击杀时，获得生命值提升以避免死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathReworkA.text:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathReworkA.zhText:
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathReworkA.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Max Armor
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyDeathReworkA.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：最大护甲减少
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyHairAbilityA.text: Celestial Twin Augment: Hold to command the twin to perform a slam attack suspending enemies in the air within |RANGE|m for |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyHairAbilityA.zhText: 天圣双身强化：长按来控制分身进行震地攻击，消耗 |ENERGY| 能量将周围 |RANGE| 米内的敌人滞空。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyHairAbilityD.text:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyHairAbilityD.zhText:
Wukong 拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyPokeAbilityD.text: Explode the iron staff to its true length, knocking down anything in its path.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyPokeAbilityD.zhText: 将定海神针恢复为原本的尺寸，打翻攻击路径上的所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyStaffAbility.text: Primal Fury Augment: Killing an enemy increases Critical Chance by |CHANCE|%. The increase decays by |DECAY|%/s
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyStaffAbility.zhText: 原始狂怒强化：每杀死一名敌人提升 |CHANCE|% 暴击几率。每秒衰减 |DECAY|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyStaffAbility.text: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/MonkeyStaffAbility.zhText: 召唤出定海神针并释放猴王的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NekrosDesc.text: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NekrosDesc.zhText: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NekrosPassiveAbili.text: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NekrosPassiveAbili.zhText: 每当周围 |RADIUS| 米范围内有敌人死亡时，恢复 |HEALTH| 生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaDesc.text: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaDesc.zhText: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaPassiveAbilit.zhText: 滑行速度加快 |SPEED|% 且距离增加 |RANGE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaRingAbilityAu.text: Blazing Chakram Augment: Each enemy hit increases the ring's Damage by |MULT|x and the chance for enemies to drop Health Orbs on death by +|ORB_MULT|x.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaRingAbilityAu.zhText: 乾坤火圈强化：每一个被击中的敌人将增加火圈 |MULT| 倍的伤害以及 |ORB_MULT| 倍掉落生命球的几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaRingAbilityDe.text: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaRingAbilityDe.zhText: 掷出一个可点燃敌人的火圈，使敌人更易受到伤害。燃烧的敌人可掉落恢复球。蓄力可增强火圈的力量，再次激活技能可瞬间传送至火圈的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityAu.text: Warding Halo Augment: Can now be cast on allies with |MULT|% effectiveness.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityAu.zhText: 混天火绫强化：能将技能的 |MULT|% 效果施放在队友身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityAu.text: Warding Halo Augment: |ENERGY_PCT|% of the casting cost returned based on how much protection is left.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityAu.zhText: 混天火绫强化：|ENERGY_PCT|% 的耗能会随着保护环耐久值的减少而逐渐回归至Nezha身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityDe.text: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityDe.zhText: 制造出守护火环，对靠近的敌人造成伤害并晕眩。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityPv.text: Create a protective ring of fire that also damages opponents who get too close.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSashAbilityPv.zhText: 创造一个保护性的火环，并对靠的太近的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityA.text: [PH] Divine Spears: Hurting impaled enemies will heal |PERCENT|% of the Damage dealt up to |CAP| Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityA.zhText: [PH] Divine Spears: Hurting impaled enemies will heal |PERCENT|% of the Damage dealt up to |CAP| Health.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityA.text: Divine Spears Augment: Status Effects spread to all speared enemies. Spear explosions scale by |MULT|x of remaining <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effects. Base Radius is |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityA.zhText: 圣火尖枪强化：异常状态会扩散至所有被刺中的敌人。尖枪的威力伤害将根据剩余的 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割、 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态的 |MULT| 倍增加。基础范围为 |RANGE| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityD.text: Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaSpearAbilityD.zhText: 用破地而出的长矛将附近的敌人刺起。再次使用技能可以将幸存的敌人猛拍回地面。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityA.text: Fire Walker Augment: Accumulate |DAMAGE_PCT|% of the damage Fire Walker deals, unleashing it in a trail of fire that lasts |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityA.zhText: 风火飞轮强化：累积风火轮输出伤害的|DAMAGE_PCT|%，并可释放形成一条持续 |DURATION|秒的火焰之道。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityD.text: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityD.zhText: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityP.text: Blaze a trail of flames, increasing Movement Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NezhaTrailAbilityP.zhText: 烧出一条火路，增加移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaSmokeScreenBo.zhText: 持续时间 / 处决击杀

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormAbilityA.text:
Blade Storm Augment: Blade Storm attacks increase your Ability Combo Counter by |COMBO|.
Passive: +|DURATION|s Combo Duration
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormAbilityA.zhText:
剑刃风暴强化：剑刃风暴的攻击会提升 |COMBO| 技能连击数。
被动：增加 |DURATION| 秒连击持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormAbilityD.text: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormAbilityD.zhText: 将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormWeaponDe.text: Ash's fearsome Shadow Clones, as projected by his Blade Storm ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormWeaponDe.zhText: Ash 的凶恶影分身，由他的「剑刃风暴」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormWeaponPr.text: Ash Prime's fearsome Shadow Clones, as projected by his Blade Storm ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaStormWeaponPr.zhText: Ash Prime 的凶恶影分身，由他的「剑刃风暴」技能创造。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaTeleportAugme.text: Increased Parkour Velocity after a Finisher Kill.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NinjaTeleportAugme.zhText: 处决击杀后，增加跑酷速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoAltHelmetDesc.text: Nokko’s alternate helm proves that the style of a warrior doesn’t have to sacrifice function.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoAltHelmetDesc.zhText: Nokko 的替代头盔证明了战士的风格不必以牺牲功能为代价。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoChassisCompon.text: Chassis component of the Nokko Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Nokko Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoDefaultSkinDe.zhText: Nokko 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoHelmetCompone.text: Neuroptics component of the Nokko Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoHelmetCompone.zhText: Nokko 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nokko Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoLaunchAbility.text: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoLaunchAbility.zhText: 释放一个混乱的弹道蘑菇，会追踪敌人并在触碰目标后爆炸反弹。接触 Nokko 的任何蘑菇都会使其活化，脉冲频率翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoNetworkAbilit.text: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoNetworkAbilit.zhText: 恢复为菌宝形态，生成使 Nokko 快速愈合和加速的球体。在此状态下，Nokko 无法被选为攻击目标并且会逐渐恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPassiveDesc.text: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPassiveDesc.zhText: 当 Nokko 受到致命伤害后会恢复为菌宝形态，其激活的蘑菇会发光，触碰后可使 Nokko 复活。生成的光球会有加速效果，但不会提供治疗效果。如果未能及时到达发光蘑菇，Nokko 将自动复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPowerShroomAb.text: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPowerShroomAb.zhText: 释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPowerShroomAb.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Reduced Strength buff and Energy Restoration
Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoPowerShroomAb.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：技能强度增益和能量恢复已减少
释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoRerootAugment.text: Reroot Augment: Collecting Reroot orbs summons additional Sprodlings inflicting |SPRODDAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage with increased Critical Chance each hit.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoRerootAugment.zhText: 根系再生强化：收集根系再生能量球会召唤额外的菌宝，每次命中造成 |SPRODDAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR> 毒素伤害，并提高暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoSuitDesc.text: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoSuitDesc.zhText: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoSystemsCompon.text: Systems component of the Nokko Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoToxicShroomAb.text: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NokkoToxicShroomAb.zhText: 扔出一个周期性释放有毒孢子的蘑菇，对附近的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害和异常状态，同时使他们陷入睡眠状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaDesc.text: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaDesc.zhText: 利用反物质。 Nova 使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaNullstarAbilit.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Damage Reduction capped at 75%.
Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaNullstarAbilit.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：伤害减免有 75% 的上限。
创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaPassiveAbility.text: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NovaPassiveAbility.zhText: 处于减速状态下的敌人被击杀后有 |CHANCE|% 几率掉落生命球。处于加速状态下的敌人被击杀有 |CHANCE|% 几率掉落能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityAug.text: Null Star Augment: Particles deal |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with guaranteed Status effect in |RANGE|m. On recast, remaining particles seek out enemies with doubled search radius.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityAug.zhText: 湮灭流星群强化：粒子在 |RANGE| 米内造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并必定造成异常状态。重新施放时，剩余粒子会以双倍的搜索范围寻找敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityDes.text: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityDes.zhText: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityPvP.text: Creates antimatter particles that seek nearby opponents and remove their Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NullstarAbilityPvP.zhText: 创造出搜寻附近敌人的反物质粒子，移除他们的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxAbsorbInvulDesc.text: Nyx is invulnerable after absorbing damage
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxAbsorbInvulDesc.zhText: Nyx 吸收伤害后进入无敌状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxAbsorbWeaponBuf.text: Increased Weapon Damage based on the damage Nyx absorbed
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxAbsorbWeaponBuf.zhText: 根据 Nyx 吸收的伤害增加武器伤害

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxDesc.text: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxDesc.zhText: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPassiveAbility.text: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPassiveAbility.zhText: Nyx 的 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内每有一个困惑的敌人，就会为她的主要武器和次要武器增加 |CRITICAL|% 暴击几率。最高增加 |MAX|% 暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPassiveBuffDesc.text: Increased Critical Chance for Nyx's Primary and Secondary Weapons
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPassiveBuffDesc.zhText: Nyx 主武器和次要武器增加暴击几率

/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPsychicDaggerAr.text: Increased Armor when hitting armored enemies with Psychic Bolts
/Lotus/Language/Suits/NyxPsychicDaggerAr.zhText: 精神飞刃击中带有护甲的敌人时，增加护甲

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonDesc.text: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonDesc.zhText: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonPassiveAbili.text: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonPassiveAbili.zhText: 当 Oberon 拾取 <HEALTH>生命球时，他与 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围的友军获得正义否决，使玩家抵挡下一次受到的伤害。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonSmiteAbility.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Reduced maximum Strength

Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OberonSmiteAbility.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：最大技能强度已减少

将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskAnchorAbili.text: Temporal Anchor Augment: While Temporal Anchor is active, each strike of Grenade Fan and Blaze Artillery strips |ARMOUR|% Armor from enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskAnchorAbili.zhText: 时泊之锚强化：当时泊之锚激活时，手雷散射和炽烈炮击的每次攻击削减敌人 |ARMOUR|% 的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskAnchorAbili.text:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskAnchorAbili.zhText:
放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，Protea 可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从 Protea 放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时死亡的话，启用回溯会使 Protea 回到过去，从而使其免于死亡。Protea 仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskBFGAbilityA.text: Blaze Artillery Augment : When Temporal Anchor is activated, one existing Artillery unit will attach to Protea, halting its duration countdown. Max combo count is |COMBO|x.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskBFGAbilityA.zhText: 炽烈炮击强化：激活时泊之锚时，一个现有的火炮会跟随 Protea 并暂停计算其持续时间。火炮最高拥有 |COMBO|x 连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskBFGAbilityD.text: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskBFGAbilityD.zhText: 部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDesc.text: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDesc.zhText: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.text: Dispensary Augment: Dispensary also creates pick ups that heal companions for |HEALPERCENT|% of their maximum health and reduce their incapacitation timer by |TIMER| sec.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.zhText: 后勤支援强化：后勤支援还能创造可以恢复同伴最大生命值的 |HEALPERCENT|% 的拾取物，并减少 |TIMER| 秒同伴失去战斗能力的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.text: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.zhText: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Duration
Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered Health Orb, Universal Ammo pack, and Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskDispensaryA.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：持续时间减短
部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskFanAbilityD.text:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskFanAbilityD.zhText:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Protea Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskPassiveAbil.text: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OdaliskPassiveAbil.zhText: 每第 |CASTS| 次施放技能可获得 +|STRENGTH|% 的技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaBroodAbility.text: Widow's Brood Augment: Scuttlers are galvanized with Electricity. Hold to direct all active Scuttlers at the aimed target, inflicting |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage and Status Effect in a radius.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaBroodAbility.zhText: 蛛心毒裔强化：急行蛛被电击强化。长按可将所有活动中的急行蛛引导至瞄准目标，对目标周围一定范围内的敌人造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害和异常状态效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaBroodAbility.text: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaBroodAbility.zhText: Oraxia 向她前方发射一连串带刺的飞镖，并施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。中毒的敌人被击杀后会生成急行蛛。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaEntangleAbil.text: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaEntangleAbil.zhText: Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaEntangleAbil.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Range
Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaEntangleAbil.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：范围减小
Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaLungeAbility.text: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia's spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaLungeAbility.zhText: 跳到敌人身上，用 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿刺穿他们，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。用这个攻击击败敌人时，他们将有几率掉落生命球或能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaPassiveBuffD.text: Oraxia gains Invisibility after Wall Latching
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OraxiaPassiveBuffD.zhText: Oraxia 在壁面攀附后获得隐身效果

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionBlackHoleDesc.text:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionBlackHoleDesc.zhText:
Orion 形成一个漂移的黑洞，将敌人困于其引力之中。以「重力斩」或「日冕抛射」命中黑洞可延长其持续时间，并改变其移动轨迹：「重力斩」会使其远离 Orion，而「日冕抛射」会将其拉向 Sirius。

（按住）切换至 Sirius 并使用「光之圣域」。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionChassisCompon.text: Chassis component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionChassisCompon.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的机体组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Orion Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionBuffDe.text: Deploy a spectral decoy when taking damage
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionBuffDe.zhText: 受到伤害时部署光谱诱饵

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionBuffDe.text: Cooldown before the next spectral decoy can be deployed
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionBuffDe.zhText: 下一次部署光谱诱饵前的冷却时间

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionDesc.text:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionDesc.zhText:
将 Orion 包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用翠玉之星。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionHelmin.text:
<HELMINTH> Cannot be used to swap Warframe

Become enveloped in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionEvasionHelmin.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 无法用于切换战甲

包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionHelmetCompone.text: Neuroptics component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionHelmetCompone.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Orion Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionScytheSlashDe.text:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionScytheSlashDe.zhText:
使用 Orion 的邪恶镰刀击退敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害和异常状态，同时削弱敌人的护盾和护甲。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用日冕抛射。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionSuitDesc.text: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionSuitDesc.zhText: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionSystemsCompon.text: Systems component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OrionSystemsCompon.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的系统组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverLoadAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverLoadAbilityBoo.zhText: 提高此能力将扩大影响范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverLoadAbilityDes.text: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverLoadAbilityDes.zhText: Volt 会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityAug.text: Accelerant Augment: Accelerant gives +|SPEED|% Casting Speed and +|DAMAGE_PCT|% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage to allies within range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityAug.zhText: 助燃强化：助燃会给予范围内队友 +|SPEED|% 施放速度和 +|DAMAGE_PCT|% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityBoo.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration and damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityBoo.zhText: 提高此能力将增加持续时间和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityDes.text: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityDes.zhText: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverloadAbilityAug.text: Discharge Augment: Converts |SHIELD_PCT|% of Damage dealt into Shields split between Volt and Squadmates.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/OverloadAbilityAug.zhText: 电能释放强化：将 |SHIELD_PCT|% 造成的伤害转为 Volt 和附近队友的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDesc.text: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDesc.zhText: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDisarmAbil.text: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDisarmAbil.zhText: 召唤一群环绕的匕首并寻找敌人的枪支，用小型爆炸来摧毁它们。与「巧躲」结合来使范围加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.text: Elude Augment: Every attack Baruuk Eludes increases his Melee Attack Speed and Melee Critical Damage by |VAL|% up to |MAX| stacks. Stacks last |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.zhText: 巧躲强化：Baruuk 每次通过巧躲来躲避攻击都会增加 |VAL|% 近战攻击速度和近战暴击伤害，最多 |MAX| 层。持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.text: Increased Melee Attack Speed and Critical Damage for each attack dodged
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.zhText: 每次闪避攻击，增加近战攻击速度和暴击伤害

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.text: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistDodgeAbili.zhText: 只处于没攻击时可闪避所有飞来的子弹。再使用一次可关闭该技能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistAbilit.text: Serene Storm Augment: Desert Wind is granted +|PERCENT|% Status Chance and changes its damage type to match enemy weaknesses.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistAbilit.zhText: 宁静风暴强化：沙漠之风的触发几率提升 |PERCENT|%，并且可以改变伤害类型来匹配敌人的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistAbilit.text: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistAbilit.zhText: 随着他的「克制」被侵蚀，Baruuk 用「宁静风暴」来使拳脚作出强大的范围攻击。掌握风暴的每一刻会使他恢复「克制」。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistDesc.text: Baruuk channels the desert wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistDesc.zhText: （英文：DESERT WIND）Baruuk 把沙漠之风转移到他的双拳和脚掌，使之成为了一件显赫武器。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistPrimeD.text: Baruuk Prime channels the Desert Wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted prime weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistFistPrimeD.zhText: （英文：DESERT WIND PRIME）Baruuk Prime 把沙漠之风转移到他的双拳和脚掌，使之成为了一件显赫 Prime 武器。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Baruuk Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistPassiveDes.text: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistPassiveDes.zhText: 每当巧躲子弹，以及每当敌人被镇静或被离手戏法缴械时，Baruuk 的克制力就会逐渐被侵蚀，同时他内心的风暴也会愈演愈烈。随着克制力的下降，Baruuk 会逐渐提升对伤害的抵抗力，且至多能抵抗 |PERCENT|% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistWaveAbilit.text:
Lull Augment: Performing a finisher on or killing a sleeping enemy will retrigger Lull for |PERCENT|% of the remaining duration.
Passive: +|BONUS|% Lull Duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistWaveAbilit.zhText:
镇静强化：处决或击杀一名沉睡中的敌人将重新触发镇静，持续时间为剩余持续时间的 |PERCENT|%。
被动：+|BONUS|% 镇静持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistWaveAbilit.text: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PacifistWaveAbilit.zhText: 平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterAltHelme.text: For those midway upon their journey.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterAltHelme.zhText: 送于那些正在旅途中的人们。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterBookAbil.text: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterBookAbil.zhText: 翻开 Dante 的显赫典籍——夜枭，向他的敌人释放悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterBookAugm.text: Noctua Augment: Alternate Fire releases Paragrimms that swarm |RADIUS|m around the point of aim for |DURATION|s, silencing enemies and stealing their Energy for allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterBookAugm.zhText: 夜枭强化：次要射击会释放幽幽鹰，它们会在瞄准点周围 |RADIUS| 米聚集，持续 |DURATION| 秒，使敌人沉默并为友军窃取敌人的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterDeathAbi.text: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterDeathAbi.zhText: Dante 的诗句从周围敌人身上抽出血液，对他们造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Dante Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterDesc.text: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterDesc.zhText: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterFinalCha.text:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterFinalCha.zhText:
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。击杀和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 悲剧：连续施放两个「暗之诗句」能够攻击敌人。来自 切割、火焰和 毒素异常状态造成的持续伤害将累积成一次性的爆发。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 守词者：「明之诗句」后跟着「暗之诗句」，将以夜枭分身为友军提供支援。夜枭分身会与其指定友军同步进行攻击。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterFinalCha.text: Copies of Noctua accompany everyone in his squad. They attack enemies damaged by the squad's weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterFinalCha.zhText: 夜枭的分身会陪伴小队中的每个人。它们会攻击被小队成员武器伤害的敌人。
按下 |CALLOUT| 以切换最终诗篇。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Dante Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterLifeAbil.text: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterLifeAbil.zhText: Dante 的活力之作赋予他和他的友军超宏防护，并恢复他们的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterPassiveD.text: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterPassiveD.zhText: 夜枭扫描目标，为资料库记录信息。攻击已完全扫描的目标时增加 |CHANCE|% 触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterRecipeHe.text: Dante's main and component blueprints are acquired from Armatus (Deimos) or purchased from Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica. Whispers in the Walls quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PagemasterRecipeHe.zhText: 可从火卫二卫城区节点获取，或从解剖圣所的洛德处购买 Dante 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。需要完成《墙中低语》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaladinReckoningAr.zhText: 护甲 / 辐射异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaladinReckoningBo.zhText: 加成 / 辐射异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PassiveAbilityBard.text: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PassiveAbilityBard.zhText: 每当使用技能后，Octavia 及其周围 |RANGE| 米内的队友就会在 |DURATION| 秒内恢复 |ENERGY| 点能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PassiveAbilityChro.text: Chosen Emissive Color dictates the type of Elemental Damage dealt by Abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PassiveAbilityChro.zhText: 所选的放射色彩会决定技能的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxBladesAbilityAu.text: Recompense Augment: Daggers whirl in a ring around Kullervo for |DURATION|s, slashing nearby foes and dealing <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage and Status Effect before returning to the ring.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxBladesAbilityAu.zhText: 血债血偿强化：匕首以环形围绕在 Kullervo 旋转，持续 |DURATION| 秒，切割附近的敌人并造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害和异常状态，随后返回匕首环。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusAltHel.zhText: 将愤怒的阴霾戴在头上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusBlades.text: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusBlades.zhText: Kullervo 用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击 Kullervo，对他造成少量伤害。Kullervo 拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Kullervo Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFieldA.text: Storm of Ukko Augment: Wrathful Advance moves the storm of daggers to the teleportation location and increases its duration by |VAL|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFieldA.zhText: 乌戈风暴强化：施放暴怒突进会使匕首风暴移动至暴怒突进的传送位置，并增加 |VAL| 秒风暴持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFieldA.text: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFieldA.zhText: 虚空以匕首雨的形式回应 Kullervo 的呼唤，向他的敌人倾泄。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFrameD.text: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFrameD.zhText: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Kullervo Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusLinkAb.text: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusLinkAb.zhText: Kullervo 发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusPassiv.text: Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusPassiv.zhText: 当 Kullervo 使用任意近战武器攻击时，其重击效率 +|EFFICIENCY|%，并且重击准备速度 +|WINDUP|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusRecipe.text: Acquire Kullervo's blueprints from Acrithis in Duviri in exchange for Kullervo's Bane. Earn Bane by both confronting Kullervo and defeating the Orowyrm in Duviri during the Fear, Anger, and Sorrow spirals.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusRecipe.zhText: 可使用 Kullervo 的灾刃从双衍王境的言录使处获得 Kullervo 的蓝图。在恐惧、愤怒和悲伤的复眠螺旋中，对抗 Kullervo 并击败双衍王境的奥金魇龙即可获得灾刃。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusTelepo.text:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusTelepo.zhText:
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusTelepo.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Range and Melee Critical Chance.
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusTelepo.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：降低范围和近战暴击几率增益
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PhysicDaggerAbilit.text: Psychic Bolts Augment: Throw an additional |PROJECTILES| force bolts with guaranteed <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effect. Enemies struck are confused for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PhysicDaggerAbilit.zhText: 精神飞刃强化：投掷额外 |PROJECTILES| 个精神飞刃，必定造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态。受攻击的敌人将陷入 |DURATION| 秒困惑状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PhysicDaggerAbilit.text: Boost the number of daggers thrown

Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PhysicDaggerAbilit.zhText: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PirateArmorAbility.text: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PirateArmorAbility.zhText: 从附近敌人身上掠夺护甲，并为你的技能和武器附加 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态影响的敌人将提供更多加成。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityAugme.text: Spores Augment: Hold to cast will grant all allies within |RADIUS|m an additional |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage to their attacks for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityAugme.zhText: 毒性孢子强化：对 |RADIUS| 米范围内队友施放可在 |DURATION| 秒内增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 的<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害至其攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityAugme.text: Spores Augment: Infected enemies within |RADIUS|m appear on the minimap. +|RADIUS| Enemy Radar.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityAugme.zhText: 毒性孢子强化：在小地图上显示 |RADIUS| 米内被毒性孢子感染的敌人。侦敌雷达 +|RADIUS|。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityDesc.text: Inflicts target with <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage over time. Destroying the spore will spread it to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityDesc.zhText: 对目标造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> 持续的病毒伤害；摧毁孢子时会扩散至邻近敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityPvPDe.text: Inflicts opponent with <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage over time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityPvPDe.zhText: 对敌人造成持续的 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityRewor.text: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PoisonAbilityRewor.zhText: 使目标受到<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀孢子的感染。破坏孢子或杀死宿主可以将孢子扩散到附近的敌人。孢子扩散的时间越久，伤害就越高。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestAlt2HelmetDe.text: An alternate helmet for Harrow, minister of the Void's veiled verses.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestAlt2HelmetDe.zhText: Harrow 的替换头盔，吟诵着虚空隐晦经文的牧师。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestAltHelmetDes.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Harrow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestAltHelmetDes.zhText: Harrow 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestCondemnAbili.text: Condemn Augment: Other players will trigger |PERCENT|% of the effects of Penance and Thurible when attacking chained enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestCondemnAbili.zhText: 责难束缚强化：其他玩家在攻击被束缚住的敌人时，将触发 |PERCENT|%「苦行加护」和「聚能焚炉」的技能效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestCondemnAbili.text: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestCondemnAbili.zhText: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化 Harrow 的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestDesc.text: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestDesc.zhText: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Harrow Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestPassiveAbili.text:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestPassiveAbili.zhText:
拥有双倍过载护盾容量。
任务开始时获得最大能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestPenanceAbili.text: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestPenanceAbili.zhText: 牺牲一定护盾来提升装填和射速，同时将施加于敌人的伤害转化为 Harrow 和附近友军的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestThuribleAbil.text: Thurible Augment: Allies in range take |PERCENT|% less Damage while channeling Thurible and grant |EPS| additional Energy charge whenever damaged.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestThuribleAbil.zhText: 聚能焚炉强化：导引聚能焚炉时，范围内的友军受到的伤害将减少 |PERCENT|%，并且在被伤害时获得 |EPS| 额外能量补充。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestThuribleAbil.text: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Weak Point kills produce extra energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestThuribleAbil.zhText: 将 Harrow 的能量导引至「聚能焚炉」以产生增幅效果。一旦导引完成，击杀敌人就会给予附近友军能量喷发。导引使用的能量越多，每个击杀获得的返还奖励就越高。弱点击杀可产生额外能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestWarPactAbili.text: Covenant Augment: Weak Point kills increase Critical Chance bonus duration by |INCREASE|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestWarPactAbili.zhText: 庇佑圣约强化：弱点击杀可延长暴击几率加成时间 |INCREASE| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestWarPactAbili.text: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Weak Point hits are amplified even further.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PriestWarPactAbili.zhText: 以能量保护附近的友军，对处于「庇佑圣约」保护下的所有人，可吸收一切伤害并将之转化为暴击几率的加成。如果击中弱点，暴击几率将被进一步增幅。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityAugment.text: Pull Augment: Adds |PULL_CHANCE|% chance to pull pickups towards Mag.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityAugment.zhText: 吸引强化：以 |PULL_CHANCE|% 几率将掉落物吸引到 Mag 所在之处。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityAugment.text: Pull Augment: Steals up to |ENERGY| Energy from the target.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityAugment.zhText: 吸引强化：窃取目标 |ENERGY| 点能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases its range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityBoost.zhText: 提升此能力会增加射程。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityDesc.text: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityDesc.zhText: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityDesc_He.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Range
Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityDesc_He.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：范围减小
Mag 制造出磁力漩涡晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityPvPDesc.text: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PullAbilityPvPDesc.zhText: Mag 制造出磁力漩涡晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityAugment.text: Sonic Boom Augment: Gain Armor for each enemy hit by Sonic Boom for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityAugment.zhText: 音爆强化 Mod：音爆每击中一个敌人后获得护甲，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityDesc.text: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityDesc.zhText: Banshee 释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityPvPDesc.text: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that knocks down targets in range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/PushAbilityPvPDesc.zhText: Banshee 发射出一道声波，击倒范围内的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexAuraAbilityD.text: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexAuraAbilityD.zhText: 保护自己和附近的友军免受异常状态影响。Qorvex 每次击杀或协助击杀受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射状态影响的敌人时，辐量防护可以阻止的异常状态数量会增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Qorvex Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexDefaultSkinD.zhText: Qorvex 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Qorvex Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexLaserAbility.text: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexLaserAbility.zhText: 从 Qorvex 的堆芯中释放光束。对命中的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，且必定触发异常状态。命中受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人会引发链式反应爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexLaserDamageP.zhText: 每层异常状态可引发的爆炸伤害

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexPassiveDesc.text: Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexPassiveDesc.zhText: Qorvex 所持有武器具有额外的 |PUNCH_THROUGH| 穿透。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexPillarAbilit.text: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexPillarAbilit.zhText: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexSuitDesc.text: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexSuitDesc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexWallAbilityD.text: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/QorvexWallAbilityD.zhText: 遏制威胁。Qorvex 召唤出墙壁并使其猛烈撞击在一起，对夹在其中的所有敌人造成伤害并造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.text: Radial Blind Augment: Blinded enemies take |DAMAGE_PCT|% more Finisher Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.zhText: 广域致盲强化：被致盲的敌人受到的处决伤害增加 |DAMAGE_PCT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.text: Radial Blind Augment: Blinded enemies are marked on the Minimap for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.zhText: 广域致盲强化：受到致盲的敌人会被标记在小地图上 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect and the duration of blindness.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.zhText: 提升此能力会增加影响范围和失明持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.text: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.zhText: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.text: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialBlindAbility.zhText: 用凶猛的嚎声震慑附近的敌人，并消除 Sentient 敌人所积累的全部抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.text: Radial Disarm Augment: Enemies will be affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status for |DURATION|s
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.zhText: 解除武装强化：敌人被缴械的同时也会受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态的影响 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.zhText: 提升此能力会增加影响范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.text: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.zhText: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.text: Lets forth a wave of energy, forcing opponents to equip their Melee Weapons and depleting their Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialDisarmAbilit.zhText: 释放出一道能量波，强制敌人装备近战并耗尽他们的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.text: Radial Javelin Augment: Each enemy hit will increase Excalibur's Melee Damage by |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.zhText: 广域标枪强化：每击中一名敌人将增加 Excalibur 的 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 的近战伤害，持续时间 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect and the number of javelins that are fired.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.zhText: 提升此能力会增加影响范围和射出的标枪数目。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.text: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RadialJavelinAbili.zhText: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerBowAbilityAu.text: Artemis Bow Augment: Fires a single arrow with +25% Base Critical Chance on full charge, additional +|CRIT|% Chance and explodes in a 7m radius on Weak Points. Removes Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerBowAbilityAu.zhText: 月神狩弓强化：射出单支箭矢，完全蓄力时获得 +25% 基础暴击几率，击中弱点时获得额外 +|CRIT|% 暴击率，并在 7 米范围内爆炸。移除穿透效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerBowAbilityDe.text: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerBowAbilityDe.zhText: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerControlAbili.text:
Navigator Augment: Each hit increases the projectile's Critical Chance by |CRIT|% up to a max of |MAX_CRIT|%.
+|PUNCH_THROUGH| Projectile Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerControlAbili.zhText:
导向拋体强化：每次命中增加投射物 |CRIT|% 的暴击几率，最高达到|MAX_CRIT|%。
+|PUNCH_THROUGH| 投射物穿透效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerControlAbili.text: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerControlAbili.zhText: 操控 Ivara 所发射出的投射物并引导飞向目标处。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.text: Quiver Augment: Dashwire grants allies |CRIT|% Critical Damage. Cloak arrow has a |STATUS|% chance to prevent Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.zhText: 战术箭袋强化：悬丝箭使友军获得 |CRIT|% 暴击伤害。隐蔽箭有 |STATUS|% 的几率防止异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.text: Quiver Augment: Quiver fires three arrows and consumes <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| more Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.zhText: 战术箭袋强化：战术箭袋将射出三支箭矢并消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY| 额外能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.text: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.zhText: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使 Ivara 和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED
Tap to release a Cloak arrow that will conceal your allies. Hold to shoot a Noise arrow that will lure your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更
轻按来放出一支让友军隐形的隐蔽之箭。长按来射出一支引诱敌人的喧扰之箭。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.text: Cycle through and shoot one of three tactical arrows: Cloak (Invisibility), Null-Shield (removes Shields) and Encumbered Arrows (disables Jump).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerQuiverAbilit.zhText: 循环并射出 3 种战术箭矢之一： 遮蔽箭（隐形）、虚盾箭（移除护盾）和阻碍箭（禁用跳跃）。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.text: Prowl Augment: Ivara is able to bypass laser barriers and gains |SPEED|% Movement Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.zhText: 潜影猎手强化：Ivara 能够绕过激光障碍并且获得 |SPEED|% 的移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.text: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.zhText: 进入隐身状态并从毫无警觉的敌人身上偷取道具，或以致命的爆头射击取走猎物的性命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.text: Become invisible and take out opponents with deadly headshots.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RangerStealAbility.zhText: 进入隐身，并用强力的爆头消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperDesc.text: Sevagoth's roving spirit, formed from concentrated Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperDesc.zhText: Sevagoth 的游魂，由凝聚的虚空能量形成。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperGraspAbility.text: Ghostly hands pull enemies into a flailing mass.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperGraspAbility.zhText: 通过幽灵之手把敌人聚成一堆。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperHarvestAbili.text: Dash through enemies and rip out their souls to heal Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperHarvestAbili.zhText: 冲刺穿过敌人并撕裂他们的灵魂来治疗幽影。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperMeleeDesc.text: These razor-sharp blades of condensed Void energy inflict deep and grievous wounds.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperMeleeDesc.zhText: 这些凝聚虚空能量的锋利之刃能造成了深切而痛苦的伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperWailAbilityD.text: Inflict nearby enemies with a harrowing condition.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperWailAbilityD.zhText: 使周围的敌人痛苦不堪。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperWraithAbilit.text: Sevagoth and his Shadow become one.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReaperWraithAbilit.zhText: Sevagoth 和他的幽影合为一体。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpBrokenFr.text: Xaku's main blueprint is awarded from the Heart of Deimos quest. Component blueprints can be acquired from Cambion Drift Bounties (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpBrokenFr.zhText: 完成《惊惧之心》系列任务即可获得 Xaku 的战甲蓝图。部件蓝图可以从魔胎之境的赏金任务中获取。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpGlass.text: Gara's main blueprint is awarded from the Saya's Vigil quest. Component blueprints are acquired from Bounties on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpGlass.zhText: Gara 的战甲蓝图可通过完成《Saya 的守夜》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可从地球夜灵平野上的赏金任务中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpProtea.text: Protea's main blueprint is awarded from the Deadlock Protocol Quest. Component blueprints are acquired via Rank 3 rewards in the Granum Void. Blueprints earned depend on the type of Granum Crown used.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpProtea.zhText: Protea 的战甲蓝图来自《僵局协议》系列任务。其部件蓝图可通过格拉努虚空的 3 级奖励获得。获得的蓝图取决于玩家所使用的格拉努硬币种类。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpText_Qor.text: Qorvex's main blueprint is awarded from the Whispers in the Walls quest. Component blueprints are acquired from Bounties in the Sanctum Anatomica (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpText_Qor.zhText: Qorvex 的战甲蓝图可通过完成《墙中低语》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可从火卫二解剖圣所的赏金任务中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpTitania.text: Titania's main and component blueprints are awarded from The Silver Grove quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RecipeHelpTitania.zhText: Titania 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图可通过完成《落银树庭》系列任务获取。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityAu.text: Reckoning Augment: Reckoning gains +|RANGE|% range. A |RADIUS|m radius around each affected enemy grants bonus armor to allies and deals |DAMAGE| damage per second to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityAu.zhText: 惩戒清算强化：惩戒清算增加 |RANGE|% 攻击范围。每个受影响敌人的半径 |RADIUS| 米范围内，额外增加队友护甲并对敌人造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityAu.text: Reckoning Augment: Health Orbs become unusable by enemies for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityAu.zhText: 惩戒清算强化：使敌人在 |DURATION| 秒内无法使用生命球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityDe.text: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ReckoningAbilityDe.zhText: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RegenerationAbilit.text: Renewal Augment: Taking fatal damage while under the effects of Renewal will instead Heal you or allies to |HEAL_PCT|% Health. This effect triggers only once for each ally every |COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RegenerationAbilit.zhText: 疗愈脉动强化：处于疗愈脉动效果之下的时候受到致命伤害会治疗你到 |HEAL_PCT|%生命值。这个效果每名队友 |COOLDOWN|秒内只能触发一次。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RegenerationAbilit.text: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies' Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RegenerationAbilit.zhText: 生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantAffliction.text: Reave Augment: Reave gains +|RANGE|% range and enemies are blinded by its fog for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantAffliction.zhText: 精华掠夺强化：精华掠夺增加 |RANGE|% 的攻击范围，被烟雾击中的敌人会被致盲 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantAffliction.text: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantAffliction.zhText: 化为一堵由 Sentient 能量组成的墙壁穿过敌人，吸取所接触敌人的护盾和生命，来自奴仆的效果受到增幅。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantDesc.text: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantDesc.zhText: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的 Revenant，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantMarkAbilit.text: Enthrall Augment: Gain +|DAMAGE|% Primary Weapon Damage for each active Thrall.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantMarkAbilit.zhText: 奴役意志强化：从每个当前存在的奴仆那里获取 +|DAMAGE|% 主要武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantMarkAbilit.text: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantMarkAbilit.zhText: 将目标转化为一个狂热的奴仆。奴仆会攻击他们的友军，并通过伤害奴役更多目标。当目标死亡后，将会分解为可以产生伤害的能量柱。成群的奴仆将持续受到 Revenant 控制，直到此技能结束。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantPassiveAbi.text: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantPassiveAbi.zhText: 每当护盾被耗尽时，释放一道能造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害并将周围 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人击倒的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantRebornAbil.text: Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantRebornAbil.zhText: 喷发出数条夜灵能量光束，形成一个死亡之环扫荡 Revenant 的四周。光束会根据所选的防御调整伤害类型，而 Revenant 遭受的伤害将转化为光束伤害。按住射击键可以额外能量为代价强化异常状态和伤害。被此技能杀死的奴仆将掉落过载护盾可拾取物。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantSentientAb.text: Mesmer Skin Augment: Revenant receives +|STRENGTH|% Mesmer Skin Strength and allies within Affinity Range are granted a maximum of |COUNT| charges.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantSentientAb.zhText: 催眠外表强化：Revenant 获得 +|STRENGTH|% 催眠外表强度，给予经验分享范围内的友军最多 |COUNT| 个充能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantSentientAb.text: Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RevenantSentientAb.zhText: 受到 Sentient 能量包围，偏转伤害并震晕胆敢攻击者。奴役被震晕的敌人不消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.text: Rhino Charge Augment: Each enemy hit increases Rhino's Armor Rating by |ARMOR_INCREASE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.zhText: 犀牛冲锋强化：每撞击到一位敌人，增加护甲 |ARMOR_INCREASE|% 并持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases the length of the charge, damage dealt and area of effect at the end.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.zhText: 提升此能力可以延长冲锋距离，增加冲锋结束后的伤害和伤害范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.text: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoChargeAbility.zhText: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoDesc.text: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoDesc.zhText: Rhino 重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoPassiveAbilit.text: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoPassiveAbilit.zhText: 从高处落地时会产生一道能造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityAu.text: Roar Augment: Roar gains +|RANGE_PCT|% range. Enemies within |RANGE|m are knocked down and suffer |STACKS| stacks of <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityAu.zhText: 战吼强化：战吼增加 |RANGE_PCT|% 技能范围。对 |RANGE| 米范围内的敌人造成击倒和 |STACKS| 层的 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityDe.text: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityDe.zhText: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityDe.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Damage Increase
Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoRoarAbilityDe.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：伤害提升减少
短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityA.text: Rhino Stomp Augment: Iron Skin Health is replenished by |PERCENT|% for each enemy affected.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityA.zhText: 犀牛践踏强化：每一个被践踏影响的敌人会补充 |PERCENT|% 的钢化皮肤生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityB.text: Boosting this ability increases its area of effect and the damage dealt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityB.zhText: 提升此能力可以增加影响范围和造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityD.text: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityD.zhText: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityP.text: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, slowing all opponents around him.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RhinoStompAbilityP.zhText: Rhino 猛力的一踏以至于可以扭曲时间，减缓他周围所有的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RicochetArmorAbili.text: Shatter Shield Augment: Reflected bullets have a chance to stagger enemies. The base |PROC_PCT|% chance increases with power strength.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RicochetArmorAbili.zhText: 破碎护盾强化：反射的子弹有 |PROC_PCT|% 的几率使敌人失衡，通过技能强度可增加此几率的基础数值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RicochetArmorAbili.text: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RicochetArmorAbili.zhText: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RiftWalkAbilityDes.text: Pass over into the rift plane.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerDesc.text: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerDesc.zhText: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。Gauss 速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gauss Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerPassiveAbili.text: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerPassiveAbili.zhText: 移动时会产生一股电流来填充 Gauss 的电池。根据电池的电量，护盾恢复速度最多可提升 |SPEED|%，同时恢复延迟最多可降低 |DELAY|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerPlatingAbili.text: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerPlatingAbili.zhText: 产生可以将一部份所吸收的动能伤害（物理、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻，以及　<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸）转成能量的动能镀层。同时也保护 Gauss 免于失去平衡或是被击倒。伤害抗性与电池电量是相对的。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRedlineAbili.text: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRedlineAbili.zhText: 将 Gauss 的电池过载至超出安全上限，大幅增强他的技能并将射速、攻击速度、装填速度，以及施放速度都设置为超载状态。当超出安全上限时，电弧束会周期性地在 Gauss 身上跃动，并在技能停用时爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRushAbilityA.text: Mach Rush Augment: Impact shockwave leaves behind a vacuum that sucks in enemies within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRushAbilityA.zhText: 马赫冲驰强化：冲击波会留下一片真空，并把 |RANGE| 米内的敌人吸入其中。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRushAbilityD.text: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerRushAbilityD.zhText: 猛冲产生一个超级冲刺来撞倒敌人并对电池蓄电，或是撞上坚固的物体来产生强大的震荡波。长按按键以持续冲刺。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.text: Thermal Sunder Augment: Allies in range gain |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% bonus Elemental Damage for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.zhText: 热能抽离强化：技能范围内的友军可获得 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 额外元素伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.text: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.zhText: 从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Scaling from <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on enemies capped to 10x Ability Damage.
Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RunnerTransferAbil.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：由敌人身上的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态带来的伤害增幅上限为技能伤害的 10 倍。
从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RuptureAbilityAugm.text: Virulence Augment: Hitting |COUNT| enemies with Virulence grants |CRIT|% Primary Weapon Critical Chance for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RuptureAbilityAugm.zhText: 致病力强化：以致病力击中 |COUNT| 名敌人，主要武器会获得 |CRIT|% 暴击几率，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RuptureAbilityDesc.text: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RuptureAbilityDesc.zhText: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.text: Shooting Gallery Augment: After |COUNT| kill assists by a player with Shooting Gallery, Mesa's next shot will blind enemies within |RANGE|m for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.zhText: 靶场强化：在 |COUNT| 次由一名玩家用靶场造成的辅助击杀时，Mesa 的下一次射击会致盲 |RANGE| 米内的敌人 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.text: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.zhText: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.text: Removes ammo from opponent's magazine and gives it to Mesa.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/RussianRouletteAbi.zhText: 将子弹从敌人的弹匣中移除，并将它们给予 Mesa。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWBatomorphaHelmet.text: A unique helmet for the Yareli Warframe, designed by Ventralhound.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWBatomorphaHelmet.zhText: Yareli 战甲的独特头盔，由 Ventralhound 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWGyreKuvealMonarc.text: A unique helmet for the Gyre Warframe, designed by Erneix.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWGyreKuvealMonarc.zhText: Gyre 战甲的独特头盔，由 Erneix 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielRe.text: A helmet for Sevagoth's Shadow, designed by Goosmo.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielRe.zhText: Sevagoth 幽影的头盔，由 Goosmo 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielRe.text: A unique skin for Sevagoth Shadow, designed by Goosmo.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielRe.zhText: Sevagoth 幽影的独特外观，由 Goosmo 设计。
