/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielSk.text: A unique skin for the Sevagoth Warframe, designed by Goosmo.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWSevagothEzrielSk.zhText: Sevagoth 战甲的独特外观，由 Goosmo 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWStyanaxAresHelme.text: A unique helmet for the Styanax Warframe, designed by blazingcobalt and Vis.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SWStyanaxAresHelme.zhText: Styanax 战甲的独特头盔，由 blazingcobalt 和 Vis 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanArmorAbilit.text: Scarab Shell Augment: When Inaros takes fatal damage, he consumes Scarab Shell to heal with a brief invulnerability that ends with a deadly <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Cooldown <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanArmorAbilit.zhText: 圣甲虫护壳强化：当 Inaros 受到致命伤害时，消耗圣甲虫护壳来治疗，并获得短暂的无敌效果，然后以致命的 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态结束。冷却时间 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanArmorAbilit.text: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanArmorAbilit.zhText: 将 Inaros 的生命值来转化为护甲。再次使用可以提前终止护甲的转化。保护层减少受到的伤害并使 Inaros 免疫异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanBlastAbilit.text: Desiccation Augment: Killing a blinded enemy with a Finisher has a |CHANCE|% chance to summon a Swarm Kavat that will spread Scarab Swarm. Maximum Swarm Kavats +2.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanBlastAbilit.zhText: 枯沙竭血强化：处决击杀一名被致盲的敌人会有 |CHANCE|% 的几率召唤一个库娃群来传播圣甲虫群。最多 2 个库娃群。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanBlastAbilit.text: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanBlastAbilit.zhText: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.text: Sandstorm Augment: Sandstorm gains |RANGE|% Ability Range and has a |CHANCE|% chance of inflicting Status Effects based on the Damage Types on the equipped Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.zhText: 吞天沙暴强化：吞天沙暴增加 |RANGE|% 技能范围，且有 |CHANCE|% 几率根据装备的近战武器的伤害类型来造成对应的异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.text: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.zhText: 化身为沙尘暴。Inaros 吞噬被卷入沙暴中的敌人，并治愈自己。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.text: Become an invulnerable whirling spiral of sand that knocks opponents down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanStormAbilit.zhText: 变成一团旋转的沙暴，击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanSwarmAbilit.text: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SandmanSwarmAbilit.zhText: 召唤带有 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀触发效果的圣甲虫群来攻击敌人。伤害与 Inaros 的生命值成正比。被虫群淹没的敌人死亡后会召唤一个沙土库娃，与 Inaros 并肩作战，并引导圣甲虫找到其他敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SarynDesc.text: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SarynDesc.zhText: 剧毒是 Saryn 的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对 Saryn 来说，毒液是一种美德。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SarynPassiveAbilit.text: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SarynPassiveAbilit.zhText: 对敌人施加的异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.text: Desecrate Augment: No longer consumes Energy, but consumes <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|HEALTH_AMOUNT| Health per corpse instead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.zhText: 亵渎强化：不再消耗能量，但每具尸体会消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|HEALTH_AMOUNT| 血量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.text: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.zhText: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.text: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop a Health Orb and are also visible to Nekros on respawn.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SearchTheDeadAbili.zhText: 强制附近陨落的敌人掉落生命球，并且重生时对 Nekros 可见。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAbilityAug.text: Effigy Augment: Cast and hold to make Effigy move to your aim point. Deals |DPS| Damage/s and restores |ENERGY| Energy for each enemy in its path. Roars on arrival, stunning nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAbilityAug.zhText: 利欲龙骸强化：施放并按住将利欲龙骸导向你瞄准的位置。对其移动路径上的敌人造成每秒 |DPS| 的伤害并根据敌人数量恢复 |ENERGY| 能量，并在抵达目标时通过咆哮震晕附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAbilityDes.text: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAbilityDes.zhText: Chroma 把他的皮甲转换成一个巨大的警戒护卫，它可以增强附近的盟友并且用元素属性攻击吞噬敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAltHelmetD.text: A fearsome alternative helmet to give Caliban a look he has not worn since the Old War.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientAltHelmetD.zhText: 一款可怕的替代头盔，让 Caliban 重现自远古之战以来就从未穿戴过的造型。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientBlastAbili.text: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientBlastAbili.zhText: 将三股原始能量流汇聚至一个点上，引发巨大爆炸。这些能量流能剥离敌人的护甲和护盾，每个被击中的敌人都会在能量流汇聚时被引爆。召唤的震荡使可施放自己的迷你版融合打击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientChassisCom.text: Chassis component of the Caliban Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientFrameDesc.text: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientFrameDesc.zhText: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与 Sentient 形态在 Caliban 身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientHelmetComp.text: Neuroptics component of the Caliban Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientHelmetComp.zhText: Caliban 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Caliban Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientPassiveAbi.text: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientPassiveAbi.zhText: 经验分享范围内的队友受到伤害后获得最高 |PCT|% 对该种伤害类型的抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientStompAbili.text: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientStompAbili.zhText: 猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地抛向空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientStompAbili.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Frontal cast only and Tau Status Effect removed.
Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly lifted into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientStompAbili.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：仅向正面施放且无法造成 Tau 异常状态。
猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地升至空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSummonAbil.text: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSummonAbil.zhText: 在 Sentient 单位类型之间切换，然后将其召唤到 Caliban 的身旁。震荡使专注于原始近战伤害。直垂使擅长远程攻击并且能造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。召唤使能召唤自己的唱鸣使，并为小队提供护盾保护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSystemsCom.text: Systems component of the Caliban Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientWhirlwindA.text: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientWhirlwindA.zhText: 在旋转的死亡漩涡中向前冲刺。被击中的敌人会受到 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态的影响，使其更易受到其他所有异常状态的伤害。每击中一个敌人，可恢复一部分能量消耗，以及生命值和护盾。被 Sentient 之怒举起的敌人受到额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientWhirlwindA.text: Razor Gyre Augment: Groups enemies together, while Lethal Progeny's Ortholysts focus fire on those enemies with +|PCT|% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage and Fire Rate for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientWhirlwindA.zhText: 刀锋环流强化：将敌人聚集在一起，而致命后裔的直垂使对这些敌人集中火力，造成 |PCT|% 的 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害和射速加成，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityAugment.text: Molt Augment: After casting Molt, Saryn regenerates |HEAL_AMMOUNT| Health/s for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityAugment.zhText: 蜕皮强化：Saryn 在施展蜕皮后 |DURATION| 秒内每秒可恢复 |HEAL_AMMOUNT| 的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityDesc.text: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityDesc.zhText: Saryn 脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityPvPDesc.text: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind that attracts nearby weapon fire.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShedAbilityPvPDesc.zhText: 如同蛇一般蜕皮，Saryn 在身后留下一个诱饵吸引附近敌人的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityAugme.text: Electric Shield Augment: Allies can pick up Electric Shield. |PERCENT|% of damage absorbed will be added to Volt's Static Discharge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityAugme.zhText: 电力屏障强化：队友可以拾起电力屏障。其吸收伤害的|PERCENT|%，会附加到 Volt 的静电释放。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityAugme.text: Electric Shield Augment: Allies that pass through have |SHIELD_INC|% Shields restored.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityAugme.zhText: 电力屏障强化：当友军穿过电力屏障时可恢复 |SHIELD_INC|% 的护盾值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases the life-time of the shield.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityBoost.zhText: 强化此能力来增加屏障的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityDesc.text:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldAbilityDesc.zhText:
Volt 部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
 
长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldBashAbilityA.text: Paralysis Augment: Affected enemies are pulled towards Valkyr and the stun duration is increased by |STUN_INCREASE|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldBashAbilityA.zhText: 瘫痪强化：受影响的敌人会被 Valkyr 拉近并延长晕眩时间 |STUN_INCREASE| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldBashAbilityD.text: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldBashAbilityD.zhText: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.text: Polarize Augment: Enemy weapons are jammed and robotics are disabled for |DURATION|s when hit by Polarize.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.zhText: 护盾极化强化：敌人的武器将被干扰，被护盾极化击中的机器人将瘫痪 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.text: Polarize Augment: Increases the time for the target's Shields to regenerate by |SHIELD_DELAY|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.zhText: 护盾极化强化：增加目标 |SHIELD_DELAY| 秒护盾恢复的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases its range and improves the amount of shield restored or drained.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.zhText: 提升此能力可以增加影响范围，并提升护盾的恢复量或吸取量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.text: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.zhText: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕 Mag 并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.text: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and adds it to Mag.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbility.zhText: 发射一道能量脉冲，耗尽敌人的护盾转给 Mag。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityAugmen.text: Shock Augment: Hold to cast will grant all allies within |RADIUS|m an additional |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to their attacks for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityAugmen.zhText: 电击强化：对队友施展技能，能使 |RADIUS| 米范围内队友的攻击增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases the damage dealt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityBoost.zhText: 提升此能力可以增加的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityDesc.text: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ShockAbilityDesc.zhText: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityAugm.text: Silence Augment: Silence staggers enemies and Finisher damage is increased by |DAMAGE_INCREASE|%
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityAugm.zhText: 静音强化：静音使敌人失衡且受到的处决伤害增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityDesc.text: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies, limits their perception and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks, and renders them unable to activate their abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityDesc.zhText: 使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityPvPD.text: Using Silence will cancel any active Abilities of opponents in range and won't allow them to cast for the duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SilenceAbilityPvPD.zhText: 使用「沉默」会抹消范围内敌人任何的现有技能，并禁止他们在持续时间内使用技能。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusChassisCompo.text: Chassis component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusChassisCompo.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的机体组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusConstellatio.text:
Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusConstellatio.zhText:
在两者之间切换可使接下来的 |COUNT| 次施放获得 |EFFICIENCY|% 技能效率。

当能量低于 50 时，Sirius & Orion 会互相窃取能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Sirius Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusHelmetCompon.text: Neuroptics component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusHelmetCompon.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的头部神经光元组件。
Sirius & Orion 头部神经光元

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Sirius Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusOrionUltimat.text:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusOrionUltimat.zhText:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryBuf.text: Gained Health Regeneration and Increased Damage Reduction. Downed allies in the field will be revived.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryBuf.zhText: 获得生命恢复和伤害减免提升。战场上倒地的友军将被复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryBuf.text: Gained Health Regeneration and Increased Damage Reduction. Downed allies in the field will be revived.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryBuf.zhText: 获得生命恢复和伤害减免提升。战场上倒地的友军将被复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryDeb.text: Cooldown before ally can be revived.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryDeb.zhText: 友军复活前的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryDes.text:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSanctuaryDes.zhText:
Sirius 会创造一个光之井，治疗并复活友军，同时减少受到的伤害。光之井的体积和威力会缓慢增长。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用事件视界。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusScytheThrowD.text:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusScytheThrowD.zhText:
投掷 Sirius 的翠玉之光镰刀，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并拾取路径上的所有物品。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用重力斩。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotBuff.text: Attacking will launch Jade Light motes at the target.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotBuff.zhText: 攻击会向目标发射翠玉之光微粒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotDesc.text:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotDesc.zhText:
Sirius 召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用星壳。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotHelm.text:
<HELMINTH> Cannot be used to swap Warframe

Conjure Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusStarShotHelm.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 无法用于切换战甲

召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSuitDesc.text: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSuitDesc.zhText: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSystemsCompo.text: Systems component for the Sirius & Orion Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SiriusSystemsCompo.zhText: Sirius & Orion 战甲的系统组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityAu.text: Slash Dash Augment: Each enemy hit during Slash Dash further increases your Melee Counter by |COMBO_COUNT|.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityAu.zhText: 突斩强化：突斩时每击中一名敌人都会增加 |COMBO_COUNT| 的近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityAu.text: Slash Dash Augment: Allies in the path of Slash Dash have |NUM_DEBUFF| debuffs removed and |SHIELD_INC|% Shields restored.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityAu.zhText: 突斩强化：解除位于突斩路径上友军的 |NUM_DEBUFF| 个负面状态并恢复 |SHIELD_INC|% 的护盾值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityBo.text: Boosting this ability increases the distance traveled and damage dealt.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityBo.zhText: 提高这个能力增加距离和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityDe.text: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityDe.zhText: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SleightOfHandAbili.text: Sleight of Hand Augment: Ammo and Orbs pickups are turned into proximity mines that deal |DAMAGE| Damage with a |PROC_CHANCE|% Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SleightOfHandAbili.zhText: 戏法强化：将掉落物转换为有 |PROC_CHANCE|% 几率触发造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害的感应地雷。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SleightOfHandAbili.text: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SleightOfHandAbili.zhText: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过镜厅的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmiteAbilityAugmen.text: Smite Augment: Hold to cast will grant all allies within |RADIUS|m an additional |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to their attacks for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmiteAbilityAugmen.zhText: 惩击强化：对队友施展此技能，可使 |RADIUS| 米范围内队友的攻击增加 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 的<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmiteAbilityDesc.text: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmiteAbilityDesc.zhText: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.text: Smoke Screen Augment: Conceals allies within |RANGE|m and grants |CRIT|% Critical Chance while invisible.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.zhText: 烟幕强化：与 |RANGE| 米范围内的队友一起进入隐身状态，并在此期间给予 |CRIT|% 暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.text: Smoke Screen Augment: Blinds enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.zhText: 烟雾强化：致盲 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases the duration of the invisibility.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.zhText: 提高这种能力增加隐形持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.text: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.zhText: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.text: Drops a smoke bomb rendering Ash invisible for a short time. Invisibility is broken on firing any weapon or using any ability, picking up health/energy/ammo and taking damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SmokeScreenAbility.zhText: 扔出一发烟雾弹，使 Ash 短时间内隐身。开火或使用技能、拾取生命/能量/弹药、受到伤害后会解除隐身效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityAu.text: Snow Globe Augment: Enemies that enter have a |FROZEN_PCT|% chance to become frozen solid for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityAu.zhText: 冰雪护罩强化：进入护罩内的敌人有 |FROZEN_PCT|% 几率被冰冻 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityAu.text: Snow Globe Augment: Snow Globe is now attached to Frost with a smaller radius while increasing your mobility. Kills on frozen enemies increase the Globe health by |HEALTH_PER_KILL|% per kill.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityAu.zhText: 冰雪护罩强化：冰雪护罩范围缩小附着在 Frost 身上，并增加你的移动力。每次击杀一名被冻结的敌人，护罩的生命值增加 |HEALTH_PER_KILL|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityBo.text: Increases the amount by which enemies touching your snow globe are slowed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityBo.zhText: 增加能够减速的敌人数量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityDe.text: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SnowGlobeAbilityDe.zhText: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityAugmen.text: Sonar Augment: Killing an enemy by shooting their Sonar's weak point will trigger another Sonar for |DURATION_PERCENT|% of its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityAugmen.zhText: 声纳强化：击中敌人的声呐弱点将其击杀后，将触发另一个声呐，持续时间为原声呐的 |DURATION_PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityAugmen.text: Sonar Augment: Affected enemies also become visible through walls for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityAugmen.zhText: 声纳强化：受到影响的敌人在 |DURATION| 秒内可被隔墙看透。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityDesc.text: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SonarAbilityDesc.zhText: Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityAu.text: Soul Punch Augment: Use on a downed ally to revive them with |HEALTH_PERCENT|% Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityAu.zhText: 灵魂重击强化：复活倒地的友军并恢复其 |HEALTH_PERCENT|% 的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityAu.text: Soul Punch Augment: Depletes up to |ENERGY| Energy from the target.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityAu.zhText: 灵魂重击强化：撤销目标身上多达 |ENERGY| 点的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityDe.text: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityDe.zhText: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityPv.text: A powerful blow that knocks down opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoulPunchAbilityPv.zhText: 用强力的一击击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoundquakeAbilityA.text: Sound Quake Augment: Channel <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas Damage and Status Effect leaks with a |DAMAGE_MULT|x Damage Multiplier that increases every second on enemies in your sight.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoundquakeAbilityA.zhText: 音波冲击强化：导引 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气伤害和异常状态效果倾泻，以 |DAMAGE_MULT| 倍的伤害倍率对视野内的敌人造成伤害，每秒递增。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoundquakeAbilityD.text: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SoundquakeAbilityD.zhText: Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityAugmen.text: Speed Augment: While moving under the effects of Speed, enemies within |RADIUS|m will take |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage with guaranteed Status effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityAugmen.zhText: 加速强化：在加速的效果下移动时，|RADIUS| 米范围内的敌人将受到 |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害并必定触发异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityAugmen.text: Speed Augment: Running into an opponent increases the duration of Speed by |DURATION_INC|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityAugmen.zhText: 加速强化：每撞击到一名敌人可延长加速持续时间 |DURATION_INC| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityBoost.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityBoost.zhText: 提升此能力可以延长持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityDesc.text: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityDesc.zhText: 显现一支电流。Volt 与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityPvPDes.text: Gain a brief boost of movement and Melee attack speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SpeedAbilityPvPDes.zhText: 获得短时间的移动速度和近战攻击速度提升。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StairwayToHeavenAb.text:
Hallowed Ground Augment: Reactivate to deal all Remaining Damage and <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
Passive: +|DURATION|% Hallowed Ground Duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StairwayToHeavenAb.zhText:
神圣领域强化：再次施展技能会造成剩余的伤害，并有几率触发<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射效果。
被动：+|DURATION|% 神圣领域持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StairwayToHeavenAb.text: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StairwayToHeavenAb.zhText: 圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerAbsorbAbili.text: Absorb incoming damage and cast it back at enemies in a barrage of energy projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerAbsorbAbili.zhText: 吸收来袭的伤害，并释放一连串能量弹射回敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerPassiveAbil.text: Stalker's attacks have +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance against enemies who do not see him.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerPassiveAbil.zhText: 追猎者的攻击对看不到他的敌人有 +|CHANCE|% 的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerSmokeScreen.text: Cast a shadow that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, briefly making Stalker invisible.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerSmokeScreen.zhText: 释放暗影眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，并短暂地使追猎者隐形。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerStunDescrip.text: Stun a target. When a target dies, a portion of damage dealt to the target is dealt to other nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerStunDescrip.zhText: 击晕目标。当目标死亡后，其受到的一部分伤害将会转移到附近的其他敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerTeleportDes.text: Teleport to a target and perform a finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Stalker regains a portion of the energy spent.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StalkerTeleportDes.zhText: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为追猎者恢复一部分消耗的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StatisAbilityDesc.text: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StatisAbilityDesc.zhText: 使被裂隙束缚的敌人静止。当其激活时，敌人的子弹将会被截停在半空中，停滞结束后这些子弹将会按照原先的弹道继续行进。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxChassisComp.text: Chassis component of the Styanax Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxHelmetCompo.text: Neuroptics component of the Styanax Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxHelmetCompo.zhText: Styanax 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/StyanaxSystemsComp.text: Systems component of the Styanax Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwitchTeleportAbil.text: Switch Teleport Augment: Switch with an enemy for |DURATION|s invulnerability. Switch with an ally to give ally |ALLYDURATION|s invulnerability. Switch also removes negative status effects on Loki and allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwitchTeleportAbil.zhText: 移形换位强化：与敌人换位后自身将拥有 |DURATION| 秒的无敌时间。与队友换位后，这名队友将拥有 |ALLYDURATION| 秒的无敌时间。换位也会移除 Loki 及其队友身上负面异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwitchTeleportAbil.text: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwitchTeleportAbil.zhText: Loki瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwordOfDoomAbility.text: Exalted Blade Augment: Exalted Blade's Damage Type changes depending on Excalibur's Emissive Color, and Status Chance is increased by |PROC|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwordOfDoomAbility.zhText: 显赫刀剑强化：显赫刀剑的伤害类型会根据 Excalibur 的放射色彩变化，并且触发几率也会提升 |PROC|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwordOfDoomAbility.text: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/SwordOfDoomAbility.zhText: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TearInSpaceAbility.text: Cataclysm Augment: Duration increased by |DURATION|s for each enemy killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TearInSpaceAbility.zhText: 灾变强化：每击杀一名敌人，持续时间延长 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TearInSpaceAbility.text: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TearInSpaceAbility.zhText: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityA.text: Teleport Augment: Using Teleport increases Parkour Velocity by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s. Executing a target with Teleport extends Smoke Screen's duration by |INCREMENT|s. Teleport Mercy Kills fully refresh the duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityA.zhText: 瞬移强化：使用瞬移可将跑酷速度提高 |PERCENT|%，持续时间 |DURATION| 秒。使用瞬移处决目标可将烟幕持续时间延长 |INCREMENT| 秒。瞬移的怜悯之击可完全恢复持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityB.text: Boosting this ability increases its range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityB.zhText: 提升此能力可以增加释放范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityD.text: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityD.zhText: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityP.text: Ash teleports towards the target, bringing him into melee range.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TeleportToAbilityP.zhText: Ash 向目标瞬移切入近战范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleAltHelmetDes.text: A spike-studded alternative helmet for the Temple Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleAltHelmetDes.zhText: Temple 战甲布满尖刺的替代头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Temple Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleDefaultSkinD.zhText: Temple 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleExaltedGuita.text:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleExaltedGuita.zhText:
一旦反拍节拍器上积聚了能量，丽兹就会燃烧起来，用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰焚烧敌人。瞄准时，丽兹以轰鸣的元素声波轰击敌人，可通过技能按键发射不同元素类型的声波。

反拍节奏：本技能不消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleExaltedGuita.text: Add <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to Lizzie, Temple's exalted guitar.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleExaltedGuita.zhText: 为 Temple 的显赫乐器——丽兹附加 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Temple Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveAugme.text: Passive Augment: Gain |OVERGUARD| Overguard when using an Ability on the Backbeat. Amount doubles up to |MAXGAIN| per Beat, but resets if the Beat is missed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveAugme.zhText: 被动强化：在反拍上施放技能时获得 |OVERGUARD| 超宏防护。每次踩中节拍时获得翻倍，最多提升至每拍 |MAXGAIN|，但错过节拍后会重置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveDesc.text: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TemplePassiveDesc.zhText: 与反拍节拍器同步施放技能，以增强技能效果的同时提升 |COST|% 的技能效率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleRecipeHelpTe.text: Temple's main and component blueprints are acquired from the Solstice Square Defense mission in Höllvania, or can be purchased from Flare Varleon in Höllvania Central Mall. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleRecipeHelpTe.zhText: Temple 的主要蓝图和部件蓝图可从霍瓦尼亚至日广场的防御任务中获取，也可以从霍瓦尼亚中央商场的弗莱尔·瓦莱昂处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleShredAbility.text:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleShredAbility.zhText:
用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害火柱冲击目标敌人。 

反拍节奏：生成更多火柱。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleShredAbility.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Backbeat synergy is unavailable.

Shred violently your guitar to spawn several <DT_FIRE_COLOR>fire pillars on enemies where you are aiming.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleShredAbility.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已改动：反拍协同作用不可用。

尽情地弹奏你的吉他，在瞄准的敌人身上产生几道 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火柱。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSoloAbilityB.zhText: 在武器上附加 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSoloAbilityD.text:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSoloAbilityD.zhText:
弹奏吉他，使 Temple 获得短暂无敌并同时获得治疗。每当随着反拍的节奏使用技能时并成功命中敌人时，<AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军武器都会被点亮并获得额外的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

反拍节奏：无敌状态持续时间更长。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSpeakersAbil.text:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSpeakersAbil.zhText:
通过将扬声器推向极度失真来产生一波具有破坏力且带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的热浪，同时使敌人更容易受到暴击。

反拍节奏：暴击几率翻倍。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSuitDesc.text: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TempleSuitDesc.zhText: 魅力四射的 Temple，手持他的感染吉他：丽兹，用强力的和弦点燃了革命的火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityAug.text: Larva Augment: Reactivate Larva to detonate and deal |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage in a |RANGE|m radius. This damage and Status Effect stacks for every enemy grabbed by the Larva.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityAug.zhText: 幼体强化：再次激活幼体可将其引爆，并造成半径 |RANGE| 米的 |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。每有一名敌人被幼体捕获，该毒素伤害和异常状态则叠加一次。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityDes.text: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityDes.zhText: 生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被杀死的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityDes.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Diminished Range
Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies, and pulls them in.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TendrilsAbilityDes.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：范围减小
生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，沾黏邻近敌人并将其拖入其中。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.text: Terrify Augment: Affected enemies have |SLOW_PCT|% reduced Movement Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.zhText: 惊骇强化：受影响的敌人会减少 |SLOW_PCT|% 的移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.text: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.zhText: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.text: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them deal less damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TerrorTotemAbility.zhText: 向附近敌人的内心投下恐惧，减少他们的伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityAu.text: Tidal Surge Augment: Clears Status Effects and grants |DURATION|s of Status Immunity for yourself and allies that come in contact with it. Reduces Tidal Surge's Energy cost to |ECOST|.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityAu.zhText: 潮汐浪涌强化：为自身与被接触的队友清除异常状态，并获得 |DURATION| 秒的异常状态免疫效果。施放潮汐浪涌需要消耗的能量降低至 |ECOST|。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityDe.text: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TidalWaveAbilityDe.zhText: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaDesc.text: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaDesc.zhText: Titania 仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaPassiveAbil.text: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TitaniaPassiveAbil.zhText: 每当 Titania 施放一个技能时，她将为自身和附近队友恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperMultinadeAb.text:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperMultinadeAb.zhText:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperStrikeAbili.text: Photon Strike Augment: If Photon Strike hits at least <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COUNT| enemies, the next cast will cost no Energy and fire two additional strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperStrikeAbili.zhText: 光子轰击强化：如果光子轰击击中至少 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COUNT| 名敌人，下一次施放将不会消耗任何能量并且发射两道额外轰击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperStrikeAbili.text: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrapperStrikeAbili.zhText: 投下一个定位信标，来召唤一场毁灭性的激光火炮打击。对拥有超宏防护的敌人造成双倍伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityDesc.text: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityDesc.zhText: Trinity 体现了救赎与治愈。她非凡的治疗技能可为队友提供强力支持。被他人破坏之处，她可治愈。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveAbil.text: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveAbil.zhText: 在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的队友将获得等同于 Trinity 最大能量值的 |BUFF|% 的生命值加成。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveBuff.text: Increased Health based on Trinity's Max Energy
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityPassiveBuff.zhText: 根据 Trinity 的最大能量值增加生命值

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityWellOfLifeA.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Increased the Immortality Cooldown to 120 seconds.
Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityWellOfLifeA.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：将免死冷却时间提升至 120 秒。
在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityWellOfLifeA.text: Cooldown on death prevention from Trinity's Well of Life
/Lotus/Language/Suits/TrinityWellOfLifeA.zhText: Trinity 的「生命之井」赋予的免死效果的冷却时间

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrDesc.text: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrDesc.zhText: Valkyr 被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrPassiveAbili.text: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ValkyrPassiveAbili.zhText: Valkyr 使用近战武器命中或击杀敌人时会积累狂怒值，最高提升 |PERCENT|% 近战伤害。当狂怒值高于 |CONSUME|% 时，受到致命伤害会消耗狂怒值避免死亡并获得 |DURATION| 秒无敌状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanDesc.text: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanDesc.zhText: Vauban 是创新技术的典范。他会通过巧妙的部署来对敌人造成群体控制。他的坚韧和专注使他令敌人生畏。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanPassiveAbili.text: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VaubanPassiveAbili.zhText: 对失去行动能力的敌人造成 x|DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VexArmorArmorPerKi.zhText: 每次近战击杀的护甲加成

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VexArmorDamagePerK.zhText: 每次远程击杀的伤害加成

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityAug.text: Rift Surge Augment: Limbo deals |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% Extra Damage for each enemy affected by Rift Surge while in the rift.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityAug.zhText: 裂隙涌流强化：在裂隙之中时，Limbo 可造成 |DAMAGE_INCREASE|% 乘以受裂隙涌流影响的敌人之数量的额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityDes.text: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VolatileAbilityDes.zhText: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被击杀时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltDesc.text: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltDesc.zhText: 电流在 Volt 身上涌动。他的攻击可造成高额伤害，并震慑敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltPassiveAbility.text: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/VoltPassiveAbility.zhText: 在地面上移动时可以积蓄电能，每移动一米可积攒 |DAMAGE| 电击伤害，积攒的伤害会在下一次攻击时释放。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.text: Toxic Lash Augment: Melee kills create |RADIUS|m toxic clouds, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin/s for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.zhText: 剧毒鞭笞强化：以近战攻击击杀敌人会产生一片范围 |RADIUS| 米的毒雾，造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 的<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.text: Toxic Lash Augment: Create |RADIUS|m toxic clouds, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage/s for |DURATION|s with every kill. Damage is twice as strong for Melee kills.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.zhText: 剧毒鞭笞强化：每次击杀敌人都会产生一片范围 |RADIUS| 米的毒雾，每秒造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。近战击杀将造成双倍的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.text: When active, melee strikes burst spores causing them to spread to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.zhText: 施放时，近战攻击会引爆孢子使其扩散到附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.text: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WeaponPoisonAbilit.zhText: 激活时，攻击将造成额外的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害；该效果对近战攻击有双倍加成。攻击被孢子感染的敌人将立刻引爆孢子。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityA.text: Well of Life Augment: On death, marked enemies will drop |HEALTH_ORBS| Health Orbs with a |ENERGY_ORB_CHANCE|% chance of dropping an Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityA.zhText: 生命之井强化：被标记的敌人死亡时会掉落 |HEALTH_ORBS| 个生命球，并有 |ENERGY_ORB_CHANCE|% 的几率掉落额外的能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityB.text: Boosting this ability increases its duration and the health leech percentage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityB.zhText: 提升此能力可以延长持续时间，并增加吸血百分比。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityD.text: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WellOfLifeAbilityD.zhText: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfAltHelmetD.text: The Yuvan Clerisy presented this ceremonial helmet to Voruna, their guardian of stray souls and attendant to the dead.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfAltHelmetD.zhText: 青春仪使团将这个仪式头盔赠予 Voruna——他们的流浪灵魂守护者和死者的侍者。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfBiteAbilit.text:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfBiteAbilit.zhText:
（轻按）亚克什的尖牙会撕裂你的敌人。5 个随机异常状态会在敌人身上堆叠 10 层。当目标死亡时，其身上的异常状态会传播给附近的其他敌人。

（长按）亚克什会守护 Voruna，提升她的异常状态抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDefaultArm.text: Default armor set for the Voruna Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDefaultSki.text: The standard skin for the Voruna Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDesc.text: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfDesc.zhText: 四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Voruna Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHowlAbilit.text: Ulfrun's Descent Augment: During Ulfrun’s attack, enemies that die from <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status within |RADIUS|m restore Voruna’s charges.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHowlAbilit.zhText: 乌尔佛伦之裔强化：在乌尔佛伦攻击时，|RADIUS| 米范围内的敌人死于 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态将为 Voruna 恢复冲锋次数。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHowlAbilit.text:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfHowlAbilit.zhText:
（轻按）Voruna 四肢着地并有 5 次凶残地冲向锁定敌人的机会。在 Voruna 冲向目标时，最强之狼乌尔佛伦会率先发起攻击。狼群们对受到异常状态影响的目标及其周围的敌人造成更高的伤害。致命攻击将使 Voruna 剩余冲锋所造成的伤害翻倍。

（长按）乌尔佛伦守护 Voruna。如果 Voruna 在守护期间死亡，则乌尔佛伦会代替她死去。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfLeapAbilit.text:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfLeapAbilit.zhText:
（轻按）莱卡斯狩猎以维系狼群。被近战击杀的敌人会掉落生命球，被爆头击杀的敌人则会掉落能量球。击杀受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护 Voruna，提升她的重击效率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfLeapAbilit.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED: Passive Removed
There is a chance for enemies killed by melee attacks to drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots to drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's Hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfLeapAbilit.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更：移除被动技能
被近战击杀的敌人有几率掉落生命球，被爆头击杀的敌人有几率掉落能量球。击杀受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfPassiveAbi.text: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfPassiveAbi.zhText: Voruna 从不孤军奋战。在任务中，长按技能可以召唤每匹狼独一无二的被动能力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfRecipeHelp.text: Voruna's main and component blueprints are acquired from Yuvarium and Circulus (Lua) after completing The War Within quest. They can also be purchased via Archimedean Yonta on the Zariman after completing the Angels of the Zariman quest.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfRecipeHelp.zhText: 完成《内战》系列任务后，可在月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus 节点获取 Voruna 的战甲蓝图和部件蓝图。完成《扎里曼的天使》系列任务后，也可以通过扎里曼号上的哲士扬塔购买。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfShroudAbil.text: Shroud of Dynar Augment: Increase an enemy’s Damage Vulnerability by |DAMAGE|%. Using Fang of Raksh on that enemy increases its spread radius by |AMOUNT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfShroudAbil.zhText: 戴拿之幕强化：使敌人增加 |DAMAGE|% 的易伤。对该敌人使用亚克什之牙可使其效果范围增加 |AMOUNT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfShroudAbil.text:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WerewolfShroudAbil.zhText:
（轻按）戴拿会使 Voruna 隐身并提高她的移动速度。Voruna 攻击时会结束隐身状态。在隐身状态结束后的短时间内，提升近战攻击的暴击伤害、触发几率、暴击几率并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。如果在增益期间近战击杀敌人，这些限时近战增益在每次施放技能时则会延长一次。 

（长按）戴拿会守护 Voruna，提升她的跑酷速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameDesc.text: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameDesc.zhText: Wisp 游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameHarnessAb.text: Breach Surge Augment: Teleporting to a Reservoir costs |ENERGY|% Energy and grants |CRIT|% Critical Chance to Primary Weapons per meter traveled for |DURATION|s. Maximum |CAP|% Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameHarnessAb.zhText: 裂口涌流强化：传送到一个储能池会消耗 |ENERGY|% 的能量，并且根据移动的距离，主要武器在 |DURATION| 秒内可获得每米 |CRIT|% 的暴击几率。最高可获得 |CAP|% 暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameHarnessAb.text:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameHarnessAb.zhText:
打开一个维度缺口来压倒附近的敌人，并使他们在受到伤害时释放出侵略性的电涌火花。
Wisp 亦可瞄准一个储能池传送，并倍化涌流的范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameLightAbil.text: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameLightAbil.zhText: 投射一个 Wisp 的光谱图像来迷惑和分散敌人的注意力。重新启动图像来移动到它所在的位置。按住按键来使图像移动速度更快，并在释放按键时传送到它所在的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFramePassiveDe.text: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFramePassiveDe.zhText: 在维度之间流动，Wisp 在空中时对敌人来说是隐形的。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameReservoir.text: Reservoirs Augment: Adds a fourth reservoir that gives the effects of all three. Costs <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY_PCT|% more Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameReservoir.zhText: 储能池强化：添加第四种储能池，使其具有所有三种储能池的效果。额外消耗 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ENERGY_PCT|% 的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameReservoir.text: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameReservoir.zhText: 选择并召唤一个充满尘埃的储能池来帮助 Wisp 和她的友军。急速尘埃可以增加移动和攻击速度。活力尘埃可以增加最大生命值和治疗时间。震荡尘埃可以震晕附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameSunAbilit.text: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispFrameSunAbilit.zhText: 打开一扇通往太阳的传送门，放出毁灭性的纯阳等离子光束。按住射击键会使伤害加倍，但同时也会增加能量消耗。当太阳之门持续攻击敌人时，会对敌人造成更多伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Wisp Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispSunAbilityAugm.text: Sol Gate Augment : Wisp and 2 spectral images cast a single blast of Sol Gate, leaving an area with |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage / Second with guaranteed Heat and Radiation Status Effects for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WispSunAbilityAugm.zhText: 太阳之门强化：Wisp 召唤 2 个幻影施放一次太阳之门爆炸，引爆后留下持续 |DURATION| 秒的区域，每秒造成 |DAMAGE|<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害且必定触发火焰和辐射异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.text: World On Fire Augment: Enemies hit have a |KNOCKDOWN|% chance of being knocked down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.zhText: 火海强化：受攻击的敌人有 |KNOCKDOWN|% 几率被击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases the duration and area of effect.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.zhText: 提升此能力可以延长持续时间，并增加效果范围。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.text: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbility.zhText: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityAug.text: Worm Hole Augment: Allies that travel through wormhole gain a |SPEED|% Speed bonus for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityAug.zhText: 虫洞强化：穿过虫洞的队友获得 |SPEED|% 速度加成，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityDes.text: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WormHoleAbilityDes.zhText: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithAltHelmetDes.text: A macabre alternate helmet for Sevagoth, the Warframe who harbors the Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithAltHelmetDes.zhText: 为潜藏幽影的战甲 Sevagoth 所设计的恐怖风格替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithChassisCompo.text: Chassis component of the Sevagoth Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Sevagoth Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithDesc.text: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithDesc.zhText: Sevagoth 不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithGloomAbility.text: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithGloomAbility.zhText: 召唤一道放射脉冲波，来诱捕敌人落入技能范围并使其减速，同时吸取他们的生命力并注入「死亡之井」。处在脉冲波范围内的友军每次攻击都会吸取敌人的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithHelmetCompon.text: Neuroptics component of the Sevagoth Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithHelmetCompon.zhText: Sevagoth 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Sevagoth Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithPassiveAbili.text: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithPassiveAbili.zhText: Sevagoth 死亡时，会化身成 Sevagoth 的幽影；通过收集重建他的墓碑所需的灵魂来使他复活。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityA.text: Reap Augment: Increase Critical Chance by |CRIT|% on enemies inflicted with Death Harvest. A new Shadow emerges from those enemies when they perish. Limit of |COUNT| Shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityA.zhText: 收割强化：对受到死亡收割影响的敌人增加 |CRIT|% 暴击几率。敌人死亡时生成一个新的幽影。最多拥有 |COUNT| 个幽影。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityD.text: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReapAbilityD.zhText: Sevagoth 的幽影向外飞去来蹂躏路径上的敌人。幸存者会随时间流逝，受到来自「死亡收割」的伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperAbilit.text: When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperAbilit.zhText: 当「死亡之井」被注满时，将能够释放 Sevagoth 的幽影形态；并可使用一系列近战技能撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for Sevagoth's Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperDefaul.zhText: Sevagoth 幽影的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithReaperHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for Sevagoth's Shadow.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityAu.text: Sow Augment: Enemies killed while inflicted with Sow spread its effect in a |RANGE|m radius. Shadow's Death Harvest also inflicts Sow.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityAu.zhText: 播种强化：受到播种影响的敌人被击杀时在 |RANGE| 米内扩散播种效果。幽影的死亡收割技能也会施加播种效果。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityDe.text: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSowAbilityDe.zhText: 向附近的目标种下死亡之种来汲取他们的生命力。收割已播种的死亡之种来引爆受影响的敌人，并按照他们生命值的百分比来造成范围伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WraithSystemsCompo.text: Systems component of the Sevagoth Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongDesc.text: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongDesc.zhText: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongPassiveAbili.text: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/WukongPassiveAbili.zhText: 在承受致命伤害后，Wukong 会自动使用他所掌握的其中一种保命神技。每次任务中，这些神技只能发动三次。
在 60 秒内，补给球的效果提升为原来的 4 倍
在 60 秒内，元素伤害提升为原来的 3 倍
在 60 秒内，获得额外的战利品掉落

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliAltHelmetDes.text: Emerge from the depths with this alternative helmet for Yareli.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliAltHelmetDes.zhText: 通过这件替换头盔来让 Yareli 从深海浮出水面。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.text: Merulina Augment: Enemies eliminated during Sea Snares heal |HEAL|% of Merulina's health. Upon healing, gain +|SPEED|% Reload Speed and Fire Rate on Secondary weapons for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.zhText: 浪漪珊瑚强化：深海诱陷期间消灭的敌人会为浪漪珊瑚恢复其生命值的 |HEAL|% 。生命值恢复时，次要武器的装填速度和射速 +|SPEED|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.text: Merulina Augment: Yareli no longer rides Merulina. Instead, Merulina follows her and casts Sea Snare on nearby enemies. |VAL|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.zhText: 浪漪珊瑚强化：Yareli 不再骑乘浪漪珊瑚。浪漪珊瑚会跟随她并对附近的敌人施放深海诱陷。冷却时间 |VAL| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.text: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBoardAbility.zhText: 召唤浪漪珊瑚，这是一种浪涌中的可骑乘生物，也是 K 式悬浮板的灵感来源。浪漪珊瑚通过吸收大部分来袭的伤害从而保护 Yareli。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBubbleAbilit.text:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliBubbleAbilit.zhText:
生成五个主动寻找敌人并会在触碰时膨胀的水球，同时对受害者造成伤害并使他们无法移动。
被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliChassisCompo.text: Chassis component of the Yareli Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Yareli 盘古底的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDeluxeSkinDe.text: With the fall of the Orokin, Yareli Pandea drifted into the ocean's depths where Hunhow rediscovered her. Now, she ascends to fight once more.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 随着奥罗金的覆灭，Yareli 盘古底漂流到海洋的深处，在那里被 Hunhow 重新发现。如今，她从深海浮升再次迎接战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDisksAbility.text: Aquablades Augment: Activate Aquablades when the ability is in use or cooldown to throw one blade. Blades gain |PCT|% damage when any Aquablade hits an enemy. No cost to throw with Merulina.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDisksAbility.zhText: 水形之刃强化：在使用中或冷却期间激活水形之刃以投掷单个刀刃。任意水形之刃击中的敌人都会增加投掷水形之刃 |PCT|% 的伤害。在激活浪漪珊瑚时投掷不消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDisksAbility.text: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliDisksAbility.zhText: 通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameDesc.text: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameDesc.zhText: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameRecipeH.text: Yareli's main blueprint is awarded from the Waverider quest. Component blueprints can be researched in the Ventkids' Bash Lab Dojo Room in any Clan.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliFrameRecipeH.zhText: 可从《驭浪者》系列任务中获取 Yareli 的战甲蓝图。部件蓝图可以在通风小子的拼装实验室道场房间中研究。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliHelmetCompon.text: Neuroptics component of the Yareli Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliHelmetCompon.zhText: Yareli 战甲的头部神经光元组件。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Yareli Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliPassiveAbili.text: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliPassiveAbili.zhText: 当 Yareli 移动超过 |TIME| 秒时，她的次要武器获得 +|CHANCE|% 的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliSpoutAbility.text: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliSpoutAbility.zhText: 把敌人拖入一个毁灭性的漩涡中，然后用一股爆裂水压将他们炸飞。每个被困在漩涡中的敌人都会增加爆裂造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YareliSystemsCompo.text: Systems component of the Yareli Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangAuraAbility.text: Pacify & Provoke Augment: Pacify converts damage done to allies into an aura that slows enemies by |SLOW|%. Provoke converts damage done to enemies into |STRENGTH|% extra Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangAuraAbility.zhText: 轻抚－激怒技能强化：轻抚将友军受到的伤害转化为减速 |SLOW|% 的光环。而激怒则将对敌人造成的伤害转化为 |STRENGTH|% 的额外技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangAuraAbility.text: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangAuraAbility.zhText: 〈黑夜形态〉时降低周围敌人造成的伤害。〈白昼形态〉时则增加附近友军的技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangBurstAbilit.text: Mend & Maim Augment: |CONSERVATION|% of charge is conserved when switching between forms.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangBurstAbilit.zhText: 补愈－致残强化：转换形态时，|CONSERVATION|% 的储能将被保留。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangBurstAbilit.text: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangBurstAbilit.zhText: 〈黑夜型态〉在附近被击杀的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为 Equinox 及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.text: Metamorphosis Augment: Equinox's other half breaks free for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE_MULT|% Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.zhText: 昼夜交替强化：Equinox 的另一半身将解放 |DURATION| 秒，并造成 |DAMAGE_MULT|% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.text: Metamorphosis Augment: Switching to Day-form staggers enemies within |RADIUS|m and knocks them down when switching to Night-form.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.zhText: 昼夜交替强化：切换至白昼形态时造成 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人失衡，切换至黑夜形态时则为击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.text: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangSwitchAbili.zhText: 昼夜交替：〈黑夜形态〉暂时获得额外护盾和护甲；〈白昼形态〉暂时获得额外伤害和速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.text: Rest & Rage Augment: Killing an affected enemy causes the effect to spread to enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DURATION_PCT|% of the remaining duration.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.zhText: 暂息－怒气强化：杀死一名受到技能影响的敌人会造成该技能的效果传播 |RADIUS| 米持续 |DURATION_PCT|% 的剩余持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.text: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.zhText: 〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.text:
<HELMINTH> ALTERED
If your Emissive color is dark, targets are put to sleep. If your Emissive color is bright, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/YinYangTargetAbili.zhText:
<HELMINTH> 已变更
如果你的放射色彩是暗色的，目标会陷入沉睡。如果你的放射色彩是亮色的，目标会变得脆弱并受到更多伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityAugm.text: Tesla Nervos Augment: Enemy health when a Nervos is first attached is converted into |RANGE|m burst of <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityAugm.zhText: 特斯拉电激强化：当电激胶囊首次附着在敌人身上时，敌人的生命值会在被击杀时转换成 |RANGE| 米范围内的 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击爆发。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityDesc.text: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZapTrapAbilityDesc.zhText: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrBurstAbility.text: Airburst Augment: Each enemy hit by Airburst increases secondary damage by |DAMAGE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrBurstAbility.zhText: 空爆强化：每一个被空爆击中的敌人都会为次要武器提升 |DAMAGE|% 伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrBurstAbility.text: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrBurstAbility.zhText: 发射一团高密度爆发空气。长按把敌人击飞，轻按则把他们拉向爆炸中央。每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害就会增加。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrDesc.text: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrDesc.zhText: 掌控风之力量。Zephyr 的旋风技能可以保护她、造成高伤害并提供群体控制。她从上方俯冲而下，留下一条毁灭之路。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrPassiveAbili.text: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrPassiveAbili.zhText: 在空中时，Zephyr 移动更快且下落更慢，同时武器也会获得 |CRIT|% 的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAbil.text: Tail Wind Augment: Casting Tail Wind resets Zephyr’s bullet jump. Each enemy hit increases Tail Wind Damage by |PERCENT|%. Damage resets upon being on the ground for 2s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAbil.zhText: 顺风强化：施放顺风会重置 Zephyr 的旋身飞跃。每一个被击中的敌人将增加 |PERCENT|% 顺风的伤害。落地后于地面两秒后伤害会被重置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAbil.text: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAbil.zhText: 在空中按住技能键，来使 Zephyr 悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAugm.text: Tail Wind Damage increased. Resets after being on ground for 2s.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTailWindAugm.zhText: 增加顺风伤害。落地 2 秒后重置。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTornadoAbili.text: Tornado Augment: Creates |NUM_TORNADOES| additional tornadoes. All tornadoes are |SIZE_MULT|% their original size and won't pick up enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTornadoAbili.zhText: 龙卷云风强化：额外制造 |NUM_TORNADOES| 个龙卷云风，所有的龙卷云风大小变为原先的 |SIZE_MULT|% ，并且不会卷起敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTornadoAbili.text: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTornadoAbili.zhText: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.text: Turbulence Augment: Turbulence increases Movement Speed by |MOVEMENT_SPEED|% and Projectile Speed by |PROJECTILE_SPEED|% for Zephyr and her allies.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.zhText: 疾风湍流强化：自身与范围内队友增加 |MOVEMENT_SPEED|% 移动速度，以及加快 |PROJECTILE_SPEED|% 投射物飞行速度。

/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.text: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.zhText: 围绕Zephyr生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/DaxSquareCapeD.text: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/DaxTwoTailsCap.text: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionBot.text: Fury tempered. Pride soothed. This unity was hard-won, and all the more precious for it.
/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionBot.zhText: 怒火平息，骄傲抚平。这份团结来之不易，也因此更加珍贵。

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionLef.text: Swaddling cloth of the infant Orion, torn in ecstatic fury.
/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionLef.zhText: 包裹着幼年 Orion 的襁褓布，在狂喜的愤怒中被撕碎。

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionRig.text: Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.
/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/SiriusOrionRig.zhText: 包裹着幼年 Sirius 的襁褓布，被当作一枚破旧的荣誉勋章佩戴着。

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/TC2025EvolvedO.text: This tattered variant syandana displays the wearer's ability to manipulate the Void.

虚空防御者披饰（虚空侵蚀）

/Lotus/Language/Syandanas/TC2025OrokinCa.text: Stand guard against the allure of the Void with this opulent syandana.

/Lotus/Language/SyndicateRewards/MiterMo.text: Each Miter blade has a |val|% chance to immediately destroy a Nullifier field.

/Lotus/Language/SyndicateRewards/ObexMod.text: Lethal ground attacks cause enemies to explode dealing |val|

（|val|% 敌人最大生命值）的 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害

/Lotus/Language/SyndicateRewards/Panther.text: Secondary Fire mode has a |val|% chance to disarm enemies.
/Lotus/Language/SyndicateRewards/Panther.zhText: 次要射击有 |val|% 几率使敌人缴械。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ArbitersDesc.text: The dogmatic Arbiters seek a truth through discipline and practice. They reject the Tenno as Warrior mythology... A lie constructed to limit their potential.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ArbitersDesc.zhText: 教条式的仲裁者通过纪律与实际作为来寻求真理。他们否认 Tenno 即是战士的神话…这是个被编造出来用以限制他们无尽潜力的谎言。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ArbitersDogTa.text: Medallion of the Arbiters of Hexis syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ArbitersDogTa.zhText: 均衡仲裁者集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ArbitersRewar.zhText: 可以使用堕落枪兵魅影

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonRewar.zhText: 可以使用护盾型无人机魅影

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonRewar.text: Hunted by Scavenger Drone Eximus Squad

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonRewar.text: Hunted by Scavenger Drone Eximus Platoon
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonRewar.zhText: 受到卓越者清道夫无人机兵团追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonSudaD.text: A vast consciousness watching with a curious eye. Seemingly devoid of emotion, Suda's thirst for knowledge and abhorrence of destruction can only be described as passionate.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonSudaD.zhText: 有着丰富的知觉并以求知的角度关注世务。表面上看来虽毫无情感，但苏达对知识的渴望以及对破坏的厌恶，只能以慷慨激昂来形容。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonSudaS.text: Pledge loyalty to Cephalon Suda in the pursuit of knowledge.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CephalonSudaS.zhText: 效忠中枢苏达，与他们一起追寻知识。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusDesc.text: A tight knit band of merchants, hucksters, and survivors, the Ostrons call Cetus their home. The town was built around an Orokin Tower, that both protects and nourishes them.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusDesc.zhText: 由一群贸易商、小贩与幸存者紧密结合在一起组成，Ostron 人称希图斯为家园。这座城镇建立在奥罗金塔周边，高塔不但庇护了他们，还滋养了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle1De.text: The Ostrons are wary of outsiders. Speak with Konzu to learn how to increase your standing with them.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle1De.zhText: Ostron 人对外来者充满戒心。与孔尊对话来了解如何提升你在他们中的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle2De.text: The Ostrons are intrigued by your presence and are willing to instruct you in their ways.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle2De.zhText: Ostron 人对你的存在感到十分好奇，并愿意以他们的方式来教导你。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle3De.text: The Ostrons have begun to accept you into their society. They will sell you goods not offered to strangers.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle3De.zhText: Ostron 人已经开始认可你融入他们的社会了。他们将会出售一些不卖给外人的商品给你。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle4De.text: You have earned the trust of the Ostrons. They regard you as a valuable ally.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle4De.zhText: 你获得了 Ostron 人的信任，他们认同你是一位值得珍视的盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle5De.text: You are respected by the Ostron Elders and adored by the children. You have access to their most sought after wares.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/CetusTitle5De.zhText: 你受到了 Ostron 长者们的尊重，也被孩童所喜爱。你可以选购他们最炙手可热的商品了。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ConclaveDesc.text: A warrior only grows if they face the ultimate enemy. Themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ConclaveDesc.zhText: 一名战士只有在面对终极敌人 -「自我」时，才能有所成长。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ConclaveRewar.text: Access to Uncommon Conclave Mods. Additional Conclave loadout slot.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ConclaveRewar.zhText: 可以使用罕见秘仪MOD，以及新增秘仪配置槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/EventSyndicat.text: Support and rewards for Tenno fighting in active operations.

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.text: Break veils. Free Brothers. Stop Narmer.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.zhText: 破除面障。解放兄弟。阻止合一众。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.text: One more brother for the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.zhText: 又多了一个兄弟来战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.text: This... Brother's home. This... What brothers fight for.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/KahlSyndicate.zhText: 这里……是兄弟们的家。这里……是兄弟们战斗的理由。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/LibraryDesc.text: Through Synthesis we can rebuild and preserve. Create memory-immortals within this data oasis. Will you become enlightened, Tenno? Will you hunt for me?
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/LibraryDesc.zhText: 借由结合仪式，我们得以将这些知识复原并传承下去。在这数据绿洲中创建永世留芳的记忆。Tenno，你们愿受到启发吗？愿为我狩猎吗？

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Max_Rep_For_T.zhText: 已达到 |TITLE| 的最高声望

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/MeridianDogTa.text: Medallion of the Steel Meridian syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/MeridianDogTa.zhText: 钢铁防线集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NeutralHint.zhText: 赚取声望推进集团进度

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaDesc.text: Only through the restoration of a pure humanity and the repopulation of Earth can the conflict end. The New Loka are worshipers of the human form and Earth, before its corruption.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaDesc.zhText: 认为唯有通过恢复人性的纯真和地球的复育才能终止冲突。在崩解之前，新世间是人类与地球的崇拜者。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaDogTag.text: Medallion of the New Loka syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaDogTag.zhText: 新世间集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.zhText: 可以使用远古治愈者魅影

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.text: Access to Syndicate Void Relic Pack
