/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.text: Access to Squad Health Restore (Large) blueprint
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.zhText: 可以使用团队生命补给（大型）

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.text: Hunted by Ancient Healer Eximus Squad
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.zhText: 受到卓越者远古治愈者小队追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.text: Hunted by Ancient Healer Eximus Platoon
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaReward.zhText: 受到卓越者远古治愈者兵团追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaSyndic.text: Pledge to honor and purify Earth with New Loka.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NewLokaSyndic.zhText: 效忠新世间，与他们一道尊崇并净化地球。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NoSacrificeDe.text: You are eligible for the title of |TITLE|
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NoSacrificeDe.zhText: 你有资格获取 |TITLE| 头衔。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NoSacrificeIn.text: Insufficient Standing to attain the title of |TITLE|
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/NoSacrificeIn.zhText: 声望值不足以获得 |TITLE| 称号。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinDogTagD.text: Medallion of The Perrin Sequence syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinDogTagD.zhText: 佩兰数列集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinReward2.text: Access to Syndicate Void Relic Pack
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinReward2.zhText: 可使用集团虚空遗物包

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinReward3.text: Access to Squad Energy Restore (Large) blueprint
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinReward3.zhText: 可以使用团队能量补给（大型）

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinRewardN.zhText: 受到卓越者恐鸟小队追猎
受到卓越者恐鸟兵团追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinSequenc.text: A collective of brilliant and powerful merchants, splintered from the Corpus. Their goal is to restore order by bringing prosperity and direction to the violent world they study.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinSequenc.zhText: 一个从 Corpus 中分裂出来，十分卓越与强大的商人集体。经过研究与观察，他们的目标是借由将繁荣与趋势导入这个暴力的世界来恢复一切的秩序。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinSyndica.text: Pledge to restore order with The Perrin Sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/PerrinSyndica.zhText: 效忠佩兰数列，与他们一同恢复秩序。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDesc.text: A secretive order, loyal to the mysterious and reclusive 'Unum.' Some say their relationship to cause and effect is unnatural, their knowledge profane. When a Quill acts, things change.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDesc.zhText: 一个神秘的团体，向神秘隐居的乌努母神效忠。有人说他们与因果有着不自然的联系，而他们的知识是亵渎的。当一名夜羽行动时，情势就将改变。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogRare.text:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogRare.zhText:
这种品质和状态的 Sentient 核心极为罕见。真正的特殊样本。

获取地点：通过捕获在地球夜间的夜灵平野漫游的夜灵获得

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogTagD.text:
An integral component of Sentient anatomy.  Rarely found undamaged, the specimen may prove useful.

Location: Drops from Vomvalysts on the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) at night, and from Sentients found on Lua and the Veil Proxima
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogTagD.zhText:
Sentient 解剖结构中不可或缺的部分。这种难得完好无损的样本可能有重要用途。

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚由轰击使掉落，并且在月球与面纱比邻星域由 Sentient 掉落

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogUnco.text:
A coveted sample of Sentient internal anatomy. Specimens of this age and quality are both rare and valuable. 

Location: Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsDogUnco.zhText:
令人垂涎的 Sentient 内部解剖样本。这种年份和品质的样本既稀有又珍贵。 

获取地点：在地球夜灵平野夜晚中漫游的夜灵

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle1D.text: The Quills are aware of you. Speak with Quill Onkko to learn how to increase your standing with them.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle1D.zhText: 夜羽们意识到了你的存在。与夜羽昂克交谈来了解如何提升你的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle2D.text: The Quills reserve some attention for you. They appear willing to involve you in their mysterious efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle2D.zhText: 夜羽们稍稍留意了你。他们看起来愿意让你参与到他们神秘的事业中。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle3D.text: The Quills consider you a useful resource. They will sell you goods not offered to strangers.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle3D.zhText: 夜羽们认为你是一个有用的资源。他们会向你出售不外流的货物。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle4D.text: After much labor The Quills take you into their confidence. You are a trusted ally.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle4D.zhText: 经过千辛万苦，夜羽们信任了你。你是可以信赖的盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle5D.text: You are a key operative, vital to their efforts, and have access to the Quills' most sought after wares.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/QuillsTitle5D.zhText: 你是一名关键的特工，对他们而言非常重要，可以获得夜羽最炙手可热的货物。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RadioLegionNo.text: Tune in to Nora's Mix Vol. 7
Tune in to Nora's Mix: Dreams of the Dead
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RadioLegionNo.zhText: 收听诺拉的混选：亡者之梦

Nora's Mix:
Dreams of the Dead

New mix. New rewards. Complete daily and weekly acts to advance through reward tiers as you fight for justice in the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RadioLegionNo.zhText: 全新的混选。全新的奖励。在始源星系为正义而战的同时，完成每日和每周行动以提升奖励等级。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilDesc.text: The Veil see corruption all around them. They are honor-bound to heal the system through a great and violent purge. No cost too great, no blood too precious.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilDesc.zhText: 血色面纱见证了他们周围一切的腐败。他们以荣誉为号召，通过强大的暴力净化来治愈星系。不惜一切代价，不惜流尽鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilDogTag.text: Medallion of Red Veil syndicate. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilDogTag.zhText: 血色面纱集团的勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilReward.text: Access to Syndicate Void Relic Pack
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilReward.zhText: 可使用集团虚空遗物包

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilReward.text: Access to Squad Ammo Restore (Large) blueprint
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilReward.zhText: 可以使用弹药能量补给（大型）
受到卓越疾冲者小队追猎
受到卓越疾冲者兵团追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilSyndic.text: Pledge to purge corruption alongside the Red Veil.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/RedVeilSyndic.zhText: 效忠血色面纱，与他们一起清除腐败。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationFir.text: Pledge allegiance to a Syndicate to increase your standing with that Syndicate and its allies and earn rewards. You lose standing with Syndicates that oppose your pledged ideals but can rescind your pledge and explore a new Syndicate at any time.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationFir.zhText: 向集团宣誓效忠，以提高你在该集团及其盟友中的声望值并获取集团奖励。你将失去与你效忠对象对立的集团声望，但你可以随时取消效忠并探索新的集团。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationGai.text: <WARNING> Earning 15% of Affinity as Standing with |SYNDICATE|
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationGai.zhText: <WARNING> 将获得经验值的 15% 转化为|SYNDICATE|的声望值

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationSwa.text: <WARNING> Use Pledge to start earning Standing with a Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationSwa.zhText: <WARNING> 通过效忠开始从集团中获得声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationTip.text: <WARNING> Wear a Sigil to earn Standing with the Syndicate you want to support
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ReputationTip.zhText: <WARNING> 佩戴纹章以获取你想要支持集团的声望

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SacrificeDesc.text: You've proven yourself already. No further sacrifice is needed to earn the title of |TITLE|
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SacrificeDesc.zhText: 你已经证明了自己。不再需要牺牲来获取 |TITLE| 头衔。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SacrificeFirs.text: |SYNDICATE| requires the following sacrifice to earn the title of |TITLE|
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SacrificeFirs.zhText: |SYNDICATE| 需要以下物品贡献才能获得 |TITLE|

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisDesc.text: Indentured workers to the Corpus; the indispensable backbone of the Corpus business model on Venus. Manning factories, rail tractors and mines they work to pay off the artificial bodies (rigs) they bought in order to work.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisDesc.zhText: Corpus 的契约工人；是金星的 Corpus 商业模式中必不可缺的骨干。运行工厂、操作轨道牵引机并挖掘矿山，他们通过工作来偿还人造身体（机械装备），而他们购买这些正是为了工作。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisSecret.text: Risen from the ashes, Solaris United returns to free the Solaris people from their mental shackles and physical servitude. No being should have to work to own their own mind, their own body, their own future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisSecret.zhText: 从灰烬中崛起，索拉里斯联盟为了将索拉里斯人从精神的桎梏和身体的枷锁中解放出来。没有人应该为了拥有独立的精神、身体和未来而强迫工作。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle1.text: Solaris United don’t trust easy, Outworlder. Talk to Eudico.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle1.zhText: 索联不会轻信他人，异世者。和 Eudico 谈谈吧。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle2.text: You get things done, but your loyalties are still unproven.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle2.zhText: 你能办好事情，但是你还没有证明你的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle3.text: You seem a solid mucker. The locals are happy to sort you out with odds and ends.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle3.zhText: 你看起来是个实在的伙计。当地人很愿意和你交易些零碎物品。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle4.text: You’re the go-to gun for the risky stuff. Word is bond.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle4.zhText: 你是处理危险情况的首选。一诺千金。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle5.text: Inner circle, mate. Eudico’s right hand. You and SU: one and the same.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisTitle5.zhText: 圈内人，老兄。Eudico 的左右手。你和索联：一心同体。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisUnited.text: Solaris United works from the shadows to free Solaris workers from the yoke of Corpus debt-slavery, to secure the right of every Solaris to own their body and control their future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SolarisUnited.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟暗中活动，为了将索拉里斯工人从 Corpus 的债务奴役中解放出来，也为了保障每一名索拉里斯人拥有各自身体并掌握自己未来的权利。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.text: Led by a battle-hardened Grineer deserter, the Steel Meridian fight a guerrilla war against a vast enemy. They are sworn protectors of what little remains of the colonies.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.zhText: 由一位久经沙场的 Grineer 叛逃者所带领，钢铁防线以游击战来对抗一个巨大的敌人。他们宣誓要保护那一小块残存的殖民地。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.text: Access to Syndicate Void Relic Pack
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.zhText: 可使用集团虚空遗物包

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.zhText: 可以使用团队生命补给（大型）

受到卓越者滚子兵团追猎

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/SteelMeridian.zhText: 效忠钢铁防线，与他们一同保护手无寸铁之人。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicate_Wor.text: Mastery Rank 3 and Syndicate affiliation required.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicate_Wor.zhText: 需要达到精通段位 3 并加入集团。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicates_Sw.zhText: 无法更改已效忠的集团。请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicates_Un.zhText: 加入集团后才能效忠。现在前往|SYND|？

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicates_Un.text: You have rescinded your pledge. Your standing with this Syndicate will no longer increase. Pledge allegiance to another Syndicate to continue developing your reputation.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/Syndicates_Un.zhText: 你撤销了对该集团的效忠，你在这个集团中的声望将不再增加。向另一个集团宣誓效忠来继续获取声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/TeshinHardMod.text: Accept Teshin's challenge and unlock THE STEEL PATH?
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/TeshinHardMod.zhText: 是否接受 Teshin 的挑战，并解锁钢铁之路？

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/UniversalSynd.text: A medallion prized by all the syndicates. Can be traded in on relay syndicate hubs for additional standing.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/UniversalSynd.zhText: 被所有集团珍视的一种勋章。可以在中继站的集团房间中交换额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VendorHint.text: <WARNING> Visit the relay to check offerings.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VendorHint.zhText: <WARNING> 造访中继站来查看声望奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsDesc.text: Hangin' with their logical fam in the ducts of Fortuna, the Ventkids get by stealing parts from the Corpus and running K-Drive races out on the Vallis. At night the ventways bang to the sound of skeg - to the chagrin of the locals.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsDesc.zhText: 和他们的义亲们住在福尔图娜的管道中。通风小子以偷取 Corpus 的零件为生，并在山谷中进行 K 式悬浮板的比赛。到了晚上，通风管道会响起管道乐，让当地人大为懊恼。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.text: No dings, never taken a hit, wouldn't know ya ta look at ya. Have you even ridden a K-Drive?
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.zhText: 经验全无，从来没有尝试过的菜鸟，路人脸。你连 K 式悬浮板都没用过吧？

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.text: Nice enough; wouldn’t last five minutes in a vent.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.zhText: 还不赖，但是在通风管里撑不过五分钟。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.text: Solid sorta mucker and you ride a K-Drive like it's stolen. ‘Cause it is.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.zhText: 还算不错的伙计，你骑着仿佛是偷来的 K 式悬浮板。因为确实是偷来的。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.text: Stand-up cove and vouched for, this one. Chekchek?
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.zhText: 敢作敢当的老兄。切克切克？

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.text: Had no say in your biological fam, but this crew's your logical fam. Ventkids are logical; got no time for muckers who ain't.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VentkidsTitle.zhText: 和你的亲生兄弟无话可说，但这里都是你的义亲。通风小子是义亲；不会和不是的家伙浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolDesc.text: Solaris United's core personnel operating under the name of that group's enigmatic and anonymous figurehead. SU is the public face of the struggle. Vox Solaris is something else entirely; something known only to Eudico... and the Quills.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolDesc.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟的核心成员借以行事的匿名神秘领袖形象。索联是奋斗反抗的代表。而索拉里斯之声则完全是另一种存在，只有 Eudico……和夜羽才知道这其中的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle1D.text: We watch, we anticipate, we intercede. We're just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle1D.zhText: 我们监察，我们预测，我们斡旋。我们才刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle2D.text: Got a good feeling about you, kid.

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle3D.text: Glad to have you with us. We say, you do. We have been waiting for you, to deliver upon them a terrible ruin.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle3D.zhText: 很高兴你和我们一起。我们说，你就做。我们一直在等你，为他们带来可怕的毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle4D.text: The best of our best. Your acts are legendary. Your acts can never be known.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle4D.zhText: 我们当中最好的。你的作为很有传奇性。你的作为永远不为人知。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle5D.text: You are one of us. Together we reach from the darkness to reclaim our future.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/VoxSolTitle5D.zhText: 你是我们的一分子。我们共同从黑暗里走出来，重夺属于我们的将来。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanDesc.text: Granted a second existence through the mysterious power of the Void, the four Holdfasts struggle to keep their sanity and their vessel intact. The return of the Tenno may turn the tide.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanDesc.zhText: 通过虚空的力量得以再度生存，这四名坚守者奋力保持理智和他们的船只完好无损。Tenno 的重返或许能扭转局势。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle1.text: The Holdfasts are now more than strangers to you... and to themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle1.zhText: 现在，坚守者对你……和他们自己来说，已经不仅仅是陌生人了。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle2.text: With memory comes remorse... but also responsibility.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle2.zhText: 记忆带来悔恨……还有责任。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle3.text: Trust has taken root and begun to grow, even in this desolate place.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle3.zhText: 信任已经开始生根发芽，即使是在这个荒凉之地。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle4.text: You have undone the worst that the Void could do, and humanity is within reach.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle4.zhText: 你已经复原了虚空所做的一切坏事，并且人性近在咫尺。

/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle5.text: You have become the savior both of the Zariman and of her last remaining crew.
/Lotus/Language/Syndicates/ZarimanTitle5.zhText: 你成为了「扎里曼号」和她仅存船员的救星。

/Lotus/Language/Synthetics/FishingAngler.text:
Dyes the waters with a compound that sticks to fish passing through it, making them easier to see from the shore.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Synthetics/FishingAngler.zhText:
用一种混合物给水域染色，这种混合物会附着在经过的鱼身上，使它们从岸边更容易被看到。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Synthetics/FishingSoftTo.text:
A compound that relaxes nearby fish.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Synthetics/FishingSoftTo.zhText:
一种可以让附近的鱼放松的混合物。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Greetings, Child. 

It has come to my attention that you have completed some difficult task or another. Well done, I suppose. I have awarded you this trinket to mark your achievement. I am certain you will revel in all the appropriate glory that this affords you.

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
孩子，你好。 

我注意到你完成了某项艰巨的任务。干得好，我想。为了表彰你的成就，我特此授予你这件小饰品。我相信你会为它所带来的荣耀而欢欣鼓舞。

你诚挚的， 
副摄政总司令罗瑟
击败 Sentient 英魂统使
按下 |CALLOUT| 使用 Tauron 打击

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Destroy Makvos Cannon with Tauron Strike

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Regularly inflicts damage. Rate and amount of damage increases with each stack.
Every 60s another stack is added. Cleared when the gauntlet is completed.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
定期造成伤害。每层增加伤害频率和伤害量。
每隔 60 秒叠加一层。在完成考验后层数清零。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
My child,

Like you, I mourn for the peace that might have been. But we cannot make the past our prison. We look backward only to learn where we are going.

Adis Truth-Bloom possessed a power unique among Sentients: the power to heal our kind. If another like him exists, we must find them.

Loid has granted us full use of the Dark Refractory. Use it. Your chaotic memories of Tau must be entered, tamed and understood.

Your memories of the Warframe Uriel have enabled Loid to reconstruct his blueprint. A difficult task, as the Orokin attempted to destroy all copies. Use Uriel with caution if you use him at all.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
我的孩子，

和你一样，我也为本该拥有的和平而哀悼。但我们不能让过去成为我们的牢笼。我们回顾过去，只是为了找到前进的方向。

"真理绽放"阿迪斯拥有 Sentient 中最为独特的力量：治愈我们族群的力量。如果还有其他像他一样的存在，我们必须找到他们。

洛德已授予我们完全使用深溯池的使用权。去好好利用它吧。你必须进入、压制并理解你在 Tau 上的混乱记忆。

你对战甲 Uriel 的记忆使洛德得以重建他的蓝图。这是一项艰巨的任务，因为奥罗金人曾试图抹除所有的存档。如果你要使用 Uriel，请千万小心。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

During your battles on Tau, you were never truly alone. These Tenno fought by your side:

|PLAYER_NAMES|

Place this memorial in your base of operations so that you will always remember their names.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

你在 Tau 的战斗期间，从来都不是孤身作战。这些 Tenno 曾与你并肩作战：

|PLAYER_NAMES|

将这座纪念碑安放在你的行动基地，这样你就能永远铭记他们的名字。

我现在掌握的情报还不够。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: The feared Orokin commander Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe, whose battlefield prowess was legendary even among the Seven.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 令人闻风丧胆的奥罗金指挥官副摄政总司令罗瑟，其战场上的英勇事迹即使在七人众之中也堪称传奇。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Greetings, Child. 

Infuriating, is it not? To one day wake up and find holes poked in what was formerly a perfectly retentive mind. 

I have no interest in commiseration of your War stories; you did what you did. Instead I come to offer you an incentive, if only for a short while.

You know of the Dark Refractory, yes? It allows one to traverse their memories, no matter how inaccessible they may have been rendered. 

Use it. Explore the deepest depths of your war-torn psyche. Show me the limits of the Device. Do so and you will earn my very own Marks of Valiance. But act with haste Operator, for my magnanimity sets like Sol itself. Come visit me within "La Cathédrale" afterwards, and I shall show you what being in the good graces of an Orokin can buy you.  

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
问候你，孩子 。

真让人恼火，不是吗？有一天你醒来，发现原本记忆力极佳的头脑被戳得千疮百孔。

我对同情你的战争故事不感兴趣；你做了你该做的。相反，我是来给你一点激励，哪怕只是一小会儿。

你知道深溯池，对吧？它可以让人穿越自己的记忆，不管那些记忆被渲染得多么难以触碰。

使用它。探索你饱受战争摧残的心灵最深处。让我看看这种设备的极限。做到的话，你就能得到我的英勇标记。赶快行动吧，指挥官，因为我的宽宏大量就像太阳神下山那么快。之后到"大教堂"来找我，我将告诉你得到奥罗金人的赏识能给你带来什么。

你诚挚的,
副摄政总司令罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: BLOOD OF PERITA: A devil's proposal
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 佩里塔之血：恶魔的提议

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Greetings once more, Child.  

Regrettably, for myself at least, this vein of the Dark Refractory has exhausted its gold. As delightful as it has been to watch you trade your mental faculties for the dregs of my once-enviable treasury, it seems there is nothing of any more value for me to glean from that machine. Yes, that means there will be no more Marks of Valiance. 

Don't stop your mental flagellation on my account, however! I am sure that there is still much for you to gain from your little Tenno war therapy sessions. I already know we lost, after all.

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
再次问候你，孩子。

遗憾的是，至少对我来说，这深溯池的脉已经耗尽了它的黄金。虽然看着你用你的心智来交换我曾经羡慕的宝藏渣滓，我还是很高兴的，但似乎我再也无法从那台机器里找到比这更有价值的东西了。是的，这意味着再也不会有勇敢的标记了。

不过，不要因为我而停止你的精神鞭笞！我敢肯定，从你的小 Tenno 战争治疗课程中，你还能学到很多东西。毕竟，我已经知道我们输了。

你诚挚的,
副摄政总司令罗瑟

自由派 Grineer 捕猎者

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. It was not uncommon to witness Dax rangers supporting Tenno as they first learnt to control their Warframes, filling in offensive gaps with precise aim.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。禁卫游侠在 Tenno 初学操控战甲时提供支援并不罕见，他们常用精准的射击填补进攻空档。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A commanding officer of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. It was not uncommon to witness Dax rangers supporting Tenno as they first learnt to control their Warframes, filling in offensive gaps with precise aim.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的指挥官。禁卫游侠在 Tenno 初学操控战甲时提供支援并不罕见，他们常用精准的射击填补进攻空档。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A turret cobbled together from technology stolen from their former masters. In preparation of hiding amongst their enemies, the Dax are drilled in every facet of tactical improvisation. The sheer performance of what should by all means be a subpar weapon of war stands as a testament to their knowledge.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 炮塔是用从他们前主人那里窃取的技术拼凑而成。为了能够潜伏在敌人之中，禁卫接受了各种即兴发挥的战术训练。这东西按理说应该算不上优秀武器，却展现出了惊人的性能，这足以证明他们高超的技艺。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forces to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。在许多行动中，解放者曲翼枪械雷鸣般的齐射声都作为信号，引导隐藏的禁卫部队从阴影中现身，如同断头台的利刃般扑向敌人。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A commanding officer of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forces to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的指挥官。在许多行动中，解放者曲翼枪械雷鸣般的齐射声都作为信号，引导隐藏的禁卫部队从阴影中现身，如同断头台的利刃般扑向敌人。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A commanding officer of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Exceptional even amongst the extraordinary, the shining armor of a Lustratus marked Dax who were fit for leadership over their brethren in battle.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一名指挥官。即便在强者之中，他也堪称佼佼者。光肃官禁卫所穿的闪亮盔甲，象征着他们有能力在战场上领导自己的同袍。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. With shield above and staff in hand, Dax medics are as adept at healing as their brethren are at cutting down the opposition.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。禁卫医疗兵高举盾牌，手持长杖，他们不仅擅长治疗，而且和他们的同胞一样精于杀敌。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. While their agility and disappearing techniques allowed these Dax to quell revolts before they had formed in earnest, their experiences allowed for their own rebellion to flourish where all others have failed.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。虽然这些禁卫凭借其敏捷身手和隐匿技巧，能够在叛乱真正形成之前就将其镇压，但正是他们那些经验，让他们自己的叛变得以壮大，超越其他所有失败者。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Within the minds of those dedicated to the blade lies a singular focus; to annihilate their enemy in the most effective manner possible.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。这些嗜剑如命之徒心中只有一个目标：以最有效的方式消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A commanding officer of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Within the minds of those dedicated to the blade lies a singular focus; to annihilate their enemy in the most effective manner possible.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 自由派禁卫派系的一名指挥官。这些嗜剑如命之徒心中只有一个目标：以最有效的方式消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A cloned soldier in top fighting form. Lancers formed the front line of the Orokin legions, advancing relentlessly to carry the full might of the army deep into enemy territory. Lancers were chosen for sheer-minded determination, the ones who found it hard to let go of an idea.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 一名克隆士兵，战斗力处于巅峰状态。枪兵是奥罗金军团的前线，他们不知疲倦地推进，将军队的全部力量深入敌后。枪兵的选拔标准是意志坚定，他们一旦认定某个想法，就很难放弃。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 只有最狡猾的克隆人才能被选中成为捕猎者。他们会接受科研的训练，学习如何操作捕猎无人机；许多人无法通过训练。由于在学习瞄准过程中容易发生意外，捕猎者经常被小队排斥。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A drone deployed by Grineer Trappers to ensnare their victims. Beams of electricity pick out targets, before stunning swaths of foes with a wide burst of electricity. The drone's systems are idiosyncratic, sharing no commonalities with any other Orokin device.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 这是 Grineer 捕猎者部署的一种无人机，用于诱捕受害者。它会发射电光束锁定目标，然后用大范围的电流冲击波击晕大片敌人。这种无人机的系统独一无二，与任何其他奥罗金设备都截然不同。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Kill |PROGRESS|/|GOAL| enemies with Melee Weapons with the Insign II Kalika Medal equipped
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 佩戴「花蕾记名军 II」勋章，使用近战武器击杀 |PROGRESS|/|GOAL| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Complete |PROGRESS|/|GOAL| Steel Path Missions with the Servio VI Kalika Medal equipped
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 佩戴「花蕾侍从军 VI」勋章，完成 |PROGRESS|/|GOAL| 场钢铁之路任务

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Everything needed to earn the respect of Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 赢得副摄政总司令罗瑟尊重所需的一切。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A long-forgotten promise is remembered. The truth of Tau is laid bare, even as the mocking whispers of the Indifference grow louder. Soon the final leap may at last be taken.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 一段尘封已久的承诺被重新记起。Tau 的真相被彻底揭开，与此同时，虚空无情之物的嘲讽低语却愈发响亮。或许，最终的一跃终将到来。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的踪迹指向始源星系之外。唯有深入探究过去，才能厘清前路——但埋藏的秘密可能致命。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Orokin military title, awarded to recognize acts of exceptional heroism in battle.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 奥罗金军事称号，授予在战斗中表现英勇无畏的人。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: A Sentient drone deployed from a Hunhullus. Carrionites scan the terrain for enemy units, alerting their lumbering master who will then obliterate them.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 一架由英魂统使部署的 Sentient 无人机。腐生无人机会扫描地形，寻找敌军，并将警报传递给它们笨重的主人，主人随后会将敌军彻底摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text: Swarming micro-drones deployed from a Sentient Hunhullus. When destroyed Marrowticks have the curious property of creating gravitic fields imbued with Void radiation, a possible consequence of their earlier role in assisting with the construction of the Solar Rail between the Origin System and Tau.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText: 成群的微型无人机从 Sentient 英魂统使部署而来。当被摧毁时，骨髓蜱具有一种奇特的特性，即会产生充满虚空辐射的引力场，这可能是它们早期参与建造始源星系和 Tau 星系之间的星际航道所导致的后果。
环绕轨道，TAU 月球"佩里塔"

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
The evolved core of a Dactolyst, bearing its true self-given name and identity. When deprived of Tau pollen, the core becomes susceptible to forcible reprogramming.

Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
这是指节使进化后的核心，承载着其真正自创的名字和身份。当 Tau 花粉供给中断时，这个核心就容易被强制重编程。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的"回忆：指节使"任务中获取。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
A delicate paraneural interface allowing a duly evolved Sentient pilot to command the colossal Hunhullus as if it were a second skin.

Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
一种精妙的外神经接口，使经过适当进化的 Sentient 飞行员能够像操控第二层皮肤一样操控庞大的英魂统使。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的"回忆：英魂统使"任务中获取。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Technology developed by Executor Ballas to allow remote piloting of a hijacked Warframe for short periods, forcing them to act against even their deepest instincts.

Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
由执行者 Ballas 开发的技术，可对被劫持的战甲进行短时间的远程操控，迫使他们违背自己最深层的本能行事。

可从佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）中的"回忆：先锋"任务中获取。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
A mark of identification carried by soldiers during The Old War so that their names might be remembered if they never returned home.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
这是远古之战时期士兵携带的身份标记，以便在他们无法返回家乡时，人们能够记住他们的名字。

获取地点：在佩里塔叛乱任务（深溯池）中的箱子和敌人处获得。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:
Awarded by Grand Carnus Roathe in recognition of valorous deeds past and present.

Obtained from Perita Rebellion (Dark Refractory) and Operation Alerts during Operation: Blood of Perita.
Exchange with Roathe after completing The Old Peace Quest.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.zhText:
由总司令罗瑟授予，以表彰其过去和现在的英勇事迹。

可通过《行动代号：佩里塔之血》期间的佩里塔叛乱（深溯池）和行动警报获得。
完成《旧日和平》系列任务后，可用来与罗瑟兑换。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFin.text:

/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/ErisMortemEv.zhText:
TENNO

原谅她

我们将在彼岸重逢

/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/ErisMortemEv.text:
Tenno. We must work to keep Eris clear of Infested so that Praghasa may feed.

If you harvest any viable Moonflesh from Eris, take it to Mother. She will need them.

With what I am asking of her, we must be certain that this succeeds.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/ErisMortemEv.zhText:
Tenno。我们必须清除阋神星上的感染者，好让「布拉喀萨」得以进食。

如果你在阋神星上采集到任何可用的月华脯，就将其交给母亲。她会用得上。

我向她提出了如此请求，我们必须确保万无一失。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/InboxMessage.text:
Praghasa can now reach Tau. 
I must pilot her, and become one with Praghasa.
When we get to Tau, it will be with my strength. 
I will not be able to free myself from her in Tau.
I will watch over you, but I can only be with you here on the Origin System. 
In Tau, I will be my true self: Natahgasa, The Sungazer – blind once again, empty of all but wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/InboxMessage.zhText:
「布拉喀萨」现在可以抵达 Tau 星系了。 
我必须亲自驾驶她，与她融为一体。
我们能够抵达 Tau 星系，所凭借的将是我的力量。 
到了 Tau 星系，我便再也无法与她分离。
我会一直守望着你，但只有在始源星系，我才能与你同在。
而在 Tau 星系，我将成为真正的自己：凝日者娜塔喀萨——再度失明，仅余智慧。

/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/IntroMessage.text:
Drifter,

The Dark Refractory is prepared. She is well. Please join us.

I should note that your younger counterpart is not best pleased about your taking the lead, so make haste.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/IntroMessage.zhText:
漂泊者，

深溯池已准备好。她安然无恙。请加入我们。

我得提醒你，你那位年轻版的自己对你抢先一步不太高兴，所以请尽快过来。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip0.text: Holding multiple Index Points incurs Financial Stress which reduces Warframe Health and Shields. The more Points you hold, the more your Health and Shields are reduced.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip0.zhText: 持有多个指数点数会带来财务压力，从而降低战甲的生命值和护盾。你持有的点数越多，你的生命值和护盾减少得就越多。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip1.text: Carrying multiple Index Points will provide a bonus amount for total points deposited. The maximum bonus is 10 extra at 20 Index Points held.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip1.zhText: 携带多个指数点数将为存入的总点数提供奖励数值。持有 20 个指数点数最多可获得 10 个额外奖励点数。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip2.text: Held Index Points carry over in-between rounds.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip2.zhText: 持有的指数点数会延续到下一轮次。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip3.text: Warframes that have damage reduction or invulnerability abilities are highly effective at carrying Index Points as they are more capable of overcoming the Financial Stress debuff.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip3.zhText: 具有伤害减免或无敌能力的战甲十分擅长携带指数点数，它们更有能力抵御财务压力减益效果。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip4.text: If you are killed while carrying Index Points, all held points are free for pick-up by friend or foe! Deposit held Index Points if you are close to lethal damage.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip4.zhText: 如果你在携带指数点数时被击杀，所有持有的点数将会被盟友或者敌人自由拾取！在接近死亡时存储你持有的指数点数。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip5.text: Each enemy Broker has its own unique ability. Stay alert when engaging them in combat.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip5.zhText: 每个敌方经纪都有自己独特的技能。与他们交战时需保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip6.text: Similar to other combat arenas, keep an eye out for Health and Energy pick-ups around the map.
/Lotus/Language/TheIndex/Tip6.zhText: 与其他的战斗竞技场相似，请留意地图周围的生命和能量恢复拾取。

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/TradingRule.text:
Welcome to Warframe's Trading system! Here you can trade in-game items and Platinum with other Tenno.

The first rule of trading in Warframe is to only trade in-game items that are available in the trade window.

Attempting to trade items outside of the game is considered a violation of the Terms of Service/EULA.

To learn more about safe trading practices, hover over the tips icon in the trade window.

Hitting "Accept" means you have read and understood the above.

Happy safe trading, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/TradingRule.zhText:
欢迎使用 《Warframe》的交易系统！在这里，你可以与其他 Tenno 交易游戏内的物品和白金。

作为《Warframe》中的第一条交易守则，请确保你只交易在交易窗口中可选的游戏内物品。

尝试交易游戏外物品的行为会被视为违反《使用条款协议》/ 《用户授权协议》。

如果你想要了解更多有关安全交易的信息，请将鼠标悬停在交易窗口中的提示图标上。

点击 "接受" 表示你已阅读，并理解以上内容。

Tenno，祝你交易安全且愉快！

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_0.text: Both players are responsible for reviewing and confirming that what they will be receiving in the Trade is what was agreed upon before accepting.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_0.zhText: 在接受交易之前，交易双方均有责任来检查和确认交易物品，以确保他们在交易后收到的物品与交易前所达成的协议一致。

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_1.text: Any changes that occur while Trading requires confirmation from both players before proceeding. Take note of each change before accepting!
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_1.zhText: 如果在交易过程中发生了任何变动，交易双方都需要对此进行确认，以继续进入下一步。在接受交易前请留意每一次变动！

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_2.text: Platinum purchased through unauthorized third-party sites or individuals is not permitted. All official and supported payment options are available through the in-game Market.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_2.zhText: 禁止通过未经授权的第三方站点或个人来购买白金。所有官方支持的购买方式都可以在游戏内商店中找到。

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_3.text: A Warframe account may only be accessed by its original creator. The transfer, sale or purchase of a Warframe account is not permitted.
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_3.zhText: 一个 Warframe 账号只能被注册这个账号的玩家访问。禁止转让、出售或购买 Warframe 账号。

/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_4.text: The breed and visual qualities of a Kubrow or Kavat Imprint can be seen in the "VIEW OFFERED IMPRINTS" button in the Trade menu. Review the Imprints you are receiving before completing trade!
/Lotus/Language/TradingHints/Trading_4.zhText: 可以通过交易菜单内的"查看提供的印记"选项来查看库狛或库娃的品种和外观品质。请在完成交易之前检查你将要收到的印记！

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: Find possessed Exolizers by looking for their |OPEN_COLOR|contaminated tendrils|CLOSE_COLOR|, spewing Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 可以通过寻找会喷出虚空能量的|OPEN_COLOR|污染卷须|CLOSE_COLOR|来找到受侵噬的无垢装置。

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: Seal |OPEN_COLOR|all 3|CLOSE_COLOR| Void tears at the end of the tendrils with an |OPEN_COLOR|Amp or Void sling|CLOSE_COLOR| to expose the possessing Thrax unit.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 使用|OPEN_COLOR|增幅器或虚空弹射|CLOSE_COLOR|来封住卷须末端的|OPEN_COLOR|所有 3 个|CLOSE_COLOR|虚空缝隙，以显露正在侵噬的凶魂单位。

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: |OPEN_COLOR|Shoot the Thrax|CLOSE_COLOR| with Void energy to completely purge the Exolizer of possession.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 使用虚空能量|OPEN_COLOR|射击凶魂|CLOSE_COLOR|来完全净化并使无垢装置免受侵噬。

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: Keep the Void Cascade meter low by |OPEN_COLOR|purging possessed Exolizers|CLOSE_COLOR| of Thrax contamination.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 通过|OPEN_COLOR|净化受凶魂污染侵噬的无垢装置|CLOSE_COLOR|来降低虚空覆涌计量表。

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: Purged Exolizers reduce Void contamination by a |OPEN_COLOR|set amount of time.|CLOSE_COLOR| Defeat nearby enemies to quickly reduce contamination.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 净化后的无垢装置减少|OPEN_COLOR|一定时间|CLOSE_COLOR|的虚空污染。击败附近的敌人来快速减少污染。

/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.text: Purged Exolizers |OPEN_COLOR|can be repossessed|CLOSE_COLOR| by Thrax units. Defeat any Thrax units nearby to keep the Exolizer safe.
/Lotus/Language/Tutorial/VoidCascadeTuto.zhText: 净化后的无垢装置可被凶魂单位|OPEN_COLOR|重新侵噬|CLOSE_COLOR|。击败凶魂单位来保护无垢装置的安全。

|OPEN_COLOR|CAMERA MOVEMENT|CLOSE_COLOR|
Move the camera with standard controls.
|OPEN_COLOR||ASCEND||CLOSE_COLOR| moves the camera |OPEN_COLOR|up|CLOSE_COLOR|.
|OPEN_COLOR||DESCEND||CLOSE_COLOR| moves the camera |OPEN_COLOR| down|CLOSE_COLOR|.

|OPEN_COLOR|CAPACITY COST|CLOSE_COLOR|
Each Decoration has a |OPEN_COLOR|<CAPACITY>Capacity Cost|CLOSE_COLOR|.
The cost is visible when selecting a Decoration.
The total cost of all Decorations in a room may not exceed the |OPEN_COLOR|Room Capacity|CLOSE_COLOR|.
The |OPEN_COLOR|<CAPACITY>Capacity Remaining|CLOSE_COLOR| in the current room is displayed in the Decorations screen.

|OPEN_COLOR|ADVANCED MODE|CLOSE_COLOR|
Press |OPEN_COLOR||ADVANCED_MODE||CLOSE_COLOR| to access additional options for placement and manipulation of Decorations.

通过标准控制移动镜头。
|OPEN_COLOR||ASCEND||CLOSE_COLOR| |OPEN_COLOR|向上|CLOSE_COLOR|移动镜头。
|OPEN_COLOR||DESCEND||CLOSE_COLOR| |OPEN_COLOR|向下|CLOSE_COLOR|移动镜头。

|OPEN_COLOR|容量消耗|CLOSE_COLOR|
每件装饰都有 |OPEN_COLOR|<CAPACITY>容量消耗|CLOSE_COLOR|。
可以在选择一件装饰时看到它的容量消耗。
房间内所有装饰的总消耗不得超过|OPEN_COLOR|房间容量|CLOSE_COLOR|。
当前房间的|OPEN_COLOR|<CAPACITY>剩余容量|CLOSE_COLOR|会显示在装饰界面。

|OPEN_COLOR|高级模式|CLOSE_COLOR|
按 |OPEN_COLOR||ADVANCED_MODE||CLOSE_COLOR| 键来访问关于放置和操作装饰的更多选项。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirm.zhText:

/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmShor.text:
