WARNING: By skipping ahead you will encounter many story spoilers, and face extremely difficult gameplay intended for experienced players with fully modded, max rank weapons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmShor.zhText:
你是否想跳过《旧日和平》系列任务及其所有前置内容，直接体验「沉沦之地」和「佩里塔叛乱」游戏模式？

警告：跳过这些内容会遇到大量剧情剧透，并会面对极高难度游戏内容，更适合装备全套 Mod 及拥有满级武器和战甲的资深玩家挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmed.text: To access The Descendia and The Perita Rebellion use the |BOLD_START|Dark Refractory|BOLD_END| option at the Navigation Console in your Base of Operations.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/OptInConfirmed.zhText: 要访问「沉沦之地」和「佩里塔叛乱」，请在行动基地的导航控制台中使用|BOLD_START|深溯池|BOLD_END|选项。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Desc.text:
The hunt for Albrecht Entrati continues.

The Hex are vying to protect their city from the Scaldra and Techrot alike. It's a race against the clock to save Höllvania — don't be late, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Desc.zhText:
对阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的追捕仍在继续。

六人组正在竭力保护他们的城市免受炽蛇军和科腐者的侵袭。拯救霍瓦尼亚迫在眉睫——Tenno，可别来晚了。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
Höllvania's a mess, the Hex are even messier. Meet our newest Syndicate, a motley crew of Protoframes trying to keep their world from falling apart. 

Bonds can be forged in even the most dire of circumstances —  with the new Romance & Relationship system, you can connect with Syndicate members like never before. Chat and play with Hex members to increase your Chemistry, expand their lore, and maybe even earn yourself a kiss. 

Access this context after completing The Hex Quest!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
霍瓦尼亚一片混乱，六人组则乱上加乱。来见见我们最新的集团，一群由各路原型战甲组成的队伍，他们试图阻止世界分崩离析。 

即使在最危急的情况下也可以建立关系——使用全新的恋爱与羁绊系统，你可以与集团成员建立前所未有的关系。与六人组成员聊天和互动，以提高他们对你的好感度，拓展他们的背景故事，甚至可能赢得一个吻。 

完成《六人组》系列任务后可解锁此内容！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
A new time, a new place —  explore all that Höllvania has to offer, featuring new enemy factions and mission types. 
• Compete against your foes and fellow Tenno in the new Faceoff game mode! 
• Hunt down Legacytes in an endless capture style mission featuring Kalymos. 
• Take on Scaldra's ultimate weapon in the H-09 Efervon Tank Assassination mission. 

Access this new content (and more!) by completing The Hex Quest in your Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
全新时代，全新地点——探索霍瓦尼亚的一切，包括全新敌对派系和任务类型。 
• 在新的对战游戏模式中与你的敌人和其他 Tenno 竞争！ 
• 在以卡利莫斯为特色的无尽捕获式任务中追杀传承种。 
• 在 H-09 艾弗旺坦克刺杀任务中对抗炽蛇军的终极武器。 

通过完成资料库中的《六人组》系列任务来解锁这些新内容（以及更多！）。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
Cruise through your mission objectives in style with the new Atomicycle! Aided by its 4 unique abilities, you can burn rubber with your new ride in Höllvania and Open Landscape missions. 

Unlock your Atomicycle via the Hex Quest and adorn it with new Liveries via the Market.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
骑着新的原子摩托车潇洒地完成任务目标！配备四种独特技能，你可以在霍瓦尼亚和开放世界任务中骑着新座驾尽情飙车。 

通过《六人组》系列任务解锁你的原子摩托车，并在游戏内商店为其添加新的外观涂装。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
Assemble the Hex into your Arsenal with new Gemini Skins. Use the corresponding Gemini emote to swap your fashion frame on the fly —  from Warframe to Protoframe, and back again! 

Embody your favourite Protoframe with these fully customizable skins featuring unique voice lines that respond to your actions in-mission.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
使用全新的双子外观将六人组纳入到你的军械库中。使用相应的双子表情动作，即时让你的时尚炫甲在战甲与原型战甲之间来回切换。

化身你最喜爱的原型英雄，这些可完全自定义且带有独特配音的外观，能根据你在任务中的行为做出反应。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
Move like a shadow, strike with force. This Warframe marries damage and stealth to tackle even the most difficult situations. Take aim at your enemies with the ultimate sharpshooter: Cyte-09.

Earn Cyte-09 via Höllvania Bounties or from Amir in Höllvania Central Mall after completing The Hex Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
身随影动，强势出击。这款战甲结合了伤害和隐身，可以应对最困难的情况。以终极神枪手：Cyte-09 的身份，瞄准你的敌人。

完成《六人组》系列任务后，可通过霍瓦尼亚赏金任务或从霍瓦尼亚中央商场的阿米尔处获取 Cyte-09。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.text:
We've freshened up both Nyx and Trinity's kits! Whether you're playing as their default, Prime, or Protoframe, these Warframes bring quality of life improvements and updated mechanics to the battlefield. 

Nyx embraces chaos with changes that increase the lethality of her Mind Control Target and improve synergy with Radiation status effects across all of her abilities. Use Psychic Bolts to strip enemy defenses and Nyx will now retain a portion of what you've stripped.

Trinity is her squad's saving grace with the ability to negate lethal damage via Well of Life. Energy Vampire now benefits from positive duration, and Link scales with strength to tether to more foes. 

For a full rundown of their changes, check out our patch notes!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999Highli.zhText:
我们更新了 Nyx 和 Trinity 的技能组！无论你是使用普通版、Prime 版还是原型战甲，这些战甲都会为战场带来游戏体验的提升和机制的更新。 

Nyx 通过一些改动来拥抱混乱，这些改动增加了她的精神控制目标的杀伤力，并提高了与她所有技能中的辐射异常状态的协同作用。使用精神飞刃剥夺敌人的防御，Nyx 现在将保留你剥夺的一部分防御。

Trinity 是小队的救星，她能够通过生命之井抵挡致命伤害。能量吸取现在会因正数持续时间而增强，而链接会随力量增强，从而链接更多的敌人。 

要了解她们的全部改动，请查看我们的更新说明！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999HowToP.text: Turn back the clock to 1999! Venture into the world of Höllvania in our new story expansion: The Hex. Access this Quest via your Codex after completing The Lotus Eaters and The Duviri Paradox.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/Update1999HowToP.zhText: 让时光倒流至 1999 年！在我们的全新故事扩展内容《六人组》中，探索霍瓦尼亚的世界。完成《食莲者》和《双衍悖论》后，通过资料库进入这个系列任务。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
A cosmic conflict stretches through time and space.

Discover what fuels this fiery battle and come to understand the Stalker's role in this follow-up to Jade Shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
一场贯穿时空的宇宙冲突。

探索这场激烈战斗的根源，并了解追猎者在《Jade 之影》续作中的角色。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

Sirius & Orion are customized and upgraded separately, but can be swapped between in-mission by hold-casting Abilities. Swap between the Sons to build up Constellation Stars, which are used to generate their ultimate Celestial Clash.

Earn our latest Warframe via the new Railjack missions in the Uranus Proxima after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

Sirius & Orion 可以分别进行自定义和升级操作，需要在任务中通过长按技能进行切换。在二子之间切换可以积攒众星，用于施放他们的终极技能——「天体冲突」。

完成《Jade 之影：众星》系列任务后，即可在天王星比邻星域的全新航道星舰任务中获得我们最新的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text: When a great Sentient summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future, Sirius and Orion, have come calling in this new cinematic quest, and they are not alone.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText: 当一位伟大的 Sentient 召唤追猎者前往奥布山谷参与一场正在展开的离奇冲突时，他必须面对自己行为所带来的令人震惊的后果。他未来的阴影——Sirius 和 Orion——正在这个全新的电影式系列任务中召唤，而这些阴影并不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
Mentors who have raised Sirius and Orion in their respective futures, Ryoku (Ash) and Vena (Garuda) share a rivalry of their own. Where Ryoku drives home his pride at the tip of an assassin's blade, Vena soaks in the endless acceptance of wrath.

Venture to the Uranus Proxima and choose which Protoframe to aid in battle. These new Railjack missions become available after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
作为在各自未来中培养了 Sirius 与 Orion 的导师，忍力（Ash）与维纳（Garuda）之间也存在着独特的竞争关系。忍力以刺客之刃彰显其骄傲，而维娜则沉浸于无尽的愤怒之中。

前往天王星比邻星域，选择要协助作战的原型战甲。完成《Jade 之影：众星》系列任务后，即可解锁这些全新的航道星舰任务。
全新原型战甲：ASH 与 GARUDA

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
Nidus' kit has received a refresh, featuring various quality of life changes to help him grow his Mutation Stacks more quickly. Highlights include:

• Increased Mutation Stacks cap to 200. 
• Virulence does Damage Over Time that also generates Mutation Stacks. 
• Larva can now be recast.
• Ravenous' radius scales with Range. 
• Improved Maggot targeting. 

For full details on this change, check out the official patch notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
Nidus 的技能组迎来了一次调整，包含多项游戏体验改动，使他能够更快地增长突变适性层数。主要改动包括：

• 突变适性层数上限提高至 200。
•「致病力」现在会造成持续伤害，并且持续产生突变适性。
•「幼体」现在可以重新施放。
•「贪婪」的半径随范围缩放。
•「蛆虫」能够更好地瞄准目标。

完整改动详情请查看官方更新日志。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
Jade Shadows: Constellations brings a variety of quality-of-life changes to existing content:

• Corpus Ship tileset remaster
• Knockdown unification from enemy attacks
• Damage Over Time Preview on healthbars
• New Camera Position setting in User Interface settings
• and more!

Learn more about these Quality of Life changes, and more, in our official patch notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
《Jade 之影：众星》为现有内容带来了一系列提升游戏体验的改动：

• 重制 Corpus 飞船场景
• 统一敌人攻击造成的击倒效果
• 在生命条上显示持续伤害预览
• 用户界面设置中新增镜头位置设置
• 以及更多精彩内容！

想了解更多关于这些提升游戏体验的改动以及更多精彩内容，请参阅我们的官方更新日志。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
New Incarnon Genesis have been added to the Circuit for the Obex, Stug, Vectis, Ballistica, and Destreza! Enhance your Arsenal even further with new Arcanes (available from Uranus Proxima missions) and new Warframe Augments. 
 
Choose the path of wisdom with the new Dante Tytonis Collection, or flaunt the new Vena and Ryoku Gemini skins for Garuda and Ash!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
现已在无尽回廊中加入全新的奥比克斯、史特克、守望者、布里斯提卡和技巧之剑灵化之源！使用全新赋能（可通过天王星比邻星域任务获得）和全新战甲技能强化 Mod，进一步提升你的战甲实力。 
 
选择智慧之路，体验全新 Dante 夜鹰组合包；或炫耀 Garuda 和 Ash 全新的维纳和忍力双子外观！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.text:
A furiously destructive conflict across the stars stretches through time and space. Discover what fuels this fiery battle and come to understand the Stalker's role in this follow-up to Jade Shadows.

The new Jade Shadows: Constellations quest is available to those who have played its prequel, Jade Shadows.

Once complete, gain access to new Railjack missions in the Uranus Proxima!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateConstellat.zhText:
一场横跨星际、破坏力惊人的冲突贯穿时空。探索这场激烈冲突的根源，并了解追猎者在《Jade 之影》续作中的角色。

全新《Jade 之影：众星》系列任务现已开放给已完成前置任务《Jade 之影》的玩家。

完成该系列任务后，即可在天王星比邻星域中体验全新的航道星舰任务！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathDesc.text:
The time has come, the day turns into night,
And the one called Dagath will finally take flight. 

A doomed mission calls for Tenno aid aboard a drifting Galleon. Answer the cry for help and be rewarded for your efforts!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathDesc.zhText:
时刻已到，白昼变为黑夜，
Dagath 终将飞翔。

在一艘漂流的帆船战舰上，一项注定失败的任务需要 Tenno 的帮助。响应求救信号，你的努力将得到回报！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Meet our newest Warframe, Dagath! Her signature melee weapon, Dorrclave, heals her slightly with each active Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 永远不要低估悲伤的力量和愤怒。来认识一下我们最新的战甲 Dagath！她的标志性近战武器怒斩，会在每次激活异常状态时轻微治愈她。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: The Syndicates need help to finish a doomed mission to recover Orokin Era Defixios from a Galleon of Grineer raiders adrift in the Abyssal Zone near Ceres. Defixios are known to contain a new Resource, Vainthorns.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 集团需要帮助来完成一项注定失败的任务，即从漂流在谷神星附近深渊区域的一艘 Grineer 帆船战舰上找到奥罗金时代的咒言板。据了解，咒言板中有浮华荆棘。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: Resurrect a Naberus legend with the new Dojo Room, Dagath's Hollow! Here you can customize your Kaithe, acquire the Blueprints for Dagath and Dorrclave, and listen to Grandmother's new Naberus legend about Dagath.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 通过全新的道场房间"Dagath 的空阁"重现一个纳贝流士传说！在这里，你可以自定义你的绝灵骥，获取 Dagath 和怒斩的蓝图，还可以听"祖母"讲述关于 Dagath 的全新纳贝流士传说。
聆听 DAGATH 的恐怖故事

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: The king of the sea has received a Rework! Hydroid's <DT_IMPACT>Impact and <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic Damage have been changed to <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage and Status; Charge Mechanics have been removed; Undertow has been replaced with a new Ability titled Plunder, and much more!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 海上之王已经经过了重制！Hydroid 的 <DT_IMPACT>冲击伤害和 <DT_MAGNETIC>磁力伤害已改为 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害和异常状态；充能机制已被移除；「水漩涡」技能已被新技能「劫掠」替代，还有更多的改动！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: Your furry, robotic, fleshy, and everything-in-between pals have received a rework and can no longer die! How you use, Mod, and interact with your Companions has changed in this first phase of the Companion system overhaul.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 你喜爱的动物朋友，无论是机械的，还是生物体，甚至是介于两者之间的，都得到了重制，并且不会再死亡了！在同伴系统修正的第一阶段中，使用同伴、Mod 以及交互的方式已经发生改变。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.text: A NEW WAY OF LIFE FOR COMPANIONS

New accouterments await you in the Market. Scare the pants off your enemies with the Awlspan Syandana, traverse Duviri in style with the Aumen Kaithe Gear, and take your fashion to the next level with Voidshell Skins for Protea, Nidus, and Mirage! All that and more is available.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHigh.zhText: 全新的精美装备在商店等着你。使用锋翼披饰吓跑你的敌人，使用金兆绝灵骥装备优雅地穿梭于双衍王境，并使用 Protea、Nidus 和 Mirage 的虚空之壳外观提升你的时尚感！更多精彩等你来发掘。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHowT.text: Purchase an Abyssal Beacon from any Syndicate to reveal the Abyssal Zone ship adrift on Ceres. Collect the new Resource Vainthorn needed to craft Dagath and the Dorrclave in the new Dojo Room, Dagath's Hollow.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDagathHowT.zhText: 从任意集团处购买深渊信标，以精确定位谷神星上的"深渊区域"节点。获取全新的资源"浮华荆棘"，来在全新的道场房间 Dagath 的空阁中打造 Dagath 战甲和怒斩武器。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteDesc.text:
Author the story of the Leverian with the help of Dante and his Exalted Tome, Noctua!

Defend the Leverian from the avaricious clutches of Parvos Granum and the Corpus! Master Dante's Abilities as you take on new Missions like Murmur focused Disruption and greater challenges than ever before.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteDesc.zhText:
在 Dante 和他的显赫典籍夜枭的帮助下编写莱弗博物馆的故事！

保护莱弗博物馆不受帕尔沃斯·格拉努和 Corpus 的贪婪魔掌！掌握 Dante 的能力，你将执行全新的比如低语者集中的中断任务和前所未有的更大挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: Awaken the king of the desert once more and command the sands with far more ferocity than ever before! Inaros has been reworked, featuring a new bleedout mechanic, and completely refreshed Second, Third, and Fourth Abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: 再次唤醒沙漠之王，以更加凶猛的姿态驾驭沙海！Inaros 已经重制，加入了新的出血机制，并彻底更新了二、三和四技能。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: This update brings some of the most difficult missions yet: Deep Archimedea. Only those with Rank 5 in the Cavia Syndicate are trusted to walk this challenging path, but with great reward waiting for them at the end. Necraloid in the Sanctum Anatomica will be your guide!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: 此次更新推出了迄今最艰难的任务之一：深层科研。只有在科维兽集团中达到声望 5 级的玩家才可以踏上这条充满挑战的道路，但在终点等待着他们的是丰厚的奖励。解剖圣所的殁世械灵将指引你前行！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: Fuse base Shards into Tauforged variants with this new Helminth expansion! Those with the Helminth Coalescent Segment installed can now fuse three of the same Color Shard into one Tauforged Shard. Earn this Segment via the Cavia Syndicate after completing the Whispers in the Walls Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: 通过这个新 Helminth 扩展，将基础源力石融合成 Tau 融造变体！安装了 Helminth 联结模块的玩家现在可以将三个相同颜色的源力石融合成一个 Tau 融造源力石。完成《墙中低语》系列任务后，可以通过科维兽集团获得这个模块。
创造 TAU 融造执刑官源力石

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: Two new Incarnon weapons can be yours: the Ruvox and the Onos! Earn these via the new Disruption mission on Deimos (after completing Whispers in the Walls), or grab them in the Market!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: 两把全新灵化武器等你拥有：古声和赘骨！通过在火卫二上的全新中断任务（需先完成《墙中低语》）来获得，或者直接在游戏内商店购买！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.text: Styanax's warrior spirit is reimagined with the Styanax Tonatiuh Collection! This update also includes new TennoGen creations from community artists Ventralhound, Erneix, and Goosmo in our TennoGen Unbound release!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHighl.zhText: Styanax 的战士精神在 Styanax 炽阳神组合包中得到了重新诠释！此次更新还包括了我们在 TennoGen 无枷发布中，来自社区艺术家 Ventralhound、Erneix 和 Goosmo 的全新 TennoGen 创作！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHowTo.text:
Visit the Cavia in Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to play the new Deep Archimedea mode, or help Drusus save the Leverian in Armatus, Deimos' newest Disruption mission! 

Complete Whispers in the Walls to gain access to Deep Archimedea, and complete both Whispers in the Walls and The Deadlock Protocol to play Armatus!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateDanteHowTo.zhText:
前往火卫一的解剖圣所造访科维兽，体验新的深层科研模式，或在火卫二最新的中断任务节点卫城区帮助德枢救回博物馆。 

完成《墙中低语》即可进入深层科研，完成《墙中低语》和《僵局协议》来游玩卫城区节点！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
A familiar face, an unlikely ally. 

Dominus Thrax calls for aid —  the Murmur have invaded the Kingdom of Duviri, led by the newly resurfaced Major Neci Rusalka. 

Step into Isleweaver and face off against Oraxia as you work to unravel Rusalka’s latest web.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
熟悉的面孔，不可能的盟友。 

士魂大帝请求支援——低语者入侵了双衍王境，其首领是刚刚复活的内奇·鲁莎卡少校。 

进入织屿人节点，与 Oraxia 对抗，努力瓦解鲁莎卡的最新势力。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Draw foes into your ever-tightening web with our 61st Warframe, Oraxia! 

Oraxia can be obtained from the new Isleweaver node in Duviri after completing The Hex Quest. Complete the spiral and defeat The Fragmented to earn Scuttler Husks (a new currency), and a chance at Oraxia's blueprints.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
阴险优雅与致命多变交织在一起；这是属于完美掠食者的进化。使用我们的第 61 款战甲——Oraxia，将敌人拉入你不断收紧的网中！ 

完成《六人组》系列任务后，可从双衍王境的织屿人节点获得 Oraxia。完成复眠螺旋并击败接肢怪，就能获得急行蛛外壳（一种新货币），并有机会获得 Oraxia 的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
Stand aside, Drifter. Warframes take the spotlight in the new Isleweaver node — with Dominus Thrax's permission, of course. 

Select your loadout from the available equipment in Teshin's Cave, and gain access to them immediately upon stepping foot into Duviri. For a limited time, play Isleweaver to earn progress and rewards for Operation: Eight Claw.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
漂泊者，靠边站。战甲将成为全新织屿人节点里的焦点——当然，这需要得到士魂大帝的许可。 

从 Teshin 的洞穴可用装备中选择你的配置，一旦踏入双衍王境，你就可以立即使用。在有限的时间内，在织屿人中畅玩以获得《行动代号：八爪》的进度和奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
The Isleweaver node brings you into a new story: the tale of The Triumph of Dust. 

Rusalka aims to write a new ending in her favor —  one that twists Duviri’s fate. Isleweaver mirrors The Lone Story mission structure, but with a twist: play through six objectives and face a formidable foe at the end. Many of your objectives will feel familiar, but are corrupted by Rusalka’s touch. 

Fight through the Murmur and put a stop to her plot, at any cost.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
织屿人节点将你带入一个全新的故事：尘埃的胜利。 

鲁莎卡的目标是书写一个对她有利的新结局——一个扭转双衍王境命运的结局。织屿人与孤独纪事的任务结构相似，但有所不同：你需要完成六个目标，并在最后面对一个强大的敌人。许多目标会让你感到熟悉，但却因为鲁莎卡的影响而扭曲。 

突破低语者，不惜一切代价阻止她的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
A berserker’s fury fills the air. Corpus, Grineer, Infested: torn pare by pare.

Valkyr’s rework focuses on her core identity: the rage of a berserker. She’s received a top-to-bottom ability refresh, including an updated Passive that leans into a new mechanic: Rage. With this, we intend to capture the essence of reckless commitment. No breaks allowed.

Learn all about the Valkyr rework in our Patch Notes, or simply unleash her in-mission to see it in-action.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
狂战士的怒火在空气中弥漫。Corpus、Grineer、Infested：被撕裂得支离破碎。

Valkyr 的重制聚焦于她的核心特质：狂战士的怒火。她获得了全面的技能更新，包括一个经过更新的被动技能，该技能引入了新的机制：狂怒。通过这一设计，我们想要体现她一往无前的本质。永不停歇。

在我们的更新说明中详细了解 Valkyr 重制的内容，或者直接在任务中使用她，亲眼见证她的实力。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
Captain Vor, master of the Janus Key, has received a rework. New and returning players can face off against this iconic foe in a dynamic new fight. While he’s not too punishing for new players, he may have a few more tricks up his sleeve if you fight him in a more difficult setting.

Junctions in the Star Chart have also received refreshed Tasks and Rewards, with the goal of streamlining the path to completing the Main Story quest line.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
沃尔上尉，雅努斯之钥的持有者迎来了重制。新玩家和回归玩家将在一场全新的动态战斗中与这位标志性敌人对决。虽然他对新玩家来说并不算太难对付，如果你在更困难的环境中与他战斗，他可能会有更多花样。

星图中的接合点也迎来了更新的任务和奖励，旨在简化主线系列任务的完成流程。
沃尔重制和接合点全面改造

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
Embrace the eternal bond between love and war with Citrine Aphrodita. 

Isleweaver also brings a slew of new community-created customizations with TennoGen Isleweaver, and familiar hairstyles for your Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
拥抱 Citrine 美神，感受爱与战争之间永恒的羁绊。

《织屿人》还通过《TennoGen 织屿人》带来了大量由玩家社区创作的全新自定义装饰，以及为你的指挥官和漂泊者提供的熟悉的发型。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.text:
Journey to the new Isleweaver node in Duviri to face off against Oraxia and Major Neci Rusalka’s forces!

Unlock Isleweaver by completing The Hex Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateIsleweaver.zhText:
前往双衍王境全新的织屿人节点，与 Oraxia 和内奇·鲁莎卡少校的部队对决！

完成《六人组》系列任务后解锁《织屿人》。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeDesc.text:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Jade Shadows brings our newest Warframe, Jade, a glorious herald of both life and death. 

Delve into long-held secrets of the Origin System with our new Ascension Game mode, and latest cinematic Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeDesc.zhText:
在绝望的时刻，让歌声响彻战场。《Jade 之影》带来了我们最新的战甲 Jade，她是生与死的光辉使者。 

通过我们的全新扬升游戏模式和最新的电影式系列任务，挖掘始源星系的深藏秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text: Evoking the solemn — yet melodic — hymns of a choir, the newest Warframe sings songs of devastation as she heralds both life and death across the Origin System’s many battlefields. Through her, the Jade Light can be a source of destruction or a source of support.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText: 这款新战甲唤起人们对合唱团庄严——而优美——的赞美诗的回忆，唱起毁灭之歌，预示着始源星系众多战场上生与死的到来。借她之手，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text:
Introducing our newest mission type: Ascension! Stalker’s stronghold is under intensive assault from marauding Corpus forces, but what they’re after must remain safe. 

Bring your Warframe gameplay to new heights with this game mode, available on Uranus after completing the Jade Shadows quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText:
全新任务类型登场：扬升任务！追猎者的据点正遭受 Corpus 部队的猛烈攻击，关键目标绝不能落入敌手。 

在完成《Jade 之影》系列任务后，此游戏模式将在天王星解锁，将你的《Warframe》玩法推向新的高度。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text: ASCEND INTO A NEW GAME MODE
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText: 扬升到新的游戏模式中

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text:
Uncover Stalker’s oldest secret in our newest cinematic quest: Jade Shadows. Venture into his lair to uncover the truth, and deal with the aftermath that unfolds from it. 

Complete The New War quest to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText:
在我们最新的电影式系列任务《Jade 之影》中揭开追猎者最古老的秘密。冒勇闯他的巢穴以揭开真相，并应对随之而来的后果。 

完成《新纪之战》系列任务以解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text:
Find these new Eximus variants wherever Eximus spawn, but be wary of their Jade Light. These foes summon a beam that deals increasing damage the longer it touches you, so you better be quick. 

Dispatch your enemy quickly or outmaneuver them to survive!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText:
无论卓越者出现在哪里，都可以找到这些新的卓越者变体，但要小心它们的翠玉之光。这些敌人会召唤出一束光束，光束接触你的时间越长，伤害就越大，所以你最好行动迅速。 

快速消灭敌人或巧妙躲避才能生存下来！
全新敌人：翠玉之光卓越者

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text:
Review your Arsenal with new Enemy Scaling and Status changes. Armor stripping has been improved with our Armor scaling rework. Simplified Enemy vulnerabilities can be viewed on any node to help optimize builds. Revisit Cold, Blast, and Magnetic damage with changes to these status types — and much more.

Check out our patch notes for full details.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText:
通过新的敌人数值缩放和异常状态改动来重新检视你的军械库。我们对护甲缩放进行了重制，加强了剥离护甲的效果。简化的敌人弱点现可在任意节点上查看，以帮助你优化配置。我们还重新审视了冷冻、爆炸及磁力伤害的异常状态改动——以及更多内容。

请查看我们的更新说明以了解完整详情。
敌人数值缩放和异常状态改动

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text:
Strike forth from the watery depths with the power of Yareli Pandea in her new Deluxe Skin collection! 

This update also features new TennoGen creations from community artists Rekkou, Lubox, LostEpoch, DasterCreations, Ventralhound, and CERF.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.zhText:
借助 Yareli 盘古底华丽外观组合包中的力量从水深之处发起攻击！

本次更新还包括了来自社区艺术家 Rekkou、Lubox、LostEpoch、DasterCreations、Ventralhound 和 CERF 的 TennoGen 最新创作。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHighli.text: A FRESH WAVE OF FASHION FRAME

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHowToP.text: Complete The New War to unlock access to the Jade Shadows quest and venture into Stalker’s Lair!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateJadeHowToP.zhText: 完成《新纪之战》即可解锁《Jade 之影》系列任务并进入追猎者之巢！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiDesc.text:
Seize the threads of destiny with Koumei.

The Dice-Maiden warns that Infested horrors lurk in the shores of Cetus. Venture into her Fate Dream to save the Ostrons from a terrible future.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiDesc.zhText:
与 Koumei 一起把握命运之线。

掷骰巫女警告说，感染者怪物潜伏在希图斯海岸。进入她的命运梦境，拯救 Ostron 人免遭可怕的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text:
Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.

Earn Koumei via the new Saya's Visions node on Earth. Learn how to access this mission via the "How to Play" button in the Update History screen.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText:
让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈

通过地球上全新的萨娅的异象节点获取 Koumei。通过更新历史界面中的"如何游玩"按钮了解如何进行此任务。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text:
Terrible horrors have been foretold in a Fate Dream, and danger darkens the Ostron’s shores. Together, Saya and the Tenno can weave a brighter future for Cetus.

Venture into the new Shrine Defense mission to protect Koumei’s shrine and ferry her offerings to help ward off the Infested threat. Access the new Saya’s Visions node on Earth by talking to Saya after completing the Saya’s Vigil and Once Awake Quests.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText:
命运梦境预言了可怕的灾难，危险笼罩着 Ostron 的海岸。萨娅和 Tenno 齐心协力，为希图斯编织出一个更光明的未来。

挑战全新祈运坛防御任务，保护 Koumei 的祈运坛并运送她的供品，以帮助抵御感染者的威胁。完成《萨娅的守夜》和《悲剧的开端》系列任务后，通过与萨娅交谈以解锁地球上新的萨娅的异象节点。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text: Caliban has received both a rework and a stunning Deluxe Skin with this update. Command your Sentient Wrath with an updated kit, including new Sentients to summon via Lethal Progeny. Then venture into the Otherworld with the new Caliban Orfeo Skin, and carry the spirits back with you.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText: 此次更新中不仅对 Caliban 进行了重制，还增加了一个令人惊艳的华丽外观。使用更新后的技能来指挥你的 Sentient 之怒，包括通过「致命后裔」召唤的新 Sentient。然后使用全新的 Caliban 奥菲欧外观勇闯异界，并将灵魂带回。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text: The second half of our Companion Rework has dropped! Visit your Arsenal to mod the new weapons for Beasts. Review your builds to see new and updated Precepts and Mods! And of course, take your companions in-mission to see new AI changes on the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText: 我们的同伴重制的第二阶段已经发布！请前往你的军械库，为野兽的新武器进行 Mod 配置。重新评估你的配装，查看新增和更新后的指令和其他 Mod！当然，带上你的同伴进入任务，体验战场上 AI 的最新变化。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text:
Bolster your loadouts with new Incarnons and Warframe Augments! Incarnon Genesis Adapters for Dera, Sybaris, Cestra, Sicarus, and Okina have been added to the Steel Path Circuit Rotation (and to Cavalero's wares during that same rotation). 

Visit the Syndicate Panel in your Orbiter to unlock Augments for Hildryn, Voruna, Grendel, and Gyre.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText:
使用全新的灵化武器和战甲强化 Mod 来增强你的配置！德拉、席芭莉丝、锡斯特、暗杀者和翁的灵化之源连接器已添加到钢铁之路无尽回廊的轮换中（并在同一轮换期间也会添加到卡瓦莱罗的商品中）。 

在你的轨道飞行器中访问集团界面，以解锁 Hildryn、Voruna、Grendel 和 Gyre 的强化 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.text: Embody chaos or elegance with the new Volt Raijin and Nova Aozukura Deluxe skins! This update also brings a new series of TennoGen featuring creations from community artists.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHigh.zhText: 使用全新的 Volt 雷帝和 Nova 蓝樱华丽外观来体现混沌或优雅！此次更新还带来了一系列新的 TennoGen，其中包括来自社区艺术家的创作。
为你的时尚炫甲注入活力

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHowT.text: Play the new Shrine Defense mission type via the Saya’s Visions node on Earth. Unlock access to this node by talking to Saya in Cetus after completing the Saya’s Vigil and Once Awake Quests!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiHowT.zhText: 通过地球上萨娅的异象节点游玩全新的祈运坛防御任务类型。完成《萨娅的守夜》和《悲剧的开端》系列任务后，通过与希图斯中的萨娅交谈以解锁此节点！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiPlay.text:
Play the Warframe: 1999 Demo?

This is a single-player mission that must be completed alone. You will leave your current squad if you choose to launch it now.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKoumeiPlay.zhText:
游玩《Warframe：1999》试玩版?

这是个单人游戏任务，只能独自完成如果选择马上开始任务，你将离开当前小队。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoDe.text:
Dare to face The Seven Crimes of Kullervo. Few are strong enough to bear the brunt of vengeance that awaits.

The new Warframe has been locked away in Duviri. Do you have the strength to confront this vengeful warrior?
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoDe.zhText:
勇敢直面 Kullervo 之七宗罪。很少有人能强大到可以承受即将到来的复仇之击。

新的战甲被困在双衍王境。你有力量来对抗这位复仇的战士吗?

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: The newest Warframe, Kullervo, answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. His signature shotgun, Rauta boasts melee synergy. Seize the power of treachery to slake Kullervo's thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: 最新的战甲 Kullervo，背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。他的标志性霰弹枪锐铁具有近战协同的优势。抓住背叛的力量来满足 Kullervo 对复仇的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: The new island, Kullervo's Hold, is located just off Duviri's mainland. Duviri citizens fear the monstrous Warframe imprisoned there. Only a ruthless warden and sympathetic children dare visit. Hear their stories. Fight the monster. Perhaps you can discern the truth about Kullervo's nature.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: Kullervo 的牢房，是一座位于双衍王境大陆附近的全新岛屿。双衍王境的公民们害怕囚禁在那里的怪物战甲。只有无情的监狱长和富有同情心的孩子们才敢来拜访。听听他们的故事。与怪物战斗。也许你能看出 Kullervo 本性的真相。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: Kaithe races, Paragrimm tomes, and lost belongings offer new experiences in Duviri. Meet Brimon, Duviri's top Kaithe rider, who will challenge you to a race. See through the eyes of a wise Paragrimm that needs your help to recover mysterious tomes. Retrieve Duviri citizens' lost belongings. They will reward your success handsomely.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: 在双衍王境，绝灵骥比赛、幽幽鹰遗失的典籍和寻找遗失物品带来了全新的体验。与布瑞蒙相遇，他是双衍王境的顶尖绝灵骥骑手，他会邀请你进行比赛。通过智慧幽幽鹰的眼睛来观察，帮助它收集神秘的遗失典籍。并为双衍王境的公民找回遗失的物品，他们会给你丰厚的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: Become a formidable force in Duviri with new Decrees and strengthen Warframes, Primary Weapons, and Secondary Weapons with new Arcanes. The king's Spiteful Decrees have complicated consequences. They offer great strength to those who are willing to make a sacrifice. Choose wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: 在双衍王境中，通过全新的王令成为一支不可小觑的力量，并使用新的赋能强化战甲、主要武器和次要武器。国王的恶意王令带有复杂的效果，愿意付出代价的人将得到强大的力量。请谨慎选择。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: The SPROUT system has powered up in Teshin's Cave. It offers a new set of Duviri plants to harvest every twenty hours. The timer resets with each harvest, so the astute will check back regularly.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: Teshin 洞穴中的茁芽系统已启动。它提供一套新的双衍王境植物，每二十小时收获一次。每次收获时计时器都会重置，因此精明的人会定期回来查看。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.text: New accouterments await you in the Market. Go full throttle with the fiery Gauss Kresnik Collection, invite good fortune with Drifter and Operator Orizu Suits, and support other player creations with the latest TennoGen. All that and more is available.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHi.zhText: 全新的精美装备在商店等着你。用炽热的 Gauss 火神组合包全力以赴，用漂泊者和指挥官纸鹤套服祈求好运，通过最新的 TennoGen 支持其他玩家的创作。所有这些以及更多内容精彩上线。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHo.text: Kullervo's Hold appears in Duviri during Anger, Fear, or Sorrow Spirals. Go there and speak to The Warden to engage in combat with Kullervo. Once you defeat both him and the Spiral's Orowyrm, you will receive Kullervo's Bane, a new Resource you can use to buy Kullervo Warframe Blueprints from Acrithis.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateKullervoHo.zhText: 在愤怒、恐惧或悲伤复眠螺旋期间，Kullervo 的牢房会出现在双衍王境。前往那里与监狱长对话，与 Kullervo 交战。同时击败他和复眠螺旋的奥金魇龙后，你将获得 Kullervo 的灾刃，这是一种新的资源，你可以用它从言录使处购买 Kullervo 战甲蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinDesc.text:
Entropy threatens the Zariman. 

Cephalon Melica has raised the alarms. Entropic Kuva seeps into the ship, twisting enemies into new Entropic Eximus. 

Find answers on Yuvan's Peak, the home of Narin's Crest. Visit this new hub to learn its secrets and stop the flow.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinDesc.zhText:
熵数正威胁着扎里曼号。

中枢梅丽卡已拉响警报。熵之赤毒正渗入飞船，将敌人扭曲成新的熵之卓越者。 

前往青春峰顶，Narin 的冰冠所在地，寻找答案。造访这个新的枢纽，揭开它的秘密，阻止熵数的蔓延。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to heal and defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.

Earn our latest Warframe from missions on the Zariman Ten Zero, or by acquiring Entropic Kuva from Entropic Eximus on the Zariman, and exchange it for her blueprints via Cephalon Melica. Find Cephalon Melica in the Chrysalith (Zariman) or on Yuvan's Peak (Earth) after completing the Angels of the Zariman Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
Narin 驾驭着旋涡降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用寒冰进行治疗和防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击时那样娴熟。

通过在「扎里曼 10-0 号」上完成任务，或者从熵之卓越者身上获取熵之赤毒，并与中枢梅丽卡交换获得她的蓝图，就能获得我们最新的战甲。在完成《扎里曼的天使》系列任务后，可以在羽化之穹（扎里曼号）或青春峰顶（地球）找到中枢梅丽卡。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
Attention students! It's time for a field trip.

Cephalon Melica has been summoned to Yuvan's Peak on Earth, where Narin's Crest glitters against the snow. Marvel at its wonder and attempt to pull Narin's Iceblade free. 

This trip is not all fun, however. Entropy threatens the Zariman, and Narin's influence on the Peak is key to stopping its spread. Collect Entropic Kuva from Entropic Eximus found on the Zariman, and exchange it with Melica to contain it. In doing so, you'll receive items from her wares, including Narin's blueprints!

As you hunt these new Eximus on the Zariman, you may find more than just Kuva — Melica has a history, and there is much for you to uncover.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
同学们注意啦！是时候进行一次实地考察了。

中枢梅丽卡已被召唤至地球上的青春峰顶，Narin 的冰冠在皑皑白雪中闪耀。在惊叹于它壮丽景色的同时，请尝试将 Narin 的冰刃拔出吧。 

然而，这次旅行并非全是轻松愉快的事。熵数正在威胁着扎里曼号，而 Narin 在峰顶的影响力是阻止其蔓延的关键。从扎里曼号上遇到的熵之卓越者身上收集熵之赤毒，并将其与梅丽卡交换以封印它。如此一来，你将获得她出售的物品，包括 Narin 的蓝图！

当你在扎里曼号上击杀这些新的卓越者时，你可能不仅会发现赤毒——梅丽卡有着一段不为人知的过去，还有许多秘密等待你去揭开。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
Ten years after Rivens were introduced, we're expanding on the Riven system! 
 
When cycling Rivens, a new "Lock Trait" button has been added to the screen. Here, players can choose one Trait to lock when cycling their Mod with Kuva. 

Cycling a Riven Mod with a Locked Trait will double the Kuva cost. Players can swap which Traits to lock or unlock as they continue to cycle their Rivens!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
在裂罅推出十年后，我们对裂罅系统进行了扩展！ 
 
在循环裂罅时，屏幕新增了一个"锁定属性"按钮。玩家可以在这里选择一个属性，在使用赤毒循环裂罅 Mod 时将其锁定。 

循环已锁定属性的裂罅 Mod 将使赤毒消耗翻倍。玩家可以在循环裂罅的过程中随时切换锁定或解锁的属性！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
We've updated Banshee's kit to make her lethality easier to master, in addition to some general quality of life and synergistic changes. 

Here's a quick overview of her key changes:
• Sonic Boom now strips armor, and the Augment now gives Banshee armor 
• Sonar's Weak Spots are now considered Weak Points 
• Silence can now be recast 
• Sound Quake is no longer a channelled ability
• Sound Quake's Augment is now channelled, and its damage is multiplied every second during casting

For full details, be sure to check our patch notes!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
我们更新了 Banshee 的技能组，除了一些总体游戏体验质量和协同变化之外，还让她的杀伤力更容易被掌握。

以下是她的主要变化的快速概述：
•「音爆」现在可以剥离护甲，而强化 Mod 现在可以为 Banshee 提供护甲
•「声纳」的弱点命中现在被视为弱点伤害
•「静音」现在可以被再次施放
•「音波冲击」不再是导引技能
•「音波冲击」的强化 Mod 现在已被导引，并且其伤害在施放期间每秒都会成倍增加

有关完整详细信息，请务必查看我们的补丁说明！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
Time for an experiment, students! What happens if you ring that bell?

High upon Yuvan Peak, Cryobells have formed, drawn out by Narin's influence. Each bell's tone leads to a time and place where a dark influence has taken hold. Six warriors must gather to ring the bell. Together they must overcome the Binds of a force not of this plane.

The Icebind is a new challenging game mode featuring a six player squad, designed to push their loadout and coordination as they tackle cooperative objectives. 

Completion of the Angels of the Zariman and Whispers in the Walls quests are required to access this content. The Icebind also only appears for those who have unlocked an Elite Archimedea.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
同学们，实验时间到！敲响那颗冰珠铃，看看会发生什么？

在青春峰顶的高处，由于 Narin 的影响，冰珠铃已经形成。每一声铃响的音调都指向一个被黑暗势力占据的时间和地点。六名战士必须集结起来敲响冰珠铃。他们必须共同克服来自异界力量的羁绊。

冰封羁绊是全新的挑战性游戏模式，需要由六名玩家组成小队，旨在考验玩家的配置和协作能力，以完成合作目标。

要开始这个游戏模式，必须先完成《扎里曼的天使》和《墙中低语》系列任务。此外，只有解锁了精英科研内容才能挑战冰封羁绊。
全新的游戏模式：冰封羁绊

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.text:
Make a hush fall across the battlefield as you step out in the new Banshee Threnodia Skin, or strike terror into the hearts of your foes with the Qorvex Basilica Skin. 

Iceblade of Narin also brings a new TennoGen: Iceblade collection featuring community-made cosmetics. Flaunt more community artwork with brand new Atragraph Mods for the Savage Silence and Reactive Storm Augments. 

Finally, this update also brings new Augment Mods for Oraxia, Uriel, Frost, and Grendel!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHighl.zhText:
使用全新的 Banshee 挽歌外观，让战场鸦雀无声；或者使用 Qorvex 圣殿外观，让敌人胆寒。 

《Narin 的冰刃》还带来了全新的 TennoGen：冰刃系列，其中包含社区创作的精美外观。使用全新的墨染 Mod，为「残酷无息」和「响应风暴」强化 Mod 增添更多社区艺术作品。 

最后，本次更新还为 Oraxia、Uriel、Frost，和 Grendel 带来了全新的强化 Mod！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHowTo.text:
The Zariman is threatened by a flow of Entropic Kuva, causing new Entropic Eximus to appear on the ship. Killing them will release the Entropic Kuva, which can be exchanged via Cephalon Melica for Narin's blueprints.

Find Cephalon Melica in the Chrysalith (Zariman) after completing the Angels of the Zariman quest. Melica can also be found on Yuvan's Peak (Earth) after completing both the Angels of the Zariman and Whispers in the Walls quests.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateNarinHowTo.zhText:
扎里曼号受到熵之赤毒的威胁，导致全新的熵之卓越者出现在飞船上。击杀他们会释放熵之赤毒，可以用它与中枢梅丽卡交换 Narin 的蓝图。

完成《扎里曼的天使》系列任务后，可以在羽化之穹（扎里曼号）找到中枢梅丽卡。完成《扎里曼的天使》和《墙中低语》两个系列任务后，也可以在青春峰顶（地球）找到梅丽卡。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceDesc.text:
Face the past. Shape the future.

Return to the battlefields of old and relive your experiences on Tau with our latest cinematic Quest. Uncover another batch of Protoframes with The Devil's Triad. 

Tenno — can you bear the weight of what the past remembers?
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceDesc.zhText:
直面过去，塑造未来。

回到历史战役，通过我们最新的电影式系列任务重温你在 Tau 上的经历。通过《恶魔三重奏》，发掘另一批原型战甲。 

Tenno——你是否能承受过往记忆的重负？

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text:
Delve into memories thought lost to time, memories of Tau, and the fragile peace brokered between Orokin and Sentient. What happened in the past to make such bitter enemies in the present? With the help of your friend, Adis Truth-bloom, only the Tenno can uncover the real story of Tau.

The Old Peace quest requires completion of The Lotus Eaters to unlock.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText:
深入探索那些被时光吞噬的记忆——关于 Tau 以及奥罗金与 Sentient 之间脆弱的和平协议的记忆。究竟发生了什么，让昔日的盟友沦为今日的死敌？在你的朋友"真理绽放"阿迪斯的帮助下，唯有 Tenno 才能揭开 Tau 的真相。

需要完成《食莲者》才能解锁《旧日和平》系列任务。
全新系列任务：《旧日和平》

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text:
Slip deep into memories of another time with Albrecht's Dark Refractory… 

Master Roathe's mind in the new Descendia gamemode: 21 Infernums to conquer, each with a challenge and penance that rotates every week.

Return to the battlefields of old and relive your experiences on Tau with The Perita Rebellion, accomplishing all you can within a 12 minute limit.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText:
沉浸于阿尔布雷希特的深溯池……

重温往昔岁月。在全新的「沉沦之地」游戏模式中，掌控罗瑟的意志：征服 21 个炼狱，每个炼狱都包含每周轮换的挑战和惩罚。

重返昔日战场，在"佩里塔叛乱"中重温你在 Tau 的经历，在 12 分钟的限制内竭尽所能。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。Uriel 用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text:
Venture back to XX99 to see Albrecht's influence in a distant alternate past! 

After completing The Old Peace quest, you're introduced to three new Protoframes: Marie, Lyon, and the first Orokin Protoframe, Roathe. Visit them in La Cathédrale in the Sanctum Anatomica, and chat via the expanded KIM system to learn why Albrecht brought them all together.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText:
回到 XX99 年，探寻阿尔布雷希特在遥远平行时空的影响！

完成《旧日和平》系列任务后，你将邂逅三位全新的原型战甲：玛丽、里昂，以及首位奥罗金原型战甲——罗瑟。在解剖圣所的大教堂拜访他们，通过升级版即时通系统前往大教堂与他们聊天，揭开阿尔布雷希特将众人汇聚于此的真相。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text:
With the rediscovery of knowledge from the Tauron Academy, new branches grow on your Focus School tree. Take full advantage of this new system to bring your Operator and Drifter's power to new peaks with the new Tauron Strikes, which allow you to wield Tektolyst Artifacts with great devastation.

Complete The Old Peace quest to gain access to this Focus Expansion!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText:
随着 Tauron 学院知识的重现，你的专精学派树上将长出新的枝桠。充分利用这套全新系统，借助全新的 Tauron 打击，将你的指挥官和漂泊者的力量提升至新的巅峰。这些打击将使你能够以惊人的威力驾驭工匠使文物。

完成《旧日和平》系列任务即可解锁此专精扩展！
全新专精扩展：Tauron 打击

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.text:
The first of its kind, the Vinquibus bayonet is both a Primary and Melee Weapon and can be modded distinctly for each slot. 

Not adverse to dispatching enemies at range or up close and personal, the Vinquibus is a Weapon from a forgotten war, finding itself in Tenno hands once again.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHighl.zhText: 制胜者刺刀是同类武器中的首创，它既可作为主要武器也可作为近战武器，并且每个武器槽位都可以进行不同的 Mod 配置。制胜者刺刀既能远距离消灭敌人，也能近身肉搏，这把来自被遗忘的战争的武器，如今再次落入 Tenno 手中。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHowTo.text:
Before you can step into the past with The Old Peace quest, players must have completed The Lotus Eaters.

Dip your toe into Dark Refractory missions using the "Dark Refractory Preview" feature in the Update Screen. Jump into the Dark Refractory missions and play with your friends, with restricted public matchmaking for those below Mastery Rank 10. 

Previewing will not complete Quests — you will need to play The Old Peace to gain access to vendors and other quest-locked content.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdatePeaceHowTo.zhText:
在体验《旧日和平》系列任务之前，玩家必须先完成《食莲者》。

你可以使用更新界面中的"深溯池预览"功能，提前体验深溯池任务。你可以直接进入深溯池任务，与好友一起游玩，但精通段位 10 以下的玩家将无法进行公开匹配。 

预览功能不会完成系列任务——你需要完成《旧日和平》才能解锁商人和其他与该系列任务锁定的内容。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
Look at the blood. Look at the ink. 
Watch it drip, drip. 

Something— no, someone haunts the ruins of the Vesper Relay. Come face-to-face with Follie, the Shadowgrapher, and complete her canvases to uncover the Truth.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
看看这血迹。看看这墨迹。 
看着它滴落，滴落。 

有什么东西——不，是某个人——在 Vesper 中继站的废墟中徘徊。与绘影者 Follie 正面交锋，完成她的画作，揭开真相。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.

Earn our latest Warframe from the new Follie's Hunt game mode on Venus!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
Follie——这位既欢乐又怪诞的绘影者，能够让墨迹化为现实。运用各种多变的素描与戏法来支援小队，并群控战场上的敌人。

在金星的全新游戏模式 Follie 的狩猎中获取我们的最新战甲！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
A mysterious painting in the ruined Vesper Relay casts a shadowy pall across the Origin System, and it falls to you to investigate. Return to the wreckage of Vesper Relay and enter a canvas of chaos, where a tragic history long lost to the shadows is waiting to be illuminated.

Visit Aspirant Zorba outside the Arbiters of Hexis enclave on any active Relay to exchange earned Atramentum.

Gain access to the Follie's Hunt mode after completing the Chains of Harrow quest!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
在废弃的 Vesper 中继站，一幅神秘画作笼罩着整个始源星系，你将负责调查这件事。重返废弃的 Vesper 中继站，踏入混沌画卷，一段早已被阴影吞噬的悲剧历史正等待着被揭开。

前往任意中继站，在均衡仲裁者的房间外拜访见习仲裁者左巴来使用获得的墨痕兑换物品。

完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务后，即可解锁 Follie 的狩猎游戏模式！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
Whether you are stepping into Warframe anew, or continuing your journey, The Shadowgrapher update brings some changes to familiar missions:

• Warframe Mantle improvements, which can be seen as you parkour in any mission. 
• Awakening Quest Remaster
• New Survival Security Bypass mechanic, which allows you to speed up Survival missions!
• Improved Excavator survivability, including shield-gating and health increases to help them scale in harder missions. 

For full details, check out our patch notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
无论你是刚刚踏入《Warframe》，还是继续你的旅程，《绘影者》更新都为大家熟悉的一些任务带来了改动：

• 《Warframe》攀附动作改进，在任何任务中进行跑酷时都可以体验到。
• 《觉醒》系列任务重制
• 全新的生存任务安保速通装置，让你能够加快生存任务的进程！
• 挖掘机耐久度提升，包括护盾保险制和生命值提高，使其在更高难度任务中也能更好地发挥作用。

完整详情请查看我们的更新日志。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
The Shadowgrapher brings a variety of quality of life changes to existing content — maybe Follie's influence isn't so terrifying after all:

• Revamped Requiem Eterna Relic, to make it easier to farm Requiem Mods. 
• Additions to Palladino's store in The Iron Wake!
• Acquisition improvements for Equinox, Nidus, Ivara, Khora, and various older weapons. 
• Player Cold Status and Arctic Eximus changes, meaning players experience reduced slowdown from Cold Status.

For full information on these quality of life changes, get all the details in our official patch notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
《绘影者》更新还为现有内容带来了多项游戏体验改动——也许 Follie 的影响其实并没有那么可怕：

• 安魂永恒遗物进行了重制，这让获取安魂 Mod 更加容易。
• 钢铁守望中的 Palladino 商店新增了更多物品！
• Equinox、Nidus、Ivara、Khora 以及多款旧武器的获取方式得到改进。
• 对玩家受到的冰冻异常状态以及极寒卓越者进行了调整，使玩家在受到冰冻异常状态影响时的减速效果降低。

有关这些游戏体验改动的完整信息，请查看我们的官方更新日志。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
There's never been a better time to play together! This update brings a new Clan Cooperation System, which incentivizes you to squad up with your Clan.

This system includes:
• New Clan & Alliance Matchmaking
• Bonus Clan Vault resources when playing with a Clan Member
• Personal Rewards for earning Bonus Resources 
• Clan Emblem Prism

And more! Check out our patch notes for full information.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
现在正是一起畅玩的最佳时机！本次更新带来了全新的氏族合作系统，鼓励你与氏族成员组队作战。

该系统包括：
• 全新的氏族与联盟匹配系统
• 与氏族成员一起游玩时可获得额外的氏族保管库资源
• 通过获取额外资源可获得个人奖励 
• 氏族徽章光谱

以及更多精彩内容！完整信息请查看我们的更新日志。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
Your Adversaries have uncovered new weapons —  time to make them your own. Hunt down your very own Kuva Ghoulsaw, Tenet Quanta, and Coda Bubonico!

Venture into battle in-style with a variety of new cosmetics, including TennoGen creations from the community, and the new Gauss and Grendel deluxe skins!

Add holographic flair to Upgrade Screens with Atragraph Mods, a purely visual upgrade accessible via Aspirant Zorba in the Relays.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
你的对手已经发现了新的武器——是时候把它们据为己有了。猎取属于你的赤毒·尸鬼电锯、信条·量子切割器，和终幕·横痃重炮吧！

以全新的外观风格踏上战场吧！本次更新带来了多款全新装饰，包括来自社区创作的 TennoGen 作品，以及全新的 Gauss 与 Grendel 华丽外观！

通过墨染 Mod 为升级界面增添全息炫酷的视觉效果。这是一种纯视觉性升级，可在中继站向见习仲裁者左巴获取。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.text:
Access the new Follie's Hunt game mode on Venus after completing the Chains of Harrow quest.

Earned Atramentum can be exchanged with Aspirant Zorba outside the Arbiters of Hexis enclave on any active Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateShadowgrap.zhText:
完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务后，即可在金星上解锁 Follie 的狩猎游戏模式。

前往任意中继站，在均衡仲裁者的房间外拜访见习仲裁者左巴来使用获得的墨痕兑换物品。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotDes.text:
New Protoframes have emerged, each with their own questions to answer and problems to solve. 

Techrot Encore also brings new Adversaries with the Technocyte Coda, new Temporal Archimedea and Stage Defense game modes, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotDes.zhText:
全新的原型战甲已经出现，他们都有各自的问题需要找到答案和解决办法。

《科腐者安可》还带来了全新的对手科技细胞终幕者、全新的时光科研和舞台防御游戏模式等更多精彩内容！

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
Turn up the volume and get ready to rock with Temple! Our 60th Warframe arrives in a glamorous blaze, wielding an Exalted (and talking!) guitar named Lizzie. Vanquish your foes with the power of song and light the flames of revolution.

Earn Temple from Stage Defense missions in Höllvania after completing The Hex quest and reaching Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
调高音量，准备和 Temple 一起摇滚吧！我们的第 60 款战甲身批华丽的火焰，手持一把名为丽兹的显赫吉他（而且会说话！）。用歌声的力量击败敌人，并点燃革命的火焰。

完成《六人组》系列任务并在六人组集团中声望达到等级 4 后，即可从霍瓦尼亚的舞台防御任务中获取 Temple。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
New Protoframes have assembled in a previously undiscovered section of Höllvania Central Mall. Relax and take a load off in The Round Table, a pub inhabited by Minerva (Saryn Protoframe), Velimir (Frost Protoframe), Kaya (Nova Protoframe), and Flare (Temple Protoframe).

Each of them grants access to new content or new wares, so be sure to stop by once you’ve reached Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
新来的原型战甲已在霍瓦尼亚中央商场一个先前未被发现的区域集合。在老圆桌酒吧放松身心，米尼娃（Saryn 原型战甲）、维利米尔（Frost 原型战甲）、卡娅（Nova 原型战甲）和弗莱尔（Temple 原型战甲）都住在这里。

他们每个人都提供新内容或新商品，因此一旦你的六人组集团声望达到等级 4，请务必前来。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
On-lyne's tour has officially kicked off, but our boys are looking a little more… infested than usual. In this new variant of the Adversary system, hunt down Technocyte Coda in Höllvania once you've completed The Hex Quest.

Increase the virality of the boyband virus in Höllvania with Antivirus and Potency Mods until they're ready for a showdown on the big stage. Defeating your Technocyte Coda will reward you with guaranteed cosmetics, in addition to Live Heartcells to trade with Eleanor for Coda Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
线上时代的巡演已正式开始，但我们的男孩们看起来比平时更像是受到了……感染。完成《六人组》系列任务后，通过这个全新对手系统的变体，在霍瓦尼亚中追捕科技细胞终幕者。

使用杀毒和效价 Mod 来增加男子组合病毒在霍瓦尼亚的病毒性，直到他们准备好在更大的舞台上一决高下。击败你的科技细胞终幕者将必定获得自定义装饰，以及用于与埃莉诺交换终幕武器的活体心肌细胞。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
Techrot Encore comes with two game mode variants: Stage Defense and Temporal Archimedea.

It's Flare's time in the spotlight, and you must protect them from an onslaught of enemies in Stage Defense. This game mode benefits from the game-wide Defense mission change, reducing rotations from 5 to 3 waves. Earn Temple's Blueprints and learn the fate of Flare's bandmates in this new mission, accessible in 1999 once you reach Rank 4 in the Hex Syndicate. 

Visit Kaya in Höllvania Central Mall to dive into Temporal Archimedea —  Deep Archimedea set in Höllvania, with a twist. Equip Peely Pix to apply buffs to your Temporal Archimedea missions, and see what deviations and risk variables 1999 has in store. Unlock this content at Rank 5 in the Hex Syndicate
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
《科腐者安可》有两种游戏模式变体：舞台防御和时光科研。

现在是弗莱尔成为焦点的时候了，你必须在舞台防御中保护他们免受敌人的猛攻。随着全游戏范围内的防御任务变化，这个游戏模式的轮次也将从 5 波减少到 3 波。获取 Temple 的蓝图并了解弗莱尔乐队成员的命运。在 1999 中达到六人组集团声望等级 4 后即可游玩此新任务。 

访问霍瓦尼亚中央商场的卡娅以深入了解时光科研——位于霍瓦尼亚的深层科研，但略有不同。装备易撕贴纸以将加成应用在你的时光科研任务，并查看 1999 有哪些偏差和风险变量。六人组集团声望达到等级 5 即可解锁此内容

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
Exalted Weapons are receiving a refresh —  and Atlas, Gara, Khora, and Ash are getting their own Exalted Weapons to boot. While these changes are extensive, here's a brief overview of some core changes:

• Exalted Weapons can now equip Arcanes and a variety of previously unusable Mods 
• Exalted Melee earn capacity from their Stance Mods
• Exalted Blade and Serene Storm now build combo via their Ranged attacks
• Whipclaw, Shattered Lash, Bladestorm, and Landslide now have moddable Exalted Weapons that benefit from a unique Combo Counter

Beyond that, we've retouched Ash's kit to overall improve his effectiveness in-mission. For full details, check out our Update Notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
显赫武器得到了新改变——Atlas、Gara、Khora 和 Ash 也将获得自己的显赫武器。虽然这些改动的范围很广，但以下是一些核心改动的简要概述：

• 显赫武器现在可以装备赋能和各种以前无法使用的 Mod
• 显赫近战武器可以通过其架式 Mod 获得容量
• 显赫刀剑和宁静风暴现在可以通过其远程攻击积累连击
• 长鞭利爪、琉璃碎击、剑刃风暴和土石坍方现在拥有可配置 Mod 的显赫武器，可从独特的连击数中获益

除此之外，我们还重新设计了 Ash 的技能，以全面提高他在任务中的效率。有关完整详情，请查看我们的更新说明。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.text:
Amp up your fashion frame with the new Gyre Vortengeist Collection, or don community-made creations with TennoGen Encore featuring cosmetics made by fellow Tenno! Reach the height of Höllvania style with new Hairstyles and Suits for your Operator and Drifter.

Techrot Encore also brings new Warframe Augments, Arcanes, Scaldra Weapons, and much more.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHig.zhText:
通过全新的 Gyre 电涡幽灵组合包提升你的时尚炫甲，或通过来自玩家社区的 TennoGen 安可，穿上其中由 Tenno 同伴创作的自定义装饰！通过全新的发型和套服为你的指挥官和漂泊者达到霍瓦尼亚风格的巅峰。

《科腐者安可》还带来了新的战甲强化 Mod、赋能、炽蛇军武器等更多精彩内容。
其他激动人心的新内容

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHow.text: Complete The Hex quest to get the most out of Techrot Encore — including the Technocyte Coda, a new Adversary to take on in Höllvania! Additional game modes and vendors are revealed once you reach Rank 4 and 5 in the Hex Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateTechrotHow.zhText: 完成《六人组》系列任务，充分体验《科腐者安可》——包括科技细胞终幕者，这是霍瓦尼亚中要面对的新对手！在六人组集团声望中达到等级 4 和 5 后，即可解锁额外的游戏模式和商人。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindD.text:
Nef Anyo's influence has expanded beyond the Orb Vallis —  to its hidden depths. 

Explore the Deepmines, a new subterranean tileset, and safeguard this ecosystem from Corpus defilement.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindD.zhText:
奈富·安尤的势力已经扩散到奥布山谷之外——延伸到了其隐藏的地底深处。 

探索深矿，这是一个全新的地下场景，保护这个生态系统免受 Corpus 的污染。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text:
Spread decay and regeneration in equal measure with Nokko! This childlike trickster ensures fungus blooms in every environment.

Earn Nokko’s Blueprints by completing Deepmines Bounties or trading with Nightcap in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText:
通过 Nokko 来让腐朽与再生并行蔓延！这名天真无邪的骗子确保真菌在所有环境里都能繁盛。

完成深矿赏金任务或与福尔图娜的夜帽交易，即可获取 Nokko 的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text:
The Deepmines is a new tileset expanding beneath the surface of the Orb Vallis. Work with Nightcap, the spore-loving member of Solaris United, to take on new Deepmine Bounties and thwart Nef Anyo's plans.

Access to this content requires completion of The New War Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText:
深矿是奥布山谷地表之下扩展的全新地图场景。与热爱孢子的索拉里斯联盟成员夜帽合作，接受新的深矿赏金任务，挫败奈富·安尤的阴谋。

需要完成《新纪之战》系列任务才能游玩此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text:
Study is the first step towards mastery. The Teacher is a new tutorial Quest that introduces players to both the Modding System and to Teshin Dax. 

Learn the basics of Modding and earn the new Thornbak Rifle in this new quest, which can be accessed immediately after completing Vor’s Prize.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText:
精通之路，始于学习。《老师》是一个新的教学任务，它将向玩家介绍 Mod 系统和 Teshin 禁卫。 

完成《沃尔的战利品》后即可立即游玩这个全新的系列任务，让你学习 Mod 的基础知识，并获得全新的棘背步枪。
全新教程系列任务：《老师》

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text: Oberon, the honorable Paladin, has received a light rework! Featuring a brand new Passive and enhanced Abilities, he is capable of offering both support and destruction on the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText: 尊贵的圣骑士 Oberon 现已进行轻度重制！他拥有全新被动技能和加强过的技能，能够在战场上同时提供支援和毁灭的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text:
The Vallis Undermind is packed to the gills with new cosmetics —  bringing both the Wukong Qitian and Lavos Khymia Deluxe Skins. 

Flaunt community-made fashions with new TennoGen pieces in the TennoGen Undermind Collection, including our first TennoGen cosmetics for Qorvex, Citrine, and Dagath.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText:
《谷底之群智》充满了全新外观——其中包括 Wukong 齐天大圣和 Lavos 点金华丽外观。 

通过 TennoGen 谷底之群智中的全新 TennoGen 作品炫耀玩家社区创作的时尚品，其中包括我们为 Qorvex、Citrine 和 Dagath 设计的首款 TennoGen 外观。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text:
With this update, we’ve also slipped in a few Quality of Life changes, including:
• Damage Attenuation scaling changes, bringing a standardized Damage Attenuation to most bosses, which now scales better with enemy level.
• Improved Screen Shake and Recoil toggles
• Signas on Drifters
• Relighting in Relays and the Grineer Asteroid Tileset
• and more!

For more details, be sure to check the official patch notes.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText:
在此更新中，我们还进行了一些游戏体验改动，包括：
• 伤害抑制数值比例改动，为大多数 Boss 带来标准化的伤害抑制，现在可以随着敌人等级更好地调整。
• 改进的画面震动和后坐力切换
• 漂泊者上的头环
• 中继站和 Grineer 小行星场景的光照重制
• 以及更多内容！

有关更多详细信息，请务必查看官方更新说明。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.text: Access the Deepmines by visiting Nightcap in The Airlock —  his secret hideout in the bowels of Fortuna! The Airlock becomes available after completing The New War Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateUndermindH.zhText: 拜访气密舱里的夜帽，进入深矿井——那是他在福尔图娜深处的秘密藏身之处！完成《新纪之战》系列任务后即可进入气密舱。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersDe.text:
Uncover mysteries left behind by the brilliant Albrecht Entrati. What exactly is the encroaching Indifference... and what are the Vessels that Albrecht created?

Once you have conquered the New War, open your Codex and select 'Whispers in the Walls' to begin Warframe's next chapter.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersDe.zhText:
揭开才华横溢的阿尔布雷希特·英择谛所遗留的秘辛。那逐渐侵袭的虚空无情之物到底是何种奥秘……他所打造的承载体又蕴含着怎样的秘密？

在你征服了《新纪之战》系列任务后，在资料库中选择《墙中低语》，来开启 Warframe 全新篇章的序幕。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: This brutalist, concrete-like Warframe features a unique design courtesy of Albrecht Entrati. Created to serve as a bulwark against terrifying forces, Qorvex functions as a new guardian to the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: 这个粗犷的且如混凝土般坚固的战甲，展现了阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的独特设计。Qorvex 作为抵御恐怖力量的壁垒而被创造，并作为 Tenno 的新守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: Warframe's next narrative chapter, Whispers in the Walls, is now available! Deep within the Necralisk, a dormant precept known as The Kalymos Sequence has been activated. Return to Deimos and investigate Albrecht's hidden, subterranean laboratory for any clues he may have left behind.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: Warframe 的下个叙事篇章《墙中低语》现已推出！在殁世幽都的深处，一个名为"卡利莫斯数列"的潜在指令已被激活。你必须回到火卫二，探查阿尔布雷希特隐藏的地下实验室，寻找他可能留下的任何线索。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: Recall the ancient art of Tennokai with new Tennokai Mods for your Melee Weapons. Make the most out of your Heavy attacks when Tennokai Procs — properly timed blows will unleash a Tennokai Heavy Attack, costing no combo counter and offering a faster wind-up speed.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: 通过全新的近战 Tenno 气解 Mod 来唤醒古技。当 Tenno 气解效果启动时，在精准的时机释放 Tenno 气解重击来发挥它的极致威力——不消耗连击数且拥有更快的蓄力时间。
精通 Tenno 气解战技

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: Introducing a new Secondary Weapon Type: Tomes! Earn your very own Tome weapon — the Grimoire — upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest. Equip specialized Tome Mods on this new weapon type to enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: 正式引入全新类型的次要武器——典籍！在完成《墙中低语》系列任务后，即可获取你的专属典籍武器——魔典。为该类型的武器装备上专属的典籍 Mod，以增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: EMBRACE THE POWER OF THE TOME

Unlock Melee Arcanes and Melee Exilus with the new Melee Upgrade Segment, earned upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest! Enhance your Melee combat with Arcanes acquired via the new Netracells mission on Deimos, or via the new Cavia Syndicate in Sanctum Anatomica.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: 完成《墙中低语》系列任务，来获取全新的近战升级模组，并借此解锁近战武器赋能与特殊功能槽！在火卫二的衰退室任务中，或是通过解剖圣所内科维兽团的声望获取近战武器赋能，从而全面提升你的近战技巧。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.text: Reveal new permanent bonuses for your Warframes with Violet, Topaz, and Emerald Archon Shards. Your existing Archon Shards can be fused to create new possibilities, using the Coalescent Fusion system available upon completion of the Whispers in the Walls Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHi.zhText: 通过紫晶、黄玉和翡翠执刑官源力石，来为你的战甲揭开全新的永久加成效果。完成《墙中低语》系列任务即可通过联结融合系统，来融合你现有的执刑官源力石，并创造全新的可能。

/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHo.text: Players must have completed The New War to access the Whispers in the Walls Quest. Once unlocked, visit your Codex to embark on Warframe's next chapter.
/Lotus/Language/Updates/UpdateWhispersHo.zhText: 玩家必须完成《新纪之战》才能开启《墙中低语》系列任务。解锁该任务后，请进入资料库来开启 Warframe 的下一篇章。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text:
Break Narmer missions rotate based on your personal progress in the following order;
Sneaky Sabotage, Junk Run, Prison Break. The current active mission persists each week until its objectives are completed and you extract, at which point the next mission will become available at the weekly reset.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 击溃合一众任务根据你的个人进度按以下顺序轮换；隐蔽破坏、垃圾回收、越狱。当前可进行的任务每周都会持续直到目标完成并且你成功撤离，此时下一个任务将在每周重置时出现。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: The Break Narmer mission of the week can be replayed as many times as needed to complete its challenges.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 每周的击溃合一众任务可以根据需要多次游玩以完成其挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: Progress on Break Narmer challenges persist between mission runs! Challenge progress can be checked in the “View Mission Progress” screen in-mission or by visiting Kahl in Kahl's Garrison.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 击溃合一众挑战的进度在任务之间持续存在！挑战进度可以在任务中的“查看任务进度”中查看，也可以通过到卡尔驻军访问卡尔查看。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: Narmer Deacons are invulnerable to regular attacks but can be stunned with Kahl's Veilbreaker ability.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 合一众执事对一般进攻是无敌的，但是可以被卡尔的破障者技能击晕。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: Veilbreaking can be done by Tapping or Holding the context action. You can change your preference in the Accessibility category of your Settings menu.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 破障可以通过轻按或按住场景互动来完成。你可以在设置菜单的"无障碍功能"分类中更改你的偏好。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: Somachord Tones can be found throughout Break Narmer missions. Interact with them to unlock new songs for the Somachord in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 身心和弦琴可以在合一众任务中找到。与它们互动来为你轨道飞行器中的身心和弦琴解锁新的歌曲。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.text: Your Rank within Kahl's Garrison increases with every Break Narmer mission you complete, up to the max rank of Home (Rank 5).
/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionBrief.zhText: 你在卡尔驻军中的等级会随着你完成的每个击溃合一众的任务而提高，最高等级为"家园"（等级5）。

/Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/MissionObjec.zhText: 为兄弟们的苦难划上句号

/Lotus/Language/VoidEclipse/EclipseVoidW.text:
A unique variant of Thrax Plasm harvested during Void Conjunctions on Lua.

Location: Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua
/Lotus/Language/VoidEclipse/EclipseVoidW.zhText:
一种独特的凶魂浆质变体，可在月球上的虚空联结期间收获。

获取地点：月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus

/Lotus/Language/VoidEclipse/LuasPreyInbo.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Lua has felt my touch as I have felt its in return. Rescuing Lua - and you - from the Void may be changing this place. The Void stirs and shakes Lua to its core… exposing ancient halls long since abandoned. 

Smelling possible treasure, the Grineer Worm Queen ordered her troops to descend upon these newly exposed halls. They were instantly Corrupted by its long dormant Orokin Neural Sentry. 

The secrets that lie buried here are yours, not theirs. 

Infiltrate the Yuvarium and Circulus, survive the Corrupted and we will reclaim those secrets together.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/VoidEclipse/LuasPreyInbo.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

月球感受到了我的触摸，就像我也感受到了它的气息。从虚空中拯救月球……和你，可能会彻底改变这个地方。虚空搅动着月球的核心……那些早已废弃的古老大厅也因此重见天日。

Grineer 蠕虫女皇嗅到了此地潜藏的宝藏，并命令她的军队很快到达了这些重现的大厅，却立即被在此休眠已久的奥罗金神经哨卫堕化了。

埋藏在这里的秘密是属于你的，而不是他们。

潜入 Yuvarium 和 Circulus，躲过堕落者的杀戮，我们将一起夺回这些秘密。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/NovaRec.zhText: 击败欧罗巴 Naamah 节点上的猛禽，可以获得 Nova 的部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/NyxReci.text: Blueprints for Nyx's components are acquired by defeating Phorid in Infested Invasion Assassination Missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/NyxReci.zhText: 在 Infested 入侵刺杀任务中击败 Phorid 可以获得 Nyx 的部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/OberonR.text: Blueprints for Oberon's components are acquired by completing Points of Interest in Grineer Railjack missions in the Earth and Saturn Proximas.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/OberonR.zhText: 通过完成地球和土星比邻星域的 Grineer 航道星舰任务中的兴趣点，可以获得 Oberon 的部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/RhinoRe.text: Blueprints for Rhino's components are acquired by defeating Jackal on Fossa (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/RhinoRe.zhText: 在金星的 Fossa 节点击败豺狼，来获得 Rhino 组件的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/SarynRe.text: Blueprints for Saryn's components are acquired by defeating Kela de Thaym on Merrow (Sedna) once acquiring enough Judgement Points via Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/SarynRe.zhText: 通过死亡角斗场获得足够的裁定点数后，到赛德娜的 Merrow 节点击败凯拉·德塞姆就可以获得 Saryn 的组件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Sevagot.text: Sevagoth's main blueprint is awarded from the Call of the Tempestarii Quest. Component blueprints can be found via Void Storms in Neptune, Pluto, and Veil Proxima Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Sevagot.zhText: Sevagoth 的战甲蓝图可以通过完成《风暴的呼唤》系列任务获得。其部件蓝图可以在海王星、冥王星和面纱比邻星域航道星舰任务中的虚空风暴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/TempleR.text: Blueprints for Temple's components can be acquired from Stage Defense missions in 1999 or bought from Flare in the Mall using Beating Heartstrings.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/TempleR.zhText: 你可以从 1999 舞台防御任务中获得 Temple 组件的蓝图，也可以使用律动心弦从商场的弗莱尔处购买。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Trinity.text: Blueprints for Trinity's components are acquired by defeating the Ambulas on Hades (Pluto). Unlock this mission via Animo Nav Beacons earned from defeating Ambulas enemies spawned in Pluto missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Trinity.zhText: Trinity 的组件蓝图可以通过击败冥王星 Hades 节点的智踱恐鸟获得。击败冥王星任务中生成的敌人可获得 Animo 导航信标来解锁这个任务。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/ValkyrR.text: Blueprints for Valkyr's components are acquired by defeating Alad V on Themisto (Jupiter).
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/ValkyrR.zhText: Valkyr 的组件可以通过到木星的 Themisto 节点击败阿拉德 V 获得。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/VaubanR.text: Blueprints for Vauban's components are acquired from Nightwave Offerings in exchange for Nightwave Creds.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/VaubanR.zhText: Vauban 的组件蓝图可以通过午夜电波贡品兑换午夜电波货币获得。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/VoltRec.text: Volt's main and component blueprints can be researched via the Tenno Lab Dojo Room in a Clan.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/VoltRec.zhText: Volt 的战甲和部件蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的 Tenno 实验室研究。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WraithR.text: Component blueprints can be found in Neptune, Pluto and Veil Void Storms.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WraithR.zhText: 部件蓝图可以在海王星、冥王星，以及面纱虚空风暴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WraithS.text: Weapon and component blueprints can be found in Earth, Venus and Saturn Void Storms.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WraithS.zhText: 武器和部件蓝图可以在地球、金星，以及土星虚空风暴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WukongR.text: Wukong's main and component blueprints can be researched via the Tenno Lab Dojo Room in a Clan.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/WukongR.zhText: Wukong 的战甲和部件蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的 Tenno 实验室研究。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Zephyer.text: Zephyr's main and component blueprints can be researched via the Tenno Lab Dojo Room in a Clan.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Zephyer.zhText: Zephyr 的战甲和部件蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的 Tenno 实验室研究。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Elemental Damage types can be combined and imbued into Lavos’ abilities in two ways: Hold two abilities together, or hold a single ability and then another to create the desired combined Elemental Damage type.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 元素伤害类型可以通过两种方式来组合并注入到 Lavos 的技能中。把两个技能结合在一起，或是先用一个技能，再用另一个技能来创造所需的组合元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Clear the current imbued Elemental Damage type by casting any of Lavos' abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 通过施放 Lavos 的任意一个技能来清除当前注入的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Recasting Transmutation Probe as it is moving will pause the Probe in place.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 在「炼制探头」移动时重新施放该技能将使探头停在原处。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Since Lavos does not require Energy, Ability Efficiency mods only change the effectiveness of Transmutation Probe's cooldown reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 由于 Lavos 不需要能量，所以技能效率 Mod 只会影响「炼制探头」冷却时间缩短的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Catalyze's damage is doubled for each unique Status Effect applied to the target. Take advantage of Catalyze's exponential damage scaling by teaming up with Warframes like Saryn or Ember.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 应用于目标的每个独特异常状态都会使「催化刺激」的伤害加倍。通过与 Saryn 或 Ember 这样的战甲组队，来充分利用「催化刺激」急剧增长的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: All of Lavos' abilities can deal two Status Effects at once: the base element tied to the  ability itself, as well as whatever element you choose to imbue.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: Lavos 的所有技能都可以同时造成两种异常状态：与技能本身相关的基础元素，以及你选择注入的任意元素。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Imbued elements are added on top of the base ability, doubling the damage. It is always better to imbue an element before casting your abilities!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 注入的元素被增加到基础技能之上，使伤害翻倍。在施放技能之前先注入一个元素准没错！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Non-damaging Status Effects will apply multiple stacks at once when imbued into Lavos' abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 非伤害性的异常状态在注入到 Lavos 的技能后，将会同时施加多个叠加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Increased Ability Duration will also increase the Duration of Status Effects caused by Lavos' abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 增加技能持续时间也将增加 Lavos 技能造成的异常状态的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Combined with his high Armor stat, Ophidian Bite makes Lavos a tough Warframe to kill. The healing scales based on total damage dealt, so try to hit multiple enemies at once.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 与他的高护甲数值相结合，「毒蛇之咬」使 Lavos 成为一个难以被击杀的战甲。治疗效果取决于所造成的总伤害，所以尽量一次击中多个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Vial Rush can be interrupted by casting the ability again or by jumping.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 「药瓶冲撞」可通过再次施放技能或跳跃来被打断。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: The number of Vial Rush charges is affected by Range mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 「药瓶冲撞」的药瓶投掷数量受到技能范围 Mod 影响。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.text: Effective use of Lavos’ abilities requires mastery of Transmutation Probe. Cast into a group once all abilities are on cooldown for greatest effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Alchemist_.zhText: 有效使用 Lavos 的技能需要精通「炼制探头」。在群体中施放，可以在所有技能都处于冷却状态时获得最佳效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Nova's passive applies to all slow effects, not just Molecular Prime. Pair her with weapons that inflict <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effects or other Warframes that slow enemies to maximize the benefits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: Nova 的被动技能适用于所有减速效果，不仅限于「分子填充」。将她与能造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态的武器或其他能减速敌人的战甲搭配，以最大限度地发挥其优势。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Null Star grants a slight Damage Reduction to Nova for each antimatter particle orbiting her. Increase the number of Null Stars with Ability Duration for more Damage Reduction!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 每个由「湮灭流星群」产生并围绕她旋转反物质粒子，能给予 Nova 生命值些微的伤害减免。提升技能持续时间以增加「湮灭流星群」的数量，并获得更高的伤害减免！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Killing enemies Primed by Molecular Prime has a 20% chance to inflict <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast Status Effects on nearby foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 击杀被「分子填充」影响的敌人时，有 20% 的几率对附近的敌人造成 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Null Star can recast while active to refresh the number of antimatter particles, which helps maintain high Damage Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 「湮灭流星群」可以在激活期间重新施放，以刷新反物质粒子的数量，从而有助于保持较高的伤害减免。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Null Star's Damage Reduction can be prolonged with low Ability Range and maintaining a safe distance from enemies to keep the particles orbiting Nova.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 通过降低技能范围并与敌人保持安全距离以保持粒子围绕 Nova 旋转，从而延长「湮灭流星群」的伤害减免。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Nova and allies can shoot Antimatter Drop's orb to increase its detonation damage. Directing Antimatter Drop through a Wormhole also partially charges the detonation.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: Nova 和友军可以通过攻击「反物质释放」的球体，进而增加其引爆的伤害。引导「反物质释放」穿过虫洞也可以部分地增加爆炸威力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Antimatter Drop will travel quickly to its target once it is fully charged, or if the ability is cast again while in flight.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 「反物质释放」一旦充能完毕或是在飞行时再次施放该技能，球体就会快速移动到目标处。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Guide Antimatter Drop away from objects it can collide with until it has been charged with gunfire, then drop into a crowd for a devastating impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 引导「反物质释放」的球体远离可能会碰撞到的物体，直到对其开火蓄满为止，再将球体投入人群中造成毁灭性的撞击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Wormhole is great for closing both horizontal and vertical distance. Consider casting upwards and jumping to gain elevation quickly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 「虫洞」非常适合快速缩短水平和垂直距离。可以考虑向上施放并跳跃，以快速提升高度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Consider the combat situation when casting Molecular Prime. Slow enemies when you are overwhelmed, and speed them up when you want to kill more enemies quickly (but be aware that their attacks are sped up as well!)
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 施放「分子填充」时要考虑战斗情况。当你被敌人压制时减缓他们速度，当你想快速击杀更多敌人时加快他们的速度（但请注意，他们的攻击速度也会加快！）

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.text: Increase the distance that Molecular Prime's wave travels with Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/AntiMatter.zhText: 用持续时间 Mod 来增加「分子填充」技能波的可传递距离。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Appearance.text: Look Link does not apply sigils.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Appearance.zhText: 造型链接不包含纹章配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_0.text: The Arsenal is used to equip, mod, and customize Warframes, Weapons, Companions, Gear, and more to prepare for your next mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_0.zhText: 军械库可以用来配置装备、Mod 以及自定义战甲、武器、同伴、携带装备，和更多物品以助你进行下一场任务。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_1.text: Select the Loadout name at the top left of your Arsenal options to switch between your preset Loadouts. These can be updated at any time and additional Loadout Slots can be purchased for Platinum.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_1.zhText: 在军械库左上角的"选项"处选择配置名称来切换预设配置。你可以随时更新这些配置，并通过白金购买来添加新的配置槽位。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_2.text: The Upgrade option allows you to equip Mods, which increases your equipment's power. Multiple Configuration tabs are available at the top to save your various Mod combinations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_2.zhText: "升级"选项可以供你装备 Mod 从而提升你装备的力量。顶部的多个"配置"选项也可以供你保存不同的 Mod 搭配。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_3.text: The Appearance option allows total visual customization on any equipment, including color changes, equipping skins, attachments, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_3.zhText: 可以通过"外观"选项对任何装备做全面的视觉定制，可进行的操作包括改变颜色、装备外观、配件，以及更多精彩物品。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_4.text: You can zoom in and out while customizing your Warframe’s Appearance to get a closer look at the details.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_4.zhText: 你可以在自定义战甲外观时通过放大和缩小来更仔细地查看外观上的细节。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_5.text: In the Appearance menu, using the Randomize button in the bottom right will mix and match colors, attachments, and more!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_5.zhText: 在外观菜单中，使用右下角的随机按钮来混搭色彩、配件，和其他物品！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_6.text: In the Appearance menu, the camera icon at the top-right opens Captura. You can take screenshots and videos using various camera tools, scenes, lighting, and more to create your masterpiece.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_6.zhText: 在"外观"菜单中，点击右上角的相机图标来打开 Captura 摄影棚。你可以使用各种相机工具、场景、灯光效果等物品来获取截屏和录制视频来创作出你的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_7.text: In the Appearance menu, the Look Link button in the top right allows you to share your customization as a chat message for others to enjoy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_7.zhText: 在"外观"菜单中，点击右上角的"造型链接"按钮可让你把自定义的装扮通过聊天频道分享给他人欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_8.text: The Parazon is a special blade used by Warframes for hacking, Mercy kills against weakened enemies, and the Adversaries system. It can be upgraded and customized in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_8.zhText: 灭骸之刃是战甲用于入侵、对被削弱的敌人和对手施展怜悯之击的特殊刀刃。它可以在军械库中进行升级和自定义。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_9.text: Different Arsenal categories are unlocked as you earn Companions and Vehicles for your journey.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Arsenal_9.zhText: 当你在旅程中获得了同伴和载具后，也会解锁相应的军械库类别。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_0.text: Banshee's passive suppresses all of hers and her Robotic Companions' weapons, offering a unique advantage in stealth situations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_0.zhText: Banshee 的被动技能可以降低自身与其机械守护的武器声响，在隐匿的状况下提供独特优势。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_1.text: Sonic Boom pushes enemies and inflicts <DT_IMPACT_COLOR> Impact Status Effect. Use this to unbalance important targets such as Disruption Demolishers to save precious time!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_1.zhText: 「音爆」会击退敌人并造成 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态。利用这一效果扰乱例如中断爆破型敌人等重要目标的平衡，从而节省宝贵时间！
