/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_2.text: Sonic Boom's guaranteed <DT_IMPACT_COLOR> Impact Status Effect can also make priority targets more vulnerable to Mercy kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_2.zhText: 「音爆」必定造成的 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态也会使优先目标更容易受到怜悯之击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_3.text: Highlighted weak points from recasting Sonar can overlap, increasing the Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_3.zhText: 「声纳」所暴露出的弱点可以叠加，并提升伤害倍率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_4.text: Weak points created by Sonar are treated the same as regular enemy weak points, meaning they can charge Incarnon weapons, and trigger other abilities related to weak points. Weapons can also be modded for additional weak point damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_4.zhText: 「声纳」生成的弱点与普通敌人的弱点相同，意味着它们可以为灵化武器充能，并触发其他与弱点相关的技能。通过为武器装备 Mod 对弱点造成额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_5.text: Enemies stunned by Silence are affected by the Stealth bonus for the duration of the stun!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_5.zhText: 被「静音」震晕的敌人其晕眩时间会受隐秘加成的影响！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_6.text: Recasting Silence while active will stun enemies who are already in range of the effect, while also resetting the ability's duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_6.zhText: 「静音」激活期间重新施放会使效果范围内的敌人再次眩晕，同时重置技能持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_7.text: Sound Quake continuously stuns enemies, providing excellent crowd control on a specific area you want to defend.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_7.zhText: 「音波冲击」能持续眩晕敌人，在你想要防御的特定区域提供出色的群体控制。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_8.text: Recasting Sound Quake will reset the duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Banshee_8.zhText: 重新施放「音波冲击」将重置持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_0.text: Customize Octavia's music using the Mandachord! Find it in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_0.zhText: 用曼达和弦琴来自定义 Octavia 的音乐吧！可在军械库找到。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_1.text: Share Mandachord songs with other players by linking the title in chat!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_1.zhText: 通过在聊天对话中链接标题便可与其他玩家分享曼达和弦琴歌曲！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_2.text: Change up Octavia's sound by choosing themed instrument packs in the Mandachord Instruments selection window.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_2.zhText: 通过在乐器曼达和弦琴选择窗口中选择主题乐器包来改变 Octavia 的声音。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_3.text: Mallet plays the Percussion track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_3.zhText: 「槌音铮鏦」会播放所选曼达和弦琴歌曲中的打击乐曲目。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_4.text: Resonator plays the Bass track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_4.zhText: 「共鸣渲染」会播放所选曼达和弦琴歌曲中的低音曲目。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_5.text: Metronome plays the Melody track from the Mandachord song picked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_5.zhText: 「谐韵节拍」会播放所选曼达和弦琴歌曲中的旋律曲目。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_6.text: Metronome buffs are much easier to maintain with a high Duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_6.zhText: 「谐韵节拍」增益在高的持续时间更容易保持。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_7.text: Metronome passively grants an Armor bonus to all allies in the radius of its aura and scales with Ability Strength Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_7.zhText: 「谐韵节拍」被动地为其光环范围内的所有友军提供额外护甲，并使用技能强度 Mod 来决定其功效高低。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_8.text: The damage and effect buildup of Octavia's abilities are influenced by the number of notes per measure on the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_8.zhText: Octavia 的技能伤害和效果累积受每个在曼达和弦琴上每个小节的音符数量影响

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_9.text: Cast Mallet in the path of approaching enemies to ensure they attack it first.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Bard_9.zhText: 对逼近的敌人必经之路中施放「槌音铮鏦」，确保他们优先攻击它。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Valkyr is immune to heavy landings, meaning there is no delay when landing on the ground from great heights.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: Valkyr 能免疫硬着陆效果。这意味着，即便从高处坠落，她在落地时也不会产生任何硬直。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Perform frequent Melee Attacks to keep Valkyr's Rage Meter from decreasing.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 频繁进行近战攻击以防止 Valkyr 的狂怒值减少。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Temporarily deactivate Hysteria by switching to Valkyr's Primary or Secondary weapon. Reactivate it by attacking with Valkyr's Talons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 通过切换 Valkyr 的主要或次要武器暂时停用「狂化爆发」。以她的利爪攻击来重新启用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Finisher Kills grant a greater increase to the Rage Meter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 处决击杀可以更大幅度地增加狂怒值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Cast Rip Line in quick succession to increase its damage and greatly reduce its Energy cost after each successful cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 在施展了「撕裂钩索」技能后，若在短时间内再次施展该技能，即可提升其伤害并降低能量消耗。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Use Rip Line strategically by using Melee Attacks to cancel the pull while maintaining momentum, or jump for a speed boost.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 策略性地使用「撕裂钩索」，通过近战攻击来取消拉动同时保持动能，或者通过跳跃来提高速度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Warcry affects all allies that are within the Shared Affinity Radius. Use the Player List to see who is within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 「咆哮」作用范围仅限于经验范围内的队友。利用玩家列表查看在范围内的玩家决定施放时机。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Warcry also applies to friendly NPCs, such as rescue targets and specters.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 「咆哮」可以对诸如救援目标和魅影这样的友军 NPC 生效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Warcry grants significantly more Armor while Hysteria is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 当「狂化爆发」激活时「咆哮」会提供更多的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: The stagger from Paralysis briefly opens enemies to Melee Finishers, allowing a faster increase of Valkyr's Rage Meter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: 「瘫痪」造成的失衡会短暂地使敌人可被近战处决，从而使 Valkyr 能够更快地积攒狂怒。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.text: Valkyr's Hysteria Talons can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Berserker_.zhText: Valkyr 的「狂化爆发」技能所产生出的双爪可以在军械库中作为独立武器来配置 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_0.text: Atlas is immune to damage during Landslide attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_0.zhText: Atlas 使用「土石坍方」技能攻击时是免疫伤害的。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_1.text: Land successful Landslide punches back to back to deal more damage to the next enemy and send them flying on every third punch in the chain!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_1.zhText: 使用「土石坍方」技能时重复打击敌人会造成更多的伤害，并会在连击到第三拳时将他们打飞到空中！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_2.text: Petrified enemies drop Rubble when killed that can restore Atlas' Health on pickup or increase his Armor if Health is full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_2.zhText: 石化的敌人在被击杀时会掉落碎石，在拾取碎石时能够恢复 Atlas 的血量或如果处于满血状态时则会提升他的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_3.text: Landslide's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it, as well as the Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_3.zhText: 「土石坍方」的伤害增幅基于技能武器所装备的 Mod 以及 Altas 的技能连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_4.text: Petrified enemies killed by Landslide drop Rubble that restore more Health and Armor than the average drops.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_4.zhText: 石化的敌人被「土石坍方」技能击杀时掉落的碎石相比平常的掉落能够恢复更多的血量和护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_5.text: Bulwarks summoned by Tectonics can be used to block doors, pathways, and even protect objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_5.zhText: 由「大地构筑」技能制造的壁垒能够用于挡住门，通道和要保护的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_6.text: Aiming Petrify at Atlas' Rumblers instantly heals them back to Max Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_6.zhText: 用「石化凝视」技能瞄准 Atlas 的石者能够立刻治疗他们恢复到满血状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_7.text: Aiming Petrify at Atlas' Bulwarks increases their rolling Speed, Distance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_7.zhText: 用「石化凝视」技能瞄准 Atlas 的壁垒会提升他们的滚动速度，距离和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_8.text: Recast Rumblers to detonate Atlas' brawlers, deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage to nearby enemies, and create Rubble.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_8.zhText: 重新施放「漫步石者」技能会引爆 Atlas 的石头人，对附近敌人造成 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害并制造碎石。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_9.text: Rumblers' brawlers durability is influenced by Atlas' Health, Shields, Armor, and Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Brawler_9.zhText: 「漫步石者」中的石头人的耐久度是受到 Atlas 的生命值，护盾，护甲和技能强度影响的。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Xaku is the only Warframe that can deal <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage, which makes them effective against Sentient enemies with the exception of Eidolons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: Xaku 是唯一能够造成 <DT_RADIANT>虚空伤害的战甲，使其可以有效对付除了夜灵以外的 Sentient 敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Xata's Whisper can be recast at any time to refresh the duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 可以随时施放「真理密语」来刷新持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Xaku's passive increases to 75% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to evade projectile, hitscan, and Melee Attacks while The Vast Untime is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: Xaku 的被动技能可在其受到范围攻击时，提供 75% 的伤害减免；并有几率在「超维炼狱」处于激活状态时，躲避来袭的投射物、即时命中类和近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Cast Xata's Whisper to devastate enemies hit by The Vast Untime who are now more susceptible to <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 施放「真理密语」来毁灭被「超维炼狱」击中后的敌人，现在他们更容易受到 <DT_RADIANT>虚空伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Grasp of Lohk can be recast up to the max number of targets to add to the batch of active stolen weapons. Each weapon has its own independent duration from those that were stolen in a separate cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 在可被影响的目标达到最大数量前，可以重新施放「虚空之握」，来增加同一批次被偷取的有效武器的数量。根据被偷取时间的不同，每件武器都有自己独立的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Accuse can be recast up to the max number of affected targets to add to the current batch of corrupted enemies. Each corrupted enemy has its own independent duration from those that were corrupted in a separate cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 在被影响的目标达到最大数量前，可以重新施放「指责」，来增加当前同一批次堕落的敌人的数量。根据堕落时间的不同，每个堕落的敌人都有自己独立的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Cast Xata's Whisper while fighting Sentient enemies to clear any damage resistances they have developed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 在对抗 Sentient 敌人时，施放「真理密语」可以消除它们的已堆叠伤害抗性。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage's Status Effect creates a field around enemies that absorbs and redirects all projectiles back onto the target. Projectiles are redirected to the specific area on the target where the Status Effect occurred. Use weapons with high Status Chance to increase the effect while Xata's Whisper is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: <DT_RADIANT>虚空伤害的异常状态会在敌人周围创造一个力场，该力场可吸收并将所有的投射物重新引导到目标身上。投射物会被重新引导到出现异常状态的目标所在的特定区域。在「真理密语」处于激活状态时，使用高触发几率的武器可提升该效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Enemies that have had their ranged weapons stolen by Grasp of Lohk will resort to melee attacking.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 被「虚空之握」偷走远程武器的敌人，将不得不转为近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Casting Grasp of Lohk on enemies that do not have weapons will manifest Void entity objects to attack with Xaku.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 向没有武器的敌人施放「虚空之握」将会召出虚空体武器来与 Xaku 一同攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: The amount of targets that can be affected by Accuse is increased by Ability Strength mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 可使用技能强度 Mod，来增加受「指责」影响的目标数量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Enemies who enter the radius of enemies locked in place by Gaze have their Armor and Shields reduced. At 100% Defense Reduction, they are stripped completely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 进入被「凝视」困住的目标范围内的敌人将会受到护甲或护盾减免。在 100% 防御减免下，护甲或护盾会完全剥离。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: Enemies that survive Deny’s Void beam attack are suspended in the air for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 从「否认」的虚空光束攻击中存活下来的敌人，会被悬停在空中一段时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.text: The Vast Untime can be recast at any time to bring Xaku back together.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/BrokenFram.zhText: 可以随时施放「超维炼狱」来将 Xaku 重新组合在一起。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_0.text: Enemies with Judgments take additional damage. Judgments can be applied by Light's Judgment and your primary fire during Glory on High.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_0.zhText: 受到"审判"的敌人受到额外伤害。"审判"可以通过在「至高荣耀」激活期间施放「圣光审判」和使用主要射击施加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_1.text: Aim Light's Judgment at large groups or chokepoints to maximize the amount of Judgments being applied.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_1.zhText: 将「圣光审判」瞄准大批的敌人或是阻塞点，以最大限度地增多所施加的"审判"。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_10.text: Judgments can be detonated by using Glory on High alternate-fire and that detonation is stronger when the enemies are within Light's Judgment radius. This also includes Judgments applied by other Jade squadmates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_10.zhText: "审判"可以通过「至高荣耀」的次要射击引爆，当敌人处于「圣光审判」范围内，爆炸威力将更强。这也包括 Jade 小队的其他成员施加的"审判"。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_2.text: Symphony of Mercy can be maintained by killing enemies affected by Judgments. Make use of Jade's abilities to spread the Judgments far and wide!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_2.zhText: 击杀受到"审判"的敌人可以保持「慈悲乐章」。确保利用好 Jade 的技能将"审判"传播得更远更广！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_3.text: Defeating enemies with Judgments will increase the duration of Jade's current Symphony of Mercy aura, regardless of who gets the kill.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_3.zhText: 击败受到"审判"的敌人将增加 Jade 当前「慈悲乐章」光环的持续时间，无论谁击杀敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_4.text: Symphony of Mercy auras are applied to squadmates currently within Shared Affinity Range. Use the Player List to see who is currently within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_4.zhText: 「慈悲乐章」光环适用于当前经验共享范围内的友军。可通过玩家列表来查看哪些玩家目前正处于范围内。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_5.text: Jade’s current Symphony of Mercy aura can be switched while the ability is active, depending on her squad’s current needs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_5.zhText: Jade 的「慈悲乐章」光环可以在技能激活时根据她的小队目前需求进行切换。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_6.text: Enemies leaving the effects of Ophanim Eyes will gradually recover their movement speed, but will not recover their Shield or Armor. They will also suffer a <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effect when their Armor or Shield breaks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_6.zhText: 「座天使之眼」效果消除的敌人会逐渐恢复移动速度，但不会恢复护盾或护甲。当他们的护甲或护盾被破坏时，他们还会触发 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_7.text: Ophanim Eyes can revive multiple allies at once, even at long distances.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_7.zhText: 「座天使之眼」即使在远距离也可以同时复活多名友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_8.text: Tap to recast Ophanim Eyes while the ability is active to refresh the duration, or hold to cancel the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_8.zhText: 当技能激活时，轻按可以重新施放「座天使之眼」以刷新持续时间，或者长按可以取消该技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_9.text: All of Jade's other abilities can be used while in flight during Glory on High. Her elevated position makes it much easier to spread Light's Judgment and affect enemies with Ophanim Eyes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Choir_9.zhText: Jade 的所有其他技能都可以在「至高荣耀」的飞行中施放。她的空中位置使她更容易传播「圣光审判」并对敌人施加「座天使之眼」的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Prioritize upgrading Qorvex's exceptionally high Health and Armor stats to maximize his rigid defenses.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 优先升级 Qorvex 极高的生命值和护甲值，最大限度地提高他森严的防御力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Take advantage of Qorvex's passive by equipping weapons that don't already have innate Punch Through. Consider single target weapons to tear through groups of enemies in one shot!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 通过装备未自带穿透的武器来充分发挥 Qorvex 的被动技能。可以考虑使用针对单个目标的武器来一枪贯穿多个敌人！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Chyrinka Pillars will become Empowered after using Containment Wall or Crucible Blast on the pillar, pulsing faster and spreading more <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Damage and Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 对柱体使用「核控壁垒」或「堆芯迸发」后，「辐射柱体」会被强化，脉冲更快并传播更多 <DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害和异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Chyrinka Pillar pulses do not travel through walls. Deploy in open areas for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 「辐射柱体」的脉冲不会穿过墙壁。在开放区域部署该技能以获得最大效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Containment Wall gathers enemies in a long line, making it most effective in corridors and narrow spaces. Utilize the additional Punch Through from Qorvex’s passive to clear out targets after casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 「核控壁垒」可将敌人聚集成一长排，因此在走廊和狭窄空间中最有效。利用 Qorvex 被动技能附带的额外穿透效果在施放后清除目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Disometric Guard immediately removes Status Effects from Allies within Affinity Range on cast, as well as preventing future Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 施放「辐量防护」会立即消除经验共享范围内友军身上的异常效果，并防止后续触发异常效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: On cast, Disometric Guard can knockdown and apply <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Status Effect to enemies within a small area around Qorvex.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 施放时，「 辐量防护」可击倒 Qorvex 周围小范围内的敌人，并对他们施加 <DT_RADIATION>辐射异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Crucible Blast grants invulnerability while casting, making it great for emergencies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 施放「堆芯迸发」时可获得无敌状态，非常适合紧急情况。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.text: Spread <DT_RADIATION>Radiation using weapons, Chyrinka Pillars or Containment Walls to increase Disometric Guard's stacks and Crucible Blast's explosive volatility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ConcreteFr.zhText: 使用武器散播 <DT_RADIATION>辐射异常状态。施放「辐射柱体」或「核控壁垒」，来增加「辐量防护」的叠加层数和「堆芯迸发」的易爆性。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_0.text: Cast Ballistic Battery before entering Peacemaker to store Mesa's Regulators damage and recast to release it all into a single shot.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_0.zhText: 进入「和平使者」之前施放「弹道蓄能」来储存 Mesa 的监察者双枪伤害并重新施放来将所有伤害注入并释发在一颗子弹内。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_1.text: Shooting Gallery not only jams guns from nearby enemies but also temporarily stuns Melee units!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_1.zhText: 「靶场」不仅会干扰附近敌人的枪械，也会短暂的震晕近战单位！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_2.text: In addition to reducing the damage from enemy fire, Shatter Shield also reflects Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_2.zhText: 除了减低来自敌人火力的伤害以外，「破碎护盾」也会反弹异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_3.text: Protect Mesa from incoming fire and Melee attacks by keeping Shatter Shield and Shooting Gallery active at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_3.zhText: 同时保持「破碎护盾」和「靶场」的激活状态来保护 Mesa 免受即将到来的火力和近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_4.text: Refresh Shooting Gallery's gun jamming effect on enemies who have recovered from it by passing by them again while it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_4.zhText: 当「靶场」还是在激活状态之下再次经过敌人来刷新已恢复武器塞住状态的敌人的塞住效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_5.text: Hold fire while Peacemaker is active to rapidly fire Mesa's Regulators, targeting all enemies currently within her reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_5.zhText: 当「和平使者」处于激活状态时，按住射击键来使 Mesa 的监察者双枪进行急速射击，瞄准所有在她的准星之内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_6.text: Cast Peacemaker in short bursts while in the air or sliding along the ground to maintain damage without sacrificing mobility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_6.zhText: 在空中或是在地面上滑行时以短发的方式施放「和平使者」来不牺牲移动性的情况之下维持伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_7.text: Continuous fire shrinks Peacemaker's focus ring, but increases its damage! Recast the ability to reset the ring and target more enemies or maintain fire to take down tougher targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_7.zhText: 持续发射会缩小「和平使者」的聚焦环不过会增加伤害！重新施放该技能来重置聚焦环并将更多敌人设为目标或是维持射击来拿下更强的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_8.text: Cast Mesa's defensive abilities before entering Peacemaker to protect her while she's unable to move freely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_8.zhText: 进入「和平使者」之前施放 Mesa 的防御性技能来在她不能自由移动的时候保护她。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_9.text: Mesa's Waltz is an Augment Mod for Peacemaker which allows Mesa to move, roll, and backflip while it's active!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Cowgirl_9.zhText: Mesa 的华尔兹是「和平使者」的强化 Mod，并让 Mesa 在技能活跃之时可以让她移动，滚动并后空翻！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_0.text: Consider equipping upgrades that generate additional Health and Energy Orbs to maximize Dagath's Passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_0.zhText: 考虑装备生成额外生命值和能量球的 Mod 来最大限度地发挥 Dagath 的被动技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_1.text: Dagath’s Wyrd Scythes inflict the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect, causing enemies to take more health damage from all sources, including Doom. Take advantage of this by equipping weapons that deal other Status Effects
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_1.zhText: Dagath 的「命定镰刃」会造成 <DT_VIRAL>病毒异常状态，导致敌人从所有攻击来源（包括「厄运」）受到更多生命值伤害。通过装备可触发其他异常状态的武器来利用这一点。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_2.text: Wyrd Scythes are great for inflicting or extending Doom on large groups, since they punch through multiple enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_2.zhText: 「命定镰刃」非常适合对大群体造成或延长「厄运」技能，因为它们可以击穿多个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_3.text: Doom inflicts its scythes in a wide cone, so position Dagath in front of as many enemies as possible before casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_3.zhText: 「厄运」在一个宽圆锥体的空间射出它的镰刀，因此在施放之前将 Dagath 放置在尽可能多的敌人面前。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_4.text: Equip Dagath with high Critical Chance weapons to maximize Grave Spirit’s devastating damage potential.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_4.zhText: 为 Dagath 配备高暴击几率的武器，以最大限度地发挥「墓灵」的毁灭性伤害潜力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_5.text: Upon dying with Grave Spirit active, Dagath will enter an invulnerable spectral form, knocking down nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_5.zhText: 在「墓灵」激活的情况下垂死，Dagath 将进入无敌的幽灵形态，击倒附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_6.text: In Dagath's spectral form, every kill generates a Health Orb. Be aggressive during Dagath’s invulnerability to ensure a safe return to life.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_6.zhText: Dagath 在幽灵形态中的每次击杀都会生成一个生命球。在 Dagath 无敌时持续进攻，以确保平安复活。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_7.text: Rakhali's Cavalry travels in the direction you cast it, and runs along the ground. Try casting in the air for a better view of the stampede's warpath.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_7.zhText: 「拉卡里的骑兵」按照你施放它的方向行进，并沿着地面奔跑。尝试在空中施法，以便更好地观察骑兵涌现的行进路线。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_8.text: Rakhali's Cavalry can hit enemies multiple times near the start of its cast, which can be very effective for rapidly stripping defenses.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_8.zhText: 「拉卡里的骑兵」在刚开始施放时可以多次攻击敌人，这可以有效地快速摧毁防御。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_9.text: Rakhali's Cavalry grants invulnerability while casting. When in mortal peril, call in the cavalry!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dagath_9.zhText: 「拉卡里的骑兵」在施放时会进入无敌状态。危难之际，召唤骑兵！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Uriel’s demons are proficient at drawing fire to protect their master. Keep all three alive to ensure Uriel’s survival.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: Uriel 的恶魔擅长吸引火力来保护他们的主人。务必保证这三只恶魔全部存活，才能确保 Uriel 的生存。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Each minion will resurrect automatically after being downed for a full 60 seconds.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 每个恶魔在倒地 60 秒后将自动复活。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: The next Brimstone cast can be charged while the ability is currently active. Sow enough chaos to unleash an unending wave of fire and Brimstone.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 下一次施放「硫磺」可以在该技能启用期间充能。制造足够的混乱，释放出永无止境的火焰和硫磺火浪潮。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Each squadmate can collect a copy of the demonic runes created by Vythelas.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 每个小队成员都可以拾取一份由烙魔创造的恶魔符文。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Hold <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> to cancel Infernalis while it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 按住 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> 可取消启用中的「炼狱火」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Enemies ignited by Infernalis will panic, reducing incoming damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 被「炼狱火」点燃的敌人会陷入恐慌，从而减少受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Many combat actions cancel Infernalis flight, such as attacking with Melee or aimgliding, allowing Uriel to weave in and out of his destructive form.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 许多战斗动作可以取消「炼狱火」的飞行状态，例如使用近战攻击或滑翔，这使得 Uriel 能够在他毁灭性的形态中穿梭。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Infernalis flight speed is affected by Parkour Velocity upgrades.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 「炼狱火」的飞行速度受跑酷速度升级的影响。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Infernalis also lights Uriel’s demons ablaze. Activate before using Demonium to launch burning souls and create chaos.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 「炼狱火」还会点燃 Uriel 的恶魔。在使用「魔群」之前启用它，可以释放燃烧的灵魂，制造混乱。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Remedium restores Shields if Uriel is already at max Health, including Overshield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 如果 Uriel 的生命值已达到最大值，则「恶魔再生」可以恢复护盾，包括过载护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.text: Brimstone gains charge upon killing enemies attacked by Uriel's demons, by picking up Vythelas' Runes or by striking enemies with Demonium.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DemonFrame.zhText: 「硫磺」可以通过击杀被 Uriel 的恶魔攻击的敌人、拾取烙魔符文或使用「魔群」击中敌人来获得充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_0.text: Devour multiple enemies at once with Feast by moving the reticle back and forth across desired targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_0.zhText: 使用「大快朵颐」来朝着目标前后移动准星，并且同时吞噬多个敌人

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_1.text: Feast can hold up to five enemies in Grendel's gut, so selectively dine on high priority targets to remove them from the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_1.zhText: 「大块朵颐」可以在 Grendel 的腹中同时容纳最多五个敌人，选择吃下高优先级的目标以从战场上移除他们。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_2.text: Nourish deals damage to enemies within Grendel's gut and can kill them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_2.zhText: 「消化滋养」对在位于 Grendel 肚子里的敌人造成伤害并击杀。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_3.text: Enemies attacking Nourished allies at close range are inflicted with the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect, weakening their defense and enabling quick retaliatory kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_3.zhText: 当敌人近距离攻击被滋养的友军会受到 <DT_VIRAL>病毒异常状态影响，防御会被削弱并且可被快速反杀。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_4.text: Use Sprint to travel faster in Pulverize, at the cost of steering control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_4.zhText: 处于「肉弹碾压」状态时可使用冲刺来加快移动速度，但无法控制方向。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_5.text: Pulverize's Heal starts to decay to half its original start value 5 seconds after cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_5.zhText: 「肉弹碾压」的恢复效果在施放技能 5 秒后会开始衰减至其初始恢复值的一半。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_6.text: Grendel can break the Armor of enemies he rolls over while in Pulverize form.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_6.zhText: Grendel 在「肉弹碾压」形态下打破被他碾压的敌人的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_7.text: Pulverize does not cost Energy if you have enemies in your gut! Use Feast while rolling to suck in enemies on the move and stay full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_7.zhText: 如果你的肚中储有敌人，「肉弹碾压」则不会消耗能量！在翻滚时使用「大块朵颐」，边移动边吞入敌人并保持饱腹。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_8.text: Feast's damage-over-time on vomited enemies and damage on Regurgitated enemies scale based on the level of enemies Grendel devours.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_8.zhText: 「大快朵颐」会对被吐出的敌人造成持续伤害，「剧烈反刍」会根据被 Grendel 吞噬的敌人的等级对他们造成不同数量的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_9.text: Focus on consuming enemies with a lot of Health - it will significantly increase the damage output when Grendel spits them out with Regurgitate!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Devourer_9.zhText: 吞噬生命值较高的敌人，这样当 Grendel 使用「剧烈反刍」将敌人吐出时将会极大提升造成的伤害！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_0.text: Chroma's Effigy benefits from Vex Armor's Fury damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_0.zhText: Chroma 的「利欲龙骸」享有「怨怒护甲」的「盛怒」伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_1.text: <DT_FIRE>Heat Elemental Ward heals allies within range by increasing their base Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_1.zhText: <DT_FIRE>火焰属性的「元素之护」可以增加治愈范围内队友的基础生命值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_2.text: <DT_POISON>Toxin Elemental Ward surrounds Chroma with toxic fumes that have a chance of afflicting <DT_POISON>Toxin Status Effect on nearby enemies. It also grants nearby allies a Reload Speed and Holster Speed increase.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_2.zhText: <DT_POISON>毒素属性的「元素之护」以毒素的气团环绕着 Chroma，有几率使靠近的敌人受到 <DT_POISON>毒素异常状态的影响。也能够使附近的友军获得装填速度以及切换武器速度的增益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_3.text: <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electric Elemental Ward increases allies' base Shields and converts incoming damage into lightning arc discharges.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_3.zhText: <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击属性的「元素之护」增加队友的基础护盾，并将袭来的伤害转换为电弧释放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_4.text: <DT_FREEZE>Cold Elemental Ward increases allies base Armor and creates a shield that deflects damage back to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_4.zhText: <DT_FREEZE>冰冻属性的「元素之护」增加队友的基础护甲，并形成一层能反弹伤害给敌人的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_5.text: Recast Vex Armor before its duration ends to maintain Chroma's Scorn and Fury buffs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_5.zhText: 在「怨怒护甲」技能时间结束前重新施放以维持 Chroma「蔑视」和「盛怒」的增益效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_6.text: Vex Armor is triggered by damage to Chroma's Shields and Health or kills with melee, Abilities, and ranged weapons. To optimize Vex Armor, equip Mods that increase Health and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_6.zhText: 「怨怼护甲」是由对 Chroma 的护盾或生命造成伤害，又或是通过近战击杀、技能和远程武器而触发。装备可以提升生命值以及护盾的 Mod 可以使「怨怼护甲」最佳化。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_7.text: Vex Armor's Scorn buff scales with Armor mods like Steel Fiber, while the Fury buff scales with base damage Mods like Serration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_7.zhText: 「怨怒护甲」的蔑视增益给予诸如钢铁纤维 Mod 的额外护甲效果，而盛怒增益给予诸如膛线 Mod 的基础伤害加成效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_8.text: Vex Armor's Fury increases Spectral Scream's damage!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_8.zhText: 「怨怒护甲」的盛怒增益也可以增强光暴怒吼技能的伤害！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_9.text: While Effigy is active, Chroma receives a Movement Speed increase and Armor Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Dragon_9.zhText: 启用「利欲龙骸」时，Chroma 会获得额外移动速度，但会减少护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_0.text: Neote builds Ice quickly even if very few targets are hit, making it useful against priority targets, even without other enemies around.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_0.zhText: 即使击中的目标很少，「寒霜疾剑」也能快速积攒冰能量，因此对付周围敌人较少的优先目标，它依然非常有效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_1.text: Casting Naraemagi removes <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effects from enemies to fuel Narin's defenses. Be prepared to counter attack or re-freeze enemies quickly once they thaw!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_1.zhText: 施放「冰翎御盾」会移除敌人身上的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，为 Narin 的防御提供能量。一旦敌人解冻，就要做好反击或再次将其冻结的准备！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_2.text: Narin is invulnerable during Hakchum, allowing her to escape danger and reassess the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_2.zhText: 在「鹤影舞坠」期间 Narin 会进入无敌状态，在遇到危险时可以善加利用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_3.text: Fine-tune Narin's height during Hakchum by using the Move Up and Move Down bindings.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_3.zhText: 在「鹤影舞坠」期间，使用向上移动和向下移动绑定按键来微调 Narin 的高度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_4.text: While Narin requires full Ice to use Nurinarim, she doesn't have to spend it all at once. Deactivate Nurinarim early to conserve Ice for later conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_4.zhText: Narin 需要满冰能量才能施放「降灵旋刃」，但她不必一次性用完。提前解除「降灵旋刃」可以保留冰能量用于之后的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_5.text: Nurinarim is most effective against <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Frozen enemies, causing radial explosions on attack. Maximize this effect by getting close enough for her aura to freeze enemies faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_5.zhText: 「降灵旋刃」是对被 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻的敌人最有效的技能，在攻击时造成范围爆炸。通过接近敌人并利用光环迅速将其冻结，可以充分发挥该技能的威力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_6.text: Nurinarim's Armor and Shield reduction multiplies with the number of <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effects applied to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_6.zhText: 「降灵旋刃」的护甲和护盾降低效果会根据施加在敌人身上的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态层数成倍增加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_7.text: Ice drains at a constant rate during Nurinarim, whether Narin is attacking or not, but attacks on Marked Targets do not cost additional ice. Strike fast and true to prolong the dance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_7.zhText: 在「降灵旋刃」期间，无论 Narin 是否攻击，冰能量都会以一定速度消耗，但攻击被标记的目标不会额外消耗冰能量。出手要迅速而精准，才能让剑舞持续下去。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_8.text: Narin can dodge and jump during Nurinarim, or use Hakchum for more significant repositioning.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_8.zhText: 在「降灵旋刃」期间，Narin 可以闪避和跳跃，或使用「鹤影舞坠」进行更有效的位置调整。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_9.text: Extra <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage from Narin's passive will also apply to her abilities while active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Duelist_9.zhText: Narin 的被动技能所提供的额外 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害也会在激活时适用她的其他技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: Each new Spiral resets the Warframe and Weapon options available, granting you new opportunities to take on whatever Dominus Thrax throws at you.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 每个新的复眠螺旋都会重置你可选的战甲和武器选项，给你新的机会来应对士魂大帝向你抛出的任何挑战。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: The most powerful version of the Warframe and Weapon variants you own are prioritized when randomly selected! For example, if you own the base and Prime version of a Warframe, the Prime will take priority.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 随机选择时，你所拥有的战甲和武器的最强力版本将被优先考虑！例如，如果你拥有一款战甲的基础款和 Prime 版，Prime 版将被优先考虑。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: Default Mods are preset combinations of Mods provided for Warframes and Weapons. Equipment you do not own uses these presets exclusively.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 默认 Mod 为战甲和武器提供预前设定的 Mod 组合。你不拥有的装备只使用这些预设。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: To customize Mod Configs for owned equipment, return to your Orbiter to access your Arsenal. Changes applied to the Mod Configs in your Arsenal will appear in Teshin's Cave.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 要为已拥有的装备进行 Mod 配置，请返回轨道飞行器以访问你的军械库。你军械库中的 Mod 配置所进行的修改将同样出现在 Teshin 的洞穴中。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: Mod Configs with 40+ used Mod Capacity appear first, instead of the Default Mod Config.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 使用了超过 40 Mod 容量的配置会优先显示，而不是使用预设 Mod 配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: The Opportunity Rank 4 and Rank 8 Drifter Intrinsics each grant you one additional Warframe option once unlocked, for a total of 5 choices.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 漂泊者「机遇」内源之力 4 级和 8 级在解锁后，分别可以给予一个额外的战甲选项，最终一共有 5 个可选。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.text: The Opportunity Rank 2 and Rank 7 Drifter Intrinsics each grant you two additional Weapon options once unlocked, for a total of 8 choices.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/DuviriBuil.zhText: 漂泊者「机遇」内源之力 2 级和 7 级在解锁后，分别可以给予两个额外的武器选项，最终一共有 8 个可选。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_0.text: Fireball gains increased damage when cast on enemies with <DT_FIRE>Heat Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_0.zhText: 对受 <DT_FIRE>火焰异常状态影响的敌人施放「火球」将会增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_1.text: Cast multiple Fireballs in quick succession to increase their damage output.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_1.zhText: 快速连续施放多个「火球」，来增加其伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_2.text: Cast Fireball to ignite and stagger groups of enemies gathered together in doorways or near objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_2.zhText: 施放「火球」来点燃聚集在门口或邻近任务目标的敌人，并使敌人失去平衡。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_3.text: Immolation's Damage Reduction increases based on current self-Immolation levels. Increase the meter gain rate by casting Fireball or Inferno.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_3.zhText: 「浴火献祭」增加的伤害减免由当前自身的「浴火献祭」水平决定。通过击杀敌人，施放「火球」，或是施放「地狱烈焰」来提升计量表的增长速率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_4.text: If Ember reaches max Immolation, she will overheat, slowly losing Energy. Use Fire Blast to reduce Immolation levels, or recast the ability to reset meter gain.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_4.zhText: 如果 Ember 达到了最高的「浴火献祭」水平，她将由于过热而逐渐失去能量。施放「火焰冲击」来降低「浴火献祭」水平，或者重新施放技能来重置计量表度数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_5.text: Fire Blast sends enemies flying if they are nearby when the ability is cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_5.zhText: 通过施放「火焰冲击」来击飞靠近的敌人！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_6.text: Fire Blast costs less Energy when Immolation level is high. Alternate between abilities that increase and reduce Immolation to maximize damage and minimize Energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_6.zhText: 「浴火献祭」水平高时，「火焰冲击」所消耗的能量较小。交替使用能够增加和减少「浴火献祭」的技能，从而将伤害最大化并且能量消耗最小化。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_7.text: Fire Blast's Armor Reduction scales based on Ember's current Immolation levels.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_7.zhText: 「火焰冲击」的护甲减免效果由 Ember 当前的「浴火献祭」水平决定。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_8.text: All enemies struck by Inferno get a personal ring of fire, expanding over time and spreading to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_8.zhText: 所有受到「地狱烈焰」打击的敌人都会有一个专属环焰，可以随时间增长而蔓延扩散到邻近的敌人

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_9.text: Inferno's fire ring damage increases based on current Immolation levels.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ember_9.zhText: 「地狱烈焰」增加的环焰伤害由当前的「浴火献祭」水平决定。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Excalibur Umbra is immune to damage for the duration of Slash Dash.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: Excalibur Umbra 在「突斩」期间免疫伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Radial Howl can temporarily deactivate Laser Barriers and Security Cameras.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 「广域嚎声」可以暂时解除激光障碍和监控摄像头。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Cast Radial Howl to get a Stealth bonus on enemies that are open to Finishers.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 施展「广域嚎声」来从开放处决攻击的敌人处获得偷袭的加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Radial Howl strips Sentient enemies of any active damage resistances!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 「广域嚎声」可以解除 Sentient 敌人身上所有激活中的伤害抗性！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Perform a Melee Spin Attack with Exalted Blade to create a small Radial Howl for half the Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 使用「显赫刀剑」施放滑行攻击来以一半的能量消耗制造一个小型的「广域嚎声」！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Cast Slash Dash while Exalted Blade is active to launch energy waves towards an enemy and any behind them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 在「显赫刀剑」处于激活状态时施展「突斩」来施放能量波打击一名敌人以及其背后的任何敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: While Exalted Blade is active, Slash Dash is granted a small bonus to its base damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 当「显赫刀剑」是激活状态时，「突斩」的基础伤害会被给予一个小小的加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Exalted Blade's innate Punch Through allows its waves to traverse through obstacles to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 「显赫刀剑」的自带穿透可以让它的冲击波穿透障碍物直达敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Build up Bonus Damage for Exalted Blade's energy waves and Excalibur Umbra's Melee Combo Counter by striking enemies at close range with the sword itself.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: 用「显赫刀剑」近距离砍击敌人，来增强能量波的额外伤害和叠加 Excalibur Umbra 的近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.text: Excalibur Umbra's Exalted Umbra Blade can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/ExcaliburU.zhText: Excalibur Umbra 的「显赫刀剑 Umbra」可以单独在军械库中更改 Mod 配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Excalibur is immune to damage for the duration of Slash Dash.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: Excalibur 在「突斩」期间免疫伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Radial Blind can temporarily deactivate Laser Barriers and Security Cameras.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 「致盲」可以暂时解除激光障碍和监控摄像头。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Cast Radial Blind to open enemies to Finishers. Blinding also grants a Stealth bonus to all Melee strikes, including Exalted Blade!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 施放「致盲」可以对受影响的敌人使用处决攻击，同时所有近战攻击也都能获得偷袭加成，这包括「显赫刀剑」！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Each enemy hit with Slash Dash adds to Excalibur's Melee Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 每个被「突斩」击中的敌人会增加 Excalibur 的近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Perform a Melee Spin Attack with Exalted Blade to create a small Radial Blind for half the Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 使用「显赫刀剑」施放滑行攻击来以一半的能量消耗制造一个小型的致盲！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Cast Slash Dash on an enemy while Exalted Blade is active to launch energy waves.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 在激活「显赫刀剑」时施展「突斩」来施放能量波。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: While Exalted Blade is active, Slash Dash is granted a small bonus to its base damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 当「显赫刀剑」是激活状态时，「突斩」的基础伤害会被给予一个小小的加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Exalted Blade's innate Punch Through allows its waves to traverse through obstacles to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 「显赫刀剑」的自带穿透可以让它的冲击波穿透障碍物直达敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Build up Bonus Damage for Exalted Blade's energy waves and Excalibur's Melee Combo Counter by striking enemies at close range with the sword itself.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: 用「显赫刀剑」近距离砍击敌人，来增强能量波的额外伤害和叠加 Excalibur 的近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.text: Excalibur's Exalted Blade can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Excalibur_.zhText: Excalibur 的「显赫刀剑」可以单独在军械库中更改 Mod 配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_0.text: Refresh Spellbind's Status Effect immunity by recasting it on Titania or allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_0.zhText: 通过重新施放在 Titania 或队友身上来刷新「迷尘」异常状态的免疫。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_1.text: Allies’ Companions within range of Tribute’s Full Moon buff also benefit from its damage increase.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_1.zhText: 在「献灵」的「满月」增益效果范围内的友军同伴，也能受益于它的伤害提升。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_10.text: Titania's small size while in Razorwing combined with Tribute's Dust buff greatly increases her evasion chances!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_10.zhText: Titania 的小身材在使用「剃刀之翼」时，结合「献灵」的尘埃增益可以大幅提升她的闪避几率！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_11.text: Cast Razorwing while in the air to shorten the casting time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_11.zhText: 在空中施放「剃刀之翼」可以缩短施放的时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_2.text: Allies within range of Tribute’s Thorns buff also benefit from its damage reduction and reflection!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_2.zhText: 在「献灵」的「荆棘」增益效果范围内的友军，也能受益于它的伤害减免和反射！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_3.text: Enemies that survive any of Titania’s Tribute buffs have their attacks weakened.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_3.zhText: 从任意 Titania 的「献灵」增益效果中存活下来的敌人，将会被削弱攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_4.text: Titania gains one additional Razorfly for each Tribute buff active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_4.zhText: 每启用一个「献灵」增益，Titania 就会额外获得一只剃刀蝶。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_5.text: Refresh the Duration of Titania's active Tribute by casting and collecting the same Aura from an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_5.zhText: 通过对敌人施放技能，并从敌人身上收集相同的光环，来刷新 Titania 当前激活的「献灵」持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_6.text: Lantern can be cast on multiple enemies, and affected enemies can be detonated by charging the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_6.zhText: 「幻灯」可施放在多个敌人身上，被击中的敌人可通过充能来引爆。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_7.text: Enemies attacked by Razorwing's Razorflies have increased vulnerability to damage from your attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_7.zhText: 被「剃刀之翼」的剃刀蝶攻击的敌人将更容易受到你的攻击造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_8.text: Titania's Razorwing weapons, the Dex Pixia pistols, and Diwata blade, can be modded separately in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_8.zhText: Titania 的「剃刀之翼」武器，Dex 妖精手枪，和仙女刀刃，可在军械库分别装备 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_9.text: Titania can cast her other abilities while in Razorwing!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Fairy_9.zhText: Titania 能在「剃刀之翼」中施放她的其他技能！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_0.text: Pair Frost with weapons that deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status to Freeze enemies quicker. Spreading Cold to nearby enemies with weapons also increases the Armor Frost gains from his passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_0.zhText: 为 Frost 配备可造成 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻异常状态的武器可更快地冻结敌人。使用武器将冰冻异常状态传播给附近的敌人还能增加 Frost 从被动获得的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_1.text: Cast Freeze on the ground to create an icy path, adding <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status Effect to the enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_1.zhText: 在地上施放「冻结」来制造一条结冰的路径，给予敌人 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_2.text: Cast Freeze on the outside of a Snow Globe to shatter it and deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage to nearby enemies, this can also be used to remove Globes from undesirable locations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_2.zhText: 在「冰雪护罩」的外围施放冰冻技能以粉碎它，并对附近的敌人造成<DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害，这也可以用来将「冰雪护罩」从不需要的位置移走。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_3.text: Cast Snow Globe on top of enemies to freeze and launch them out of the area!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_3.zhText: 在敌人逼近时施放「冰雪护罩」来冷冻他们并将他们投掷出去！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_4.text: Increase the max Health of Snow Globes with Ability Strength and Armor Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_4.zhText: 使用技能强度及护甲 Mod 来增加「冰雪护罩」的最大生命值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_5.text: Frost can cast up to four Snow Globes to cover more ground.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_5.zhText: Frost 可以施放最多 4 个「冰雪护罩」以覆盖更多的面积。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_6.text: Snow Globes absorb damage and convert it to Health within the first few seconds after cast. Cast them while taking heavy damage to convert high levels of damage into its total Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_6.zhText: 「冰雪护罩」在施放后的前几秒会吸收伤害并将它转换成冰罩的额外生命。在受到严重伤害时施放技能会将高级别伤害转换到总血量中去。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_7.text: Reset the damage absorption period and invulnerability window for an existing Snow Globe by casting a new one inside of it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_7.zhText: 通过在「冰雪护罩」内施放一个新的护罩来重置其伤害吸收时间和无敌的区间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_8.text: Enemies frozen by Avalanche have Reduced Armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_8.zhText: 被「雪崩」冻住的敌人护甲将减少。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_9.text: Enemies affected by <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status Effects also take additional Critical Damage. Pair Frost with high Critical Chance weapons to maximize the damage on targets affected by Cold.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frost_9.zhText: 受 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻异常状态影响的敌人也会受到额外的暴击伤害。为 Frost 装备高暴击几率武器可最大限度地提高对受冰冻异常状态影响目标的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Enemies scanned by Seek are also marked in the minimap.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 通过「侦察」扫描到的敌人也会在小地图上标记。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Evade removes all Status Effects on Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「闪避」会消除 Cyte-09 的所有异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Evade bypasses Cyte-09’s Shield Regen Delay, meaning his Shields start regenerating immediately after casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「闪避」会无视 Cyte-09 的护盾恢复延迟，这意味着他的护盾在施放后将立即开始恢复。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Cyte-09 and allies all have their own instance of the Resupply Ammo Packs, meaning no one can take them from him or each other.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: Cyte-09 和队友都拥有独立的「补给」弹药包，这意味着他们不会抢走彼此的补给。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Cyte-09's Primary, Secondary and Neutralize Exalted Weapon can each pick up their own Resupply Ammo Pack, meaning you can have up to three different elemental damage types on each to swap between.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: Cyte-09 的主要、次要和显赫武器「肃清者」可以各自拾取自己的补给弹药包，这意味着可以在所有武器上切换最多三种不同的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Resupply Ammo Packs last until collected, and Cyte-09 can deploy up to six at a time. Arrange a wide variety of elements near stationary objectives to give allies a stockpile of munitions to choose from.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「补给」产生的弹药包会一直存在，直到收集完毕，Cyte-09 一次最多可以部署六个。在固定目标附近布置各种元素弹药包，为友军提供可供选择的弹药储备。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Resupply will retain the last used Elemental ammo type for easy recasting until a new type is selected.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「补给」将保留最后使用的元素弹药类型，以便于重新施放，直到选择新类型。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Neutralizer also benefits from Resupply and applies the chosen Status Effects onto its ricochet shots, on top of the <DT_COLD_COLOR>Cold Damage from its alt-fire attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「肃清者」也能从「补给」中受益，并将所选的异常状态应用到其弹射射击上，此外还会对影响其次要射击造成的 <DT_COLD_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Seek uses Cyte-09's Energy color to mark enemy weak spots. Use a bright color to help you target them better!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: 「侦察」使用 Cyte-09 的能量颜色来标记敌人的弱点。使用明亮的颜色可以帮助你更好地瞄准它们！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.text: Each bullet that ricochets off of enemy weak points from Cyte-09's passive contributes to Neutralize's Shot Combo Counter. Combine this with its Zoom multiplier for massive damage potential!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Frumentari.zhText: Cyte-09 被动技能下，每颗从敌人弱点反弹出的子弹都会增加「肃清者」的射击连击数。结合其缩放倍率，可产生巨大的伤害潜力！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_0.text: Garuda's passive applies Bonus Damage to both abilities and Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_0.zhText: Garuda 的被动技能可以使技能和武器造成额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_1.text: Cast Dread Mirror on multiple enemies to collect their life force into a single projectile, which lasts indefinitely until launched.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_1.zhText: 通过向多个敌人施放「恐惧魔镜」来将他们的生命之力收集到一个抛射玻片中，这个玻片可以无限持续到被发射出去为止。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_10.text: Seeking Talons can be charged in the air while hovering over enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_10.zhText: 「穿心利爪」能够在悬浮于敌人上方时于空中蓄力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_2.text: Hold Dread Mirror to channel Energy into damage for its projectile, causing a more impactful explosion upon release!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_2.zhText: 长按施放「恐惧魔镜」以将能量导入其抛射玻片造成的伤害中，在释放时造成更有冲击力的爆炸！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_3.text: Cast Blood Altar and Bloodletting back to back to trade Energy for Health and Health for Energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_3.zhText: 连续施放「鲜血祭坛」和「祭血仪式」以将能量转化为生命值，同时将生命值转化为能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_4.text: Roll into enemies with Dread Mirror to knock them away and clear a path!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_4.zhText: 向敌人群中施放「恐惧魔镜」来将它们击飞并开辟出一条血路来！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_5.text: Blood Altar's effects can be stacked by overlapping the healing circles, allowing for potent defensive zones using the impaled enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_5.zhText: 「鲜血祭坛」的技能效果可以通过重叠治疗圈来叠加，并且让你能够使用被刺穿的敌人来建立强大的防御区域。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_6.text: Seeking Talons can pierce the same enemy multiple times if they are the only one in the reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_6.zhText: 如果范围内只有一名敌人，「穿心利爪」可在其身上多次进行穿刺。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_7.text: Cast Seeking Talons multiple times on a single target to make quick work of them with the <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect from its Slash Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_7.zhText: 在单个目标身上多次施放「穿心利爪」来快速地以切割伤害触发的 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态解决它。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_8.text: Unequipping Garuda's Melee Weapon in the Arsenal equips her Talons instead, which can be modded separately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_8.zhText: 在军械库卸下 Garuda 的近战武器会装备她的利爪，其可以被分别更换 Mod 的配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_9.text: Unleash a highly charged projectile from Dread Mirror onto targets affected by Seeking Talons for a devastating enemy bloodbath!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Garuda_9.zhText: 从「恐惧魔镜」向受到「穿心利爪」影响的敌人释放高蓄能投射物来血洗敌军！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_0.text: Enemies hit with Fractured Blast will have a Crystal floating above their head to indicate they are affected by the <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect. Killing them while this Slash Status is active will result in an increased drop chance of a Health or Energy Orb.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_0.zhText: 被「碎裂晶爆」击中的敌人头顶会漂浮一块水晶，表示他们受到了 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态的影响。在此切割异常状态触发期间杀死他们会增加生命球或能量球的掉落几率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_1.text: Prioritize killing enemies affected by Fractured Blast to increase the amount of health restored over time by Citrine's passive. The more Health Orbs Citrine picks up, the more her passive will heal!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_1.zhText: 优先杀死受「碎裂晶爆」影响的敌人，以增加 Citrine 被动技能中持续恢复的生命值。Citrine 拾取的生命球越多，她的被动技能治疗量就越多！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_2.text: Preserving Shell is applied to all allies within Shared Affinity Range. Allies gain or lose this protection based on their current distance, so stay close together to maximize the Ability’s effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_2.zhText: 「封存护壳」适用于处在经验共享范围内的所有友军。友军会根据他们当前的距离获得或失去这种保护，因此请聚在一起以最大限度地发挥该技能的功效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_3.text: The total Damage Resistance applied by Preserving Shell has a special indicator in the HUD while active. Citrine can increase the Resistance by getting kills or assists while it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_3.zhText: 启用「封存护壳」时，其产生的总伤害抗性会显示在界面中的一个特殊指示标。Citrine 在技能启用期间可通过击杀或助攻来增加该抗性。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_4.text: Prismatic Gem will only target one enemy at a time. Focus its attack by using weapons against priority targets, as it will not attack foes harmed by Abilities only (with the exception of Fractured Blast).
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_4.zhText: 「棱彩宝石」一次只会瞄准一个敌人。通过用武器选择优先攻击的目标来进行集中攻击，因为它不会仅攻击受到技能伤害的敌人（受到「碎裂晶爆」伤害的除外）。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_5.text: Prismatic Gem’s area of effect for Ally Status Effect and Duration buffs is indicated by a prismatic aura in the air. Enemies are targeted by Prismatic Gem as long as Citrine or the enemy are inside the aura when struck.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_5.zhText: 「棱彩宝石」对友军身上异常状态和持续时间增益的影响范围由空气中的棱彩光环显示。只要 Citrine 或敌人在被击中时处在光环内，敌人就会成为「棱彩宝石」的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_6.text: Each attack from Prismatic Gem will apply one stack of all its Status Effects (<DT_FIRE>Heat, <DT_FREEZE>Cold, <DT_POISON>Toxin and <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity). Harm the target with rapid fire weapons to apply multiple stacks of these Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_6.zhText: 「棱彩宝石」的每次攻击都会给目标施加一层所有异常状态（<DT_FIRE>火焰、<DT_FREEZE>冰冻、<DT_POISON>毒素和 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击）。用高射速武器伤害目标，以将这些异常状态的效果叠加在目标身上。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_7.text: Enemies with Overguard will not be immobilized by Crystalize, but will still grow Crystals! Shoot the Crystal Growths to take down their Overguard faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_7.zhText: 拥有超宏防护的敌人不会被「晶化生长」固定住，但身上仍会长出晶体！射击这些生长出来的晶体以更快地摧毁他们的超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_8.text: Casting Crystallize will generate fractals for every enemy within Range and Line of Sight. If an enemy was just out of range, Citrine can reposition and immediately cast again without removing the effect on already-Crystallized foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_8.zhText: 施放「晶化生长」将对范围和视线内的每个敌人生成分形晶石。如果敌人刚刚超出范围，Citrine 可以重新定位并立即再次施放「晶化生长」，而不会移除对已经结晶的敌人的影响。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_9.text: Casting Preserving Shell also staggers nearby enemies. The Damage Resistance is maintained upon recast, so Citrine can use this functionality to get out of a pinch.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Geode_9.zhText: 施放「封存护壳」也会使附近的敌人失衡。重新施放时可维持伤害抗性，这样 Citrine 可以使用此功能来摆脱困境。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_0.text: Tap Shattered Lash to stab enemies with <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage, or hold to sweep enemies with <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_0.zhText: 轻触施放「琉璃碎击」来以< DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺伤害刺伤敌人，或长按以砍伤扫掠敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_1.text: Shattered Lash's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it and her Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_1.zhText: 「琉璃碎击」的伤害增幅基于技能武器所装备的 Mod 以及 Gara 的技能连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_2.text: Splinter Storm can be cast on allies and Defense objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_2.zhText: 「玻片风暴」可以被施放在友军和防御目标上。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_3.text: Gara and her allies can refresh Splinter Storm's duration by passing through Mass Vitrify's ring while it is expanding.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_3.zhText: Gara 和她的友军可以通过穿越扩张时的「广域玻璃化」的玻璃环来刷新「玻片风暴」的技能持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_4.text: Splinter Storm's damage is increased when Spectrorage's mirrors shatter within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_4.zhText: 当与「光谱盛怒」的镜面碎片在同一范围内时，「玻片风暴」的伤害会增加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_5.text: Destroy Mass Vitrify's ring with Shattered Lash when standing near of it to increase Splinter Storm's damage!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_5.zhText: 在玻璃环附近使用「琉璃碎击」破坏「广域玻璃化」的玻璃环来增加「玻片风暴」的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_6.text: Cast Splinter Storm on an enemy to damage surrounding foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_6.zhText: 通过在一名敌人身上施放「玻片风暴」来对其周遭敌人造成范围伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_7.text: Mass Vitrify's ring gains durability based on the Health and Shields of the enemies crystallized during the cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_7.zhText: 「广域玻璃化」的玻璃环的持续时间会根据被晶体化的敌人的生命值和护盾而增加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_8.text: Increase the vertical height of Mass Vitrify's ring by casting it from a high point or by casting it mid-air.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Glass_8.zhText: 通过在高处或者半空中施放「广域玻璃化」来增加玻璃环的纵向高度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_0.text: Most of Gyre’s abilities inflict <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Status, which her passive converts into additional Critical Chance on subsequent damage. High-Status Chance weapons modded with <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage can maximize this effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_0.zhText: Gyre 的大部分技能都会造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击异常状态，她的被动技能会在随后的伤害中将这些异常状态转化为额外的暴击几率。搭配拥有高触发几率且装备了 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害 Mod 的武器可最大化这一效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_1.text: The <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Status from Gyre's abilities makes her strong at crowd control thanks to its stun effect. Use abilities strategically to protect yourself and allies by keeping enemies locked down.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_1.zhText: 得益于 Gyre 技能中 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击异常状态为敌人带来的眩晕状态，她在控场方面表现尤其出色。战略性地使用她的技能，来通过约束敌人保护自己和友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_2.text: Gather enemies using Coil Horizon before tossing Arcsphere, making it easier to hit multiple enemies and trigger Arcsphere’s damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_2.zhText: 在投掷「电弧球」之前可以先通过「旋爆视界」把敌人聚集起来，以便能够更轻易地攻击到更多敌人来触发「电弧球」的伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_3.text: Coil Horizon will knock enemies down if it hits them directly on cast. Since the suction effect is not immediate, use this to incapacitate nearby targets in a pinch.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_3.zhText: 如果施放「旋爆视界」时直接击中了敌人，则会将其击倒。由于该技能的吸取效果不是即时生效的，因此可以在紧急情况下使用该技能来使附近的目标失去行动能力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_4.text: Cathode Grace works best when there are many targets to kill. Modding for increased Ability Duration coupled with a steady stream of kills helps maximize uptime before the casting cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_4.zhText: 当你有多个目标需要击杀时，「阴极泰来」能带来最佳效果。通过搭配可提升技能持续时间的 Mod，并且结合稳定的击杀流来最大限度地在技能冷却时间开始之前，提升技能持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_5.text: Cathode Grace stacks with Gyre’s passive ability, up to a maximum of 300% combined Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_5.zhText: 「阴极泰来」与 Gyre 的被动技能叠加，最高可获得 300% 结合暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_6.text: Gyre’s excellent critical hit potential makes it easy to trigger Rotorswell's discharge frequently. Maximize her passive, use Cathode Grace, or equip a weapon with high Critical Chance stats to take advantage. Does not apply to Helminth abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Gyre_6.zhText: Gyre 出色的暴击潜力可以轻松触发「超旋链波」的频繁电能释放。最大化她的被动技能、使用「阴极泰来」，或装备具有高暴击几率的武器来充分利用她的优势。不适用于 Helminth 技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Only a couple of the Mirror clones fire with Mirage, but all of them perform melee attacks!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 只有个别镜面幻影能与 Mirage 一同开火，但它们全都能施展近战攻击！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Hall of Mirrors' clones mimic different weapon attacks, including alt-fires and Melee Heavy Attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 「镜厅」的幻影模彷不同的武器攻击，包括次要射击和近战重击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Cast Hall of Mirrors to draw enemy fire to Mirage's clones instead of her.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 施放「镜厅」来引导敌军的炮火到 Mirage 的幻影身上而非她自身。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Equip Mirage with area of effect weapons to quickly clear rooms of enemies with the help of her Hall of Mirror's clones.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 用范围影响武器来装备 Mirage，通过她「镜厅」的幻影的帮忙来极速清空房内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Sleight of Hand turns Security Cameras into allies, keeping them from activating Laser Barriers when detected.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 「戏法」将监控摄像机转换成友军，防止它们在检测到活动时激活激光障碍。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Cast Sleight of Hand when there is a large amount of Ammo Pickups on the ground for a chance that they'll randomly explode and deal <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 当地面有大量弹药掉落物时施展「戏法」，致使它们或会随机爆炸并对附近的敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE>的冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Total Eclipse is an Augment Mod for Eclipse that grants allies in range its benefits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 全蚀是「黯然失色」的强化 Mod，能为范围内的友军带来增益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Sleight of Hand is especially useful in Spy and Rescue missions, cast it when enemies are rushing to consoles to cause an explosion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 「戏法」在间谍和救援任务中尤其见效，在敌人冲往控制台时使用来造就一次爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: Prism bounces off of surfaces and can be especially useful in narrow pathways.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 「棱镜」能从表面反弹，在狭窄的通道中尤其有用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.text: With the Solar Eclipse buff active, Prism deals double damage. With the Lunar Eclipse buff active, Prism's casting cost is halved.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Harlequin_.zhText: 日蚀的增益效果激活时，「棱镜」造成的伤害加倍。月食的增益效果激活时，施放「棱镜」所需的能量减半。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_0.text: Styanax’s Passive increase to critical chance is based on total Shields, including Overshields. Equip mods that increase Shield capacity, and generate Overshields with Rally Point or other Warframe abilities for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_0.zhText: Styanax 暴击几率的被动提高是根据总护盾量，包括过载护盾而定。装备提高护盾容量的 Mod，并通过「集结点」或其他战甲技能来产生过载护盾以达到最大效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_1.text: Axios Javelin can be thrown in rapid succession to create multiple vortex points, helping to control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_1.zhText: 可以接连投掷「崇敬标枪」来制造多个漩涡点，以帮助控制战局。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_2.text: If an enemy is not near any walls, throw an Axios Javelin from above and pin them to the floor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_2.zhText: 如果敌人周围没有墙壁，则可从上方投掷「崇敬标枪」来将他们钉在地上。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_3.text: Gather enemies using Axios Javelin and cast Tharros Strike against the group to effectively strip them of their defenses and heal Styanax. Final Stand can also be cast to smite the remaining foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_3.zhText: 使用「崇敬标枪」来聚集敌人并对这群敌人施放「豪勇之击」来有效地削减他们的防御并治疗 Styanax。也可以施放「终极之战」来终结剩下的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_4.text: Rally Point draws enemy attention to Styanax. Cast near teammates while drawing fire, and quickly bring down the enemy to regenerate allies’ Shields and hold the line.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_4.zhText: 「集结点」将敌人的注意力引到 Styanax 身上。吸引火力的同时在队友附近施放，快速击杀敌人以恢复队友的护盾并坚守战线。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_5.text: Rally Point's bonuses apply to each teammate in range at the time of casting. Teammates do not need to stay near Styanax to continue regenerating Energy and Shields.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_5.zhText: 「集结点」的加成适用于在施放该技能时处于范围内的每个队友。小队成员不需要一直留在 Styanax 附近来获得持续恢复的能量和护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_6.text: Styanax is vulnerable during Final Stand. Cast it from a safe distance or combine it with Rally Point for added Shield protection.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_6.zhText: Styanax 在施放「终极之战」期间将很容易受到伤害。在安全距离外施放该技能，或将它与「集结点」结合使用以获得提升的护盾保护。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_7.text: Styanax’s airborne position can be shifted slightly during Final Stand using movement inputs. Combine with the spears’ explosion to hunt down enemies behind cover.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Hoplite_7.zhText: 施放「终极之战」期间，可以通过移动指令来轻微改变 Styanax 在空中的位置。结合「崇敬标枪」的爆炸伤害来追捕躲在掩体背后的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Hold Virulence to highlight the area it will travel before casting!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 在施放「致病力」前，按住技能键会显示其将要行进的区域！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Cast Larva close to the ground so that Virulence can reach enemies caught by the tendrils for easy Mutation Stacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 在靠近地面的地方施放「幼体」，以便「致病力」可以触及被卷须捕获的敌人，以轻松堆叠「突变适性」层数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: The more Mutation Stacks Nidus has, the more damage Virulence and detonated Maggots deal!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: Nidus 的「突变适性」层数越多，「致病力」和被引爆的蛆虫伤害越高！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Standing in Ravenous' area regenerates Health over time and scales with Ability Strength Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 站在「贪婪」的感染范围内会随着时间恢复生命值并使用技能强度 Mod 来决定其功效高低。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Ravenous use Mutation Stacks instead of Energy to cast. The ability icon light up when there are enough stacks to cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 「贪婪」利用突变适性而非能量来施放。当有足够层突变适性并准备好施放时，技能标志会亮起。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: For each enemy hit by the first pulse of damage, Virulence refunds a portion of its casting cost. This means lower Ability Efficiency can actually return more energy overall when striking groups larger than four!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 每个被「致病力」第一波伤害脉冲击中的敌人，都会返还一部分消耗的能量。这意味着在更低的技能效率情况下打击超过 4 个敌人的群体会返还更多的能量！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Hold Parasitic Link to cast on the nearest ally.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 按住「寄生链接」，对最近的友军施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Parasitic Link will flash and play a sound when it's about to break to let you know you're too far from your target!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 当「寄生链接」即将断裂时，链接会闪烁并发出提示音，提醒你与目标的距离过远！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Link to an ally or enemy with Parasitic Link and cast Virulence to create a second growth from the linked unit.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 用「寄生链接」连接到友军或敌人身上并施放「致病力」以在被连接单位身上制造第二条生长物。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Use Parasitic Link on free-moving companions and Specters to buff Nidus and the companion or Specter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 对自由移动的同伴和魅影使用「寄生链接」，为 Nidus 以及同伴或魅影提供增益效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Enemy heavy units can withstand more damage which makes them ideal Parasitic Link targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 敌方重型单位可以承受更多伤害，这使它们成为理想的「寄生链接」的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: Cast Virulence into Ravenous' infested area to detonate Maggots and deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 在「贪婪」的感染范围内施放「致病力」来引爆蛆虫及对附近的敌人造成 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.text: While Ravenous is active, hold Virulence to mark the location of its Maggots and release to cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Infestatio.zhText: 当「贪婪」生效时，按住「致病力」去标示蛆虫的位置，放开技能键即可施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_0.text: Forced Perspective can allow Follie to traverse great distances quickly, while also bypassing some obstacles and traps.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_0.zhText: 「强制透视」可以让 Follie 快速穿越很远的距离，同时还能绕过一些障碍物和陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_1.text: Forced Perspective clears Status Effects and grants brief invincibility, making it great for both aggressive advances and tactical retreats.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_1.zhText: 「强制透视」可以清除异常状态并赋予短暂的无敌状态，因此非常适合进攻和战术撤退。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_2.text: A Shadowgraph's beauty is in the eye of the beholder. Many objects are only useful in certain mission types, and require proper awareness and knowledge to be used effectively!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_2.zhText: 绘影图之美，在于观者眼中。许多物品仅适用于特定任务类型，且需具备充分的认知与知识方能有效运用！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_3.text: Each individual Shadowgraph has its own cooldown, tracked in the bottom right corner of the screen.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_3.zhText: 每张绘影图都有自己的冷却时间，在屏幕右下角进行记录。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_4.text: Shadowgraph creates objects as they are in the world, meaning they do not scale with mods, but instead scale with enemy level in the current mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_4.zhText: 绘影图生成的物体遵循它们在世界中的形态，这意味着它们不会被 Mod 影响，而是被当前任务中的敌人等级影响。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_5.text: Self Portrait reduces damage taken by all nearby allies, including companions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_5.zhText: 自画像可以减少附近所有友军（包括同伴）所受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_6.text: Plein Air can be recast to capture new enemies, without releasing enemies that are already in flight.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_6.zhText: 可以重新施放「户外写生」来捕捉新的敌人，而不会释放已经在飞行中的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_7.text: Enemies falling out of Plein Air will cause a radial explosion of ink on impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_7.zhText: 敌人从「户外写生」中坠落时，落地会引发墨汁的放射状爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_8.text: Equip precision weaponry to pop certain balloons, or to shoot enemies without releasing them from flying captivity. Conversely, use explosive Shadowgraphs like Thermian RPGs and Amphors to make them all fall down!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_8.zhText: 装备精密武器击破特定气球，或射击敌人而不使其脱离空中囚禁。或者反之，使用热熔火箭炮和元素瓶等爆炸性绘影图，让所有敌人坠落！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_9.text: Plein Air balloons can be bounced upon from above, popping them and refreshing expended double jumps.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inkblot_9.zhText: 「户外写生」可从上方踩踏，使其爆裂并刷新二段跳。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_0.text: Invasions pit enemy factions against each other. You may choose to support Grineer or Corpus forces as they fight against the Infested, or even against each other.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_0.zhText: 入侵任务使敌对派系相互对抗。你可以选择支持 Grineer 或 Corpus 的部队来对抗 Infested，甚至是在他们双方相互对抗时支持其中一方。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_1.text: To earn the reward, you must complete three missions for one side on that mission node. Items are only awarded once the Invasion has ended; the reward is then sent to your inbox, regardless of who won the conflict.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_1.zhText: 想要获得奖励，你必须在该任务节点上为你支持的一方完成三场任务。奖励只有在入侵任务结束后才会被授予；无论最终哪方赢得了冲突，作战奖励都会在随后递送至你的收件箱。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_2.text: Certain weapons can only be built using parts earned from Invasions. Other rewards may include Orokin Catalysts and Reactors, Forma, or Exilus Adapters - so check back often!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_2.zhText: 有些武器只能使用从入侵任务中获得的部件来制造。其他任务奖励可能包括奥罗金催化剂和反应堆、Forma，或是特殊功能槽连接器——所以请经常回来看看！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_3.text: Depending on who loses control over the sector, the Corpus Zanuka Hunter or The Grineer Grustrag Three will have their sights on you and may ambush you in future missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_3.zhText: 取决于哪一方失去了对该区域的控制权，Corpus 派系的 Zanuka 猎犬或是 Grineer 派系的 Grustrag 三霸将会把目光投向你，并可能在未来的任务中对你进行伏击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_4.text: You may participate in multiple mission nodes for a single invasion. Keep in mind you may only earn one reward from each node.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_4.zhText: 你可以在一次入侵任务中参加多个任务节点的行动。请记住，你只能从每个节点获得一次奖励。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_5.text: You may assist both sides of a conflict on different mission nodes. To change which side is supported on a specific node, you will need to play enough missions to undo assistance given to the other faction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Invasion_5.zhText: 你可以在不同的任务节点上支持冲突的双方。要改变在特定节点上对哪一方的支持，你需要执行足够多的任务来抵消先前对另一派系的支援。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: Blueprints are used to build items in the Foundry. They can be obtained from the Market with Credits, by completing various missions, and more. Unlock the Foundry by completing the Vor’s Prize Quest.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 蓝图是用来在铸造厂中打造物品的。可以在游戏内商店通过现金购买它们，或者通过完成各种任务等方式获得。完成《沃尔的战利品》系列任务来解锁铸造厂。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: Inventory Slots are used to store your Warframes, Weapons and other equipment. Additional Slots can be purchased for Platinum or earned via Nightwave rewards.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 仓库槽位是用来存放你的战甲、武器，和其他装备的。额外的槽位可以使用白金购买，或者通过午夜电波的奖励获得。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: The amount of Open Inventory Slots you own for each equipment type is viewable by selecting the equipment’s category in your Inventory. Additional Slots can be purchased here as well!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 你拥有的每种装备类别的可用仓库槽位数量，可以通过在仓库中选择装备类别来查看。额外的槽位也可以在这里购买！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: The Mastery earned from leveling equipment to Max Rank remains even after selling the Mastered item - meaning it can be sold to vacate Slots for new equipment!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 即使出售已精通过的物品，升级该装备到最高等级所获得的精通经验依然保留——这意味着你可以出售它以腾出槽位给新的装备！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: Once something is sold, it cannot be returned to your inventory - always double check before confirming.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 一旦某个物品被出售，它将无法被还原至你的仓库中——请在确认出售之前再次检查。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: The Mods you own can be viewed and upgraded after unlocking the Mod Segment via the Vor’s Prize Quest.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 通过《沃尔的战利品》系列任务解锁 Mod 模块后，你可以查看并升级你所拥有的 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.text: Preview an item to learn more about it. View its tradability, stats, description, Mastery Rank requirement, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Inventory_.zhText: 预览一个物品并了解它。查看它的可交易性、属性、描述、精通段位要求等内容。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Overshields prevent Health damage from Status Effects!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 过载护盾可以避免异常状态对生命值产生伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Hildryn's abilities consume Shields instead of Energy! Equip her with Mods that increase Shield Capacity and Shield Recharge to maximize that pool.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: Hildryn 的技能消耗的是护盾而非能量！将增加护盾容量以及护盾充能的 Mod 装备给她来将护盾池最大化。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Balefire's Charger can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 「野火充能」的充能可以单独的在军械库更改 Mod 的配置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Increase Hildryn's Movement Speed while Aegis Storm is active by Dodging.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: Hildyrn 启用「神盾风暴」时，可借由闪避动作加快移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Hildryn's Balefire uses her Shields to fire its shots - The longer you charge the attack, the more Shields are consumed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: Hildryn 的「野火燎原」能使用她的护盾来发射——将攻击充能的越久，就会消耗更多的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Cast Pillage to replenish Hildryn's Shields and Overshields so that they can be used to cast her other abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 施放「掠夺」来补充 Hildryn 的护盾以及过载护盾以便可以使用它们来施放她的其他技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Haven can be cast on friendly NPCs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 「和平之地」可以在友军 NPC 身上施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: The Shield bars of Hildryn and allies affected by Haven have a special visual effect that indicates when her passive is ready to be activated.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: Hildryn 以及受「和平之地」影响的友军的护盾条都有一个特别的效果来显示当她的被动技能已准备好再次启用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Cast Haven while Hildryn is in Aegis Storm to grant allies its protective aura while on high.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 当 Hildryn 在「神盾风暴」激活期间，施放「和平之地」来给予友军它的保护性光环。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Hold jump to float up or hold crouch to float down while Hildryn is in Aegis Storm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 当 Hildryn 在「神盾风暴」激活期间按住跳跃键来浮上或按住下蹲键来往下。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Recast Aegis Storm to send Hildryn flying down onto enemies, dealing damage on impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 重新施放「神盾风暴」来使 Hildryn 冲向敌人并在冲击之时造成伤害。
