/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.text: Aegis Storm drains Hildryn's Shields over time. Watch her Shields carefully and cast Pillage to refuel.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/IronFrame_.zhText: 「神盾风暴」随着时间会消耗 Hildryn 的护盾。小心注意她的护盾并施放「掠夺」来补充护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_0.text: Mind Controlled enemies visually react before turning on their allies. Damage dealt to them during this window will increase their damage output while they are under Nyx’s control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_0.zhText: 被「精神控制」的敌人在攻击其友军前会作出视觉上的反应。在此期间对他们造成的伤害将增加他们在 Nyx 控制期间的伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_1.text: Cast Mind Control on Shield Ospreys so that Nyx and allies can benefit from their Shield regenerating effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_1.zhText: 对护盾鱼鹰施放「精神控制」，以便 Nyx 和友军可以从它们的护盾恢复效果中受益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_10.text: Recast Absorb while active to detonate the bubble early.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_10.zhText: 在「聚合吸收」启用时，重新施放该技能可提前引爆。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_2.text: Mind Controlled enemies will attack aggressively with little regard for self-preservation, prioritizing enemies that Nyx is currently targeting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_2.zhText: 被「精神控制」影响的敌人会奋不顾身地发起攻击，优先攻击 Nyx 当前正在瞄准的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_3.text: Cast Psychic Bolts to temporarily disable Auras from Ancients.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_3.zhText: 施放「精神飞刃」来暂时停用远古敌人的光环效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_4.text: Psychic Bolts can be recast any time to engage new targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_4.zhText: 可以随时重新施放「精神飞刃」来攻击新目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_5.text: Psychic Bolts siphons enemies’ defenses onto Nyx. This applies to Shields, Armor and Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_5.zhText: 「精神飞刃」会将敌人的防御力转移到 Nyx 身上。这适用于护盾、护甲和超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_6.text: Casting Absorb while airborne allows Nyx to float above the battlefield. Hold jump to float upwards or crouch to float down, drawing as much fire as possible.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_6.zhText: 在空中施放「聚合吸收」技能可使 Nyx 漂浮在战场上空。按住跳跃键可向上漂浮，按住蹲伏键可向下漂浮，尽可能多地吸引火力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_7.text: Absorb also converts damage received from allies. Coordinate with allies to build up a more powerful explosion!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_7.zhText: 「聚合吸收」也能转换来自友军所受到的伤害。与友军合作来制造出更强力的爆炸！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_8.text: Damage that enemies do to each other is added to Absorb’s detonation if the ability is active. Create mass confusion with Mind Control and Chaos before casting Absorb to maximize damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_8.zhText: 启用「聚合吸收」时，敌人之间相互造成的伤害会添加到该技能的爆炸中。在施放之前，先用「精神控制」和「混乱」制造大规模混乱，以最大化伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_9.text: Nyx is completely invulnerable during Absorb, making it a great last resort when under heavy fire.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Jade_9.zhText: Nyx 在「聚合吸收」期间完全无敌，使其成为遭受重火力攻击时的最后手段。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_0.text: Enemies bound by Ensnare are dealt more damage from Whipclaw and Venari attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_0.zhText: 被「束缚陷阱」束缚的敌人会受到更多来自「长鞭利爪」以及薇娜丽攻击的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_1.text: Cast Whipclaw on an enemy trapped in Strangledome to hit all held enemies at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_1.zhText: 对受困于「绞杀穹顶」的一名敌人施放「长鞭利爪」来同时打击所有受困的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_10.text: Whipclaw's damage scales based on Mods equipped on it and her Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_10.zhText: 「长鞭利爪」的伤害增幅基于技能武器所装备的 Mod 以及 Khora 的技能连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_11.text: Khora can cast up to two Strangledomes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_11.zhText: Khora 能施放最多 2 个「绞杀穹顶」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_2.text: Cast Strangledome on Defense objectives to protect them from approaching enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_2.zhText: 在防御目标上施放「绞杀穹顶」来保护他们不被逼近的敌人伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_3.text: Venari Tail Whip's enemies in her Protect posture to knock them down and disarm them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_3.zhText: 薇娜丽的尾巴在她的护卫形态之时会抽打敌人来将之击倒并使之缴械。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_4.text: Command Venari to stay in place by marking her while she's in her Heal posture.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_4.zhText: 当薇娜丽在治疗的形态之时标示她来对她下达留在原地的指令。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_5.text: Command Venari in her Heal posture to revitalize Khora by recasting the ability while enemies are not in the reticle.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_5.zhText: 当敌人不在准心内重新施放指令使薇娜丽进入她的治疗形态来让 Khora 恢复元气。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_6.text: Venari Snares a target temporarily in her Attack posture. Choose a new target for Venari to Snare by casting the ability on an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_6.zhText: 薇娜丽在她的攻击形态之时会短暂地罗网她的敌人。对一名敌人施放该技能来给薇娜丽网罗一个新的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_7.text: Venari's Heal posture can heal Defense objectives when marked!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_7.zhText: 当防御任务的目标被标记时，薇娜丽的治疗形态可以治疗他们！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_8.text: Venari grants Khora a permanent buff to her Movement Speed which scales with Ability Strength.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_8.zhText: 薇娜丽给予了 Khora 的移动速度一个永久性的增益，它随着技能强度增加或减少。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_9.text: Khora can have both Venari and another Companion with her in a mission!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Khora_9.zhText: Khora 可以和薇娜丽以及另一个同伴一起进入同一个任务。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_0.text: One weapon type will always be affected by Koumei’s passive, causing it to inflict additional Status Effects. Pay attention to your currently buffed weapon type, and swap weapons accordingly!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_0.zhText: 一种武器类型将始终受到 Koumei 被动技能的影响，从而造成额外的异常状态。注意你当前带有增益的武器类型，并相应地更换武器！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_1.text: Each ability cast rolls all five of Koumei’s Dice. The total value rolled changes the effectiveness of the ability you cast. Rolling three sixes at once unleashes a powerful effect unique to each ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_1.zhText: 每次施放技能时，都会掷出 Koumei 的所有五个骰子。掷出的总值会影响你施放技能的效果。一次掷出三个六点将释放出每个技能独有的强大效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_2.text: Kumihimo's threads cover a wide area in whatever direction the ability is cast. Block off narrow corridors and chokepoints, or increase Ability Range to inflict many Status Effects across larger open areas with many enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_2.zhText: 在向所指方向施放「命运编织」时，其丝线会覆盖一个大范围区域。可以封锁狭窄的走廊和咽喉要道，或通过增加技能范围，在敌人众多的开阔区域造成多种异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_3.text: Your current Omikuji challenge is displayed on-screen at all times, along with the progress towards completion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_3.zhText: 你当前的「御神签」挑战会一直显示在屏幕上，以及完成的进度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_4.text: Each cast of Omikuji permanently increases the cooldown for the duration of the mission before it can be cast again.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_4.zhText: 每次施放「御神签」，会在任务期间永久性增加下一次施放所需的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_5.text: Hold Omikuji to cancel your current challenge. Be aware that a canceled Omikuji will still increase the cooldown timer.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_5.zhText: 按住「御神签」可取消当前挑战。请注意，取消「御神签」仍会增加冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_6.text: A full list of all Decrees earned through Omikuji during your mission can be found on the pause menu.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_6.zhText: 在任务期间你可以在暂停菜单中找到通过「御神签」获得的所有王令的完整列表。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_7.text: Consider pairing Koumei with weapons that are good for completing Omikuji challenges, such as those that apply each of the four base Status Effects, or weapons that excel at long range or headshot kills.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_7.zhText: 考虑将 Koumei 与适合完成「御神签」挑战的武器配对，例如可造成四种基本异常状态的武器，或擅长远距离或爆头击杀的武器。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_8.text: Omamori’s defensive charms cannot be refreshed until you have almost run out. Watch your charges and recast Omamori when you get low.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_8.zhText: 「御守」防御护符只有在你几乎用完时才能刷新。注意你的护符数量，当护符快用完时重新施放「御守」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_9.text: Bunraku affects enemies that Koumei can see within range. Size up large groups of enemies and watch them dance!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Koumei_9.zhText: 「人偶戏」会影响 Koumei 视野范围内的敌人。聚集大群敌人并观看他们跳舞！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_0.text: Escape danger by casting Decoy at a distance and Switch Teleporting to it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_0.zhText: 在一段距离施放「诱饵」并使用「移形换位」来传送到那个位置并逃避危险。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_1.text: Cast Decoy before Invisibility expires to draw fire away from Loki for the brief period he is visible before recasting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_1.zhText: 在「隐身」失效之前施放「诱饵」，这样可以在 Loki 重新施放前短暂露面以分散敌人火力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_2.text: Cast Decoy in the middle of large groups to take advantage of the scaling health and shield absorbed from nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_2.zhText: 在敌群中间施放「诱饵」，通过吸收附近敌人身上的生命值和护盾值来获得优势。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_3.text: Cast Invisibility to stealthily revive fallen allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_3.zhText: 施放「隐身」来偷偷地复活倒下的友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_4.text: Stay out of the line of fire while Invisibility is active and retreat when the ability is about to expire for a safer recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_4.zhText: 在「隐身」激活期间避开敌人火力范围，并在技能即将结束时撤退，以便更安全地重新施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_5.text: Switch Teleport can be used on friendly characters like rescue targets, escort drones, and downed allies. Use to re-position high priority targets to safer locations!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_5.zhText: 「移形换位」可用在友军角色上，例如救援目标、护卫的无人机和倒地的队友。善用此技能把重要目标传送到更安全的地方！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_6.text: Cast Switch Teleport on priority and nearby targets to confuse them, leaving them open to attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_6.zhText: 对优先及附近的目标施放「移形换位」来扰乱他们，使其更易受到攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_7.text: Switch Teleport with Dargyn Pilots on the Plains of Eidolon to steal their vehicle!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_7.zhText: 在夜灵平野对轻型艇驾驶施放「移形换位」来偷走他们的载具！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_8.text: Unlike other factions, Infested enemies are knocked down by Radial Disarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_8.zhText: 与别的派系不一样的是，Infested 敌人是可以被「解除武装」击倒。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_9.text: Irradiating Disarm is an Augment Mod for Radial Disarm that puts enemies into a frenzy with the <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Loki_9.zhText: 辐射缴械是「解除武装」的强化 Mod，它可以用 <DT_RADIATION>辐射异常状态将敌人陷入疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_0.text: Cast Polarize to strip enemy Armor and Shields before casting Crush for more effective destruction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_0.zhText: 在施放「粉碎」之前先施放「护盾极化」，可以剥离敌人的护甲和护盾以造成更加有效的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_1.text: Cast Pull to draw enemies away from allies that are at risk of being downed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_1.zhText: 在友军有生命危险时施放「吸引」技能来将敌人从友军身边移开。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_2.text: Cast Magnetize on high priority enemy units to keep them at bay and inflict continuous damage onto them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_2.zhText: 对高优先级的敌方单位施放「磁吸力场」技能，使其无法靠近并对其造成持续的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_3.text: Magnetize targets take increased damage from Pull and Polarize.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_3.zhText: 被「磁吸力场」技能影响的敌人会受到更多来自「吸引」和「护盾极化」技能的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_4.text: Projectile weapons with punch through are especially devastating inside Magnetize bubbles, circling through enemies multiple times.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_4.zhText: 带有穿透效果的投射类武器在「磁吸力场」的罩子中具有特别强大的破坏性，可循环多次穿过敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_5.text: Multiple Magnetize bubbles can be placed on different enemies at once. If the limit is reached, the first bubble will detonate if the target is no longer alive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_5.zhText: 多个「磁吸力场」产生的磁化气泡可以同时被放置在不同敌人的身上。如果达到技能上限，第一个磁化气泡将在目标死亡的情况下引爆。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_6.text: Magnetize bubbles explode and deal <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage if the originating target dies before the ability has ended.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_6.zhText: 如果原始目标在技能结束前死亡，「磁吸力场」产生的磁化气泡将会爆炸并产生<DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_7.text: Cast Polarize to replenish the Shields of Defense objectives if they are getting low.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_7.zhText: 当防御目标的护盾变低时，施放「护盾极化」以补充其护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_8.text: Crush grants Shields to nearby allies including Companions when cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Mag_8.zhText: 施放「粉碎」来给予附近的友军包括同伴的护盾充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_0.text: The Rift provides cover from hazards, like Grineer Arc Traps and Laser Barriers.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_0.zhText: 地图上的裂隙为潜在危险例如 Grineer 的电弧陷阱及激光障碍提供遮蔽。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.text: Allies can roll to leave the Rift when Banished!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.zhText: 友军可在被「放逐」时通过滚动的方式离开裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.text: Damaging Status Effects like <DT_SLASH>Slash, <DT_GAS>Gas or <DT_POISON>Toxin will continue dealing damage while enemies are affected by Stasis.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.zhText: 伤害异常状态例如 <DT_SLASH>切割，<DT_GAS>毒气或 <DT_POISON>毒素会继续对处于「停滞」中的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.text: Allies inside the Rift can still damage enemies using their Warframe abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.zhText: 在裂隙中的友军仍然能够用他们的战甲技能来伤害到敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.text: Cast Rift Surge before Cataclysm expires in order to keep all enemies in the Rift between casts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_1.zhText: 在「灾变」结束之前施放「裂隙涌流」可以在施放间期让敌人保持于裂隙之中。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_2.text: Banish can be used to protect vulnerable allies, including friendly NPCs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_2.zhText: 「放逐」技能可以被用来保护脆弱的友军，包括友善的 NPC。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_3.text: Limbo must be on the same plane as his target to push them out of their current Rift plane using Banish.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_3.zhText: Limbo 必须和他的目标在同一空间平面内才可以通过「放逐」将其推出目前的裂隙位面。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_4.text: Stasis' Duration is half as long as Cataclysm. Recast Stasis frequently to ensure any enemies caught by Cataclysm remain frozen and vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_4.zhText: 「停滞」的持续时间是「灾变」的一半长度。频繁重新施放「停滞」来确保任何被「灾变」捕获到的敌人保持冻住和可受到伤害状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_5.text: Stasis freezes enemies who enter the Rift. Combine it with Cataclysm to protect Defense objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_5.zhText: 「停滞」技能可以冻结住进入裂隙中的敌人，和「灾变」技能搭配使用来保护防御目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_6.text: Cast Stasis before Banish or Cataclysm to instantly freeze enemies in place!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_6.zhText: 在使用「放逐」或是「灾变」技能前施放「停滞」技能以将敌人立即冻结在原地！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_7.text: Cast Cataclysm on Defense Objectives to keep them safe inside the Rift.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_7.zhText: 在防御目标上施放「灾变」技能以保持他们在裂隙中的安全。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_8.text: Cataclysm deals more damage to enemies within it when detonated at its minimum size.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_8.zhText: 「灾变」在技能范围缩至最小尺寸引爆时会对深陷其中的敌人会产生更多的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_9.text: Detonating Cataclysm by recasting does less damage to the same target for every subsequent use.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Magician_9.zhText: 通过再次施放「灾变」技能来引爆它会在每一次使用时减少对相同目标的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MegaPrimeV.text: Stay tuned for future Prime Vault details!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MegaPrimeV.zhText: 敬请期待未来 Prime Vault 的相关内容！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Change the focus of Wukong's Celestial Twin by recasting the ability on an enemy. Doing so increases the damage dealt by the Twin and can be especially useful when dealing with higher priority targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 对另一名敌人重新施放「天圣双身」来更改目标。这么做可以增加分身所造成的伤害并且在应付高度优先的目标特别有用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Hold Celestial Twin to dismiss the existing twin.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 按住「天圣双身」来解散目前的分身。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Melee while holding aim with Primal Fury active to perform area of effect attacks that stagger enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「原始狂怒」在激活状态之下，保持瞄准并进行近战攻击来施行一个可以使敌人失去平衡的区域性攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Melee while holding aim and moving forward to perform high range and gap closing attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 保持瞄准并往前移动之时再进行近战攻击来施行一个高射程及缩减差距的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text:
Wukong's passive has 5 possible survival techniques: 
<MINI_ARROW> Primal Forces: Triple Elemental Damage for 60 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Heavenly Cloak: Invisibility for 30 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Cosmic Armor: Invulnerable for 30 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Monkey Luck: Extra Loot Drops for 60 seconds
<MINI_ARROW> Sly Alchemy: Orbs 4x more effective for 60 seconds
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText:
Wukong 的被动技能有 5 种可能的保命神技：
<MINI_ARROW> 原始之力：在 60 秒内，元素伤害提升为原来的 3 倍
<MINI_ARROW> 天界披风：隐身 30 秒
<MINI_ARROW> 神力之甲：无敌 30 秒
<MINI_ARROW> 吉猴之运：在 60 秒内，获得额外的战利品掉落
<MINI_ARROW> 狡诈淬炼：在 60 秒内，补给球的效果提升为原来的 4 倍

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Cast Cloud Walker to bypass Security Cameras and traverse through Laser Barriers.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 施放「筋斗游云」来绕过监控摄像头并穿过激光障碍。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Cloud Walker heals Wukong based on distance moved in cloud form. Escape and reposition during tough combat encounters, re-emerging ready to fight!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「筋斗游云」会根据 Wukong 在云雾形态下所移动的距离来治疗他。在艰苦的战斗中撤离并变换阵地，重振旗鼓再现身来战斗！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Cloud Walker's heal and invulnerability also apply to Celestial Twin, if active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「筋斗游云」的治疗和无敌效果同样适用于处于激活状态中的「天圣双身」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Celestial Twin remains active during Cloud Walker and teleports to Wukong once deactivated.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「天圣双身」会在筋斗游云的状态中保持激活，并且会在被解散时传送至 Wukong 身边。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Defy is cast in sync with Wukong's Celestial Twin - damage absorbed by both is combined into a single value, affecting the strength of their retaliatory strikes, as well as their shared Armor bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「死命顽抗」与 Wukong 的「天圣双身」会被同步施放——两者吸收的伤害会合并为一个单一数值，此数值会影响它们报复攻击的强度，以及它们共享的额外护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Primal Fury's Iron Staff can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 「原始狂怒」的「定海神针」可在军械库中独立配置 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Melee with Primal Fury active to perform frontal attacks with high damage multipliers.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 在「原始狂怒」激活状态下进行近战攻击来施行高伤害倍率的正面攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.text: Melee while moving forward with Primal Fury active to perform fast sweeping attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/MonkeyKing.zhText: 在前进时使用近战攻击并激活「原始狂怒」以施展快速的扫打攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_0.text: Soul Punch heals existing Shadows of the Dead if the max number of enemies affected are active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_0.zhText: 如果受影响的敌人数量达到最大值，那么「灵魂重击」会治疗现有的「亡者幽影」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_1.text: Soul Survivor is an Augment Mod for Soul Punch that consumes all of Nekros' Energy to revive downed allies instantly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_1.zhText: 幸存生灵是「灵魂重击」的强化 Mod，可以消耗 Nekros 的全部能量来使倒地的友军立即复活 。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_10.text: Enemies that are below 25% Health are instantly killed by Soul Punch and turned into a Shadow of the Dead up until the max amount of enemies affected.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_10.zhText: 「灵魂重击」可立即杀死生命值低于 25% 的敌人，并将它们变为「亡者幽影」，直至被影响的敌人数量达到了最大值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_2.text: Terrify reduces enemy Armor and can be stacked multiple times when recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_2.zhText: 「惊骇」能减低敌人的护甲且在重新施放时可堆叠数次。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_3.text: Creeping Terrify is an Augment Mod for Terrify that reduces the Movement Speed of enemies affected by the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_3.zhText: 缓动惊骇是「惊骇」的强化 Mod，减低受该效能影响敌人的移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_4.text: Cast Desecrate in Survival and Excavation missions to increase the drop chance of Life Support and Power Cells.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_4.zhText: 在生存和挖掘任务中施展「亵渎」来增加维生模块和能量电池的掉落几率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_5.text: Combine <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage weapons with Desecrate to create more enemy parts for loot to drop from.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_5.zhText: 将「亵渎」与 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害武器结合来制造更多的敌人尸块进而增加战利品的掉落。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_6.text: Despoil is an Augment Mod for Desecrate that fuels the ability with Nekros' Health instead of Energy. With it, Nekros can better utilize Health orbs created by Desecrate, opening up synergies with powerful Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_6.zhText: 掠夺是「亵渎」的强化 Mod，供给 Nekros 的生命而非能量。有了它，Nekros 能更好好运用「亵渎」所制造的生命球，用强大的 Mod 来开启协力反应。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_7.text: Enemies that spawn additional units continue to do so even after they are summoned as a Shadow of the Dead.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_7.zhText: 产生额外单位的敌人即使被召唤为「亡者幽影」，也会继续这样做。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_8.text: Recast Shadows of the Dead to fully heal them for less time than a regular cast!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_8.zhText: 重新施展「亡者幽影」比起正常施放能花更少时间便可完全治愈他们！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_9.text: Decrease the rate at which Shadows lose Health over time with Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Necro_9.zhText: 通过装备增加持续时间的 Mod，来减缓幽影失去生命值的速率。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_0.text: Use Fire Walker to lock down strategic areas, such as narrow pathways or objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_0.zhText: 运用「风火飞轮」去锁定战略领域，如峡窄过道和物件。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_1.text: Fire Walker removes Status Effects from allies when they cross its path!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_1.zhText: 当友军穿越「风火飞轮」的路径时可移除他们的异常状态！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_2.text: Recast Blazing Chakram to teleport Nezha to the Chakram. If Fire Walker is active, a ring of fire will also appear wherever he lands.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_2.zhText: 重新施放「乾坤火圈」来将 Nezha 传送到火圈。如果「风火飞轮」处于激活状态，会有一圈火环出现于他的落脚点。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_3.text: Cast Blazing Chakram on an enemy impaled by Divine Spears to spawn a second Chakram!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_3.zhText: 向被「圣火尖枪」刺穿的敌人施展「乾坤火圈」来产生第二个火圈！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_4.text: Charge Nezha's Blazing Chakram before launching it to increase its damage and  cause it to fly straight ahead, instead of locking onto enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_4.zhText: 蓄力发射「乾坤火圈」来增加伤害并使它直线飞向前方，而不是默认的锁定敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_5.text: After Warding Halo's Health depletes, a wave of <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage ignites surrounding enemies, and a brief invulnerability phase gives Nezha time to recast his Halo safely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_5.zhText: 当「混天火绫」的生命值耗尽后，一波 <DT_FIRE>的火焰伤害会点燃附近的敌人，短暂的无敌时间让 Nezha 有时间安全地施放他的火绫。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_6.text: Warding Halo prevents Status Effects such as <DT_SLASH>Slash and Knockdowns.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_6.zhText: 「混天火绫」可避免异常状态如 <DT_SLASH>切割和击倒。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_7.text: Safeguard is an Augment Mod for Warding Halo that allows Nezha to cast Halos onto allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_7.zhText: 火绫守护是「混天火绫」的强化 Mod，让 Nezha 能够向友军身上施放火绫。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_8.text: Cast Warding Halo when under heavy fire to briefly prevent damage, and increase the durability of the resulting Halo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_8.zhText: 在猛烈炮火下施放「混天火绫」可短暂避免伤害，并增加该火绫效果可吸收的伤害量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_9.text: Recast Divine Spears while the ability is active to retract the spears, dealing additional damage to impaled enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nezha_9.zhText: 在「圣火尖枪」激活时重新施放此技能可取回尖枪，并对被刺穿的敌人造成额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.text: Not all challenges need to be completed in order to hit the max Reward Tier by the end of a Series. Complete as many as you can!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.zhText: 不需完成所有挑战就能在一个系列结束时达到最高的奖励阶层。尽可能多地完成你能完成的！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.text: If enough Acts are completed in a single week, Acts missed earlier in the Series will reappear for another chance to earn Standing. No Weekly Act is lost forever!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.zhText: 若在单周内完成了足够的行动，那么以往系列的行动会再次出现以提供再一次获取声望的机会。没有每周行动是从此就失去的！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.text: Cred Offerings rotate every week and may bring new items. A timer in the shop will tell you when you can expect new Offerings to arrive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.zhText: 货币贡品每周会轮替并带来全新的物品。商店中的一个计时器会告诉你什么时候可以预期新的贡品会到来。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.text: Nightwave Creds do not persist between Series, so be sure to visit the Offerings store before the current Series ends.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.zhText: 午夜电波兑换币不会在系列之间存留，因此请确保在目前的系列结束之前拜访贡品商店。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.text: The News Panel in your Orbiter will notify you a few weeks before the end of a Series.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nightwave_.zhText: 轨道飞行器的新闻面板会在系列结束的前几周通知你。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_0.text: Weapons that inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage deal more damage over time with Ash's increased <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_0.zhText: 在 Ash 提升 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态的被动技能影响下，使用造成 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害的武器会随着时间造成更多的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_1.text: Shuriken can seek and destroy nearby Security Cameras.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_1.zhText: 「手里剑」能够搜寻并摧毁附近的安保摄像头。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_10.text: Ash can Teleport to any enemy in his line of sight. Use this to bypass windows, Laser Barriers, and more.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_10.zhText: Ash 可以瞬移到任何处于他视线内的敌人处。可以用这个方式来绕过窗户，激光屏障和更多类似的障碍。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_11.text: The Bladestorm ability input can be held to target enemies, and activates upon release, instead of tapping the ability input twice.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_11.zhText: 按住「剑刃风暴」技能键来瞄准敌人，并在放开时施放技能，而无需按两次技能键。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_2.text: Shuriken hits contribute to Ash’s Melee Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_2.zhText: 「手里剑」的命中会增加 Ash 的近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_3.text: Smoke Screen's invisibility also applies to Ash's Companions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_3.zhText: Ash 的「烟幕」技能隐形效果也能应用于其同伴。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_4.text: Cast Smoke Screen before activating Blade Storm to mark enemies under cover safely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_4.zhText: 在激活「剑刃风暴」技能之前施放「烟幕」技能可以安全的在「烟幕」的掩护下标记敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_5.text: Use Teleport to reach allies, Rescue Targets, Cryopods, Excavators, and more!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_5.zhText: 使用「瞬移」技能来到达友军旁边，前往救援目标，冷冻舱，挖掘机等等其它更多的类似东西！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_6.text: Casting Teleport on a marked enemy, while Ash's Shadow Clones are attacking, does not consume Energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_6.zhText: 施放「瞬移」技能到一名被标记的敌人时，且 Ash 的幻影分身也在攻击时，不会消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_7.text: Ash is immune to damage when teleporting to an enemy during Shadow Clones attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_7.zhText: Ash 在瞬移到一名处于被幻影分身攻击时的敌人会有免疫伤害的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_8.text: Blade Storm's damage scales with Mods equipped on Shadow Clones, as well as the Ability Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_8.zhText: 「剑刃风暴」的伤害增幅随着影分身所装备的 Mod 以及技能连击数而变化。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_9.text: Any source of invisibility reduces the cost of Blade Storm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ninja_9.zhText: 任何来源的隐形效果可以减少「剑刃风暴」技能的消耗。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_0.text: There’s safety in mushrooms! Always keep a Stinkbrain or Brightbonnet nearby when things get dangerous to take advantage of Nokko’s passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_0.zhText: 蘑菇也可以很安全！遇到危险时，记得让「臭脑菇」或「亮帽菇」在附近，这样才能充分利用 Nokko 的被动技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_1.text: Use Stinkbrain mushrooms to soften up enemies with lots of Health using <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects, then focus fire with weapons.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_1.zhText: 使用「臭脑菇」通过 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态来削弱生命值高的敌人，然后用武器集中火力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_10.text: Nokko can unleash up to three Sporespring mushrooms at a time for maximum chaos! Don’t forget to use Brightbonnet to help sustain the cost of frequent casting, while also increasing Sporespring damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_10.zhText: Nokko 最多可以同时释放三个「孢子泉」蘑菇，营造极致混乱！别忘了使用「亮帽菇」来抵消频繁施放的消耗，同时还能提升「孢子泉」的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_2.text: Brightbonnets increase Nokko’s Energy and Ability Strength, in addition to his allies’. It’s always a good idea to deploy one before casting other Abilities!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_2.zhText: 「亮帽菇」能同时增加 Nokko 及其友军的能量和技能强度。先部署好一个「亮帽菇」，再施放其他技能，准没错！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_3.text: You don't need to stay inside the radius of a Brightbonnet to keep the Ability Strength increase. Each pulse will refresh the buff's duration, so simply return when the Ability Strength increase expires.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_3.zhText: 你不需要一直待在「亮帽菇」的技能范围内，来保持技能强度增益。每次脉冲都会刷新增益的持续时间，所以只需在技能强度增益结束时，回到范围内即可。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_4.text: Nokko is fragile, but resilient. Use Reroot when under fire to regenerate Health and Shields while repositioning.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_4.zhText: Nokko 虽然脆弱，但也坚韧。受到攻击时，使用「根系再生」技能，在重新定位的同时恢复生命值和护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_5.text: Stinkbrain and Brightbonnet mushrooms can be bounced on to gain upwards momentum. It even works in Sprodling form!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_5.zhText: 「臭脑菇」和「亮帽菇」可以用来弹跳，来获得向上的动力。在菌宝形态下也能使用！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_6.text: Stinkbrain and Brightbonnet mushrooms appear on the minimap, making them easier to track down for Nokko and his allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_6.zhText: 「臭脑菇」和「亮帽菇」会出现在小地图上，使 Nokko 及其友军更容易找到它们。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_7.text: Sprodling form can roll to dash forward quickly, and also has a 'triple jump', for when you need some extra propulsion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_7.zhText: 菌宝形态可以翻滚以快速向前冲刺，并且还能"三级跳"，以便在你需要额外推进力时使用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_8.text: Sporespring mushrooms bounce more erratically based on Ability Range upgrades.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_8.zhText: 「孢子泉」蘑菇的弹跳会根据技能范围升级变得更加不规律。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_9.text: Sporespring will attempt to strike high priority targets (like Eximus units) when flying into crowds. They will also bounce off of stationary mushrooms that are nearby.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Nokko_9.zhText: 「孢子泉」在飞入敌群时会尝试攻击高优先级目标（比如：卓越者单位）。它们也会从附近静止的蘑菇上弹开。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_0.text: Protea's passive applies to every 4th ability cast before resetting. Plan ahead by using abilities with low Energy cost to strengthen those with larger costs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_0.zhText: 只要第四项技能尚未被重置， Protea 的被动技能就可以生效。做好规划，利用那些能量消耗较低的技能来强化那些高开销技能吧。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_1.text: Allies can collect Shield Satellites by walking near them. Throw them at squadmates’ feet or in their path to apply its effects immediately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_1.zhText: 当队友走近「护盾卫星」时可拾取它们。将其扔向队友的脚下或队友前进的路上可立即使其生效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_2.text: Blaze Artillery has a short duration, but gets stronger with every target it hits. Cast in areas with tightly packed enemies for maximum firepower.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_2.zhText: 「炽烈炮击」的持续时间较短，但是每击中一个目标就会变得更强大。在敌人密集的区域施放该技能，以施展出最大火力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_3.text: Cast Dispensary with Protea's passive active to generate more pickups.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_3.zhText: 在 Protea 的被动技能被激活时施放「后勤支援」，以生成更多拾取物。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_4.text: Rewinding through Temporal Anchor does not reset Protea’s other active abilities, cast as many as you can before time runs out.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_4.zhText: 通过「时泊之锚」回溯并不会重置 Protea 的其他已生效技能。因此，你可以在时间耗尽之前尽可能多地施放技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_5.text: Recast Temporal Anchor after casting Protea’s other abilities to have the Energy spent returned in a pinch!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_5.zhText: 在 Protea 施放其他技能后再次施放「时泊之锚」，以在必要时返还所消耗的能量！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_6.text: Holding Temporal Anchor while it's active will cancel the ability entirely without the implosion, rewind, or Energy refund.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Odalisk_6.zhText: 在「时泊之锚」发动期间，长按对应的技能键即可完全取消技能，而且不会引发内爆、回溯和能量返还效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_0.text: The Predator's Lurk passive effect can be refreshed while active, allowing Oraxia to remain invisible as she weaves around the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_0.zhText: 「捕食者的潜伏」被动技能效果可以在激活时刷新，让 Oraxia 在战场上穿梭时保持隐身。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_1.text: Enemies below 50% health will have a marker above them, indicating they can be instantly killed by Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_1.zhText: 生命值低于 50% 的敌人上方会出现标记，表示可被「仁慈之吻」立即击杀。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_2.text: Mercy’s Kiss instant kill also applies to any enemy vulnerable to a Mercy Kill. Use <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects to raise the Mercy Kill threshold.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_2.zhText: 「仁慈之吻」的立即击杀也适用于任何可被怜悯之击的敌人。使用 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态来提高怜悯之击的阈值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_3.text: Scuttler bites also deal <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects with added duration, increasing the Mercy Kill threshold and making enemies more vulnerable to Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_3.zhText: 急行蛛撕咬也会造成 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态，并延长其持续时间，提高怜悯之击的阈值，使敌人更容易受到「仁慈之吻」的影响。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_4.text: Scuttlers increase in level to match the mission, making them increasingly deadly against harder foes.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_4.zhText: 急行蛛会提升等级以匹配任务等级，使其在面对更强大的敌人时变得更加致命。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_5.text: Use the Dodge input to web sling to any surface during Silken Stride. Oraxia can also jump while being pulled or Wall Latching for increased mobility options.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_5.zhText: 「蛛丝步法」期间通过闪避来利用蛛网吊在任何表面。Oraxia 还可以在被拉拽或攀附墙面时进行跳跃，增加机动性选择。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_6.text: During Silken Stride, Oraxia's jump height and Bullet Jump velocity is increased. She also cannot be staggered or knocked down, nor will she experience hard landings.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_6.zhText: 在「蛛丝步法」期间，Oraxia 的跳跃高度和旋身飞跃速度提升。她不会失衡或被击倒，也不会硬着陆。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_7.text: Oraxia can remain Wall Latched indefinitely during Silken Stride for very little Energy. Unleash chaos with her Scuttlers, weaken enemies from above, then strike with Mercy's Kiss when the time is right!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_7.zhText: Oraxia 可以在「蛛丝步法」期间消耗极少的能量来无限地保持墙面攀附。释放她的急行蛛来制造混乱，从上方削弱敌人，然后在时机成熟时以「仁慈之吻」发起致命一击！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_8.text: The <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage explosion on death during Silken Stride also applies to assists, as long as damage was done by Oraxia or her Scuttlers shortly before the kill.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_8.zhText: 在「蛛丝步法」期间，敌人死亡时引发的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害爆炸也会计入助攻，只要 Oraxia 或她的急行蛛在击杀前有造成过伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_9.text: While using Silken Stride, Oraxia's Melee Weapon is disabled, but can instead be used to trigger Mercy's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Oraxia_9.zhText: 使用「蛛丝步法」时，Oraxia 无法使用近战武器，但可以用来触发「仁慈之吻」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_0.text: Increase Elude's evasion angle with Ability Range Mods. At 360°, Baruuk avoids attacks from all directions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_0.zhText: 用范围 Mod 来增加「巧躲」技能的回避角度。提升至 360° 时，Baruuk 可以闪避所有方向的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_1.text: Baruuk can Elude both gunfire and melee attacks, but cannot evade splash damage - be wary against explosive-wielding enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_1.zhText: Baruuk 能以「巧躲」回避远程枪枝和近战攻击，但无法躲过溅射伤害 － 多加提防持有爆炸型武器的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_1.text: Serene Storm's energy waves punch through enemies and increase the Melee Combo Counter for each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_1.zhText: 「宁静风暴」的能量波会穿透敌人，并且每击中一个敌人就会增加近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_2.text: Unlike other sleep Abilities, enemies affected by Lull awaken with their alert levels reset.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_2.zhText: 不同于其他能使敌人睡眠的技能，受「镇静」技能影响的敌人醒来时他们的警戒等级将会重置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_3.text: Baruuk can give an ally up to half of his maximum Desolate Hands charges, granting Damage Reduction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_3.zhText: Baruuk 可将「离手戏法」技能最大充能数的一半分享给友军，给予其伤害减免的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_4.text: Ability Strength increases the maximum number of Desolate Hands charges upon cast - this also increases maximum for sharing with other players!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_4.zhText: 技能强度可增加施放时「离手戏法」的最大充能数 － 这也能增加分享给其他玩家的充能数！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_5.text: Enemies sent flying by Serene Storm attacks will be disarmed! Baruuk's Ground Slam and Spin Attacks are great for achieving this effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_5.zhText: 「宁静风暴」能缴械被打飞的敌人！Baruuk 的震地攻击和滑行攻击都能达到这样的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_6.text: Serene Storm's energy waves can deflect enemy projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_6.zhText: 「宁静风暴」的能量波能使敌人的投射物偏转。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_7.text: Baruuk blocks a majority of all frontal damage with Serene Storm active, even while attacking or performing other actions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_7.zhText: Baruuk 启动「宁静风暴」时能挡住大量前方迎来的伤害，甚至在攻击或做其他动作时也有效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_8.text: Keep Baruuk's Restraint meter low while Serene Storm is active using Elude, Lull, and Desolate Hands.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_8.zhText: 启动「宁静风暴」时，使用「巧躲」、沉睡和「离手戏法」技能来降低 Baruuk 克制值的量表。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_9.text: Baruuk's Desert Wind can be separately modded in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pacifist_9.zhText: Baruuk 的沙漠之风可在军械库中独立配置 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: When encountering new and dangerous enemies, use Noctua or other Codex scanning tools to complete their Codex entry quickly and benefit from Dante’s passive going forward.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 遇到新的和危险的敌人时，使用「夜枭」或其他资料库扫描工具快速完成它们的资料库扫描，以便今后获得 Dante 的被动效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Noctua can equip any number of Tome Mods, making it a versatile tool for both utility and destruction.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「夜枭」可装备任意数量的典籍 Mod，使其成为一个既实用又具破坏力的多功能工具。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Noctua’s projectile spreads into four fragments upon impact. Fire into large groups to hit multiple enemies and charge the Alternate Fire quickly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「夜枭」的投射物在撞击时会分裂成四块碎片。向密集的敌群射击以击中多个敌人并迅速为次要射击充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Light Verse and Final Verse’s Triumph grants Dante invulnerability during cast, offering immediate protection when you need it most.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「明之诗句」和「最终诗篇：胜利」赋予 Dante 在施放期间的无敌状态，为你在关键时刻提供即时保护。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Protect allies in range by combining the Overguard granted from Light Verse and Final Verse's Triumph.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 通过结合「明之诗句」和「最终诗篇：胜利」赋予的超宏防护来保护范围内的友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Noctua’s clones created by Wordwarden use the same damage types as the mods equipped on Noctua. Consider which Status Effects would be most beneficial to your allies when modding the Noctua.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「最终诗篇：守词者」创造的夜枭分身使用与装备在夜枭上的 Mod 相同的伤害类型。在为夜枭配置 Mod 时，考虑哪些异常状态对你的友军最有利。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: The Paragrimms summoned by Final Verse’s Pageflight draw fire from enemies, offering crowd control while attacking.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 由「最终诗篇：书页飞羽」召唤的幽幽鹰会吸引敌人的火力，提供群体控制的同时进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Final Verse’s Tragedy applies all damage from Status Effects on an enemy instantly. Take advantage of this by applying <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects with Dark Verse and Pageflight, then cast Tragedy to wipe out heavy targets!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「最终诗篇：悲剧」可立刻使敌人承受所有异常状态的伤害。利用「暗之诗句」和「最终诗篇：书页飞羽」造成 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态，然后施放「最终诗篇：悲剧」来迅速消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Increased Status Chance from Dante’s passive and Pageflight with Status Vulnerability and Status Damage can be used to stack <DT_SLASH>Slash, <DT_FIRE>Heat, and <DT_POISON>Toxin Status Effects from other sources, dramatically increasing the damage of Tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 通过由 Dante 被动技能增加的触发几率，和「最终诗篇：书页飞羽」带来的异常状态易伤和异常状态伤害，可以叠加来自其他来源的 <DT_SLASH>切割、<DT_FIRE>火焰和 <DT_POISON>毒素异常状态，从而大幅增加「最终诗篇：悲剧」的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.text: Final Verse is based on the last two Verses cast. If you’ve set up the wrong combination, keep casting to replace your pending Verses.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pagemaster.zhText: 「最终诗篇」基于最后两次施放的「诗句」。如果你选择了错误的组合，继续施放来调整你的待用诗句。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_0.text: Oberon's Righteous Negation passive can be activated using Health Orbs from Reckoning or any other source. This also includes Universal Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_0.zhText: Oberon 的「正义否决」被动技能可以通过使用「惩戒清算」或其他来源的生命球来激活。这也包括通用补给球。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_1.text: Smite removes Overguard and Armor from the initial target, and also scales based on the target's Health and Shield values. Eximus units are prioritized when casting into large groups of enemies, since they're the ideal target.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_1.zhText: 「惩击」会移除初始目标的超宏防护和护甲，并根据目标的生命值和护盾值进行调整。当对大群敌人施放时，卓越者单位会被优先考虑，因为他们是理想的目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_2.text: Enemies targeted by Smite are vulnerable to Melee Finishers for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_2.zhText: 受到「惩击」攻击的敌人会在短时间内容易受到近战处决攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_3.text: Up to three Hallowed Ground fields can be active at once. Spread them across the battlefield to boost Renewal healing for allies, and to sow chaos with <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_3.zhText: 最多可同时激活三个「神圣领域」。将它们散布在战场上，增强友军的「疗愈脉动」治疗效果，并使用 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态播下混乱。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_4.text: Enter Oberon’s Affinity Range while Renewal is active to gain the buff. The effects of Renewal continue to benefit allies for as long as the ability is active, even if they move out of the initial range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_4.zhText: 在「疗愈脉动」激活期间进入 Oberon 的经验共享范围即可获得增益。只要该技能处于激活状态，即使友军超出初始范围，「疗愈脉动」的效果也会持续生效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_5.text: Summoned allies, such as Specters and Nekros' Shadows, also benefit from Renewal's various positive effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_5.zhText: 召唤的友军，例如魅影和 Nekros 的幽影，也可以从「疗愈脉动」的各种增益效果中受益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_6.text: Renewal will negate Status Effects when the target is at maximum Health.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_6.zhText: 当目标处于最大生命值时，「疗愈脉动」将抵消异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_7.text: Renewal grants additional Armor for allies with each target hit by Reckoning. This Armor increase will remain as long as Renewal remains active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_7.zhText: 「惩戒清算」每击中一个目标，「疗愈脉动」都会为友军提供额外护甲。只要「疗愈脉动」保持激活，此护甲提升效果就会持续存在。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_8.text: Cast Renewal to increase the bleed out timer for downed allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_8.zhText: 施放「疗愈脉动」来增加倒地友军的濒死倒数时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_9.text: Reckoning deals significantly more damage to enemies already affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effects. Weaken enemies with Hallowed Ground, then strike them down!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Paladin_9.zhText: 「惩戒清算」对已经受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人造成的伤害显著提升。使用「神圣领域」削弱敌人，然后将他们击倒！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Wrathful Advance attacks benefit from the melee combo counter. Cast Kullervo's other abilities to help build the combo counter with their dagger hits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 「暴怒突进」可以从近战连击数受益。施放 Kullervo 的其他技能，利用它们的匕首命中来积累连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Using Wrathful Advance to teleport forward refreshes Kullervo’s double jump.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 使用「暴怒突进」向前传送可以刷新 Kullervo 的二段跳。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Collective Curse circulates damage from large singular attacks like Wrathful Advance and from rapid strikes like Storm of Ukko.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 「群体诅咒」可以传递「暴怒突进」的高额单体伤害或是「乌戈风暴」的快速多段伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Wrathful Advance can teleport Kullervo in any direction. Aim the reticle above to jump out of dicey situations or to reach high up locations.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 「暴怒突进」可以将 Kullervo 向任何方向传送。将准心指向上方，以便逃离危险情况或者抵达高处。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Holding Wrathful Advance and releasing while aiming at an enemy will lock Kullervo onto and attack the target the same way tapping the ability does.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 按住「暴怒突进」并在对准敌人时释放，会让 Kullervo 锁定并以和按下技能相同的方式攻击目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Cast Recompense before entering the fray with Wrathful Advance, so that the daggers target enemies immediately upon teleporting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 在用「暴怒突进」投入战斗前，先施放「血债血偿」，这样在传送后匕首立即瞄准敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Once Recompense is cast there is a 5 second window before its daggers turn on Kullervo. Find as many enemies as you can before casting to avoid taking that damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 从「血债血偿」施放后到匕首开始攻击 Kullervo 之前，有 5 秒的时间窗口。在施放前尽可能找到更多的敌人以避免承受伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Each enemy can be hit by up to 3 Recompense daggers. Reposition yourself near a cluster of enemies to launch each of those daggers before they turn on Kullervo!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 每个敌人最多可以被 3 把「血债血偿」匕首击中。在匕首转向攻击 Kullervo 之前，尽量把自己置于敌人聚集的地方，以便发射每一把匕首！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Recompense grants Overguard which is a mechanism that grants additional Health protection and provides Knockdown Immunity while active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 「血债血偿」赋予超宏防护，这是一种在激活状态下提供额外生命值保护和击倒免疫的机制。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Collective Curse can be cast multiple times to create a longer chain of shared enemy suffering.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 「群体诅咒」可以多次施放以形成一个更长的、使敌人共同承受痛苦的链条。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.text: Melee attacks and dagger hits spread to chained enemies by Collective Curse add to the melee combo counter.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/PaxDuviric.zhText: 通过「群体诅咒」链接的敌人，其受到的近战攻击和匕首命中都会增加近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_0.text: Once Hydroid damages an enemy, his passive applies to Corrosive Status Effects from any source, even those applied by allies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_0.zhText: 当 Hydroid 对敌人造成伤害后，他的被动技能就会对来自任何来源的腐蚀异常状态生效，甚至包括友军造成的腐蚀异常状态！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_1.text: Cast Tempest Barrage on Corpus Nullifiers to shrink and burst their bubbles!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_1.zhText: 在 Corpus 堕落虚能者身上施放「暴风雨弹幕」来缩小并戳爆它们的能量护盾。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_2.text: Tempest Barrage can be recast to create multiple barrage areas.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_2.zhText: 可以通过重新施放「暴风雨弹幕」来制造多个弹幕区域。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_3.text: Cast Tidal Surge to get out of tough situations quickly with brief invulnerability while cleansing negative Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_3.zhText: 施放「潮汐涌动」可获得短暂的无敌状态并清除负面异常状态，助你迅速摆脱困境。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_4.text: Casting Plunder removes any <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Status Effects currently affecting enemies, permanently reducing their maximum Armor based on the Corrosive Status removed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_4.zhText: 施放「劫掠」会清除敌人身上的 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀异常状态，并根据所清除的腐蚀异常状态永久性地降低他们的最大护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_5.text: Stack up Corrosive Status with Hydroid's abilities before casting Plunder to maximize its effect. Reach 100% Armor reduction with Hydroid's Passive to permanently remove all of their Armor!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_5.zhText: 使用 Hydroid 的技能堆叠腐蚀异常状态，然后施放「劫掠」以最大化其效果。利用 Hydroid 的被动技能达到 100% 的护甲削减，从而永久消除敌人的全部护甲！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_6.text: Bring weapons with <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Status to bolster Hydroid’s abilities, or bring weapons with <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage to take full advantage of their lack of Armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_6.zhText: 使用造成 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀异常状态的武器可以强化 Hydroid 的技能，或选择带有 <DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害的武器来针对敌人缺乏护甲的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_7.text: Tidal Surge can drag enemies into an area locked down by Tempest Barrage and Tentacle Swarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_7.zhText: 「潮汐浪涌」可以将敌人拖入被「暴风雨弹幕」和「触角肆虐」锁定的区域。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_8.text: Tentacle Swarm’s Tentacles will automatically find a new target if their current target dies - No need to recast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_8.zhText: 「触角肆虐」的触手在其当前目标死亡后会自行寻找新目标——无需重新施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_9.text: Use the Pilfering Swarm Augment to gain extra loot from enemies that die while held by Tentacle Swarm.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Pirate_9.zhText: 通过贪夺触角强化 Mod，从被「触角肆虐」抓住后并死亡的敌人身上获得额外战利品。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_0.text: Harrow's increased Overshield Capacity benefits from Shield Restores and other Shield regenerating Warframe abilities!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_0.zhText: Harrow 增加过的超载护盾容量可以从护盾补给和其他可以为护盾充能的战甲技能受益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_1.text: Condemn's chains expand outward the further they travel, covering a wide conical area.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_1.zhText: 「责难束缚」的枷锁随着它们走得越远向外延伸得也越远，以此来一个覆盖更广阔的圆锥形区域。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_2.text: Cast Condemn to generate more Shields for Penance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_2.zhText: 施放「责难束缚」来为「苦行加护」产生更多的护盾能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_3.text: Condemned enemies allow for easy headshots that can help achieve Thurible's energy burst faster.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_3.zhText: 被「责难束缚」影响的敌人会更容易被爆头击杀，由此产生的额外能量可以帮助「聚能焚炉」更快对友军施放能量喷发。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_4.text: Cast Condemn when Harrow is at max Shields for Overshields!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_4.zhText: 在 Harrow 的过载护盾达到了最大护盾能量时施放「责难束缚」！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_5.text: Recast Penance to increase its duration!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_5.zhText: 重新施放「苦行加护」以增加它的技能持续时间！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_6.text: Energy generated by Thurible and the Critical Chance bonus from Covenant are both significantly stronger on Weak Points.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_6.zhText: 「聚能焚炉」产生的能量和「庇佑圣约」产生的暴击几率加成均会在击中弱点时显著提高。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_7.text: Use Covenant's invulnerability effect as an opportunity to charge up Thurible.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_7.zhText: 使用「庇佑圣约」的无敌效果来为「聚能焚炉」充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_8.text: Harrow can move freely while Thurible is active - stay agile to avoid enemy fire while it is charging.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_8.zhText: Harrow 在「聚能焚炉」被激活时仍可自由走动 - 在技能充能时保持警惕以避免被敌人攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_9.text: Both Penance and Covenant affect all allies that are within the Shared Affinity Radius. Use the Player List to see who is within range at the time of casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Priest_9.zhText: 「苦行加护」和「庇佑圣约」作用范围仅限于经验范围内的队友。利用玩家列表查看在范围内的玩家决定施放时机。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_0.text: Stack Ivara's radar passive with Mods like Enemy Radar.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_0.zhText: 用 Mod 来叠加 Ivara 的雷达如侦敌雷达。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_1.text: Use Alt-Fire with Artemis Bow to instantly shoot the currently selected Quiver Arrow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_1.zhText: 使用「月神狩弓」的次要射击来发射当下已选的「战术箭袋」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_10.text: Alarming weapons temporarily drop Prowl's invisibility when fired. Silent weapons allow invisibility to be maintained.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_10.zhText: 以引起警戒的武器开火，会暂时解除「潜影猎手」的隐身效果。消音武器可以保持隐身。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_11.text: Navigator can apply to a projectile that is already in flight. If no projectiles are active, it will apply to the next one that is fired.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_11.zhText: 「导向抛体」可用来操控已射出的投射物。若无可用投射物，则会应用至下次开火。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_2.text: Fire a Cloak Arrow from Ivara's Quiver onto allies to temporarily grant them invisibility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_2.zhText: 从 Ivara 的「战术箭袋」发射隐蔽箭到友军身上能给予他们短暂隐身。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_3.text: Ivara can create multiple ziplines using the Dashwire Arrow from Quiver.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_3.zhText: 「战术箭袋」的悬丝之箭可以让 Ivara 制造多个滑索。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_4.text: Increase the alert radius of Noise Arrow from Ivara's Quiver with Ability Range Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_4.zhText: 使用技能范围 Mod 来增加 Ivara 「战术箭袋」的喧扰之箭的警戒半径。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_5.text: Navigator can be used with Quiver's arrows to direct the chosen arrow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_5.zhText: 「导向抛体」可以与「战术箭袋」的箭矢搭配使用来引导所选择的箭矢。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_6.text: Increase the Projectile Speed of Navigator by holding fire or holding aim to decrease.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_6.zhText: 按住射击来增加「导向抛体」的弹头速度或是按住瞄准来将它减少。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_7.text: A single arrow shot from Ivara's Artemis Bow can be controlled using Navigator!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_7.zhText: Ivara 的「月神狩弓」的单一箭矢可以使用「导向抛体」来控制！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_8.text: Roll while Prowl is active to cover more ground without breaking Ivara's cloaked state.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_8.zhText: 「潜影猎手」激活之时使用滚动来在不破坏 Ivara 的隐身状态之下涵盖更多的地面。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_9.text: Avoid the Energy drain and movement restrictions from Prowl by traveling on Ziplines!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Ranger_9.zhText: 在滑索上行走来避免「潜影猎手」的能量消耗及移动上的限制！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_0.text: Open Void Relics by equipping them during a Void Fissure mission.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_0.zhText: 装备虚空遗物来在进行虚空裂缝任务的期间打开它们。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_1.text: A Relic's quality can be improved by spending Void Traces, earned in Void Fissures. Higher quality Relics have a better chance of rare items.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_1.zhText: 一个遗物的品质能通过花费从虚空裂缝中获取的虚空光体来改善。越高品质的遗物就越有机会获得稀有的物品。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_2.text: If you reach your full capacity of stored Void Traces, any extra Traces earned from Void Fissure missions will be lost. Increase the capacity by earning more Mastery Rank.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_2.zhText: 若你已经抵达了最高能储存虚空光体的容量，你将会失去任何从虚空裂缝任务中获取的额外虚空光体。赚取更高的精通段位来增加此容量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_3.text: Got extra Prime Parts? Visit the Ducat Kiosk in the Relays to trade them for Ducats, used to purchase Offerings from Baro Ki'Teer when he visits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_3.zhText: 有额外的 Prime 部件？请拜访在中继站的杜卡德金币交易站来将它们交易换取杜卡德金币。当 Baro Ki'Teer 拜访时可以使用杜卡德金币来购买贡品。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_4.text: Earn Aya in Open World Bounties and missions in the Void, while Regal Aya can be purchased directly from Varzia.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_4.zhText: 在开放世界的赏金任务和虚空任务中获取阿耶精华，而御品阿耶精华则可以直接向瓦奇娅购买。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_5.text: Varzia’s wares rotate on a regular basis.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_5.zhText: 瓦奇娅的商品定期轮换。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_6.text: Use Aya to purchase the exact Relics you want from Varzia.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_6.zhText: 使用阿耶精华向瓦奇娅购买你想要的确切遗物。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_7.text: Regal Aya lets you purchase Prime Warframes, Weapons, and Accessories from Varzia’s wares.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_7.zhText: 御品阿耶精华可以让你从瓦奇娅的商品中购买 Prime 战甲、武器和配件。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_8.text: Save your Regal Aya and Aya for the next rotation of Varzia’s wares if she doesn’t have what you’re looking for!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_8.zhText: 如果瓦奇娅没有你目前想要的东西，你可以把你的御品阿耶精华和阿耶精华保存起来等待下次瓦奇娅的商品轮换！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_9.text: Varzia’s wares contain Prime items and Relics not often available in the drop tables.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Relics_9.zhText: 瓦奇娅的商品中包含了掉落表中不常见的 Prime 物品和遗物。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_0.text: Revenant is immune to the <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic waters in the Plains of Eidolon at night.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_0.zhText: 在夜晚时 Revenant 对夜灵平野中的 <DT_MAGNETIC>磁性水体免疫。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_1.text: Enthralled enemies can still be damaged by Revenant and his allies. Cull the herd to keep enthralling new enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_1.zhText: 被「奴役意志」影响的敌人仍可以被 Revenant 及他的友军伤害。筛拣敌群来持续奴役更多名新敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_2.text: Enthralled enemies do not benefit from other enemy buffs while under control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_2.zhText: 受到「奴役意志」影响控制的敌人，无法获得其它敌人可获得的增益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_3.text: Cast Enthrall on an enemy that has been stunned by Mesmer Skin at no Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_3.zhText: 在被「催眠外表」震晕的敌人以无任何能量代价施放「奴役意志」！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_4.text: Cast Mesmer Skin when reviving allies to prevent damage and stun any enemies who attempt to interrupt.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_4.zhText: 在复活友军之时施放「催眠外表」来防止受到伤害并震晕任何尝试中断复活过程的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_5.text: Cast Reave while Danse Macabre is active to halve its Energy cost!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_5.zhText: 在「死亡之舞」的期间施放「精华掠夺」来将它的能量消耗减半！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_6.text: Increase Reave's travel distance with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_6.zhText: 用技能持续时间的 Mod 来增加「精华掠夺」的行进距离。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_7.text: Cast Reave onto an ally while Mesmer Skin is active to share a single charge with them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_7.zhText: 当「催眠外表」活跃之时对一名友军施放「精华掠夺」来与他们分享一层「催眠外表」充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_8.text: Cast Reave on Enthralled enemies to restore Mesmer Skin charges.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_8.zhText: 对被「奴役意志」影响的敌人施放「精华掠夺」来恢复「催眠外表」的充能数量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_9.text: Danse Macabre's beams detonate energy pillars left by Revenant's thralls. Cast Enthrall first to set up an explosive combo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Revenant_9.zhText: 「死亡之舞」的光束可以引爆 Revenant 的奴仆所遗留下来的能量柱。先施放「奴役意志」来设置一个爆炸性连击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_0.text: Rhino is immune to damage during Rhino Charge.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_0.zhText: Rhino 在「犀牛冲锋」的期间对于伤害是无敌的。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_1.text: Cast Rhino Charge on enemies that have been stunned by Stomp for more damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_1.zhText: 对被震晕的敌人施放「犀牛践踏」会造成更多的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_2.text: Cast Iron Skin before Rhino Charge to increase the <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage dealt to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_2.zhText: 在施放「犀牛冲锋」之前施放「钢化皮肤」来增加对敌人造成的 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_3.text: Cast Rhino Charge in quick succession to reduce its Energy cost and double its damage and range!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_3.zhText: 连续施放「犀牛冲锋」来减少它的能量消耗以及使它的伤害及范围加倍！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_4.text: Iron Skin prevents Status Effects such as <DT_SLASH>Slash and Knockdowns!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_4.zhText: 「钢化皮肤」可以防止异常状态比如 <DT_SLASH>切割及击倒！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_5.text: Iron Skin scales off both Ability Strength and Armor mods, and the damage absorbed when cast determines its Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_5.zhText: 「钢化皮肤」会随着技能强度和护甲 Mod 的强度而增加，并且施放之时所吸收的伤害会指定它的超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_6.text: Cast Iron Skin when taking heavy damage to convert more damage into its total Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_6.zhText: 受到大量伤害时施放「钢化皮肤」来将更多的伤害转换成它的超宏防护值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_7.text: Iron Skin's remaining Overguard total is displayed next to Rhino's Health bar, watch for when it gets low to recast when it runs out.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_7.zhText: 「钢化皮肤」剩下的超宏防护总值会显示在 Rhino 的生命值旁边，注意当它变低的时候再次重新施放它。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_8.text: Cast Roar when allies are within the Ability Radius, to ensure they do not miss out on its damage increasing benefits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_8.zhText: 当友军在技能范围之内时施放「战吼」来确保他们不会错过它增加伤害的好处

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_9.text: Keep enemies affected by Stomp suspended in the air longer with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Rhino_9.zhText: 用技能持续时间 Mod 来将被「犀牛践踏」影响的敌人更久的悬挂在半空中。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_0.text: Mach Rush's impact shockwave causes <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage and a <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect when Kinetic Plating is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_0.zhText: 当「动能镀层」启用时，「马赫冲驰」的冲击震波会造成 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害以及一个 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_1.text: Mach Rush will absorb the elements of Thermal Sunder fields it crosses through, adding damage to both the dash and impact shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_1.zhText: 使用「马赫冲驰」穿过「热能抽离」的区域将吸收元素效果，增加伤害到冲刺以及产生的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_2.text: Using Thermal Sunder to chill enemies causes those already affected by <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status to become frozen solid.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_2.zhText: 使用「热能抽离」来冷冻敌人会导致那些已经被 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻状态异常状态影响的敌人被冻结。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_3.text: Using Thermal Sunder to heat enemies causes those already affected by <DT_FIRE>Heat Status to take further damage over time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_3.zhText: 使用「热能抽离」来对敌人加热会导致那些已经被 <DT_FIRE>火焰异常状态影响的敌人随着时间受到更多的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_4.text: Casting the opposite Thermal Sunder effect on an enemy suffering <DT_FIRE>Heat or <DT_FREEZE>Cold cancels the old Status, deals <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage, and inflicts the new Status.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_4.zhText: 对一名已经受 <DT_FIRE>火焰或是 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻所折磨的敌人施放相反的「热能抽离」效果会抵消旧的异常状态并造成 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害并且施加新的异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_5.text: Mach Rush consumes half as much Energy when Redlining.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_5.zhText: 在「赤限」启动时，「马赫冲驰」只消耗一半的能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_6.text: When Redlining with Kinetic Plating active, Melee Attacks inflict Extra Damage and stagger enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_6.zhText: 当「动能镀层」启用之时进行「赤限」，近战攻击会对敌人造成额外的伤害并使它们失衡。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_7.text: Thermal Sunder gains additional properties when Redline is active. <DT_FREEZE>Cold freezes enemies solid, <DT_FIRE>Heat does additional damage, and the combined <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast will strip armor.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_7.zhText: 在「赤限」启动时，「热能抽离」会获得额外的状态效果。<DT_FREEZE>冰冻会冻结敌人，<DT_FIRE>火焰会造成额外的伤害，以及结合的 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸会削减护甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_8.text: Easily maintain Mach Rush's momentum by switching to the move forward button, then releasing the held ability button.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_8.zhText: 通过切换到前进按键，再松开按住的技能按键，就可以很轻松的维持「马赫冲驰」的动量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_9.text: Gauss can jump from the ground while running in Mach Rush without cancelling the dash.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Runner_9.zhText: 在「马赫冲驰」的奔跑过程中，Gauss 可以在不取消冲刺的情况下进行跳跃。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_0.text: The more Inaros dies, the more hits on enemies are required to revive him. Staying alive will reduce that number over time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_0.zhText: Inaros 死亡次数越多，复活所需击中敌人的次数就越多。所需次数会随着存活时间逐渐减少。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_1.text: When downed, find an enemy that can survive multiple hits to revive Inaros quickly!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_1.zhText: 倒下时，寻找一个能承受多次攻击的敌人来快速复活 Inaros！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_2.text: Attacks from Inaros’ Swarm Kavats contribute to his revival progress.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_2.zhText: Inaros 的「 库娃群」攻击有助于他的复活进程。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_3.text: Cast Desiccation while enemies are facing Inaros to blind them, then use a melee Finisher to regain health!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_3.zhText: 当敌人面对 Inaros 时，施放「枯沙竭血」使他们致盲，然后使用近战处决击杀来恢复生命值！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_4.text: Sandstorm is a great way to get out of desperate situations, healing Inaros and making him invulnerable while active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_4.zhText: 「吞天沙暴」是脱离困境的好方法，它能治愈 Inaros 并在激活期间赋予他无敌状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_5.text: Sandstorm can be ended early by casting it a second time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_5.zhText: 可通过再次施放「吞天沙暴」来提前结束它。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_6.text: Each Status Effect absorbed by Scarab Shell drains 5% of the charged Armor.  Rebuild this protection by recasting the ability!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_6.zhText: 每个「圣甲虫护壳」吸收的异常状态都会消耗 5% 的充能护甲。通过重新施放技能来重建这种保护！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_7.text: Regain Health consumed by Scarab Shell by casting Sandstorm on a large group of enemies, or using finishers enabled by Desiccation.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sandman_7.zhText: 通过对一大群敌人施放「 吞天沙暴」，或者使用「 枯沙竭血」的处决，来恢复「圣甲虫护壳 」所消耗的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_0.text: Saryn can spread Spores by killing enemies under the effects of Miasma, killing enemies with Molt's explosion, or attacking them while Toxic Lash is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_0.zhText: Saryn 的「毒性孢子」可以通过击杀处于「瘴气」负面效果中的敌人、通过「蜕皮」的爆炸击杀敌人，或在「剧毒鞭笞」激活期间攻击敌人来传播。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_1.text: Combine Toxic Lash with area of effect weapons to spread Spores effectively.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_1.zhText: 结合「剧毒鞭笞」和范围影响武器来更有效地撒播「毒性孢子」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_2.text: Cast Molt to give Saryn a brief Movement Speed boost to escape danger or catch up to enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_2.zhText: 施放「蜕皮」来短暂提升 Saryn 的移动速度，来逃离危险或赶上敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_3.text: Increase Molt's Movement Speed boost and initial Health with Ability Strength Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_3.zhText: 使用技能强度类 Mod 来提升「蜕皮」带来的移动速度加成以及其初始生命值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_4.text: Recast Molt to detonate it and deal <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage to nearby enemies and spread Spores if the explosion kills them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_4.zhText: 重新施放「蜕皮」来将其引爆，并对附近的敌人造成 <DT_POISON>的毒素伤害，敌人被引爆杀死的同时会传播「毒性孢子」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_5.text: Cast Molt while under heavy fire to convert incoming damage to Health for Saryn's decoy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_5.zhText: 在承受猛烈的火力下施放「蜕皮」，把来袭的伤害转化为 Saryn 诱饵的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_6.text: Cast Molt to protect Saryn from enemy fire while reviving fallen teammates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_6.zhText: 在复活倒地的队友时，施放「蜕皮」可以保护 Saryn 免受敌人的火力攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_7.text: Maximize Spores' <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage by inflicting enemies with multiple casts.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_7.zhText: 通过对敌人多次施放该技能，来最大限度地增加「毒性孢子」的 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_8.text: Recast Miasma to refresh the <DT_VIRAL>Viral Status Effect on previously affected enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_8.zhText: 重新施放「瘴气」，来刷新已经受到影响的敌人身上的 <DT_VIRAL>病毒异常状态！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_9.text: Cast Molt to strip Saryn of all Status Effects and any attack that can latch onto her like latchers from Grineer Seekers and Nox's toxic sludge.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Saryn_9.zhText: 施放「蜕皮」来削减 Saryn 的所有异常状态，以及任何能够攀附在她身上的攻击：例如 Grineer 追踪者的粘子炸弹和毒化者的剧毒软泥。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_0.text: Caliban’s abilities can inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effects, which increases Status Chance Vulnerability on the enemy by 10% and up to 10 times. Each Status Effect lasts for 8s.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_0.zhText: Caliban 的技能可以造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态，使受影响敌人的异常状态易受性增加 10%，最多可叠加 10 层。每层异常状态持续 8 秒。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_1.text: When Caliban is at max Health, Razor Gyre will convert any additional Health into Shields. If Shields are at max, he gains Overshields!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_1.zhText: 当 Caliban 在满血状态下，「刀锋环流」会将任何额外生命值转换为护盾。如果护盾值全满，他将获得过载护盾！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_2.text: Razor Gyre will refund 25% of its Energy cost for each enemy hit. Make sure to hit as many enemies as possible while using it!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_2.zhText: 「刀锋环流」每击中一个敌人，将返还 25% 的能量消耗。使用该技能时，一定要尽可能多地击中敌人！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_3.text: Cast Sentient Wrath to hold surviving enemies in place before aiming Fusion Strike’s beams at them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_3.zhText: 在将「融合打击」的光束瞄准存活下来的敌人之前，可以先施放「Sentient 之怒」来把他们固定在原地。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_4.text: Sentient Wrath can be recast while already active to reset the ability duration on affected enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_4.zhText: 「Sentient 之怒」可以在激活期间重新施放，以重置受影响敌人的技能持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_5.text: Ortholysts’ default weapon has 100% Status Chance, guaranteeing <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effects. Take advantage of its Status Chance Vulnerability and shower affected enemies with damage.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_5.zhText: 直垂使的默认武器具有 100% 触发几率，并必定造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。利用其容易造成异常状态的特点，对受影响的敌人造成大量伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_6.text: Summulyst and its Choralyst summons have high target prioritization, meaning enemies target them whenever possible. Use this to protect yourself and allies when a mission gets overwhelming.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_6.zhText: 召唤使及其召唤的唱鸣使具有较高的目标优先级，这意味着敌人会尽可能地以它们为目标。当任务变得艰难时，利用它们保护自己和友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_7.text: Conculysts will also Fusion Strike when the ability is cast by Caliban. Paired with their offensive capabilities, these Sentients are the best choice for stripping defenses and clearing rooms with sheer force.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_7.zhText: 当 Caliban 施放「融合打击」时，震荡使也会使出该技能。结合这些 Sentient 的攻击能力，它们是凭借纯粹的力量削弱防御和清空区域的最佳选择。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_8.text: Caliban is invulnerable while casting Fusion Strike.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Sentient_8.zhText: Caliban 在施放「融合打击」时会处于无敌状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Sirius & Orion are modded separately and benefit from different stats.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: Sirius & Orion 根据不同状态分别装配相应的 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Whichever of the two you are not controlling will continue to fight and cast abilities independently.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 你未操控的另一名角色将继续自动战斗并施放技能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: You can swap whether Sirius or Orion is your default Warframe at the crib in Pontis Tower, after completing the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 完成《Jade 之影：众星》系列任务后，你可以在渡界之塔的婴儿床上切换 Sirius 或 Orion 作为你的默认战甲。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Gravitic Slash can be aimed up or down to hit enemies above and below Orion.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 「重力斩」可以向上或向下瞄准，攻击 Orion 上方和下方的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Coronal Ejection, Gravitic Slash, and Celestial Clash will fire Jade Stars for each enemy hit, making them deadlier to use!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 「日冕抛射」、「重力斩」和「天体冲突」会在击中每个敌人时施放「翠玉之星」，使其威力更大！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Jade Stars and Astral Shell are applied to both Sirius and Orion when casted.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 施放时，「翠玉之星」和「星壳」会同时应用于 Sirius 和 Orion。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Recasting Light's Sanctuary in the well of light will refresh the duration without changing the well's position.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 在光之井中重新施放「光之圣域」，可以刷新持续时间，但光之井的位置不会改变。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Redirecting Orion's Event Horizon with his Gravitic Slash or Sirius' Coronal Ejection also increases its duration.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 使用「重力斩」改变 Orion 的「事件视界」，或使用 Sirius 的「日冕抛射」增加其持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Swapping back and forth in Celestial Clash significantly increases Sirius & Orion's Critical Chance. Successfully matching all 7 Constellation Stars while using Celestial Clash will result in a special final attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 在「天体冲突」中来回切换可以显著提高 Sirius & Orion 的暴击几率。在使用「天体冲突」时成功匹配全部 7 颗众星，将触发特殊的最后一击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: Tap Dodge during Celestial Clash to teleport in the direction you are moving.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 在「天体冲突」施放期间点击闪躲即可向你移动的方向传送。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.text: There is a brief moment of invulnerability when swapping between Sirius & Orion. Use this to avoid dangerous attacks.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SiriusOrio.zhText: 在 Sirius & Orion 之间切换时，会有一段短暂的无敌效果。利用这段时间可以躲避危险的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Your Cryobell's Personal Bind applies in-mission regardless of which Cryobell was selected by the Squad.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: 无论小队选择了哪个冰珠铃，你的冰珠铃个人羁绊都会在任务期间生效。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Mission Binds alter the theme of the Icebind and introduce gameplay elements to play around.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: 任务羁绊改变了冰封羁绊的主题，并设定相应的游戏玩法挑战。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Cryo Cores deal escalating damage to health and invulnerability, so trade the core between players to disarm it safely.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Cryo Cores deal escalating damage to health and invulnerability, so trade the core between players to disarm it safely.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Lockbox Cyphers drop from killed enemies when the objective is active. Once all cyphers have been collected, stand near the chest until it has completely unlocked.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Lockbox Cyphers drop from killed enemies when the objective is active. Once all cyphers have been collected, stand near the chest until it has completely unlocked.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Before you extract, use your keys to open chests in the Treasure Room to earn extra rewards.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Before you extract, use your keys to open chests in the Treasure Room to earn extra rewards.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: If you fail a mission, you keep your Cryobell. Cryobells are only consumed upon mission extraction!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: If you fail a mission, you keep your Cryobell. Cryobells are only consumed upon mission extraction!

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Mission Vote does not begin until all players have selected a Cryobell. Take time to review your options before the vote starts, and plan your loadout accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Mission Vote does not begin until all players have selected a Cryobell. Take time to review your options before the vote starts, and plan your loadout accordingly.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Gather at the side objective waypoint to begin the task. The objective text will list what players are missing before the task can be started.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Gather at the side objective waypoint to begin the task. The objective text will list what players are missing before the task can be started.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Active side objectives will pause mission extraction until they are successfully completed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Active side objectives will pause mission extraction until they are successfully completed.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Failing a side objective fails the mission, so only attempt them if you want to take the risk for additional rewards.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Failing a side objective fails the mission, so only attempt them if you want to take the risk for additional rewards.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Side objectives reward Frozen Keys, which unlock extra rewards.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: Side objectives reward Frozen Keys, which unlock extra rewards.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: Indomitable Ice takes the most damage from precision weaponry. Help your teammates by focusing on crystals that aren't being fired at.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: 坚韧冰晶容易受到精准武器的伤害。集中火力射击未受损的水晶，以协助小队。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: The ground around the Entropy Orb is dangerous. Look for signs of where you can safely stand while remaining close to the orb.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: The ground around the Entropy Orb is dangerous. Look for signs of where you can safely stand while remaining close to the orb.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.text: The Signal Chain side objective can go through obstacles, even floors! A chain effect will appear to indicate you are close enough to form a connection.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/SixStackSe.zhText: The Signal Chain side objective can go through obstacles, even floors! A chain effect will appear to indicate you are close enough to form a connection.

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.text: Use the Pledge button to choose a Syndicate to gain 15% Standing while playing missions.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.zhText: 在执行任务时，使用效忠按钮选择一个集团来获得 15% 的声望值转化率。
