/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.text: Syndicates have a unique relationship between one another - they can be allied, opposed, or enemies. Supporting one Syndicate will affect Standing with related Syndicates. Join multiple Syndicates that work together for faster Standing gain.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.zhText: 集团之间有着独特的关系－他们可以是友军、对立、或是敌人。支持一个集团将影响与之相关集团的声望值。加入多个有一起合作的集团来更快速获取声望值。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.text: Search Syndicate missions carefully for Medallions unique to each faction; these can be turned in for additional standing at any Relay.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.zhText: 仔细搜索集团任务来获得每个集团特有的奖章；这些奖章可以在任意中继站兑换来获得额外的声望。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.text: Most Syndicate Offerings, such as faction-modified weapons, can be traded with players from other Syndicates.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Syndicate_.zhText: 大部分的集团贡品，比如派系改造武器，可以拿来与来自其他集团的玩家交易。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_0.text: Try casting all of Temple's abilities on the Backbeat to gain bonus effects and conserve Energy during a live performance.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_0.zhText: 尝试随着反拍的节奏施放 Temple 的技能，以获得加成效果并在现场演出期间节省能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_1.text: Pyrotechnics will detonate in a radius from where you are currently aiming. The <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat pillars can reach enemies behind Temple if your target is close by.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_1.zhText: 「烟火」会在你当前瞄准位置的范围内爆炸。如果你的目标在附近，<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火柱甚至可以到达 Temple 背后的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_2.text: Each new <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effect will cause the enemy to panic. Chain Pyrotechnics casts to keep the room locked down while stacking damage and charging your Exalted Solo.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_2.zhText: 每当造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态都会使敌人陷入恐慌。连续施放「烟火」以封锁区域，同时叠加伤害并为你的「显赫独奏」充能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_3.text: Overdrive affects enemies in front of Temple, making it ideal for high priority targets you want taken down quickly.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_3.zhText: 「超负荷」会影响 Temple 前方的敌人，非常适合迅速解决高优先级目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_4.text: Overdrive’s Critical Chance Vulnerability is not dependent on the Critical Chance of the weapon, making it best paired with any weapon that has a high Critical Damage multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_4.zhText: 「超负荷」的暴击几率易伤性并不依赖于武器的暴击几率，这使得它最适合与任何具有高暴击伤害倍率的武器搭配使用。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_5.text: Temple is invulnerable while casting Ripper’s Wail, giving you time to reassess the situation in an emergency.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_5.zhText: Temple 在施放「撕裂者之嚎」时处于无敌状态，让你有时间在紧急情况下重新评估形势。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_6.text: Casting abilities to damage enemies on the Backbeat while Ripper’s Wail is active will increase the <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage it offers, while also extending the duration of the ability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_6.zhText: 在「撕裂者之嚎」激活期间，随着反拍节奏施放技能以对敌人造成伤害，将增加其造成的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，同时延长技能的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_7.text: Ripper’s Wail buff decays slowly when the ability expires. Recast while the buff is active to refresh the duration and retain your accumulated <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_7.zhText: 「撕裂者之嚎」增益效果会在技能失效时缓慢衰减。在增益效果生效期间重新施放可刷新持续时间并保留你累积的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_8.text: Exalted Solo is charged by casting abilities on the Backbeat. It can even be recharged while active - for when the show must go on!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_8.zhText: 可随着反拍节奏施放「显赫独奏」以进行充能。它甚至可以在使用时充能——确保演出可以顺利进行！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_9.text: When aiming with Lizzie during Exalted Solo, Temple’s ability inputs will shoot solid walls of sound, inflicting guaranteed Status Effects depending on the input.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Temple_9.zhText: 当在「显赫独奏」期间使用丽兹瞄准时，Temple 的技能键将发射实体音墙，根据技能键的输入必定造成异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_0.text: While using Tail Wind's flight mode, you can stay airborne as long as you have energy.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_0.zhText: 在使用「顺风」的飞行模式时，只要有能量，你就可以保持空中飞行。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_1.text: Cast Tail Wind in short burst to quickly travel across the Plains of Eidolon and the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_1.zhText: 在夜灵平野和奥布山谷中连续使用「顺风」技能来快速进行长距离移动。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_2.text: Cast Tail Wind's Dive bomb at greater heights to increase the damage dealt on impact.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_2.zhText: 在高处发动「顺风」技能的俯冲轰炸攻击能提升其落地时造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_3.text: Cast Tail Wind and Airburst while Zephyr is Airborne to decrease their Energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_3.zhText: 在浮空状态下，施展「顺风」和空爆技能所消耗的能量会降低。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_4.text: Tornadoes transfer allied Weapon Damage to each enemy held in Zephyr's Tornadoes. Fire powerful weapons into them to deal massive damage to the group of captured enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_4.zhText: 「龙卷云风」会将友方武器伤害转移到每个被困在 Zephyr「龙卷云风」里的敌人身上。使用强大火力的武器对其进行射击，就能对受困的敌人造成巨大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_5.text: Cast Turbulence while hovering above enemies to attack them with added protection from their projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_5.zhText: 当悬浮于敌人之上时施展「疾风湍流」技能，就能在攻击敌人的同时防御敌方投射物。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_6.text: Hold to cast a wandering Tornado and command the direction it travels by aiming down sights at it and then moving the reticle to a desired location.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_6.zhText: 长按来施放一个游走的「龙卷云风」，可通过右键瞄准「龙卷云风」，然后把准星移动到指定位置来控制「龙卷云风」的移动方向。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_7.text: Zephyr's Tornadoes inflict the Elemental damage type based on which type is in the majority of the damage absorbed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_7.zhText: Zephyr 的「龙卷云风」所施加的元素伤害类型是根据其吸收最多的伤害类型所决定。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_8.text: Each of Zephyr's Tornados can have different Elemental damage types.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Tengu_8.zhText: Zephyr 的每个「龙卷云风」都能拥有不同的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_0.text: Vauban's Abilities travel in an arc, aim higher to throw farther!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_0.zhText: Vauban 的技能会沿弧线飞行，想要丢得远，就往高处扔吧！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_1.text: Deploy multiple Tesla Nervos drones at once by fully charging the ability cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_1.zhText: 通过长按技能键，来一次性部署多个「特斯拉电激无人机」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_2.text: Each Tesla Nervos drone has a limited number of charges before it must be replaced.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_2.zhText: 每一架特斯拉电激无人机都有有限的充电次数，次数用完后必须更换。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_3.text: Minelayer's Tether-Flechette orb can be attached to walls and ceilings. Use this to create clever traps for your enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_3.zhText: 「布雷器」的桎梏飞掷丸可以吸附在墙壁和天花板上。利用它为你的敌人设置巧妙的陷阱！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_4.text: Use Vector-Overdrive pads to give allies a burst of speed or to push enemies away from important mission objectives.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_4.zhText: 使用「矢量超载垫」来为友军提供瞬时加速，或是把敌人推离重要的任务目标。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_5.text: Photon Strike works best when enemies are grouped together by abilities like Bastille's Vortex and the Tether-Flechette orb.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_5.zhText: 当敌人被类似「力场牢狱的漩涡」和「桎梏飞掷丸」这样的技能拉聚在一起时，「光子轰击」能发挥出最大的威力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_6.text: Cast Bastille around Defense objectives and downed allies to protect them.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_6.zhText: 在防御目标和倒地的友军周围施放「力场牢狱」来保护他们。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_7.text: Hold cast Bastille to deploy a vortex instead, or to collapse all Bastilles that have already been deployed.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_7.zhText: 长按「力场牢狱」技能键来释放一个旋涡，或是使所有已部署的「力场牢狱」坍塌。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_8.text: Stand inside Bastille to gain Armor from trapped enemies. Gain an increased amount when stripping Armor from enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_8.zhText: 站在「力场牢狱」内可以从被困敌人身上获得护甲。剥离敌人护甲时获得的护甲值更多。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_9.text: Damage from both Minelayer and Photon Strike scale with enemy level.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trapper_9.zhText: 「布雷器」和「光子轰击」造成的伤害都会随着敌人等级的提升而增加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_0.text: Cast Well of Life or Energy Vampire on high priority targets to take them out of battle by suspending them in the air.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_0.zhText: 对重点目标施展「生命之井」或「能量吸取」技能来限制其行动，使他们无法参与战斗。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_1.text: Recasting Well of Life releases the oldest enemy when at max targets.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_1.zhText: 当目标数达到最大时，重新施放「生命之井」会释放最早被控制的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_2.text: Kill an enemy marked by Energy Vampire to immediately transfer all of its remaining Energy reserves to nearby allies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_2.zhText: 击杀被「能量吸取」技能标记的敌人，即可让技能剩余的能量储备瞬间传输至周围的队友身上！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_3.text: Increasing Ability Duration will cause Energy Vampire targets to release additional pulses, granting more total Energy from each target.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_3.zhText: 增加技能持续时间将导致「能量吸取」目标释放额外的脉冲，从而从每个目标中获得更多的总能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_4.text: Cast Energy Vampire to replenish Trinity's Energy pool before casting her other abilities.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_4.zhText: 在施展其他技能前，使用「能量吸取」技能来让 Trinity 恢复足够的能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_5.text: Link redirects enemy Status Effects back towards linked enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_5.zhText: 「链接」技能可以将敌人施加的异常状态转移至被连接的敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_6.text: Use Link tethers to track down nearby enemies through walls!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_6.zhText: 利用「链接」技能所产生的能量弧来追踪墙壁后面的敌人吧！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_7.text: Blessing applies to Drones and other non-player allies within Affinity range. Healing also applies to Defense objectives, Excavators and other defendable objects, at a diminished rate.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_7.zhText: 「祝福」适用于经验共享范围内的无人机和其他非玩家友军。治疗也适用于防御目标、挖掘机和其他可防御物体，但治疗速度会降低。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_8.text: Cast Blessing within the Shared Affinity Range to benefit all allies. Use the Player List to see who is currently within range at the time of casting.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Trinity_8.zhText: 施放「祝福」恢复在经验分享范围内的队友。利用玩家列表查看在范围内的玩家决定施放时机。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_0.text: Cast Speed to cover distance quickly and rapidly build Damage for Volt's passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_0.zhText: 使用「加速」技能来快速移动并为 Volt 的被动技能积累伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_1.text: Cast Shock on priority target to temporarily stun them and open an opportunity for attack.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_1.zhText: 对重点目标施展「电击」技能来使其短暂眩晕，同时为接下来的攻击创造契机。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_10.text: Cast Shock on an Electric Shield to electrify it, causing it to deal <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage to enemies that pass through it.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_10.zhText: 施放「电击」使「电力屏障」通电，经过屏障的敌人会受到 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_11.text: Allies within range of Volt when Speed is cast will also benefit, but can backflip if they wish to opt-out of its effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_11.zhText: 施放「加速」时，处于 Volt 附近的队友也将受益，但如果他们想取消这个效果，可以通过后空翻来实现。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_2.text: Cast Shock on an enemy affected by Discharge to release an electric burst to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_2.zhText: 对受到「电能释放」技能效果影响的敌人施展「电击」技能，使其向周围敌人爆发电能。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_3.text: Electric Shield increases the Critical Damage of weapons fired through it!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_3.zhText: 武器射出的子弹在穿过「电力屏障」后，其暴击伤害会得到提升！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_4.text: Cast and shoot through multiple Electric Shields to stack the <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage from each shield.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_4.zhText: 每当技能和武器投射物通过「电力屏障」，就能从每个屏障累积 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_5.text: Cast multiple Electric Shields around a defense point to protect it from all angles.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_5.zhText: 在防守点周围布下多道「电力屏障」来抵御从自各个角度袭来的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_6.text: Pick up Volt's Electric Shield to be used as mobile cover while on the move. Sprint into enemies to knock them over!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_6.zhText: 拾起 Volt 的「电力屏障」后，即可将其作为携带掩体来使用。若在此时冲入敌群之中，还能将敌人击倒！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_7.text: Cast Shock and Discharge on a tightly packed group of enemies to chain the stun from <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity's Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_7.zhText: 对集中在一起的敌人施展电击和「电能释放」技能来让 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击异常状态的眩晕效果在敌人身上传递。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_8.text: Stun enemies affected by Discharge longer with Ability Duration Mods.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Volt_8.zhText: 利用技能持续时间类 Mod 来延长「电能释放」技能眩晕敌人的时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_0.text: Each of Voruna's wolves provide a specific passive when the respective ability button is held. Swap effects depending on the combat situation.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_0.zhText: 按住相应的技能键时，Voruna 的每只狼会提供一个特定的被动技能。根据战况所需切换技能效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.text: Use Shroud of Dynar's invisibility to reposition Voruna before starting her deadly offense.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.zhText: 使用「戴拿之幕」提供的隐身效果，在 Voruna 展开致命进攻之前调整位置。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.text: Recasting Ulfrun's Descent to cancel the ability early will provide a partial Energy refund.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.zhText: 重新施放「乌尔佛伦之裔」来提前取消该技能将会返还部分能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.text: Voruna gains a Movement Speed increase while using Ulfrun's Descent to help hunt her prey.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_1.zhText: Voruna 在使用「乌尔佛伦之裔」来帮助追捕猎物时，移动速度会提高。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_2.text: Shroud of Dynar's melee buff is extended upon melee kill. Stalk a weak target and strike with lethal force for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_2.zhText: 近战击杀会延长「戴拿之幕」近战增益的持续时间。跟踪一个弱小的目标并对其致命打击以获得最大效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_3.text: Fangs of Raksh can help weaken a specific target to guarantee a quick kill, which is useful for triggering Shroud of Dynar's melee buff.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_3.zhText: 「亚克什之牙」可以协助削弱特定目标以保证快速击杀，进而用来触发「戴拿之幕」的近战增益。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_4.text: Shroud of Dynar's buff will only be extended if you earn a Melee kill within 3 seconds of exiting invisibility. Be precise and strike true.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_4.zhText: 若想延长「戴拿之幕」的增益效果，必须在解除隐身状态后的 3 秒内完成近战击杀。出手还需稳准狠。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_5.text: Take advantage of Fangs of Raksh's Status Effects by equipping Voruna with weapons and Mods that do more damage to enemies inflicted with several Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_5.zhText: 为了更好的利用「亚克什之牙」造成的异常状态，可以为 Voruna 装备对多重异常状态下的敌人造成额外伤害的武器和 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_6.text: Lycath's Hunt provides ample Health orbs when utilizing Voruna's vicious melee expertise. Equip her with upgrades (Mods, Arcanes, etc.) that offer bonuses from these orbs to maximize the ability's effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_6.zhText: 「莱卡斯之猎」可以在 Voruna 利用她残暴的近战专长时提供充足数量的生命球。为她配备可以从生命球中获得收益的升级装备（Mod、赋能等等），来将此技能的效果最大化。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_7.text: More precise hunters may want to choose pinpoint weapons that can easily land headshots, and upgrades (Mods, Arcanes, etc.) that utilize orbs for buffs to maximize Lycath's Hunt Energy orb production.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_7.zhText: 枪法更好的猎手可以选用易于爆头的定点式武器，以及利用掉落球获得增益的升级装备（Mod、赋能等），来最大程度的提高「莱卡斯之猎」的能量球产出。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_8.text: All of Voruna's abilities can be cast while Ulfrun's Descent is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_8.zhText: Voruna 的所有技能都可以在「乌尔佛伦之裔」激活时施放。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_9.text: Attacks using Ulfrun's Descent do not break the stealth provided by Shroud of Dynar.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Werewolf_9.zhText: 使用「乌尔佛伦之裔」发出的攻击不会打破「戴拿之幕」提供的隐身效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_0.text: Six Reservoirs of any type can be active at a time. Summoning a Reservoir while at max will replace the oldest one.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_0.zhText: 同时可启动六个任何类型的「储能池」。达数量最大值时，召唤「储能池」将取代最旧的「储能池」。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_1.text: Only one of each Mote is capable of attaching to Wisp and her allies at any given time.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_1.zhText: 在任何时间，只能有一种尘埃连结至 Wisp 和她的友军。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_2.text: Reset the duration of a Mote by stepping into the area surrounding a Reservoir of the same type - stay within it to keep it active for longer!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_2.zhText: 通过进入一个相同类型的「储能池」周围的区域来重置一个尘埃的持续时间，停留在它之中使其持续的时间更长！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_3.text: Cast Breach Surge while Wil-O-Wisp is active to trigger another surge at its location.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_3.zhText: 在「幻影鬼火」激活期间时，施放「裂口涌流」以在幻影的位置引发另一次涌流。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_4.text: Increase Wil-O-Wisp's travel distance with Duration mods!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_4.zhText: 持续时间 Mod 可以增加「幻影鬼火」的行进距离！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_5.text: Motes attached to Wisp alter the power of Sol Gate! Vitality and Shock Motes increase its damage by 25% each, and Haste adds a Corrosive Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_5.zhText: 连接 Wisp 的尘埃可以改变「太阳之门」的力量！每个活力和震荡尘埃提高 25% 伤害，而急速尘埃可增加腐蚀异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_6.text: Cast Wil-O-Wisp while Sol Gate is active to draw enemies away from Wisp and allow for a strategic repositioning of the beam.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_6.zhText: 在「太阳之门」启动时，施放「幻影鬼火」转移敌人对 Wisp 的注意，提供重新变换其光束的战略位置

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_7.text: Attacking enemies while in the air makes Wisp visible again, regardless of her passive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_7.zhText: 无论 Wisp 的被动技能是否生效，在空中攻击敌人都会使她现形。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_8.text: Increase Wisp's Movement Speed while Sol Gate is active by Dodging.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wisp_8.zhText: Wisp 使用「太阳之门」时，可借由闪避动作加快移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_0.text: Sevagoth’s Shadow has a limited amount of time to revive Sevagoth when he is downed. Shadow’s Consume ability becomes far more deadly during this time to collect the required souls to revive.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_0.zhText: 当 Sevagoth 倒下时，Sevagoth 的幽影可以在限定时间内复活他。在这段时间内，幽影的「亡魂吞噬」技能会变得更加致命，以收集复活所需要的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_1.text: Aim down sights after casting Reap to direct Sevagoth’s Shadow for the duration it is active.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_1.zhText: 在施放「收割」后，通过右键的瞄准模式，来在 Sevagoth 幽影的活动期间对其进行引导。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_10.text: Reuniting Sevagoth's Shadow with Sevagoth restores some of his Health. The longer they are separated, the greater the healing from Reunite.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_10.zhText: 通过重聚 Sevagoth 和他的幽影，来恢复 Sevagoth 的一部分生命值。他和幽影分离得越久，施放「重聚」时可恢复的生命值就越多。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_2.text: The slowing effect of Gloom scales with Ability Strength mods and stacks with other slowing effects, like <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage's Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_2.zhText: 「惨淡」的减速效果受技能强度 Mod 的影响，并可与其他减速效果（例如<DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害的异常状态）叠加。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_3.text: Sevagoth's Shadow can perform all Melee attacks and uses both the Melee and Fire Weapon inputs to do so.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_3.zhText: Sevagoth 的幽影能够进行各种近战攻击，可使用近战武器和射击武器按键来发动攻击。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_4.text: Sevagoth's Shadow can be activated once the Death Well is at least 75% full.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_4.zhText: 将「死亡之井」至少注满 75% 来激活 Sevagoth 的幽影。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_5.text: Sevagoth's Shadow will remain active until it is killed, the Death Well drains completely, or when Reunite is cast.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_5.zhText: Sevagoth 的幽影会在「死亡之井」完全耗尽，或是其被杀死前一直保持活跃状态；施放「重聚」也会使 Sevagoth 的幽影不再活跃。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_6.text: Sevagoth's Shadow and its weapon can be separately modded in the Arsenal. Auras, Arcanes, and Set Mods equipped on Sevagoth do not apply to his Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_6.zhText: Sevagoth 的幽影及其武器在军械库有独立的配置。Sevagoth 战甲上装备的赋能、光环 Mod，以及组合 Mod 不会被应用到他的幽影上。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_7.text: Cast Embrace with Sevagoth's Shadow to set up group melee kills or to pull enemies into range for Death's Harvest.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_7.zhText: 作为 Sevagoth 的幽影来施放「幽影之拥」，以达成群体近战击杀，或是将敌人拖进「死亡收割」的技能范围。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_8.text: Cast Consume in Sevagoth's Shadow without a target for added horizontal mobility.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_8.zhText: 作为 Sevagoth 的幽影，在不瞄准任何目标的情况下施放「亡魂吞噬」，以增加水平方向的移动能力。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_9.text: Minimize Sevagoth Shadow’s downtime by casting Death’s Harvest to infect enemies before switching back to Sevagoth to kill affected enemies and fill the Death Well.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Wraith_9.zhText: 通过施放「死亡收割」来感染敌人，然后再切回到 Sevagoth 来击杀受影响的敌人并填满「死亡之井」，从而最大限度地减少 Sevagoth 幽影不可用的时间。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_0.text: Yareli's Passive activates both on foot and when riding Merulina. Equip a Secondary weapon with high Critical stats to maximize the bonus.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_0.zhText: Yareli 的被动技能在步行和骑乘「浪漪珊瑚」时都会启用。装备一把具有高暴击属性的次要武器来最大化获取加成。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_1.text: Yareli can have up to 15 Sea Snare globules active at a time. Casting more than 15 causes the earliest globules to pop.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_1.zhText: Yareli 最多可以同时有 15 个「深海诱陷」球体处于激活状态。施放超过 15 个球体会导致最早生成的球体爆裂。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_2.text: Sea Snare globules can be cast without a target and will linger for a limited amount of time until enemies are in range. This can be used to set up traps for unsuspecting enemies!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_2.zhText: 「深海诱陷」的球体可以在没有目标的情况下施放，并且它会持续一段时间，直到有敌人进入它的范围内。可以借此来对毫无防备的敌人设下陷阱！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_3.text: Merulina is key to Yareli's survival, reducing incoming damage and keeping her mobile. The ability lasts until it runs out of health or until you dismount by recasting the ability or pressing the melee button.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_3.zhText: 「浪漪珊瑚」是 Yareli 生存的关键，它可以减少来袭的伤害并使她保持灵活机动。技能一直持续到它的生命值耗尽，或是直至你通过重新施放技能或按下近战攻击键来从中跳下。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_4.text: Merulina can perform double jumps that can reach great heights and does not ragdoll Yareli if she’s knocked off.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_4.zhText: 「浪漪珊瑚」可以进行二段跳来到达很高的高度，并且它可以让 Yareli 在被击倒时不进入布娃娃状态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_5.text: Aquablades inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects to clear out weaker enemies. Stronger enemies that are not taken down are staggered by Aquablades, making it ideal for crowd control.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_5.zhText: 「水形之刃」会造成 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态来清除较弱的敌人，没有被击倒的较强敌人会因为「水形之刃」的攻击而失去平衡。这使该技能成为群体控制的理想选择。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_6.text: Riptide can temporarily incapacitate many enemies while also grouping them together for follow-up attacks or melee finishers!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_6.zhText: 「激流漩涌」可以使许多敌人暂时失去战斗力，同时还可以将他们聚集在一起，以进行后续的攻击或近战终结！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_7.text: Casting Sea Snares on enemies before Riptide will keep them trapped in globules if they survive the blow.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_7.zhText: 在施放「激流漩涌」之前先对敌人施放「深海诱陷」，如果他们能活过「激流漩涌」，那么他们还是会被困在球体内。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_8.text: Recasting Riptide while the ability is active will detonate it early. Holding the initial cast will detonate it immediately.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/Yareli_8.zhText: 在技能激活时再次施放「激流漩涌」将会使其提前爆炸。初始施放时一直按住则会立即引爆。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_0.text: Select bright Emissive Colors to default Equinox to her Day Form when entering missions, or dark Emissive Colors for her Night Form.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_0.zhText: 在进入任务时，选择 Equinox 亮色的放射色彩预设为白昼形态，或暗色的放射色彩为她的黑夜形态。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_1.text: Metamorphosis to Equinox's Day Form to receive increased Weapon Damage and Movement Speed!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_1.zhText: 使用「昼夜交替」技能到 Equinox 的白昼形态来提升武器伤害和移动速度！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_2.text: Metamorphosis' buffs decay over time. Switch forms often to maximize their effects.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_2.zhText: 「昼夜交替」技能的加成会随着时间而衰减。经常切换形态来最大化她们的效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_3.text: In Equinox's Night Form, Rest's sleeping effect makes it easier to pick off enemies while Mend is active, increasing its regenerating effect to allies.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_3.zhText: 在 Equinox 的黑夜形态时，「暂息」的睡眠效果在「补愈」被激活时能让她更容易一个个干掉敌人，并且会提升给队友的再生效果。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_4.text: Switch to Equinox's Night Form with Metamorphosis for a quick burst of Shield replenishing!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_4.zhText: 使用「昼夜交替」切换至 Equinox 的黑夜型态，能快速恢复大量护盾！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_5.text: Cast Rage while Provoke is active to increase enemy damage vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_5.zhText: 在「激怒」时，施放「怒气」可以增加敌人对伤害的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_6.text: Enemies closest to Equinox while Pacify is active receive higher Damage Reduction!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_6.zhText: 当「轻抚」被激活时，越接近 Equinox 的敌人造成的伤害被削减的越多！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_7.text: Metamorphosis to Equinox's Night Form, while Provoke is active to apply its bonus Ability Strength to the temporary Armor and Shield, gained from switching forms!
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_7.zhText: 「昼夜交替」为 Equinox 的黑夜形态时，在「激怒」时将增加额外的临时护甲和护盾技能强度，从切换形式中获得！

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_8.text: Pacify and Provoke drain Equinox's Energy only when enemies are within range.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_8.zhText: 只有当敌人在范围内时，「轻抚－激怒」才会消耗 Equinox 的能量。

/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_9.text: Recast Maim and discharge all stored damage to break nearby containers and resource deposits.
/Lotus/Language/WarframeHints/YinYang_9.zhText: 再次施放「致残」释放所有储存的伤害以破坏附近的资源箱和资源矿藏。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/1999EntHybridPis.text: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/1999EntHybridPis.text: Blueprint and components for the Riot-848 weapon are acquired from the Solstice Square Defense mission in Höllvania, or can be purchased from Flare Varleon in Höllvania Central Mall. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/1999EntHybridPis.zhText: 暴乱-848 武器的主要蓝图和部件蓝图可从霍瓦尼亚至日广场的防御任务中获取，也可以从霍瓦尼亚中央商场的弗莱尔·瓦莱昂处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AK47WeaponDesc.text: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AK47WeaponDesc.zhText: （英文：AX-52）这款前奥罗金时代的武器因其在恶劣条件下的可靠性而广受欢迎。腰射时，弹药效率会提高。瞄准时，爆头有极高的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AckAndBruntIncar.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有在空中和滑行攻击时发出一把光谱战斧的能力。
认知 & 冲击灵化之源

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AmbulasEventVand.text: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AmbulasEventVand.zhText: （英文：SUPRA VANDAL）强力苏普拉的定制版本，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AngstrumIncarnon.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to launch target-seeking fireballs that ricochet toward enemies in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AngstrumIncarnon.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射自动瞄准并弹向敌人的火球的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AnkuIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to temporarily increase Range and inflict guaranteed <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status for all attacks after a successful slide attack in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AnkuIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这把武器的技能，在灵化形态下成功进行滑行攻击后，暂时增加攻击范围同时其所有攻击都可造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonDualDagger.text: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonDualDagger.zhText: （英文：NEPHERI）执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonTridentDes.text: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonTridentDes.zhText: （英文：KORUMM）执刑官诡文枭主的标志性三叉戟。战术组合可以将雷霆暴君插入地面，并在拔出时造成电击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonWhipDesc.text: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonWhipDesc.zhText: （英文：VERDILAC）执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AtomosIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high-powered grenades in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/AtomosIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射高能榴弹的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BallasSwordDesc.text: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BallisticaIncarn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire cross-shaped projectiles high in <DT_SLASH_COLOR> Slash Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BallisticaIncarn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的十字形投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintExi.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Cephalon Simaris after completing the Natah quest or purchased from Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintExi.zhText: 蓝图可以在完成 Natah 系列任务后通过中枢 Simaris 获得或者从 Teshin 那购买。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintGla.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Alert missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintGla.zhText: 蓝图可以通过警报任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintHea.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Alert missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintHea.zhText: 蓝图可以通过警报任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintMit.text: Blueprints for the weapon and its components are acquired by defeating Lech Kril and Captain Vor on Ceres.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintMit.zhText: 武器蓝图以及其部件可以通过击败位于谷神星的 Lech Kril 和沃尔上尉获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintNig.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Nightwave Cred Offerings.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintNig.zhText: 蓝图可以从货币兑换处换取。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintSim.text: Blueprint can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintSim.zhText: 蓝图可以从中枢 Simaris 处购买

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintTwi.text: Blueprint is acquired by defeating Lech Kril and Captain Vor on Ceres.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintTwi.zhText: 蓝图可以通过击败位于谷神星的 Lech Kril 和沃尔上尉获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintTwi.text: Blueprint is acquired by defeating Kela De Thaym.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintTwi.zhText: 蓝图可以通过击败 Kela De Thaym 获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintWea.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Syndicate Offerings and Requiem Relics.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BlueprintHintWea.zhText: 从集团声望奖励和安魂遗物中可获取蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoIncarnonUnlock.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Range and Heavy Attack Efficiency in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoIncarnonUnlock.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和重击效率的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoarIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire three short-range beams that chain link enemies in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoarIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射三道短程光束链接敌人的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoltorIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to prioritize <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and gain Multishot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BoltorIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有优先造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害并获得多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BratonIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BratonIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BroncoIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Range and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BroncoIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BurstonIncarnonU.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and deal Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/BurstonIncarnonU.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有自动射击模式和造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CeramicDaggerInc.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth spectral daggers during Heavy Attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CeramicDaggerInc.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有发射光谱匕首的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CestraIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Critical Chance the longer it is fired uninterrupted.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CestraIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有连续射击时间越长暴击几率越大的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ChoirEruptWeapon.text: Unleash the power of the Jade Light.

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CintaRecipeHelpT.text: Obtain blueprints for the Cinta and its components by solving Duviri Enigmas.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CintaRecipeHelpT.zhText: 通过解开双衍王境奥理获得遂心蓝图和部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CodaBubonicoCann.text: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CodaBubonicoCann.zhText: （英文：CODA BUBONICO）终幕·横痃重炮增加了弹匣容量，其设计源于科技细胞病毒对传播感染的渴望。持续射击时，主要射击的射速会逐渐提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusSpearGunDe.text: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusSpearGunDe.zhText: （英文：FERROX）释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusTonfaDesc.text: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusTonfaDesc.zhText: （英文：OHMA）用这对带电的双子拐刃使你的敌人跪地求饶。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorufellRecipeHe.text: Acquire the Corufell blueprint and components from Tyana Pass on Mars or from Otak in Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorufellRecipeHe.zhText: 从火星的 Tyana Pass 节点或者殁世幽都的奥塔那里获得「闪劫」蓝图及其部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CraftingComponen.zhText: 艾弗旺-5 木星 枪管
艾弗旺-5 木星 枪机
艾弗旺-5 木星 枪托
艾弗旺-8 火星 枪管
艾弗旺-8 火星 枪机
艾弗旺-8 火星 枪托

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CraftingComponen.text: A weapon component for the Arbucep.
A weapon component for the Arbucep.
A weapon component for the Arbucep.

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpArSniperDesc.text: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpArSniperDesc.zhText: （英文：AMBASSADOR）使用这支 Corpus 突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpArSniperRecip.text: Blueprint for the Ambassador and its components can be found in Corpus Proxima Survival missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpArSniperRecip.zhText: 使节的蓝图和组件可从 Corpus 比邻星域的生存任务中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEArcaPlasmor.text: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEArcaPlasmor.zhText: （英文：TENET ARCA PLASMOR）Corpus 经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBECycronDesc.text: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBECycronDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET CYCRON）这款重新设计的循环离子枪拥有一个折射能量盘，光束射击可以从主要目标上分离，最多击中附近的两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEDetronDesc.text: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEDetronDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET DETRON）帕尔沃斯·格拉努的工程师们为这把已经十分凶猛的手炮增加了一种新的射击模式，在一次毁灭性的爆发中清空整个弹匣，使这把武器更加致命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEFerroxDesc.text: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEFerroxDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET FERROX）帕尔沃斯·格拉努部门的专业工程师优化了铁晶磁轨炮的杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEFluxRifleDe.text: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEFluxRifleDe.zhText: （英文：TENET FLUX RIFLE）由姐妹们改装过的通量步枪提升了射速和射程。充电系统已被弹匣取代以适应更高的电量消耗。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEGlaxionDesc.text: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEGlaxionDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET GLAXION）微电子技术的进步改进了 Corpus 的经典武器。信条·冷冻光束步枪的光子束最多可以同时攻击四个敌人。它还拥有较高的伤害、暴击几率和触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEPlinxDesc.text: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEPlinxDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET PLINX）这把重新设计的漫射者可以使用次要射击发射一枚投射物将敌人拉近然后爆炸。爆炸后冷却时间会增加以满足电池的电量需求。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEQuantaDesc.text: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEQuantaDesc.zhText: （英文：Tenet Quanta）曾经的采矿工具为了军事用途而改造，帕尔沃斯式的工程技术进一步增强了量子切割器的杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBETetraDesc.text: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBETetraDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET TETRA）经典特拉的帕尔沃斯式升级版。射速较慢但拥有更大的弹匣。次要射击可以将整个弹匣作为高爆炸范围的榴弹发射出去。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBigSlashDesc.text: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBigSlashDesc.zhText: （英文：TENET EXEC）这把重型巨刃使用了最前沿的格拉努科技。震地攻击会向前发射三道冲击波，而重型震地攻击则会发射大量冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBlastorWeapon.text: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBlastorWeapon.zhText: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBowDesc.text:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBowDesc.zhText:
（英文：LENZ）从这把 Corpus 弓箭中射出的箭矢将会放出极寒脉冲，紧接产生常规爆炸。额外拾取的其他武器弹药将会转化为楞次弓的电荷。

警告：此原型机未使用安全协议。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcase2HKa.text: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcase2HKa.zhText: （英文：TENET LIVIA）格拉努公文包的流畅线条下隐藏着削铁如泥的双持利刃。格挡攻击有几率增加格挡角度。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时暂停连击倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseAkim.text: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseAkim.zhText: （英文：TENET DIPLOS）用这对自动锁定追踪目标的双枪将敌人逐个击破。腰射模式与传统手枪无异。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseLaun.text: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseLaun.zhText: （英文：TENET ENVOY）这款朴素的火箭发射器在董事会会议或休闲郊游时同样适用。瞄准发射的火箭是线导的，精确度更高，但飞行速度更慢。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseScyt.text: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBriefcaseScyt.zhText: （英文：TENET GRIGORI）滑行重击时，这把 Corpus 镰刀会发射一个旋转的能量盘在战场上弹跳。能量盘的持续时间由近战连击数决定。注意：格拉努公文包系统会在武器收起时暂停连击倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpChargeGunDesc.text: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpChargeGunDesc.zhText: （英文：CYCRON）用这把装有能量恢复圆盘的等离子体发射手枪摆脱弹药的限制。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpFreezeRayVand.text: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpFreezeRayVand.zhText: （英文：GLAXION VANDAL）一把用尖端技术打造的卤素冷却电子加速器，能够瞬间将目标冷冻起来。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGhostCatcherG.text: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGhostCatcherG.zhText: （英文：XORIS）一件来源于 Corpus 且鲜为人知的战刃武器，与魅影技术有内在联系。「驱魔之刃」可以迅速进行打击，并拥有显著的破坏力。此外它可以无限进行连击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGlaiveDesc.text: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGlaiveDesc.zhText: （英文：FALCOR）用这把 Corpus 科技的战刃以手术般的精确性剖开敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGunbladeDesc.text: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpGunbladeDesc.zhText: （英文：STROPHA）一件暗藏玄机的短刃近战武器。通过强大的短程冲击波来击飞附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerDesc.text: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：ARCA TITRON）这柄巨型电子重锤的每一次连续击杀都会积累一重电荷，可以通过震地攻击将其释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerShieldD.text: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerShieldD.zhText: （英文：TENET AGENDUS）用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpIgniterPistol.text: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpIgniterPistol.zhText: （英文：TENET SPIREX）用这把手枪快如闪电的弹道压制对手。爆头可加快装填速度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpLaserPistolVa.text: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpLaserPistolVa.zhText: （英文：SPECTRA VANDAL）一把特殊订制的 Corpus 切割工具，只适用于大师级工匠。具有独特的蓝铜色电镀外观和用于精准清澈化以及切割的聚焦水晶。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpRubanRifleDes.text: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpRubanRifleDes.zhText: （英文：STAHLTA）将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpScopeGunDesc.text: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpScopeGunDesc.zhText: （英文：ARCA SCISCO）这把带有瞄准镜的手枪会分析着弹，获悉如何更有效的对目标造成伤害。在连续成功命中五次后会达到最大的伤害输出。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpSentAmlgPisto.text: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpSentAmlgPisto.zhText: （英文：CYANEX）Sentient 科技与 Corpus 设计的结合，发展出这款致命的次要武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpSentAmlgSnipe.text: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpSentAmlgSnipe.zhText: （英文：KOMOREX）Corpus 独具匠心地利用 Tau 技术创造了一把可怕的大弹匣容量狙击枪。变焦可减少后坐力并增加穿透力。再次变焦可发射爆炸的病毒子弹，但射速降低。猛毒有自带的弹药转换。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastDes.text: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastDes.zhText: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShockGripWhip.text: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShockGripWhip.zhText: （英文：GALVACORD）使用这把重型伸缩鞭施以电击与残害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShotgunDesc.text: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShotgunDesc.zhText: （英文：ARCA PLASMOR）用这把 Corpus 设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDrifterSpearD.text: Edun befits dexterous warriors. Power Strike knocks down and blinds enemies by surrounding them with a cloud of dust.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDrifterSpearD.zhText: （英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。使用强力攻击激起一团环绕敌人的尘雾，从而击倒并致盲他们。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDrifterSpearM.text:
Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal, and for the Drifter in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDrifterSpearM.zhText:
（英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。重击以投掷出雷石祭。 雷石祭在刺入敌人体内后便会爆炸。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDuviriAsymmet.text: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxDuviriAsymmet.zhText: （英文：CINTA）遂心的功能非常多样化，可以快速连续地射出箭矢，迅速充能释放冲击震波，或完全充能并进行威力强大的聚焦式射击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerDesc.text: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：SAMPOTES）喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerDrifter.text: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Power Strike slams Sampotes into the ground to damage enemies with a shockwave that inflicts <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerDrifter.zhText: （英文：SAMPOTES）喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚。使用强力攻击猛击地面，用产生的冲击波伤害敌人，并造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerMarketD.text:
A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal, and for the Drifter in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxHammerMarketD.zhText:
（英文：SAMPOTES）喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldDes.text: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldDes.zhText: （英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚守阵地的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldDri.text: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Block to activate its staggering energy shield. Power Strike stuns enemies and inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Perfect Parry restores your Power Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldDri.zhText: （英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚忍不拔的战士提供支持。格挡以激活其惊人的能量护盾。强力攻击会击晕敌人并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。完美招架可重置强力攻击的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldMar.text:
Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal and for the Drifter in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxMaceShieldMar.zhText:
（英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚忍不拔的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaD.text: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaD.zhText: （英文：SYAM）业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaD.text: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Power Strike lifts enemies into the air and unleashes a flurry of deadly slashes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaD.zhText: （英文：SYAM）业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。使用强力攻击将敌人震飞至空中，并释放出一连串的致命斩击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaM.text:
Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal, and for the Drifter in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxSingleKatanaM.zhText:
（英文：SYAM）业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.text: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.zhText: （英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.text: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Power Strike plunges Azothane into the ground to send forth five celestial blades that apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status and then explode.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.zhText: （英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。使用强力攻击将溶灵尊插入地面，召唤出五道短暂与漂泊者并肩作战的刃气，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，随即它们便会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.text:
Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal, and for the Drifter in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatana.zhText:
（英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击数。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxWarframeMaceS.text: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxWarframeMaceS.zhText: （英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚守阵地的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxWarframeSpear.text: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxWarframeSpear.zhText: （英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。重击以投掷出雷石祭。 雷石祭在刺入敌人体内后便会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DeraIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high power beams and gain <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DeraIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射高能光束并造成 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DerelictCernosDe.text: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DerelictCernosDe.zhText: （英文：PROBOSCIS CERNOS）每支箭在冲击时都会产生大量的粘稠附着物。这些像舌头一样的探针会吸附在附近的倒霉蛋身上，并把他们拖近，然后爆裂形成一团病害黏液。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DespairIncarnonU.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DespairIncarnonU.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下获得造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DestrezaIncarnon.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to summon ghostly rapiers that fly forth upon Heavy Attacks, while Heavy Attack kills grant <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DestrezaIncarnon.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击发射幽影细剑，同时重击击杀获得 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.text: Blueprint for the Acceltra drop from the Demolisher Infestation on Grineer Galleons in Disruption missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.zhText: 迅发电浆炮的蓝图从中断任务中 Grineer 帆船战舰上的爆破型感染者掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.text: Blueprint for the Akarius drops from the Demolisher Infestation on Grineer Galleons in Disruption missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.zhText: 阿利乌双枪的蓝图从中断任务中 Grineer 帆船战舰上的爆破型感染者掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.text: This weapon has Drifter-compatible and a Warframe-compatible variants. You will receive the Warframe-compatible weapon blueprint when you use Pathos Clamps in Duviri to unlock the Drifter-compatible weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.zhText: 这把武器有漂泊者适用和战甲适用的版本。当你在双衍王境使用苦栓解锁漂泊者适用的武器时，你将收到战甲适用版本的武器蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.text: Blueprint for the Pennant can be found on invading Grineer Galleons during Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.zhText: 尖幡的蓝图可以在航道星舰任务中入侵的 Grineer 帆船战舰上找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.text: Blueprint for the Quellor can be found on invading Grineer Galleons during Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DetailedPurchase.zhText: 压制者的蓝图可以在航道星舰任务中入侵的 Grineer 帆船战舰上找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/Dex2023NikanaDes.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/Dex2023NikanaDes.zhText: 这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份 11 周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DjinnMacheteDesc.text: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DjinnMacheteDesc.zhText: （英文：GAZAL MACHETE）每次用这把俯冲样式的刀刃击杀会给引灵下一次释放的致命诱惑增加额外的伤害。作为回报，致命诱惑会赋予这把武器一段时间的 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DreadIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DreadIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DrifterPistolDes.text: A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DrifterPistolDes.zhText: （英文：SIROCCO）一款为漂泊者设计的手枪式消音增幅器。从虚空能量中汲取弹药。在精准的时机进行装填会使下一次射击获得额外充能。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DrifterTazerDesc.text: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DrifterTazerDesc.zhText: （英文：RUMBLEJACK）用废料组装而成的电击器，可用于快速近战攻坚。非常适合用来对付毫无防备的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualGrnEgyptSwdD.text: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualGrnEgyptSwdD.zhText: （英文：DUAL KROHKUR）双手持有克鲁古尔之刃能让战场中的杀戮变得轻而易举

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualIchorIncarno.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage field after a kill in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualIchorIncarno.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有击杀产生 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害力场的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualToxocystInca.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DualToxocystInca.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有自动射击模式和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriHeavyScyth.text: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriHeavyScyth.zhText: （英文：HESPAR）这把重型镰刀呼应了另一个时代的战斗。其更像是一种纯粹的力量型武器，而不是一种技巧型武器。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriHeavyScyth.text: Acquire the Hespar blueprint from Zariman Bounties. Complete Zariman missions to collect components.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriHeavyScyth.zhText: 从扎里曼赏金任务中获得暮斩蓝图。完成扎里曼任务以收集部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriRifleDesc.text: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：AEOLAK）这把非同寻常的自动步枪给人一种奇异的熟悉感，并且拥有两种开火模式。主要射击附带辐射伤害，次要射击充能后可发射一枚爆炸投射物。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriRifleRecip.text: Acquire the Aeolak blueprint from Zariman Bounties. Complete Zariman missions to collect components.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/DuviriRifleRecip.zhText: 从扎里曼赏金任务中获得风鸣蓝图。完成扎里曼任务以收集部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/EntratiFistIncar.text: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/EntratiFistIncar.zhText: （英文：RUVOX）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把拳套武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，使用重型震地攻击会以尖刺刺穿附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/EntratiWristGunW.text: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/EntratiWristGunW.zhText: （英文：ONOS）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，吸收周围的能量对敌人造成逐渐增加的伤害。当能量充满时，释放一股 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FlamethrowerWrai.text: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FlamethrowerWrai.zhText: （英文：IGNIS WRAITH）这款破坏性火焰喷射器的血红变体。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FuraxIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Heavy Slam Efficiency and leave behind <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage fields after Heavy Slams in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FuraxIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提高重型震地效率，重型震地攻击后留下 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害力场的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FurisIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to project a wide <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage beam in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/FurisIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射一束广范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害光束的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GammacorIncarnon.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire projectiles that pull enemies into a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage explosion in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GammacorIncarnon.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射投射物将敌人拉入 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害爆炸中的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GarudaCrossbowDe.text: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GarudaCrossbowDe.zhText: （英文：NAGANTAKA）Garuda 的标志性十字弓能以一支精准的弩矢斩断目标，而次要射击则能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头射击则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GlassHammerDesc.text: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GlassHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：VOLNUS）用这把轻量灵活的玻璃锤来撕裂并残害目标。Gara 的标志性近战武器。在被 Gara 使用时，它会获得额外的震地范围伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GlassKunaiDesc.text: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GlassKunaiDesc.zhText: （英文：FUSILAI）无声地以 Gara 的标志性玻璃飞刀撕裂敌人。在被 Gara 使用时，该武器的投射物飞行速度会提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GorgonIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GorgonIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrimoireDesc.text: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrimoireDesc.zhText: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnAmphisPistolD.text: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnAmphisPistolD.zhText: （英文：QUATZ）拥有紧凑的四管设计且装有一个自充电电容器，会在空枪装填时释放电流。腰射时为自动模式，瞄准时为瞬间射出四发子弹模式。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnCannonDesc.text: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnCannonDesc.zhText: （英文：ZARR）从这具火炮的巨型炮管可以倾泻出爆裂的弹幕或者一枚大型的高射炮弹。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnChainSawTonfa.text: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnChainSawTonfa.zhText: （英文：TONKKATT）用这对由采矿工具改装而来的拐刃撕裂并点燃你的敌人。积累连击倍率将使武器过热，让敌人熊熊燃烧。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnDrillScytheDe.text: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnDrillScytheDe.zhText: （英文：GALARIAK PRIME）奥罗金时代的 Grineer 战士将镰刀镀上黄金，以此象征他们对黄金之主的忠诚。每有一种异常状态影响目标，镰刀的暴击几率就会提升一定百分比。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnEgyptSwdDesc.text: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnEgyptSwdDesc.zhText: （英文：KROHKUR）这把钩刃能在拥有精湛技艺的人手里造成致命的打击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFlameSpearDes.text: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFlameSpearDes.zhText: （英文：JAVLOK）对单个敌人发射极热的子弹。或者将整个武器掷出并在地狱火光中点燃成群的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFourBarrelBlu.text: Blueprint for Quartakk can be acquired from Ghoul Bounties in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFourBarrelBlu.zhText: 夸塔克蓝图可以通过希图斯中尸鬼赏金任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFourBarrelRif.text: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFourBarrelRif.zhText: （英文：QUARTAKK）用这把大口径的 Grineer 步枪的 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnGhoulSawDesc.text: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnGhoulSawDesc.zhText: （英文：GHOULSAW）为那些最粗鲁的 Grineer 士兵所打造的最残忍的武器。削铁如肉，割肉如泥。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnGunbladeDesc.text: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnGunbladeDesc.zhText: （英文：VASTILOK）用这把凶猛的重型 Grineer 枪刃斩杀、爆破。高切割伤害与重型霰弹攻击相得益彰。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHalberdDesc.text: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHalberdDesc.zhText: （英文：KESHEG）用这柄凶猛的长戟割开群魔乱舞的敌人；这是赤毒守卫者标志性的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHeavyGrenadeL.text: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHeavyGrenadeL.zhText: （英文：KUVA AYANGA）用这款全自动曲翼榴弹发射器的怒火来扫荡大群敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnKusarigamaDes.text: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnKusarigamaDes.zhText: （英文：JAT KUSAR）用这把喷气动力的镰刀和锋利锁链武器击垮你的敌人。蓄力攻击可以点燃一次远距离的爆破。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnKuvaLichRifle.text: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnKuvaLichRifle.zhText: （英文：KUVA CHAKKHURR）用这款需要精确瞄准的低射速步枪来打爆敌人的头颅。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnOrokinPistolD.text: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnOrokinPistolD.zhText: （英文：SAGEK PRIME）作为精英 Grineer 战士的首选次要武器，杀格 Prime 融合了 Grineer 的残暴和 Orokin 的美学。当杀格 Prime 造成暴击时，其下一次射击有几率大幅提升触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnOrokinRifleWe.text: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnOrokinRifleWe.zhText: （英文：GOTVA PRIME）早在克隆基因衰变之前，精英 Grineer 指挥官就用这把强大的步枪从战甲的叛乱中保护幸存的奥罗金人。当骨葬 Prime 造成异常状态时，下一次射击有机会造成超级暴击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnQueenGuardDua.text: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnQueenGuardDua.zhText: （英文：TWIN ROGGA）这对能够带来破坏的枪管是赤毒守卫者手枪标志性的特征。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnQueenSceptreD.text: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnQueenSceptreD.zhText: （英文：BROKEN SCEPTER）Grineer 大女皇的护身物，虽已破碎但仍具有神秘力量。能从死去敌人身上取得生命球，或从被破坏的机器人中取得能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSharbolaDesc.text: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSharbolaDesc.zhText: （英文：SLAYTRA）屠煞是对传统 Grineer 砍刀的强大重现，它可以使 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的出血持续时间加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSharbolaRecip.text: Acquire the Slaytra blueprint from Chipper in the Drifter's Camp.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSharbolaRecip.zhText: 从漂泊者营地的切片哥那里获取屠煞的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSpiderSparrin.text: Blueprint for Korrudo can drop from the Tusk Thumper Bull or Tusk Thumper Doma in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSpiderSparrin.zhText: 库鲁多的蓝图会从夜灵平野的巨牙重击者公牛或巨牙重击者多玛处掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSpiderSparrin.text: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnSpiderSparrin.zhText: （英文：KORRUDO）当他们出上拳的时候，你就出下拳。强大的气动握把和尖锐的部分可以强化每一次攻击。多达四种方法来施放双倍的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnUziBlueprintR.text: Blueprint for Stubba can be acquired from Ghoul Bounties in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnUziBlueprintR.zhText: 史度巴蓝图可以通过希图斯中尸鬼赏金任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnUziDesc.text: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnUziDesc.zhText: （英文：STUBBA）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪的爆发速射特性来产生相应的苦痛。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnVorStickyBomb.text: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnVorStickyBomb.zhText: （英文：AEGRIT）骇敌榴弹虽然数量稀少但威力来补。将骇敌榴弹投掷到敌人的位置，然后在适当的时机远程引爆，以获得最大的破坏效果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnVorStickyBomb.text: Acquire the Aegrit blueprint from Chipper in the Drifter's Camp.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnVorStickyBomb.zhText: 从漂泊者营地的切片哥那里获取骇敌榴弹的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunScytheDesc.text: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunScytheDesc.zhText: （英文：CORUFELL）重击会在短时间内将闪劫变形为一把枪刃。枪刃开火后，闪劫返回其重型镰刀状态。Citrine 使用时，它的变形速度最为快速。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunbrellaRecipeH.text: Acquire Higasa's main and component blueprints from Saya's Visions on Earth or in exchange for Fate Pearls at Koumei's Shrine in Cetus. Access this content by talking to Saya in Cetus after completing both the Saya's Vigil and Once Awake Quests.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunbrellaRecipeH.zhText: 从地球上的萨娅的异象获取晴日伞的主要和组件蓝图，或在希图斯 Koumei 的祈运坛处用命运之珠交换。完成《萨娅的守夜》和《悲剧的开端》系列任务后，通过与希图斯中的萨娅交谈来解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunbrellaWeaponD.text: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GunbrellaWeaponD.zhText: （英文：HIGASA）依靠晴日伞抵御如雨倾泻的子弹。瞄准可形成一面盾牌，阻挡敌方武器的射击。击杀和阻挡射击将为次要射击充能，以释放光束。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GyreRifleDesc.text: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GyreRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：ALTERNOX）Gyre 的标志性武器有两种射击模式。主要射击可通过带电球体攻击敌人。次要射击可产生一个大型带电球体，该球体可附着在任何表面并在爆炸之前产生 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>带电脉冲。被 Gyre 使用时，该武器可产生少量的多重射击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GyreRifleRecipeH.text: Acquire the Alternox blueprint from Zariman Bounties.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/GyreRifleRecipeH.zhText: 从扎里曼赏金任务中获得电幻步枪蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/HalikarWraithDes.text: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/HalikarWraithDes.zhText: （英文：HALIKAR WRAITH）有别于回力飞锤，哈利卡亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/HateIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to embed blades that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage during Forward and Neutral Combos in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/HateIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下进行向前和中立连击时具有嵌入带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的爆炸刀片的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfArmCannonDesc.text: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfArmCannonDesc.zhText: （英文：BUBONICO）可远距离投下三连爆炸性病毒囊腔，随后可通过主要射击一次性释放出多重毒螫来消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfBeamPistolDes.text: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfBeamPistolDes.zhText: （英文：CATABOLYST）可在短距离内向敌人喷射腐蚀性胆汁，此外，弹药囊腔可在装填时被用作投掷手雷。手枪的弹药囊腔越空，其造成的伤害就越强。完全射空的囊腔能发挥出最大的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfBoomerangDesc.text: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfBoomerangDesc.zhText: （英文：PATHOCYST）这把感染战刃的每一次攻击都会让目标感染病原体。而在飞行或与敌人接触时，它偶尔还会释放出狂乱的孢子以及追踪敌人的蛆虫。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfEmbolistScyth.text: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfEmbolistScyth.zhText: （英文：CAUSTACYST）这把镰刀的重击会释放出一道酸液，分解敌人并留下一条腐蚀的泥泞。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularBarrel.text:
Primary: Long-range proboscis attaches to a target and then splits off to attack up to three more enemies.
Secondary: Three short-range proboscises fiercely latch onto targets and maul them.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularBarrel.zhText:
主要武器：远距口器附着在一个目标上，然后分裂开来攻击至多 3 名敌人。
次要武器：三个短距口器猛烈地卡住目标，并对其进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularBarrel.text:
Primary: Launches spore-sacs that explode with toxic mist on each bounce. Automatic trigger.
Secondary: Fires spore-sacs that rupture into three smaller toxic projectiles on impact. Semi-automatic trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularBarrel.zhText:
主要武器：发射孢子囊，每次弹跳时都会有毒雾爆炸。自动扳机。
次要武器：发射孢子囊，撞击时会破裂成三个较小的毒性投射物。半自动扳机。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipBi.text: Large loader that contributes to both Critical Chance and Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipBi.zhText: 同时对暴击几率和触发几率概率有所提升的大型装弹器。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipBi.text: Massive capacity loader with a long, cumbersome reload.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipBi.zhText: 大容量装弹器，装填时间长而繁琐。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipSm.text: Small loader that contributes to both Critical Chance and Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipSm.zhText: 同时对暴击几率和触发几率概率有所提升的小型装弹器。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipSm.text: A higher capacity small loader with a slower reload process.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularClipSm.zhText: 更大容量的小型装弹器，装填过程更加缓慢。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularPrimar.text: This primary grip increases fire-rate while sacrificing little in the damage delivery.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularPrimar.zhText: 这件主要武器握柄在提高射速的同时，几乎没有损失伤害传递。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularSecond.text: This secondary grip increases fire-rate while sacrificing little in the damage delivery.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfModularSecond.zhText: 这件次要武器握柄在提高射速的同时，几乎没有损失伤害传递。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfNunchukDesc.text: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfNunchukDesc.zhText: （英文：PULMONARS）用这两块被韧带连接的脉动肉块进行击打和感染。掌握古代军用武器的恶毒演变。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfSniperRifleDe.text: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfSniperRifleDe.zhText: （英文：SPOROTHRIX）这把长射程步枪发射锋利且浸透病毒的倒钩，在猛烈爆发出充满孢子的雾气前，它会继续攻击其宿主。开镜爆头可增加杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfStaffDesc.text: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfStaffDesc.zhText: （英文：PUPACYST）双管齐下的夹击；棍尖端包覆的带骨茧状物把血肉撕裂，而其中的病毒块则会扩散到每个新受害人的伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfTransformClaw.text: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfTransformClaw.zhText: （英文：KERATINOS）这些感染利爪可以在更大的重击范围内留下你的印记。达到最高连击数时进行重击，可以保持持续三分钟的、更大的攻击范围和震地半径。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfTransformClaw.text: Blueprint for the Keratinos is available for purchase from Father in Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfTransformClaw.zhText: 卡提努之爪的蓝图可从殁世幽都中的"父亲"处购买。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfUziWeaponDesc.text: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfUziWeaponDesc.zhText: （英文：ZYMOS）用这件散射孢子的手枪来感染你的敌人。爆头射击会钻入敌人的体内并爆炸，释放出飘向附近敌人的孢子云。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfUziWeaponReci.text: Blueprint for the Zymos is available for purchase from Father in Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfUziWeaponReci.zhText: 邪莫斯的蓝图可从殁世幽都中的"父亲"处购买。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfWarfanDesc.text: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfWarfanDesc.zhText: （英文：ARUM SPINOSA）用两片极其罕见的疆南星刺植物的叶子砍杀敌人。重击对范围内的攻击者抽出一连串的毒刺。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedBurstRif.text: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedBurstRif.zhText: （英文：HEMA）一把吸血者。这把点放式的共生步枪会吸取生命来铸造弹药，并在每次爆头射击时恢复生命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedDualAxeD.text: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedDualAxeD.zhText: （英文：DUAL ICHOR）迅捷凶残的恶脓双斧能借由高几率的强力暴击快速撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedKogakeDe.text: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/InfestedKogakeDe.zhText: （英文：HIRUDO）以拳头上如同剃刀般的锋利软骨切入敌人，每次暴击时窃取生命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KahlAAGunDesc.text: Mounted anti-aircrat gun found on Grineer Bolkor dropships.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KahlAAGunDesc.zhText: 安装在 Grineer 博寇空投艇上防空炮。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KahlHeavyGrenade.text: Plucked from the wreckage of a downed Thumper.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KahlHeavyGrenade.zhText: （英文：Salvaged Kuva Ayanga）从被击倒的重击者残骸中取出。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KunaiIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to seek Headshots and increase Multishot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KunaiIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有追踪爆头和增加多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaBrakkDesc.text: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaBrakkDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA BRAKK）这把玄骸变体的半自动手枪，小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击力。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaDrakgoonDesc.text: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaDrakgoonDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA DRAKGOON）这款改造版龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射且不会减速的高热弹片。它拥有更大的弹匣容量和更快的装填速度。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGhoulsawDesc.text: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGhoulsawDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA GHOULSAW）赤毒将尸鬼电锯锻造成了更野蛮的武器，可以进行更快的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGrattlerDesc.text: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGrattlerDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA GRATTLER）重新调配以获得最大杀伤力，赤毒葛拉特勒仍使用爆裂弹来粉碎目标，但现在可以瞬间达到最高射速。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGrnBowDesc.text: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaGrnBowDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA BRAMMA）这把 Grineer 弓箭能射出尖端配有集束炸弹的复仇箭矢，可以在空中或遇到冲击时引爆。低箭袋容量，箭矢逐个恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaHekDesc.text: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaHekDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA HEK）蠕虫女皇亲自下令锻造这把本就十分强大的霰弹枪，拥有额外功能可以同时从全部四个枪管开火。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaHindDesc.text: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaHindDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA HIND）这款强大的 Grineer 连射步枪经过改装，增加了半自动和全自动开火模式。
