/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKarakDesc.text: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKarakDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA KARAK）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。相比于原版卡拉克步枪，它拥有更快的装填速度、更低的后座力以及更高的精准度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKohmDesc.text: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKohmDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA KOHM ）这把赤毒寇恩热能枪变体拥有比原版更高的射速。赤毒寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKrakenDesc.text: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKrakenDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA KRAKEN）一种北海巨妖的改装变体，单扣扳机可迅速击出三连发射击，或者可通过次要射击来进行点射。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaNukorDesc.text: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaNukorDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaOgrisDesc.text: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaOgrisDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA OGRIS）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。与原版不同，它拥有更小的弹匣，能以半自动的方式发射满载易爆物的炮弹，同时每一发能造成更多伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaQuartakkDesc.text: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaQuartakkDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA QUARTAKK）与原版夸塔克不同，这种赤毒玄骸夸塔克变体能从腰际全自动开火射击，同时保持了瞄准时的特点：用 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaScytheDesc.text: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaScytheDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA SHILDEG）一款以碾碎与杀戮为卖点的火箭动力刺锤。这显然是 Grineer 的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaSeerDesc.text: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaSeerDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA SEER）这把变体手枪拥有更高的射速、弹匣容量以及变焦倍率。此外，它射出的子弹还会产生小范围腐蚀爆炸效果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaSobekDesc.text: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaSobekDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA SOBEK）赤毒·鳄神出色的装填速度、暴击几率和触发几率，与赤毒玄骸的霸道风格高度契合。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaStubbaDesc.text: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaStubbaDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA TWIN STUBBAS）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪双持变体的爆发速射特性来产生双倍的苦痛。它拥有更高的射速和更大的弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaTonkorDesc.text: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaTonkorDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA TONKOR）这种榴弹发射器玄骸变体拥有更快的装填速度，可以对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaZarrDesc.text: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaZarrDesc.zhText: （英文：KUVA ZARR）一把更强大的沙皇火炮，满足了赤毒玄骸的需求。拥有更强的爆裂弹幕和更远距离的高射炮弹。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooAKDesc.text: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooAKDesc.zhText: （英文：EFV-5 JUPITER）使用这把炽蛇军机枪扫射科腐者和任何胆敢阻挡你的人。次要射击使用涂有艾弗旺的霰弹重击目标。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooAKPlayerWe.text: Blueprint and components for the EFV-5 Jupiter weapon can be purchased from Minerva Hendricks in Höllvania. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooAKPlayerWe.zhText: 艾弗旺-5 木星的武器蓝图和组件可从位于霍瓦尼亚的米尼娃·亨德里克斯处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooPistolPlay.text: Blueprint and components for the EFV-8 Mars weapon can be purchased from Minerva Hendricks in Höllvania. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooPistolPlay.zhText: 艾弗旺-8 火星的武器蓝图和组件可从位于霍瓦尼亚的米尼娃·亨德里克斯处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooPistolWeap.text: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooPistolWeap.zhText: （英文：EFV-8 MARS）标准的单兵艾弗旺喷射器，各个军衔的炽蛇军都配有此武器。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklePlay.text: Blueprint and components for the Dual Viciss weapon can be purchased from Minerva Hendricks in Höllvania. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklePlay.zhText: 双子恶行的武器蓝图和组件可从位于霍瓦尼亚的米尼娃·亨德里克斯处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesDes.text: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesDes.zhText: （英文：DUAL VICISS）用这对凶恶的炽蛇军镰刀来收获科腐者所播种的恶果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesUpg.text: Gain movement and attack speed when enemies are inflicted with <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas Status Effects from your melee weapon
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesUpg.zhText: 当近战武器对敌人造成 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气异常状态时，增加移动速度和攻击速度

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesUpg.text: |CONDITION|: Gain |BONUS1| and |BONUS2| for |DURATION|s. Stacks up to |STACKS|x.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasGooSicklesUpg.zhText: |CONDITION|：获得 |BONUS1| 和 |BONUS2|，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多叠加到 |STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasNoxPlayerWeap.text: Blueprint and components for the Purgator 1 weapon can be purchased from Minerva Hendricks in Höllvania. The Hex quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasNoxPlayerWeap.zhText: 净化者 1 的武器蓝图和组件可从位于霍瓦尼亚的米尼娃·亨德里克斯处购买。需要完成《六人组》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasSilencedPisto.text: Acquire the Vesper 77 blueprint from Bounties in Höllvania (1999). Component blueprints can drop from Legacyte Harvest and Hell-Scrub missions in Höllvania. All of Vesper 77's blueprints can also be purchased from Amir Beckett in Höllvania Central Mall. Access this content after completing The Hex quest.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasSilencedPisto.zhText: 从霍瓦尼亚（1999）的赏金任务中获取夜语者 77 蓝图。组件蓝图可能会在霍瓦尼亚的传承种收割和地狱净化任务中掉落。所有夜语者 77 的蓝图也可以从霍瓦尼亚中央商场的阿米尔·贝克特处购买。完成 《六人组》系列任务后即可解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasSilencedPisto.text: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasSilencedPisto.zhText: （英文：VESPER 77）夜语者 77 是霍瓦尼亚工程的真正杰作，其先进的激光瞄准器可突出显示敌人的弱点。瞄准来提高其暴击伤害倍率。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LaserAimRifleDes.text: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LaserAimRifleDes.zhText: （英文：ARGONAK）利用这把 Grineer 步枪的先进激光瞄准系统高亮敌人，将他们逐一射杀。单发和全自动模式都非常致命。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasrianNoxPlayer.text: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LasrianNoxPlayer.zhText: （英文：PURGATOR 1）用这把炽蛇军武器让敌人再起不能。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LatoIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Punch Through and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LatoIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有穿透和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LatronIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage energy waves that bounce off enemies and terrain in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LatronIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射遇到敌人和地形反弹的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害能量波的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LexIncarnonUnloc.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire energy waves that deal <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation and Punch Through damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LexIncarnonUnloc.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射和穿透伤害的能量波的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LotusModularGunD.text: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LotusModularGunD.zhText: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LotusModularWeap.text: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled only by Hok in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/LotusModularWeap.zhText: （英文：ZAW）一把从许多种可选部件中挑选组合而成的自定义武器。只有希图斯的霍刻可以组装。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MaduraiBowDesc.text: The unwavering Bow of the school of Madurai. To face its wielder is to fight against its Tauron Strike, the tempestuous power of the Void itself; and there it has been lost since time immemorial.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MaduraiBowDesc.zhText: （英文：THARA）Madurai 学派的无畏之弓。与它的持有者对抗，就如同与它的 Tauron 打击对抗，那是虚空本身狂暴的力量；而它自古以来就遗失在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MagistarIncarnon.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Initial Combo and Wind Up Speed in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MagistarIncarnon.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提升初始连击和重击准备速度的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MiterIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire homing and bouncing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage explosives in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MiterIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射追踪和反弹式 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MortiforShieldAn.text: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/MortiforShieldAn.zhText: （英文：TAK & LUG）这套残暴而致命的剑盾组合完美展示了最好的防守就是进攻。通过独特的重击可投掷出盾牌，造成爆炸异常状态和大范围伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NWOrokinSwordDes.text: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NWOrokinSwordDes.zhText: （英文：VITRICA）传说中的奥罗金行刑者无刹，用这把剑来将犯人玻璃化。在飞身瞄准时挥动攻击可以使敌人玻璃化。震地攻击将击碎附近玻璃化的敌人，同时向前放出一道冲击窄波，来击碎远处的敌人。重型震地攻击则会放出威力更大且更宽的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaginataRecipeHe.text: Acquire Amanata's main and component blueprints from Saya's Visions on Earth or in exchange for Fate Pearls at Koumei's Shrine in Cetus. Access this content by talking to Saya in Cetus after completing both the Saya's Vigil and Once Awake Quests.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaginataRecipeHe.zhText: 从地球上的萨娅的异象获取天薙刀的主要和组件蓝图，或在希图斯 Koumei 的祈运坛处用命运之珠交换。完成《萨娅的守夜》和《悲剧的开端》系列任务后，通过与希图斯中的萨娅交谈来解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaginataWeaponDe.text: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaginataWeaponDe.zhText: （英文：AMANATA）天薙刀每命中敌人 30 次，就掷一次 Koumei 的骰子。掷出 1 到 5 的结果各赋予一种增益，而掷出 6 则一次性赋予所有增益。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NamiSoloIncarnon.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to greatly increase its range in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NamiSoloIncarnon.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有大幅提升范围的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaramonBladeDesc.text: The incisive Blade of the school of Naramon. A sword that cleaves fate as cleanly as its Tauron Strike would any mountain, should it ever be discovered in the vastness of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NaramonBladeDesc.zhText: （英文：VEXORIC）Naramon 学派的利剑。若它有朝一日能在浩瀚的虚空中被发现，这把剑能像它的 Tauron 打击一样，一击断山、斩断命运。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NokkoArchGunDesc.text: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/NokkoArchGunDesc.zhText: （英文：ARBUCEP）Nokko 的标志性曲翼枪械可发射六枚追踪导弹，每枚导弹都运载着六种组合元素之一，命中时会在区域内引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ObexIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to perform a large radial attack for each Finisher hit in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ObexIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次处决攻击都能发动范围攻击的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OkinaIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to spawn spectral daggers on kill. Daggers seek out enemies, applying max <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OkinaIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下击杀敌人会生成光谱匕首的能力。匕首会自动寻找敌人，造成最大的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态叠层。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OmicrusDesc.text: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OmicrusDesc.zhText: （英文：NATARUK）Hunhow 的礼物，由其亲属的骨头雕刻而成。射击时可以充能并维持该状态；在完全充能前一刻发射即可获得最佳效果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OnosRecipeHelpTe.text: Blueprint for the Onos weapon can be purchased from Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica or found in Armatus on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OnosRecipeHelpTe.zhText: 赘骨的武器蓝图可以从位于火卫二解剖圣所的洛德处购买或是在卫城区找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OpStalkerMiosDes.text: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OpStalkerMiosDes.zhText: （英文：CETI LACERA）这款专为参与猩红之矛战役的老将所打造的悲痛之刃，经过了改造以提高敏捷性和杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OperatorAmpWeapo.text:
A custom Amplifier made from many possible parts. Assembled by:
Quill Onkko in Cetus
Little Duck in Fortuna
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/OperatorAmpWeapo.zhText:
一把从许多种可选部件中挑选组合而成的自定义增幅器。由他们来组装：
希图斯的夜羽昂克
福尔图娜的小鸭子

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PacifistShieldSw.text: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PacifistShieldSw.zhText: （英文：COBRA & CRANE）Baruuk 的标志性武器：代表报应的剑，以及象征克制的盾。唯有在 Baruuk 的手中，眼镜蛇招式中的第一次打击可使敌人失去意识。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ParisIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ParisIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PaxDuviricusShot.text: Acquire the Rauta blueprint and components from Acrithis in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PaxDuviricusShot.zhText: 从双衍王境里的言录使处获取锐铁的蓝图和部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeAstillaDesc.text: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeAstillaDesc.zhText: （英文：ASTILLA PRIME）Gara 标志性的霰弹枪以惊人的 Prime 形态呈现，可以射出爆炸性的玻璃弹头来击穿敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeCorvasDesc.text: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeCorvasDesc.zhText: （英文：CORVAS PRIME）招摇又考究的美人，这款曲翼枪械版高射炮比其标准版更具破坏性。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeDualKeresDe.text: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeDualKeresDe.zhText: （英文：DUAL KERES PRIME）当猎物面对 Khora Prime 的标志性双刀时，生命将迅速终结。Khora 挥舞双刀时，其重击效率会被增强。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeHystrixDesc.text: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeHystrixDesc.zhText: （英文：HYSTRIX PRIME）灵活多变的武器与致命的猎人相得益彰。Khora Prime 的标志性手枪可在火焰、冰冻、电击和毒素刺镖中轮换。当 Khora 装备上豪猪 Prime 并造成爆头时，则弹药有几率立即重新装填。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeKnellDesc.text: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeKnellDesc.zhText: （英文：KNELL PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性手枪在敌人的头颅上敲响葬礼的钟声。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeLarkspurDes.text: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeLarkspurDes.zhText: （英文：LARKSPUR PRIME）迎接混乱的到来吧。连锁攻击和爆炸潜能在翠雀 Prime 身上相遇。当 Hildryn 使用这件强大的武器时，她会携带更多的弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeNagantakaDe.text: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeNagantakaDe.zhText: （英文：NAGANTAKA PRIME）Garuda 的标志性十字弓的镀金版本，由奥罗金最优秀的工匠所锻造。次要射击能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头击杀则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeRevenantSho.text: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeRevenantSho.zhText: （英文：PHANTASMA PRIME）幻离子 Prime 由死亡之力打磨而成。它在 Revenant 的手中，会拥有更多的弹匣容量。它的等离子照射光束所发出的威力，会让人不禁想起那令人生畏的夜灵。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeScourgeDesc.text: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeScourgeDesc.zhText: （英文：SCOURGE PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性标枪打击不义之徒。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeTatsuDesc.text: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeTatsuDesc.zhText: （英文：TATSU PRIME）龙辰 Prime 闪着幽光。每一个刀下亡魂都会让它的光更闪耀，尤其是在为 Revenant 所用的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeVolnusDesc.text: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeVolnusDesc.zhText: （英文：VOLNUS PRIME）作为最初由奥罗金所铸造的辉煌，Gara 标志性的玻璃锤看似轻敏，却极具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaAngstrumDe.text: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaAngstrumDe.zhText: （英文：PRISMA ANGSTRUM）灌注了最出色的棱晶，这款经过精制后的安格斯壮的特点是具有更快的蓄力和装填速度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaArchHeavyP.text: Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaArchHeavyP.zhText: （英文：PRISMA DUAL DECURIONS）比太空更冷酷无情，棱晶为已经很时尚的什长双枪带来了卓越的效率。只需轻轻一碰即可装填弹药，这把双持曲翼枪械证明了重型武器也可以保持优雅。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaGrinlokDes.text: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaGrinlokDes.zhText: （英文：PRISMA GRINLOK）棱晶的强化铸造了一个名贵的器械；一把能够在意想不到的范围内夺走生命的武器，并且只需要扣一次其精确好使的扳机。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaObexDesc.text: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaObexDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA OBEX）用这件由无比坚硬的棱晶所打造的搏击武器，打出令人眼花缭乱的招式，进而摧毁敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaOhmaDesc.text: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaOhmaDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA OHMA）棱晶在这对带电的拐刃上闪闪发光。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaTwinGremli.text: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrismaTwinGremli.zhText: （英文：PRISMA TWIN GREMLINS）熔合了棱晶，这崭新的 Grineer 随身武器能恐吓到任何敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/QuillDartgunDesc.text: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/QuillDartgunDesc.zhText: （英文：HYSTRIX）火焰、冰冻、电击或者毒素：选择一种元素并发射出一簇簇致命的刺镖。这款灵活多变的次要武器是 Khora 的标志性武器。当她使用豪猪时，爆头有几率使弹药重新装填。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/QuillDualSwordsD.text: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/QuillDualSwordsD.zhText: （英文：DUAL KERES）用这恶毒的爪状刀片撕开任何目标。Khora 的标志性刀剑。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpCrpGun.text: Blueprint for the Stropha drops from the Jackal. Components are hidden in the Granum Void.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpCrpGun.zhText: 「诡计之刃」的蓝图会从豺狼处掉落。该武器的其他组件隐藏在格拉努虚空之中。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpCrpRub.text: Blueprint for the Stahlta drops from the Jackal. Components are hidden in the Granum Void.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpCrpRub.zhText: 「钢刃步枪」的蓝图会从豺狼处掉落。该武器的其他组件隐藏在格拉努虚空之中。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpProtea.text: Components for the Velox are hidden in the Granum Void.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpProtea.zhText: 「逐电」的组件隐藏在格拉努虚空之中。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpTextMa.text: Blueprints for the Mandonel are acquired from Cavia Bounties in the Sanctum Anatomica in Deimos. Components can be found in Munio, Cambire and Persto.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelpTextMa.zhText: 辐光弩炮的蓝图可通过火卫二上解剖圣所的科维兽赏金任务中获得。部件可以在墓垒、异化区以及不灭之地获取。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.text: Blueprint for the Nepheri can be found in Narmer Bounties.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.zhText: 赤炎流星的蓝图可在合一众赏金任务中找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.text: Blueprint for the Korumm can be found in Narmer Bounties.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.zhText: 雷霆暴君的蓝图可在合一众赏金任务中找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.text: Blueprint for the Verdilac can be found in Narmer Bounties.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RecipeHelp_Archo.zhText: 蝰首骨妖的蓝图可在合一众赏金任务中找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RevenantShotgunD.text: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RevenantShotgunD.zhText: （英文：PHANTASMA）用连续的致命等离子束照射敌人；次要攻击充能后可以释放出一团等离子球，球体碰撞时会产生多发制导的小型炸弹。在被 Revenant 使用时，该武器的弹匣容量会提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RuvoxRecipeHelpT.text: Blueprint and components for the Ruvox weapon can be purchased from Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica or found in Armatus on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/RuvoxRecipeHelpT.zhText: 古声的武器蓝图和组件可从位于火卫二解剖圣所的洛德处购买或是在卫城区找到。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SapientPistolDes.text: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SapientPistolDes.zhText: （英文：AKARIUS）使用目标追踪火箭弹轰击成群的敌人。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SapientPrimaryDe.text: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SapientPrimaryDe.zhText: （英文：ACCELTRA）通过使用速射电浆火箭弹，Gauss 的标志性武器铺设了一条毁灭之路。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。为了安全起见，火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentJointedScyth.text: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentJointedScyth.zhText: （英文：VENATO）Caliban 的标志性镰刀，由几个世纪前从一个倒下的夜灵身上扯下的肢体锻造而成。被 Caliban 挥舞时，有 50% 几率获得额外近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentRifleNewWarG.text: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentRifleNewWarG.zhText: （英文：BASMU）这种 Sentient 军械可以用爆炸投射物密集轰击目标，也可以利用其可再生电池制造出两股将多个目标束缚在一起的等离子光束。当电量完全耗尽时，会在短时间内吸取附近敌人的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentinelFreezeRa.text: Designed as the perfect mate for Nautilus, this Sentinel weapon projects an icy beam at nearby targets.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentinelFreezeRa.zhText: 作为鹦鹉螺的完美同伴，这件守护武器可向附近的目标投射冰冻光束。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentinelGremlinD.text: Freeze targets in their tracks with this sentinel mounted ice-beam.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SentinelGremlinD.zhText: （英文：ARTAX）使用守护装有的冰冷光束将目标在行动路线上冻结。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SheduWeaponDesc.text: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SheduWeaponDesc.zhText: （英文：SHEDU）这种从 Sentient 身上扯下来的手炮能快速射出热脉冲，并在电击中爆炸。它有一个不需要弹药的快充电容器，在完全放电时会发出回弹脉冲并解除 Sentient 的伤害抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SibearIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Blast Radius with Heavy Slams, slowing enemies and increasing Critical Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SibearIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有在重型震地攻击时制造一片 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻爆炸范围，还有减缓敌人速度和增加暴击伤害的能力。
西伯利亚冰锤灵化之源

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SicarusIncarnonU.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to ricochet its bullets.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SicarusIncarnonU.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下的子弹跳弹能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SkanaIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to stun nearby enemies when it enters Incarnon Form and after Finisher attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SkanaIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在进行灵化形态时和进行处决攻击后具有晕眩附近敌人的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SomaIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain increased Status Chance and Multishot while slowing fire rate in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SomaIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有降低射速、增加触发几率和多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SteflosRecipeHel.text: Acquire the Steflos blueprint and components from Tyana Pass on Mars or from Otak in Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SteflosRecipeHel.zhText: 从火星的 Tyana Pass 节点或者殁世幽都的奥塔那里获得「石晶之花」蓝图及其部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/StrunIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire staggering explosive projectiles in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/StrunIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射令敌人失衡的爆炸投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/StugIncarnonUnlo.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to unleash a chaotic maelstrom of bouncing corrosive blobs in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/StugIncarnonUnlo.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下释放出混乱的、弹跳的腐蚀性泡状物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SundialBoardSwor.text: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SundialBoardSwor.zhText: （英文：SIGMA & OCTANTIS）西格玛剑的致命切砍唯有南极座空中掷出的力量能与之匹敌。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SundialRifleDesc.text: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SundialRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：ZENITH）部署雷达盘揭示隐藏的敌人，紧接着用足以穿透障碍的精确射击打击敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SybarisIncarnonU.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire 4-round bursts and gain <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Status.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SybarisIncarnonU.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下可发射 4 连发并造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸异常状态的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SybarisPistolDes.text: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/SybarisPistolDes.zhText: （英文：ZYLOK）用这把轻盈的重击手猛击敌人。具有复动式扳机，可以快速、猛烈地发射。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TeshinDualSwords.text: Teshin’s twin blades. Power Strike sends forth two arcs of energy that inflict <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TeshinDualSwords.zhText: （英文：SUN & MOON）Teshin 的双侍刃。使用强力攻击可发出两道造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的爆炸性能量弧。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TeshinGlaiveDesc.text: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TeshinGlaiveDesc.zhText: （英文：ORVIUS）使用 Teshin 灵活多变的飞盘将敌人变成你的提线木偶。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechArchGun.text: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy flamethrower with surprising range. Secondary fire launches three projectiles in a fan pattern that explode, leaving a damaging area of effect for a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechArchGun.zhText: （英文：CORTEGE）英择谛为其殁世机甲所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把重型火焰喷射器拥有惊人的射程。次要射击可扇形投射三枚爆炸弹丸，并在短时间内留下一片破坏性区域。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechGrenade.text: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechGrenade.zhText: （英文：MORGHA）通过双管射出的充能弹头来轰击敌人。这会吸取他们的生命精华，然后将其用于生成次要射击的大规模空爆迫击炮。这件古老的英择谛武器是为殁世机甲打造的，但也可以作为一把曲翼枪械来使用。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechLongGun.text: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Punishing automatic primary fire and a secondary mode that charges up to unleash a destructive beam of energy with a large explosion at point of impact.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechLongGun.zhText: （英文：MAUSOLON）英择谛为其殁世机甲所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。拥有惩戒性的全自动主要射击。次要模式可在充能后释放一道破坏性能量束，并在作用点造成大范围爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechPistolD.text: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechPistolD.zhText: （英文：SEPULCRUM）一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把大且沉的双管手枪可发出双股投射弹药，并在撞击时产生强力爆炸。次要射击会将手枪置于锁定状态，可追踪多个目标，并释放制导弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechRifleDe.text: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechRifleDe.zhText: （英文：TRUMNA）一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把具有毁灭级火力的重型超大号自动步枪可迅速造成火焰伤害。次要射击可呈弧线抛射出一枚跳射弹丸，每次撞击到物体表面和敌人都会造成爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThreeLeafRapierD.text: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThreeLeafRapierD.zhText: （英文：ENDURA）这把 Tenno 细剑的精巧外形让它的凶猛而富有弹性的力量藏而不露。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnAlchemistShotg.text: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire's precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnAlchemistShotg.zhText: （英文：CEDO）发射能在表面弹跳并爆发出元素伤害的战刃，然后通过主要射击的精准鹿弹来击穿敌人。伤害会随着目标所受到的每个异常状态而增加。当 Lavos 持有他标志性的塞多时，他会将一小部分拾取到的任意弹药转化为主要武器弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBardPistolDesc.text: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBardPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：PANDERO）Octavia 的手枪以单发或迅速齐发的方式将子弹打入敌人体内。在被 Octavia 使用时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀会提升装填速度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBardRifleDesc.text: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBardRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：TENORA）释放出强大冲击力的机枪炮火，或者用单发充能射击进行重和弦攻击。当 Octavia 使用她的标志性步枪时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀有几率立即装填弹匣。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBayonetWeaponD.text: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBayonetWeaponD.zhText: （英文：VINQUIBUS）通过 Uriel 的标志性步枪和刺刀组合，将地狱之火带入战场。这把独特的武器既可作为主要武器也可作为近战武器，完美融合了精准的射击和毫不留情的近战攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBeltFedRifleWe.text: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBeltFedRifleWe.zhText: （英文：RECONIFEX）Cyte-09 的标志性步枪是强力枪手的理想搭档。精确的装填可提高装填速度，并为下一个弹匣注入火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBeltFedRifleWe.text: Acquire the Reconifex blueprint from Bounties in Höllvania (1999). Component blueprints can drop from Legacyte Harvest and Hell-Scrub missions in Höllvania. All of Reconifex's blueprints can also be purchased from Amir Beckett in Höllvania Central Mall. Access this content after completing The Hex quest.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBeltFedRifleWe.zhText: 从霍瓦尼亚（1999）的赏金任务中获取侦察者蓝图。组件蓝图可能会在霍瓦尼亚的传承种收割和地狱净化任务中掉落。所有侦察者的蓝图也可以从霍瓦尼亚中央商场的阿米尔·贝克特处购买。完成 《六人组》系列任务后即可解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBrokenFrameWar.text: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBrokenFrameWar.zhText: （英文：QUASSUS）用这把重型武扇拂开敌人。威震武扇会散射出轻巧的匕首，在 Xaku 的挥舞下将更为致命精准。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBrokenWarfanRe.text: Blueprint for Quassus can be acquired from Cambion Drift Bounties in Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBrokenWarfanRe.zhText: 威震武扇蓝图，可以通过殁世幽都中，魔胎之境赏金任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBubbleGunDesc.text: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBubbleGunDesc.zhText: （英文：KOMPRESSA）发射一连串的剧毒高压水弹，包围目标并剧烈爆炸。Yareli 的标志性手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChiselKanaboDe.text: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChiselKanaboDe.zhText: （英文：MASSETER）用这把不寻常的，曲轴风格巨剑撕破并嚼碎敌人的骨肉。在 Grendel 的控制下，他在进行重击时不会受到失衡和击倒的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirBowRecipe.text: Acquire the Evensong blueprint from Brutus (Uranus), or from Ordis in the Drifter Camp (Earth). Players must complete the Jade Shadows quest to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirBowRecipe.zhText: 从布鲁图斯（天王星）或漂泊者营地（地球）的 Ordis 处获取晚祷蓝图。玩家必须完成《Jade 之影》系列任务才能解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirKunaiReci.text: Acquire the Cantare blueprint from Brutus (Uranus), or from Ordis in the Drifter Camp (Earth). Players must complete the Jade Shadows quest to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirKunaiReci.zhText: 从布鲁图斯（天王星）或漂泊者营地（地球）的 Ordis 处获取歌颂蓝图。玩家必须完成《Jade 之影》系列任务才能解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirScytheRec.text: Acquire the Harmony blueprint from Brutus (Uranus), or from Ordis in the Drifter Camp (Earth). Players must complete the Jade Shadows quest to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnChoirScytheRec.zhText: 从布鲁图斯（天王星）或漂泊者营地（地球）的 Ordis 处获取和谐蓝图。玩家必须完成《Jade 之影》系列任务才能解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnConcreteArchgu.text: Mandonel fires <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnConcreteArchgu.zhText: （英文：MANDONEL）辐光弩炮发射 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害投射物。未完全充能的射击会散射，而完全充能的射击则会释放出光束并生成辐射力场。穿过力场的投射物会被增强。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnConcreteArchgu.text: Mandonel's beams charge Qorvex's Chyrinka Pillars. Fully charged shots dissolve into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field gain 2x Damage, 2x Status Chance, +10% Critical Chance, +50% Critical Damage, +2 Bounce, +1m Punch Through, and increased Projectile Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnConcreteArchgu.zhText: 辐光弩炮的光束可为 Qorvex 的辐射柱体充能。完全蓄力的射击会形成一个辐射场。穿过辐射场的投射物将获得 2x 伤害、2x 触发几率、+10% 暴击几率、+50% 暴击伤害、+2 次弹跳、+1 米穿透，以及提高的投射物速度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnDagathBladeWhi.text: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnDagathBladeWhi.zhText: （英文：DORRCLAVE）在 10 次击杀或助攻后，怒斩进入光谱状态，使得武器伤害穿透系数加倍，并且接下来的 10 次攻击必定造成异常状态。如果是 Dagath 使用，每个激活的状态效果都会轻微治疗她。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnDuviriShotgunD.text: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnDuviriShotgunD.zhText: （英文：RAUTA）Kullervo 的标志性武器具有近战协同的优势。每次命中都会增加持枪者的近战连击数。当 Kullervo 使用锐铁时，它也会增加他的近战连击持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnExaltedGuitarD.text: Lizzie was born from Flare’s own Techrot-infested blood. More than a mere instrument, she thrums with fire-spitting fury.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnExaltedGuitarD.zhText: （英文：LIZZIE）丽兹诞生于弗莱尔被科腐者感染的血液中。她演奏出的不仅有美妙的音符，还有狂热的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnExaltedSniperD.text: Cyte-09's exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a grenade that completely freezes enemies with a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect, leaving a freezing zone that continues to apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status for a duration.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnExaltedSniperD.zhText: （英文：NEUTRALIZER）Cyte-09 的显赫狙击步枪。子弹从敌人的弱点弹射而出，寻找附近的其他敌人弱点。次要射击投掷的榴弹会以 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态完全冻结敌人，并在持续时间内留下一个持续施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态的冻结区域。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGlassShotgunDe.text: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGlassShotgunDe.zhText: （英文：ASTILLA）用玻璃弹头轰炸敌人，碰撞时将炸裂。当 Gara 手持这把的标志性武器时，其弹药上限会得到提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGuandaoPistolD.text: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGuandaoPistolD.zhText: （英文：ZAKTI）可以发射如剃刀般锋利的飞镖固定在目标上，接着喷发出一股有毒气体。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGuandaoPolearm.text: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnGuandaoPolearm.zhText: （英文：GUANDAO）用这把如塔般耸立的长柄武器收割敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHalberdPolearm.text: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHalberdPolearm.zhText: （英文：CASSOWAR）轻盈且灵巧。即使是防护严密的成群敌人，也会被这件长柄武器上的双刃所肢解。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHeavyShotgunDe.text: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHeavyShotgunDe.zhText: （英文：CORINTH）用这把霰弹枪打出沉重的一击，或者射出一发在空中爆炸的子弹来击倒附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHopliteSpearGu.text: Styanax's speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHopliteSpearGu.zhText: （英文：AFENTIS）Styanax 的标枪与他的力量相匹配。投掷圣英来压制敌人，其附近的敌人也会被击晕。将圣英投掷到地上，可创造一个为友军带来增益的炮兵威能力场，可增加装填速度，射速，弹药最大值，并降低后坐力。当获得炮兵威能的友军击杀敌人后，炮兵威能效果则会在他们离开圣英力场后继续维持一小段时间。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHopliteSpearGu.text: Acquire the Afentis blueprint from Chipper in the Drifter's Camp.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnHopliteSpearGu.zhText: 从漂泊者营地的切片哥那里获取圣英的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnInkRifleWeapon.text: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnInkRifleWeapon.zhText: （英文：ENKAUS）使用 Follie 的标志性步枪将敌人的噩梦化为现实。当被墨汁侵染的敌人生命值较低时，绘墨会瞬间将其击杀并溶解。射击被墨汁侵染的敌人可将墨水回流至绘墨，实现持续不断的创造性破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnJetTurbinePist.text: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnJetTurbinePist.zhText: （英文：ATHODAI）这款强力手枪由喷射推进器技术逆向设计而成。弱点击杀会触发超载状态，该状态将禁用次要射击，并在短时间内最大化你的射速和弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnMoonWarfanDesc.text: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnMoonWarfanDesc.zhText: （英文：VERICRES）展开这把武扇，就如一弯快速升起的上弦月。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnNoctuaDesc.text: Wield the power of Dante's chronicles. Customize Noctua with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Primary attack releases pages that tear into lethal pieces on hits. Its alternate attack releases a wave with infinite Punch Through.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnNoctuaDesc.zhText: （英文：NOCTUA）掌握 Dante 编年史的力量。为夜枭安装典籍 Mod 以增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。主要攻击释放的书页在命中后会碎裂成致命的碎片。次要攻击会释放具有无限穿透的攻击波。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOdaliskSmgPist.text: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOdaliskSmgPist.zhText: （英文：VELOX）在高射速、高弹药效率以及高装填速度的加持下，这把非比寻常的次要武器能昼夜无休地大杀四方。作为 Protea 的标志性武器，弹药效率会在 Protea 使用它时更进一步地提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOraxiaFlechett.text: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOraxiaFlechett.zhText: （英文：SCYOTID）使用 Oraxia 的标志性次要武器进行狩猎。你可以射出一连串充满毒素的倒钩，或者投放一个在撞击时散开的团状陷阱，抓住附近的敌人并将其拖到一起。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOrionScytheDes.text: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOrionScytheDes.zhText: （英文：WRATH）复仇之道，重在时机，此为深谙此语之人的怒火。Orion 的标志性重型镰刀。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnPriestPistolDe.text: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnPriestPistolDe.zhText: （英文：KNELL）鸣响死神的丧钟。爆头射击短暂地将这把带瞄准镜的手枪变成快速击发，不消耗弹药的暴击伤害恶魔。在被 Harrow 使用时，丧钟会拥有双发弹匣。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnPriestSpearGun.text: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnPriestSpearGun.zhText: （英文：SCOURGE）用腐蚀性的等离子体轰炸目标，或是投出手杖用能量场增幅附近敌人的脑波，使其吸引子弹。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnQuadRifleDesc.text: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnQuadRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：PERIGALE）就像一阵风，这把多管狙击枪发射的子弹能被它的目标感觉到，却从未被看到。快速连续爆头可提高月面狂风的弹药效率。当 Voruna 手持月面狂风时，它的弹药库会因此增加。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnQuadRifleRecip.text: Acquire the Perigale blueprint and components from Archimedean Yonta at the Chrysalith or from Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnQuadRifleRecip.zhText: 从羽化之穹的哲士扬塔处或是月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus 节点那里获得「月面狂风」蓝图及其部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRailJackGreatK.text: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRailJackGreatK.zhText: （英文：PENNANT）远古之战航道星舰舰员的钢铁旗帜。这个尖幡在击退登舰敌人时十分有用。每一个重击击杀都会提高尖幡的攻击速度。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRailJackRifleD.text: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRailJackRifleD.zhText: （英文：QUELLOR）压制者是远古之战时禁卫航道星舰舰员的标准配置武器，其最早的铸造可追溯到西格玛系列之前。这是一种速射突击步枪，拥有较大的弹匣容量，是全能型的主战武器。而且也有着巨大的、短距离的冰冻冲击。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRevolverRifleD.text: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnRevolverRifleD.zhText: （英文：VELDT）结合精确校准、快速击发式扳机以及稳定持枪三项特点，打倒各种顽强的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnSMGWeaponDesc.text: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnSMGWeaponDesc.zhText: （英文：BAZA）凭借着安静、灵敏及精准的特性，这把 Tenno 冲锋枪能轻易地猎杀敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnShieldFameArch.text: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnShieldFameArch.zhText: （英文：LARKSPUR）从死亡之中生长的翠雀。一把独特且具有威胁性的曲翼枪械，初始攻击会锁定目标并将靠近第一个目标的其他敌人链在一起。它还配有爆炸性投弹模式。在 Hildryn 的握持之下，翠雀会携带更多的预备弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnSiriusScytheDe.text: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnSiriusScytheDe.zhText: （英文：PRIDE）知晓自身价值的人，自有傲骨。Sirius 的标志性重型镰刀。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnTwoHandedKatan.text: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnTwoHandedKatan.zhText: （英文：TATSU）尊贵而令人畏惧，这把优雅的双手侍刃是任何军械库里的骄傲。击杀可以蓄能，而在施展滑行攻击时，积蓄的能量会转化为投射物，追踪并击晕那些浑然不觉的敌人。在被 Revenant 使用时，龙辰的蓄能次数上限会得到提升。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnWispRifleDesc.text: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnWispRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：FULMIN）用寂静或雷鸣般的闪电来攻击。可在隐秘的短距离放电和自动闪电枪两种模式中切换。在被 Wisp 使用时，武器的模式切换速度会更快。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnWraitheSidearm.text: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnWraitheSidearm.zhText: （英文：EPITAPH）Sevagoth 的腕式次要武器可以发射令人胆寒的慢速移动石板，石板可以减缓敌人的速度，以更轻松地瞄准敌人。蓄力射击可发射一个惩戒性的高速、高暴击几率的石板，石板可击穿障碍物。在 Sevagoth 手中可造成额外的爆头伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnoLotusPodShotg.text: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnoLotusPodShotg.zhText: （英文：STEFLOS）石晶之花发射的能量弹会在飞向敌人时变大。当投射物击中敌人时，其飞行持续时间会增加。当 Citrine 使用石晶之花时，它的投射物速度会增加。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnoOctaMiniGunDe.text: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnoOctaMiniGunDe.zhText: （英文：HAALVU）通过这件死亡利器释放无情的 Sentient 炮火。次要射击可将武器拆分为多把独立的步枪，同时锁定最多 4 个目标，进一步扩展其毁灭威力，但每发射击将消耗更多弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ToridIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire a long-range <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin beam in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ToridIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射远距离 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素光束的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/UmbraKatanaDesc.text: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/UmbraKatanaDesc.zhText: （英文：SKIAJATI）这把优雅的侍刃从 Umbra 肉体移植的钢材锻造而成，并与其战甲结合形成拥有沸腾意志的整体。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/UnairuHammerDesc.text: The mighty Hammer of the school of Unairu. Now lost to the Void, but if found, its Tauron Strike would be granted strength enough to topple armies.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/UnairuHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：COGRON）Unairu 学派的强大战锤。如今已遗失于虚空，但若能寻回，其 Tauron 打击将拥有足以摧毁军队的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VandalCrpBFGDesc.text: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VandalCrpBFGDesc.zhText: （英文：OPTICOR VANDAL）装有精密制作的透镜，这把定制化版本的奥堤克光子枪达到了以前认为不可能有的性能水平。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VastoIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to rapidly empty its entire magazine in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VastoIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高速全弹发射的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VazarinStaffDesc.text: The righteous Staff of the school of Vazarin. Before being lost to the Void, it was a weapon whose very presence could signal the end to a conflict, such is the destructive power of its Tauron Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VazarinStaffDesc.zhText: （英文：NIDRI）Vazarin 学派的正义之杖。在被虚空吞噬之前，它曾是一件武器，其存在本身就能预示着一场冲突的结束，这就是它的 Tauron 打击所具有的破坏力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VectisIncarnonUn.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire slowing projectiles that explode upon headshots in Incarnon Form. Transforms on Alt Fire while unscoped.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VectisIncarnonUn.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射减速投射物的能力，并在爆头击杀时爆炸。未瞄准时，通过次要射击可变形。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VoidHeavyScytheD.text: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/VoidHeavyScytheD.zhText: （英文：THALYS）大力士曾在扎里曼收获节中扮演仪式性的角色，原本用来收获 Tau 星系的最初成果。而如今，它的用途已被扭曲，转而在敌人的肉体中播种虚空碎片。每种下一块新碎片，现有的碎片便会对宿主造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WarfanWeaponDesc.text: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WarfanWeaponDesc.zhText: （英文：GUNSEN）用两把带有锐利剃刀的军扇来撕碎攻击者。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponAmpArcaneU.text: Fuses with an Amp to unlock an Arcane Slot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponAmpArcaneU.zhText: 融入一件增幅器来解锁一个赋能槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponArchGunArc.text: Fuses with an Archgun weapon to unlock one of its two available Arcane Slots.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponArchGunArc.zhText: 与曲翼枪械武器融合以解锁其两个可用的赋能槽位之一。
曲翼枪械赋能槽连接器

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponMeleeArcan.text: Fuses with a Melee weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponMeleeArcan.zhText: 融入一件近战武器来解锁赋能槽位。
近战武器赋能槽连接器

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponPrimaryArc.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Steel Path
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponPrimaryArc.zhText: 蓝图可以通过钢铁之路获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponPrimaryArc.text: Fuses with a Primary weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponPrimaryArc.zhText: 融入一件主要武器来解锁赋能槽位。
主要武器赋能槽连接器

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponSecondaryA.text: Blueprint can be acquired from Steel Path
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponSecondaryA.zhText: 蓝图可以通过钢铁之路获得。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponsecondaryA.text: Fuses with a Secondary weapon to unlock the Arcane Slot.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WeaponsecondaryA.zhText: 融入一件次要武器来解锁赋能槽位。
次要武器赋能槽连接器

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfFrameAxeReci.text: Acquire the Sarofang blueprint and components from Archimedean Yonta at the Chrysalith or from Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfFrameAxeReci.zhText: 从羽化之穹的哲士扬塔处或是月球的 Yuvarium 和 Circulus 节点那里获得「沙罗之牙」蓝图及其部件。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfFrameAxeWeap.text: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfFrameAxeWeap.zhText: （英文：SAROFANG）给予维持正义所带来的剧痛。当沙罗之牙的连击倍率达到 8 倍时，重型震地攻击会产生一个漩涡，将被举起的敌人卷入。在 Voruna 的手中，沙罗之牙只需要 5 倍的连击倍率就能召唤漩涡。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfHammerDesc.text: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/WolfHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：WOLF SLEDGE）能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的唯一可怕狂人的标志性武器。一旦被解放，这把强大的战锤总是能找到回家的路。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/YareliPistolReci.text: Weapon and component blueprints for the Kompressa can be obtained from Ventkids offerings in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/YareliPistolReci.zhText: 卡帕压力枪的武器和部件蓝图可以从福尔图娜的通风小子声望奖励处获取。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanDaggerDes.text: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanDaggerDes.zhText: （英文：INNODEM）在早期的奥罗金帝国，精英们会佩戴清刚作为提醒他们保护手无寸铁者的象征。这种传统早已过时了，但念旧的精英们有时会以礼物的形式认可这种理念。而虚空则放大了这一理念，虚空能量增强了这把武器的滑翔制空攻击之力；当佩戴者在灵化形态下进行处决攻击时，会感受到这把武器增强的韧性。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanHeavyPist.text: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanHeavyPist.zhText: （英文：LAETUM）在阅兵式和得胜行军期间，人们会用奏凯发射色彩缤纷的空爆弹化作鲜艳的雨点落在欢庆的人群身上。奥罗金人将奏凯送上了「扎里曼号」，以便他们能够好好庆祝前往 Tau 星系的成功首航。虽然这样的庆祝活动从未发生，但虚空给奏凯赋予了更强的爆炸之力。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanPumpShotg.text: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanPumpShotg.zhText: （英文：FELARX）逐枭唤起了古代贵族狩猎活动的历史。为了仪式，奥罗金精英培育出与其狩猎的猛禽相像之生物来重现文化传说。他们赐予「扎里曼号」船员逐枭和一对猛禽，作为接受船员们进入精英社会的标志。而这对猛禽在虚空的作用下变成了一对手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanSemiAutoR.text: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanSemiAutoR.zhText: （英文：PHENMOR）扎里曼殖民者们最初是希望在葬礼上使用凤殁的。在奥罗金的社会体系中，越高阶级的逝者葬礼上，人们为了纪念逝者射出的子弹数量就越多。这把武器的枪托由只在焦土上释放幼苗的樟子松雕刻而成。在与虚空的接触中，凤殁充满了阴暗的侵略性。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanTonfasDes.text: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZarimanTonfasDes.zhText: （英文：PRAEDOS）奥罗金精英很佩服那些被征服地区的农夫，他们在武器禁令的压制下学会了通过改良的农具来进行战斗。当「扎里曼号」启航时，船上的人们获得了双雄以表彰他们坚韧不拔的精神。虚空通过增强双雄的力量来奖励使用该武器的人。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZenurikGrimoireD.text: The overpowering Grimoire of the school of Zenurik was perhaps ever destined for the Void. Though powerful, the ruinous secrets it whispers through its Tauron Strike can drive even the clearheaded to madness.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZenurikGrimoireD.zhText: （英文：LORAK）Zenurik 学派那本威力无比的魔典或许注定要坠入虚空。尽管它力量强大，但它通过 Tauron 打击所低语出的毁灭性秘密，足以将头脑清醒之人逼入疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZylokIncarnonUnl.text: Awaken this weapon's ability to charge a large single shot that deals Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Language/Weapons/ZylokIncarnonUnl.zhText: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有蓄力进行一次造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的大型单发射击的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_AshDesc.text: Ash is great for players looking for a stealthier approach to combat. Lethal abilities are complemented by powers of distraction.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_AshDesc.zhText: Ash 非常适合寻求隐秘击杀的玩家，兼具进攻和操控。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_EmberDesc.text: Ember is a nightmare for light-armored targets. Ember can super-heat the air, which opens up surprising crowd-control possibilities.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_EmberDesc.zhText: Ember 是轻型装甲敌人的噩梦。Ember 可以加热空气，开辟了令人惊讶的群体控制可能性。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_ExcaliburDesc.text: The perfect training Warframe: the Excalibur suit allows players to explore the power of Warframes with a balanced set of capabilities.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_ExcaliburDesc.zhText: 完美的训练用 Warframe: Excalibur 套装让新手玩家学习如何使用能力均衡的 Warframe。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FoundersPackA.text: ALL FOUNDERS PACKAGES INCLUDE IMMEDIATE CLOSED BETA ACCESS
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FoundersPackA.zhText: 所有的创始人礼包均包含封闭 Beta 测试激活码

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FoundersPackD.text: Being a Founder has its privileges. Snag exclusive itmes that will never be available again, PLUS instant access to the Closed Beta!
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FoundersPackD.zhText: 成为创始人即可拥有特权。获取绝版道具，外加封闭 Beta 测试激活码！

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FrostDesc.text: By channeling moisture and vapor in the surrounding environment, Frost creates formidable defenses and lethal attacks from sub-zero conditions.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_FrostDesc.zhText: 藉由引导周围的水分与蒸汽，FROST能在绝对零度的环境下建立坚不可破的防御和致命的冰霜攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_HelpShapeFutu.text: HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF WARFRAME

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_LokiDesc.text: Desired by advanced players, Loki offers a variety of reconfiguring abilities. The abnormality of Loki's powers allows players to manipulate the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_LokiDesc.zhText: LOKI 提供了高级玩家所期望的多样化重组技能。Loki 所拥有的反常能力让玩家可以操控整个战局。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_MagDesc.text: With full command of surrounding magnetic energy, Mag is an expert at enemy manipulation. She is a perfect choice for players that want to deal heavy damage in unconventional ways.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_MagDesc.zhText: 彻底操控周身的磁场，Mag 是操纵敌人方面的专家。她是想要以非常规的方式造成大量伤害的玩家的完美选择。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_NoAccount.text: Don't have an account? Sign Up!
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_NoAccount.zhText: 还没有账户么？现在注册！

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_NyxDesc.text: Mind control and psychic attacks make Nyx a very dangerous foe. Her ability to reach into enemy consciousness and manipulate their behavior can turn the tide of any battle.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_NyxDesc.zhText: 心灵控制和精神攻击使 Nyx 成为非常危险的敌人。她进入敌人意识海和操纵他们行为的能力可以在战斗里力挽狂澜。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_RhinoDesc.text: Rhino is the heaviest of all the Warframes. His strength enables him to combine a mix of devastating offensive attacks with formidable defensive powers.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_RhinoDesc.zhText: Rhino 是所有战甲里最重的。他的力量使他能够在摧枯拉朽的攻击里附带强大的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_TrinityDesc.text: Trinity is great for players who prefer a supportive role. Warframes with healing technologies are rare making Trinity a great equalizer when the odds are stacked against the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_TrinityDesc.zhText: TRINITY 非常适合辅助向的玩家。拥有治疗能力的 Warframes 非常稀少，使得 Trinity 在队伍遭遇重大危机时能成为队伍的重要支柱。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_UpgradeDesc.text: Upgrade your Founders Package and only pay the difference from your original purchase.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_UpgradeDesc.zhText: 升级您的创始人礼包，只需付差价。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_VoltDesc.text: Volt can create and harness electrical elements. This is a high-damage Warframe perfect for players who want a potent alternative to gun-play.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_VoltDesc.zhText: VOLT 可以创造和掌控电元素。这是一种为那些非枪系玩家提供新玩法而专门设计的强力 Warframe。

/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_WarframesDesc.text: Warframe exo-armor uses unique combative technology to create the ultimate weaponry. The Warframes hold many mysterious powers and mastering one requires dedicated use.
/Lotus/Language/Webpage/WP_WarframesDesc.zhText: Warframe 外甲是使用独特的战斗艺术创建的终极武器。Warframes 拥有许多神奇的能力并且需要潜心使用才能掌握。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventDe.text: Hush! Can you feel it? It's almost upon us! The ancient festival of death and mischief, Naberus! You have a special invitation, and we'll make you very welcome.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventDe.zhText: 嘘！你感受到了吗？马上就要到了！死亡与恶作剧的古老节日，纳贝流士！这有一份特别的邀请给你，并且我们会让你宾至如归。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventDe.text: Visit Daughter in the Necralisk to view Event details.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventDe.zhText: 拜访殁世幽都的"女儿"来查看活动详情。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventFo.text: Protect our relay from an incoming Fomorian.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventFo.zhText: 保护我们的中继站免受来袭的巨人战舰侵扰。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventFo.text: Requires Fomorian Disruptor in Gear Wheel
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventFo.zhText: 需要在携带装备轮盘中装备巨人战舰干扰器

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventGh.text: The ground of the Plains is erupting with vile beings of Grineer origin - repugnant Ghouls that overrun their victims in a gruesome mass of limbs and toxin.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventGh.zhText: 平野地表正在爆发产生来自 Grineer 的邪恶生物－令人厌恶的尸鬼，它们以大量可怕的肢体和毒素蹂躏受害者。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventHa.text: Face your fears and defeat the dreaded Jack O'Naut!
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventHa.zhText: 直面恐惧，击败可怕的南瓜巨兽！

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventHe.text: Thermia fractures are cracking open the surface of Venus, a consequence of Nef Anyo's unrelenting greed. He's willing to do whatever it takes for a quick profit, including putting the whole Orb Vallis at risk. Seal fractures across Orb Vallis to stabilize the region.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventHe.zhText: 热美亚裂缝正在撕裂金星地表，这是奈富·安尤贪得无厌的后果。为了快速获取收益，他不惜一切代价，包括把整个奥布山谷置于危险之中。封闭遍布奥布山谷的裂缝，以稳定该地区。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventIn.text: Konzu has a problem. A massive Infested Boil has broken through Earth's atmosphere, crashing down outside Cetus. As the boil grows, it spawns rapid Infested putting all life on the plains in jeopardy.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventIn.zhText: 孔尊遇到了麻烦，一个巨大的感染疖瘤突破了地球的大气层，坠落在希图斯外。随着疖瘤的生长，它产生了狂暴的感染怪物，使得平野上的生命受到了严重威胁。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventIn.text: Visit Konzu to initiate the Plague Star Bounty
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventIn.zhText: 造访孔尊来开启《瘟疫之星》赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.text:
Collect Marks of Valiance by facing the darkest of memories in exchange for lucrative rewards. Obtain them from Perita Rebellion missions and special Void Alerts.

Visit Roathe in La Cathédrale to claim rewards and show the remnant of the Orokin true valor.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.zhText:
直面最黑暗的记忆，收集英勇徽章，换取丰厚奖励。可通过佩里塔叛乱任务和特殊虚空警报获得。

前往大教堂拜访罗瑟，领取奖励，向残存的奥罗金人展现真正的勇气。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.text: Visit Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar to view details.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.zhText: 拜访 Maroo 的市集中的瓦奇娅来浏览详细信息。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.text: Complete the The Old Peace quest to unlock this event.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventMP.zhText: 完成《旧日和平》系列任务即可解锁此活动。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventRa.text: Protect the relays from Nef Anyo's Razorback Armada.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventRa.zhText: 保护中继站免受奈富·安尤的利刃豺狼舰队侵扰。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventRa.text: Requires Razorback Cipher in Gear Wheel
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventRa.zhText: 需要在携带装备轮盘中装备利刃豺狼密码

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventVa.text:
It's Star Days, Stardust.
Stop by. I've gathered a few delightful curiosities just for you.
Let's celebrate! These are days for you and everyone we care about.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventVa.zhText:
星尘，你的星日到了。
来看看吧。我特意为你收集了几件珍贵物品。
让我们一起庆祝吧！这是属于你的日子，也是属于每个被我们所在意的人的日子。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventVa.text: Visit Ticker's shop to view available rewards
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventVa.zhText: 造访 Ticker 的商店来查看可获取的奖励

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventWa.text: Kela de Thaym challenges you to a very special Rathuum... a water fight!?! No killing, just soaking. Nakak is ready to trade gathered pearls for sweet rewards.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/EventWa.zhText: Kela de Thaym 向你发出挑战，邀请你参加一场十分特别的死亡角斗场……一场水战！？！这里没有杀戮，只是会被淋湿。娜卡已经准备好用丰富的奖励来换取你收集到的珍珠。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.text: Side with the |FACTION| and complete 3 missions to unlock the Battle Pay.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.zhText: 选择与 |FACTION| 统一阵营，并完成 3 场任务来解锁战区报酬。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.text: Choose a side and complete 3 missions to unlock the Battle Pay.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.zhText: 选择一个阵营，并完成 3 场任务来解锁战区报酬。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.text: Are you sure you want to side with the |NEW_FACTION|? One mission of progress will be lost towards the |OLD_FACTION| Battle Pay if you complete the mission.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/Invasio.zhText: 是否要与 |NEW_FACTION| 统一阵营？这样做将在你完成一场任务后，导致其进度被扣除来抵扣 |OLD_FACTION| 的战区报酬。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/KuvaSip.zhText: <KUVA>赤毒 + 有几率获取<REQUIEM_RELIC>安魂遗物

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.text: The likelihood that you will receive a <MYTHIC> Tauforged Shard increases every time you receive a Regular Shard as your Archon Hunt Reward. The reward chance for Amber, Azure, and Crimson Shards is tracked individually. Once you receive a <MYTHIC> Tauforged Shard, the reward chance for that color resets.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.zhText: 每当你收到一个普通源力石作为你执行官猎杀的奖励时，你收到 <MYTHIC>Tau 融造源力石的可能性就会增加。琥珀、蔚蓝和深红源力石的奖励几率是单独跟踪的。一旦你收到一个 <MYTHIC>Tau 融造源力石，该颜色的奖励几率就会重置。
<MYTHIC> 执刑官 Tau 融造源力石概率

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.zhText: 完成所有执刑官猎杀任务会奖励一个|CRYSTAL|，该源力石有 |PERCENT| 几率成为 <MYTHIC>Tau 融造源力石，以及以下其中一件物品：

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.text: You need to complete the prerequisite Archon Hunt mission at |PREREQ| in order to play this mission.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.zhText: 你必须先完成位于 |PREREQ| 的前置执刑官猎杀任务才能执行此任务。

/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.text: Complete the 'Veilbreaker' Quest and equip a Rank |SUIT_RANK| Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/WorldStateWindow/LiteSor.zhText: 完成《破障者》系列任务，并装备一个等级 |SUIT_RANK| 的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/RisingTideCo.text:
Crew,

This Railjack is spaceworthy. We are free to begin the process of continuous improvement. That process requires resources.

You will be notified when salvage opportunities present themselves.

Cephalon Cy
/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/RisingTideCo.zhText:
舰员们，

这艘航道星舰的适航性是值得信赖的。我们可以开始持续改造的过程了。这个过程将会需要用到资源。

当回收残骸的机会出现时，你将会收到通知。

中枢赛伊

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestD.text: Void Storms gather in Corpus lanes... could a mysterious vessel somehow be the cause?
/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestD.zhText: 虚空风暴正在 Corpus 航道上聚集……难道是某艘神秘诡舰所造成的？

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestE.text:
Transmission from the Tempestarii.

Sevagoth reconstruction is possible. A task not to be undertaken lightly.

Old warriors do not forget their debts.

Prediction: we have not seen the last of the Tempestarii.

-Cephalon Cy
/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestE.zhText:
来自「风暴使者号」的通讯。

重新打造 Sevagoth 是可行的。这是一项不能轻易放弃的任务。

老兵们不会忘记他们的债务。

预测：我们还没有了解到「风暴使者号」的全部秘密。

-中枢赛伊

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestH.text:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST> The Deadlock Protocol Quest
<MINI_ARROW> Railjack required
/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestH.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST> 《僵局协议》系列任务
<MINI_ARROW> 需要拥有航道星舰

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestI.text:
Crew,

Corpus Convoy moving toward Voidspace redzone. Shipping lanes long abandoned. Void storms. Anomalies. Temporal ghosting.

Remember Lucretia Platform. The final disastrous result of incursion into that place. We are not wanted there. Yet the Corpus return.

It would be stupid to investigate.

Saddle up. We are about to do something stupid.

-Cephalon Cy
/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestI.zhText:
舰员们，

Corpus 舰队正在驶向虚空危险区域。航道早已被废弃。虚空风暴。异常现象。时空幽灵。

别忘了卢克丽霞平台发生的事。侵入那个地方而最终导致的灾难性后果。我们在那不受欢迎。然而，Corpus 还是回来了。

如果去进行调查那就太蠢了。

准备出发吧。我们马上就要去做一件蠢事了。

-中枢赛伊
伏击的好机会，发动航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/WraithQuest/WraithQuestM.zhText: 歼灭 Corpus 回收舰员
躲避「风暴使者号」的攻击
启动「风暴使者号」的反制系统

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/CheckInbox.zhText: 在收件箱中查看小洛的信息

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/CheckInboxGr.zhText: 在收件箱中查看"祖母"的信息

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/ComicDesc.text: An exceedingly rare Graphica chronicling the first known adventure of the Warframe Yareli.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/ComicDesc.zhText: 一份极为罕见的漫画图像，记录了战甲 Yareli 史上首次已知的冒险。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/CompleteChal.text: Enter Orb Vallis to complete K-Drive challenges
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/CompleteChal.zhText: 进入奥布山谷完成 K 式悬浮板挑战

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/ExtraRewards.text:
Oh, curse this addled memory of mine. It seems that you and my dear Yareli are already known to one another.

So, in honor of mutual friendship and adventures to come, a small additional reward for you.

Mind how you go!

Grandmother
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/ExtraRewards.zhText:
哦，我这该死的混乱记忆。看来你和我亲爱的 Yareli 已经互相认识了。

所以，为了纪念彼此的友谊和即将到来的冒险，这是一点给你的额外奖励。

路上小心！

"祖母"

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/GrandmotherI.text:
Oh, hello dear. What a pity that all Nef Anyo's money could not buy him a morsel of taste nor a crumb of conscience. A man with the morals of a creeping scab, and just between the two of us, not a patch on the man his father was. One hates to do business of any kind with his sort, but you must understand, dear, that an old friend's life was at stake.
Imagine failing to recognise the beauty of Waverider 1! Thinking of it as low, commoner art, seeing it only as a source of cash! What do you suppose he might have said if he'd known that there was something quite unexpected concealed in those pages? Well. More someone than something, if I'm being honest with you.

This is for you, Tenno. The very, very old friend of mine I mentioned before, finally located. Bring her to life, if you'd be so kind? I think my young ‘tenants' on Fortuna would like to meet her.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/GrandmotherI.zhText:
哦，你好，亲爱的。多么遗憾的是，奈富·安尤的全副身家都不能为他买来一丁点品味，也买不来一丁点良心。一个毫无道德底线的人，而且就在我们俩之间，丝毫没有他父亲的影子。人们讨厌与他这类人进行任何形式的交易，但你必须明白，亲爱的，有一位老朋友已经危在旦夕。

想象一下未能体会到《驭浪者 #1》的美妙之处！认为它是底层平民的艺术品，只是把它看成一件可以换到钱的物品！如果他知道那几页中潜藏着某件出人意料的东西，你猜他会说什么？好吧。老实说，与其说那是某件东西，倒不如说是某个人。

Tenno，这是给你的。那个我先前提到的非常非常老的朋友，终于找到了。如果你是个好人的话，那就让她重获新生吧？我想我在福尔图娜的年轻“房客”会想见见她的。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/MenuDesc.zhText: 显示当前页面的解锁要求

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line10.text: SOME DAYS I WOULD SLEEP STANDING UP. MY HANDS STILL ASSEMBLING GRAV-LIFTERS.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line10.zhText: 有些时候，我站着就能睡着。而我的手还在组装反重力提升器。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line2.text: VULGRAN ALWAYS RAN THE FLUX CRUCIBLES AT FULL HEAT.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line2.zhText: 武戈兰总是让通量坩埚在全热状态下运作。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line5.text: Harder, piss-rats! Your mothers are weeping in their graves to see such idleness!
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line5.zhText: 用点力，小耗子！你们的母亲看到你们如此懒惰，只能在坟墓里哭泣！

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line7.text: How about I turn off the tethers, and one of you whelps can try and run?
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page1Line7.zhText: 要不我把系绳解掉，然后你们谁试着逃跑看看？

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line2.text: I don't know out of what Void-sodden crevice you crawled...
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line2.zhText: 我不知道你是从虚空中的哪个缝隙里爬出来的……

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line3.text: … but I’ll send you back there in nice neat slices.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line3.zhText: ……但我会把你剁成碎片，再整齐地送回去。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line4.text: Come on, drippy. There must be more fight in you than th-
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line4.zhText: 来啊，小水滴。你的战斗力应该还要再高一点，相较于——

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line5.text: Oh, good. A runner. I’m going to enjoy this.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line5.zhText: 哦，不错。一个奔逃者。我会享受这个过程。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line6.text: NONE OF US BOTHERED TO HOPE.

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line7.text:
WE KNEW IT WAS AS GOOD AS OVER.
VULGRAN ALWAYS CAUGHT THE RUNNERS.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page2Line7.zhText:
我们知道这基本已经宣告结束了。
武戈兰总是能逮住逃跑的人。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line1.zhText: 但 YARELI 决不是奔逃者。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line3.text: SHE HAD HIM GOOD AND MAD.

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line5.text: HE NEVER LET UP. NOT ONCE. HE CHASED HER DOWN.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line5.zhText: 他从未停歇。一次也没有。他对她追逐到底。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line6.text: BY THE END, THEY WERE BOTH FLAGGING, THEIR ENERGY ALMOST SPENT.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line6.zhText: 最后，他们俩都精疲力尽了。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line8.text: BUT EVEN A WARFRAME CAN’T KEEP GOING FOREVER.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page3Line8.zhText: 不过即便是战甲，也无法永远坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line1.text: Let’s… *gasp* see what color your blood is…
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line1.zhText: 咱们来……*气喘吁吁*看看你的血是什么颜色的……

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line2.text: SHE BOUGHT US TIME. ENOUGH FOR US TO GET FAR AWAY.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line2.zhText: 她为我们争取到了时间。足够让我们躲得远远的了。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line3.zhText: 但她自己的时间却不够了。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line4.text:
Huh. Fists… it is, then.
That’ll… take longer.
Good.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line4.zhText:
嗯。那就……用拳头吧。
那会……花上更长时间。
很好。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line5.text: Here’s the thing about rats, boss-man.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line5.zhText: 老大，你要知道耗子是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line6.text: Hunt them one at a time, and they’re easy to kill.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line6.zhText: 逐个猎杀他们，那么他们不堪一击。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line7.text: But if you let them come at you in a pack…
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line7.zhText: 但如果你让他们成群结队地找上你……

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page4Line9.zhText: 那就来吧，你们这些……咕噜

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line1.zhText: 等等……*窒息声**咕噜*反重力提升器？

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line11.text: AND I WONDER IF SOMETIMES, SHE DREAMS OF ME?
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line11.zhText: 我也想知道，她是否也会偶尔梦到我？

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line2.text: What… do you think you’re… doing?
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line2.zhText: 你知道……你们在……做什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line5.text: AN OBJECT THAT WEIGHS NOTHING CAN BE SHOT A VERY, VERY LONG DISTANCE.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line5.zhText: 他变成了一个没有任何重量的物体，并且能被射出非常，非常远的距离。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line6.text: I SUPPOSE HE MUST HAVE COME DOWN, SOMEWHERE. HOPE IT WAS THE SEA.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line6.zhText: 我想，他一定是坠落在了某个地方。希望是在海上。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line7.text: OTHERWISE, HE’D PROBABLY HAVE MADE QUITE A CRATER.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line7.zhText: 不然，他肯定会砸出一个相当大的陨石坑。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line8.text: YARELI MUST BE OUT THERE SOMEWHERE, TOO.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line8.zhText: YARELI 肯定也在某个地方。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line9.text: WHEREVER SHE IS, I HOPE SHE’S RIDING FAST AND FREE.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/Page5Line9.zhText: 无论她在哪里，我都希望她能自在地驰骋于天地之间。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/QuestDesc.text: When tragedy strikes, the Ventkids search for hope in a long-lost story.
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/QuestDesc.zhText: 当悲剧突然降临时，通风小子在一个失传已久的故事中寻找希望。

/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/RokyInboxBod.text:
glinty,

meet me in the vents. got a favor to ask and something primo to show you.

roky
/Lotus/Language/YareliQuest/RokyInboxBod.zhText:
闪闪，

在通风口和我碰头。有事相求，还有些好玩意要给你见识下。

小洛

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanRegionDes.text: The Zariman Ten Zero was a colony ship until a horrific Void accident changed the course of history.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanRegionDes.zhText: 「扎里曼 10-0 号」曾是一艘殖民飞船，直到一场可怕的虚空事故改变了历史。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipDesc.text: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipDesc.zhText: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinA.text: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Dorsat skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with rocky or barren terrain.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinA.zhText: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系岩石或荒地的地形时，星察就会被装备上脊岩外观。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinB.text: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Mesaen skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study hot and volcanic regions of Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinB.zhText: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系的炎热火山区域时，星察就会被装备上狱火外观。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinC.text: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Fremutar skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with water and other resources that support life.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinC.zhText: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系中可维持生命的水资源或其他资源时，星察就会被装备上水道外观。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinC.text: The light and dark of the cosmos are etched into this skin for the Parallax Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinC.zhText: 宇宙间的光与暗蚀刻在了这款星察登陆艇外观上。

/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinD.text: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Albodix skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study cold or dark regions of Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Zariman/ZarimanShipSkinD.zhText: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系的低温区和黑暗区时，星察就会被装备上反照外观。
