/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A golden statue celebrating the bold trailblazing men of the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 一座金色雕像，庆祝具有大胆开拓精神的扎里曼男性。
扎里曼雕像（殖民者男性）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A golden statue celebrating the competitive spirit of the Zariman colonists.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 一座金色雕像，庆祝扎里曼殖民者的竞争精神。
扎里曼雕像（运动员）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: This golden statue depicts a Zariman musician. Playing a dancing rhythm for the enigmatic Gyra, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 这座金色雕像描绘了一个扎里曼音乐家。也许正在为神秘的盖拉演奏舞蹈节奏？
扎里曼雕像（鼓手）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A golden statue depicting a Zariman colonist meditating on the glorious path ahead.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 一座金色的雕像，描绘了一名正对未来光辉道路进行冥想的扎里曼殖民者。
扎里曼雕像（冥想）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A golden statue depicting a studious youth.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 一座描绘好学青年的金色雕像。
扎里曼雕像（学生）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A golden statue of Executor Tuvul, exalted member of the Orokin Seven. Patron of the Zariman Ten Zero expedition.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 奥罗金七人众尊贵成员、「扎里曼 10-0 号」远征计划资助者──执行者涂沃的金色雕像。
扎里曼雕像（执行者涂沃）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: A gold platform for displaying statues.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: 一个用于展示雕像的黄金平台。
扎里曼雕像柱基

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.text: [PH] A statue of a Zariman ship.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxSta.zhText: [PH] A statue of a Zariman ship.
[PH] Zariman Statue Ship

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxTro.zhText: 一个金色的月动球奖杯。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxTro.text: A gold trophy of a Lunaro goal.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxTro.zhText: 一个月动球球门的黄金奖杯。
扎里曼奖杯（月动球球门）

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxTro.text: A gold trophy with a Lunaro ball.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanApartment/ZARxTro.zhText: 一个带有月动球的黄金奖杯。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.text: The Operator/Drifter will face tough challenges aboard the Zariman, make sure they are as ready as possible.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.zhText: 指挥官/漂泊者将在「扎里曼」号上面临严峻挑战，确保他们做好万全准备。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.text: You have enough Focus to unlock additional Focus Nodes.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.zhText: 你有足够的专精来解锁额外的专精节点。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.text: You have a Mote Amp equipped. Consider equipping a stronger Amp, such as the Sirocco.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/BeginWarnin.zhText: 你配备了微尘增幅器。考虑装备更强大的增幅器，例如赤风。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQCompleteD.text: The legacy of the Zariman is secure. Watched over by the Holdfasts, she is now both dam and bridge... and a fortress against what is yet to come.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQCompleteD.zhText: 「扎里曼号」的延续得以保留。在坚守者的照料下，她既是大坝也是桥梁……更是一座抵御临近危机的堡垒。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQEndInboxB.text:
We got a lot here to protect, kid. Let’s roll up our sleeves and get to work.

Hombask
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQEndInboxB.zhText:
孩子，我们有很多要守护的人和物。卷起袖子干活吧。

霍姆巴斯

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQEndInboxT.text: Some advice, and something to wear

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQIntroDior.text: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQIntroDior.zhText: 一道声音从感知以外的幽深之处响起，其回响不容忽视。不再完全被变幻万千的虚空所掩盖，「扎里曼号」现在停泊于两界之间。荧惑的歌声在星系中回荡，是时候与过去开始一场早该进行的斗争了……

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidArena.text: Tap or hold <JUMP> while airborne to Void Sling through the Orbs.
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidArena.zhText: 在空中时按下或按住 <JUMP> 来使用「虚空弹射」穿过球体。

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidFlood.text: Keep the Flood Meter low to avoid negative Void complications
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidFlood.zhText: 降低洪流计量仪表以避免虚空减益状态

/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidFlood.text: Closing ruptures lowers the Flood Meter
/Lotus/Language/ZarimanQuest/ZQVoidFlood.zhText: 封住裂口以降低洪流计量仪表

/Test/TestLoc.text:
You made me whole again!

Or… or what about that time you returned -covered in blood - from that awful Grineer ship? I wasn't even mad at the gory mess you left behind.

How could I be, when you are so perfect, Operator? You always will be.

Goodbye, my friend, my Operator…
